```md
# Portal

[![Android](https://img.shields.io/badge/Android-10%20--%2017-blue.svg?style=flat)](https://github.com/Lecheeel/Portal/releases)

<!--[![LICENSE](https://img.shields.io/badge/license-Apache%20License-brightgreen.svg?style=flat)](https://github.com/Lecheeel/Portal/blob/main/LICENSE)-->


基于 [Portal](https://github.com/fuqiuluo/Portal) [@fuqiuluo](https://github.com/fuqiuluo)

Android 虚拟定位/环境伪造工具，支持路线播放和悬浮摇杆，模拟与伪造GNSS/NMEA/WiFi/基站/SIM卡


##  ⚠已知问题
(**v2.3.6**)[https://github.com/Lecheeel/Portal/releases/tag/v2.3.6] 会造成：
- #11 荐作用域勾失败
- #21 在 Redmi K70 / HyperOS 2 上导致基带丢失（RIL 初始化失败）
- - 注：基带丢失关闭模块即可恢复，Portal不会修改基带、Vendor分区
- - 如无特殊需要，先不要开启运营商/SIM卡伪造

其中基带丢失问题会出现在**所有**Android13-15的设备上

如有需要请更换至(**v2.3.5**)[https://github.com/Lecheeel/Portal/releases/tag/v2.3.5]

### 运行模式

| 模式 | 前置条件 | 主要用途 |
|---|---|---|
| 标准 Mock | 在开发者选项中设为模拟位置应用，并授予定位权限 | 无 Root 单点、路线与摇杆模拟 |
| Xposed | 支持 libxposed API 102 的框架，启用相应系统作用域 | 系统定位、GNSS/NMEA、环境与分应用扩展 |
| Native + Xposed | Root、arm64 设备及已激活的 Xposed | 实验性 Native 传感器扩展，⚠system hook |


### ⚠⚠⚠当你使用Native + Xposed模式， 必看！！！

+++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++

**此模式会对system_service进行修改，包括不限于** 

**接入传感器事件**

加速度计	TYPE_ACCELEROMETER	/ 陀螺仪	TYPE_GYROSCOPE	

磁力计/地磁	TYPE_MAGNETIC_FIELD	 / 气压计	TYPE_PRESSURE	

步数计数器	TYPE_STEP_COUNTER	/ 单步检测器	TYPE_STEP_DETECTOR


**修改定位数据**

经纬度、海拔高度、速度、运动航向、定位精度及相关字段

GPS/Network/Fused 定位结果


**修改 GNSS 卫星数据** 

卫星数量、编号与所属星座、卫星方位角、仰角

信号强度 CN0、载波频率、参与定位状态

按目标地点与时间生成天空，支持广播星历、历书与虚拟兜底


**接入 NMEA 数据**

GGA/RMC/GSA/GSV/GST/ZDA

位置、海拔、速度、航向、UTC 时间、卫星数量、DOP、卫星状态与 NMEA 主动投递

**NMEA 需要单独开启，并非选择 Native 后全部自动开启**

### ⚠ ⚠ 注意事项和bug ⚠ ⚠ 

传感器目前主要改写设备已有事件，不会凭空增加硬件，也不保证没有硬件事件时仍能持续输出

原始 GNSS 已支持 GPS L1 测量值的合成投递；导航电文、天线信息不可用 （**待办**）

这里修改的是系统软件处理与回调数据，不会刷写 GNSS 芯片固件，也不会改变真实卫星信号！

停止模拟 **不是** 卸载 Native Hook！！ ** 已经加载的 Native Hook，需要重启相关进程或设备才能卸载！！ **

+++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++
```

```kts
fun configureAppSigningConfigsForRelease(project: Project) {
    val keystorePath: String? = System.getenv("KEYSTORE_PATH")
    if (keystorePath.isNullOrBlank()) {
        return
    }
    project.configure<ApplicationExtension> {
        signingConfigs {
            create("release") {
                storeFile = file(System.getenv("KEYSTORE_PATH"))
                storePassword = System.getenv("KEYSTORE_PASSWORD")
                keyAlias = System.getenv("KEY_ALIAS")
                keyPassword = System.getenv("KEY_PASSWORD")
                enableV2Signing = true
            }
        }
        buildTypes {
            release {
                signingConfig = signingConfigs.findByName("release")
            }
            debug {
                signingConfig = signingConfigs.findByName("release")
            }
        }
    }
}

androidComponents {
    onVariants(selector().withBuildType("release")) { variant ->
        // minSdk 31 otherwise leaves DEX uncompressed. Compress Release DEX to
        // reduce download size, keeping Debug and native packaging unchanged.
        variant.packaging.dex.useLegacyPackaging.set(true)
        val abi = when (variant.flavorName) { "app" -> "all"; "x64" -> "x86_64"; else -> "arm64" }
        val export = tasks.register<Copy>("export${variant.name.replaceFirstChar { it.uppercase() }}Apk") {
            from(variant.artifacts.get(SingleArtifact.APK))
            include("*.apk")
            into(layout.buildDirectory.dir("outputs/distribution"))
            rename { "LocationService-v${releaseVersionName.get()}-$abi.apk" }
        }
        exportReleaseApks.configure { dependsOn(export) }
    }
```

```kt
package com.system.location.service

import androidx.compose.ui.test.*
import androidx.compose.ui.test.junit4.v2.createEmptyComposeRule
import androidx.test.core.app.ActivityScenario
import androidx.test.ext.junit.runners.AndroidJUnit4
import androidx.test.platform.app.InstrumentationRegistry
import com.system.location.service.ext.sensorTargetPackages
import org.junit.Assert.assertEquals
import org.junit.Rule
import org.junit.Test
import org.junit.runner.RunWith

@RunWith(AndroidJUnit4::class)
class AppSelectionUiTest {
    @get:Rule val compose = createEmptyComposeRule()

    @Test fun packageEditorKeepsInvalidDraftAcrossRecreationAndSavesOnlyValidPackages() {
        val context = InstrumentationRegistry.getInstrumentation().targetContext
        val original = context.sensorTargetPackages
        acceptSelectedMapForUiTest()
        grantUiPermissions()
        try {
            context.sensorTargetPackages = setOf("dev.portal.original")
            ActivityScenario.launch(MainActivity::class.java).use { scenario ->
                compose.openPage(scenario, R.id.nav_settings_apps)
                compose.scrollToText("编辑包名").performClick()
                compose.onNode(hasSetTextAction()).performTextReplacement("invalid")
                compose.onNodeWithText("保存包名").performClick()
                compose.onNodeWithText("请填写完整包名，最多 128 个").assertIsDisplayed()
                assertEquals(setOf("dev.portal.original"), context.sensorTargetPackages)
                scenario.recreate()
                compose.onNode(hasSetTextAction()).assertTextContains("invalid")
                compose.onNode(hasSetTextAction()).performTextReplacement("dev.portal.first\ndev.portal.second")
                captureUi("settings-package-editor")
                compose.onNodeWithText("保存包名").performClick()
                compose.scrollToText("编辑包名").assertIsDisplayed()
                assertEquals(setOf("dev.portal.first", "dev.portal.second"), context.sensorTargetPackages)
            }
        } finally { context.sensorTargetPackages = original }
    }

    @Test fun savedPackagesSurviveSearchRecreationAndCancelUntilExplicitSave() {
        val context = InstrumentationRegistry.getInstrumentation().targetContext
        val original = context.sensorTargetPackages
        val hiddenPackage = "dev.portal.saved.hidden"
        acceptSelectedMapForUiTest()
        grantUiPermissions()
        try {
            context.sensorTargetPackages = setOf(hiddenPackage)
            ActivityScenario.launch(MainActivity::class.java).use { scenario ->
                compose.openPage(scenario, R.id.nav_settings_apps)
                compose.scrollToText("选择应用").performClick()
                compose.onNodeWithText("搜索应用名称或包名").performTextInput(hiddenPackage)
                compose.waitUntil(10_000) {
                    compose.onAllNodesWithText(hiddenPackage).fetchSemanticsNodes().isNotEmpty()
                }
                compose.onNode(hasText(hiddenPackage) and isToggleable()).assertIsDisplayed()
                captureUi("settings-app-selector")
                compose.onNodeWithText("清空选择").performClick()
                scenario.recreate()
                compose.onNodeWithText("保存选择（0）").assertIsDisplayed()
                assertEquals(setOf(hiddenPackage), context.sensorTargetPackages)
                scenario.onActivity { it.onSupportNavigateUp() }
                compose.scrollToText("选择应用").performClick()
                compose.onNodeWithText("保存选择（1）").assertIsDisplayed()
                compose.onNodeWithText("清空选择").performClick()
                compose.waitUntil(10_000) {
                    runCatching { compose.onNodeWithText("保存选择（0）").assertIsEnabled(); true }.getOrDefault(false)
                }
                compose.onNodeWithText("保存选择（0）").performClick()
                compose.scrollToText("选择应用").assertIsDisplayed()
                assertEquals(emptySet<String>(), context.sensorTargetPackages)
            }
        } finally { context.sensorTargetPackages = original }
    }
}
```

`app/src/androidTest/java/com/system/location/service/CarrierConfigRedactionObjectTest.kt`:

```kt
package com.system.location.service

import android.os.PersistableBundle
import com.system.location.service.core.carrier.SimCarrierProfile
import org.junit.Assert.*
import org.junit.Test

class CarrierConfigRedactionObjectTest {
    @Test fun emptyRedactedConfigIsNeverExpandedAndSubsetDoesNotGainUnrequestedFields() {
        val type = Class.forName("com.system.location.service.hook.hooks.telephony.CarrierConfigReadHook")
        val instance = type.getField("INSTANCE").get(null)
        val method = type.declaredMethods.single { it.name.startsWith("overlay") && it.parameterCount == 3 }
        method.isAccessible = true
        val profile = SimCarrierProfile(1, virtual = true, countryIso = "US", mcc = 310,
            mnc = 260, carrierName = "Test")
        fun overlay(bundle: PersistableBundle, requested: Set<String>? = null) =
            method.invoke(instance, bundle, profile, requested) as PersistableBundle
        val empty = PersistableBundle()
        assertSame(empty, overlay(empty))
        assertSame(empty, overlay(empty, setOf("carrier_name_string")))
        val original = PersistableBundle().apply { putBoolean("unrelated", true) }
        val subset = overlay(original, setOf("carrier_name_string"))
        assertEquals("Test", subset.getString("carrier_name_string"))
        assertEquals(setOf("unrelated", "carrier_name_string"), subset.keySet())
        assertEquals(setOf("unrelated"), original.keySet())
        val untouched = overlay(original, emptySet())
        assertEquals(original.keySet(), untouched.keySet())
        val full = overlay(original)
        assertEquals("us", full.getString("sim_country_iso_override_string"))
        assertEquals(1, full.getInt("carrier_id_int"))
        assertTrue(full.getBoolean("unrelated"))
        assertFalse(original.containsKey("carrier_id_int"))
    }
}
```

```kt
import androidx.compose.ui.test.junit4.v2.createEmptyComposeRule
import androidx.test.core.app.ActivityScenario
import androidx.test.ext.junit.runners.AndroidJUnit4
import androidx.test.platform.app.InstrumentationRegistry
import com.system.location.service.core.carrier.CarrierIdentityConfig
import com.system.location.service.core.carrier.SimCarrierProfile
import com.system.location.service.debug.CarrierEditorTestActivity
import com.system.location.service.ext.sharedPrefs
import kotlinx.serialization.json.Json
import org.junit.Assert.assertTrue
import org.junit.Rule
import org.junit.Test
import org.junit.runner.RunWith

@RunWith(AndroidJUnit4::class)
class CarrierEditorRecoveryUiTest {
    @get:Rule val compose = createEmptyComposeRule()

    private fun editorText(text: String): SemanticsNodeInteraction {
        compose.onNode(hasScrollToIndexAction() and SemanticsMatcher.keyIsDefined(
            androidx.compose.ui.semantics.SemanticsProperties.VerticalScrollAxisRange))
            .performScrollToNode(hasText(text))
        return compose.onNodeWithText(text)
    }

    @Test(timeout = 120_000)
    fun dualSimDraftsAndAppSelectionsSurviveNavigationAndRecreation() {
        val context = InstrumentationRegistry.getInstrumentation().targetContext
        val preferences = context.sharedPrefs
        val keys = listOf("carrierIdentityEnabled", "carrierIdentityJson")
        val snapshot = preferences.all
        val config = CarrierIdentityConfig(sims = listOf(
            SimCarrierProfile(1, countryIso = "US", mcc = 310, mnc = 260, carrierName = "Saved one"),
            SimCarrierProfile(2, countryIso = "CN", mcc = 460, mnc = 0, mncDigits = 2, carrierName = "Saved two"),
        ))
        try {
            assertTrue(preferences.edit().putBoolean("carrierIdentityEnabled", false)
                .putString("carrierIdentityJson", Json.encodeToString(CarrierIdentityConfig.serializer(), config)).commit())
            ActivityScenario.launch(CarrierEditorTestActivity::class.java).use { scenario ->
                editorText("与已保存配置一致").assertIsDisplayed()
                editorText("SIM 1 · Saved one").assertIsDisplayed()
                editorText("SIM 2 · Saved two").assertIsDisplayed()
                editorText("运营商名称").performTextReplacement("Unsaved one")
                editorText("有未保存的修改").assertIsDisplayed()
                editorText("仅分应用").performClick()
                editorText("SIM 2").performClick()
                editorText("运营商名称").performTextReplacement("Unsaved two")
                scenario.onActivity { activity ->
                    activity.getSystemService(android.view.inputmethod.InputMethodManager::class.java)
                        .hideSoftInputFromWindow(activity.window.decorView.windowToken, 0)
                }
                editorText("添加应用").performClick()
                compose.onNodeWithText("搜索应用名称或包名").performTextInput(context.packageName)
                scenario.onActivity { activity ->
                    activity.getSystemService(android.view.inputmethod.InputMethodManager::class.java)
                        .hideSoftInputFromWindow(activity.window.decorView.windowToken, 0)
                }
                compose.onNode(hasText(context.packageName) and isToggleable()).performClick()
                compose.onNodeWithText("保存选择（1）").performClick()
                editorText("运营商名称")
                compose.onNode(hasSetTextAction() and hasText("Unsaved two")).assertIsDisplayed()
                scenario.recreate()
                editorText("有未保存的修改").assertIsDisplayed()
                editorText("SIM 1 · Unsaved one").assertIsDisplayed()
                editorText("SIM 2 · Unsaved two").assertIsDisplayed()
                editorText("仅分应用").assertIsSelected()
                editorText("运营商名称")
                compose.onNode(hasSetTextAction() and hasText("Unsaved two")).assertIsDisplayed()
                editorText("SIM 1").performClick()
                editorText("运营商名称")
                compose.onNode(hasSetTextAction() and hasText("Unsaved one")).assertIsDisplayed()
                editorText(context.packageName).assertIsDisplayed()
            }
        } finally {
            val edit = preferences.edit()
            keys.forEach { key -> when (val value = snapshot[key]) {
                is String -> edit.putString(key, value)
                is Boolean -> edit.putBoolean(key, value)
                else -> edit.remove(key)
            } }
            check(edit.commit())
        }
    }
}
```

`app/src/androidTest/java/com/system/location/service/CarrierGlobalPropertyDeviceTest.kt`:

```kt
package com.system.location.service

import android.Manifest
import android.location.LocationManager
import android.os.ParcelFileDescriptor
import android.telephony.SubscriptionManager
import androidx.test.platform.app.InstrumentationRegistry
import com.system.location.service.core.backend.BackendType
import com.system.location.service.core.carrier.*
import com.system.location.service.core.geo.Wgs84
import com.system.location.service.core.scenario.Scenario
import com.system.location.service.ext.sharedPrefs
import com.system.location.service.runtime.ScenarioRuntime
import com.system.location.service.service.MockServiceHelper
import kotlinx.coroutines.runBlocking
import org.junit.Assert.*
import org.junit.Assume.assumeTrue
import org.junit.Test

/** Reads property service through shell, outside target-app injected getters. */
class CarrierGlobalPropertyDeviceTest {
    @Test fun globalPropertiesMatchBothSlotsAndRestoreAcrossPerAppAndStop() = runBlocking {
        val automation = InstrumentationRegistry.getInstrumentation().uiAutomation
        val context = InstrumentationRegistry.getInstrumentation().targetContext
        val prefs = context.sharedPrefs
        val saved = prefs.all
        val backend = ScenarioRuntime.state.value.backend
        val location = context.getSystemService(LocationManager::class.java)
        automation.adoptShellPermissionIdentity(Manifest.permission.READ_PHONE_STATE)
        fun property(key: String) = ParcelFileDescriptor.AutoCloseInputStream(
            automation.executeShellCommand("getprop $key")).use { String(it.readBytes(), Charsets.UTF_8).trim() }
        val expected = mapOf("gsm.sim.operator.numeric" to "310260,50501",
            "gsm.sim.operator.alpha" to "Property US,Property AU",
            "gsm.sim.operator.iso-country" to "us,au",
            "gsm.operator.numeric" to "310260,50501",
            "gsm.operator.alpha" to "Network US,Network AU",
            "gsm.operator.iso-country" to "us,au",
            "gsm.sim.state" to "READY,READY",
            "gsm.network.type" to "NR,LTE")
        fun phonePid() = ParcelFileDescriptor.AutoCloseInputStream(
            automation.executeShellCommand("pidof com.android.phone")).use { String(it.readBytes(), Charsets.UTF_8).trim() }
        var originalPhonePid = phonePid()
        assertTrue("Phone process must be running", originalPhonePid.isNotEmpty())
        val original = expected.keys.associateWith(::property)
        var phoneRestarted = false
        fun restoredValues(values: Map<String, String>) = if (phoneRestarted && values == original)
            values - "gsm.network.type" else values
        fun assertStableBaseline() {
            repeat(3) {
                Thread.sleep(250)
                assertEquals("Phone process restarted during subscription notification", originalPhonePid, phonePid())
                val restored = restoredValues(original)
                assertEquals(restored, restored.keys.associateWith(::property))
                if (phoneRestarted) assertNotEquals("Modeled RATs survived withdrawal",
                    expected.getValue("gsm.network.type"), property("gsm.network.type"))
            }
        }
        fun awaitProperties(values: Map<String, String>, timeout: Long = 5000) {
            val until = android.os.SystemClock.elapsedRealtime() + timeout
            var current: Map<String, String>
            val target = restoredValues(values)
            do {
                current = target.keys.associateWith(::property)
                if (current == target) return
                Thread.sleep(150)
            } while (android.os.SystemClock.elapsedRealtime() < until)
            assertEquals(target, current)
        }
        val subscriptions = context.getSystemService(SubscriptionManager::class.java)
        val changed = java.util.concurrent.LinkedBlockingQueue<List<Int>>()
        lateinit var listener: SubscriptionManager.OnSubscriptionsChangedListener
        InstrumentationRegistry.getInstrumentation().runOnMainSync {
            listener = object : SubscriptionManager.OnSubscriptionsChangedListener() {
                override fun onSubscriptionsChanged() {
                    changed.offer(subscriptions.activeSubscriptionInfoList.orEmpty().map { it.simSlotIndex }.sorted())
                }
            }
        }
        var listening = false
        fun awaitSubscriptionEvent(slots: List<Int>) {
            val until = android.os.SystemClock.elapsedRealtime() + 5000
            var last: List<Int>? = null
            do {
                changed.poll(200, java.util.concurrent.TimeUnit.MILLISECONDS)?.let { last = it }
                if (last == slots) return
            } while (android.os.SystemClock.elapsedRealtime() < until)
            fail("Subscription listener missed slots=$slots; last=$last")
        }
        var fixtureStarted = false
        try {
            assumeTrue("Requires no active physical SIM", context.getSystemService(SubscriptionManager::class.java)
                .activeSubscriptionInfoList.orEmpty().isEmpty())
            assertTrue(ScenarioRuntime.selectBackend(BackendType.XPOSED).await())
            fixtureStarted = true
            subscriptions.addOnSubscriptionsChangedListener(java.util.concurrent.Executor { it.run() }, listener)
            listening = true
            changed.clear()
            val config = CarrierIdentityConfig(sims = listOf(
                SimCarrierProfile(1, virtual = true, countryIso = "US", mcc = 310, mnc = 260,
                    carrierName = "Property US", operatorName = "Network US"),
                SimCarrierProfile(2, virtual = true, countryIso = "AU", mcc = 505, mnc = 1,
                    mncDigits = 2, carrierName = "Property AU", operatorName = "Network AU", radio = CarrierRadio.LTE)))
            check(prefs.edit().putBoolean("carrierIdentityEnabled", true)
                .putString("carrierIdentityJson", CarrierIdentityCodec.encode(config)).commit())
            assertTrue(ScenarioRuntime.start(Scenario("carrier-properties", "Carrier properties", point = Wgs84(-33.86, 151.2))).await())
            assertTrue(MockServiceHelper.putConfig(location, context))
            awaitProperties(expected)
            awaitSubscriptionEvent(listOf(0, 1))
            val restartMode = InstrumentationRegistry.getArguments().getString("restart_phone")
            if (restartMode == "true" || restartMode == "external") {
                val before = phonePid()
                assertTrue("Unexpected phone PID format", before.matches(Regex("[1-9][0-9]*")))
                if (restartMode == "external") {
                    val token = InstrumentationRegistry.getArguments().getString("restart_token").orEmpty()
                    require(token.matches(Regex("[a-zA-Z0-9-]{1,64}")))
                    java.io.File(context.cacheDir, "portal-phone-restart-$token").writeText(before)
                } else {
                    ParcelFileDescriptor.AutoCloseInputStream(automation.executeShellCommand("su 0 kill -9 $before"))
                        .use { it.readBytes() }
                }
                val until = android.os.SystemClock.elapsedRealtime() + 30_000
                var next = ""
                var serviceStatus = ""
                var ready = false
                do {
                    next = phonePid()
                    serviceStatus = ParcelFileDescriptor.AutoCloseInputStream(automation.executeShellCommand("service check phone"))
                        .use { String(it.readBytes(), Charsets.UTF_8) }
                    if (next.isNotEmpty() && next != before && serviceStatus.contains("found") && !serviceStatus.contains("not found")) {
                        ready = true
                        break
                    }
                    Thread.sleep(200)
                } while (android.os.SystemClock.elapsedRealtime() < until)
                assertTrue("Phone process/service did not restart: before=$before after=$next service=$serviceStatus", ready)
                originalPhonePid = next
                phoneRestarted = true
                assertTrue(MockServiceHelper.putConfig(location, context))
                awaitProperties(expected, 15_000)
                System.err.println("PORTAL_PHONE_RESTART_RECOVERED $before -> $next")
            }
            changed.clear()
            check(prefs.edit().putString("carrierIdentityJson",
                CarrierIdentityCodec.encode(config.copy(mode = CarrierIdentityMode.PER_APP))).commit())
            assertTrue(MockServiceHelper.putConfig(location, context))
            awaitProperties(original)
            awaitSubscriptionEvent(emptyList())
            awaitProperties(original)
            assertStableBaseline()
            changed.clear()
            check(prefs.edit().putString("carrierIdentityJson", CarrierIdentityCodec.encode(config)).commit())
            assertTrue(MockServiceHelper.putConfig(location, context))
            awaitProperties(expected)
            awaitSubscriptionEvent(listOf(0, 1))
            changed.clear()
            ScenarioRuntime.stop().await()
            awaitProperties(original)
            awaitSubscriptionEvent(emptyList())
            awaitProperties(original)
            assertStableBaseline()
        } finally {
            if (listening) subscriptions.removeOnSubscriptionsChangedListener(listener)
            try { if (fixtureStarted) {
                ScenarioRuntime.stop().await()
                val edit = prefs.edit()
                for (key in listOf("carrierIdentityEnabled", "carrierIdentityJson")) when (val value = saved[key]) {
                    is Boolean -> edit.putBoolean(key, value)
                    is String -> edit.putString(key, value)
                    else -> edit.remove(key)
                }
                check(edit.commit())
                MockServiceHelper.putConfig(location, context)
                ScenarioRuntime.selectBackend(backend).await()
            } } finally { automation.dropShellPermissionIdentity() }
        }
    }
}
```

`app/src/androidTest/java/com/system/location/service/CarrierIdentityProbeService.java`:

```java
package com.system.location.service;

import android.Manifest;
import android.app.Service;
import android.content.Intent;
import android.content.pm.PackageManager;
import android.os.Binder;
import android.os.Bundle;
import android.os.IBinder;
import android.os.Parcel;
import android.os.RemoteException;
import android.telephony.SignalStrength;
import android.telephony.SubscriptionInfo;
import android.telephony.SubscriptionManager;
import android.telephony.TelephonyManager;

import java.util.ArrayList;
import java.util.List;

/** Test APK implementation: framework reads execute as this service's independent UID. */
public final class CarrierIdentityProbeService extends Service {
    public static final String DESCRIPTOR = "Portal.CarrierIdentityProbe";
    public static final int QUERY = IBinder.FIRST_CALL_TRANSACTION;

    private final Binder binder = new Binder() {
        @Override
        protected boolean onTransact(int code, Parcel data, Parcel reply, int flags)
                throws RemoteException {
            if (code == IBinder.INTERFACE_TRANSACTION) {
                if (reply != null) reply.writeString(DESCRIPTOR);
                return true;
            }
            if (code != QUERY) return super.onTransact(code, data, reply, flags);
            data.enforceInterface(DESCRIPTOR);
            CarrierIdentityProbeService.this.enforceCallingPermission(
                    Manifest.permission.DUMP, "Carrier identity probe requires DUMP");
            if (reply == null) throw new IllegalArgumentException("Probe query requires a reply");
            final int forcedSubId = data.dataAvail() >= Integer.BYTES ? data.readInt() : -1;
            final int callerUid = Binder.getCallingUid();
            final long token = Binder.clearCallingIdentity();
            final Bundle result;
            try {
                result = query(callerUid, forcedSubId);
            } finally {
                Binder.restoreCallingIdentity(token);
            }
            reply.writeNoException();
            reply.writeBundle(result);
            return true;
        }
    };

    @Override
    public IBinder onBind(Intent intent) {
        return binder;
    }

    @SuppressWarnings("deprecation")
    private Bundle query(int callerUid, int forcedSubId) {
        final Bundle result = new Bundle();
        result.putString("package", CarrierIdentityProbeService.this.getPackageName());
        result.putInt("uid", android.os.Process.myUid());
        result.putInt("pid", android.os.Process.myPid());
        result.putInt("callerUid", callerUid);
        result.putBoolean("uidDifferentFromCaller", android.os.Process.myUid() != callerUid);
        result.putBoolean("privileged", CarrierIdentityProbeService.this.checkSelfPermission(
                "android.permission.READ_PRIVILEGED_PHONE_STATE") == PackageManager.PERMISSION_GRANTED);
        for (String permission : new String[]{"android.permission.READ_PHONE_STATE",
                "android.permission.READ_PHONE_NUMBERS", "android.permission.READ_SMS"}) {
            result.putBoolean("granted:" + permission, CarrierIdentityProbeService.this.checkSelfPermission(
                    permission) == PackageManager.PERMISSION_GRANTED);
        }
        result.putInt("opNumberMode", CarrierIdentityProbeService.this.getSystemService(
                android.app.AppOpsManager.class).checkOpNoThrow(
                android.app.AppOpsManager.OPSTR_READ_PHONE_NUMBERS, android.os.Process.myUid(),
                CarrierIdentityProbeService.this.getPackageName()));
        result.putInt("forcedSubId", forcedSubId);
        final ArrayList<Bundle> rows = new ArrayList<>();
        result.putParcelableArrayList("rows", rows);
        final SubscriptionManager subscriptions = CarrierIdentityProbeService.this.getSystemService(
                SubscriptionManager.class);
        final TelephonyManager telephony = CarrierIdentityProbeService.this.getSystemService(
                TelephonyManager.class);
        try {
            if (subscriptions == null) throw new IllegalStateException("SubscriptionManager unavailable");
            final List<SubscriptionInfo> active = subscriptions.getActiveSubscriptionInfoList();
            if (active == null) {
                result.putString("activeSubscriptionsError", "Framework returned a null active subscription list");
            } else {
                for (SubscriptionInfo info : active) rows.add(queryRow(info, subscriptions, telephony));
            }
        } catch (Exception | LinkageError failure) {
            result.putString("activeSubscriptionsError", error(failure));
        }
        if (forcedSubId >= 0) {
            result.putString("forcedNumber", null);
            result.putString("forcedLine1", null);
            capture(result, "forcedNumber", () -> {
                if (subscriptions == null) throw new IllegalStateException("SubscriptionManager unavailable");
                return subscriptions.getPhoneNumber(forcedSubId);
            });
            capture(result, "forcedLine1", () -> {
                if (telephony == null) throw new IllegalStateException("TelephonyManager unavailable");
                return telephony.createForSubscriptionId(forcedSubId).getLine1Number();
            });
        }
        return result;
    }

    @SuppressWarnings("deprecation")
    private Bundle queryRow(SubscriptionInfo info, SubscriptionManager subscriptions,
            TelephonyManager telephony) {
        final Bundle row = new Bundle();
        row.putInt("id", -1);
        row.putInt("slot", -1);
        row.putInt("rat", -1);
        row.putInt("signalLevel", -1);
        for (String key : new String[]{"plmn", "carrierName", "simOperator", "networkOperator", "number", "line1"}) {
            row.putString(key, null);
        }
        if (info == null) {
            row.putString("error", "Framework active subscription list contained null");
            return row;
        }
        capture(row, "id", info::getSubscriptionId);
        capture(row, "slot", info::getSimSlotIndex);
        capture(row, "plmn", () -> {
            final String mcc = info.getMccString();
            final String mnc = info.getMncString();
            return mcc == null || mnc == null ? null : mcc + mnc;
        });
        capture(row, "carrierName", () -> {
            final CharSequence name = info.getCarrierName();
            return name == null ? null : name.toString();
        });
        final int subId = row.getInt("id", -1);
        TelephonyManager scoped = null;
        try {
            if (telephony == null) throw new IllegalStateException("TelephonyManager unavailable");
            if (subId < 0) throw new IllegalStateException("Invalid active subscription ID");
            scoped = telephony.createForSubscriptionId(subId);
        } catch (Exception | LinkageError failure) {
            row.putString("telephonyManagerError", error(failure));
        }
        final TelephonyManager perSub = scoped;
        capture(row, "simOperator", () -> require(perSub).getSimOperator());
        capture(row, "networkOperator", () -> require(perSub).getNetworkOperator());
        capture(row, "number", () -> subscriptions.getPhoneNumber(subId));
        capture(row, "line1", () -> require(perSub).getLine1Number());
        capture(row, "rat", () -> require(perSub).getDataNetworkType());
        capture(row, "signalLevel", () -> {
            final SignalStrength signal = require(perSub).getSignalStrength();
            return signal == null ? -1 : signal.getLevel();
        });
        return row;
    }

    private static TelephonyManager require(TelephonyManager manager) {
        if (manager == null) throw new IllegalStateException("Per-subscription TelephonyManager unavailable");
        return manager;
    }

    private interface QueryValue {
        Object read() throws Exception;
    }

    private static void capture(Bundle output, String key, QueryValue query) {
        try {
            final Object value = query.read();
            if (value instanceof Integer) output.putInt(key, (Integer) value);
            else output.putString(key, value == null ? null : value.toString());
        } catch (Exception | LinkageError failure) {
            output.putString(key + "Error", error(failure));
        }
    }

    private static String error(Throwable failure) {
        final String message = failure.getMessage();
        return failure.getClass().getName() + (message == null ? "" : ": " + message);
    }
}
```

`app/src/androidTest/java/com/system/location/service/CarrierIdentitySeedPreferencesTest.kt`:

```kt
package com.system.location.service

import androidx.test.platform.app.InstrumentationRegistry
import com.system.location.service.core.carrier.*
import com.system.location.service.data.persistence.CarrierIdentityPreferences
import org.junit.Assert.*
import org.junit.Test

class CarrierIdentitySeedPreferencesTest {
    @Test fun legacyMigrationPersistsOnceAndIndependentPreferencesGetDifferentIdentities() {
        val context = InstrumentationRegistry.getInstrumentation().targetContext
        val name = "carrier-seed-fixture-${java.util.UUID.randomUUID()}"
        val preferences = context.getSharedPreferences(name, 0)
        try {
            val legacy = CarrierIdentityConfig(sims = listOf(
                SimCarrierProfile(1, countryIso = "US", mcc = 310, mnc = 260, carrierName = "Test"),
                SimCarrierProfile(2, countryIso = "AU", mcc = 505, mnc = 1, mncDigits = 2, carrierName = "Test AU")))
            assertTrue(preferences.edit().putString("carrierIdentityJson", CarrierIdentityCodec.encode(legacy)).commit())
            val occupied = (1..65533).toSet()
            val first = CarrierIdentityPreferences.migrate(preferences, occupied)!!
            assertEquals(setOf(65534, 65535), first.sims.map { it.virtualSubscriptionId }.toSet())
            assertTrue(first.sims.all { it.identitySeed != 0L })
            assertNotEquals(first.sims[0].identitySeed, first.sims[1].identitySeed)
            assertEquals(first, CarrierIdentityPreferences.migrate(preferences))
            assertEquals(first, CarrierIdentityCodec.decode(preferences.getString("carrierIdentityJson", "")!!))
            val independent = CarrierIdentityPreferences.seedMissing(legacy)
            assertNotEquals(CarrierVirtualIdentity.imsi(first.sims[0]), CarrierVirtualIdentity.imsi(independent.sims[0]))
            assertEquals(first, CarrierIdentityPreferences.seedMissing(first))
        } finally { context.deleteSharedPreferences(name) }
    }
}
```

`app/src/androidTest/java/com/system/location/service/CarrierIndependentAppsDeviceTest.kt`:

```kt
package com.system.location.service

import android.Manifest
import android.content.*
import android.location.LocationManager
import android.os.*
import android.telephony.SubscriptionManager
import androidx.test.platform.app.InstrumentationRegistry
import com.system.location.service.core.backend.BackendType
import com.system.location.service.core.carrier.*
import com.system.location.service.core.geo.Wgs84
import com.system.location.service.core.scenario.Scenario
import com.system.location.service.ext.sharedPrefs
import com.system.location.service.runtime.ScenarioRuntime
import com.system.location.service.service.MockServiceHelper
import kotlinx.coroutines.runBlocking
import org.junit.Assert.*
import org.junit.Assume.assumeTrue
import org.junit.Test
import java.util.concurrent.CountDownLatch
import java.util.concurrent.Executors
import java.util.concurrent.TimeUnit
import java.util.concurrent.atomic.AtomicReference

/** Two separately installed packages query as their own UIDs, never the instrumentation UID. */
class CarrierIndependentAppsDeviceTest {
    private data class Probe(val packageName: String, val binder: IBinder)

    @Test fun separateAppsReadTheirOwnSimConcurrentlyAcrossRoutingChanges() = runBlocking {
        assumeTrue("Requires explicit independent probe fixture",
            InstrumentationRegistry.getArguments().getString("independent_probes") == "true")
        val strictNumbers = InstrumentationRegistry.getArguments().getString("strict_numbers") == "true"
        val automation = InstrumentationRegistry.getInstrumentation().uiAutomation
        val context = InstrumentationRegistry.getInstrumentation().targetContext
        val prefs = context.sharedPrefs
        val saved = prefs.all
        val backend = ScenarioRuntime.state.value.backend
        val location = context.getSystemService(LocationManager::class.java)
        val connections = mutableListOf<ServiceConnection>()
        val workers = Executors.newFixedThreadPool(2)
        var started = false
        automation.adoptShellPermissionIdentity(Manifest.permission.READ_PHONE_STATE,
            "android.permission.READ_PRIVILEGED_PHONE_STATE", Manifest.permission.DUMP)
        fun bind(packageName: String, className: String): Probe {
            val latch = CountDownLatch(1)
            val service = AtomicReference<IBinder>()
            val connection = object : ServiceConnection {
                override fun onServiceConnected(name: ComponentName, binder: IBinder) { service.set(binder); latch.countDown() }
                override fun onServiceDisconnected(name: ComponentName) { }
                override fun onNullBinding(name: ComponentName) { latch.countDown() }
            }
            assertTrue("Cannot bind independent probe $packageName", context.bindService(
                Intent().setComponent(ComponentName(packageName, className)), connection, Context.BIND_AUTO_CREATE))
            connections.add(connection)
            assertTrue("Probe did not connect: $packageName", latch.await(10, TimeUnit.SECONDS))
            return Probe(packageName, checkNotNull(service.get()) { "Null probe binding" })
        }
        fun query(probe: Probe, forced: Int = -1): Bundle {
            val request = Parcel.obtain()
            val reply = Parcel.obtain()
            try {
                request.writeInterfaceToken("Portal.CarrierIdentityProbe")
                request.writeInt(forced)
                assertTrue(probe.binder.transact(IBinder.FIRST_CALL_TRANSACTION, request, reply, 0))
                reply.readException()
                return checkNotNull(reply.readBundle(Bundle::class.java.classLoader))
            } finally { request.recycle(); reply.recycle() }
        }
        fun verify(probe: Probe, value: Bundle, profiles: List<SimCarrierProfile>) {
            assertEquals(probe.packageName, value.getString("package"))
            assertTrue("Probe shared instrumentation UID: $value", value.getInt("uid") != android.os.Process.myUid())
            assertEquals(android.os.Process.myUid(), value.getInt("callerUid"))
            assertTrue(value.getInt("uid") >= 10000)
            assertFalse("Probe borrowed privileged identity", value.getBoolean("privileged"))
            for (permission in listOf("android.permission.READ_PHONE_STATE",
                "android.permission.READ_PHONE_NUMBERS")) {
                assertTrue("Fixture permission missing on ${probe.packageName}: $permission",
                    value.getBoolean("granted:$permission"))
            }
            val listError = value.getString("activeSubscriptionsError")
            assertTrue("Probe list error: $listError", listError == null || profiles.isEmpty() &&
                listError == "Framework returned a null active subscription list")
            @Suppress("DEPRECATION")
            val rows = value.getParcelableArrayList<Bundle>("rows").orEmpty()
            assertEquals("Wrong independently visible slots: $value", profiles.map { it.slot - 1 }.sorted(),
                rows.map { it.getInt("slot") }.sorted())
            for (row in rows) {
                assertTrue("Probe field errors: $row", row.keySet().none { it.endsWith("Error") || it == "error" })
                val profile = profiles.single { it.slot - 1 == row.getInt("slot") }
                assertEquals(profile.virtualSubscriptionId, row.getInt("id"))
                for (name in listOf("plmn", "simOperator", "networkOperator"))
                    assertEquals("${probe.packageName}: $name", profile.operatorNumeric, row.getString(name))
                assertEquals(profile.carrierName, row.getString("carrierName"))
                assertEquals(profile.phoneNumber, row.getString("line1"))
                // Known gap: SubscriptionManager.getPhoneNumber() still returns empty for an
                // unprivileged caller even with READ_PHONE_NUMBERS and its AppOp allowed, while the
                // legacy line-1 getter already returns the modeled number. Keep it as a strict-only
                // check so the gap stays visible rather than weakening the line-1 assertion above.
                if (strictNumbers) {
                    assertEquals("row=$row opMode=${value.getInt("opNumberMode")}",
                        profile.phoneNumber, row.getString("number"))
                }
                assertEquals(20, row.getInt("rat"))
                assertTrue("NR signal missing: $row", row.getInt("signalLevel") in 1..4)
            }
        }
        fun await(probe: Probe, profiles: List<SimCarrierProfile>) {
            val deadline = SystemClock.elapsedRealtime() + 8000
            var failure: AssertionError? = null
            do {
                try { verify(probe, query(probe), profiles); return }
                catch (error: AssertionError) { failure = error }
                Thread.sleep(100)
            } while (SystemClock.elapsedRealtime() < deadline)
            throw checkNotNull(failure)
        }
        fun concurrently(a: Probe, aProfiles: List<SimCarrierProfile>, b: Probe, bProfiles: List<SimCarrierProfile>) {
            await(a, aProfiles); await(b, bProfiles)
            val start = CountDownLatch(1)
            val jobs = listOf(a to aProfiles, b to bProfiles).map { (probe, profiles) ->
                workers.submit {
                    check(start.await(5, TimeUnit.SECONDS))
                    repeat(12) { verify(probe, query(probe), profiles); Thread.sleep(40) }
                }
            }
            start.countDown()
            jobs.forEach { it.get(30, TimeUnit.SECONDS) }
        }
        try {
            assumeTrue("Requires no active SIM fixture", context.getSystemService(SubscriptionManager::class.java)
                .activeSubscriptionInfoList.orEmpty().isEmpty())
            assertTrue(ScenarioRuntime.selectBackend(BackendType.XPOSED).await())
            started = true
            val a = bind("com.system.location.service.test", "com.system.location.service.CarrierIdentityProbeService")
            val b = bind("com.system.location.service.detector.carrierprobe", "com.system.location.service.detector.CarrierIdentityProbeService")
            val initialA = query(a); val initialB = query(b)
            assertNotEquals("Probe packages share UID", initialA.getInt("uid"), initialB.getInt("uid"))
            assertNotEquals("Probe packages share PID", initialA.getInt("pid"), initialB.getInt("pid"))
            val config = CarrierIdentityConfig(sims = listOf(
                SimCarrierProfile(1, virtual = true, countryIso = "US", mcc = 310, mnc = 260,
                    carrierName = "Independent US", nrBand = 71, nrArfcn = 127000, phoneNumber = "+12025550123"),
                SimCarrierProfile(2, virtual = true, countryIso = "AU", mcc = 505, mnc = 1, mncDigits = 2,
                    carrierName = "Independent AU", phoneNumber = "+61491570156")))
            check(prefs.edit().putBoolean("carrierIdentityEnabled", true)
                .putString("carrierIdentityJson", CarrierIdentityCodec.encode(config)).commit())
            assertTrue(ScenarioRuntime.start(Scenario("carrier-independent", "Carrier independent apps",
                point = Wgs84(-33.86, 151.2))).await())
            assertTrue(MockServiceHelper.putConfig(location, context))
            val seeded = CarrierIdentityCodec.decode(prefs.getString("carrierIdentityJson", "")!!)
            val one = seeded.sims.single { it.slot == 1 }; val two = seeded.sims.single { it.slot == 2 }
            concurrently(a, listOf(one, two), b, listOf(one, two))
            fun apply(next: CarrierIdentityConfig) {
                check(prefs.edit().putString("carrierIdentityJson", CarrierIdentityCodec.encode(next)).commit())
                assertTrue(MockServiceHelper.putConfig(location, context))
            }
            apply(seeded.copy(mode = CarrierIdentityMode.PER_APP, appRoutes = listOf(
                CarrierAppRoute(a.packageName, CarrierTarget.SIM1), CarrierAppRoute(b.packageName, CarrierTarget.SIM2))))
            concurrently(a, listOf(one), b, listOf(two))
            apply(seeded.copy(mode = CarrierIdentityMode.PER_APP, appRoutes = listOf(
                CarrierAppRoute(a.packageName, CarrierTarget.REAL), CarrierAppRoute(b.packageName, CarrierTarget.SIM1))))
            concurrently(a, emptyList(), b, listOf(one))
            val retired = query(a, two.virtualSubscriptionId)
            assertNotEquals(two.phoneNumber, retired.getString("forcedNumber"))
            assertNotEquals(two.phoneNumber, retired.getString("forcedLine1"))
            check(prefs.edit().putBoolean("carrierIdentityEnabled", false).commit())
            assertTrue(MockServiceHelper.putConfig(location, context))
            concurrently(a, emptyList(), b, emptyList())
        } finally {
            workers.shutdownNow()
            connections.forEach { runCatching { context.unbindService(it) } }
            try { if (started) {
                ScenarioRuntime.stop().await()
                val edit = prefs.edit()
                for (key in listOf("carrierIdentityEnabled", "carrierIdentityJson")) when (val value = saved[key]) {
                    is Boolean -> edit.putBoolean(key, value)
                    is String -> edit.putString(key, value)
                    else -> edit.remove(key)
                }
                check(edit.commit())
                MockServiceHelper.putConfig(location, context)
                ScenarioRuntime.selectBackend(backend).await()
            } } finally { automation.dropShellPermissionIdentity() }
        }
    }
}
```

`app/src/androidTest/java/com/system/location/service/CarrierNrCellDeviceTest.kt`:

```kt
package com.system.location.service

import android.os.Parcel
import android.telephony.CellInfo
import android.telephony.CellInfoNr
import com.system.location.service.core.environment.CellTower
import com.system.location.service.core.environment.CellType
import com.system.location.service.hook.hooks.telephony.CellInfoSynthesis
import org.junit.Assert.*
import org.junit.Test

class CarrierNrCellDeviceTest {
    @Test fun missingAndOutOfRangeSignalMetricsFollowPlatformNormalization() {
        val source = CellTower(CellType.NR, 310, 260, 1, 123456L,
            pci = 10, arfcn = 640000, rsrp = -88, registered = true,
            mncDigits = 3, bands = listOf(78))
        for (tower in listOf(source, source.copy(rsrq = -99, rssnr = 99))) {
            val cell = CellInfoSynthesis.buildNrResult(tower).getOrThrow() as CellInfoNr
            val signal = cell.cellSignalStrength as android.telephony.CellSignalStrengthNr
            assertEquals(CellInfo.UNAVAILABLE, signal.ssRsrq)
            assertEquals(CellInfo.UNAVAILABLE, signal.ssSinr)
            assertEquals(CellInfo.UNAVAILABLE, signal.csiRsrp)
            assertEquals(-88, signal.dbm)
            assertEquals(52, signal.asuLevel)
            val reference = com.system.location.service.hook.runtime.Reflection.newInstance(
                android.telephony.CellSignalStrengthNr::class.java,
                CellInfo.UNAVAILABLE, CellInfo.UNAVAILABLE, CellInfo.UNAVAILABLE,
                -88, CellInfo.UNAVAILABLE, CellInfo.UNAVAILABLE) as android.telephony.CellSignalStrengthNr
            assertEquals(reference.level, signal.level)
        }
    }

    @Test fun aggregateContainsOnlyServingNrAndSurvivesParcel() {
        val tower = CellTower(CellType.NR, 310, 260, 1, 123456L, pci = 10, arfcn = 640000,
            rsrp = -88, rsrq = -12, rssnr = 20, registered = true, mncDigits = 3, bands = listOf(78))
        val serving = (CellInfoSynthesis.buildNrResult(tower).getOrThrow() as CellInfoNr).cellSignalStrength
            as android.telephony.CellSignalStrengthNr
        val type = Class.forName("com.system.location.service.hook.hooks.telephony.CarrierSignalStrengthHook")
        val method = type.declaredMethods.single { it.name.startsWith("aggregate") && it.parameterCount == 1 }
        method.isAccessible = true
        val aggregate = method.invoke(type.getField("INSTANCE").get(null), serving) as android.telephony.SignalStrength
        fun verify(signal: android.telephony.SignalStrength) {
            val list = signal.cellSignalStrengths
            assertEquals(1, list.size)
            assertTrue(list.single() is android.telephony.CellSignalStrengthNr)
            assertEquals(serving, list.single())
            assertEquals(serving.level, signal.level)
            for (name in listOf("getMiuiLevel", "getOptimizedLevel")) {
                val getter = com.system.location.service.hook.runtime.Reflection.findMethodExactIfExists(signal.javaClass, name)
                if (getter != null) assertEquals("$name disagrees with serving NR", serving.level, getter.invoke(signal))
            }
            assertEquals(serving.asuLevel,
                com.system.location.service.hook.runtime.Reflection.callMethod(signal, "getAsuLevel"))
            assertEquals(serving.dbm,
                com.system.location.service.hook.runtime.Reflection.callMethod(signal, "getDbm"))
        }
        verify(aggregate)
        val parcel = Parcel.obtain()
        try {
            aggregate.writeToParcel(parcel, 0)
            parcel.setDataPosition(0)
            verify(android.telephony.SignalStrength.CREATOR.createFromParcel(parcel))
        } finally { parcel.recycle() }
    }

    @Test fun nrIdentityAndSignalSurviveAndroidConstructionAndParcel() {
        val tower = CellTower(CellType.NR, 310, 260, 0x234567, 0x123456789L,
            pci = 777, arfcn = 640000, rsrp = -88, rsrq = -12, rssnr = 20,
            registered = true, mncDigits = 3, operatorName = "Test NR", bands = listOf(78))
        val cell = CellInfoSynthesis.buildNrResult(tower).getOrThrow() as CellInfoNr
        assertNotNull("NR Android object construction failed", cell)
        fun verify(value: CellInfoNr) {
            val identity = value.cellIdentity as android.telephony.CellIdentityNr
            val signal = value.cellSignalStrength as android.telephony.CellSignalStrengthNr
            assertEquals("310", identity.mccString)
            assertEquals("260", identity.mncString)
            assertEquals(tower.cellId, identity.nci)
            assertEquals(777, identity.pci)
            assertEquals(tower.areaCode, identity.tac)
            assertEquals(640000, identity.nrarfcn)
            assertArrayEquals(intArrayOf(78), identity.bands)
            assertEquals("Test NR", identity.operatorAlphaLong)
            assertEquals(-88, signal.ssRsrp)
            assertEquals(-12, signal.ssRsrq)
            assertEquals(20, signal.ssSinr)
            assertTrue(value.isRegistered)
            assertEquals(CellInfo.CONNECTION_PRIMARY_SERVING, value.cellConnectionStatus)
        }
        verify(cell)
        val parcel = Parcel.obtain()
        try {
            cell.writeToParcel(parcel, 0)
            parcel.setDataPosition(0)
            verify(CellInfo.CREATOR.createFromParcel(parcel) as CellInfoNr)
        } finally { parcel.recycle() }
    }
}
```

`app/src/androidTest/java/com/system/location/service/CarrierNrRequestDeviceTest.kt`:

```kt
package com.system.location.service

import android.Manifest
import android.location.LocationManager
import android.telephony.*
import androidx.test.platform.app.InstrumentationRegistry
import com.system.location.service.core.backend.BackendType
import com.system.location.service.core.carrier.*
import com.system.location.service.core.geo.Wgs84
import com.system.location.service.core.scenario.Scenario
import com.system.location.service.ext.sharedPrefs
import com.system.location.service.runtime.ScenarioRuntime
import com.system.location.service.service.MockServiceHelper
import kotlinx.coroutines.runBlocking
import org.junit.Assert.*
import org.junit.Assume.assumeTrue
import org.junit.Test
import java.util.concurrent.CountDownLatch
import java.util.concurrent.TimeUnit
import java.util.concurrent.atomic.AtomicReference

class CarrierNrRequestDeviceTest {
    @Test fun perSubscriptionRequestsReturnConfiguredNrBandChannelAndPlmn() = runBlocking {
        val context = InstrumentationRegistry.getInstrumentation().targetContext
        val automation = InstrumentationRegistry.getInstrumentation().uiAutomation
        val preferences = context.sharedPrefs
        val saved = preferences.all
        val backend = ScenarioRuntime.state.value.backend
        val location = context.getSystemService(LocationManager::class.java)
        automation.adoptShellPermissionIdentity(Manifest.permission.READ_PHONE_STATE,
            Manifest.permission.ACCESS_FINE_LOCATION, Manifest.permission.ACCESS_COARSE_LOCATION)
        try {
            val subscriptions = context.getSystemService(SubscriptionManager::class.java)
            assumeTrue(subscriptions.activeSubscriptionInfoList.orEmpty().isEmpty())
            assertTrue(ScenarioRuntime.selectBackend(BackendType.XPOSED).await())
            val config = CarrierIdentityConfig(sims = listOf(
                SimCarrierProfile(1, virtual = true, countryIso = "US", mcc = 310, mnc = 260,
                    carrierName = "NR US", nrBand = 71, nrArfcn = 127000),
                SimCarrierProfile(2, virtual = true, countryIso = "AU", mcc = 505, mnc = 1,
                    mncDigits = 2, carrierName = "NR AU", nrBand = 78, nrArfcn = 640000)))
            check(preferences.edit().putBoolean("carrierIdentityEnabled", true)
                .putString("carrierIdentityJson", CarrierIdentityCodec.encode(config)).commit())
            assertTrue(ScenarioRuntime.start(Scenario(id = "nr-request", name = "NR request",
                point = Wgs84(-33.8688, 151.2093))).await())
            assertTrue(MockServiceHelper.putConfig(location, context))
            val deadline = android.os.SystemClock.elapsedRealtime() + 5000
            while (subscriptions.activeSubscriptionInfoList.orEmpty().size != 2 &&
                android.os.SystemClock.elapsedRealtime() < deadline) Thread.sleep(100)
            val active = subscriptions.activeSubscriptionInfoList.orEmpty()
            assertEquals(2, active.size)
            val overview = context.getSystemService(TelephonyManager::class.java).allCellInfo.orEmpty()
            assertTrue("All-cell overview must include both virtual radios", overview.isNotEmpty())
            assertTrue(overview.all { it is CellInfoNr })
            val grouped = overview.filterIsInstance<CellInfoNr>().groupBy {
                val id = it.cellIdentity as CellIdentityNr
                id.mccString + id.mncString
            }
            assertEquals(config.sims.map { it.operatorNumeric }.toSet(), grouped.keys)
            config.sims.forEach { profile ->
                val cells = grouped.getValue(profile.operatorNumeric)
                assertEquals(1, cells.count { it.isRegistered })
                cells.forEach {
                    val id = it.cellIdentity as CellIdentityNr
                    assertArrayEquals(intArrayOf(profile.nrBand), id.bands)
                    assertEquals(profile.nrArfcn, id.nrarfcn)
                }
            }
            active.forEach { info ->
                val manager = context.getSystemService(TelephonyManager::class.java)
                    .createForSubscriptionId(info.subscriptionId)
                val profileForListener = config.sims.first { it.slot == info.simSlotIndex + 1 }
                val notifications = java.util.concurrent.LinkedBlockingQueue<List<CellInfo>>()
                val listener = object : TelephonyCallback(), TelephonyCallback.CellInfoListener {
                    override fun onCellInfoChanged(cellInfo: MutableList<CellInfo>) { notifications.offer(cellInfo.toList()) }
                }
                manager.registerTelephonyCallback({ it.run() }, listener)
                try {
                    val until = android.os.SystemClock.elapsedRealtime() + 5000
                    var initial: List<CellInfo>? = null
                    do {
                        val value = notifications.poll(200, TimeUnit.MILLISECONDS)
                        if (!value.isNullOrEmpty()) { initial = value; break }
                    } while (android.os.SystemClock.elapsedRealtime() < until)
                    assertNotNull("Continuous listener did not receive virtual cells", initial)
                    assertEquals(1, initial!!.count { it.isRegistered })
                    initial!!.forEach { cell ->
                        assertTrue(cell is CellInfoNr)
                        val id = (cell as CellInfoNr).cellIdentity as CellIdentityNr
                        assertEquals(profileForListener.operatorNumeric, id.mccString + id.mncString)
                        assertArrayEquals(intArrayOf(profileForListener.nrBand), id.bands)
                        assertEquals(profileForListener.nrArfcn, id.nrarfcn)
                    }
                    fun awaitCells(label: String, matches: (List<CellInfo>) -> Boolean) {
                        val deadline = android.os.SystemClock.elapsedRealtime() + 5000
                        do {
                            val value = notifications.poll(200, TimeUnit.MILLISECONDS)
                            if (value != null && matches(value)) return
                        } while (android.os.SystemClock.elapsedRealtime() < deadline)
                        fail(label)
                    }
                    val originalNcis = initial!!.filterIsInstance<CellInfoNr>().map {
                        (it.cellIdentity as CellIdentityNr).nci
                    }.toSet()
                    val routingBefore = preferences.getString("routingJson", null)
                    val routed = com.system.location.service.core.routing.RoutingConfig(
                        mode = com.system.location.service.core.routing.RoutingMode.PER_APP,
                        routes = listOf(com.system.location.service.core.routing.AppRoute(context.packageName,
                            point = Wgs84(37.77, -122.42))))
                    notifications.clear()
                    check(preferences.edit().putString("routingJson", kotlinx.serialization.json.Json.encodeToString(
                        com.system.location.service.core.routing.RoutingConfig.serializer(), routed)).commit())
                    assertTrue(MockServiceHelper.putConfig(location, context))
                    assertTrue(MockServiceHelper.broadcastLocation(location))
                    awaitCells("Independent app route did not update virtual cells") { cells ->
                        cells.isNotEmpty() && cells.all { it is CellInfoNr } &&
                            cells.filterIsInstance<CellInfoNr>().map { (it.cellIdentity as CellIdentityNr).nci }.toSet() != originalNcis
                    }
                    check(preferences.edit().apply {
                        if (routingBefore == null) remove("routingJson") else putString("routingJson", routingBefore)
                    }.commit())
                    assertTrue(MockServiceHelper.putConfig(location, context))
                    assertTrue(MockServiceHelper.broadcastLocation(location))
                    awaitCells("Restoring app route did not restore original cells") { cells ->
                        cells.isNotEmpty() && cells.all { it is CellInfoNr } &&
                            cells.filterIsInstance<CellInfoNr>().map { (it.cellIdentity as CellIdentityNr).nci }.toSet() == originalNcis
                    }
                    notifications.clear()
                    assertTrue(ScenarioRuntime.setSpeed(200.0).await())
                    assertTrue(ScenarioRuntime.motion(0.0, true).await())
                    awaitCells("Position change did not update virtual cells") { cells ->
                        cells.isNotEmpty() && cells.all { it is CellInfoNr } &&
                            cells.filterIsInstance<CellInfoNr>().map { (it.cellIdentity as CellIdentityNr).nci }.toSet() != originalNcis
                    }
                    notifications.clear()
                    ScenarioRuntime.stop().await()
                    awaitCells("Stopping did not clear active cell listener") { it.isEmpty() }
                    notifications.clear()
                    assertTrue(ScenarioRuntime.start(Scenario(id = "nr-request", name = "NR request",
                        point = Wgs84(-33.8688, 151.2093))).await())
                    assertTrue(MockServiceHelper.putConfig(location, context))
                    awaitCells("Restart did not restore active cell listener") { it.isNotEmpty() }
                    val persisted = CarrierIdentityCodec.decode(preferences.getString("carrierIdentityJson", "")!!)
                    val changed = persisted.copy(sims = persisted.sims.map {
                        if (it.slot == info.simSlotIndex + 1) it.copy(nrBand = 77, nrArfcn = 650000) else it
                    })
                    notifications.clear()
                    check(preferences.edit().putString("carrierIdentityJson", CarrierIdentityCodec.encode(changed)).commit())
                    assertTrue(MockServiceHelper.putConfig(location, context))
                    awaitCells("Active cell listener did not receive new NR channel") { cells ->
                        cells.isNotEmpty() && cells.all {
                            it is CellInfoNr && (it.cellIdentity as CellIdentityNr).let { id ->
                                id.nrarfcn == 650000 && id.bands.contentEquals(intArrayOf(77)) &&
                                    id.mccString + id.mncString == profileForListener.operatorNumeric
                            }
                        }
                    }
                    notifications.clear()
                    check(preferences.edit().putBoolean("carrierIdentityEnabled", false).commit())
                    assertTrue(MockServiceHelper.putConfig(location, context))
                    awaitCells("Disabled cell listener retained virtual cells") { it.isEmpty() }
                    notifications.clear()
                    check(preferences.edit().putBoolean("carrierIdentityEnabled", true)
                        .putString("carrierIdentityJson", CarrierIdentityCodec.encode(persisted)).commit())
                    assertTrue(MockServiceHelper.putConfig(location, context))
                    awaitCells("Re-enabled cell listener did not receive cells") { cells ->
                        cells.isNotEmpty() && cells.all { it is CellInfoNr &&
                            (it.cellIdentity as CellIdentityNr).nrarfcn == profileForListener.nrArfcn }
                    }
                } finally { manager.unregisterTelephonyCallback(listener) }
                notifications.clear()
                val afterUnregister = CarrierIdentityCodec.decode(preferences.getString("carrierIdentityJson", "")!!)
                check(preferences.edit().putString("carrierIdentityJson", CarrierIdentityCodec.encode(
                    afterUnregister.copy(sims = afterUnregister.sims.map { it.copy(operatorName = "NR updated") }))).commit())
                assertTrue(MockServiceHelper.putConfig(location, context))
                assertNull("Unregistered cell listener received an update", notifications.poll(600, TimeUnit.MILLISECONDS))
                val latch = CountDownLatch(1)
                val result = AtomicReference<List<CellInfo>>()
                val error = AtomicReference<String>()
                manager.requestCellInfoUpdate({ it.run() }, object : TelephonyManager.CellInfoCallback() {
                    override fun onCellInfo(cells: MutableList<CellInfo>) { result.set(cells); latch.countDown() }
                    override fun onError(code: Int, detail: Throwable?) { error.set("$code: $detail"); latch.countDown() }
                })
                assertTrue("No callback for slot ${info.simSlotIndex}", latch.await(10, TimeUnit.SECONDS))
                assertNull("Virtual NR request failed: ${error.get()}", error.get())
                val cells = result.get().orEmpty()
                assertTrue("Virtual NR list must be populated", cells.isNotEmpty())
                assertEquals(1, cells.count { it.isRegistered })
                val aggregate = manager.signalStrength
                assertNotNull("Virtual subscription returned no aggregate signal", aggregate)
                val signals = aggregate!!.cellSignalStrengths
                assertEquals("NR SA aggregate must have only one valid radio", 1, signals.size)
                assertTrue(signals.single() is CellSignalStrengthNr)
                val servingSignal = (cells.single { it.isRegistered } as CellInfoNr).cellSignalStrength
                assertEquals(servingSignal, signals.single())
                assertEquals(servingSignal.level, aggregate.level)
                val signalEvents = java.util.concurrent.LinkedBlockingQueue<SignalStrength>()
                val signalListener = object : TelephonyCallback(), TelephonyCallback.SignalStrengthsListener {
                    override fun onSignalStrengthsChanged(signalStrength: SignalStrength) { signalEvents.offer(signalStrength) }
                }
                manager.registerTelephonyCallback({ it.run() }, signalListener)
                try {
                    val until = android.os.SystemClock.elapsedRealtime() + 5000
                    var received: SignalStrength? = null
                    do {
                        val event = signalEvents.poll(200, TimeUnit.MILLISECONDS)
                        if (event?.cellSignalStrengths == signals) received = event
                    } while (received == null && android.os.SystemClock.elapsedRealtime() < until)
                    assertNotNull("Signal listener did not receive matching virtual NR", received)
                    assertEquals(aggregate.level, received!!.level)
                    fun awaitSignal(label: String, matches: (SignalStrength) -> Boolean) {
                        val until = android.os.SystemClock.elapsedRealtime() + 5000
                        var last: SignalStrength? = null
                        do {
                            val event = signalEvents.poll(200, TimeUnit.MILLISECONDS)
                            if (event != null) last = event
                            if (event != null && matches(event)) return
                        } while (android.os.SystemClock.elapsedRealtime() < until)
                        fail("$label; last=$last current=${manager.signalStrength}")
                    }
                    signalEvents.clear()
                    check(preferences.edit().putBoolean("carrierIdentityEnabled", false).commit())
                    assertTrue(MockServiceHelper.putConfig(location, context))
                    awaitSignal("Disabling retained virtual NR signal") { it.cellSignalStrengths.isEmpty() }
                    signalEvents.clear()
                    check(preferences.edit().putBoolean("carrierIdentityEnabled", true).commit())
                    assertTrue(MockServiceHelper.putConfig(location, context))
                    awaitSignal("Re-enable did not restore virtual NR signal") { it.cellSignalStrengths == signals }
                    signalEvents.clear()
                    ScenarioRuntime.stop().await()
                    awaitSignal("Stopping retained virtual NR signal") { it.cellSignalStrengths.isEmpty() }
                    signalEvents.clear()
                    assertTrue(ScenarioRuntime.start(Scenario(id = "nr-request", name = "NR request",
                        point = Wgs84(-33.8688, 151.2093))).await())
                    assertTrue(MockServiceHelper.putConfig(location, context))
                    awaitSignal("Restart did not restore virtual NR signal") {
                        it.cellSignalStrengths.isNotEmpty() &&
                            it.cellSignalStrengths == manager.signalStrength?.cellSignalStrengths
                    }
                } finally { manager.unregisterTelephonyCallback(signalListener) }
                val profile = config.sims.first { it.slot == info.simSlotIndex + 1 }
                cells.forEach { cell ->
                    assertTrue(cell is CellInfoNr)
                    val identity = (cell as CellInfoNr).cellIdentity as CellIdentityNr
                    assertEquals(profile.operatorNumeric, identity.mccString + identity.mncString)
                    assertEquals(profile.nrArfcn, identity.nrarfcn)
                    assertArrayEquals(intArrayOf(profile.nrBand), identity.bands)
                    assertTrue(identity.nci in 0 until (1L shl 36))
                    assertTrue(identity.pci in 0..1007)
                }
            }
        } finally {
            try {
                ScenarioRuntime.stop().await()
                val edit = preferences.edit()
                for (key in listOf("carrierIdentityEnabled", "carrierIdentityJson", "speed", "routingJson")) when (val value = saved[key]) {
                    is Float -> edit.putFloat(key, value)
                    is Boolean -> edit.putBoolean(key, value)
                    is String -> edit.putString(key, value)
                    else -> edit.remove(key)
                }
                check(edit.commit())
                MockServiceHelper.putConfig(location, context)
                ScenarioRuntime.selectBackend(backend).await()
            } finally { automation.dropShellPermissionIdentity() }
        }
    }
}
```
