`app/src/androidTest/java/com/system/location/service/CarrierOverrideExecutionDeviceTest.kt`:

```kt
package com.system.location.service

import android.os.PersistableBundle
import com.system.location.service.hook.runtime.HookRuntime
import io.github.libxposed.api.XposedInterface
import java.lang.reflect.Executable
import java.lang.reflect.Method
import java.lang.reflect.Proxy
import org.junit.Assert.*
import org.junit.Test

/** Real Android bundles + fake platform calls. Never hooks ART or changes the real phone service. */
class CarrierOverrideExecutionDeviceTest {
    @Test fun queuedApplyReapplyRestoreAndFailureUseRealHookCallbacks() {
        val framework = HookRuntime::class.java.getDeclaredField("framework").apply { isAccessible = true }
        val previousFramework = framework.get(HookRuntime)
        val hookType = Class.forName("com.system.location.service.hook.hooks.telephony.CarrierConfigOverrideHook")
        val instance = hookType.getField("INSTANCE").get(null)
        val callbacks = linkedMapOf<Method, XposedInterface.Hooker>()
        val helper = FakeLoader::class.java.getDeclaredMethod("overrideConfig",
            arrayOfNulls<PersistableBundle>(0).javaClass, Int::class.javaPrimitiveType, PersistableBundle::class.java)
        val outer = FakeLoader::class.java.getDeclaredMethod("overrideConfig",
            Int::class.javaPrimitiveType, PersistableBundle::class.java, Boolean::class.javaPrimitiveType)
        val fake = FakeLoader()
        fun call(method: Method, args: List<Any?>, action: (List<Any?>) -> Any?): Any? {
            val chain = proxy(XposedInterface.Chain::class.java) { called, values -> when (called.name) {
                "getExecutable" -> method
                "getThisObject" -> fake
                "getArgs" -> args
                "getArg" -> args[values!![0] as Int]
                "proceed" -> action(if (values.isNullOrEmpty()) args else (values[0] as Array<*>).toList())
                else -> error("Unexpected chain ${called.name}")
            } }
            return callbacks.getValue(method).intercept(chain)
        }
        val api = proxy(XposedInterface::class.java) { method, args -> when (method.name) {
            "log" -> null
            "hook" -> {
                val executable = args!![0] as Method
                lateinit var builder: XposedInterface.HookBuilder
                builder = proxy(XposedInterface.HookBuilder::class.java) { builderMethod, values ->
                    when (builderMethod.name) {
                        "setPriority", "setExceptionMode" -> builder
                        "intercept" -> {
                            callbacks[executable] = values!![0] as XposedInterface.Hooker
                            proxy(XposedInterface.HookHandle::class.java) { handleMethod, _ -> when (handleMethod.name) {
                                "getExecutable" -> executable
                                "unhook" -> null
                                else -> error("Unexpected handle")
                            } }
                        }
                        else -> error("Unexpected builder")
                    }
                }
                builder
            }
            "getInvoker" -> {
                val target = args!![0] as Method
                lateinit var invoker: XposedInterface.Invoker<*, *>
                invoker = proxy(XposedInterface.Invoker::class.java) { called, values -> when (called.name) {
                    "setType" -> invoker
                    "invoke" -> target.invoke(values!![0], *(values[1] as Array<*>))
                    else -> error("Unexpected invoker")
                } }
                invoker
            }
            else -> error("Unexpected framework ${method.name}")
        } }
        val fields = listOf("pending", "owned", "failures")
        val stateFields = fields.associateWith { hookType.getDeclaredField(it).apply { isAccessible = true } }
        val supported = hookType.getDeclaredField("supported").apply { isAccessible = true }
        val oldSupported = supported.getBoolean(instance)
        val handles = HookRuntime::class.java.getDeclaredField("handles").apply { isAccessible = true }
        @Suppress("UNCHECKED_CAST")
        val tracked = handles.get(HookRuntime) as MutableCollection<Any>
        val oldHandles = tracked.toList()
        var fixtureOwnsState = false
        try {
            check(stateFields.values.all { field -> when (val value = field.get(instance)) {
                is Map<*, *> -> value.isEmpty()
                is Collection<*> -> value.isEmpty()
                else -> false
            } }) { "Fixture must not overwrite an active local override session" }
            fixtureOwnsState = true
            framework.set(HookRuntime, api)
            val uid: () -> Int = { 1000 }
            hookType.declaredMethods.single { it.name.startsWith("installType") &&
                it.parameterTypes.toList() == listOf(Class::class.java, kotlin.jvm.functions.Function0::class.java) }
                .invoke(instance, FakeLoader::class.java, uid)
            fun failed(sub: Int) = hookType.getDeclaredMethod("failed", Int::class.javaPrimitiveType)
                .invoke(instance, sub) as Boolean
            fun status(sub: Int) = hookType.getDeclaredMethod("status", Int::class.javaPrimitiveType)
                .invoke(instance, sub) as Pair<*, *>
            fun queue(sub: Int, action: String, name: String? = null) {
                val request = PersistableBundle().apply {
                    putString("portal_carrier_override_action", action)
                    name?.let { putString("carrier_name_string", it) }
                }
                call(outer, listOf(sub, request, false)) { values ->
                    val clean = values[1] as PersistableBundle
                    assertFalse(clean.containsKey("portal_carrier_override_action"))
                    fake.queued += clean
                    null
                }
            }
            fun drain(phoneId: Int = 0) {
                val bundle = fake.queued.removeAt(0)
                call(helper, listOf(fake.layer, phoneId, bundle)) { values ->
                    if (fake.failMerge) error("platform merge failed")
                    @Suppress("UNCHECKED_CAST")
                    fake.overrideConfig(values[0] as Array<PersistableBundle?>, values[1] as Int,
                        values[2] as PersistableBundle?)
                    null
                }
            }
            fake.layer[0] = PersistableBundle().apply {
                putString("carrier_name_string", "original")
                putBoolean("unrelated_volte", true)
            }
            queue(10, "apply", "Portal")
            assertEquals(false to true, status(10))
            drain()
            assertEquals(true to false, status(10))
            assertFalse(failed(10))
            assertEquals("Portal", fake.layer[0]!!.getString("carrier_name_string"))
            fake.layer[0]!!.putString("carrier_name_string", "other tool")
            queue(10, "apply", "Portal second")
            drain()
            queue(10, "restore")
            drain()
            assertEquals("other tool", fake.layer[0]!!.getString("carrier_name_string"))
            assertTrue(fake.layer[0]!!.getBoolean("unrelated_volte"))
            assertEquals(false to false, status(10))
            queue(10, "apply", "active")
            drain()
            fake.failMerge = true
            queue(10, "apply", "must fail")
            assertThrows(IllegalStateException::class.java) { drain() }
            assertTrue(failed(10))
            assertEquals(true to false, status(10))
            assertEquals("active", fake.layer[0]!!.getString("carrier_name_string"))
            fake.failMerge = false
            queue(11, "apply", "wrong subscription")
            assertThrows(IllegalStateException::class.java) { drain() }
            assertTrue(failed(11))
            assertEquals("active", fake.layer[0]!!.getString("carrier_name_string"))
            queue(10, "restore")
            drain()
            assertFalse(failed(10))
            assertEquals("other tool", fake.layer[0]!!.getString("carrier_name_string"))
        } finally {
            framework.set(HookRuntime, previousFramework)
            if (fixtureOwnsState) {
                stateFields.values.forEach { field -> when (val value = field.get(instance)) {
                    is MutableMap<*, *> -> value.clear()
                    is MutableCollection<*> -> value.clear()
                    else -> Unit
                } }
                supported.setBoolean(instance, oldSupported)
                tracked.toList().filter { handle -> oldHandles.none { it === handle } }
                    .forEach { tracked.remove(it) }
            }
        }
    }

    class FakeLoader {
        val layer: Array<PersistableBundle?> = arrayOfNulls(2)
        val queued = mutableListOf<PersistableBundle>()
        var failMerge = false
        fun overrideConfig(subId: Int, values: PersistableBundle?, persistent: Boolean) = Unit
        fun overrideConfig(current: Array<PersistableBundle?>, phoneId: Int, patch: PersistableBundle?) {
            if (patch == null) current[phoneId] = PersistableBundle()
            else if (current[phoneId] == null) current[phoneId] = patch
            else current[phoneId]!!.putAll(patch)
        }
    }

    private fun <T> proxy(type: Class<T>, action: (Method, Array<out Any?>?) -> Any?): T {
        @Suppress("UNCHECKED_CAST")
        return Proxy.newProxyInstance(type.classLoader, arrayOf(type)) { instance, method, args -> when (method.name) {
            "equals" -> instance === args?.get(0)
            "hashCode" -> System.identityHashCode(instance)
            "toString" -> "CarrierFixture${type.simpleName}"
            else -> action(method, args)
        } } as T
    }
}
```

`app/src/androidTest/java/com/system/location/service/CarrierPhoneNumberDeviceTest.kt`:

```kt
package com.system.location.service

import android.Manifest
import android.app.AppOpsManager
import android.location.LocationManager
import android.os.Bundle
import android.os.ParcelFileDescriptor
import android.telephony.SubscriptionManager
import android.telephony.TelephonyManager
import androidx.test.platform.app.InstrumentationRegistry
import com.system.location.service.core.backend.BackendType
import com.system.location.service.core.carrier.*
import com.system.location.service.core.geo.Wgs84
import com.system.location.service.core.scenario.Scenario
import com.system.location.service.ext.sharedPrefs
import com.system.location.service.runtime.ScenarioRuntime
import com.system.location.service.service.MockServiceHelper
import kotlinx.coroutines.runBlocking
import org.junit.Assert.*
import org.junit.Assume.assumeTrue
import org.junit.Test

class CarrierPhoneNumberDeviceTest {
    @Test fun savedDualNumbersRespectPermissionAndAllPublicNumberInterfaces() = runBlocking {
        val automation = InstrumentationRegistry.getInstrumentation().uiAutomation
        val context = InstrumentationRegistry.getInstrumentation().targetContext
        val prefs = context.sharedPrefs
        val saved = prefs.all
        val backend = ScenarioRuntime.state.value.backend
        val location = context.getSystemService(LocationManager::class.java)
        val subscriptions = context.getSystemService(SubscriptionManager::class.java)
        val telephony = context.getSystemService(TelephonyManager::class.java)
        automation.adoptShellPermissionIdentity(Manifest.permission.READ_PHONE_STATE, "android.permission.READ_PRIVILEGED_PHONE_STATE")
        var started = false
        var opChanged = false
        var smsOpChanged = false
        val testDeniedOps = InstrumentationRegistry.getArguments().getString("appop_denial") == "true"
        val ops = context.getSystemService(AppOpsManager::class.java)
        fun setOp(mode: String, operation: String = "READ_PHONE_NUMBERS") = ParcelFileDescriptor.AutoCloseInputStream(automation.executeShellCommand(
            "cmd appops set ${context.packageName} $operation $mode")).use { it.readBytes() }
        var uidOpChanged = false
        fun shellText(command: String) = ParcelFileDescriptor.AutoCloseInputStream(automation.executeShellCommand(command))
            .use { String(it.readBytes(), Charsets.UTF_8) }
        val oldUidText = shellText("cmd appops get ${android.os.Process.myUid()} READ_PHONE_NUMBERS")
        val oldUidMode = Regex(": (allow|ignore|deny|default|foreground)").find(oldUidText)?.groupValues?.get(1) ?: "default"
        fun setUidOp(mode: String) { shellText("cmd appops set --uid ${context.packageName} READ_PHONE_NUMBERS $mode"); uidOpChanged = true }
        fun packageMode(operation: String): String = Regex("(?m)^${Regex.escape(operation)}: (allow|ignore|deny|default|foreground)")
            .find(shellText("cmd appops get ${context.packageName} $operation"))?.groupValues?.get(1) ?: "default"
        val oldPackageMode = packageMode("READ_PHONE_NUMBERS")
        val oldSmsPackageMode = packageMode("READ_SMS")
        try {
            assumeTrue("Requires no active SIM fixture", subscriptions.activeSubscriptionInfoList.orEmpty().isEmpty())
            assertTrue(ScenarioRuntime.selectBackend(BackendType.XPOSED).await())
            started = true
            val cn = CarrierPhoneNumbers.generate("CN", "北京市", "CMCC")
            val au = CarrierPhoneNumbers.generate("AU")
            val config = CarrierIdentityConfig(sims = listOf(
                SimCarrierProfile(1, virtual = true, countryIso = "CN", mcc = 460, mnc = 0, mncDigits = 2,
                    carrierName = "CMCC", phoneNumber = cn, phoneNumberCity = "北京市"),
                SimCarrierProfile(2, virtual = true, countryIso = "AU", mcc = 505, mnc = 1, mncDigits = 2,
                    carrierName = "Telstra", phoneNumber = au)))
            check(prefs.edit().putBoolean("carrierIdentityEnabled", true)
                .putString("carrierIdentityJson", CarrierIdentityCodec.encode(config)).commit())
            assertTrue(ScenarioRuntime.start(Scenario("carrier-numbers", "Carrier numbers", point = Wgs84(39.9, 116.4))).await())
            assertTrue(MockServiceHelper.putConfig(location, context))
            val deadline = android.os.SystemClock.elapsedRealtime() + 5000
            var active = subscriptions.activeSubscriptionInfoList.orEmpty()
            while (active.size != 2 && android.os.SystemClock.elapsedRealtime() < deadline) {
                Thread.sleep(150); active = subscriptions.activeSubscriptionInfoList.orEmpty()
            }
            assertEquals(2, active.size)
            fun verifyNumbers() {
                for (info in subscriptions.activeSubscriptionInfoList.orEmpty()) {
                    val expected = if (info.simSlotIndex == 0) cn else au
                    val manager = telephony.createForSubscriptionId(info.subscriptionId)
                    repeat(2) {
                        @Suppress("DEPRECATION")
                        assertEquals("line1 SIM${info.simSlotIndex}", expected, manager.line1Number)
                        assertEquals("first available", expected, subscriptions.getPhoneNumber(info.subscriptionId))
                        assertEquals("UICC source", expected, subscriptions.getPhoneNumber(info.subscriptionId, 1))
                        @Suppress("DEPRECATION")
                        assertEquals("SubscriptionInfo.number", expected, info.number)
                    }
                    val reply = Bundle().apply { putString("kind", "phone"); putInt("id", info.simSlotIndex) }
                    assertTrue(location.sendExtraCommand("fused_ext", "portal_carrier_identity_snapshot", reply))
                    val exposed = kotlinx.serialization.json.Json.decodeFromString(SimCarrierProfile.serializer(), reply.getString("profile")!!)
                    assertEquals("Snapshot leaked phone number", "", exposed.phoneNumber)
                    assertEquals("Snapshot leaked city", "", exposed.phoneNumberCity)
                }
            }
            verifyNumbers()
            for (info in active) {
                for (source in listOf(2, 3)) {
                    assertTrue("Non-UICC source $source invented a number",
                        subscriptions.getPhoneNumber(info.subscriptionId, source).isEmpty())
                }
                try {
                    subscriptions.getPhoneNumber(info.subscriptionId, -1)
                    fail("Invalid number source did not retain framework exception")
                } catch (_: IllegalArgumentException) { }
            }
            if (testDeniedOps) { setUidOp("ignore"); opChanged = true }
            automation.adoptShellPermissionIdentity(Manifest.permission.READ_PHONE_STATE)
            for (info in subscriptions.activeSubscriptionInfoList.orEmpty()) {
                @Suppress("DEPRECATION")
                assertTrue("Subscription list leaked number", info.number.isNullOrEmpty())
                try {
                    assertTrue(subscriptions.getPhoneNumber(info.subscriptionId).isEmpty())
                } catch (_: SecurityException) { }
                try {
                    @Suppress("DEPRECATION")
                    assertTrue(telephony.createForSubscriptionId(info.subscriptionId).line1Number.isNullOrEmpty())
                } catch (_: SecurityException) { }
            }
            if (!testDeniedOps) {
            setOp("allow", "READ_SMS"); smsOpChanged = true
            automation.adoptShellPermissionIdentity(Manifest.permission.READ_PHONE_STATE, Manifest.permission.READ_SMS)
            for (info in active) {
                @Suppress("DEPRECATION")
                assertEquals("READ_SMS legacy line1", if (info.simSlotIndex == 0) cn else au,
                    telephony.createForSubscriptionId(info.subscriptionId).line1Number)
                try {
                    assertTrue("Modern number API accepted legacy SMS permission", subscriptions.getPhoneNumber(info.subscriptionId).isEmpty())
                } catch (_: SecurityException) { }
            }
            }
            setOp("allow"); opChanged = true
            automation.adoptShellPermissionIdentity(Manifest.permission.READ_PHONE_STATE)
            if (testDeniedOps) {
                assertEquals(android.content.pm.PackageManager.PERMISSION_GRANTED,
                    context.checkSelfPermission(Manifest.permission.READ_PHONE_NUMBERS))
            for (deniedMode in listOf("ignore", "deny")) {
                setUidOp(deniedMode)
                val effectiveMode = ops.unsafeCheckOpNoThrow(AppOpsManager.OPSTR_READ_PHONE_NUMBERS,
                    android.os.Process.myUid(), context.packageName)
                assertTrue("AppOp $deniedMode was not effectively denied: $effectiveMode",
                    effectiveMode == AppOpsManager.MODE_IGNORED || effectiveMode == AppOpsManager.MODE_ERRORED)
                System.err.println("PORTAL_NUMBER_APPOP requested=$deniedMode effective=$effectiveMode")
                for (info in subscriptions.activeSubscriptionInfoList.orEmpty()) {
                    @Suppress("DEPRECATION")
                    assertTrue("AppOp $deniedMode leaked list number", info.number.isNullOrEmpty())
                    try {
                        assertTrue("AppOp $deniedMode leaked new number", subscriptions.getPhoneNumber(info.subscriptionId).isEmpty())
                    } catch (_: SecurityException) { }
                    try {
                        @Suppress("DEPRECATION")
                        assertTrue("AppOp $deniedMode leaked line1", telephony.createForSubscriptionId(info.subscriptionId).line1Number.isNullOrEmpty())
                    } catch (_: SecurityException) { }
                }
            }
            }
            if (!testDeniedOps) automation.adoptShellPermissionIdentity(Manifest.permission.READ_PHONE_STATE,
                Manifest.permission.READ_PHONE_NUMBERS)
            if (testDeniedOps) setUidOp("allow")
            setOp("allow")
            verifyNumbers()
            automation.adoptShellPermissionIdentity(Manifest.permission.READ_PHONE_STATE, "android.permission.READ_PRIVILEGED_PHONE_STATE")
            val off = CarrierIdentityCodec.decode(prefs.getString("carrierIdentityJson", "")!!)
                .copy(mode = CarrierIdentityMode.PER_APP)
            check(prefs.edit().putString("carrierIdentityJson", CarrierIdentityCodec.encode(off)).commit())
            assertTrue(MockServiceHelper.putConfig(location, context))
            val removedBy = android.os.SystemClock.elapsedRealtime() + 5000
            while (subscriptions.activeSubscriptionInfoList.orEmpty().isNotEmpty() &&
                android.os.SystemClock.elapsedRealtime() < removedBy) Thread.sleep(150)
            assertTrue("Unlisted caller retained virtual numbers", subscriptions.activeSubscriptionInfoList.orEmpty().isEmpty())
            for (info in active) {
                assertNotEquals(if (info.simSlotIndex == 0) cn else au, subscriptions.getPhoneNumber(info.subscriptionId))
            }
        } finally {
            try {
                if (uidOpChanged) { shellText("cmd appops set --uid ${context.packageName} READ_PHONE_NUMBERS $oldUidMode") }
                if (opChanged) setOp(oldPackageMode)
                if (smsOpChanged) setOp(oldSmsPackageMode, "READ_SMS")
                if (started) {
                    ScenarioRuntime.stop().await()
                    val edit = prefs.edit()
                    for (key in listOf("carrierIdentityEnabled", "carrierIdentityJson")) when (val value = saved[key]) {
                        is Boolean -> edit.putBoolean(key, value)
                        is String -> edit.putString(key, value)
                        else -> edit.remove(key)
                    }
                    check(edit.commit())
                    MockServiceHelper.putConfig(location, context)
                    ScenarioRuntime.selectBackend(backend).await()
                }
            } finally { automation.dropShellPermissionIdentity() }
        }
    }
}
```

```kt
package com.system.location.service

import androidx.compose.ui.test.*
import androidx.compose.ui.test.junit4.v2.createEmptyComposeRule

import org.junit.Assert.*
import org.junit.Rule
import org.junit.Test

class CarrierPhoneNumberEditorUiTest {
    @get:Rule val compose = createEmptyComposeRule()
    private fun text(value: String): SemanticsNodeInteraction {
        compose.onNode(hasScrollToIndexAction() and SemanticsMatcher.keyIsDefined(
            androidx.compose.ui.semantics.SemanticsProperties.VerticalScrollAxisRange))
            .performScrollToNode(hasText(value))
        return compose.onNodeWithText(value)
    }
    private fun number() = compose.onNodeWithText("模拟手机号码（可选）").fetchSemanticsNode()
        .config[androidx.compose.ui.semantics.SemanticsProperties.EditableText].text

    @Test(timeout = 120_000) fun citySelectionRandomFillTwoSlotsAndRecreationPersistNumbers() {
        val prefs = InstrumentationRegistry.getInstrumentation().targetContext.sharedPrefs
        val saved = prefs.all
        val config = CarrierIdentityConfig(sims = listOf(
            SimCarrierProfile(1, countryIso = "CN", mcc = 460, mnc = 0, mncDigits = 2, carrierName = "CMCC"),
            SimCarrierProfile(2, countryIso = "AU", mcc = 505, mnc = 1, mncDigits = 2, carrierName = "Telstra")))
        try {
            check(prefs.edit().putBoolean("carrierIdentityEnabled", false)
                .putString("carrierIdentityJson", CarrierIdentityCodec.encode(config)).commit())
            ActivityScenario.launch(CarrierEditorTestActivity::class.java).use { activity ->
                text("选择号段归属城市")
                compose.waitUntil(10000) {
                    !compose.onNodeWithText("选择号段归属城市").fetchSemanticsNode().config
                        .contains(androidx.compose.ui.semantics.SemanticsProperties.Disabled)
                }
                compose.onNodeWithText("选择号段归属城市").performClick()
                compose.onNodeWithText("搜索省、市或地区").performTextInput("北京")
                compose.onNodeWithText("北京市").performClick()
                text("随机填充号码").performClick()
                var cn = number()
                assertTrue(CarrierPhoneNumbers.belongsToCity(cn, CarrierPhoneCity("北京市", "CMCC")))
                activity.recreate()
                text("模拟手机号码（可选）")
                assertEquals(cn, number())
                text("MNC").performTextReplacement("01")
                text("模拟手机号码（可选）")
                assertEquals("", number())
                text("选择号段归属城市").assertIsDisplayed()
                text("MNC").performTextReplacement("00")
                text("选择号段归属城市")
                compose.waitUntil(10000) {
                    !compose.onNodeWithText("选择号段归属城市").fetchSemanticsNode().config
                        .contains(androidx.compose.ui.semantics.SemanticsProperties.Disabled)
                }
                compose.onNodeWithText("选择号段归属城市").performClick()
                compose.onNodeWithText("北京市").performClick()
                text("随机填充号码").performClick()
                cn = number()
                assertTrue(CarrierPhoneNumbers.belongsToCity(cn, CarrierPhoneCity("北京市", "CMCC")))
                text("SIM 2").performClick()
                text("随机填充号码").performClick()
                val au = number()
                assertTrue(CarrierPhoneNumbers.matchesRegion(au, "AU"))
                text("保存并应用").performClick()
                compose.waitUntil(10000) {
                    CarrierIdentityCodec.decode(prefs.getString("carrierIdentityJson", "")!!).sims
                        .firstOrNull { it.slot == 2 }?.phoneNumber == au
                }
                val persisted = CarrierIdentityCodec.decode(prefs.getString("carrierIdentityJson", "")!!)
                assertEquals(cn, persisted.sims.first { it.slot == 1 }.phoneNumber)
                assertEquals("北京市", persisted.sims.first { it.slot == 1 }.phoneNumberCity)
                assertEquals(au, persisted.sims.first { it.slot == 2 }.phoneNumber)
            }
        } finally {
            val edit = prefs.edit()
            for (key in listOf("carrierIdentityEnabled", "carrierIdentityJson")) when (val value = saved[key]) {
                is Boolean -> edit.putBoolean(key, value)
                is String -> edit.putString(key, value)
                else -> edit.remove(key)
            }
            check(edit.commit())
            val context = InstrumentationRegistry.getInstrumentation().targetContext
            com.system.location.service.service.MockServiceHelper.putConfig(
                context.getSystemService(android.location.LocationManager::class.java), context)
        }
    }
}
```

`app/src/androidTest/java/com/system/location/service/CarrierServiceStateCallbackDeviceTest.kt`:

```kt
package com.system.location.service

import android.Manifest
import android.location.LocationManager
import android.telephony.ServiceState
import android.telephony.SubscriptionManager
import android.telephony.TelephonyCallback
import android.telephony.TelephonyManager
import androidx.test.platform.app.InstrumentationRegistry
import com.system.location.service.core.backend.BackendType
import com.system.location.service.core.carrier.*
import com.system.location.service.core.geo.Wgs84
import com.system.location.service.core.scenario.Scenario
import com.system.location.service.ext.sharedPrefs
import com.system.location.service.runtime.ScenarioRuntime
import com.system.location.service.service.MockServiceHelper
import kotlinx.coroutines.runBlocking
import org.junit.Assert.*
import org.junit.Assume.assumeTrue
import org.junit.Test
import java.util.concurrent.LinkedBlockingQueue
import java.util.concurrent.TimeUnit

/** Actual application callback transports in system_server; no reflective invocation of callbacks. */
class CarrierServiceStateCallbackDeviceTest {
    private class Listener : TelephonyCallback(), TelephonyCallback.ServiceStateListener,
        TelephonyCallback.DisplayInfoListener {
        val displays = LinkedBlockingQueue<android.telephony.TelephonyDisplayInfo>()
        override fun onDisplayInfoChanged(info: android.telephony.TelephonyDisplayInfo) { displays.offer(info) }
        val states = LinkedBlockingQueue<ServiceState>()
        override fun onServiceStateChanged(serviceState: ServiceState) { states.offer(serviceState) }
    }

    @Test fun separateSubscriptionsReceiveTheirOwnPlmnAndStopAfterUnregister() = runBlocking {
        val automation = InstrumentationRegistry.getInstrumentation().uiAutomation
        val context = InstrumentationRegistry.getInstrumentation().targetContext
        val preferences = context.sharedPrefs
        val saved = preferences.all
        val backend = ScenarioRuntime.state.value.backend
        val location = context.getSystemService(LocationManager::class.java)
        val registered = mutableListOf<Pair<TelephonyManager, Listener>>()
        automation.adoptShellPermissionIdentity(Manifest.permission.READ_PHONE_STATE,
            Manifest.permission.ACCESS_FINE_LOCATION, Manifest.permission.ACCESS_COARSE_LOCATION)
        try {
            val subscriptions = context.getSystemService(SubscriptionManager::class.java)
            assumeTrue("Requires no active physical SIM", subscriptions.activeSubscriptionInfoList.orEmpty().isEmpty())
            assertTrue(ScenarioRuntime.selectBackend(BackendType.XPOSED).await())
            val config = CarrierIdentityConfig(sims = listOf(
                SimCarrierProfile(1, virtual = true, countryIso = "US", mcc = 310, mnc = 260,
                    carrierName = "Callback US", nrBand = 71, nrArfcn = 127000),
                SimCarrierProfile(2, virtual = true, countryIso = "AU", mcc = 505, mnc = 1,
                    mncDigits = 2, carrierName = "Callback AU", radio = CarrierRadio.LTE)))
            check(preferences.edit().putBoolean("carrierIdentityEnabled", true)
                .putString("carrierIdentityJson", CarrierIdentityCodec.encode(config)).commit())
            val started = ScenarioRuntime.start(Scenario(id = "carrier-callback", name = "Carrier callback",
                point = Wgs84(-33.8688, 151.2093))).await()
            assertTrue("Scenario did not start: ${ScenarioRuntime.state.value}", started)
            assertTrue(MockServiceHelper.putConfig(location, context))
            val deadline = android.os.SystemClock.elapsedRealtime() + 5000
            while (subscriptions.activeSubscriptionInfoList.orEmpty().size != 2 &&
                android.os.SystemClock.elapsedRealtime() < deadline) Thread.sleep(100)
            val active = subscriptions.activeSubscriptionInfoList.orEmpty().sortedBy { it.simSlotIndex }
            assertEquals(2, active.size)
            active.forEach { info ->
                val manager = context.getSystemService(TelephonyManager::class.java)
                    .createForSubscriptionId(info.subscriptionId)
                val listener = Listener()
                manager.registerTelephonyCallback({ it.run() }, listener)
                registered.add(manager to listener)
            }
            registered.forEachIndexed { index, (_, listener) ->
                val expected = if (index == 0) "310260" else "50501"
                val timeout = android.os.SystemClock.elapsedRealtime() + 5000
                var matching: ServiceState? = null
                do {
                    val state = listener.states.poll(200, TimeUnit.MILLISECONDS)
                    assertFalse("SIM callback crossed subscriptions before initial state",
                        state?.operatorNumeric == if (index == 0) "50501" else "310260")
                    if (state?.operatorNumeric == expected) matching = state
                } while (matching == null && android.os.SystemClock.elapsedRealtime() < timeout)
                assertNotNull("SIM ${index + 1} must receive its own virtual state", matching)
                assertEquals(ServiceState.STATE_IN_SERVICE, matching!!.state)
                assertFalse(matching!!.roaming)
                val remaining = listener.states.toList()
                assertTrue("SIM callback crossed subscriptions", remaining.none {
                    it.operatorNumeric == if (index == 0) "50501" else "310260"
                })
            }
            registered.forEachIndexed { index, (_, listener) ->
                val expectedRat = if (index == 0) TelephonyManager.NETWORK_TYPE_NR else TelephonyManager.NETWORK_TYPE_LTE
                val deadline = android.os.SystemClock.elapsedRealtime() + 5000
                var display: android.telephony.TelephonyDisplayInfo? = null
                do {
                    val next = listener.displays.poll(200, TimeUnit.MILLISECONDS)
                    if (next?.networkType == expectedRat) display = next
                } while (display == null && android.os.SystemClock.elapsedRealtime() < deadline)
                assertNotNull("SIM ${index + 1} did not receive its display RAT", display)
                assertEquals(android.telephony.TelephonyDisplayInfo.OVERRIDE_NETWORK_TYPE_NONE, display!!.overrideNetworkType)
            }
            fun awaitDisplay(listener: Listener, expected: Int, label: String) {
                val deadline = android.os.SystemClock.elapsedRealtime() + 5000
                var last: android.telephony.TelephonyDisplayInfo? = null
                do {
                    val next = listener.displays.poll(200, TimeUnit.MILLISECONDS)
                    if (next != null) last = next
                    if (next?.networkType == expected) {
                        assertEquals(android.telephony.TelephonyDisplayInfo.OVERRIDE_NETWORK_TYPE_NONE, next.overrideNetworkType)
                        return
                    }
                } while (android.os.SystemClock.elapsedRealtime() < deadline)
                fail("$label expected=$expected last=$last")
            }
            fun awaitState(listener: Listener, label: String, predicate: (ServiceState) -> Boolean) {
                val until = android.os.SystemClock.elapsedRealtime() + 5000
                do {
                    val value = listener.states.poll(200, TimeUnit.MILLISECONDS)
                    if (value != null && predicate(value)) return
                } while (android.os.SystemClock.elapsedRealtime() < until)
                fail(label)
            }
            registered.forEach { it.second.states.clear() }
            val persisted = CarrierIdentityCodec.decode(preferences.getString("carrierIdentityJson", "")!!)
            registered.forEach { it.second.displays.clear() }
            val switched = persisted.copy(sims = persisted.sims.map { it.copy(
                radio = if (it.radio == CarrierRadio.NR) CarrierRadio.LTE else CarrierRadio.NR) })
            check(preferences.edit().putString("carrierIdentityJson", CarrierIdentityCodec.encode(switched)).commit())
            assertTrue(MockServiceHelper.putConfig(location, context))
            registered.forEachIndexed { index, (_, listener) ->
                awaitDisplay(listener, if (index == 0) TelephonyManager.NETWORK_TYPE_LTE else TelephonyManager.NETWORK_TYPE_NR,
                    "Active display did not switch SIM ${index + 1}")
            }
            registered.forEach { it.second.displays.clear() }
            val renamed = persisted.copy(sims = persisted.sims.map { it.copy(operatorName = "Updated ${it.slot}") })
            check(preferences.edit().putString("carrierIdentityJson", CarrierIdentityCodec.encode(renamed)).commit())
            assertTrue(MockServiceHelper.putConfig(location, context))
            registered.forEachIndexed { index, (_, listener) ->
                awaitDisplay(listener, if (index == 0) TelephonyManager.NETWORK_TYPE_NR else TelephonyManager.NETWORK_TYPE_LTE,
                    "Restoring display did not update SIM ${index + 1}")
                awaitState(listener, "Active SIM ${index + 1} did not receive profile update") {
                    it.operatorAlphaLong == "Updated ${index + 1}" &&
                        it.operatorNumeric == if (index == 0) "310260" else "50501"
                }
            }
            registered.forEach { it.second.states.clear(); it.second.displays.clear() }
            check(preferences.edit().putBoolean("carrierIdentityEnabled", false).commit())
            assertTrue(MockServiceHelper.putConfig(location, context))
            registered.forEach { (_, listener) ->
                awaitState(listener, "Disabling left active listener with virtual state") {
                    it.operatorNumeric !in listOf("310260", "50501")
                }
                val until = android.os.SystemClock.elapsedRealtime() + 5000
                var cleared = false
                do {
                    if (listener.displays.poll(200, TimeUnit.MILLISECONDS)?.networkType == TelephonyManager.NETWORK_TYPE_UNKNOWN)
                        cleared = true
                } while (!cleared && android.os.SystemClock.elapsedRealtime() < until)
                assertTrue("Disabling retained virtual display RAT", cleared)
            }
            registered.forEach { it.second.states.clear(); it.second.displays.clear() }
            check(preferences.edit().putBoolean("carrierIdentityEnabled", true).commit())
            assertTrue(MockServiceHelper.putConfig(location, context))
            registered.forEachIndexed { index, (_, listener) ->
                awaitState(listener, "Re-enable did not notify active SIM") { it.operatorAlphaLong == "Updated ${index + 1}" }
                awaitDisplay(listener, if (index == 0) TelephonyManager.NETWORK_TYPE_NR else TelephonyManager.NETWORK_TYPE_LTE,
                    "Re-enabling did not restore display SIM ${index + 1}")
            }
            registered.forEach { it.second.states.clear(); it.second.displays.clear() }
            ScenarioRuntime.stop().await()
            registered.forEach { (_, listener) ->
                awaitState(listener, "Stopping left active listener with virtual state") {
                    it.operatorNumeric !in listOf("310260", "50501")
                }
                awaitDisplay(listener, TelephonyManager.NETWORK_TYPE_UNKNOWN, "Stopping retained display RAT")
            }
            registered.forEach { (manager, listener) -> manager.unregisterTelephonyCallback(listener) }
            registered.forEach { it.second.states.clear() }
            assertTrue(MockServiceHelper.putConfig(location, context))
            registered.forEach { (_, listener) ->
                assertNull("Unregistered listener received a callback", listener.states.poll(600, TimeUnit.MILLISECONDS))
            }
            registered.clear()
        } finally {
            try {
                registered.forEach { (manager, listener) -> runCatching { manager.unregisterTelephonyCallback(listener) } }
                ScenarioRuntime.stop().await()
                val edit = preferences.edit()
                for (key in listOf("carrierIdentityEnabled", "carrierIdentityJson")) when (val value = saved[key]) {
                    is Boolean -> edit.putBoolean(key, value)
                    is String -> edit.putString(key, value)
                    else -> edit.remove(key)
                }
                check(edit.commit())
                MockServiceHelper.putConfig(location, context)
                ScenarioRuntime.selectBackend(backend).await()
            } finally { automation.dropShellPermissionIdentity() }
        }
    }
}
```

`app/src/androidTest/java/com/system/location/service/CarrierServiceStateDeviceTest.kt`:

```kt
package com.system.location.service

import android.os.Parcel
import android.telephony.ServiceState
import com.system.location.service.core.carrier.SimCarrierProfile
import com.system.location.service.hook.hooks.telephony.CarrierServiceStateHook
import org.junit.Assert.*
import org.junit.Test

/** Device-side Android object test, independent of module activation and physical SIM presence. */
class CarrierServiceStateDeviceTest {
    private val profile = SimCarrierProfile(1, countryIso = "US", mcc = 310, mnc = 260,
        carrierName = "Test Carrier", operatorName = "Test Network")

    @Test fun identityCopyPreservesRegistrationRoamingAndOriginalObject() {
        val original = ServiceState().apply {
            state = ServiceState.STATE_OUT_OF_SERVICE
            setOperatorName("Original Long", "Original Short", "46000")
            roaming = true
        }
        val copy = CarrierServiceStateHook.copyWithIdentity(original, profile)
        assertNotSame(original, copy)
        assertEquals("Test Network", copy.operatorAlphaLong)
        assertEquals("Test Carrier", copy.operatorAlphaShort)
        assertEquals("310260", copy.operatorNumeric)
        assertEquals(original.state, copy.state)
        assertEquals(original.roaming, copy.roaming)
        assertEquals("Original Long", original.operatorAlphaLong)
        assertEquals("46000", original.operatorNumeric)
        val parcel = Parcel.obtain()
        try {
            copy.writeToParcel(parcel, 0)
            parcel.setDataPosition(0)
            val received = ServiceState.CREATOR.createFromParcel(parcel)
            assertEquals("310260", received.operatorNumeric)
            assertEquals(copy.state, received.state)
            assertEquals(copy.roaming, received.roaming)
        } finally { parcel.recycle() }
    }

    @Test fun internalRegistrationNeverRetainsOriginalCellIdentity() {
        val reflection = com.system.location.service.hook.runtime.Reflection
        val builder = reflection.newInstance(Class.forName("android.telephony.NetworkRegistrationInfo\$Builder"))
        reflection.callMethod(builder, "setDomain", 2)
        reflection.callMethod(builder, "setTransportType", 1)
        reflection.callMethod(builder, "setRegistrationState", 1)
        reflection.callMethod(builder, "setAccessNetworkTechnology", 13)
        reflection.callMethod(builder, "setRegisteredPlmn", "46000")
        val tower = com.system.location.service.core.environment.CellTower(
            com.system.location.service.core.environment.CellType.NR, 460, 0, 1234, 123456L,
            pci = 10, arfcn = 640000, rsrp = -90, registered = true, mncDigits = 2)
        val cell = com.system.location.service.hook.hooks.telephony.CellInfoSynthesis
            .buildNrResult(tower).getOrThrow() as android.telephony.CellInfoNr
        reflection.callMethod(builder, "setCellIdentity", cell.cellIdentity)
        val registration = reflection.callMethod(builder, "build")!!
        val original = ServiceState().apply {
            setOperatorName("Original", "Original", "46000")
        }
        reflection.callMethod(original, "addNetworkRegistrationInfo", registration)
        val copy = CarrierServiceStateHook.copyWithIdentity(original, profile)
        val results = reflection.callMethod(copy, "getNetworkRegistrationInfoList") as List<*>
        val item = results.first { reflection.callMethod(it, "getDomain") == 2 && reflection.callMethod(it, "getTransportType") == 1 }
        assertNull(reflection.callMethod(item, "getCellIdentity"))
        assertEquals("310260", reflection.callMethod(item, "getRegisteredPlmn"))
        assertEquals(20, reflection.callMethod(item, "getAccessNetworkTechnology"))
        val originals = reflection.callMethod(original, "getNetworkRegistrationInfoList") as List<*>
        val originalItem = originals.first { reflection.callMethod(it, "getDomain") == 2 && reflection.callMethod(it, "getTransportType") == 1 }
        assertNotNull(reflection.callMethod(originalItem, "getCellIdentity"))
        assertEquals("46000", reflection.callMethod(originalItem, "getRegisteredPlmn"))
        val protectedOnly = CarrierServiceStateHook.copyWithoutCellIdentity(original)
        assertEquals("46000", protectedOnly.operatorNumeric)
        val protectedRegistrations = reflection.callMethod(protectedOnly, "getNetworkRegistrationInfoList") as List<*>
        val protectedItem = protectedRegistrations.first {
            reflection.callMethod(it, "getDomain") == 2 && reflection.callMethod(it, "getTransportType") == 1
        }
        assertNull(reflection.callMethod(protectedItem, "getCellIdentity"))
        assertEquals(13, reflection.callMethod(protectedItem, "getAccessNetworkTechnology"))
        assertNotNull(reflection.callMethod(originalItem, "getCellIdentity"))
    }

    @Test fun virtualPacketRegistrationMatchesRadioAndSurvivesParcel() {
        val reflection = com.system.location.service.hook.runtime.Reflection
        for (slot in 1..2) for (radio in com.system.location.service.core.carrier.CarrierRadio.entries) {
            val virtual = profile.copy(slot = slot, virtual = true, radio = radio)
            val absent = ServiceState().apply { state = ServiceState.STATE_POWER_OFF }
            val created = CarrierServiceStateHook.copyWithIdentity(absent, virtual)
            val parcel = Parcel.obtain()
            try {
                created.writeToParcel(parcel, 0)
                parcel.setDataPosition(0)
                val received = ServiceState.CREATOR.createFromParcel(parcel)
                for (state in listOf(created, received)) {
                    assertEquals(ServiceState.STATE_IN_SERVICE, state.state)
                    assertEquals(ServiceState.STATE_IN_SERVICE, reflection.callMethod(state, "getDataRegistrationState"))
                    assertEquals(false, reflection.callMethod(state, "isEmergencyOnly"))
                    assertFalse(state.roaming)
                    assertEquals("310260", state.operatorNumeric)
                    val infos = reflection.callMethod(state, "getNetworkRegistrationInfoList") as List<*>
                    val ps = infos.single { reflection.callMethod(it, "getDomain") == 2 &&
                        reflection.callMethod(it, "getTransportType") == 1 }!!
                    assertEquals(true, reflection.callMethod(ps, "isRegistered"))
                    assertEquals("310260", reflection.callMethod(ps, "getRegisteredPlmn"))
                    val expectedRat = if (radio == com.system.location.service.core.carrier.CarrierRadio.NR) 20 else 13
                    assertEquals(expectedRat, reflection.callMethod(ps, "getAccessNetworkTechnology"))
                    assertEquals(expectedRat, reflection.callMethod(state, "getDataNetworkType"))
                    assertEquals(listOf(2), reflection.callMethod(ps, "getAvailableServices"))
                    assertNull(reflection.callMethod(ps, "getCellIdentity"))
                }
                assertEquals(ServiceState.STATE_POWER_OFF, absent.state)
            } finally { parcel.recycle() }
        }
    }

    @Test fun unavailableOrRedactedOperatorFieldsStayUnavailable() {
        val original = ServiceState().apply {
            state = ServiceState.STATE_POWER_OFF
            setOperatorName(null, "", null)
        }
        val copy = CarrierServiceStateHook.copyWithIdentity(original, profile)
        assertNull(copy.operatorAlphaLong)
        assertNull(copy.operatorNumeric)
        assertEquals("", copy.operatorAlphaShort)
        assertEquals(ServiceState.STATE_POWER_OFF, copy.state)
    }
}
```

`app/src/androidTest/java/com/system/location/service/CarrierStatusBarDeviceTest.kt`:

```kt
package com.system.location.service

import android.Manifest
import android.accessibilityservice.AccessibilityServiceInfo
import android.location.LocationManager
import android.os.ParcelFileDescriptor
import android.os.SystemClock
import android.telephony.SubscriptionManager
import android.view.accessibility.AccessibilityNodeInfo
import androidx.test.platform.app.InstrumentationRegistry
import com.system.location.service.core.backend.BackendType
import com.system.location.service.core.carrier.*
import com.system.location.service.core.geo.Wgs84
import com.system.location.service.core.scenario.Scenario
import com.system.location.service.ext.sharedPrefs
import com.system.location.service.runtime.ScenarioRuntime
import com.system.location.service.service.MockServiceHelper
import kotlinx.coroutines.runBlocking
import org.junit.Assert.*
import org.junit.Assume.assumeTrue
import org.junit.Test

/** Actual SystemUI text through accessibility; requires explicitly enabled SystemUI module scope. */
class CarrierStatusBarDeviceTest {
    @Test fun globalDualCarrierTextAppearsAndDisablingRemovesIt() = runBlocking {
        val instrumentation = InstrumentationRegistry.getInstrumentation()
        val context = instrumentation.targetContext
        val automation = instrumentation.uiAutomation
        val preferences = context.sharedPrefs
        val saved = preferences.all
        val previousBackend = ScenarioRuntime.state.value.backend
        val location = context.getSystemService(LocationManager::class.java)
        val originalServiceInfo = automation.serviceInfo
        val originalFlags = originalServiceInfo.flags
        automation.serviceInfo = automation.serviceInfo.apply {
            flags = flags or AccessibilityServiceInfo.FLAG_RETRIEVE_INTERACTIVE_WINDOWS
        }
        automation.adoptShellPermissionIdentity(Manifest.permission.READ_PHONE_STATE)
        fun shell(command: String) = ParcelFileDescriptor.AutoCloseInputStream(
            automation.executeShellCommand(command)).use { it.readBytes() }
        fun texts(): List<String> {
            val result = mutableListOf<String>()
            fun visit(node: AccessibilityNodeInfo?) {
                if (node == null) return
                node.text?.toString()?.let(result::add)
                node.contentDescription?.toString()?.let(result::add)
                for (index in 0 until node.childCount) visit(node.getChild(index))
            }
            automation.windows.forEach { visit(it.root) }
            return result
        }
        fun capture(label: String) {
            if (InstrumentationRegistry.getArguments().getString("capture_systemui") != "true") return
            fun dump() = String(shell("dumpsys activity service com.android.systemui/.SystemUIService NetworkController"), Charsets.UTF_8)
            var data = dump()
            if (label == "global") {
                val profiles = CarrierIdentityCodec.decode(preferences.getString("carrierIdentityJson", "")!!).sims
                val telephony = context.getSystemService(android.telephony.TelephonyManager::class.java)
                val expected = profiles.associate { profile -> profile.virtualSubscriptionId to
                    telephony.createForSubscriptionId(profile.virtualSubscriptionId).signalStrength!!.level }
                fun matches(): Boolean = expected.all { (id, level) ->
                    val block = data.substringAfter("- NetworkController.MobileSignalController($id) -----", "")
                        .substringBefore("\n      - NetworkController.")
                    level > 0 && block.lineSequence().firstOrNull { it.trim().startsWith("Current State:") }
                        ?.contains("level=$level,") == true
                }
                val until = SystemClock.elapsedRealtime() + 5000
                while (!matches() && SystemClock.elapsedRealtime() < until) {
                    Thread.sleep(200)
                    data = dump()
                }
                java.io.File(context.cacheDir, "carrier-systemui-$label.txt").writeText(data)
                assertTrue("Both SystemUI controller levels must match serving NR: $expected", matches())
            } else java.io.File(context.cacheDir, "carrier-systemui-$label.txt").writeText(data)
            java.io.File(context.cacheDir, "carrier-systemui-$label-accessibility.txt")
                .writeText(texts().joinToString("\n"))
            automation.takeScreenshot()?.let { bitmap ->
                java.io.File(context.cacheDir, "carrier-systemui-$label.png").outputStream().use {
                    check(bitmap.compress(android.graphics.Bitmap.CompressFormat.PNG, 100, it))
                }
                bitmap.recycle()
            }
        }
        fun awaitText(present: Boolean): Boolean {
            shell("cmd statusbar expand-settings")
            val deadline = SystemClock.elapsedRealtime() + 15_000
            do {
                val visible = texts().joinToString("\n")
                val first = visible.contains("Portal Alpha")
                val second = visible.contains("Portal Beta")
                if (if (present) first && second else !first && !second) return true
                Thread.sleep(500)
            } while (SystemClock.elapsedRealtime() < deadline)
            capture("text-timeout")
            System.err.println("PORTAL_CARRIER_TEXT_TIMEOUT present=$present visible=${texts().joinToString("|")}")
            return false
        }
        var fixtureStarted = false
        try {
            assumeTrue("Requires no physical SIM", context.getSystemService(SubscriptionManager::class.java)
                .activeSubscriptionInfoList.orEmpty().isEmpty())
            assertTrue(ScenarioRuntime.selectBackend(BackendType.XPOSED).await())
            fixtureStarted = true
            val config = CarrierIdentityConfig(sims = listOf(
                SimCarrierProfile(1, virtual = true, countryIso = "US", mcc = 310, mnc = 260,
                    carrierName = "Portal Alpha", nrBand = 71, nrArfcn = 127000),
                SimCarrierProfile(2, virtual = true, countryIso = "AU", mcc = 505, mnc = 1,
                    mncDigits = 2, carrierName = "Portal Beta")))
            assertTrue(preferences.edit().putBoolean("carrierIdentityEnabled", true)
                .putString("carrierIdentityJson", CarrierIdentityCodec.encode(config)).commit())
            assertTrue(ScenarioRuntime.start(Scenario(id = "carrier-statusbar", name = "Carrier statusbar",
                point = Wgs84(-33.8688, 151.2093))).await())
            assertTrue(MockServiceHelper.putConfig(location, context))
            shell("cmd statusbar expand-settings")
            assertTrue("Both simulated carrier names must be visible in SystemUI", awaitText(true))
            capture("global")
            assertTrue(preferences.edit().putString("carrierIdentityJson",
                CarrierIdentityCodec.encode(config.copy(mode = CarrierIdentityMode.PER_APP))).commit())
            assertTrue(MockServiceHelper.putConfig(location, context))
            assertTrue("PER_APP must leave SystemUI real", awaitText(false))
            assertTrue(preferences.edit().putString("carrierIdentityJson", CarrierIdentityCodec.encode(config)).commit())
            assertTrue(MockServiceHelper.putConfig(location, context))
            assertTrue("Returning to GLOBAL must restore both names", awaitText(true))
            assertTrue(preferences.edit().putBoolean("carrierIdentityEnabled", false).commit())
            assertTrue(MockServiceHelper.putConfig(location, context))
            assertTrue("Disabling must remove both simulated names", awaitText(false))
            assertTrue(preferences.edit().putBoolean("carrierIdentityEnabled", true).commit())
            assertTrue(MockServiceHelper.putConfig(location, context))
            assertTrue("Re-enabling must restore both names", awaitText(true))
            ScenarioRuntime.stop().await()
            assertTrue("Stopping the scenario must remove simulated names", awaitText(false))
            capture("stopped")
        } finally {
            try { if (fixtureStarted) {
                shell("cmd statusbar collapse")
                ScenarioRuntime.stop().await()
                val edit = preferences.edit()
                for (key in listOf("carrierIdentityEnabled", "carrierIdentityJson")) when (val value = saved[key]) {
                    is Boolean -> edit.putBoolean(key, value)
                    is String -> edit.putString(key, value)
                    else -> edit.remove(key)
                }
                check(edit.commit())
                MockServiceHelper.putConfig(location, context)
                ScenarioRuntime.selectBackend(previousBackend).await()
            } } finally {
                automation.serviceInfo = originalServiceInfo.apply { flags = originalFlags }
                automation.dropShellPermissionIdentity()
            }
        }
    }
}
```

`app/src/androidTest/java/com/system/location/service/CarrierVirtualNoSimDeviceTest.kt`:

```kt
package com.system.location.service

import android.Manifest
import android.location.LocationManager
import android.telephony.SubscriptionManager
import androidx.test.platform.app.InstrumentationRegistry
import com.system.location.service.core.backend.BackendType
import com.system.location.service.core.carrier.CarrierIdentityConfig
import com.system.location.service.core.carrier.CarrierVirtualIdentity
import com.system.location.service.core.carrier.SimCarrierProfile
import com.system.location.service.core.geo.Wgs84
import com.system.location.service.core.scenario.Scenario
import com.system.location.service.ext.sharedPrefs
import com.system.location.service.runtime.ScenarioRuntime
import com.system.location.service.service.MockServiceHelper
import kotlinx.coroutines.runBlocking
import kotlinx.serialization.json.Json
import org.junit.Assert.assertEquals
import org.junit.Assert.assertNotNull
import org.junit.Assert.assertTrue
import org.junit.Assume.assumeTrue
import org.junit.Test

/** Runs on a real no-SIM phone: virtual subscription must be visible without a physical SIM. */
class CarrierVirtualNoSimDeviceTest {
    @Test fun globalVirtualSubscriptionIsVisibleWithoutPhysicalSim() = runBlocking {
        val instrumentation = InstrumentationRegistry.getInstrumentation()
        val context = instrumentation.targetContext
        val automation = instrumentation.uiAutomation
        automation.adoptShellPermissionIdentity(Manifest.permission.READ_PHONE_STATE,
            "android.permission.READ_PRIVILEGED_PHONE_STATE")
        val preferences = context.sharedPrefs
        val originalPreferences = preferences.all
        val keys = listOf("carrierIdentityEnabled", "carrierIdentityJson")
        val previousBackend = ScenarioRuntime.state.value.backend
        val location = context.getSystemService(LocationManager::class.java)
        try {
            val subscriptions = context.getSystemService(SubscriptionManager::class.java)
            assumeTrue("Requires no active physical SIM fixture",
                subscriptions.activeSubscriptionInfoList.orEmpty().isEmpty())
            assertTrue("Requires Xposed backend", ScenarioRuntime.selectBackend(BackendType.XPOSED).await())
            val profile = SimCarrierProfile(1, virtual = true, countryIso = "US", mcc = 310,
                mnc = 260, carrierName = "T-Mobile", operatorName = "T-Mobile USA",
                nrBand = 71, nrArfcn = 127000)
            val config = CarrierIdentityConfig(sims = listOf(profile))
            assertTrue(preferences.edit().putBoolean("carrierIdentityEnabled", true)
                .putString("carrierIdentityJson", Json.encodeToString(CarrierIdentityConfig.serializer(), config))
                .commit())
            assertTrue(ScenarioRuntime.start(Scenario(
                id = "carrier-virtual-no-sim", name = "Carrier virtual no SIM",
                point = Wgs84(40.7128, -74.0060))).await())
            assertTrue(MockServiceHelper.putConfig(location, context))
            Thread.sleep(2_000)

            val active = subscriptions.activeSubscriptionInfoList.orEmpty()
            assertEquals("virtual subscription count", 1, active.size)
            val info = active.single()
            assertEquals(0, info.simSlotIndex)
            assertTrue(info.subscriptionId in 1..65535)
            assertEquals(com.system.location.service.core.carrier.CarrierIdentityCodec.decode(
                preferences.getString("carrierIdentityJson", "")!!).sims.single().virtualSubscriptionId, info.subscriptionId)
            assertEquals("T-Mobile", info.carrierName.toString())
            assertEquals("310", info.mccString)
            assertEquals("260", info.mncString)
            val persisted = com.system.location.service.core.carrier.CarrierIdentityCodec.decode(
                preferences.getString("carrierIdentityJson", "")!!).sims.single()
            assertEquals(CarrierVirtualIdentity.iccid(persisted), info.iccId)

            val snapshot = android.os.Bundle().apply {
                putString("kind", "phone")
                putInt("id", 0)
            }
            val commandAccepted = location.sendExtraCommand(
                "fused_ext",
                com.system.location.service.hook.hooks.telephony.CarrierIdentitySnapshotCommand.COMMAND,
                snapshot,
            )
            assertTrue("snapshot command rejected", commandAccepted)
            assertTrue("phone runtime did not resolve virtual profile: $snapshot",
                snapshot.containsKey(
                    com.system.location.service.hook.hooks.telephony.CarrierIdentitySnapshotCommand.PROFILE))
            // Carrier getters in an arbitrary app require the module's target-app scope. The
            // phone/system stack path is exercised by the profile snapshot and SystemUI fixture.
            System.err.println("PORTAL_VIRTUAL_SIM_READY ${info.subscriptionId}")
            Thread.sleep(8_000)
        } finally {
            try {
                ScenarioRuntime.stop().await()
                val edit = preferences.edit()
                keys.forEach { key -> when (val value = originalPreferences[key]) {
                    is Boolean -> edit.putBoolean(key, value)
                    is String -> edit.putString(key, value)
                    else -> edit.remove(key)
                } }
                check(edit.commit())
                MockServiceHelper.putConfig(location, context)
                ScenarioRuntime.selectBackend(previousBackend).await()
            } finally { automation.dropShellPermissionIdentity() }
        }
    }

    @Test fun globalVirtualSubscriptionsForBothSlots() = runBlocking {
        val instrumentation = InstrumentationRegistry.getInstrumentation()
        val context = instrumentation.targetContext
        val automation = instrumentation.uiAutomation
        automation.adoptShellPermissionIdentity(Manifest.permission.READ_PHONE_STATE,
            "android.permission.READ_PRIVILEGED_PHONE_STATE")
        val preferences = context.sharedPrefs
        val originalPreferences = preferences.all
        val keys = listOf("carrierIdentityEnabled", "carrierIdentityJson")
        val previousBackend = ScenarioRuntime.state.value.backend
        val location = context.getSystemService(LocationManager::class.java)
        try {
            val subscriptions = context.getSystemService(SubscriptionManager::class.java)
            assumeTrue("Requires no active physical SIM fixture",
                subscriptions.activeSubscriptionInfoList.orEmpty().isEmpty())
            assertTrue("Requires Xposed backend", ScenarioRuntime.selectBackend(BackendType.XPOSED).await())
            val us = SimCarrierProfile(1, virtual = true, countryIso = "US", mcc = 310,
                mnc = 260, carrierName = "T-Mobile", operatorName = "T-Mobile USA",
                nrBand = 71, nrArfcn = 127000)
            val au = SimCarrierProfile(2, virtual = true, countryIso = "AU", mcc = 505,
                mnc = 1, mncDigits = 2, carrierName = "Telstra", operatorName = "Telstra",
                nrBand = 78, nrArfcn = 640000)
            val config = CarrierIdentityConfig(sims = listOf(us, au))
            assertTrue(preferences.edit().putBoolean("carrierIdentityEnabled", true)
                .putString("carrierIdentityJson", Json.encodeToString(CarrierIdentityConfig.serializer(), config))
                .commit())
            assertTrue(ScenarioRuntime.start(Scenario(
                id = "carrier-virtual-dual-slot", name = "Carrier virtual dual slot",
                point = Wgs84(-33.8688, 151.2093))).await())
            assertTrue(MockServiceHelper.putConfig(location, context))
            Thread.sleep(2_000)

            val active = subscriptions.activeSubscriptionInfoList.orEmpty()
            assertEquals("virtual subscription count", 2, active.size)
            assertEquals(2, subscriptions.activeSubscriptionInfoCount)
            for (item in active) {
                assertTrue("Virtual subscription is not active", subscriptions.isActiveSubscriptionId(item.subscriptionId))
                assertEquals(item.simSlotIndex, SubscriptionManager.getSlotIndex(item.subscriptionId))
                assertEquals(item.subscriptionId,
                    subscriptions.getActiveSubscriptionInfoForSimSlotIndex(item.simSlotIndex)?.subscriptionId)
                assertEquals(item.simSlotIndex,
                    subscriptions.getActiveSubscriptionInfo(item.subscriptionId)?.simSlotIndex)
            }
            val first = active.first { it.simSlotIndex == 0 }
            val second = active.first { it.simSlotIndex == 1 }
            assertTrue(first.subscriptionId in 1..65535 && second.subscriptionId in 1..65535)
            assertTrue(first.subscriptionId != second.subscriptionId)
            val assignedProfiles = com.system.location.service.core.carrier.CarrierIdentityCodec.decode(
                preferences.getString("carrierIdentityJson", "")!!).sims.associateBy { it.slot }
            assertEquals(assignedProfiles.getValue(1).virtualSubscriptionId, first.subscriptionId)
            assertEquals(assignedProfiles.getValue(2).virtualSubscriptionId, second.subscriptionId)
            assertEquals("T-Mobile", first.carrierName.toString())
            assertEquals("Telstra", second.carrierName.toString())
            assertEquals("310", first.mccString)
            assertEquals("260", first.mncString)
            assertEquals("505", second.mccString)
            assertEquals("01", second.mncString)
            val persisted = com.system.location.service.core.carrier.CarrierIdentityCodec.decode(
                preferences.getString("carrierIdentityJson", "")!!).sims.associateBy { it.slot }
            assertEquals(CarrierVirtualIdentity.iccid(persisted.getValue(1)), first.iccId)
            assertEquals(CarrierVirtualIdentity.iccid(persisted.getValue(2)), second.iccId)
            automation.adoptShellPermissionIdentity(Manifest.permission.READ_PHONE_STATE)
            try {
                val redacted = subscriptions.activeSubscriptionInfoList.orEmpty()
                assertEquals(2, redacted.size)
                assertTrue("READ_PHONE_STATE must not reveal ICCID", redacted.all { it.iccId.isNullOrEmpty() })
                val reply = android.os.Bundle().apply {
                    putString("kind", "phone"); putInt("id", 0); putBoolean("identifiers", true)
                    putString("imsi", "must be removed"); putString("iccid", "must be removed")
                }
                location.sendExtraCommand("fused_ext",
                    com.system.location.service.hook.hooks.telephony.CarrierIdentitySnapshotCommand.COMMAND, reply)
                val encoded = reply.getString("profile")!!
                val publicProfile = Json.decodeFromString(SimCarrierProfile.serializer(), encoded)
                assertEquals(0L, publicProfile.identitySeed)
                assertTrue(!encoded.contains("identitySeed"))
                assertTrue(!reply.containsKey("imsi"))
                assertTrue(!reply.containsKey("iccid"))
            } finally {
                automation.adoptShellPermissionIdentity(Manifest.permission.READ_PHONE_STATE,
                    "android.permission.READ_PRIVILEGED_PHONE_STATE")
            }
            val privilegedReply = android.os.Bundle().apply {
                putString("kind", "phone"); putInt("id", 0); putBoolean("identifiers", true)
            }
            location.sendExtraCommand("fused_ext",
                com.system.location.service.hook.hooks.telephony.CarrierIdentitySnapshotCommand.COMMAND, privilegedReply)
            assertEquals(CarrierVirtualIdentity.imsi(persisted.getValue(1)), privilegedReply.getString("imsi"))
            assertEquals(CarrierVirtualIdentity.iccid(persisted.getValue(1)), privilegedReply.getString("iccid"))
            assertTrue(!privilegedReply.getString("profile")!!.contains("identitySeed"))
            privilegedReply.putBoolean("identifiers", false)
            location.sendExtraCommand("fused_ext",
                com.system.location.service.hook.hooks.telephony.CarrierIdentitySnapshotCommand.COMMAND, privilegedReply)
            assertTrue(!privilegedReply.containsKey("imsi") && !privilegedReply.containsKey("iccid"))
            if (androidx.test.platform.app.InstrumentationRegistry.getArguments().getString("direct_subscriber") == "true") {
                val serviceManager = Class.forName("android.os.ServiceManager")
                val binder = serviceManager.getMethod("getService", String::class.java).invoke(null, "iphonesubinfo")
                assertNotNull("IPhoneSubInfo binder must exist", binder)
                val stub = Class.forName("com.android.internal.telephony.IPhoneSubInfo\$Stub")
                val remote = stub.getMethod("asInterface", android.os.IBinder::class.java).invoke(null, binder)
                fun readIdentifier(name: String, id: Int): String? {
                    val method = remote.javaClass.methods.single { it.name == name && it.parameterCount == 3 }
                    return try { method.invoke(remote, id, context.packageName, null) as? String }
                    catch (failure: java.lang.reflect.InvocationTargetException) { throw failure.targetException }
                }
                for (item in active) {
                    val expected = persisted.getValue(item.simSlotIndex + 1)
                    assertEquals(CarrierVirtualIdentity.imsi(expected),
                        readIdentifier("getSubscriberIdForSubscriber", item.subscriptionId))
                    assertEquals(CarrierVirtualIdentity.iccid(expected),
                        readIdentifier("getIccSerialNumberForSubscriber", item.subscriptionId))
                }
                val phoneBinder = serviceManager.getMethod("getService", String::class.java).invoke(null, "phone")
                val phoneStub = Class.forName("com.android.internal.telephony.ITelephony\$Stub")
                val phone = phoneStub.getMethod("asInterface", android.os.IBinder::class.java).invoke(null, phoneBinder)
                for (item in active) {
                    val expected = persisted.getValue(item.simSlotIndex + 1)
                    for (name in listOf("getSubscriptionCarrierId", "getSubscriptionSpecificCarrierId")) {
                        assertEquals(CarrierVirtualIdentity.carrierId(expected), phone.javaClass.getMethod(name,
                            Int::class.javaPrimitiveType).invoke(phone, item.subscriptionId))
                    }
                    for (name in listOf("getSubscriptionCarrierName", "getSubscriptionSpecificCarrierName")) {
                        assertEquals(expected.carrierName, phone.javaClass.getMethod(name,
                            Int::class.javaPrimitiveType).invoke(phone, item.subscriptionId)?.toString())
                    }
                }
                automation.adoptShellPermissionIdentity(Manifest.permission.READ_PHONE_STATE)
                try {
                    for (name in listOf("getSubscriberIdForSubscriber", "getIccSerialNumberForSubscriber")) {
                        try {
                            assertTrue("Direct binder leaked $name without privileged permission",
                                readIdentifier(name, first.subscriptionId).isNullOrEmpty())
                        } catch (_: SecurityException) { /* Platform rejection remains intact. */ }
                    }
                } finally {
                    automation.adoptShellPermissionIdentity(Manifest.permission.READ_PHONE_STATE,
                        "android.permission.READ_PRIVILEGED_PHONE_STATE")
                }
            }
            System.err.println("PORTAL_VIRTUAL_DUAL_SLOT_READY ${first.subscriptionId} ${second.subscriptionId}")
            val seeded = com.system.location.service.core.carrier.CarrierIdentityCodec.decode(
                preferences.getString("carrierIdentityJson", "")!!)
            fun applyIdentity(next: com.system.location.service.core.carrier.CarrierIdentityConfig) {
                check(preferences.edit().putString("carrierIdentityJson",
                    com.system.location.service.core.carrier.CarrierIdentityCodec.encode(next)).commit())
                assertTrue(MockServiceHelper.putConfig(location, context))
            }
            fun awaitIds(ids: Set<Int>) {
                val until = android.os.SystemClock.elapsedRealtime() + 5000
                while ((subscriptions.activeSubscriptionInfoList.orEmpty().map { it.subscriptionId }.toSet() != ids ||
                    subscriptions.activeSubscriptionInfoCount != ids.size) &&
                    android.os.SystemClock.elapsedRealtime() < until) Thread.sleep(100)
                assertEquals(ids, subscriptions.activeSubscriptionInfoList.orEmpty().map { it.subscriptionId }.toSet())
                assertEquals(ids.size, subscriptions.activeSubscriptionInfoCount)
            }
            val unlisted = seeded.copy(mode = com.system.location.service.core.carrier.CarrierIdentityMode.PER_APP,
                appRoutes = emptyList())
            applyIdentity(unlisted)
            awaitIds(emptySet())
            val hidden = android.os.Bundle().apply { putString("kind", "phone"); putInt("id", 1) }
            location.sendExtraCommand("fused_ext",
                com.system.location.service.hook.hooks.telephony.CarrierIdentitySnapshotCommand.COMMAND, hidden)
            assertTrue("Unlisted caller received a virtual profile", !hidden.containsKey("profile"))
            val simTwoOnly = unlisted.copy(appRoutes = listOf(com.system.location.service.core.carrier.CarrierAppRoute(
                context.packageName, com.system.location.service.core.carrier.CarrierTarget.SIM2)))
            applyIdentity(simTwoOnly)
            awaitIds(setOf(second.subscriptionId))
            assertEquals(second.subscriptionId, subscriptions.getActiveSubscriptionInfoForSimSlotIndex(1)?.subscriptionId)
            val selected = android.os.Bundle().apply { putString("kind", "phone"); putInt("id", 0) }
            location.sendExtraCommand("fused_ext",
                com.system.location.service.hook.hooks.telephony.CarrierIdentitySnapshotCommand.COMMAND, selected)
            val selectedProfile = Json.decodeFromString(SimCarrierProfile.serializer(), selected.getString("profile")!!)
            assertEquals(2, selectedProfile.slot)
            assertEquals("50501", selectedProfile.operatorNumeric)
            val real = unlisted.copy(appRoutes = listOf(com.system.location.service.core.carrier.CarrierAppRoute(
                context.packageName, com.system.location.service.core.carrier.CarrierTarget.REAL)))
            applyIdentity(real)
            awaitIds(emptySet())
            applyIdentity(seeded)
            awaitIds(setOf(first.subscriptionId, second.subscriptionId))
            val physicalOnlySecond = seeded.copy(sims = seeded.sims.map {
                if (it.slot == 2) it.copy(virtual = false) else it
            })
            check(preferences.edit().putString("carrierIdentityJson",
                com.system.location.service.core.carrier.CarrierIdentityCodec.encode(physicalOnlySecond)).commit())
            assertTrue(MockServiceHelper.putConfig(location, context))
            val removalDeadline = android.os.SystemClock.elapsedRealtime() + 5_000L
            while (subscriptions.activeSubscriptionInfoList.orEmpty().size != 1 &&
                android.os.SystemClock.elapsedRealtime() < removalDeadline) Thread.sleep(100)
            assertEquals(listOf(first.subscriptionId), subscriptions.activeSubscriptionInfoList.orEmpty().map { it.subscriptionId })
            assertEquals(1, subscriptions.activeSubscriptionInfoCount)
            assertTrue(!subscriptions.isActiveSubscriptionId(second.subscriptionId))
            assertEquals(SubscriptionManager.INVALID_SIM_SLOT_INDEX, SubscriptionManager.getSlotIndex(second.subscriptionId))
            val allPhysicalOnly = physicalOnlySecond.copy(sims = physicalOnlySecond.sims.map { it.copy(virtual = false) })
            check(preferences.edit().putString("carrierIdentityJson",
                com.system.location.service.core.carrier.CarrierIdentityCodec.encode(allPhysicalOnly)).commit())
            assertTrue(MockServiceHelper.putConfig(location, context))
            val emptyDeadline = android.os.SystemClock.elapsedRealtime() + 5_000L
            while (subscriptions.activeSubscriptionInfoList.orEmpty().isNotEmpty() &&
                android.os.SystemClock.elapsedRealtime() < emptyDeadline) Thread.sleep(100)
            assertTrue(subscriptions.activeSubscriptionInfoList.orEmpty().isEmpty())
            assertEquals(0, subscriptions.activeSubscriptionInfoCount)
            assertEquals("no_active_sim", MockServiceHelper.carrierIdentityStatus)
        } finally {
            try {
                ScenarioRuntime.stop().await()
                val edit = preferences.edit()
                keys.forEach { key -> when (val value = originalPreferences[key]) {
                    is Boolean -> edit.putBoolean(key, value)
                    is String -> edit.putString(key, value)
                    else -> edit.remove(key)
                } }
                check(edit.commit())
                MockServiceHelper.putConfig(location, context)
                ScenarioRuntime.selectBackend(previousBackend).await()
            } finally { automation.dropShellPermissionIdentity() }
        }
    }
}
```
