`app/src/androidTest/java/com/system/location/service/CarrierVirtualSubscriptionObjectTest.kt`:

```kt
package com.system.location.service

import android.os.Parcel
import android.telephony.SubscriptionInfo
import com.system.location.service.core.carrier.SimCarrierProfile
import org.junit.Assert.*
import org.junit.Test

/** Requires host-side temporary hidden API access, as do the other platform object tests. */
class CarrierVirtualSubscriptionObjectTest {
    @Test fun platformBuilderProducesCompleteCopyableAndParcelableSubscriptions() {
        val type = Class.forName("com.system.location.service.hook.hooks.telephony.CarrierVirtualSubscription")
        val instance = type.getField("INSTANCE").get(null)
        val method = type.getDeclaredMethod("info", SimCarrierProfile::class.java)
        for (slot in 1..2) {
            val profile = SimCarrierProfile(slot, virtual = true, countryIso = "AU", mcc = 505,
                mnc = 1, mncDigits = 2, carrierName = "Test AU")
            val info = method.invoke(instance, profile) as? SubscriptionInfo
            assertNotNull("Builder must produce a complete subscription", info)
            val parcel = Parcel.obtain()
            try {
                info!!.writeToParcel(parcel, 0)
                parcel.setDataPosition(0)
                val copy = SubscriptionInfo.CREATOR.createFromParcel(parcel)
                assertEquals(info, copy)
                assertEquals(info.hashCode(), copy.hashCode())
                assertEquals(slot - 1, copy.simSlotIndex)
                assertEquals("505", copy.mccString)
                assertEquals("01", copy.mncString)
                assertEquals("au", copy.countryIso)
                assertEquals("Test AU", copy.carrierName.toString())
                assertNotNull(copy.toString())
                val builder = Class.forName("android.telephony.SubscriptionInfo\$Builder")
                    .getConstructor(SubscriptionInfo::class.java).newInstance(copy)
                assertEquals(copy, builder.javaClass.getMethod("build").invoke(builder))
            } finally { parcel.recycle() }
        }
    }
}
```

```kt
package com.system.location.service

/** Run on a compact viewport, including the device's actual native map and dialog windows. */
@RunWith(AndroidJUnit4::class)
class CompactLayoutUiTest {
    @get:Rule val compose = createEmptyComposeRule()

    @Test fun numericSettingsAndRouteMapRemainReachableWithLargeTextOnSmallScreen() {
        val config = InstrumentationRegistry.getInstrumentation().targetContext.resources.configuration
```

`app/src/androidTest/java/com/system/location/service/ComposeUiFixture.kt`:

```kt
package com.system.location.service

import android.Manifest
import android.view.View
import android.view.ViewGroup
import androidx.compose.ui.test.SemanticsMatcher
import androidx.compose.ui.test.SemanticsNodeInteraction
import androidx.compose.ui.test.hasScrollToNodeAction
import androidx.compose.ui.test.hasText
import androidx.compose.ui.test.junit4.ComposeTestRule
import androidx.compose.ui.test.onNodeWithText
import androidx.compose.ui.test.performScrollToNode
import androidx.navigation.findNavController
import androidx.test.core.app.ActivityScenario
import androidx.test.platform.app.InstrumentationRegistry
import com.system.location.service.maps.MapProvider
import com.system.location.service.maps.mapProvider
import com.system.location.service.privacy.SdkPrivacy
import com.system.location.service.privacy.TencentPrivacy

/** ActivityScenario owns launch/recreation; the empty Compose rule only synchronizes semantics. */
internal fun ComposeTestRule.openPage(scenario: ActivityScenario<MainActivity>, destination: Int) {
    waitForIdle()
    scenario.onActivity { it.findNavController(R.id.nav_host_fragment_content_main).navigate(destination) }
    // Compose idleness alone does not await Fragment's seekable View transitions.
    waitUntil(5_000) {
        var ready = false
        scenario.onActivity { activity ->
            val host = activity.supportFragmentManager.findFragmentById(R.id.nav_host_fragment_content_main)
            ready = activity.findNavController(R.id.nav_host_fragment_content_main).currentDestination?.id == destination &&
                host?.childFragmentManager?.primaryNavigationFragment?.lifecycle?.currentState == androidx.lifecycle.Lifecycle.State.RESUMED
        }
        ready
    }
    waitForIdle()
    if (destination == R.id.nav_route_gallery) {
        waitUntil(10_000) {
            var ready = false
            scenario.onActivity { activity ->
                val host = activity.supportFragmentManager.findFragmentById(R.id.nav_host_fragment_content_main)
                val page = host?.childFragmentManager?.primaryNavigationFragment
                if (page != null) {
                    val model = androidx.lifecycle.ViewModelProvider(page)[com.system.location.service.ui.viewmodel.LibraryViewModel::class.java]
                    ready = !model.state.value.busy && model.state.value.items.size == when (model.state.value.kind) {
                        com.system.location.service.ui.viewmodel.LibraryKind.ROUTES -> com.system.location.service.data.repository.LibraryRepositories.routes.list().size
                        com.system.location.service.ui.viewmodel.LibraryKind.SCENARIOS -> com.system.location.service.data.repository.LibraryRepositories.scenarios.list().size
                        com.system.location.service.ui.viewmodel.LibraryKind.LOCATIONS -> com.system.location.service.data.repository.LibraryRepositories.locations.list().size
                    }
                }
            }
            ready
        }
        waitForIdle()
    }
}

/** Search the LazyColumn, including items that have not been composed yet. */
internal fun ComposeTestRule.scrollTo(matcher: SemanticsMatcher): SemanticsNodeInteraction {
    waitUntil(5_000) {
        runCatching { onAllNodes(hasScrollToNodeAction()).fetchSemanticsNodes().isNotEmpty() }.getOrDefault(false)
    }
    onNode(hasScrollToNodeAction()).performScrollToNode(matcher)
    return onNode(matcher)
}

internal fun ComposeTestRule.scrollToText(text: String, substring: Boolean = false) =
    scrollTo(hasText(text, substring = substring))

/** Explicit fixture consent follows the saved provider, including the fresh-install default. */
internal fun acceptSelectedMapForUiTest() {
    val instrumentation = InstrumentationRegistry.getInstrumentation()
    val context = instrumentation.targetContext
    instrumentation.runOnMainSync {
        when (context.mapProvider) {
            MapProvider.TENCENT -> TencentPrivacy.accept(context)
            MapProvider.AMAP -> SdkPrivacy.acceptMaps()
        }
    }
}

internal fun grantUiPermissions() {
    val instrumentation = InstrumentationRegistry.getInstrumentation()
    listOf(Manifest.permission.ACCESS_COARSE_LOCATION, Manifest.permission.ACCESS_FINE_LOCATION,
        Manifest.permission.POST_NOTIFICATIONS).forEach {
        if (androidx.core.content.ContextCompat.checkSelfPermission(instrumentation.targetContext, it) != android.content.pm.PackageManager.PERMISSION_GRANTED) {
            instrumentation.uiAutomation.grantRuntimePermission(instrumentation.targetContext.packageName, it)
        }
    }
}

/** SDK surfaces intentionally remain Views, and no longer have XML layout IDs in Compose. */
internal inline fun <reified T : View> View.descendantsOfType(): List<T> {
    val pending = ArrayDeque<View>()
    val found = mutableListOf<T>()
    pending.add(this)
    while (pending.isNotEmpty()) {
        val next = pending.removeFirst()
        if (next is T) found.add(next)
        if (next is ViewGroup) for (index in 0 until next.childCount) pending.add(next.getChildAt(index))
    }
    return found
}
```

```kt
    @Test fun edgeSwipeBackSelectionAndRecreationKeepNavigationState() {

        ActivityScenario.launch(MainActivity::class.java).use { scenario ->
            compose.onNodeWithContentDescription("打开菜单").assertIsDisplayed()
            fun drawer(open: Boolean) {
                compose.waitForIdle()
                compose.waitUntil(5_000) {
                    var matches = false
                    scenario.onActivity {
                        matches = if (open) it.drawerState.isOpen
                            else !(it.drawerState.isOpen || it.drawerState.isAnimationRunning)
                    }
                    matches
                }
            }
            compose.onNodeWithTag("portal_shell").performTouchInput {
                swipe(start = androidx.compose.ui.geometry.Offset(4f, centerY),
                    end = androidx.compose.ui.geometry.Offset(width * .75f, centerY), durationMillis = 600)
            }
            drawer(true)
            captureUi("drawer-home-selection")
            scenario.onActivity { it.onBackPressedDispatcher.onBackPressed() }
            drawer(false)
            compose.onNodeWithText("开始模拟").assertIsDisplayed()

            compose.onNodeWithContentDescription("打开菜单").performClick()
            drawer(true)
            compose.onNodeWithText("设置").performClick()
            drawer(false)
            compose.onNodeWithText("地图与定位").performClick()
            compose.waitUntil(5_000) {
                runCatching { compose.onNodeWithText("定位精度").assertIsDisplayed(); true }.getOrDefault(false)
            }
            compose.onNodeWithText("定位精度").assertIsDisplayed()
            scenario.recreate()
            compose.onNodeWithText("定位精度").assertIsDisplayed()
            scenario.onActivity {
                assertTrue((it.selectedDrawerId == R.id.nav_settings))
                it.onSupportNavigateUp()
            }
            compose.waitUntil(5_000) {
                runCatching { compose.onNodeWithText("地图与定位").assertIsDisplayed(); true }.getOrDefault(false)
            }
            compose.onNodeWithText("地图与定位").assertIsDisplayed()
            scenario.onActivity { it.openDrawer() }
            drawer(true)
            scenario.recreate()
            drawer(true)
            captureUi("drawer-settings-selection-restored")
            scenario.onActivity { it.onBackPressedDispatcher.onBackPressed() }
            drawer(false)
            scenario.onActivity {
                assertEquals(R.id.nav_settings, it.findNavController(R.id.nav_host_fragment_content_main).currentDestination?.id)
            }
        }
```

`app/src/androidTest/java/com/system/location/service/DrawerModeUiTest.kt`:

```kt
package com.system.location.service

import androidx.compose.ui.semantics.SemanticsActions
import androidx.compose.ui.semantics.SemanticsProperties
import androidx.compose.ui.graphics.toPixelMap
import androidx.compose.ui.test.*
import androidx.compose.ui.test.junit4.v2.createEmptyComposeRule
import androidx.core.view.GravityCompat
import androidx.test.core.app.ActivityScenario
import androidx.test.ext.junit.runners.AndroidJUnit4
import androidx.test.platform.app.InstrumentationRegistry
import com.system.location.service.core.backend.BackendType
import com.system.location.service.runtime.ScenarioRuntime
import kotlinx.coroutines.runBlocking
import org.junit.Assert.*
import org.junit.Rule
import org.junit.Test
import org.junit.runner.RunWith

@RunWith(AndroidJUnit4::class)
class DrawerModeUiTest {
    @get:Rule val compose = createEmptyComposeRule()

    @Test fun sliderSelectsThreeModesAndNativeRequiresExplicitConfirmationAcrossRecreation() {
        acceptSelectedMapForUiTest()
        grantUiPermissions()
        assertFalse(ScenarioRuntime.state.value.isActive)
        val original = ScenarioRuntime.state.value.backend
        val preferences = InstrumentationRegistry.getInstrumentation().targetContext.getSharedPreferences("scenario_runtime", 0)
        val hadOptIn = preferences.contains("native_opt_in")
        val optIn = preferences.getBoolean("native_opt_in", false)
        fun select(position: Float) {
            compose.onNodeWithTag("drawer-mode-slider").assertIsEnabled()
                .performSemanticsAction(SemanticsActions.SetProgress) { it(position) }
        }
        fun awaitBackend(backend: BackendType) {
            compose.waitUntil(10_000) {
                if (!compose.mainClock.autoAdvance) compose.mainClock.advanceTimeByFrame()
                ScenarioRuntime.state.value.backend == backend
            }
            assertFalse("Quick selection must never start a scenario", ScenarioRuntime.state.value.isActive)
        }
        try {
            assertTrue(runBlocking { ScenarioRuntime.selectBackend(BackendType.MOCK_PROVIDER).await() })
            ActivityScenario.launch(MainActivity::class.java).use { scenario ->
                scenario.onActivity { it.openDrawer() }
                select(1f)
                awaitBackend(BackendType.XPOSED)
                select(2f)
                compose.onNodeWithText("实验性模式风险须知").assertIsDisplayed()
                assertEquals(BackendType.XPOSED, ScenarioRuntime.state.value.backend)
                scenario.recreate()
                compose.onNodeWithText("实验性模式风险须知").assertIsDisplayed()
                compose.onNodeWithText("取消").performClick()
                compose.onNodeWithTag("drawer-mode-slider").assertIsDisplayed()
                assertEquals(1f, compose.onNodeWithTag("drawer-mode-slider").fetchSemanticsNode()
                    .config[SemanticsProperties.ProgressBarRangeInfo].current)
                select(2f)
                compose.onNodeWithText("已知悉并选择").assertIsDisplayed()
                compose.mainClock.autoAdvance = false
                compose.onNodeWithText("已知悉并选择").performClick()
                awaitBackend(BackendType.NATIVE)
                compose.waitForIdle()
                compose.mainClock.advanceTimeBy(600)
                compose.onNodeWithText("MAX").assertDoesNotExist()
                compose.onNodeWithText("快速模式").assertDoesNotExist()
                compose.onNodeWithTag("drawer-mode-slider").assertIsDisplayed()
                captureUi("drawer-native-mode")
                // Still changing well after the old two-sweep animation would have finished.
                compose.mainClock.advanceTimeBy(4_000)
                val first = compose.onNodeWithTag("drawer-mode-slider").captureToImage().toPixelMap()
                compose.mainClock.advanceTimeBy(400)
                val second = compose.onNodeWithTag("drawer-mode-slider").captureToImage().toPixelMap()
                val changed = (0 until first.width step 3).sumOf { x ->
                    (0 until first.height step 3).count { y -> first[x, y] != second[x, y] }
                }
                assertTrue("Native track must keep animating", changed > 10)
                captureUi("drawer-native-energy-loop")
                compose.mainClock.autoAdvance = true
                select(0f)
                awaitBackend(BackendType.MOCK_PROVIDER)
                assertTrue(runBlocking { ScenarioRuntime.selectBackend(BackendType.XPOSED).await() })
                compose.waitForIdle()
                assertEquals(1f, compose.onNodeWithTag("drawer-mode-slider").fetchSemanticsNode()
                    .config[SemanticsProperties.ProgressBarRangeInfo].current)
            }
        } finally {
            compose.mainClock.autoAdvance = true
            assertTrue(runBlocking { ScenarioRuntime.selectBackend(original).await() })
            preferences.edit().apply {
                if (hadOptIn) putBoolean("native_opt_in", optIn) else remove("native_opt_in")
            }.commit()
        }
    }
}
```

`app/src/androidTest/java/com/system/location/service/EnvironmentDraftDeviceTest.kt`:

```kt
package com.system.location.service

import android.app.Application
import androidx.compose.ui.test.junit4.v2.createEmptyComposeRule
import androidx.lifecycle.SavedStateHandle
import androidx.lifecycle.viewModelScope
import androidx.test.ext.junit.runners.AndroidJUnit4
import androidx.test.platform.app.InstrumentationRegistry
import com.system.location.service.core.environment.*
import com.system.location.service.environment.EnvironmentStore
import com.system.location.service.ui.environment.EnvironmentEditorViewModel
import kotlinx.coroutines.cancel
import org.junit.Assert.*
import org.junit.Rule
import org.junit.Test
import org.junit.runner.RunWith
import java.io.File

@RunWith(AndroidJUnit4::class)
class EnvironmentDraftDeviceTest {
    @get:Rule val compose = createEmptyComposeRule()

    @Test fun largeDraftRestoresFromCacheWithoutPuttingThePayloadInSavedState() {
        val instrumentation = InstrumentationRegistry.getInstrumentation()
        val app = instrumentation.targetContext.applicationContext as Application
        val handle = SavedStateHandle()
        lateinit var first: EnvironmentEditorViewModel
        var second: EnvironmentEditorViewModel? = null
        instrumentation.runOnMainSync { first = EnvironmentEditorViewModel(app, handle) }
        val drafts = EnvironmentStore(File(app.cacheDir, "environment-editor-drafts"))
        val key = handle.get<String>("draftName")!!
        try {
            compose.waitUntil(5_000) { first.state.value.profile != null }
            val profile = first.state.value.profile!!.copy(wifi = listOf(
                WifiAp("large-draft", "A4:50:46:12:34:56", -60, 2412, 1, capabilities = "x".repeat(700_000)),
            ))
            instrumentation.runOnMainSync { first.update(profile) }
            compose.waitUntil(10_000) { key in drafts.list() && drafts.load(key) == profile }
            val snapshot = handle.keys().associateWith { handle.get<Any>(it) }
            assertTrue(snapshot.values.filterIsInstance<String>().all { it.length < 100 })
            instrumentation.runOnMainSync { second = EnvironmentEditorViewModel(app, SavedStateHandle(snapshot)) }
            compose.waitUntil(5_000) { second!!.state.value.profile != null }
            assertEquals(profile, second!!.state.value.profile)
        } finally {
            instrumentation.runOnMainSync { first.viewModelScope.cancel(); second?.viewModelScope?.cancel() }
            drafts.delete(key)
        }
    }
}
```

```kt
                compose.onNodeWithText("环境").assertIsSelected()

                assertEquals(1, profile.ble.size)
                assertEquals(1, profile.cells.size)

                assertEquals(30.0, profile.origin!!.latitude, 0.0)
                assertEquals(10.0, profile.originAccuracyMeters!!, 0.0)
                scenario.recreate()

                compose.onNodeWithText("搜索已保存环境").performTextInput(name)
```

```kt
package com.system.location.service

import androidx.compose.ui.test.*
import androidx.compose.ui.test.junit4.v2.createEmptyComposeRule
import androidx.test.core.app.ActivityScenario
import androidx.test.ext.junit.runners.AndroidJUnit4
import androidx.test.platform.app.InstrumentationRegistry
import com.system.location.service.core.environment.EnvironmentProfile
import com.system.location.service.core.environment.EnvironmentSourceType
import com.system.location.service.environment.EnvironmentStore
import org.junit.Assert.*
import org.junit.Rule
import org.junit.Test
import org.junit.runner.RunWith
import java.io.File
import java.util.UUID

@RunWith(AndroidJUnit4::class)
class EnvironmentLibraryUiTest {
    @get:Rule val compose = createEmptyComposeRule()
    private val context get() = InstrumentationRegistry.getInstrumentation().targetContext
    private fun profile() = EnvironmentProfile(source = EnvironmentSourceType.REPLAY,
        generatedAtMillis = 1, seed = 42)

    @Test fun searchAndRenameDraftSurviveRecreationAndDeleteRequiresConfirmation() {
        acceptSelectedMapForUiTest()
        grantUiPermissions()
        val store = EnvironmentStore(context)
        val name = "ui-library-${UUID.randomUUID()}"
        val renamed = "$name-new"
        try {
            store.save(name, profile())
            ActivityScenario.launch(MainActivity::class.java).use { scenario ->
                compose.openPage(scenario, R.id.nav_environment_library)
                compose.onNodeWithText("搜索已保存环境").performTextInput(name)
                compose.waitUntil(10_000) { compose.onAllNodes(hasText(name) and hasClickAction() and hasSetTextAction().not()).fetchSemanticsNodes().isNotEmpty() }
                scenario.recreate()
                compose.onNodeWithText("搜索已保存环境").assertTextContains(name)
                compose.waitUntil(10_000) { compose.onAllNodes(hasText(name) and hasClickAction() and hasSetTextAction().not()).fetchSemanticsNodes().isNotEmpty() }
                compose.onNode(hasText(name) and hasClickAction() and hasSetTextAction().not()).performClick()
                compose.onNodeWithText("重命名").performClick()
                compose.onNodeWithText("环境名称").performTextReplacement(renamed)
                scenario.recreate()
                compose.onNodeWithText("环境名称").assertTextContains(renamed)
                compose.onNodeWithText("保存").performClick()
                compose.waitUntil(10_000) { renamed in store.list() }
                compose.waitUntil(10_000) { compose.onAllNodes(hasText(renamed) and hasClickAction() and hasSetTextAction().not()).fetchSemanticsNodes().isNotEmpty() }
                compose.onNode(hasText(renamed) and hasClickAction() and hasSetTextAction().not()).performClick()
                compose.onNodeWithText("删除").assertIsDisplayed()
                android.os.SystemClock.sleep(350)
                captureUi("environment-action-icons")
                compose.onNodeWithText("删除").performClick()
                compose.onNodeWithText("确认删除").assertIsDisplayed()
                android.os.SystemClock.sleep(350)
                captureUi("environment-delete-confirmation")
                compose.onNodeWithText("取消").performClick()
                assertTrue(renamed in store.list())
                compose.onNode(hasText(renamed) and hasClickAction() and hasSetTextAction().not()).performClick()
                compose.onNodeWithText("删除").performClick()
                compose.onNodeWithText("确认删除").performClick()
                compose.waitUntil(10_000) { renamed !in store.list() }
                compose.waitUntil(10_000) { compose.onAllNodesWithText("没有符合条件的环境").fetchSemanticsNodes().isNotEmpty() ||
                    compose.onAllNodesWithText("还没有保存环境").fetchSemanticsNodes().isNotEmpty() }
                // Compose idleness does not wait for the platform dialog window to disappear.
                android.os.SystemClock.sleep(350)
                captureUi("environment-empty-state")
            }
        } finally { store.delete(name); store.delete(renamed) }
    }

    @Test fun unreadableListShowsRetryAndRecoversWithoutReplacingFiles() {
        acceptSelectedMapForUiTest()
        grantUiPermissions()
        val directory = File(context.filesDir, "environment")
        val backup = File(context.filesDir, "environment-ui-backup-${UUID.randomUUID()}")
        val existed = directory.exists()
        if (existed) assertTrue(directory.renameTo(backup))
        val name = "ui-library-retry"
        try {
            directory.writeText("blocked directory")
            ActivityScenario.launch(MainActivity::class.java).use { scenario ->
                compose.openPage(scenario, R.id.nav_environment_library)
                compose.waitUntil(10_000) { compose.onAllNodesWithText("重新加载").fetchSemanticsNodes().isNotEmpty() }
                compose.onNodeWithText("还没有保存环境").assertDoesNotExist()
                assertEquals("blocked directory", directory.readText())
                assertTrue(directory.delete())
                EnvironmentStore(context).save(name, profile())
                compose.onNodeWithText("重新加载").performClick()
                compose.waitUntil(10_000) { compose.onAllNodes(hasText(name) and hasClickAction() and hasSetTextAction().not()).fetchSemanticsNodes().isNotEmpty() }
                captureUi("environment-library-search")
            }
        } finally {
            if (directory.isDirectory) { EnvironmentStore(context).delete(name); assertTrue(directory.delete()) }
            else if (directory.exists()) assertTrue(directory.delete())
            if (existed) assertTrue(backup.renameTo(directory))
        }
    }
}
```

`app/src/androidTest/java/com/system/location/service/GnssBinderTestService.java`:

```java
package com.system.location.service;

import android.app.Service;
import android.content.Intent;
import android.os.Binder;
import android.os.IBinder;
import android.os.Parcel;
import android.os.Process;
import java.util.ArrayList;
import java.util.List;
import java.util.concurrent.CountDownLatch;
import java.util.concurrent.TimeUnit;

/** Test APK remote processes do not inherit the target APK's Kotlin runtime. */
public final class GnssBinderTestService extends Service {
    public static final String DESCRIPTOR = "Portal.GnssBinderTest";
    public static final int SUBMIT = IBinder.FIRST_CALL_TRANSACTION;
    public static final int WAIT_ENTERED = SUBMIT + 1;
    public static final int RELEASE = SUBMIT + 2;
    public static final int READ = SUBMIT + 3;
    public static final int PID = SUBMIT + 4;
    public static final int DIE = SUBMIT + 5;
    private final CountDownLatch entered = new CountDownLatch(1);
    private final CountDownLatch release = new CountDownLatch(1);
    private final List<Integer> accepted = new ArrayList<>();
    private final IBinder endpoint = new Binder() {
        @Override protected boolean onTransact(int code, Parcel data, Parcel reply, int flags)
                throws android.os.RemoteException {
            if (code < SUBMIT || code > DIE) return super.onTransact(code, data, reply, flags);
            data.enforceInterface(DESCRIPTOR);
            switch (code) {
                case SUBMIT:
                    int index = data.readInt();
                    boolean block = data.readInt() != 0;
                    synchronized (accepted) { accepted.add(index); }
                    if (block) {
                        entered.countDown();
                        if (!await(release, 10)) throw new IllegalStateException("Transaction was not released");
                    }
                    reply.writeNoException();
                    break;
                case WAIT_ENTERED:
                    boolean observed = await(entered, 3);
                    reply.writeNoException();
                    reply.writeInt(observed ? 1 : 0);
                    break;
                case RELEASE:
                    release.countDown();
                    reply.writeNoException();
                    break;
                case READ:
                    synchronized (accepted) {
                        int[] values = new int[accepted.size()];
                        for (int i = 0; i < values.length; i++) values[i] = accepted.get(i);
                        reply.writeNoException();
                        reply.writeIntArray(values);
                    }
                    break;
                case PID:
                    reply.writeNoException();
                    reply.writeInt(Process.myPid());
                    break;
                case DIE:
                    Process.killProcess(Process.myPid()); // one-way; no reply is awaited
                    break;
            }
            return true;
        }
    };
    private static boolean await(CountDownLatch latch, int seconds) {
        try { return latch.await(seconds, TimeUnit.SECONDS); }
        catch (InterruptedException error) { Thread.currentThread().interrupt(); throw new IllegalStateException(error); }
    }
    @Override public IBinder onBind(Intent intent) { return endpoint; }
    @Override public void onDestroy() { release.countDown(); super.onDestroy(); }
}
```

`app/src/androidTest/java/com/system/location/service/GnssCaptureIsolationDeviceTest.kt`:

```kt
package com.system.location.service

import android.Manifest
import android.content.ContextWrapper
import android.content.pm.PackageManager
import android.location.LocationManager
import android.os.SystemClock
import androidx.test.ext.junit.runners.AndroidJUnit4
import androidx.test.platform.app.InstrumentationRegistry
import com.system.location.service.core.geo.Wgs84
import com.system.location.service.core.gnss.GnssCaptureCodec
import com.system.location.service.core.gnss.GnssCaptureStore
import com.system.location.service.core.gnss.GnssCaptureValidator
import com.system.location.service.core.location.LocationSample
import com.system.location.service.gnss.GnssReceiverCollector
import com.system.location.service.gnss.GnssCaptureRepository
import com.system.location.service.runtime.ScenarioRuntime
import com.system.location.service.service.MockServiceHelper
import kotlinx.coroutines.CompletableDeferred
import kotlinx.coroutines.Dispatchers
import kotlinx.coroutines.async
import kotlinx.coroutines.cancelAndJoin
import kotlinx.coroutines.runBlocking
import kotlinx.coroutines.withContext
import kotlinx.coroutines.withTimeout
import org.junit.Assert.*
import org.junit.Assume.*
import org.junit.Before
import org.junit.Test
import org.junit.runner.RunWith
import java.io.File
import java.nio.file.Files

/** Opt-in system-server checks. Never save fixture data or change the user's backend/settings. */
@RunWith(AndroidJUnit4::class)
class GnssCaptureIsolationDeviceTest {
    private val instrumentation = InstrumentationRegistry.getInstrumentation()
    private val context = instrumentation.targetContext
    private val manager = context.getSystemService(LocationManager::class.java)

    @Before fun requireStoppedDevice() = runBlocking {
        assumeTrue("Enable explicitly with -e libxposedDevice true",
            InstrumentationRegistry.getArguments().getString("libxposedDevice") == "true")
        ScenarioRuntime.awaitInitialized()
        assumeFalse("Preserve active local simulation", ScenarioRuntime.state.value.isActive)
        for (permission in listOf(Manifest.permission.ACCESS_FINE_LOCATION, Manifest.permission.ACCESS_BACKGROUND_LOCATION)) {
            assumeTrue("Existing permission required: $permission",
                context.checkSelfPermission(permission) == PackageManager.PERMISSION_GRANTED)
        }
        assumeTrue("GPS must already be enabled", manager.isProviderEnabled(LocationManager.GPS_PROVIDER))
        if (!MockServiceHelper.isServiceInit()) MockServiceHelper.tryInitService(manager)
        val status = checkNotNull(MockServiceHelper.runtimeStatus(manager))
        assertEquals("SYSTEM_SERVER", status.getString("hook_scope"))
        assertTrue("Reload current module first", status.getString("runtime_instance")?.isNotBlank() == true)
        assumeFalse("Preserve active system simulation", status.getBoolean("is_start"))
    }

    @Test fun remoteActiveWithIdleUiCannotBeCaptured() = runBlocking {
        try {
            assertTrue(MockServiceHelper.publishSample(manager, sample()))
            assertFalse("UI must remain idle for this regression", ScenarioRuntime.state.value.isActive)
            val failure = runCatching {
                withTimeout(5_000L) { GnssReceiverCollector(context).capture(30_000L) }
            }.exceptionOrNull()
            assertTrue("Expected authoritative pre-registration rejection: $failure",
                failure is IllegalStateException && failure.message.orEmpty().contains("停止系统模拟"))
        } finally { stopSystem() }
    }

    @Test fun completedRemoteSessionDuringCaptureInvalidatesWindowAndReleasesCollector() = runBlocking {
        val firstFrame = CompletableDeferred<Unit>()
        val capture = async(Dispatchers.Default) {
            runCatching { GnssReceiverCollector(context).capture(30_000L) { firstFrame.complete(Unit) } }
        }
        try {
            withTimeout(15_000L) { firstFrame.await() }
            val before = checkNotNull(MockServiceHelper.runtimeStatus(manager))
            withContext(Dispatchers.IO) {
                assertTrue(MockServiceHelper.publishSample(manager, sample()))
                stopSystem()
            }
            val after = checkNotNull(MockServiceHelper.runtimeStatus(manager))
            assertEquals(before.getString("runtime_instance"), after.getString("runtime_instance"))
            assertEquals(before.getLong("simulation_generation") + 2, after.getLong("simulation_generation"))
            assertFalse(after.getBoolean("is_start"))
            val failure = withTimeout(5_000L) { capture.await() }.exceptionOrNull()
            assertTrue("A fully stopped session still contaminates the window: $failure",
                failure is IllegalStateException && failure.message.orEmpty().contains("系统模拟状态发生变化"))
        } finally {
            capture.cancelAndJoin()
            stopSystem()
        }
        // A new callback proves the failure path unregistered and released the singleton gate.
        val retryFrame = CompletableDeferred<Unit>()
        val retry = async(Dispatchers.Default) {
            GnssReceiverCollector(context).capture(30_000L) { retryFrame.complete(Unit) }
        }
        try { withTimeout(15_000L) { retryFrame.await() } }
        finally { retry.cancelAndJoin() }
    }

    @Test fun physicalWindowRetainsEvidenceAndPromotesOnlyWhenQualityAllows() = runBlocking {
        val duration = InstrumentationRegistry.getArguments().getString("physicalCaptureMillis")?.toLong() ?: 60_000L
        require(duration in 30_000L..300_000L)
        val capture = withTimeout(duration + 15_000L) { GnssReceiverCollector(context).capture(duration) }
        // Preserve the distinction even on devices that accept callbacks but advertise no raw
        // support, or advertise support while providing no data in this acquisition window.
        assertTrue(capture.notes.any { it.startsWith("系统声明 GNSS 能力：") || it.startsWith("GNSS 能力读取失败：") })
        assertTrue(capture.notes.any { it.startsWith("原始测量监听注册：") })
        assertTrue(capture.notes.any { it.startsWith("导航电文监听注册：") })
        val quality = GnssCaptureValidator.validate(capture, System.currentTimeMillis())
        // Persist real evidence in the test cache for inspection, never the user's profile.
        File(context.cacheDir, "gnss-physical-window.json").writeText(GnssCaptureCodec.encode(capture))
        val directory = Files.createTempDirectory(context.cacheDir.toPath(), "gnss-physical-test-").toFile()
        val isolated = object : ContextWrapper(context) { override fun getNoBackupFilesDir() = directory }
        try {
            val repository = GnssCaptureRepository(isolated)
            val failure = runCatching { repository.save(capture) }.exceptionOrNull()
            if (quality.eligible) {
                assertNull(failure)
                assertEquals(capture, repository.load())
            } else {
                assertTrue("Rejected evidence must reach the archival boundary: $failure", failure is IllegalStateException)
                assertNull(repository.load())
                assertEquals(capture, GnssCaptureStore(directory.resolve("gnss/latest-rejected-capture.json")).load())
            }
            instrumentation.sendStatus(0, android.os.Bundle().apply {
                putString("physical_capture_quality", "eligible=${quality.eligible}; ${quality.issues.joinToString()}")
                putInt("physical_capture_frames", capture.frames.size)
                putInt("physical_capture_usable_samples", capture.frames.sumOf { f ->
                    f.satellites.count(GnssCaptureValidator::isUsableSatellite)
                })
            })
        } finally { directory.deleteRecursively() }
    }

    private fun stopSystem() {
        assertTrue("Stop command failed", MockServiceHelper.tryCloseMock(manager))
        assertFalse(checkNotNull(MockServiceHelper.runtimeStatus(manager)).getBoolean("is_start"))
    }

    private fun sample() = LocationSample(
        coordinate = Wgs84(31.230416, 121.473701), altitude = 42.0,
        accuracy = 5f, speed = 0f, bearing = 73f,
        timeMillis = System.currentTimeMillis(), elapsedNanos = SystemClock.elapsedRealtimeNanos(),
    )
}
```

`app/src/androidTest/java/com/system/location/service/GnssCaptureRepositoryDeviceTest.kt`:

```kt
package com.system.location.service

import android.content.ContextWrapper
import androidx.test.ext.junit.runners.AndroidJUnit4
import androidx.test.platform.app.InstrumentationRegistry
import com.system.location.service.core.geo.Wgs84
import com.system.location.service.core.gnss.*
import com.system.location.service.gnss.GnssCaptureRepository
import java.nio.file.Files
import kotlinx.coroutines.runBlocking
import org.junit.Assert.*
import org.junit.Test
import org.junit.runner.RunWith

@RunWith(AndroidJUnit4::class)
class GnssCaptureRepositoryDeviceTest {
    @Test fun rejectedWindowIsArchivedWithoutReplacingAcceptedProfile() = runBlocking {
        val target = InstrumentationRegistry.getInstrumentation().targetContext
        val directory = Files.createTempDirectory(target.cacheDir.toPath(), "gnss-repository-test-").toFile()
        val isolated = object : ContextWrapper(target) { override fun getNoBackupFilesDir() = directory }
        val now = System.currentTimeMillis()
        // Synthetic storage fixture; never placed in the application's production GNSS directory.
        val accepted = GnssCapture(deviceModel = "storage fixture", osVersion = "test",
            startedAtMillis = now - 60_000, endedAtMillis = now,
            frames = (0..60).map { index -> GnssObservationFrame(now - 60_000 + index * 1_000L,
                observer = Wgs84(31.0, 121.0), satellites = listOf(
                    GnssSatellite(Constellation.GPS, 1, 25f, 123f, 32f, true, true, true))) })
        val rejected = accepted.copy(frames = accepted.frames.map { it.copy(observer = null) })
        try {
            val repository = GnssCaptureRepository(isolated)
            repository.save(accepted)
            val active = directory.resolve("gnss/receiver-capture.json")
            val original = active.readBytes()
            val failure = runCatching { repository.save(rejected) }.exceptionOrNull()
            assertTrue(failure is IllegalStateException)
            assertTrue(failure?.message.orEmpty().contains("缺少真实观测坐标"))
            assertArrayEquals(original, active.readBytes())
            assertEquals(accepted, repository.load())
            assertEquals(rejected, GnssCaptureStore(directory.resolve("gnss/latest-rejected-capture.json")).load())
            val zeroCn0 = accepted.copy(frames = accepted.frames.map { frame ->
                frame.copy(satellites = frame.satellites.map { it.copy(cn0DbHz = 0f, usedInFix = false) })
            })
            val zeroFailure = runCatching { repository.save(zeroCn0) }.exceptionOrNull()
            assertTrue(zeroFailure is IllegalStateException)
            assertTrue(zeroFailure?.message.orEmpty().contains("有效帧不足"))
            assertArrayEquals(original, active.readBytes())
            assertEquals(zeroCn0, GnssCaptureStore(directory.resolve("gnss/latest-rejected-capture.json")).load())
        } finally { directory.deleteRecursively() }
    }
}
```
