`app/src/androidTest/java/com/system/location/service/GnssFrameDeliveryDeviceTest.kt`:

```kt
package com.system.location.service

import android.Manifest
import android.content.pm.PackageManager
import android.location.GnssStatus
import android.location.GnssMeasurementsEvent
import android.location.Location
import android.location.LocationListener
import android.location.LocationManager
import android.location.OnNmeaMessageListener
import android.os.Bundle
import android.os.Binder
import android.os.Parcel
import android.os.ParcelFileDescriptor
import android.os.SystemClock
import androidx.test.ext.junit.runners.AndroidJUnit4
import androidx.test.platform.app.InstrumentationRegistry
import com.system.location.service.core.geo.Wgs84
import com.system.location.service.core.gnss.*
import com.system.location.service.core.location.LocationSample
import com.system.location.service.core.runtime.RuntimeTransferWire
import com.system.location.service.core.runtime.OrderedRuntimeReceiver
import com.system.location.service.core.routing.AppRoute
import com.system.location.service.core.routing.RoutingConfig
import com.system.location.service.core.routing.RoutingMode
import com.system.location.service.hook.RuntimeSyncCommand
import com.system.location.service.hook.security.CommandClient
import com.system.location.service.hook.security.SampleWire
import com.system.location.service.runtime.ScenarioRuntime
import com.system.location.service.runtime.XposedServiceBridge
import java.util.concurrent.ConcurrentLinkedQueue
import java.util.concurrent.LinkedBlockingQueue
import java.util.concurrent.TimeUnit
import java.util.concurrent.atomic.AtomicLong
import java.util.concurrent.atomic.AtomicBoolean
import java.util.concurrent.atomic.AtomicInteger
import kotlinx.serialization.json.Json
import kotlinx.coroutines.*
import org.junit.Assert.*
import org.junit.Assume.*
import org.junit.Test
import org.junit.runner.RunWith

/** Synthetic transport fixture only: no real-profile, constellation-distribution or orbit claim. */
@RunWith(AndroidJUnit4::class)
class GnssFrameDeliveryDeviceTest {
    private data class Status(val arrived: Long, val satellites: List<GnssSatellite>)
    private data class Sentence(val epoch: Long, val text: String)

    @Test fun sharedFrameReachesStatusNmeaAndLocationExtrasThroughSystemServer() = verifyDelivery()

    @Test fun fixedPointRouteReachesLocationAndNmeaWithoutUsingTheGlobalCoordinate() =
        verifyDelivery(Wgs84(40.0, 116.0))

    @Test fun unregisterReregisterStopAndResumeDoNotLeakOrRepeatFrozenFrames() =
        verifyDelivery(Wgs84(40.0, 116.0), cycleListeners = true)

    @Test fun hotReloadRestoresActiveFixedPointListenersWithoutReregistration() {
        assumeTrue("Explicit hot reload lab run required",
            InstrumentationRegistry.getArguments().getString("libxposedReload") == "true")
        verifyDelivery(Wgs84(40.0, 116.0), reload = true)
    }

    private fun verifyDelivery(fixedPoint: Wgs84? = null, reload: Boolean = false,
        cycleListeners: Boolean = false) = runBlocking {
        assumeTrue("Explicit device run required", InstrumentationRegistry.getArguments().getString("libxposedDevice") == "true")
        val context = InstrumentationRegistry.getInstrumentation().targetContext
        val manager = context.getSystemService(LocationManager::class.java)
        ScenarioRuntime.awaitInitialized()
        if (reload) assumeTrue("Bound libxposed service required", XposedServiceBridge.bound())
        assumeFalse("Preserve local simulation", ScenarioRuntime.state.value.isActive)
        for (permission in listOf(Manifest.permission.ACCESS_FINE_LOCATION, Manifest.permission.ACCESS_BACKGROUND_LOCATION)) {
            assumeTrue("Existing permission required: $permission",
                context.checkSelfPermission(permission) == PackageManager.PERMISSION_GRANTED)
        }
        assumeTrue("GPS must already be enabled", manager.isProviderEnabled(LocationManager.GPS_PROVIDER))
        val client = CommandClient()
        assertTrue(client.connect(manager))
        fun command(name: String, fill: Bundle.() -> Unit = {}): Bundle = Bundle().apply {
            putString("command_id", name); fill()
            assertTrue("Command failed: $name", client.send(manager, this))
        }
        val initial = command("get_runtime_status")
        assertEquals("SYSTEM_SERVER", initial.getString("hook_scope"))
        assumeFalse("Preserve system simulation", initial.getBoolean("is_start"))
        val original = RuntimeTransferWire.decode(checkNotNull(command("sync_config").getByteArray(RuntimeSyncCommand.PAYLOAD))).state
        assumeTrue("Preserve existing routing rules", original.routing == null)
        assumeTrue("Fixture requires no production source; do not replace user evidence", original.configuration.gnssSource == null)
        val statuses = ConcurrentLinkedQueue<Status>()
        val sentences = ConcurrentLinkedQueue<Sentence>()
        val locations = ConcurrentLinkedQueue<Location>()
        val peerSequences = ConcurrentLinkedQueue<Long>()
        val acceptPeer = AtomicBoolean(true)
        val rejectedPeer = AtomicInteger()
        val rejectedPeerSequences = ConcurrentLinkedQueue<String>()
        val peerSession = java.util.UUID.randomUUID().toString()
        val peerReceiver = OrderedRuntimeReceiver({ null }) { _, _ -> }
        peerReceiver.begin(peerSession)
        val peer = object : Binder() {
            override fun onTransact(code: Int, data: Parcel, reply: Parcel?, flags: Int): Boolean {
                if (code != RuntimeSyncCommand.TRANSACTION) return super.onTransact(code, data, reply, flags)
                if (Binder.getCallingUid() != 1000) return false
                val message = checkNotNull(data.readBundle(Bundle::class.java.classLoader))
                val sequence = message.getLong(RuntimeSyncCommand.SEQUENCE)
                val accepted = acceptPeer.get() && peerReceiver.receive(
                    checkNotNull(message.getString(RuntimeSyncCommand.SESSION)), sequence,
                    checkNotNull(message.getByteArray(RuntimeSyncCommand.PAYLOAD)), SystemClock.elapsedRealtimeNanos())
                if (accepted) peerSequences += sequence else if (acceptPeer.get()) {
                    rejectedPeer.incrementAndGet()
                    rejectedPeerSequences += "$sequence after ${peerSequences.maxOrNull()}"
                }
                reply?.writeNoException()
                reply?.writeInt(if (accepted) 1 else 0)
                return true
            }
        }
        val sampleWallOverride = AtomicLong(0L)
        val existingRaw = object : GnssMeasurementsEvent.Callback() {}
        val blockedStatuses = LinkedBlockingQueue<Int>()
        val blockedRaw = object : GnssMeasurementsEvent.Callback() {
            override fun onStatusChanged(status: Int) { blockedStatuses.offer(status) }
        }
        assumeTrue("Preserve existing raw registrations", rawRegistrations(context.packageName) == 0)
        val callback = object : GnssStatus.Callback() {
            override fun onSatelliteStatusChanged(status: GnssStatus) {
                val satellites = (0 until status.satelliteCount).map { index ->
                    GnssSatellite(system(status.getConstellationType(index)), status.getSvid(index),
                        status.getElevationDegrees(index), status.getAzimuthDegrees(index), status.getCn0DbHz(index),
                        status.usedInFix(index), status.hasEphemerisData(index), status.hasAlmanacData(index))
                }
                statuses += Status(System.currentTimeMillis(), satellites)
            }
        }
        val nmea = OnNmeaMessageListener { message, timestamp -> sentences += Sentence(timestamp, message) }
        val location = LocationListener { locations += Location(it) }
        val now = System.currentTimeMillis()
        val observer = Wgs84(31.230416, 121.473701)
        val satellites = Constellation.entries
            .flatMap { constellation -> (0..3).map { index ->
                val svid = when (constellation) {
                    Constellation.QZSS -> 193 + index
                    Constellation.SBAS -> 120 + index
                    else -> index + 1
                }
                GnssSatellite(constellation, svid, if (index == 3) 75f else 20f,
                    index * 90f, 32f + index, true, true, true)
            } }
        val fixture = GnssCapture(deviceModel = "SYNTHETIC DEVICE TEST", osVersion = "transport fixture",
            startedAtMillis = now - 60_000L, endedAtMillis = now,
            frames = (0..60).map { index -> GnssObservationFrame(now - 60_000L + index * 1_000L,
                observer = observer, satellites = satellites) })
        assertNotNull("Fixture must have valid geometry", GnssGeometry.solve(satellites).dop)
        var renewal: Job? = null
        var configured = false
        var reloadAttempted = false
        var primaryFailure: Throwable? = null
        try {
            command("put_config") {
                putString("gnss_capture", GnssCaptureWire.encode(fixture))
                putString("gnss_mode", GnssSimulationMode.REPLAY.name)
                putBoolean("enable_nmea", true)
                putBoolean("enable_physical_noise", false)
                putInt("min_satellites", 0)
                fixedPoint?.let { point ->
                    putString("routing_json", Json.encodeToString(RoutingConfig.serializer(),
                        RoutingConfig(mode = RoutingMode.PER_APP,
                            routes = listOf(AppRoute(context.packageName, point = point)))))
                }
            }
            configured = true
            if (reload) command("set_proxy") {
                putBinder("proxy", peer)
                putString("proxy_name", "instrumentation-${peerSession}")
                putString(RuntimeSyncCommand.SESSION, peerSession)
            }
            command("start_gnss_mock")
            assertTrue(manager.registerGnssStatusCallback({ it.run() }, callback))
            assertTrue(manager.addNmeaListener({ it.run() }, nmea))
            assertTrue(manager.registerGnssMeasurementsCallback({ it.run() }, existingRaw))
            assertEquals(1, rawRegistrations(context.packageName))
            fun publish() {
                command("publish_sample") {
                    SampleWire.write(this, LocationSample(observer, altitude = 42.0, accuracy = 5f,
                        speed = 0f, bearing = 73f, timeMillis = sampleWallOverride.get().takeIf { it > 0L }
                            ?: System.currentTimeMillis(), elapsedNanos = SystemClock.elapsedRealtimeNanos()))
                }
            }
            publish()
            renewal = launch(Dispatchers.IO) { while (isActive) { delay(100L); publish() } }
            val rawResult = runCatching { manager.registerGnssMeasurementsCallback({ it.run() }, blockedRaw) }
            assertNull("Raw registration rejection must not throw: $rawResult", rawResult.exceptionOrNull())
            assertEquals("Rejected raw registration must not leak", 1, rawRegistrations(context.packageName))
            assertEquals("Rejected raw registration must report unsupported",
                0, blockedStatuses.poll(2, TimeUnit.SECONDS))
            manager.unregisterGnssMeasurementsCallback(existingRaw)
            assertEquals("Existing registration must be removable while blocked", 0, rawRegistrations(context.packageName))
            manager.requestLocationUpdates(LocationManager.GPS_PROVIDER, 0L, 0f, { it.run() }, location)
            withTimeout(12_000L) {
                while (statuses.size < 3 || sentences.count { type(it.text) == "GGA" } < 3 || locations.size < 3) delay(100L)
            }
            if (reload) {
                fun systemPid(): String = ParcelFileDescriptor.AutoCloseInputStream(
                    InstrumentationRegistry.getInstrumentation().uiAutomation.executeShellCommand("pidof system_server"))
                    .bufferedReader().use { it.readText().trim() }
                val beforePid = systemPid()
                assertTrue(beforePid.isNotBlank())
                renewal.cancelAndJoin()
                withTimeout(5_000L) { while (peerSequences.size < 5) delay(50L) }
                val beforeSequence = peerSequences.max()
                // Reconnect command authentication after a generation change; do not re-register
                // any receiver listener or resend its routing/profile/configuration.
                reloadAttempted = true
                val outcome = withContext(Dispatchers.IO) { XposedServiceBridge.hotReloadSystemServer() }
                assertTrue(outcome, outcome.startsWith("hot reload SUCCEEDED"))
                assertTrue("Command authentication did not recover after $outcome", client.connect(manager))
                assertEquals("Reload must not restart system_server", beforePid, systemPid())
                val restored = RuntimeTransferWire.decode(checkNotNull(command("sync_config")
                    .getByteArray(RuntimeSyncCommand.PAYLOAD))).state
                assertNotNull("Reload lost the active receiver profile", restored.configuration.gnssSource)
                assertEquals(fixedPoint, restored.routing!!.routes.single().point)
                statuses.clear(); sentences.clear(); locations.clear()
                publish()
                renewal = launch(Dispatchers.IO) { while (isActive) { delay(100L); publish() } }
                withTimeout(10_000L) {
                    while (statuses.size < 4 || sentences.count { type(it.text) == "GGA" } < 4 ||
                        locations.size < 20 || peerSequences.none { it > beforeSequence }) delay(100L)
                }
                assertEquals("A restored peer must retain monotonic publications without a new session: before=$beforeSequence rejected=$rejectedPeerSequences accepted=$peerSequences", 0, rejectedPeer.get())
            }
            val expectedIds = satellites.map { it.constellation to it.svid }.toSet()
            for (status in statuses) {
                assertEquals(expectedIds, status.satellites.map { it.constellation to it.svid }.toSet())
                assertTrue(status.satellites.all { it.usedInFix && it.hasEphemeris && it.hasAlmanac })
                assertEquals(satellites.sortedBy { it.svid }.map { it.cn0DbHz }.sorted(), status.satellites.map { it.cn0DbHz }.sorted())
            }
            val groups = sentences.groupBy { it.epoch }
            val complete = groups.values.filter { batch -> batch.any { type(it.text) == "ZDA" } }
            assertTrue("Need at least two complete epochs", complete.size >= 2)
            val expectedDop = checkNotNull(GnssGeometry.solve(satellites).dop)
            for (batch in complete) {
                assertEquals("One GGA per epoch ${batch.first().epoch}: ${batch.map { it.text }}",
                    1, batch.count { type(it.text) == "GGA" })
                val gga = batch.single { type(it.text) == "GGA" }.text.substringBefore('*').split(',')
                assertEquals(1, gga[6].toInt())
                assertEquals(satellites.size, gga[7].toInt())
                assertEquals(expectedDop.hdop, gga[8].toDouble(), 0.051)
                if (fixedPoint != null) {
                    assertEquals("4000.0000", gga[2])
                    assertEquals("N", gga[3])
                    assertEquals("11600.0000", gga[4])
                    assertEquals("E", gga[5])
                }
                val gsv = batch.filter { type(it.text) == "GSV" }
                assertEquals(setOf("GP", "BD", "GA", "GL", "GQ", "GI"), gsv.map { it.text.substring(1, 3) }.toSet())
                assertEquals(7, gsv.size) // GPS and SBAS share GP, requiring two GSV pages.
                for ((talker, pages) in gsv.groupBy { it.text.substring(1, 3) }) {
                    val expected = when (talker) {
                        "GP" -> listOf(1, 2, 3, 4, 33, 34, 35, 36)
                        "GL" -> listOf(65, 66, 67, 68)
                        else -> listOf(1, 2, 3, 4)
                    }
                    val ids = pages.sortedBy { it.text.substringBefore('*').split(',')[2].toInt() }.flatMap { sentence ->
                        val fields = sentence.text.substringBefore('*').split(',')
                        assertEquals(expected.size, fields[3].toInt())
                        (4 until fields.size step 4).map { fields[it].toInt() }
                    }
                    assertEquals(expected, ids)
                }
                val gsa = batch.filter { type(it.text) == "GSA" }.map { it.text.substringBefore('*').split(',') }
                assertEquals(setOf("1", "2", "3", "4", "5", "6"), gsa.map { it.last() }.toSet())
                assertEquals(satellites.size, gsa.sumOf { fields -> fields.subList(3, 15).count { it.isNotBlank() } })
            }
            for (fix in locations) {
                assertEquals((fixedPoint ?: observer).latitude, fix.latitude, 0.0)
                assertEquals((fixedPoint ?: observer).longitude, fix.longitude, 0.0)
                val extras = checkNotNull(fix.extras) { "Missing extras: sampleAfterCapture=${fix.time - fixture.endedAtMillis}ms provider=${fix.provider}" }
                assertEquals(satellites.size, extras.getInt("satellites", -1))
                assertEquals(33.5f, extras.getFloat("meanCn0", -1f), 0.001f)
                assertEquals(35f, extras.getFloat("maxCn0", -1f), 0.001f)
            }
            // Freeze only this fixture's display clock to revisit one sparse empirical frame.
            // The elapsed publication lease remains current; no system clock/settings are changed.
            val sparse = satellites.take(satellites.size / 2)
            assertNotNull(GnssGeometry.solve(sparse).dop)
            val variable = fixture.copy(frames = fixture.frames.mapIndexed { index, frame ->
                if (index == fixture.frames.lastIndex) frame.copy(satellites = sparse) else frame
            })
            sampleWallOverride.set(fixture.endedAtMillis)
            command("put_config") { putString("gnss_capture", GnssCaptureWire.encode(variable)) }
            for ((minimum, expectedCount) in listOf(0 to sparse.size, 20 to 20, 128 to satellites.size, 0 to sparse.size)) {
                statuses.clear()
                command("put_config") { putInt("min_satellites", minimum) }
                publish()
                withTimeout(5_000L) {
                    while (statuses.none { it.satellites.size == expectedCount }) delay(100L)
                }
                // The fixture clock is frozen: renewal extends the lease but must not emit
                // the same immutable frame on the next worker tick.
                delay(1_100L)
                val latest = statuses.filter { it.satellites.size == expectedCount }
                assertEquals("Frozen publication must be delivered exactly once at minimum=$minimum", 1, latest.size)
                assertTrue(latest.all { it.satellites.all { satellite -> satellite.constellation to satellite.svid in expectedIds } })
            }
            if (cycleListeners) {
                manager.unregisterGnssStatusCallback(callback)
                manager.removeNmeaListener(nmea)
                statuses.clear(); sentences.clear()
                delay(1_200L)
                assertTrue("Unregistered status callback still received data", statuses.isEmpty())
                assertTrue("Unregistered NMEA callback still received data", sentences.isEmpty())
                assertTrue(manager.registerGnssStatusCallback({ it.run() }, callback))
                assertTrue(manager.addNmeaListener({ it.run() }, nmea))
                withTimeout(5_000L) {
                    while (statuses.isEmpty() || sentences.none { type(it.text) == "ZDA" }) delay(50L)
                }
                delay(1_100L)
                assertEquals("New registration receives the current frozen frame exactly once", 1, statuses.size)
                assertEquals(1, sentences.count { type(it.text) == "GGA" })

                renewal.cancelAndJoin()
                command("stop")
                assertFalse(command("get_runtime_status").getBoolean("is_start"))
                // Already queued one-way Binder callbacks may finish. This window verifies that
                // no later worker tick submits the old synthetic epoch; physical passthrough is allowed.
                delay(300L)
                sentences.clear()
                delay(1_300L)
                assertTrue("Stopped simulation continued submitting its frozen NMEA epoch",
                    sentences.none { it.epoch == fixture.endedAtMillis })

                val resumedEpoch = System.currentTimeMillis()
                sampleWallOverride.set(resumedEpoch)
                statuses.clear(); sentences.clear()
                publish()
                renewal = launch(Dispatchers.IO) { while (isActive) { delay(100L); publish() } }
                withTimeout(5_000L) {
                    while (statuses.isEmpty() || sentences.none { it.epoch == resumedEpoch && type(it.text) == "ZDA" }) delay(50L)
                }
                delay(1_100L)
                assertEquals("Resumed epoch must be delivered once", 1,
                    sentences.count { it.epoch == resumedEpoch && type(it.text) == "GGA" })
                assertTrue(command("get_runtime_status").getBoolean("is_start"))
            }
        } catch (error: Throwable) {
            primaryFailure = error
            throw error
        } finally { runCatching {
            renewal?.cancelAndJoin()
            acceptPeer.set(false) // The cleanup stop publication removes this temporary peer.
            try {
                manager.removeUpdates(location)
                manager.unregisterGnssStatusCallback(callback)
                manager.removeNmeaListener(nmea)
                manager.unregisterGnssMeasurementsCallback(existingRaw)
                manager.unregisterGnssMeasurementsCallback(blockedRaw)
            } finally {
                if (reloadAttempted) assertTrue("Reconnect for fixture cleanup", client.connect(manager))
                command("stop")
                if (configured) {
                    command("put_config") {
                        putString("gnss_capture", null)
                        putString("gnss_mode", original.configuration.gnssSimulation.mode.name)
                        putBoolean("enable_nmea", original.configuration.nmeaEnabled)
                        putBoolean("enable_physical_noise", original.physicalNoise)
                        putInt("min_satellites", original.configuration.minimumSatellites)
                        if (fixedPoint != null) putString("routing_json", null)
                    }
                    command(if (original.configuration.gnssEnabled) "start_gnss_mock" else "stop_gnss_mock")
                }
                val restored = RuntimeTransferWire.decode(checkNotNull(command("sync_config").getByteArray(RuntimeSyncCommand.PAYLOAD))).state
                assertNull("Synthetic evidence must not survive fixture cleanup", restored.configuration.gnssSource)
                assertFalse(restored.configuration.enabled)
                assertEquals(original.routing, restored.routing)
            }
        }.exceptionOrNull()?.let { cleanup ->
            primaryFailure?.addSuppressed(cleanup) ?: throw cleanup
        } }
    }

    private fun type(sentence: String) = sentence.substring(3, 6)

    private fun rawRegistrations(packageName: String): Int {
        val dump = ParcelFileDescriptor.AutoCloseInputStream(
            InstrumentationRegistry.getInstrumentation().uiAutomation.executeShellCommand("dumpsys location"))
            .bufferedReader().use { it.readText() }.lines()
        val starts = dump.indices.filter { dump[it].trim() == "Measurements Provider:" }
        check(starts.size == 1) { "Expected one Measurements Provider section, found ${starts.size}: $starts" }
        val start = starts.single()
        val indent = dump[start].takeWhile(Char::isWhitespace).length
        val section = dump.drop(start + 1).takeWhile { it.isBlank() || it.takeWhile(Char::isWhitespace).length > indent }
        check(section.any { it.trimStart().startsWith("service:") }) { "Provider dump has no service state" }
        val entry = Regex("^\\s*\\d+/${Regex.escape(packageName)}(?:\\[|/|\\s|$)")
        return section.count { entry.containsMatchIn(it) }
    }

    private fun system(androidType: Int): Constellation = when (androidType) {
        GnssStatus.CONSTELLATION_GPS -> Constellation.GPS
        GnssStatus.CONSTELLATION_BEIDOU -> Constellation.BEIDOU
        GnssStatus.CONSTELLATION_GALILEO -> Constellation.GALILEO
        GnssStatus.CONSTELLATION_GLONASS -> Constellation.GLONASS
        GnssStatus.CONSTELLATION_QZSS -> Constellation.QZSS
        GnssStatus.CONSTELLATION_IRNSS -> Constellation.IRNSS
        GnssStatus.CONSTELLATION_SBAS -> Constellation.SBAS
        else -> error("Unknown constellation")
    }
}

```

`app/src/androidTest/java/com/system/location/service/GnssIndependentReceiverDeviceTest.kt`:

```kt
package com.system.location.service

import android.Manifest
import android.content.pm.PackageManager
import android.location.LocationManager
import android.location.GnssStatus
import android.os.Bundle
import android.os.ParcelFileDescriptor
import android.os.Process
import android.os.SystemClock
import androidx.test.ext.junit.runners.AndroidJUnit4
import androidx.test.platform.app.InstrumentationRegistry
import com.system.location.service.core.geo.Wgs84
import com.system.location.service.core.gnss.*
import com.system.location.service.core.location.LocationSample
import com.system.location.service.core.runtime.RuntimeTransferWire
import com.system.location.service.core.routing.AppRoute
import com.system.location.service.core.routing.RoutingConfig
import com.system.location.service.core.routing.RoutingMode
import com.system.location.service.hook.RuntimeSyncCommand
import com.system.location.service.hook.security.CommandClient
import com.system.location.service.hook.security.SampleWire
import com.system.location.service.runtime.ScenarioRuntime
import java.io.File
import java.io.IOException
import java.net.InetSocketAddress
import java.net.Socket
import java.util.concurrent.ConcurrentLinkedQueue
import kotlinx.serialization.json.Json
import kotlinx.coroutines.*
import org.json.JSONObject
import org.junit.Assert.*
import org.junit.Assume.*
import org.junit.Test
import org.junit.runner.RunWith

/** Opt-in integration with a separate Detector UID; synthetic and captured sources stay explicit. */
@RunWith(AndroidJUnit4::class)
class GnssIndependentReceiverDeviceTest {
    @Test fun movingNoisySamplesRemainCoherentForAnIndependentReceiver() = verifyReceiver()

    @Test fun receiverDeathClearsFrameworkRegistrationAndRestartDoesNotDuplicateFrames() =
        verifyReceiver(terminateFirstRun = true)

    @Test fun capturedProfileRemainsCoherentForAnIndependentReceiver() = verifyReceiver(realCapture = true)

    @Test fun autonomousSkyWithoutCaptureReachesAnIndependentReceiver() = verifyReceiver(autonomous = true)

    @Test fun autonomousRoutesDeliverTheirOwnSkyToTwoReceivers() = verifyReceiver(autonomous = true, routed = true)

    private fun verifyReceiver(terminateFirstRun: Boolean = false, realCapture: Boolean = false,
        autonomous: Boolean = false, routed: Boolean = false) = runBlocking {
        val instrumentation = InstrumentationRegistry.getInstrumentation()
        val arguments = InstrumentationRegistry.getArguments()
        assumeTrue("Explicit independent receiver run required",
            arguments.getString("independentDetector") == "true")
        if (realCapture) assumeTrue("Explicit real evidence run required", arguments.getString("realCapturedProfile") == "true")
        val sampleSeconds = if (realCapture || autonomous) arguments.getString("receiverSeconds")?.toInt() ?: 120 else 20
        require(sampleSeconds in 20..240)
        val minimum = if (autonomous) arguments.getString("receiverMinimum")?.toInt() ?: 64
            else if (realCapture) arguments.getString("receiverMinimum")?.toInt() ?: 0 else 0
        require(minimum in 0..128)
        val context = instrumentation.targetContext
        val manager = context.getSystemService(LocationManager::class.java)
        ScenarioRuntime.awaitInitialized()
        assumeFalse("Preserve local simulation", ScenarioRuntime.state.value.isActive)
        for (permission in listOf(Manifest.permission.ACCESS_FINE_LOCATION, Manifest.permission.ACCESS_BACKGROUND_LOCATION)) {
            assumeTrue("Existing permission required: $permission",
                context.checkSelfPermission(permission) == PackageManager.PERMISSION_GRANTED)
        }
        fun shell(command: String): String = ParcelFileDescriptor.AutoCloseInputStream(
            instrumentation.uiAutomation.executeShellCommand(command)).bufferedReader().use { it.readText() }
        val receiverPackage = "com.system.location.service.detector"
        val receiverUid = Regex("uid:(\\d+)").find(shell("cmd package list packages -U $receiverPackage"))
            ?.groupValues?.get(1)?.toInt()
        assumeTrue("Independent Detector must already be installed", receiverUid != null)
        assertNotEquals("Receiver must have a separate UID", Process.myUid(), receiverUid)
        fun statusRegistrations(): Int {
            val dump = shell("dumpsys location").lines()
            val start = dump.indices.single { dump[it].trim() == "Status Provider:" }
            val indent = dump[start].takeWhile(Char::isWhitespace).length
            val section = dump.drop(start + 1).takeWhile { it.isBlank() || it.takeWhile(Char::isWhitespace).length > indent }
            check(section.any { it.trimStart().startsWith("service:") }) { "Provider dump has no service state" }
            return section.count { Regex("^\\s*\\d+/${Regex.escape(receiverPackage)}(?:\\[|/|\\s|$)").containsMatchIn(it) }
        }
        assumeTrue("Preserve existing receiver registrations", statusRegistrations() == 0)
        assumeTrue("GPS must already be enabled", manager.isProviderEnabled(LocationManager.GPS_PROVIDER))
        val client = CommandClient()
        assertTrue(client.connect(manager))
        fun command(name: String, fill: Bundle.() -> Unit = {}): Bundle = Bundle().apply {
            putString("command_id", name); fill()
            assertTrue("Command failed: $name", client.send(manager, this))
        }
        val initial = command("get_runtime_status")
        assertEquals("SYSTEM_SERVER", initial.getString("hook_scope"))
        assumeFalse("Preserve system simulation", initial.getBoolean("is_start"))
        val original = RuntimeTransferWire.decode(checkNotNull(command("sync_config").getByteArray(RuntimeSyncCommand.PAYLOAD))).state
        assumeTrue("Preserve user routing and evidence", original.routing == null && original.configuration.gnssSource == null)
        val now = System.currentTimeMillis()
        val localPoint = Wgs84(31.0, 121.0)
        val remotePoint = Wgs84(-31.0, -59.0)
        val localFrames = ConcurrentLinkedQueue<Pair<Long, List<GnssSatellite>>>()
        val androidSystems = mapOf(1 to Constellation.GPS, 2 to Constellation.SBAS, 3 to Constellation.GLONASS,
            4 to Constellation.QZSS, 5 to Constellation.BEIDOU, 6 to Constellation.GALILEO, 7 to Constellation.IRNSS)
        val localCallback = object : GnssStatus.Callback() {
            override fun onSatelliteStatusChanged(status: GnssStatus) {
                localFrames += System.currentTimeMillis() to (0 until status.satelliteCount).map { index ->
                    GnssSatellite(androidSystems.getValue(status.getConstellationType(index)), status.getSvid(index),
                        status.getElevationDegrees(index), status.getAzimuthDegrees(index), status.getCn0DbHz(index),
                        status.usedInFix(index), status.hasEphemerisData(index), status.hasAlmanacData(index))
                }
            }
        }
        val captured = if (realCapture) {
            val file = File(context.cacheDir, "gnss-real-validation-source.json")
            check(file.length() in 1..GnssCaptureCodec.MAX_BYTES.toLong()) { "Supply bounded real capture evidence first" }
            GnssCaptureCodec.decode(file.readText()).also {
                val quality = GnssCaptureValidator.validate(it, now)
                check(quality.eligible) { "Rejected real profile: ${quality.issues}" }
            }
        } else null
        val observer = captured?.frames?.firstNotNullOf { it.observer } ?: Wgs84(31.230416, 121.473701)
        val satellites = Constellation.entries.flatMap { system -> (0..3).map { index ->
            val svid = when (system) {
                Constellation.QZSS -> 193 + index
                Constellation.SBAS -> 120 + index
                else -> index + 1
            }
            GnssSatellite(system, svid, if (index == 3) 75f else 20f, index * 90f,
                32f + index, true, true, true)
        } }
        val fixture = captured ?: GnssCapture(deviceModel = "SYNTHETIC INDEPENDENT RECEIVER TEST", osVersion = "transport fixture",
            startedAtMillis = now - 60_000L, endedAtMillis = now,
            frames = (0..60).map { index -> GnssObservationFrame(now - 60_000L + index * 1_000L,
                observer = observer, satellites = satellites) })
        var renewal: Job? = null
        var configured = false
        try {
            command("put_config") {
                putString("gnss_capture", if (autonomous) null else GnssCaptureWire.encode(fixture))
                putString("gnss_mode", if (autonomous) GnssSimulationMode.AUTONOMOUS.name else GnssSimulationMode.REPLAY.name)
                if (autonomous) {
                    putString("gnss_navigation", null)
                    putString("gnss_minimum_policy", GnssMinimumPolicy.GUARANTEE_QUANTITY.name)
                    putString("gnss_environment", GnssSimulationEnvironment.OPEN_SKY.name)
                }
                if (routed) putString("routing_json", Json.encodeToString(RoutingConfig.serializer(),
                    RoutingConfig(mode = RoutingMode.PER_APP, routes = listOf(
                        AppRoute(context.packageName, point = localPoint), AppRoute(receiverPackage, point = remotePoint)))))
                putBoolean("enable_nmea", true)
                putBoolean("enable_physical_noise", !routed)
                putInt("min_satellites", minimum)
            }
            configured = true
            if (autonomous) {
                val accepted = RuntimeTransferWire.decode(checkNotNull(command("sync_config").getByteArray(RuntimeSyncCommand.PAYLOAD))).state
                assertNull("Autonomous fixture must not depend on local capture", accepted.configuration.gnssSource)
                assertNull("Autonomous fixture must not depend on a downloaded navigation resource", accepted.configuration.gnssNavigation)
                assertEquals(GnssSimulationMode.AUTONOMOUS, accepted.configuration.gnssSimulation.mode)
            }
            command("start_gnss_mock")
            if (routed) assertTrue(manager.registerGnssStatusCallback({ it.run() }, localCallback))
            val startElapsed = SystemClock.elapsedRealtimeNanos()
            fun publish() {
                val elapsed = SystemClock.elapsedRealtimeNanos()
                val seconds = (elapsed - startElapsed) / 1_000_000_000.0
                command("publish_sample") {
                    SampleWire.write(this, LocationSample(Wgs84(observer.latitude + seconds * 0.00002, observer.longitude),
                        altitude = 42.0, accuracy = 5f, speed = 2.2f, bearing = 0f,
                        timeMillis = System.currentTimeMillis(), elapsedNanos = elapsed))
                }
            }
            publish()
            renewal = launch(Dispatchers.IO) { while (isActive) { delay(100L); publish() } }
            val launchResult = shell("am start -W -n $receiverPackage/.MainActivity")
            assertFalse("Cannot launch independent receiver", launchResult.contains("Error:"))
            val rawReport = withContext(Dispatchers.IO) {
                // Raw loopback HTTP is limited to the explicitly enabled lab debug bridge.
                fun request(method: String, path: String, body: String = ""): String = Socket().use { socket ->
                    socket.connect(InetSocketAddress("127.0.0.1", 8766), 500)
                    socket.soTimeout = (sampleSeconds + 40) * 1_000
                    socket.getOutputStream().apply {
                        write(("$method $path HTTP/1.1\r\nHost: localhost\r\nContent-Type: application/json\r\n" +
                            "Content-Length: ${body.toByteArray().size}\r\nConnection: close\r\n\r\n$body").toByteArray())
                        flush()
                    }
                    val response = socket.getInputStream().bufferedReader().use { it.readText() }
                    check(response.startsWith("HTTP/1.1 200")) { "Detector bridge failed: ${response.lineSequence().first()}" }
                    response.substringAfter("\r\n\r\n")
                }
                // Activity launch completion need not coincide with the bridge's worker startup.
                suspend fun bridgeReady(): JSONObject = withTimeout(5_000L) {
                    var status: String? = null
                    while (status == null) {
                        try { status = request("GET", "/status") }
                        catch (_: IOException) { delay(100L) }
                    }
                    JSONObject(status)
                }
                val status = bridgeReady()
                assertFalse("Preserve an existing independent receiver run", status.getBoolean("running"))
                if (terminateFirstRun) {
                    // No duration override: killing the process must not persist temporary settings
                    // whose normal restoration would otherwise depend on the bridge's finally block.
                    val interrupted = async { runCatching { request("POST", "/run", "{}") } }
                    withTimeout(5_000L) {
                        while (statusRegistrations() != 1) delay(100L)
                    }
                    assertTrue(request("GET", "/status").let(::JSONObject).getBoolean("running"))
                    val oldPid = shell("pidof $receiverPackage").trim()
                    assertTrue("Independent receiver process missing", oldPid.isNotBlank())
                    shell("am force-stop $receiverPackage")
                    withTimeout(5_000L) {
                        while (statusRegistrations() != 0 || shell("pidof $receiverPackage").isNotBlank()) delay(100L)
                    }
                    assertTrue("Interrupted bridge unexpectedly completed a report", interrupted.await().isFailure)
                    val restart = shell("am start -W -n $receiverPackage/.MainActivity")
                    assertFalse("Cannot restart independent receiver", restart.contains("Error:"))
                    assertFalse(bridgeReady().getBoolean("running"))
                    assertNotEquals("Receiver process was not replaced", oldPid, shell("pidof $receiverPackage").trim())
                }
                request("POST", "/run", "{\"sampleSeconds\":$sampleSeconds}")
            }
            val filename = if (routed) "autonomous-routed-independent-gnss-min$minimum-report.json"
                else if (autonomous) "autonomous-independent-gnss-min$minimum-report.json"
                else if (realCapture) "captured-independent-gnss-min$minimum-report.json" else "synthetic-independent-gnss-report.json"
            File(context.getExternalFilesDir(null), filename).writeText(rawReport)
            val report = JSONObject(rawReport)
            val frames = report.getJSONObject("gnssEvidence").getJSONArray("frames")
            assertTrue("Independent receiver did not see the GNSS stream", frames.length() >= sampleSeconds - 5)
            assertTrue("Duplicate 1 Hz GNSS deliveries", frames.length() <= sampleSeconds + 2)
            val expectedCounts = mapOf(1 to 4, 2 to 4, 3 to 4, 4 to 4, 5 to 4, 6 to 4, 7 to 4)
            val androidTypes = mapOf(Constellation.GPS to 1, Constellation.SBAS to 2, Constellation.GLONASS to 3,
                Constellation.QZSS to 4, Constellation.BEIDOU to 5, Constellation.GALILEO to 6, Constellation.IRNSS to 7)
            val realIdentities = captured?.frames?.flatMap { it.satellites }?.filter(GnssCaptureValidator::isUsableSatellite)
                ?.map { androidTypes.getValue(it.constellation) to it.svid }?.toSet()
            for (index in 0 until frames.length()) {
                val records = frames.getJSONObject(index).getJSONArray("satellites")
                val counts = (0 until records.length()).map { records.getJSONObject(it).getInt("constellation") }.groupingBy { it }.eachCount()
                if (autonomous) {
                    assertTrue("Visible floor was not delivered", records.length() >= minimum)
                    val identities = (0 until records.length()).map {
                        records.getJSONObject(it).getInt("constellation") to records.getJSONObject(it).getInt("svid")
                    }
                    assertEquals("Duplicate identity in autonomous sky", identities.size, identities.distinct().size)
                } else if (!realCapture) assertEquals(expectedCounts, counts)
                for (record in 0 until records.length()) {
                    val satellite = records.getJSONObject(record)
                    if (autonomous) {
                        assertTrue(satellite.getDouble("elevationDegrees") in 0.0..90.0)
                        assertTrue(satellite.getDouble("azimuthDegrees") in 0.0..<360.0)
                        assertTrue(satellite.getDouble("cn0DbHz") in 0.0..63.0)
                        if (satellite.getBoolean("usedInFix")) assertTrue(satellite.getBoolean("hasEphemeris"))
                    } else if (!realCapture) assertTrue(satellite.getBoolean("usedInFix"))
                    else {
                        assertTrue("Invented satellite identity", checkNotNull(realIdentities).contains(
                            satellite.getInt("constellation") to satellite.getInt("svid")))
                        assertTrue(satellite.getDouble("elevationDegrees") in 0.0..90.0)
                        val azimuth = satellite.getDouble("azimuthDegrees")
                        assertTrue(azimuth >= 0.0 && azimuth < 360.0)
                        assertTrue(satellite.getDouble("cn0DbHz") > 0.0)
                    }
                }
            }
            if (routed) {
                assertTrue("Local receiver did not run alongside independent receiver", localFrames.size >= sampleSeconds - 5)
                val model = GnssBundledOrbitResources.model(original.configuration.gnssSimulation.copy(
                    mode = GnssSimulationMode.AUTONOMOUS, minimumPolicy = GnssMinimumPolicy.GUARANTEE_QUANTITY,
                    environment = GnssSimulationEnvironment.OPEN_SKY), GnssOutputLimits(128, 36, 32), 604800.0)
                fun matchesSky(records: List<GnssSatellite>, at: Long, point: Wgs84): Boolean {
                    // Android status callbacks carry arrival time only. Allow bounded delivery
                    // latency; compare angular geometry, never claim arrival is the native epoch.
                    val predicted = model.frame(GnssSkyRequest(at, point, 42.0), minimum)!!.satellites
                        .associateBy { it.constellation to it.svid }
                    return records.count { record ->
                        predicted[record.constellation to record.svid]?.let { expected ->
                            val azimuth = kotlin.math.abs(record.azimuthDeg - expected.azimuthDeg)
                            kotlin.math.abs(record.elevationDeg - expected.elevationDeg) < .25 &&
                                minOf(azimuth, 360f - azimuth) < .25
                        } == true
                    } >= records.size * .95
                }
                localFrames.forEach { (at, records) ->
                    assertTrue("Local route sky does not match its target", matchesSky(records, at, localPoint))
                    assertFalse("Local route reused the remote sky", matchesSky(records, at, remotePoint))
                }
                for (index in 0 until frames.length()) {
                    val frame = frames.getJSONObject(index)
                    val records = frame.getJSONArray("satellites")
                    val satellites = (0 until records.length()).map { item -> records.getJSONObject(item).let {
                        GnssSatellite(androidSystems.getValue(it.getInt("constellation")), it.getInt("svid"),
                            it.getDouble("elevationDegrees").toFloat(), it.getDouble("azimuthDegrees").toFloat(),
                            it.getDouble("cn0DbHz").toFloat(), it.getBoolean("usedInFix"),
                            it.getBoolean("hasEphemeris"), it.getBoolean("hasAlmanac"))
                    } }
                    val at = frame.getLong("capturedAtMillis")
                    assertTrue("Independent route sky does not match its target", matchesSky(satellites, at, remotePoint))
                    assertFalse("Independent route reused the local sky", matchesSky(satellites, at, localPoint))
                }
            }
            val checks = report.getJSONArray("checks")
            val relevant = (0 until checks.length()).map { checks.getJSONObject(it) }.associateBy { it.getString("id") }
            for (id in listOf("C05", "C07")) {
                val check = checkNotNull(relevant[id])
                assertEquals("$id: ${check.getString("detail")}", "PASS", check.getString("status"))
            }
            val locationEvidence = checkNotNull(relevant["C05"]).getJSONArray("evidence")
            val lines = (0 until locationEvidence.length()).map { locationEvidence.getString(it) }
            val coverage = lines.firstNotNullOfOrNull {
                Regex("GPS extras=(\\d+)，同时间窗对账=(\\d+)").find(it)
            } ?: error("Detector did not report GPS extras comparison coverage")
            val suppliedGps = coverage.groupValues[1].toInt()
            val comparedGps = coverage.groupValues[2].toInt()
            assertTrue("GPS callbacks did not exercise the high-rate stream", suppliedGps >= sampleSeconds * 5)
            assertEquals("Every supplied GPS extras sample must be compared", suppliedGps, comparedGps)
            val distinctGps = lines.firstNotNullOfOrNull { Regex("GPS 不同坐标=(\\d+)").find(it) }
                ?.groupValues?.get(1)?.toInt() ?: error("Detector did not report GPS movement coverage")
            if (routed) assertEquals("Fixed route must not inherit global movement", 1, distinctGps)
            else assertTrue("Independent GPS receiver did not observe movement/noise", distinctGps >= sampleSeconds * 5)
            val nmeaEvidence = checkNotNull(relevant["C07"]).getJSONArray("evidence")
            val nmeaLines = (0 until nmeaEvidence.length()).map { nmeaEvidence.getString(it) }
            val pairedGsv = nmeaLines.firstNotNullOfOrNull {
                Regex("GSV↔GnssStatus：(\\d+) 组完成同时间窗身份对账；身份差异=(\\d+) 组，最大数量差=(\\d+)").find(it)
            } ?: error("Detector did not report per-epoch GSV identity comparison coverage")
            val bursts = nmeaLines.firstNotNullOfOrNull { Regex("GSV：(\\d+) 组 burst").find(it) }
                ?.groupValues?.get(1)?.toInt() ?: error("Detector did not report GSV burst count")
            val expectedBursts = if (realCapture || autonomous) (0 until frames.length()).count {
                frames.getJSONObject(it).getJSONArray("satellites").length() > 0
            } - 2 else sampleSeconds - 5
            assertTrue("Insufficient independent NMEA/GNSS comparisons", bursts >= expectedBursts)
            assertEquals("Every GSV epoch must be compared", bursts, pairedGsv.groupValues[1].toInt())
            assertEquals("GSV identities differ from status", 0, pairedGsv.groupValues[2].toInt())
            assertEquals("GSV count differs from status", 0, pairedGsv.groupValues[3].toInt())
            assertNotEquals("Invalid GNSS fields observed", "FAIL", checkNotNull(relevant["C06"]).getString("status"))
            assertEquals("Completed receiver run leaked a framework status registration", 0, statusRegistrations())
        } finally {
            renewal?.cancelAndJoin()
            if (routed) manager.unregisterGnssStatusCallback(localCallback)
            command("stop")
            if (configured) {
                command("put_config") {
                    if (routed) putString("routing_json", null)
                    putString("gnss_capture", null)
                    putString("gnss_mode", original.configuration.gnssSimulation.mode.name)
                    if (autonomous) {
                        putString("gnss_navigation", original.configuration.gnssNavigation?.let(RinexNavigationResource::encodeWire))
                        putString("gnss_minimum_policy", original.configuration.gnssSimulation.minimumPolicy.name)
                        putString("gnss_environment", original.configuration.gnssSimulation.environment.name)
                    }
                    putBoolean("enable_nmea", original.configuration.nmeaEnabled)
                    putBoolean("enable_physical_noise", original.physicalNoise)
                    putInt("min_satellites", original.configuration.minimumSatellites)
                }
                command(if (original.configuration.gnssEnabled) "start_gnss_mock" else "stop_gnss_mock")
            }
            val restored = RuntimeTransferWire.decode(checkNotNull(command("sync_config").getByteArray(RuntimeSyncCommand.PAYLOAD))).state
            assertNull(restored.configuration.gnssSource)
            assertFalse(restored.configuration.enabled)
            assertEquals(original.physicalNoise, restored.physicalNoise)
            assertEquals(original.configuration.nmeaEnabled, restored.configuration.nmeaEnabled)
            assertEquals(original.configuration.gnssEnabled, restored.configuration.gnssEnabled)
            assertEquals(original.configuration.minimumSatellites, restored.configuration.minimumSatellites)
            assertEquals(original.configuration.gnssSimulation, restored.configuration.gnssSimulation)
            assertEquals(original.routing, restored.routing)
        }
    }
}
```

```kt
package com.system.location.service

import android.os.ParcelFileDescriptor
import androidx.compose.ui.test.*
import androidx.compose.ui.test.junit4.v2.createEmptyComposeRule
import androidx.test.core.app.ActivityScenario
import androidx.test.ext.junit.runners.AndroidJUnit4
import androidx.test.platform.app.InstrumentationRegistry
import com.system.location.service.runtime.ScenarioRuntime
import org.junit.Assert.*
import org.junit.Rule
import org.junit.Test
import org.junit.runner.RunWith

@RunWith(AndroidJUnit4::class)
class GnssLiveObservationUiTest {
    @get:Rule val compose = createEmptyComposeRule()

    /** Restrict inspection to current GPS state; historical logs can contain old requests. */
    private fun gpsState(): String {
        val descriptor = InstrumentationRegistry.getInstrumentation().uiAutomation.executeShellCommand("dumpsys location")
        val dump = ParcelFileDescriptor.AutoCloseInputStream(descriptor).bufferedReader().use { it.readText() }
        return dump.substringAfter("    gps provider:").substringBefore("GNSS_KPI_START")
    }

    @Test fun realObservationStartsWithoutSimulationAndReleasesRequestsWhenHidden() {
        acceptSelectedMapForUiTest()
        grantUiPermissions()
        assertFalse("Run on an idle device", ScenarioRuntime.state.value.isActive)
        ActivityScenario.launch(MainActivity::class.java).use { scenario ->
            compose.openPage(scenario, R.id.nav_mock)
            compose.waitUntil(5_000) { !gpsState().contains("com.system.location.service") }
            compose.onNodeWithText("卫星").performClick()
            compose.onNodeWithText("星图信息").assertExists()
            compose.waitUntil(5_000) { gpsState().contains("com.system.location.service") }
            assertFalse(ScenarioRuntime.state.value.isActive)
            // Signal acquisition depends on the physical environment; record the actual sky.
            Thread.sleep(10_000)
            compose.waitForIdle()
            captureUi("satellite-live-observation")
            compose.onNodeWithText("环境").performClick()
            compose.waitUntil(5_000) { !gpsState().contains("com.system.location.service") }
            compose.onNodeWithText("卫星").performClick()
            compose.waitUntil(5_000) { gpsState().contains("com.system.location.service") }
            scenario.moveToState(androidx.lifecycle.Lifecycle.State.CREATED)
            compose.waitUntil(5_000) { !gpsState().contains("com.system.location.service") }
            scenario.moveToState(androidx.lifecycle.Lifecycle.State.RESUMED)
            compose.waitUntil(5_000) { gpsState().contains("com.system.location.service") }
        }
    }
}
```

`app/src/androidTest/java/com/system/location/service/GnssPassthroughDeviceTest.kt`:

```kt
package com.system.location.service

import android.Manifest
import android.content.pm.PackageManager
import android.location.GnssMeasurementsEvent
import android.location.GnssStatus
import android.location.LocationListener
import android.location.LocationManager
import android.os.Bundle
import android.os.ParcelFileDescriptor
import android.os.SystemClock
import androidx.test.ext.junit.runners.AndroidJUnit4
import androidx.test.platform.app.InstrumentationRegistry
import com.system.location.service.core.geo.Wgs84
import com.system.location.service.core.location.LocationSample
import com.system.location.service.core.runtime.RuntimeTransferWire
import com.system.location.service.hook.RuntimeSyncCommand
import com.system.location.service.hook.security.CommandClient
import com.system.location.service.hook.security.SampleWire
import com.system.location.service.runtime.ScenarioRuntime
import java.util.concurrent.LinkedBlockingQueue
import java.util.concurrent.TimeUnit
import kotlinx.coroutines.*
import org.junit.Assert.*
import org.junit.Assume.*
import org.junit.Test
import org.junit.runner.RunWith

/** Real receiver registration/callback checks with an authenticated, explicitly absent profile. */
@RunWith(AndroidJUnit4::class)
class GnssPassthroughDeviceTest {
    @Test fun absentProfilePreservesPhysicalCallbacksAndRegistrationLifecycle() = runBlocking {
        assumeTrue("Explicit device run required", InstrumentationRegistry.getArguments().getString("libxposedDevice") == "true")
        val instrumentation = InstrumentationRegistry.getInstrumentation()
        val context = instrumentation.targetContext
        val manager = context.getSystemService(LocationManager::class.java)
        ScenarioRuntime.awaitInitialized()
        assumeFalse("Preserve local simulation", ScenarioRuntime.state.value.isActive)
        for (permission in listOf(Manifest.permission.ACCESS_FINE_LOCATION, Manifest.permission.ACCESS_BACKGROUND_LOCATION)) {
            assumeTrue("Existing permission required: $permission",
                context.checkSelfPermission(permission) == PackageManager.PERMISSION_GRANTED)
        }
        assumeTrue("GPS must already be enabled", manager.isProviderEnabled(LocationManager.GPS_PROVIDER))
        val client = CommandClient()
        assertTrue("Authenticated connection required", client.connect(manager))
        fun command(name: String, fill: Bundle.() -> Unit = {}): Bundle = Bundle().apply {
            putString("command_id", name); fill()
            assertTrue("Command failed: $name", client.send(manager, this))
        }
        val initial = command("get_runtime_status")
        assertEquals("SYSTEM_SERVER", initial.getString("hook_scope"))
        assumeFalse("Preserve system simulation", initial.getBoolean("is_start"))
        val snapshot = RuntimeTransferWire.decode(checkNotNull(command("sync_config").getByteArray(RuntimeSyncCommand.PAYLOAD)))
        assumeTrue("Requires an absent profile; do not clear user evidence", snapshot.state.configuration.gnssSource == null)

        fun registrations(header: String): Int {
            val dump = ParcelFileDescriptor.AutoCloseInputStream(
                instrumentation.uiAutomation.executeShellCommand("dumpsys location"))
                .bufferedReader().use { it.readText() }.lines()
            val start = dump.indices.single { dump[it].trim() == header }
            val indent = dump[start].takeWhile(Char::isWhitespace).length
            val section = dump.drop(start + 1).takeWhile { it.isBlank() || it.takeWhile(Char::isWhitespace).length > indent }
            check(section.any { it.trimStart().startsWith("service:") }) { "Provider dump has no service state" }
            val packageEntry = Regex("^\\s*\\d+/${Regex.escape(context.packageName)}(?:\\[|/|\\s|$)")
            return section.count { packageEntry.containsMatchIn(it) }
        }
        assumeTrue("Preserve preexisting registrations", registrations("Status Provider:") == 0 && registrations("Measurements Provider:") == 0)
        val statusEvents = LinkedBlockingQueue<Int>()
        val status = object : GnssStatus.Callback() {
            override fun onSatelliteStatusChanged(status: GnssStatus) { statusEvents.offer(status.satelliteCount) }
        }
        val existing = object : GnssMeasurementsEvent.Callback() {}
        val addedWhileActive = object : GnssMeasurementsEvent.Callback() {}
        val location = LocationListener { }
        var renewal: Job? = null
        try {
            assertTrue(manager.registerGnssStatusCallback({ it.run() }, status))
            assertTrue(manager.registerGnssStatusCallback({ it.run() }, status))
            assertEquals("Duplicate status registration", 1, registrations("Status Provider:"))
            assertTrue(manager.registerGnssMeasurementsCallback({ it.run() }, existing))
            assertEquals(1, registrations("Measurements Provider:"))
            fun publish() {
                command("publish_sample") {
                    SampleWire.write(this, LocationSample(Wgs84(31.230416, 121.473701),
                        altitude = 42.0, accuracy = 5f, speed = 0f, bearing = 73f,
                        timeMillis = System.currentTimeMillis(), elapsedNanos = SystemClock.elapsedRealtimeNanos()))
                }
            }
            publish()
            renewal = launch(Dispatchers.IO) { while (isActive) { delay(500L); publish() } }
            assertTrue("Without a frame, raw registration must reach Android",
                manager.registerGnssMeasurementsCallback({ it.run() }, addedWhileActive))
            assertEquals(2, registrations("Measurements Provider:"))
            manager.requestLocationUpdates(LocationManager.GPS_PROVIDER, 1_000L, 0f, { it.run() }, location)
            // No captured source exists, so these callbacks can only be the real provider stream.
            repeat(2) { assertNotNull("Physical status was suppressed while no profile exists", statusEvents.poll(8, TimeUnit.SECONDS)) }
            assertTrue(command("get_runtime_status").getBoolean("is_start"))
            manager.unregisterGnssMeasurementsCallback(existing)
            assertEquals(1, registrations("Measurements Provider:"))
            manager.unregisterGnssStatusCallback(status)
            assertEquals(0, registrations("Status Provider:"))
            renewal.cancelAndJoin()
            command("stop")
            manager.unregisterGnssMeasurementsCallback(addedWhileActive)
            assertEquals(0, registrations("Measurements Provider:"))
        } finally {
            renewal?.cancelAndJoin()
            try {
                manager.removeUpdates(location)
                manager.unregisterGnssStatusCallback(status)
                manager.unregisterGnssMeasurementsCallback(existing)
                manager.unregisterGnssMeasurementsCallback(addedWhileActive)
            } finally {
                assertFalse(command("stop").let { command("get_runtime_status").getBoolean("is_start") })
            }
        }
    }
}
```

`app/src/androidTest/java/com/system/location/service/GnssRemoteBinderDeviceTest.java`:

```java
package com.system.location.service;

import android.content.ComponentName;
import android.content.Context;
import android.content.Intent;
import android.content.ServiceConnection;
import android.os.IBinder;
import android.os.IInterface;
import android.os.Parcel;
import android.os.Process;
import androidx.test.ext.junit.runners.AndroidJUnit4;
import androidx.test.platform.app.InstrumentationRegistry;
import com.system.location.service.hook.hooks.gnss.GnssCallbackRegistry;
import com.system.location.service.hook.runtime.CallbackSubscription;
import com.system.location.service.hook.runtime.DeliveryWorker;
import java.util.concurrent.CountDownLatch;
import java.util.concurrent.TimeUnit;
import java.util.concurrent.atomic.AtomicReference;
import kotlin.Unit;
import org.junit.Test;
import org.junit.runner.RunWith;
import static org.junit.Assert.*;

/** Java accesses the production registry's JVM API without widening its Kotlin visibility. */
@RunWith(AndroidJUnit4.class)
public class GnssRemoteBinderDeviceTest {
    @Test public void unregisterDuringRemoteTransactionInvalidatesTheOldBatch() throws Exception {
        try (Remote remote = new Remote()) {
            GnssCallbackRegistry registry = new GnssCallbackRegistry();
            IInterface listener = () -> remote.binder;
            assertTrue(registry.register(listener, "old", Process.myUid()));
            AtomicReference<Throwable> error = new AtomicReference<>();
            Thread sender = new Thread(() -> {
                try { deliver(registry, listener, remote, true); }
                catch (Throwable failure) { error.set(failure); }
            });
            try {
                sender.start();
                try {
                    assertEquals(1, remote.integer(GnssBinderTestService.WAIT_ENTERED));
                    // This must finish while the actual remote Binder transaction is still blocked.
                    registry.unregister(listener);
                    assertTrue(registry.register(listener, "replacement", Process.myUid()));
                } finally {
                    try { remote.control(GnssBinderTestService.RELEASE); }
                    finally { sender.join(4000); }
                }
                assertFalse(sender.isAlive());
                if (error.get() != null) throw new AssertionError(error.get());
                assertArrayEquals(new int[] {0}, remote.accepted());
                assertNull(registry.subscriptions().get(0).getPendingDeliveryKey());
                deliver(registry, listener, remote, false);
                assertArrayEquals(new int[] {0, 0, 1, 2}, remote.accepted());
            } finally { registry.clear(); }
        }
    }

    @Test public void pauseDuringRemoteTransactionTransfersOnlyItsUnsentSuffix() throws Exception {
        try (Remote remote = new Remote()) {
            GnssCallbackRegistry registry = new GnssCallbackRegistry();
            GnssCallbackRegistry successor = new GnssCallbackRegistry();
            IInterface listener = () -> remote.binder;
            assertTrue(registry.register(listener, "receiver", Process.myUid()));
            AtomicReference<Exception> error = new AtomicReference<>();
            DeliveryWorker worker = new DeliveryWorker("RemoteBinderTest", () -> 60000L, false,
                () -> { deliver(registry, listener, remote, true); return Unit.INSTANCE; },
                failure -> { error.set(failure); return Unit.INSTANCE; });
            try {
                worker.start();
                assertEquals(1, remote.integer(GnssBinderTestService.WAIT_ENTERED));
                assertFalse("Binder is still in flight", worker.stop(20));
                remote.control(GnssBinderTestService.RELEASE);
                assertTrue(worker.stop(4000));
                assertNull(error.get());
                assertArrayEquals(new int[] {0}, remote.accepted());
                CallbackSubscription saved = registry.subscriptions().get(0);
                assertEquals(1, saved.getNextDeliveryIndex());
                registry.clear();
                assertTrue(successor.restore(saved));
                deliver(successor, listener, remote, false);
                deliver(successor, listener, remote, false);
                assertArrayEquals(new int[] {0, 1, 2}, remote.accepted());
            } finally {
                try { remote.control(GnssBinderTestService.RELEASE); }
                finally {
                    try { worker.stop(4000); }
                    finally { registry.clear(); successor.clear(); }
                }
            }
        }
    }

    @Test public void remoteProcessDeathRemovesTheRealBinderRegistration() throws Exception {
        try (Remote remote = new Remote()) {
            GnssCallbackRegistry registry = new GnssCallbackRegistry();
            IInterface listener = () -> remote.binder;
            CountDownLatch died = new CountDownLatch(1);
            IBinder.DeathRecipient death = died::countDown;
            remote.binder.linkToDeath(death, 0);
            try {
                assertTrue(registry.register(listener, "receiver", Process.myUid()));
                Parcel data = Parcel.obtain();
                try {
                    data.writeInterfaceToken(GnssBinderTestService.DESCRIPTOR);
                    assertTrue(remote.binder.transact(GnssBinderTestService.DIE, data, null, IBinder.FLAG_ONEWAY));
                } finally { data.recycle(); }
                assertTrue("Real remote death notification missing", died.await(4, TimeUnit.SECONDS));
                long until = System.nanoTime() + TimeUnit.SECONDS.toNanos(3);
                while (!registry.subscriptions().isEmpty() && System.nanoTime() < until) Thread.sleep(10);
                assertTrue(registry.subscriptions().isEmpty());
                assertFalse(registry.register(listener, "dead", Process.myUid()));
            } finally {
                registry.clear();
                remote.binder.unlinkToDeath(death, 0);
            }
        }
    }

    private static void deliver(GnssCallbackRegistry registry, IInterface listener, Remote remote, boolean block) {
        registry.deliverBatch(listener, "exact batch", 3, () -> true, index -> {
            remote.submit(index, block);
            return Unit.INSTANCE;
        });
    }

    private static final class Remote implements AutoCloseable {
        final Context context = InstrumentationRegistry.getInstrumentation().getContext();
        final CountDownLatch connected = new CountDownLatch(1);
        IBinder binder;
        boolean bound;
        final ServiceConnection connection = new ServiceConnection() {
            @Override public void onServiceConnected(ComponentName name, IBinder service) {
                binder = service;
                connected.countDown();
            }
            @Override public void onServiceDisconnected(ComponentName name) { }
        };
        Remote() throws Exception {
            Intent intent = new Intent().setComponent(new ComponentName(context.getPackageName(),
                GnssBinderTestService.class.getName()));
            bound = context.bindService(intent, connection, Context.BIND_AUTO_CREATE);
            try {
                assertTrue("Cannot bind test APK service", bound);
                assertTrue("Remote service did not connect", connected.await(5, TimeUnit.SECONDS));
                assertNotEquals("Fixture must cross a process boundary", Process.myPid(), integer(GnssBinderTestService.PID));
            } catch (Throwable error) { close(); throw error; }
        }
        interface Read<T> { T read(Parcel parcel); }
        <T> T transact(int code, java.util.function.Consumer<Parcel> fill, Read<T> read) {
            Parcel data = Parcel.obtain();
            Parcel reply = Parcel.obtain();
            try {
                data.writeInterfaceToken(GnssBinderTestService.DESCRIPTOR);
                fill.accept(data);
                assertTrue(binder.transact(code, data, reply, 0));
                reply.readException();
                return read.read(reply);
            } catch (android.os.RemoteException error) { throw new AssertionError(error); }
            finally { data.recycle(); reply.recycle(); }
        }
        void submit(int index, boolean block) {
            transact(GnssBinderTestService.SUBMIT, p -> { p.writeInt(index); p.writeInt(block ? 1 : 0); }, p -> null);
        }
        int integer(int code) { return transact(code, p -> {}, Parcel::readInt); }
        int[] accepted() { return transact(GnssBinderTestService.READ, p -> {}, Parcel::createIntArray); }
        void control(int code) { transact(code, p -> {}, p -> null); }
        @Override public void close() { if (bound) { context.unbindService(connection); bound = false; } }
    }
}
```

`app/src/androidTest/java/com/system/location/service/GnssStandardCaptureDeviceTest.kt`:

```kt
package com.system.location.service

import android.Manifest
import android.content.pm.PackageManager
import android.location.LocationManager
import androidx.test.ext.junit.runners.AndroidJUnit4
import androidx.test.platform.app.InstrumentationRegistry
import com.system.location.service.core.gnss.GnssCaptureCodec
import com.system.location.service.core.gnss.GnssCaptureValidator
import com.system.location.service.gnss.GnssReceiverCollector
import com.system.location.service.runtime.ScenarioRuntime
import com.system.location.service.service.MockServiceHelper
import java.io.File
import kotlinx.coroutines.runBlocking
import kotlinx.coroutines.withTimeout
import org.junit.Assert.*
import org.junit.Assume.*
import org.junit.Test
import org.junit.runner.RunWith

/** Real evidence on the standard backend; never installs a fixture or changes a saved profile. */
@RunWith(AndroidJUnit4::class)
class GnssStandardCaptureDeviceTest {
    @Test fun collectPhysicalWindowWithoutHookAuthority() = runBlocking {
        val instrumentation = InstrumentationRegistry.getInstrumentation()
        val arguments = InstrumentationRegistry.getArguments()
        assumeTrue(arguments.getString("standardProviderDevice") == "true")
        val context = instrumentation.targetContext
        val manager = context.getSystemService(LocationManager::class.java)
        ScenarioRuntime.awaitInitialized()
        assumeFalse("Preserve active simulation", ScenarioRuntime.state.value.isActive)
        for (permission in listOf(Manifest.permission.ACCESS_FINE_LOCATION, Manifest.permission.ACCESS_BACKGROUND_LOCATION)) {
            assumeTrue("Existing permission required: $permission",
                context.checkSelfPermission(permission) == PackageManager.PERMISSION_GRANTED)
        }
        assumeTrue(manager.isProviderEnabled(LocationManager.GPS_PROVIDER))
        MockServiceHelper.tryInitService(manager)
        assertNull("Standard comparison requires absent Hook authority", MockServiceHelper.runtimeStatus(manager))
        val duration = arguments.getString("physicalCaptureMillis")?.toLong() ?: 120_000L
        require(duration in 30_000L..300_000L)
        val capture = withTimeout(duration + 15_000L) { GnssReceiverCollector(context).capture(duration) }
        File(context.cacheDir, "gnss-standard-physical-window.json").writeText(GnssCaptureCodec.encode(capture))
        val quality = GnssCaptureValidator.validate(capture, System.currentTimeMillis())
        instrumentation.sendStatus(0, android.os.Bundle().apply {
            putString("physical_capture_quality", "eligible=${quality.eligible}; ${quality.issues.joinToString()}")
            putInt("physical_capture_frames", capture.frames.size)
            putInt("physical_capture_usable_samples", capture.frames.sumOf { frame ->
                frame.satellites.count(GnssCaptureValidator::isUsableSatellite)
            })
            putInt("measurement_batches", capture.measurements.size)
            putInt("navigation_messages", capture.navigation.size)
        })
        // Quality is reported separately: collecting rejected evidence is not profile acceptance.
        assertTrue(capture.frames.isNotEmpty())
        assertNull(MockServiceHelper.runtimeStatus(manager))
    }
}
```

`app/src/androidTest/java/com/system/location/service/HomeMapLifetimeUiTest.kt`:

```kt
package com.system.location.service

import androidx.compose.ui.test.assertIsDisplayed
import androidx.compose.ui.test.onNodeWithText
import androidx.compose.ui.test.junit4.v2.createEmptyComposeRule
import androidx.test.core.app.ActivityScenario
import androidx.test.ext.junit.runners.AndroidJUnit4
import androidx.test.platform.app.InstrumentationRegistry
import com.system.location.service.ext.sharedPrefs
import com.system.location.service.maps.MapProvider
import com.system.location.service.maps.PortalMapView
import com.system.location.service.maps.mapProvider
import org.junit.Assert.*
import org.junit.Rule
import org.junit.Test
import org.junit.runner.RunWith

@RunWith(AndroidJUnit4::class)
class HomeMapLifetimeUiTest {
    @get:Rule val compose = createEmptyComposeRule()

    @Test fun pausedHomeMapIsReusedButReleasedOnMemoryPressureAndActivityRecreation() {
        val context = InstrumentationRegistry.getInstrumentation().targetContext
        val preferences = context.sharedPrefs
        val hadProvider = preferences.contains("map_provider")
        val originalProvider = preferences.getString("map_provider", null)
        try {
            for (provider in MapProvider.entries) {
                context.mapProvider = provider
                acceptSelectedMapForUiTest()
                grantUiPermissions()
                ActivityScenario.launch(MainActivity::class.java).use { scenario ->
                    fun drawerPage(destination: Int) {
                        compose.waitForIdle()
                        scenario.onActivity { it.navigateFromDrawer(destination) }
                        compose.waitUntil(5_000) {
                            var resumed = false
                            scenario.onActivity { activity ->
                                val host = activity.supportFragmentManager.findFragmentById(R.id.nav_host_fragment_content_main)!!
                                val page = host.childFragmentManager.primaryNavigationFragment
                                resumed = (host as androidx.navigation.fragment.NavHostFragment).navController.currentDestination?.id == destination &&
                                    page?.lifecycle?.currentState == androidx.lifecycle.Lifecycle.State.RESUMED
                            }
                            resumed
                        }
                        compose.waitForIdle()
                    }
                    fun currentMap(): PortalMapView {
                        compose.waitUntil(5_000) {
                            runCatching { compose.onNodeWithText("开始模拟").assertIsDisplayed(); true }.getOrDefault(false)
                        }
                        compose.onNodeWithText("开始模拟").assertIsDisplayed()
                        lateinit var map: PortalMapView
                        scenario.onActivity { activity ->
                            map = activity.window.decorView.descendantsOfType<PortalMapView>().single { it.isAttachedToWindow }
                        }
                        assertEquals(provider, map.provider)
                        assertTrue(map.childCount > 0)
                        return map
                    }
                    val initial = currentMap()
                    lateinit var home: androidx.fragment.app.Fragment
                    scenario.onActivity { activity ->
                        home = activity.supportFragmentManager.findFragmentById(R.id.nav_host_fragment_content_main)!!
                            .childFragmentManager.primaryNavigationFragment!!
                    }
                    repeat(2) {
                        drawerPage(R.id.nav_settings)
                        compose.onNodeWithText("地图与定位").assertIsDisplayed()
                        assertNull("Paused map must detach from its previous AndroidView holder", initial.parent)
                        drawerPage(R.id.nav_home)
                        assertSame("Returning must not initialize the SDK again", initial, currentMap())
                    }
                    drawerPage(R.id.nav_settings)
                    // Compose can be idle while Fragment's native exit transition still owns its View.
                    // Exercise memory pressure on the cached, offscreen map after onDestroyView.
                    compose.waitUntil(5_000) {
                        var offscreen = false
                        scenario.onActivity { offscreen = home.view == null }
                        offscreen
                    }
                    scenario.onActivity { home.onLowMemory() }
                    assertEquals("Memory pressure must release the offscreen SDK", 0, initial.childCount)
                    drawerPage(R.id.nav_home)
                    val replacement = currentMap()
                    assertNotSame(initial, replacement)
                    scenario.recreate()
                    assertEquals("Activity destruction must release the cached SDK", 0, replacement.childCount)
                    assertNotSame(replacement, currentMap())
                    captureUi("home-map-reused-${provider.name.lowercase()}")
                }
            }
        } finally {
            preferences.edit().apply {
                if (hadProvider) putString("map_provider", originalProvider) else remove("map_provider")
            }.commit()
        }
    }
}
```
