```kt
    @Test fun robotStartsSavedRouteAndOnlyEnablesManualControlForAPoint() = withSavedTargets { location, route ->
        withMockRuntime {
            val appOps = context.getSystemService(AppOpsManager::class.java)
            val previousMode = appOps.unsafeCheckOpNoThrow(AppOpsManager.OPSTR_SYSTEM_ALERT_WINDOW, Process.myUid(), context.packageName)
            val preferences = context.getSharedPreferences("rocker_overlay", Context.MODE_PRIVATE)
            val savedVisibility = preferences.snapshot("enabled")
            fun permission(mode: String) {
                ParcelFileDescriptor.AutoCloseInputStream(instrumentation.uiAutomation.executeShellCommand(
                    "appops set ${context.packageName} SYSTEM_ALERT_WINDOW $mode")).use { it.readBytes() }
            }
            fun overlay(id: Int) = onView(withId(id)).inRoot(withDecorView(hasDescendant(withId(R.id.rocker_minimized))))
            try {
                permission("allow")
                instrumentation.runOnMainSync { RockerOverlay.setEnabled(false) }
                preferences.edit().putBoolean("enabled", true).commit()
                ActivityScenario.launch(MainActivity::class.java).use {
                    compose.onNodeWithText("开始模拟").assertIsDisplayed()
                    overlay(R.id.rocker_minimized).perform(click())
                    fun choose(label: String) {
                        overlay(R.id.auto).perform(click())
                        compose.waitUntil(10_000) {
                            // Poll the separate window without Espresso's longer missing-root timeout.
                            var visible = false
                            instrumentation.runOnMainSync {
                                visible = WindowInspector.getGlobalWindowViews().any { root ->
                                    (root as? ViewGroup)?.descendants?.filterIsInstance<TextView>()
                                        ?.any { it.isShown && it.text.toString() == label } == true
                                }
                            }
                            visible
                        }
                        // The picker uses TYPE_APPLICATION_OVERLAY, so Espresso's default root
                        // can select the now-unfocused Activity instead of this separate window.
                        onView(withText(label)).inRoot(withDecorView(hasDescendant(withText(label)))).perform(click())
                    }
                    choose(context.getString(R.string.overlay_target_route, route.route.name))

                    choose(context.getString(R.string.overlay_target_location, location.name))
                    awaitRunning(location.name)
                    assertNull(ScenarioRuntime.state.value.routeId)
                    assertCoordinate(location.coordinate, ScenarioRuntime.state.value)
                    overlay(R.id.rocker).check(matches(androidx.test.espresso.matcher.ViewMatchers.isEnabled()))
                }
            } finally {
                instrumentation.runOnMainSync { RockerOverlay.setEnabled(false) }
                preferences.restore(savedVisibility)
                permission(when (previousMode) {
                    AppOpsManager.MODE_ALLOWED -> "allow"
                    AppOpsManager.MODE_IGNORED -> "ignore"
                    AppOpsManager.MODE_ERRORED -> "deny"
                    else -> "default"
                })
            }
        }
    }

    @Test fun deletingTheSelectedRecordClearsItsTargetAfterRecreation() = withSavedTargets { location, route ->
        withMockRuntime {
            ActivityScenario.launch(MainActivity::class.java).use { scenario ->
                selectSavedTarget("路线", route.route.name)
                assertSelectionWithoutStart(route.route.name)
                LibraryRepositories.routes.delete(route.route.id)
                scenario.recreate()
                assertDeletedTargetCleared(route.route.name)
                selectSavedTarget("地点", location.name)

                LibraryRepositories.locations.delete(location.id)
                scenario.recreate()
                assertDeletedTargetCleared(location.name)

    private fun assertDeletedTargetCleared(name: String) {
        compose.waitUntil(10_000) {
            compose.onAllNodes(hasText("已选目标已被删除，请重新选择")).fetchSemanticsNodes().isNotEmpty()
        }
        compose.onNodeWithText(name).assertDoesNotExist()
        compose.onNodeWithText("开始模拟").assertIsNotEnabled()
        compose.onNodeWithText("停止模拟").assertIsNotEnabled()
        assertFalse("A deleted target must not start a fallback point or route", ScenarioRuntime.state.value.isActive)
    }

    private fun openPicker() {
        compose.onNodeWithContentDescription("选择模拟目标").assertIsDisplayed().performClick()
    }

    private fun selectSavedTarget(tab: String, name: String) {
        openPicker()
        compose.onNode(hasText(tab) and hasAnyAncestor(hasTestTag("home-target-picker"))).performClick()
        compose.scrollTo(hasText(name) and hasAnyAncestor(hasTestTag("home-target-picker"))).performClick()
        compose.onNode(hasText(name) and hasAnyAncestor(hasTestTag("home-target-picker"))).assertDoesNotExist()
    }

    private fun assertSelectionWithoutStart(name: String) {
        compose.waitUntil(10_000) {
            compose.onAllNodes(hasText(name)).fetchSemanticsNodes().isNotEmpty() &&
                compose.onAllNodes(hasText("开始模拟") and isEnabled()).fetchSemanticsNodes().isNotEmpty()
        }
        compose.onNodeWithText(name).assertIsDisplayed()
        compose.onNodeWithText("开始模拟").assertIsEnabled()
        compose.onNodeWithText("停止模拟").assertIsNotEnabled()
        assertFalse("Selecting or restoring a saved target must never start simulation", ScenarioRuntime.state.value.isActive)
    }

    private fun awaitRunning(name: String) {
        compose.waitUntil(15_000) {
            val state = ScenarioRuntime.state.value
            assertNotEquals("Home start failed: ${state.error}", RuntimePhase.ERROR, state.phase)
            state.phase == RuntimePhase.RUNNING && state.scenarioName == name && state.sample != null
        }
        assertEquals(name, ScenarioRuntime.state.value.scenarioName)
    }

    private fun assertCoordinate(expected: Wgs84, state: RuntimeState) {
        val sample = checkNotNull(state.sample) { "Running target must publish a sample" }
        assertEquals(expected.latitude, sample.coordinate.latitude, 0.000001)
        assertEquals(expected.longitude, sample.coordinate.longitude, 0.000001)
    }

    private fun stopFromHome() {
        compose.onNodeWithText("停止模拟").assertIsEnabled().performClick()
        compose.waitUntil(10_000) { !ScenarioRuntime.state.value.isActive }
        assertEquals(RuntimePhase.STOPPED, ScenarioRuntime.state.value.phase)
        compose.onNodeWithText("开始模拟").assertIsEnabled()
    }

    /** Append uniquely named records so existing user data cannot affect selection assertions. */
    private fun withSavedTargets(test: (SavedLocation, SavedRoute) -> Unit) {
        LibraryRepositories.ensureMigrated()
        val locations = LibraryRepositories.locations.list()
        val routes = LibraryRepositories.routes.list()
        val token = UUID.randomUUID().toString()
        val location = SavedLocation("home-point-$token", "Home point $token", Wgs84(25.123456, 119.123456), "Home test address")
        val route = SavedRoute(Route("home-route-$token", "Home route $token",
            listOf(Wgs84(26.1, 120.1), Wgs84(26.2, 120.2))), mode = RouteMode.LOOP)
        val selected = context.sharedPrefs.snapshot("selectedLocation", "selectedRoute")
        try {
            LibraryRepositories.locations.create(location)
            LibraryRepositories.routes.create(route)
            test(location, route)
        } finally {
            try { LibraryRepositories.locations.replaceAll(locations) }
            finally {
                try { LibraryRepositories.routes.replaceAll(routes) }
                finally { context.sharedPrefs.restore(selected) }
            }
        }
    }

    /** Exercise the real foreground service and Mock Provider; never replace runtime responses. */
    private fun withMockRuntime(test: () -> Unit) {
        runBlocking { ScenarioRuntime.refreshDiagnostics().await() }
        assertFalse("Selection tests require an inactive runtime", ScenarioRuntime.state.value.isActive)
        val backend = ScenarioRuntime.state.value.backend
        val preferences = context.getSharedPreferences("scenario_runtime", Context.MODE_PRIVATE)
        val runtimePreferences = preferences.snapshot("backend", "interrupted")
        val motionKeys = arrayOf("gmsMockEnabled", "platformFusedEnabled", "experimentalOrbitMotion", "startupBurstEnabled", "speed")
        val motionPreferences = context.sharedPrefs.snapshot(*motionKeys)
        val config = File(context.noBackupFilesDir, "active-config.json")
        val originalConfig = config.takeIf { it.exists() }?.readBytes()
        val appOps = context.getSystemService(AppOpsManager::class.java)
        val previousMockMode = appOps.unsafeCheckOpNoThrow(AppOpsManager.OPSTR_MOCK_LOCATION, Process.myUid(), context.packageName)
        fun setMockMode(mode: String) {
            ParcelFileDescriptor.AutoCloseInputStream(instrumentation.uiAutomation.executeShellCommand(
                "appops set ${context.packageName} android:mock_location $mode")).use { it.readBytes() }
        }
        try {
            setMockMode("allow")
            assertEquals("Mock authorization must be effective", AppOpsManager.MODE_ALLOWED,
                appOps.unsafeCheckOpNoThrow(AppOpsManager.OPSTR_MOCK_LOCATION, Process.myUid(), context.packageName))
            context.sharedPrefs.edit().putBoolean("gmsMockEnabled", false).putBoolean("platformFusedEnabled", false)
                .putBoolean("experimentalOrbitMotion", false).putBoolean("startupBurstEnabled", false).putFloat("speed", 0f)
                .commit().also { assertTrue("Cannot save deterministic motion preferences", it) }
            assertTrue(runBlocking { ScenarioRuntime.selectBackend(BackendType.MOCK_PROVIDER).await() })
            test()
        } finally {
            try {
                assertTrue("Test runtime must release its providers", runBlocking { ScenarioRuntime.stop().await() })
                assertFalse(ScenarioRuntime.state.value.isActive)
                assertTrue("Original backend must be restored", runBlocking { ScenarioRuntime.selectBackend(backend).await() })
            } finally {
                try {
                    try {
                        if (originalConfig == null) {
                            assertTrue("Test config must be removed", !config.exists() || config.delete())
                        } else config.writeBytes(originalConfig)
                    } finally {
                        try { context.sharedPrefs.restore(motionPreferences) }
                        finally { preferences.restore(runtimePreferences) }
                    }
                } finally {
                    setMockMode(when (previousMockMode) {
                        AppOpsManager.MODE_ALLOWED -> "allow"
                        AppOpsManager.MODE_IGNORED -> "ignore"
                        AppOpsManager.MODE_ERRORED -> "deny"
                        AppOpsManager.MODE_FOREGROUND -> "foreground"
                        else -> "default"
                    })
                }
            }
        }
    }

    private fun SharedPreferences.snapshot(vararg keys: String): Map<String, Any?> =
        keys.associateWith { all[it] }

    private fun SharedPreferences.restore(values: Map<String, Any?>) {
        val editor = edit()
        values.forEach { (key, value) ->
            when (value) {
                null -> editor.remove(key)
                is String -> editor.putString(key, value)
                is Boolean -> editor.putBoolean(key, value)
                is Float -> editor.putFloat(key, value)
                else -> error("Unexpected fixture preference type for $key")
            }
        }
        assertTrue("Fixture preferences must be restored", editor.commit())
    }
}
```

`app/src/androidTest/java/com/system/location/service/LauncherIconUiTest.kt`:

```kt
package com.system.location.service

import android.content.Intent
import androidx.compose.ui.test.*
import androidx.compose.ui.test.junit4.v2.createEmptyComposeRule
import androidx.test.core.app.ActivityScenario
import androidx.test.ext.junit.runners.AndroidJUnit4
import androidx.test.platform.app.InstrumentationRegistry
import com.system.location.service.ui.settings.LauncherIcon
import org.junit.Assert.*
import org.junit.Rule
import org.junit.Test
import org.junit.runner.RunWith

@RunWith(AndroidJUnit4::class)
class LauncherIconUiTest {
    @get:Rule val compose = createEmptyComposeRule()

    @Test fun iconDraftCancelApplyRecreateAndLauncherEntryStayConsistent() {
        val context = InstrumentationRegistry.getInstrumentation().targetContext
        val original = LauncherIcon.current(context)
        fun assertEntry(icon: LauncherIcon) {
            val intent = Intent(Intent.ACTION_MAIN).addCategory(Intent.CATEGORY_LAUNCHER).setPackage(context.packageName)
            val entries = context.packageManager.queryIntentActivities(intent, 0)
            assertEquals("Exactly one desktop entry", 1, entries.size)
            assertEquals(icon.component(context).className, entries.single().activityInfo.name)
            assertTrue(context.packageManager.getActivityInfo(icon.component(context), 0).loadIcon(context.packageManager).intrinsicWidth > 0)
        }
        try {
            LauncherIcon.select(context, LauncherIcon.STANDARD)
            acceptSelectedMapForUiTest()
            grantUiPermissions()
            ActivityScenario.launch(MainActivity::class.java).use { scenario ->
                compose.openPage(scenario, R.id.nav_settings_updates)
                compose.onNodeWithText("应用图标").performClick()
                compose.onNodeWithText("霓虹版").performClick()
                scenario.recreate()
                compose.onNode(hasText("霓虹版") and isSelectable()).assertIsSelected()
                compose.onNodeWithText("取消").performClick()
                assertEntry(LauncherIcon.STANDARD)
                compose.onNodeWithText("应用图标").performClick()
                compose.onNodeWithText("霓虹版").performClick()
                compose.onNode(hasText("霓虹版") and isSelectable()).assertIsSelected()
                android.os.SystemClock.sleep(350)
                captureUi("launcher-icon-picker")
                compose.onNodeWithText("应用", useUnmergedTree = true).performClick()
                compose.waitForIdle()
                assertEntry(LauncherIcon.NEON)
                scenario.recreate()
                compose.onNodeWithText("霓虹版").assertIsDisplayed()
                compose.onNodeWithText("应用图标").performClick()
                compose.onNodeWithText("普通版").performClick()
                compose.onNodeWithText("应用", useUnmergedTree = true).performClick()
                compose.waitForIdle()
                assertEntry(LauncherIcon.STANDARD)
                scenario.onActivity { it.requestedOrientation = android.content.pm.ActivityInfo.SCREEN_ORIENTATION_LANDSCAPE }
                compose.waitUntil(5_000) {
                    var landscape = false
                    scenario.onActivity { landscape = it.resources.configuration.orientation == android.content.res.Configuration.ORIENTATION_LANDSCAPE }
                    landscape
                }
                compose.onNodeWithText("应用图标").performScrollTo().performClick()
                compose.onNode(hasText("霓虹版") and isSelectable()).performScrollTo().performClick()
                compose.onNodeWithText("应用", useUnmergedTree = true).assertIsDisplayed()
                compose.onNodeWithText("取消").assertIsDisplayed().performClick()
                assertEntry(LauncherIcon.STANDARD)
                scenario.onActivity { it.requestedOrientation = android.content.pm.ActivityInfo.SCREEN_ORIENTATION_PORTRAIT }
            }
            // Launch the enabled alias, not only the explicit MainActivity test entry.
            LauncherIcon.select(context, LauncherIcon.NEON)
            ActivityScenario.launch<MainActivity>(Intent(Intent.ACTION_MAIN)
                .addCategory(Intent.CATEGORY_LAUNCHER).setComponent(LauncherIcon.NEON.component(context))).use {
                compose.onNodeWithText("开始模拟").assertIsDisplayed()
            }
        } finally { LauncherIcon.select(context, original) }
    }
```

`app/src/androidTest/java/com/system/location/service/LibXposedDeviceTest.kt`:

```kt
package com.system.location.service

import android.Manifest
import android.content.pm.PackageManager
import android.location.Location
import android.location.LocationListener
import android.location.LocationManager
import android.location.LocationRequest
import android.os.Bundle
import android.os.CancellationSignal
import android.os.OperationCanceledException
import android.os.SystemClock
import androidx.test.ext.junit.runners.AndroidJUnit4
import androidx.test.platform.app.InstrumentationRegistry
import com.system.location.service.core.geo.Wgs84
import com.system.location.service.core.location.LocationSample
import com.system.location.service.hook.security.SampleWire
import com.system.location.service.service.MockServiceHelper
import java.util.concurrent.LinkedBlockingQueue
import java.util.concurrent.CountDownLatch
import java.util.concurrent.atomic.AtomicReference
import java.util.concurrent.TimeUnit
import org.junit.Assert.assertEquals
import org.junit.Assert.assertFalse
import org.junit.Assert.assertNotNull
import org.junit.Assert.assertTrue
import org.junit.Assume.assumeFalse
import org.junit.Assume.assumeTrue
import org.junit.Before
import org.junit.Test
import org.junit.runner.RunWith

/**
 * Explicitly enabled API102 device checks through the controller's own UID. These results do not
 * establish third-party app visibility, detection behavior, or other devices/frameworks.
 */
@RunWith(AndroidJUnit4::class)
class LibXposedDeviceTest {
    private val instrumentation = InstrumentationRegistry.getInstrumentation()
    private val context = instrumentation.targetContext
    private val manager = context.getSystemService(LocationManager::class.java)

    @Before
    fun requireExplicitDeviceRun() {
        assumeTrue(
            "Enable explicitly with -e libxposedDevice true",
            InstrumentationRegistry.getArguments().getString("libxposedDevice") == "true",
        )
    }

    @Test
    fun authenticatedRuntimeStatusComesFromSystemServer() {
        val status = connectAndReadStatus()
        assertEquals("SYSTEM_SERVER", status.getString("hook_scope"))
        assertTrue("No installed system hooks reported", status.getInt("hook_installed") > 0)
        assertTrue("The command hook must have executed", status.getInt("hook_matched") > 0)
        assertTrue("Missing authoritative start state", status.containsKey("is_start"))
        assertTrue(
            "Unsupported sample protocol",
            SampleWire.isCompatible(status.getInt("sample_version")),
        )
    }

    @Test
    fun publishedSamplesReturnThroughGpsCacheAndContinuousListenerThenStop() {
        val initial = connectAndReadStatus()
        assumeFalse("Preserving the user's active simulation", initial.getBoolean("is_start"))
        // No UI is launched and no permission/AppOp/provider setting is changed by this fixture.
        for (permission in
            listOf(
                Manifest.permission.ACCESS_FINE_LOCATION,
                Manifest.permission.ACCESS_BACKGROUND_LOCATION,
            )) {
            assumeTrue("Existing permission required: $permission", hasPermission(permission))
        }
        assumeTrue("GPS must already exist", manager.hasProvider(LocationManager.GPS_PROVIDER))
        assumeTrue(
            "GPS must already be enabled",
            manager.isProviderEnabled(LocationManager.GPS_PROVIDER),
        )

        val received = LinkedBlockingQueue<Location>()
        val listener = LocationListener { received.offer(Location(it)) }
        var registrationAttempted = false
        var publicationAttempted = false
        try {
            // Publish first so registration exercises the active system-server hook.
            val first = sample(31.230416, 121.473701)
            publicationAttempted = true
            assertTrue(
                "First sample command failed",
                MockServiceHelper.publishSample(manager, first),
            )
            assertActive(first)
            assertSample(
                first,
                manager.getLastKnownLocation(LocationManager.GPS_PROVIDER),
                "GPS cache",
            )

            registrationAttempted = true
            manager.requestLocationUpdates(
                LocationManager.GPS_PROVIDER,
                0L,
                0f,
                { task -> task.run() },
                listener,
            )
            // Two separate publications exercise the same listener registration continuously.
            for (index in 1..2) {
                val outgoing = sample(31.230416 + index * 0.01, 121.473701 + index * 0.01)
                assertTrue(
                    "Sample $index command failed",
                    MockServiceHelper.publishSample(manager, outgoing),
                )
                assertActive(outgoing)
                assertSample(
                    outgoing,
                    manager.getLastKnownLocation(LocationManager.GPS_PROVIDER),
                    "GPS cache $index",
                )
                assertSample(
                    outgoing,
                    awaitSample(received, outgoing.elapsedNanos),
                    "GPS callback $index",
                )
            }
        } finally {
            try {
                if (registrationAttempted) manager.removeUpdates(listener)
            } finally {
                if (publicationAttempted) {
                    assertTrue("Stop command failed", MockServiceHelper.tryCloseMock(manager))
                    val stopped = requireStatus()
                    assertTrue("Stop response has no start state", stopped.containsKey("is_start"))
                    assertFalse(
                        "Simulation remained active after cleanup",
                        stopped.getBoolean("is_start"),
                    )
                }
            }
        }
    }

    @Test
    fun listenerRegisteredBeforeSimulationReceivesLaterPublishedSamples() {
        val initial = connectAndReadStatus()
        assumeFalse("Preserving the user's active simulation", initial.getBoolean("is_start"))
        for (permission in listOf(Manifest.permission.ACCESS_FINE_LOCATION,
                Manifest.permission.ACCESS_BACKGROUND_LOCATION)) {
            assumeTrue("Existing permission required: $permission", hasPermission(permission))
        }
        assumeTrue("GPS must already be enabled", manager.isProviderEnabled(LocationManager.GPS_PROVIDER))
        val received = LinkedBlockingQueue<Location>()
        val listener = LocationListener { received.offer(Location(it)) }
        var registered = false
        var attempted = false
        try {
            manager.requestLocationUpdates(LocationManager.GPS_PROVIDER, 0L, 0f,
                { task -> task.run() }, listener)
            registered = true
            assertFalse("Registering a listener started simulation", requireStatus().getBoolean("is_start"))
            received.clear()
            repeat(2) { index ->
                val outgoing = sample(31.230416 + index * 0.01, 121.473701 + index * 0.01)
                attempted = true
                assertTrue("Sample command failed", MockServiceHelper.publishSample(manager, outgoing))
                assertSample(outgoing, awaitSample(received, outgoing.elapsedNanos), "pre-existing GPS listener")
            }
        } finally {
            try { if (registered) manager.removeUpdates(listener) }
            finally {
                if (attempted) {
                    assertTrue("Stop command failed", MockServiceHelper.tryCloseMock(manager))
                    assertFalse(requireStatus().getBoolean("is_start"))
                }
            }
        }
    }

    @Test
    fun currentLocationUsesPublishedSampleWithoutHardwareWarmup() {
        val initial = connectAndReadStatus()
        assumeFalse("Preserving the user's active simulation", initial.getBoolean("is_start"))
        assumeTrue("Fine location permission required", hasPermission(Manifest.permission.ACCESS_FINE_LOCATION))
        assumeTrue("Background location permission required", hasPermission(Manifest.permission.ACCESS_BACKGROUND_LOCATION))
        assumeTrue("GPS must already be enabled", manager.isProviderEnabled(LocationManager.GPS_PROVIDER))
        var attempted = false
        try {
            // No continuous listener or real GPS fix is required. Each request must use the
            // latest publication, including multiple callback objects of the same transport class.
            repeat(5) { index ->
                val outgoing = sample(31.230416 + index * 0.01, 121.473701 + index * 0.01)
                attempted = true
                assertTrue("Sample command failed", MockServiceHelper.publishSample(manager, outgoing))
                assertActive(outgoing)
                assertSample(outgoing, boundedCurrentFix(), "current callback $index without warmup")
            }
            val cancelled = CancellationSignal().apply { cancel() }
            val delivered = CountDownLatch(1)
            val cancelledFailure = runCatching {
                manager.getCurrentLocation(LocationManager.GPS_PROVIDER, cancelled, { it.run() }) {
                    delivered.countDown()
                }
            }.exceptionOrNull()
            assertTrue("A pre-cancelled request must retain the platform exception",
                cancelledFailure is OperationCanceledException)
            assertFalse("A cancelled request invoked its consumer", delivered.await(300, TimeUnit.MILLISECONDS))
            val invalid = runCatching {
                manager.getCurrentLocation("portal_current_missing_provider", null, { it.run() }) { }
            }.exceptionOrNull()
            assertTrue("The real framework must reject an unknown provider", invalid is IllegalArgumentException)
        } finally {
            if (attempted) {
                assertTrue("Stop command failed", MockServiceHelper.tryCloseMock(manager))
                assertFalse("Simulation remained active", requireStatus().getBoolean("is_start"))
            }
        }
    }

    @Test
    fun currentLocationCallbackUsesPublishedSampleWhenGpsCanSupplyAFix() {
        val initial = connectAndReadStatus()
        assumeFalse("Preserving the user's active simulation", initial.getBoolean("is_start"))
        assumeTrue("Fine location permission required", hasPermission(Manifest.permission.ACCESS_FINE_LOCATION))
        assumeTrue("Background location permission required", hasPermission(Manifest.permission.ACCESS_BACKGROUND_LOCATION))
        assumeTrue("GPS must already be enabled", manager.isProviderEnabled(LocationManager.GPS_PROVIDER))

        val baselineMillis = InstrumentationRegistry.getArguments()
            .getString("gpsBaselineMillis")?.toLongOrNull()?.coerceIn(2_000L, 120_000L) ?: 30_000L
        val baselineStartedNanos = SystemClock.elapsedRealtimeNanos()
        val fixes = LinkedBlockingQueue<Location>()
        val warmListener = LocationListener { location ->
            if (location.elapsedRealtimeNanos >= baselineStartedNanos) fixes.offer(Location(location))
        }
        var registrationAttempted = false
        var publicationAttempted = false
        try {
            // Instrumentation restarts the app, ending its UI location requests. Keep a real GPS
            // stream alive so the independent current consumer can use a fresh provider fix.
            registrationAttempted = true
            manager.requestLocationUpdates(
                LocationManager.GPS_PROVIDER, 1_000L, 0f, { task -> task.run() }, warmListener,
            )
            assumeTrue("GPS supplied no fresh continuous baseline fix",
                fixes.poll(baselineMillis, TimeUnit.MILLISECONDS) != null)
            // The continuous callback above is the real-provider baseline. The independent
            // current-location request below is the behavior under test and must fail loudly if
            // it does not deliver after simulation starts.
            val outgoing = sample(31.230416, 121.473701)
            publicationAttempted = true
            assertTrue("Sample command failed", MockServiceHelper.publishSample(manager, outgoing))
            assertActive(outgoing)
            val received = boundedCurrentFix()
            assertActive(outgoing)
            assertSample(outgoing, received, "GPS current callback")
        } finally {
            try {
                if (registrationAttempted) manager.removeUpdates(warmListener)
            } finally {
                if (publicationAttempted) {
                    assertTrue("Stop command failed", MockServiceHelper.tryCloseMock(manager))
                    val stopped = requireStatus()
                    assertTrue("Stop response has no start state", stopped.containsKey("is_start"))
                    assertFalse("Simulation remained active after cleanup", stopped.getBoolean("is_start"))
                }
            }
        }
    }

    private fun boundedCurrentFix(durationMillis: Long = 2_000L): Location? {
        val cancellation = CancellationSignal()
        val delivered = CountDownLatch(1)
        val received = AtomicReference<Location?>()
        return try {
            manager.getCurrentLocation(
                LocationManager.GPS_PROVIDER,
                LocationRequest.Builder(1_000L)
                    .setQuality(LocationRequest.QUALITY_HIGH_ACCURACY)
                    .setDurationMillis(durationMillis)
                    .build(),
                cancellation,
                { task -> task.run() },
            ) { location ->
                received.set(location?.let { Location(it) })
                delivered.countDown()
            }
            val callbackArrived = delivered.await(durationMillis + 1_000L, TimeUnit.MILLISECONDS)
            android.util.Log.i("PortalDeviceTest",
                "GPS current request: callback=$callbackArrived nonNull=${received.get() != null}")
            if (callbackArrived) received.get() else null
        } finally {
            cancellation.cancel()
        }
    }

    private fun connectAndReadStatus(): Bundle {
        // Reuse the app's client, since a new handshake invalidates the prior session for this UID.
        if (!MockServiceHelper.isServiceInit()) MockServiceHelper.tryInitService(manager)
        assertTrue("Authenticated controller handshake failed", MockServiceHelper.isServiceInit())
        return requireStatus()
    }

    private fun requireStatus(): Bundle {
        val status = MockServiceHelper.runtimeStatus(manager)
        assertNotNull("No authenticated runtime response", status)
        val reply = checkNotNull(status)
        assertEquals(
            "Expected the system-server backend",
            "SYSTEM_SERVER",
            reply.getString("hook_scope"),
        )
        assertTrue("No installed system hooks reported", reply.getInt("hook_installed") > 0)
        return reply
    }

    private fun assertActive(sample: LocationSample) {
        val status = requireStatus()
        assertTrue("Published sample did not start the backend", status.getBoolean("is_start"))
        assertEquals(
            "Backend did not accept this sample",
            sample.timeMillis,
            status.getLong("last_publish"),
        )
    }

    private fun sample(latitude: Double, longitude: Double) =
        LocationSample(
            coordinate = Wgs84(latitude, longitude),
            altitude = 42.0,
            accuracy = 5f,
            speed = 0f,
            bearing = 73f,
            timeMillis = System.currentTimeMillis(),
            elapsedNanos = SystemClock.elapsedRealtimeNanos(),
        )

    private fun awaitSample(queue: LinkedBlockingQueue<Location>, elapsedNanos: Long): Location? {
        val deadline = SystemClock.elapsedRealtime() + 2_000
        while (true) {
            val remaining = deadline - SystemClock.elapsedRealtime()
            if (remaining <= 0) return null
            val location = queue.poll(remaining, TimeUnit.MILLISECONDS) ?: return null
            if (location.elapsedRealtimeNanos == elapsedNanos) return location
        }
    }

    private fun assertSample(expected: LocationSample, location: Location?, surface: String) {
        assertNotNull("No sample from $surface", location)
        val actual = checkNotNull(location)
        assertEquals("Wrong provider at $surface", LocationManager.GPS_PROVIDER, actual.provider)
        assertEquals(
            "Wrong sample timestamp at $surface",
            expected.elapsedNanos,
            actual.elapsedRealtimeNanos,
        )
        assertEquals("Wrong wall clock at $surface", expected.timeMillis, actual.time)
        val distance = FloatArray(1)
        Location.distanceBetween(
            expected.latitude,
            expected.longitude,
            actual.latitude,
            actual.longitude,
            distance,
        )
        // Existing optional physical noise can offset coordinates by a few meters; retain that
        // setting.
        assertTrue("Unexpected coordinate at $surface (offset ${distance[0]}m)", distance[0] <= 10f)
        assertTrue(
            "Invalid accuracy at $surface",
            actual.hasAccuracy() && actual.accuracy.isFinite() && actual.accuracy > 0f,
        )
    }

    private fun hasPermission(permission: String): Boolean =
        context.checkSelfPermission(permission) == PackageManager.PERMISSION_GRANTED
}
```

`app/src/androidTest/java/com/system/location/service/LibXposedNmeaDeviceTest.kt`:

```kt
package com.system.location.service

import android.Manifest
import android.content.pm.PackageManager
import android.location.GnssMeasurementsEvent
import android.location.LocationManager
import android.os.Bundle
import android.os.ParcelFileDescriptor
import android.os.SystemClock
import androidx.test.ext.junit.runners.AndroidJUnit4
import androidx.test.platform.app.InstrumentationRegistry
import com.system.location.service.core.geo.Wgs84
import com.system.location.service.core.location.LocationSample
import com.system.location.service.service.MockServiceHelper
import org.junit.Assert.assertEquals
import org.junit.Assert.assertFalse
import org.junit.Assert.assertTrue
import org.junit.Assume.assumeFalse
import org.junit.Assume.assumeTrue
import org.junit.Before
import org.junit.Test
import org.junit.runner.RunWith

/**
 * Exercises the raw-measurement add/remove points owned by LocationNMEAHook. This is not an NMEA
 * callback test. Only current registrations are inspected; dumps and coordinates are never logged.
 */
@RunWith(AndroidJUnit4::class)
class LibXposedNmeaDeviceTest {
    private val instrumentation = InstrumentationRegistry.getInstrumentation()
    private val context = instrumentation.targetContext
    private val manager = context.getSystemService(LocationManager::class.java)

    @Before
    fun requireExplicitDeviceRun() {
        assumeTrue(
            "Enable explicitly with -e libxposedDevice true",
            InstrumentationRegistry.getArguments().getString("libxposedDevice") == "true",
        )
    }

    @Test
    fun existingRawMeasurementRegistrationCanBeRemovedWhileNewOnesAreSuppressed() {
        if (!MockServiceHelper.isServiceInit()) MockServiceHelper.tryInitService(manager)
        assertTrue("Authenticated controller handshake failed", MockServiceHelper.isServiceInit())
        assumeFalse("Preserving the user's active simulation", status().getBoolean("is_start"))
        for (permission in listOf(
            Manifest.permission.ACCESS_FINE_LOCATION,
            Manifest.permission.ACCESS_BACKGROUND_LOCATION,
        )) {
            assumeTrue(
                "Existing permission required: $permission",
                context.checkSelfPermission(permission) == PackageManager.PERMISSION_GRANTED,
            )
        }
        assumeTrue("GPS must already exist", manager.hasProvider(LocationManager.GPS_PROVIDER))
        assumeTrue("GPS must already be enabled", manager.isProviderEnabled(LocationManager.GPS_PROVIDER))
        assumeTrue(
            "Preserving an existing raw-measurement registration from this package",
            currentRegistrationCount() == 0,
        )

        val existing = object : GnssMeasurementsEvent.Callback() {}
        val suppressed = object : GnssMeasurementsEvent.Callback() {}
        var publicationAttempted = false
        var lastPublication = 0L
        val deadline = SystemClock.elapsedRealtime() + 9_000L

        fun renewLeaseIfNeeded(force: Boolean = false) {
            if (!force && SystemClock.elapsedRealtime() - lastPublication < 1_000L) return
            publicationAttempted = true
            val sample = LocationSample(
                coordinate = Wgs84(31.230416, 121.473701),
                altitude = 42.0,
                accuracy = 5f,
                speed = 0f,
                bearing = 73f,
                timeMillis = System.currentTimeMillis(),
                elapsedNanos = SystemClock.elapsedRealtimeNanos(),
            )
            assertTrue("Sample command failed", MockServiceHelper.publishSample(manager, sample))
            lastPublication = SystemClock.elapsedRealtime()
            val active = status()
            assertTrue("Published sample did not activate the backend", active.getBoolean("is_start"))
            assertEquals("Backend did not accept this sample", sample.timeMillis, active.getLong("last_publish"))
        }

        fun awaitCount(expected: Int, active: Boolean): Boolean {
            val phaseDeadline = minOf(deadline, SystemClock.elapsedRealtime() + 2_000L)
            do {
                if (active) renewLeaseIfNeeded()
                val count = currentRegistrationCount()
                if (active) assertTrue("Backend expired during registration observation", status().getBoolean("is_start"))
                if (count == expected) return true
                SystemClock.sleep(100)
            } while (SystemClock.elapsedRealtime() < phaseDeadline)
            return false
        }

        try {
            assertTrue(
                "Android rejected the initial raw-measurement registration",
                manager.registerGnssMeasurementsCallback({ task -> task.run() }, existing),
            )
            assertTrue("No real raw-measurement registration appeared", awaitCount(1, active = false))
            renewLeaseIfNeeded(force = true)

            // Observe the add gate instead of assuming that the user's enableNMEA value is false.
            manager.registerGnssMeasurementsCallback({ task -> task.run() }, suppressed)
            val gateDeadline = minOf(deadline, SystemClock.elapsedRealtime() + 500L)
            var gateSuppressed = true
            do {
                renewLeaseIfNeeded()
                gateSuppressed = gateSuppressed && currentRegistrationCount() == 1
                assertTrue("Backend expired during add-gate observation", status().getBoolean("is_start"))
                SystemClock.sleep(100)
            } while (SystemClock.elapsedRealtime() < gateDeadline)
            assumeTrue(
                "Raw-listener add suppression is not observable; enableNMEA may be enabled or the add path differs. Settings were preserved",
                gateSuppressed,
            )

            renewLeaseIfNeeded(force = true)
            manager.unregisterGnssMeasurementsCallback(existing)
            assertTrue("Existing raw registration remained while simulation was active", awaitCount(0, active = true))
        } finally {
            try {
                try {
                    manager.unregisterGnssMeasurementsCallback(existing)
                } finally {
                    manager.unregisterGnssMeasurementsCallback(suppressed)
                }
            } finally {
                if (publicationAttempted) {
                    assertTrue("Stop command failed", MockServiceHelper.tryCloseMock(manager))
                    assertFalse("Simulation remained active after cleanup", status().getBoolean("is_start"))
                }
            }
        }
    }

    private fun status(): Bundle {
        val result = checkNotNull(MockServiceHelper.runtimeStatus(manager)) { "No authenticated runtime response" }
        assertEquals("Expected the system-server backend", "SYSTEM_SERVER", result.getString("hook_scope"))
        assertTrue("Missing authoritative start state", result.containsKey("is_start"))
        return result
    }

    private fun currentRegistrationCount(): Int {
        // Shell access is used solely for read-only dumpsys, never root, permissions or settings.
        val dump = ParcelFileDescriptor.AutoCloseInputStream(
            instrumentation.uiAutomation.executeShellCommand("dumpsys location"),
        ).bufferedReader().use { it.readText() }
        val lines = dump.lineSequence().toList()
        val headers = lines.indices.filter { lines[it].trim() == "Measurements Provider:" }
        check(headers.size == 1) { "Cannot identify a unique raw-measurements provider section" }
        val start = headers.single()
        val indent = lines[start].takeWhile { it.isWhitespace() }.length
        val section = lines.drop(start + 1).takeWhile {
            it.isBlank() || it.takeWhile(Char::isWhitespace).length > indent
        }
        check(section.any { it.trimStart().startsWith("service:") }) {
            "Raw-measurements provider dump does not expose current service state"
        }
        val packageEntry = Regex("^\\s*\\d+/${Regex.escape(context.packageName)}(?:\\[|/|\\s|$)")
        // Current listener entries begin with uid/package. The boundary above excludes Event Log.
        return section.count { packageEntry.containsMatchIn(it) }
    }
}
```

`app/src/androidTest/java/com/system/location/service/LocationListenerLifecycleDeviceTest.kt`:

```kt
package com.system.location.service

import android.Manifest
import android.content.pm.PackageManager
import android.location.LocationListener
import android.location.LocationManager
import android.os.Bundle
import androidx.test.ext.junit.runners.AndroidJUnit4
import androidx.test.platform.app.InstrumentationRegistry
import com.system.location.service.hook.security.CommandClient
import com.system.location.service.runtime.ScenarioRuntime
import java.util.concurrent.Executor
import kotlinx.coroutines.runBlocking
import org.junit.Assert.*
import org.junit.Assume.*
import org.junit.Test
import org.junit.runner.RunWith

/** Opt-in framework round trip; never starts simulation or modifies receiver evidence/settings. */
@RunWith(AndroidJUnit4::class)
class LocationListenerLifecycleDeviceTest {
    @Test fun repeatedRegistrationKeepsOneSubscriptionPerProviderAndUnregisterReleasesIt() = verifyRegistration()

    @Test fun rejectedProviderDoesNotCreateAModuleSubscription() = verifyRegistration(rejectedProvider = true)

    private fun verifyRegistration(rejectedProvider: Boolean = false) = runBlocking {
        assumeTrue("Explicit device run required",
            InstrumentationRegistry.getArguments().getString("libxposedDevice") == "true")
        val context = InstrumentationRegistry.getInstrumentation().targetContext
        ScenarioRuntime.awaitInitialized()
        assumeFalse("Preserve local simulation", ScenarioRuntime.state.value.isActive)
        assumeTrue("Existing precise location permission required",
            context.checkSelfPermission(Manifest.permission.ACCESS_FINE_LOCATION) == PackageManager.PERMISSION_GRANTED)
        val manager = context.getSystemService(LocationManager::class.java)
        val client = CommandClient()
        assertTrue(client.connect(manager))
        fun command(name: String): Bundle = Bundle().apply {
            putString("command_id", name)
            assertTrue("Command failed: $name", client.send(manager, this))
        }
        val status = command("get_runtime_status")
        assertEquals("SYSTEM_SERVER", status.getString("hook_scope"))
        assumeFalse("Preserve system simulation", status.getBoolean("is_start"))
        fun size() = command("get_listener_size").getInt("size", -1).also { assertTrue(it >= 0) }
        val baseline = size()
        val listener = LocationListener { }
        val executor = Executor { it.run() }
        var verified = false
        try {
            if (rejectedProvider) {
                val error = runCatching {
                    manager.requestLocationUpdates("portal_lifecycle_missing_provider", 1000L, 0f, executor, listener)
                }.exceptionOrNull()
                assertTrue("Framework must reject the unknown provider", error is IllegalArgumentException)
                assertEquals("Rejected registration left a module subscription", baseline, size())
                verified = true
                return@runBlocking
            }
            repeat(20) { manager.requestLocationUpdates(LocationManager.GPS_PROVIDER, 1000L, 0f, executor, listener) }
            assertEquals("Duplicate GPS subscriptions in module registry", baseline + 1, size())
            repeat(5) { manager.requestLocationUpdates(LocationManager.NETWORK_PROVIDER, 1000L, 0f, executor, listener) }
            assertEquals("One transport must preserve its separate provider subscriptions", baseline + 2, size())
            manager.removeUpdates(listener)
            assertEquals("Explicit unregister did not release all provider subscriptions", baseline, size())
            verified = true
        } finally {
            manager.removeUpdates(listener)
            // Keep the original assertion if Android did not retain a rejected client transport.
            if (verified) assertEquals("Test left listener subscriptions behind", baseline, size())
            assertFalse(command("get_runtime_status").getBoolean("is_start"))
        }
    }
}
```

`app/src/androidTest/java/com/system/location/service/LocationSampleTest.kt`:

```kt
package com.system.location.service

import android.location.Location
import android.os.Build
import android.os.Parcel
import com.system.location.service.core.providers.ProviderKind
import com.system.location.service.core.providers.ProviderMixer
import com.system.location.service.hook.utils.FakeLoc
import com.system.location.service.hook.utils.toLocation
import org.junit.Assert.*
import org.junit.Test
import java.util.concurrent.atomic.AtomicReference

/** Runs on ART: exercises real Location and elapsedRealtimeNanos, without enabling hooks. */
class LocationSampleTest {
    @Test fun mockMarkerSurvivesLocationCopiesAndParcelRoundTrips() {
        fun parcelCopy(source: Location): Location {
            val parcel = Parcel.obtain()
            return try {
                source.writeToParcel(parcel, 0)
                parcel.setDataPosition(0)
                Location.CREATOR.createFromParcel(parcel)
            } finally {
                parcel.recycle()
            }
        }

        val marked = Location("gps").apply { setMock(true) }
        assertTrue(marked.isMock)
        assertTrue(Location(marked).isMock)
        assertTrue(parcelCopy(marked).isMock)

        val unmarked = Location("gps").apply { setMock(false) }
        assertFalse(unmarked.isMock)
        assertFalse(Location(unmarked).isMock)
        assertFalse(parcelCopy(unmarked).isMock)
    }

    @Test fun conversionUsesExplicitPolicyAfterLiveSettingsChange() {
        val saved = FakeLoc.runtimeSnapshots.current()
        try {
            val sample = com.system.location.service.core.location.LocationSample(
                com.system.location.service.core.geo.Wgs84(31.0, 121.0), 10.0, 5f, 2f, 90f, 1000, 1000)
            val captured = com.system.location.service.core.runtime.RuntimeSnapshot(sample = sample,
                configuration = com.system.location.service.core.runtime.HookConfiguration(
                    enabled = true, hideMock = true, gnssEnabled = false))
            FakeLoc.runtimeSnapshots.set(captured.copy(configuration = captured.configuration.copy(hideMock = false)))
            val old = sample.toLocation("gps", state = captured)
            assertFalse(old.isMock)
            val extras = requireNotNull(old.extras)
            assertEquals(0, extras.getInt("satellites"))
            assertEquals(0f, extras.getFloat("meanCn0"), 0f)
            assertEquals(0f, extras.getFloat("maxCn0"), 0f)
            assertTrue(sample.toLocation("gps").isMock)
            assertEquals(sample.coordinate.latitude, old.latitude, 0.0)
            assertEquals(sample.elapsedNanos, old.elapsedRealtimeNanos)
        } finally { FakeLoc.runtimeSnapshots.set(saved) }
    }

    @Test fun fixedPointNeverJittersEvenWithLargeAccuracy() {
        FakeLoc.accuracy = 1000f
        FakeLoc.bearing = 123.0
        FakeLoc.updateCoordinates(39.9, 116.4)
        repeat(1000) {
            val sample = FakeLoc.snapshot(force = true)
            assertEquals(39.9, sample.latitude, 0.0)
            assertEquals(116.4, sample.longitude, 0.0)
            assertEquals(0f, sample.speed)
            assertEquals(123f, sample.bearing)
        }
    }

    @Test fun providerMaskControlsAndroidLocationFieldPresence() {
        val sample = com.system.location.service.core.location.LocationSample(
            com.system.location.service.core.geo.Wgs84(31.0, 121.0), 20.0, 5f, 2f, 90f, 10_000L, 10_000_000_000L)
        val mixed = ProviderMixer().mix(sample)
        val gps = sample.toLocation("gps", providerSample = mixed.getValue(ProviderKind.GPS))
        val network = sample.toLocation("network", providerSample = mixed.getValue(ProviderKind.NETWORK))

        assertTrue(gps.hasAltitude())
        assertTrue(gps.hasSpeed())
        assertTrue(gps.hasBearing())
        if (Build.VERSION.SDK_INT >= 34) assertFalse(gps.hasMslAltitude())
        assertFalse(network.hasAltitude())
        assertFalse(network.hasSpeed())
        assertFalse(network.hasBearing())
        if (Build.VERSION.SDK_INT >= 34) assertFalse(network.hasMslAltitude())
        assertTrue(network.hasVerticalAccuracy())
        assertEquals(0f, network.speed, 0f)
    }

    @Test fun eachBroadcastIsFreshAndEveryRecipientGetsTheSameFix() {
        FakeLoc.updateCoordinates(31.2, 121.5)
        var previous = FakeLoc.snapshot(force = true)
        repeat(100) {
            val sample = FakeLoc.snapshot(force = true)
            assertTrue(sample.elapsedNanos > previous.elapsedNanos)
            assertTrue(kotlin.math.abs(System.currentTimeMillis() - sample.timeMillis) < 1000)
            val gps = sample.toLocation("gps")
            val network = sample.toLocation("network")
            assertEquals(gps.latitude, network.latitude, 0.0)
            assertEquals(gps.longitude, network.longitude, 0.0)
            assertEquals(gps.elapsedRealtimeNanos, network.elapsedRealtimeNanos)
            assertEquals(gps.time, network.time)
            assertTrue(gps.hasAccuracy())
            previous = sample
        }
    }

    @Test fun coordinateChangeInvalidatesCachedSampleAndResetsSpeed() {
        FakeLoc.updateCoordinates(39.9, 116.4, 3f)
        val before = FakeLoc.snapshot()
        assertEquals(3f, before.speed)
        FakeLoc.updateCoordinates(31.2, 121.5)
        val after = FakeLoc.snapshot()
        assertEquals(31.2, after.latitude, 0.0)
        assertEquals(121.5, after.longitude, 0.0)
        assertEquals(0f, after.speed)
        assertTrue(after.elapsedNanos > before.elapsedNanos)
    }

    @Test fun simultaneousReadsNeverMixLatitudeAndLongitude() {
        FakeLoc.updateCoordinates(10.0, 20.0)
        val failure = AtomicReference<Throwable?>()
        val writer = Thread {
            repeat(2000) { FakeLoc.updateCoordinates(if (it % 2 == 0) 10.0 else 30.0, if (it % 2 == 0) 20.0 else 40.0) }
        }
        val reader = Thread {
            try {
                repeat(2000) {
                    val sample = FakeLoc.snapshot()
                    assertTrue(sample.latitude == 10.0 && sample.longitude == 20.0 || sample.latitude == 30.0 && sample.longitude == 40.0)
                }
            } catch (t: Throwable) { failure.set(t) }
        }
        writer.start(); reader.start()
        writer.join(); reader.join()
        failure.get()?.let { throw it }
    }
}
```

```kt
package com.system.location.service
```

```kt
class MockFlagExperimentTest {
    @Test fun experimentPreservesLocationDataAndReportsLocalScope() {
        val location = Location("gps").apply {
            latitude = 25.123456
            longitude = 119.123456
            altitude = 80.0
            accuracy = 25f
            speed = 0f
            bearing = 90f
            time = 12345L
            elapsedRealtimeNanos = 67890L
            isMock = true
        }

        assertEquals(25f, location.accuracy)
        assertEquals(0f, location.speed)
        assertEquals(90f, location.bearing)
        assertEquals(12345L, location.time)
        assertEquals(67890L, location.elapsedRealtimeNanos)
    }

    @Test fun repeatedClearsAcceptAnAlreadyUnmarkedObject() {
        val experiment = MockFlagExperiment()
```

`app/src/androidTest/java/com/system/location/service/MockProviderBaselineDeviceTest.kt`:

```kt
package com.system.location.service

import android.Manifest
import android.app.AppOpsManager
import android.content.pm.PackageManager
import android.location.Location
import android.location.LocationListener
import android.location.LocationManager
import android.os.ParcelFileDescriptor
import android.os.Process
import android.os.SystemClock
import androidx.test.ext.junit.runners.AndroidJUnit4
import androidx.test.platform.app.InstrumentationRegistry
import com.system.location.service.backend.mock.AndroidMockProviderPort
import com.system.location.service.backend.mock.MockProviderBackend
import com.system.location.service.backend.mock.MockProviderPort
import com.system.location.service.core.backend.BackendResult
import com.system.location.service.core.geo.Wgs84
import com.system.location.service.core.location.LocationSample
import com.system.location.service.runtime.ScenarioRuntime
import com.system.location.service.service.MockServiceHelper
import java.util.concurrent.LinkedBlockingQueue
import java.util.concurrent.TimeUnit
import kotlinx.coroutines.runBlocking
import org.junit.Assert.*
import org.junit.Assume.*
import org.junit.Test
import org.junit.runner.RunWith

/** Run only after disabling the module and rebooting; this is a standard API comparison. */
@RunWith(AndroidJUnit4::class)
class MockProviderBaselineDeviceTest {
    @Test fun standardBackendRoundTripsAndCleansUpWithoutSynthesizingGnssFields() = runBlocking {
        assumeTrue("Explicit isolated run required",
            InstrumentationRegistry.getArguments().getString("standardProviderDevice") == "true")
        val instrumentation = InstrumentationRegistry.getInstrumentation()
        val context = instrumentation.targetContext
        val manager = context.getSystemService(LocationManager::class.java)
        ScenarioRuntime.awaitInitialized()
        assumeFalse("Preserve active simulation", ScenarioRuntime.state.value.isActive)
        for (permission in listOf(Manifest.permission.ACCESS_FINE_LOCATION, Manifest.permission.ACCESS_BACKGROUND_LOCATION)) {
            assumeTrue("Existing permission required: $permission",
                context.checkSelfPermission(permission) == PackageManager.PERMISSION_GRANTED)
        }
        assumeTrue("GPS must already be enabled", manager.isProviderEnabled(LocationManager.GPS_PROVIDER))
        MockServiceHelper.tryInitService(manager)
        assertNull("The Hook authority must be absent", MockServiceHelper.runtimeStatus(manager))
        val realPort = AndroidMockProviderPort(context)
        assumeTrue("Preserve existing provider ownership", realPort.pendingProviders().isEmpty())
        // Exercise the mandatory GPS/network channels without changing the optional fused setting.
        val port = object : MockProviderPort by realPort { override fun optionalProviders() = emptySet<String>() }
        val backend = MockProviderBackend(port)
        val appOps = context.getSystemService(AppOpsManager::class.java)
        val originalMode = appOps.unsafeCheckOpNoThrow(AppOpsManager.OPSTR_MOCK_LOCATION, Process.myUid(), context.packageName)
        val restoreMode = when (originalMode) {
            AppOpsManager.MODE_ALLOWED -> "allow"
            AppOpsManager.MODE_IGNORED -> "ignore"
            AppOpsManager.MODE_ERRORED -> "deny"
            AppOpsManager.MODE_FOREGROUND -> "foreground"
            else -> "default"
        }
        fun authorization(mode: String) {
            instrumentation.uiAutomation.executeShellCommand("appops set ${context.packageName} android:mock_location $mode")
                .let { ParcelFileDescriptor.AutoCloseInputStream(it).use { stream -> stream.readBytes() } }
        }
        val callbacks = LinkedBlockingQueue<Location>()
        val listener = LocationListener { callbacks.offer(Location(it)) }
        var registered = false
        try {
            authorization("allow")
            repeat(2) {
                assertEquals(BackendResult.Success, backend.prepare())
                assertEquals(BackendResult.Success, backend.start())
                if (!registered) {
                    manager.requestLocationUpdates(LocationManager.GPS_PROVIDER, 0L, 0f, { it.run() }, listener)
                    registered = true
                }
                for (index in 0..2) {
                    val sample = LocationSample(Wgs84(31.230416 + index * 0.001, 121.473701),
                        altitude = 42.0, accuracy = 5f, speed = 2f, bearing = 73f,
                        timeMillis = System.currentTimeMillis(), elapsedNanos = SystemClock.elapsedRealtimeNanos())
                    assertEquals(BackendResult.Success, backend.publish(sample, null))
                    val deadline = SystemClock.elapsedRealtime() + 5_000L
                    var incoming: Location? = null
                    while (incoming == null && SystemClock.elapsedRealtime() < deadline) {
                        val candidate = callbacks.poll(100L, TimeUnit.MILLISECONDS)
                        if (candidate?.elapsedRealtimeNanos == sample.elapsedNanos) incoming = candidate
                    }
                    assertNotNull("No current GPS callback", incoming)
                    val fix = checkNotNull(incoming)
                    assertTrue("Android must retain the standard mock marker", fix.isMock)
                    assertEquals(sample.latitude, fix.latitude, 0.0)
                    assertEquals(sample.longitude, fix.longitude, 0.0)
                    for (key in listOf("satellites", "meanCn0", "maxCn0")) {
                        assertFalse("Standard backend invented $key", fix.extras?.containsKey(key) == true)
                    }
                    assertTrue(checkNotNull(manager.getLastKnownLocation(LocationManager.GPS_PROVIDER)).isMock)
                }
                assertEquals(BackendResult.Success, backend.stop())
                assertTrue("Stop must clear durable ownership", realPort.pendingProviders().isEmpty())
            }
        } finally {
            try {
                if (registered) manager.removeUpdates(listener)
            } finally {
                try {
                    authorization("allow")
                    assertEquals(BackendResult.Success, backend.stop())
                } finally { authorization(restoreMode) }
            }
        }
    }
}
```

`app/src/androidTest/java/com/system/location/service/MockProviderDeviceTest.kt`:

```kt
package com.system.location.service

import android.Manifest
import android.app.AppOpsManager
import android.app.ActivityManager
import android.content.Intent
import android.graphics.Bitmap
import android.location.Location
import android.location.LocationListener
import android.location.LocationManager
import android.os.Process
import android.os.SystemClock
import androidx.test.ext.junit.runners.AndroidJUnit4
import androidx.test.core.app.ActivityScenario
import androidx.test.platform.app.InstrumentationRegistry
import com.system.location.service.backend.mock.AndroidMockProviderPort
import com.system.location.service.backend.mock.MockAuthorizationException
import com.system.location.service.backend.mock.MockFlagExperiment
import org.junit.Assert.*
import org.junit.Test
import org.junit.runner.RunWith
import java.util.concurrent.CountDownLatch
import java.util.concurrent.TimeUnit
import java.util.concurrent.atomic.AtomicReference
import com.system.location.service.runtime.ScenarioRuntime
import com.system.location.service.ui.diagnostics.LocationProbeActivity
import kotlinx.coroutines.runBlocking

@RunWith(AndroidJUnit4::class)
class MockProviderDeviceTest {
    @org.junit.Before fun acceptMapConsentForThisFixture() {
        acceptSelectedMapForUiTest()
    }
    private val instrumentation = InstrumentationRegistry.getInstrumentation()
    private val context = instrumentation.targetContext
    private val manager = context.getSystemService(LocationManager::class.java)
    private val provider = "portal_device_test_${Process.myPid()}"

    private fun setMockMode(mode: String) {
        instrumentation.uiAutomation.executeShellCommand("appops set ${context.packageName} android:mock_location $mode")
            .let { android.os.ParcelFileDescriptor.AutoCloseInputStream(it).use { stream -> stream.readBytes() } }
    }
    private fun setLocationEnabled(enabled: Boolean) {
        instrumentation.uiAutomation.executeShellCommand("cmd location set-location-enabled $enabled")
            .let { android.os.ParcelFileDescriptor.AutoCloseInputStream(it).use { stream -> stream.readBytes() } }
    }
    private fun withAuthorization(test: (AndroidMockProviderPort) -> Unit) {
        listOf(Manifest.permission.ACCESS_COARSE_LOCATION, Manifest.permission.ACCESS_FINE_LOCATION).forEach {
            instrumentation.uiAutomation.grantRuntimePermission(context.packageName, it)
        }
        val previous = context.getSystemService(AppOpsManager::class.java)
            .unsafeCheckOpNoThrow(AppOpsManager.OPSTR_MOCK_LOCATION, Process.myUid(), context.packageName)
        val restore = when (previous) {
            AppOpsManager.MODE_ALLOWED -> "allow"
            AppOpsManager.MODE_IGNORED -> "ignore"
            AppOpsManager.MODE_ERRORED -> "deny"
            AppOpsManager.MODE_FOREGROUND -> "foreground"
            else -> "default"
        }
        val port = AndroidMockProviderPort(context)
        val locationEnabled = manager.isLocationEnabled
        try {
            setMockMode("allow")
            assertTrue("Mock AppOp must be granted for the test", port.permissionGranted())
            if (!locationEnabled) setLocationEnabled(true)
            test(port)
        }
        finally {
            try { setMockMode("allow"); port.remove(provider) }
            finally {
                try { setMockMode(restore) }
                finally { if (!locationEnabled) setLocationEnabled(false) }
            }
        }
    }

    @Test fun submittedLocationIsMarkedMockAfterSystemRoundTrip() = withAuthorization { port ->
        // Foreground-only location permission must be exercised with a resumed activity.
        ActivityScenario.launch(MainActivity::class.java).use {
        instrumentation.waitForIdleSync()
        assertTrue("Location must be enabled for delivery", manager.isLocationEnabled)
        port.register(provider); port.enable(provider, true)
        val received = AtomicReference<Location>()
        val delivered = CountDownLatch(1)
        val listener = LocationListener { received.set(Location(it)); delivered.countDown() }
        try {
            manager.requestLocationUpdates(provider, 0L, 0f, context.mainExecutor, listener)
            val outgoing = Location(provider).apply {
                latitude = 25.123456; longitude = 119.123456; accuracy = 3f
                time = System.currentTimeMillis(); elapsedRealtimeNanos = SystemClock.elapsedRealtimeNanos()
            }
            MockFlagExperiment().clear(outgoing)
            assertFalse(outgoing.isMock)
            manager.setTestProviderLocation(provider, outgoing)
            assertTrue("No provider callback within 10 seconds", delivered.await(10, TimeUnit.SECONDS))
            val incoming = received.get()
            assertTrue("System delivery must retain the standard mock marker", incoming.isMock)
            assertEquals(outgoing.latitude, incoming.latitude, 0.0)
            assertEquals(outgoing.elapsedRealtimeNanos, incoming.elapsedRealtimeNanos)
            assertTrue(manager.getLastKnownLocation(provider)!!.isMock)
        } finally { manager.removeUpdates(listener) }
        }
    }

    @Test fun ignoredAuthorizationCannotDiscardPendingProviderCleanup() = withAuthorization { port ->
        port.register(provider); port.enable(provider, true)
        setMockMode("ignore")
        assertFalse(port.permissionGranted())
        assertThrows(MockAuthorizationException::class.java) { port.remove(provider) }
        assertTrue(port.pendingProviders().contains(provider))
        setMockMode("allow")
        port.remove(provider)
        assertFalse(port.pendingProviders().contains(provider))
    }

    @Test fun observerProcessCannotRecoverOrRemoveMainProcessProviders() = withAuthorization { port ->
        runBlocking { ScenarioRuntime.refreshDiagnostics().await() }
        val preferences = context.getSharedPreferences("scenario_runtime", android.content.Context.MODE_PRIVATE)
        val interrupted = preferences.getBoolean("interrupted", false)
        val backend = preferences.getString("backend", null)
        port.register(provider); port.enable(provider, true)
        preferences.edit().putBoolean("interrupted", true).putString("backend", "MOCK_PROVIDER").commit()
        try {
            context.startActivity(Intent(context, LocationProbeActivity::class.java).addFlags(Intent.FLAG_ACTIVITY_NEW_TASK))
            val activities = context.getSystemService(ActivityManager::class.java)
            val deadline = SystemClock.uptimeMillis() + 10_000
            fun ready(): Boolean {
                val attached = activities.runningAppProcesses.any { it.processName == "${context.packageName}:location_probe" }
                val visible = instrumentation.uiAutomation.rootInActiveWindow
                    ?.findAccessibilityNodeInfosByText(context.getString(R.string.probe_title))
                    ?.any { it.isVisibleToUser } == true
                return attached && visible
            }
            while (!ready() && SystemClock.uptimeMillis() < deadline) {
                Thread.sleep(50)
            }
            assertTrue("Observer process and rendered diagnostic page must be ready", ready())
            assertTrue(activities.getRunningTasks(5).any { it.topActivity?.className == LocationProbeActivity::class.java.name })
            val process = activities.runningAppProcesses.single { it.processName == "${context.packageName}:location_probe" }
            assertNotEquals(Process.myPid(), process.pid)
            assertTrue(port.pendingProviders().contains(provider))
            assertTrue(manager.allProviders.contains(provider))
            assertTrue(preferences.getBoolean("interrupted", false))
            instrumentation.uiAutomation.waitForIdle(200, 5000)
            val bitmap = checkNotNull(instrumentation.uiAutomation.takeScreenshot())
            val file = java.io.File(context.getExternalFilesDir(null), "location-probe.png")
            try { file.outputStream().use { bitmap.compress(Bitmap.CompressFormat.PNG, 100, it) } }
            finally { bitmap.recycle() }
            instrumentation.uiAutomation.executeShellCommand("mkdir -p /sdcard/Download/Portal-ui-captures")
                .let { android.os.ParcelFileDescriptor.AutoCloseInputStream(it).use { stream -> stream.readBytes() } }
            instrumentation.uiAutomation.executeShellCommand("cp ${file.absolutePath} /sdcard/Download/Portal-ui-captures/location-probe.png")
                .let { android.os.ParcelFileDescriptor.AutoCloseInputStream(it).use { stream -> stream.readBytes() } }
        } finally {
            instrumentation.uiAutomation.performGlobalAction(android.accessibilityservice.AccessibilityService.GLOBAL_ACTION_BACK)
            preferences.edit().putBoolean("interrupted", interrupted).apply {
                if (backend == null) remove("backend") else putString("backend", backend)
            }.commit()
        }
    }
}
```

`app/src/androidTest/java/com/system/location/service/MockProviderIndependentReceiverDeviceTest.kt`:

```kt
package com.system.location.service

import android.Manifest
import android.app.AppOpsManager
import android.content.pm.PackageManager
import android.location.LocationManager
import android.os.ParcelFileDescriptor
import android.os.Process
import android.os.SystemClock
import androidx.test.ext.junit.runners.AndroidJUnit4
import androidx.test.platform.app.InstrumentationRegistry
import com.system.location.service.backend.mock.AndroidMockProviderPort
import com.system.location.service.backend.mock.MockProviderBackend
import com.system.location.service.backend.mock.MockProviderPort
import com.system.location.service.core.backend.BackendResult
import com.system.location.service.core.geo.Wgs84
import com.system.location.service.core.location.LocationSample
import com.system.location.service.runtime.ScenarioRuntime
import com.system.location.service.service.MockServiceHelper
import java.io.File
import java.io.IOException
import java.net.InetSocketAddress
import java.net.Socket
import kotlinx.coroutines.*
import org.json.JSONObject
import org.junit.Assert.*
import org.junit.Assume.*
import org.junit.Test
import org.junit.runner.RunWith

/** Standard APIs observed by a separate UID, with no system Hook authority. */
@RunWith(AndroidJUnit4::class)
class MockProviderIndependentReceiverDeviceTest {
    @Test fun independentReceiverObservesMovementAndSystemMockMarkerWithoutGnssExtras() = runBlocking {
        val instrumentation = InstrumentationRegistry.getInstrumentation()
        val arguments = InstrumentationRegistry.getArguments()
        assumeTrue(arguments.getString("standardProviderDevice") == "true")
        val receiver = arguments.getString("standardDetectorPackage")
        assumeTrue("Explicit lab Detector package required", receiver != null)
        require(checkNotNull(receiver).matches(Regex("[A-Za-z][A-Za-z0-9_.]+")))
        val context = instrumentation.targetContext
        val manager = context.getSystemService(LocationManager::class.java)
        ScenarioRuntime.awaitInitialized()
        assumeFalse("Preserve local simulation", ScenarioRuntime.state.value.isActive)
        for (permission in listOf(Manifest.permission.ACCESS_FINE_LOCATION, Manifest.permission.ACCESS_BACKGROUND_LOCATION)) {
            assumeTrue(context.checkSelfPermission(permission) == PackageManager.PERMISSION_GRANTED)
        }
        assumeTrue(manager.isProviderEnabled(LocationManager.GPS_PROVIDER))
        MockServiceHelper.tryInitService(manager)
        assertNull("Hook authority must be absent", MockServiceHelper.runtimeStatus(manager))
        fun shell(command: String) = ParcelFileDescriptor.AutoCloseInputStream(
            instrumentation.uiAutomation.executeShellCommand(command)).bufferedReader().use { it.readText() }
        val receiverUid = Regex("uid:(\\d+)").find(shell("cmd package list packages -U $receiver"))
            ?.groupValues?.get(1)?.toInt()
        assumeTrue("Detector must already be installed", receiverUid != null)
        assertNotEquals(Process.myUid(), receiverUid)
        val receiverState = shell("dumpsys package $receiver")
        assumeTrue("Grant the lab receiver precise location before starting",
            receiverState.contains("android.permission.ACCESS_FINE_LOCATION: granted=true"))
        if (receiver != "com.system.location.service.detector") {
            assumeTrue("Avoid another debug bridge on port 8766",
                shell("pidof com.system.location.service.detector").isBlank())
        }
        val realPort = AndroidMockProviderPort(context)
        assumeTrue("Preserve provider ownership", realPort.pendingProviders().isEmpty())
        val backend = MockProviderBackend(object : MockProviderPort by realPort {
            override fun optionalProviders() = emptySet<String>()
        })
        val mode = context.getSystemService(AppOpsManager::class.java)
            .unsafeCheckOpNoThrow(AppOpsManager.OPSTR_MOCK_LOCATION, Process.myUid(), context.packageName)
        val restoreMode = when (mode) {
            AppOpsManager.MODE_ALLOWED -> "allow"
            AppOpsManager.MODE_IGNORED -> "ignore"
            AppOpsManager.MODE_ERRORED -> "deny"
            AppOpsManager.MODE_FOREGROUND -> "foreground"
            else -> "default"
        }
        fun authorize(value: String) { shell("appops set ${context.packageName} android:mock_location $value") }
        fun request(method: String, path: String, body: String = ""): JSONObject = Socket().use { socket ->
            socket.connect(InetSocketAddress("127.0.0.1", 8766), 500)
            socket.soTimeout = 60_000
            socket.getOutputStream().apply {
                write(("$method $path HTTP/1.1\r\nHost: localhost\r\nContent-Type: application/json\r\n" +
                    "Content-Length: ${body.toByteArray().size}\r\nConnection: close\r\n\r\n$body").toByteArray())
                flush()
            }
            val response = socket.getInputStream().bufferedReader().use { it.readText() }
            check(response.startsWith("HTTP/1.1 200")) { response.lineSequence().first() }
            JSONObject(response.substringAfter("\r\n\r\n"))
        }
        var publisher: Job? = null
        try {
            val launch = shell("am start -n $receiver/com.system.location.service.detector.MainActivity")
            assertFalse(launch, launch.contains("Error:"))
            withContext(Dispatchers.IO) {
                withTimeout(5_000L) {
                    while (true) {
                        try {
                            assertFalse("Preserve existing Detector run", request("GET", "/status").getBoolean("running"))
                            break
                        } catch (_: IOException) { delay(100L) }
                    }
                }
            }
            authorize("allow")
            assertEquals(BackendResult.Success, backend.prepare())
            assertEquals(BackendResult.Success, backend.start())
            val start = SystemClock.elapsedRealtimeNanos()
            publisher = launch(Dispatchers.IO) {
                while (isActive) {
                    val elapsed = SystemClock.elapsedRealtimeNanos()
                    val seconds = (elapsed - start) / 1_000_000_000.0
                    val sample = LocationSample(Wgs84(31.230416 + seconds * 0.00002, 121.473701),
                        altitude = 42.0, accuracy = 5f, speed = 2.2f, bearing = 0f,
                        timeMillis = System.currentTimeMillis(), elapsedNanos = elapsed)
                    assertEquals(BackendResult.Success, backend.publish(sample, null))
                    delay(100L)
                }
            }
            val report = withContext(Dispatchers.IO) { request("POST", "/run", "{\"sampleSeconds\":20}") }
            File(context.cacheDir, "standard-independent-detector.json").writeText(report.toString())
            val checks = report.getJSONArray("checks")
            val byId = (0 until checks.length()).map(checks::getJSONObject).associateBy { it.getString("id") }
            val mock = checkNotNull(byId["C01"])
            // FAIL is expected here: the standard system API preserves the mock marker.
            assertEquals(mock.getString("detail"), "FAIL", mock.getString("status"))
            val marked = checkNotNull(Regex("^(\\d+)/(\\d+)").find(mock.getString("detail")))
            assertEquals("Every inspected callback must retain its system mock marker",
                marked.groupValues[2], marked.groupValues[1])
            assertTrue(marked.groupValues[2].toInt() >= 30)
            val fields = checkNotNull(byId["C05"])
            assertEquals(fields.getString("detail"), "PASS", fields.getString("status"))
            val evidence = fields.getJSONArray("evidence")
            val lines = (0 until evidence.length()).map(evidence::getString)
            val distinct = lines.firstNotNullOfOrNull { Regex("GPS 不同坐标=(\\d+)").find(it) }
                ?.groupValues?.get(1)?.toInt() ?: error("Missing independent GPS coverage")
            // CheckSampler requests 500ms updates; standard Android honors that request. A 20s
            // run should observe about 40 GPS samples, with a 25% scheduling tolerance.
            assertTrue("Independent receiver did not observe the moving stream: $distinct", distinct >= 30)
            assertTrue("Standard backend supplied synthetic GNSS extras", lines.any { it.contains("GPS extras=0，") })
            assertNull(MockServiceHelper.runtimeStatus(manager))
        } finally {
            publisher?.cancelAndJoin()
            try {
                authorize("allow")
                assertEquals(BackendResult.Success, backend.stop())
                assertTrue(realPort.pendingProviders().isEmpty())
            } finally { authorize(restoreMode) }
        }
    }
}
```
