`app/src/androidTest/java/com/system/location/service/NmeaStatusLeakDeviceTest.kt`:

```kt
package com.system.location.service

import android.location.GnssStatus
import android.location.LocationManager
import android.location.OnNmeaMessageListener
import androidx.test.ext.junit.runners.AndroidJUnit4
import androidx.test.platform.app.InstrumentationRegistry
import com.system.location.service.core.backend.BackendType
import com.system.location.service.core.geo.Wgs84
import com.system.location.service.core.scenario.MovementProfile
import com.system.location.service.core.scenario.Scenario
import com.system.location.service.ext.enableNMEA
import com.system.location.service.runtime.ScenarioRuntime
import kotlinx.coroutines.runBlocking
import org.junit.Assert.assertEquals
import org.junit.Assert.assertTrue
import org.junit.Assume.assumeTrue
import org.junit.Test
import org.junit.runner.RunWith
import java.util.concurrent.CopyOnWriteArrayList

/**
 * A protected listener must not receive real NMEA or real status lifecycle/TTFF data while the
 * simulation is active, even if synthetic NMEA is disabled or no synthetic frame is available.
 */
@RunWith(AndroidJUnit4::class)
class NmeaStatusLeakDeviceTest {
    @Test fun protectedListenerNeverSeesRealNmeaOrStatusLifecycle() = runBlocking {
        val context = InstrumentationRegistry.getInstrumentation().targetContext
        val manager = context.getSystemService(LocationManager::class.java)
        assumeTrue("Xposed backend unavailable", ScenarioRuntime.selectBackend(BackendType.XPOSED).await())
        val oldNmea = context.enableNMEA
        context.enableNMEA = false
        val scenario = Scenario(
            id = "leak-canary",
            name = "Leak canary",
            point = Wgs84(31.2304, 121.4737),
            profile = MovementProfile(speedMps = 0.0, altitudeMeters = 12.0, accuracyMeters = 2.0f, intervalMs = 500L),
        )
        assumeTrue("scenario did not start", ScenarioRuntime.start(scenario).await())
        val nmea = CopyOnWriteArrayList<String>()
        var started = 0
        var firstFix = 0
        var stopped = 0
        val nmeaListener = OnNmeaMessageListener { message, _ -> nmea += message }
        val status = object : GnssStatus.Callback() {
            override fun onStarted() { started++ }
            override fun onFirstFix(ttffMillis: Int) { firstFix++ }
            override fun onStopped() { stopped++ }
        }
        try {
            assertTrue(manager.addNmeaListener({ it.run() }, nmeaListener))
            assertTrue(manager.registerGnssStatusCallback({ it.run() }, status))
            Thread.sleep(6_000)
            assertEquals("Protected listener received real NMEA", 0, nmea.size)
            // One synthetic lifecycle is expected. A second call would mean a real framework
            // onStarted/onFirstFix leaked through the guard.
            assertEquals("Unexpected onStarted count", 1, started)
            assertEquals("Unexpected onFirstFix count", 1, firstFix)
            assertEquals("Protected listener received synthetic or real onStopped", 0, stopped)
        } finally {
            manager.removeNmeaListener(nmeaListener)
            manager.unregisterGnssStatusCallback(status)
            context.enableNMEA = oldNmea
            ScenarioRuntime.stop().await()
        }
    }
}
```

```kt
    @Test fun emptyAndCorruptLibrariesHaveDistinctStatesAndRetryRecovers() {
```

`app/src/androidTest/java/com/system/location/service/PortalTestRunner.kt`:

```kt
package com.system.location.service

import androidx.test.runner.AndroidJUnitRunner
import android.app.Application
import com.system.location.service.ext.sharedPrefs

/** No implicit agreement: each map test fixture explicitly accepts maps. */
class PortalTestRunner : AndroidJUnitRunner() {
    override fun callApplicationOnCreate(app: Application) {
        // Clear BEFORE Application restores choices or initializes third-party SDKs.
        if (androidx.test.platform.app.InstrumentationRegistry.getArguments().getString("freshPrivacy") == "true") {
            // Both vendors' consent lives here, including Tencent's tencent_maps_v1.
            check(app.getSharedPreferences("sdk_privacy", 0).edit().clear().commit())
            // Exercise the actual no-preference default, even after a prior provider test.
            check(app.sharedPrefs.edit().remove("map_provider").commit())
        }
        super.callApplicationOnCreate(app)
    }
}
```

```kt
import androidx.activity.BackEventCompat

@RunWith(AndroidJUnit4::class)
class PredictiveBackUiTest {
    @get:Rule val compose = createEmptyComposeRule()
    private fun event(progress: Float) = BackEventCompat(200f * progress, 400f, progress, BackEventCompat.EDGE_LEFT)

    @Test fun drawerTracksProgressCancelsAndCommitsWithoutLeavingThePage() {
        acceptSelectedMapForUiTest()
        grantUiPermissions()

            compose.waitUntil(5_000) { runCatching { compose.onNodeWithText("开始模拟").assertIsDisplayed(); true }.getOrDefault(false) }

                open
            }
            scenario.onActivity {
                it.onBackPressedDispatcher.dispatchOnBackStarted(event(0f))
                it.onBackPressedDispatcher.dispatchOnBackProgressed(event(.65f))
                // The Compose drawer handles progress without navigating the underlying page.
                assertEquals(R.id.nav_home, it.currentDestinationId)
                assertTrue(it.drawerState.isOpen)
                it.onBackPressedDispatcher.dispatchOnBackCancelled()

            compose.waitUntil(5_000) {
                var restored = false
                scenario.onActivity { restored = it.drawerState.isOpen && !it.drawerState.isAnimationRunning }
                restored
            }
            scenario.onActivity {
                assertTrue(it.drawerState.isOpen)
                it.onBackPressedDispatcher.dispatchOnBackStarted(event(0f))
                it.onBackPressedDispatcher.dispatchOnBackProgressed(event(.8f))
                it.onBackPressedDispatcher.onBackPressed()
            }
            compose.waitUntil(5_000) {
                var closed = false
                scenario.onActivity { closed = !(it.drawerState.isOpen || it.drawerState.isAnimationRunning) }
                closed
            }
            compose.onNodeWithText("开始模拟").assertIsDisplayed()
            scenario.onActivity { assertEquals(R.id.nav_home, it.findNavController(R.id.nav_host_fragment_content_main).currentDestination?.id) }
        }
    }

    @androidx.test.filters.SdkSuppress(minSdkVersion = 34)
    @Test fun settingsBackCancellationKeepsDetailAndCommitReturnsToDirectory() {
        acceptSelectedMapForUiTest()
        grantUiPermissions()
        ActivityScenario.launch(MainActivity::class.java).use { scenario ->
            compose.openPage(scenario, R.id.nav_settings)
            compose.onNodeWithText("地图与定位").performClick()
            fun resumed() = compose.waitUntil(5_000) {
                var ready = false
                scenario.onActivity {
                    ready = it.supportFragmentManager.findFragmentById(R.id.nav_host_fragment_content_main)!!
                        .childFragmentManager.primaryNavigationFragment?.lifecycle?.currentState == androidx.lifecycle.Lifecycle.State.RESUMED
                }
                ready
            }
            resumed()
            compose.onNodeWithText("定位精度").assertIsDisplayed()
            scenario.onActivity {
                val page = it.supportFragmentManager.findFragmentById(R.id.nav_host_fragment_content_main)!!
                    .childFragmentManager.primaryNavigationFragment!!
                assertTrue((page.returnTransition as androidx.transition.Slide).isSeekingSupported)
                it.onBackPressedDispatcher.dispatchOnBackStarted(event(0f))
            }
            compose.waitForIdle()
            scenario.onActivity {
                it.onBackPressedDispatcher.dispatchOnBackProgressed(event(.5f))
            }
            // A seekable Back must attach the previous page before the gesture commits.
            compose.waitUntil(5_000) {
                var previewing = false
                scenario.onActivity {
                    val host = it.supportFragmentManager.findFragmentById(R.id.nav_host_fragment_content_main)!!
                    previewing = host.childFragmentManager.fragments.count { page ->
                        page.view?.parent != null && page.view?.visibility == android.view.View.VISIBLE
                    } >= 2
                }
                previewing
            }
            scenario.onActivity { it.onBackPressedDispatcher.dispatchOnBackCancelled() }
            resumed()

            compose.waitForIdle()
            scenario.onActivity {
                it.onBackPressedDispatcher.dispatchOnBackProgressed(event(.8f))
                it.onBackPressedDispatcher.onBackPressed()
            }
            resumed()
            compose.onNodeWithText("常用设置").assertIsDisplayed()
            scenario.onActivity { assertEquals(R.id.nav_settings, it.findNavController(R.id.nav_host_fragment_content_main).currentDestination?.id) }
        }
    }
```

```kt
package com.system.location.service

import android.location.LocationManager
import androidx.test.core.app.ActivityScenario
import androidx.test.ext.junit.runners.AndroidJUnit4
import androidx.test.platform.app.InstrumentationRegistry
import com.system.location.service.core.backend.BackendType
import com.system.location.service.core.geo.Wgs84
import com.system.location.service.core.scenario.Scenario
import com.system.location.service.ext.sharedPrefs
import com.system.location.service.gnss.gnssReplayOnStart
import com.system.location.service.runtime.ScenarioRuntime
import com.system.location.service.service.MockServiceHelper
import kotlinx.coroutines.runBlocking
import org.junit.Assert.*
import org.junit.Assume.*
import org.junit.Test
import org.junit.runner.RunWith

@RunWith(AndroidJUnit4::class)
class QuickReplayStartupDeviceTest {
    @Test fun xposedStartsTheSavedCombinationAndHonorsDisablingSatelliteOnRestart() {
        val context = InstrumentationRegistry.getInstrumentation().targetContext
        val manager = context.getSystemService(LocationManager::class.java)
        runBlocking { ScenarioRuntime.awaitInitialized() }
        assumeFalse("Preserve active runtime", ScenarioRuntime.state.value.isActive)
        MockServiceHelper.tryInitService(manager)
        assumeTrue("Requires an installed system module", MockServiceHelper.isServiceInit())
        assumeFalse("Preserve active system simulation", MockServiceHelper.isMockStart(manager))
        val backend = ScenarioRuntime.state.value.backend
        val preferences = context.sharedPrefs
        val keys = listOf("gnssReplayOnStart", "gnssSimulationMode", "enableMockWifi", "disableWifiScan", "environmentSourceMode")
        val original = preferences.all.filterKeys { it in keys }
        val satellite = MockServiceHelper.isGnssMockStart(manager)
        val wifi = MockServiceHelper.isWifiMockStart(manager)
        val config = context.noBackupFilesDir.resolve("active-config.json")
        val originalConfig = config.takeIf { it.exists() }?.readBytes()
        acceptSelectedMapForUiTest()
        grantUiPermissions()
        ActivityScenario.launch(MainActivity::class.java).use {
            try {
                preferences.edit().putBoolean("gnssReplayOnStart", true).putString("gnssSimulationMode", "AUTONOMOUS")
                    .putBoolean("enableMockWifi", true).putBoolean("disableWifiScan", true)
                    .putString("environmentSourceMode", "PROCEDURAL").commit()
                runBlocking {
                    assertTrue(ScenarioRuntime.selectBackend(BackendType.XPOSED).await())
                    val scenario = Scenario("quick-replay-device", "快捷回放验证", point = Wgs84(30.0, 120.0))
                    assertTrue(ScenarioRuntime.start(scenario).await())
                    assertTrue(MockServiceHelper.isGnssMockStart(manager))
                    assertTrue(MockServiceHelper.isWifiMockStart(manager))
                    assertTrue(ScenarioRuntime.stop().await())
                    context.gnssReplayOnStart = false
                    assertTrue(ScenarioRuntime.start(scenario).await())
                    assertFalse(MockServiceHelper.isGnssMockStart(manager))
                    assertTrue(MockServiceHelper.isWifiMockStart(manager))
                    context.gnssReplayOnStart = true
                    assertTrue(ScenarioRuntime.applyReplaySettings().await())
                    assertTrue(MockServiceHelper.isGnssMockStart(manager))
                }
            } finally {
                runBlocking {
                    ScenarioRuntime.stop().await()
                    ScenarioRuntime.selectBackend(backend).await()
                }
                preferences.edit().apply {
                    keys.forEach(::remove)
                    original.forEach { (key, value) -> when (value) {
                        is String -> putString(key, value)
                        is Boolean -> putBoolean(key, value)
                    } }
                }.commit()
                if (originalConfig == null) config.delete() else config.writeBytes(originalConfig)
                MockServiceHelper.putConfig(manager, context)
                if (satellite) MockServiceHelper.startGnssMock(manager) else MockServiceHelper.stopGnssMock(manager)
                if (wifi) MockServiceHelper.startWifiMock(manager) else MockServiceHelper.stopWifiMock(manager)
            }
        }
    }
}
```

`app/src/androidTest/java/com/system/location/service/RawGnssDeliveryDeviceTest.kt`:

```kt
package com.system.location.service

import android.location.GnssMeasurement
import android.location.GnssMeasurementsEvent
import android.location.LocationManager
import android.os.SystemClock
import androidx.test.ext.junit.runners.AndroidJUnit4
import androidx.test.platform.app.InstrumentationRegistry
import com.system.location.service.core.backend.BackendType
import com.system.location.service.core.geo.Wgs84
import com.system.location.service.core.gnss.Constellation
import com.system.location.service.core.gnss.GnssMeasurementBatch
import com.system.location.service.core.gnss.GnssMeasurementObservation
import com.system.location.service.core.gnss.GnssObserverGeometry
import com.system.location.service.core.gnss.GpsIndependentPositionSolver
import com.system.location.service.core.gnss.GpsRangeObservation
import com.system.location.service.core.gnss.GpsReceptionGeometry
import com.system.location.service.core.gnss.GpsReceiverClock
import com.system.location.service.core.gnss.GpsTime
import com.system.location.service.core.gnss.RawGnssSynthesis
import com.system.location.service.core.scenario.MovementProfile
import com.system.location.service.core.scenario.Scenario
import com.system.location.service.runtime.ScenarioRuntime
import kotlin.math.hypot
import kotlinx.coroutines.runBlocking
import org.junit.Assert.assertEquals
import org.junit.Assert.assertNotNull
import org.junit.Assert.assertNull
import org.junit.Assert.assertTrue
import org.junit.Assume.assumeTrue
import org.junit.Test
import org.junit.runner.RunWith
import java.util.concurrent.CountDownLatch
import java.util.concurrent.LinkedBlockingQueue
import java.util.concurrent.TimeUnit

/** Device proof that the system-server hook delivers synthetic raw observations, not a rejection. */
@RunWith(AndroidJUnit4::class)
class RawGnssDeliveryDeviceTest {
    @Test fun syntheticGpsL1MeasurementsArriveFromTargetFrame() = runBlocking {
        val context = InstrumentationRegistry.getInstrumentation().targetContext
        val manager = context.getSystemService(LocationManager::class.java)
        assumeTrue("Xposed backend unavailable", ScenarioRuntime.selectBackend(BackendType.XPOSED).await())
        val scenario = Scenario(
            id = "raw-canary",
            name = "Raw canary",
            point = Wgs84(31.2304, 121.4737),
            profile = MovementProfile(speedMps = 0.0, altitudeMeters = 12.0, accuracyMeters = 2.0f, intervalMs = 500L),
        )
        val started = ScenarioRuntime.start(scenario).await()
        assumeTrue("scenario did not start", started)
        val events = LinkedBlockingQueue<GnssMeasurementsEvent>()
        val statuses = LinkedBlockingQueue<Int>()
        val firstEvent = CountDownLatch(1)
        val callback = object : GnssMeasurementsEvent.Callback() {
            override fun onGnssMeasurementsReceived(event: GnssMeasurementsEvent) {
                events.offer(event)
                firstEvent.countDown()
            }
            override fun onStatusChanged(status: Int) { statuses.offer(status) }
        }
        try {
            assertTrue(manager.registerGnssMeasurementsCallback({ it.run() }, callback))
            val status = statuses.poll(5, TimeUnit.SECONDS)
            assertEquals("Synthetic registration must report READY", 1, status)
            assertTrue("No synthetic raw measurement arrived", firstEvent.await(12, TimeUnit.SECONDS))
            val event = requireNotNull(events.poll())
            val clock = event.clock
            assertNotNull(clock)
            assertTrue("Synthetic clock must carry full bias", clock.hasFullBiasNanos())
            assertTrue("Synthetic clock must carry elapsed time", clock.hasElapsedRealtimeNanos())
            val measurements = event.measurements.toList()
            assertTrue("Need four GPS measurements, got ${measurements.size}", measurements.size >= 4)
            assertTrue(measurements.all { it.constellationType == 1 })
            assertTrue(measurements.all { it.hasCarrierFrequencyHz() })
            assertTrue(measurements.all {
                it.accumulatedDeltaRangeState and GnssMeasurement.ADR_STATE_VALID != 0
            })
            assertTrue(measurements.all { it.svid in 1..32 && it.receivedSvTimeNanos > 0 })
            assertTrue(measurements.all { it.cn0DbHz in 0.0..63.0 })
            assertNull("Synthetic READY must be emitted only once",
                statuses.poll(1, TimeUnit.SECONDS))
            val statusAt = SystemClock.elapsedRealtimeNanos()
            assertTrue(clock.elapsedRealtimeNanos <= statusAt + 1_000_000_000L)

            // Independent receiver-side check: consume only the Android observations and solve
            // without reading the target coordinate from Portal's runtime state.
            val target = Wgs84(31.2304, 121.4737)
            val targetEcef = GnssObserverGeometry.ecef(target, 12.0)
            val ranges = syntheticRanges(event, target, 12.0)
            assertTrue("Need four range observations, got ${ranges.size}", ranges.size >= 4)
            val solved = GpsIndependentPositionSolver.solve(
                ranges,
                targetEcef.copy(
                    xMeters = targetEcef.xMeters + 1_000.0,
                    yMeters = targetEcef.yMeters - 700.0,
                    zMeters = targetEcef.zMeters + 400.0,
                ),
            )
            assertNotNull("Independent solver did not converge", solved)
            val error = hypot(hypot(
                solved!!.position.xMeters - targetEcef.xMeters,
                solved.position.yMeters - targetEcef.yMeters,
            ), solved.position.zMeters - targetEcef.zMeters)
            assertTrue("Synthetic raw solved ${error}m away from target", error < 30.0)
        } finally {
            manager.unregisterGnssMeasurementsCallback(callback)
            ScenarioRuntime.stop().await()
        }
    }

    private fun syntheticRanges(
        event: GnssMeasurementsEvent,
        target: Wgs84,
        altitudeMeters: Double,
    ): List<GpsRangeObservation> {
        val clock = event.clock
        val observations = event.measurements.map { measurement ->
            GnssMeasurementObservation(
                constellation = Constellation.GPS,
                svid = measurement.svid,
                state = measurement.state,
                timeOffsetNanos = measurement.timeOffsetNanos,
                receivedSvTimeNanos = measurement.receivedSvTimeNanos,
                receivedSvTimeUncertaintyNanos = measurement.receivedSvTimeUncertaintyNanos,
                cn0DbHz = measurement.cn0DbHz,
                pseudorangeRateMetersPerSecond = measurement.pseudorangeRateMetersPerSecond,
                pseudorangeRateUncertaintyMetersPerSecond =
                    measurement.pseudorangeRateUncertaintyMetersPerSecond,
                accumulatedDeltaRangeState = measurement.accumulatedDeltaRangeState,
                accumulatedDeltaRangeMeters = measurement.accumulatedDeltaRangeMeters,
                accumulatedDeltaRangeUncertaintyMeters =
                    measurement.accumulatedDeltaRangeUncertaintyMeters,
                carrierHz = measurement.carrierFrequencyHz.toDouble()
                    .takeIf { measurement.hasCarrierFrequencyHz() },
                codeType = measurement.codeType.takeIf { measurement.hasCodeType() },
            )
        }
        val batch = GnssMeasurementBatch(
            capturedAtMillis = System.currentTimeMillis(),
            timeNanos = clock.timeNanos,
            fullBiasNanos = clock.fullBiasNanos.takeIf { clock.hasFullBiasNanos() },
            biasNanos = clock.biasNanos.takeIf { clock.hasBiasNanos() },
            hardwareClockDiscontinuityCount = clock.hardwareClockDiscontinuityCount,
            measurements = observations,
            timeUncertaintyNanos = clock.timeUncertaintyNanos.takeIf { clock.hasTimeUncertaintyNanos() },
            biasUncertaintyNanos = clock.biasUncertaintyNanos.takeIf { clock.hasBiasUncertaintyNanos() },
            driftNanosPerSecond = clock.driftNanosPerSecond.takeIf { clock.hasDriftNanosPerSecond() },
            driftUncertaintyNanosPerSecond = clock.driftUncertaintyNanosPerSecond
                .takeIf { clock.hasDriftUncertaintyNanosPerSecond() },
            elapsedRealtimeNanos = clock.elapsedRealtimeNanos.takeIf { clock.hasElapsedRealtimeNanos() },
            elapsedRealtimeUncertaintyNanos = clock.elapsedRealtimeUncertaintyNanos
                .takeIf { clock.hasElapsedRealtimeUncertaintyNanos() },
        )
        val receiverTime = GpsReceiverClock.decode(batch).epoch?.time ?: return emptyList()
        val ephemerides = RawGnssSynthesis.ephemerides(null, System.currentTimeMillis())
        return observations.mapNotNull { measurement ->
            val ephemeris = ephemerides.firstOrNull { it.svid == measurement.svid } ?: return@mapNotNull null
            var transmitTime = GpsTime(receiverTime.week, measurement.receivedSvTimeNanos / 1e9)
            if (receiverTime.secondsSince(transmitTime) < 0.0) {
                transmitTime = transmitTime.plusSeconds(-GpsTime.SECONDS_PER_WEEK)
            }
            val geometry = GpsReceptionGeometry.observe(
                ephemeris, receiverTime, target, altitudeMeters,
            ).observation ?: return@mapNotNull null
            val light = GpsReceptionGeometry.SPEED_OF_LIGHT_METERS_PER_SECOND
            val meters = (receiverTime.secondsSince(transmitTime) + geometry.l1CaClockBiasSeconds) * light
            if (!meters.isFinite() || meters <= 0.0) null
            else GpsRangeObservation(geometry.satelliteInReceptionEcef, meters)
        }
    }
}
```

`app/src/androidTest/java/com/system/location/service/ReplayPreferencesDeviceTest.kt`:

```kt
package com.system.location.service

import android.content.Context
import android.content.ContextWrapper
import androidx.test.ext.junit.runners.AndroidJUnit4
import androidx.test.platform.app.InstrumentationRegistry
import com.system.location.service.core.geo.Wgs84
import com.system.location.service.core.gnss.*
import com.system.location.service.core.runtime.RouteEndPosition
import com.system.location.service.ext.routeEndPosition
import com.system.location.service.ext.sharedPrefs
import com.system.location.service.gnss.gnssReplayOnStart
import com.system.location.service.gnss.gnssReplayProblem
import org.junit.Assert.*
import org.junit.Test
import org.junit.runner.RunWith
import java.nio.file.Files
import java.util.UUID

@RunWith(AndroidJUnit4::class)
class ReplayPreferencesDeviceTest {
    @Test fun routeEndPositionDefaultsToEndpointAndMigratesLegacySwitch() {
        val target = InstrumentationRegistry.getInstrumentation().targetContext
        val name = "route-end-position-${UUID.randomUUID()}"
        val isolated = object : ContextWrapper(target) {
            override fun getSharedPreferences(ignored: String, mode: Int) =
                target.getSharedPreferences(name, Context.MODE_PRIVATE)
        }
        try {
            assertEquals(RouteEndPosition.END, isolated.routeEndPosition)
            isolated.sharedPrefs.edit().putBoolean("holdAtRouteEnd", false).commit()
            assertEquals(RouteEndPosition.REAL_LOCATION, isolated.routeEndPosition)
            isolated.sharedPrefs.edit().putBoolean("holdAtRouteEnd", true).commit()
            assertEquals(RouteEndPosition.END, isolated.routeEndPosition)
            isolated.routeEndPosition = RouteEndPosition.START
            assertEquals(RouteEndPosition.START, isolated.routeEndPosition)
        } finally { target.deleteSharedPreferences(name) }
    }

    @Test fun missingAndExpiredSourcesFailOnlyWhenReplayIsSelected() {
        val target = InstrumentationRegistry.getInstrumentation().targetContext
        val directory = Files.createTempDirectory(target.cacheDir.toPath(), "replay-readiness-").toFile()
        val name = "replay-readiness-${UUID.randomUUID()}"
        val isolated = object : ContextWrapper(target) {
            override fun getNoBackupFilesDir() = directory
            override fun getSharedPreferences(ignored: String, mode: Int) = target.getSharedPreferences(name, Context.MODE_PRIVATE)
        }
        try {
            isolated.sharedPrefs.edit().putString("gnssSimulationMode", "REPLAY").commit()
            assertNull(isolated.gnssReplayProblem())
            isolated.gnssReplayOnStart = true
            assertNotNull(isolated.gnssReplayProblem())
            val now = System.currentTimeMillis()
            // Storage policy fixture, isolated from the production receiver evidence.
            val capture = GnssCapture(deviceModel = "readiness fixture", osVersion = "test",
                startedAtMillis = now - 60_000, endedAtMillis = now,
                frames = (0..60).map { index -> GnssObservationFrame(now - 60_000 + index * 1000L,
                    observer = Wgs84(30.0, 120.0), satellites = listOf(
                        GnssSatellite(Constellation.GPS, 1, 25f, 120f, 32f, true, true, true))) })
            val store = GnssCaptureStore(directory.resolve("gnss/receiver-capture.json"))
            store.save(capture)
            assertNull(isolated.gnssReplayProblem())
            val shift = GnssCaptureValidator.MAX_AGE_MILLIS + 60_000
            store.save(capture.copy(startedAtMillis = capture.startedAtMillis - shift,
                endedAtMillis = capture.endedAtMillis - shift,
                frames = capture.frames.map { it.copy(capturedAtMillis = it.capturedAtMillis - shift) }))
            assertNotNull(isolated.gnssReplayProblem())
            isolated.sharedPrefs.edit().putString("gnssSimulationMode", "AUTONOMOUS").commit()
            assertNull(isolated.gnssReplayProblem())
        } finally { directory.deleteRecursively(); target.deleteSharedPreferences(name) }
    }
}
```

```kt
import android.Manifest

/** Integration test for overlay ownership and the user's persisted visibility choice. */
@RunWith(AndroidJUnit4::class)
class RockerOverlayTest {
    @get:Rule val compose = createEmptyComposeRule()
    @org.junit.Before fun acceptMapConsentForThisFixture() {
        acceptSelectedMapForUiTest()
    }
    @Test fun deniedOverlayPermissionOpensSettingsEvenWhenVisibilityWasEnabled() {
        val instrumentation = InstrumentationRegistry.getInstrumentation()
        val context = instrumentation.targetContext
        grantUiPermissions()
        val appOps = context.getSystemService(AppOpsManager::class.java)
        val previousMode = appOps.unsafeCheckOpNoThrow(AppOpsManager.OPSTR_SYSTEM_ALERT_WINDOW, Process.myUid(), context.packageName)
        val preferences = context.getSharedPreferences("rocker_overlay", Context.MODE_PRIVATE)
        val previousPreferences = preferences.all
        val requested = AtomicReference<Intent>()
        val monitor = object : Instrumentation.ActivityMonitor() {
            override fun onStartActivity(intent: Intent): Instrumentation.ActivityResult? {
                if (intent.action != Settings.ACTION_MANAGE_OVERLAY_PERMISSION) return null
                requested.set(intent)
                return Instrumentation.ActivityResult(Activity.RESULT_CANCELED, null)
            }
        }
        fun permission(mode: String) {
            ParcelFileDescriptor.AutoCloseInputStream(instrumentation.uiAutomation.executeShellCommand(
                "appops set ${context.packageName} SYSTEM_ALERT_WINDOW $mode")).use { it.readBytes() }
        }
        instrumentation.addMonitor(monitor)
        try {
            permission("ignore")
            assertFalse(com.system.location.service.android.window.OverlayUtils.hasOverlayPermissions(context))
            preferences.edit().putBoolean("enabled", true).commit()
            ActivityScenario.launch(MainActivity::class.java).use { scenario ->
                compose.onNodeWithContentDescription("打开悬浮窗").performClick()
                compose.waitUntil(5_000) { requested.get() != null }
                assertEquals("package:${context.packageName}", requested.get().dataString)
                scenario.onActivity { assertFalse(RockerOverlay.isVisible) }
                compose.onNodeWithContentDescription("打开悬浮窗").assertIsDisplayed()
            }
        } finally {
            instrumentation.removeMonitor(monitor)
            instrumentation.runOnMainSync { RockerOverlay.setEnabled(false) }
            preferences.edit().apply {
                if (previousPreferences.containsKey("enabled")) putBoolean("enabled", previousPreferences["enabled"] as Boolean)
                else remove("enabled")
            }.commit()
            permission(when (previousMode) {
                AppOpsManager.MODE_ALLOWED -> "allow"
                AppOpsManager.MODE_IGNORED -> "ignore"
                AppOpsManager.MODE_ERRORED -> "deny"
                else -> "default"
            })
        }
    }

    @Test fun overlaySurvivesNavigationRecreationAndStopUntilHomeDisablesIt() {
        val instrumentation = InstrumentationRegistry.getInstrumentation()
        val context = instrumentation.targetContext
        val overlayWasAllowed = Settings.canDrawOverlays(context)
        fun overlayPermission(mode: String) {
            ParcelFileDescriptor.AutoCloseInputStream(instrumentation.uiAutomation.executeShellCommand(
                "appops set ${context.packageName} SYSTEM_ALERT_WINDOW $mode")).use { it.readBytes() }
        }
        overlayPermission("allow")
        fun overlay(id: Int) = onView(withId(id)).inRoot(
            withDecorView(hasDescendant(withId(R.id.rocker_minimized))))
        listOf(Manifest.permission.ACCESS_COARSE_LOCATION, Manifest.permission.ACCESS_FINE_LOCATION,
            Manifest.permission.POST_NOTIFICATIONS).forEach {
            instrumentation.uiAutomation.grantRuntimePermission(context.packageName, it)
        }
        val preferences = context.getSharedPreferences("rocker_overlay", Context.MODE_PRIVATE)
        val previouslyEnabled = preferences.getBoolean("enabled", true)
        val hadSpeed = context.sharedPrefs.contains("speed")
        val savedSpeed = context.speed
        context.speed = 3.05
        preferences.edit().remove("enabled").commit()
        try {
            ActivityScenario.launch(MainActivity::class.java).use { scenario ->
                compose.onNodeWithText("开始模拟").assertIsDisplayed()
                scenario.onActivity {
                    assertTrue(RockerOverlay.isEnabled)
                    assertTrue("Grant overlay permission on the test device", RockerOverlay.isVisible)
                }
                overlay(R.id.rocker_minimized).check(matches(isDisplayed()))
                captureUi("overlay-minimized")
                overlay(R.id.rocker_minimized).perform(click())
                overlay(R.id.rocker).check(matches(isDisplayed()))
                overlay(R.id.speed_slider).check(matches(withEffectiveVisibility(Visibility.GONE)))
                captureUi("overlay-expanded")
                // Invoke the real click callback without injected tap timing: a stalled
                // emulator can turn Espresso's down/up into a tooltip long press.
                overlay(R.id.speed_toggle).perform(object : androidx.test.espresso.ViewAction {
                    override fun getConstraints() = isDisplayed()
                    override fun getDescription() = "Activate the speed panel click action"
                    override fun perform(ui: androidx.test.espresso.UiController, view: android.view.View) {
                        assertTrue(view.performClick())
                        ui.loopMainThreadUntilIdle()
                    }
                })
                overlay(R.id.speed_slider).check(matches(withContentDescription(R.string.rocker_speed)))
                overlay(R.id.speed_slider).check(matches(isDisplayed()))
                captureUi("overlay-speed-expanded")
                overlay(R.id.speed_up).perform(click())
                runBlocking { withTimeout(5000) { while (kotlin.math.abs(context.speed - 3.15) > 0.001) delay(10) } }
                overlay(R.id.speed).check(matches(withText(context.getString(R.string.overlay_speed_number, context.speed))))
                overlay(R.id.speed_down).perform(click())
                runBlocking { withTimeout(5000) { while (kotlin.math.abs(context.speed - 3.05) > 0.001) delay(10) } }
                overlay(R.id.speed_kmh).check(matches(withText(context.getString(R.string.speed_kmh, context.speed * 3.6))))
                overlay(R.id.expand_menu).perform(click())
                overlay(R.id.rocker_minimized).check(matches(isDisplayed()))
                overlay(R.id.rocker_minimized).perform(click())
                overlay(R.id.speed_slider).check(matches(withEffectiveVisibility(Visibility.GONE)))
                overlay(R.id.speed_summary).check(matches(withText(context.getString(R.string.overlay_speed_value, context.speed))))
                overlay(R.id.expand_menu).perform(click())
                scenario.onActivity { it.findNavController(R.id.nav_host_fragment_content_main).navigate(R.id.nav_runtime) }
                scenario.recreate()
                overlay(R.id.rocker_minimized).check(matches(isDisplayed()))
                // Stopping even an idle scenario must not dismiss the independent overlay.
                runBlocking { ScenarioRuntime.stop().await() }
                overlay(R.id.rocker_minimized).check(matches(isDisplayed()))
                scenario.onActivity { it.findNavController(R.id.nav_host_fragment_content_main).navigate(R.id.nav_home) }
                compose.onNodeWithContentDescription("关闭悬浮窗").performClick()
                scenario.onActivity {
                    assertFalse(RockerOverlay.isEnabled)
                    assertFalse(RockerOverlay.isVisible)
                }
                scenario.recreate()
                scenario.onActivity { assertFalse(RockerOverlay.isVisible) }
                compose.onNodeWithContentDescription("打开悬浮窗").performClick()
                overlay(R.id.rocker_minimized).check(matches(isDisplayed()))
            }
        } finally {
            instrumentation.runOnMainSync { RockerOverlay.setEnabled(false) }
            preferences.edit().putBoolean("enabled", previouslyEnabled).commit()
            if (hadSpeed) context.speed = savedSpeed else context.sharedPrefs.edit().remove("speed").commit()
            if (!overlayWasAllowed) overlayPermission("default")
        }
    }
}
```

`app/src/androidTest/java/com/system/location/service/RouteGestureTest.kt`:

```kt
package com.system.location.service

import android.view.MotionEvent
import android.view.View
import android.widget.FrameLayout
import androidx.test.ext.junit.runners.AndroidJUnit4
import androidx.test.platform.app.InstrumentationRegistry
import com.system.location.service.ui.mock.RouteGestureLayout
import org.junit.Assert.*
import org.junit.Test
import org.junit.runner.RunWith

@RunWith(AndroidJUnit4::class)
class RouteGestureTest {
    @Test fun secondFingerCancelsStrokeAndMapReceivesCompleteGesture() {
        val instrumentation = InstrumentationRegistry.getInstrumentation()
        instrumentation.runOnMainSync {
            val strokes = mutableListOf<Int>()
            val mapEvents = mutableListOf<Int>()
            val layout = RouteGestureLayout(instrumentation.targetContext).apply {
                drawingEnabled = true
                onStrokeTouch = { strokes.add(it.actionMasked) }
                addView(View(context).apply { setOnTouchListener { _, e -> mapEvents.add(e.actionMasked); true } },
                    FrameLayout.LayoutParams(500, 500))
                measure(View.MeasureSpec.makeMeasureSpec(500, View.MeasureSpec.EXACTLY), View.MeasureSpec.makeMeasureSpec(500, View.MeasureSpec.EXACTLY))
                layout(0, 0, 500, 500)
            }
            var time = android.os.SystemClock.uptimeMillis()
            val downTime = time
            fun dispatch(action: Int, count: Int = 1) {
                val props = Array(count) { i -> MotionEvent.PointerProperties().apply { id = i; toolType = MotionEvent.TOOL_TYPE_FINGER } }
                val coords = Array(count) { i -> MotionEvent.PointerCoords().apply { x = 100f + i * 100; y = 100f; pressure = 1f; size = 1f } }
                val event = MotionEvent.obtain(downTime, ++time, action, count, props, coords, 0, 0, 1f, 1f, 0, 0, android.view.InputDevice.SOURCE_TOUCHSCREEN, 0)
                layout.dispatchTouchEvent(event)
                event.recycle()
            }
            dispatch(MotionEvent.ACTION_DOWN)
            dispatch(MotionEvent.ACTION_MOVE)
            dispatch(MotionEvent.ACTION_POINTER_DOWN or (1 shl MotionEvent.ACTION_POINTER_INDEX_SHIFT), 2)
            dispatch(MotionEvent.ACTION_MOVE, 2)
            dispatch(MotionEvent.ACTION_POINTER_UP or (1 shl MotionEvent.ACTION_POINTER_INDEX_SHIFT), 2)
            dispatch(MotionEvent.ACTION_MOVE)
            dispatch(MotionEvent.ACTION_UP)
            assertEquals(listOf(MotionEvent.ACTION_DOWN, MotionEvent.ACTION_MOVE, MotionEvent.ACTION_CANCEL), strokes)
            assertEquals(listOf(MotionEvent.ACTION_DOWN, MotionEvent.ACTION_POINTER_DOWN, MotionEvent.ACTION_MOVE,
                MotionEvent.ACTION_POINTER_UP, MotionEvent.ACTION_MOVE, MotionEvent.ACTION_UP), mapEvents)
            mapEvents.clear(); strokes.clear()
            dispatch(MotionEvent.ACTION_DOWN); dispatch(MotionEvent.ACTION_MOVE); dispatch(MotionEvent.ACTION_UP)
            assertEquals(listOf(MotionEvent.ACTION_DOWN, MotionEvent.ACTION_MOVE, MotionEvent.ACTION_UP), strokes)
            assertTrue(mapEvents.isEmpty())
            layout.drawingEnabled = false
            strokes.clear()
            dispatch(MotionEvent.ACTION_DOWN); dispatch(MotionEvent.ACTION_UP)
            assertTrue(strokes.isEmpty())
            assertEquals(listOf(MotionEvent.ACTION_DOWN, MotionEvent.ACTION_UP), mapEvents)
        }
    }
}
```

`app/src/androidTest/java/com/system/location/service/SatelliteDefaultsDeviceTest.kt`:

```kt
package com.system.location.service

import android.location.LocationManager
import android.Manifest
import android.content.pm.PackageManager
import androidx.test.ext.junit.runners.AndroidJUnit4
import androidx.test.platform.app.InstrumentationRegistry
import com.system.location.service.android.root.RootEnvironmentProbe
import com.system.location.service.backend.xposed.XposedBackend
import com.system.location.service.core.backend.BackendType
import com.system.location.service.core.geo.Wgs84
import com.system.location.service.core.scenario.Scenario
import com.system.location.service.ext.sharedPrefs
import com.system.location.service.gnss.gnssReplayOnStart
import com.system.location.service.runtime.ScenarioRuntime
import com.system.location.service.runtime.XposedServiceBridge
import com.system.location.service.service.MockServiceHelper
import kotlinx.coroutines.runBlocking
import org.junit.Assert.*
import org.junit.Assume.*
import org.junit.Test
import org.junit.runner.RunWith

/** Opt-in rooted system-module test; restores saved satellite choices and never enables Native. */
@RunWith(AndroidJUnit4::class)
class SatelliteDefaultsDeviceTest {
    @Test fun targetSkyStartsWithLocationAndExplicitReplayOrDisablingIsPreserved() = runBlocking {
        assumeTrue("Explicit device run required",
            InstrumentationRegistry.getArguments().getString("libxposedDevice") == "true")
        val context = InstrumentationRegistry.getInstrumentation().targetContext
        ScenarioRuntime.awaitInitialized()
        assumeFalse("Preserve local simulation", ScenarioRuntime.state.value.isActive)
        for (permission in listOf(Manifest.permission.ACCESS_FINE_LOCATION, Manifest.permission.ACCESS_BACKGROUND_LOCATION)) {
            assumeTrue("Existing location permission required: $permission",
                context.checkSelfPermission(permission) == PackageManager.PERMISSION_GRANTED)
        }
        val manager = context.getSystemService(LocationManager::class.java)
        MockServiceHelper.tryInitService(manager)
        assumeTrue("Requires a running system module", MockServiceHelper.isServiceInit())
        assumeFalse("Preserve system simulation", MockServiceHelper.isMockStart(manager))
        assumeTrue("Root implementation or a system-capable framework must be available",
            XposedServiceBridge.supportsSystemScope() || RootEnvironmentProbe.isAvailable())
        val preferences = context.sharedPrefs
        val keys = listOf("gnssReplayOnStart", "gnssSimulationMode")
        val saved = preferences.all.filterKeys { it in keys }
        val backend = ScenarioRuntime.state.value.backend
        val satellite = MockServiceHelper.isGnssMockStart(manager)
        val wifi = MockServiceHelper.isWifiMockStart(manager)
        val config = context.noBackupFilesDir.resolve("active-config.json")
        val savedConfig = config.takeIf { it.exists() }?.readBytes()
        try {
            assertTrue(preferences.edit().remove("gnssReplayOnStart").remove("gnssSimulationMode").commit())
            assertTrue(ScenarioRuntime.selectBackend(BackendType.XPOSED).await())
            val scenario = Scenario("satellite-default-device", "默认目标天空验证", point = Wgs84(30.0, 120.0))
            assertTrue(ScenarioRuntime.start(scenario).await())
            assertTrue(context.gnssReplayOnStart)
            assertEquals("AUTONOMOUS", preferences.getString("gnssSimulationMode", null))
            assertTrue("Default satellite simulation did not start", MockServiceHelper.isGnssMockStart(manager))
            assertFalse("Default startup loaded Native", MockServiceHelper.runtimeStatus(manager)!!.getBoolean("native_loaded"))
            assertTrue(ScenarioRuntime.stop().await())

            assertTrue(preferences.edit().putBoolean("gnssReplayOnStart", true)
                .putString("gnssSimulationMode", "REPLAY").commit())
            // Readiness may reject a missing/expired recording. It must never replace the
            // selected source with target sky to make startup succeed.
            XposedBackend(context).prepare()
            assertTrue(context.gnssReplayOnStart)
            assertEquals("REPLAY", preferences.getString("gnssSimulationMode", null))

            assertTrue(preferences.edit().putBoolean("gnssReplayOnStart", false)
                .putString("gnssSimulationMode", "OFF").commit())
            assertTrue(ScenarioRuntime.start(scenario).await())
            assertFalse("Explicit disabling was overwritten", MockServiceHelper.isGnssMockStart(manager))
        } finally {
            ScenarioRuntime.stop().await()
            ScenarioRuntime.selectBackend(backend).await()
            preferences.edit().apply {
                keys.forEach(::remove)
                saved.forEach { (key, value) -> when (value) {
                    is String -> putString(key, value)
                    is Boolean -> putBoolean(key, value)
                } }
            }.commit()
            if (savedConfig == null) config.delete() else config.writeBytes(savedConfig)
            MockServiceHelper.putConfig(manager, context)
            if (satellite) MockServiceHelper.startGnssMock(manager) else MockServiceHelper.stopGnssMock(manager)
            if (wifi) MockServiceHelper.startWifiMock(manager) else MockServiceHelper.stopWifiMock(manager)
        }
    }
}
```

`app/src/androidTest/java/com/system/location/service/SdkPrivacyUiTest.kt`:

```kt
package com.system.location.service

import androidx.test.core.app.ActivityScenario
import androidx.test.espresso.Espresso.onView
import androidx.test.espresso.action.ViewActions.click
import androidx.test.espresso.assertion.ViewAssertions.matches
import androidx.test.espresso.matcher.ViewMatchers.*
import androidx.test.ext.junit.runners.AndroidJUnit4
import androidx.test.platform.app.InstrumentationRegistry
import com.system.location.service.ext.sharedPrefs
import com.system.location.service.maps.MapProvider
import com.system.location.service.maps.mapProvider
import com.system.location.service.privacy.SdkPrivacy
import com.system.location.service.privacy.TencentPrivacy
import org.junit.Assume.assumeTrue
import org.junit.Assert.*
import org.junit.Before
import org.junit.Test
import org.junit.runner.RunWith

@RunWith(AndroidJUnit4::class)
class SdkPrivacyUiTest {
    @Before fun requireFreshPrivacyProcess() {
        assumeTrue("Run alone with -e freshPrivacy true", InstrumentationRegistry.getArguments().getString("freshPrivacy") == "true")
        val context = InstrumentationRegistry.getInstrumentation().targetContext
        assertFalse("Fresh privacy must exercise the unsaved provider default", context.sharedPrefs.contains("map_provider"))
        assertEquals(MapProvider.TENCENT, context.mapProvider)
        assertPrivacyState(tencentAccepted = false)
    }

    @Test fun freshPromptSurvivesRotationDeclineAndLaterExplicitAcceptance() {
        ActivityScenario.launch(MainActivity::class.java).use { scenario ->
            onView(withText(R.string.map_privacy_title)).inRoot(androidx.test.espresso.matcher.RootMatchers.isDialog()).check(matches(isDisplayed()))
            onView(withText(R.string.tencent_privacy_message)).inRoot(androidx.test.espresso.matcher.RootMatchers.isDialog()).check(matches(isDisplayed()))
            scenario.onActivity { assertTrue(it.supportFragmentManager.fragments.isEmpty()) }
            assertPrivacyState(tencentAccepted = false)
            scenario.recreate()
            onView(withText(R.string.map_privacy_title)).inRoot(androidx.test.espresso.matcher.RootMatchers.isDialog()).check(matches(isDisplayed()))
            onView(withText(R.string.tencent_privacy_message)).inRoot(androidx.test.espresso.matcher.RootMatchers.isDialog()).check(matches(isDisplayed()))
            scenario.onActivity { assertTrue(it.supportFragmentManager.fragments.isEmpty()) }
            assertPrivacyState(tencentAccepted = false)
            onView(withText(R.string.map_privacy_decline)).inRoot(androidx.test.espresso.matcher.RootMatchers.isDialog()).perform(click())
            // finish() schedules lifecycle work; an idle main queue does not guarantee onDestroy.
            val deadline = android.os.SystemClock.uptimeMillis() + 5_000
            while (scenario.state != androidx.lifecycle.Lifecycle.State.DESTROYED &&
                android.os.SystemClock.uptimeMillis() < deadline) {
                InstrumentationRegistry.getInstrumentation().waitForIdleSync()
                android.os.SystemClock.sleep(50)
            }
            assertEquals(androidx.lifecycle.Lifecycle.State.DESTROYED, scenario.state)
            assertPrivacyState(tencentAccepted = false)
        }
        grantUiPermissions()
        ActivityScenario.launch(MainActivity::class.java).use { scenario ->
            onView(withText(R.string.tencent_privacy_message)).inRoot(androidx.test.espresso.matcher.RootMatchers.isDialog()).check(matches(isDisplayed()))
            scenario.onActivity { assertTrue(it.supportFragmentManager.fragments.isEmpty()) }
            assertPrivacyState(tencentAccepted = false)
            onView(withText(R.string.map_privacy_accept)).inRoot(androidx.test.espresso.matcher.RootMatchers.isDialog()).perform(click())
            assertPrivacyState(tencentAccepted = true)
            scenario.recreate()
            assertPrivacyState(tencentAccepted = true)
        }
    }

    private fun assertPrivacyState(tencentAccepted: Boolean) {
        val instrumentation = InstrumentationRegistry.getInstrumentation()
        instrumentation.runOnMainSync {
            assertEquals(tencentAccepted, instrumentation.targetContext.getSharedPreferences("sdk_privacy", 0)
                .getBoolean("tencent_maps_v1", false))
            // ready() can initialize Tencent; observe the guard without changing SDK state.
            val initialized = TencentPrivacy::class.java.getDeclaredField("initialized").apply { isAccessible = true }
            assertEquals("Tencent initialization must follow explicit consent", tencentAccepted,
                initialized.getBoolean(TencentPrivacy))
            assertFalse("Tencent consent must not accept AMap", SdkPrivacy.mapsAccepted)
            assertFalse("Tencent consent must not initialize AMap", SdkPrivacy.mapsReady)
            assertFalse(SdkPrivacy.crashReportingEnabled)
            assertFalse(SdkPrivacy.crashReportingRequested)
        }
    }
}
```

```kt
import org.junit.runner.RunWith

/** Explicit fresh-boot acceptance checkpoint; does not alter the selected backend or start a fix. */
@RunWith(AndroidJUnit4::class)
class SensorDailyModeDeviceTest {
    @Test fun dailyXposedModeLeavesNativeUnloadedAndDisabled() {
        assumeTrue(InstrumentationRegistry.getArguments().getString("sensorDailyDevice") == "true")
        val context = InstrumentationRegistry.getInstrumentation().targetContext
        assertEquals("XPOSED", context.getSharedPreferences("scenario_runtime", 0).getString("backend", null))
        val manager = context.getSystemService(LocationManager::class.java)
        MockServiceHelper.tryInitService(manager)
        val status = checkNotNull(MockServiceHelper.runtimeStatus(manager)) { "System module unavailable" }
        assertEquals("SYSTEM_SERVER", status.getString("hook_scope"))
        assertTrue(status.getInt("hook_installed") > 0)
        assertFalse("Acceptance must start with no active scenario", status.getBoolean("is_start"))
        assertTrue(status.containsKey("native_loaded") && status.containsKey("native_enabled"))
        assertFalse("Daily mode loaded the optional library", status.getBoolean("native_loaded"))
        assertFalse("Daily mode enabled Native", status.getBoolean("native_enabled"))
    }
}
```

```kt
package com.system.location.service

import kotlinx.coroutines.runBlocking
import org.junit.Assert.*
import org.junit.Rule
import org.junit.Test
import org.junit.runner.RunWith

/** UI capability states only: backend selection never prepares or starts a scene. */
@RunWith(AndroidJUnit4::class)
class SettingsBackendUiTest {
    @get:Rule val compose = createEmptyComposeRule()

    @Test fun capabilitiesFollowSelectedBackendWithoutStartingSimulation() {
        acceptSelectedMapForUiTest()
        grantUiPermissions()
        assertFalse(ScenarioRuntime.state.value.isActive)
        val original = ScenarioRuntime.state.value.backend
        try {
            ActivityScenario.launch(MainActivity::class.java).use { scenario ->
                compose.openPage(scenario, R.id.nav_settings_gnss)
                for (backend in BackendType.entries) {
                    assertTrue(runBlocking { ScenarioRuntime.selectBackend(backend).await() })
                    compose.scrollToText("卫星生成模式")
                    if (backend == BackendType.MOCK_PROVIDER) {
                        compose.onNodeWithText("卫星生成模式", substring = true).assertIsNotEnabled()
                        compose.scrollToText("最少卫星数").assertIsNotEnabled()
                    } else {
                        compose.onNodeWithText("卫星生成模式", substring = true).assertIsEnabled()
                        compose.scrollToText("最少卫星数").assertIsEnabled()
                    }
                    compose.openPage(scenario, R.id.nav_settings_system)
                    compose.scrollToText("SIM 就绪")
                    val sim = compose.onNode(hasText("SIM 就绪") and isToggleable())
                    if (backend == BackendType.MOCK_PROVIDER) sim.assertIsNotEnabled() else sim.assertIsEnabled()
                    compose.openPage(scenario, R.id.nav_settings_motion)
                    compose.scrollToText("物理漂移噪声")
                    val noise = compose.onNode(hasText("物理漂移噪声") and isToggleable())
                    if (backend == BackendType.MOCK_PROVIDER) noise.assertIsNotEnabled() else noise.assertIsEnabled()
                    compose.openPage(scenario, R.id.nav_settings_apps)
                    compose.onNodeWithText("需 Xposed：", substring = true).assertIsDisplayed()
                    assertFalse("Reading capability states must not start a scene", ScenarioRuntime.state.value.isActive)
                    compose.openPage(scenario, R.id.nav_settings_gnss)
                }
            }
        } finally { assertTrue(runBlocking { ScenarioRuntime.selectBackend(original).await() }) }
    }
}
```

```kt
                scenario.onActivity { closed = !it.drawerState.isOpen }

            }
```

`app/src/androidTest/java/com/system/location/service/SettingsRestoreUiTest.kt`:

```kt
package com.system.location.service

import android.app.AppOpsManager
import android.content.SharedPreferences
import android.os.ParcelFileDescriptor
import android.os.Process
import androidx.compose.ui.test.*
import androidx.compose.ui.test.junit4.v2.createEmptyComposeRule
import androidx.test.core.app.ActivityScenario
import androidx.test.ext.junit.runners.AndroidJUnit4
import androidx.test.platform.app.InstrumentationRegistry
import com.system.location.service.core.backend.BackendType
import com.system.location.service.core.geo.Wgs84
import com.system.location.service.core.runtime.RuntimePhase
import com.system.location.service.core.scenario.MovementProfile
import com.system.location.service.core.scenario.Scenario
import com.system.location.service.ext.*
import com.system.location.service.runtime.ScenarioRuntime
import kotlinx.coroutines.runBlocking
import org.junit.Assert.*
import org.junit.Rule
import org.junit.Test
import org.junit.runner.RunWith
import java.io.File

@RunWith(AndroidJUnit4::class)
class SettingsRestoreUiTest {
    @get:Rule val compose = createEmptyComposeRule()

    @Test fun restoreWorksAfterStopAndSynchronizesSavedMotionWithThePage() {
        val instrumentation = InstrumentationRegistry.getInstrumentation()
        val context = instrumentation.targetContext
        acceptSelectedMapForUiTest()
        grantUiPermissions()
        runBlocking { ScenarioRuntime.refreshDiagnostics().await() }
        assertFalse("Requires an inactive test fixture", ScenarioRuntime.state.value.isActive)
        val backend = ScenarioRuntime.state.value.backend
        val runtimePrefs = context.getSharedPreferences("scenario_runtime", 0)
        val originalRuntime = runtimePrefs.all
        val originalPreferences = context.sharedPrefs.all
        val config = File(context.noBackupFilesDir, "active-config.json")
        val originalConfig = config.takeIf { it.exists() }?.readBytes()
        val appOps = context.getSystemService(AppOpsManager::class.java)
        val originalMode = appOps.unsafeCheckOpNoThrow(AppOpsManager.OPSTR_MOCK_LOCATION, Process.myUid(), context.packageName)
        fun mockMode(mode: String) {
            ParcelFileDescriptor.AutoCloseInputStream(instrumentation.uiAutomation.executeShellCommand(
                "appops set ${context.packageName} android:mock_location $mode")).use { it.readBytes() }
        }
        try {
            mockMode("allow")
            context.gmsMockEnabled = false
            context.platformFusedEnabled = false
            context.startupBurstEnabled = false
            assertTrue(runBlocking { ScenarioRuntime.selectBackend(BackendType.MOCK_PROVIDER).await() })
            ActivityScenario.launch(MainActivity::class.java).use { activity ->
                val profile = MovementProfile(speedMps = 1.4, altitudeMeters = 123.5, accuracyMeters = 7f, intervalMs = 120, smoothMotion = true)
                assertTrue(runBlocking { ScenarioRuntime.start(Scenario("restore-ui", "恢复测试", point = Wgs84(30.0, 120.0), profile = profile)).await() })
                assertFalse("Mock Provider must not send Hook configuration", runBlocking { ScenarioRuntime.applyConfigNow() })
                assertFalse("Mock Provider must not start system GNSS mocking", runBlocking { ScenarioRuntime.setGnssMock(true).await() })
                assertTrue(runBlocking { ScenarioRuntime.stop().await() })
                assertEquals(RuntimePhase.STOPPED, ScenarioRuntime.state.value.phase)
                context.altitude = 999.0
                context.accuracy = 50f
                context.speed = 9.0
                context.reportDuration = 500
                context.smoothRouteMotion = false
                compose.openPage(activity, R.id.nav_runtime)
                compose.scrollToText("恢复并启动上次场景").assertIsEnabled().performClick()
                compose.waitUntil(10_000) { ScenarioRuntime.state.value.phase == RuntimePhase.RUNNING }
                compose.onNodeWithText("恢复并启动上次场景").assertIsNotEnabled()
                assertEquals(123.5, context.altitude, 0.001)
                assertEquals(1.4, context.speed, 0.001)
                assertEquals(7f, context.accuracy)
                assertEquals(120, context.reportDuration)
                assertTrue(context.smoothRouteMotion)
                compose.openPage(activity, R.id.nav_settings_location)
                compose.scrollToText("定位海拔")
                compose.onNodeWithText("%.2f 米".format(123.5)).assertIsDisplayed()
                assertTrue(runBlocking { ScenarioRuntime.stop().await() })
                compose.openPage(activity, R.id.nav_runtime)
                compose.scrollToText("恢复并启动上次场景").assertIsEnabled()
            }
        } finally {
            try {
                runBlocking { ScenarioRuntime.stop().await(); ScenarioRuntime.selectBackend(backend).await() }
                if (originalConfig == null) config.delete() else config.writeBytes(originalConfig)
                restore(context.sharedPrefs, originalPreferences)
                restore(runtimePrefs, originalRuntime)
            } finally {
                mockMode(when (originalMode) {
                    AppOpsManager.MODE_ALLOWED -> "allow"
                    AppOpsManager.MODE_IGNORED -> "ignore"
                    AppOpsManager.MODE_ERRORED -> "deny"
                    AppOpsManager.MODE_FOREGROUND -> "foreground"
                    else -> "default"
                })
            }
        }
    }

    private fun restore(preferences: SharedPreferences, values: Map<String, *>) {
        val editor = preferences.edit().clear()
        values.forEach { (key, value) ->
            when (value) {
                is String -> editor.putString(key, value)
                is Boolean -> editor.putBoolean(key, value)
                is Int -> editor.putInt(key, value)
                is Long -> editor.putLong(key, value)
                is Float -> editor.putFloat(key, value)
                is Set<*> -> editor.putStringSet(key, value.filterIsInstance<String>().toSet())
                else -> error("Unsupported fixture preference type")
            }
        }
        assertTrue(editor.commit())
    }
}
```

`app/src/androidTest/java/com/system/location/service/SettingsSwitchUiTest.kt`:

```kt
package com.system.location.service

import androidx.compose.ui.test.*
import androidx.compose.ui.graphics.toPixelMap
import androidx.compose.ui.test.junit4.v2.createEmptyComposeRule
import androidx.test.core.app.ActivityScenario
import androidx.test.ext.junit.runners.AndroidJUnit4
import androidx.test.platform.app.InstrumentationRegistry
import com.system.location.service.ext.*
import org.junit.Assert.assertEquals
import org.junit.Rule
import org.junit.Test
import org.junit.runner.RunWith

@RunWith(AndroidJUnit4::class)
class SettingsSwitchUiTest {
    @get:Rule val compose = createEmptyComposeRule()

    @Test fun sharedSwitchAnimatesBetweenOffAndOn() {
        acceptSelectedMapForUiTest()
        grantUiPermissions()
        val automation = InstrumentationRegistry.getInstrumentation().uiAutomation
        fun shell(command: String): String = automation.executeShellCommand(command).use {
            android.os.ParcelFileDescriptor.AutoCloseInputStream(it).bufferedReader().readText().trim()
        }
        val oldScale = shell("settings get global animator_duration_scale")
        shell("settings put global animator_duration_scale 1")
        try {
        ActivityScenario.launch(MainActivity::class.java).use { scenario ->
            val checked = androidx.compose.runtime.mutableStateOf(false)
            scenario.onActivity { activity ->
                activity.setContentView(androidx.compose.ui.platform.ComposeView(activity).apply {
                    setContent {
                        com.system.location.service.designsystem.theme.PortalTheme {
                            com.system.location.service.designsystem.components.PortalSwitchRow(
                                title = "动画测试", checked = checked.value,
                                onCheckedChange = { checked.value = it },
                            )
                        }
                    }
                })
            }
            compose.waitForIdle()
            compose.mainClock.autoAdvance = false
            try {
                val node = compose.onNode(hasText("动画测试") and isToggleable())
                fun pixels(): Int {
                    val image = node.captureToImage().toPixelMap()
                    var hash = 1
                    // Only the trailing switch, using a primitive accumulator (no boxed pixel list).
                    val left = (image.width - 240).coerceAtLeast(0)
                    for (y in 0 until image.height) for (x in left until image.width) {
                        hash = 31 * hash + image[x, y].hashCode()
                    }
                    return hash
                }
                val off = pixels()
                node.performClick()
                compose.mainClock.advanceTimeBy(32)
                val moving = pixels()
                compose.mainClock.advanceTimeBy(500)
                val on = pixels()
                org.junit.Assert.assertNotEquals("Thumb must move after a tap", off, on)
                org.junit.Assert.assertNotEquals("Animation must have an intermediate frame", moving, on)
                node.assertIsOn()
            } finally { compose.mainClock.autoAdvance = true }
        }
        } finally {
            if (oldScale == "null") shell("settings delete global animator_duration_scale")
            else shell("settings put global animator_duration_scale $oldScale")
        }
    }

    @Test fun preferenceSwitchesUpdateImmediatelyAndCanToggleBackWithoutLeavingPage() {
        val context = InstrumentationRegistry.getInstrumentation().targetContext
        acceptSelectedMapForUiTest()
        grantUiPermissions()
        val smooth = context.smoothRouteMotion
        val noise = context.physicalNoise
        val burst = context.startupBurstEnabled
        try {
            ActivityScenario.launch(MainActivity::class.java).use { scenario ->
                compose.openPage(scenario, R.id.nav_settings_motion)
                fun checkSwitch(title: String, read: () -> Boolean) {
                    compose.scrollToText(title)
                    val node = compose.onNode(hasText(title) and isToggleable())
                    val before = read()
                    node.assertIsToggleable().assert(SemanticsMatcher.expectValue(androidx.compose.ui.semantics.SemanticsProperties.ToggleableState,
                        if (before) androidx.compose.ui.state.ToggleableState.On else androidx.compose.ui.state.ToggleableState.Off))
                    node.performClick()
                    assertEquals("Preference must change for $title", !before, read())
                    node.assert(SemanticsMatcher.expectValue(androidx.compose.ui.semantics.SemanticsProperties.ToggleableState,
                        if (!before) androidx.compose.ui.state.ToggleableState.On else androidx.compose.ui.state.ToggleableState.Off))
                    node.performClick()
                    assertEquals("Second tap must restore $title", before, read())
                    node.assert(SemanticsMatcher.expectValue(androidx.compose.ui.semantics.SemanticsProperties.ToggleableState,
                        if (before) androidx.compose.ui.state.ToggleableState.On else androidx.compose.ui.state.ToggleableState.Off))
                }
                checkSwitch("路线平滑运动") { context.smoothRouteMotion }
                if (com.system.location.service.runtime.ScenarioRuntime.state.value.backend ==
                    com.system.location.service.core.backend.BackendType.MOCK_PROVIDER) {
                    compose.scrollToText("物理漂移噪声")
                    compose.onNode(hasText("物理漂移噪声") and isToggleable()).assertIsNotEnabled()
                } else checkSwitch("物理漂移噪声") { context.physicalNoise }
                compose.openPage(scenario, R.id.nav_settings_advanced)
                checkSwitch("启动突发") { context.startupBurstEnabled }
                scenario.recreate()
                compose.openPage(scenario, R.id.nav_settings_motion)
                compose.scrollToText("路线平滑运动")
                compose.onNode(hasText("路线平滑运动") and isToggleable()).assert(SemanticsMatcher.expectValue(androidx.compose.ui.semantics.SemanticsProperties.ToggleableState,
                    if (smooth) androidx.compose.ui.state.ToggleableState.On else androidx.compose.ui.state.ToggleableState.Off))
            }
        } finally {
            context.smoothRouteMotion = smooth
            context.physicalNoise = noise
            context.startupBurstEnabled = burst
        }
    }
```

```kt
            compose.onNodeWithText("位置名称").assertDoesNotExist()
        }
    }

    @Test fun cancellingNativeSelectionKeepsActualBackendAcrossRecreation() {
        val original = ScenarioRuntime.state.value.backend
        assertFalse("Run on an idle fixture", ScenarioRuntime.state.value.isActive)
        val baseline = BackendType.MOCK_PROVIDER
        assertTrue(runBlocking { ScenarioRuntime.selectBackend(baseline).await() })
        try {
            ActivityScenario.launch(MainActivity::class.java).use { scenario ->
                compose.openPage(scenario, R.id.nav_runtime)
                compose.scrollToText(BackendType.NATIVE.displayLabel()).performClick()

                compose.onNodeWithText("取消").performClick()
                compose.onNodeWithText("实验性模式风险须知").assertDoesNotExist()

                compose.onNode(hasText(BackendType.NATIVE.displayLabel()) and hasClickAction()).assertIsNotSelected()
            }
        } finally { assertTrue(runBlocking { ScenarioRuntime.selectBackend(original).await() }) }
    }
```

```kt
package com.system.location.service

import androidx.compose.ui.test.junit4.v2.createEmptyComposeRule

import org.junit.runner.RunWith

@RunWith(AndroidJUnit4::class)
class TencentMapLifecycleTest {
    @get:Rule val compose = createEmptyComposeRule()
    @Test fun unconsentedViewDoesNotConstructVendorMap() {
        val instrumentation = InstrumentationRegistry.getInstrumentation()
        val context = instrumentation.targetContext
        val original = context.mapProvider
        val prefs = context.getSharedPreferences("sdk_privacy", 0)
        val accepted = prefs.getBoolean("tencent_maps_v1", false)
        try {
            context.mapProvider = MapProvider.TENCENT
            check(prefs.edit().remove("tencent_maps_v1").commit())
            instrumentation.runOnMainSync {
                val view = PortalMapView(context)
                assertEquals(0, view.childCount)
                assertTrue(runCatching { view.onCreate(null) }.isFailure)
                assertEquals(0, view.childCount)
                view.onDestroy(); view.onDestroy()
            }
        } finally {
            context.mapProvider = original
            prefs.edit().putBoolean("tencent_maps_v1", accepted).commit()
        }
    }

    @Test fun acceptedTencentMapSurvivesActivityRecreationAndRouteEditor() {
        val instrumentation = InstrumentationRegistry.getInstrumentation()
        val context = instrumentation.targetContext
        val original = context.mapProvider
        grantUiPermissions()
        try {
            instrumentation.runOnMainSync { TencentPrivacy.accept(context); context.mapProvider = MapProvider.TENCENT }
            ActivityScenario.launch(MainActivity::class.java).use { scenario ->
                compose.waitForIdle()
                scenario.onActivity {
                    val map = it.window.decorView.descendantsOfType<PortalMapView>().filter { view -> view.isAttachedToWindow }.single()
                    assertEquals(MapProvider.TENCENT, map.provider)
                    assertEquals(1, map.childCount)
                }
                scenario.recreate()
                compose.waitForIdle()
                scenario.onActivity {
                    assertEquals(MapProvider.TENCENT, it.window.decorView.descendantsOfType<PortalMapView>().filter { view -> view.isAttachedToWindow }.single().provider)
                    androidx.navigation.Navigation.findNavController(it, R.id.nav_host_fragment_content_main).navigate(R.id.nav_route_edit)
                }
                compose.waitForIdle()
                scenario.onActivity {
                    val map = it.window.decorView.descendantsOfType<PortalMapView>().filter { view -> view.isAttachedToWindow }.single()
                    assertEquals(MapProvider.TENCENT, map.provider)
                    assertEquals(1, map.childCount)
                }
                scenario.recreate()
                compose.waitForIdle()
                scenario.onActivity { assertEquals(MapProvider.TENCENT, it.window.decorView.descendantsOfType<PortalMapView>().filter { view -> view.isAttachedToWindow }.single().provider) }
            }
        } finally { context.mapProvider = original }
    }
}
```

`app/src/androidTest/java/com/system/location/service/UiCapture.kt`:

```kt
package com.system.location.service

import android.graphics.Bitmap
import android.os.ParcelFileDescriptor
import androidx.test.platform.app.InstrumentationRegistry
import androidx.test.runner.lifecycle.ActivityLifecycleMonitorRegistry
import androidx.test.runner.lifecycle.Stage
import java.io.File
import java.util.concurrent.CountDownLatch
import java.util.concurrent.TimeUnit

/** AGP uninstalls the app after connected tests; preserve captures outside its removed data. */
internal fun captureUi(name: String) {
    require(name.matches(Regex("[a-z0-9-]+")))
    val instrumentation = InstrumentationRegistry.getInstrumentation()
    instrumentation.waitForIdleSync()
    // An idle main queue can still precede rendering: wait for the resumed window's
    // next committed frame, then allow two display frames before reading pixels.
    val frame = CountDownLatch(1)
    instrumentation.runOnMainSync {
        val activity = ActivityLifecycleMonitorRegistry.getInstance().getActivitiesInStage(Stage.RESUMED).single()
        val decor = activity.window.decorView
        check(decor.isHardwareAccelerated) { "Captures require a rendered hardware window" }
        decor.viewTreeObserver.registerFrameCommitCallback { frame.countDown() }
        decor.invalidate()
    }
    check(frame.await(5, TimeUnit.SECONDS)) { "Window did not commit a frame for $name" }
    val presented = CountDownLatch(1)
    instrumentation.runOnMainSync {
        val decor = ActivityLifecycleMonitorRegistry.getInstance().getActivitiesInStage(Stage.RESUMED).single().window.decorView
        decor.postOnAnimation { decor.postOnAnimation { presented.countDown() } }
    }
    check(presented.await(5, TimeUnit.SECONDS)) { "Display frames unavailable for $name" }
    instrumentation.waitForIdleSync()
    val directory = File(instrumentation.targetContext.getExternalFilesDir(null), "ui-captures").apply { check(mkdirs() || isDirectory) }
    val screenshot = File(directory, "$name.png")
    val bitmap = checkNotNull(instrumentation.uiAutomation.takeScreenshot()) { "Screenshot unavailable" }
    try { screenshot.outputStream().use { check(bitmap.compress(Bitmap.CompressFormat.PNG, 100, it)) } }
    finally { bitmap.recycle() }
    fun shell(command: String) {
        ParcelFileDescriptor.AutoCloseInputStream(instrumentation.uiAutomation.executeShellCommand(command)).use { it.readBytes() }
    }
    shell("mkdir -p /sdcard/Download/Portal-ui-captures")
    shell("cp ${screenshot.absolutePath} /sdcard/Download/Portal-ui-captures/$name.png")
}
```

```kt
    @Test fun homeHasNoToolbarGapAfterReturningFromEveryOtherPage() {
        permissions()
        ActivityScenario.launch(MainActivity::class.java).use { scenario ->
            fun homeGeometry(): List<Int> {
                compose.onNode(hasSetTextAction()).assertIsDisplayed()
                compose.onNodeWithText("开始模拟").assertIsDisplayed()
                val search = compose.onNode(hasSetTextAction()).fetchSemanticsNode().boundsInRoot
                val bottom = compose.onNodeWithText("开始模拟").fetchSemanticsNode().boundsInRoot
                var geometry = emptyList<Int>()
                scenario.onActivity { activity ->
                    val map = activity.window.decorView.descendantsOfType<PortalMapView>().filter { it.isAttachedToWindow }.single()
                    val mapPosition = IntArray(2).also { map.getLocationOnScreen(it) }
                    val rootPosition = IntArray(2).also { activity.shellView.getLocationOnScreen(it) }
                    assertArrayEquals("Map must start at the full-screen content origin", rootPosition, mapPosition)
                    assertEquals("Map must fill the content width", activity.shellView.width, map.width)
                    assertEquals("Map must extend behind the action panel", activity.shellView.height, map.height)
                    assertEquals("The vendor map must retain its full viewport", map.height, map.getChildAt(0).height)
                    assertEquals(map.width, map.getChildAt(0).width)
                    assertEquals(R.id.nav_home, activity.currentDestinationId)
                    geometry = listOf(mapPosition[0], mapPosition[1], map.width, map.height, search.top.toInt(), bottom.bottom.toInt())
                }
                return geometry
            }
            val initial = homeGeometry()
            for (destination in listOf(R.id.nav_mock, R.id.nav_runtime, R.id.nav_gnss_mock,
                R.id.nav_route_gallery, R.id.nav_settings, R.id.nav_route_edit)) {
                for (useDrawer in listOf(true, false)) {
                    scenario.onActivity { activity ->
                        activity.findNavController(R.id.nav_host_fragment_content_main).navigate(destination)
                    }
                    compose.onNodeWithTag("portal_toolbar").assertIsDisplayed()
                    if (useDrawer) {
                        scenario.onActivity { activity ->
                            activity.navigateFromDrawer(R.id.nav_home)
                        }
                    } else {
                        scenario.onActivity { it.onBackPressedDispatcher.onBackPressed() }
                    }
                    assertEquals("Home geometry changed after destination $destination (drawer=$useDrawer)", initial, homeGeometry())
                }
            }
            scenario.onActivity { it.findNavController(R.id.nav_host_fragment_content_main).navigate(R.id.nav_mock) }
            compose.onNodeWithTag("portal_toolbar").assertIsDisplayed()
            scenario.recreate()
            compose.onNodeWithTag("portal_toolbar").assertIsDisplayed()
            scenario.onActivity { it.onBackPressedDispatcher.onBackPressed() }
            assertEquals(initial, homeGeometry())
            capture("home-after-navigation")
        }
    }
```
