```kt
    @Test fun edgeToEdgeKeepsMapFullSizeAndControlsInsideSafeInsets() {
        permissions()
        ActivityScenario.launch(MainActivity::class.java).use { scenario ->
            compose.onNode(hasSetTextAction()).assertIsDisplayed()
            val insets = androidx.core.view.WindowInsetsCompat.Builder()
                .setInsets(androidx.core.view.WindowInsetsCompat.Type.systemBars(), androidx.core.graphics.Insets.of(12, 48, 16, 32))
                .build()
            fun applyInsets() {
                scenario.onActivity { androidx.core.view.ViewCompat.dispatchApplyWindowInsets(it.shellView, insets) }
                compose.waitForIdle()
            }
            applyInsets()
            val search = compose.onNode(hasSetTextAction()).fetchSemanticsNode().boundsInRoot
            val start = compose.onNodeWithText("开始模拟").fetchSemanticsNode().boundsInRoot
            var mapWidth = 0
            var mapHeight = 0
            scenario.onActivity { activity ->
                val container = activity.shellView
                assertEquals(0, container.paddingTop)
                assertEquals(0, container.paddingBottom)
                val map = activity.window.decorView.descendantsOfType<PortalMapView>().filter { it.isAttachedToWindow }.single()
                mapWidth = map.width
                mapHeight = activity.shellView.height
                val mapPosition = IntArray(2).also { map.getLocationOnScreen(it) }
                val rootPosition = IntArray(2).also { activity.shellView.getLocationOnScreen(it) }
                assertArrayEquals("Insets must not move the full-screen map", rootPosition, mapPosition)
                assertEquals("Insets must not shrink the map width", activity.shellView.width, map.width)
                assertEquals("Map must remain full-height behind the controls", mapHeight, map.height)
                assertEquals(R.id.nav_home, activity.currentDestinationId)
            }
            assertTrue("Search must avoid the status bar", search.top >= 48f)
            assertTrue("Search must avoid side insets", search.left >= 12f && search.right <= mapWidth - 16f)
            assertTrue("Start action must avoid navigation bar", start.bottom <= mapHeight - 32f)
            for (description in listOf("切换地图图层", "选择模拟目标", "输入坐标", "定位到真实位置")) {
                val button = compose.onNodeWithContentDescription(description).assertIsDisplayed().fetchSemanticsNode().boundsInRoot
                assertTrue("$description must avoid side insets", button.left >= 12f && button.right <= mapWidth - 16f)
                assertTrue("$description must stay inside safe vertical bounds", button.top >= 48f && button.bottom <= mapHeight - 32f)
                assertTrue("$description must not overlap the start action", button.bottom <= start.top)
            }
            applyInsets()
            assertEquals(search, compose.onNode(hasSetTextAction()).fetchSemanticsNode().boundsInRoot)
            assertEquals(start, compose.onNodeWithText("开始模拟").fetchSemanticsNode().boundsInRoot)
            compose.openPage(scenario, R.id.nav_mock)
            applyInsets()
            compose.onNodeWithTag("portal_toolbar").assertIsDisplayed()
            val toolbar = compose.onNodeWithTag("portal_toolbar").fetchSemanticsNode().boundsInRoot
            assertTrue("Secondary toolbar must avoid the status bar", toolbar.top >= 48f)
        }
    }

    private val instrumentation = InstrumentationRegistry.getInstrumentation()

    @Test fun sampleRedrawsAreBoundedWithoutDelayingPauseErrorsOrBackendChanges() = runBlocking {
        val initial = RuntimeState(phase = RuntimePhase.RUNNING)
        val rendered = flow {
            emit(initial)
            repeat(100) { emit(initial.copy(submissionHealth = SubmissionHealth(count = it.toLong()))) }
            emit(initial.copy(phase = RuntimePhase.PAUSED))
            emit(initial.copy(phase = RuntimePhase.ERROR))
            emit(initial.copy(backend = com.system.location.service.core.backend.BackendType.XPOSED))
        }.displayStates().toList()
        assertEquals(RuntimePhase.RUNNING, rendered.first().phase)
        assertTrue(rendered.size < 10)

        assertEquals(com.system.location.service.core.backend.BackendType.XPOSED, rendered.last().backend)
    }

    @Test fun librarySearchCategoriesAndTransferActionsRemainAccessible() {
        fun <T> phase(name: String, action: () -> T): T {
            android.util.Log.i("PortalUiTest", "librarySearch BEGIN $name")
            return action().also { android.util.Log.i("PortalUiTest", "librarySearch END $name") }
        }
        phase("permissions") { permissions() }
        val scenario = phase("launch") { ActivityScenario.launch(MainActivity::class.java) }
        try {
            phase("open library") { compose.openPage(scenario, R.id.nav_route_gallery) }
            phase("search unmatched record") { compose.scrollToText("搜索资料").performTextReplacement("不会匹配的记录") }
            // Finish text entry before scrolling another lazy item into view: while the IME is
            // open, focused-field bring-into-view can compete with the list's test scroll.
            phase("dismiss search keyboard") {
                InstrumentationRegistry.getInstrumentation().sendKeyDownUpSync(android.view.KeyEvent.KEYCODE_BACK)
            }
            phase("assert empty search") { compose.scrollToText("没有匹配的资料").assertIsDisplayed() }
            phase("clear search") { compose.scrollToText("搜索资料").performTextReplacement("") }
            phase("select locations") { compose.scrollToText("位置").performClick() }
            phase("await selected category") {
                compose.waitUntil(5_000) { compose.onAllNodes(hasText("位置") and isSelected()).fetchSemanticsNodes().isNotEmpty() }
            }
            phase("assert selected category") { compose.scrollToText("位置").assertIsSelected() }
            val more = phase("reveal transfer actions") { compose.scrollToText("更多") }
            phase("await transfer readiness") {
                compose.waitUntil(5_000) { compose.onAllNodes(hasText("更多") and isEnabled()).fetchSemanticsNodes().isNotEmpty() }
            }
            phase("open transfer dialog") { more.assertIsEnabled().performClick() }
            phase("assert location transfer formats") {
                compose.onNodeWithText("导入 JSON").assertIsDisplayed()
                compose.onNodeWithText("导出 JSON").assertIsDisplayed()
                compose.onNodeWithText("导入 GPX").assertDoesNotExist()
            }
            phase("dismiss transfer dialog") { compose.onNodeWithText("取消").performClick() }
            phase("capture") { capture("library-empty") }
        } finally {
            phase("close activity") { scenario.close() }
            assertEquals(androidx.lifecycle.Lifecycle.State.DESTROYED, scenario.state)
        }
    }

    @Test fun largeLibraryUsesLazyRowsAndKeepsTheSelectedItemIdentity() {
        permissions()
        LibraryRepositories.ensureMigrated()
        val original = LibraryRepositories.routes.list()
        try {
            LibraryRepositories.routes.replaceAll((0 until 1000).map {

        val deadline = android.os.SystemClock.uptimeMillis() + 5_000

            Thread.sleep(50)
```

`app/src/androidTest/java/com/system/location/service/UiFrameProbe.kt`:

```kt
package com.system.location.service

import android.app.Activity
import android.os.Build
import android.os.Handler
import android.os.HandlerThread
import android.os.ParcelFileDescriptor
import android.view.FrameMetrics
import android.view.Window
import androidx.test.platform.app.InstrumentationRegistry
import org.json.JSONArray
import org.json.JSONObject
import java.io.File
import java.util.concurrent.CountDownLatch
import java.util.concurrent.TimeUnit

/** Real window frame timings. Vendor map Surface/GPU presentation is outside this measurement. */
internal class UiFrameProbe(activity: Activity) : AutoCloseable {
    private val instrumentation = InstrumentationRegistry.getInstrumentation()
    private val worker = HandlerThread("portal-ui-frame-probe").apply { start() }
    private val handler = Handler(worker.looper)
    private val window = activity.window
    private val refreshRate = activity.windowManager.defaultDisplay.refreshRate.toDouble()
    private val frames = mutableListOf<Pair<Long, Long>>()
    private var droppedReports = 0
    private var firstDraws = 0
    private var attached = true
    private val listener = Window.OnFrameMetricsAvailableListener { _, metrics, dropped ->
        droppedReports += dropped
        if (metrics.getMetric(FrameMetrics.FIRST_DRAW_FRAME) == 1L) firstDraws++
        else {
            val duration = metrics.getMetric(FrameMetrics.TOTAL_DURATION)
            val deadline = if (Build.VERSION.SDK_INT >= 31) metrics.getMetric(FrameMetrics.DEADLINE) else 0L
            if (duration > 0) frames += duration to (deadline.takeIf { it > 0 } ?: (1_000_000_000 / refreshRate).toLong())
        }
    }
    init { instrumentation.runOnMainSync { window.addOnFrameMetricsAvailableListener(listener, handler) } }

    fun save(name: String): JSONObject {
        require(name.matches(Regex("[a-z0-9-]+")))
        detach()
        val flushed = CountDownLatch(1)
        handler.post { flushed.countDown() }
        check(flushed.await(5, TimeUnit.SECONDS))
        check(frames.isNotEmpty()) { "No window frames were recorded for $name" }
        val sorted = frames.map { it.first / 1_000_000.0 }.sorted()
        fun percentile(q: Double) = sorted[(kotlin.math.ceil(sorted.size * q).toInt() - 1).coerceAtLeast(0)]
        val report = JSONObject().apply {
            put("workload", name); put("build", "debug"); put("device", Build.MODEL)
            put("android", Build.VERSION.SDK_INT); put("refreshRateAtStartHz", refreshRate)
            put("scope", "app-window; excludes vendor map Surface/GPU presentation; first draws excluded")
            put("frames", frames.size); put("excludedFirstDraws", firstDraws); put("droppedMetricReports", droppedReports)
            put("p50Ms", percentile(.50)); put("p95Ms", percentile(.95)); put("p99Ms", percentile(.99))
            put("maxMs", sorted.last()); put("missedDeadline", frames.count { (duration, deadline) -> duration > deadline })
            put("durationsMs", JSONArray(frames.map { it.first / 1_000_000.0 }))
            put("deadlinesMs", JSONArray(frames.map { it.second / 1_000_000.0 }))
        }
        val directory = File(instrumentation.targetContext.getExternalFilesDir(null), "ui-frame-stats").apply { check(mkdirs() || isDirectory) }
        val file = File(directory, "$name.json").apply { writeText(report.toString(2)) }
        fun shell(command: String) {
            ParcelFileDescriptor.AutoCloseInputStream(instrumentation.uiAutomation.executeShellCommand(command)).use { it.readBytes() }
        }
        shell("mkdir -p /sdcard/Download/Portal-ui-frame-stats")
        shell("cp ${file.absolutePath} /sdcard/Download/Portal-ui-frame-stats/$name.json")
        android.util.Log.i("PortalUiFrames", report.toString())
        return report
    }

    override fun close() {
        try {
            detach()
        } finally {
            worker.quitSafely()
            worker.join(5_000)
            check(!worker.isAlive) { "Frame probe worker did not stop" }
        }
    }

    private fun detach() {
        instrumentation.runOnMainSync {
            if (attached) {
                window.removeOnFrameMetricsAvailableListener(listener)
                attached = false
            }
        }
    }
}
```

`app/src/androidTest/java/com/system/location/service/UiInteractionFrameTest.kt`:

```kt
package com.system.location.service

import android.os.SystemClock
import android.view.accessibility.AccessibilityNodeInfo
import androidx.core.view.GravityCompat
import androidx.navigation.findNavController
import androidx.test.core.app.ActivityScenario
import androidx.test.ext.junit.runners.AndroidJUnit4
import androidx.test.platform.app.InstrumentationRegistry
import org.junit.Test
import org.junit.runner.RunWith
import java.io.File

/** No Compose test rule: animations use the device's real frame clock. Timings are diagnostic. */
@RunWith(AndroidJUnit4::class)
class UiInteractionFrameTest {
    private val instrumentation = InstrumentationRegistry.getInstrumentation()
    private fun await(condition: () -> Boolean) {
        val deadline = SystemClock.uptimeMillis() + 10_000
        while (!condition()) {
            check(SystemClock.uptimeMillis() < deadline) { "UI did not reach the expected state" }
            SystemClock.sleep(50)
        }
    }
    private fun findText(text: String): AccessibilityNodeInfo? {
        val pending = java.util.ArrayDeque<AccessibilityNodeInfo>()
        instrumentation.uiAutomation.rootInActiveWindow?.let(pending::add)
        while (pending.isNotEmpty()) {
            val node = pending.removeFirst()
            if (node.text?.toString() == text || node.contentDescription?.toString() == text) return node
            for (index in 0 until node.childCount) node.getChild(index)?.let(pending::add)
        }
        return null
    }
    private fun clickText(text: String) {
        var target: AccessibilityNodeInfo? = null
        await {
            target = findText(text)
            target != null
        }
        var node = checkNotNull(target)
        while (!node.isClickable) node = checkNotNull(node.parent) { "No click action for $text" }
        check(node.performAction(AccessibilityNodeInfo.ACTION_CLICK))
        SystemClock.sleep(350) // Let the physical transition render on its normal clock.
    }

    @Test fun recordDrawerNavigationAndEditorWindowFrames() {
        acceptSelectedMapForUiTest()
        grantUiPermissions()
        val draft = File(instrumentation.targetContext.filesDir, "route_draft.json")
        val original = draft.takeIf { it.exists() }?.readBytes()
        val methodTrace = InstrumentationRegistry.getArguments().getString("methodTrace") == "true"
        var tracing = false
        fun save(probe: UiFrameProbe, name: String) = probe.save(if (methodTrace) "$name-traced" else name)
        try {
            check(!draft.exists() || draft.delete())
            ActivityScenario.launch(MainActivity::class.java).use { scenario ->
                await { findText("开始模拟") != null }
                SystemClock.sleep(500)
                lateinit var activity: MainActivity
                scenario.onActivity { activity = it }
                var probe = UiFrameProbe(activity)
                probe.use {
                    repeat(4) {
                        scenario.onActivity { it.openDrawer() }
                        await { var open = false; scenario.onActivity { open = it.drawerState.isOpen }; open }
                        SystemClock.sleep(350)
                        scenario.onActivity { it.closeDrawer() }
                        await { var open = true; scenario.onActivity { open = (it.drawerState.isOpen || it.drawerState.isAnimationRunning) }; !open }
                        SystemClock.sleep(350)
                    }
                    save(probe, "drawer-transitions")
                }
                if (methodTrace) {
                    // Diagnostic mode only: tracing perturbs timings, so reports use separate names.
                    android.os.Debug.startMethodTracingSampling(
                        File(instrumentation.targetContext.cacheDir, "ui-navigation.trace").absolutePath,
                        32 * 1024 * 1024, 1_000)
                    tracing = true
                }
                scenario.onActivity { it.navigateFromDrawer(R.id.nav_settings) }
                await { findText("地图与定位") != null }
                SystemClock.sleep(350)
                probe = UiFrameProbe(activity)
                probe.use {
                    repeat(4) {
                        clickText("地图与定位")
                        clickText("定位精度")
                        clickText("取消")
                        scenario.onActivity { it.onSupportNavigateUp() }
                        SystemClock.sleep(350)
                    }
                    save(probe, "settings-navigation")
                }
                probe = UiFrameProbe(activity)
                probe.use {
                    repeat(4) {
                        scenario.onActivity { it.navigateFromDrawer(R.id.nav_home) }
                        await { findText("开始模拟") != null }
                        SystemClock.sleep(350)
                        scenario.onActivity { it.navigateFromDrawer(R.id.nav_settings) }
                        await { findText("地图与定位") != null }
                        SystemClock.sleep(350)
                    }
                    save(probe, "map-settings-roundtrips")
                }
                scenario.onActivity { it.findNavController(R.id.nav_host_fragment_content_main).navigate(R.id.nav_route_edit) }
                SystemClock.sleep(700)
                probe = UiFrameProbe(activity)
                probe.use {
                    repeat(4) { clickText("画线"); clickText("加点"); clickText("规划") }
                    save(probe, "route-mode-transitions")
                }
                captureUi("route-editor-feedback")
            }
        } finally {
            if (tracing) android.os.Debug.stopMethodTracing()
            if (original == null) check(!draft.exists() || draft.delete()) else draft.writeBytes(original)
        }
    }
}
```

`app/src/androidTest/java/com/system/location/service/gnss/GnssNavigationDownloadDeviceTest.kt`:

```kt
package com.system.location.service.gnss

import androidx.test.ext.junit.runners.AndroidJUnit4
import androidx.test.platform.app.InstrumentationRegistry
import com.system.location.service.core.gnss.RinexNavigationResource
import com.system.location.service.core.gnss.RinexNavigationResourceStore
import java.io.File
import kotlinx.coroutines.runBlocking
import org.junit.Assert.*
import org.junit.Assume.assumeTrue
import org.junit.Test
import org.junit.runner.RunWith

/** Explicit public-network integration; no location permission, live configuration or Hook mutation. */
@RunWith(AndroidJUnit4::class)
class GnssNavigationDownloadDeviceTest {
    @Test fun publicResourcesDownloadValidateAndRoundTripOnAndroid() = runBlocking {
        assumeTrue("Explicit external navigation run required",
            InstrumentationRegistry.getArguments().getString("externalNavigation") == "true")
        if (InstrumentationRegistry.getArguments().getString("catalogOnly") == "true") {
            val catalog = HttpsGnssBeiDouCatalogDownload().fetch(System.currentTimeMillis())
            assertEquals(catalog, catalog.validate())
            android.util.Log.i("GnssNetworkProbe", "BeiDou catalog accepted: epoch=${catalog.creationLabel}")
            return@runBlocking
        }
        val context = InstrumentationRegistry.getInstrumentation().targetContext
        val directory = File(context.cacheDir, "navigation-network-probe-${System.nanoTime()}")
        assertTrue(directory.mkdirs())
        val file = File(directory, "navigation.json")
        try {
            val status = GnssNavigationSyncStatus()
            assertTrue(GnssNavigationRepository(file, status = status).refresh())
            assertNull("Both public endpoints must succeed: ${status.state.value.problem}", status.state.value.problem)
            val accepted = requireNotNull(RinexNavigationResourceStore(file).load())
            assertNotNull(accepted.beiDouCatalog)
            val wire = RinexNavigationResource.encodeWire(accepted)
            assertEquals(accepted, RinexNavigationResource.decodeWire(wire))
            val restarted = RinexNavigationResourceStore(file).load()
            assertEquals(accepted, restarted)
            android.util.Log.i("GnssNetworkProbe", "Both resources accepted: navigationBytes=${accepted.navigation.length}, " +
                "wireChars=${wire.length}, catalogEpoch=${accepted.beiDouCatalog!!.creationLabel}")
            Unit
        } finally {
            file.delete()
            directory.delete()
        }
    }
}
```

```kt
        super.onCreate(savedInstanceState)
        setShowWhenLocked(true)
        setTurnScreenOn(true)
```

```kt
import java.io.OutputStream
import java.net.InetSocketAddress
import java.net.NetworkInterface
import java.net.ServerSocket
import java.net.Socket
import java.util.Collections
import java.util.concurrent.TimeUnit
import kotlinx.coroutines.runBlocking
import kotlinx.serialization.json.Json
import kotlinx.serialization.json.JsonObject
import kotlinx.serialization.json.JsonPrimitive
import kotlinx.serialization.json.buildJsonArray
import kotlinx.serialization.json.buildJsonObject
import kotlinx.serialization.json.doubleOrNull
import kotlinx.serialization.json.jsonObject
import kotlinx.serialization.json.jsonPrimitive
import kotlinx.serialization.json.put

/**
 * P8 debug-only HTTP control surface. It is compiled into all variants for now, but only starts
 * when [BuildConfig.DEBUG] is true; the release entry point never calls [start].
 *
 * No auth: intended for a trusted lab LAN / adb-forwarded port only.
 */
object DebugHttpServer {
    const val PORT = 8765
    private const val TAG = "PortalDebug"
    private val json = Json { prettyPrint = true }
    @Volatile private var server: ServerSocket? = null
    @Volatile private var localServer: LocalServerSocket? = null
    @Volatile private var context: Context? = null

    fun start(appContext: Context) {
        if (!BuildConfig.DEBUG) return
        if (server != null || localServer != null) return
        context = appContext.applicationContext
        Thread({
            try {
                val socket = ServerSocket()
                socket.reuseAddress = true
                socket.bind(InetSocketAddress("0.0.0.0", PORT))
                server = socket
                Log.i(TAG, "debug server http://${localIp()}:$PORT (adb forward tcp:18765 localabstract:portal-debug)")
                while (!socket.isClosed) {
                    val client = socket.accept()
                    Log.d(TAG, "accepted ${client.remoteSocketAddress}")
                    Thread({ handle(client) }, "portal-debug-client").apply { isDaemon = true }.start()
                }
            } catch (error: Throwable) {
                Log.e(TAG, "debug server stopped: ${error.message}", error)
            } finally {
                server = null
            }
        }, "portal-debug").apply { isDaemon = true }.start()
        Thread({
            try {
                val local = LocalServerSocket("portal-debug")
                localServer = local
                while (true) {
                    val client = local.accept()
                    Thread({ client.use { handleStreams(it.inputStream, it.outputStream) } }, "portal-debug-local-client")
                        .apply { isDaemon = true }.start()
                }
            } catch (error: Throwable) {
                Log.e(TAG, "local debug server stopped: ${error.message}", error)
            } finally {
                localServer = null
            }
        }, "portal-debug-local").apply { isDaemon = true }.start()
    }

    fun stop() {
        runCatching { server?.close() }
        runCatching { localServer?.close() }
        server = null
        localServer = null
    }

    private fun handle(socket: Socket) {
        socket.use { client -> handleStreams(client.getInputStream(), client.getOutputStream()) }
    }

    private fun handleStreams(input: InputStream, output: OutputStream) {
        runCatching {
            val request = readRequest(input) ?: return
            Log.d(TAG, "${request.method} ${request.path}")
            val response = route(request)
            writeResponse(output, response.first, response.second)
        }.onFailure {
            runCatching {
                writeResponse(output, 500, """{"ok":false,"error":"${escape(it.message ?: "error")}"}""")
            }
        }
    }

    private fun route(request: Request): Pair<Int, String> = when {
        request.method == "GET" && request.path == "/" -> 200 to help()
        request.method == "GET" && request.path == "/status" -> 200 to status()
        request.method == "GET" && request.path == "/logs" -> 200 to logs(request)
        request.method == "GET" && request.path == "/targets" -> 200 to targets()
        request.method == "GET" && request.path == "/sensors" -> 200 to sensorHandles()
        request.method == "GET" && request.path == "/runtime_status" -> 200 to runtimeStatus()
        request.method == "POST" && request.path == "/location" -> location(request.body)
        request.method == "POST" && request.path == "/motion" -> motion(request.body)
        request.method == "POST" && request.path == "/scenario/start" -> location(request.body)
        request.method == "POST" && request.path == "/scenario/stop" -> stopScenario()
        request.method == "POST" && request.path == "/config" -> config(request.body)
        request.method == "POST" && request.path == "/hot_reload" -> hotReload()
        request.method == "POST" && request.path == "/shell" -> shell(request.body)
        request.method == "OPTIONS" -> 204 to ""
        else -> 404 to """{"ok":false,"error":"not found"}"""
    }

    private fun help(): String = json.encodeToString(JsonObject.serializer(), buildJsonObject {
        put("ok", true)
        put("endpoints", buildJsonArray {
            listOf(
                "GET /status", "GET /logs?since=0&limit=200",
                "POST /location {lat,lon,speed?,altitude?,accuracy?}",
                "POST /scenario/start {lat,lon}", "POST /scenario/stop",
                "POST /config {key:value}", "POST /shell {cmd}",
            ).forEach { add(JsonPrimitive(it)) }
        })
    })

    private fun status(): String {
        val state = ScenarioRuntime.state.value
        return json.encodeToString(JsonObject.serializer(), buildJsonObject {
            put("ok", true)
            put("app", BuildConfig.VERSION_NAME)
            put("versionCode", BuildConfig.VERSION_CODE)
            put("revision", BuildConfig.GIT_REVISION)
            put("device", "${android.os.Build.MANUFACTURER} ${android.os.Build.MODEL}")
            put("android", android.os.Build.VERSION.RELEASE)
            put("sdk", android.os.Build.VERSION.SDK_INT)
            put("phase", state.phase.name)
            put("backend", state.backend.name)
            put("scenarioId", state.scenarioId)
            put("scenarioName", state.scenarioName)
            put("speedMps", state.configuredSpeedMps)
            put("diagnostics", ScenarioRuntime.diagnostics.value.size)
            state.sample?.let { sample ->
                put("sample", buildJsonObject {
                    put("lat", sample.latitude)
                    put("lon", sample.longitude)
                    put("altitude", sample.altitude)
                    put("accuracy", sample.accuracy)
                    put("speed", sample.speed)
                    put("bearing", sample.bearing)
                    put("timeMillis", sample.timeMillis)
                })
            }
        })
    }

    private fun logs(request: Request): String {
        val since = request.query["since"]?.toLongOrNull() ?: 0L
        val limit = (request.query["limit"]?.toIntOrNull() ?: 200).coerceIn(1, 1000)
        val events = ScenarioRuntime.diagnostics.value.filter { it.timestamp > since }.takeLast(limit)
        return json.encodeToString(JsonObject.serializer(), buildJsonObject {
            put("ok", true)
            put("events", buildJsonArray {
                events.forEach { event ->
                    add(buildJsonObject {
                        put("timestamp", event.timestamp)
                        put("backend", event.backend.name)
                        put("stage", event.stage)
                        put("result", event.result)
                        put("reason", event.reason)
                        put("suggestion", event.suggestion)
                    })
                }
            })
        })
    }

    private fun location(body: String): Pair<Int, String> {
        val obj = parseObject(body)
        val lat = obj["lat"]?.jsonPrimitive?.doubleOrNull
            ?: return 400 to """{"ok":false,"error":"lat required"}"""
        val lon = obj["lon"]?.jsonPrimitive?.doubleOrNull
            ?: return 400 to """{"ok":false,"error":"lon required"}"""
        if (lat !in -90.0..90.0 || lon !in -180.0..180.0) {
            return 400 to """{"ok":false,"error":"coordinate out of range"}"""
        }
        val app = context ?: return 500 to """{"ok":false,"error":"server not ready"}"""
        val speed = obj["speed"]?.jsonPrimitive?.doubleOrNull ?: app.speed
        val altitude = obj["altitude"]?.jsonPrimitive?.doubleOrNull ?: app.altitude
        val accuracy = obj["accuracy"]?.jsonPrimitive?.doubleOrNull?.toFloat() ?: app.accuracy
        app.speed = speed
        app.altitude = altitude
        app.accuracy = accuracy
        val scenario = Scenario(
            id = "debug-${System.currentTimeMillis()}",
            name = "Debug API",
            point = Wgs84(lat, lon),
            profile = MovementProfile(
                speedMps = speed,
                altitudeMeters = altitude,
                accuracyMeters = accuracy,
                intervalMs = app.reportDuration.toLong(),
            ),
        )
        val started = runBlocking {
            if (ScenarioRuntime.state.value.isActive) ScenarioRuntime.stop().await()
            ScenarioRuntime.start(scenario).await()
        }
        return if (started) 200 to status() else 500 to """{"ok":false,"error":"start failed"}"""
    }

    private fun motion(body: String): Pair<Int, String> {
        val obj = parseObject(body)
        val bearing = obj["bearing"]?.jsonPrimitive?.doubleOrNull ?: 0.0
        val moving = obj["moving"]?.jsonPrimitive?.jsonPrimitive?.content?.toBooleanStrictOrNull() ?: true
        val strength = obj["strength"]?.jsonPrimitive?.doubleOrNull?.coerceIn(0.0, 1.0) ?: 1.0
        val applied = runBlocking { ScenarioRuntime.motion(bearing, moving, strength).await() }
        return 200 to buildJsonObject {
            put("ok", applied)
            put("bearing", bearing)
            put("moving", moving)
            put("strength", strength)
        }.toString()
    }

    private fun stopScenario(): Pair<Int, String> = 200 to buildJsonObject {        val stopped = runBlocking { ScenarioRuntime.stop().await() }
        put("ok", stopped)
        put("phase", ScenarioRuntime.state.value.phase.name)
    }.toString()

    private fun config(body: String): Pair<Int, String> {
        val obj = parseObject(body)
        val app = context ?: return 500 to """{"ok":false,"error":"server not ready"}"""
        if (obj.isEmpty()) return 400 to """{"ok":false,"error":"empty config"}"""
        if ("gnss_orbital" in obj || "gnss_model" in obj)
            return 400 to """{"ok":false,"error":"obsolete GNSS model selector; use receiver capture"}"""
        obj["backend"]?.jsonPrimitive?.content?.let { name ->
            val backend = runCatching { BackendType.valueOf(name.uppercase()) }.getOrNull()
                ?: return 400 to """{"ok":false,"error":"unknown backend"}"""
            runBlocking { ScenarioRuntime.selectBackend(backend).await() }
        }
        obj["enable_nmea"]?.jsonPrimitive?.jsonPrimitive?.content?.toBooleanStrictOrNull()
            ?.let { app.enableNMEA = it }
        obj["enable_mock_wifi"]?.jsonPrimitive?.jsonPrimitive?.content?.toBooleanStrictOrNull()
            ?.let { app.mockWifiEnabled = it }
        obj["sensor_cadence_scale"]?.jsonPrimitive?.doubleOrNull
            ?.let { app.sensorCadenceScale = it.coerceIn(0.5, 2.0) }
        obj["sensor_variation"]?.jsonPrimitive?.doubleOrNull
            ?.let { app.sensorVariation = it.coerceIn(0.0, 0.5) }
        obj["sensor_targets"]?.jsonPrimitive?.content
            ?.let { app.sensorTargetPackages = com.system.location.service.core.sensors.SensorTargets.parse(it) }
        obj["speed"]?.jsonPrimitive?.doubleOrNull?.let { app.speed = it.coerceIn(0.0, 1000.0) }
        obj["altitude"]?.jsonPrimitive?.doubleOrNull?.let { app.altitude = it.coerceIn(0.0, 20_000.0) }
        obj["accuracy"]?.jsonPrimitive?.doubleOrNull?.let { app.accuracy = it.toFloat().coerceIn(0.1f, 10_000f) }
        obj["report_interval"]?.jsonPrimitive?.jsonPrimitive?.content?.toIntOrNull()
            ?.let { app.reportDuration = it.coerceIn(50, 1000) }
        obj["environment_ap_count"]?.jsonPrimitive?.jsonPrimitive?.content?.toIntOrNull()
            ?.let { app.environmentApCount = it }
        obj["physical_noise"]?.jsonPrimitive?.jsonPrimitive?.content?.toBooleanStrictOrNull()
            ?.let { app.physicalNoise = it }
        obj["wifi_fingerprint_enabled"]?.jsonPrimitive?.jsonPrimitive?.content?.toBooleanStrictOrNull()
            ?.let { app.wifiFingerprintEnabled = it }
        obj["sim_ready"]?.jsonPrimitive?.jsonPrimitive?.content?.toBooleanStrictOrNull()?.let { app.simReady = it }
        obj["environment_source"]?.jsonPrimitive?.content?.let { app.environmentSourceMode = it }
        val applied = runBlocking { ScenarioRuntime.applyConfigNow() }
        return 200 to buildJsonObject {
            put("ok", true)
            put("applied", applied)
            put("config", buildJsonObject {
                put("backend", ScenarioRuntime.state.value.backend.name)
                put("speed", app.speed)
                put("altitude", app.altitude)
                put("accuracy", app.accuracy)
                put("report_interval", app.reportDuration)
                put("environment_ap_count", app.environmentApCount)
                put("physical_noise", app.physicalNoise)
                put("wifi_fingerprint_enabled", app.wifiFingerprintEnabled)
                put("sim_ready", app.simReady)
                put("environment_source", app.environmentSourceMode)
                put("enable_nmea", app.enableNMEA)
                put("enable_mock_wifi", app.mockWifiEnabled)
            })
        }.toString()
    }

    private fun runtimeStatus(): String {
        val manager = context?.getSystemService(LocationManager::class.java)
            ?: return """{"ok":false,"error":"location manager unavailable"}"""
        val status = MockServiceHelper.runtimeStatus(manager)
            ?: return """{"ok":false,"error":"runtime status unavailable"}"""
        return json.encodeToString(JsonObject.serializer(), buildJsonObject {
            put("ok", true)
            status.keySet().sorted().forEach { key ->
                put(key, status.get(key)?.toString())
            }
        })
    }

    private fun sensorHandles(): String {
        val manager = context?.getSystemService(SensorManager::class.java)
            ?: return """{"ok":false,"error":"sensor manager unavailable"}"""
        return json.encodeToString(JsonObject.serializer(), buildJsonObject {
            put("ok", true)
            put("sensors", buildJsonArray {
                manager.getSensorList(Sensor.TYPE_ALL)
                    .filter { it.type == Sensor.TYPE_STEP_COUNTER || it.type == Sensor.TYPE_STEP_DETECTOR }
                    .forEach { sensor ->
                        add(buildJsonObject {
                            put("name", sensor.name)
                            put("type", sensor.type)
                            put("wakeUp", sensor.isWakeUpSensor)
                            put("handle", runCatching {
                                sensor.javaClass.getMethod("getHandle").apply { isAccessible = true }
                                    .invoke(sensor) as Int
                            }.getOrDefault(-1))
                        })
                    }
            })
        })
    }

    private fun targets(): String {
        val targets = com.system.location.service.runtime.XposedServiceBridge.runningTargets()
        return json.encodeToString(JsonObject.serializer(), buildJsonObject {
            put("ok", true)
            put("serviceBound", com.system.location.service.runtime.XposedServiceBridge.bound())
            put("targets", buildJsonArray {
                targets.forEach { target ->
                    add(buildJsonObject {
                        put("process", target.processName)
                        put("pid", target.pid)
                        put("uid", target.uid)
                        put("state", target.state.name)
                        put("versionCode", target.loadedVersionCode)
                    })
                }
            })
        })
    }

    private fun hotReload(): Pair<Int, String> {
        val result = com.system.location.service.runtime.XposedServiceBridge.hotReloadSystemServer()
        return 200 to buildJsonObject {
            put("ok", !result.startsWith("hot reload FAILED") && !result.startsWith("hot reload timed out"))
            put("result", result)
            put("serviceBound", com.system.location.service.runtime.XposedServiceBridge.bound())
        }.toString()
    }

    private fun shell(body: String): Pair<Int, String> {        val command = parseObject(body)["cmd"]?.jsonPrimitive?.content
            ?: return 400 to """{"ok":false,"error":"cmd required"}"""
        if (command.isBlank()) return 400 to """{"ok":false,"error":"empty cmd"}"""
        val process = runCatching {
            ProcessBuilder("su", "-c", command).redirectErrorStream(true).start()
        }.getOrElse { return 500 to """{"ok":false,"error":"${escape(it.message ?: "spawn failed")}"}""" }
        val finished = process.waitFor(30, TimeUnit.SECONDS)
        if (!finished) {
            process.destroyForcibly()
            return 504 to """{"ok":false,"error":"timeout"}"""
        }
        val output = process.inputStream.bufferedReader().readText().take(65_536)
        return 200 to buildJsonObject {
            put("ok", process.exitValue() == 0)
            put("exit", process.exitValue())
            put("output", output)
        }.toString()
    }

    private fun parseObject(body: String): Map<String, kotlinx.serialization.json.JsonElement> =
        runCatching { json.parseToJsonElement(body).jsonObject }.getOrElse { return emptyMap() }

    private fun localIp(): String {
        val candidates = Collections.list(NetworkInterface.getNetworkInterfaces())
            .flatMap { Collections.list(it.inetAddresses) }
            .filter { !it.isLoopbackAddress && it.isSiteLocalAddress }
        return candidates.firstOrNull()?.hostAddress ?: "127.0.0.1"
    }

    private fun readRequest(input: InputStream): Request? {
        val header = ByteArrayOutputStream()
        var state = 0
        while (state < 4) {
            val value = input.read()
            if (value == -1) return null
            header.write(value)
            state = when {
                state == 0 && value == '\r'.code -> 1
                state == 1 && value == '\n'.code -> 2
                state == 2 && value == '\r'.code -> 3
                state == 3 && value == '\n'.code -> 4
                else -> 0
            }
            if (header.size() > 64 * 1024) error("headers too large")
        }
        val lines = header.toString(Charsets.UTF_8.name()).split("\r\n")
        val first = lines.firstOrNull()?.split(" ") ?: return null
        if (first.size < 2) return null
        val headers = lines.drop(1).mapNotNull { line ->
            val index = line.indexOf(':')
            if (index <= 0) null else line.substring(0, index).trim().lowercase() to line.substring(index + 1).trim()
        }.toMap()
        val length = headers["content-length"]?.toIntOrNull() ?: 0
        if (length < 0 || length > 1024 * 1024) error("body too large")
        val body = ByteArray(length)
        var read = 0
        while (read < length) {
            val count = input.read(body, read, length - read)
            if (count <= 0) break
            read += count
        }
        val target = first[1]
        val path = target.substringBefore('?')
        val query = target.substringAfter('?', "").split('&').mapNotNull {
            if (it.isBlank()) null else it.substringBefore('=') to it.substringAfter('=', "")
        }.toMap()
        return Request(first[0], path, query, String(body, 0, read, Charsets.UTF_8))
    }

    private fun writeResponse(output: OutputStream, code: Int, body: String) {
        val bytes = body.toByteArray(Charsets.UTF_8)
        val reason = when (code) {
            200 -> "OK"; 204 -> "No Content"; 400 -> "Bad Request"; 404 -> "Not Found"
            500 -> "Internal Server Error"; 504 -> "Gateway Timeout"; else -> "OK"
        }
        val head = "HTTP/1.1 $code $reason\r\n" +
            "Content-Type: application/json; charset=utf-8\r\n" +
            "Access-Control-Allow-Origin: *\r\n" +
            "Access-Control-Allow-Headers: content-type\r\n" +
            "Content-Length: ${bytes.size}\r\nConnection: close\r\n\r\n"
        output.write(head.toByteArray(Charsets.UTF_8))
        if (bytes.isNotEmpty()) output.write(bytes)
        output.flush()
    }

    private fun escape(value: String): String = value.replace("\\", "\\\\").replace("\"", "\\\"")

    private data class Request(
        val method: String,
        val path: String,
        val query: Map<String, String>,
        val body: String,
    )
}
```

```kt
package com.system.location.service

import android.app.Application
import android.content.Context
import com.system.location.service.privacy.SdkPrivacy

open class LocationServiceApp: Application() {

    override fun onCreate() {
        super.onCreate()
        appContext = applicationContext
        com.system.location.service.runtime.XposedServiceBridge.register()
        // The receiver must not initialize playback or clean the main process's providers.
        if (getProcessName() == "$packageName:location_probe") return

        SdkPrivacy.initialize(this)

        com.system.location.service.runtime.ScenarioRuntime.initialize()

        // Optional SDK restore failures are isolated by SdkPrivacy; runtime remains usable.
    }

    companion object {
        lateinit var appContext: Context
    }
}
```

`app/src/main/java/com/system/location/service/MainActivity.kt`:

```kt
package com.system.location.service

import android.Manifest.permission.ACCESS_COARSE_LOCATION
import android.Manifest.permission.ACCESS_FINE_LOCATION
import android.Manifest.permission.ACCESS_LOCATION_EXTRA_COMMANDS
import android.Manifest.permission.ACCESS_NETWORK_STATE
import android.Manifest.permission.ACCESS_WIFI_STATE
import android.Manifest.permission.CHANGE_WIFI_STATE
import android.Manifest.permission.FOREGROUND_SERVICE
import android.Manifest.permission.INTERNET
import android.Manifest.permission.READ_PHONE_STATE
import android.Manifest.permission.VIBRATE
import android.annotation.SuppressLint
import android.app.Notification
import android.app.PendingIntent
import android.content.Intent
import android.content.pm.PackageManager
import android.graphics.Color
import android.location.LocationManager
import android.net.Uri
import android.os.Build
import android.os.Bundle
import android.provider.Settings
import android.util.Log
import android.view.View
import android.view.WindowManager
import android.widget.Toast
import androidx.activity.viewModels
import androidx.appcompat.app.AppCompatActivity
import androidx.core.app.ActivityCompat
import androidx.core.view.WindowCompat
import androidx.core.view.WindowInsetsControllerCompat
import androidx.lifecycle.Lifecycle
import androidx.lifecycle.lifecycleScope
import androidx.lifecycle.repeatOnLifecycle
import androidx.navigation.NavGraph.Companion.findStartDestination
import androidx.navigation.navOptions
import com.system.location.service.maps.*
import com.system.location.service.privacy.TencentPrivacy
import com.system.location.service.privacy.SdkPrivacy
import com.google.android.material.dialog.MaterialAlertDialogBuilder
import kotlinx.coroutines.suspendCancellableCoroutine
import kotlin.coroutines.resume
import kotlinx.coroutines.launch
import com.system.location.service.android.permission.RequestPermissions
import com.system.location.service.android.root.ShellUtils
import com.system.location.service.android.window.OverlayUtils
import androidx.activity.compose.setContent
import androidx.compose.runtime.getValue
import androidx.compose.runtime.setValue
import com.system.location.service.ui.navigation.PortalAppShell
import com.system.location.service.ext.Loc4j
import com.system.location.service.ui.notification.NotificationUtils
import com.system.location.service.ui.viewmodel.AMapViewModel
import com.system.location.service.ui.viewmodel.MockServiceViewModel
import com.system.location.service.update.StartupUpdateViewModel
import com.system.location.service.runtime.ScenarioRuntime
import com.system.location.service.update.UpdateDialogFragment
import com.system.location.service.ui.navigation.PortalNavigationTransitions
import com.system.location.service.designsystem.theme.PortalTheme

class MainActivity : AppCompatActivity() {
    internal var drawerState = androidx.compose.material3.DrawerState(androidx.compose.material3.DrawerValue.Closed)
        private set
    internal var currentDestinationId by androidx.compose.runtime.mutableIntStateOf(R.id.nav_home)
        private set
    internal var selectedDrawerId by androidx.compose.runtime.mutableIntStateOf(R.id.nav_home)
        private set
    private var pageTitle by androidx.compose.runtime.mutableStateOf("Portal")
    private var shellReady = false
    private var navHost: androidx.navigation.fragment.NavHostFragment? = null
    internal val shellView: View get() = findViewById(android.R.id.content)
    internal val navigationController get() = requireNotNull(navHost).navController

    fun openDrawer() { lifecycleScope.launch { drawerState.open() } }
    fun closeDrawer() { lifecycleScope.launch { drawerState.close() } }
    fun navigateFromDrawer(destination: Int) {
        val controller = navigationController
        if (controller.currentDestination?.id == destination) return
        val start = controller.graph.findStartDestination().id
        if (destination == start && controller.popBackStack(start, false)) return
        controller.navigate(destination, null, navOptions { launchSingleTop = true; popUpTo(start) })
    }

    private fun createNavigationHost(): View {
        // Fragment navigation remains the interoperability layer for the existing Compose screens.
        // Construct its container synchronously before restoring the graph's Fragment views.
        return androidx.fragment.app.FragmentContainerView(this).apply {
            id = R.id.nav_host_fragment_content_main
            setBackgroundColor(androidx.core.content.ContextCompat.getColor(context, R.color.page_background))
            val host = supportFragmentManager.findFragmentById(id) as? androidx.navigation.fragment.NavHostFragment
                ?: androidx.navigation.fragment.NavHostFragment.create(R.navigation.mobile_navigation).also {
                    supportFragmentManager.beginTransaction().add(this, it, "portal_navigation_host")
                        .setPrimaryNavigationFragment(it).commitNow()
                }
            navHost = host
            androidx.navigation.Navigation.setViewNavController(this, host.navController)
            host.navController.addOnDestinationChangedListener { _, destination, args ->
                currentDestinationId = destination.id
                pageTitle = destination.label?.toString()?.let { label ->
                    Regex("\\{(.+?)\\}").replace(label) { match -> args?.get(match.groupValues[1])?.toString().orEmpty() }
                }.orEmpty()
                selectedDrawerId = when {
                    destination.arguments.containsKey("category") -> R.id.nav_settings
                    destination.id == R.id.nav_gnss_mock -> R.id.nav_mock
                    destination.id == R.id.nav_route_edit -> R.id.nav_route_gallery
                    destination.id in setOf(R.id.nav_app_selection, R.id.nav_sensor_packages,
                        R.id.nav_point_selection, R.id.nav_map_keys, R.id.nav_carrier_identity) -> R.id.nav_settings
                    destination.id in setOf(R.id.nav_environment_library, R.id.nav_environment_editor) -> R.id.nav_route_gallery
                    destination.id == R.id.nav_environment -> R.id.nav_mock
                    else -> destination.id
                }
            }
        }
    }

    /* Permission */
    private val requestMultiplePermissions = RequestPermissions(this)

    /* ViewModels */
    private val aMapViewModel by viewModels<AMapViewModel>()
    private val mockServiceViewModel by viewModels<MockServiceViewModel>()
    private val startupUpdateViewModel by viewModels<StartupUpdateViewModel>()

    private fun getRequiredPermissions(): MutableSet<String> {
        val permissions = mutableSetOf(
            ACCESS_FINE_LOCATION,
            ACCESS_COARSE_LOCATION,
        )
        if (Build.VERSION.SDK_INT >= 33) {
            permissions.add(android.Manifest.permission.POST_NOTIFICATIONS)
        }
        return permissions
    }

    private fun handleDeniedPermissions(denied: Set<String>) {
        denied.forEach { permission ->
            if (ActivityCompat.shouldShowRequestPermissionRationale(this, permission)) {
                showPermissionDeniedToast(permission)
            } else {
                ActivityCompat.requestPermissions(this, arrayOf(permission), REQUEST_PERMISSIONS_CODE)
            }
        }

    }

    private fun showPermissionDeniedToast(permission: String) {
        val message = when (permission) {
            ACCESS_FINE_LOCATION, ACCESS_COARSE_LOCATION -> "LocationService需要完整位置权限"
            ACCESS_LOCATION_EXTRA_COMMANDS -> "LocationService需要额外位置命令权限和系统交互"
            CHANGE_WIFI_STATE, ACCESS_WIFI_STATE -> "LocationService需要访问Wi-Fi状态"
            READ_PHONE_STATE -> "LocationService需要读取设备信息"
            ACCESS_NETWORK_STATE, INTERNET -> "LocationService需要访问网络"
            VIBRATE -> "LocationService需要访问传感器"
            else -> "需要  才能运行"
        }
        Toast.makeText(this, message, Toast.LENGTH_SHORT).show()
    }

    private suspend fun checkPermission(): Boolean {
        val permissions = getRequiredPermissions()
        val (_, denied) = requestMultiplePermissions.request(permissions)
        handleDeniedPermissions(denied)
        return denied.isEmpty()
    }

    override fun onCreate(savedInstanceState: Bundle?) {
        supportFragmentManager.registerFragmentLifecycleCallbacks(PortalNavigationTransitions(), true)
        // super restores NavHost and its MapViews synchronously.
        // Discard old UI state unless consent is confirmed and the map SDK is ready.
        val mapsReady = selectedMapsReady()
        val restoreDrawerOpen = mapsReady && savedInstanceState?.getBoolean("portal.drawer.open") == true
        super.onCreate(if (mapsReady) savedInstanceState else null)

        // Edge-to-Edge full immersion layout
        WindowCompat.setDecorFitsSystemWindows(window, false)

        lifecycleScope.launch {
            if (!awaitMapConsent()) { finish(); return@launch }
            repeatOnLifecycle(Lifecycle.State.CREATED) {
                checkPermission()
                mockServiceViewModel.locationManager = getSystemService(LOCATION_SERVICE) as? LocationManager

                initNotification()

                drawerState = androidx.compose.material3.DrawerState(if (restoreDrawerOpen)
                    androidx.compose.material3.DrawerValue.Open else androidx.compose.material3.DrawerValue.Closed)
                setContent {
                    PortalTheme {
                        PortalAppShell(drawerState, currentDestinationId, selectedDrawerId, pageTitle,
                            onNavigate = ::navigateFromDrawer, onBack = { onSupportNavigateUp() },
                            createHost = ::createNavigationHost)
                    }
                }
                shellReady = true
                applySystemBarTheme()
                startupUpdateViewModel.check()
            }
        }

        lifecycleScope.launch {
            repeatOnLifecycle(Lifecycle.State.RESUMED) {
                startupUpdateViewModel.pendingUpdate.collect { info ->
                    if (info != null && UpdateDialogFragment.show(supportFragmentManager, info)) {
                        startupUpdateViewModel.onPromptShown()
                    }
                }
            }
        }

    }

    private suspend fun awaitMapConsent(): Boolean {
        if (selectedMapsReady()) return true
        return suspendCancellableCoroutine { continuation ->
            val dialog = MaterialAlertDialogBuilder(this)
                .setTitle(R.string.map_privacy_title)
                .setMessage(if (mapProvider == MapProvider.TENCENT) R.string.tencent_privacy_message else R.string.map_privacy_message)
                .setCancelable(false)
                .setNegativeButton(R.string.map_privacy_decline) { _, _ ->
                    if (continuation.isActive) continuation.resume(false)
                }
                .setNeutralButton(R.string.map_privacy_policy, null)
                .setPositiveButton(R.string.map_privacy_accept, null)
                .create()
            dialog.setOnShowListener {
                dialog.getButton(android.content.DialogInterface.BUTTON_NEUTRAL).setOnClickListener {
                    runCatching { startActivity(Intent(Intent.ACTION_VIEW, Uri.parse(if (mapProvider == MapProvider.TENCENT) "https://lbs.qq.com/userAgreements/agreements/privacy" else "https://lbs.amap.com/pages/privacy/"))) }
                        .onFailure { Toast.makeText(this, R.string.map_privacy_no_browser, Toast.LENGTH_LONG).show() }
                }
                dialog.getButton(android.content.DialogInterface.BUTTON_POSITIVE).setOnClickListener {
                    runCatching { if (mapProvider == MapProvider.TENCENT) TencentPrivacy.accept(this) else SdkPrivacy.acceptMaps() }.onSuccess {
                        if (continuation.isActive) continuation.resume(true)
                        dialog.dismiss()
                    }.onFailure { Toast.makeText(this, it.message ?: getString(R.string.privacy_save_failed), Toast.LENGTH_LONG).show() }
                }
            }
            continuation.invokeOnCancellation { dialog.dismiss() }
            dialog.show()
        }
    }

    private fun selectedMapsReady(): Boolean = if (mapProvider == MapProvider.TENCENT)
        TencentPrivacy.ready(this) else SdkPrivacy.mapsAccepted && SdkPrivacy.mapsReady

    fun onUpdateChannelChanged() {
        startupUpdateViewModel.channelChanged()
    }

    override fun onStart() {
        super.onStart()
        if (shellReady) startupUpdateViewModel.check()
    }

    override fun onResume() {
        super.onResume()
        applySystemBarTheme()
        com.system.location.service.ui.mock.RockerOverlay.refresh()
    }

    private fun applySystemBarTheme() {
        // Android 15 edge-to-edge also derives navigation icon contrast from the
        // window background. Resolve it after AppCompat applies local night mode.
        window.setBackgroundDrawableResource(R.color.page_background)
        window.addFlags(WindowManager.LayoutParams.FLAG_DRAWS_SYSTEM_BAR_BACKGROUNDS)
        window.statusBarColor = Color.TRANSPARENT
        window.navigationBarColor = Color.TRANSPARENT
        window.isNavigationBarContrastEnforced = false
        val light = resources.getBoolean(R.bool.light_system_bars)
        WindowInsetsControllerCompat(window, window.decorView).apply {
            isAppearanceLightStatusBars = light
            isAppearanceLightNavigationBars = light
        }
    }

        if (!isChangingConfigurations) startupUpdateViewModel.onBackgrounded()
        super.onStop()
    }

    private fun initNotification() {
        with(aMapViewModel) {
            mNotification = if (Build.VERSION.SDK_INT >= Build.VERSION_CODES.O) {
                val notificationUtils = NotificationUtils(this@MainActivity)
                val builder = notificationUtils.getAndroidChannelNotification(
                    "LocationService后台定位服务",

                )
                builder.build()
            } else {
                val builder = Notification.Builder(this@MainActivity)
                val nfIntent = Intent(
                    this@MainActivity,
                    MainActivity::class.java
                )
                builder.setContentIntent(PendingIntent.getActivity(

                    .setContentTitle("LocationService后台定位服务")
                    .setSmallIcon(R.mipmap.ic_launcher)
                    .setContentText("正在后台定位")
                    .setWhen(System.currentTimeMillis())

            }

    private fun requireFloatWindows(): Boolean {
        fun requestSettingCanDrawOverlays() {
            kotlin.runCatching {
                val intent = Intent(Settings.ACTION_MANAGE_OVERLAY_PERMISSION)
                intent.data = Uri.parse("package:")
                startActivity(intent)
            }.onFailure {
                Log.e("MainActivity", "requestSettingCanDrawOverlays: ", it)
                Toast.makeText(this, "跳转失败，请手动去设置授权", Toast.LENGTH_LONG).show()
            }
            finish()
        }

        if (!OverlayUtils.hasOverlayPermissions(this)) {
            Toast.makeText(this, "请授予悬浮窗权限", Toast.LENGTH_LONG).show()
            requestSettingCanDrawOverlays()
            return false
        }

        return true
    }

    override fun onRequestPermissionsResult(
        requestCode: Int,
        permissions: Array<out String>,
        grantResults: IntArray
    ) {
        super.onRequestPermissionsResult(requestCode, permissions, grantResults)
        if (requestCode == REQUEST_PERMISSIONS_CODE) {
            val denied = permissions.filterIndexed { index, _ ->
                grantResults[index] != PackageManager.PERMISSION_GRANTED
            }

            if (denied.isEmpty()) {
                mockServiceViewModel.locationManager = getSystemService(LOCATION_SERVICE) as? LocationManager
                return
            }

            for (permission in denied) {
                Toast.makeText(this, when(permission) {
                    ACCESS_FINE_LOCATION, ACCESS_COARSE_LOCATION -> "LocationService需要完整位置权限"
                    ACCESS_LOCATION_EXTRA_COMMANDS -> "LocationService需要额外位置命令权限和系统交互"
                    CHANGE_WIFI_STATE, ACCESS_WIFI_STATE -> "LocationService需要访问Wi-Fi状态"
                    READ_PHONE_STATE -> "LocationService需要读取设备信息"
                    ACCESS_NETWORK_STATE, INTERNET -> "LocationService需要访问网络"
                    VIBRATE -> "LocationService需要访问传感器"
                    else -> "需要  才能运行"
                } + "，请手动授权！", Toast.LENGTH_SHORT).show()
            }

        }
    }

    override fun onSupportNavigateUp(): Boolean {
        val controller = navHost?.navController ?: return false
        if (com.system.location.service.ui.navigation.portalDestinations.any { it.id == currentDestinationId } ||
            currentDestinationId == R.id.nav_gnss_mock) {
            openDrawer()
            return true
        }
        return controller.navigateUp()
    }

    override fun onSaveInstanceState(outState: Bundle) {
        outState.putBoolean("portal.drawer.open", drawerState.isOpen)
        super.onSaveInstanceState(outState)
    }

    companion object {
        private const val REQUEST_PERMISSIONS_CODE = 111

        internal var mCityString: String? = null
            set(value) {
                if (field != value)  {
                    field = value
                    Log.d("MainActivity", "cityString: ")
                }
            }
    }
```

```kt
package com.system.location.service.amap

import android.graphics.Color
import android.util.Log
import com.amap.api.maps.AMap
import com.amap.api.maps.CameraUpdateFactory
import com.amap.api.maps.model.BitmapDescriptorFactory
import com.amap.api.maps.model.LatLng
import com.amap.api.maps.model.MyLocationStyle
import com.amap.api.services.help.Tip
import com.system.location.service.bdmap.Poi
import com.system.location.service.ext.Loc4j
import com.system.location.service.ui.viewmodel.AMapViewModel

/**
 * 高德输入提示(Tip) -> Poi（WGS84）
 */
fun List<Tip>.toPoi(
    currentLocation: Pair<Double, Double>? = null
): List<Poi> = this
    .filter { !it.name.isNullOrBlank() && it.point != null }
    .map {
        val gcj02Lat = it.point.latitude
        val gcj02Lon = it.point.longitude
        val (lat, lon) = Loc4j.gcj2wgs(gcj02Lat, gcj02Lon)
        val address = listOfNotNull(it.district, it.name)
            .filter { s -> s.isNotBlank() }
            .joinToString(" ")
        if (currentLocation != null) {
            Log.d("toPoi", "currentLocation: , lat: , lon: ")
            Poi(
                name = it.name,
                address = address,
                longitude = lon,
                latitude = lat,
                tag = "",
            ).also {
                val distance = it.distanceTo(currentLocation.first, currentLocation.second).toInt()
                if (distance < 1000) {
                    it.address = "m "
                } else {
                    it.address = "km "
                }
            }
        } else {
            Poi(
                name = it.name,
                address = address,
                longitude = lon,
                latitude = lat,
                tag = "",
            )
        }
    }

fun AMap.setMapConfig(mode: AMapViewModel.Perspective, resourceId: Int?) {
    val style = MyLocationStyle()
    if (resourceId != null) {
        style.myLocationIcon(BitmapDescriptorFactory.fromResource(resourceId))
        style.strokeColor(Color.TRANSPARENT)
        style.radiusFillColor(Color.TRANSPARENT)
    }
    style.myLocationType(
        when (mode) {
            AMapViewModel.Perspective.NORMAL ->
                MyLocationStyle.LOCATION_TYPE_LOCATION_ROTATE_NO_CENTER
            AMapViewModel.Perspective.FOLLOWING ->
                MyLocationStyle.LOCATION_TYPE_MAP_ROTATE
        }
    )
    myLocationStyle = style
    isMyLocationEnabled = true
}

fun AMap.locateMe(target: LatLng? = null) {
    if (target != null && target.latitude != 0.0 && target.longitude != 0.0) {
        animateCamera(CameraUpdateFactory.newLatLngZoom(target, 17f), 600, null)
    } else {
        val myLoc = myLocation
        if (myLoc != null && myLoc.latitude != 0.0 && myLoc.longitude != 0.0) {
            animateCamera(CameraUpdateFactory.newLatLngZoom(LatLng(myLoc.latitude, myLoc.longitude), 17f), 600, null)
        } else {
            myLocationStyle = MyLocationStyle().myLocationType(MyLocationStyle.LOCATION_TYPE_LOCATE)
            isMyLocationEnabled = true
        }
    }
}
```

`app/src/main/java/com/system/location/service/amap/AMapRoutePlanner.kt`:

```kt
package com.system.location.service.amap

import android.content.Context
import com.amap.api.services.core.LatLonPoint
import com.amap.api.services.route.*
import com.system.location.service.core.geo.Gcj02
import com.system.location.service.core.planning.PlanRequest
import kotlinx.coroutines.suspendCancellableCoroutine
import kotlin.coroutines.resume
import kotlin.coroutines.resumeWithException

/** A new SDK request object per plan prevents listener replacement from mixing responses. */
class AMapRoutePlanner(private val context: Context) {
    suspend fun plan(request: PlanRequest): List<List<Gcj02>> = suspendCancellableCoroutine { continuation ->
        try {
            val search = RouteSearch(context)
            search.setRouteSearchListener(object : RouteSearch.OnRouteSearchListener {
                override fun onWalkRouteSearched(result: WalkRouteResult?, code: Int) {
                    if (!continuation.isActive) return
                    runCatching {
                        check(code == 1000) { "高德步行规划失败（$code），请检查网络、地图 Key 与授权" }
                        // paths are alternatives; steps within the selected path are sequential.
                        val path = result?.paths?.firstOrNull() ?: error("高德未返回可用路线")
                        path.steps.orEmpty().map { step -> step.polyline.orEmpty().map { Gcj02(it.latitude, it.longitude) } }
                    }.onSuccess { continuation.resume(it) }.onFailure { continuation.resumeWithException(it) }
                }
                override fun onBusRouteSearched(result: BusRouteResult?, code: Int) = Unit
                override fun onDriveRouteSearched(result: DriveRouteResult?, code: Int) = Unit
                override fun onRideRouteSearched(result: RideRouteResult?, code: Int) = Unit
            })
            val endpoints = RouteSearch.FromAndTo(LatLonPoint(request.start.latitude, request.start.longitude),
                LatLonPoint(request.end.latitude, request.end.longitude))
            search.calculateWalkRouteAsyn(RouteSearch.WalkRouteQuery(endpoints))
        } catch (error: Exception) { if (continuation.isActive) continuation.resumeWithException(error) }
    }
}
```

`app/src/main/java/com/system/location/service/android/Bugly.kt`:

```kt
package com.system.location.service.android

import android.annotation.SuppressLint
import android.content.Context
import android.os.Build
import android.provider.Settings
import android.telephony.TelephonyManager
import java.io.File
import java.security.MessageDigest
import java.util.UUID

object Bugly {
    fun getDeviceModel(): String {
        return Build.MODEL
    }

    /**
     * 获取设备唯一标识符
     *
     * 该方法综合了多种获取设备ID的策略，按优先级顺序尝试：
     * 1. ANDROID_ID (适用于大多数设备)
     * 2. IMEI (仅适用于Android Q/10以下版本，需要权限)
     * 3. MAC地址 (Android M/6.0以下版本可获取实际MAC地址，以上版本可能返回固定值)
     * 4. 自定义生成的UUID (如果以上方法都失败，则生成并持久化一个UUID)
     *
     * @param context 应用上下文
     * @return 设备唯一标识符的MD5哈希值
     */
    @SuppressLint("HardwareIds", "MissingPermission")
    fun getUniqueDeviceId(context: Context): String {
        var deviceId = ""

        val androidId = Settings.Secure.getString(context.contentResolver, Settings.Secure.ANDROID_ID)
        if (!androidId.isNullOrEmpty() && androidId != "9774d56d682e549c") { // 忽略已知的错误值
            deviceId = androidId
        }

        if (deviceId.isEmpty() && Build.VERSION.SDK_INT < Build.VERSION_CODES.Q) {
            try {
                val telephonyManager = context.getSystemService(Context.TELEPHONY_SERVICE) as TelephonyManager
                @Suppress("DEPRECATION")
                val imei = telephonyManager.deviceId
                if (!imei.isNullOrEmpty()) {
                    deviceId = imei
                }
            } catch (e: Exception) {

            }
        }

        if (deviceId.isEmpty()) {
            deviceId = getOrCreatePersistentUUID(context)
        }

        return hashMD5(deviceId)
    }

    /**
     * 获取或创建持久化的UUID
     * 将UUID存储在应用私有目录中，确保卸载后重装会重新生成
     */
    private fun getOrCreatePersistentUUID(context: Context): String {
        val file = File(context.filesDir, "device_uuid")

        // 检查文件是否存在，如果存在则读取
        if (file.exists()) {
            try {
                return file.readText()
            } catch (e: Exception) {
            }
        }

        val uuid = UUID.randomUUID().toString()
        try {
            file.writeText(uuid)
        } catch (e: Exception) {
        }

        return uuid
    }

    /**
     * 将字符串转换为MD5哈希值
     */
    private fun hashMD5(input: String): String {
        try {
            val md = MessageDigest.getInstance("MD5")
            val digest = md.digest(input.toByteArray())
            return digest.joinToString("") { "%02x".format(it) }
        } catch (e: Exception) {
            return input
        }
    }
}
```

`app/src/main/java/com/system/location/service/android/permission/RequestPermissions.kt`:

```kt
package com.system.location.service.android.permission

import androidx.appcompat.app.AppCompatActivity
import kotlinx.coroutines.channels.Channel
import androidx.activity.result.contract.ActivityResultContracts.RequestMultiplePermissions
import android.content.Context
import android.content.pm.PackageManager

// https://medium.com/@wind.orca.pe/handling-android-runtime-permissions-with-coroutines-and-suspend-functions-5b4aa4e74ee5

class RequestPermissions(
    activity: AppCompatActivity
) {
    private val activityResultLauncher = with(activity) {
        registerForActivityResult(RequestMultiplePermissions()) { result ->
            val m = result.mapValues { (key, value) ->
                if (value) {
                    PermissionChecker.State.Granted
                } else {
                    PermissionChecker.State.Denied(shouldShowRequestPermissionRationale(key))
                }
            }

            channel.trySend(PermissionChecker.Result(m))
        }
    }

    private val channel = Channel<PermissionChecker.Result>(1)

    suspend fun request(permissions: Set<String>): PermissionChecker.Result {
        activityResultLauncher.launch(permissions.toTypedArray())

        return channel.receive()
    }

}

interface PermissionChecker {
    class Result(m: Map<String, State>) : Map<String, State> by HashMap(m) {
        operator fun component1(): Set<String> = granted()
        operator fun component2(): Set<String> = denied()

        private fun denied() = filterValues(State::isDenied).keys
        private fun granted() = filterValues(State::isGranted).keys
    }

    sealed interface State {
        val shouldShowRequestPermissionRationale: Boolean

        fun isGranted() = this is Granted
        fun isDenied() = this is Denied

        data object Granted : State {
            override val shouldShowRequestPermissionRationale: Boolean = false
        }

        data class Denied(
            override val shouldShowRequestPermissionRationale: Boolean
        ) : State
    }

    fun Context.checkSelfMultiplePermissions(permissions: Array<out String>): Boolean {
        return permissions.all {
            checkSelfPermission(it) == PackageManager.PERMISSION_GRANTED
        }
    }

    fun Context.checkSelfSinglePermission(permission: String): Boolean {
        return checkSelfPermission(permission) == PackageManager.PERMISSION_GRANTED
    }
}
```

```kt
package com.system.location.service.android.rom

import java.io.BufferedReader
import java.io.IOException
import java.io.InputStreamReader

object RomUtils {
    fun isMiui(): Boolean {
        return !getProp("ro.miui.ui.version.name").isNullOrBlank()
    }

    fun isEmui(): Boolean {
        return getProp("ro.build.version.emui") != null
    }

    private fun getProp(name: String): String? {
        return try {
            val p = Runtime.getRuntime().exec("getprop $name")
            val `in` = BufferedReader(InputStreamReader(p.inputStream))
            val value = `in`.readLine()
            `in`.close()
            value
        } catch (e: IOException) {
            null
        }
    }
}
```

`app/src/main/java/com/system/location/service/android/root/RootEnvironmentProbe.kt`:

```kt
package com.system.location.service.android.root

import java.util.concurrent.TimeUnit

/** Checks the root implementation's version without requesting a privileged shell or changing it. */
internal object RootEnvironmentProbe {
    fun isAvailable(): Boolean {
        val process = try { ProcessBuilder("su", "-v").redirectErrorStream(true).start() }
            catch (_: Exception) { return false }
        return try {
            process.waitFor(1_000, TimeUnit.MILLISECONDS) && process.exitValue() == 0
        } catch (interrupted: InterruptedException) {
            Thread.currentThread().interrupt()
            false
        } finally {
            runCatching { if (process.isAlive) process.destroyForcibly() }
            runCatching { process.inputStream.close() }
            runCatching { process.errorStream.close() }
            runCatching { process.outputStream.close() }
        }
    }
}
```

`app/src/main/java/com/system/location/service/android/root/ShellUtils.kt`:

```kt
package com.system.location.service.android.root

object ShellUtils {
    fun hasRoot(): Boolean {
        val runtime = Runtime.getRuntime()
        try {
            val process = runtime.exec("su")
            process.outputStream.write("exit\n".toByteArray())
            process.outputStream.flush()
            process.waitFor()
            return process.exitValue() == 0
        } catch (e: Exception) {
            return false
        }
    }

    fun setEnforceMode(enabled: Boolean) {
        val runtime = Runtime.getRuntime()
        try {
            val process = runtime.exec("su")
            process.outputStream.write("setenforce ${if (enabled) "1" else "0"}\n".toByteArray())
            process.outputStream.write("exit\n".toByteArray())
            process.outputStream.flush()
            process.waitFor()
        } catch (e: Exception) {
            e.printStackTrace()
        }
    }

    fun executeCommand(command: String): String {
        val runtime = Runtime.getRuntime()
        try {
            val process = runtime.exec("su")
            process.outputStream.write("$command\n".toByteArray())
            process.outputStream.write("exit\n".toByteArray())
            process.outputStream.flush()
            process.waitFor()
            if (process.exitValue() != 0) {
                return process.errorStream.bufferedReader().readText()
            }
            return process.inputStream.bufferedReader().readText()
        } catch (e: Exception) {
            e.printStackTrace()
            return ""
        }
    }

    fun executeCommandToBytes(command: String): ByteArray {
        val runtime = Runtime.getRuntime()
        try {
            val process = runtime.exec("su")
            process.outputStream.write("$command\n".toByteArray())
            process.outputStream.write("exit\n".toByteArray())
            process.outputStream.flush()
            process.waitFor()
            if (process.exitValue() != 0) {
                return process.errorStream.use { it.readBytes() }
            }
            return process.inputStream.use { it.readBytes() }
        } catch (e: Exception) {
            e.printStackTrace()
            return ByteArray(0)
        }
    }
}
```

```kt
class RockerView(context: Context, attributeSet: AttributeSet? = null): View(context, attributeSet) {
    private var mAreaBackgroundPaint: Paint

        val typedArray = context.obtainStyledAttributes(attributeSet, R.styleable.RockerView)
        val areaBackground = typedArray.getDrawable(R.styleable.RockerView_areaBackground)
        if (null != areaBackground) {

            } else {

        }
        val rockerBackground = typedArray.getDrawable(R.styleable.RockerView_rockerBackground)

            }
        }
        typedArray.recycle()

        mAreaBackgroundPaint = Paint()
        mAreaBackgroundPaint.isAntiAlias = true

        mRockerPaint = Paint()
        mRockerPaint.isAntiAlias = true
        mRockerPaint.color = mRockerColor
        robotBitmap = ResourcesCompat.getDrawable(resources, R.drawable.baseline_robot_24, context.theme)
            ?.mutate()?.apply { setTint(gripColor) }?.toBitmap()
```
