```kt
        mRockerPosition = Point()

        directionPaint.textAlign = Paint.Align.CENTER
        directionPaint.typeface = Typeface.create("sans-serif-medium", Typeface.NORMAL)
        ringPaint.style = Paint.Style.STROKE
        ringPaint.strokeCap = Paint.Cap.ROUND
        lockBitmap = ResourcesCompat.getDrawable(resources, R.drawable.baseline_lock_24, context.theme)!!
            .mutate().apply { setTint(gripColor) }.toBitmap()

        lockPaint.isAntiAlias = true
    }

    override fun onMeasure(widthMeasureSpec: Int, heightMeasureSpec: Int) {
        val width = getMySize(widthMeasureSpec)
        val height = getMySize(heightMeasureSpec)
        val min = width.coerceAtMost(height)
        setMeasuredDimension(min, min)
    }

    override fun onDraw(canvas: Canvas) {
        super.onDraw(canvas)
        val paddingLeft = paddingLeft
        val paddingRight = paddingRight
        val paddingTop = paddingTop
        val paddingBottom = paddingBottom
        val inset = (DEFAULT_PADDING_SIZE * density).toInt()
        val width = (width - paddingLeft - paddingRight - inset).coerceAtLeast(1)
        val height = (height - paddingBottom - paddingTop - inset).coerceAtLeast(1)
        val cx = width / 2 + paddingLeft + inset / 2
        val cy = height / 2 + paddingTop + inset / 2
        mCenterPoint[cx] = cy
        mAreaRadius = (min(width.toDouble(), height.toDouble()) / 2).toFloat()


        if (0 == mRockerPosition.x || 0 == mRockerPosition.y) {
            mRockerPosition[mCenterPoint.x] = mCenterPoint.y
        }

        mAreaBackgroundPaint.color = mAreaColor
        canvas.drawCircle(mCenterPoint.x.toFloat(), mCenterPoint.y.toFloat(), mAreaRadius, mAreaBackgroundPaint)

        ringPaint.color = borderColor
        ringPaint.strokeWidth = density
        canvas.drawCircle(cx.toFloat(), cy.toFloat(), mAreaRadius - density / 2, ringPaint)
        ringPaint.alpha = 100
        canvas.drawCircle(cx.toFloat(), cy.toFloat(), mAreaRadius * 0.45f, ringPaint)
        ringPaint.alpha = 255

        drawDirection(canvas)

        mRockerInnerCircleRadius = mAreaRadius * 0.24f
        detailPaint.color = android.graphics.Color.argb(18, 0, 0, 0)
        canvas.drawCircle(mRockerPosition.x.toFloat(), mRockerPosition.y + 2 * density,
            mRockerInnerCircleRadius + density, detailPaint)
        canvas.drawCircle(
            mRockerPosition.x.toFloat(),
            mRockerPosition.y.toFloat(), mRockerInnerCircleRadius, mRockerPaint
        )
        ringPaint.color = gripColor
        ringPaint.alpha = 70
        ringPaint.strokeWidth = density
        canvas.drawCircle(mRockerPosition.x.toFloat(), mRockerPosition.y.toFloat(),
            mRockerInnerCircleRadius - 2 * density, ringPaint)
        ringPaint.alpha = 255
        if (isLocked.get()) {
            drawLock(canvas)
        } else if (isAuto.get()) {
            robotBitmap?.let {
                val half = mRockerInnerCircleRadius * 0.55f
                canvas.drawBitmap(it, null, RectF(mRockerPosition.x - half, mRockerPosition.y - half,
                    mRockerPosition.x + half, mRockerPosition.y + half), lockPaint)
            }
        } else {
            detailPaint.color = gripColor
            for (offset in -1..1) {
                canvas.drawCircle(mRockerPosition.x + offset * 4 * density,
                    mRockerPosition.y.toFloat(), density, detailPaint)
            }
        }
    }

    private fun drawDirection(canvas: Canvas, circleRadius: Float = mAreaRadius, circleX: Float = mCenterPoint.x.toFloat(), circleY: Float = mCenterPoint.y.toFloat()) {
        ringPaint.strokeWidth = density
        for (index in 0 until 24) {
            val angle = Math.toRadians(index * 15.0 - 90.0)
            val major = index % 6 == 0
            val inner = circleRadius * if (major) 0.80f else 0.85f
            val outer = circleRadius * 0.90f
            ringPaint.color = if (index == 0) mRockerColor else secondaryColor
            ringPaint.alpha = if (major) 220 else 80
            canvas.drawLine(circleX + inner * cos(angle).toFloat(), circleY + inner * sin(angle).toFloat(),
                circleX + outer * cos(angle).toFloat(), circleY + outer * sin(angle).toFloat(), ringPaint)
        }
        ringPaint.alpha = 255
        directionPaint.textSize = 10 * density
        val baseline = -(directionPaint.ascent() + directionPaint.descent()) / 2
        listOf("N", "E", "S", "W").forEachIndexed { index, label ->
            val angle = Math.toRadians(index * 90.0 - 90.0)
            directionPaint.color = if (index == 0) mRockerColor else secondaryColor
            canvas.drawText(label, circleX + circleRadius * 0.64f * cos(angle).toFloat(),
                circleY + circleRadius * 0.64f * sin(angle).toFloat() + baseline, directionPaint)
        }
    }

    @SuppressLint("ClickableViewAccessibility")
    override fun onTouchEvent(event: MotionEvent?): Boolean {
        if (event == null || !isEnabled) return false
        when (event.action) {
            MotionEvent.ACTION_DOWN -> {
                returnAnimator?.cancel()
                listener?.onStarted()

                val moveX = event.x
                val moveY = event.y

                val (mRockerPosition, w) = getRockerPositionPoint(mCenterPoint, Point(moveX.toInt(), moveY.toInt()), mAreaRadius, mRockerInnerCircleRadius)
                this.mRockerPosition = mRockerPosition
                moveRocker(mRockerPosition.x, mRockerPosition.y)

                if (!w.first && isLocked.get() && lockRunnable == null) {
                    isLocked.set(false)
                    listener?.onLockChanged(false)
                }
            }

            MotionEvent.ACTION_MOVE -> {
                if (!isLocked.get()) {
                    val moveX = event.x
                    val moveY = event.y
                    val (mRockerPosition, w) = getRockerPositionPoint(
                        mCenterPoint,
                        Point(moveX.toInt(), moveY.toInt()),
                        mAreaRadius,
                        mRockerInnerCircleRadius
                    )
                    this.mRockerPosition = mRockerPosition
                    moveRocker(mRockerPosition.x, mRockerPosition.y)

                    // 自动时不锁定
                    if (w.first && lockRunnable == null && !isAuto.get()) {
                        lockRunnable = Runnable {
                            isLocked.set(true)
                            listener?.onLockChanged(true)
                            performHapticFeedback(HapticFeedbackConstants.LONG_PRESS)
                            Toast.makeText(context, "方向锁定", Toast.LENGTH_SHORT).show()
                            lockRunnable = null
                            invalidate()
                        }
                        handler.postDelayed(lockRunnable!!, 3000)
                    }

                    if (!w.first && lockRunnable != null) {
                        handler.removeCallbacks(lockRunnable!!)
                        lockRunnable = null
                    }
                }
            }

            MotionEvent.ACTION_UP -> {
                cancelPendingLock()
                if (!isLocked.get()) {
                    listener?.onFinished()
                    animateReturn()
                }
            }

            MotionEvent.ACTION_CANCEL -> {
                cancelPendingLock()
                isLocked.set(false)
                listener?.onLockChanged(false)
                listener?.onFinished()
                animateReturn()
            }
        }
        return true
    }

    private fun moveRocker(x: Int, y: Int) {
        mRockerPosition[x] = y
        invalidate()
    }

    private fun drawLock(canvas: Canvas) {
        val rockerRadius = mRockerInnerCircleRadius
        val lockSize = rockerRadius * 0.6f
        val rockerX = mRockerPosition.x.toFloat()
        val rockerY = mRockerPosition.y.toFloat()
        val rectF = RectF(rockerX - lockSize, rockerY - lockSize, rockerX + lockSize, rockerY + lockSize)
        canvas.drawBitmap(lockBitmap, null, rectF, lockPaint)
    }

    private fun getMySize(measureSpec: Int): Int {
        val result: Int
        val specMode = MeasureSpec.getMode(measureSpec)
        val defaultSize = (DEFAULT_SIZE * density).toInt()
        val specSize = MeasureSpec.getSize(measureSpec)
        result = when (specMode) {
            MeasureSpec.EXACTLY -> specSize
            MeasureSpec.AT_MOST -> defaultSize.coerceAtMost(specSize)
            else -> defaultSize
        }
        return result
    }

    private fun getRockerPositionPoint(
        centerPoint: Point,
        touchPoint: Point,
        regionRadius: Float,
        rockerRadius: Float
    ): Pair<Point, Pair<Boolean, Double>> {
        val lenX = (touchPoint.x - centerPoint.x).toFloat()
        val lenY = (touchPoint.y - centerPoint.y).toFloat()
        val lenXY = sqrt((lenX * lenX + lenY * lenY).toDouble()).toFloat()
        val radian = atan2(lenY.toDouble(), lenX.toDouble())
        val motion = JoystickInput.evaluate(lenX.toDouble(), lenY.toDouble(), (regionRadius - rockerRadius).coerceAtLeast(1f).toDouble())
        val angle = motion.bearing
        listener?.onStrength(motion.strength)
        if (lenXY + rockerRadius <= regionRadius) {
            listener?.onAngle(angle)
            return touchPoint to (false to angle)
        } else {
            val showPointX = (centerPoint.x + (regionRadius - rockerRadius) * cos(radian)).toInt()
            val showPointY = (centerPoint.y + (regionRadius - rockerRadius) * sin(radian)).toInt()
            listener?.onAngle(angle)
            return Point(showPointX, showPointY) to (true to angle)
        }
    }

    fun reset() {
        returnAnimator?.cancel()
        // joystick back to center
        lockRunnable?.let { handler.removeCallbacks(it) }
        lockRunnable = null
        mRockerPosition = Point()
        isLocked.set(false)
        listener?.onLockChanged(false)
        invalidate()
    }

    private fun cancelPendingLock() {
        lockRunnable?.let { handler.removeCallbacks(it) }
        lockRunnable = null
    }
    private fun animateReturn() {
        returnAnimator?.cancel()
        val x = mRockerPosition.x; val y = mRockerPosition.y
        returnAnimator = ValueAnimator.ofFloat(0f, 1f).apply {
            duration = 160
            addUpdateListener { animation ->
                val f = animation.animatedValue as Float
                moveRocker((x + (mCenterPoint.x - x) * f).toInt(), (y + (mCenterPoint.y - y) * f).toInt())
            }
            start()
        }
    }
    override fun onDetachedFromWindow() {
        reset()
        listener?.onFinished()
        super.onDetachedFromWindow()
    }

    fun auto(enable: Boolean) {
        isAuto.set(enable)
        invalidate()
    }

    companion object {
        const val DEFAULT_SIZE: Int = 144
        const val DEFAULT_PADDING_SIZE: Int = 12

        interface OnMoveListener {
            fun onStarted() {}

            fun onAngle(angle: Double)
            fun onStrength(strength: Double) {}

            fun onLockChanged(isLocked: Boolean)

            fun onFinished() {}
        }
    }
}
```

`app/src/main/java/com/system/location/service/android/widget/SatelliteRadar.kt`:

```kt
package com.system.location.service.android.widget

import android.Manifest
import android.Manifest.permission.ACCESS_FINE_LOCATION
import android.annotation.SuppressLint
import android.content.Context
import android.content.pm.PackageManager
import android.graphics.Canvas
import android.graphics.Color
import android.graphics.Paint
import android.hardware.Sensor
import android.hardware.SensorEvent
import android.hardware.SensorEventListener
import android.hardware.SensorManager
import android.location.GnssStatus
import android.location.LocationManager
import android.os.Build
import android.util.AttributeSet
import android.util.Log
import android.view.MotionEvent
import android.view.View
import androidx.annotation.RequiresPermission
import androidx.core.app.ActivityCompat
import androidx.core.content.ContextCompat
import com.system.location.service.R
import kotlin.math.abs
import kotlin.math.cos
import kotlin.math.sin
import kotlin.math.sqrt

data class SatelliteData(
    val prn: Int,
    val snr: Float,
    val elevation: Float,
    val azimuth: Float,
    val hasAlmanac: Boolean,
    val hasEphemeris: Boolean,
    val usedInFix: Boolean,
    var screenX: Float = 0f,
    var screenY: Float = 0f,
    val constellationType: Int = GnssStatus.CONSTELLATION_UNKNOWN,
)

class SatelliteRadarView(context: Context, attributeSet: AttributeSet?): View(context, attributeSet), SensorEventListener {
    private var satellites = emptyList<SatelliteData>()
    private val radarPoint = Paint(Paint.ANTI_ALIAS_FLAG)
    private val satellitePaint = Paint(Paint.ANTI_ALIAS_FLAG)
    private val usedColor = ContextCompat.getColor(context, R.color.status_success)
    private val visibleColor = ContextCompat.getColor(context, R.color.primary)
    private var centerX: Int = 0
    private var centerY: Int = 0
    private var radius: Float = 0f

    // 磁场传感器
    private var active = true
    private var sensorsRegistered = false
    private var sensorManager: SensorManager? = null
    private var rotationSensor: Sensor? = null
    private var magneticSensor: Sensor? = null
    private var accelerometerSensor: Sensor? = null

    // 缓存的传感器数据
    private var rotationVector = FloatArray(3)
    private var accelerometerValues = FloatArray(3)
    private var magneticFieldValues = FloatArray(3)

    // 当前设备朝向角度（方位角）
    private var currentAzimuth: Float = 0f

    // 是否使用设备朝向
    private var useDeviceOrientation: Boolean = false

    init {
        initSensors(context)

        radarPoint.style = Paint.Style.STROKE
        radarPoint.color = ContextCompat.getColor(context, R.color.text_secondary)

        satellitePaint.style = Paint.Style.FILL
        satellitePaint.color = visibleColor
    }

    private fun initSensors(context: Context) {
        sensorManager = context.getSystemService(Context.SENSOR_SERVICE) as SensorManager

        // 尝试使用旋转矢量传感器（更准确）
        rotationSensor = sensorManager?.getDefaultSensor(Sensor.TYPE_ROTATION_VECTOR)

        // 如果没有旋转矢量传感器，使用加速度和磁场传感器的组合
        if (rotationSensor == null) {
            accelerometerSensor = sensorManager?.getDefaultSensor(Sensor.TYPE_ACCELEROMETER)
            magneticSensor = sensorManager?.getDefaultSensor(Sensor.TYPE_MAGNETIC_FIELD)
        }
    }

    override fun onAttachedToWindow() {
        super.onAttachedToWindow()
        registerSensors()
    }

    override fun onDetachedFromWindow() {
        super.onDetachedFromWindow()
        unregisterSensors()
    }

    fun setActive(active: Boolean) {
        this.active = active
        if (active) registerSensors() else unregisterSensors()
    }

    private fun registerSensors() {
        if (!active || sensorsRegistered || !isAttachedToWindow) return
        sensorsRegistered = true
        if (rotationSensor != null) {
            sensorManager?.registerListener(this, rotationSensor, SensorManager.SENSOR_DELAY_UI)
        } else {
            if (accelerometerSensor != null) {
                sensorManager?.registerListener(this, accelerometerSensor, SensorManager.SENSOR_DELAY_UI)
            }
            if (magneticSensor != null) {
                sensorManager?.registerListener(this, magneticSensor, SensorManager.SENSOR_DELAY_UI)
            }
        }
    }

    private fun unregisterSensors() {
        sensorsRegistered = false
        sensorManager?.unregisterListener(this)
    }

    override fun onSizeChanged(w: Int, h: Int, oldw: Int, oldh: Int) {
        super.onSizeChanged(w, h, oldw, oldh)
        centerX = w / 2
        centerY = h / 2
        radius = w.coerceAtMost(h) * 0.4f
    }

    override fun onMeasure(widthMeasureSpec: Int, heightMeasureSpec: Int) {
        val widthMode = MeasureSpec.getMode(widthMeasureSpec)
        val widthSize = MeasureSpec.getSize(widthMeasureSpec)

        val size = when (widthMode) {
            MeasureSpec.EXACTLY -> widthSize
            MeasureSpec.AT_MOST -> minOf(widthSize, (200 * resources.displayMetrics.density).toInt())
            else -> (200 * resources.displayMetrics.density).toInt() // 默认200dp
        }

        setMeasuredDimension(size, size)
    }

    override fun onDraw(canvas: Canvas) {
        super.onDraw(canvas)

        // 绘制雷达圆环 - 不随设备方向变化
        radarPoint.style = Paint.Style.STROKE
        for (i in 1..3) {
            val circleRadius = radius * i / 3
            canvas.drawCircle(centerX.toFloat(), centerY.toFloat(), circleRadius, radarPoint)
        }

        // 绘制雷达线 - 不随设备方向变化
        for (angle in 0 until 360 step 90) {
            val x = centerX + radius * cos(Math.toRadians(angle.toDouble())).toFloat()
            val y = centerY + radius * sin(Math.toRadians(angle.toDouble())).toFloat()
            canvas.drawLine(centerX.toFloat(), centerY.toFloat(), x, y, radarPoint)
        }

        // 绘制卫星点 - 根据设备朝向调整
        for (satellite in satellites) {
            // 根据设备朝向调整卫星方位角
            val adjustedAzimuth = if (useDeviceOrientation) {
                // 这里是关键 - 从卫星的方位角中减去设备的方位角
                val angle = (satellite.azimuth - currentAzimuth) % 360
                if (angle < 0) angle + 360 else angle
            } else {
                satellite.azimuth
            }

            val satelliteRadius = radius * (1 - satellite.elevation / 90f)
            val x = centerX + satelliteRadius * sin(Math.toRadians(adjustedAzimuth.toDouble())).toFloat()
            val y = centerY - satelliteRadius * cos(Math.toRadians(adjustedAzimuth.toDouble())).toFloat()
            satellite.screenX = x
            satellite.screenY = y

            // 设置卫星点大小和颜色
            val pointSize = 5f + (satellite.snr / 20f).coerceAtMost(10f)

            // 根据是否用于定位改变颜色
            if (satellite.usedInFix) {
                satellitePaint.color = usedColor
            } else {
                satellitePaint.color = visibleColor
            }

            canvas.drawCircle(x, y, pointSize, satellitePaint)

            // 画卫星PRN编号
            // 注释掉的代码可以取消注释以显示卫星编号
            // val textWidth = satellitePaint.measureText(satellite.prn.toString())
            // val textX = x - textWidth / 2
            // canvas.drawText(satellite.prn.toString(), textX, y + 20, satellitePaint)
        }
    }

    override fun onTouchEvent(event: MotionEvent?): Boolean {
        if (event == null) return super.onTouchEvent(event)
        return when (event.actionMasked) {
            MotionEvent.ACTION_DOWN -> true
            MotionEvent.ACTION_MOVE, MotionEvent.ACTION_CANCEL -> true
            MotionEvent.ACTION_UP -> {
                performClick()
                satellites.firstOrNull { distance(event.x, event.y, it.screenX, it.screenY) < 20 }
                    ?.let { Log.d("SatelliteRadarView", "Touched satellite $it") }
                true
            }
            else -> super.onTouchEvent(event)
        }
    }

    override fun performClick(): Boolean {
        super.performClick()
        setUseDeviceOrientation(!useDeviceOrientation)
        return true
    }

    private fun distance(x: Float, y: Float, x1: Float, y1: Float): Double {
        return sqrt((x - x1) * (x - x1) + (y - y1) * (y - y1).toDouble())
    }

    fun setSatellites(satellites: List<SatelliteData>) {
        this.satellites = satellites
        invalidate()
    }

    // 设置是否使用设备朝向
    fun setUseDeviceOrientation(use: Boolean) {
        this.useDeviceOrientation = use
        invalidate()
    }

    // SensorEventListener接口实现
    override fun onSensorChanged(event: SensorEvent) {
        when (event.sensor.type) {
            Sensor.TYPE_ROTATION_VECTOR -> {
                // 使用旋转矢量传感器
                rotationVector = event.values.clone()
                updateOrientation()
            }
            Sensor.TYPE_ACCELEROMETER -> {
                // 使用加速度传感器
                accelerometerValues = event.values.clone()
                updateOrientation()
            }
            Sensor.TYPE_MAGNETIC_FIELD -> {
                // 使用磁场传感器
                magneticFieldValues = event.values.clone()
                updateOrientation()
            }
        }
    }

    private fun updateOrientation() {
        if (rotationSensor != null) {
            // 使用旋转矢量计算方位角
            val rotationMatrix = FloatArray(9)
            val orientationValues = FloatArray(3)

            SensorManager.getRotationMatrixFromVector(rotationMatrix, rotationVector)
            SensorManager.getOrientation(rotationMatrix, orientationValues)

            // 将弧度转换为角度并调整为0-360度范围
            val azimuthInRadians = orientationValues[0]
            var azimuthInDegrees = Math.toDegrees(azimuthInRadians.toDouble()).toFloat()
            if (azimuthInDegrees < 0) {
                azimuthInDegrees += 360f
            }

            // 更新当前方位角
            if (Math.abs(azimuthInDegrees - currentAzimuth) > 1) {
                currentAzimuth = azimuthInDegrees
                invalidate()
            }
        } else if (accelerometerSensor != null && magneticSensor != null) {
            // 使用加速度和磁场传感器计算方位角
            val rotationMatrix = FloatArray(9)
            val orientationValues = FloatArray(3)

            val success = SensorManager.getRotationMatrix(
                rotationMatrix,
                null,
                accelerometerValues,
                magneticFieldValues
            )

            if (success) {
                SensorManager.getOrientation(rotationMatrix, orientationValues)

                // 将弧度转换为角度并调整为0-360度范围
                val azimuthInRadians = orientationValues[0]
                var azimuthInDegrees = Math.toDegrees(azimuthInRadians.toDouble()).toFloat()
                if (azimuthInDegrees < 0) {
                    azimuthInDegrees += 360f
                }

                // 更新当前方位角（添加一定阈值避免频繁刷新）
                if (abs(azimuthInDegrees - currentAzimuth) > 1) {
                    currentAzimuth = azimuthInDegrees
                    invalidate()
                }
            }
        }
    }

    override fun onAccuracyChanged(sensor: Sensor?, accuracy: Int) {
        // 可以根据传感器精度变化采取相应措施
    }
}
```

`app/src/main/java/com/system/location/service/backend/mock/AndroidGmsMockPort.kt`:

```kt
package com.system.location.service.backend.mock

import android.annotation.SuppressLint
import android.content.Context
import com.google.android.gms.common.ConnectionResult
import com.google.android.gms.common.GoogleApiAvailability
import com.google.android.gms.location.LocationServices
import com.google.android.gms.tasks.Task
import com.google.android.gms.tasks.Tasks
import com.system.location.service.core.location.LocationSample
import com.system.location.service.core.providers.ProviderSample
import com.system.location.service.ext.gmsMockEnabled
import com.system.location.service.ext.experimentalClearMockFlag
import java.util.concurrent.Executor

@SuppressLint("MissingPermission")
class AndroidGmsMockPort(context: Context) : FusedMockPort {
    private val context = context.applicationContext
    private val journal = context.getSharedPreferences("gms_mock_ownership", Context.MODE_PRIVATE)
    private val client by lazy { LocationServices.getFusedLocationProviderClient(this.context) }
    private val flag = MockFlagExperiment()
    private val available by lazy { GoogleApiAvailability.getInstance().isGooglePlayServicesAvailable(context) == ConnectionResult.SUCCESS }
    private val session = GmsMockSession(this.context.gmsMockEnabled, { available }, object : GmsOwnership {
        override val pending get() = journal.getBoolean("pending", false)
        override fun record(pending: Boolean) {
            check(journal.edit().putBoolean("pending", pending).commit()) { "GMS 所有权记录保存失败" }
        }
    }, { enabled -> TaskOperation(client.setMockMode(enabled)) }, { sample: ProviderSample ->
        val location = sample.toLocation("fused")
        if (this.context.experimentalClearMockFlag) flag.clear(location)
        TaskOperation(client.setMockLocation(location))
    }, { android.os.SystemClock.elapsedRealtimeNanos() })

    override val capability get() = session.capability
    override fun diagnostics() = session.diagnostics()
    override suspend fun prepare() = session.prepare()
    override suspend fun start() = session.start()
    override suspend fun publish(sample: LocationSample) = session.publish(sample)
    override suspend fun publish(sample: ProviderSample) = session.publish(sample)
    override suspend fun stop() = session.stop()

    private class TaskOperation(val task: Task<Void>) : GmsOperation {
        override val isComplete get() = task.isComplete
        override val isSuccessful get() = task.isSuccessful
        override val failure get() = task.exception
        override fun then(action: () -> GmsOperation?): GmsOperation = TaskOperation(
            task.continueWithTask(DIRECT) { (action() as? TaskOperation)?.task ?: Tasks.forResult<Void>(null) })
    }
    companion object { private val DIRECT = Executor { it.run() } }
}
```

`app/src/main/java/com/system/location/service/backend/mock/AndroidMockProviderPort.kt`:

```kt
package com.system.location.service.backend.mock

import android.app.AppOpsManager
import android.content.Context
import android.location.LocationManager
import android.location.provider.ProviderProperties
import android.os.CancellationSignal
import android.os.Handler
import android.os.Looper
import android.os.Process
import android.util.Log
import com.system.location.service.core.backend.BackendDiagnostic
import com.system.location.service.core.location.LocationSample
import com.system.location.service.core.providers.ProviderKind
import com.system.location.service.core.providers.ProviderMixer
import com.system.location.service.core.providers.ProviderSample
import com.system.location.service.ext.experimentalClearMockFlag
import com.system.location.service.ext.platformFusedEnabled

/** Standard mock APIs, with an opt-in local reflection experiment before submission. */
class AndroidMockProviderPort(context: Context) : MockProviderPort {
    private val context = context.applicationContext
    private val manager = context.getSystemService(LocationManager::class.java)
    private val journal = context.getSharedPreferences("mock_provider_ownership", Context.MODE_PRIVATE)
    private val mockFlagExperiment = MockFlagExperiment()
    @Volatile private var lastFlagOutcome: MockFlagExperiment.Outcome? = null
    private var experimentWasEnabled = false
    override fun optionalProviders() = if (context.platformFusedEnabled) setOf("fused") else emptySet()
    override fun diagnostics(): List<BackendDiagnostic> {
        val enabled = context.experimentalClearMockFlag
        val outcome = lastFlagOutcome
        return listOf(BackendDiagnostic("PLATFORM_FUSED", if (context.platformFusedEnabled) "EXPERIMENTAL" else "DISABLED",
            "系统 fused Test Provider：${if (context.platformFusedEnabled) "已选择，实际状态见所有权及异常记录" else "已关闭"}；与 Google 融合定位通道独立"), BackendDiagnostic("MOCK_FLAG_EXPERIMENT",
            if (!enabled) "DISABLED" else if (outcome == null) "PENDING" else if (outcome.invoked) "LOCAL_ONLY" else "UNAVAILABLE",
            if (!enabled) "提交前反射清除实验已关闭" else outcome?.detail ?: "实验已开启，等待定位提交",
            "Android 可能重新标记 mock；不能据此判断高德是否接受定位"))
    }
    override fun permissionGranted() = context.getSystemService(AppOpsManager::class.java)
        .unsafeCheckOpNoThrow(AppOpsManager.OPSTR_MOCK_LOCATION, Process.myUid(), context.packageName) == AppOpsManager.MODE_ALLOWED
    override fun pendingProviders(): Set<String> = journal.getStringSet("providers", emptySet())!!.toSet()
    private fun record(providers: Set<String>) {
        check(journal.edit().putStringSet("providers", providers).commit()) { "无法保存 Provider 清理记录" }
    }
    private fun requireAuthorization(operation: String) {
        if (!permissionGranted()) throw MockAuthorizationException(operation)
    }
    override fun register(provider: String) {
        requireAuthorization("注册 $provider 前")
        record(pendingProviders() + provider)
        manager.addTestProvider(provider, ProviderProperties.Builder()
            .setHasNetworkRequirement(provider == LocationManager.NETWORK_PROVIDER)
            .setHasSatelliteRequirement(provider == LocationManager.GPS_PROVIDER)
            .setHasAltitudeSupport(true).setHasSpeedSupport(true).setHasBearingSupport(true)
            .setPowerUsage(ProviderProperties.POWER_USAGE_LOW)
            .setAccuracy(ProviderProperties.ACCURACY_FINE).build())
        requireAuthorization("注册 $provider 后")
    }
    override fun enable(provider: String, enabled: Boolean) {
        requireAuthorization("设置 $provider 前")
        manager.setTestProviderEnabled(provider, enabled)
        requireAuthorization("设置 $provider 后")
    }
    override fun publish(provider: String, sample: LocationSample) {
        val kind = when (provider) {
            LocationManager.GPS_PROVIDER -> ProviderKind.GPS
            LocationManager.NETWORK_PROVIDER -> ProviderKind.NETWORK
            "fused" -> ProviderKind.FUSED
            else -> error("No provider model for $provider")
        }
        val providerSample = ProviderMixer(useSampleAccuracy = true).mix(sample)[kind]
            ?: error("No provider model for $provider")
        publish(provider, providerSample)
    }
    override fun publish(provider: String, sample: ProviderSample) {
        requireAuthorization("提交 $provider 前")
        val location = sample.toLocation(provider)
        val enabled = context.experimentalClearMockFlag
        if (enabled) {
            val outcome = mockFlagExperiment.clear(location)
            if (!experimentWasEnabled || outcome != lastFlagOutcome) {
                Log.i("MockFlagExperiment", outcome.detail)
            }
            lastFlagOutcome = outcome
        } else {
            lastFlagOutcome = null
        }
        experimentWasEnabled = enabled
        try { manager.setTestProviderLocation(provider, location) }
        catch (error: IllegalArgumentException) {
            val message = error.message.orEmpty().lowercase(java.util.Locale.ROOT)
            if (listOf("not a test provider", "doesn't exist", "does not exist", "unknown provider").any { message.contains(it) }) throw MissingMockProviderException(provider, error)
            throw error
        }
        requireAuthorization("提交 $provider 后")
    }
    override fun remove(provider: String) {
        requireAuthorization("清理 $provider 前")
        try { manager.removeTestProvider(provider) }
        catch (_: IllegalArgumentException) { /* Already removed by Android; cleanup is idempotent. */ }
        // A denied/no-op removal must not discard the durable cleanup obligation.
        requireAuthorization("清理 $provider 后")
        record(pendingProviders() - provider)
    }

    /**
     * Removing a test provider does not invalidate the platform's cached fix. Ask each real
     * provider for one current location so a subsequent getLastKnownLocation is hardware-backed.
     */
    override fun flushRealLocation() {
        val handler = Handler(Looper.getMainLooper())
        listOf(
            LocationManager.NETWORK_PROVIDER,
            LocationManager.GPS_PROVIDER,
            LocationManager.PASSIVE_PROVIDER,
        ).forEach { provider ->
            val enabled = runCatching { manager.isProviderEnabled(provider) }.getOrDefault(false)
            if (!enabled) return@forEach
            val signal = CancellationSignal()
            handler.postDelayed({ runCatching { signal.cancel() } }, FLUSH_TIMEOUT_MS)
            try {
                manager.getCurrentLocation(provider, signal, context.mainExecutor) { _ ->
                    // The provider's own last-location cache is updated by the platform.
                }
            } catch (_: SecurityException) {
                // A best-effort cache refresh must not fail provider cleanup.
            } catch (_: Exception) {
                // Providers can disappear while cleanup is in progress.
            }
        }
    }

    private companion object {
        const val FLUSH_TIMEOUT_MS = 15_000L
    }
}
```

`app/src/main/java/com/system/location/service/backend/mock/AndroidPhysicalLocationRecovery.kt`:

```kt
package com.system.location.service.backend.mock

import android.annotation.SuppressLint
import android.content.Context
import android.location.Location
import android.location.LocationListener
import android.location.LocationManager
import android.os.Looper
import android.os.SystemClock
import kotlinx.coroutines.*
import kotlinx.coroutines.channels.Channel

/** Best-effort physical fixes, not a cache purge. A new session cancels every old callback. */
class AndroidPhysicalLocationRecovery(
    context: Context,
    private val scope: CoroutineScope,
    private val report: suspend (String, String) -> Unit,
) : PhysicalLocationRecovery {
    private val manager = context.getSystemService(LocationManager::class.java)
    private var job: Job? = null

    @Synchronized override fun cancel() { job?.cancel(); job = null }

    @Synchronized override fun request() {
        cancel()
        job = scope.launch {
            val since = SystemClock.elapsedRealtimeNanos()
            val outcomes = supervisorScope {
                listOf("gps", "network").map { provider -> async { recover(provider, since) } }.awaitAll()
            }
            ensureActive()
            report(if (outcomes.any { it.endsWith(":FRESH") }) "SUCCESS" else "UNKNOWN",
                "停止后真实定位请求：${outcomes.joinToString()}；不代表其他应用缓存已刷新")
        }
    }

    @SuppressLint("MissingPermission")
    private suspend fun recover(provider: String, since: Long): String = withContext(Dispatchers.Main.immediate) {
        val fixes = Channel<Location>(Channel.CONFLATED)
        val listener = object : LocationListener {
            override fun onLocationChanged(location: Location) {
                if (!location.isMock && location.elapsedRealtimeNanos >= since) fixes.trySend(location)
            }
        }
        try {
            if (!manager.isProviderEnabled(provider)) return@withContext "$provider:DISABLED"
            manager.requestLocationUpdates(provider, 1000L, 0f, listener, Looper.getMainLooper())
            val fix = withTimeoutOrNull(10_000) { fixes.receive() }
            "$provider:${if (fix == null) "TIMEOUT" else "FRESH"}"
        } catch (cancelled: CancellationException) {
            throw cancelled
        } catch (_: SecurityException) {
            "$provider:NO_PERMISSION"
        } catch (_: IllegalArgumentException) {
            "$provider:UNAVAILABLE"
        } catch (error: RuntimeException) {
            "$provider:ERROR_${error.javaClass.simpleName}"
        } finally {
            runCatching { manager.removeUpdates(listener) }
            fixes.close()
        }
    }
}
```

`app/src/main/java/com/system/location/service/backend/mock/FusedMockBackend.kt`:

```kt
package com.system.location.service.backend.mock

import com.system.location.service.core.backend.*
import com.system.location.service.core.location.LocationSample
import com.system.location.service.core.providers.ProviderKind
import com.system.location.service.core.providers.ProviderMixer
import com.system.location.service.core.providers.ProviderSample
import kotlinx.coroutines.CancellationException

interface FusedMockPort {
    val capability: CapabilityStatus
    fun diagnostics(): List<BackendDiagnostic>
    suspend fun prepare()
    suspend fun start()
    suspend fun publish(sample: LocationSample)
    suspend fun publish(sample: ProviderSample) = publish(sample.sample)
    suspend fun stop()
}

/** The optional GMS channel may degrade; mandatory providers and cleanup remain authoritative. */
class FusedMockBackend(private val base: LocationBackend, private val fused: FusedMockPort) : LocationBackend {
    private var useFused = false
    private var failure: String? = null
    private val providerMixer = ProviderMixer(useSampleAccuracy = true)
    override val type get() = base.type
    override val capabilities get() = base.capabilities + (Capability.GMS_FUSED to fused.capability)
    override suspend fun diagnose() = base.diagnose() + fused.diagnostics() + listOfNotNull(failure?.let { BackendDiagnostic("GMS_DEGRADED", "UNAVAILABLE", it) })
    override suspend fun prepare(): BackendResult {
        val result = base.prepare()
        if (result is BackendResult.Failure) return result
        failure = null
        return try { fused.prepare(); BackendResult.Success }
        catch (cancelled: CancellationException) { throw cancelled }
        catch (error: Exception) { BackendResult.Failure("GMS_CLEANUP", error.message ?: "GMS 残留清理失败", "恢复 Google Play 服务及模拟位置授权后重试停止") }
    }
    override suspend fun start(): BackendResult {
        val result = base.start()
        if (result is BackendResult.Failure) return result
        useFused = false
        try { fused.start(); useFused = true }
        catch (cancelled: CancellationException) { throw cancelled }
        catch (error: Exception) { degrade(error, "GMS 通道启动失败，继续使用标准 Provider") }
        return BackendResult.Success
    }
    override suspend fun publish(sample: LocationSample, scenarioId: String?): BackendResult {
        val result = base.publish(sample, scenarioId)
        if (result is BackendResult.Failure) return result
        if (useFused) try {
            val providerSample = providerMixer.mix(sample)[ProviderKind.FUSED]
            if (providerSample == null) fused.publish(sample) else fused.publish(providerSample)
        }
        catch (cancelled: CancellationException) { throw cancelled }
        catch (error: Exception) { degrade(error, "GMS 提交失败，继续使用标准 Provider") }
        return BackendResult.Success
    }
    private suspend fun degrade(error: Exception, fallback: String) {
        useFused = false
        failure = error.message ?: fallback
        // A stale fused mock fix can mask healthy platform providers: disable it on degradation.
        try { fused.stop() }
        catch (cancelled: CancellationException) { throw cancelled }
        catch (cleanup: Exception) { failure += "; GMS 清理待重试：${cleanup.message}" }
    }
    override suspend fun pause() = base.pause()
    override suspend fun resume() = base.resume()
    override suspend fun stop(): BackendResult {
        useFused = false
        val result = base.stop()
        return try { fused.stop(); result }
        catch (cancelled: CancellationException) { throw cancelled }
        catch (error: Exception) { BackendResult.Failure("GMS_CLEANUP", error.message ?: "GMS 清理未完成", "恢复 Google Play 服务及模拟位置授权后重试停止") }
    }
    override suspend fun release() = stop()
}
```

`app/src/main/java/com/system/location/service/backend/mock/GmsMockSession.kt`:

```kt
package com.system.location.service.backend.mock

import com.system.location.service.core.backend.*
import com.system.location.service.core.location.LocationSample
import com.system.location.service.core.providers.ProviderKind
import com.system.location.service.core.providers.ProviderMixer
import com.system.location.service.core.providers.ProviderSample
import kotlinx.coroutines.*

/** Task seam: production wraps the GMS Task; tests control completion without Android. */
internal interface GmsOperation {
    val isComplete: Boolean
    val isSuccessful: Boolean
    val failure: Exception?
    fun then(action: () -> GmsOperation?): GmsOperation
}
internal interface GmsOwnership {
    val pending: Boolean
    fun record(pending: Boolean)
}

/** Owns the actual GMS lifecycle, including submission coalescing and cleanup ordering. */
internal class GmsMockSession(
    private val requested: Boolean,
    private val available: () -> Boolean,
    private val ownership: GmsOwnership,
    private val setMode: (Boolean) -> GmsOperation,
    private val submit: (ProviderSample) -> GmsOperation,
    private val nanos: () -> Long,
    private val timeoutMs: Long = 2000,
) : FusedMockPort {
    private val generationLock = Any()
    private var generation = 0L
    // Timeouts only end our wait; the remote operation may still change mock mode later.
    // Retain enable, disable, and chained compensation Tasks until every one is terminal.
    private val modeOperations = mutableListOf<GmsOperation>()
    private var publishing: GmsOperation? = null
    private var active = false
    private var detail = "等待启动"
    private var submitted = 0L
    private var coalesced = 0L
    private var lastSuccessNanos: Long? = null
    private var publishStarted = 0L
    override val capability get() = when {
        !requested -> CapabilityStatus(Availability.REQUIRES_ACTION, "可选 GMS 通道已关闭，在设置中启用")
        !available() -> CapabilityStatus(Availability.UNAVAILABLE, "此设备没有可用的 Google Play 服务")
        active -> CapabilityStatus(Availability.AVAILABLE, "Google 融合定位 Mock 已启用；不代表目标 App 采用")
        else -> CapabilityStatus(Availability.EXPERIMENTAL, detail)
    }
    override fun diagnostics() = listOf(BackendDiagnostic("GMS_FUSED", when {
        active -> "AVAILABLE"; !requested -> "DISABLED"; !available() -> "UNAVAILABLE"; else -> "EXPERIMENTAL"
    }, "$detail；已请求=$submitted；合并跳过=$coalesced；最近成功单调时间=${lastSuccessNanos?.div(1_000_000) ?: 0}ms；待清理=${ownership.pending}"))
    override suspend fun prepare() { if (ownership.pending) stop() }
    override suspend fun start() {
        if (!requested) { detail = "用户关闭 GMS 通道"; return }
        if (!available()) { detail = "Google Play 服务不可用，使用标准 Provider"; return }
        check(!ownership.pending) { "GMS 清理尚未完成，先重试停止" }
        val token = synchronized(generationLock) { ++generation }
        ownership.record(true)
        val enabling = synchronized(generationLock) { setMode(true).also { modeOperations += it } }
        try {
            await(enabling)
            active = true; detail = "GMS Mock 已启用"
        } catch (error: Exception) {
            active = false; detail = "GMS 启动未完成：${error.message}"
            // Track the continuation too: enable may be complete before its callback runs.
            synchronized(generationLock) {
                modeOperations += enabling.then {
                    synchronized(generationLock) {
                        if (generation == token) setMode(false).also { modeOperations += it } else null
                    }
                }
            }
            throw error
        }
    }
    override suspend fun publish(sample: LocationSample) {
        val providerSample = ProviderMixer().mix(sample)[ProviderKind.FUSED] ?: return
        publish(providerSample)
    }
    override suspend fun publish(sample: ProviderSample) {
        if (!active) return
        publishing?.let { task ->
            if (!task.isComplete) {
                coalesced++
                if (nanos() - publishStarted > 2_000_000_000) {
                    active = false; detail = "GMS 提交超时，标准 Provider 继续运行"; throw IllegalStateException(detail)
                }
                return
            }
            if (!task.isSuccessful) { active = false; detail = "GMS 提交失败：${task.failure?.message}"; throw IllegalStateException(detail) }
            lastSuccessNanos = publishStarted
        }
        publishStarted = nanos()
        publishing = submit(sample)
        submitted++
    }
    override suspend fun stop() {
        active = false
        if (!ownership.pending) return
        check(available()) { "Google Play 服务不可用，保留待清理记录" }
        // Publication can remain pending forever. Disable is independent of that Task.
        val disable = synchronized(generationLock) {
            // Every retry gets a fresh attempt, without forgetting older remote operations.
            modeOperations.removeAll { it.isComplete }
            setMode(false).also { modeOperations += it }
        }
        await(disable)
        synchronized(generationLock) {
            check(modeOperations.all { it.isComplete }) { "GMS 模式操作仍未完成，保留迟到清理和所有权" }
            ownership.record(false)
            generation++
            modeOperations.clear()
        }
        publishing = null
        detail = "GMS Mock 已停止"
    }
    private suspend fun await(task: GmsOperation) {
        val complete = withTimeoutOrNull(timeoutMs) { while (!task.isComplete) delay(1); true } ?: false
        check(complete) { "GMS 操作超时" }
        check(task.isSuccessful) { task.failure?.message ?: "GMS 操作失败或取消" }
    }
}
```

`app/src/main/java/com/system/location/service/backend/mock/MockFlagExperiment.kt`:

```kt
package com.system.location.service.backend.mock

import android.location.Location

/** Only changes the outgoing object. Android may mark it mock again after submission. */
class MockFlagExperiment {
    data class Outcome(val invoked: Boolean, val detail: String)
    private data class Attempt(val name: String, val clear: ((Location) -> Unit)?, val failure: String?)

    // Resolve once, not on every 50 ms publication. No hidden-API exemption is requested.
    private val attempts by lazy {
        listOf("setMock", "setIsFromMockProvider").map { name ->
            try {
                val method = Location::class.java.getDeclaredMethod(name, Boolean::class.javaPrimitiveType)
                method.isAccessible = true
                Attempt(name, { location -> method.invoke(location, false) }, null)
            } catch (error: Exception) {
                Attempt(name, null, error.javaClass.simpleName)
            }
        } + try {
            val field = Location::class.java.getDeclaredField("mIsFromMockProvider")
            field.isAccessible = true
            Attempt("mIsFromMockProvider", { location -> field.setBoolean(location, false) }, null)
        } catch (error: Exception) {
            Attempt("mIsFromMockProvider", null, error.javaClass.simpleName)
        }
    }

    fun clear(location: Location): Outcome {
        val before = location.isMock
        val failures = mutableListOf<String>()
        for (attempt in attempts) {
            val action = attempt.clear
            if (action == null) {
                failures += "${attempt.name}: ${attempt.failure}"
                continue
            }
            try {
                action(location)
                if (!location.isMock) return Outcome(true,
                    "${attempt.name} 调用完成；提交前 isMock=$before → false；仅本地对象，不代表系统或高德收到的标记")
                failures += "${attempt.name}: 标记仍为 true"
            } catch (error: Exception) {
                failures += "${attempt.name}: ${error.javaClass.simpleName}"
            }
        }
        return Outcome(false, "反射清除不可用；提交前 isMock=$before → ${location.isMock}；" + failures.joinToString("; "))
    }
}
```

`app/src/main/java/com/system/location/service/backend/mock/MockProviderBackend.kt`:

```kt
package com.system.location.service.backend.mock

import com.system.location.service.core.backend.*
import com.system.location.service.core.location.LocationSample
import com.system.location.service.core.providers.ProviderKind
import com.system.location.service.core.providers.ProviderMixer
import com.system.location.service.core.providers.ProviderSample

/** Android operations are injected so partial registration and cleanup can be tested on the JVM. */
interface MockProviderPort {
    fun optionalProviders(): Set<String> = emptySet()
    fun diagnostics(): List<BackendDiagnostic> = emptyList()
    fun permissionGranted(): Boolean
    fun pendingProviders(): Set<String>
    fun register(provider: String)
    fun enable(provider: String, enabled: Boolean)
    fun publish(provider: String, sample: LocationSample)
    fun publish(provider: String, sample: ProviderSample) = publish(provider, sample.sample)
    fun remove(provider: String)
    /** Ask the real hardware/network providers for one fresh fix after the test provider goes away. */
    fun flushRealLocation() {}
}

class MissingMockProviderException(provider: String, cause: Exception? = null) : IllegalStateException("模拟 Provider 丢失: $provider", cause)
class MockAuthorizationException(operation: String) : SecurityException("模拟位置授权已失效（$operation）；请恢复授权后重新启动场景")

class MockProviderBackend(private val port: MockProviderPort) : LocationBackend {
    enum class Phase { IDLE, PREPARED, RUNNING, PAUSED, STOPPED, ERROR }
    var phase = Phase.IDLE
        private set
    private val owned = linkedSetOf<String>()
    private val lastRecovery = mutableMapOf<String, Long>()
    private var recoveryCount = 0
    private val optionalFailures = mutableMapOf<String, String>()
    private val providerMixer = ProviderMixer(useSampleAccuracy = true)
    override val type = BackendType.MOCK_PROVIDER
    override suspend fun diagnose() = listOf(
        BackendDiagnostic("MOCK_PERMISSION", if (port.permissionGranted()) "AVAILABLE" else "REQUIRES_ACTION",
            "标准模拟位置授权；Provider 状态：$phase", "在开发者选项中选择本应用"),
        BackendDiagnostic("PROVIDER_OWNERSHIP", "INFO", "待清理 Provider：${port.pendingProviders().joinToString().ifEmpty { "无" }}"),
        BackendDiagnostic("PROVIDER_RECOVERY", "INFO", "本次会话重新注册次数：$recoveryCount（仅恢复明确丢失的 Provider；最多3次）")) +
        optionalFailures.map { BackendDiagnostic("OPTIONAL_${it.key.uppercase()}", "UNAVAILABLE", it.value) } + port.diagnostics()
    override val capabilities get() = Capability.entries.associateWith {
        when (it) {
            Capability.STANDARD_MOCK -> CapabilityStatus(
                if (runCatching { port.permissionGranted() }.getOrDefault(false)) Availability.AVAILABLE else Availability.REQUIRES_ACTION,
                "仅 Android 标准模拟位置；请在开发者选项中选择本应用为模拟位置信息应用")
            Capability.BACKGROUND_PLAYBACK -> CapabilityStatus(Availability.AVAILABLE, "定位前台服务；受系统电源策略影响")
            Capability.GMS_FUSED -> CapabilityStatus(Availability.UNAVAILABLE, "未集成 GMS mock API，不能保证 Google 融合定位采纳标准 Provider")
            else -> CapabilityStatus(Availability.UNAVAILABLE, "标准 Mock Provider 不提供 Hook 能力")
        }
    }

    override suspend fun prepare(): BackendResult {
        if (phase in setOf(Phase.RUNNING, Phase.PAUSED)) return failure("PREPARE", "请先停止运行中的场景")
        return guarded("PREPARE") {
            if (!port.permissionGranted()) return@guarded failure("CHECK_MOCK_PERMISSION", "未获得标准模拟位置授权")
            owned += port.pendingProviders()
            if (owned.isNotEmpty()) {
                val cleanup = cleanup()
                if (cleanup is BackendResult.Failure) return@guarded cleanup
            }
            phase = Phase.PREPARED
            BackendResult.Success
        }
    }

    override suspend fun start(): BackendResult {
        if (phase != Phase.PREPARED) return failure("START_PROVIDER", "后端尚未准备完成")
        return guarded("START_PROVIDER") {
            requireAuthorization("启动 Provider")
            for (provider in listOf("gps", "network")) {
                // Track attempted registration too: a platform operation may fail after allocating.
                owned += provider
                port.register(provider)
                port.enable(provider, true)
            }
            optionalFailures.clear()
            for (provider in port.optionalProviders().filter { it == "fused" }) {
                try { owned += provider; port.register(provider); port.enable(provider, true) }
                catch (error: Exception) {
                    optionalFailures[provider] = "可选通道启动失败：${error.message}；GPS/Network 继续运行"
                    // Retain ownership on cleanup failure so stop can retry it.
                    runCatching { port.remove(provider) }.onSuccess { owned.remove(provider) }
                }
            }
            phase = Phase.RUNNING
            lastRecovery.clear()
            recoveryCount = 0
            BackendResult.Success
        }
    }

    override suspend fun publish(sample: LocationSample, scenarioId: String?): BackendResult {
        if (phase !in setOf(Phase.RUNNING, Phase.PAUSED)) return failure("PUBLISH", "Provider 未启动")
        return guarded("PUBLISH") {
            requireAuthorization("提交位置")
            val fix = if (phase == Phase.PAUSED) sample.copy(speed = 0f) else sample
            owned.toList().filterNot { it in optionalFailures }.forEach { provider ->
                requireAuthorization("提交 $provider 前")
                try {
                    val providerFix = providerMixer.mix(fix)[providerKind(provider)]
                    if (providerFix == null) port.publish(provider, fix)
                    else publishWithRecovery(provider, providerFix)
                    requireAuthorization("提交 $provider 后")
                }
                catch (error: Exception) {
                    if (error is MockAuthorizationException) throw error
                    if (provider != "fused") throw error
                    optionalFailures[provider] = "可选通道提交失败：${error.message}；GPS/Network 继续运行"
                    runCatching { port.remove(provider) }.onSuccess { owned.remove(provider) }
                }
            }
            BackendResult.Success
        }
    }
    private fun providerKind(provider: String): ProviderKind = when (provider) {
        "gps" -> ProviderKind.GPS
        "network" -> ProviderKind.NETWORK
        "fused" -> ProviderKind.FUSED
        else -> ProviderKind.GPS
    }

    private fun publishWithRecovery(provider: String, fix: ProviderSample) {        try { port.publish(provider, fix) }
        catch (missing: MissingMockProviderException) {
            val previous = lastRecovery[provider]
            if (!port.permissionGranted() || recoveryCount >= 3 ||
                previous != null && fix.sample.elapsedNanos - previous < 5_000_000_000) throw missing
            lastRecovery[provider] = fix.sample.elapsedNanos
            recoveryCount++
            port.register(provider)
            port.enable(provider, true)
            port.publish(provider, fix)
        }
    }
    override suspend fun pause(): BackendResult {
        if (phase != Phase.RUNNING) return failure("PAUSE", "场景不在运行状态")
        phase = Phase.PAUSED
        return BackendResult.Success
    }
    override suspend fun resume(): BackendResult {
        if (phase != Phase.PAUSED) return failure("RESUME", "场景尚未暂停")
        phase = Phase.RUNNING
        return BackendResult.Success
    }
    override suspend fun stop(): BackendResult {
        owned += port.pendingProviders().filter { it in setOf("gps", "network", "fused") }
        return cleanup()
    }
    override suspend fun release(): BackendResult = stop()
    private fun requireAuthorization(operation: String) {
        if (!port.permissionGranted()) throw MockAuthorizationException(operation)
    }

    private inline fun guarded(stage: String, action: () -> BackendResult): BackendResult = try { action() }
    catch (error: Exception) {
        val cleanup = cleanup()
        phase = Phase.ERROR
        failure(if (error is MockAuthorizationException) "MOCK_PERMISSION_REVOKED" else stage, (error.message ?: error.javaClass.simpleName) +
            if (cleanup is BackendResult.Failure) "; 清理未完成: ${cleanup.reason}" else "")
    }
    private fun cleanup(): BackendResult {
        val errors = mutableListOf<String>()
        val hadProviders = owned.isNotEmpty()
        owned.toList().asReversed().forEach { provider ->
            // Removal restores the original provider even when disabling it fails.
            runCatching { port.enable(provider, false) }
            try { port.remove(provider); owned.remove(provider) }
            catch (error: Exception) { errors += "$provider: ${error.message ?: error.javaClass.simpleName}" }
        }
        // A test provider leaves its last fix in the platform cache. Wake the real providers so
        // applications that read getLastKnownLocation after stopping do not keep the fake fix.
        if (hadProviders) runCatching { port.flushRealLocation() }
        phase = if (errors.isEmpty()) Phase.STOPPED else Phase.ERROR
        return if (errors.isEmpty()) BackendResult.Success else failure("CLEANUP_PROVIDER", errors.joinToString("; "))
    }
    private fun failure(stage: String, reason: String) = BackendResult.Failure(stage, reason,
        "开发者选项 → 选择模拟位置信息应用 → LocationService；恢复授权后重试停止/启动")
}
```

```kt
package com.system.location.service.backend.mock

import android.location.Location
import android.os.Build
import com.system.location.service.core.providers.ProviderFieldMask
import com.system.location.service.core.providers.ProviderSample

/** A fresh Location keeps absent fields unset without calling newer platform removal APIs. */
internal fun ProviderSample.toLocation(provider: String): Location {
    val view = this
    val mslAltitudeMeters = view.mslAltitudeMeters
    return Location(provider).apply {
        latitude = view.sample.latitude
        longitude = view.sample.longitude
        accuracy = view.sample.accuracy
        time = view.sample.timeMillis
        elapsedRealtimeNanos = view.sample.elapsedNanos

        if (view.has(ProviderFieldMask.ALTITUDE)) altitude = view.sample.altitude
        if (view.has(ProviderFieldMask.SPEED)) speed = view.sample.speed
        if (view.has(ProviderFieldMask.BEARING)) bearing = view.sample.bearing

        if (view.has(ProviderFieldMask.VERTICAL_ACCURACY)) {
            verticalAccuracyMeters = view.verticalAccuracyMeters ?: view.sample.accuracy
        }
        if (view.has(ProviderFieldMask.SPEED_ACCURACY)) {
            speedAccuracyMetersPerSecond = view.speedAccuracyMps ?: 0f
        }
        if (view.has(ProviderFieldMask.BEARING_ACCURACY)) {
            bearingAccuracyDegrees = view.bearingAccuracyDeg ?: 0f
        }
        if (view.has(ProviderFieldMask.ELAPSED_REALTIME_UNCERTAINTY)) {
            elapsedRealtimeUncertaintyNanos = view.elapsedRealtimeUncertaintyNanos?.toDouble() ?: 0.0
        }
        if (Build.VERSION.SDK_INT >= Build.VERSION_CODES.UPSIDE_DOWN_CAKE &&
            view.has(ProviderFieldMask.MSL_ALTITUDE) && mslAltitudeMeters != null) {
            this.mslAltitudeMeters = mslAltitudeMeters
        }
    }
}
```

`app/src/main/java/com/system/location/service/backend/mock/RecoveringMockBackend.kt`:

```kt
package com.system.location.service.backend.mock

import com.system.location.service.core.backend.*

interface PhysicalLocationRecovery {
    fun cancel()
    fun request()
}

/** Recovery starts only after both mock channels stop, and never changes cleanup success. */
class RecoveringMockBackend(
    private val delegate: LocationBackend,
    private val recovery: PhysicalLocationRecovery,
) : LocationBackend by delegate {
    private var started = false

    override suspend fun prepare(): BackendResult {
        recovery.cancel()
        return delegate.prepare()
    }

    override suspend fun start(): BackendResult = delegate.start().also {
        if (it is BackendResult.Success) started = true
    }

    override suspend fun stop(): BackendResult = delegate.stop().also {
        if (it is BackendResult.Success && started) {
            started = false
            recovery.request()
        }
    }

    override suspend fun release() = stop()
}
```

`app/src/main/java/com/system/location/service/backend/native/NativeBackend.kt`:

```kt
package com.system.location.service.backend.native

import android.content.Context
import android.location.LocationManager
import com.system.location.service.backend.xposed.XposedBackend
import com.system.location.service.core.backend.*
import com.system.location.service.core.location.LocationSample
import com.system.location.service.service.MockServiceHelper

/** Optional sensor extension around Xposed; it is not an independent location publisher. */
class NativeBackend(private val context: Context) : LocationBackend {
    private val xposed = XposedBackend(context)
    private val manager = context.getSystemService(LocationManager::class.java)
    private var sensorsEnabled = false
    override val type = BackendType.NATIVE
    override suspend fun diagnose() = xposed.diagnose() + BackendDiagnostic("NATIVE", "EXPERIMENTAL",
        "Native 依赖 Xposed；当前实例传感器启用状态：$sensorsEnabled", "符号安装成功不等于 ROM 行为已验证")
    override val capabilities get() = xposed.capabilities + mapOf(
        Capability.NATIVE to CapabilityStatus(Availability.EXPERIMENTAL, "需要 Root 与 Xposed；固定符号、偏移，未进行设备兼容性验证"),
        Capability.SENSOR_SIMULATION to CapabilityStatus(Availability.EXPERIMENTAL, "停止只禁用行为；已安装的 Native Hook 需重启系统才能卸载"))
    override suspend fun prepare(): BackendResult {
        if (!context.getSharedPreferences("scenario_runtime", Context.MODE_PRIVATE).getBoolean("native_opt_in", false))
            return BackendResult.Failure("NATIVE_OPT_IN", "尚未启用实验性 Native 后端", "在后端页面阅读限制并明确选择")
        val connected = xposed.prepare()
        if (connected is BackendResult.Failure) return connected
        val installed = NativeLibraryInstaller.install(context)
        if (installed is BackendResult.Failure) return installed
        val loaded = MockServiceHelper.loadLibrary(manager, NativeLibraryInstaller.DESTINATION)
        if (loaded != "success") return BackendResult.Failure("NATIVE_LOAD", loaded ?: "系统进程拒绝加载", "检查 Root/SELinux 和 ABI，或改用 Xposed 后端")
        if (!MockServiceHelper.prepareNative(manager)) return BackendResult.Failure("NATIVE_SYMBOLS",
            "当前 ROM 缺少所需符号，或 Hook 安装失败", "改用 Xposed 后端；Native 不保证兼容当前系统")
        // Keep the mapping, remove the named file: root can no longer read or re-open it.
        NativeLibraryInstaller.removeInstalled()
        return BackendResult.Success
    }
    override suspend fun start(): BackendResult {
        val started = xposed.start()
        if (started is BackendResult.Failure) return started
        sensorsEnabled = MockServiceHelper.setNativeEnabled(manager, true)
        if (!sensorsEnabled) return BackendResult.Failure(
            "NATIVE_ENABLE", "无法启用 Native 传感器", "停止后重试或改用 Xposed 后端"
        )
        return BackendResult.Success
    }
    override suspend fun publish(sample: LocationSample, scenarioId: String?): BackendResult {
        val published = xposed.publish(sample, scenarioId)
        if (published is BackendResult.Failure) return published
        if (!sensorsEnabled) {
            sensorsEnabled = MockServiceHelper.setNativeEnabled(manager, true)
            if (!sensorsEnabled) return BackendResult.Failure("NATIVE_ENABLE", "无法启用 Native 实验行为", "停止后重试或改用 Xposed")
        }
        return BackendResult.Success
    }
    override suspend fun pause() = xposed.pause()
    override suspend fun resume() = xposed.resume()
    override suspend fun stop(): BackendResult {
        val stopped = xposed.stop() // stop also disables native in system_server.
        if (stopped is BackendResult.Success) sensorsEnabled = false
        return stopped
    }
    override suspend fun release() = stop()
}
```

`app/src/main/java/com/system/location/service/backend/native/NativeLibraryInstaller.kt`:

```kt
package com.system.location.service.backend.native

import android.content.Context
import android.os.Build
import com.system.location.service.core.backend.BackendResult
import java.io.File
import java.util.concurrent.TimeUnit

/** Explicit experimental path; never changes SELinux policy or grants world write access. */
object NativeLibraryInstaller {
    const val DESTINATION = "/data/local/ext-lib/liblocationext.so"
    private const val ASSET = "liblocationext.bin"
    private val KEY = byteArrayOf(
        0xA7.toByte(), 0x3C, 0x91.toByte(), 0x5E,
        0xD2.toByte(), 0x44, 0xBB.toByte(), 0x6F,
    )

    /** Decode encrypted payload to app-private cache; removed after the privileged copy. */
    private fun decodedAsset(context: Context): File? = runCatching {
        val encoded = context.assets.open(ASSET).use { it.readBytes() }
        require(encoded.size > 64)
        val decoded = ByteArray(encoded.size) { index ->
            (encoded[index].toInt() xor KEY[index % KEY.size].toInt()).toByte()
        }
        File(context.cacheDir, "liblocationext.so").apply { writeBytes(decoded) }
    }.getOrNull()

    fun install(context: Context): BackendResult {
        if (Build.SUPPORTED_ABIS.firstOrNull() != "arm64-v8a") return BackendResult.Failure("NATIVE_ABI",
            "当前 Native 路径只评估 arm64 固定符号布局", "改用标准 Mock 或 Xposed 后端")
        val decoded = decodedAsset(context)
        val source = decoded ?: File(context.applicationInfo.nativeLibraryDir, "liblocationext.so")
        if (!source.isFile) {
            decoded?.delete()
            return BackendResult.Failure("NATIVE_LIBRARY", "APK 中未找到 Native 库", "检查安装包 ABI")
        }
        fun quote(path: String) = "'" + path.replace("'", "'\\''") + "'"
        val directory = "/data/local/ext-lib"
        val temporary = "$DESTINATION.tmp"
        // Only root and system_server (gid 1000) need access; target apps must not read the
        // payload, and /data/local/tmp must never retain a copy.
        val script = "umask 077 && test ! -L ${quote(directory)} && test ! -L ${quote(temporary)} && " +
            "mkdir -p ${quote(directory)} && chmod 0710 ${quote(directory)} && " +
            "chown 0:1000 ${quote(directory)} && " +
            "cp ${quote(source.absolutePath)} ${quote(temporary)} && chmod 0650 ${quote(temporary)} && " +
            "chown 0:1000 ${quote(temporary)} && " +
            "chcon u:object_r:system_file:s0 ${quote(temporary)} 2>/dev/null || true; " +
            "mv -f ${quote(temporary)} ${quote(DESTINATION)}"
        return try {
            val process = ProcessBuilder("su", "-c", script).redirectErrorStream(true).start()
            try {
                if (!process.waitFor(20, TimeUnit.SECONDS)) {
                    process.destroyForcibly()
                    BackendResult.Failure("NATIVE_ROOT", "Root 授权或复制超时", "授权后重试，或改用其他后端")
                } else if (process.exitValue() == 0) BackendResult.Success
                else BackendResult.Failure("NATIVE_COPY", process.inputStream.bufferedReader().readText().take(1000),
                    "检查 Root 授权和系统访问策略；不会自动关闭 SELinux")
            } finally { process.inputStream.close(); process.outputStream.close(); process.errorStream.close() }
        } catch (error: Exception) { BackendResult.Failure("NATIVE_ROOT", error.message ?: "无法运行 su", "选择无 Root 模式或配置 Root") }
        finally { decoded?.delete() }
    }

    /** Remove the named copy after System.load; the mapping remains valid but the file is gone. */
    fun removeInstalled(): Boolean = runCatching {
        val process = ProcessBuilder(
            "su", "-c", "rm -f '$DESTINATION'; rmdir '/data/local/ext-lib' 2>/dev/null || true",
        ).redirectErrorStream(true).start()
        process.waitFor(10, TimeUnit.SECONDS) && process.exitValue() == 0
    }.getOrDefault(false)
}
```

`app/src/main/java/com/system/location/service/backend/xposed/ReplayActivation.kt`:

```kt
package com.system.location.service.backend.xposed

/** Apply both values, including false, so switches cannot leak from a previous session. */
internal object ReplayActivation {
    fun apply(
        environment: Boolean,
        satellite: Boolean,
        setEnvironment: (Boolean) -> Boolean,
        setSatellite: (Boolean) -> Boolean,
    ): Boolean {
        if (!setEnvironment(environment)) return false
        return setSatellite(satellite)
    }
}
```

`app/src/main/java/com/system/location/service/backend/xposed/XposedBackend.kt`:

```kt
package com.system.location.service.backend.xposed

import android.content.Context
import android.content.Intent
import android.content.IntentFilter
import android.location.LocationManager
import android.os.BatteryManager
import android.os.Debug
import android.os.SystemClock
import com.system.location.service.core.backend.*
import com.system.location.service.core.location.LocationSample
import com.system.location.service.core.performance.PerformanceProbe
import com.system.location.service.ext.mockWifiEnabled
import com.system.location.service.ext.sensorTargetPackages
import com.system.location.service.gnss.gnssReplayOnStart
import com.system.location.service.gnss.gnssReplayProblem
import com.system.location.service.gnss.applySatelliteStartupDefaults
import com.system.location.service.ext.sharedPrefs
import com.system.location.service.hook.security.SampleWire
import com.system.location.service.service.MockServiceHelper

/** The scenario runtime owns movement. One authenticated IPC sends each immutable fix. */
class XposedBackend(private val context: Context) : LocationBackend {
    private val manager = context.getSystemService(LocationManager::class.java)
    private val publishProbe = PerformanceProbe()
    private var previousCpuMillis = 0L
    private var previousCpuWallMillis = 0L
    private var connected = false
    override val type = BackendType.XPOSED
    override suspend fun diagnose(): List<BackendDiagnostic> {
        if (!MockServiceHelper.isServiceInit()) MockServiceHelper.tryInitService(manager)
        val status = MockServiceHelper.runtimeStatus(manager)
        connected = status?.getInt("sample_version")?.let(SampleWire::isCompatible) == true
        if (!connected) return listOf(BackendDiagnostic("REMOTE_COMMAND", "FAILED", "未连接兼容的系统模块", "启用系统作用域，安装当前版本并重启"))
        val scope = status!!.getString("hook_scope") ?: "unknown"
        val expected = status.getInt("hook_expected")
        val missing = status.getInt("hook_missing")
        val missingPoints = status.getStringArrayList("hook_missing_points").orEmpty()
        val publishSamples = status.getInt("publish_samples", 0)
        val latency = if (publishSamples > 0) {
            val p50 = status.getLong("publish_p50_nanos") / 1_000_000.0
            val p95 = status.getLong("publish_p95_nanos") / 1_000_000.0
            val max = status.getLong("publish_max_nanos") / 1_000_000.0
            BackendDiagnostic(
                "PUBLISH_LATENCY",
                if (p95 > 100.0) "WARN" else "INFO",
                "n=$publishSamples · p50=%.1f ms · p95=%.1f ms · max=%.1f ms".format(p50, p95, max),
            )
        } else null
        val appLatency = publishProbe.snapshot()?.let { stats ->
            BackendDiagnostic(
                "APP_PUBLISH_LATENCY",
                if (stats.p95Nanos > 100_000_000L) "WARN" else "INFO",
                "n=${stats.samples} · p50=%.1f ms · p95=%.1f ms · max=%.1f ms".format(
                    stats.p50Nanos / 1_000_000.0,
                    stats.p95Nanos / 1_000_000.0,
                    stats.maxNanos / 1_000_000.0,
                ),
            )
        }
        val memory = Debug.MemoryInfo().also { Debug.getMemoryInfo(it) }
        val runtime = Runtime.getRuntime()
        val heapUsedMb = (runtime.totalMemory() - runtime.freeMemory()) / (1024 * 1024)
        val heapMaxMb = runtime.maxMemory() / (1024 * 1024)
        val appMemory = BackendDiagnostic(
            "APP_MEMORY",
            "INFO",
            "pss=${memory.totalPss / 1024} MB · heap=$heapUsedMb/$heapMaxMb MB",
        )
        val cpuMillis = android.os.Process.getElapsedCpuTime()
        val wallMillis = SystemClock.elapsedRealtime()
        val cpuPercent = if (previousCpuWallMillis > 0L && wallMillis > previousCpuWallMillis) {
            (cpuMillis - previousCpuMillis).coerceAtLeast(0L) * 100.0 / (wallMillis - previousCpuWallMillis)
        } else 0.0
        previousCpuMillis = cpuMillis
        previousCpuWallMillis = wallMillis
        val appCpu = BackendDiagnostic("APP_CPU", "INFO", "cpu=%.1f%% (since last diagnose)".format(cpuPercent))
        val batteryIntent = context.registerReceiver(null, IntentFilter(Intent.ACTION_BATTERY_CHANGED))
        val level = batteryIntent?.getIntExtra(BatteryManager.EXTRA_LEVEL, -1) ?: -1
        val scale = batteryIntent?.getIntExtra(BatteryManager.EXTRA_SCALE, -1) ?: -1
        val batteryPercent = if (level >= 0 && scale > 0) level * 100 / scale else -1
        val batteryTemp = (batteryIntent?.getIntExtra(BatteryManager.EXTRA_TEMPERATURE, 0) ?: 0) / 10.0
        val battery = BackendDiagnostic(
            "BATTERY",
            "INFO",
            "level=${if (batteryPercent >= 0) "$batteryPercent%" else "unknown"} · temp=%.1f°C".format(batteryTemp),
        )
        return listOf(BackendDiagnostic("REMOTE_COMMAND", "CONNECTED", "system_server 远程通道已连接"),
            BackendDiagnostic("HOOK_SUMMARY", "INFO", "system_server：installed=${status.getInt("hook_installed")}, matched=${status.getInt("hook_matched")}, skipped=${status.getInt("hook_skipped")}, failed=${status.getInt("hook_failed")}"),
            BackendDiagnostic("HOOK_OWNERSHIP", if (missing == 0) "INFO" else "WARN",
                "scope=$scope · expected=$expected · missing=$missing" +
                    if (missingPoints.isEmpty()) "" else " · ${missingPoints.joinToString(", ")}"),
            BackendDiagnostic("LAST_PUBLISH", "INFO", "系统侧最近发布时间：${status.getLong("last_publish")}; 启用状态：${status.getBoolean("is_start")}")) +
            listOfNotNull(latency) +
            listOfNotNull(appLatency) +
            listOf(appMemory) +
            listOf(appCpu) +
            listOf(battery) +
            status.getStringArrayList("hook_details").orEmpty().take(60).map { BackendDiagnostic("HOOK_POINT", "INFO", it) }
    }
    override val capabilities get() = Capability.entries.associateWith { capability ->
        when (capability) {
            Capability.XPOSED, Capability.GNSS_INJECTION -> CapabilityStatus(
                if (connected) Availability.AVAILABLE else Availability.REQUIRES_ACTION,
                "需要在框架中启用 system_server 作用域；Hook 命中仍取决于设备")
            Capability.BACKGROUND_PLAYBACK -> CapabilityStatus(Availability.AVAILABLE, "由定位前台服务运行")
            Capability.SENSOR_SIMULATION -> CapabilityStatus(
                if (context.sensorTargetPackages.isEmpty()) Availability.REQUIRES_ACTION else Availability.EXPERIMENTAL,
                "需在设置和框架中选择目标应用并重启应用；仅 Java 传感器队列，不需 Native")
            else -> CapabilityStatus(Availability.UNAVAILABLE, "当前后端未提供此能力")
        }
    }
    override suspend fun prepare(): BackendResult {
        MockServiceHelper.tryInitService(manager)
        connected = MockServiceHelper.isServiceInit()
        if (!connected) return checked(false, "CONNECT", "启用 Xposed 模块的系统作用域并重启设备")
        val status = MockServiceHelper.runtimeStatus(manager)
        if (status?.getInt("sample_version")?.let(SampleWire::isCompatible) != true) {
            connected = false
            return BackendResult.Failure("PROTOCOL", "已加载的系统模块不支持统一定位快照", "安装当前版本并重启设备")
        }
        context.applySatelliteStartupDefaults(status.getString("hook_scope") == "SYSTEM_SERVER" &&
            status.getInt("hook_installed") > 0)
        context.gnssReplayProblem()?.let { return BackendResult.Failure("GNSS_CAPTURE", it, "重新采集或在快捷回放中选择目标天空") }
        if (!MockServiceHelper.setNativeEnabled(manager, false)) {
            return BackendResult.Failure("NATIVE_DISABLE", "无法关闭之前的 Native 传感器", "重新连接系统模块后重试")
        }
        return checked(MockServiceHelper.putConfig(manager, context), "CONFIGURE", "检查系统服务连接")
    }
    override suspend fun start(): BackendResult {
        return checked(activateReplay(context, manager), "REPLAY_START", "检查系统模块连接后重试")
    }
    override suspend fun publish(sample: LocationSample, scenarioId: String?): BackendResult {
        val started = SystemClock.elapsedRealtimeNanos()
        return try {
            checked(MockServiceHelper.publishSample(manager, sample, scenarioId),
                "PUBLISH", "检查模块是否仍启用")
        } finally {
            publishProbe.record((SystemClock.elapsedRealtimeNanos() - started).coerceAtLeast(0L))
        }
    }
    override suspend fun stop(): BackendResult {
        if (!connected) {
            MockServiceHelper.tryInitService(manager)
            connected = MockServiceHelper.isServiceInit()
        }
        if (!connected) return checked(false, "STOP", "重新连接系统服务后重试停止")
        val stopped = MockServiceHelper.tryCloseMock(manager)
        return checked(stopped, "STOP", "重新连接系统服务后重试停止")
    }
    override suspend fun release() = stop()
    private fun checked(ok: Boolean, stage: String, suggestion: String) =
        if (ok) BackendResult.Success else BackendResult.Failure(stage, "Xposed 远程命令失败", suggestion)
}

/** Used under the runtime command lock for live changes, and during backend startup. */
internal fun activateReplay(context: Context, manager: LocationManager): Boolean = ReplayActivation.apply(
    context.mockWifiEnabled, context.gnssReplayOnStart && context.sharedPrefs.getString("gnssSimulationMode", "AUTONOMOUS") != "OFF",
    setEnvironment = { enabled ->
        val accepted = if (enabled) MockServiceHelper.startWifiMock(manager) else MockServiceHelper.stopWifiMock(manager)
        accepted && MockServiceHelper.isWifiMockStart(manager) == enabled
    },
    setSatellite = { enabled ->
        val accepted = if (enabled) MockServiceHelper.startGnssMock(manager) else MockServiceHelper.stopGnssMock(manager)
        accepted && MockServiceHelper.isGnssMockStart(manager) == enabled
    },
)
```

`app/src/main/java/com/system/location/service/bdmap/Poi.kt`:

```kt
package com.system.location.service.bdmap

import kotlin.math.atan2
import kotlin.math.cos
import kotlin.math.sin
import kotlin.math.sqrt

data class Poi(
    val name: String,
    var address: String,
    val longitude: Double,
    val latitude: Double,

    val tag: String,
) {
    companion object {
        const val KEY_NAME = "name"
        const val KEY_ADDRESS = "address"
        const val KEY_LONGITUDE = "longitude"
        const val KEY_LATITUDE = "latitude"
        const val KEY_LONGITUDE_RAW = "longitude_raw"
        const val KEY_LATITUDE_RAW = "latitude_raw"
        const val KEY_TAG = "tag"
    }

    fun toMap(): Map<String, String> {
        return mapOf(
            KEY_NAME to name,
            KEY_ADDRESS to address,
            KEY_LONGITUDE to longitude.toString().take(5),
            KEY_LATITUDE to latitude.toString().take(5),
            KEY_TAG to tag,
            KEY_LONGITUDE_RAW to longitude.toString(),
            KEY_LATITUDE_RAW to latitude.toString(),
        )
    }

    /**
     * Calculate the distance between two points on the Earth's surface.
     * @param other The other point.
     * @return The distance in meters.
     */
    fun distanceTo(other: Poi): Double {
        val earthRadius = 6371000.0
        val dLat = Math.toRadians(other.latitude - latitude)
        val dLng = Math.toRadians(other.longitude - longitude)
        val a = sin(dLat / 2) * sin(dLat / 2) +
                cos(Math.toRadians(latitude)) * cos(Math.toRadians(other.latitude)) *
                sin(dLng / 2) * sin(dLng / 2)
        val c = 2 * atan2(sqrt(a), sqrt(1 - a))
        return earthRadius * c
    }

    fun distanceTo(lat: Double, lng: Double): Double {
        val earthRadius = 6371000.0
        val dLat = Math.toRadians(lat - latitude)
        val dLng = Math.toRadians(lng - longitude)
        val a = sin(dLat / 2) * sin(dLat / 2) +
                cos(Math.toRadians(latitude)) * cos(Math.toRadians(lat)) *
                sin(dLng / 2) * sin(dLng / 2)
        val c = 2 * atan2(sqrt(a), sqrt(1 - a))
        return earthRadius * c
    }
}
```
