`app/src/main/java/com/system/location/service/data/persistence/AtomicDocumentStore.kt`:

```kt
package com.system.location.service.data.persistence

import android.util.AtomicFile
import com.system.location.service.core.repository.DocumentStore
import com.system.location.service.core.repository.VersionedRepository
import java.io.File
import java.io.FileNotFoundException
import java.io.ByteArrayOutputStream

class AtomicDocumentStore(file: File) : DocumentStore {
    private val file = AtomicFile(file)
    @Synchronized override fun read(): String? = try {
        file.openRead().use { input ->
            val output = ByteArrayOutputStream()
            val buffer = ByteArray(8192)
            while (true) {
                val count = input.read(buffer)
                if (count < 0) break
                require(output.size() + count <= VersionedRepository.MAX_DOCUMENT_CHARS * 4) { "File exceeds library size limit" }
                output.write(buffer, 0, count)
            }
            output.toByteArray().toString(Charsets.UTF_8)
        }
    } catch (_: FileNotFoundException) { null }
    @Synchronized override fun writeAtomically(text: String) {
        val stream = file.startWrite()
        try { stream.write(text.toByteArray(Charsets.UTF_8)); file.finishWrite(stream) }
        catch (error: Throwable) { file.failWrite(stream); throw error }
    }
}
```

`app/src/main/java/com/system/location/service/data/persistence/CarrierIdentityPreferences.kt`:

```kt
package com.system.location.service.data.persistence

import android.content.SharedPreferences
import com.system.location.service.core.carrier.CarrierIdentityCodec
import com.system.location.service.core.carrier.CarrierIdentityConfig
import java.security.SecureRandom

/** Assign once in the controller, persist before publication, and send the same value to peers. */
object CarrierIdentityPreferences {
    private val random = SecureRandom()

    fun seedMissing(config: CarrierIdentityConfig, occupiedIds: Set<Int> = emptySet()): CarrierIdentityConfig {
        val assigned = (occupiedIds + config.sims.map { it.virtualSubscriptionId }).toMutableSet()
        return config.copy(sims = config.sims.map { profile ->
            var seed = profile.identitySeed
            if (seed == 0L) do { seed = random.nextLong() } while (seed == 0L)
            var id = profile.virtualSubscriptionId
            if (id == 0) {
                val available = (1..65535).filterNot { it in assigned }
                check(available.isNotEmpty()) { "No virtual subscription ID available" }
                id = available[random.nextInt(available.size)]
                assigned.add(id)
            }
            profile.copy(identitySeed = seed, virtualSubscriptionId = id)
        })
    }

    fun occupiedIds(context: android.content.Context): Set<Int> = try {
        context.getSystemService(android.telephony.SubscriptionManager::class.java)
            ?.activeSubscriptionInfoList.orEmpty().map { it.subscriptionId }.toSet()
    } catch (_: SecurityException) {
        emptySet()
    }

    @Synchronized
    fun migrate(preferences: SharedPreferences, occupiedIds: Set<Int> = emptySet()): CarrierIdentityConfig? {
        val raw = preferences.getString("carrierIdentityJson", "").orEmpty()
        if (raw.isBlank()) return null
        val config = CarrierIdentityCodec.decode(raw)
        if (config.sims.none { it.identitySeed == 0L || it.virtualSubscriptionId == 0 }) return config
        val seeded = seedMissing(config, occupiedIds)
        check(preferences.edit().putString("carrierIdentityJson", CarrierIdentityCodec.encode(seeded)).commit()) {
            "Unable to persist SIM identity seeds"
        }
        return seeded
    }
}
```

`app/src/main/java/com/system/location/service/data/persistence/CoordinatePreferences.kt`:

```kt
package com.system.location.service.data.persistence

/** Small storage boundary: migrated latitude and longitude are committed together. */
class CoordinatePreferences(
    private val read: () -> Map<String, *>,
    private val write: (Map<String, Any>) -> Unit,
) {
    fun get(key: String): Double {
        migrate()
        return (read()[key] as? String)?.toDoubleOrNull()?.takeIf { it.isFinite() } ?: 0.0
    }

    fun set(key: String, value: Double) {
        require(key in keys)
        require(value.isFinite() && value in if (key == LATITUDE) -90.0..90.0 else -180.0..180.0)
        migrate()
        write(mapOf(key to value.toString()))
    }

    private fun migrate() {
        val values = read()
        val version = values[VERSION] as? Int ?: 0
        require(version in 0..1) { "Unsupported coordinate schema: $version" }
        if (version == 1) return
        val migrated = mutableMapOf<String, Any>(VERSION to 1)
        keys.forEach { key ->
            val old = values[key]
            val number = when (old) {
                is Number -> old.toDouble()
                is String -> old.toDoubleOrNull()
                else -> null
            }
            migrated[key] = (number?.takeIf { it.isFinite() } ?: 0.0).toString()
        }
        write(migrated)
    }

    companion object {
        const val LATITUDE = "last_known_lat"
        const val LONGITUDE = "last_known_lng"
        const val VERSION = "coordinate_schema_version"
        private val keys = setOf(LATITUDE, LONGITUDE)
    }
}
```

```kt
package com.system.location.service.data.persistence

import com.system.location.service.core.environment.EnvironmentConfig
import com.system.location.service.core.gnss.GnssFrame
import com.system.location.service.core.gnss.GnssSimulationPolicy
import com.system.location.service.core.location.LocationSanitizer
import com.system.location.service.core.runtime.RuntimeSnapshot

/** Build one full wire batch from one SharedPreferences.all and one runtime fallback snapshot. */
object HookConfigurationPreferences {
    fun read(preferences: Map<String, *>, fallback: RuntimeSnapshot): Map<String, Any?> {
        val policy = fallback.configuration
        fun flag(key: String, default: Boolean) = preferences[key]?.let { it as Boolean } ?: default
        fun number(key: String, default: Float) = preferences[key]?.let { it as Float } ?: default
        fun integer(key: String, default: Int) = preferences[key]?.let { it as Int } ?: default
        fun text(key: String, default: String = "") = preferences[key]?.let { it as String } ?: default
        val interval = integer("reportDuration", 100).toLong().coerceIn(50, 1000)
        return mapOf(
            "altitude" to number("altitude", 0f).toDouble(),
            "speed" to number("speed", fallback.speedMps.toFloat()).toDouble(),
            "accuracy" to number("accuracy", LocationSanitizer.DEFAULT_HORIZONTAL_ACCURACY)
                .coerceIn(0.1f, 10_000f),
            "report_interval" to if (flag("loopBroadcastLocation", false)) interval else maxOf(500L, interval),
            // `disableWifiScan` is a legacy key whose historical true value
            // actually enabled replacement. Prefer the canonical key when it
            // exists, while preserving upgrades from older installations.
            "enable_mock_wifi" to (preferences["enableMockWifi"] as? Boolean
                ?: flag("disableWifiScan", policy.wifiEnabled)),
            "enable_debug_log" to flag("debug", policy.debugLog),
            "disable_get_current_location" to flag("disableGetCurrentLocation", policy.disableGetCurrentLocation),
            "disable_register_location_listener" to flag("disableRegitserLocationListener", policy.disableRegisterLocationListener),
            "disable_fused_location" to flag("disableFusedProvider", policy.disableFusedLocation),
            "need_downgrade_to_2g" to flag("needDowngradeToCdma", policy.downgradeToCdma),
            "enable_nmea" to flag("enableNMEA", true),
            "hide_mock" to flag("hideMock", policy.hideMock),
            "carrier_identity_enabled" to flag("carrierIdentityEnabled", policy.carrierIdentityEnabled),
            "carrier_identity_json" to text("carrierIdentityJson").takeIf { it.isNotBlank() },
            "experimental_anti_detect" to flag("antiDetectEnabled", policy.antiDetectEnabled),
            "experimental_stack_trace" to flag("stackTraceCleanEnabled", policy.stackTraceCleanEnabled),
            "experimental_stack_trace_replace" to flag("stackTraceReplaceEnabled", policy.stackTraceReplaceEnabled),
            "sensor_cadence_scale" to number("sensorCadenceScale", 1f).toDouble(),
            "sensor_variation" to number("sensorVariation", 0.15f).toDouble(),
            "sensor_targets" to text("sensorTargetPackages"),
            "disable_request_geofence" to !flag("enableRequestGeofence", !policy.disableRequestGeofence),
            "disable_get_from_location" to !flag("enableGetFromLocation", !policy.disableGetFromLocation),
            "enable_physical_noise" to flag("physicalNoise", fallback.physicalNoise),
            "sim_ready" to flag("simReady", true),
            "environment_ap_count" to integer("environmentApCount", 4)
                .coerceIn(EnvironmentConfig.MIN_AP_PER_CELL, EnvironmentConfig.MAX_AP_PER_CELL),
            "cell_mode" to text("cellMode", "FULL_REPLAY"),
            "environment_source" to text("environmentSourceMode", "AUTO"),
            "wifi_fingerprint_enabled" to flag("wifiFingerprintEnabled", false),
            // Full synchronization explicitly clears removed values; partial commands omit keys.
            "wifi_fingerprint_json" to text("wifiFingerprintCatalogJson").takeIf { it.isNotBlank() },
            "routing_json" to text("routingJson").takeIf { it.isNotBlank() },
            "environment_json" to text("environmentReplayJson").takeIf { it.isNotBlank() },
        ) + readGnss(preferences, fallback)
    }

    /** Same wire defaults for local prediction and configuration, independent of unrelated settings. */
    fun readGnss(preferences: Map<String, *>, fallback: RuntimeSnapshot): Map<String, Any> {
        val policy = fallback.configuration.gnssSimulation
        fun text(key: String, default: String) = preferences[key]?.let { it as String } ?: default
        return mapOf(
            "min_satellites" to (preferences["minSatelliteCount"]?.let { it as Int } ?: GnssSimulationPolicy.DEFAULT_MINIMUM_SATELLITES)
                .coerceIn(0, GnssFrame.MAX_SATELLITES),
            "gnss_mode" to text("gnssSimulationMode", policy.mode.name),
            "gnss_minimum_policy" to text("gnssMinimumPolicy", policy.minimumPolicy.name),
            "gnss_environment" to text("gnssSimulationEnvironment", policy.environment.name),
            "gnss_virtual_seed" to (preferences["gnssVirtualSeed"]?.let { it as Long } ?: policy.virtualSeed),
        )
    }
}
```

```kt
package com.system.location.service.data.repository

import android.content.Context
import com.system.location.service.LocationServiceApp
import com.system.location.service.core.geo.Wgs84
import com.system.location.service.core.repository.*
import com.system.location.service.core.scenario.Route
import com.system.location.service.data.persistence.AtomicDocumentStore
import com.system.location.service.ui.mock.HistoricalLocation
import com.system.location.service.ui.mock.HistoricalRoute
import com.system.location.service.ui.mock.RouteJson
import kotlinx.serialization.json.*
import java.io.File
import java.util.UUID

fun stableRecordId(kind: String, value: String): String = UUID.nameUUIDFromBytes("$kind:$value".toByteArray(Charsets.UTF_8)).toString()
fun HistoricalRoute.toSaved() = SavedRoute(Route(id, name, route.map { Wgs84(it.first, it.second) }), mode, favorite)
fun SavedRoute.toHistorical() = HistoricalRoute(route.name, route.points.map { it.latitude to it.longitude }, route.id, mode, favorite)
fun HistoricalLocation.toSaved() = SavedLocation(id, name, Wgs84(lat, lon), address, favorite)
fun SavedLocation.toHistorical() = HistoricalLocation(name, address, coordinate.latitude, coordinate.longitude, id, favorite)

data class LegacyMigration(val routes: List<SavedRoute>, val locations: List<SavedLocation>, val issues: List<String>)
object LegacyLibraryMigration {
    fun decode(routeJson: String?, rawLocations: Set<String>): LegacyMigration {
        val routes = mutableListOf<SavedRoute>(); val locations = mutableListOf<SavedLocation>(); val issues = mutableListOf<String>()
        if (!routeJson.isNullOrBlank()) runCatching {
            val root = Json.parseToJsonElement(routeJson)
            val entries = if (root is JsonObject) {
                require(root["schemaVersion"]?.jsonPrimitive?.intOrNull == 1) { "未知旧路线版本" }
                root["routes"]!!.jsonArray
            } else root.jsonArray
            entries.forEachIndexed { index, entry ->
                runCatching { RouteJson.decodeRoute(entry.toString())!!.toSaved() }
                    .onSuccess { saved ->
                        routes += if (routes.any { it.route.id == saved.route.id })
                            saved.copy(route = saved.route.copy(id = stableRecordId("duplicate-route", "$index:$entry"))) else saved
                    }.onFailure { issues += "旧路线 ${index + 1}: ${it.message}" }
            }
        }.onFailure { issues += "旧路线库: ${it.message}" }
        rawLocations.sorted().forEachIndexed { index, text ->
            runCatching { HistoricalLocation.fromString(text).toSaved() }
                .onSuccess { if (locations.none { old -> old.id == it.id }) locations += it }
                .onFailure { issues += "旧位置 ${index + 1}: ${it.message}" }
        }
        return LegacyMigration(routes, locations, issues)
    }
}

/** Singleton repository instances serialize access to each atomic document. Legacy preferences are retained. */
object LibraryRepositories {
    private val context get() = LocationServiceApp.appContext
    private fun store(name: String) = AtomicDocumentStore(File(context.filesDir, "library/$name.json"))
    val routes by lazy { RouteRepository(store("routes")) }
    val scenarios by lazy { ScenarioRepository(store("scenarios")) }
    val locations by lazy { LocationRepository(store("locations")) }
    @Synchronized fun ensureMigrated() {
        val preferences = context.getSharedPreferences("fused_ext", Context.MODE_PRIVATE)
        if (preferences.getInt("library_migration_version", 0) == 1) return
        val migration = LegacyLibraryMigration.decode(preferences.getString("routes", null), preferences.getStringSet("locations", emptySet())!!.toSet())
        migration.routes.forEach { if (routes.get(it.route.id) == null) routes.create(it) }
        migration.locations.forEach { if (locations.get(it.id) == null) locations.create(it) }
        check(preferences.edit().putStringSet("library_migration_issues", migration.issues.toSet())
            .putInt("library_migration_version", 1).commit()) { "无法保存迁移记录" }
    }
    fun migrationIssues(): Set<String> = context.getSharedPreferences("fused_ext", Context.MODE_PRIVATE)
        .getStringSet("library_migration_issues", emptySet())!!.toSet()
}
```

`app/src/main/java/com/system/location/service/environment/BleScanWindow.kt`:

```kt
package com.system.location.service.environment

import com.system.location.service.core.environment.BleBeacon
import kotlinx.coroutines.CompletableDeferred
import kotlinx.coroutines.CancellationException
import kotlinx.coroutines.coroutineScope
import kotlinx.coroutines.delay
import kotlinx.coroutines.launch

internal suspend fun collectBleScanWindow(
    timeoutMillis: Long,
    maxResults: Int,
    startScan: (onResult: (BleBeacon) -> Unit, onFailure: () -> Unit) -> Unit,
    stopScan: () -> Unit,
): List<BleBeacon> = coroutineScope {
    require(timeoutMillis > 0L && maxResults > 0)
    val completed = CompletableDeferred<List<BleBeacon>>()
    val found = LinkedHashMap<String, BleBeacon>()
    val lock = Any()
    fun snapshot() = synchronized(lock) { found.values.toList() }

    val onResult: (BleBeacon) -> Unit = { beacon ->
        val full = synchronized(lock) {
            val address = beacon.address.lowercase()
            if (address in found || found.size < maxResults) found[address] = beacon
            found.size >= maxResults
        }
        if (full) completed.complete(snapshot())
    }
    var started = false
    try {
        started = true
        startScan(onResult) { completed.complete(snapshot()) }
        val timeout = launch {
            delay(timeoutMillis)
            completed.complete(snapshot())
        }
        try {
            completed.await()
        } finally {
            timeout.cancel()
        }
    } catch (cancelled: CancellationException) {
        throw cancelled
    } catch (_: Exception) {
        snapshot()
    } finally {
        if (started) runCatching(stopScan)
    }
}
```

`app/src/main/java/com/system/location/service/environment/EnvironmentCaptureFreshness.kt`:

```kt
package com.system.location.service.environment

/** Keeps cached radio observations temporally close to the location used to anchor a capture. */
internal object EnvironmentCaptureFreshness {
    const val MAX_FIX_DELTA_NANOS = 15_000_000_000L

    fun matchesFix(sampleElapsedNanos: Long, fixElapsedNanos: Long): Boolean {
        if (sampleElapsedNanos <= 0L || fixElapsedNanos <= 0L) return false
        val delta = if (sampleElapsedNanos >= fixElapsedNanos) {
            sampleElapsedNanos - fixElapsedNanos
        } else {
            fixElapsedNanos - sampleElapsedNanos
        }
        return delta <= MAX_FIX_DELTA_NANOS
    }

    fun wifiTimestampNanos(timestampMicros: Long): Long? =
        timestampMicros.takeIf { it > 0L && it <= Long.MAX_VALUE / 1_000L }?.times(1_000L)

    fun cellTimestampNanos(timestampMillis: Long): Long? =
        timestampMillis.takeIf { it > 0L && it <= Long.MAX_VALUE / 1_000_000L }?.times(1_000_000L)
}
```

`app/src/main/java/com/system/location/service/environment/EnvironmentCaptureLocation.kt`:

```kt
package com.system.location.service.environment

import android.content.Context
import android.location.Location
import android.location.LocationManager
import android.os.CancellationSignal
import android.os.SystemClock
import com.system.location.service.core.geo.Wgs84
import kotlinx.coroutines.suspendCancellableCoroutine
import kotlinx.coroutines.withTimeoutOrNull
import kotlin.coroutines.resume

data class EnvironmentCaptureOrigin(
    val coordinate: Wgs84,
    val accuracyMeters: Double,
    val elapsedRealtimeNanos: Long,
)

class EnvironmentCaptureLocation(private val context: Context) {
    @Suppress("MissingPermission")
    suspend fun current(): EnvironmentCaptureOrigin {
        val manager = context.getSystemService(LocationManager::class.java)
            ?: error("系统定位服务不可用")
        val providers = listOf(LocationManager.GPS_PROVIDER, LocationManager.NETWORK_PROVIDER)
            .filter { provider -> runCatching { manager.isProviderEnabled(provider) }.getOrDefault(false) }
        check(providers.isNotEmpty()) { "请先开启系统定位" }

        for (provider in providers) {
            val location = withTimeoutOrNull(LOCATION_TIMEOUT_MILLIS) { request(manager, provider) }
                ?: continue
            if (isUsable(location, SystemClock.elapsedRealtimeNanos())) {
                return EnvironmentCaptureOrigin(
                    Wgs84(location.latitude, location.longitude),
                    location.accuracy.toDouble(),
                    location.elapsedRealtimeNanos,
                )
            }
        }
        error("未取得新鲜、非模拟且带有效精度的定位，请移至信号良好处重试")
    }

    private suspend fun request(manager: LocationManager, provider: String): Location? =
        suspendCancellableCoroutine { continuation ->
            val signal = CancellationSignal()
            continuation.invokeOnCancellation { signal.cancel() }
            try {
                manager.getCurrentLocation(provider, signal, context.mainExecutor) { location ->
                    if (continuation.isActive) continuation.resume(location)
                }
            } catch (failure: SecurityException) {
                if (continuation.isActive) continuation.resume(null)
            } catch (failure: RuntimeException) {
                if (continuation.isActive) continuation.resume(null)
            }
        }

    private fun isUsable(location: Location, nowElapsedNanos: Long): Boolean {
        if (location.isMock || !location.hasAccuracy()) return false
        val accuracy = location.accuracy
        if (!accuracy.isFinite() || accuracy <= 0f) return false
        val ageNanos = nowElapsedNanos - location.elapsedRealtimeNanos
        return ageNanos in 0..MAX_FIX_AGE_NANOS
    }

    private companion object {
        const val LOCATION_TIMEOUT_MILLIS = 8_000L
        const val MAX_FIX_AGE_NANOS = 15_000_000_000L
    }
}
```

`app/src/main/java/com/system/location/service/environment/EnvironmentCollector.kt`:

```kt
package com.system.location.service.environment

import android.Manifest
import android.bluetooth.BluetoothManager
import android.bluetooth.le.ScanCallback
import android.bluetooth.le.ScanResult as BleScanResult
import android.content.BroadcastReceiver
import android.content.Context
import android.content.Intent
import android.content.IntentFilter
import android.content.pm.PackageManager
import android.net.wifi.WifiManager
import android.net.wifi.ScanResult as WifiScanResult
import android.os.Build
import android.telephony.CellIdentityLte
import android.telephony.CellIdentityNr
import android.telephony.CellIdentity
import android.telephony.CellInfo
import android.telephony.CellInfoCdma
import android.telephony.CellInfoGsm
import android.telephony.CellInfoLte
import android.telephony.CellInfoNr
import android.telephony.CellInfoWcdma
import android.telephony.TelephonyManager
import androidx.core.content.ContextCompat
import com.system.location.service.core.environment.BleBeacon
import com.system.location.service.core.environment.CellTower
import com.system.location.service.core.environment.CellType
import com.system.location.service.core.environment.CellSignalPolicy
import com.system.location.service.core.environment.CdmaTower
import com.system.location.service.core.environment.EnvironmentProfile
import com.system.location.service.core.environment.EnvironmentSourceType
import com.system.location.service.core.environment.WifiAp
import com.system.location.service.core.geo.Wgs84
import kotlinx.coroutines.suspendCancellableCoroutine
import kotlinx.coroutines.withTimeoutOrNull
import java.util.concurrent.atomic.AtomicBoolean
import kotlin.coroutines.resume

/**
 * Captures a public-API WiFi/cell/BLE snapshot for a user-managed environment profile. Every source
 * is best-effort: denied permission or a ROM-specific SecurityException does not fail the capture.
 */
class EnvironmentCollector(private val context: Context) {

    suspend fun capture(
        origin: Wgs84? = null,
        originAccuracyMeters: Double? = null,
        seed: Long = 0L,
        atMillis: Long = System.currentTimeMillis(),
        originElapsedRealtimeNanos: Long? = null,
        onProgress: (String) -> Unit = {},
    ): EnvironmentProfile {
        onProgress("正在读取蜂窝小区…")
        val cells = captureCells(originElapsedRealtimeNanos)
        onProgress("正在扫描 Wi-Fi…")
        val wifi = captureWifi(originElapsedRealtimeNanos)
        onProgress("正在扫描蓝牙信标…")
        val ble = captureBle(originElapsedRealtimeNanos)
        return EnvironmentProfile(
            source = EnvironmentSourceType.REPLAY,
            origin = origin,
            originAccuracyMeters = originAccuracyMeters,
            generatedAtMillis = atMillis,
            seed = seed,
            wifi = wifi,
            cells = cells.gsm,
            cdmaCells = cells.cdma,
            ble = ble,
        )
    }

    @Suppress("DEPRECATION", "MissingPermission")
    private suspend fun captureWifi(originElapsedRealtimeNanos: Long?): List<WifiAp> {
        if (context.checkSelfPermission(Manifest.permission.ACCESS_FINE_LOCATION) != PackageManager.PERMISSION_GRANTED) {
            return emptyList()
        }
        val manager = context.applicationContext.getSystemService(WifiManager::class.java) ?: return emptyList()
        val connectedBssid = runCatching { manager.connectionInfo?.bssid?.lowercase() }.getOrNull()
        val results = requestWifiScanResults(manager)
        return results.asSequence().filter { result ->
            originElapsedRealtimeNanos == null || EnvironmentCaptureFreshness.wifiTimestampNanos(result.timestamp)
                ?.let { EnvironmentCaptureFreshness.matchesFix(it, originElapsedRealtimeNanos) } == true
        }.mapNotNull { result ->
            runCatching {
                val ssid = result.SSID?.takeIf { it.isNotBlank() && !it.contains("unknown ssid") } ?: return@runCatching null
                val bssid = result.BSSID?.takeIf { WifiAp.BSSID_PATTERN.matches(it) } ?: return@runCatching null
                if (bssid.equals(WifiAp.SENTINEL_BSSID, ignoreCase = true)) return@runCatching null
                val frequency = result.frequency
                val channel = WifiAp.channelForFrequencyMhz(frequency) ?: return@runCatching null
                val capabilities = result.capabilities ?: return@runCatching null
                WifiAp(
                    ssid = ssid,
                    bssid = bssid,
                    rssi = result.level,
                    frequencyMhz = frequency,
                    channel = channel,
                    capabilities = capabilities,
                    standard = result.wifiStandard,
                    connected = bssid.lowercase() == connectedBssid,
                )
            }.getOrNull()
        }.distinctBy { it.bssid.lowercase() }.take(EnvironmentProfile.MAX_WIFI).toList()
    }

    @Suppress("MissingPermission")
    private data class CellCapture(val gsm: List<CellTower>, val cdma: List<CdmaTower>)

    private suspend fun captureCells(originElapsedRealtimeNanos: Long?): CellCapture {
        if (context.checkSelfPermission(Manifest.permission.ACCESS_FINE_LOCATION) != PackageManager.PERMISSION_GRANTED) {
            return CellCapture(emptyList(), emptyList())
        }
        val manager = context.getSystemService(TelephonyManager::class.java)
            ?: return CellCapture(emptyList(), emptyList())
        val updated = requestCellInfoUpdate(manager)
        val source = updated?.takeIf { it.isNotEmpty() }
            ?: runCatching { manager.allCellInfo }.getOrDefault(emptyList())
        val cells = source.filter { cell ->
            originElapsedRealtimeNanos == null || EnvironmentCaptureFreshness.cellTimestampNanos(cell.timestampMillis)
                ?.let { EnvironmentCaptureFreshness.matchesFix(it, originElapsedRealtimeNanos) } == true
        }
        val gsm = cells.mapNotNull { cell -> runCatching { cell.toTower() }.getOrNull() }
            .distinctBy { "${it.mcc}:${it.mnc}:${it.areaCode}:${it.cellId}" }
            .take(EnvironmentProfile.MAX_CELLS)
        val cdma = cells.mapNotNull { cell -> runCatching { cell.toCdmaTower() }.getOrNull() }
            .distinctBy { "${it.systemId}:${it.networkId}:${it.baseStationId}" }
            .take((EnvironmentProfile.MAX_CELLS - gsm.size).coerceAtLeast(0))
        return CellCapture(gsm, cdma)
    }

    @Suppress("MissingPermission")
    private suspend fun requestCellInfoUpdate(manager: TelephonyManager): List<CellInfo>? =
        withTimeoutOrNull(CELL_INFO_TIMEOUT_MILLIS) {
            suspendCancellableCoroutine { continuation ->
                val completed = AtomicBoolean(false)
                try {
                    manager.requestCellInfoUpdate(context.mainExecutor, object : TelephonyManager.CellInfoCallback() {
                        override fun onCellInfo(cellInfo: MutableList<CellInfo>) {
                            if (completed.compareAndSet(false, true) && continuation.isActive) {
                                continuation.resume(cellInfo.toList())
                            }
                        }

                        override fun onError(errorCode: Int, detail: Throwable?) {
                            if (completed.compareAndSet(false, true) && continuation.isActive) {
                                continuation.resume(null)
                            }
                        }
                    })
                } catch (_: Exception) {
                    if (completed.compareAndSet(false, true) && continuation.isActive) continuation.resume(null)
                }
            }
        }

    @Suppress("MissingPermission", "DEPRECATION")
    private suspend fun requestWifiScanResults(manager: WifiManager): List<WifiScanResult> {
        fun cached() = runCatching { manager.scanResults }.getOrDefault(emptyList())
        return withTimeoutOrNull(WIFI_SCAN_TIMEOUT_MILLIS) {
            suspendCancellableCoroutine { continuation ->
                val completed = AtomicBoolean(false)
                val registered = AtomicBoolean(false)
                lateinit var receiver: BroadcastReceiver
                fun unregister() {
                    if (registered.compareAndSet(true, false)) runCatching { context.unregisterReceiver(receiver) }
                }
                fun finish(results: List<WifiScanResult>) {
                    if (completed.compareAndSet(false, true)) {
                        unregister()
                        if (continuation.isActive) continuation.resume(results)
                    }
                }
                receiver = object : BroadcastReceiver() {
                    override fun onReceive(context: Context?, intent: Intent?) {
                        if (intent?.action == WifiManager.SCAN_RESULTS_AVAILABLE_ACTION) finish(cached())
                    }
                }
                try {
                    registered.set(true)
                    ContextCompat.registerReceiver(
                        context, receiver, IntentFilter(WifiManager.SCAN_RESULTS_AVAILABLE_ACTION),
                        ContextCompat.RECEIVER_EXPORTED,
                    )
                    continuation.invokeOnCancellation { completed.set(true); unregister() }
                    if (continuation.isActive && !completed.get() &&
                        !runCatching { manager.startScan() }.getOrDefault(false)
                    ) finish(cached())
                } catch (_: Exception) {
                    registered.set(false)
                    finish(cached())
                }
            }
        } ?: cached()
    }

    private fun CellInfo.toTower(): CellTower? = when (this) {
        is CellInfoLte -> (cellSignalStrength as? android.telephony.CellSignalStrengthLte)?.let { signal ->
            cellIdentity.toTower(signal.rsrp, signal.rsrq, signal.rssnr, isRegistered)
        }
        is CellInfoNr -> {
            val identity = cellIdentity as? CellIdentityNr
            val signal = cellSignalStrength as? android.telephony.CellSignalStrengthNr
            if (identity == null || signal == null) null else identity.toTower(
                signal.ssRsrp, signal.ssRsrq, signal.ssSinr, isRegistered,
            )
        }
        is CellInfoGsm -> cellIdentity.toTower(
            cellSignalStrength.dbm, cellIdentity.bsic, cellIdentity.arfcn,
            CellType.GSM, isRegistered,
        )
        is CellInfoWcdma -> cellIdentity.toTower(
            cellSignalStrength.dbm, cellIdentity.psc, cellIdentity.uarfcn,
            CellType.WCDMA, isRegistered,
        )
        else -> null
    }

    private fun CellInfo.toCdmaTower(): CdmaTower? {
        val cell = this as? CellInfoCdma ?: return null
        val identity = cell.cellIdentity
        val signal = cell.cellSignalStrength
        val latitude = identity.latitude.takeIf {
            it in CdmaTower.MIN_LATITUDE_QUARTER_SECONDS..CdmaTower.MAX_LATITUDE_QUARTER_SECONDS
        }
        val longitude = identity.longitude.takeIf {
            it in CdmaTower.MIN_LONGITUDE_QUARTER_SECONDS..CdmaTower.MAX_LONGITUDE_QUARTER_SECONDS
        }
        val hasCoordinates = latitude != null && longitude != null
        return CdmaTower(
            systemId = identity.systemId,
            networkId = identity.networkId,
            baseStationId = identity.basestationId,
            latitudeQuarterSeconds = latitude.takeIf { hasCoordinates },
            longitudeQuarterSeconds = longitude.takeIf { hasCoordinates },
            cdmaDbm = signal.cdmaDbm.takeIf { it in CdmaTower.MIN_SIGNAL_DBM..CdmaTower.MAX_SIGNAL_DBM },
            cdmaEcio = signal.cdmaEcio.takeIf { it in CdmaTower.MIN_ECIO_DB..CdmaTower.MAX_ECIO_DB },
            evdoDbm = signal.evdoDbm.takeIf { it in CdmaTower.MIN_SIGNAL_DBM..CdmaTower.MAX_SIGNAL_DBM },
            evdoEcio = signal.evdoEcio.takeIf { it in CdmaTower.MIN_ECIO_DB..CdmaTower.MAX_ECIO_DB },
            evdoSnr = signal.evdoSnr.takeIf { it in CdmaTower.MIN_EVDO_SNR..CdmaTower.MAX_EVDO_SNR },
            registered = cell.isRegistered,
        )
    }

    private fun CellIdentityLte.toTower(rsrp: Int, rsrq: Int, rssnr: Int, registered: Boolean): CellTower? {
        if (mcc !in 1..999 || mnc !in 0..999 || ci <= 0) return null
        val signal = CellSignalPolicy.lte(rsrp, rsrq, rssnr) ?: return null
        return CellTower(
            type = CellType.LTE,
            mcc = mcc,
            mnc = mnc,
            areaCode = tac,
            cellId = ci.toLong(),
            pci = pci.takeIf { it in 0..CellTower.MAX_LTE_PCI },
            arfcn = earfcn.takeIf { it > 0 },
            rsrp = signal.rsrp,
            rsrq = signal.rsrq,
            rssnr = signal.rssnr,
            registered = registered,
            mncDigits = mncDigits(mnc),
            operatorName = operatorName(),
        )
    }

    private fun CellIdentityNr.toTower(rsrp: Int, rsrq: Int, rssnr: Int, registered: Boolean): CellTower? {
        val mcc = mccString?.toIntOrNull() ?: return null
        val mnc = mncString?.toIntOrNull() ?: return null
        if (mcc !in 1..999 || mnc !in 0..999 || nci <= 0) return null
        val signal = CellSignalPolicy.nr(rsrp, rsrq, rssnr) ?: return null
        return CellTower(
            type = CellType.NR,
            mcc = mcc,
            mnc = mnc,
            areaCode = tac,
            cellId = nci,
            pci = pci.takeIf { it in 0..CellTower.MAX_NR_PCI },
            arfcn = nrarfcn.takeIf { it > 0 },
            rsrp = signal.rsrp,
            rsrq = signal.rsrq,
            rssnr = signal.rssnr,
            registered = registered,
            mncDigits = mncDigits(mnc),
            operatorName = operatorName(),
        )
    }

    private fun android.telephony.CellIdentityGsm.toTower(
        dbm: Int,
        bsic: Int,
        arfcn: Int,
        type: CellType,
        registered: Boolean,
    ): CellTower? {
        if (mcc !in 1..999 || mnc !in 0..999 || cid <= 0 || dbm !in CellTower.MIN_GSM_RSSI..CellTower.MAX_GSM_RSSI) return null
        return CellTower(
            type = type,
            mcc = mcc,
            mnc = mnc,
            areaCode = lac.coerceAtLeast(0),
            cellId = cid.toLong(),
            pci = bsic.takeIf { it in 0..CellTower.MAX_GSM_BSIC },
            arfcn = arfcn.takeIf { it in 0..CellTower.MAX_GSM_ARFCN },
            rsrp = dbm,
            registered = registered,
            mncDigits = mncDigits(mnc),
            operatorName = operatorName(),
        )
    }

    private fun android.telephony.CellIdentityWcdma.toTower(
        rscp: Int,
        psc: Int,
        uarfcn: Int,
        type: CellType,
        registered: Boolean,
    ): CellTower? {
        if (mcc !in 1..999 || mnc !in 0..999 || cid <= 0 ||
            rscp !in CellTower.MIN_WCDMA_RSCP..CellTower.MAX_WCDMA_RSCP
        ) return null
        return CellTower(
            type = type,
            mcc = mcc,
            mnc = mnc,
            areaCode = lac.coerceAtLeast(0),
            cellId = cid.toLong(),
            pci = psc.takeIf { it in 0..CellTower.MAX_WCDMA_PSC },
            arfcn = uarfcn.takeIf { it in 0..CellTower.MAX_WCDMA_UARFCN },
            rsrp = rscp,
            registered = registered,
            mncDigits = mncDigits(mnc),
            operatorName = operatorName(),
        )
    }

    private fun CellIdentity.mncDigits(expectedMnc: Int): Int? = runCatching {
        (javaClass.getMethod("getMncString").invoke(this) as? String)
            ?.takeIf { it.all(Char::isDigit) && it.toIntOrNull() == expectedMnc }
            ?.length
            ?.takeIf { it in CellTower.MIN_MNC_DIGITS..CellTower.MAX_MNC_DIGITS }
    }.getOrNull()

    private fun CellIdentity.operatorName(): String? = runCatching {
        (javaClass.getMethod("getOperatorAlphaLong").invoke(this) as? String)
            ?.takeIf { it.isNotBlank() && it.toByteArray(Charsets.UTF_8).size <= CellTower.MAX_OPERATOR_NAME_BYTES }
    }.getOrNull()

    @Suppress("MissingPermission")
    private suspend fun captureBle(originElapsedRealtimeNanos: Long?): List<BleBeacon> {
        val scanPermissionGranted = if (Build.VERSION.SDK_INT >= Build.VERSION_CODES.S) {
            context.checkSelfPermission(Manifest.permission.BLUETOOTH_SCAN) == PackageManager.PERMISSION_GRANTED
        } else {
            false
        }
        val fineLocationGranted = context.checkSelfPermission(Manifest.permission.ACCESS_FINE_LOCATION) ==
            PackageManager.PERMISSION_GRANTED
        if (!BleScanPermission.isGranted(Build.VERSION.SDK_INT, scanPermissionGranted, fineLocationGranted)) {
            return emptyList()
        }
        val scanner = runCatching {
            context.getSystemService(BluetoothManager::class.java)
                ?.adapter
                ?.takeIf { it.isEnabled }
                ?.bluetoothLeScanner
        }.getOrNull() ?: return emptyList()
        var callback: ScanCallback? = null
        return collectBleScanWindow(
            timeoutMillis = BLE_SCAN_TIMEOUT_MILLIS,
            maxResults = EnvironmentProfile.MAX_BLE,
            startScan = { onResult, onFailure ->
                callback = object : ScanCallback() {
                    override fun onScanResult(callbackType: Int, result: BleScanResult) {
                        if (originElapsedRealtimeNanos != null &&
                            !EnvironmentCaptureFreshness.matchesFix(result.timestampNanos, originElapsedRealtimeNanos)
                        ) return
                        val address = result.device?.address ?: return
                        val beacon = runCatching {
                            val scanRecord = result.scanRecord
                            val scanRecordHex = scanRecord?.bytes
                                ?.takeIf { it.isNotEmpty() && it.size <= BleBeacon.MAX_SCAN_RECORD_BYTES }
                                ?.joinToString(separator = "") { byte -> "%02x".format(byte.toInt() and 0xff) }
                            val txPower = scanRecord?.txPowerLevel
                                ?.takeIf { it != Int.MIN_VALUE && it in BleBeacon.MIN_TX_POWER_DBM..BleBeacon.MAX_TX_POWER_DBM }
                            BleBeacon(
                                address = address,
                                // The advertised name is available with scan permission. Reading the
                                // device's cached name requires BLUETOOTH_CONNECT on Android 12+.
                                name = scanRecord?.deviceName.orEmpty()
                                    .takeIf { it.toByteArray(Charsets.UTF_8).size <= BleBeacon.MAX_NAME_BYTES }.orEmpty(),
                                rssi = result.rssi,
                                scanRecordHex = scanRecordHex,
                                txPowerDbm = txPower,
                            )
                        }.getOrNull() ?: return
                        onResult(beacon)
                    }

                    override fun onScanFailed(errorCode: Int) = onFailure()
                }
                scanner.startScan(checkNotNull(callback))
            },
            stopScan = { callback?.let { scanner.stopScan(it) } },
        )
    }

    private companion object {
        const val BLE_SCAN_TIMEOUT_MILLIS = 1_500L
        const val WIFI_SCAN_TIMEOUT_MILLIS = 5_000L
        const val CELL_INFO_TIMEOUT_MILLIS = 5_000L
    }
}
```

`app/src/main/java/com/system/location/service/environment/EnvironmentStore.kt`:

```kt
package com.system.location.service.environment

import android.content.Context
import com.system.location.service.core.environment.EnvironmentCodecException
import com.system.location.service.core.environment.EnvironmentProfile
import com.system.location.service.core.environment.EnvironmentProfileCodec
import java.io.ByteArrayOutputStream
import java.io.File
import java.io.FileOutputStream
import java.nio.file.AccessDeniedException
import java.nio.file.AtomicMoveNotSupportedException
import java.nio.ByteBuffer
import java.nio.charset.CodingErrorAction
import java.nio.file.Files
import java.nio.file.StandardCopyOption.ATOMIC_MOVE
import java.nio.file.StandardCopyOption.REPLACE_EXISTING

/**
 * User-triggered environment capture storage (P2-02). Never used on a location callback; every
 * method is synchronous file I/O and must be called off the main thread by the UI.
 */
class EnvironmentStore(private val directory: File) {
    constructor(context: Context) : this(File(context.filesDir, DIRECTORY))

    /** Save an imported profile under a fresh name so importing never replaces a saved profile. */
    fun saveNew(name: String, profile: EnvironmentProfile): String = synchronized(SAVE_LOCK) {
        val base = sanitize(name)
        var candidate = base
        var suffix = 2L
        while (File(directory, "$candidate$EXTENSION").exists()) {
            val suffixText = "-$suffix"
            candidate = base.take((MAX_NAME_LENGTH - suffixText.length).coerceAtLeast(0)) + suffixText
            suffix++
        }
        save(candidate, profile)
        candidate
    }

    fun save(name: String, profile: EnvironmentProfile): File {
        ensureDirectory()
        val safe = sanitize(name)
        val file = File(directory, "$safe$EXTENSION")
        val payload = EnvironmentProfileCodec.encode(profile).toByteArray(Charsets.UTF_8)
        val tmp = Files.createTempFile(directory.toPath(), "${safe.take(40)}-env-", ".tmp").toFile()
        try {
            FileOutputStream(tmp).use { stream ->
                stream.write(payload)
                stream.fd.sync()
            }
            synchronized(SAVE_LOCK) {
                try {
                    Files.move(tmp.toPath(), file.toPath(), ATOMIC_MOVE, REPLACE_EXISTING)
                } catch (_: AtomicMoveNotSupportedException) {
                    Files.move(tmp.toPath(), file.toPath(), REPLACE_EXISTING)
                } catch (_: AccessDeniedException) {
                    Files.move(tmp.toPath(), file.toPath(), REPLACE_EXISTING)
                }
            }
        } finally {
            if (tmp.exists()) tmp.delete()
        }
        return file
    }

    fun load(name: String): EnvironmentProfile = EnvironmentProfileCodec.decode(
        readUtf8Bounded(File(directory, "${sanitize(name)}$EXTENSION")),
    )

    fun list(): List<String> {
        if (!directory.exists()) return emptyList()
        require(directory.isDirectory) { "Environment path is not a directory" }
        val files = directory.listFiles { file -> file.isFile && file.name.endsWith(EXTENSION) }
            ?: error("Cannot read environment directory")
        return files.map { it.name.removeSuffix(EXTENSION) }.sorted()
    }

    fun delete(name: String): Boolean = synchronized(SAVE_LOCK) {
        File(directory, "${sanitize(name)}$EXTENSION").delete()
    }

    fun rename(oldName: String, newName: String): File = synchronized(SAVE_LOCK) {
        ensureDirectory()
        val source = File(directory, "${sanitize(oldName)}$EXTENSION")
        val target = File(directory, "${sanitize(newName)}$EXTENSION")
        require(source.isFile) { "Environment not found" }
        require(!target.exists()) { "Environment already exists" }
        if (!source.renameTo(target)) error("Cannot rename environment")
        target
    }

    private fun ensureDirectory() {
        if (!directory.exists() && !directory.mkdirs()) error("Cannot create environment directory")
    }

    private fun readUtf8Bounded(file: File): String {
        val output = ByteArrayOutputStream()
        file.inputStream().use { input ->
            val buffer = ByteArray(8 * 1024)
            while (true) {
                val count = input.read(buffer)
                if (count < 0) break
                if (output.size() > EnvironmentProfileCodec.MAX_PROFILE_BYTES - count) {
                    throw EnvironmentCodecException(
                        "Environment profile exceeds ${EnvironmentProfileCodec.MAX_PROFILE_BYTES} bytes",
                    )
                }
                output.write(buffer, 0, count)
            }
        }
        return try {
            Charsets.UTF_8.newDecoder()
                .onMalformedInput(CodingErrorAction.REPORT)
                .onUnmappableCharacter(CodingErrorAction.REPORT)
                .decode(ByteBuffer.wrap(output.toByteArray()))
                .toString()
        } catch (error: java.nio.charset.CharacterCodingException) {
            throw EnvironmentCodecException("Invalid UTF-8 environment profile", error)
        }
    }

    private fun sanitize(name: String): String {
        val safe = name.trim().replace(Regex("[^A-Za-z0-9._-]"), "_").take(MAX_NAME_LENGTH)
        require(safe.isNotBlank()) { "Invalid environment name" }
        return safe
    }

    private companion object {
        val SAVE_LOCK = Any()
        const val MAX_NAME_LENGTH = 64
        const val DIRECTORY = "environment"
        const val EXTENSION = ".json"
    }
}
```

```kt
package com.system.location.service.ext

import com.amap.api.location.AMapLocation
import com.amap.api.maps.model.LatLng

val LatLng.wgs84: Pair<Double, Double>
    get() = Loc4j.gcj2wgs(latitude, longitude)

val AMapLocation.wgs84: Pair<Double, Double>
    get() = Loc4j.gcj2wgs(latitude, longitude)

val Pair<Double, Double>.gcj02: LatLng
    get() = Loc4j.wgs2gcj(first, second).let { LatLng(it.first, it.second) }

/**
 * GCJ-02 <-> WGS-84 坐标转换（纯 Kotlin 实现，替代百度 SDK 的 Jni.coorEncrypt）。
 * 标准偏移算法：对 GCJ-02 与 WGS-84 差值做迭代逼近，精度约 1e-6 度（<1m）。
 */
object Loc4j {
    fun gcj2wgs(lat: Double, lon: Double): Pair<Double, Double> =
        com.system.location.service.core.geo.CoordinateTransform.toWgs84(
            com.system.location.service.core.geo.Gcj02(lat, lon)).let { it.latitude to it.longitude }
    fun wgs2gcj(lat: Double, lon: Double): Pair<Double, Double> =
        com.system.location.service.core.geo.CoordinateTransform.toGcj02(
            com.system.location.service.core.geo.Wgs84(lat, lon)).let { it.latitude to it.longitude }
}
```

`app/src/main/java/com/system/location/service/gnss/GnssBeiDouCatalogDownload.kt`:

```kt
package com.system.location.service.gnss

import com.system.location.service.core.gnss.BeiDouCatalogResource
import java.io.ByteArrayOutputStream
import java.net.HttpURLConnection
import java.net.URI

internal fun interface GnssBeiDouCatalogDownload {
    fun fetch(nowMillis: Long): BeiDouCatalogResource
}

/** Fixed HTTPS endpoint, no redirects, bounded body and total read deadline. No location sent. */
internal class HttpsGnssBeiDouCatalogDownload : GnssBeiDouCatalogDownload {
    override fun fetch(nowMillis: Long): BeiDouCatalogResource {
        val connection = URI(BeiDouCatalogResource.SOURCE_URL).toURL().openConnection() as HttpURLConnection
        try {
            connection.instanceFollowRedirects = false
            connection.connectTimeout = 10000
            connection.readTimeout = 10000
            connection.setRequestProperty("User-Agent", "Portal-GNSS")
            connection.setRequestProperty("Accept-Encoding", "identity")
            check(connection.responseCode == 200) { "BeiDou metadata HTTP ${connection.responseCode}" }
            require(connection.contentLengthLong <= MAX_BYTES) { "BeiDou metadata too large" }
            val modified = connection.lastModified
            require(modified > 0 && modified <= nowMillis && nowMillis >= 0) { "Invalid metadata Last-Modified evidence" }
            val deadline = System.nanoTime() + 30_000_000_000L
            val output = ByteArrayOutputStream()
            connection.inputStream.use { input ->
                val buffer = ByteArray(8192)
                while (true) {
                    check(!Thread.currentThread().isInterrupted && System.nanoTime() < deadline) { "BeiDou metadata read interrupted or timed out" }
                    val size = input.read(buffer)
                    if (size < 0) break
                    require(output.size() + size <= MAX_BYTES) { "BeiDou metadata exceeds budget" }
                    output.write(buffer, 0, size)
                }
            }
            return BeiDouCatalogResource.import(output.toString(Charsets.US_ASCII.name()), modified)
        } finally { connection.disconnect() }
    }

    private companion object { const val MAX_BYTES = 2 * 1024 * 1024 }
}
```

`app/src/main/java/com/system/location/service/gnss/GnssCaptureRepository.kt`:

```kt
package com.system.location.service.gnss

import android.content.Context
import com.system.location.service.core.gnss.GnssCapture
import com.system.location.service.core.gnss.GnssCaptureStore
import com.system.location.service.core.gnss.GnssCaptureValidator
import java.io.File
import kotlinx.coroutines.Dispatchers
import kotlinx.coroutines.withContext

/** Receiver evidence stays local and is excluded from Android backup. */
class GnssCaptureRepository(context: Context) {
    private val store = GnssCaptureStore(File(context.noBackupFilesDir, "gnss/receiver-capture.json"))
    private val rejected = GnssCaptureStore(File(context.noBackupFilesDir, "gnss/latest-rejected-capture.json"))

    suspend fun load(): GnssCapture? = withContext(Dispatchers.IO) { store.load() }

    suspend fun save(capture: GnssCapture) = withContext(Dispatchers.IO) {
        val now = System.currentTimeMillis()
        val quality = GnssCaptureValidator.validate(capture, now)
        if (!quality.eligible) {
            // Keep receiver evidence for diagnosis without replacing the last playback source.
            rejected.save(capture)
            error("采集未达到回放条件：${quality.issues.joinToString("；")}。保留上次画像；本次记录仅保存为本地诊断")
        }
        store.saveForPlayback(capture, now)
    }
}
```

`app/src/main/java/com/system/location/service/gnss/GnssCaptureSessionGuard.kt`:

```kt
package com.system.location.service.gnss

internal data class GnssCaptureSystemState(val instance: String, val generation: Long, val active: Boolean) {
    init { require(instance.isNotBlank() && instance.length <= 256 && generation >= 0) }
}

/** Reject a window if even a complete local/remote simulation session occurred between polls. */
internal class GnssCaptureSessionGuard(
    private val localStartGeneration: Long,
    localActive: Boolean,
    systemRequired: Boolean,
    private val systemState: GnssCaptureSystemState?,
) {
    init {
        require(localStartGeneration >= 0)
        check(!localActive) { "请先停止模拟，再采集真实卫星" }
        check(!systemRequired || systemState != null) { "无法确认系统模拟已停止，请检查后端连接后重新采集" }
        check(systemState?.active != true) { "请先停止系统模拟，再采集真实卫星" }
    }

    fun checkLocal(generation: Long, active: Boolean) {
        check(!active && generation == localStartGeneration) { "采集期间启动过模拟，已废弃本次采集" }
    }

    fun checkSystem(current: GnssCaptureSystemState?) {
        check(current == systemState) { "采集期间系统模拟状态发生变化或无法确认，已废弃本次采集" }
    }
}
```

`app/src/main/java/com/system/location/service/gnss/GnssNavigationDownload.kt`:

```kt
package com.system.location.service.gnss

import com.system.location.service.core.gnss.RinexNavigationReader
import com.system.location.service.core.gnss.RinexNavigationResource
import com.system.location.service.core.gnss.RinexNavigationSnapshot
import java.io.ByteArrayOutputStream
import java.io.InputStream
import java.net.HttpURLConnection
import java.net.URI
import java.time.Instant
import java.time.ZoneOffset
import java.util.Locale
import java.util.zip.GZIPInputStream

/** No receiver position is sent. The server receives only a public UTC day/archive request. */
internal object GnssNavigationUrls {
    fun candidates(nowMillis: Long): List<String> {
        require(nowMillis >= 0)
        val date = Instant.ofEpochMilli(nowMillis).atZone(ZoneOffset.UTC).toLocalDate()
        return listOf(date, date.minusDays(1)).map { day ->
            val year = "%04d".format(Locale.ROOT, day.year)
            val doy = "%03d".format(Locale.ROOT, day.dayOfYear)
            "https://igs.bkg.bund.de/root_ftp/IGS/BRDC/$year/$doy/BRDC00WRD_R_${year}${doy}0000_01D_MN.rnx.gz"
        }
    }
}

internal fun interface GnssNavigationTransport {
    /** Null means HTTP 404 (day not published). Other failures must retain the old cache. */
    fun download(url: String): String?
}

internal class HttpsGnssNavigationTransport : GnssNavigationTransport {
    override fun download(url: String): String? {
        val uri = URI(url)
        require(uri.scheme == "https" && uri.host == "igs.bkg.bund.de" && uri.port == -1 &&
            uri.userInfo == null && uri.query == null && uri.fragment == null &&
            uri.path.matches(Regex("/root_ftp/IGS/BRDC/[0-9]{4}/[0-9]{3}/BRDC00WRD_R_[0-9]{11}_01D_MN\\.rnx\\.gz")))
        val connection = uri.toURL().openConnection() as HttpURLConnection
        try {
            connection.instanceFollowRedirects = false
            connection.connectTimeout = 10000
            connection.readTimeout = 10000
            connection.setRequestProperty("User-Agent", "Portal-GNSS")
            connection.setRequestProperty("Accept-Encoding", "identity")
            val status = connection.responseCode
            if (status == 404) return null
            check(status == 200) { "GNSS archive HTTP $status" }
            require(connection.contentLengthLong <= MAX_COMPRESSED_BYTES) { "GNSS archive too large" }
            val deadline = System.nanoTime() + 30_000_000_000L
            val compressed = connection.inputStream.use { readBounded(it, MAX_COMPRESSED_BYTES, deadline) }
            return GZIPInputStream(compressed.inputStream()).use {
                readBounded(it, RinexNavigationReader.MAX_BYTES, deadline).toString(Charsets.US_ASCII)
            }
        } finally { connection.disconnect() }
    }

    private fun readBounded(input: InputStream, limit: Int, deadline: Long): ByteArray {
        val output = ByteArrayOutputStream()
        val buffer = ByteArray(8192)
        while (true) {
            check(!Thread.currentThread().isInterrupted && System.nanoTime() < deadline) { "GNSS archive read interrupted or timed out" }
            val count = input.read(buffer)
            if (count < 0) break
            require(output.size() + count <= limit) { "GNSS archive expansion exceeds budget" }
            output.write(buffer, 0, count)
        }
        return output.toByteArray()
    }

    private companion object { const val MAX_COMPRESSED_BYTES = 4 * 1024 * 1024 }
}

/** Complete and validate the candidate before the repository touches the last good cache. */
internal class GnssNavigationDownload(private val transport: GnssNavigationTransport) {
    fun fetch(nowMillis: Long): RinexNavigationResource {
        for (url in GnssNavigationUrls.candidates(nowMillis)) {
            val archive = transport.download(url) ?: continue
            return RinexNavigationSnapshot.select(archive, url, nowMillis)
        }
        error("GNSS navigation archives are not published for the current or previous UTC day")
    }
}
```

`app/src/main/java/com/system/location/service/gnss/GnssNavigationRepository.kt`:

```kt
package com.system.location.service.gnss

import com.system.location.service.core.gnss.RinexNavigationResource
import com.system.location.service.core.gnss.RinexNavigationResourceStore
import java.io.File
import kotlinx.coroutines.Dispatchers
import kotlinx.coroutines.ensureActive
import kotlinx.coroutines.runInterruptible
import kotlinx.coroutines.sync.Mutex
import kotlinx.coroutines.sync.withLock
import kotlinx.coroutines.withContext
import kotlin.coroutines.coroutineContext
import kotlinx.coroutines.CancellationException

/** Network and disk operations are independent of receiver collection and location ticks. */
internal class GnssNavigationRepository(
    file: File,
    private val download: GnssNavigationDownload = GnssNavigationDownload(HttpsGnssNavigationTransport()),
    private val status: GnssNavigationSyncStatus = GnssNavigationSyncStatus.shared,
    private val catalogDownload: GnssBeiDouCatalogDownload? = HttpsGnssBeiDouCatalogDownload(),
) {
    private val store = RinexNavigationResourceStore(file)
    private val updates = Mutex()

    /** True only when bytes/provenance changed; downloading the same upload does not reset sky. */
    suspend fun refresh(nowMillis: Long = System.currentTimeMillis()): Boolean = updates.withLock {
        status.begin()
        try {
            val old = withContext(Dispatchers.IO) { runCatching { store.load() }.getOrNull() }
            val navigation = try { runInterruptible(Dispatchers.IO) { download.fetch(nowMillis) } }
                catch (cancelled: CancellationException) { throw cancelled }
                catch (error: Exception) { if (catalogDownload == null || old == null) throw error; null }
            val catalog = try { catalogDownload?.let { runInterruptible(Dispatchers.IO) { it.fetch(nowMillis) } } }
                catch (cancelled: CancellationException) { throw cancelled }
                catch (_: Exception) { null }
            coroutineContext.ensureActive()
            if (navigation == null && (catalog == null || catalog == old?.beiDouCatalog))
                error("Neither navigation nor metadata refresh supplied an update")
            val candidate = (navigation ?: requireNotNull(old)).copy(beiDouCatalog = catalog)
            val changed = withContext(Dispatchers.IO) {
                coroutineContext.ensureActive()
                val accepted = store.update(RinexNavigationResource.encode(candidate))
                old?.sha256 != accepted.sha256 || old.sourceUrl != accepted.sourceUrl ||
                    old.beiDouCatalog != accepted.beiDouCatalog
            }
            status.accepted(nowMillis, candidate.sourceUrl)
            if (catalogDownload != null && catalog == null) status.catalogFailed()
            if (navigation == null) status.navigationRetained()
            changed
        } catch (cancelled: CancellationException) {
            status.cancelled()
            throw cancelled
        } catch (error: Exception) {
            status.failed()
            throw error
        }
    }
}

```

`app/src/main/java/com/system/location/service/gnss/GnssNavigationSyncStatus.kt`:

```kt
package com.system.location.service.gnss

import kotlinx.coroutines.flow.MutableStateFlow
import kotlinx.coroutines.flow.asStateFlow
import kotlinx.coroutines.flow.update

internal data class GnssNavigationSyncState(
    val refreshing: Boolean = false,
    val acceptedAtMillis: Long? = null,
    val sourceUrl: String? = null,
    val problem: String? = null,
)

/** App-process diagnostics only; never claims that a remote receiver has consumed a frame. */
internal class GnssNavigationSyncStatus {
    private val mutable = MutableStateFlow(GnssNavigationSyncState())
    val state = mutable.asStateFlow()
    fun begin() { mutable.update { it.copy(refreshing = true, problem = null) } }
    fun accepted(atMillis: Long, sourceUrl: String) {
        mutable.value = GnssNavigationSyncState(acceptedAtMillis = atMillis, sourceUrl = sourceUrl)
    }
    fun failed() { mutable.update { it.copy(refreshing = false,
        problem = "导航数据更新失败，保留已接受资源；无适用数据时继续虚拟天空") } }
    fun cancelled() { mutable.update { it.copy(refreshing = false) } }
    fun catalogFailed() { mutable.update { it.copy(
        problem = "导航数据已更新，北斗目录下载失败；保留旧目录，失效后降级至其他来源") } }
    fun navigationRetained() { mutable.update { it.copy(
        problem = "北斗目录已更新，广播导航下载失败；保留已接受的广播数据") } }
    fun synchronizationFailed() { mutable.update { it.copy(
        problem = "导航资源已缓存，但运行配置同步失败；接收端可能仍使用此前资源") } }

    companion object { val shared = GnssNavigationSyncStatus() }
}
```
