```kt
import com.system.location.service.core.geo.Wgs84
import com.system.location.service.core.gnss.*
import com.system.location.service.core.backend.BackendType
import com.system.location.service.runtime.ScenarioRuntime
import com.system.location.service.service.MockServiceHelper
import java.util.Base64
import java.util.concurrent.atomic.AtomicBoolean
import kotlinx.coroutines.Dispatchers
import kotlinx.coroutines.delay
import kotlinx.coroutines.withContext

/** Capture only while all simulation backends are stopped. All callbacks run on the main looper. */
class GnssReceiverCollector(
    context: Context,
    private val simulationActive: () -> Boolean = { ScenarioRuntime.state.value.isActive },
) {
    private val context = context.applicationContext

    @Suppress("MissingPermission", "DEPRECATION")
    suspend fun capture(durationMillis: Long = 60_000L, onProgress: (Int) -> Unit = {}): GnssCapture =
        withContext(Dispatchers.Main.immediate) {
            require(durationMillis in 30_000L..300_000L) { "采集窗口必须为 30–300 秒" }
            ScenarioRuntime.awaitInitialized()
            check(!simulationActive()) { "请先停止模拟，再采集真实卫星" }
            check(context.checkSelfPermission(Manifest.permission.ACCESS_FINE_LOCATION) == PackageManager.PERMISSION_GRANTED) {
                "真实卫星采集需要精确位置权限"
            }
            val manager = checkNotNull(context.getSystemService(LocationManager::class.java)) { "定位服务不可用" }
            check(manager.isProviderEnabled(LocationManager.GPS_PROVIDER)) { "请先开启系统定位" }
            val localGeneration = ScenarioRuntime.controller.startGeneration
            val systemState = readSystemState(manager, initialize = true)
            fun localActive() = ScenarioRuntime.state.value.isActive || simulationActive()
            val session = GnssCaptureSessionGuard(localGeneration, localActive(),
                ScenarioRuntime.state.value.backend != BackendType.MOCK_PROVIDER, systemState)
            session.checkLocal(ScenarioRuntime.controller.startGeneration, localActive())
            check(capturing.compareAndSet(false, true)) { "已有卫星采集任务" }

            val frames = mutableListOf<GnssObservationFrame>()
            val measurements = mutableListOf<GnssMeasurementBatch>()
            val navigation = mutableListOf<GnssNavigationObservation>()
            val notes = linkedSetOf<String>()
            val started = System.currentTimeMillis()
            val elapsedStart = SystemClock.elapsedRealtime()
            val handler = Handler(Looper.getMainLooper())
            var location: Location? = null
            var contaminated = false
            var accepting = true
            var statusRegistered = false
            var measurementRegistered = false
            var navigationRegistered = false
            var locationRegistered = false
            fun accepts(): Boolean {
                if (localActive() || ScenarioRuntime.controller.startGeneration != localGeneration) contaminated = true
                return accepting && !contaminated
            }
            val locationListener = LocationListener { sample ->
                if (sample.isMock) contaminated = true
                if (!accepts()) return@LocationListener
                val arrival = SystemClock.elapsedRealtimeNanos()
                val valid = sample.latitude in -90.0..90.0 && sample.longitude in -180.0..180.0 &&
                    sample.elapsedRealtimeNanos in 1..arrival &&
                    (!sample.hasAltitude() || sample.altitude.isFinite()) &&
                    (!sample.hasAccuracy() || sample.accuracy.isFinite() && sample.accuracy >= 0f) &&
                    (!sample.hasVerticalAccuracy() || sample.verticalAccuracyMeters.isFinite() && sample.verticalAccuracyMeters >= 0f) &&
                    (Build.VERSION.SDK_INT < Build.VERSION_CODES.Q || !sample.hasElapsedRealtimeUncertaintyNanos() ||
                        sample.elapsedRealtimeUncertaintyNanos.isFinite() && sample.elapsedRealtimeUncertaintyNanos >= 0.0)
                if (valid) location = Location(sample)
                else notes += "真实定位包含无效坐标、单调时刻或精度，未将该定位用于卫星观察点"
            }
            val statusCallback = object : GnssStatus.Callback() {
                override fun onStarted() { if (accepts()) notes += "GNSS 引擎已启动" }
                override fun onStopped() { if (accepts()) notes += "GNSS 引擎已停止" }
                override fun onFirstFix(ttffMillis: Int) { if (accepts()) notes += "首次定位耗时：${ttffMillis}ms" }
                override fun onSatelliteStatusChanged(status: GnssStatus) {
                    if (!accepts() || frames.size >= GnssCapture.MAX_FRAMES) return
                    val capturedElapsed = SystemClock.elapsedRealtimeNanos()
                    val capturedAt = System.currentTimeMillis()
                    if (status.satelliteCount > 512) {
                        notes += "卫星状态超过 512 条信号记录，未保存该异常帧"
                        return
                    }
                    val signals = (0 until status.satelliteCount).mapNotNull { index ->
                        val constellation = constellation(status.getConstellationType(index)) ?: run {
                            notes += "未知星座类型：${status.getConstellationType(index)}"
                            return@mapNotNull null
                        }
                        runCatching {
                            val satellite = GnssSatellite(constellation, status.getSvid(index), status.getElevationDegrees(index),
                                status.getAzimuthDegrees(index), status.getCn0DbHz(index), status.usedInFix(index),
                                status.hasEphemerisData(index), status.hasAlmanacData(index),
                                if (status.hasCarrierFrequencyHz(index)) status.getCarrierFrequencyHz(index) else null)
                            GnssSignalObservation(satellite,
                                if (Build.VERSION.SDK_INT >= Build.VERSION_CODES.R && status.hasBasebandCn0DbHz(index))
                                    status.getBasebandCn0DbHz(index) else null)
                        }.onFailure { notes += "部分卫星状态字段无效：${it.javaClass.simpleName} ${it.message}" }.getOrNull()
                    }
                    val satellites = GnssSignalProjection.spacecraft(signals)
                    val observer = location?.takeIf {
                        capturedElapsed - it.elapsedRealtimeNanos in 0..10_000_000_000L
                    }
                    frames += GnssObservationFrame(
                        capturedAtMillis = capturedAt,
                        observer = observer?.let { Wgs84(it.latitude, it.longitude) },
                        altitudeMeters = observer?.takeIf { it.hasAltitude() }?.altitude,
                        satellites = satellites,
                        signalObservations = signals,
                        measurementsAvailable = measurements.isNotEmpty(),
                        navigationMessagesAvailable = navigation.isNotEmpty(),
                        capturedElapsedRealtimeNanos = capturedElapsed,
                        observerElapsedRealtimeNanos = observer?.elapsedRealtimeNanos,
                        observerElapsedRealtimeUncertaintyNanos = observer?.takeIf {
                            Build.VERSION.SDK_INT >= Build.VERSION_CODES.Q && it.hasElapsedRealtimeUncertaintyNanos()
                        }?.elapsedRealtimeUncertaintyNanos,
                        observerHorizontalAccuracyMeters = observer?.takeIf { it.hasAccuracy() }?.accuracy?.toDouble(),
                        observerVerticalAccuracyMeters = observer?.takeIf { it.hasAltitude() && it.hasVerticalAccuracy() }
                            ?.verticalAccuracyMeters?.toDouble(),
                    )
                    onProgress(frames.size)
                }
            }
            val measurementCallback = object : GnssMeasurementsEvent.Callback() {
                override fun onGnssMeasurementsReceived(event: GnssMeasurementsEvent) {
                    if (!accepts() || measurements.size >= GnssCapture.MAX_FRAMES) return
                    val capturedElapsed = SystemClock.elapsedRealtimeNanos()
                    val capturedAt = System.currentTimeMillis()
                    val clock = event.clock
                    val values = event.measurements.mapNotNull { sample ->
                        val constellation = constellation(sample.constellationType) ?: return@mapNotNull null
                        runCatching {
                            GnssMeasurementObservation(constellation, sample.svid, sample.state, sample.timeOffsetNanos,
                                sample.receivedSvTimeNanos, sample.receivedSvTimeUncertaintyNanos, sample.cn0DbHz,
                                sample.pseudorangeRateMetersPerSecond, sample.pseudorangeRateUncertaintyMetersPerSecond,
                                sample.accumulatedDeltaRangeState, sample.accumulatedDeltaRangeMeters,
                                sample.accumulatedDeltaRangeUncertaintyMeters,
                                if (sample.hasCarrierFrequencyHz()) sample.carrierFrequencyHz.toDouble() else null,
                                if (sample.hasCodeType()) sample.codeType else null,
                                fullInterSignalBiasNanos = if (sample.hasFullInterSignalBiasNanos()) sample.fullInterSignalBiasNanos else null,
                                fullInterSignalBiasUncertaintyNanos = if (sample.hasFullInterSignalBiasUncertaintyNanos())
                                    sample.fullInterSignalBiasUncertaintyNanos else null,
                                satelliteInterSignalBiasNanos = if (sample.hasSatelliteInterSignalBiasNanos())
                                    sample.satelliteInterSignalBiasNanos else null,
                                satelliteInterSignalBiasUncertaintyNanos = if (sample.hasSatelliteInterSignalBiasUncertaintyNanos())
                                    sample.satelliteInterSignalBiasUncertaintyNanos else null)
                        }.onFailure { notes += "部分原始测量字段无效：${it.javaClass.simpleName}" }.getOrNull()
                    }.take(512)
                    runCatching {
                        GnssMeasurementBatch(capturedAt, clock.timeNanos,
                            if (clock.hasFullBiasNanos()) clock.fullBiasNanos else null,
                            if (clock.hasBiasNanos()) clock.biasNanos else null,
                            clock.hardwareClockDiscontinuityCount, values,
                            timeUncertaintyNanos = if (clock.hasTimeUncertaintyNanos()) clock.timeUncertaintyNanos else null,
                            biasUncertaintyNanos = if (clock.hasBiasUncertaintyNanos()) clock.biasUncertaintyNanos else null,
                            driftNanosPerSecond = if (clock.hasDriftNanosPerSecond()) clock.driftNanosPerSecond else null,
                            driftUncertaintyNanosPerSecond = if (clock.hasDriftUncertaintyNanosPerSecond()) clock.driftUncertaintyNanosPerSecond else null,
                            leapSecond = if (clock.hasLeapSecond()) clock.leapSecond else null,
                            elapsedRealtimeNanos = if (Build.VERSION.SDK_INT >= 29 && clock.hasElapsedRealtimeNanos()) clock.elapsedRealtimeNanos else null,
                            elapsedRealtimeUncertaintyNanos = if (Build.VERSION.SDK_INT >= 29 && clock.hasElapsedRealtimeUncertaintyNanos()) clock.elapsedRealtimeUncertaintyNanos else null,
                            capturedElapsedRealtimeNanos = capturedElapsed,
                            referenceConstellationTypeForIsb = if (clock.hasReferenceConstellationTypeForIsb())
                                clock.referenceConstellationTypeForIsb else null,
                            referenceCarrierHzForIsb = if (clock.hasReferenceCarrierFrequencyHzForIsb())
                                clock.referenceCarrierFrequencyHzForIsb else null,
                            referenceCodeTypeForIsb = if (clock.hasReferenceCodeTypeForIsb()) clock.referenceCodeTypeForIsb else null)
                    }.onSuccess { measurements += it }
                        .onFailure { notes += "原始接收机时钟字段无效：${it.message}" }
                }
                override fun onStatusChanged(status: Int) { notes += "原始测量状态：$status" }
            }
            val navigationCallback = object : GnssNavigationMessage.Callback() {
                override fun onGnssNavigationMessageReceived(event: GnssNavigationMessage) {
                    if (!accepts() || navigation.size >= GnssCapture.MAX_NAVIGATION_MESSAGES) return
                    val capturedElapsed = SystemClock.elapsedRealtimeNanos()
                    val capturedAt = System.currentTimeMillis()
                    runCatching {
                        GnssNavigationObservation(capturedAt, event.type, event.svid, event.status,
                            event.messageId, event.submessageId, Base64.getEncoder().encodeToString(event.data), capturedElapsed)
                    }.onSuccess { navigation += it }
                        .onFailure { notes += "导航电文字段无效：${it.javaClass.simpleName}" }
                }
                override fun onStatusChanged(status: Int) { notes += "导航电文状态：$status" }
            }
            try {
                // HAL capability flags, registration acceptance and actual received data are
                // independent evidence. A successful registration does not imply hardware support.
                runCatching {
                    val capabilities = manager.gnssCapabilities
                    notes += "系统声明 GNSS 能力：原始测量=${capabilities.hasMeasurements()}，导航电文=${capabilities.hasNavigationMessages()}"
                }.onFailure { notes += "GNSS 能力读取失败：${it.javaClass.simpleName}" }
                runCatching {
                    notes += "GNSS 驱动：${manager.gnssHardwareModelName ?: "未提供"}；硬件年份=${manager.gnssYearOfHardware}（0 表示未提供 2016 年及以后的年份）"
                }.onFailure { notes += "GNSS 驱动信息读取失败：${it.javaClass.simpleName}" }
                statusRegistered = manager.registerGnssStatusCallback(statusCallback, handler)
                check(statusRegistered) { "系统拒绝注册卫星状态监听" }
                measurementRegistered = runCatching {
                    manager.registerGnssMeasurementsCallback(measurementCallback, handler)
                }.onFailure { notes += "原始测量不可用：${it.javaClass.simpleName}" }.getOrDefault(false)
                notes += "原始测量监听注册：${if (measurementRegistered) "已接受" else "未接受"}"
                navigationRegistered = runCatching {
                    manager.registerGnssNavigationMessageCallback(navigationCallback, handler)
                }.onFailure { notes += "导航电文不可用：${it.javaClass.simpleName}" }.getOrDefault(false)
                notes += "导航电文监听注册：${if (navigationRegistered) "已接受" else "未接受"}"
                manager.requestLocationUpdates(LocationManager.GPS_PROVIDER, 1000L, 0f, locationListener, Looper.getMainLooper())
                locationRegistered = true
                var lastSystemCheck = SystemClock.elapsedRealtime()
                while (SystemClock.elapsedRealtime() - elapsedStart < durationMillis) {
                    delay(250L)
                    check(accepts()) { "采集期间启动了模拟，已废弃本次采集" }
                    if (SystemClock.elapsedRealtime() - lastSystemCheck >= 1_000L) {
                        session.checkSystem(readSystemState(manager, initialize = false))
                        lastSystemCheck = SystemClock.elapsedRealtime()
                    }
                }
                // Freeze the buffer before the final Binder round trip. A start after the final
                // observation cannot introduce any further callbacks into the accepted window.
                accepting = false
                session.checkSystem(readSystemState(manager, initialize = systemState == null))
                session.checkLocal(ScenarioRuntime.controller.startGeneration, localActive())
                check(!contaminated) { "采集期间收到模拟定位，已废弃本次采集" }
                check(frames.isNotEmpty()) {
                    "未收到卫星状态帧（测量批次 ${measurements.size}、导航电文 ${navigation.size}）；" +
                        "${notes.joinToString("；")}" + "。请检查接收环境和系统定位后重新采集"
                }
                // A nonempty acquisition window can contain only zero-CN0 rows. Return
                // that evidence so the repository can archive it without promoting it
                // to a playback profile. Quality gating belongs at that boundary.
                if (frames.none { it.satellites.any(GnssCaptureValidator::isUsableSatellite) }) {
                    notes += "未收到正 CN0 且几何有效的信号；本窗口仅供诊断，不可用于画像回放"
                }
                check(System.currentTimeMillis() >= frames.last().capturedAtMillis &&
                    frames.zipWithNext().all { (a, b) -> a.capturedAtMillis <= b.capturedAtMillis }) {
                    "采集期间系统时间倒退，请重新采集"
                }
                GnssCapture(deviceModel = "${Build.MANUFACTURER} ${Build.MODEL}", osVersion = "${Build.VERSION.RELEASE} / API ${Build.VERSION.SDK_INT}",
                    startedAtMillis = started, endedAtMillis = System.currentTimeMillis(), frames = frames.toList(),
                    measurements = measurements.toList(), navigation = navigation.toList(), notes = notes.toList(),
                    bootCount = runCatching { Settings.Global.getInt(context.contentResolver, Settings.Global.BOOT_COUNT) }
                        .getOrNull()?.takeIf { it >= 0 })
            } finally {
                accepting = false
                if (statusRegistered) runCatching { manager.unregisterGnssStatusCallback(statusCallback) }
                if (measurementRegistered) runCatching { manager.unregisterGnssMeasurementsCallback(measurementCallback) }
                if (navigationRegistered) runCatching { manager.unregisterGnssNavigationMessageCallback(navigationCallback) }
                if (locationRegistered) runCatching { manager.removeUpdates(locationListener) }
                capturing.set(false)
            }
        }

    @Suppress("DEPRECATION")
    private suspend fun readSystemState(manager: LocationManager, initialize: Boolean): GnssCaptureSystemState? =
        withContext(Dispatchers.IO) {
            if (initialize && !MockServiceHelper.isServiceInit()) MockServiceHelper.tryInitService(manager)
            var reply = runCatching { MockServiceHelper.runtimeStatus(manager) }.getOrNull()
            if (initialize && reply == null && MockServiceHelper.isServiceInit()) {
                // A stale token may be refreshed before collecting any receiver evidence.
                MockServiceHelper.tryInitService(manager)
                reply = runCatching { MockServiceHelper.runtimeStatus(manager) }.getOrNull()
            }
            val status = reply ?: return@withContext null
            val instance = status.get("runtime_instance")
            val generation = status.get("simulation_generation")
            val active = status.get("is_start")
            check(status.getString("hook_scope") == "SYSTEM_SERVER" && instance is String &&
                instance.isNotBlank() && instance.length <= 256 && generation is Long && generation >= 0 && active is Boolean) {
                "系统未提供可核对的模拟状态，请更新并重新加载模块后采集"
            }
            GnssCaptureSystemState(instance, generation, active)
        }

    companion object {
        private val capturing = AtomicBoolean(false)

        internal fun constellation(code: Int): Constellation? = when (code) {
            GnssStatus.CONSTELLATION_GPS -> Constellation.GPS
            GnssStatus.CONSTELLATION_BEIDOU -> Constellation.BEIDOU
            GnssStatus.CONSTELLATION_GLONASS -> Constellation.GLONASS
            GnssStatus.CONSTELLATION_GALILEO -> Constellation.GALILEO
            GnssStatus.CONSTELLATION_QZSS -> Constellation.QZSS
            GnssStatus.CONSTELLATION_SBAS -> Constellation.SBAS
            GnssStatus.CONSTELLATION_IRNSS -> Constellation.IRNSS
            else -> null
        }
    }
}
```

`app/src/main/java/com/system/location/service/gnss/GnssSkyPreview.kt`:

```kt
package com.system.location.service.gnss

import com.system.location.service.core.gnss.*
import com.system.location.service.core.location.LocationSample

/**
 * Local prediction using the same receiver model as injection, with private model ownership.
 * Never calls the process-wide publication cache: opening UI must not anchor a production route
 * to a different first sample or advance its publication sequence.
 */
internal class GnssSkyPreview {
    private data class Key(val policy: GnssSimulationPolicy, val digest: String?, val source: String?,
        val calibration: GnssAutonomousSignalCalibration?, val catalog: BeiDouCatalogManifest?)
    private var key: Key? = null
    private var model: ReceiverAutonomousSkyModel? = null

    fun frame(sample: LocationSample, minimum: Int, policy: GnssSimulationPolicy,
        navigation: RinexNavigationResource?, capture: CapturedGnssSource? = null,
        validationAtMillis: Long = sample.timeMillis): ReceiverGnssFrame? {
        if (policy.mode == GnssSimulationMode.OFF || policy.mode == GnssSimulationMode.REPLAY) return null
        navigation?.validate()
        val calibration = capture?.signalCalibration.takeIf { policy.mode == GnssSimulationMode.AUTO }
        val next = Key(policy, navigation?.sha256, navigation?.sourceUrl, calibration,
            navigation?.beiDouCatalog?.manifest)
        if (key != next) {
            model = GnssBundledOrbitResources.model(policy, GnssOutputLimits(128, 36, 32),
                gpsAlmanacAgeBudgetSeconds = 7 * 86400.0, navigation = navigation, signalCalibration = calibration)
            key = next
        }
        return model!!.frame(GnssSkyRequest(sample.timeMillis, sample.coordinate, sample.altitude), minimum, validationAtMillis)
    }
}
```

`app/src/main/java/com/system/location/service/gnss/ReplayPreferences.kt`:

```kt
package com.system.location.service.gnss

import android.content.Context
import com.system.location.service.ext.sharedPrefs
import com.system.location.service.core.gnss.GnssCaptureStore
import com.system.location.service.core.gnss.GnssCaptureValidator
import com.system.location.service.android.root.RootEnvironmentProbe
import com.system.location.service.runtime.XposedServiceBridge
import java.io.File
import kotlinx.coroutines.Dispatchers
import kotlinx.coroutines.withContext

/** Startup choices are separate from the live module's transient switches. */
var Context.gnssReplayOnStart: Boolean
    get() = sharedPrefs.getBoolean("gnssReplayOnStart", false)
    set(value) { sharedPrefs.edit().putBoolean("gnssReplayOnStart", value).apply() }

val Context.replayEnvironmentName: String
    get() = sharedPrefs.getString("replayEnvironmentName", "").orEmpty()

/** Called after the authenticated system-module handshake, before its full config is sent. */
internal suspend fun Context.applySatelliteStartupDefaults(systemModuleActive: Boolean) {
    if (!systemModuleActive || sharedPrefs.contains("gnssReplayOnStart") ||
        sharedPrefs.getString("gnssSimulationMode", null) == "OFF") return
    withContext(Dispatchers.IO) {
        val rooted = XposedServiceBridge.supportsSystemScope() || RootEnvironmentProbe.isAvailable()
        // Read after the probe so a manual choice made while checking Root wins.
        val additions = SatelliteStartupDefaults.additions(sharedPrefs.all, rooted, systemModuleActive)
        if (additions.isNotEmpty()) {
            check(sharedPrefs.edit().apply {
                additions.forEach { (key, value) -> when (value) {
                    is Boolean -> putBoolean(key, value)
                    is String -> putString(key, value)
                } }
            }.commit()) { "无法保存卫星启动设置" }
        }
    }
}

/** Called off the main thread, including every start, since receiver evidence expires. */
internal fun Context.gnssReplayProblem(): String? {
    if (!gnssReplayOnStart || sharedPrefs.getString("gnssSimulationMode", "AUTONOMOUS") != "REPLAY") return null
    return try {
        val capture = GnssCaptureStore(File(noBackupFilesDir, "gnss/receiver-capture.json")).load()
            ?: return "尚无卫星采集，请先采集或选择目标天空"
        GnssCaptureValidator.validate(capture, System.currentTimeMillis()).takeUnless { it.eligible }
            ?.let { "卫星采集不可用：${it.issues.joinToString("；")}" }
    } catch (_: Exception) { "无法读取卫星采集，请重新采集或选择目标天空" }
}
```

`app/src/main/java/com/system/location/service/gnss/SatelliteStartupDefaults.kt`:

```kt
package com.system.location.service.gnss

import com.system.location.service.core.gnss.GnssSimulationMode

/** Fill only an untouched startup choice; explicit replay and disabling remain user choices. */
internal object SatelliteStartupDefaults {
    fun additions(preferences: Map<String, *>, rooted: Boolean, systemModuleActive: Boolean): Map<String, Any> {
        if (!rooted || !systemModuleActive || preferences.containsKey("gnssReplayOnStart")) return emptyMap()
        if (preferences["gnssSimulationMode"] == GnssSimulationMode.OFF.name) return emptyMap()
        return buildMap {
            put("gnssReplayOnStart", true)
            if (!preferences.containsKey("gnssSimulationMode")) {
                put("gnssSimulationMode", GnssSimulationMode.AUTONOMOUS.name)
            }
        }
    }
}
```

`app/src/main/java/com/system/location/service/maps/AMapKeyPolicy.kt`:

```kt
package com.system.location.service.maps

import java.security.MessageDigest
import java.io.ByteArrayOutputStream
import java.io.InputStream

internal object AMapKeyPolicy {
    fun readBounded(input: InputStream, maxBytes: Int): ByteArray {
        require(maxBytes >= 0)
        val output = ByteArrayOutputStream(minOf(maxBytes, 1024))
        val buffer = ByteArray(256)
        while (true) {
            val count = input.read(buffer)
            if (count < 0) return output.toByteArray()
            require(count <= maxBytes - output.size()) { "自定义 Key 文件过大" }
            output.write(buffer, 0, count)
        }
    }

    fun effectiveKey(hasCustomKey: Boolean, readCustomKey: () -> String?, bundledKey: () -> String): String {
        if (hasCustomKey) runCatching(readCustomKey).getOrNull()?.let { return it }
        return bundledKey()
    }

    fun normalize(value: String): String? {
        val key = value.trim()
        if (key.isEmpty()) return null
        require(key.length in 8..256 && key.all {
            it in 'A'..'Z' || it in 'a'..'z' || it in '0'..'9' || it == '-' || it == '_'
        }) {
            "高德 Key 格式不合法"
        }
        return key
    }

    fun signerSha1(signatures: List<ByteArray>): String {
        require(signatures.isNotEmpty()) { "无法读取当前安装包签名" }
        return signatures.map { signature ->
            MessageDigest.getInstance("SHA-1").digest(signature)
                .joinToString(":") { byte -> "%02X".format(byte) }
        }.sorted().joinToString("\n")
    }
}
```

`app/src/main/java/com/system/location/service/maps/AMapKeySettings.kt`:

```kt
package com.system.location.service.maps

import android.content.Context
import android.content.pm.PackageManager
import android.os.Build
import com.amap.api.location.AMapLocationClient
import com.amap.api.maps.MapsInitializer
import com.amap.api.services.core.ServiceSettings

object AMapKeySettings {
    private val store = EncryptedKeyStore("portal.amap.api.key.v1", "amap-api-key.enc")

    fun customKey(context: Context): String? = store.read(context.applicationContext)
        ?.let(AMapKeyPolicy::normalize)

    fun effectiveKey(context: Context): String {
        val app = context.applicationContext
        val customKey = runCatching { customKey(app) }.getOrNull()
        return customKey ?: bundledKey(app)
    }

    fun saveCustomKey(context: Context, value: String) {
        val key = AMapKeyPolicy.normalize(value)
        if (key == null) {
            clearCustomKey(context)
            return
        }
        store.write(context.applicationContext, key)
    }

    fun clearCustomKey(context: Context) = store.clear(context.applicationContext)

    fun apply(context: Context): Boolean {
        val key = effectiveKey(context)
        if (key.isBlank()) return false
        MapsInitializer.setApiKey(key)
        ServiceSettings.getInstance().setApiKey(key)
        AMapLocationClient.setApiKey(key)
        return true
    }

    fun applicationSha1(context: Context): String {
        val packageManager = context.packageManager
        val info = when {
            Build.VERSION.SDK_INT >= Build.VERSION_CODES.TIRAMISU -> packageManager.getPackageInfo(
                context.packageName,
                PackageManager.PackageInfoFlags.of(PackageManager.GET_SIGNING_CERTIFICATES.toLong()),
            )
            Build.VERSION.SDK_INT >= Build.VERSION_CODES.P -> packageManager.getPackageInfo(
                context.packageName,
                PackageManager.GET_SIGNING_CERTIFICATES,
            )
            else -> {
                @Suppress("DEPRECATION")
                packageManager.getPackageInfo(context.packageName, PackageManager.GET_SIGNATURES)
            }
        }
        val signatures = if (Build.VERSION.SDK_INT >= Build.VERSION_CODES.P) {
            info.signingInfo?.apkContentsSigners.orEmpty().map { it.toByteArray() }
        } else {
            @Suppress("DEPRECATION")
            info.signatures.orEmpty().map { it.toByteArray() }
        }
        return AMapKeyPolicy.signerSha1(signatures)
    }

    private fun bundledKey(context: Context): String = runCatching {
        val info = if (Build.VERSION.SDK_INT >= Build.VERSION_CODES.TIRAMISU) {
            context.packageManager.getApplicationInfo(
                context.packageName,
                PackageManager.ApplicationInfoFlags.of(PackageManager.GET_META_DATA.toLong()),
            )
        } else {
            @Suppress("DEPRECATION")
            context.packageManager.getApplicationInfo(context.packageName, PackageManager.GET_META_DATA)
        }
        info.metaData?.getString("com.amap.api.v2.apikey").orEmpty()
    }.getOrDefault("")
}
```

`app/src/main/java/com/system/location/service/maps/EncryptedKeyStore.kt`:

```kt
package com.system.location.service.maps

import android.content.Context
import android.security.keystore.KeyGenParameterSpec
import android.security.keystore.KeyProperties
import android.util.AtomicFile
import android.util.Base64
import java.io.File
import java.security.KeyStore
import javax.crypto.Cipher
import javax.crypto.KeyGenerator
import javax.crypto.SecretKey
import javax.crypto.spec.GCMParameterSpec

/**
 * One API key, encrypted at rest with a per-purpose Android Keystore key.
 *
 * The plaintext key never enters SharedPreferences or logs. A corrupt/foreign file is reported as
 * an invalid custom key so the caller can fall back to the bundled key or ask the user to save it
 * again. This is intentionally a small primitive shared by map providers.
 */
internal class EncryptedKeyStore(
    private val keyAlias: String,
    private val fileName: String,
) {
    private val storageLock = Any()

    fun read(context: Context): String? = synchronized(storageLock) {
        val app = context.applicationContext
        val file = AtomicFile(File(app.noBackupFilesDir, fileName))
        if (!file.baseFile.exists()) return null
        val fields = file.openRead().use { input ->
            KeyFilePolicy.readBounded(input, MAX_STORAGE_BYTES).toString(Charsets.US_ASCII)
        }.split('\n')
        require(fields.size == 3 && fields[0].toIntOrNull() == FORMAT_VERSION) {
            "自定义 Key 文件格式无效"
        }
        val iv = Base64.decode(fields[1], Base64.NO_WRAP)
        val ciphertext = Base64.decode(fields[2], Base64.NO_WRAP)
        require(iv.size == IV_BYTES && ciphertext.size in TAG_BYTES..MAX_CIPHERTEXT_BYTES) {
            "自定义 Key 文件数据无效"
        }
        val cipher = Cipher.getInstance("AES/GCM/NoPadding")
        cipher.init(Cipher.DECRYPT_MODE, secretKey(), GCMParameterSpec(128, iv))
        cipher.doFinal(ciphertext).toString(Charsets.UTF_8).takeIf(String::isNotBlank)
    }

    fun write(context: Context, value: String) = synchronized(storageLock) {
        val cipher = Cipher.getInstance("AES/GCM/NoPadding")
        cipher.init(Cipher.ENCRYPT_MODE, secretKey())
        val ciphertext = cipher.doFinal(value.toByteArray(Charsets.UTF_8))
        val payload = listOf(
            FORMAT_VERSION.toString(),
            Base64.encodeToString(cipher.iv, Base64.NO_WRAP),
            Base64.encodeToString(ciphertext, Base64.NO_WRAP),
        ).joinToString("\n").toByteArray(Charsets.US_ASCII)
        writeAtomically(context.applicationContext, payload)
    }

    fun clear(context: Context) = synchronized(storageLock) {
        val file = AtomicFile(File(context.applicationContext.noBackupFilesDir, fileName))
        if (file.baseFile.exists()) file.delete()
        runCatching {
            KeyStore.getInstance("AndroidKeyStore").apply { load(null) }.deleteEntry(keyAlias)
        }
        Unit
    }

    private fun writeAtomically(context: Context, payload: ByteArray) {
        val file = AtomicFile(File(context.noBackupFilesDir, fileName))
        val stream = file.startWrite()
        try {
            stream.write(payload)
            file.finishWrite(stream)
        } catch (failure: Throwable) {
            file.failWrite(stream)
            throw failure
        }
    }

    private fun secretKey(): SecretKey {
        val store = KeyStore.getInstance("AndroidKeyStore").apply { load(null) }
        (store.getKey(keyAlias, null) as? SecretKey)?.let { return it }
        val generator = KeyGenerator.getInstance(KeyProperties.KEY_ALGORITHM_AES, "AndroidKeyStore")
        generator.init(KeyGenParameterSpec.Builder(
            keyAlias,
            KeyProperties.PURPOSE_ENCRYPT or KeyProperties.PURPOSE_DECRYPT,
        )
            .setBlockModes(KeyProperties.BLOCK_MODE_GCM)
            .setEncryptionPaddings(KeyProperties.ENCRYPTION_PADDING_NONE)
            .setRandomizedEncryptionRequired(true)
            .build())
        return generator.generateKey()
    }

    private companion object {
        const val FORMAT_VERSION = 1
        const val MAX_STORAGE_BYTES = 1024
        const val IV_BYTES = 12
        const val TAG_BYTES = 16
        // 256 UTF-8 bytes of key material plus the GCM tag.
        const val MAX_CIPHERTEXT_BYTES = 256 + TAG_BYTES
    }
}

/** Shared bounded-read rule used by tests and both map key stores. */
internal object KeyFilePolicy {
    fun readBounded(input: java.io.InputStream, maxBytes: Int): ByteArray {
        require(maxBytes >= 0)
        val output = java.io.ByteArrayOutputStream(minOf(maxBytes, 1024))
        val buffer = ByteArray(256)
        while (true) {
            val count = input.read(buffer)
            if (count < 0) return output.toByteArray()
            require(count <= maxBytes - output.size()) { "自定义 Key 文件过大" }
            output.write(buffer, 0, count)
        }
    }
}
```

`app/src/main/java/com/system/location/service/maps/MapLocationBadge.kt`:

```kt
package com.system.location.service.maps

import android.content.Context
import android.graphics.Canvas
import android.graphics.DashPathEffect
import android.graphics.Paint
import android.graphics.Typeface
import android.view.View
import androidx.core.content.ContextCompat
import com.system.location.service.R

/** The marker anchor is the centre of the dot, below its persistent caption. */
internal class MapLocationBadge(context: Context, private val original: Boolean, private val caption: String) : View(context) {
    private val density = resources.displayMetrics.density
    private val paint = Paint(Paint.ANTI_ALIAS_FLAG)
    private val blue = android.graphics.Color.rgb(37, 99, 235)
    private val muted = ContextCompat.getColor(context, R.color.text_secondary)
    private val surface = ContextCompat.getColor(context, R.color.surface)
    private val dashed = DashPathEffect(floatArrayOf(3 * density, 3 * density), 0f)

    override fun onMeasure(widthMeasureSpec: Int, heightMeasureSpec: Int) {
        setMeasuredDimension((116 * density).toInt(), (64 * density).toInt())
    }

    override fun onDraw(canvas: Canvas) {
        val cx = width / 2f
        val cy = 44 * density
        val color = if (original) muted else blue
        paint.style = Paint.Style.FILL
        paint.color = surface
        paint.alpha = if (original) 210 else 245
        canvas.drawRoundRect(2 * density, 0f, width - 2 * density, 25 * density, 12 * density, 12 * density, paint)
        paint.alpha = 255
        paint.color = color
        paint.typeface = Typeface.create("sans-serif-medium", Typeface.NORMAL)
        paint.textAlign = Paint.Align.CENTER
        paint.textSize = minOf(12 * resources.displayMetrics.scaledDensity, 14 * density)
        val baseline = 12.5f * density - (paint.ascent() + paint.descent()) / 2
        canvas.drawText(caption, cx, baseline, paint)
        paint.alpha = if (original) 16 else 30
        canvas.drawCircle(cx, cy, 17 * density, paint)
        paint.alpha = if (original) 150 else 255
        if (original) {
            paint.style = Paint.Style.STROKE
            paint.strokeWidth = 1.5f * density
            paint.pathEffect = dashed
            canvas.drawCircle(cx, cy, 12 * density, paint)
            paint.pathEffect = null
            paint.strokeWidth = density
            canvas.drawCircle(cx, cy, 4 * density, paint)
        } else {
            paint.color = android.graphics.Color.WHITE
            canvas.drawCircle(cx, cy, 10 * density, paint)
            paint.color = blue
            canvas.drawCircle(cx, cy, 7 * density, paint)
        }
        paint.style = Paint.Style.FILL
        paint.alpha = 255
    }
}
```

`app/src/main/java/com/system/location/service/maps/MapProvider.kt`:

```kt
package com.system.location.service.maps

import android.content.Context
import com.system.location.service.ext.sharedPrefs

enum class MapProvider(val label: String) {
    AMAP("高德地图"), TENCENT("腾讯地图");
    companion object {
        fun restore(value: String?) = entries.firstOrNull { it.name == value } ?: TENCENT
    }
}

var Context.mapProvider: MapProvider
    get() = MapProvider.restore(sharedPrefs.getString("map_provider", null))
    set(value) {
        val previous = sharedPrefs.getString("map_provider", null)
        if (!sharedPrefs.edit().putString("map_provider", value.name).commit()) {
            // A failed disk commit still updates SharedPreferences' in-memory value.
            val rollback = sharedPrefs.edit()
            if (previous == null) rollback.remove("map_provider") else rollback.putString("map_provider", previous)
            rollback.commit()
            error("地图设置保存失败")
        }
    }

/** Logical styles deliberately do not persist SDK integer constants across providers. */
var Context.satelliteMap: Boolean
    get() = sharedPrefs.getBoolean("map_satellite", sharedPrefs.getInt("mapType", 1) == 2)
    set(value) { sharedPrefs.edit().putBoolean("map_satellite", value).apply() }
```

`app/src/main/java/com/system/location/service/maps/MapServices.kt`:

```kt
package com.system.location.service.maps

import android.content.Context
import com.amap.api.services.help.Inputtips
import com.amap.api.services.help.InputtipsQuery
import com.amap.api.services.geocoder.*
import com.amap.api.services.core.LatLonPoint
import com.system.location.service.amap.AMapRoutePlanner
import com.system.location.service.core.geo.Gcj02
import com.system.location.service.core.planning.PlanRequest
import kotlinx.coroutines.*
import org.json.JSONObject
import java.net.HttpURLConnection
import java.net.URI
import java.net.URLEncoder
import kotlin.coroutines.resume
import kotlin.coroutines.resumeWithException

data class PlaceSuggestion(val name: String, val address: String, val point: Gcj02)
data class PlaceAddress(val title: String, val address: String)

/** Provider captured with the map view: never fall back to a competing service. */
class MapServices(private val context: Context, val provider: MapProvider = context.mapProvider) {
    suspend fun suggestions(query: String, city: String = ""): List<PlaceSuggestion> {
        if (provider == MapProvider.TENCENT) {
            val data = get("place/v1/suggestion/", mapOf("keyword" to query, "region" to city.ifBlank { "全国" }, "region_fix" to "0")).getJSONArray("data")
            return (0 until data.length()).mapNotNull { i ->
                val item = data.getJSONObject(i)
                val p = item.optJSONObject("location") ?: return@mapNotNull null
                PlaceSuggestion(item.optString("title"), item.optString("address"), Gcj02(p.getDouble("lat"), p.getDouble("lng")))
            }
        }
        return suspendCancellableCoroutine { continuation ->
            try {
                Inputtips(context, InputtipsQuery(query, city)).apply {
                    setInputtipsListener { tips, code ->
                        if (!continuation.isActive) return@setInputtipsListener
                        if (code != 1000) continuation.resumeWithException(IllegalStateException("高德搜索失败（$code）"))
                        else continuation.resume(tips.orEmpty().mapNotNull { tip -> tip.point?.let {
                            PlaceSuggestion(tip.name.orEmpty(), tip.address.orEmpty(), Gcj02(it.latitude, it.longitude))
                        } })
                    }
                    requestInputtipsAsyn()
                }
            } catch (error: Exception) { if (continuation.isActive) continuation.resumeWithException(error) }
        }
    }
    suspend fun address(point: Gcj02): PlaceAddress {
        if (provider == MapProvider.TENCENT) {
            val result = get("geocoder/v1/", mapOf("location" to "${point.latitude},${point.longitude}", "get_poi" to "0")).getJSONObject("result")
            val address = result.optString("address")
            return PlaceAddress(result.optJSONObject("formatted_addresses")?.optString("recommend").orEmpty().ifBlank { address }, address)
        }
        return suspendCancellableCoroutine { continuation ->
            try {
                GeocodeSearch(context).apply {
                    setOnGeocodeSearchListener(object : GeocodeSearch.OnGeocodeSearchListener {
                        override fun onGeocodeSearched(result: GeocodeResult?, code: Int) = Unit
                        override fun onRegeocodeSearched(result: RegeocodeResult?, code: Int) {
                            if (!continuation.isActive) return
                            val address = result?.regeocodeAddress
                            if (code != 1000 || address == null) continuation.resumeWithException(IllegalStateException("高德地址查询失败（$code）"))
                            else continuation.resume(PlaceAddress(address.pois?.firstOrNull()?.title ?: address.district.orEmpty(), address.formatAddress.orEmpty()))
                        }
                    })
                    getFromLocationAsyn(RegeocodeQuery(LatLonPoint(point.latitude, point.longitude), 200f, GeocodeSearch.AMAP))
                }
            } catch (error: Exception) { if (continuation.isActive) continuation.resumeWithException(error) }
        }
    }
    suspend fun walk(request: PlanRequest): List<List<Gcj02>> {
        if (provider == MapProvider.AMAP) return AMapRoutePlanner(context).plan(request)
        val result = get("direction/v1/walking/", mapOf("from" to "${request.start.latitude},${request.start.longitude}",
            "to" to "${request.end.latitude},${request.end.longitude}"))
        val routes = result.getJSONObject("result").getJSONArray("routes")
        check(routes.length() > 0) { "腾讯未返回可用步行路线" }
        val raw = routes.getJSONObject(0).getJSONArray("polyline")
        val values = (0 until raw.length()).map { raw.getDouble(it) }.toMutableList()
        return listOf(TencentPolyline.decode(values))
    }
    private suspend fun get(path: String, params: Map<String, String>): JSONObject = withContext(Dispatchers.IO) {
        check(provider == MapProvider.TENCENT && com.system.location.service.privacy.TencentPrivacy.ready(context)) { "腾讯地图尚未授权" }
        val key = TencentKeySettings.effectiveKey(context)
        check(key.isNotBlank()) { "腾讯地图 Key 未配置" }
        val query = (params + ("key" to key)).entries.joinToString("&") {
            URLEncoder.encode(it.key, "UTF-8") + "=" + URLEncoder.encode(it.value, "UTF-8")
        }
        val connection = URI("https://apis.map.qq.com/ws/$path?$query").toURL().openConnection() as HttpURLConnection
        connection.connectTimeout = 10_000; connection.readTimeout = 15_000
        try {
            ensureActive()
            check(connection.responseCode == 200) { "腾讯地图网络请求失败（HTTP ${connection.responseCode}）" }
            val body = connection.inputStream.bufferedReader().use { it.readText() }
            ensureActive()
            val result = JSONObject(body)
            val status = result.optInt("status", -1)
            check(status == 0) { "腾讯地图请求失败（$status）：${result.optString("message")}" }
            result
        } finally { connection.disconnect() }
    }
}

/** Tencent walking responses delta-encode each coordinate from the preceding same-axis value. */
object TencentPolyline {
    fun decode(encoded: List<Double>): List<Gcj02> {
        require(encoded.size >= 4 && encoded.size % 2 == 0) { "腾讯步行路线坐标无效" }
        val values = encoded.toMutableList()
        for (i in 2 until values.size) values[i] = values[i - 2] + values[i] / 1_000_000.0
        return values.chunked(2).map { Gcj02(it[0], it[1]) }
    }
}
```

`app/src/main/java/com/system/location/service/maps/MapViewLifecycle.kt`:

```kt
package com.system.location.service.maps

/** Compose creation and Fragment callbacks can catch up to the same visible SDK session. */
internal class MapViewLifecycle(private val dispatch: (Event) -> Unit) {
    enum class Event { START, RESUME, PAUSE, STOP }
    private var started = false
    private var resumed = false
    private var closed = false
    private var stopRequested = false

    fun start() {
        stopRequested = false
        if (closed || started) return
        dispatch(Event.START)
        started = true
    }

    fun resume() {
        stopRequested = false
        if (closed || resumed) return
        start()
        dispatch(Event.RESUME)
        resumed = true
    }

    fun pause() {
        if (!resumed) return
        dispatch(Event.PAUSE)
        resumed = false
    }

    fun stop(visible: Boolean = false) {
        stopRequested = true
        if (visible) return
        stopNow()
    }

    fun visibilityChanged(visible: Boolean) {
        if (stopRequested && !visible) stopNow()
    }

    private fun stopNow() {
        stopRequested = false
        pause()
        if (!started) return
        dispatch(Event.STOP)
        started = false
    }

    fun close() {
        if (closed) return
        stop()
        closed = true
    }
}
```

`app/src/main/java/com/system/location/service/maps/PortalMapView.kt`:

```kt
package com.system.location.service.maps

import android.content.Context
import android.content.res.Configuration
import android.graphics.Point
import android.graphics.Bitmap
import android.os.Bundle
import android.util.AttributeSet
import android.view.View
import android.widget.FrameLayout
import android.widget.ImageView
import com.system.location.service.core.geo.Gcj02
import com.system.location.service.core.planning.MapCamera
import com.system.location.service.privacy.TencentPrivacy
import com.amap.api.maps.CameraUpdateFactory as ACamera
import com.amap.api.maps.model.LatLng as APoint
import com.tencent.tencentmap.mapsdk.maps.CameraUpdateFactory as TCamera
import com.tencent.tencentmap.mapsdk.maps.TencentMapOptions
import com.tencent.tencentmap.mapsdk.maps.model.LatLng as TPoint

interface MapOverlay { fun remove() }
interface MapMarker : MapOverlay { fun position(point: Gcj02) }
interface MapLine : MapOverlay { fun points(points: List<Gcj02>) }

/** Only the selected SDK view is constructed, after its consent gate. Coordinates are GCJ-02. */
class PortalMapView @JvmOverloads constructor(context: Context, attrs: AttributeSet? = null) : FrameLayout(context, attrs) {
    val provider = context.mapProvider
    private var amap: com.amap.api.maps.MapView? = null
    private var tencent: com.tencent.tencentmap.mapsdk.maps.MapView? = null
    private var current: MapMarker? = null
    private var original: MapMarker? = null
    private var currentSimulated = false
    private var destroyed = false
    private var bottomObstruction = 0
    private var cameraRequest = 0L
    private var transitionFrame: ImageView? = null
    private var snapshotRequest = 0L

    /** GL surfaces cannot be faded by Fragment transitions; animate the SDK's own last frame. */
    fun holdTransitionFrame(ready: () -> Unit) {
        val request = ++snapshotRequest
        var completed = false
        fun accept(bitmap: Bitmap?) {
            if (completed) return
            completed = true
            if (request == snapshotRequest && !destroyed && isAttachedToWindow && bitmap != null) {
                transitionFrame?.let(::removeView)
                transitionFrame = ImageView(context).apply {
                    scaleType = ImageView.ScaleType.FIT_XY
                    setImageBitmap(bitmap)
                    importantForAccessibility = View.IMPORTANT_FOR_ACCESSIBILITY_NO
                    addView(this, LayoutParams(-1, -1))
                }
            }
            ready()
        }
        postDelayed({ accept(null) }, 200)
        if (tencent != null) tencent?.map?.snapshot { bitmap -> post { accept(bitmap) } }
        else if (amap != null) amap?.map?.getMapScreenShot(object : com.amap.api.maps.AMap.OnMapScreenShotListener {
            override fun onMapScreenShot(bitmap: Bitmap?) { post { accept(bitmap) } }
            override fun onMapScreenShot(bitmap: Bitmap?, status: Int) { post { accept(bitmap) } }
        }) else accept(null)
    }

    private fun releaseTransitionFrame() {
        snapshotRequest++
        transitionFrame?.let { it.setImageDrawable(null); removeView(it) }
        transitionFrame = null
    }
    private val lifecycle = MapViewLifecycle { event ->
        when (event) {
            MapViewLifecycle.Event.START -> tencent?.onStart()
            MapViewLifecycle.Event.RESUME -> { amap?.onResume(); tencent?.onResume() }
            MapViewLifecycle.Event.PAUSE -> { amap?.onPause(); tencent?.onPause() }
            MapViewLifecycle.Event.STOP -> tencent?.onStop()
        }
    }
    fun onCreate(state: Bundle?) {
        check(!destroyed && childCount == 0)
        if (provider == MapProvider.AMAP) {
            check(com.system.location.service.privacy.SdkPrivacy.mapsReady)
            amap = com.amap.api.maps.MapView(context).also { view ->
                addView(view, LayoutParams(-1, -1)); view.onCreate(state)
                view.map.uiSettings.apply {
                    isCompassEnabled = true; isZoomControlsEnabled = false
                    isScaleControlsEnabled = true; isMyLocationButtonEnabled = false
                }
            }
        } else {
            check(TencentPrivacy.ready(context)) { "请先同意腾讯地图隐私政策" }
            val options = TencentMapOptions().also { options ->
                TencentKeySettings.effectiveKey(context).takeIf(String::isNotBlank)
                    ?.let(options::setMapKey)
            }
            tencent = com.tencent.tencentmap.mapsdk.maps.MapView(context, options).also { view ->
                addView(view, LayoutParams(-1, -1))
                view.map.uiSettings.apply {
                    isCompassEnabled = true; isZoomControlsEnabled = false
                    isScaleViewEnabled = true; isMyLocationButtonEnabled = false
                }
            }
        }
        satellite(context.satelliteMap)
    }

    /** Keep vendor attribution in the map, above measured floating controls. Values are pixels. */
    fun setBottomObstruction(pixels: Int) {
        val next = pixels.coerceAtLeast(0)
        if (bottomObstruction == next) return
        bottomObstruction = next
        positionMapControls()
    }

    override fun onSizeChanged(w: Int, h: Int, oldw: Int, oldh: Int) {
        super.onSizeChanged(w, h, oldw, oldh)
        positionMapControls()
    }

    private fun positionMapControls() {
        if (height == 0) return
        val edge = (16 * resources.displayMetrics.density).toInt()
        val bottom = bottomObstruction + edge
        // AMap uses absolute screen coordinates for the scale, bottom margins for its logo.
        amap?.map?.uiSettings?.apply {
            setLogoPosition(com.amap.api.maps.AMapOptions.LOGO_POSITION_BOTTOM_LEFT)
            setLogoLeftMargin(edge)
            setLogoBottomMargin(bottom)
            setScaleControlsPosition(Point(edge, (height - bottom - 32 * resources.displayMetrics.density).toInt().coerceAtLeast(0)))
        }
        // Tencent's bottom-left logo margins are [bottom, left]; scale supports explicit margins.
        tencent?.map?.uiSettings?.apply {
            setLogoPosition(com.tencent.tencentmap.mapsdk.maps.TencentMapOptions.LOGO_POSITION_BOTTOM_LEFT, intArrayOf(bottom, edge))
            setScaleViewPositionWithMargin(com.tencent.tencentmap.mapsdk.maps.TencentMapOptions.SCALEVIEW_POSITION_BOTTOM_LEFT,
                -1, bottom + (32 * resources.displayMetrics.density).toInt(), edge, -1)
        }
    }

    fun fit(points: List<Gcj02>, padding: Int) {
        if (points.isEmpty()) return
        val request = ++cameraRequest
        // SDK bounds updates require a measured map; skip callbacks after destruction.
        post {
            if (destroyed || request != cameraRequest || width == 0 || height == 0) return@post
            val inset = padding.coerceAtMost((minOf(width, height) / 3).coerceAtLeast(0))
            val bottom = (bottomObstruction + inset).coerceAtMost((height * 0.65f).toInt())
            val top = (112 * resources.displayMetrics.density).toInt().coerceAtMost(height / 3)
            amap?.map?.let { map ->
                val bounds = com.amap.api.maps.model.LatLngBounds.builder()
                points.forEach { bounds.include(APoint(it.latitude, it.longitude)) }
                map.moveCamera(ACamera.newLatLngBoundsRect(bounds.build(), inset, inset, top, bottom))
            }
            tencent?.map?.let { map ->
                val bounds = com.tencent.tencentmap.mapsdk.maps.model.LatLngBounds.builder()
                points.forEach { bounds.include(TPoint(it.latitude, it.longitude)) }
                map.moveCamera(TCamera.newLatLngBoundsRect(bounds.build(), inset, inset, top, bottom))
            }
        }
    }
    fun satellite(enabled: Boolean) {
        val dark = resources.configuration.uiMode and Configuration.UI_MODE_NIGHT_MASK == Configuration.UI_MODE_NIGHT_YES
        amap?.map?.mapType = if (enabled) 2 else if (dark) 3 else 1
        tencent?.map?.mapType = if (enabled) com.tencent.tencentmap.mapsdk.maps.TencentMap.MAP_TYPE_SATELLITE
            else if (dark) com.tencent.tencentmap.mapsdk.maps.TencentMap.MAP_TYPE_DARK else com.tencent.tencentmap.mapsdk.maps.TencentMap.MAP_TYPE_NORMAL
    }
    fun move(point: Gcj02, zoom: Float? = null, animate: Boolean = false) {
        cameraRequest++
        amap?.map?.let { map ->
            val update = if (zoom == null) ACamera.changeLatLng(APoint(point.latitude, point.longitude))
                else ACamera.newLatLngZoom(APoint(point.latitude, point.longitude), zoom)
            if (animate) map.animateCamera(update) else map.moveCamera(update)
        }
        tencent?.map?.let { map ->
            val update = if (zoom == null) TCamera.newLatLng(TPoint(point.latitude, point.longitude))
                else TCamera.newLatLngZoom(TPoint(point.latitude, point.longitude), zoom)
            if (animate) map.animateCamera(update) else map.moveCamera(update)
        }
    }
    fun camera(camera: MapCamera) {
        amap?.map?.moveCamera(ACamera.newCameraPosition(com.amap.api.maps.model.CameraPosition(
            APoint(camera.target.latitude, camera.target.longitude), camera.zoom, camera.tilt, camera.bearing)))
        tencent?.map?.moveCamera(TCamera.newCameraPosition(com.tencent.tencentmap.mapsdk.maps.model.CameraPosition(
            TPoint(camera.target.latitude, camera.target.longitude), camera.zoom, camera.tilt, camera.bearing)))
    }
    fun onClick(callback: ((Gcj02) -> Unit)?) {
        amap?.map?.setOnMapClickListener(callback?.let { cb -> com.amap.api.maps.AMap.OnMapClickListener { cb(Gcj02(it.latitude, it.longitude)) } })
        tencent?.map?.setOnMapClickListener(callback?.let { cb -> com.tencent.tencentmap.mapsdk.maps.TencentMap.OnMapClickListener { cb(Gcj02(it.latitude, it.longitude)) } })
    }
    fun onCamera(callback: ((MapCamera) -> Unit)?) {
        amap?.map?.setOnCameraChangeListener(if (callback == null) null else object : com.amap.api.maps.AMap.OnCameraChangeListener {
            override fun onCameraChange(p: com.amap.api.maps.model.CameraPosition?) = Unit
            override fun onCameraChangeFinish(p: com.amap.api.maps.model.CameraPosition?) { p?.let { callback(MapCamera(Gcj02(it.target.latitude, it.target.longitude), it.zoom, it.bearing, it.tilt)) } }
        })
        tencent?.map?.setOnCameraChangeListener(if (callback == null) null else object : com.tencent.tencentmap.mapsdk.maps.TencentMap.OnCameraChangeListener {
            override fun onCameraChange(p: com.tencent.tencentmap.mapsdk.maps.model.CameraPosition?) = Unit
            override fun onCameraChangeFinished(p: com.tencent.tencentmap.mapsdk.maps.model.CameraPosition?) { p?.let { callback(MapCamera(Gcj02(it.target.latitude, it.target.longitude), it.zoom, it.bearing, it.tilt)) } }
        })
    }
    fun project(point: Point): Gcj02 = amap?.map?.projection?.fromScreenLocation(point)?.let { Gcj02(it.latitude, it.longitude) }
        ?: tencent!!.map.projection.fromScreenLocation(point).let { Gcj02(it.latitude, it.longitude) }
    fun marker(point: Gcj02, title: String, label: View? = null, selected: Boolean = false, anchorY: Float = 1f): MapMarker {
        amap?.map?.let { map ->
            val options = com.amap.api.maps.model.MarkerOptions().position(APoint(point.latitude, point.longitude)).title(title)
            if (label != null) options.icon(com.amap.api.maps.model.BitmapDescriptorFactory.fromView(label)).anchor(0.5f, anchorY)
            else if (selected) options.icon(com.amap.api.maps.model.BitmapDescriptorFactory.fromResource(com.system.location.service.R.drawable.icon_selected_location_16))
            val marker = map.addMarker(options)
            return object : MapMarker {
                override fun remove() { marker.remove() }
                override fun position(point: Gcj02) { marker.position = APoint(point.latitude, point.longitude) }
            }
        }
        val options = com.tencent.tencentmap.mapsdk.maps.model.MarkerOptions().position(TPoint(point.latitude, point.longitude)).title(title)
        if (label != null) options.icon(com.tencent.tencentmap.mapsdk.maps.model.BitmapDescriptorFactory.fromView(label)).anchor(0.5f, anchorY)
        else if (selected) options.icon(com.tencent.tencentmap.mapsdk.maps.model.BitmapDescriptorFactory.fromResource(com.system.location.service.R.drawable.icon_selected_location_16))
        val marker = tencent!!.map.addMarker(options)
        return object : MapMarker {
            override fun remove() { marker.remove() }
            override fun position(point: Gcj02) { marker.position = TPoint(point.latitude, point.longitude) }
        }
    }
    fun line(points: List<Gcj02>, color: Int, width: Float = 10f): MapLine {
        amap?.map?.let { map ->
            val line = map.addPolyline(com.amap.api.maps.model.PolylineOptions().addAll(points.map { APoint(it.latitude, it.longitude) }).width(width).color(color))
            return object : MapLine {
                override fun remove() { line.remove() }
                override fun points(points: List<Gcj02>) { line.points = points.map { APoint(it.latitude, it.longitude) } }
            }
        }
        val line = tencent!!.map.addPolyline(com.tencent.tencentmap.mapsdk.maps.model.PolylineOptions().addAll(points.map { TPoint(it.latitude, it.longitude) }).width(width).color(color))
        return object : MapLine {
            override fun remove() { line.remove() }
            override fun points(points: List<Gcj02>) { line.points = points.map { TPoint(it.latitude, it.longitude) } }
        }
    }
    fun currentPosition(point: Gcj02, simulated: Boolean = false) {
        if (currentSimulated != simulated) clearCurrentPosition()
        currentSimulated = simulated
        val existing = current
        if (existing != null) existing.position(point) else {
            val title = if (simulated) "模拟位置" else "当前位置"
            current = marker(point, title, MapLocationBadge(context, false, title), anchorY = 44f / 64f)
        }
    }
    fun clearCurrentPosition() { current?.remove(); current = null }
    fun originalPosition(point: Gcj02?) {
        if (point == null) { original?.remove(); original = null; return }
        val existing = original
        if (existing != null) existing.position(point) else {
            original = marker(point, "这是原始位置", MapLocationBadge(context, true, "这是原始位置"), anchorY = 44f / 64f)
        }
    }
    fun clear() { current = null; original = null; amap?.map?.clear(); tencent?.map?.clear() }
    fun onStart() = lifecycle.start()
    fun onResume() { releaseTransitionFrame(); lifecycle.resume() }
    fun onPause() = lifecycle.pause()
    fun onStop() = lifecycle.stop(isShown && windowVisibility == View.VISIBLE)
    override fun onVisibilityChanged(changedView: View, visibility: Int) {
        super.onVisibilityChanged(changedView, visibility)
        if (visibility != View.VISIBLE) lifecycle.visibilityChanged(false)
    }
    override fun onWindowVisibilityChanged(visibility: Int) {
        super.onWindowVisibilityChanged(visibility)
        if (visibility != View.VISIBLE) lifecycle.visibilityChanged(false)
    }
    override fun onDetachedFromWindow() {
        lifecycle.stop()
        super.onDetachedFromWindow()
    }
    fun onSaveInstanceState(state: Bundle) { amap?.onSaveInstanceState(state) }
    fun onDestroy() {
        if (destroyed) return
        releaseTransitionFrame()
        lifecycle.close()
        destroyed = true
        onClick(null); onCamera(null)
        amap?.onDestroy(); tencent?.onDestroy()
        amap = null; tencent = null; current = null; original = null; removeAllViews()
    }
}
```

`app/src/main/java/com/system/location/service/maps/RealPositionLifecycle.kt`:

```kt
package com.system.location.service.maps

class RealPositionLifecycle(private val positioning: (Boolean) -> Unit) {
    private var resumed = false
    private var simulating = false
    private var destroyed = false
    private var running = false
    fun resume(simulationActive: Boolean) { if (!destroyed) { resumed = true; simulating = simulationActive; update() } }
    fun simulation(active: Boolean) { simulating = active; update() }
    fun pause() { resumed = false; update() }
    fun destroy() { destroyed = true; resumed = false; update() }
    fun acceptsFix() = running && !destroyed
    private fun update() {
        val next = resumed && !simulating && !destroyed
        if (running != next) { running = next; positioning(next) }
    }
}
```

`app/src/main/java/com/system/location/service/maps/TencentKeySettings.kt`:

```kt
package com.system.location.service.maps

import android.content.Context
import com.system.location.service.BuildConfig

/**
 * Tencent map key storage.
 *
 * The WebService endpoints read the effective key at request time, so a saved key applies without
 * restarting Portal. The vector map SDK reads its key during SDK initialization; that value is
 * documented separately on the map-key screen and falls back to the build-time key when the SDK
 * does not support a runtime override.
 */
object TencentKeySettings {
    private val store = EncryptedKeyStore("portal.tencent.api.key.v1", "tencent-api-key.enc")

    fun customKey(context: Context): String? = store.read(context.applicationContext)
        ?.let(TencentKeyPolicy::normalize)

    fun effectiveKey(context: Context): String =
        runCatching { customKey(context) }.getOrNull()
            ?: BuildConfig.TENCENT_MAP_KEY.takeIf(String::isNotBlank).orEmpty()

    fun saveCustomKey(context: Context, value: String) {
        val key = TencentKeyPolicy.normalize(value)
        if (key == null) {
            clearCustomKey(context)
            return
        }
        store.write(context.applicationContext, key)
    }

    fun clearCustomKey(context: Context) = store.clear(context.applicationContext)

    /** No public Tencent SDK key setter exists; WebService reads the value per request. */
    fun apply(context: Context): Boolean = effectiveKey(context).isNotBlank()
}

internal object TencentKeyPolicy {
    fun normalize(value: String): String? {
        val key = value.trim()
        if (key.isEmpty()) return null
        require(key.length in 8..128 && key.all {
            it in 'A'..'Z' || it in 'a'..'z' || it in '0'..'9' || it == '-' || it == '_'
        }) {
            "腾讯 Key 格式不合法"
        }
        return key
    }
}
```

`app/src/main/java/com/system/location/service/privacy/SdkConsentController.kt`:

```kt
package com.system.location.service.privacy

internal data class SdkConsent(val mapsAccepted: Boolean = false, val crashReporting: Boolean = false)
internal interface SdkConsentStore {
    fun read(): SdkConsent
    fun write(value: SdkConsent)
}
internal interface ConsentSdk {
    fun initializeMaps()
    fun setCrashReporting(enabled: Boolean)
}
internal class SdkConsentController(private val store: SdkConsentStore, private val sdk: ConsentSdk) {
    private var mapsInitialized = false
    private var crashEnabled = false
    private var crashClosed = false
    private var stopPending = false
    private var confirmed = SdkConsent()
    private var loaded = false
    private fun load() {
        if (!loaded) { confirmed = store.read(); loaded = true }
    }
    val mapsAccepted: Boolean @Synchronized get() = confirmed.mapsAccepted
    val mapsReady: Boolean @Synchronized get() = mapsInitialized
    val crashReportingRequested: Boolean @Synchronized get() = confirmed.crashReporting
    val crashReportingEnabled: Boolean @Synchronized get() = crashEnabled
    val crashReportingPendingRestart: Boolean @Synchronized get() = confirmed.crashReporting && crashClosed
    var lastFailure: Throwable? = null
        private set

    private fun persist(value: SdkConsent) {
        val previous = confirmed
        try {
            store.write(value)
            confirmed = value
        } catch (failure: Throwable) {
            try { store.write(previous) } catch (rollback: Throwable) { failure.addSuppressed(rollback) }
            throw failure
        }
    }
    @Synchronized fun restore() {
        lastFailure = null
        try { load(); apply(confirmed) } catch (failure: Throwable) { lastFailure = failure }
    }
    @Synchronized fun acceptMaps() {
        load()
        val next = confirmed.copy(mapsAccepted = true)
        persist(next)
        apply(next)
    }
    @Synchronized fun setCrashReporting(enabled: Boolean) {
        load()
        val current = confirmed
        check(!enabled || current.mapsAccepted) { "请先确认地图隐私说明" }
        val next = current.copy(crashReporting = enabled)
        if (!enabled) {
            val wasRunning = crashEnabled || stopPending
            crashEnabled = false
            confirmed = next // Withdrawal wins over both stop and storage failures.
            var stopFailure: Throwable? = null
            if (wasRunning) {
                crashClosed = true
                try { sdk.setCrashReporting(false); stopPending = false }
                catch (failure: Throwable) { stopPending = true; stopFailure = failure }
            }
            try { persist(next) } catch (failure: Throwable) {
                stopFailure?.let { failure.addSuppressed(it) }
                throw failure
            }
            stopFailure?.let { throw it }
            return
        }
        // Validate mandatory SDK readiness before persisting an optional opt-in.
        if (!mapsInitialized) { sdk.initializeMaps(); mapsInitialized = true }
        persist(next)
        apply(next)
    }
    private fun apply(consent: SdkConsent) {
        if (!consent.mapsAccepted) return
        if (!mapsInitialized) { sdk.initializeMaps(); mapsInitialized = true }
        if (consent.crashReporting && crashClosed) return
        if (consent.crashReporting != crashEnabled) {
            try {
                sdk.setCrashReporting(consent.crashReporting)
                crashEnabled = consent.crashReporting
            } catch (failure: Throwable) {
                crashClosed = true
                crashEnabled = false
                try { sdk.setCrashReporting(false); stopPending = false }
                catch (stop: Throwable) { stopPending = true; failure.addSuppressed(stop) }
                confirmed = confirmed.copy(crashReporting = false)
                try { persist(confirmed) } catch (save: Throwable) { failure.addSuppressed(save) }
                throw failure
            }
        }
    }
}
```

`app/src/main/java/com/system/location/service/privacy/SdkPrivacy.kt`:

```kt
package com.system.location.service.privacy

import android.content.Context
import com.amap.api.location.AMapLocationClient
import com.amap.api.maps.MapsInitializer
import com.tencent.bugly.crashreport.CrashReport
import java.util.UUID

/** Map consent and optional crash reporting are separate, persisted choices. */
object SdkPrivacy {
    private lateinit var application: Context
    private var stopFailed = false
    private val preferences get() = application.getSharedPreferences("sdk_privacy", Context.MODE_PRIVATE)
    private val controller by lazy {
        SdkConsentController(object : SdkConsentStore {
            override fun read() = SdkConsent(
                preferences.getBoolean("maps_accepted", false),
                preferences.getBoolean("crash_reporting", false)
            )
            override fun write(value: SdkConsent) {
                check(preferences.edit().putBoolean("maps_accepted", value.mapsAccepted)
                    .putBoolean("crash_reporting", value.crashReporting).commit()) { "隐私选择保存失败，请重试" }
            }
        }, object : ConsentSdk {
            override fun initializeMaps() {
                com.system.location.service.maps.AMapKeySettings.apply(application)
                MapsInitializer.updatePrivacyShow(application, true, true)
                MapsInitializer.updatePrivacyAgree(application, true)
                AMapLocationClient.updatePrivacyShow(application, true, true)
                AMapLocationClient.updatePrivacyAgree(application, true)
            }
            override fun setCrashReporting(enabled: Boolean) {
                if (enabled) {
                    CrashReport.enableBugly(true)
                    CrashReport.setCollectPrivacyInfo(application, false)
                    var installationId = preferences.getString("crash_installation_id", null)
                    if (installationId == null) {
                        installationId = UUID.randomUUID().toString()
                        if (!preferences.edit().putString("crash_installation_id", installationId).commit()) {
                            preferences.edit().remove("crash_installation_id").commit()
                            error("崩溃上报标识保存失败")
                        }
                    }
                    CrashReport.setDeviceId(application, installationId)
                    CrashReport.initCrashReport(application)
                    // Bugly can silently skip initialization (for example without an app id).
                    check(com.tencent.bugly.CrashModule.getInstance().hasInitialized()) { "崩溃上报服务初始化失败" }
                } else {
                    // closeBugly unregisters user-info callbacks and shuts down the shared
                    // executor too. It must run BEFORE enableBugly(false), which gates it.
                    // The controller never tries to reopen it in this process.
                    if (stopFailed) CrashReport.enableBugly(true) // closeBugly is gated by this flag.
                    try { CrashReport.closeBugly(); stopFailed = false }
                    catch (failure: Throwable) { stopFailed = true; throw failure }
                    finally { CrashReport.enableBugly(false) }
                }
            }
        })
    }
    val mapsAccepted get() = controller.mapsAccepted
    val mapsReady get() = controller.mapsReady
    val crashReportingEnabled get() = controller.crashReportingEnabled
    val crashReportingRequested get() = controller.crashReportingRequested
    val crashReportingPendingRestart get() = controller.crashReportingPendingRestart
    fun initialize(context: Context) {
        application = context.applicationContext
        controller.restore()
    }
    fun acceptMaps() = controller.acceptMaps()
    fun setCrashReporting(enabled: Boolean) = controller.setCrashReporting(enabled)
}
```

`app/src/main/java/com/system/location/service/privacy/TencentPrivacy.kt`:

```kt
package com.system.location.service.privacy

import android.content.Context
import com.tencent.tencentmap.mapsdk.maps.TencentMapInitializer

/** AMap consent is never interpreted as Tencent consent. */
object TencentPrivacy {
    private var initialized = false
    fun ready(context: Context): Boolean {
        if (!context.getSharedPreferences("sdk_privacy", 0).getBoolean("tencent_maps_v1", false)) return false
        if (!initialized) {
            TencentMapInitializer.setAgreePrivacy(context.applicationContext, true)
            TencentMapInitializer.start(context.applicationContext)
            initialized = true
        }
        return true
    }
    fun accept(context: Context) {
        val prefs = context.getSharedPreferences("sdk_privacy", 0)
        if (!prefs.edit().putBoolean("tencent_maps_v1", true).commit()) {
            prefs.edit().remove("tencent_maps_v1").commit()
            error("隐私选择保存失败，请重试")
        }
        check(ready(context))
    }
}
```

`app/src/main/java/com/system/location/service/runtime/BackgroundGuidance.kt`:

```kt
package com.system.location.service.runtime

import android.Manifest
import android.content.ComponentName
import android.content.Context
import android.content.Intent
import android.content.pm.PackageManager
import android.net.Uri
import android.os.Build
import android.os.PowerManager
import android.provider.Settings
import android.widget.Toast
import androidx.core.app.NotificationManagerCompat
import androidx.core.content.ContextCompat
import com.google.android.material.dialog.MaterialAlertDialogBuilder
import com.system.location.service.R

object BackgroundGuidance {
    private data class Status(val batteryUnrestricted: Boolean, val locationGranted: Boolean, val notificationsEnabled: Boolean)

    private fun inspect(context: Context) = Status(
        batteryUnrestricted = context.getSystemService(PowerManager::class.java).isIgnoringBatteryOptimizations(context.packageName),
        locationGranted = ContextCompat.checkSelfPermission(context, Manifest.permission.ACCESS_FINE_LOCATION) == PackageManager.PERMISSION_GRANTED,
        notificationsEnabled = NotificationManagerCompat.from(context).areNotificationsEnabled(),
    )

    fun status(context: Context): String {
        val state = inspect(context)
        return context.getString(R.string.background_status, Build.MANUFACTURER, Build.MODEL,
            context.getString(if (state.batteryUnrestricted) R.string.battery_unrestricted else R.string.battery_restricted),
            context.getString(if (state.locationGranted) R.string.permission_granted else R.string.permission_missing),
            context.getString(if (state.notificationsEnabled) R.string.permission_granted else R.string.permission_missing))
    }

    fun diagnosticStatus(context: Context): String {
        val state = inspect(context)
        return "后台状态：电池优化豁免=${state.batteryUnrestricted}；精确位置权限=${state.locationGranted}；通知=${state.notificationsEnabled}"
    }
    fun show(context: Context) {
        MaterialAlertDialogBuilder(context).setTitle(R.string.background_guidance)
            .setMessage(status(context) + "\n\n" + context.getString(R.string.background_guidance_desc))
            .setNegativeButton(android.R.string.cancel, null)
            .setPositiveButton(R.string.open_background_settings) { _, _ ->
                MaterialAlertDialogBuilder(context).setTitle(R.string.background_settings)
                    .setItems(context.resources.getStringArray(R.array.background_settings_options)) { _, index ->
                        when (index) {
                            0 -> open(context, listOf(Intent(Settings.ACTION_IGNORE_BATTERY_OPTIMIZATION_SETTINGS), details(context)))
                            1 -> open(context, listOf(Intent().setComponent(ComponentName("com.miui.securitycenter", "com.miui.permcenter.autostart.AutoStartManagementActivity")), details(context)))
                            2 -> open(context, listOf(details(context)))
                            3 -> open(context, listOf(Intent(Settings.ACTION_APP_NOTIFICATION_SETTINGS).putExtra(Settings.EXTRA_APP_PACKAGE, context.packageName), details(context)))
                        }
                    }.show()
            }.show()
    }
    private fun details(context: Context) = Intent(Settings.ACTION_APPLICATION_DETAILS_SETTINGS, Uri.parse("package:${context.packageName}"))
    private fun open(context: Context, candidates: List<Intent>) {
        for (intent in candidates) {
            try { context.startActivity(intent.addFlags(Intent.FLAG_ACTIVITY_NEW_TASK)); return }
            catch (_: android.content.ActivityNotFoundException) { }
            catch (_: SecurityException) { }
        }
        Toast.makeText(context, R.string.settings_unavailable, Toast.LENGTH_LONG).show()
    }
}
```

`app/src/main/java/com/system/location/service/runtime/RuntimeCommandLifecycle.kt`:

```kt
package com.system.location.service.runtime

import com.system.location.service.core.runtime.RuntimeState
import com.system.location.service.core.runtime.RuntimePhase
import kotlinx.coroutines.NonCancellable
import kotlinx.coroutines.withContext

/** Serialized by the process command mutex; Android effects are supplied by the facade. */
internal class RuntimeCommandLifecycle(
    private val state: () -> RuntimeState,
    private val clearInterrupted: () -> Unit,
    private val finishService: suspend () -> Unit,
) {
    suspend fun <T> execute(action: suspend () -> T): T = try {
        action()
    } finally {
        withContext(NonCancellable) {
            val current = state()
            if (!current.isActive) {
                try {
                    if (current.phase == RuntimePhase.STOPPED) clearInterrupted()
                } finally {
                    finishService()
                }
            }
        }
    }
}
```
