```kt
import com.system.location.service.ext.smoothRouteMotion
import com.system.location.service.ext.routeEndPosition
import com.system.location.service.service.MockServiceHelper
import com.system.location.service.gnss.gnssReplayProblem
import kotlinx.coroutines.*
import kotlinx.coroutines.flow.collect
import kotlinx.coroutines.sync.Mutex
import kotlinx.coroutines.sync.withLock
import kotlinx.serialization.json.Json

/** Process-owned command facade. UI cancellation never cancels an accepted runtime command. */
object ScenarioRuntime {
    private val context get() = LocationServiceApp.appContext

    /** Serialize system configuration with runtime commands; a Mock Provider session has no Hook config. */
    suspend fun applyConfigNow(): Boolean {
        initialized.await()
        return commands.withLock {
            val current = state.value
            if (!current.isActive || current.backend == BackendType.MOCK_PROVIDER) return@withLock false
            val manager = context.getSystemService(LocationManager::class.java) ?: return@withLock false
            withContext(Dispatchers.IO) {
                if (!MockServiceHelper.isServiceInit()) MockServiceHelper.tryInitService(manager)
                runCatching { MockServiceHelper.putConfig(manager, context) }.getOrDefault(false)
            }
        }
    }
    suspend fun gnssMockRunning(): Boolean {
        initialized.await()
        return commands.withLock {
            if (!state.value.isActive || state.value.backend == BackendType.MOCK_PROVIDER) return@withLock false
            withContext(Dispatchers.IO) {
                runCatching { MockServiceHelper.isGnssMockStart(context.getSystemService(LocationManager::class.java)) }
                    .getOrDefault(false)
            }
        }
    }

    /** One serialized operation applies the saved replay combination without restarting movement. */
    fun applyReplaySettings() = command {
        if (!state.value.isActive || state.value.backend == BackendType.MOCK_PROVIDER) return@command false
        withContext(Dispatchers.IO) {
            if (context.gnssReplayProblem() != null) return@withContext false
            val manager = context.getSystemService(LocationManager::class.java) ?: return@withContext false
            if (!MockServiceHelper.isServiceInit()) MockServiceHelper.tryInitService(manager)
            MockServiceHelper.putConfig(manager, context) &&
                com.system.location.service.backend.xposed.activateReplay(context, manager)
        }
    }

    fun setGnssMock(enabled: Boolean) = command {
        if (!state.value.isActive || state.value.backend == BackendType.MOCK_PROVIDER) return@command false
        withContext(Dispatchers.IO) {
            val manager = context.getSystemService(LocationManager::class.java) ?: return@withContext false
            if (enabled) {
                if (!MockServiceHelper.putConfig(manager, context)) return@withContext false
                if (!MockServiceHelper.startGnssMock(manager)) return@withContext false
            } else if (!MockServiceHelper.stopGnssMock(manager)) return@withContext false
            MockServiceHelper.isGnssMockStart(manager) == enabled
        }
    }

    private val scope = CoroutineScope(SupervisorJob() + Dispatchers.Default)
    private val commands = Mutex()
    private val preferences get() = context.getSharedPreferences("scenario_runtime", Context.MODE_PRIVATE)
    private val journal by lazy { DiagnosticJournal(AtomicDocumentStore(File(context.noBackupFilesDir, "runtime-diagnostics.json"))) }
    private val configStore by lazy { FileConfigStore(File(context.noBackupFilesDir, "active-config.json")) }
    private val writer by lazy { DiagnosticWriter(journal) }
    private val physicalRecovery by lazy {
        com.system.location.service.backend.mock.AndroidPhysicalLocationRecovery(context, scope) { result, reason ->
            commands.withLock { controller.note("PHYSICAL_RECOVERY", result, reason) }
        }
    }
    val controller: ScenarioController = ScenarioController({ type ->
        val backend = when (type) {
            BackendType.XPOSED -> XposedBackend(context)
            BackendType.MOCK_PROVIDER -> com.system.location.service.backend.mock.RecoveringMockBackend(
                FusedMockBackend(MockProviderBackend(AndroidMockProviderPort(context)), AndroidGmsMockPort(context)), physicalRecovery)
            BackendType.NATIVE -> com.system.location.service.backend.native.NativeBackend(context)
        }
        object : LocationBackend by backend {
            override suspend fun prepare(): BackendResult {
                physicalRecovery.cancel()
                return backend.prepare()
            }
        }
    }, object : RuntimeClock {
        override fun nanos() = SystemClock.elapsedRealtimeNanos()
        override fun millis() = System.currentTimeMillis()
    }, diagnosticBatchSink = { events -> writer.enqueue(events) })
    val state = controller.state
    val diagnostics = controller.diagnostics
    @Volatile private var service: ScenarioService? = null
    @Volatile private var ready = CompletableDeferred<Unit>()
    private val serviceStarts = ServiceStartGate()
    private var startupBurst: StartupBurst? = null
    private val lifecycle = RuntimeCommandLifecycle({ state.value }, {
        check(preferences.edit().putBoolean("interrupted", false).commit()) { "无法清除运行标记" }
    }, { finishService() })
    private val initialized by lazy {
        scope.async {
            scope.launch { writer.failure.collect { controller.reportDiagnosticStorageFailure(it) } }
            withContext(Dispatchers.IO) {
                runCatching { journal.read() }.onSuccess { controller.restoreDiagnostics(it) }
                    .onFailure { controller.note("DIAGNOSTIC_STORAGE", "FAILED", it.message ?: "历史日志读取失败") }
                runCatching { configStore.load() }.getOrNull()?.let { saved ->
                    controller.note("CONFIG_STORE", "INFO", "最近配置已恢复 rev=${saved.revision}")
                }
            }
            val selected = runCatching { BackendType.valueOf(preferences.getString("backend", "MOCK_PROVIDER")!!) }
                .getOrDefault(BackendType.MOCK_PROVIDER)
            controller.selectBackend(selected)
            if (preferences.getBoolean("interrupted", false)) {
                controller.recoverInterrupted(selected, "上次场景未正常结束，运行进程已中断")
            }
        }
    }

    fun initialize() { initialized.start() }

    /** Consumers of backend policy must not observe the temporary pre-restoration default. */
    suspend fun awaitInitialized() { initialized.await() }

    /** Restore and start the last successfully persisted config; never auto-starts on boot. */
    suspend fun restoreLastConfig(): Boolean = command {
        if (state.value.phase !in setOf(RuntimePhase.IDLE, RuntimePhase.STOPPED)) return@command false
        val saved = withContext(Dispatchers.IO) {
            runCatching { configStore.load() }.getOrNull()
        } ?: return@command false
        withContext(Dispatchers.IO) {
            context.routingJson = Json.encodeToString(RoutingConfig.serializer(), saved.routing)
            context.environmentApCount = saved.environment.apPerCell
            context.cellMode = saved.environment.cellMode.name
            val replayJson = saved.replayEnvironmentJson.orEmpty()
            context.environmentReplayJson = replayJson
            context.environmentSourceMode = EnvironmentRestorePolicy.sourceMode(saved.environment.source, replayJson)
            context.physicalNoise = saved.noise.enabled
            context.speed = saved.scenario.profile.speedMps
            context.altitude = saved.scenario.profile.altitudeMeters
            context.accuracy = saved.scenario.profile.accuracyMeters
            context.reportDuration = saved.scenario.profile.intervalMs.toInt()
            context.smoothRouteMotion = saved.scenario.profile.smoothMotion
        }
        startLocked(saved.scenario.frozen())
    }.await()

    fun selectBackend(type: BackendType) = command {
        controller.selectBackend(type).also { if (it) preferences.edit().putString("backend", type.name).commit() }
    }
    fun start(scenario: Scenario): Deferred<Boolean> {
        val frozen = scenario.frozen()
        return command { startLocked(frozen) }
    }

    /** Caller holds commands; restore and start must not interleave with another accepted command. */
    private suspend fun startLocked(frozen: Scenario): Boolean {
        physicalRecovery.cancel()
        return try {
            if (service == null) {
                ready = CompletableDeferred()
                val request = serviceStarts.begin()
                withContext(Dispatchers.Main) {
                    ContextCompat.startForegroundService(context, Intent(context, ScenarioService::class.java)
                        .putExtra(ScenarioService.REQUEST, request))
                }
                withTimeout(10_000) { ready.await() }
            }
            check(preferences.edit().putBoolean("interrupted", true).commit()) { "无法持久化运行标记" }
            controller.configureOrbit(context.experimentalOrbitMotion, context.experimentalOrbitRadius, context.orbitPeriodSeconds)
            val started = controller.start(frozen, routeEndPosition = context.routeEndPosition)
            if (started) {
                withContext(Dispatchers.IO) {
                    runCatching {
                        val revision = (configStore.load()?.revision ?: 0L) + 1L
                        val routing = context.routingJson.takeIf { it.isNotBlank() }
                            ?.let { Json.decodeFromString(RoutingConfig.serializer(), it) }
                            ?: RoutingConfig()
                        val sourceMode = runCatching { EnvironmentSourceMode.valueOf(context.environmentSourceMode) }
                            .getOrDefault(EnvironmentSourceMode.AUTO)
                        val environment = EnvironmentConfig(
                            source = EnvironmentRestorePolicy.savedSource(sourceMode, context.environmentReplayJson),
                            apPerCell = context.environmentApCount,
                            cellMode = runCatching { CellMode.valueOf(context.cellMode) }
                                .getOrDefault(CellMode.AUTO),
                        )
                        configStore.save(ConfigEnvelope(
                            revision = revision,
                            scenario = frozen,
                            routing = routing,
                            environment = environment,
                            noise = NoiseProfile(enabled = context.physicalNoise),
                            updatedAtMillis = System.currentTimeMillis(),
                            replayEnvironmentJson = context.environmentReplayJson.takeIf { it.isNotBlank() },
                        ))
                    }.onFailure { controller.note("CONFIG_STORE", "FAILED", it.message ?: "配置保存失败") }
                }
            }
            started.also {
                startupBurst = if (it && context.startupBurstEnabled)
                    StartupBurst(state.value.scenarioId, state.value.startedAt) else null
                service?.reschedule()
            }
        } catch (cancelled: CancellationException) {
            if (cancelled !is TimeoutCancellationException) throw cancelled
            failStart(cancelled)
        } catch (error: Exception) { failStart(error) }
    }

    private suspend fun failStart(error: Exception): Boolean {
        controller.reportFailure(BackendResult.Failure("FOREGROUND_SERVICE", error.message ?: error.javaClass.simpleName,
            "在应用前台启动，并授予精确位置权限"))
        return false
    }
    fun pause() = command { startupBurst = null; controller.pause() }
    fun refreshDiagnostics() = command { controller.refreshDiagnostics(); true }
    suspend fun diagnosticReport(): String = withContext(Dispatchers.IO) {
        initialized.await()
        flushDiagnostics()
        commands.withLock {
            buildString {
                appendLine("LocationService ${BuildConfig.VERSION_NAME} (${BuildConfig.VERSION_CODE}) revision=${BuildConfig.GIT_REVISION}")
                appendLine("Android ${Build.VERSION.RELEASE} API ${Build.VERSION.SDK_INT}")
                appendLine(BackgroundGuidance.diagnosticStatus(context))
                appendLine("状态=${state.value.phase} 后端=${state.value.backend} 配置间隔=${controller.intervalMs}ms")
                appendLine("当前偏好（运行场景可能持有启动时快照）：GMS=${context.gmsMockEnabled} 系统Fused=${context.platformFusedEnabled} 密集启动=${context.startupBurstEnabled} 清除标记=${context.experimentalClearMockFlag} 平滑运动=${context.smoothRouteMotion} 圆周=${context.experimentalOrbitMotion} 半径=${context.experimentalOrbitRadius}m 周期=${context.orbitPeriodSeconds}s")
                appendLine("以下是 API 提交及运行诊断，不能证明目标 App 接受定位。")
                controller.diagnostics.value.forEach { appendLine("${java.time.Instant.ofEpochMilli(it.timestamp)} ${it.backend} ${it.stage} ${it.result}: ${it.reason} ${it.suggestion}") }
            }
                .let(DiagnosticExportRedactor::redact)
        }
    }
    fun resume() = command { controller.resume() }
    fun rebuildMockProviders() = command {
        startupBurst = null
        controller.rebuildMockProviders().also {
            service?.reschedule()
        }
    }
    fun motion(bearing: Double, moving: Boolean, strength: Double = 1.0) = command { controller.setMotion(bearing, moving, strength) }
    fun setSpeed(speed: Double): Deferred<Boolean> {
        val expected = state.value
        return command {
            val current = state.value
            if (!speed.isFinite() || speed !in 0.0..LocationSanitizer.MAX_SPEED_MPS ||
                current.scenarioId != expected.scenarioId || current.startedAt != expected.startedAt ||
                current.phase != expected.phase) return@command false
            val accepted = if (current.isActive) controller.setSpeed(speed) else true
            if (accepted) context.speed = speed
            accepted
        }
    }
    fun stop() = command {
        startupBurst = null
        controller.stop()
    }

    private fun command(action: suspend () -> Boolean) = scope.async {
        initialized.await()
        try {
            commands.withLock { lifecycle.execute(action) }
        } finally {
            if (!state.value.isActive) flushDiagnostics()
        }
    }
    private suspend fun flushDiagnostics() {
        controller.reportDiagnosticStorageFailure(writer.flush().exceptionOrNull())
    }
    internal fun attached(instance: ScenarioService, request: Long): Boolean {
        if (!serviceStarts.accept(request)) return false
        service = instance
        ready.complete(Unit)
        return true
    }
    internal fun attachmentFailed(request: Long, error: Exception) {
        if (serviceStarts.accept(request)) ready.completeExceptionally(error)
    }
    internal fun detached(instance: ScenarioService) {
        if (service !== instance) return
        service = null
        command {
            // An old service can finish destruction after a replacement has attached.
            if (service == null) controller.interrupted("前台服务已被系统终止，场景已中断")
            false
        }
    }
    internal suspend fun nextTickDelay(instance: ScenarioService): Long = commands.withLock {
        if (service !== instance) controller.intervalMs
        else if (state.value.phase == RuntimePhase.HOLDING) 60 * 60 * 1000L
        else startupBurst?.nextDelay(state.value, controller.intervalMs) ?: controller.intervalMs
    }
    internal suspend fun tick(instance: ScenarioService) {
        try {
            commands.withLock {
                if (service === instance) {
                    lifecycle.execute {
                        if (state.value.isActive && state.value.phase != RuntimePhase.HOLDING) {
                            startupBurst?.accept(state.value)
                            controller.tick()
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
        } finally {
            if (!state.value.isActive) flushDiagnostics()
        }
    }
    private suspend fun finishService() = withContext(Dispatchers.Main) {
        startupBurst = null
        serviceStarts.cancel()
        service?.let { instance -> service = null; instance.finishPlayback() }
    }
}
```

`app/src/main/java/com/system/location/service/runtime/ScenarioService.kt`:

```kt
package com.system.location.service.runtime

import android.app.*
import android.content.Intent
import android.content.pm.ServiceInfo
import android.os.IBinder
import android.os.PowerManager
import androidx.core.app.NotificationCompat
import androidx.core.app.ServiceCompat
import com.system.location.service.MainActivity
import com.system.location.service.R
import com.system.location.service.core.backend.BackendType
import com.system.location.service.core.gnss.GnssSimulationMode
import com.system.location.service.core.gnss.GnssSimulationPolicy
import com.system.location.service.ext.sharedPrefs
import com.system.location.service.gnss.GnssNavigationRepository
import com.system.location.service.gnss.GnssNavigationSyncStatus
import com.system.location.service.hook.utils.Logger
import java.io.File
import kotlinx.coroutines.*
import kotlinx.coroutines.channels.Channel
import kotlinx.coroutines.selects.select
import kotlinx.coroutines.selects.onTimeout

/** The service owns the tick loop and wake lock, never a Fragment or ViewModel. */
@OptIn(kotlinx.coroutines.ExperimentalCoroutinesApi::class)
class ScenarioService : Service() {
    private val scope = CoroutineScope(SupervisorJob() + Dispatchers.Default)
    private var wakeLock: PowerManager.WakeLock? = null
    private var startupError: Exception? = null
    private val scheduleChanges = Channel<Unit>(Channel.CONFLATED)
    internal fun reschedule() { scheduleChanges.trySend(Unit) }
    override fun onCreate() {
        super.onCreate()
        val notifications = getSystemService(NotificationManager::class.java)
        notifications.createNotificationChannel(NotificationChannel(CHANNEL, "场景播放", NotificationManager.IMPORTANCE_LOW))
        val open = PendingIntent.getActivity(this, 0, Intent(this, MainActivity::class.java), PendingIntent.FLAG_IMMUTABLE)
        val stop = PendingIntent.getService(this, 1, Intent(this, ScenarioService::class.java).setAction(STOP), PendingIntent.FLAG_IMMUTABLE)
        val notification = NotificationCompat.Builder(this, CHANNEL)
            .setSmallIcon(R.drawable.baseline_play_24).setContentTitle("定位场景运行中")
            .setContentText("打开应用查看状态；停止后清理定位后端")
            .setContentIntent(open).addAction(R.drawable.baseline_stop_24, "停止", stop).setOngoing(true).build()
        try {
            ServiceCompat.startForeground(this, 201, notification, ServiceInfo.FOREGROUND_SERVICE_TYPE_LOCATION)
            wakeLock = getSystemService(PowerManager::class.java)
                .newWakeLock(PowerManager.PARTIAL_WAKE_LOCK, "LocationService:Playback").apply {
                    setReferenceCounted(false)
                    acquire(600_000)
                }
            scope.launch {
                var renewedAt = android.os.SystemClock.elapsedRealtime()
                while (isActive) {
                    val interval = ScenarioRuntime.nextTickDelay(this@ScenarioService)
                    val tickDue = select<Boolean> {
                        scheduleChanges.onReceive { false }
                        onTimeout(interval) { true }
                    }
                    if (!tickDue) continue
                    ScenarioRuntime.tick(this@ScenarioService)
                    val now = android.os.SystemClock.elapsedRealtime()
                    val phase = ScenarioRuntime.state.value.phase
                    if (phase == com.system.location.service.core.runtime.RuntimePhase.HOLDING) {
                        wakeLock?.let { if (it.isHeld) it.release() }
                    } else if (ScenarioRuntime.state.value.isActive &&
                        (wakeLock?.isHeld != true || now - renewedAt >= 300_000)) {
                        wakeLock?.acquire(600_000)
                        renewedAt = now
                    }
                }
            }
            // Independent of location ticks: offline startup immediately uses bundled/fallback
            // resources. The service owns cancellation; no detached network job survives stop.
            scope.launch {
                val navigation = GnssNavigationRepository(File(noBackupFilesDir, "gnss/navigation-resource.json"))
                while (isActive) {
                    val state = ScenarioRuntime.state.value
                    val mode = sharedPrefs.getString("gnssSimulationMode", GnssSimulationPolicy().mode.name)
                    if (!state.isActive || state.backend == BackendType.MOCK_PROVIDER ||
                        mode !in setOf(GnssSimulationMode.AUTO.name, GnssSimulationMode.AUTONOMOUS.name)) {
                        delay(5000)
                        continue
                    }
                    var cached = false
                    val refreshed = try {
                        navigation.refresh()
                        cached = true
                        // Retry config synchronization even if the file digest is unchanged.
                        // Runtime command serialization checks that a Hook session is still active.
                        ScenarioRuntime.applyConfigNow().also { applied ->
                            if (!applied) GnssNavigationSyncStatus.shared.synchronizationFailed()
                        }
                    } catch (cancelled: CancellationException) {
                        throw cancelled
                    } catch (error: Exception) {
                        if (cached) GnssNavigationSyncStatus.shared.synchronizationFailed()
                        Logger.error("GNSS navigation refresh failed: ${error.javaClass.simpleName}")
                        false
                    }
                    delay(if (refreshed) 30 * 60_000L else 5 * 60_000L)
                }
            }
        } catch (error: Exception) {
            startupError = error
        }
    }
    override fun onStartCommand(intent: Intent?, flags: Int, startId: Int): Int {
        if (intent?.action == STOP) ScenarioRuntime.stop().invokeOnCompletion {
            // A notification action can recreate the service after its process was killed.
            scope.launch(Dispatchers.Main) { if (!ScenarioRuntime.state.value.isActive) finishPlayback() }
        }
        else {
            val request = intent?.getLongExtra(REQUEST, -1) ?: -1
            val error = startupError
            if (error != null) { ScenarioRuntime.attachmentFailed(request, error); finishPlayback() }
            else if (!ScenarioRuntime.attached(this, request)) finishPlayback()
        }
        // A dead process is reported as interrupted, never silently restored as running.
        return START_NOT_STICKY
    }
    internal fun finishPlayback() { stopForeground(STOP_FOREGROUND_REMOVE); stopSelf() }
    override fun onDestroy() {
        ScenarioRuntime.detached(this)
        scope.cancel()
        wakeLock?.let { if (it.isHeld) it.release() }
        super.onDestroy()
    }
    override fun onBind(intent: Intent?): IBinder? = null
    companion object {
        private const val CHANNEL = "scenario_playback"
        private const val STOP = "com.system.location.service.STOP_SCENARIO"
        const val REQUEST = "request_id"
    }
}
```

`app/src/main/java/com/system/location/service/runtime/XposedServiceBridge.kt`:

```kt
package com.system.location.service.runtime

import android.util.Log
import io.github.libxposed.service.HookedTarget
import io.github.libxposed.service.HotReloadResult
import io.github.libxposed.service.XposedService
import io.github.libxposed.service.XposedServiceHelper
import java.util.concurrent.CountDownLatch
import java.util.concurrent.TimeUnit
import java.util.concurrent.atomic.AtomicReference

/** Module-app side libxposed service: exposes running targets and requests hot reload. */
object XposedServiceBridge : XposedServiceHelper.OnServiceListener {
    private const val TAG = "XposedServiceBridge"

    @Volatile private var service: XposedService? = null
    @Volatile var lastResult: String = "service not bound"
        private set

    fun register() {
        runCatching { XposedServiceHelper.registerListener(this) }
            .onFailure { Log.e(TAG, "register listener failed", it) }
    }

    fun bound(): Boolean = service != null

    /** A system-capable framework is available even if the root manager hides su from the app. */
    fun supportsSystemScope(): Boolean = runCatching {
        val current = service ?: return false
        current.getFrameworkProperties() and XposedService.PROP_CAP_SYSTEM != 0L
    }.getOrDefault(false)

    override fun onServiceBind(service: XposedService) {
        this.service = service
        lastResult = "service bound: ${runCatching { service.getFrameworkName() }.getOrDefault("unknown")}"
        Log.i(TAG, lastResult)
    }

    override fun onServiceDied(service: XposedService) {
        if (this.service === service) this.service = null
        lastResult = "service died"
        Log.i(TAG, lastResult)
    }

    fun runningTargets(): List<HookedTarget> =
        service?.getRunningTargets() ?: emptyList()

    fun hotReloadSystemServer(): String {
        val current = service ?: return "service not bound".also { lastResult = it }
        val targets = runCatching { current.getRunningTargets() }
            .getOrElse { error ->
                return "getRunningTargets failed: ${error.javaClass.simpleName}: ${error.message}"
                    .also { lastResult = it }
            }
        val target = targets.firstOrNull { it.processName == "system_server" || it.processName == "system" }
            ?: return "system_server target not running".also { lastResult = it }
        val outcome = AtomicReference<HotReloadResult?>(null)
        val latch = CountDownLatch(1)
        return runCatching {
            current.hotReloadModule(target, null, object : XposedService.HotReloadCallback {
                override fun onHotReloadResult(target: HookedTarget, result: HotReloadResult) {
                    this@XposedServiceBridge.lastResult =
                        "hot reload ${result.status}${result.message?.let { ": $it" } ?: ""}"
                    outcome.set(result)
                    latch.countDown()
                }
            })
            val completed = latch.await(40, TimeUnit.SECONDS)
            val answer = outcome.get()
            val message = when {
                !completed -> "hot reload timed out"
                answer == null -> "hot reload returned no result"
                else -> "hot reload ${answer.status}${answer.message?.let { ": $it" } ?: ""}"
            }
            lastResult = message
            message
        }.getOrElse { error ->
            val message = "hot reload failed: ${error.javaClass.simpleName}: ${error.message}"
            lastResult = message
            message
        }
    }
}
```

```kt
package com.system.location.service.service

import android.content.Context
import android.location.LocationManager
import android.os.Bundle
import android.util.Log
import com.system.location.service.LocationServiceApp
import com.system.location.service.ext.reportDuration
import com.system.location.service.ext.sharedPrefs
import com.system.location.service.ext.loopBroadcastlocation
import com.system.location.service.hook.utils.FakeLoc

object MockServiceHelper {
    const val PROVIDER_NAME = "fused_ext"
    private val commandClient = com.system.location.service.hook.security.CommandClient()
    @Volatile var carrierIdentityStatus: String? = null
        private set
    @Volatile var carrierOverrideSupported: Boolean? = null
        private set


    fun tryInitService(locationManager: LocationManager) {
        runCatching { commandClient.connect(locationManager) }
            .onFailure { Log.e("MockServiceHelper", "Service connection failed", it) }
    }
    fun isMockStart(locationManager: LocationManager): Boolean {
        if (!commandClient.connected) {
            return false
        }
        val rely = Bundle()
        rely.putString("command_id", "is_start")
        if(commandClient.send(locationManager, rely)) {
            return rely.getBoolean("is_start")
        }
        return false
    }

    fun isGnssMockStart(locationManager: LocationManager): Boolean {
        if (!commandClient.connected) {
            return false
        }
        val rely = Bundle()
        rely.putString("command_id", "is_gnss_start")
        if(commandClient.send(locationManager, rely)) {
            return rely.getBoolean("is_gnss_start")
        }
        return false
    }

    fun startGnssMock(locationManager: LocationManager): Boolean {
        if (!commandClient.connected) {
            return false
        }
        val rely = Bundle()

    fun putConfig(locationManager: LocationManager, context: Context): Boolean {
        if (!commandClient.connected) {
            return false
        }

        val fallback = FakeLoc.runtimeSnapshots.current()
        val values = try {
            com.system.location.service.data.persistence.CarrierIdentityPreferences.migrate(context.sharedPrefs,
                com.system.location.service.data.persistence.CarrierIdentityPreferences.occupiedIds(context))
            com.system.location.service.data.persistence.HookConfigurationPreferences
                .read(context.sharedPrefs.all, fallback).toMutableMap()
        } catch (error: Exception) {
            com.system.location.service.hook.utils.Logger.error("Configuration preferences invalid: ${error.javaClass.simpleName}")
            return false
        }
        val captureFile = java.io.File(context.noBackupFilesDir, "gnss/receiver-capture.json")
        val capturePayload = runCatching {
            com.system.location.service.core.gnss.GnssCaptureStore(captureFile).load()
                ?.let(com.system.location.service.core.gnss.GnssCaptureWire::encode)
        }.getOrElse {
            com.system.location.service.hook.utils.Logger.error("GNSS capture unavailable: ${it.javaClass.simpleName}")
            // Receiver evidence is optional. Keep the last decoded source if disk loading or
            // compaction fails; required preferences and the authenticated send still fail normally.
            fallback.configuration.gnssSource?.wirePayload()
        }
        values["gnss_capture"] = capturePayload
        // Download/import work stays outside the authenticated command. Only a complete cached
        // resource crosses IPC; cache failures preserve the accepted in-memory resource.
        val navigationFile = java.io.File(context.noBackupFilesDir, "gnss/navigation-resource.json")
        values["gnss_navigation"] = runCatching {
            com.system.location.service.core.gnss.RinexNavigationResourceStore(navigationFile).load()
                ?.let(com.system.location.service.core.gnss.RinexNavigationResource::encodeWire)
        }.getOrElse {
            com.system.location.service.hook.utils.Logger.error("GNSS navigation unavailable: ${it.javaClass.simpleName}")
            fallback.configuration.gnssNavigation?.let(com.system.location.service.core.gnss.RinexNavigationResource::encodeWire)
        }
        val prepared = try {
            com.system.location.service.core.runtime.PreparedRuntimeConfiguration
                .prepare(values, fallback.configuration.gnssSource)
        } catch (error: Exception) {
            com.system.location.service.hook.utils.Logger.error("Configuration rejected: ${error.javaClass.simpleName}")
            return false
        }
        val rely = Bundle().apply {
            putString("command_id", "put_config")
            values.forEach { (key, value) ->
                when (value) {
                    null -> putString(key, null)
                    is String -> putString(key, value)
                    is Boolean -> putBoolean(key, value)
                    is Int -> putInt(key, value)
                    is Long -> putLong(key, value)
                    is Float -> putFloat(key, value)
                    is Double -> putDouble(key, value)
                    else -> error("Unsupported configuration type for $key")
                }
            }
        }
        carrierIdentityStatus = null
        carrierOverrideSupported = null
        if (!commandClient.send(locationManager, rely)) return false
        carrierIdentityStatus = rely.getString("carrier_identity_status")
        carrierOverrideSupported = if (rely.containsKey("carrier_override_supported"))
            rely.getBoolean("carrier_override_supported") else null
        FakeLoc.runtimeSnapshots.update(prepared::applyTo)
        return true
    }

    fun isServiceInit(): Boolean {
        return commandClient.connected
    }

    fun publishSample(
        locationManager: LocationManager,
        sample: com.system.location.service.core.location.LocationSample,
        scenarioId: String? = null,
    ): Boolean {
        val request = Bundle()
        request.putString("command_id", "publish_sample")
        scenarioId?.takeIf { it.isNotBlank() }?.let { request.putString("scenario_id", it) }
        com.system.location.service.hook.security.SampleWire.write(request, sample)
        return commandClient.send(locationManager, request)
    }

    fun runtimeStatus(locationManager: LocationManager): Bundle? {
        val request = Bundle()
        request.putString("command_id", "get_runtime_status")
        return if (commandClient.send(locationManager, request)) request else null
    }

    fun prepareNative(locationManager: LocationManager): Boolean = commandClient.send(locationManager, Bundle().apply {
        putString("command_id", "native_prepare")
    })
    fun setNativeEnabled(locationManager: LocationManager, enabled: Boolean): Boolean = commandClient.send(locationManager, Bundle().apply {
        putString("command_id", "native_status"); putBoolean("enabled", enabled)
    })


    private fun broadcastInterval(context: Context): Long {
        val interval = context.reportDuration.toLong().coerceIn(50, 1000)
        return if (context.loopBroadcastlocation) interval else maxOf(500L, interval)
    }

}
```

`app/src/main/java/com/system/location/service/ui/PreferenceState.kt`:

```kt
package com.system.location.service.ui

import android.content.SharedPreferences
import androidx.compose.runtime.Composable
import androidx.compose.runtime.getValue
import androidx.compose.runtime.produceState
import androidx.compose.ui.platform.LocalContext
import androidx.lifecycle.Lifecycle
import androidx.lifecycle.compose.LocalLifecycleOwner
import androidx.lifecycle.repeatOnLifecycle
import com.system.location.service.ext.sharedPrefs
import kotlinx.coroutines.awaitCancellation

/** Invalidate preference snapshots while visible, and re-read changes made while the page was stopped. */
@Composable
internal fun preferenceRevision(): Int {
    val preferences = LocalContext.current.sharedPrefs
    val lifecycle = LocalLifecycleOwner.current.lifecycle
    val revision by produceState(0, preferences, lifecycle) {
        lifecycle.repeatOnLifecycle(Lifecycle.State.STARTED) {
            val listener = SharedPreferences.OnSharedPreferenceChangeListener { _, _ -> value += 1 }
            preferences.registerOnSharedPreferenceChangeListener(listener)
            value += 1
            try { awaitCancellation() }
            finally { preferences.unregisterOnSharedPreferenceChangeListener(listener) }
        }
    }
    return revision
}
```

`app/src/main/java/com/system/location/service/ui/RuntimePresentation.kt`:

```kt
package com.system.location.service.ui

import android.os.SystemClock
import android.widget.TextView
import com.system.location.service.core.backend.BackendType
import com.system.location.service.core.runtime.RuntimePhase
import com.system.location.service.core.runtime.RuntimeState
import kotlinx.coroutines.flow.Flow
import kotlinx.coroutines.flow.flow

/** Limit sample-only redraws to 5 Hz; lifecycle, backend, errors and capabilities remain immediate. */
fun Flow<RuntimeState>.displayStates(): Flow<RuntimeState> = flow {
    var previous: RuntimeState? = null
    var lastRender = 0L
    collect { state ->
        val old = previous
        val now = SystemClock.uptimeMillis()
        val controlsChanged = old == null || old.phase != state.phase || old.backend != state.backend ||
            old.scenarioId != state.scenarioId || old.scenarioName != state.scenarioName ||
            old.routeId != state.routeId || old.error != state.error || old.capabilities != state.capabilities ||
            old.configuredSpeedMps != state.configuredSpeedMps
        if (controlsChanged || now - lastRender >= 200L) {
            previous = state
            lastRender = now
            emit(state)
        }
    }
}

fun TextView.setTextIfChanged(value: CharSequence) {
    if (!android.text.TextUtils.equals(text, value)) text = value
}

fun RuntimePhase.displayLabel(): String = when (this) {
    RuntimePhase.IDLE -> "尚未开始"
    RuntimePhase.PREPARING -> "准备中"
    RuntimePhase.READY -> "准备就绪"
    RuntimePhase.RUNNING -> "正在模拟"
    RuntimePhase.PAUSED -> "已暂停"
    RuntimePhase.HOLDING -> "停留在终点"
    RuntimePhase.STOPPING -> "正在停止"
    RuntimePhase.STOPPED -> "已停止"
    RuntimePhase.ERROR -> "需要处理"
}

fun RuntimeState.displayLabel(): String = when {
    phase != RuntimePhase.HOLDING -> phase.displayLabel()
    holdingPosition == com.system.location.service.core.runtime.RouteEndPosition.START -> "停留在起点"
    else -> "停留在终点"
}

fun BackendType.displayLabel(): String = when (this) {
    BackendType.MOCK_PROVIDER -> "无 Root"
    BackendType.XPOSED -> "Xposed"
    BackendType.NATIVE -> "Native + Xposed"
}
```

`app/src/main/java/com/system/location/service/ui/diagnostics/LocationProbeActivity.kt`:

```kt
package com.system.location.service.ui.diagnostics

import android.Manifest
import android.annotation.SuppressLint
import android.content.ClipData
import android.content.ClipboardManager
import android.content.pm.PackageManager
import android.location.Location
import android.location.LocationListener
import android.location.LocationManager
import android.os.*
import android.widget.Toast
import androidx.activity.result.contract.ActivityResultContracts
import androidx.appcompat.app.AppCompatActivity
import androidx.core.content.ContextCompat
import androidx.lifecycle.Lifecycle
import androidx.lifecycle.ViewModel
import androidx.lifecycle.ViewModelProvider
import com.google.android.gms.common.ConnectionResult
import com.google.android.gms.common.GoogleApiAvailability
import com.google.android.gms.location.*
import com.google.android.gms.tasks.CancellationTokenSource
import androidx.activity.compose.setContent
import androidx.compose.runtime.getValue
import androidx.compose.runtime.mutableStateOf
import androidx.compose.runtime.setValue
import androidx.core.view.WindowCompat
import com.system.location.service.designsystem.theme.PortalTheme

/** Separate process, same package/UID. This observer never writes providers or mock AppOps. */
class LocationProbeActivity : AppCompatActivity() {
    class State : ViewModel() { val journal = LocationProbeJournal() }
    private var statusText by mutableStateOf("")
    private var reportText by mutableStateOf("")
    private val journal by lazy { ViewModelProvider(this)[State::class.java].journal }
    private val manager by lazy { getSystemService(LocationManager::class.java) }
    private val handler = Handler(Looper.getMainLooper())
    private val listeners = mutableListOf<LocationListener>()
    private val cancellations = mutableListOf<CancellationSignal>()
    private val timeouts = mutableListOf<Runnable>()
    private var gmsClient: FusedLocationProviderClient? = null
    private var gmsCallback: LocationCallback? = null
    private var gmsCancellation: CancellationTokenSource? = null
    private var gmsRegistration: com.google.android.gms.tasks.Task<Void>? = null
    private var active = false
    private var wanted = true
    private var generation = 0L
    private val permissions = registerForActivityResult(ActivityResultContracts.RequestMultiplePermissions()) {
        if (wanted && lifecycle.currentState.isAtLeast(Lifecycle.State.STARTED)) startReceiving()
    }

    override fun onCreate(savedInstanceState: Bundle?) {
        super.onCreate(savedInstanceState)
        WindowCompat.setDecorFitsSystemWindows(window, false)
        setContent {
            PortalTheme {
                LocationProbeScreen(statusText, reportText, onBack = ::finish,
                    onStart = {
                        wanted = true
                        if (!hasPermission()) permissions.launch(arrayOf(Manifest.permission.ACCESS_COARSE_LOCATION, Manifest.permission.ACCESS_FINE_LOCATION))
                        else { stopReceiving(); startReceiving() }
                    },
                    onStop = { wanted = false; stopReceiving(); render() },
                    onCopy = {
                        getSystemService(ClipboardManager::class.java).setPrimaryClip(ClipData.newPlainText("位置接收诊断", report()))
                        Toast.makeText(this, "接收日志已复制", Toast.LENGTH_SHORT).show()
                    })
            }
        }
        render()
    }

    override fun onStart() { super.onStart(); if (wanted) startReceiving() }
    override fun onStop() { stopReceiving(); super.onStop() }
    private fun hasPermission() = ContextCompat.checkSelfPermission(this, Manifest.permission.ACCESS_FINE_LOCATION) == PackageManager.PERMISSION_GRANTED
    private fun current(token: Long) = active && token == generation
    private fun event(source: String, detail: String) { journal.message(source, detail); render() }
    private fun receive(source: String, location: Location?, token: Long) {
        if (!current(token)) return
        val fix = location?.let { ProbeFix(it.provider, it.latitude, it.longitude, it.isMock, it.elapsedRealtimeNanos, it.time, it.accuracy) }
        journal.receive(source, fix, SystemClock.elapsedRealtimeNanos()); render()
    }
    private fun report() = "LocationService 接收端 ${com.system.location.service.BuildConfig.VERSION_NAME}\nAndroid ${Build.VERSION.RELEASE} API ${Build.VERSION.SDK_INT} ROM=${Build.DISPLAY}\nprocess=${android.app.Application.getProcessName()} uid=${Process.myUid()}\n" + journal.report()
    private fun render() {
        statusText = if (active) "正在前台接收 · 收到 ${journal.sampleCount} 条 · mock ${journal.mockCount} 条" else "接收已停止；无新样本不能证明不存在模拟位置"
        reportText = report()
    }

    @SuppressLint("MissingPermission")
    private fun startReceiving() {
        if (active) return
        if (!hasPermission()) { event("permission", "请点击重新订阅并授予精确位置权限"); return }
        active = true
        val token = ++generation
        event("session", "开始订阅 generation=$token；只读观察，不修改模拟授权")
        for (provider in listOf("gps", "network", "passive", "fused")) {
            if (!manager.allProviders.contains(provider)) { event(provider, "系统未提供此通道"); continue }
            runCatching { manager.getLastKnownLocation(provider) }
                .onSuccess { receive("lastKnown/$provider", it, token) }.onFailure { event(provider, "缓存读取失败：${it.javaClass.simpleName}") }
            val listener = object : LocationListener {
                override fun onLocationChanged(location: Location) { receive("updates/$provider", location, token) }
                override fun onProviderDisabled(name: String) { if (current(token)) event(provider, "Provider 已禁用") }
            }
            listeners += listener
            runCatching { manager.requestLocationUpdates(provider, 1000L, 0f, listener, Looper.getMainLooper()) }
                .onFailure { event(provider, "持续订阅失败：${it.javaClass.simpleName}") }
            if (provider == "passive") continue // Passive observes other requests, it is not an independent fix source.
            val signal = CancellationSignal().also { cancellations += it }
            var complete = false
            val timeout = Runnable {
                if (current(token) && !complete) { complete = true; signal.cancel(); event("current/$provider", "10 秒超时，无样本") }
            }
            timeouts += timeout; handler.postDelayed(timeout, 10_000)
            runCatching {
                manager.getCurrentLocation(provider, signal, mainExecutor) { location ->
                    if (!complete) { complete = true; handler.removeCallbacks(timeout); receive("current/$provider", location, token) }
                }
            }.onFailure { complete = true; handler.removeCallbacks(timeout); event(provider, "单次请求失败：${it.javaClass.simpleName}") }
        }
        startGms(token)
    }

    @SuppressLint("MissingPermission")
    private fun startGms(token: Long) {
        if (GoogleApiAvailability.getInstance().isGooglePlayServicesAvailable(this) != ConnectionResult.SUCCESS) {
            event("FLP", "Google Play 服务不可用"); return
        }
        runCatching {
            val client = LocationServices.getFusedLocationProviderClient(this).also { gmsClient = it }
            client.lastLocation.addOnSuccessListener { receive("lastKnown/FLP", it, token) }
                .addOnFailureListener { if (current(token)) event("FLP", "缓存读取失败：${it.javaClass.simpleName}") }
            val cancellation = CancellationTokenSource().also { gmsCancellation = it }
            client.getCurrentLocation(CurrentLocationRequest.Builder().setPriority(Priority.PRIORITY_HIGH_ACCURACY)
                .setMaxUpdateAgeMillis(0).setDurationMillis(10_000).build(), cancellation.token)
                .addOnSuccessListener { receive("current/FLP", it, token) }
                .addOnFailureListener { if (current(token)) event("FLP", "单次请求失败：${it.javaClass.simpleName}") }
            val callback = object : LocationCallback() {
                override fun onLocationResult(result: LocationResult) { result.locations.forEach { receive("updates/FLP", it, token) } }
            }.also { gmsCallback = it }
            gmsRegistration = client.requestLocationUpdates(LocationRequest.Builder(Priority.PRIORITY_HIGH_ACCURACY, 1000L).build(), callback, Looper.getMainLooper())
                .addOnFailureListener { if (current(token)) event("FLP", "持续订阅失败：${it.javaClass.simpleName}") }
        }.onFailure { event("FLP", "初始化失败：${it.javaClass.simpleName}") }
    }

    private fun stopReceiving() {
        val wasActive = active
        active = false; generation++
        timeouts.forEach(handler::removeCallbacks); timeouts.clear()
        cancellations.forEach { runCatching { it.cancel() } }; cancellations.clear()
        listeners.forEach { runCatching { manager.removeUpdates(it) } }; listeners.clear()
        gmsCancellation?.cancel(); gmsCancellation = null
        val client = gmsClient
        gmsCallback?.let { callback ->
            if (client != null) runCatching {
                // A subscription can finish after onStop; queue removal after that task.
                gmsRegistration?.continueWithTask(java.util.concurrent.Executor { it.run() }) { client.removeLocationUpdates(callback) }
                    ?: client.removeLocationUpdates(callback)
            }
        }
        gmsRegistration = null
        gmsCallback = null; gmsClient = null
        if (wasActive) event("session", "已取消订阅；忽略旧会话回调")
    }
}
```

`app/src/main/java/com/system/location/service/ui/diagnostics/LocationProbeJournal.kt`:

```kt
package com.system.location.service.ui.diagnostics

import java.util.ArrayDeque
import java.util.Locale
import java.util.UUID

data class ProbeFix(
    val provider: String?, val latitude: Double, val longitude: Double, val mock: Boolean,
    val elapsedNanos: Long, val timeMillis: Long, val accuracy: Float
)

/** Bounded, in-memory receiver evidence. A missing fix is never classified as non-mock. */
class LocationProbeJournal(private val capacity: Int = 64) {
    init { require(capacity > 0) }
    val runId: String = UUID.randomUUID().toString()
    private val events = ArrayDeque<String>()
    private var sequence = 0L
    var sampleCount = 0L; private set
    var mockCount = 0L; private set
    var nonMockCount = 0L; private set

    fun message(source: String, detail: String) = append("$source · $detail")
    fun receive(source: String, fix: ProbeFix?, nowNanos: Long) {
        if (fix == null) { message(source, "无样本（不等于非模拟）"); return }
        sampleCount++
        if (fix.mock) mockCount++ else nonMockCount++
        append(String.format(Locale.ROOT,
            "%s · provider=%s · isMock=%s\nWGS84=%.7f, %.7f · accuracy=%.1fm\nageMs=%.1f · elapsedNanos=%d · timeMillis=%d",
            source, fix.provider, fix.mock, fix.latitude, fix.longitude, fix.accuracy,
            (nowNanos - fix.elapsedNanos) / 1_000_000.0, fix.elapsedNanos, fix.timeMillis))
    }
    private fun append(detail: String) {
        events.addFirst("#${++sequence} $detail")
        while (events.size > capacity) events.removeLast()
    }
    fun report(): String = "runId=$runId\n收到=$sampleCount · mock=$mockCount · nonMock=$nonMockCount\n" +
        "仅表示本接收进程的样本，不代表其他 App 的检测结果；保留最近 $capacity 条事件。\n\n" + events.joinToString("\n\n")
}
```

```kt
            item { SelectionContainer { Text(report, fontFamily = FontFamily.Monospace,
                style = MaterialTheme.typography.bodySmall) } }
        }
    }
}
```

`app/src/main/java/com/system/location/service/ui/environment/EnvironmentComposeFragment.kt`:

```kt
package com.system.location.service.ui.environment

import android.Manifest

import androidx.compose.foundation.layout.padding
import androidx.compose.foundation.layout.Spacer
import androidx.compose.foundation.layout.fillMaxSize
import androidx.compose.foundation.layout.fillMaxWidth
import androidx.compose.foundation.layout.height
import androidx.compose.foundation.lazy.LazyColumn
import androidx.compose.material3.AlertDialog
import androidx.compose.material3.Button

import androidx.compose.material3.OutlinedButton
import androidx.compose.material3.OutlinedTextField
import androidx.compose.material3.RadioButton
import androidx.compose.material3.Surface
import androidx.compose.material3.Text

import androidx.compose.runtime.Composable
import androidx.compose.runtime.saveable.rememberSaveable

import androidx.compose.ui.semantics.Role
import androidx.compose.runtime.LaunchedEffect
import com.system.location.service.ui.preferenceRevision
import androidx.compose.runtime.getValue
import androidx.compose.runtime.mutableStateOf
import androidx.compose.runtime.remember
import androidx.compose.runtime.setValue
import androidx.compose.ui.Modifier
import androidx.compose.ui.platform.ComposeView
import androidx.compose.ui.platform.LocalContext
import androidx.compose.ui.platform.ViewCompositionStrategy
import androidx.compose.ui.res.stringResource
import androidx.compose.ui.unit.dp
import androidx.fragment.app.Fragment
import androidx.fragment.app.activityViewModels
import androidx.navigation.fragment.findNavController
import kotlinx.coroutines.Job
import kotlinx.coroutines.CancellationException
import androidx.lifecycle.compose.collectAsStateWithLifecycle
import androidx.lifecycle.lifecycleScope
import com.system.location.service.R
import com.system.location.service.core.environment.EnvironmentProfile
import com.system.location.service.core.environment.EnvironmentProfileCodec
import com.system.location.service.core.environment.WifiFingerprintImporter
import com.system.location.service.designsystem.components.PortalActionRow
import com.system.location.service.designsystem.components.PortalSettingGroup
import com.system.location.service.designsystem.components.PortalSwitchRow
import com.system.location.service.designsystem.theme.PortalSpacing
import com.system.location.service.designsystem.theme.PortalTheme
import com.system.location.service.environment.EnvironmentCollector
import com.system.location.service.environment.EnvironmentCaptureLocation
import com.system.location.service.environment.EnvironmentStore
import com.system.location.service.ext.cellMode
import com.system.location.service.ext.sharedPrefs
import com.system.location.service.ext.environmentApCount
import com.system.location.service.ext.environmentSourceMode
import com.system.location.service.ext.wifiFingerprintCatalogJson
import com.system.location.service.ext.wifiFingerprintEnabled
import kotlinx.coroutines.Dispatchers
import kotlinx.coroutines.flow.MutableStateFlow
import kotlinx.coroutines.launch
import kotlinx.coroutines.withContext
import java.text.SimpleDateFormat
import java.util.Date
import java.util.Locale
import java.io.ByteArrayOutputStream
import java.nio.ByteBuffer
import java.nio.charset.CodingErrorAction

/**
 * Compose replacement for the environment tools leaf screen.
 *
 * SAF launchers stay in the Fragment and Compose owns presentation/state.
 */
open class EnvironmentComposeFragment : Fragment() {
    private val replayModel by activityViewModels<com.system.location.service.ui.viewmodel.QuickReplayViewModel>()
    private val library = MutableStateFlow(EnvironmentLibraryState())
    private var libraryJob: Job? = null
    private var captureJob: Job? = null
    private val captureState = MutableStateFlow(EnvironmentCaptureState())
    private var pendingExport: Pair<String, EnvironmentProfile>? = null

    private val locationPermission = registerForActivityResult(
        ActivityResultContracts.RequestMultiplePermissions(),
    ) { grants ->
        if (grants[Manifest.permission.ACCESS_FINE_LOCATION] == true) requestEnvironmentCapture()
        else showToast(getString(R.string.environment_capture_requires_location))
    }

    private val bleScanPermission = registerForActivityResult(
        ActivityResultContracts.RequestPermission(),
    ) { granted ->
        if (!granted) showToast(getString(R.string.environment_ble_permission_denied))
        captureEnvironment()
    }

    private val createEnvironmentDocument = registerForActivityResult(
        ActivityResultContracts.CreateDocument("application/json"),
    ) { uri ->
        val pending = pendingExport
        pendingExport = null
        if (uri == null || pending == null) return@registerForActivityResult
        runCatching {
            requireContext().contentResolver.openOutputStream(uri)?.use { stream ->
                stream.write(EnvironmentProfileCodec.encode(pending.second).toByteArray(Charsets.UTF_8))
            } ?: error("无法写入文件")
        }.onSuccess {
            showToast(getString(R.string.environment_export_success))
        }.onFailure { error ->
            showToast(getString(R.string.environment_export_failed, error.message ?: "unknown"))
        }
    }

    private val importEnvironmentDocument = registerForActivityResult(
        ActivityResultContracts.OpenDocument(),
    ) { uri ->
        if (uri == null) return@registerForActivityResult
        val appContext = requireContext().applicationContext
        lifecycleScope.launch {
            val result = withContext(Dispatchers.IO) {
                runCatching {
                    val raw = appContext.contentResolver.openInputStream(uri)?.use {
                        readUtf8Document(it, EnvironmentProfileCodec.MAX_PROFILE_BYTES, "环境配置")
                    }
                        ?: error("无法读取文件")
                    val profile = EnvironmentProfileCodec.decode(raw)
                    val name = "import-" + SimpleDateFormat("yyyyMMdd-HHmmss", Locale.US).format(Date())
                    EnvironmentStore(appContext).saveNew(name, profile)
                }
            }
            result.onSuccess { name ->
                refreshNames()
                showToast(getString(R.string.environment_import_success, name))
            }.onFailure { error ->
                showToast(getString(R.string.environment_import_failed, error.message ?: "unknown"))
            }
        }
    }

    private val importWifiFingerprintDocument = registerForActivityResult(
        ActivityResultContracts.OpenDocument(),
    ) { uri ->
        if (uri == null) return@registerForActivityResult
        val appContext = requireContext().applicationContext
        lifecycleScope.launch {
            val result = withContext(Dispatchers.IO) {
                runCatching {
                    val raw = appContext.contentResolver.openInputStream(uri)?.use {
                        readUtf8Document(it, WifiFingerprintImporter.MAX_CATALOG_BYTES, "Wi-Fi 指纹库")
                    }
                        ?: error("无法读取文件")
                    val imported = WifiFingerprintImporter.importJson(raw)
                    appContext.wifiFingerprintCatalogJson =
                        WifiFingerprintImporter.encodeJson(imported.catalog)
                    imported
                }
            }
            result.onSuccess { imported ->
                showToast(getString(R.string.settings_wifi_imported, imported.imported))
            }.onFailure { error ->
                showToast(getString(R.string.settings_wifi_import_failed, error.message ?: "unknown"))
            }
        }
    }

    private fun readUtf8Document(input: java.io.InputStream, maxBytes: Int, label: String): String {
        val output = ByteArrayOutputStream()
        val buffer = ByteArray(8 * 1024)
        while (true) {
            val count = input.read(buffer)
            if (count < 0) break
            require(output.size() <= maxBytes - count) {
                "${label}文件超过 $maxBytes 字节"
            }
            output.write(buffer, 0, count)
        }
        return Charsets.UTF_8.newDecoder()
            .onMalformedInput(CodingErrorAction.REPORT)
            .onUnmappableCharacter(CodingErrorAction.REPORT)
            .decode(ByteBuffer.wrap(output.toByteArray()))
            .toString()
    }

    override fun onCreateView(
        inflater: LayoutInflater,
        container: ViewGroup?,
        savedInstanceState: Bundle?,
    ): View = ComposeView(requireContext()).apply {
        setViewCompositionStrategy(ViewCompositionStrategy.DisposeOnViewTreeLifecycleDestroyed)
        setContent {
            PortalTheme {
                val state by library.collectAsStateWithLifecycle()
                val capture by captureState.collectAsStateWithLifecycle()
                val replay by replayModel.state.collectAsStateWithLifecycle()
                if (arguments?.getBoolean("library") == true) {
                    EnvironmentLibraryScreen(state, ::refreshNames, ::exportEnvironment,
                        ::replayEnvironment, ::deleteEnvironment, ::renameEnvironment,
                        ::editEnvironmentProfile, { editEnvironmentProfile("") }, ::requestEnvironmentCapture,
                        ::importEnvironment, capture, { captureJob?.cancel() },
                        if (replay.busy) "正在应用回放…" else replay.message)
                } else EnvironmentScreen(
                    replayModel = replayModel,
                    library = state,
                    onOpenLibrary = { findNavController().navigate(R.id.nav_environment_library) },
                    onOpenSim = { findNavController().navigate(R.id.nav_carrier_identity) },
                    onCapture = ::requestEnvironmentCapture,
                    onCreate = { editEnvironmentProfile("") },
                    capture = capture,
                    onCancelCapture = { captureJob?.cancel() },
                    onImport = ::importEnvironment,
                    onImportFingerprint = { importWifiFingerprintDocument.launch(arrayOf("application/json", "text/plain", "*/*")) },
                    onApplyConfig = ::applyConfigNowWithToast,
                )
            }
        }
    }

    override fun onResume() {
        super.onResume()
        refreshNames()
    }

    private fun importEnvironment() {
        importEnvironmentDocument.launch(arrayOf("application/json", "text/plain", "*/*"))
    }

    private fun refreshNames() {
        val appContext = requireContext().applicationContext
        libraryJob?.cancel()
        libraryJob = lifecycleScope.launch {
            library.value = library.value.copy(loading = true, error = null)
            runCatching { withContext(Dispatchers.IO) { EnvironmentStore(appContext).list() } }
                .onSuccess { library.value = EnvironmentLibraryState(it, loading = false) }
                .onFailure {
                    if (it is CancellationException) throw it
                    library.value = EnvironmentLibraryState(loading = false, error = "无法读取环境列表，原有文件未修改")
                }
        }
    }

    private fun requestEnvironmentCapture() {
        if (captureJob?.isActive == true) return
        val context = requireContext()
        if (context.checkSelfPermission(Manifest.permission.ACCESS_FINE_LOCATION) != PackageManager.PERMISSION_GRANTED) {
            locationPermission.launch(arrayOf(
                Manifest.permission.ACCESS_COARSE_LOCATION,
                Manifest.permission.ACCESS_FINE_LOCATION,
            ))
            return
        }
        requestBleScanPermissionOrCapture()
    }

    private fun requestBleScanPermissionOrCapture() {
        val context = requireContext()
        if (Build.VERSION.SDK_INT >= Build.VERSION_CODES.S &&
            context.checkSelfPermission(Manifest.permission.BLUETOOTH_SCAN) != PackageManager.PERMISSION_GRANTED
        ) {
            bleScanPermission.launch(Manifest.permission.BLUETOOTH_SCAN)
            return
        }
        captureEnvironment()
    }

    private fun captureEnvironment() {
        if (captureJob?.isActive == true) return
        val appContext = requireContext().applicationContext
        captureState.value = EnvironmentCaptureState(busy = true, message = "正在获取真实位置…")
        captureJob = viewLifecycleOwner.lifecycleScope.launch {
            try {
                val (name, profile) = withContext(Dispatchers.IO) {
                    val origin = EnvironmentCaptureLocation(appContext).current()
                    val profile = EnvironmentCollector(appContext).capture(
                        origin = origin.coordinate,
                        originAccuracyMeters = origin.accuracyMeters,
                        seed = System.currentTimeMillis(),
                        originElapsedRealtimeNanos = origin.elapsedRealtimeNanos,
                        onProgress = { captureState.value = EnvironmentCaptureState(true, it) },
                    )
                    val baseName = "capture-" + SimpleDateFormat("yyyyMMdd-HHmmss", Locale.US).format(Date())
                    EnvironmentStore(appContext).saveNew(baseName, profile) to profile
                }
                captureState.value = EnvironmentCaptureState(message =
                    "已保存 $name · Wi-Fi ${profile.wifi.size} · 小区 ${profile.cells.size + profile.cdmaCells.size} · 蓝牙 ${profile.ble.size}")
                refreshNames()
                if (profile.wifi.isEmpty() && profile.cells.isEmpty() && profile.cdmaCells.isEmpty() && profile.ble.isEmpty()) {
                    captureState.value = EnvironmentCaptureState(message = "已保存 $name，但未获取到无线数据。请检查 Wi-Fi、蓝牙及权限，也可手动添加。")
                }
            } catch (cancelled: CancellationException) {
                captureState.value = EnvironmentCaptureState(message = "已取消采集")
                throw cancelled
            } catch (error: Exception) {
                captureState.value = EnvironmentCaptureState(message = "采集失败：${error.message ?: "请重试"}", failed = true)
            } finally {
                captureState.value = captureState.value.copy(busy = false)
            }
        }
    }

    private fun exportEnvironment(name: String) {
        val appContext = requireContext().applicationContext
        lifecycleScope.launch {
            val profile = withContext(Dispatchers.IO) {
                runCatching { EnvironmentStore(appContext).load(name) }.getOrNull()
            }
            if (profile == null) {
                showToast(getString(R.string.environment_export_failed, "无法读取环境"))
                return@launch
            }
            pendingExport = name to profile
            createEnvironmentDocument.launch("$name.json")
        }
    }

    private fun replayEnvironment(name: String) {
        val command = replayModel.environment(name) ?: return
        lifecycleScope.launch {
            command.join()
            if (!replayModel.state.value.failed && isAdded && arguments?.getBoolean("library") == true &&
                parentFragment !is com.system.location.service.ui.mock.RouteGalleryComposeFragment) findNavController().popBackStack()
        }
    }

    private fun deleteEnvironment(name: String) {
        val appContext = requireContext().applicationContext
        lifecycleScope.launch {
            val deleted = withContext(Dispatchers.IO) {
                runCatching { EnvironmentStore(appContext).delete(name) }.getOrDefault(false)
            }
            refreshNames()
            showToast(
                if (deleted) getString(R.string.environment_deleted)
                else getString(R.string.environment_delete_failed),
            )
        }
    }

    private fun renameEnvironment(name: String, nextName: String) {
        val appContext = requireContext().applicationContext
        lifecycleScope.launch {
            val result = withContext(Dispatchers.IO) {
                runCatching { EnvironmentStore(appContext).rename(name, nextName.trim()) }
            }
            refreshNames()
            result.onSuccess { showToast(getString(R.string.environment_renamed)) }
                .onFailure { showToast(getString(R.string.environment_rename_failed, it.message ?: "unknown")) }
        }
    }

    private fun editEnvironmentProfile(name: String) {
        findNavController().navigate(R.id.nav_environment_editor, Bundle().apply { putString("name", name) })
    }

    private fun applyConfigNowWithToast() {
        lifecycleScope.launch {
            val applied = withContext(Dispatchers.IO) {
                com.system.location.service.runtime.ScenarioRuntime.applyConfigNow()
            }
            showToast(if (applied) "配置已应用" else "已保存，下次启动场景生效")
        }
    }

    private fun showToast(message: String) {
        if (isAdded) Toast.makeText(requireContext(), message, Toast.LENGTH_SHORT).show()
    }
}

@Composable
private fun EnvironmentScreen(
    replayModel: com.system.location.service.ui.viewmodel.QuickReplayViewModel,
    library: EnvironmentLibraryState,
    onOpenLibrary: () -> Unit,
    onOpenSim: () -> Unit,
    onCapture: () -> Unit,
    onCreate: () -> Unit,
    capture: EnvironmentCaptureState,
    onCancelCapture: () -> Unit,
    onImport: () -> Unit,
    onImportFingerprint: () -> Unit,
    onApplyConfig: () -> Unit,
) {
    val context = LocalContext.current
    val revision = preferenceRevision()
    val apCount = remember(revision) { context.environmentApCount }
    val cellMode = remember(revision) { context.cellMode }
    val sourceMode = remember(revision) { context.environmentSourceMode }
    val fingerprintEnabled = remember(revision) { context.wifiFingerprintEnabled }
    var apDialog by rememberSaveable { mutableStateOf(false) }
    var apInput by rememberSaveable { mutableStateOf(apCount.toString()) }
    var cellDialog by rememberSaveable { mutableStateOf(false) }
    var sourceDialog by rememberSaveable { mutableStateOf(false) }

    fun apply() {
        onApplyConfig()
    }

    if (apDialog) {
        val apRangeMessage = stringResource(R.string.settings_environment_ap_range)
        AlertDialog(
            onDismissRequest = { apDialog = false },
            title = { Text(stringResource(R.string.environment_ap_title)) },
            text = {
                OutlinedTextField(
                    value = apInput,
                    onValueChange = { apInput = it.filter(Char::isDigit).take(1) },
                    singleLine = true,
                    label = { Text("3–8") },
                )
            },
            confirmButton = {
                TextButton(onClick = {
                    val count = apInput.toIntOrNull()
                    if (count == null || count !in 3..8) {
                        Toast.makeText(context, apRangeMessage, Toast.LENGTH_SHORT).show()
                    } else {
                        context.environmentApCount = count
                        apDialog = false
                        apply()
                    }
                }) { Text("保存") }
            },
            dismissButton = { TextButton(onClick = { apDialog = false }) { Text("取消") } },
        )
    }

    ChoiceDialog(
        visible = cellDialog,
        title = stringResource(R.string.cell_mode_title),
        options = listOf("AUTO", "FULL_REPLAY", "NO_SIM_WIFI_ONLY", "LEGACY_CDMA"),
        selected = cellMode,
        label = ::cellModeLabel,
        onSelect = {
            context.cellMode = it
            cellDialog = false
            apply()
        },
        onDismiss = { cellDialog = false },
    )
    ChoiceDialog(
        visible = sourceDialog,
        title = stringResource(R.string.environment_source_title),
        options = listOf("AUTO", "PROCEDURAL", "REPLAY"),
        selected = sourceMode,
        label = ::environmentSourceLabel,
        onSelect = {
            context.environmentSourceMode = it
            sourceDialog = false
            apply()
        },
        onDismiss = { sourceDialog = false },
    )

    Surface(Modifier.fillMaxSize(), color = MaterialTheme.colorScheme.background) {
        LazyColumn(
            contentPadding = PaddingValues(20.dp, 24.dp, 20.dp, 32.dp),
            verticalArrangement = Arrangement.spacedBy(16.dp),
        ) {
            item(key = "quick-replay") {
                com.system.location.service.ui.mock.QuickReplayCard(replayModel, satellite = false)
            }
            item {
                Text(
                    stringResource(R.string.environment_capture_desc),
                    style = MaterialTheme.typography.bodyMedium,
                    color = MaterialTheme.colorScheme.onSurfaceVariant,
                )
            }
            item {
                EnvironmentCreationActions(onCreate, onCapture, onImport, capture, onCancelCapture)
            }
            item(key = "sim-environment") {
                val enabled = context.sharedPrefs.getBoolean("carrierIdentityEnabled", false)
                val config = remember(revision) {
                    runCatching {
                        com.system.location.service.core.carrier.CarrierIdentityCodec.decode(
                            context.sharedPrefs.getString("carrierIdentityJson", "").orEmpty())
                    }.getOrNull()
                }
                val summary = config?.sims.orEmpty().filter { it.enabled }
                    .sortedBy { it.slot }.joinToString(" · ") { "SIM ${it.slot} ${it.carrierName}" }
                PortalSettingGroup("SIM 与蜂窝环境", 1) { _, rowModifier ->
                    PortalActionRow(
                        title = "双卡与运营商",
                        subtitle = if (summary.isEmpty()) "配置国家、运营商和 NR 频段；支持无卡模拟"
                            else summary,
                        onClick = onOpenSim,
                        status = if (!enabled) "未启用" else if (config?.mode ==
                            com.system.location.service.core.carrier.CarrierIdentityMode.PER_APP)
                            "分应用" else "全局",
                        modifier = rowModifier,
                    )
                }
            }
            item {
                PortalSettingGroup("环境资料库", 1) { _, rowModifier ->
                    PortalActionRow(stringResource(R.string.environment_list_action),
                        when {
                            library.loading -> "正在读取环境列表"
                            library.error != null -> "列表读取失败，进入后可重试"
                            else -> "共 ${library.names.size} 个环境；可编辑、回放和导出"
                        }, onOpenLibrary, modifier = rowModifier)
                }
            }
            item {
                PortalSettingGroup(stringResource(R.string.settings_environment_fingerprint), 2) { index, rowModifier ->
                    when (index) {
                        0 -> PortalSwitchRow(
                            title = stringResource(R.string.wifi_fingerprint_enable),
                            subtitle = "仅 Xposed / Native 模拟输出有效",
                            status = "运行中尝试立即应用",
                            checked = fingerprintEnabled,
                            onCheckedChange = {
                                context.wifiFingerprintEnabled = it
                                onApplyConfig()
                            },
                            modifier = rowModifier,
                        )
                        1 -> PortalActionRow(stringResource(R.string.wifi_fingerprint_import),
                            "从文件导入 Wi-Fi 指纹库", onImportFingerprint, modifier = rowModifier)
                    }
                }
            }
            item {
                PortalSettingGroup(stringResource(R.string.settings_environment_replay), 3) { index, rowModifier ->
                    when (index) {
                        0 -> PortalActionRow(
                            title = stringResource(R.string.environment_ap_value, apCount),
                            status = "运行中尝试立即应用",
                            onClick = { apInput = apCount.toString(); apDialog = true },
                            modifier = rowModifier,
                        )
                        1 -> PortalActionRow(
                            title = stringResource(R.string.cell_mode_value, cellModeLabel(cellMode)),
                            status = "运行中尝试立即应用",
                            onClick = { cellDialog = true },
                            modifier = rowModifier,
                        )
                        2 -> PortalActionRow(
                            title = stringResource(R.string.environment_source_value, environmentSourceLabel(sourceMode)),
                            status = "运行中尝试立即应用",
                            onClick = { sourceDialog = true },
                            modifier = rowModifier,
                        )
                    }
                }
            }
            item {
                Text(
                    "环境回放和 WiFi 指纹属于实验能力，失败时会回退到程序化环境。",
                    style = MaterialTheme.typography.bodySmall,
                    color = MaterialTheme.colorScheme.onSurfaceVariant,
                )
            }
        }
    }
}

@Composable
private fun ChoiceDialog(
    visible: Boolean,
    title: String,
    options: List<String>,
    selected: String,
    label: (String) -> String,
    onSelect: (String) -> Unit,
    onDismiss: () -> Unit,
) {
    if (!visible) return
    AlertDialog(
        onDismissRequest = onDismiss,
        title = { Text(title) },
        text = {
            Column {
                options.forEach { option ->
                    Row(
                        modifier = Modifier.fillMaxWidth().selectable(
                            selected = option == selected, role = Role.RadioButton,
                            onClick = { onSelect(option) },
                        ).padding(vertical = 8.dp),
                        verticalAlignment = androidx.compose.ui.Alignment.CenterVertically,
                    ) {
                        RadioButton(selected = option == selected, onClick = null)
                        Text(label(option), Modifier.padding(start = 8.dp))
                    }
                }
            }
        },
        confirmButton = { TextButton(onClick = onDismiss) { Text("取消") } },
    )
}

private fun cellModeLabel(value: String) = when (value) {
    "AUTO" -> "自动选择"
    "FULL_REPLAY" -> "完整回放"
    "NO_SIM_WIFI_ONLY" -> "无 SIM / 仅 Wi-Fi"
    "LEGACY_CDMA" -> "CDMA 网络"
    else -> "未知模式（$value）"
}

private fun environmentSourceLabel(value: String) = when (value) {
    "AUTO" -> "自动选择"
    "PROCEDURAL" -> "按位置生成"
    "REPLAY" -> "已保存环境回放"
    else -> "未知来源（$value）"
}
```
