`app/src/main/java/com/system/location/service/ui/environment/EnvironmentEditorFragment.kt`:

```kt
package com.system.location.service.ui.environment

import android.os.Bundle
import android.view.LayoutInflater
import android.view.View
import android.view.ViewGroup
import androidx.compose.foundation.layout.*
import androidx.compose.foundation.lazy.LazyColumn
import androidx.compose.foundation.lazy.rememberLazyListState
import androidx.compose.material3.*
import androidx.compose.runtime.*
import androidx.compose.runtime.saveable.rememberSaveable
import androidx.compose.ui.Modifier
import androidx.compose.ui.platform.ComposeView
import androidx.compose.ui.platform.ViewCompositionStrategy
import androidx.compose.ui.res.painterResource
import androidx.compose.ui.unit.dp
import androidx.fragment.app.Fragment
import androidx.fragment.app.viewModels
import androidx.lifecycle.compose.collectAsStateWithLifecycle
import androidx.navigation.fragment.findNavController
import com.system.location.service.R
import com.system.location.service.core.environment.*
import com.system.location.service.designsystem.components.PortalActionRow
import com.system.location.service.designsystem.components.PortalCard
import com.system.location.service.designsystem.theme.PortalTheme


class EnvironmentEditorFragment : Fragment() {
    private val model by viewModels<EnvironmentEditorViewModel>()

    override fun onCreateView(inflater: LayoutInflater, container: ViewGroup?, savedInstanceState: Bundle?): View =
        ComposeView(requireContext()).apply {
            setViewCompositionStrategy(ViewCompositionStrategy.DisposeOnViewTreeLifecycleDestroyed)
            setContent {
                PortalTheme {
                    val state by model.state.collectAsStateWithLifecycle()
                    LaunchedEffect(state.saved) {
                        if (state.saved) findNavController().popBackStack()
                    }
                    val profile = state.profile
                    if (profile == null) {
                        Column(Modifier.fillMaxSize().padding(24.dp), verticalArrangement = Arrangement.spacedBy(16.dp)) {
                            if (state.busy) LinearProgressIndicator(Modifier.fillMaxWidth())
                            state.error?.let { Text(it, color = MaterialTheme.colorScheme.error) }
                            TextButton(model::load, enabled = !state.busy) { Text("重新加载") }
                        }
                    } else EnvironmentProfileEditor(profile, state, model.originalName, model::update,
                        model::save, { findNavController().popBackStack() })
                }
            }
        }
}

@Composable
private fun EnvironmentProfileEditor(
    profile: EnvironmentProfile,
    state: EnvironmentEditorState,
    originalName: String,
    onUpdate: (EnvironmentProfile) -> Unit,
    onSave: (String, String, String, String) -> Unit,
    onBack: () -> Unit,
) {
    var name by rememberSaveable { mutableStateOf(originalName) }
    var latitude by rememberSaveable { mutableStateOf(profile.origin?.latitude?.toString().orEmpty()) }
    var longitude by rememberSaveable { mutableStateOf(profile.origin?.longitude?.toString().orEmpty()) }
    var accuracy by rememberSaveable { mutableStateOf(profile.originAccuracyMeters?.toString().orEmpty()) }
    var kind by rememberSaveable { mutableStateOf(EnvironmentDataKind.WIFI) }
    var editIndex by rememberSaveable { mutableStateOf<Int?>(null) }
    val scroll = rememberLazyListState()
    val labels = when (kind) {
        EnvironmentDataKind.WIFI -> profile.wifi.map { it.ssid to "${it.bssid} · ${it.rssi} dBm${if (it.connected) " · 已连接" else ""}" }
        EnvironmentDataKind.BLE -> profile.ble.map { it.name.ifBlank { "BLE 信标" } to "${it.address} · ${it.rssi} dBm" }
        EnvironmentDataKind.CELL -> profile.cells.map { "${it.type} · ${it.cellId}" to
            "${it.operatorNumeric ?: "${it.mcc}-${it.mnc}"} · ${it.rsrp} dBm${if (it.registered) " · 已注册" else ""}" }
        EnvironmentDataKind.CDMA -> profile.cdmaCells.map { "SID ${it.systemId} · BID ${it.baseStationId}" to
            "NID ${it.networkId}${if (it.registered) " · 已注册" else ""}" }
    }
    val limit = when (kind) {
        EnvironmentDataKind.WIFI -> EnvironmentProfile.MAX_WIFI
        EnvironmentDataKind.BLE -> EnvironmentProfile.MAX_BLE
        else -> EnvironmentProfile.MAX_CELLS
    }
    val count = if (kind == EnvironmentDataKind.CELL || kind == EnvironmentDataKind.CDMA)
        profile.cells.size + profile.cdmaCells.size else labels.size

    Box {
        if (editIndex == null) EnvironmentEditorPage(onBack, { Text(if (originalName.isBlank()) "新建环境" else "编辑环境") }, text = {
            LazyColumn(Modifier.fillMaxSize(), state = scroll, verticalArrangement = Arrangement.spacedBy(12.dp),
                contentPadding = PaddingValues(bottom = 16.dp)) {
                item(key = "identity") {
                    PortalCard {
                        OutlinedTextField(name, { name = it }, label = { Text("环境名称") },
                            enabled = originalName.isBlank() && !state.busy, singleLine = true, modifier = Modifier.fillMaxWidth(),
                            supportingText = { Text("名称用于文件保存；支持字母、数字、点、下划线和连字符") })
                        Text("回放位置（WGS84）", style = MaterialTheme.typography.titleSmall)
                        Text("坐标与精度可留空暂存；用于回放时需填写，且模拟位置应在此坐标附近。",
                            style = MaterialTheme.typography.bodySmall, color = MaterialTheme.colorScheme.onSurfaceVariant)
                        OutlinedTextField(latitude, { latitude = it }, label = { Text("纬度") },
                            singleLine = true, modifier = Modifier.fillMaxWidth())
                        OutlinedTextField(longitude, { longitude = it }, label = { Text("经度") },
                            singleLine = true, modifier = Modifier.fillMaxWidth())
                        OutlinedTextField(accuracy, { accuracy = it }, label = { Text("精度（米）") },
                            singleLine = true, modifier = Modifier.fillMaxWidth())
                    }
                }
                item(key = "kind") {
                    Row(Modifier.fillMaxWidth(), horizontalArrangement = Arrangement.spacedBy(6.dp)) {
                        EnvironmentDataKind.entries.forEach { option ->
                            FilterChip(kind == option, { kind = option }, label = { Text(option.label) })
                        }
                    }
                    Text("${kind.label} · ${labels.size} 条", style = MaterialTheme.typography.titleMedium)
                    Text("Wi-Fi ${profile.wifi.size} · 蓝牙 ${profile.ble.size} · 小区 ${profile.cells.size + profile.cdmaCells.size}",
                        style = MaterialTheme.typography.bodySmall, color = MaterialTheme.colorScheme.onSurfaceVariant)
                }
                item(key = "add") {
                    OutlinedButton({ editIndex = -1 }, enabled = !state.busy && count < limit,
                        modifier = Modifier.fillMaxWidth()) { Text("添加${kind.label}") }
                }
                if (labels.isEmpty()) item(key = "empty") {
                    Text("还没有${kind.label}数据，可直接手动添加。", color = MaterialTheme.colorScheme.onSurfaceVariant)
                }
                items(labels.size, key = { "${kind.name}-$it" }) { index ->
                    PortalCard {
                        PortalActionRow(labels[index].first, labels[index].second,
                            onClick = { editIndex = index })
                        TextButton(onClick = {
                            onUpdate(when (kind) {
                                EnvironmentDataKind.WIFI -> profile.copy(wifi = profile.wifi.filterIndexed { i, _ -> i != index })
                                EnvironmentDataKind.BLE -> profile.copy(ble = profile.ble.filterIndexed { i, _ -> i != index })
                                EnvironmentDataKind.CELL -> profile.copy(cells = profile.cells.filterIndexed { i, _ -> i != index })
                                EnvironmentDataKind.CDMA -> profile.copy(cdmaCells = profile.cdmaCells.filterIndexed { i, _ -> i != index })
                            })
                        }, enabled = !state.busy) {
                            Icon(painterResource(R.drawable.ic_portal_delete), null, Modifier.size(18.dp))
                            Text("移除", Modifier.padding(start = 6.dp))
                        }
                    }
                }
                state.error?.let { item(key = "error") { Text(it, color = MaterialTheme.colorScheme.error) } }
            }
        }, confirmButton = {
            if (state.busy) CircularProgressIndicator(Modifier.size(22.dp))
            TextButton({ onSave(name, latitude, longitude, accuracy) }, enabled = !state.busy) { Text("保存环境") }
        }, dismissButton = { TextButton(onBack, enabled = !state.busy) { Text("返回") } })

        editIndex?.let { index ->
            key(kind, index) {
                val close = { editIndex = null }
                fun apply(change: () -> EnvironmentProfile) {
                    onUpdate(change())
                    close()
                }
                when (kind) {
                    EnvironmentDataKind.WIFI -> EnvironmentWifiApPage(profile.wifi.getOrNull(index), close, { ap -> apply {
                        require(profile.wifi.withIndex().none { it.index != index && it.value.bssid.equals(ap.bssid, true) }) { "BSSID 已存在" }
                        val list = profile.wifi.mapIndexed { i, old -> if (i == index) ap else if (ap.connected) old.copy(connected = false) else old }
                        profile.copy(wifi = if (index < 0) list + ap else list)
                    } })
                    EnvironmentDataKind.BLE -> EnvironmentBleBeaconPage(profile.ble.getOrNull(index), close, { beacon -> apply {
                        require(profile.ble.withIndex().none { it.index != index && it.value.address.equals(beacon.address, true) }) { "蓝牙地址已存在" }
                        profile.copy(ble = if (index < 0) profile.ble + beacon else profile.ble.mapIndexed { i, old -> if (i == index) beacon else old })
                    } })
                    EnvironmentDataKind.CELL -> EnvironmentCellTowerPage(profile.cells.getOrNull(index), close, { cell -> apply {
                        require(profile.cells.withIndex().none { it.index != index && it.value.let { old ->
                            old.type == cell.type && old.mcc == cell.mcc && old.mnc == cell.mnc && old.areaCode == cell.areaCode && old.cellId == cell.cellId
                        } }) { "蜂窝小区已存在" }
                        val list = profile.cells.mapIndexed { i, old -> if (i == index) cell else if (cell.registered) old.copy(registered = false) else old }
                        profile.copy(cells = if (index < 0) list + cell else list,
                            cdmaCells = if (cell.registered) profile.cdmaCells.map { it.copy(registered = false) } else profile.cdmaCells)
                    } })
                    EnvironmentDataKind.CDMA -> EnvironmentCdmaTowerPage(profile.cdmaCells.getOrNull(index), close, { cell -> apply {
                        require(profile.cdmaCells.withIndex().none { it.index != index && it.value.let { old ->
                            old.systemId == cell.systemId && old.networkId == cell.networkId && old.baseStationId == cell.baseStationId
                        } }) { "CDMA 小区已存在" }
                        val list = profile.cdmaCells.mapIndexed { i, old -> if (i == index) cell else if (cell.registered) old.copy(registered = false) else old }
                        profile.copy(cdmaCells = if (index < 0) list + cell else list,
                            cells = if (cell.registered) profile.cells.map { it.copy(registered = false) } else profile.cells)
                    } })
                }

            }
        }
    }
}
```

`app/src/main/java/com/system/location/service/ui/environment/EnvironmentEditorViewModel.kt`:

```kt
package com.system.location.service.ui.environment

import android.app.Application
import androidx.lifecycle.AndroidViewModel
import androidx.lifecycle.SavedStateHandle
import androidx.lifecycle.viewModelScope
import com.system.location.service.core.environment.EnvironmentProfile
import com.system.location.service.core.environment.EnvironmentSourceType
import com.system.location.service.core.geo.Wgs84
import com.system.location.service.environment.EnvironmentStore
import kotlinx.coroutines.CancellationException
import kotlinx.coroutines.Dispatchers
import kotlinx.coroutines.channels.Channel
import kotlinx.coroutines.flow.MutableStateFlow
import kotlinx.coroutines.flow.asStateFlow
import kotlinx.coroutines.launch
import kotlinx.coroutines.withContext
import java.io.File
import java.util.UUID

internal data class EnvironmentEditorState(
    val profile: EnvironmentProfile? = null,
    val busy: Boolean = true,
    val error: String? = null,
    val saved: Boolean = false,
)

/** The draft survives navigation and recreation; files are touched only on explicit save. */
internal class EnvironmentEditorViewModel(
    application: Application,
    handle: SavedStateHandle,
) : AndroidViewModel(application) {
    val originalName: String = handle["name"] ?: ""
    private val draftName = handle.get<String>("draftName") ?: UUID.randomUUID().toString().also { handle["draftName"] = it }
    private val drafts = EnvironmentStore(File(application.cacheDir, "environment-editor-drafts"))
    private val changes = Channel<EnvironmentProfile>(Channel.CONFLATED)
    private val mutable = MutableStateFlow(EnvironmentEditorState())
    val state = mutable.asStateFlow()

    init {
        // An imported profile can reach 2 MiB. Save only its cache key in the Android state
        // bundle, otherwise restoring a large draft can fail with TransactionTooLargeException.
        viewModelScope.launch {
            for (profile in changes) {
                try { withContext(Dispatchers.IO) { drafts.save(draftName, profile) } }
                catch (cancelled: CancellationException) { throw cancelled }
                catch (error: Exception) {
                    mutable.value = state.value.copy(error = "草稿暂存失败：${error.message}，请保存环境后再退出")
                }
            }
        }
        load()
    }

    fun load() {
        if (state.value.profile != null) return
        viewModelScope.launch {
            mutable.value = EnvironmentEditorState()
            try {
                val profile = withContext(Dispatchers.IO) {
                    draftName.takeIf { it in drafts.list() }?.let(drafts::load)
                        ?: if (originalName.isNotBlank()) EnvironmentStore(getApplication<Application>()).load(originalName)
                        else EnvironmentProfile(source = EnvironmentSourceType.REPLAY,
                            generatedAtMillis = System.currentTimeMillis(), seed = System.currentTimeMillis())
                }
                mutable.value = EnvironmentEditorState(profile, busy = false)
            } catch (cancelled: CancellationException) { throw cancelled }
            catch (error: Exception) {
                mutable.value = EnvironmentEditorState(busy = false, error = "读取失败：${error.message}")
            }
        }
    }

    fun update(profile: EnvironmentProfile) {
        mutable.value = state.value.copy(profile = profile, error = null)
        changes.trySend(profile)
    }

    fun save(name: String, latitude: String, longitude: String, accuracy: String) {
        val current = state.value
        val profile = current.profile ?: return
        if (current.busy || current.saved) return
        viewModelScope.launch {
            mutable.value = current.copy(busy = true, error = null)
            try {
                require(name.isNotBlank()) { "请输入环境名称" }
                val hasOrigin = latitude.isNotBlank() || longitude.isNotBlank()
                val origin = if (hasOrigin) Wgs84(latitude.trim().toDouble(), longitude.trim().toDouble()) else null
                require(origin != null || accuracy.isBlank()) { "请先填写环境坐标" }
                val next = profile.copy(source = EnvironmentSourceType.REPLAY, origin = origin,
                    originAccuracyMeters = accuracy.trim().takeIf { it.isNotEmpty() }?.toDouble())
                withContext(Dispatchers.IO) {
                    val store = EnvironmentStore(getApplication<Application>())
                    if (originalName.isBlank()) store.saveNew(name.trim(), next)
                    else store.save(originalName, next)
                }
                mutable.value = current.copy(profile = next, busy = false, saved = true)
            } catch (cancelled: CancellationException) { throw cancelled }
            catch (error: Exception) {
                mutable.value = current.copy(busy = false, error = "保存失败：${error.message ?: "请检查输入"}")
            }
        }
    }

    override fun onCleared() {
        changes.close()
        super.onCleared()
    }
}
```

`app/src/main/java/com/system/location/service/ui/environment/EnvironmentItemEditors.kt`:

```kt
package com.system.location.service.ui.environment

import androidx.compose.foundation.layout.*
import androidx.compose.foundation.lazy.LazyColumn
import androidx.compose.foundation.lazy.items
import androidx.compose.material3.*
import androidx.compose.runtime.*
import androidx.compose.runtime.saveable.rememberSaveable
import androidx.compose.ui.Modifier
import androidx.compose.ui.res.painterResource
import androidx.compose.ui.unit.dp
import com.system.location.service.R
import com.system.location.service.core.environment.BleBeacon
import com.system.location.service.core.environment.CellTower
import com.system.location.service.core.environment.CellType
import com.system.location.service.core.environment.CdmaTower
import com.system.location.service.core.environment.EnvironmentProfile
import com.system.location.service.core.environment.WifiAp
import com.system.location.service.designsystem.components.PortalActionRow

@Composable
internal fun EnvironmentBleBeaconPage(
    initial: BleBeacon?,
    onDismiss: () -> Unit,
    onSave: (BleBeacon) -> Unit,
) {
    var address by rememberSaveable(initial?.address) { mutableStateOf(initial?.address.orEmpty()) }
    var name by rememberSaveable(initial?.address) { mutableStateOf(initial?.name.orEmpty()) }
    var rssi by rememberSaveable(initial?.address) { mutableStateOf(initial?.rssi?.toString() ?: "-65") }
    var scanRecord by rememberSaveable(initial?.address) { mutableStateOf(initial?.scanRecordHex.orEmpty()) }
    var txPower by rememberSaveable(initial?.address) { mutableStateOf(initial?.txPowerDbm?.toString().orEmpty()) }
    var validationError by remember { mutableStateOf<String?>(null) }
    EnvironmentEditorPage(
        onBack = onDismiss,
        title = { Text(if (initial == null) "新增 BLE 信标" else "编辑 BLE 信标") },
        text = {
            Column(Modifier.fillMaxWidth().fillMaxSize(), verticalArrangement = Arrangement.spacedBy(6.dp)) {
                LazyColumn(Modifier.fillMaxSize(), contentPadding = PaddingValues(bottom = 16.dp), verticalArrangement = Arrangement.spacedBy(6.dp)) {
                    item { OutlinedTextField(address, { address = it }, modifier = Modifier.fillMaxWidth(), label = { Text("地址") }, singleLine = true) }
                    item { OutlinedTextField(name, { name = it }, modifier = Modifier.fillMaxWidth(), label = { Text("广播名称") }, singleLine = true) }
                    item { OutlinedTextField(rssi, { rssi = it }, modifier = Modifier.fillMaxWidth(), label = { Text("RSSI (dBm)") }, singleLine = true) }
                    item { OutlinedTextField(scanRecord, { scanRecord = it }, modifier = Modifier.fillMaxWidth(), label = { Text("广播数据 Hex（可选）") }) }
                    item { OutlinedTextField(txPower, { txPower = it }, modifier = Modifier.fillMaxWidth(), label = { Text("Tx Power dBm（可选）") }, singleLine = true) }
                    validationError?.let { message -> item { Text(message, color = MaterialTheme.colorScheme.error) } }
                }
            }
        },
        confirmButton = {
            TextButton({
                runCatching {
                    val rawAdvertisement = scanRecord.trim().ifEmpty { null }
                    require(rawAdvertisement == null || BleBeacon.isValidAdvertisementHex(rawAdvertisement)) {
                        "广播数据 Hex 无效或 AD 结构不完整"
                    }
                    BleBeacon(address.trim(), name.trim(), rssi.toInt(), rawAdvertisement,
                        txPower.trim().takeIf(String::isNotEmpty)?.toInt())
                }.mapCatching { onSave(it) }.onFailure {
                    val message = it.message ?: "信标字段无效"
                    validationError = message
                }
            }) { Text("保存信标") }
        },
        dismissButton = { TextButton(onDismiss) { Text("取消") } },
    )
}
@Composable
internal fun EnvironmentWifiApPage(
    initial: WifiAp?,
    onDismiss: () -> Unit,
    onSave: (WifiAp) -> Unit,
) {
    var ssid by rememberSaveable(initial?.bssid) { mutableStateOf(initial?.ssid.orEmpty()) }
    var bssid by rememberSaveable(initial?.bssid) { mutableStateOf(initial?.bssid.orEmpty()) }
    var rssi by rememberSaveable(initial?.bssid) { mutableStateOf(initial?.rssi?.toString() ?: "-60") }
    var frequency by rememberSaveable(initial?.bssid) { mutableStateOf(initial?.frequencyMhz?.toString() ?: "2412") }
    var capabilities by rememberSaveable(initial?.bssid) { mutableStateOf(initial?.capabilities ?: "[WPA2-PSK-CCMP][ESS]") }
    var standard by rememberSaveable(initial?.bssid) { mutableStateOf(initial?.standard?.toString() ?: "4") }
    var connected by rememberSaveable(initial?.bssid) { mutableStateOf(initial?.connected ?: false) }
    var validationError by remember { mutableStateOf<String?>(null) }
    EnvironmentEditorPage(
        onBack = onDismiss,
        title = { Text(if (initial == null) "新增 Wi-Fi AP" else "编辑 Wi-Fi AP") },
        text = {
            Column(Modifier.fillMaxWidth().fillMaxSize(), verticalArrangement = Arrangement.spacedBy(6.dp)) {
                LazyColumn(Modifier.fillMaxSize(), contentPadding = PaddingValues(bottom = 16.dp), verticalArrangement = Arrangement.spacedBy(6.dp)) {
                    item { OutlinedTextField(ssid, { ssid = it }, modifier = Modifier.fillMaxWidth(), label = { Text("SSID") }, singleLine = true) }
                    item { OutlinedTextField(bssid, { bssid = it }, modifier = Modifier.fillMaxWidth(), label = { Text("BSSID") }, singleLine = true) }
                    item { OutlinedTextField(rssi, { rssi = it }, modifier = Modifier.fillMaxWidth(), label = { Text("RSSI (dBm)") }, singleLine = true) }
                    item { OutlinedTextField(frequency, { frequency = it }, modifier = Modifier.fillMaxWidth(), label = { Text("频率 (MHz)") }, singleLine = true) }
                    item { OutlinedTextField(capabilities, { capabilities = it }, modifier = Modifier.fillMaxWidth(), label = { Text("Capabilities") }) }
                    item { OutlinedTextField(standard, { standard = it }, modifier = Modifier.fillMaxWidth(), label = { Text("Wi-Fi 标准编号") }, singleLine = true) }
                    item {
                        Row(verticalAlignment = androidx.compose.ui.Alignment.CenterVertically) {
                            Checkbox(checked = connected, onCheckedChange = { connected = it })
                            Text("连接中的 AP")
                        }
                    }
                    validationError?.let { message -> item { Text(message, color = MaterialTheme.colorScheme.error) } }
                }
            }
        },
        confirmButton = {
            TextButton({
                runCatching {
                    val mhz = frequency.toInt()
                    val channel = requireNotNull(WifiAp.channelForFrequencyMhz(mhz)) {
                        "频率不是有效的 Wi-Fi 信道中心频率"
                    }
                    WifiAp(ssid.trim(), bssid.trim(), rssi.toInt(), mhz, channel,
                        capabilities.trim(), standard.toInt(), connected)
                }.mapCatching { onSave(it) }.onFailure {
                    val message = it.message ?: "Wi-Fi AP 字段无效"
                    validationError = message
                }
            }) { Text("保存 AP") }
        },
        dismissButton = { TextButton(onDismiss) { Text("取消") } },
    )
}

@Composable
internal fun EnvironmentCellTowerPage(
    initial: CellTower?,
    onDismiss: () -> Unit,
    onSave: (CellTower) -> Unit,
) {
    var type by rememberSaveable(initial?.cellId) { mutableStateOf(initial?.type ?: CellType.LTE) }
    var typeMenu by remember { mutableStateOf(false) }
    var mncDigits by rememberSaveable(initial?.cellId) { mutableStateOf(initial?.mncDigits) }
    var mncDigitsMenu by remember { mutableStateOf(false) }
    var mcc by rememberSaveable(initial?.cellId) { mutableStateOf(initial?.mcc?.toString() ?: "460") }
    var mnc by rememberSaveable(initial?.cellId) {
        mutableStateOf(initial?.mnc?.toString()?.padStart(initial.mncDigits ?: 1, '0') ?: "0")
    }
    var operatorName by rememberSaveable(initial?.cellId) { mutableStateOf(initial?.operatorName.orEmpty()) }
    var areaCode by rememberSaveable(initial?.cellId) { mutableStateOf(initial?.areaCode?.toString() ?: "1") }
    var cellId by rememberSaveable(initial?.cellId) { mutableStateOf(initial?.cellId?.toString() ?: "1") }
    var pci by rememberSaveable(initial?.cellId) { mutableStateOf(initial?.pci?.toString().orEmpty()) }
    var arfcn by rememberSaveable(initial?.cellId) { mutableStateOf(initial?.arfcn?.toString().orEmpty()) }
    var rsrp by rememberSaveable(initial?.cellId) { mutableStateOf(initial?.rsrp?.toString() ?: "-90") }
    var rsrq by rememberSaveable(initial?.cellId) { mutableStateOf(initial?.rsrq?.toString().orEmpty()) }
    var rssnr by rememberSaveable(initial?.cellId) { mutableStateOf(initial?.rssnr?.toString().orEmpty()) }
    var registered by rememberSaveable(initial?.cellId) { mutableStateOf(initial?.registered ?: false) }
    var validationError by remember { mutableStateOf<String?>(null) }
    EnvironmentEditorPage(
        onBack = onDismiss,
        title = { Text(if (initial == null) "新增蜂窝小区" else "编辑蜂窝小区") },
        text = {
            Column(Modifier.fillMaxWidth().fillMaxSize(), verticalArrangement = Arrangement.spacedBy(6.dp)) {
                LazyColumn(Modifier.fillMaxSize(), contentPadding = PaddingValues(bottom = 16.dp), verticalArrangement = Arrangement.spacedBy(6.dp)) {
                    item {
                        Box {
                            OutlinedButton(onClick = { typeMenu = true }) { Text("制式：$type") }
                            DropdownMenu(expanded = typeMenu, onDismissRequest = { typeMenu = false }) {
                                CellType.entries.forEach { option ->
                                    DropdownMenuItem(text = { Text(option.name) }, onClick = {
                                        type = option
                                        typeMenu = false
                                    })
                                }
                            }
                        }
                    }
                    item { OutlinedTextField(mcc, { mcc = it }, modifier = Modifier.fillMaxWidth(), label = { Text("MCC") }, singleLine = true) }
                    item { OutlinedTextField(mnc, { mnc = it }, modifier = Modifier.fillMaxWidth(), label = { Text("MNC") }, singleLine = true) }
                    item {
                        Box {
                            OutlinedButton(onClick = { mncDigitsMenu = true }) {
                                Text("MNC 位数：${mncDigits?.toString() ?: "未知"}")
                            }
                            DropdownMenu(expanded = mncDigitsMenu, onDismissRequest = { mncDigitsMenu = false }) {
                                DropdownMenuItem(text = { Text("未知") }, onClick = {
                                    mncDigits = null
                                    mncDigitsMenu = false
                                })
                                listOf(2, 3).forEach { digits ->
                                    DropdownMenuItem(text = { Text("$digits 位") }, onClick = {
                                        mnc = mnc.trim().filter(Char::isDigit).takeLast(digits).padStart(digits, '0')
                                        mncDigits = digits
                                        mncDigitsMenu = false
                                    })
                                }
                            }
                        }
                    }
                    item { OutlinedTextField(operatorName, { operatorName = it }, modifier = Modifier.fillMaxWidth(), label = { Text("运营商名称（可选）") }, singleLine = true) }
                    item { OutlinedTextField(areaCode, { areaCode = it }, modifier = Modifier.fillMaxWidth(), label = { Text("LAC / TAC") }, singleLine = true) }
                    item { OutlinedTextField(cellId, { cellId = it }, modifier = Modifier.fillMaxWidth(), label = { Text("CID / NCI") }, singleLine = true) }
                    item { OutlinedTextField(pci, { pci = it }, modifier = Modifier.fillMaxWidth(), label = { Text("PCI / PSC（可选）") }, singleLine = true) }
                    item { OutlinedTextField(arfcn, { arfcn = it }, modifier = Modifier.fillMaxWidth(), label = { Text("ARFCN（可选）") }, singleLine = true) }
                    item { OutlinedTextField(rsrp, { rsrp = it }, modifier = Modifier.fillMaxWidth(), label = { Text("RSRP / RSSI (dBm)") }, singleLine = true) }
                    item { OutlinedTextField(rsrq, { rsrq = it }, modifier = Modifier.fillMaxWidth(), label = { Text("RSRQ（可选）") }, singleLine = true) }
                    item { OutlinedTextField(rssnr, { rssnr = it }, modifier = Modifier.fillMaxWidth(), label = { Text("RSSNR / SINR（可选）") }, singleLine = true) }
                    item {
                        Row(verticalAlignment = androidx.compose.ui.Alignment.CenterVertically) {
                            Checkbox(checked = registered, onCheckedChange = { registered = it })
                            Text("当前注册小区")
                        }
                    }
                    validationError?.let { message -> item { Text(message, color = MaterialTheme.colorScheme.error) } }
                }
            }
        },
        confirmButton = {
            TextButton({
                runCatching {
                    val mncText = mnc.trim()
                    require(mncText.isNotEmpty() && mncText.all(Char::isDigit)) { "MNC 必须是数字" }
                    require(mncDigits == null || mncText.length == mncDigits) {
                        "MNC 必须是 ${mncDigits} 位数字"
                    }
                    CellTower(
                        type = type,
                        mcc = mcc.toInt(),
                        mnc = mncText.toInt(),
                        areaCode = areaCode.toInt(),
                        cellId = cellId.toLong(),
                        pci = pci.trim().takeIf(String::isNotEmpty)?.toInt(),
                        arfcn = arfcn.trim().takeIf(String::isNotEmpty)?.toInt(),
                        rsrp = rsrp.toInt(),
                        rsrq = rsrq.trim().takeIf(String::isNotEmpty)?.toInt(),
                        rssnr = rssnr.trim().takeIf(String::isNotEmpty)?.toInt(),
                        registered = registered,
                        mncDigits = mncDigits,
                        operatorName = operatorName.trim().takeIf(String::isNotEmpty),
                    )
                }.mapCatching { onSave(it) }.onFailure {
                    val message = it.message ?: "蜂窝小区字段无效"
                    validationError = message
                }
            }) { Text("保存小区") }
        },
        dismissButton = { TextButton(onDismiss) { Text("取消") } },
    )
}
```

```kt
package com.system.location.service.ui.environment

import androidx.compose.foundation.layout.*
import androidx.compose.foundation.lazy.LazyColumn
import androidx.compose.foundation.lazy.items
import androidx.compose.material3.*
import androidx.compose.runtime.*
import androidx.compose.runtime.saveable.rememberSaveable
import androidx.compose.ui.Modifier
import androidx.compose.ui.res.painterResource
import androidx.compose.ui.unit.dp
import com.system.location.service.R
import com.system.location.service.designsystem.components.PortalActionRow
import com.system.location.service.designsystem.components.PortalSettingGroup

internal data class EnvironmentLibraryState(
    val names: List<String> = emptyList(),
    val loading: Boolean = true,
    val error: String? = null,
)


@Composable
internal fun EnvironmentLibraryScreen(
    state: EnvironmentLibraryState,
    onRetry: () -> Unit,
    onExport: (String) -> Unit,
    onReplay: (String) -> Unit,
    onDelete: (String) -> Unit,
    onRename: (String, String) -> Unit,
    onEditProfile: (String) -> Unit,
    onCreate: () -> Unit,
    onCapture: () -> Unit,
    onImport: () -> Unit,
    capture: EnvironmentCaptureState,
    onCancelCapture: () -> Unit,
    replayStatus: String? = null,
) {
    var query by rememberSaveable { mutableStateOf("") }
    var action by rememberSaveable { mutableStateOf<String?>(null) }
    var deleting by rememberSaveable { mutableStateOf<String?>(null) }
    var renaming by rememberSaveable { mutableStateOf<String?>(null) }
    var nameInput by rememberSaveable { mutableStateOf("") }
    val visible = remember(state.names, query) { state.names.filter { it.contains(query, true) } }
    Surface(Modifier.fillMaxSize(), color = MaterialTheme.colorScheme.background) {
        Column(Modifier.fillMaxSize().padding(horizontal = 20.dp),
            verticalArrangement = Arrangement.spacedBy(12.dp)) {
            EnvironmentCreationActions(onCreate, onCapture, onImport, capture, onCancelCapture)
            replayStatus?.let { Text(it, style = MaterialTheme.typography.bodySmall, color = MaterialTheme.colorScheme.primary) }
            OutlinedTextField(query, { query = it }, label = { Text("搜索已保存环境") },
                singleLine = true, modifier = Modifier.fillMaxWidth())
            Text(when {
                state.loading -> "正在读取环境列表"
                state.error != null -> "列表读取失败"
                else -> "${state.names.size} 个环境 · 选择后可回放、导出、重命名或删除"
            },
                style = MaterialTheme.typography.bodySmall, color = MaterialTheme.colorScheme.onSurfaceVariant)
            LazyColumn(Modifier.weight(1f).fillMaxWidth(), contentPadding = PaddingValues(bottom = 24.dp),
                verticalArrangement = Arrangement.spacedBy(8.dp)) {
                when {
                    state.loading -> item { LinearProgressIndicator(Modifier.fillMaxWidth()) }
                    state.error != null -> item {
                        Text(state.error, color = MaterialTheme.colorScheme.error)
                        TextButton(onRetry) { Text("重新加载") }
                    }
                    state.names.isEmpty() -> item {
                        Icon(painterResource(R.drawable.ic_portal_info), contentDescription = null,
                            tint = MaterialTheme.colorScheme.onSurfaceVariant, modifier = Modifier.size(24.dp))
                        Text("还没有保存环境")
                        Text("手动新建、采集当前环境，或从文件导入。", style = MaterialTheme.typography.bodyMedium)
                    }
                    visible.isEmpty() -> item {
                        Icon(painterResource(R.drawable.ic_portal_info), contentDescription = null,
                            tint = MaterialTheme.colorScheme.onSurfaceVariant, modifier = Modifier.size(24.dp))
                        Text("没有符合条件的环境")
                    }
                    else -> items(visible, key = { it }) { name ->
                        PortalActionRow(name, onClick = { action = name })
                    }
                }
            }
        }
    }
    action?.let { name ->
        AlertDialog(onDismissRequest = { action = null }, title = { Text(name) }, text = {
            PortalSettingGroup("环境操作", 5) { index, modifier ->
                when (index) {
                    0 -> PortalActionRow("设置为回放环境", onClick = { action = null; onReplay(name) }, modifier = modifier)
                    1 -> PortalActionRow("导出环境 JSON", onClick = { action = null; onExport(name) }, modifier = modifier)
                    2 -> PortalActionRow("编辑环境", onClick = { action = null; onEditProfile(name) }, modifier = modifier)
                    3 -> PortalActionRow("重命名", onClick = { action = null; renaming = name; nameInput = name }, modifier = modifier)
                    4 -> PortalActionRow("删除", onClick = { action = null; deleting = name }, modifier = modifier,
                        leadingContent = {
                            Icon(painterResource(R.drawable.ic_portal_delete), contentDescription = null,
                                tint = MaterialTheme.colorScheme.error, modifier = Modifier.size(24.dp))
                        })
                }
            }
        }, confirmButton = { TextButton({ action = null }) { Text("取消") } })
    }
    deleting?.let { name ->
        AlertDialog(onDismissRequest = { deleting = null }, title = { Text("删除环境？") },
            text = { Text("将删除“$name”，此操作无法撤销。已设置的回放配置会保留。") },
            confirmButton = { TextButton({ deleting = null; onDelete(name) },
                colors = ButtonDefaults.textButtonColors(contentColor = MaterialTheme.colorScheme.error)) { Text("确认删除") } },
            dismissButton = { TextButton({ deleting = null }) { Text("取消") } })
    }
    renaming?.let { name ->
        AlertDialog(onDismissRequest = { renaming = null }, title = { Text("重命名环境") }, text = {
            OutlinedTextField(nameInput, { nameInput = it }, singleLine = true, label = { Text("环境名称") },
                supportingText = { Text("最多 64 个字母、数字或 . _ -；其他字符将替换为下划线") })
        }, confirmButton = { TextButton({ renaming = null; onRename(name, nameInput.trim()) },
            enabled = nameInput.isNotBlank() && nameInput.trim() != name) { Text("保存") } },
            dismissButton = { TextButton({ renaming = null }) { Text("取消") } })
    }
}
```

`app/src/main/java/com/system/location/service/ui/gnss/GnssCaptureCard.kt`:

```kt
package com.system.location.service.ui.gnss

import android.Manifest
import android.content.pm.PackageManager
import androidx.activity.compose.rememberLauncherForActivityResult
import androidx.activity.result.contract.ActivityResultContracts
import androidx.compose.foundation.layout.Arrangement
import androidx.compose.foundation.layout.Column
import androidx.compose.foundation.layout.fillMaxWidth
import androidx.compose.material3.Button
import androidx.compose.material3.MaterialTheme
import androidx.compose.material3.Text
import androidx.compose.runtime.Composable
import androidx.compose.runtime.getValue
import androidx.compose.runtime.remember
import androidx.compose.ui.Modifier
import androidx.compose.ui.platform.LocalContext
import androidx.lifecycle.compose.collectAsStateWithLifecycle
import com.system.location.service.designsystem.components.PortalCard
import com.system.location.service.designsystem.components.PortalSectionTitle
import com.system.location.service.designsystem.theme.PortalSpacing
import com.system.location.service.ui.viewmodel.GnssCaptureViewModel
import com.system.location.service.ui.preferenceRevision
import com.system.location.service.ext.minSatelliteCount
import java.util.Locale

@Composable
internal fun GnssCaptureCard(model: GnssCaptureViewModel, simulationActive: Boolean) {
    val state by model.state.collectAsStateWithLifecycle()
    val context = LocalContext.current
    val revision = preferenceRevision()
    val minimumSatellites = remember(context, revision) { context.minSatelliteCount }
    val permission = rememberLauncherForActivityResult(ActivityResultContracts.RequestMultiplePermissions()) { granted ->
        if (granted[Manifest.permission.ACCESS_FINE_LOCATION] == true) model.capture()
    }
    PortalCard {
        Column(verticalArrangement = Arrangement.spacedBy(PortalSpacing.sm)) {
            PortalSectionTitle("卫星采集")
            Text("停止模拟后，在室外采集 60 秒。记录保存在本机，可在上方选择回放。",
                style = MaterialTheme.typography.bodySmall)
            state.profile?.let { profile ->
                Text("${profile.deviceModel} · ${profile.frameCount} 帧 · ${profile.totalSatelliteSamples} 个卫星样本",
                    style = MaterialTheme.typography.bodyMedium)
                Text(profile.constellations.joinToString("\n") { item ->
                    String.format(Locale.getDefault(), "%s：平均 %.1f 颗，占比 %.1f%%，在用 %.1f%%",
                        item.constellation.name, item.meanSatellitesPerFrame, item.ratio * 100, item.usedRatio * 100)
                }, style = MaterialTheme.typography.bodySmall)
            }
            GnssCaptureStatus(model, minimumSatellites)
            if (state.collecting) Text("正在采集：${state.frames} 帧", style = MaterialTheme.typography.bodyMedium)
            Button(
                onClick = {
                    if (state.collecting) model.cancel()
                    else if (context.checkSelfPermission(Manifest.permission.ACCESS_FINE_LOCATION) == PackageManager.PERMISSION_GRANTED) model.capture()
                    else permission.launch(arrayOf(Manifest.permission.ACCESS_COARSE_LOCATION, Manifest.permission.ACCESS_FINE_LOCATION))
                },
                enabled = !state.loading && (state.collecting || !simulationActive),
                modifier = Modifier.fillMaxWidth(),
            ) { Text(if (state.collecting) "取消采集" else "采集真实卫星（60 秒）") }
            state.message?.let { Text(it, style = MaterialTheme.typography.bodySmall) }
        }
    }
}
```

`app/src/main/java/com/system/location/service/ui/gnss/GnssCaptureStatus.kt`:

```kt
package com.system.location.service.ui.gnss

import androidx.compose.foundation.layout.Column
import androidx.compose.material3.MaterialTheme
import androidx.compose.material3.Text
import androidx.compose.runtime.Composable
import androidx.compose.runtime.getValue
import androidx.compose.runtime.remember
import androidx.lifecycle.compose.collectAsStateWithLifecycle
import com.system.location.service.core.gnss.GnssCapturePlaybackState
import com.system.location.service.core.gnss.ReceiverGnssSource
import com.system.location.service.ui.viewmodel.GnssCaptureViewModel

/** The preview is local evidence, not a claim about a third-party receiver's current callbacks. */
@Composable
internal fun GnssCaptureStatus(model: GnssCaptureViewModel, minimumSatellites: Int) {
    val flow = remember(model, minimumSatellites) { model.preview(minimumSatellites) }
    val preview by flow.collectAsStateWithLifecycle(initialValue = null)
    Column {
        val current = preview
        if (current == null) {
            Text("正在读取实测回放画像…", style = MaterialTheme.typography.bodySmall)
        } else when (current.state) {
            GnssCapturePlaybackState.WAITING_FOR_CAPTURE -> Text("尚无实测回放画像；自动和自主模式无需本机采集。",
                style = MaterialTheme.typography.bodySmall)
            GnssCapturePlaybackState.INVALID_CAPTURE -> {
                Text("实测回放画像不可用；自动和自主模式可继续使用轨道资源或虚拟天空。", style = MaterialTheme.typography.bodySmall,
                    color = MaterialTheme.colorScheme.error)
                current.issues.forEach { Text(it, style = MaterialTheme.typography.bodySmall) }
            }
            GnssCapturePlaybackState.READY -> current.frame?.let { frame ->
                val sourceLabel = when (frame.source) {
                    ReceiverGnssSource.STATISTICAL_REPLAY -> "统计回放"
                    ReceiverGnssSource.BROADCAST_EPHEMERIS -> "广播星历几何"
                    ReceiverGnssSource.HYBRID_BROADCAST_REPLAY -> "广播星历几何 + 统计回放"
                    ReceiverGnssSource.AUTONOMOUS -> "自主天空仿真"
                }
                Text("实测回放参考（$sourceLabel，采集地点）：有效池 ${frame.availableSatelliteCapacity} 颗，可见 ${frame.satellites.size} 颗；不代表模拟地点的当前天空。",
                    style = MaterialTheme.typography.bodySmall)
                Text(if (minimumSatellites == 0) {
                    if (frame.source == ReceiverGnssSource.STATISTICAL_REPLAY) "回放数量：按实测分布生成。"
                    else "回放数量：按采集证据和当前可用几何生成。"
                }
                    else "回放参考下限 $minimumSatellites 颗${if (frame.satellites.size >= minimumSatellites) "，已满足。" else "，此实测池无法满足；自主模式可另选数量保证策略。"}",
                    style = MaterialTheme.typography.bodySmall,
                    color = if (frame.satellites.size < minimumSatellites) MaterialTheme.colorScheme.error
                        else MaterialTheme.colorScheme.onSurfaceVariant)
                frame.diagnostics.forEach { Text(it, style = MaterialTheme.typography.bodySmall) }
            }
        }
    }
}
```

```kt
package com.system.location.service.ui.gnss

/**
 * Compose replacement for the satellite tab. The Radar View remains a custom Android View and is
 * hosted through AndroidView; all surrounding content and controls are Compose.
 */
class GnssComposeFragment : Fragment() {
    private val replayModel by activityViewModels<com.system.location.service.ui.viewmodel.QuickReplayViewModel>()
    private val model by viewModels<GnssViewModel>()
    private val captureModel by viewModels<com.system.location.service.ui.viewmodel.GnssCaptureViewModel>()
    private val skyPreviewModel by viewModels<com.system.location.service.ui.viewmodel.GnssSkyPreviewViewModel>()
    override fun onCreateView(
        inflater: LayoutInflater,
        container: ViewGroup?,
        savedInstanceState: Bundle?,
    ): View = ComposeView(requireContext()).apply {
        setViewCompositionStrategy(ViewCompositionStrategy.DisposeOnViewTreeLifecycleDestroyed)
        setContent {
            PortalTheme {
                GnssScreen(model, captureModel, skyPreviewModel, replayModel)
            }
        }
    }

@Composable
private fun GnssScreen(model: GnssViewModel, captureModel: com.system.location.service.ui.viewmodel.GnssCaptureViewModel,
    skyPreviewModel: com.system.location.service.ui.viewmodel.GnssSkyPreviewViewModel,
    replayModel: com.system.location.service.ui.viewmodel.QuickReplayViewModel) {
    val context = LocalContext.current
    val runtime by ScenarioRuntime.state.collectAsStateWithLifecycle()
    val locationManager = remember(context) { context.getSystemService(Context.LOCATION_SERVICE) as? LocationManager }
    var satellites by remember { mutableStateOf<List<SatelliteData>>(emptyList()) }
    var observationMessage by remember { mutableStateOf("等待卫星信号，可移至室外重试") }
    var permissionRevision by remember { mutableIntStateOf(0) }
    val permissionLauncher = rememberLauncherForActivityResult(ActivityResultContracts.RequestMultiplePermissions()) {
        permissionRevision++
    }
    val control by model.state.collectAsStateWithLifecycle()
    val replay by replayModel.state.collectAsStateWithLifecycle()
    LaunchedEffect(replay.busy, runtime.backend, runtime.phase) {
        if (!replay.busy) model.refresh()
    }
    val lifecycle = LocalLifecycleOwner.current.lifecycle
    val lifecycleState by lifecycle.currentStateFlow.collectAsState()
    val hookReady = runtime.backend != BackendType.MOCK_PROVIDER && runtime.isActive

    LaunchedEffect(locationManager, lifecycle, model, permissionRevision, runtime.isActive) {
        lifecycle.repeatOnLifecycle(Lifecycle.State.RESUMED) {
            coroutineScope {
                launch {
                    ScenarioRuntime.state.map { it.backend to it.phase }.distinctUntilChanged().collect { model.refresh() }
                }
                val manager = locationManager ?: run {
                    observationMessage = "此设备没有可用的定位服务"
                    return@coroutineScope
                }
                var listening = true
                val callback = object : GnssStatus.Callback() {
                    override fun onStarted() {
                        if (listening) observationMessage = "等待卫星信号，可移至室外重试"
                    }
                    override fun onStopped() {
                        if (listening) {
                            satellites = emptyList()
                            observationMessage = "GNSS 观测已停止，等待系统恢复"
                        }
                    }

                    override fun onSatelliteStatusChanged(status: GnssStatus) {
                        if (!listening) return
                        val list = buildList {
                            for (index in 0 until status.satelliteCount) {
                                val cn0 = status.getCn0DbHz(index)
                                val elevation = status.getElevationDegrees(index)
                                val azimuth = status.getAzimuthDegrees(index)
                                // CN0=0 is Android's placeholder for an unmeasured row.
                                if (!cn0.isFinite() || cn0 <= 0f || !elevation.isFinite() ||
                                    elevation !in 0f..90f || !azimuth.isFinite() || azimuth !in 0f..<360f
                                ) continue
                                add(
                                    SatelliteData(
                                        prn = status.getSvid(index),
                                        constellationType = status.getConstellationType(index),
                                        snr = cn0,
                                        elevation = elevation,
                                        azimuth = azimuth,
                                        hasAlmanac = status.hasAlmanacData(index),
                                        hasEphemeris = status.hasEphemerisData(index),
                                        usedInFix = status.usedInFix(index),
                                    ),
                                )
                            }
                        }
                        satellites = displaySpacecraft(list)
                    }
                }
                val locationListener = object : LocationListener {
                    override fun onLocationChanged(location: Location) = Unit
                    override fun onProviderDisabled(provider: String) {
                        if (listening) { satellites = emptyList(); observationMessage = "系统定位已关闭，请开启后查看真实卫星" }
                    }
                    override fun onProviderEnabled(provider: String) {
                        if (listening) observationMessage = "等待卫星信号，可移至室外重试"
                    }
                }
                if (androidx.core.content.ContextCompat.checkSelfPermission(context, Manifest.permission.ACCESS_FINE_LOCATION) == PackageManager.PERMISSION_GRANTED) {
                    try {
                        check(manager.registerGnssStatusCallback(context.mainExecutor, callback)) { "系统未接受卫星状态监听" }
                        if (!runtime.isActive) {
                            // Status callbacks alone do not turn on the GNSS receiver. Keep it active
                            // only while this tab is resumed and no simulated scene is running.
                            check(manager.allProviders.contains(LocationManager.GPS_PROVIDER)) { "此设备不支持 GPS 卫星观测" }
                            observationMessage = if (manager.isProviderEnabled(LocationManager.GPS_PROVIDER))
                                "等待卫星信号，可移至室外重试" else "系统定位已关闭，请开启后查看真实卫星"
                            manager.requestLocationUpdates(LocationManager.GPS_PROVIDER, 1_000L, 0f,
                                context.mainExecutor, locationListener)
                        }
                    } catch (_: SecurityException) {
                        satellites = emptyList()
                        observationMessage = "需要精确位置权限才能读取真实卫星"
                    } catch (error: Exception) {
                        satellites = emptyList()
                        observationMessage = error.message ?: "卫星观测启动失败，请稍后重试"
                    }
                } else {
                    satellites = emptyList()
                    observationMessage = "需要精确位置权限才能读取真实卫星"
                }
                try { awaitCancellation() }
                finally {
                    listening = false
                    runCatching { manager.unregisterGnssStatusCallback(callback) }
                    runCatching { manager.removeUpdates(locationListener) }
                    satellites = emptyList()
                }
            }
        }
    }


    val inView = satellites.size
    val inUse = satellites.count { it.usedInFix }
    val averageCn0 = satellites.filter { it.usedInFix && it.snr > 0f }.map { it.snr }.average()
        .takeIf { it.isFinite() }
    val systems = satellites.groupingBy { it.constellationType }.eachCount()
        .toSortedMap().map { (type, count) ->
            val name = when (type) {
                GnssStatus.CONSTELLATION_GPS -> "GPS"
                GnssStatus.CONSTELLATION_GLONASS -> "GLONASS"
                GnssStatus.CONSTELLATION_BEIDOU -> "北斗"
                GnssStatus.CONSTELLATION_GALILEO -> "Galileo"
                GnssStatus.CONSTELLATION_QZSS -> "QZSS"
                GnssStatus.CONSTELLATION_SBAS -> "SBAS"
                GnssStatus.CONSTELLATION_IRNSS -> "NavIC"
                else -> "未知系统 ($type)"
            }
            "$name：$count"
        }.joinToString("   ").ifEmpty { "暂无观测" }


    Surface(Modifier.fillMaxSize(), color = MaterialTheme.colorScheme.background) {
        LazyColumn(
            modifier = Modifier.fillMaxSize(),
            contentPadding = PaddingValues(PortalSpacing.xl, PortalSpacing.xl, PortalSpacing.xl, 40.dp),
            verticalArrangement = Arrangement.spacedBy(PortalSpacing.lg),
        ) {
            item(key = "quick-replay") {
                com.system.location.service.ui.mock.QuickReplayCard(replayModel, environment = false)
            }
            item(key = "sky") {
                PortalCard(modifier = Modifier.animateContentSize()) {
                    Row(verticalAlignment = Alignment.CenterVertically, horizontalArrangement = Arrangement.spacedBy(12.dp)) {
                        Icon(painterResource(R.drawable.baseline_satellite_alt_24), null, tint = MaterialTheme.colorScheme.primary)
                        PortalSectionTitle("星图信息")
                    }
                    AndroidView(
                        factory = { SatelliteRadarView(it, null) },
                        update = { it.setSatellites(satellites); it.setActive(lifecycleState.isAtLeast(Lifecycle.State.RESUMED)) },
                        onReset = null,
                        onRelease = { it.setActive(false) },
                        modifier = Modifier.align(Alignment.CenterHorizontally).widthIn(max = 280.dp).fillMaxWidth().aspectRatio(1f),
                    )
                    AnimatedVisibility(visible = satellites.isEmpty()) {
                        Text(
                            observationMessage,
                            modifier = Modifier.fillMaxWidth().padding(bottom = 16.dp),
                            style = MaterialTheme.typography.bodyMedium,
                            color = MaterialTheme.colorScheme.onSurfaceVariant,
                            textAlign = androidx.compose.ui.text.style.TextAlign.Center,
                        )
                    }
                    if (satellites.isEmpty()) {
                        if (androidx.core.content.ContextCompat.checkSelfPermission(context, Manifest.permission.ACCESS_FINE_LOCATION) != PackageManager.PERMISSION_GRANTED) {
                            TextButton({ permissionLauncher.launch(arrayOf(Manifest.permission.ACCESS_COARSE_LOCATION, Manifest.permission.ACCESS_FINE_LOCATION)) }) {
                                Text("授予精确位置权限")
                            }
                        } else TextButton({ permissionRevision++ }) { Text("重新观测") }
                    }
                    Row(Modifier.fillMaxWidth(), horizontalArrangement = Arrangement.spacedBy(12.dp)) {
                        GnssMetric("可用卫星", "$inView 颗", Modifier.weight(1f))
                        GnssMetric("在用卫星", "$inUse 颗", Modifier.weight(1f))
                    }
                    Spacer(Modifier.height(PortalSpacing.md))
                    GnssMetric("平均信号强度", averageCn0?.let { "%.1f dB-Hz".format(it) } ?: "— dB-Hz", Modifier.fillMaxWidth())
                    Spacer(Modifier.height(PortalSpacing.lg))
                    HorizontalDivider(color = MaterialTheme.colorScheme.outlineVariant)
                    Spacer(Modifier.height(PortalSpacing.md))
                    Text("导航系统", style = MaterialTheme.typography.labelMedium, color = MaterialTheme.colorScheme.onSurfaceVariant)
                    Spacer(Modifier.height(PortalSpacing.xs))
                    Text(systems, style = MaterialTheme.typography.bodyMedium)
                }
            }
            item(key = "target-sky") { GnssSkyPreviewCard(skyPreviewModel) }
            item(key = "capture") { GnssCaptureCard(captureModel, runtime.isActive) }
            item(key = "control") {
                PortalCard(modifier = Modifier.animateContentSize()) {
                    PortalSectionTitle("GNSS 控制")
                    Spacer(Modifier.height(PortalSpacing.sm))
                    Button(
                        onClick = model::toggle,
                        enabled = hookReady && !control.busy,
                        modifier = Modifier.fillMaxWidth().heightIn(min = 48.dp),
                    ) {
                        AnimatedContent(targetState = control.running, label = "gnssControl") { running ->
                            Row(verticalAlignment = Alignment.CenterVertically) {
                                Icon(painterResource(if (running) R.drawable.baseline_stop_24 else R.drawable.rounded_play_arrow_24), null, Modifier.size(20.dp))
                                Spacer(Modifier.width(8.dp))
                                Text(if (running) "停止模拟" else "开始模拟")
                            }
                        }
                    }
                    control.message?.let { message ->
                        Text(message, style = MaterialTheme.typography.bodySmall, modifier = Modifier.padding(top = 8.dp))
                    }
                    AnimatedVisibility(visible = !hookReady) {
                        Text(
                            "需要先运行 Xposed/Native 场景。",
                            modifier = Modifier.padding(top = PortalSpacing.sm),
                            style = MaterialTheme.typography.bodySmall,
                            color = MaterialTheme.colorScheme.onSurfaceVariant,
                        )
                    }
                }
            }
            item(key = "settings") {
                PortalCard {
                    PortalSectionTitle("功能设置")
                    PortalSwitchRow(
                        title = "允许地理围栏请求",
                        checked = control.geofence,
                        onCheckedChange = if (control.busy) null else ({ enabled: Boolean ->
                            model.setPreference(GnssSetting.GEOFENCE, enabled)
                        }),
                    )
                    PortalSwitchRow(
                        title = "允许地理编码查询",
                        subtitle = "按坐标或地名查询地址，不控制 Location 定位请求",
                        checked = control.fromLocation,
                        onCheckedChange = if (control.busy) null else ({ enabled: Boolean ->
                            model.setPreference(GnssSetting.FROM_LOCATION, enabled)
                        }),
                    )
                    PortalSwitchRow(
                        title = "启用 NMEA 模块",
                        checked = control.nmea,
                        onCheckedChange = if (control.busy) null else ({ enabled: Boolean ->
                            model.setPreference(GnssSetting.NMEA, enabled)
                        }),
                    )
                }
            }
            item(key = "requirements") {
                Text(
                    "模拟定位期间不转发真实 GNSS 测量、导航电文和天线数据；尚无自洽合成数据的接口会报告不支持。",
                    style = MaterialTheme.typography.bodySmall,
                    color = MaterialTheme.colorScheme.onSurfaceVariant,
                )
            }
        }
    }
}

@Composable
private fun GnssMetric(label: String, value: String, modifier: Modifier = Modifier) {
    Surface(modifier = modifier, shape = MaterialTheme.shapes.small, color = MaterialTheme.colorScheme.surfaceVariant) {
        Column(Modifier.padding(12.dp), verticalArrangement = Arrangement.spacedBy(4.dp)) {
            Text(label, style = MaterialTheme.typography.labelMedium, color = MaterialTheme.colorScheme.onSurfaceVariant)
            Text(value, style = MaterialTheme.typography.titleLarge)
        }
    }
}
```

`app/src/main/java/com/system/location/service/ui/gnss/GnssPolicyControls.kt`:

```kt
package com.system.location.service.ui.gnss

import androidx.compose.material3.AlertDialog
import androidx.compose.material3.Text
import androidx.compose.material3.TextButton
import androidx.compose.material3.RadioButton
import androidx.compose.foundation.layout.Row
import androidx.compose.foundation.layout.fillMaxWidth
import androidx.compose.foundation.layout.padding
import androidx.compose.foundation.selection.selectable
import androidx.compose.ui.Modifier
import androidx.compose.ui.Alignment
import androidx.compose.ui.semantics.Role
import androidx.compose.ui.unit.dp
import androidx.compose.runtime.saveable.rememberSaveable
import com.system.location.service.designsystem.components.PortalSettingGroup
import androidx.compose.runtime.*
import androidx.compose.ui.platform.LocalContext
import androidx.core.content.edit
import com.system.location.service.core.gnss.GnssMinimumPolicy
import com.system.location.service.core.gnss.GnssSimulationEnvironment
import com.system.location.service.core.gnss.GnssSimulationMode
import com.system.location.service.core.gnss.GnssSimulationPolicy
import com.system.location.service.designsystem.components.PortalActionRow
import com.system.location.service.ext.sharedPrefs
import com.system.location.service.ui.preferenceRevision

/** Uses the same persisted enum names as the authenticated runtime configuration. */
@Composable
internal fun GnssPolicyControls(enabled: Boolean, onChanged: () -> Unit) {
    val context = LocalContext.current
    val revision = preferenceRevision()
    val preferences = remember(context, revision) { context.sharedPrefs.all }
    var selection by rememberSaveable { mutableStateOf<String?>(null) }
    val modes = listOf(
        GnssSimulationMode.AUTO.name to "自动：目标天空 + 可选实测信号校准",
        GnssSimulationMode.AUTONOMOUS.name to "自主：目标天空，不使用本机采集校准",
        GnssSimulationMode.REPLAY.name to "实测回放：复现采集地点与时段",
        GnssSimulationMode.OFF.name to "关闭：保留真实卫星回调",
    )
    val quantities = listOf(
        GnssMinimumPolicy.PHYSICAL_FIRST.name to "物理优先：不足时报告实际数量",
        GnssMinimumPolicy.GUARANTEE_QUANTITY.name to "数量保证：在输出容量内用虚拟卫星补足",
    )
    val environments = listOf(
        GnssSimulationEnvironment.OPEN_SKY.name to "开阔天空",
        GnssSimulationEnvironment.URBAN.name to "城市遮挡",
        GnssSimulationEnvironment.INDOOR.name to "室内衰减",
    )
    val settings = listOf(
        Triple("gnssSimulationMode", "卫星生成模式", modes),
        Triple("gnssMinimumPolicy", "卫星数量策略", quantities),
        Triple("gnssSimulationEnvironment", "模拟接收环境", environments),
    )
    val defaultPolicy = GnssSimulationPolicy()
    val defaults = mapOf("gnssSimulationMode" to defaultPolicy.mode.name,
        "gnssMinimumPolicy" to defaultPolicy.minimumPolicy.name,
        "gnssSimulationEnvironment" to defaultPolicy.environment.name)
    PortalSettingGroup("卫星生成策略", settings.size) { index, rowModifier ->
        val (key, title, options) = settings[index]
        val value = preferences[key] as? String ?: defaults.getValue(key)
        val label = options.firstOrNull { it.first == value }?.second ?: "未知设置：$value"
        PortalActionRow(title, label, onClick = { selection = key }, enabled = enabled, modifier = rowModifier,
            status = "运行中尝试立即应用")
    }
    if (selection != null) {
        val (key, title, options) = settings.single { it.first == selection }
        AlertDialog(
            onDismissRequest = { selection = null },
            title = { Text(title) },
            text = {
                androidx.compose.foundation.layout.Column {
                    options.forEach { (value, label) ->
                        val selectedValue = preferences[key] as? String ?: defaults.getValue(key)
                        Row(
                            modifier = Modifier.fillMaxWidth().selectable(
                                selected = value == selectedValue, enabled = enabled, role = Role.RadioButton,
                                onClick = {
                                    context.sharedPrefs.edit { putString(key, value) }
                                    selection = null
                                    onChanged()
                                },
                            ).padding(vertical = 8.dp),
                            verticalAlignment = Alignment.CenterVertically,
                        ) {
                            RadioButton(selected = value == selectedValue, onClick = null, enabled = enabled)
                            Text(label, Modifier.padding(start = 8.dp))
                        }
                    }
                    if (key == "gnssSimulationEnvironment") Text("模拟环境与手机实际摆放环境相互独立；室内场景可能没有可用定位解。")
                    if (key == "gnssMinimumPolicy") Text("下限针对可见数量；跟踪数、参与定位数和 DOP 仍独立计算。实测回放不补入其他天空。")
                    if (key == "gnssSimulationMode") Text("自动和自主模式均无需采集。自动模式可迁移有效画像的信号特征，不搬用采集地天空，也不代表模拟地点的真实接收情况。")
                }
            },
            confirmButton = {},
            dismissButton = { TextButton(onClick = { selection = null }) { Text("取消") } },
        )
    }
```

`app/src/main/java/com/system/location/service/ui/gnss/GnssSatelliteDisplay.kt`:

```kt
package com.system.location.service.ui.gnss

import com.system.location.service.android.widget.SatelliteData

/** One radar point and one count per spacecraft; zero-CN0 rows stay in raw capture only. */
internal fun displaySpacecraft(signals: List<SatelliteData>): List<SatelliteData> = signals
    .filter { it.snr > 0f && it.snr <= 63f && it.elevation in 0f..90f && it.azimuth in 0f..<360f }
    .groupBy { it.constellationType to it.prn }
    .values.map { candidates ->
        // Keep an entire measured row, prioritizing an in-use band. Stable tie-breaks
        // prevent callback array ordering from moving the radar point between bands.
        candidates.minWith(compareBy<SatelliteData>({ !it.usedInFix }, { -it.snr },
            { it.elevation }, { it.azimuth }, { !it.hasEphemeris }, { !it.hasAlmanac }))
    }
    .sortedWith(compareBy({ it.constellationType }, { it.prn }))
```

`app/src/main/java/com/system/location/service/ui/home/DebouncedSearch.kt`:

```kt
package com.system.location.service.ui.home

import com.system.location.service.ui.CallbackScheduler

internal class DebouncedSearch<T>(
    private val scheduler: CallbackScheduler,
    private val query: () -> String,
    private val viewActive: () -> Boolean,
    private val request: (String, (T) -> Unit) -> Unit,
    private val render: (T) -> Unit,
) {
    private var pending: Runnable? = null
    private var generation = 0L

    private var changingSelection = false
    private var destroyed = false

    fun destroy() {
        destroyed = true
        invalidate()
    }

    fun submit() = schedule(immediate = true)

    fun select(updateText: () -> Unit) {
        invalidate()
        changingSelection = true
        try { updateText() } finally { changingSelection = false }
    }

    fun textChanged() {
        if (!changingSelection) schedule(immediate = false)
    }

    private fun invalidate() {
        ++generation
        pending?.let(scheduler::remove)
        pending = null
    }

    private fun schedule(immediate: Boolean) {
        invalidate()
        if (destroyed) return
        val version = generation
        val text = query().trim()
        if (text.isEmpty()) return
        val callback = Runnable {
            if (!isCurrent(version, text)) return@Runnable
            pending = null
            request(text) { result ->
                if (isCurrent(version, text)) render(result)
            }
        }
        if (immediate) callback.run() else {
            pending = callback
            scheduler.post(300L, callback)
        }
    }

    private fun isCurrent(version: Long, text: String) =
        !destroyed && generation == version && viewActive() && query().trim() == text
}
```

`app/src/main/java/com/system/location/service/ui/home/HomeCameraPolicy.kt`:

```kt
package com.system.location.service.ui.home

/** Camera requests never select a simulation target. All positions are trusted WGS-84 fixes. */
internal class HomeCameraPolicy {
    data class Position(val latitude: Double, val longitude: Double)
    data class Move(val position: Position, val zoom: Float = 16.5f)

    private var pending = true
    private var position: Position? = null
    private var observedAt = 0L

    fun accept(
        latitude: Double,
        longitude: Double,
        ageMillis: Long,
        nowMillis: Long,
        isMock: Boolean,
        simulationActive: Boolean,
    ): Move? {
        if (isMock || simulationActive || ageMillis !in 0..MAX_FIX_AGE_MILLIS ||
            latitude !in -90.0..90.0 || longitude !in -180.0..180.0 ||
            latitude == 0.0 && longitude == 0.0) return null
        position = Position(latitude, longitude)
        observedAt = nowMillis - ageMillis
        return if (pending) Move(position!!).also { pending = false } else null
    }

    fun locate(nowMillis: Long): Move? {
        val current = position
        if (current != null && nowMillis - observedAt in 0..MAX_FIX_AGE_MILLIS) {
            pending = false
            return Move(current)
        }
        pending = true
        return null
    }

    fun userMovedCamera() { pending = false }

    companion object { const val MAX_FIX_AGE_MILLIS = 120_000L }
}
```

```kt
/** Compose home screen; the map remains an AndroidView and owns its SDK lifecycle. */
class HomeComposeFragment : Fragment() {

    private val mapModel by activityViewModels<AMapViewModel>()
    private val mockModel by activityViewModels<MockServiceViewModel>()
    private val targetState = kotlinx.coroutines.flow.MutableStateFlow(HomeTarget())
    private val libraryState = kotlinx.coroutines.flow.MutableStateFlow(HomeLibraryState())
    private var libraryLoad: Job? = null
    private var libraryRequest = 0L
    private var startInFlight = false
    private var selectionRevision = 0L
    private var restoredKind: String? = null
    private var restoredId: String? = null
    private var map: PortalMapView? = null
    private var targetMarker: com.system.location.service.maps.MapOverlay? = null

    private var systemLocation: LocationManager? = null

    private var providerReceiverRegistered = false

        override fun onReceive(context: Context?, intent: Intent?) {

        }

        if (hasLocationPermission()) locate() else showLocationIssue(HomeLocationIssue.PERMISSION)

    private val overlayPermission = registerForActivityResult(ActivityResultContracts.StartActivityForResult()) {

    override fun onCreate(savedInstanceState: Bundle?) {
        super.onCreate(savedInstanceState)
        restoredKind = savedInstanceState?.getString("home.target.kind")
        restoredId = savedInstanceState?.getString("home.target.id")
        if (restoredKind == "point" && restoredId == null && savedInstanceState != null) {
            val point = Wgs84(savedInstanceState.getDouble("home.target.lat"), savedInstanceState.getDouble("home.target.lon"))
            targetState.value = HomeTarget(HomeSelection.Point(point, savedInstanceState.getString("home.target.name")))
        }
    }

    override fun onViewCreated(view: View, savedInstanceState: Bundle?) {
        super.onViewCreated(view, savedInstanceState)
        viewLifecycleOwner.lifecycleScope.launch {
            viewLifecycleOwner.repeatOnLifecycle(Lifecycle.State.STARTED) {
                mockModel.runtimeState.collect { runtime ->
                    renderRuntimePosition()
                    if (runtime.isActive || startInFlight) {
                        stopRealLocation()
                        locationState.value = locationState.value.copy(loading = false, issue = null)
                    } else startRealLocation()
                }
            }
        }
    }

    override fun onCreateView(
        inflater: LayoutInflater,
        container: ViewGroup?,
        savedInstanceState: Bundle?,
    ): View = ComposeView(requireContext()).apply {
        setViewCompositionStrategy(ViewCompositionStrategy.DisposeOnViewTreeLifecycleDestroyed)
        setContent {
            PortalTheme {
                HomeScreen(
                    mockModel = mockModel,
                    replayModel = replayModel,
                    onManageReplay = { findNavController().navigate(R.id.nav_mock) },
                    targetFlow = targetState,
                    locationFlow = locationState,
                    libraryFlow = libraryState,
                    onLocate = ::locate,
                    onLocationRecovery = ::recoverLocation,
                    onBrowse = ::browseMap,
                    createMap = ::createMap,
                    onMenu = ::openDrawer,
                    onTarget = ::setTarget,
                    onSearch = ::search,
                    onSaveLocation = ::saveLocation,
                    onRocker = ::toggleRocker,
                    onOpenTargets = ::refreshLibrary,
                    onSelection = ::selectTarget,
                    onStart = ::startSelected,
                    onCreateRoute = { findNavController().navigate(R.id.nav_route_edit) },
                    onMapType = ::toggleMapType,
                )
            }
```
