```kt
    private fun createMap(context: Context): View {
        map?.let { existing ->
            if (existing.provider == context.mapProvider) {
                // The home Fragment survives on the back stack. Reattach its paused map rather
                // than synchronously initializing the vendor SDK on every return from settings.
                (existing.parent as? ViewGroup)?.removeView(existing)
                existing.satellite(context.satelliteMap)
                existing.onStart()
                existing.onResume()
                renderRuntimePosition()
                return existing
            }
            releaseMap()
        }
        val view = PortalMapView(context)
        cameraPolicy = HomeCameraPolicy()
        locationState.value = HomeLocationState()
        map = view
        view.onCreate(null)
        if (targetState.value.selection == null && restoredKind == null) mapModel.markedLoc?.let { point ->
            targetState.value = HomeTarget(HomeSelection.Point(Wgs84(point.first, point.second), mapModel.markName))
        }
        renderSelection(moveCamera = true)
        renderRuntimePosition()
        if (targetState.value.selection == null && mapModel.markedLoc == null) {
            mockModel.runtimeState.value.takeIf { it.isActive }?.sample?.let { sample ->
                cameraPolicy.userMovedCamera()
                view.move(CoordinateTransform.toGcj02(sample.coordinate), 16.5f)
                locationState.value = locationState.value.copy(mapVisible = true, loading = false)
            }
        }
        view.onClick { point ->
            val wgs = CoordinateTransform.toWgs84(point)
            setTarget(wgs.latitude to wgs.longitude, null)
        }
        view.onStart()
        view.onResume()
        view.post {
            if (map === view && lifecycle.currentState.isAtLeast(Lifecycle.State.STARTED)) startRealLocation()
        }
        return view
    }

    private fun openDrawer() {
        val activity = activity as? MainActivity ?: return
        activity.openDrawer()
    }

    private fun setTarget(wgs: Pair<Double, Double>, name: String?) {
        selectTarget(HomeSelection.Point(Wgs84(wgs.first, wgs.second), name))
        val revision = selectionRevision
        val map = map ?: return
        val gcj = CoordinateTransform.toGcj02(Wgs84(wgs.first, wgs.second))
        viewLifecycleOwner.lifecycleScope.launch {
            val address = withContext(Dispatchers.IO) {
                runCatching { MapServices(map.context.applicationContext, map.provider).address(gcj) }.getOrNull()
            }
            if (address != null && selectionRevision == revision) {
                mapModel.markName = address.title.ifBlank { address.address }
                targetState.value = targetState.value.copy(selection = HomeSelection.Point(Wgs84(wgs.first, wgs.second), mapModel.markName))
            }
        }
    }

    private fun selectTarget(selection: HomeSelection) {
        selectionRevision++
        restoredKind = null
        restoredId = null
        targetState.value = HomeTarget(selection, busy = startInFlight)
        renderSelection(moveCamera = true)
    }

    private fun renderSelection(moveCamera: Boolean = false) {
        val selected = targetState.value.selection
        routeLine?.remove()
        routeLine = null
        targetMarker?.remove()
        targetMarker = null
        val point = when (selected) {
            is HomeSelection.Point -> selected.coordinate
            is HomeSelection.Route -> selected.saved.route.points.first()
            null -> null
        }
        mapModel.markedLoc = (selected as? HomeSelection.Point)?.coordinate?.let { it.latitude to it.longitude }
        mapModel.markName = (selected as? HomeSelection.Point)?.name

        if (point == null) return
        cameraPolicy.userMovedCamera()
        locationState.value = locationState.value.copy(mapVisible = true)
        val map = map ?: return
        val gcj = CoordinateTransform.toGcj02(point)
        targetMarker = map.marker(gcj, targetState.value.name ?: "待确认位置",
            label = MapLocationBadge(map.context, false, "模拟目标"), anchorY = 44f / 64f)
        if (selected is HomeSelection.Route) {
            val geometry = selected.saved.route.points.map(CoordinateTransform::toGcj02)
            routeLine = map.line(geometry, Color.argb(200, 59, 130, 246), 12f)
            if (moveCamera) map.fit(geometry, (72 * resources.displayMetrics.density).toInt())
        } else if (moveCamera) map.move(gcj, 16.5f, animate = true)
    }

    private fun refreshLibrary() {
        val request = ++libraryRequest
        libraryLoad?.cancel()
        val revision = selectionRevision
        libraryState.value = libraryState.value.copy(busy = true, error = null)
        targetState.value = targetState.value.copy(busy = true)
        libraryLoad = viewLifecycleOwner.lifecycleScope.launch {
            try {
                val loaded = withContext(Dispatchers.IO) {
                    LibraryRepositories.ensureMigrated()
                    HomeLibraryState(
                        routes = LibraryRepositories.routes.list().sortedWith(compareByDescending<SavedRoute> { it.favorite }.thenBy { it.route.name }),
                        locations = LibraryRepositories.locations.list().sortedBy { it.name },
                    )
                }
                libraryState.value = loaded
                if (selectionRevision == revision) {
                    val old = targetState.value.selection
                    val selected = when (restoredKind) {
                        "route" -> loaded.routes.firstOrNull { it.route.id == restoredId }?.let(HomeSelection::Route)
                        "point" -> if (restoredId != null) loaded.locations.firstOrNull { it.id == restoredId }
                            ?.let { HomeSelection.Point(it.coordinate, it.name, it.id) } else old
                        else -> old?.refreshed(loaded.routes, loaded.locations)
                    }
                    val missing = selected == null && (old != null || restoredId != null)
                    restoredKind = null
                    restoredId = null
                    targetState.value = HomeTarget(selected, busy = startInFlight, message = if (missing) "已选目标已被删除，请重新选择" else null)
                    renderSelection(moveCamera = old != selected)
                }
            } catch (cancelled: kotlinx.coroutines.CancellationException) {
                throw cancelled
            } catch (error: Exception) {
                libraryState.value = libraryState.value.copy(busy = false, error = "资料库加载失败，请重试")
                if (selectionRevision == revision) targetState.value = targetState.value.copy(busy = startInFlight, message = "资料库加载失败，请重新选择或重试")
            } finally {
                if (libraryRequest == request && selectionRevision == revision) targetState.value = targetState.value.copy(busy = startInFlight)
            }
        }
    }

    private fun startSelected() {
        val selected = targetState.value.selection ?: return
        if (startInFlight || targetState.value.busy) return
        startInFlight = true
        stopRealLocation()
        val revision = selectionRevision
        targetState.value = targetState.value.copy(busy = true)
        viewLifecycleOwner.lifecycleScope.launch {
            try {
                val current = withContext(Dispatchers.IO) {
                    LibraryRepositories.ensureMigrated()
                    when (selected) {
                        is HomeSelection.Route -> LibraryRepositories.routes.get(selected.saved.route.id)?.let(HomeSelection::Route)
                        is HomeSelection.Point -> if (selected.savedId == null) selected else LibraryRepositories.locations.get(selected.savedId)
                            ?.let { HomeSelection.Point(it.coordinate, it.name, it.id) }
                    }
                }
                if (revision != selectionRevision) return@launch
                targetState.value = HomeTarget(current, busy = true,
                    message = if (current == null) "已选目标已被删除，请重新选择" else null)
                renderSelection()
                current?.let {
                    val started = it.start(
                        point = { point -> mockModel.startPoint(point.coordinate.latitude to point.coordinate.longitude, point.name ?: "目标位置") },
                        route = { route -> mockModel.startRoute(route.toHistorical()) },
                    )
                    if (!started) Toast.makeText(requireContext(), mockModel.failureMessage(), Toast.LENGTH_LONG).show()
                }
            } catch (cancelled: kotlinx.coroutines.CancellationException) {
                throw cancelled
            } catch (error: Exception) {
                if (revision == selectionRevision) targetState.value = targetState.value.copy(message = "启动失败，请重试")
            } finally {
                startInFlight = false
                targetState.value = targetState.value.copy(busy = libraryState.value.busy)
                if (!mockModel.runtimeState.value.isActive) startRealLocation()
            }
        }
    }

    private fun search(query: String, result: (List<PlaceSuggestion>) -> Unit) {
        if (query.isBlank()) return
        val map = map ?: return
        val appContext = requireContext().applicationContext
        viewLifecycleOwner.lifecycleScope.launch {
            val suggestions = try {
                withContext(Dispatchers.IO) { MapServices(appContext, map.provider).suggestions(query) }
            } catch (cancelled: kotlinx.coroutines.CancellationException) { throw cancelled }
            catch (_: Exception) { emptyList() }
            result(suggestions)
        }
    }

    private fun saveLocation(name: String, address: String, lat: Double, lon: Double) {
        lifecycleScope.launch {
            val result = mockModel.saveLocation(name, address, lat, lon).await()
            Toast.makeText(
                requireContext(),
                if (result.isSuccess) "已加入位置库" else "保存失败：${result.exceptionOrNull()?.message}",
                Toast.LENGTH_LONG,
            ).show()
        }
    }

    private fun toggleRocker() {
        if (!com.system.location.service.android.window.OverlayUtils.hasOverlayPermissions(requireContext())) {
            Toast.makeText(requireContext(), "请先授权悬浮窗权限", Toast.LENGTH_SHORT).show()
            runCatching {
                overlayPermission.launch(Intent(Settings.ACTION_MANAGE_OVERLAY_PERMISSION,
                    android.net.Uri.parse("package:${requireContext().packageName}")))
            }.onFailure {
                Toast.makeText(requireContext(), "无法打开设置，请在系统设置中允许 Portal 显示悬浮窗", Toast.LENGTH_LONG).show()
            }
        } else if (RockerOverlay.isVisible) {
            RockerOverlay.setEnabled(false)
        } else if (!RockerOverlay.setEnabled(true)) {
            Toast.makeText(requireContext(), "悬浮窗显示失败", Toast.LENGTH_SHORT).show()
        }
    }

    private fun toggleMapType(): Boolean {
        val map = map ?: return false
        val next = !requireContext().satelliteMap
        map.satellite(next)
        requireContext().satelliteMap = next
        return next
    }

    override fun onStart() {
        super.onStart()
        map?.onStart()
        if (!providerReceiverRegistered) {
            ContextCompat.registerReceiver(requireContext(), providerReceiver,
                IntentFilter(LocationManager.PROVIDERS_CHANGED_ACTION), ContextCompat.RECEIVER_EXPORTED)
            providerReceiverRegistered = true
        }
        startRealLocation()
        refreshLibrary()
    }

    override fun onResume() {
        super.onResume()
        map?.onResume()
        startRealLocation()
    }

    override fun onStop() {
        if (providerReceiverRegistered) {
            requireContext().unregisterReceiver(providerReceiver)
            providerReceiverRegistered = false
        }
        stopRealLocation()
        // A paused Fragment can still be visible in the exit or predictive-back transition.
        // Stop the SDK only when its surface is no longer part of that visible page.
        map?.onStop()
        super.onStop()
    }

    override fun onSaveInstanceState(outState: Bundle) {
        super.onSaveInstanceState(outState)
        map?.onSaveInstanceState(outState)
        val selected = targetState.value.selection
        outState.putString("home.target.kind", when (selected) {
            is HomeSelection.Route -> "route"
            is HomeSelection.Point -> "point"
            null -> restoredKind
        })
        outState.putString("home.target.id", when (selected) {
            is HomeSelection.Route -> selected.saved.route.id
            is HomeSelection.Point -> selected.savedId
            null -> restoredId
        })
        if (selected is HomeSelection.Point) {
            outState.putDouble("home.target.lat", selected.coordinate.latitude)
            outState.putDouble("home.target.lon", selected.coordinate.longitude)
            outState.putString("home.target.name", selected.name)
        }
    }

    override fun onDestroyView() {
        libraryLoad?.cancel()
        stopRealLocation()
        // onStop suspends rendering and location requests before the view is removed.
        // Keep only this Fragment's map; Activity recreation and Fragment removal release it.
        (map?.parent as? ViewGroup)?.removeView(map)
        super.onDestroyView()
    }

    override fun onDestroy() {
        releaseMap()
        super.onDestroy()
    }

    override fun onLowMemory() {
        super.onLowMemory()
        if (view == null) releaseMap()
    }

    private fun releaseMap() {
        map?.onDestroy()
        map = null
        targetMarker = null
        routeLine = null
    }

    private fun hasLocationPermission() = listOf(
        Manifest.permission.ACCESS_FINE_LOCATION, Manifest.permission.ACCESS_COARSE_LOCATION,
    ).any { ContextCompat.checkSelfPermission(requireContext(), it) == PackageManager.PERMISSION_GRANTED }

    private fun showLocationIssue(issue: HomeLocationIssue) {
        locationTimeout?.cancel()
        locationState.value = locationState.value.copy(loading = false, issue = issue)
    }

    private fun recoverLocation() {
        when (locationState.value.issue) {
            HomeLocationIssue.PERMISSION -> {
                val requested = requireContext().getSharedPreferences("home_location", Context.MODE_PRIVATE)
                val deniedPermanently = requested.getBoolean("requested", false) &&
                    !shouldShowRequestPermissionRationale(Manifest.permission.ACCESS_FINE_LOCATION) &&
                    !shouldShowRequestPermissionRationale(Manifest.permission.ACCESS_COARSE_LOCATION)
                if (deniedPermanently) {
                    startActivity(Intent(Settings.ACTION_APPLICATION_DETAILS_SETTINGS,
                        android.net.Uri.parse("package:${requireContext().packageName}")))
                } else {
                    requested.edit().putBoolean("requested", true).apply()
                    locationPermission.launch(arrayOf(Manifest.permission.ACCESS_FINE_LOCATION, Manifest.permission.ACCESS_COARSE_LOCATION))
                }
            }
            HomeLocationIssue.DISABLED -> startActivity(Intent(Settings.ACTION_LOCATION_SOURCE_SETTINGS))
            else -> locate()
        }
    }

    private fun browseMap() {
        cameraPolicy.userMovedCamera()
        // An explicit browse action uses a world overview, never an implied Beijing fix.
        map?.move(Gcj02(20.0, 0.0), 2f)
        locationState.value = locationState.value.copy(mapVisible = true)
    }

    private fun moveCamera(move: HomeCameraPolicy.Move) {
        map?.move(CoordinateTransform.toGcj02(Wgs84(move.position.latitude, move.position.longitude)), move.zoom,
            animate = locationState.value.mapVisible)
        locationState.value = locationState.value.copy(mapVisible = true)
    }

    private fun locate() {
        val runtime = mockModel.runtimeState.value
        if (runtime.isActive) {
            runtime.sample?.coordinate?.let { point ->
                cameraPolicy.userMovedCamera()
                map?.currentPosition(CoordinateTransform.toGcj02(point), simulated = true)
                moveCamera(HomeCameraPolicy.Move(HomeCameraPolicy.Position(point.latitude, point.longitude)))
            } ?: Toast.makeText(requireContext(), "正在等待模拟位置", Toast.LENGTH_SHORT).show()
            return
        }
        if (!hasLocationPermission()) { stopRealLocation(); showLocationIssue(HomeLocationIssue.PERMISSION); return }
        cameraPolicy.locate(SystemClock.elapsedRealtime())?.let {
            moveCamera(it)
            locationState.value = locationState.value.copy(loading = false, issue = null)
            return
        }
        stopRealLocation()
        startRealLocation()
    }

    private fun renderRuntimePosition() {
        val view = map ?: return
        val runtime = mockModel.runtimeState.value
        val original = mapModel.originalLocation?.let { (lat, lon) -> CoordinateTransform.toGcj02(Wgs84(lat, lon)) }
        view.originalPosition(if (runtime.isActive) original else null)
        if (runtime.isActive) {
            val sample = runtime.sample
            if (sample != null) {
                view.currentPosition(CoordinateTransform.toGcj02(sample.coordinate), simulated = true)
                locationState.value = locationState.value.copy(mapVisible = true, loading = false, issue = null)
            } else view.clearCurrentPosition()
        } else {
            mapModel.currentLocation?.let { (lat, lon) ->
                view.currentPosition(CoordinateTransform.toGcj02(Wgs84(lat, lon)))
            } ?: view.clearCurrentPosition()
        }
    }

    private fun acceptRealLocation(loc: Location, point: Pair<Double, Double>) {
        if (map == null || !lifecycle.currentState.isAtLeast(Lifecycle.State.STARTED)) return
        val active = mockModel.runtimeState.value.isActive
        val age = if (loc.elapsedRealtimeNanos > 0L) {
            (SystemClock.elapsedRealtimeNanos() - loc.elapsedRealtimeNanos) / 1_000_000
        } else {
            // Some fused network fixes omit elapsed time; still require a recent timestamp.
            System.currentTimeMillis() - loc.time
        }
        if (loc.isMock || active || age !in 0..HomeCameraPolicy.MAX_FIX_AGE_MILLIS ||
            point.first !in -90.0..90.0 || point.second !in -180.0..180.0 ||
            point.first == 0.0 && point.second == 0.0) return
        val move = cameraPolicy.accept(point.first, point.second, age, SystemClock.elapsedRealtime(), loc.isMock, active)
        mapModel.currentLocation = point
        mapModel.rememberOriginalLocation(point, loc.isMock, active)
        map?.currentPosition(CoordinateTransform.toGcj02(Wgs84(point.first, point.second)))
        requireContext().lastKnownLat = point.first
        requireContext().lastKnownLng = point.second
        move?.let(::moveCamera)
        locationTimeout?.cancel()
        locationState.value = locationState.value.copy(loading = false, issue = null)
    }

    @Suppress("MissingPermission")
    private fun startRealLocation() {
        val map = map ?: return
        if (mockModel.runtimeState.value.isActive || startInFlight) {
            stopRealLocation()
            locationState.value = locationState.value.copy(loading = false, issue = null)
            return
        }
        if (!hasLocationPermission()) { stopRealLocation(); showLocationIssue(HomeLocationIssue.PERMISSION); return }
        val manager = requireContext().getSystemService(Context.LOCATION_SERVICE) as? LocationManager
        if (manager == null) { showLocationIssue(HomeLocationIssue.UNAVAILABLE); return }
        if (!manager.isLocationEnabled) { stopRealLocation(); showLocationIssue(HomeLocationIssue.DISABLED); return }
        if (amapLocation != null || locationListener != null) return
        locationState.value = locationState.value.copy(loading = true, issue = null)
        locationTimeout?.cancel()
        locationTimeout = viewLifecycleOwner.lifecycleScope.launch {
            delay(20_000)
            showLocationIssue(HomeLocationIssue.TIMEOUT)
        }
        systemLocation = manager
        // Consent is completed by MainActivity before this view is created. Only the selected
        // provider's client is initialized; Tencent never initializes AMap for positioning.
        if (map.provider == MapProvider.AMAP) {
            runCatching {
                AMapLocationClient(requireContext()).also { client ->
                    amapLocation = client
                    client.setLocationOption(AMapLocationClientOption().apply {
                        locationMode = AMapLocationClientOption.AMapLocationMode.Hight_Accuracy
                        isOnceLocation = false
                        isNeedAddress = false
                        isLocationCacheEnable = false
                        interval = 1_000
                    })
                    client.setLocationListener { loc ->
                        if (amapLocation !== client || loc == null) return@setLocationListener
                        if (loc.errorCode == 0) acceptRealLocation(loc, loc.wgs84)
                    }
                    client.startLocation()
                }
            }.onFailure { stopRealLocation(); showLocationIssue(HomeLocationIssue.UNAVAILABLE) }
        } else {
            val listener = object : android.location.LocationListener {
                override fun onLocationChanged(location: Location) {
                    if (locationListener === this) acceptRealLocation(location, location.latitude to location.longitude)
                }
                override fun onProviderDisabled(provider: String) {
                    if (!manager.isLocationEnabled) showLocationIssue(HomeLocationIssue.DISABLED)
                }
                override fun onProviderEnabled(provider: String) {
                    if (!locationState.value.loading && locationState.value.issue != null) locate()
                }
            }
            locationListener = listener
            val providers = listOf(LocationManager.GPS_PROVIDER, LocationManager.NETWORK_PROVIDER)
                .filter { it in manager.allProviders }
            val registered = providers.count { provider ->
                runCatching {
                    manager.requestLocationUpdates(provider, 1_000L, 0f, listener, android.os.Looper.getMainLooper())
                }.isSuccess
            }
            if (registered == 0) { stopRealLocation(); showLocationIssue(HomeLocationIssue.UNAVAILABLE) }
            // A recent system fix can avoid an unnecessary wait. Old and mock fixes are rejected.
            providers.mapNotNull { runCatching { manager.getLastKnownLocation(it) }.getOrNull() }
                .sortedByDescending { it.elapsedRealtimeNanos }
                .firstOrNull { !it.isMock }?.let { acceptRealLocation(it, it.latitude to it.longitude) }
        }
    }

    private fun stopRealLocation() {
        locationTimeout?.cancel()
        locationTimeout = null
        val client = amapLocation
        amapLocation = null
        client?.let { runCatching { it.stopLocation(); it.onDestroy() } }
        locationListener?.let { listener -> runCatching { systemLocation?.removeUpdates(listener) } }
        locationListener = null
        systemLocation = null
    }
}

private enum class HomeLocationIssue(val message: String, val action: String) {
    PERMISSION("允许访问位置后，可将地图定位到你附近。也可直接搜索或选择坐标。", "授权位置"),
    DISABLED("系统定位已关闭，可开启定位或直接选择目标位置。", "开启定位"),
    TIMEOUT("暂时未获取到真实位置，请检查定位和网络，或移至开阔处重试。", "重新定位"),
    UNAVAILABLE("定位暂不可用，可重试或直接选择目标位置。", "重试"),
}

private data class HomeLocationState(
    val mapVisible: Boolean = false,
    val loading: Boolean = true,
    val issue: HomeLocationIssue? = null,
)

private data class HomeTarget(
    val selection: HomeSelection? = null,
    val busy: Boolean = false,
    val message: String? = null,
) {
    val point get() = (selection as? HomeSelection.Point)?.coordinate?.let { it.latitude to it.longitude }
    val name get() = when (selection) {
        is HomeSelection.Point -> selection.name
        is HomeSelection.Route -> selection.saved.route.name
        null -> null
    }
}

/** Consistent 48 dp touch targets with 24 dp vectors, independent of font scaling. */
@Composable
private fun HomeMapButton(icon: Int, description: String, onClick: () -> Unit) {
    FilledTonalIconButton(onClick = onClick, modifier = Modifier.size(48.dp)) {
        Icon(painterResource(icon), contentDescription = description, modifier = Modifier.size(24.dp))
    }
}

@Composable
@OptIn(ExperimentalMaterial3Api::class)
private fun HomeScreen(
    mockModel: MockServiceViewModel,
    replayModel: com.system.location.service.ui.viewmodel.QuickReplayViewModel,
    onManageReplay: () -> Unit,
    targetFlow: kotlinx.coroutines.flow.Flow<HomeTarget>,
    locationFlow: kotlinx.coroutines.flow.StateFlow<HomeLocationState>,
    libraryFlow: kotlinx.coroutines.flow.StateFlow<HomeLibraryState>,
    onLocate: () -> Unit,
    onLocationRecovery: () -> Unit,
    onBrowse: () -> Unit,
    createMap: (Context) -> View,
    onMenu: () -> Unit,
    onTarget: (Pair<Double, Double>, String?) -> Unit,
    onSearch: (String, (List<PlaceSuggestion>) -> Unit) -> Unit,
    onSaveLocation: (String, String, Double, Double) -> Unit,
    onRocker: () -> Unit,
    onOpenTargets: () -> Unit,
    onSelection: (HomeSelection) -> Unit,
    onStart: () -> Unit,
    onCreateRoute: () -> Unit,
    onMapType: () -> Boolean,
) {
    val context = LocalContext.current
    val runtimeState by mockModel.runtimeState.collectAsStateWithLifecycle()
    val runtime = remember(runtimeState) { HomeRuntimeUi.from(runtimeState) }
    val location by locationFlow.collectAsStateWithLifecycle()
    val target by targetFlow.collectAsStateWithLifecycle(initialValue = HomeTarget())
    val library by libraryFlow.collectAsStateWithLifecycle()
    var targetPicker by rememberSaveable { mutableStateOf(false) }
    var replayPicker by rememberSaveable { mutableStateOf(false) }
    val queryState = remember { mutableStateOf("") }
    var query by queryState
    var suggestions by remember { mutableStateOf<List<PlaceSuggestion>>(emptyList()) }
    var saveDialog by remember { mutableStateOf(false) }
    var coordinateDialog by remember { mutableStateOf(false) }
    var saveName by remember { mutableStateOf("") }
    var saveAddress by remember { mutableStateOf("") }
    var latInput by remember { mutableStateOf("") }
    var lonInput by remember { mutableStateOf("") }
    val scope = rememberCoroutineScope()

    if (replayPicker) ModalBottomSheet(onDismissRequest = { replayPicker = false }) {
        LazyColumn(Modifier.fillMaxWidth(), contentPadding = PaddingValues(20.dp, 0.dp, 20.dp, 24.dp)) {
            item {
                com.system.location.service.ui.mock.QuickReplayCard(replayModel, onManage = {
                    replayPicker = false
                    onManageReplay()
                })
            }
        }
    }

    val lifecycle = LocalLifecycleOwner.current.lifecycle
    val requestSearch by rememberUpdatedState(onSearch)
    val search = remember(lifecycle, context) {
        val handler = android.os.Handler(android.os.Looper.getMainLooper())
        DebouncedSearch<List<PlaceSuggestion>>(
            scheduler = object : CallbackScheduler {
                override fun post(delayMillis: Long, callback: Runnable) { handler.postDelayed(callback, delayMillis) }
                override fun remove(callback: Runnable) { handler.removeCallbacks(callback) }
            },
            query = { queryState.value },
            viewActive = { lifecycle.currentState.isAtLeast(Lifecycle.State.RESUMED) },
            request = { text, reply -> requestSearch(text, reply) },
            render = { result ->
                suggestions = result
                if (result.isEmpty()) Toast.makeText(context, "未找到地点，请修改搜索词后重试", Toast.LENGTH_SHORT).show()
            },
        )
    }
    DisposableEffect(search, lifecycle) {
        val observer = LifecycleEventObserver { _, event ->
            if (event == Lifecycle.Event.ON_PAUSE) search.select { suggestions = emptyList() }
        }
        lifecycle.addObserver(observer)
        onDispose { lifecycle.removeObserver(observer); search.destroy() }
    }
    fun dismissSearch() { search.select { suggestions = emptyList() } }

    if (targetPicker) HomeTargetPicker(
        library = library,
        onSelect = { onSelection(it); targetPicker = false },
        onDismiss = { targetPicker = false },
        onRetry = onOpenTargets,
        onCreateRoute = { targetPicker = false; onCreateRoute() },
    )

    if (suggestions.isNotEmpty()) {
        AlertDialog(
            onDismissRequest = ::dismissSearch,
            title = { Text("选择地点") },
            text = {
                LazyColumn(Modifier.height(300.dp)) {
                    items(suggestions) { suggestion ->
                        TextButton(onClick = {
                            search.select { suggestions = emptyList(); query = suggestion.name }
                            val wgs = CoordinateTransform.toWgs84(suggestion.point)
                            onTarget(wgs.latitude to wgs.longitude, suggestion.name)
                        }) { Text("${suggestion.name}\n${suggestion.address}") }
                    }
                }
            },
            confirmButton = { TextButton(onClick = ::dismissSearch) { Text("取消") } },
        )
    }

    if (saveDialog) {
        AlertDialog(
            onDismissRequest = { saveDialog = false },
            title = { Text("保存至位置库") },
            text = {
                Column {
                    OutlinedTextField(saveName, { saveName = it }, label = { Text("名称") }, singleLine = true)
                    Spacer(Modifier.height(8.dp))
                    OutlinedTextField(saveAddress, { saveAddress = it }, label = { Text("地址") }, singleLine = true)
                }
            },
            confirmButton = {
                TextButton(onClick = {
                    val selected = target.point
                    if (selected == null || saveName.isBlank()) {
                        Toast.makeText(context, "请填写名称并选择位置", Toast.LENGTH_SHORT).show()
                    } else {
                        onSaveLocation(saveName, saveAddress.ifBlank { saveName }, selected.first, selected.second)
                        saveDialog = false
                    }
                }) { Text("保存") }
            },
            dismissButton = { TextButton(onClick = { saveDialog = false }) { Text("取消") } },
        )
    }

    if (coordinateDialog) {
        AlertDialog(
            onDismissRequest = { coordinateDialog = false },
            title = { Text("跳转位置") },
            text = {
                Column {
                    OutlinedTextField(latInput, { latInput = it }, label = { Text("纬度") }, singleLine = true)
                    Spacer(Modifier.height(8.dp))
                    OutlinedTextField(lonInput, { lonInput = it }, label = { Text("经度") }, singleLine = true)
                }
            },
            confirmButton = {
                TextButton(onClick = {
                    val lat = latInput.toDoubleOrNull()
                    val lon = lonInput.toDoubleOrNull()
                    if (lat == null || lon == null || lat !in -90.0..90.0 || lon !in -180.0..180.0) {
                        Toast.makeText(context, "坐标格式错误", Toast.LENGTH_SHORT).show()
                    } else {
                        onTarget(lat to lon, null)
                        coordinateDialog = false
                    }
                }) { Text("确定") }
            },
            dismissButton = { TextButton(onClick = { coordinateDialog = false }) { Text("取消") } },
        )
    }

    var bottomPanelHeight by remember { mutableStateOf(0) }
    val density = androidx.compose.ui.platform.LocalDensity.current
    val mapBottomInset = bottomPanelHeight + with(density) {
        (24.dp + WindowInsets.safeDrawing.asPaddingValues().calculateBottomPadding()).roundToPx()
    }
    BoxWithConstraints(Modifier.fillMaxSize()) {
        val compact = maxHeight < 500.dp
        AndroidView(
            factory = { ctx -> createMap(ctx) },
            update = {
                it.visibility = if (location.mapVisible) View.VISIBLE else View.INVISIBLE
                (it as PortalMapView).setBottomObstruction(mapBottomInset)
            },
            modifier = Modifier.fillMaxSize(),
        )
        if (!location.mapVisible) {
            Surface(Modifier.fillMaxSize(), color = MaterialTheme.colorScheme.surface) {}
        }
        Column(
            Modifier.fillMaxSize().windowInsetsPadding(WindowInsets.safeDrawing)
                .padding(start = 16.dp, end = if (compact) 80.dp else 16.dp, top = 16.dp, bottom = 16.dp),
            verticalArrangement = Arrangement.SpaceBetween,
        ) {
            Card(
                shape = RoundedCornerShape(22.dp),
                colors = CardDefaults.cardColors(containerColor = MaterialTheme.colorScheme.surface),
            ) {
                Row(Modifier.fillMaxWidth().padding(4.dp), verticalAlignment = Alignment.CenterVertically) {
                    IconButton(onClick = onMenu) {
                        Icon(painterResource(R.drawable.ic_home_menu), contentDescription = "打开菜单")
                    }
                    OutlinedTextField(
                        value = query,
                        onValueChange = { text -> search.select { query = text; suggestions = emptyList() } },
                        placeholder = { Text("搜索") },
                        singleLine = true,
                        keyboardOptions = KeyboardOptions(imeAction = ImeAction.Search),
                        keyboardActions = KeyboardActions(onSearch = { search.submit() }),
                        modifier = Modifier.weight(1f),
                    )
                    IconButton(onClick = { search.submit() }, enabled = query.isNotBlank()) {
                        Icon(painterResource(R.drawable.ic_home_search), contentDescription = "搜索地点")
                    }
                }
            }
            if (!runtime.isActive && (location.loading || location.issue != null || !location.mapVisible)) {
                Card(colors = CardDefaults.cardColors(containerColor = MaterialTheme.colorScheme.surface)) {
                    if (compact) Row(Modifier.padding(horizontal = 12.dp), verticalAlignment = Alignment.CenterVertically) {
                        Text(if (location.loading) "正在获取真实位置" else location.issue?.message ?: "可直接浏览地图",
                            modifier = Modifier.weight(1f), style = MaterialTheme.typography.bodySmall,
                            maxLines = 2, overflow = TextOverflow.Ellipsis)
                        location.issue?.let { issue -> TextButton(onClick = onLocationRecovery) { Text(issue.action) } }
                        if (!location.mapVisible) TextButton(onClick = onBrowse) { Text("先浏览地图") }
                    } else Column(Modifier.padding(16.dp), verticalArrangement = Arrangement.spacedBy(8.dp)) {
                        if (location.loading) {
                            Row(verticalAlignment = Alignment.CenterVertically, horizontalArrangement = Arrangement.spacedBy(12.dp)) {
                                androidx.compose.material3.CircularProgressIndicator(Modifier.size(24.dp), strokeWidth = 2.dp)
                                Text("正在获取真实位置", style = MaterialTheme.typography.titleSmall)
                            }
                            Text("仅用于显示当前位置，不会修改模拟目标。", style = MaterialTheme.typography.bodySmall)
                        } else {
                            Text(location.issue?.message ?: "可搜索地点或直接浏览地图", style = MaterialTheme.typography.bodyMedium)
                        }
                        Row(horizontalArrangement = Arrangement.spacedBy(8.dp)) {
```

```kt
package com.system.location.service.ui.home

import androidx.compose.animation.AnimatedVisibility

import com.system.location.service.core.runtime.RuntimeState
import com.system.location.service.ui.displayLabel

/** Position samples belong to the map renderer and do not invalidate the controls. */
internal data class HomeRuntimeUi(
    val phase: RuntimePhase,
    val backend: BackendType,
    val name: String?,
    val holdingPosition: com.system.location.service.core.runtime.RouteEndPosition?,
) {
    val isActive get() = phase in setOf(RuntimePhase.PREPARING, RuntimePhase.READY,
        RuntimePhase.RUNNING, RuntimePhase.PAUSED, RuntimePhase.HOLDING, RuntimePhase.STOPPING)
    companion object {
        fun from(state: RuntimeState) = HomeRuntimeUi(state.phase, state.backend, state.scenarioName, state.holdingPosition)
    }
}

@Composable
internal fun HomeRuntimeControls(
    runtime: HomeRuntimeUi,
    canStart: Boolean,
    onStart: () -> Unit,
    onPauseResume: () -> Unit,
    onStop: () -> Unit,
) {
    val phaseLabel = if (runtime.phase == RuntimePhase.HOLDING &&
        runtime.holdingPosition == com.system.location.service.core.runtime.RouteEndPosition.START) "停留在起点"
    else runtime.phase.displayLabel()
    Text(listOfNotNull(phaseLabel, runtime.backend.displayLabel(),
        runtime.name?.takeIf { runtime.isActive }).joinToString(" · "),
        style = MaterialTheme.typography.bodySmall, maxLines = 1, overflow = TextOverflow.Ellipsis,
        color = MaterialTheme.colorScheme.onSurfaceVariant)
    Spacer(Modifier.height(8.dp))
    Row(horizontalArrangement = Arrangement.spacedBy(8.dp)) {
        Button(onClick = onStart,
            enabled = canStart && runtime.phase !in setOf(RuntimePhase.PREPARING, RuntimePhase.STOPPING),
            modifier = Modifier.weight(1f)) {
            Text(if (runtime.isActive) "切换位置" else "开始模拟")
        }
        AnimatedVisibility(runtime.phase in setOf(RuntimePhase.RUNNING, RuntimePhase.PAUSED), enter = fadeIn(), exit = fadeOut()) {
            FilledTonalIconButton(onClick = onPauseResume,
                enabled = runtime.phase in setOf(RuntimePhase.RUNNING, RuntimePhase.PAUSED),
                modifier = Modifier.size(48.dp)) {
                val paused = runtime.phase == RuntimePhase.PAUSED
                Icon(painterResource(if (paused) R.drawable.ic_portal_run else R.drawable.ic_portal_pause),
                    contentDescription = if (paused) "继续模拟" else "暂停模拟")
            }
        }
        OutlinedButton(onClick = onStop, enabled = runtime.isActive && runtime.phase != RuntimePhase.STOPPING,
            colors = ButtonDefaults.outlinedButtonColors(contentColor = MaterialTheme.colorScheme.error),
            modifier = Modifier.weight(1f)) { Text("停止模拟") }
    }
}
```

`app/src/main/java/com/system/location/service/ui/home/HomeSelection.kt`:

```kt
package com.system.location.service.ui.home

import com.system.location.service.core.geo.Wgs84
import com.system.location.service.core.repository.SavedRoute

/** The selected target is independent of the runtime's already-frozen active scenario. */
internal sealed interface HomeSelection {
    data class Point(val coordinate: Wgs84, val name: String?, val savedId: String? = null) : HomeSelection
    data class Route(val saved: SavedRoute) : HomeSelection
}

internal fun HomeSelection.refreshed(
    routes: List<SavedRoute>,
    locations: List<com.system.location.service.core.repository.SavedLocation>,
): HomeSelection? = when (this) {
    is HomeSelection.Route -> routes.firstOrNull { it.route.id == saved.route.id }?.let(HomeSelection::Route)
    is HomeSelection.Point -> if (savedId == null) this else locations.firstOrNull { it.id == savedId }
        ?.let { HomeSelection.Point(it.coordinate, it.name, it.id) }
}

internal suspend fun HomeSelection.start(
    point: suspend (HomeSelection.Point) -> Boolean,
    route: suspend (SavedRoute) -> Boolean,
): Boolean = when (this) {
    is HomeSelection.Point -> point(this)
    is HomeSelection.Route -> route(saved)
}
```

`app/src/main/java/com/system/location/service/ui/home/PositionFilter.kt`:

```kt
package com.system.location.service.ui.home

import com.system.location.service.hook.utils.FakeLoc

/** Suppress stale fixes and stationary GPS noise, without filtering simulated movement. */
class PositionFilter {
    private var lastTime = 0L
    private var last: Pair<Double, Double>? = null

    fun accept(point: Pair<Double, Double>, time: Long, accuracy: Float, speed: Float): Pair<Double, Double>? {
        if (point.first !in -90.0..90.0 || point.second !in -180.0..180.0 || time <= lastTime) return null
        lastTime = time
        val previous = last
        if (previous != null && speed < 0.8f &&
            FakeLoc.haversine(previous.first, previous.second, point.first, point.second) < accuracy.coerceIn(2f, 5f)) {
            return previous
        }
        return point.also { last = it }
    }
}
```

`app/src/main/java/com/system/location/service/ui/mock/HistoricalLocation.kt`:

```kt
package com.system.location.service.ui.mock

import com.system.location.service.core.geo.Wgs84
import kotlinx.serialization.Serializable
import kotlinx.serialization.encodeToString
import kotlinx.serialization.json.Json
import com.system.location.service.data.repository.stableRecordId

@Serializable data class HistoricalLocation(val name: String, val address: String, val lat: Double, val lon: Double,
    val id: String = stableRecordId("location", "$name:$address:$lat:$lon"), val favorite: Boolean = false) {
    init { require(name.isNotBlank()); Wgs84(lat, lon) }
    override fun toString(): String = json.encodeToString(LocationEnvelope(location = this))
    companion object {
        private val json = Json { encodeDefaults = true }
        /** Legacy CSV is read only; new records are versioned JSON with Double fields. */
        fun fromString(text: String): HistoricalLocation {
            if (text.trimStart().startsWith("{")) {
                val envelope = Json.decodeFromString<LocationEnvelope>(text)
                require(envelope.schemaVersion == 1) { "Unsupported saved location schema" }
                return envelope.location
            }
            val fields = mutableListOf<String>()
            val field = StringBuilder()
            var quoted = false
            var index = 0
            while (index < text.length) {
                val char = text[index]
                when {
                    char == '"' && quoted && text.getOrNull(index + 1) == '"' -> { field.append('"'); index++ }
                    char == '"' -> quoted = !quoted
                    char == ',' && !quoted -> { fields += field.toString().trim(); field.setLength(0) }
                    else -> field.append(char)
                }
                index++
            }
            require(!quoted) { "Unclosed CSV quote" }
            fields += field.toString().trim()
            require(fields.size == 4) { "Expected four CSV fields" }
            return HistoricalLocation(fields[0], fields[1], fields[2].toDouble(), fields[3].toDouble())
        }
    }
}
@Serializable private data class LocationEnvelope(val schemaVersion: Int = 1, val location: HistoricalLocation)

```

`app/src/main/java/com/system/location/service/ui/mock/HistoricalLocationAdapter.kt`:

```kt
package com.system.location.service.ui.mock

import android.annotation.SuppressLint
import android.view.LayoutInflater
import android.view.View
import android.view.ViewGroup
import androidx.recyclerview.widget.RecyclerView
import com.google.android.material.textview.MaterialTextView
import com.system.location.service.R
import java.math.BigDecimal

class HistoricalLocationAdapter(
    private val dataSet: MutableList<HistoricalLocation>,
    private val onItemClicked: (HistoricalLocation, isLongClicked: Boolean) -> Unit
): RecyclerView.Adapter<HistoricalLocationAdapter.ViewHolder>() {
    class ViewHolder(
        val root: View
    ) : RecyclerView.ViewHolder(root) {
        val locationName: MaterialTextView = root.findViewById(R.id.history_location_name)
        val locationLatLon: MaterialTextView = root.findViewById(R.id.history_location_latlon)
        val locationAddress: MaterialTextView = root.findViewById(R.id.history_location_address)
    }

    operator fun get(position: Int): HistoricalLocation {
        return dataSet[position]
    }

    fun removeItem(position: Int): HistoricalLocation {
        val removed = dataSet.removeAt(position)
        notifyItemRemoved(position)
        notifyItemRangeChanged(position, itemCount - position)
        return removed
    }

    /**
     * Called when RecyclerView needs a new [ViewHolder] of the given type to represent
     * an item.
     *
     *
     * This new ViewHolder should be constructed with a new View that can represent the items
     * of the given type. You can either create a new View manually or inflate it from an XML
     * layout file.
     *
     *
     * The new ViewHolder will be used to display items of the adapter using
     * [.onBindViewHolder]. Since it will be re-used to display
     * different items in the data set, it is a good idea to cache references to sub views of
     * the View to avoid unnecessary [View.findViewById] calls.
     *
     * @param parent The ViewGroup into which the new View will be added after it is bound to
     * an adapter position.
     * @param viewType The view type of the new View.
     *
     * @return A new ViewHolder that holds a View of the given view type.
     * @see .getItemViewType
     * @see .onBindViewHolder
     */
    override fun onCreateViewHolder(parent: ViewGroup, viewType: Int): ViewHolder {
        val view = LayoutInflater.from(parent.context)
            .inflate(R.layout.layout_history_location_item, parent, false)

        return ViewHolder(view)
    }

    /**
     * Returns the total number of items in the data set held by the adapter.
     *
     * @return The total number of items in this adapter.
     */
    override fun getItemCount(): Int {
        return dataSet.size
    }

    /**
     * Called by RecyclerView to display the data at the specified position. This method should
     * update the contents of the [ViewHolder.itemView] to reflect the item at the given
     * position.
     *
     *
     * Note that unlike [android.widget.ListView], RecyclerView will not call this method
     * again if the position of the item changes in the data set unless the item itself is
     * invalidated or the new position cannot be determined. For this reason, you should only
     * use the `position` parameter while acquiring the related data item inside
     * this method and should not keep a copy of it. If you need the position of an item later
     * on (e.g. in a click listener), use [ViewHolder.getAdapterPosition] which will
     * have the updated adapter position.
     *
     * Override [.onBindViewHolder] instead if Adapter can
     * handle efficient partial bind.
     *
     * @param holder The ViewHolder which should be updated to represent the contents of the
     * item at the given position in the data set.
     * @param position The position of the item within the adapter's data set.
     */
    @SuppressLint("SetTextI18n")
    override fun onBindViewHolder(holder: ViewHolder, position: Int) {
        holder.locationName.text = dataSet[position].name
        val lat = BigDecimal(dataSet[position].lat).toPlainString().take(8)
        val lon = BigDecimal(dataSet[position].lon).toPlainString().take(8)
        holder.locationLatLon.text = "$lat,$lon"
        holder.locationAddress.text = dataSet[position].address
        holder.root.setOnClickListener {
            onItemClicked(dataSet[position], false)
        }
        holder.root.setOnLongClickListener {
            onItemClicked(dataSet[position], true)
            true
        }
    }
}
```

`app/src/main/java/com/system/location/service/ui/mock/LibraryAdapter.kt`:

```kt
package com.system.location.service.ui.mock

import android.view.LayoutInflater
import android.view.ViewGroup
import androidx.recyclerview.widget.DiffUtil
import androidx.recyclerview.widget.ListAdapter
import androidx.recyclerview.widget.RecyclerView
import com.system.location.service.R
import com.system.location.service.databinding.ItemLibraryBinding
import com.system.location.service.ui.viewmodel.LibraryItem
import com.system.location.service.ui.viewmodel.LibraryKind

data class LibraryRow(val kind: LibraryKind, val item: LibraryItem)

/** One adapter per view; asynchronous diffs preserve scroll and reuse unchanged rows. */
class LibraryAdapter(private val onClick: (LibraryItem) -> Unit) : ListAdapter<LibraryRow, LibraryAdapter.Holder>(DIFF) {
    class Holder(val ui: ItemLibraryBinding) : RecyclerView.ViewHolder(ui.root)
    override fun onCreateViewHolder(parent: ViewGroup, viewType: Int) =
        Holder(ItemLibraryBinding.inflate(LayoutInflater.from(parent.context), parent, false))
    override fun onBindViewHolder(holder: Holder, position: Int) {
        val row = getItem(position)
        holder.ui.itemTitle.text = row.item.title
        holder.ui.itemDetail.text = row.item.detail
        holder.ui.itemIcon.setImageResource(when (row.kind) {
            LibraryKind.ROUTES -> R.drawable.baseline_route_24
            LibraryKind.SCENARIOS -> R.drawable.baseline_workspaces_filled_24
            LibraryKind.LOCATIONS -> R.drawable.baseline_location_on_24
        })
        holder.ui.root.setOnClickListener { onClick(row.item) }
    }
    private companion object {
        val DIFF = object : DiffUtil.ItemCallback<LibraryRow>() {
            override fun areItemsTheSame(old: LibraryRow, new: LibraryRow) = old.kind == new.kind && old.item.id == new.item.id
            override fun areContentsTheSame(old: LibraryRow, new: LibraryRow) = old == new
        }
    }
}
```

`app/src/main/java/com/system/location/service/ui/mock/OverlayComposeOwner.kt`:

```kt
package com.system.location.service.ui.mock

import android.view.View
import androidx.lifecycle.Lifecycle
import androidx.lifecycle.LifecycleOwner
import androidx.lifecycle.LifecycleRegistry
import androidx.lifecycle.ViewModelStore
import androidx.lifecycle.ViewModelStoreOwner
import androidx.lifecycle.setViewTreeLifecycleOwner
import androidx.lifecycle.setViewTreeViewModelStoreOwner
import androidx.savedstate.SavedStateRegistry
import androidx.savedstate.SavedStateRegistryController
import androidx.savedstate.SavedStateRegistryOwner
import androidx.savedstate.setViewTreeSavedStateRegistryOwner

/** Each overlay attachment has its own composition lifetime, without retaining an Activity. */
internal class OverlayComposeOwner : LifecycleOwner, SavedStateRegistryOwner, ViewModelStoreOwner {
    private val registry = LifecycleRegistry(this)
    private val state = SavedStateRegistryController.create(this)
    override val lifecycle: Lifecycle get() = registry
    override val savedStateRegistry: SavedStateRegistry get() = state.savedStateRegistry
    override val viewModelStore = ViewModelStore()

    fun attach(view: View) {
        state.performAttach()
        state.performRestore(null)
        view.setViewTreeLifecycleOwner(this)
        view.setViewTreeSavedStateRegistryOwner(this)
        view.setViewTreeViewModelStoreOwner(this)
        registry.currentState = Lifecycle.State.RESUMED
    }

    fun close() {
        registry.currentState = Lifecycle.State.DESTROYED
        viewModelStore.clear()
    }
}
```

```kt
import androidx.compose.material3.LinearProgressIndicator
import androidx.compose.material3.MaterialTheme
import androidx.compose.material3.Text
import androidx.compose.material3.TextButton
import androidx.compose.runtime.*
import androidx.compose.runtime.saveable.rememberSaveable
import androidx.compose.ui.Modifier
import androidx.compose.ui.platform.LocalContext
import androidx.lifecycle.Lifecycle
import androidx.lifecycle.compose.LocalLifecycleOwner
import androidx.lifecycle.compose.collectAsStateWithLifecycle
import androidx.lifecycle.repeatOnLifecycle
import com.system.location.service.core.backend.BackendType
import com.system.location.service.core.gnss.GnssSimulationMode
import com.system.location.service.designsystem.components.PortalActionRow
import com.system.location.service.designsystem.components.PortalCard
import com.system.location.service.designsystem.components.PortalSectionTitle
import com.system.location.service.designsystem.theme.PortalSpacing
import com.system.location.service.ext.environmentSourceMode
import com.system.location.service.ext.mockWifiEnabled
import com.system.location.service.ext.sharedPrefs
import com.system.location.service.gnss.gnssReplayOnStart
import com.system.location.service.gnss.replayEnvironmentName
import com.system.location.service.runtime.ScenarioRuntime
import com.system.location.service.ui.preferenceRevision
import com.system.location.service.ui.viewmodel.QuickReplayViewModel
import kotlinx.coroutines.awaitCancellation
import kotlinx.coroutines.launch

/** Selection immediately saves and applies; all entry points share the activity-owned command. */
@Composable
internal fun QuickReplayCard(
    model: QuickReplayViewModel,
    environment: Boolean = true,
    satellite: Boolean = true,
    onManage: (() -> Unit)? = null,
) {
    val context = LocalContext.current
    val scope = rememberCoroutineScope()
    val revision = preferenceRevision()
    val state by model.state.collectAsStateWithLifecycle()
    val runtime by ScenarioRuntime.state.collectAsStateWithLifecycle()
    val lifecycle = LocalLifecycleOwner.current.lifecycle
    LaunchedEffect(model, lifecycle) {
        lifecycle.repeatOnLifecycle(Lifecycle.State.RESUMED) {
            model.refresh()
            awaitCancellation()
        }
    }
    val environmentLabel = remember(revision) {
        when {
            context.environmentSourceMode == "REPLAY" -> context.replayEnvironmentName.ifEmpty { "已选环境" }
            context.environmentSourceMode == "PROCEDURAL" -> "程序生成"
            else -> "自动"
        }
    }
    val satelliteLabel = remember(revision) {
        if (!context.gnssReplayOnStart) "关闭"
        else when (context.sharedPrefs.getString("gnssSimulationMode", "AUTONOMOUS")) {
            "REPLAY" -> "最近采集"
            "AUTO" -> "自动"
            "OFF" -> "关闭"
            else -> "目标天空"
        }
    }
    var picker by rememberSaveable { mutableStateOf<String?>(null) }
    PortalCard {
        Column(verticalArrangement = Arrangement.spacedBy(PortalSpacing.sm)) {
            PortalSectionTitle("快捷回放")
            if (state.busy || state.loading) LinearProgressIndicator(Modifier.fillMaxWidth())
            if (environment) Box {
                PortalActionRow("回放环境", environmentLabel, { picker = "environment" }, enabled = !state.busy)
                DropdownMenu(expanded = picker == "environment", onDismissRequest = { picker = null }) {
                    DropdownMenuItem(text = { Text("关闭环境模拟") }, onClick = { picker = null; model.disableEnvironment() })
                    DropdownMenuItem(text = { Text("程序生成") }, onClick = { picker = null; model.environment("") })
                    state.names.forEach { name ->
                        DropdownMenuItem(text = { Text(name) }, onClick = { picker = null; model.environment(name) })
                    }
                    if (state.names.isEmpty() && !state.loading) DropdownMenuItem(text = { Text("暂无已保存环境") }, onClick = {}, enabled = false)
                    DropdownMenuItem(text = { Text("刷新列表") }, onClick = { picker = null; scope.launch { model.refresh() } })
                }
            }
            if (satellite) Box {
                PortalActionRow("回放卫星", satelliteLabel, { picker = "satellite" }, enabled = !state.busy)
                DropdownMenu(expanded = picker == "satellite", onDismissRequest = { picker = null }) {
                    DropdownMenuItem(text = { Text("关闭卫星模拟") }, onClick = { picker = null; model.satellite(null) })
                    DropdownMenuItem(text = { Text("目标天空（无需采集）") }, onClick = { picker = null; model.satellite(GnssSimulationMode.AUTONOMOUS) })
                    DropdownMenuItem(text = { Text("最近采集") }, onClick = { picker = null; model.satellite(GnssSimulationMode.REPLAY) })
                }
            }
            Text(
                if (runtime.backend == BackendType.MOCK_PROVIDER) "选择会保存；环境和卫星回放需要 Xposed / Native。"
                else if (runtime.isActive) "选择后立即应用。" else "选择后随定位启动。",
                style = MaterialTheme.typography.bodySmall, color = MaterialTheme.colorScheme.onSurfaceVariant,
            )
            if (environment && context.environmentSourceMode == "REPLAY" && context.mockWifiEnabled) {
                Text("环境仅在录入或采集地点附近回放。", style = MaterialTheme.typography.bodySmall,
                    color = MaterialTheme.colorScheme.onSurfaceVariant)
            }
            if (satellite && satelliteLabel == "最近采集") Text("卫星回放使用采集地点与时段的数据。",
                style = MaterialTheme.typography.bodySmall, color = MaterialTheme.colorScheme.onSurfaceVariant)
            if (runtime.isActive && runtime.backend != BackendType.MOCK_PROVIDER) Button(
                onClick = model::replay, enabled = !state.busy, modifier = Modifier.fillMaxWidth(),
            ) { Text("立即回放") }
            onManage?.let { PortalActionRow("管理环境 / 卫星", onClick = it) }
            state.message?.let { Text(it, style = MaterialTheme.typography.bodySmall,
                color = if (state.failed) MaterialTheme.colorScheme.error else MaterialTheme.colorScheme.onSurfaceVariant) }
            if (state.failed && !state.busy) {
                TextButton(onClick = { scope.launch { model.refresh() } }) { Text("重试") }
            }
        }
    }
}
```

`app/src/main/java/com/system/location/service/ui/mock/Rocker.kt`:

```kt
package com.system.location.service.ui.mock

import android.content.Context
import android.graphics.PixelFormat
import android.view.Gravity
import android.view.WindowManager
import androidx.compose.runtime.getValue
import androidx.compose.runtime.mutableStateOf
import androidx.compose.runtime.setValue
import androidx.compose.ui.platform.ComposeView
import androidx.compose.ui.platform.ViewCompositionStrategy
import com.system.location.service.R
import com.system.location.service.android.widget.RockerView
import com.system.location.service.core.runtime.RuntimePhase
import com.system.location.service.designsystem.theme.PortalTheme
import com.system.location.service.ext.rockerCoords
import kotlin.math.round

/** A single application-owned Compose overlay; it never retains an Activity or Fragment. */
class Rocker(private val context: Context) {
    private val windowManager = context.getSystemService(WindowManager::class.java)
    private val root = ComposeView(context).apply {
        setViewCompositionStrategy(ViewCompositionStrategy.DisposeOnDetachedFromWindow)
    }
    private val rockerView = RockerView(context, null).apply { id = R.id.rocker }
    private var owner: OverlayComposeOwner? = null
    private val targetMenu = RockerTargetMenu(context)
    private val layoutParams = WindowManager.LayoutParams(
        WindowManager.LayoutParams.WRAP_CONTENT, WindowManager.LayoutParams.WRAP_CONTENT,
        WindowManager.LayoutParams.TYPE_APPLICATION_OVERLAY,
        WindowManager.LayoutParams.FLAG_NOT_TOUCH_MODAL or WindowManager.LayoutParams.FLAG_NOT_FOCUSABLE,
        PixelFormat.TRANSLUCENT,
    ).apply {
        gravity = Gravity.LEFT or Gravity.TOP
        x = context.rockerCoords.first
        y = context.rockerCoords.second
    }
    var isStart = false
        private set
    var isMinimized by mutableStateOf(true)
        private set
    private var speedExpanded by mutableStateOf(false)
    private var displayedSpeed by mutableStateOf(0.0)
    private var route by mutableStateOf(false)
    private var status by mutableStateOf("")
    private var canMove by mutableStateOf(false)
    private var targetsEnabled by mutableStateOf(true)
    private var draggingSpeed = false
    var onSpeedChanged: ((Double) -> Unit)? = null

    init { root.addOnLayoutChangeListener { _, _, _, _, _, _, _, _, _ -> clampPosition() } }

    fun show() {
        if (isStart) return
        minimize(true)
        val session = OverlayComposeOwner().also { it.attach(root); owner = it }
        root.setContent {
            PortalTheme {
                RockerPanel(isMinimized, speedExpanded, status, displayedSpeed, route, canMove,
                    targetsEnabled, rockerView, ::minimize, { speedExpanded = !speedExpanded },
                    { resetMovement(); rockerView.listener?.onFinished(); targetMenu.open() },
                    ::changeSpeed, { draggingSpeed = it }, ::drag, ::savePosition)
            }
        }
        try {
            windowManager.addView(root, layoutParams)
            isStart = true
            root.post { clampPosition() }
        } catch (failure: RuntimeException) {
            root.disposeComposition()
            session.close()
            owner = null
            throw failure
        }
    }

    fun hide() {
        targetMenu.close()
        resetMovement()
        if (isStart) windowManager.removeViewImmediate(root)
        isStart = false
        root.disposeComposition()
        owner?.close()
        owner = null
    }

    fun minimize(value: Boolean) {
        if (value) { speedExpanded = false; draggingSpeed = false }
        isMinimized = value
        if (isStart) root.post { clampPosition() }
    }

    fun setPlaybackState(phase: RuntimePhase, route: Boolean,
        holdingPosition: com.system.location.service.core.runtime.RouteEndPosition? = null) {
        canMove = phase == RuntimePhase.RUNNING && !route
        status = if (phase == RuntimePhase.HOLDING) {
            if (holdingPosition == com.system.location.service.core.runtime.RouteEndPosition.START) "停留在起点" else "停留在终点"
        } else context.getString(when (phase) {
            RuntimePhase.RUNNING -> if (route) R.string.overlay_route_running else R.string.overlay_running
            RuntimePhase.PAUSED -> R.string.overlay_paused
            else -> R.string.overlay_idle
        })
        targetsEnabled = phase !in setOf(RuntimePhase.PREPARING, RuntimePhase.READY, RuntimePhase.STOPPING)
        rockerView.isEnabled = canMove
        rockerView.stateDescription = status
        if (!canMove) resetMovement()
    }

    fun resetMovement() { rockerView.auto(false); rockerView.reset() }
    fun setRockerListener(listener: RockerView.Companion.OnMoveListener) { rockerView.listener = listener }
    fun setSpeedState(route: Boolean, speed: Double) {
        this.route = route
        if (!draggingSpeed) displayedSpeed = speed.coerceIn(0.0, 1000.0)
    }
    private fun changeSpeed(speed: Double) {
        displayedSpeed = (round(speed * 100.0) / 100.0).coerceIn(0.0, 1000.0)
        onSpeedChanged?.invoke(displayedSpeed)
    }
    private fun drag(dx: Float, dy: Float) {
        if (!isStart) return
        layoutParams.x += dx.toInt()
        layoutParams.y += dy.toInt()
        clampPosition()
        windowManager.updateViewLayout(root, layoutParams)
    }
    private fun savePosition() { context.rockerCoords = layoutParams.x to layoutParams.y }
    private fun clampPosition() {
        if (!isStart) return
        val metrics = windowManager.currentWindowMetrics
        val insets = metrics.windowInsets.getInsetsIgnoringVisibility(
            android.view.WindowInsets.Type.systemBars() or android.view.WindowInsets.Type.displayCutout())
        val maxX = (metrics.bounds.width() - insets.left - insets.right - root.width).coerceAtLeast(0)
        val maxY = (metrics.bounds.height() - insets.top - insets.bottom - root.height).coerceAtLeast(0)
        val x = layoutParams.x.coerceIn(0, maxX)
        val y = layoutParams.y.coerceIn(0, maxY)
        if (x != layoutParams.x || y != layoutParams.y) {
            layoutParams.x = x
            layoutParams.y = y
            windowManager.updateViewLayout(root, layoutParams)
            savePosition()
        }
    }
}
```

`app/src/main/java/com/system/location/service/ui/mock/RockerOverlay.kt`:

```kt
package com.system.location.service.ui.mock

import android.content.Context
import android.content.SharedPreferences
import android.hardware.display.DisplayManager
import android.util.Log
import android.view.ContextThemeWrapper
import android.view.Display
import android.view.WindowManager
import android.widget.Toast
import androidx.compose.runtime.getValue
import androidx.compose.runtime.mutableStateOf
import androidx.compose.runtime.setValue
import com.system.location.service.LocationServiceApp
import com.system.location.service.R
import com.system.location.service.android.widget.RockerView
import com.system.location.service.android.window.OverlayUtils
import com.system.location.service.core.runtime.RuntimePhase
import com.system.location.service.ext.sharedPrefs
import com.system.location.service.ext.speed
import com.system.location.service.runtime.ScenarioRuntime
import kotlinx.coroutines.CoroutineScope
import kotlinx.coroutines.Dispatchers
import kotlinx.coroutines.SupervisorJob
import kotlinx.coroutines.flow.distinctUntilChanged
import kotlinx.coroutines.flow.map
import kotlinx.coroutines.launch

/** Main-thread owner of the overlay, independent of navigation and playback lifetime. */
object RockerOverlay {
    private val context get() = LocationServiceApp.appContext
    private val preferences get() = context.getSharedPreferences("rocker_overlay", Context.MODE_PRIVATE)
    private val scope = CoroutineScope(SupervisorJob() + Dispatchers.Main.immediate)
    private var rocker: Rocker? = null
    private var observing = false
    private var overlayNightMode: Int? = null
    private var moving = false
    private var locked = false
    private var bearing = 0.0
    private var strength = 0.0
    private val speedPreferenceListener = SharedPreferences.OnSharedPreferenceChangeListener { _, key ->
        if (key == "speed") scope.launch { updateSpeedState() }
    }
    val isEnabled get() = preferences.getBoolean("enabled", true)
    var isVisible by mutableStateOf(false)
        private set

    fun refresh(): Boolean {
        if (!isEnabled || !OverlayUtils.hasOverlayPermissions(context)) {
            moving = false
            locked = false
            publishMotion()
            rocker?.hide()
            isVisible = false
            return false
        }
        val nightMode = context.resources.configuration.uiMode and android.content.res.Configuration.UI_MODE_NIGHT_MASK
        if (rocker != null && overlayNightMode != nightMode) {
            moving = false
            locked = false
            publishMotion()
            rocker?.hide()
            isVisible = false
            rocker = null
        }
        overlayNightMode = nightMode
        if (!observing) {
            observing = true
            context.sharedPrefs.registerOnSharedPreferenceChangeListener(speedPreferenceListener)
            scope.launch {
                ScenarioRuntime.state.map { Triple(it.phase, it.scenarioId, it.startedAt) }
                    .distinctUntilChanged().collect {
                        moving = false
                        locked = false
                        if (it.first == RuntimePhase.PAUSED) publishMotion()
                        rocker?.resetMovement()
                        updatePlaybackState()
                    }
            }
            scope.launch {
                ScenarioRuntime.state.map { Triple(it.phase, it.routeId, it.configuredSpeedMps) }
                    .distinctUntilChanged().collect { updateSpeedState() }
            }
        }
        return try {
            val window = rocker ?: Rocker(ContextThemeWrapper(
                context.createDisplayContext(context.getSystemService(DisplayManager::class.java)
                    .getDisplay(Display.DEFAULT_DISPLAY))
                    .createWindowContext(WindowManager.LayoutParams.TYPE_APPLICATION_OVERLAY, null), R.style.AppTheme
            )).also { view ->
                rocker = view
                view.onSpeedChanged = { speed ->
                    val change = ScenarioRuntime.setSpeed(speed)
                    scope.launch {
                        if (!change.await()) {
                            updateSpeedState()
                            Toast.makeText(context, R.string.overlay_speed_failed, Toast.LENGTH_SHORT).show()
                        }
                    }
                }
                view.setRockerListener(object : RockerView.Companion.OnMoveListener {
                    override fun onStarted() {
                        bearing = ScenarioRuntime.state.value.sample?.bearing?.toDouble() ?: bearing
                        moving = true
                    }
                    override fun onAngle(angle: Double) {
                        bearing = angle
                        publishMotion()
                    }
                    override fun onStrength(strength: Double) { this@RockerOverlay.strength = strength }
                    override fun onLockChanged(isLocked: Boolean) { locked = isLocked }
                    override fun onFinished() {
                        if (!locked) {
                            moving = false
                            publishMotion()
                        }
                    }
                })
            }
            updatePlaybackState()
            updateSpeedState()
            window.show()
            isVisible = window.isStart
            true
        } catch (error: RuntimeException) {
            Log.e("RockerOverlay", "Unable to show floating rocker", error)
            false
        }
    }

    fun setEnabled(enabled: Boolean): Boolean {
        preferences.edit().putBoolean("enabled", enabled).apply()
        if (enabled) return refresh()
        moving = false
        locked = false
        publishMotion()
        rocker?.hide()
        isVisible = false
        return true
    }

    private fun publishMotion() {
        val state = ScenarioRuntime.state.value
        if (state.routeId == null && state.phase in setOf(RuntimePhase.RUNNING, RuntimePhase.PAUSED)) {
            ScenarioRuntime.motion(bearing, moving, strength)
        }
    }

    private fun updatePlaybackState() {
        val state = ScenarioRuntime.state.value
        rocker?.setPlaybackState(state.phase, state.routeId != null, state.holdingPosition)
    }

    private fun updateSpeedState() {
        val state = ScenarioRuntime.state.value
        rocker?.setSpeedState(state.isActive && state.routeId != null,
            if (state.isActive) state.configuredSpeedMps ?: context.speed else context.speed)
    }
}
```

`app/src/main/java/com/system/location/service/ui/mock/RockerPanel.kt`:

```kt
package com.system.location.service.ui.mock

import androidx.compose.foundation.gestures.detectDragGestures
import androidx.compose.foundation.layout.*
import androidx.compose.material3.*
import androidx.compose.runtime.Composable
import androidx.compose.ui.Modifier
import androidx.compose.ui.input.pointer.pointerInput
import androidx.compose.ui.platform.testTag
import androidx.compose.ui.res.painterResource
import androidx.compose.ui.res.stringResource
import androidx.compose.ui.semantics.contentDescription
import androidx.compose.ui.semantics.semantics
import androidx.compose.ui.semantics.stateDescription
import androidx.compose.ui.unit.dp
import androidx.compose.ui.viewinterop.AndroidView
import com.system.location.service.R
import com.system.location.service.android.widget.RockerView
import kotlin.math.ceil

@Composable
internal fun RockerPanel(minimized: Boolean, expanded: Boolean, status: String, speed: Double,
    route: Boolean, canMove: Boolean, targetsEnabled: Boolean, rocker: RockerView,
    onMinimize: (Boolean) -> Unit, onExpand: () -> Unit, onTargets: () -> Unit,
    onSpeed: (Double) -> Unit, onDraggingSpeed: (Boolean) -> Unit,
    onDrag: (Float, Float) -> Unit, onDragEnd: () -> Unit) {
    val drag = Modifier.pointerInput(Unit) {
        detectDragGestures(onDragEnd = onDragEnd, onDragCancel = onDragEnd) { change, delta ->
            change.consume()
            onDrag(delta.x, delta.y)
        }
    }
    val title = stringResource(if (route) R.string.overlay_route_speed else R.string.rocker_speed)
    Surface(Modifier.padding(6.dp).testTag("rocker_overlay"), shape = MaterialTheme.shapes.large,
        shadowElevation = 6.dp, color = MaterialTheme.colorScheme.surface) {
        if (minimized) IconButton(onClick = { onMinimize(false) },
            modifier = drag.size(48.dp).semantics { stateDescription = status }.testTag("rocker_expand")) {
            Icon(painterResource(R.drawable.ic_home_rocker), stringResource(R.string.overlay_expand),
                tint = MaterialTheme.colorScheme.primary)
        } else Column(Modifier.width(184.dp).padding(8.dp)) {
            Row {
                Icon(painterResource(R.drawable.rocker_grip), stringResource(R.string.overlay_drag),
                    modifier = drag.weight(1f).height(48.dp).padding(12.dp).semantics { stateDescription = status })
                IconButton(onClick = onTargets, enabled = targetsEnabled, modifier = Modifier.size(48.dp)) {
                    Icon(painterResource(R.drawable.baseline_robot_24), stringResource(R.string.overlay_target_menu))
                }
                IconButton(onClick = { onMinimize(true) }, modifier = Modifier.size(48.dp)) {
                    Icon(painterResource(R.drawable.baseline_close_24), stringResource(R.string.overlay_minimize))
                }
            }
            AndroidView(factory = {
                (rocker.parent as? android.view.ViewGroup)?.removeView(rocker)
                rocker
            }, update = { it.isEnabled = canMove; it.alpha = if (canMove) 1f else .55f; it.stateDescription = status },
                modifier = Modifier.fillMaxWidth().height(152.dp).testTag("rocker_direction"))
            TextButton(onClick = onExpand, modifier = Modifier.fillMaxWidth().testTag("rocker_speed_toggle")) {
                Text(stringResource(R.string.overlay_speed_value, speed))
            }
            if (expanded) {
                Row(Modifier.fillMaxWidth(), horizontalArrangement = Arrangement.SpaceBetween) {
                    IconButton(onClick = { onSpeed(speed - .1) }, enabled = speed > 0) { Text("−") }
                    Text(stringResource(R.string.overlay_speed_number, speed), Modifier.padding(top = 12.dp))
                    IconButton(onClick = { onSpeed(speed + .1) }, enabled = speed < 1000) { Text("+") }
                }
                Text(stringResource(R.string.speed_kmh, speed * 3.6), style = MaterialTheme.typography.bodySmall)
                Slider(value = speed.toFloat(), onValueChange = { onDraggingSpeed(true); onSpeed(it.toDouble()) },
                    onValueChangeFinished = { onDraggingSpeed(false) },
                    valueRange = 0f..maxOf(50.0, ceil(speed / 10.0) * 10.0).toFloat(),
                    modifier = Modifier.semantics { contentDescription = title }.testTag("rocker_speed_slider"))
            }
        }
    }
}
```
