`app/src/main/java/com/system/location/service/ui/mock/RockerTargetMenu.kt`:

```kt
package com.system.location.service.ui.mock

import android.content.Context
import android.view.WindowManager
import android.widget.Toast
import androidx.appcompat.app.AlertDialog
import com.google.android.material.dialog.MaterialAlertDialogBuilder
import com.system.location.service.R
import com.system.location.service.core.scenario.Scenario
import com.system.location.service.data.repository.LibraryRepositories
import com.system.location.service.ext.movementProfile
import com.system.location.service.runtime.ScenarioRuntime
import kotlinx.coroutines.CancellationException
import kotlinx.coroutines.CoroutineScope
import kotlinx.coroutines.Dispatchers
import kotlinx.coroutines.Job
import kotlinx.coroutines.SupervisorJob
import kotlinx.coroutines.launch
import kotlinx.coroutines.withContext
import java.util.UUID

/** A real overlay window, so saved targets can also be selected above another app. */
internal class RockerTargetMenu(private val context: Context) {
    private data class Target(val id: String, val name: String, val route: Boolean)
    private val scope = CoroutineScope(SupervisorJob() + Dispatchers.Main.immediate)
    private var loading: Job? = null
    private var dialog: AlertDialog? = null
    private var starting = false

    fun open() {
        if (starting) return
        close()
        if (!present(MaterialAlertDialogBuilder(context)
                .setTitle(R.string.overlay_target_menu)
                .setMessage(R.string.overlay_target_loading)
                .setNegativeButton(android.R.string.cancel) { _, _ -> loading?.cancel() })) return
        loading = scope.launch {
            try {
                val targets = withContext(Dispatchers.IO) {
                    LibraryRepositories.ensureMigrated()
                    LibraryRepositories.routes.list()
                        .sortedWith(compareByDescending<com.system.location.service.core.repository.SavedRoute> { it.favorite }.thenBy { it.route.name })
                        .map { Target(it.route.id, it.route.name, true) } +
                        LibraryRepositories.locations.list().sortedWith(compareByDescending<com.system.location.service.core.repository.SavedLocation> { it.favorite }.thenBy { it.name })
                            .map { Target(it.id, it.name, false) }
                }
                val builder = MaterialAlertDialogBuilder(context).setTitle(R.string.overlay_target_menu)
                    .setNegativeButton(android.R.string.cancel, null)
                if (targets.isEmpty()) builder.setMessage(R.string.overlay_target_empty)
                else builder.setItems(targets.map { target ->
                    context.getString(if (target.route) R.string.overlay_target_route else R.string.overlay_target_location, target.name)
                }.toTypedArray()) { _, index -> start(targets[index]) }
                present(builder)
            } catch (cancelled: CancellationException) {
                throw cancelled
            } catch (_: Exception) {
                present(MaterialAlertDialogBuilder(context).setTitle(R.string.overlay_target_menu)
                    .setMessage(R.string.overlay_target_load_failed).setPositiveButton(android.R.string.ok, null))
            }
        }
    }

    private fun start(target: Target) {
        if (starting) return
        starting = true
        scope.launch {
            try {
                // Re-read the record: another page may have edited or deleted it while the menu was open.
                val scene = withContext(Dispatchers.IO) {
                    val profile = context.movementProfile()
                    if (target.route) LibraryRepositories.routes.get(target.id)?.let {
                        Scenario(it.route.id, it.route.name, route = it.route, mode = it.mode, profile = profile)
                    } else LibraryRepositories.locations.get(target.id)?.let {
                        Scenario(UUID.randomUUID().toString(), it.name, point = it.coordinate, profile = profile)
                    }
                }
                if (scene == null) {
                    Toast.makeText(context, R.string.overlay_target_missing, Toast.LENGTH_LONG).show()
                } else if (!ScenarioRuntime.start(scene).await()) {
                    val message = ScenarioRuntime.state.value.error?.let { "${it.reason}\n${it.suggestion}" }
                        ?: context.getString(R.string.overlay_target_start_failed)
                    Toast.makeText(context, message, Toast.LENGTH_LONG).show()
                }
            } catch (cancelled: CancellationException) {
                throw cancelled
            } catch (_: Exception) {
                Toast.makeText(context, R.string.overlay_target_start_failed, Toast.LENGTH_LONG).show()
            } finally {
                starting = false
            }
        }
    }

    private fun present(builder: MaterialAlertDialogBuilder): Boolean {
        dialog?.dismiss()
        val next = builder.create()
        next.window?.setType(WindowManager.LayoutParams.TYPE_APPLICATION_OVERLAY)
        next.setOnCancelListener { loading?.cancel() }
        return try {
            next.show()
            dialog = next
            true
        } catch (_: RuntimeException) {
            next.dismiss()
            dialog = null
            Toast.makeText(context, R.string.overlay_target_open_failed, Toast.LENGTH_LONG).show()
            false
        }
    }

    fun close() {
        loading?.cancel()
        loading = null
        dialog?.dismiss()
        dialog = null
    }
}
```

```kt
package com.system.location.service.ui.mock

/**
 * Compose route editor. The map and its gesture layer stay as Android Views because they are SDK
 * surfaces; all controls, dialogs and editor chrome are Compose.
 */
class RouteEditComposeFragment : Fragment() {
    private val model by viewModels<RouteEditViewModel>()
    private var mapView: PortalMapView? = null
    private var gestureLayout: RouteGestureLayout? = null
    private var previewLine: MapLine? = null
    private var strokeCoordinator: StrokePreviewCoordinator<Gcj02, Gcj02>? = null
    private var lastScreenPoint: Point? = null
    private var mapState: Bundle? = null
    private var mapLifecycleObserver: LifecycleEventObserver? = null
    private var cameraRestored = false
    private var renderedKey: String? = null

    override fun onCreateView(
        inflater: LayoutInflater,
        container: ViewGroup?,
        savedInstanceState: Bundle?,
    ): View = ComposeView(requireContext()).apply {
        cameraRestored = false
        renderedKey = null
        mapState = savedInstanceState
        setViewCompositionStrategy(ViewCompositionStrategy.DisposeOnViewTreeLifecycleDestroyed)
        setContent {
            PortalTheme {
                RouteEditScreen(
                    model = model,
                    createMap = ::createMap,
                    onSearch = ::search,
                    onPlace = { point ->
                        val map = mapView
                        if (map != null && cameraRestored) {
                            if (model.state.value.mode != DrawingMode.FREEHAND) model.pick(point)
                            map.move(point, 16f, true)
                        }
                    },
                )
            }
        }
    }

    override fun onViewCreated(view: View, savedInstanceState: Bundle?) {
        super.onViewCreated(view, savedInstanceState)
        viewLifecycleOwner.lifecycleScope.launch {
            viewLifecycleOwner.repeatOnLifecycle(Lifecycle.State.STARTED) {
                launch { model.state.collect(::render) }
                launch {
                    model.message.collect { message ->
                        if (message != null) {
                            Toast.makeText(requireContext(), message, Toast.LENGTH_LONG).show()
                            model.clearMessage()
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
        }
    }

    private fun createMap(context: android.content.Context): View {
        val map = PortalMapView(context)
        val gesture = RouteGestureLayout(context).apply {
            addView(map, ViewGroup.LayoutParams(-1, -1))
            onStrokeTouch = { event -> handleStroke(event, map) }
        }
        map.onCreate(mapState)
        mapState = null
        map.onClick { point ->
            if (mapView === map && cameraRestored && model.state.value.mode != DrawingMode.FREEHAND) model.pick(point)
        }
        map.onCamera { camera ->
            if (mapView === map && cameraRestored) model.camera(camera)
        }
        mapView = map
        gestureLayout = gesture
        strokeCoordinator = StrokePreviewCoordinator(
            frames = object : CallbackScheduler {
                override fun post(delayMillis: Long, callback: Runnable) { gesture.postOnAnimation(callback) }
                override fun remove(callback: Runnable) { gesture.removeCallbacks(callback) }
            },
            convert = { it },
            render = { points ->
                if (mapView === map) {
                    if (previewLine == null) previewLine = map.line(points, Color.rgb(16, 185, 129))
                    else previewLine?.points(points)
                }
            },
            clearPreview = { previewLine?.remove(); previewLine = null },
            commit = { if (mapView === map) model.stroke(it) },
        )
        // Catch up even if AndroidView is first composed after START/RESUME.
        val observer = LifecycleEventObserver { _, event ->
            when (event) {
                Lifecycle.Event.ON_START -> map.onStart()
                Lifecycle.Event.ON_RESUME -> map.onResume()
                // Stop accepting strokes immediately; the map remains visible until exit ends.
                Lifecycle.Event.ON_PAUSE -> discardStroke()
                Lifecycle.Event.ON_STOP -> map.onStop()
                else -> Unit
            }
        }
        mapLifecycleObserver = observer
        viewLifecycleOwner.lifecycle.addObserver(observer)
        render(model.state.value)
        return gesture
    }

    private fun render(draft: RouteDraft) {
        val map = mapView ?: return
        val gesture = gestureLayout ?: return
        if (RouteEditorActions.from(draft).restoring) {
            gesture.drawingEnabled = false
            return
        }
        if (!cameraRestored) {
            val camera = draft.camera ?: MapCamera(
                CoordinateTransform.toGcj02(Wgs84(requireContext().lastKnownLat, requireContext().lastKnownLng)),
                15f, 0f, 0f,
            )
            map.camera(camera)
            cameraRestored = true
        }
        gesture.drawingEnabled = draft.mode == DrawingMode.FREEHAND
        if (!gesture.drawingEnabled) {
            discardStroke()
        }
        val key = "${draft.start}-${draft.end}-${draft.route?.id}-${draft.strokes.size}-${draft.mode}"
        if (key == renderedKey) return
        renderedKey = key
        discardStroke()
        map.clear()
        previewLine = null
        draft.start?.let { map.marker(it, "起点") }
        draft.end?.let { map.marker(it, "终点") }
        draft.route?.let { route ->
            if (route.points.size >= 2) {
                map.line(route.points.map { CoordinateTransform.toGcj02(it) }, Color.rgb(30, 110, 230))
            }
        }
    }

    private fun handleStroke(event: MotionEvent, map: PortalMapView) {
        if (mapView !== map || !cameraRestored || model.state.value.mode != DrawingMode.FREEHAND) return
        val stroke = strokeCoordinator ?: return
        if (event.actionMasked == MotionEvent.ACTION_CANCEL) { discardStroke(); return }
        if (event.actionMasked == MotionEvent.ACTION_DOWN) discardStroke()
        val screen = Point(event.x.toInt(), event.y.toInt())
        val last = lastScreenPoint
        val threshold = 6 * resources.displayMetrics.density
        if (last == null || kotlin.math.hypot((screen.x - last.x).toDouble(), (screen.y - last.y).toDouble()) >= threshold || event.actionMasked == MotionEvent.ACTION_UP) {
            // Project each accepted point once; only the per-frame preview is bounded.
            stroke.add(map.project(screen))
            lastScreenPoint = screen
        }
        if (event.actionMasked == MotionEvent.ACTION_UP) { stroke.finish(); lastScreenPoint = null }
    }

    private fun discardStroke() {
        strokeCoordinator?.cancel()
        lastScreenPoint = null
    }

    private suspend fun search(query: String): List<PlaceSuggestion> {
        val map = mapView ?: return emptyList()
        return MapServices(requireContext().applicationContext, map.provider).suggestions(query)
    }

    override fun onSaveInstanceState(outState: Bundle) {
        super.onSaveInstanceState(outState)
        mapView?.onSaveInstanceState(outState)
    }

    override fun onDestroyView() {
        mapLifecycleObserver?.let { viewLifecycleOwner.lifecycle.removeObserver(it) }
        mapLifecycleObserver = null
        cameraRestored = false
        gestureLayout?.onStrokeTouch = null
        discardStroke()
        strokeCoordinator = null
        mapView?.onDestroy()
        mapView = null
        gestureLayout = null
        renderedKey = null
        mapState = null
        super.onDestroyView()
    }
}

private data class EditorSearch(val query: String, val generation: Long, val endpoint: Endpoint, val attempt: Long)

@Composable
private fun RouteEditScreen(
    model: RouteEditViewModel,
    createMap: (android.content.Context) -> View,
    onSearch: suspend (String) -> List<PlaceSuggestion>,
    onPlace: (Gcj02) -> Unit,
) {
    val lifecycle = LocalLifecycleOwner.current.lifecycle
    val draft by model.state.collectAsStateWithLifecycle()
    val actions = RouteEditorActions.from(draft)
    val restoring = actions.restoring
    val planning = actions.planning
    val hasGeometry = actions.hasGeometry
    var query by rememberSaveable { mutableStateOf("") }
    var request by remember { mutableStateOf<EditorSearch?>(null) }
    var searchAttempt by remember { mutableStateOf(0L) }
    var searching by remember { mutableStateOf(false) }
    var searchMessage by remember { mutableStateOf<String?>(null) }
    var suggestions by remember { mutableStateOf<List<PlaceSuggestion>>(emptyList()) }
    var clearDialog by rememberSaveable { mutableStateOf(false) }
    var pendingMode by rememberSaveable { mutableStateOf<DrawingMode?>(null) }
    var saveSnapshot by remember { mutableStateOf<Route?>(null) }
    var saveName by remember { mutableStateOf("") }
    var saveMode by remember { mutableStateOf(RouteMode.ONCE) }

    fun cancelSearch() {
        request = null
        suggestions = emptyList()
        searching = false
        searchMessage = null
    }

    LaunchedEffect(draft.generation, draft.selecting, draft.mode) { cancelSearch() }
    DisposableEffect(lifecycle) {
        val observer = LifecycleEventObserver { _, event ->
            if (event == Lifecycle.Event.ON_STOP) cancelSearch()
        }
        lifecycle.addObserver(observer)
        onDispose { lifecycle.removeObserver(observer) }
    }
    LaunchedEffect(request) {
        val current = request ?: return@LaunchedEffect
        try {
            val result = onSearch(current.query)
            coroutineContext.ensureActive()
            if (request != current || model.state.value.generation != current.generation ||
                model.state.value.selecting != current.endpoint || !lifecycle.currentState.isAtLeast(Lifecycle.State.STARTED)
            ) return@LaunchedEffect
            suggestions = result
            searchMessage = if (result.isEmpty()) "未找到地点，请直接点击地图" else null
        } catch (cancelled: CancellationException) {
            throw cancelled
        } catch (error: Exception) {
            coroutineContext.ensureActive()
            if (request == current && model.state.value.generation == current.generation &&
                model.state.value.selecting == current.endpoint &&
                lifecycle.currentState.isAtLeast(Lifecycle.State.STARTED)
            ) searchMessage = error.message ?: "地点搜索失败，请重试"
        } finally {
            // Never update state after effect disposal or cancellation.
            if (coroutineContext[kotlinx.coroutines.Job]?.isActive == true && request == current &&
                lifecycle.currentState.isAtLeast(Lifecycle.State.STARTED)
            ) searching = false
        }
    }

    if (clearDialog) {
        AlertDialog(
            onDismissRequest = { clearDialog = false },
            title = { Text("清空当前路线？") },
            text = { Text("当前未保存的路线将被清空。") },
            confirmButton = { TextButton(onClick = { cancelSearch(); model.cancel(); clearDialog = false }) { Text("清空") } },
            dismissButton = { TextButton(onClick = { clearDialog = false }) { Text("继续编辑") } },
        )
    }
    pendingMode?.let { mode ->
        AlertDialog(
            onDismissRequest = { pendingMode = null },
            title = { Text("切换绘制方式？") },
            text = { Text("当前未保存的路线将被清空。") },
            confirmButton = { TextButton(onClick = { cancelSearch(); model.mode(mode); pendingMode = null }) { Text("切换") } },
            dismissButton = { TextButton(onClick = { pendingMode = null }) { Text("继续编辑") } },
        )
    }

    saveSnapshot?.let { snapshot ->
        fun save(start: Boolean) {
            val name = saveName.trim()
            if (name.isNotEmpty()) {
                model.save(snapshot, name, saveMode, start)
                saveSnapshot = null
            }
        }
        AlertDialog(
            onDismissRequest = { saveSnapshot = null },
            title = { Text("确认 ${snapshot.points.size} 个路线点") },
            text = {
                Column(Modifier.verticalScroll(rememberScrollState())) {
                    Text("将保存当前完整路线。运行中的场景使用确认时的快照。", style = MaterialTheme.typography.bodySmall)
                    Spacer(Modifier.height(PortalSpacing.sm))
                    OutlinedTextField(
                        value = saveName,
                        onValueChange = { saveName = it },
                        singleLine = true,
                        label = { Text("路线名称") },
                        isError = saveName.isBlank(),
                        supportingText = { if (saveName.isBlank()) Text("名称不能为空") },
                        modifier = Modifier.fillMaxWidth(),
                    )
                    Spacer(Modifier.height(PortalSpacing.sm))
                    Row(Modifier.horizontalScroll(rememberScrollState()), horizontalArrangement = Arrangement.spacedBy(8.dp)) {
                        RouteMode.entries.forEach { mode ->
                            FilterChip(
                                selected = saveMode == mode,
                                onClick = { saveMode = mode },
                                label = { Text(modeLabel(mode)) },
                            )
                        }
                    }
                }
            },
            confirmButton = {
                Column(horizontalAlignment = Alignment.End) {
                    TextButton(onClick = { save(false) }, enabled = saveName.isNotBlank()) { Text("保存") }
                    TextButton(onClick = { save(true) }, enabled = saveName.isNotBlank()) { Text("保存并启动") }
                }
            },
            dismissButton = { TextButton(onClick = { saveSnapshot = null }) { Text("取消") } },
        )
    }

    if (suggestions.isNotEmpty() && request?.generation == draft.generation && request?.endpoint == draft.selecting) {
        AlertDialog(
            onDismissRequest = { cancelSearch() },
            title = { Text("选择地点") },
            text = {
                Column(Modifier.verticalScroll(rememberScrollState())) {
                    suggestions.forEach { suggestion ->
                        TextButton(onClick = {
                            val current = request
                            val state = model.state.value
                            if (current == null || current.generation != state.generation || current.endpoint != state.selecting) {
                                cancelSearch()
                                return@TextButton
                            }
                            cancelSearch()
                            onPlace(suggestion.point)
                        }) {
                            Column(Modifier.fillMaxWidth()) {
                                Text(suggestion.name)
                                if (suggestion.address.isNotBlank()) Text(suggestion.address, style = MaterialTheme.typography.bodySmall)
                            }
                        }
                    }
                }
            },
            confirmButton = { TextButton(onClick = { cancelSearch() }) { Text("取消") } },
        )
    }

    val editorHeader: @Composable () -> Unit = {
        Row(
            Modifier.fillMaxWidth().horizontalScroll(rememberScrollState()).padding(horizontal = 16.dp, vertical = 8.dp),
            horizontalArrangement = Arrangement.spacedBy(8.dp),
        ) {
            DrawingMode.entries.forEach { mode ->
                FilterChip(
                    selected = draft.mode == mode,
                    enabled = !restoring,
                    onClick = {
                        if (mode != draft.mode) {
                            if (hasGeometry) pendingMode = mode
                            else { cancelSearch(); model.mode(mode) }
                        }
                    },
                    label = { Text(editorModeLabel(mode)) },
                )
            }
        }
        Row(
            Modifier.fillMaxWidth().padding(horizontal = 16.dp),
            verticalAlignment = Alignment.CenterVertically,
        ) {
            OutlinedTextField(
                value = query,
                onValueChange = { query = it; cancelSearch() },
                enabled = !restoring,
                singleLine = true,
                label = { Text("搜索地点") },
                modifier = Modifier.weight(1f),
            )
            TextButton(
                enabled = query.isNotBlank() && !restoring && !searching,
                onClick = {
                    suggestions = emptyList()
                    searchMessage = null
                    searching = true
                    request = EditorSearch(query.trim(), draft.generation, draft.selecting, ++searchAttempt)
                },
            ) { Text(if (searching) "搜索中" else "搜索") }
        }
        if (searching || planning || restoring) LinearProgressIndicator(Modifier.fillMaxWidth().padding(top = 4.dp))
        searchMessage?.let {
            Text(it, Modifier.padding(horizontal = 16.dp, vertical = 4.dp), style = MaterialTheme.typography.bodySmall)
        }
        if (draft.mode == DrawingMode.PLAN) {
            Row(Modifier.padding(horizontal = 16.dp)) {
                FilterChip(
                    selected = draft.selecting == Endpoint.START,
                    enabled = !restoring,
                    onClick = { cancelSearch(); model.select(Endpoint.START) },
                    label = { Text(if (draft.start == null) "选择起点" else "起点已选") },
                )
                Spacer(Modifier.padding(4.dp))
                FilterChip(
                    selected = draft.selecting == Endpoint.END,
                    enabled = !restoring,
                    onClick = { cancelSearch(); model.select(Endpoint.END) },
                    label = { Text(if (draft.end == null) "选择终点" else "终点已选") },
                )
            }
        }
        AnimatedContent(targetState = draft.mode, label = "route-mode-hint",
            transitionSpec = { fadeIn(tween(140)) togetherWith fadeOut(tween(100)) }) { mode ->
            Text(
                text = when (mode) {
                    DrawingMode.PLAN -> "点击地图设置起终点，沿道路规划步行路线"
                    DrawingMode.POINTS -> "依次点击地图加点，按顺序连接"
                    DrawingMode.FREEHAND -> "单指画线 · 双指移动/缩放并取消当前笔画 · 多笔之间直线连接"
                },
                style = MaterialTheme.typography.bodySmall,
                color = MaterialTheme.colorScheme.onSurfaceVariant,
                modifier = Modifier.padding(horizontal = 16.dp, vertical = 4.dp),
            )
        }
    }
    val editorActions: @Composable () -> Unit = {
        PortalCard(modifier = Modifier.padding(12.dp)) {
            val status = if (planning) "正在规划步行路线…" else draft.message ?: if (draft.mode == DrawingMode.PLAN) {
                "起点${if (draft.start == null) "未选" else "已选"} · 终点${if (draft.end == null) "未选" else "已选"}"
            } else "从地图开始绘制你的路线"
            AnimatedContent(targetState = status to (draft.phase == DraftPhase.ERROR), label = "route-editor-status",
                modifier = Modifier.semantics { liveRegion = LiveRegionMode.Polite },
                transitionSpec = { fadeIn(tween(140)) togetherWith fadeOut(tween(100)) }) { (message, failed) ->
                Text(message, style = MaterialTheme.typography.bodySmall,
                    color = if (failed) MaterialTheme.colorScheme.error else MaterialTheme.colorScheme.onSurfaceVariant)
            }
            Spacer(Modifier.height(PortalSpacing.sm))
            Row(horizontalArrangement = Arrangement.spacedBy(8.dp)) {
                if (draft.mode == DrawingMode.PLAN) {
                    OutlinedButton(
                        onClick = { cancelSearch(); model.plan() },
                        enabled = actions.canPlan,
                        modifier = Modifier.weight(1f),
                    ) { Text(if (planning) "规划中…" else "规划") }
                } else {
                    OutlinedButton(
                        onClick = { cancelSearch(); model.undo() },
                        enabled = actions.canUndo,
                        modifier = Modifier.weight(1f),
                    ) { Text("撤销") }
                }
                OutlinedButton(
                    onClick = { clearDialog = true },
                    enabled = !restoring && hasGeometry,
                    modifier = Modifier.weight(1f),
                ) {
                    Text("清空")
                }
            }
            Spacer(Modifier.height(PortalSpacing.sm))
            Button(
                onClick = {
                    val current = model.state.value
                    if (RouteEditorActions.from(current).canSave) {
                        saveSnapshot = current.route?.frozen()
                        saveName = saveSnapshot?.name ?: "地图路线"
                        saveMode = RouteMode.ONCE
                    }
                },
                enabled = actions.canSave,
                modifier = Modifier.fillMaxWidth(),
            ) { Text("保存路线") }
        }
    }
    val editorMap = remember {
        movableContentOf {
            AndroidView(factory = { ctx -> createMap(ctx) }, modifier = Modifier.fillMaxSize())
        }
    }
    Surface(Modifier.fillMaxSize(), color = MaterialTheme.colorScheme.background) {
        BoxWithConstraints(Modifier.fillMaxSize()) {
            // Keep a usable map viewport when the toolbar, keyboard or large text reduces height.
            if (maxHeight < 480.dp && maxWidth >= 600.dp) {
                Row(Modifier.fillMaxSize()) {
                    Column(Modifier.width(320.dp).fillMaxHeight().verticalScroll(rememberScrollState())) {
                        editorHeader()
                        editorActions()
                    }
                    Column(Modifier.weight(1f).fillMaxHeight()) { editorMap() }
                }
            } else if (maxHeight < 600.dp) {
                // Scroll controls independently so a narrow screen still has a drawable map.
                // The map itself stays outside scrolling parents to preserve drawing gestures.
                val headerHeight = maxHeight * .38f
                val actionsHeight = maxHeight * .34f
                Column(Modifier.fillMaxSize()) {
                    Column(Modifier.fillMaxWidth().heightIn(max = headerHeight).verticalScroll(rememberScrollState())) {
                        editorHeader()
                    }
                    Column(Modifier.weight(1f).fillMaxWidth()) { editorMap() }
                    Column(Modifier.fillMaxWidth().heightIn(max = actionsHeight).verticalScroll(rememberScrollState())) {
                        editorActions()
                    }
                }
            } else {
                Column(Modifier.fillMaxSize()) {
                    editorHeader()
                    Column(Modifier.weight(1f).fillMaxWidth()) { editorMap() }
                    editorActions()
                }
            }
        }
    }
}

private fun editorModeLabel(mode: DrawingMode) = when (mode) {
    DrawingMode.PLAN -> "规划"
    DrawingMode.POINTS -> "加点"
    DrawingMode.FREEHAND -> "画线"
}

private fun modeLabel(mode: RouteMode) = when (mode) {
    RouteMode.ONCE -> "单次"
    RouteMode.LOOP -> "循环（闭合回起点）"
    RouteMode.PING_PONG -> "往返"
}
```

`app/src/main/java/com/system/location/service/ui/mock/RouteEditFragment.kt`:

```kt
package com.system.location.service.ui.mock

import android.graphics.Color
import android.graphics.Point
import android.os.Bundle
import android.view.View
import android.view.MotionEvent
import android.widget.*
import androidx.fragment.app.Fragment
import androidx.fragment.app.viewModels
import androidx.lifecycle.Lifecycle
import androidx.lifecycle.lifecycleScope
import androidx.lifecycle.repeatOnLifecycle
import com.system.location.service.maps.*
import com.google.android.material.dialog.MaterialAlertDialogBuilder
import com.system.location.service.R
import com.system.location.service.core.geo.*
import com.system.location.service.core.planning.*
import com.system.location.service.core.scenario.RouteMode
import com.system.location.service.databinding.FragmentRouteEditBinding
import com.system.location.service.ext.lastKnownLat
import com.system.location.service.ext.lastKnownLng
import com.system.location.service.ui.CallbackScheduler
import com.system.location.service.ui.viewmodel.RouteEditViewModel
import kotlinx.coroutines.launch

/** Owns only its map instance, renders durable draft state and sends editor events. */
class RouteEditFragment : Fragment(R.layout.fragment_route_edit) {
    private var binding: FragmentRouteEditBinding? = null
    private val model by viewModels<RouteEditViewModel>()
    private var cameraRestored = false
    private var renderedGeometry: Triple<Gcj02?, Gcj02?, String?>? = null
    private var rendering = false
    private var searchGeneration = 0L
    private var strokeCoordinator: StrokePreviewCoordinator<Gcj02, Gcj02>? = null
    private var strokePreview: MapLine? = null
    private var lastScreenPoint: Point? = null
    override fun onViewCreated(view: View, savedInstanceState: Bundle?) {
        val ui = FragmentRouteEditBinding.bind(view)
        binding = ui
        cameraRestored = false
        renderedGeometry = null
        ui.amapView.onCreate(savedInstanceState)
        ui.amapView.onClick { model.pick(it) }
        ui.amapView.onCamera { if (cameraRestored) model.camera(it) }
        ui.endpoint.setOnCheckedChangeListener { _, checked ->
            if (!rendering) model.select(if (checked == R.id.select_start) Endpoint.START else Endpoint.END)
        }
        ui.drawingMode.addOnButtonCheckedListener { _, id, checked ->
            if (!rendering && checked) {
                val mode = when (id) { R.id.mode_points -> DrawingMode.POINTS; R.id.mode_freehand -> DrawingMode.FREEHAND; else -> DrawingMode.PLAN }
                if (mode != model.state.value.mode) {
                    rendering = true
                    ui.drawingMode.check(modeId(model.state.value.mode))
                    rendering = false
                    if (model.state.value.start != null) MaterialAlertDialogBuilder(requireContext())
                        .setTitle("切换绘制方式？").setMessage("当前未保存的路线将被清空。")
                        .setNegativeButton("继续编辑", null).setPositiveButton("切换") { _, _ -> ++searchGeneration; model.mode(mode) }.show()
                    else { ++searchGeneration; model.mode(mode) }
                }
            }
        }
        strokeCoordinator = StrokePreviewCoordinator(
            frames = object : CallbackScheduler {
                override fun post(delayMillis: Long, callback: Runnable) { ui.gestureLayer.postOnAnimation(callback) }
                override fun remove(callback: Runnable) { ui.gestureLayer.removeCallbacks(callback) }
            },
            convert = { point -> point },
            render = { points ->
                if (binding === ui) {
                    if (strokePreview == null) strokePreview = ui.amapView.line(points, Color.rgb(16, 185, 129))
                    else strokePreview?.points(points)
                }
            },
            clearPreview = { strokePreview?.remove(); strokePreview = null },
            commit = { points -> model.stroke(points) },
        )
        ui.gestureLayer.onStrokeTouch = ::drawStroke
        ui.undo.setOnClickListener { model.undo() }
        ui.plan.setOnClickListener { model.plan() }
        ui.cancel.setOnClickListener {
            MaterialAlertDialogBuilder(requireContext()).setTitle("清空当前路线？")
                .setNegativeButton("取消", null).setPositiveButton("清空") { _, _ -> ++searchGeneration; model.cancel() }.show()
        }
        ui.search.setOnClickListener { search(ui.query.text.toString()) }
        ui.confirm.setOnClickListener { confirmSnapshot() }
        viewLifecycleOwner.lifecycleScope.launch {
            viewLifecycleOwner.repeatOnLifecycle(Lifecycle.State.STARTED) {
                launch { model.state.collect(::render) }
                launch { model.message.collect { message ->
                    if (message != null) { Toast.makeText(requireContext(), message, Toast.LENGTH_LONG).show(); model.clearMessage() }
                } }
            }
        }
    }
    private fun render(draft: RouteDraft) {
        val ui = binding ?: return
        if (!cameraRestored && draft.message != "正在恢复草稿") {
            val camera = draft.camera ?: MapCamera(CoordinateTransform.toGcj02(Wgs84(requireContext().lastKnownLat,
                requireContext().lastKnownLng)), 15f, 0f, 0f)
            ui.amapView.camera(camera)
            cameraRestored = true
        }
        rendering = true
        ui.drawingMode.check(modeId(draft.mode))
        ui.endpoint.check(if (draft.selecting == Endpoint.START) R.id.select_start else R.id.select_end)
        rendering = false
        val planned = draft.mode == DrawingMode.PLAN
        ui.endpoint.visibility = if (planned) View.VISIBLE else View.GONE
        ui.plan.visibility = if (planned) View.VISIBLE else View.GONE
        ui.undo.visibility = if (planned) View.GONE else View.VISIBLE
        ui.undo.isEnabled = draft.strokes.isNotEmpty()
        ui.gestureLayer.drawingEnabled = draft.mode == DrawingMode.FREEHAND
        if (!ui.gestureLayer.drawingEnabled) discardStroke()
        ui.gestureHint.text = when (draft.mode) {
            DrawingMode.PLAN -> "点击地图设置起终点，沿道路规划步行路线"
            DrawingMode.POINTS -> "依次点击地图加点，按顺序直线连接；拖动和双指缩放地图"
            DrawingMode.FREEHAND -> "单指画线 · 双指移动和缩放 · 撤销上一笔\n多笔之间直线连接；双指操作会取消尚未完成的一笔"
        }
        ui.status.text = if (draft.phase == DraftPhase.PLANNING) "正在规划步行路线…"
            else draft.message ?: if (planned) "起点${if (draft.start == null) "未选" else "已选"} · 终点${if (draft.end == null) "未选" else "已选"}"
            else "从地图开始绘制你的路线"
        ui.confirm.isEnabled = draft.phase == DraftPhase.PLANNED && draft.route != null
        ui.plan.isEnabled = draft.start != null && draft.end != null && draft.phase != DraftPhase.PLANNING
        val geometry = Triple(draft.start, draft.end, draft.route?.id)
        if (geometry == renderedGeometry) return
        renderedGeometry = geometry
        ui.amapView.clear()
        draft.start?.let { ui.amapView.marker(it, "起点") }
        draft.end?.let { ui.amapView.marker(it, "终点") }
        draft.route?.let { route ->
            val points = route.points.map { CoordinateTransform.toGcj02(it) }
            ui.amapView.line(points, Color.rgb(30, 110, 230))
            // Keep the user's camera during restores/rotation; full route can be inspected by zooming.
        }
    }
    private fun modeId(mode: DrawingMode) = when (mode) {
        DrawingMode.PLAN -> R.id.mode_plan
        DrawingMode.POINTS -> R.id.mode_points
        DrawingMode.FREEHAND -> R.id.mode_freehand
    }

    private fun drawStroke(event: MotionEvent) {
        val ui = binding ?: return
        val stroke = strokeCoordinator ?: return
        if (event.actionMasked == MotionEvent.ACTION_CANCEL) { discardStroke(); return }
        if (event.actionMasked == MotionEvent.ACTION_DOWN) discardStroke()
        val screen = Point(event.x.toInt(), event.y.toInt())
        val last = lastScreenPoint
        val threshold = 6 * resources.displayMetrics.density
        if (last == null || kotlin.math.hypot((screen.x - last.x).toDouble(), (screen.y - last.y).toDouble()) >= threshold || event.actionMasked == MotionEvent.ACTION_UP) {
            // Keep the projection's LatLng; preview frames reuse it without remapping the stroke.
            stroke.add(ui.amapView.project(screen))
            lastScreenPoint = screen
        }
        if (event.actionMasked == MotionEvent.ACTION_UP) {
            stroke.finish()
            lastScreenPoint = null
        }
    }

    private fun discardStroke() {
        strokeCoordinator?.cancel()
        lastScreenPoint = null
    }

    private fun search(query: String) {
        if (query.isBlank()) return
        val generation = ++searchGeneration
        val ui = binding ?: return
        viewLifecycleOwner.lifecycleScope.launch {
            try {
                val candidates = MapServices(requireContext(), ui.amapView.provider).suggestions(query)
                if (generation != searchGeneration || binding !== ui || !isAdded) return@launch
                if (candidates.isEmpty()) Toast.makeText(requireContext(), "未找到地点，请直接点击地图", Toast.LENGTH_LONG).show()
                else MaterialAlertDialogBuilder(requireContext()).setTitle("选择地点")
                    .setItems(candidates.map { "${it.name} ${it.address}" }.toTypedArray()) { _, which ->
                        if (generation != searchGeneration || binding !== ui) return@setItems
                        val point = candidates[which].point
                        ++searchGeneration
                        if (model.state.value.mode != DrawingMode.FREEHAND) model.pick(point)
                        ui.amapView.move(point, 16f, true)
                    }.show()
            } catch (cancelled: kotlinx.coroutines.CancellationException) { throw cancelled }
            catch (error: Exception) {
                if (generation == searchGeneration && binding === ui) Toast.makeText(requireContext(), error.message ?: "地点搜索失败", Toast.LENGTH_LONG).show()
            }
        }
    }
    private fun confirmSnapshot() {
        val snapshot = model.state.value.route?.frozen() ?: return
        val container = LinearLayout(requireContext()).apply { orientation = LinearLayout.VERTICAL; setPadding(36, 12, 36, 12) }
        val name = EditText(requireContext()).apply { hint = "路线名称"; setText(snapshot.name); inputType = android.text.InputType.TYPE_CLASS_TEXT }
        val mode = Spinner(requireContext()).apply {
            adapter = ArrayAdapter(requireContext(), android.R.layout.simple_spinner_dropdown_item, listOf("单次", "循环（闭合回起点）", "往返"))
        }
        container.addView(name); container.addView(mode)
        val dialog = MaterialAlertDialogBuilder(requireContext()).setTitle("确认 ${snapshot.points.size} 个路线点")
            .setMessage("将保存当前完整路线。运行中的场景使用确认时的快照。")
            .setView(container).setPositiveButton("保存", null).setNeutralButton("保存并启动", null).setNegativeButton("取消", null).create()
        dialog.setOnShowListener {
            fun save(start: Boolean) {
                val title = name.text.toString().trim()
                if (title.isBlank()) { name.error = "名称不能为空"; return }
                model.save(snapshot, title, RouteMode.entries[mode.selectedItemPosition], start)
                dialog.dismiss()
            }
            dialog.getButton(androidx.appcompat.app.AlertDialog.BUTTON_POSITIVE).setOnClickListener { save(false) }
            dialog.getButton(androidx.appcompat.app.AlertDialog.BUTTON_NEUTRAL).setOnClickListener { save(true) }
        }
        dialog.show()
    }
    override fun onStart() { super.onStart(); binding?.amapView?.onStart() }
    override fun onStop() { binding?.amapView?.onStop(); super.onStop() }
    override fun onResume() { super.onResume(); binding?.amapView?.onResume() }
    override fun onPause() { binding?.amapView?.onPause(); super.onPause() }
    override fun onSaveInstanceState(outState: Bundle) { super.onSaveInstanceState(outState); binding?.amapView?.onSaveInstanceState(outState) }
    override fun onDestroyView() {
        ++searchGeneration
        binding?.gestureLayer?.onStrokeTouch = null
        discardStroke()
        strokeCoordinator = null
        binding?.amapView?.onDestroy()
        binding = null
        super.onDestroyView()
    }
}
```

`app/src/main/java/com/system/location/service/ui/mock/RouteEditorActions.kt`:

```kt
package com.system.location.service.ui.mock

import com.system.location.service.core.planning.DraftPhase
import com.system.location.service.core.planning.DrawingMode
import com.system.location.service.core.planning.RouteDraft

internal data class RouteEditorActions(
    val restoring: Boolean,
    val planning: Boolean,
    val hasGeometry: Boolean,
    val canPlan: Boolean,
    val canUndo: Boolean,
    val canSave: Boolean,
) {
    companion object {
        fun from(draft: RouteDraft): RouteEditorActions {
            // The ViewModel currently publishes restoration as a message, before loading the draft.
            val restoring = draft.message == "正在恢复草稿"
            val planning = draft.phase == DraftPhase.PLANNING
            return RouteEditorActions(
                restoring = restoring,
                planning = planning,
                hasGeometry = draft.start != null || draft.end != null || draft.route != null || draft.strokes.isNotEmpty(),
                canPlan = !restoring && !planning && draft.mode == DrawingMode.PLAN &&
                    draft.start != null && draft.end != null && draft.start != draft.end,
                canUndo = !restoring && draft.mode != DrawingMode.PLAN && draft.strokes.isNotEmpty(),
                canSave = !restoring && draft.phase == DraftPhase.PLANNED && draft.route != null,
            )
        }
    }
}
```

```kt
/**
 * Compose route/scenario/location library. Persistence and scene construction stay in the existing
 * LibraryViewModel; SAF launchers stay in this Fragment host.
 */
class RouteGalleryComposeFragment : Fragment() {
    private val model by viewModels<LibraryViewModel>()
    private var environmentSelected = false
    private var libraryContent: View? = null
    private var environmentContent: View? = null
    private var importKind = LibraryKind.ROUTES
    private var exportKind = LibraryKind.ROUTES
    private var exportRouteId: String? = null

    private val importGpx = registerForActivityResult(ActivityResultContracts.OpenDocument()) { uri ->
        if (uri != null) model.importGpx(uri)
    }
    private val exportGpx = registerForActivityResult(ActivityResultContracts.CreateDocument("application/gpx+xml")) { uri ->
        if (uri != null) model.exportGpx(uri, exportRouteId)
    }
    private val importFile = registerForActivityResult(ActivityResultContracts.OpenDocument()) { uri ->
        if (uri != null) model.import(uri, importKind)
    }
    private val exportFile = registerForActivityResult(ActivityResultContracts.CreateDocument("application/json")) { uri ->
        if (uri != null) model.export(uri, exportKind)
    }

    override fun onCreate(savedInstanceState: Bundle?) {
        super.onCreate(savedInstanceState)
        environmentSelected = savedInstanceState?.getBoolean("environmentSelected") ?: false
        savedInstanceState?.getString("libraryKind")?.let { key ->
            LibraryKind.entries.firstOrNull { it.name == key }?.let(model::kind)
        }
        importKind = runCatching { LibraryKind.valueOf(savedInstanceState?.getString("importKind") ?: "ROUTES") }.getOrDefault(LibraryKind.ROUTES)
        exportKind = runCatching { LibraryKind.valueOf(savedInstanceState?.getString("exportKind") ?: "ROUTES") }.getOrDefault(LibraryKind.ROUTES)
        exportRouteId = savedInstanceState?.getString("exportRouteId")
    }

    override fun onCreateView(
        inflater: LayoutInflater,
        container: ViewGroup?,
        savedInstanceState: Bundle?,
    ): View = android.widget.LinearLayout(requireContext()).apply {
        orientation = android.widget.LinearLayout.VERTICAL
        addView(ComposeView(context).apply {
            setViewCompositionStrategy(ViewCompositionStrategy.DisposeOnViewTreeLifecycleDestroyed)
            setContent {
                PortalTheme {
                    val state by model.state.collectAsStateWithLifecycle()
                    var environment by rememberSaveable { mutableStateOf(environmentSelected) }
                    PrimaryTabRow(if (environment) 3 else state.kind.ordinal,
                        containerColor = MaterialTheme.colorScheme.background, divider = {}) {
                        (LibraryKind.entries.map { it.libraryLabel() } + "环境").forEachIndexed { index, label ->
                            Tab(selected = if (index == 3) environment else !environment && state.kind.ordinal == index,
                                onClick = {
                                    environment = index == 3
                                    environmentSelected = environment
                                    if (!environment) model.kind(LibraryKind.entries[index])
                                    showLibraryTab()
                                }, enabled = !state.busy,
                                text = { Text(label, style = MaterialTheme.typography.titleSmall) },
                                icon = { Icon(painterResource(if (index == 3) R.drawable.ic_layers_modern
                                    else LibraryKind.entries[index].libraryIcon()), null, Modifier.size(22.dp)) })
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
        }, android.widget.LinearLayout.LayoutParams(-1, -2))
        val body = android.widget.FrameLayout(context)
        addView(body, android.widget.LinearLayout.LayoutParams(-1, 0, 1f))
        body.addView(FragmentContainerView(context).apply {
            id = R.id.library_environment_content
            environmentContent = this
        }, android.widget.FrameLayout.LayoutParams(-1, -1))
        body.addView(ComposeView(context).apply {
            libraryContent = this
            setViewCompositionStrategy(ViewCompositionStrategy.DisposeOnViewTreeLifecycleDestroyed)
            setContent {
                PortalTheme {
                    LibraryScreen(
                        model = model,
                        onAddRoute = { findNavController().navigate(R.id.nav_route_edit) },
                        onImportJson = { kind ->
                            importKind = kind
                            importFile.launch(arrayOf("application/json", "text/*"))
                        },
                        onExportJson = { kind ->
                            exportKind = kind
                            exportFile.launch("location-${kind.name.lowercase()}.json")
                        },
                        onImportGpx = { importGpx.launch(arrayOf("application/gpx+xml", "application/xml", "text/xml", "application/octet-stream")) },
                        onExportGpx = { routeId ->
                            exportRouteId = routeId
                            exportGpx.launch(if (routeId == null) "location-routes.gpx" else "route.gpx")
                        },
                    )
                }
            }
        }, android.widget.FrameLayout.LayoutParams(-1, -1))
    }

    override fun onViewCreated(view: View, savedInstanceState: Bundle?) {
        super.onViewCreated(view, savedInstanceState)
        if (childFragmentManager.findFragmentByTag("library_environment") == null) {
            childFragmentManager.beginTransaction().add(R.id.library_environment_content,
                EnvironmentComposeFragment().apply { arguments = Bundle().apply { putBoolean("library", true) } },
                "library_environment").commitNow()
        }
        showLibraryTab()
    }

    private fun showLibraryTab() {
        libraryContent?.visibility = if (environmentSelected) View.GONE else View.VISIBLE
        environmentContent?.visibility = if (environmentSelected) View.VISIBLE else View.GONE
        val fragment = childFragmentManager.findFragmentByTag("library_environment") ?: return
        childFragmentManager.beginTransaction().apply {
            if (environmentSelected) {
                show(fragment)
                setMaxLifecycle(fragment, Lifecycle.State.RESUMED)
                setPrimaryNavigationFragment(fragment)
            } else {
                hide(fragment)
                setMaxLifecycle(fragment, Lifecycle.State.CREATED)
                setPrimaryNavigationFragment(null)
            }
        }.commitNow()
    }

    override fun onDestroyView() {
        libraryContent = null
        environmentContent = null
        super.onDestroyView()
    }

    override fun onResume() {
        super.onResume()
        model.refresh()
    }

    override fun onSaveInstanceState(outState: Bundle) {
        outState.putBoolean("environmentSelected", environmentSelected)
        outState.putString("libraryKind", model.state.value.kind.name)
        outState.putString("importKind", importKind.name)
        outState.putString("exportKind", exportKind.name)
        outState.putString("exportRouteId", exportRouteId)
        super.onSaveInstanceState(outState)
    }
}

@Composable
private fun LibraryScreen(
    model: LibraryViewModel,
    onAddRoute: () -> Unit,
    onImportJson: (LibraryKind) -> Unit,
    onExportJson: (LibraryKind) -> Unit,
    onImportGpx: () -> Unit,
    onExportGpx: (String?) -> Unit,
) {

    val state by model.state.collectAsStateWithLifecycle()
    val runtime by ScenarioRuntime.state.collectAsStateWithLifecycle()
    var query by rememberSaveable { mutableStateOf("") }
    var selectedItem by remember { mutableStateOf<LibraryItem?>(null) }
    var renameTarget by remember { mutableStateOf<LibraryItem?>(null) }
    var renameValue by remember { mutableStateOf("") }
    var renameIsCopy by remember { mutableStateOf(false) }
    var moreOpen by remember { mutableStateOf(false) }
    var modeTarget by remember { mutableStateOf<LibraryItem?>(null) }

    val filtered = remember(state.items, query) {
        if (query.isBlank()) state.items
        else state.items.filter { it.title.contains(query, ignoreCase = true) || it.detail.contains(query, ignoreCase = true) }
    }

    if (moreOpen) {
        val choices = buildList {
            add("导入 JSON")
            add("导出 JSON")
            if (state.kind == LibraryKind.ROUTES) {
                add("导入 GPX")
                add("导出 GPX")
            }
        }
        AlertDialog(
            onDismissRequest = { moreOpen = false },
            title = { Text("资料库操作") },
            text = {
                Column {
                    choices.forEach { choice ->
                        PortalActionRow(choice, onClick = {
                            moreOpen = false
                            when (choice) {
                                "导入 JSON" -> onImportJson(state.kind)
                                "导出 JSON" -> onExportJson(state.kind)
                                "导入 GPX" -> onImportGpx()
                                "导出 GPX" -> onExportGpx(null)
                            }
                        })
                    }
                }
            },
            confirmButton = { TextButton(onClick = { moreOpen = false }) { Text("取消") } },
        )
    }

    selectedItem?.let { item ->
        val actions = buildList {
            add("启动")
            add("重命名")
            add("复制")
            add("删除")
            if (state.kind != LibraryKind.SCENARIOS) add("收藏 / 取消收藏")
            if (state.kind != LibraryKind.LOCATIONS) add("播放模式")
            if (state.kind == LibraryKind.ROUTES) add("导出 GPX")
        }
        AlertDialog(
            onDismissRequest = { selectedItem = null },
            title = { Text(item.title.removePrefix("★ ")) },
            text = {
                Column {
                    actions.forEach { action ->
                        PortalActionRow(action, onClick = {
                            selectedItem = null
                            when (action) {
                                "启动" -> model.start(item.id)
                                "重命名" -> {
                                    renameIsCopy = false
                                    renameTarget = item
                                    renameValue = item.title.removePrefix("★ ")
                                }
                                "复制" -> {
                                    renameIsCopy = true
                                    renameTarget = item
                                    renameValue = item.title.removePrefix("★ ") + " 副本"
                                }
                                "删除" -> model.delete(item.id)
                                "收藏 / 取消收藏" -> model.favorite(item.id)
                                "播放模式" -> modeTarget = item
                                "导出 GPX" -> onExportGpx(item.id)
                            }
                        })
                    }
                }
            },
            confirmButton = { TextButton(onClick = { selectedItem = null }) { Text("取消") } },
        )
    }

    renameTarget?.let { item ->
        AlertDialog(
            onDismissRequest = { renameTarget = null },
            title = { Text(if (renameIsCopy) "复制" else "重命名") },
            text = {
                OutlinedTextField(
                    value = renameValue,
                    onValueChange = { renameValue = it },
                    singleLine = true,
                    label = { Text("名称") },
                )
            },
            confirmButton = {
                TextButton(onClick = {
                    val target = renameTarget
                    renameTarget = null
                    if (target != null && renameValue.isNotBlank()) {
                        if (renameIsCopy) model.copy(target.id, renameValue)
                        else model.rename(target.id, renameValue)
                    }
                }) { Text("保存") }
            },
            dismissButton = { TextButton(onClick = { renameTarget = null }) { Text("取消") } },
        )
    }

    modeTarget?.let { item ->
        AlertDialog(
            onDismissRequest = { modeTarget = null },
            title = { Text("播放模式") },
            text = {
                Column {
                    RouteMode.entries.forEach { mode ->
                        PortalActionRow(
                            when (mode) {
                                RouteMode.ONCE -> "单次"
                                RouteMode.LOOP -> "循环（闭合回起点）"
                                RouteMode.PING_PONG -> "往返"
                            },
                            onClick = {
                                modeTarget = null
                                model.mode(item.id, mode)
                            },
                        )
                    }
                }
            },
            confirmButton = { TextButton(onClick = { modeTarget = null }) { Text("取消") } },
        )
    }

    Surface(Modifier.fillMaxSize(), color = MaterialTheme.colorScheme.background) {
        LazyColumn(
            modifier = Modifier.fillMaxSize().imePadding(),
            contentPadding = PaddingValues(PortalSpacing.xl, PortalSpacing.xl, PortalSpacing.xl, 40.dp),
            verticalArrangement = Arrangement.spacedBy(PortalSpacing.md),
        ) {
            item(key = "search") {
                OutlinedTextField(
                    value = query,
                    onValueChange = { query = it },
                    label = { Text("搜索资料") },
                    leadingIcon = { Icon(painterResource(R.drawable.baseline_search_24), null) },
                    trailingIcon = {
                        if (query.isNotEmpty()) {
                            IconButton(onClick = { query = "" }) {
                                Icon(painterResource(R.drawable.baseline_close_24), "清除搜索")
                            }
                        }
                    },
                    shape = MaterialTheme.shapes.medium,
                    singleLine = true,
                    modifier = Modifier.fillMaxWidth(),
                )
            }
            item(key = "actions") {
                Row(horizontalArrangement = Arrangement.spacedBy(8.dp)) {
                    Button(
                        onClick = onAddRoute,
                        enabled = !state.busy && state.kind == LibraryKind.ROUTES,
                        modifier = Modifier.weight(1f).heightIn(min = 48.dp),
                    ) {
                        Icon(painterResource(R.drawable.baseline_route_24), null, Modifier.size(20.dp))
                        Spacer(Modifier.width(8.dp))
                        Text("新建路线")
                    }
                    OutlinedButton(onClick = { moreOpen = true }, enabled = !state.busy, modifier = Modifier.heightIn(min = 48.dp)) {
                        Icon(painterResource(R.drawable.ic_more_horizontal), null, Modifier.size(20.dp))
                        Spacer(Modifier.width(8.dp))
                        Text("更多")
                    }
                }
            }
            item(key = "progress") {
                AnimatedVisibility(visible = state.busy) {
                    LinearProgressIndicator(Modifier.fillMaxWidth())
                }
            }
            item(key = "summary") {
                Text(
                    state.message ?: "共 ${filtered.size} 条",
                    modifier = Modifier.animateContentSize(),
                    style = MaterialTheme.typography.bodySmall,
                    color = MaterialTheme.colorScheme.onSurfaceVariant,
                )
            }
            if (filtered.isEmpty() && !state.busy) {
                item(key = "empty") {
                    PortalCard {
                        Column(
                            modifier = Modifier.fillMaxWidth().padding(vertical = 24.dp),
                            horizontalAlignment = Alignment.CenterHorizontally,
                            verticalArrangement = Arrangement.spacedBy(16.dp),
                        ) {
                            Surface(shape = MaterialTheme.shapes.large, color = MaterialTheme.colorScheme.primaryContainer) {
                                Icon(
                                    painterResource(if (query.isNotBlank()) R.drawable.baseline_search_24 else state.kind.libraryIcon()),
                                    null,
                                    Modifier.size(72.dp).padding(20.dp),
                                    tint = MaterialTheme.colorScheme.onPrimaryContainer,
                                )
                            }
                            Text(
                                if (query.isNotBlank()) "没有匹配的资料" else "暂无${state.kind.libraryLabel()}",
                                style = MaterialTheme.typography.titleMedium,
                            )
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
            items(filtered, key = { "${state.kind}-${it.id}" }) { item ->
                LibraryEntryCard(
                    item = item,
                    kind = state.kind,
                    onClick = { selectedItem = item },
                    modifier = Modifier.animateItem(),
                )
            }
            item(key = "runtime") {
                AnimatedVisibility(visible = runtime.isActive || runtime.error != null) {
                    PortalCard(modifier = Modifier.animateContentSize()) {
                        PortalSectionTitle(
                            "${runtime.backend.displayLabel()} · ${runtime.displayLabel()}",
                            runtime.scenarioName.orEmpty(),
                        )
                        Spacer(Modifier.height(PortalSpacing.sm))
                        runtime.error?.let { error ->
                            Text("${error.stage}: ${error.reason}", color = MaterialTheme.colorScheme.error)
                        }
                        Row(horizontalArrangement = Arrangement.spacedBy(8.dp)) {
                            OutlinedButton(
                                onClick = {
                                    if (runtime.phase == RuntimePhase.PAUSED) ScenarioRuntime.resume()
                                    else ScenarioRuntime.pause()
                                },
                                enabled = runtime.phase in setOf(RuntimePhase.RUNNING, RuntimePhase.PAUSED),
                                modifier = Modifier.weight(1f),
                            ) { Text(if (runtime.phase == RuntimePhase.PAUSED) "继续" else "暂停") }
                            OutlinedButton(
                                onClick = { ScenarioRuntime.stop() },
                                enabled = runtime.isActive || runtime.error != null,
                                modifier = Modifier.weight(1f),
                            ) {
                                Icon(painterResource(R.drawable.baseline_stop_24), null, Modifier.size(18.dp))
                                Spacer(Modifier.width(6.dp))
                                Text("停止")
                            }
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
        }
    }
}
```

`app/src/main/java/com/system/location/service/ui/mock/RouteGestureLayout.kt`:

```kt
package com.system.location.service.ui.mock

import android.content.Context
import android.util.AttributeSet
import android.view.MotionEvent
import android.widget.FrameLayout

/** Single fingers draw. A second finger cancels the uncommitted stroke and hands a complete
 * gesture stream to the map, including DOWN; drawing resumes only on the next fresh gesture. */
class RouteGestureLayout @JvmOverloads constructor(context: Context, attrs: AttributeSet? = null) : FrameLayout(context, attrs) {
    var drawingEnabled = false
    var onStrokeTouch: ((MotionEvent) -> Unit)? = null
    private var navigating = false

    override fun dispatchTouchEvent(event: MotionEvent): Boolean {
        if (!drawingEnabled) return super.dispatchTouchEvent(event)
        if (event.actionMasked == MotionEvent.ACTION_DOWN) navigating = false
        if (!navigating && event.pointerCount > 1) {
            val cancel = MotionEvent.obtain(event).apply { action = MotionEvent.ACTION_CANCEL }
            onStrokeTouch?.invoke(cancel)
            cancel.recycle()
            navigating = true
            val properties = MotionEvent.PointerProperties().also { event.getPointerProperties(0, it) }
            val coordinates = MotionEvent.PointerCoords().also { event.getPointerCoords(0, it) }
            val down = MotionEvent.obtain(event.downTime, event.eventTime, MotionEvent.ACTION_DOWN,
                1, arrayOf(properties), arrayOf(coordinates), event.metaState, event.buttonState,
                event.xPrecision, event.yPrecision, event.deviceId, event.edgeFlags, event.source, event.flags)
            super.dispatchTouchEvent(down)
            down.recycle()
        }
        if (navigating) super.dispatchTouchEvent(event) else onStrokeTouch?.invoke(event)
        return true
    }
}
```

`app/src/main/java/com/system/location/service/ui/mock/RouteJson.kt`:

```kt
package com.system.location.service.ui.mock

import kotlinx.serialization.encodeToString
import kotlinx.serialization.json.Json
import kotlinx.serialization.json.*

/** Route persistence uses generated serializers, including Kotlin's built-in Pair serializer. */
object RouteJson {
    fun encodeRoutes(routes: List<HistoricalRoute>): String = envelope("routes", Json.encodeToJsonElement(routes))

    fun decodeRoutes(json: String): List<HistoricalRoute> =
        if (json.isBlank()) emptyList() else Json.decodeFromJsonElement(payload(json, "routes"))

    fun encodeRoute(route: HistoricalRoute?): String = envelope("route", Json.encodeToJsonElement(route))

    fun decodeRoute(json: String): HistoricalRoute? = Json.decodeFromJsonElement(payload(json, "route"))

    private fun envelope(key: String, value: JsonElement) = buildJsonObject {
        put("schemaVersion", 1)
        put(key, value)
    }.toString()

    private fun payload(text: String, key: String): JsonElement {
        val root = Json.parseToJsonElement(text)
        if (root is JsonObject && "schemaVersion" in root) {
            require(root["schemaVersion"]?.jsonPrimitive?.intOrNull == 1) { "Unsupported route schema" }
            return root[key] ?: error("Missing $key")
        }
        return root // Existing unversioned route records are migrated on the next write.
    }

    fun encodePoints(points: List<Pair<Double, Double>>): String = Json.encodeToString(points)

    fun decodePoints(json: String): List<Pair<Double, Double>> =
        Json.decodeFromString<List<Pair<Double, Double>>>(json).also(::validatePoints)

    internal fun validatePoints(points: List<Pair<Double, Double>>) {
        require(points.size >= 2) { "路线经纬度至少需要两个点" }
        require(points.all { (lat, lon) -> lat in -90.0..90.0 && lon in -180.0..180.0 }) {
            "路线经纬度格式错误"
        }
    }
}
```

```kt
package com.system.location.service.ui.mock

import android.os.Bundle
import android.content.res.Configuration
import android.view.View
import android.widget.*
import androidx.activity.result.contract.ActivityResultContracts
import androidx.fragment.app.Fragment
import androidx.fragment.app.viewModels
import androidx.lifecycle.Lifecycle
import androidx.lifecycle.lifecycleScope
import androidx.lifecycle.repeatOnLifecycle
import androidx.navigation.fragment.findNavController
import androidx.core.widget.addTextChangedListener
import androidx.recyclerview.widget.LinearLayoutManager
import com.google.android.material.dialog.MaterialAlertDialogBuilder
import com.system.location.service.R
import com.system.location.service.core.runtime.RuntimePhase
import com.system.location.service.core.scenario.RouteMode
import com.system.location.service.databinding.FragmentRouteMockBinding
import com.system.location.service.runtime.ScenarioRuntime
import com.system.location.service.ui.viewmodel.*
import com.system.location.service.ui.displayLabel
import com.system.location.service.ui.displayStates
import com.system.location.service.ui.setTextIfChanged
import kotlinx.coroutines.Dispatchers
import kotlinx.coroutines.flow.MutableStateFlow
import kotlinx.coroutines.flow.combine
import kotlinx.coroutines.flow.distinctUntilChanged
import kotlinx.coroutines.flow.map
import kotlinx.coroutines.flow.mapLatest
import kotlinx.coroutines.withContext
import kotlinx.coroutines.launch

@OptIn(kotlinx.coroutines.ExperimentalCoroutinesApi::class)
class RouteMockFragment : Fragment(R.layout.fragment_route_mock) {
    private val model by viewModels<LibraryViewModel>()
    private var importKind = LibraryKind.ROUTES
    private var exportKind = LibraryKind.ROUTES
    private var exportRouteId: String? = null
    private val query = MutableStateFlow("")
    private val importGpx = registerForActivityResult(ActivityResultContracts.OpenDocument()) { uri ->
        if (uri != null) model.importGpx(uri)
    }
    private val exportGpx = registerForActivityResult(ActivityResultContracts.CreateDocument("application/gpx+xml")) { uri ->
        if (uri != null) model.exportGpx(uri, exportRouteId)
    }
    private val importFile = registerForActivityResult(ActivityResultContracts.OpenDocument()) { uri ->
        if (uri != null) model.import(uri, importKind)
    }
    private val exportFile = registerForActivityResult(ActivityResultContracts.CreateDocument("application/json")) { uri ->
        if (uri != null) model.export(uri, exportKind)
    }
    override fun onCreate(savedInstanceState: Bundle?) {
        super.onCreate(savedInstanceState)
        importKind = runCatching { LibraryKind.valueOf(savedInstanceState?.getString("importKind") ?: "ROUTES") }.getOrDefault(LibraryKind.ROUTES)
        exportKind = runCatching { LibraryKind.valueOf(savedInstanceState?.getString("exportKind") ?: "ROUTES") }.getOrDefault(LibraryKind.ROUTES)
        exportRouteId = savedInstanceState?.getString("exportRouteId")
    }
    override fun onViewCreated(view: View, savedInstanceState: Bundle?) {
        val ui = FragmentRouteMockBinding.bind(view)
        applyCompactLayout(ui)
        val kindIds = listOf(R.id.kind_routes, R.id.kind_scenarios, R.id.kind_locations)
        ui.libraryKind.check(kindIds[model.state.value.kind.ordinal])
        ui.libraryKind.addOnButtonCheckedListener { _, id, checked ->
            if (checked && kindIds.indexOf(id) != model.state.value.kind.ordinal) model.kind(LibraryKind.entries[kindIds.indexOf(id)])
        }
        ui.librarySearch.setText(query.value)
        ui.librarySearch.addTextChangedListener { query.value = it.toString() }
        val adapter = LibraryAdapter(::actions)
        ui.libraryItems.layoutManager = LinearLayoutManager(requireContext())
        ui.libraryItems.adapter = adapter
        ui.libraryItems.itemAnimator = null
        ui.addRoute.setOnClickListener { findNavController().navigate(R.id.nav_route_edit) }
        ui.libraryMore.setOnClickListener {
            val routes = model.state.value.kind == LibraryKind.ROUTES
            val choices = if (routes) arrayOf("导入 JSON", "导出 JSON", "导入 GPX", "导出 GPX") else arrayOf("导入 JSON", "导出 JSON")
            MaterialAlertDialogBuilder(requireContext()).setTitle(R.string.ui_library_more).setItems(choices) { _, index ->
                when (index) {
                    0 -> { importKind = model.state.value.kind; importFile.launch(arrayOf("application/json", "text/*")) }
                    1 -> { exportKind = model.state.value.kind; exportFile.launch("location-${exportKind.name.lowercase()}.json") }
                    2 -> importGpx.launch(arrayOf("application/gpx+xml", "application/xml", "text/xml", "application/octet-stream"))
                    3 -> { exportRouteId = null; exportGpx.launch("location-routes.gpx") }
                }
            }.show()
        }
        ui.pauseResume.setOnClickListener { if (ScenarioRuntime.state.value.phase == RuntimePhase.PAUSED) ScenarioRuntime.resume() else ScenarioRuntime.pause() }
        ui.stopScene.setOnClickListener { ScenarioRuntime.stop() }
        viewLifecycleOwner.lifecycleScope.launch {
            viewLifecycleOwner.repeatOnLifecycle(Lifecycle.State.STARTED) {
                launch { model.state.collect { state ->
                    ui.libraryStatus.setTextIfChanged(state.message ?: if (state.busy) "正在读取／保存…" else getString(R.string.ui_library_count, state.items.size))
                    ui.libraryLoading.visibility = if (state.busy) View.VISIBLE else View.GONE
                    ui.libraryKind.isEnabled = !state.busy
                    kindIds.forEach { ui.libraryKind.findViewById<View>(it).isEnabled = !state.busy }
                    if (ui.libraryKind.checkedButtonId != kindIds[state.kind.ordinal]) ui.libraryKind.check(kindIds[state.kind.ordinal])
                    ui.libraryMore.isEnabled = !state.busy
                    ui.addRoute.isEnabled = !state.busy
                    ui.addRoute.visibility = if (state.kind == LibraryKind.ROUTES) View.VISIBLE else View.GONE
                } }
                launch {
                    combine(model.state.map { it.kind to it.items }.distinctUntilChanged(), query) { data, text -> data to text }
                        .mapLatest { (data, text) -> withContext(Dispatchers.Default) {
                            data.second.filter { text.isBlank() || it.title.contains(text, true) || it.detail.contains(text, true) }
                                .map { LibraryRow(data.first, it) }
                        } }.collect { rows ->
                            adapter.submitList(rows)
                            ui.libraryEmpty.visibility = if (rows.isEmpty()) View.VISIBLE else View.GONE
                            ui.emptyTitle.setText(if (query.value.isBlank()) R.string.ui_library_empty else R.string.ui_library_no_match)
                            ui.emptyDescription.setText(if (query.value.isBlank()) R.string.ui_library_empty_desc else R.string.ui_library_no_match_desc)
                        }
                }
                launch { ScenarioRuntime.state.displayStates().collect { state ->
                    ui.libraryRuntimeCard.visibility = if (state.isActive || state.error != null) View.VISIBLE else View.GONE
                    ui.runtimeStatus.setTextIfChanged("${state.backend.displayLabel()} · ${state.displayLabel()} · ${state.scenarioName.orEmpty()}" +
                        (state.error?.let { "\n${it.stage}: ${it.reason}\n${it.suggestion}" } ?: "")
                    )
                    ui.pauseResume.isEnabled = state.phase in setOf(RuntimePhase.RUNNING, RuntimePhase.PAUSED)
                    val action = if (state.phase == RuntimePhase.PAUSED) "继续" else "暂停"
                    if (ui.pauseResume.text != action) {
                        ui.pauseResume.text = action
                        ui.pauseResume.setIconResource(if (state.phase == RuntimePhase.PAUSED) R.drawable.baseline_play_24 else R.drawable.ic_pause)
                    }
                } }
            }
        }
    }
    override fun onConfigurationChanged(newConfig: Configuration) {
        super.onConfigurationChanged(newConfig)
        view?.let { applyCompactLayout(FragmentRouteMockBinding.bind(it)) }
    }

    private fun applyCompactLayout(ui: FragmentRouteMockBinding) {
        val visibility = if (resources.configuration.screenHeightDp < 480) View.GONE else View.VISIBLE
        ui.libraryHeading.visibility = visibility
        ui.emptyArtwork.visibility = visibility
        ui.emptyDescription.visibility = visibility
    }

    private fun actions(item: LibraryItem) {
        if (model.state.value.busy || model.state.value.items.none { it.id == item.id }) return
        val choices = mutableListOf("启动", "重命名", "复制", "删除")
        if (model.state.value.kind != LibraryKind.SCENARIOS) choices += "收藏 / 取消收藏"
        if (model.state.value.kind != LibraryKind.LOCATIONS) choices += "播放模式"
        if (model.state.value.kind == LibraryKind.ROUTES) choices += "导出 GPX"
        MaterialAlertDialogBuilder(requireContext()).setTitle(item.title).setItems(choices.toTypedArray()) { _, which ->
            when (choices[which]) {
                "启动" -> model.start(item.id)
                "导出 GPX" -> { exportRouteId = item.id; exportGpx.launch("route.gpx") }
                "重命名", "复制" -> {
                    val name = EditText(requireContext()).apply { setText(item.title.removePrefix("★ ")); inputType = android.text.InputType.TYPE_CLASS_TEXT }
                    MaterialAlertDialogBuilder(requireContext()).setTitle(choices[which]).setView(name)
                        .setPositiveButton("保存") { _, _ ->
                            if (choices[which] == "复制") model.copy(item.id, name.text.toString()) else model.rename(item.id, name.text.toString())
                        }.setNegativeButton("取消", null).show()
                }
                "删除" -> MaterialAlertDialogBuilder(requireContext()).setMessage("删除 ${item.title}？")
                    .setPositiveButton("删除") { _, _ -> model.delete(item.id) }.setNegativeButton("取消", null).show()
                "收藏 / 取消收藏" -> model.favorite(item.id)
                "播放模式" -> MaterialAlertDialogBuilder(requireContext()).setTitle("播放模式")
                    .setItems(arrayOf("单次", "循环（闭合回起点）", "往返")) { _, index -> model.mode(item.id, RouteMode.entries[index]) }.show()
            }
        }.show()
    }
    override fun onResume() { super.onResume(); model.refresh() }
    override fun onSaveInstanceState(outState: Bundle) {
        outState.putString("importKind", importKind.name); outState.putString("exportKind", exportKind.name)
        outState.putString("exportRouteId", exportRouteId)
        super.onSaveInstanceState(outState)
    }
}
```
