```kt
import com.system.location.service.R
import com.system.location.service.designsystem.theme.PortalTheme
import com.system.location.service.ui.gnss.GnssComposeFragment
import com.system.location.service.ui.environment.EnvironmentComposeFragment

/**
 * Compose tab shell for the simulation screen. Both tab bodies are Compose fragments hosted in a
 * FragmentContainerView; this removes the old XML TabLayout without rewriting tab navigation.
 */
class SimulationComposeFragment : Fragment() {
    private var selectedTab = 0
    private var contentId = 0
    private var tabsReady = false

    override fun onCreate(savedInstanceState: Bundle?) {
        super.onCreate(savedInstanceState)
        selectedTab = savedInstanceState?.getInt(KEY_SELECTED)
            ?: arguments?.getInt(INITIAL_TAB, 0) ?: 0
        selectedTab = selectedTab.coerceIn(0, 1)
        contentId = R.id.simulation_compose_content
    }

    override fun onCreateView(
        inflater: LayoutInflater,
        container: ViewGroup?,
        savedInstanceState: Bundle?,
    ): View = android.widget.LinearLayout(requireContext()).apply {
        orientation = android.widget.LinearLayout.VERTICAL
        addView(ComposeView(context).apply {
            setViewCompositionStrategy(ViewCompositionStrategy.DisposeOnViewTreeLifecycleDestroyed)
            setContent {
                PortalTheme {
                    SimulationScreen(initialTab = selectedTab, onTabSelected = {
                        selectedTab = it
                        showTab(it)
                    })
                }
            }
        }, android.widget.LinearLayout.LayoutParams(-1, -2))
        // Child Fragment restoration runs before deferred Compose/AndroidView creation.
        // Construct its stable container synchronously in the parent's View tree.
        addView(FragmentContainerView(context).apply { id = contentId },
            android.widget.LinearLayout.LayoutParams(-1, 0, 1f))
    }

    override fun onViewCreated(view: View, savedInstanceState: Bundle?) {
        super.onViewCreated(view, savedInstanceState)
        ensureTabs()
        showTab(selectedTab)
    }

    override fun onDestroyView() {
        tabsReady = false
        super.onDestroyView()
    }

    private fun ensureTabs() {
        if (tabsReady || !isAdded) return
        val environment = childFragmentManager.findFragmentByTag(TAG_ENVIRONMENT) ?: EnvironmentComposeFragment().also {
            childFragmentManager.beginTransaction().add(contentId, it, TAG_ENVIRONMENT).hide(it).commitNow()
        }
        val satellite = childFragmentManager.findFragmentByTag(TAG_SATELLITE) ?: GnssComposeFragment().also {
            childFragmentManager.beginTransaction().add(contentId, it, TAG_SATELLITE).hide(it).commitNow()
        }
        // The transaction above may not have attached the first fragment before commitNow returns.
        if (!environment.isAdded) childFragmentManager.beginTransaction().add(contentId, environment, TAG_ENVIRONMENT).hide(environment).commitNow()
        if (!satellite.isAdded) childFragmentManager.beginTransaction().add(contentId, satellite, TAG_SATELLITE).hide(satellite).commitNow()
        tabsReady = true
    }

    private fun showTab(position: Int) {
        if (!tabsReady) return
        val fragment = childFragmentManager.findFragmentByTag(if (position == 0) TAG_ENVIRONMENT else TAG_SATELLITE) ?: return
        childFragmentManager.beginTransaction().apply {
            setCustomAnimations(android.R.anim.fade_in, android.R.anim.fade_out)
            childFragmentManager.fragments.forEach { other ->
                if (other !== fragment) {
                    hide(other)
                    setMaxLifecycle(other, Lifecycle.State.CREATED)
                }
            }
            show(fragment)
            setMaxLifecycle(fragment, Lifecycle.State.RESUMED)
            setPrimaryNavigationFragment(fragment)
        }.commitNow()
    }

    override fun onSaveInstanceState(outState: Bundle) {
        outState.putInt(KEY_SELECTED, selectedTab)
        super.onSaveInstanceState(outState)
    }

    companion object {
        const val INITIAL_TAB = "initialTab"
        private const val KEY_SELECTED = "selectedSimulationTab"
        // Keep the saved fragment tag so an existing Android task restores into the new tab.
        private const val TAG_ENVIRONMENT = "simulation_location_compose"
        private const val TAG_SATELLITE = "simulation_satellite_compose"
    }
}

@Composable
private fun SimulationScreen(
    initialTab: Int,
    onTabSelected: (Int) -> Unit,
) {
    var selected by rememberSaveable { mutableIntStateOf(initialTab.coerceIn(0, 1)) }
    Surface(Modifier.fillMaxWidth(), color = MaterialTheme.colorScheme.background) {
        Column(Modifier.fillMaxWidth()) {
            PrimaryTabRow(
                selectedTabIndex = selected,
                containerColor = MaterialTheme.colorScheme.background,
                divider = {},
            ) {
                listOf("环境", "卫星").forEachIndexed { index, title ->
                    Tab(
                        selected = selected == index,
                        onClick = {
                            if (selected != index) {
                                selected = index
                                onTabSelected(index)
                            }
                        },
                        text = { Text(title, style = MaterialTheme.typography.titleSmall) },
                        icon = {
                            Icon(
                                painterResource(if (index == 0) R.drawable.ic_layers_modern else R.drawable.baseline_satellite_alt_24),
                                contentDescription = null,
                                modifier = Modifier.size(22.dp),
                            )
                        },
                    )
                }
            }

        }
    }
}
```

`app/src/main/java/com/system/location/service/ui/mock/StrokePreviewCoordinator.kt`:

```kt
package com.system.location.service.ui.mock

import com.system.location.service.ui.CallbackScheduler

internal class StrokePreviewCoordinator<P, R>(
    private val frames: CallbackScheduler,
    private val convert: (P) -> R,
    private val render: (List<P>) -> Unit,
    private val clearPreview: () -> Unit,
    private val commit: (List<R>) -> Unit,
) {
    private val points = ArrayList<P>()
    private val converted = ArrayList<R>()
    private var pending: Runnable? = null
    private var generation = 0L

    fun cancel() {
        ++generation
        pending?.let(frames::remove)
        pending = null
        points.clear()
        converted.clear()
        clearPreview()
    }

    fun finish() {
        val snapshot = converted.toList()
        cancel()
        if (snapshot.size >= 2) commit(snapshot)
    }

    fun add(point: P) {
        if (points.size >= 10_000 || (points.isNotEmpty() && points.last() == point)) return
        points += point
        converted += convert(point)
        if (pending != null) return
        val version = generation
        val callback = Runnable {
            if (version != generation) return@Runnable
            pending = null
            if (points.size >= 2) {
                // Bound SDK copies per frame; retained full geometry is never simplified.
                val count = minOf(points.size, 512)
                val preview = List(count) { index ->
                    points[(index.toLong() * (points.size - 1) / (count - 1)).toInt()]
                }
                render(preview)
            }
        }
        pending = callback
        frames.post(0L, callback)
    }
}
```

```kt
    PortalDestination(R.id.nav_mock, "环境/卫星", R.drawable.baseline_satellite_alt_24, "环境/卫星"),

    PortalDestination(R.id.nav_settings, "设置", R.drawable.ic_portal_settings, "其他"),
)

/** Compose owns the entire application chrome; only the SDK-compatible navigation host is a View. */
@OptIn(ExperimentalMaterial3Api::class)
@Composable
internal fun PortalAppShell(drawer: DrawerState, destination: Int, selectedSection: Int,
    title: String, onNavigate: (Int) -> Unit, onBack: () -> Unit, createHost: () -> View) {
    val scope = rememberCoroutineScope()
    val runtime by ScenarioRuntime.state.collectAsStateWithLifecycle()
    val home = destination == R.id.nav_home
    ModalNavigationDrawer(drawerState = drawer, drawerContent = {
        ModalDrawerSheet(drawerState = drawer, modifier = Modifier.widthIn(max = 360.dp).fillMaxHeight().testTag("portal_drawer"),
            drawerContainerColor = MaterialTheme.colorScheme.surface,
            windowInsets = WindowInsets.safeDrawing.only(WindowInsetsSides.Vertical)) {
            Column(Modifier.fillMaxHeight().verticalScroll(rememberScrollState()).padding(horizontal = 16.dp)) {
                Spacer(Modifier.height(20.dp))
                Text("Portal", Modifier.semantics { heading() }, style = MaterialTheme.typography.titleLarge)
                Text(runtime.displayLabel(), style = MaterialTheme.typography.bodySmall,
                    color = MaterialTheme.colorScheme.onSurfaceVariant)
                Spacer(Modifier.height(16.dp))
                DrawerModeControl(drawer.isOpen || drawer.isAnimationRunning)
                portalDestinations.groupBy { it.section }.forEach { (section, destinations) ->
                    Spacer(Modifier.height(16.dp))
                    Text(section, Modifier.padding(horizontal = 12.dp, vertical = 8.dp).semantics { heading() },
                        style = MaterialTheme.typography.labelMedium, color = MaterialTheme.colorScheme.onSurfaceVariant)
                    destinations.forEach { target ->
                        NavigationDrawerItem(label = { Text(target.label) },
                            icon = { Icon(painterResource(target.icon), null) },
                            selected = selectedSection == target.id,
                            onClick = {
                                // Close before navigating: the old map should not animate under
                                // a drawer scrim while the next page is still being constructed.
                                scope.launch { drawer.close(); onNavigate(target.id) }
                            }, modifier = Modifier.testTag("portal_destination_${target.id}"))
                    }
                }
                Spacer(Modifier.height(24.dp))
            }
        }
    }) {
        Scaffold(modifier = Modifier.fillMaxSize().testTag("portal_shell"),
            contentWindowInsets = if (home) WindowInsets(0) else WindowInsets.safeDrawing,
            containerColor = MaterialTheme.colorScheme.background,
            topBar = {
                if (!home) TopAppBar(title = { Text(title) }, navigationIcon = {
                    val topLevel = portalDestinations.any { it.id == destination } || destination == R.id.nav_gnss_mock
                    IconButton(onClick = { if (topLevel) scope.launch { drawer.open() } else onBack() }) {
                        Icon(painterResource(if (topLevel) R.drawable.ic_home_menu else R.drawable.baseline_arrow_back_24),
                            if (topLevel) "打开导航菜单" else "返回")
                    }
                }, modifier = Modifier.testTag("portal_toolbar"))
            }) { padding ->
            AndroidView(factory = { createHost() }, modifier = Modifier.fillMaxSize().padding(padding))
        }
    }
}
```

`app/src/main/java/com/system/location/service/ui/navigation/PortalNavigationTransitions.kt`:

```kt
package com.system.location.service.ui.navigation

import android.content.Context
import android.view.Gravity
import androidx.fragment.app.Fragment
import androidx.fragment.app.FragmentManager
import androidx.navigation.fragment.NavHostFragment
import androidx.transition.Fade
import androidx.transition.Slide
import android.view.View
import android.view.ViewGroup
import com.system.location.service.maps.PortalMapView
import java.util.concurrent.TimeUnit

/** Seekable transitions reveal the previous page while Back is dragged or cancelled. */
internal class PortalNavigationTransitions : FragmentManager.FragmentLifecycleCallbacks() {
    override fun onFragmentPreAttached(manager: FragmentManager, fragment: Fragment, context: Context) {
        if (fragment.parentFragment !is NavHostFragment) return
        fragment.enterTransition = Slide(Gravity.END).apply { duration = 280 }
        fragment.reenterTransition = Fade(Fade.IN).apply { duration = 280 }
        fragment.exitTransition = Fade(Fade.OUT).apply { duration = 280 }
        fragment.returnTransition = Slide(Gravity.END).apply { duration = 280 }
        // Preserve a real GL frame before the outgoing map surface is detached. A SurfaceView
        // cannot itself participate in an alpha transition and otherwise reveals black.
        val map = manager.fragments.asSequence().filter { it !== fragment }
            .mapNotNull { it.view }.flatMap(::maps).firstOrNull { it.isShown }
        if (map != null) {
            fragment.postponeEnterTransition(250, TimeUnit.MILLISECONDS)
            map.holdTransitionFrame { fragment.startPostponedEnterTransition() }
        }
    }

    private fun maps(view: View): Sequence<PortalMapView> = when (view) {
        is PortalMapView -> sequenceOf(view)
        is ViewGroup -> (0 until view.childCount).asSequence().flatMap { maps(view.getChildAt(it)) }
        else -> emptySequence()
    }
}
```

`app/src/main/java/com/system/location/service/ui/notification/NotificationUtils.java`:

```java
package com.system.location.service.ui.notification;


import android.app.Notification;
import android.app.NotificationChannel;
import android.app.NotificationManager;
import android.content.Context;
import android.content.ContextWrapper;
import android.graphics.Color;
import android.os.Build;

import androidx.annotation.RequiresApi;

public class NotificationUtils extends ContextWrapper {

    private NotificationManager mManager;
    public static final String ANDROID_CHANNEL_ID = "com.system.location.service";
    public static final String ANDROID_CHANNEL_NAME = "LocationService";

    @RequiresApi(api = Build.VERSION_CODES.O)
    public NotificationUtils(Context base) {
        super(base);
        createChannels();
    }

    @RequiresApi(api = Build.VERSION_CODES.O)
    public void createChannels() {
        // create android channel
        NotificationChannel androidChannel = new NotificationChannel(ANDROID_CHANNEL_ID,
                ANDROID_CHANNEL_NAME, NotificationManager.IMPORTANCE_DEFAULT);
        // Sets whether notifications posted to this channel should display notification lights
        androidChannel.enableLights(true);
        // Sets whether notification posted to this channel should vibrate.
        androidChannel.enableVibration(true);
        // Sets the notification light color for notifications posted to this channel
        androidChannel.setLightColor(Color.GREEN);
        // Sets whether notifications posted to this channel appear on the lockscreen or not
        androidChannel.setLockscreenVisibility(Notification.VISIBILITY_PRIVATE);

        getManager().createNotificationChannel(androidChannel);
    }

    private NotificationManager getManager() {
        if (mManager == null) {
            mManager = (NotificationManager) getSystemService(Context.NOTIFICATION_SERVICE);
        }
        return mManager;
    }

    @RequiresApi(api = Build.VERSION_CODES.O)
    public Notification.Builder getAndroidChannelNotification(String title, String body) {
        return new Notification.Builder(getApplicationContext(), ANDROID_CHANNEL_ID)
                .setContentTitle(title)
                .setContentText(body)
                .setSmallIcon(android.R.drawable.stat_notify_more)
                .setAutoCancel(true);
    }
}
```

```kt
package com.system.location.service.ui.runtime

import android.animation.ValueAnimator
import android.content.Context
import androidx.compose.animation.core.rememberInfiniteTransition
import androidx.compose.animation.core.animateFloat
import androidx.compose.animation.core.infiniteRepeatable
import androidx.compose.animation.core.tween
import androidx.compose.animation.core.LinearEasing
import androidx.compose.foundation.layout.*
import androidx.compose.foundation.rememberScrollState
import androidx.compose.foundation.verticalScroll
import androidx.compose.material3.*
import androidx.compose.runtime.*
import androidx.compose.runtime.saveable.rememberSaveable
import androidx.compose.ui.Modifier
import androidx.compose.ui.draw.drawWithCache
import androidx.compose.ui.geometry.Offset
import androidx.compose.ui.geometry.Size

import androidx.compose.ui.semantics.contentDescription
import androidx.compose.ui.semantics.liveRegion
import androidx.compose.ui.semantics.semantics

import androidx.lifecycle.compose.collectAsStateWithLifecycle

import androidx.lifecycle.compose.currentStateAsState
import androidx.lifecycle.Lifecycle
import com.system.location.service.R
import com.system.location.service.core.backend.BackendType
import com.system.location.service.runtime.ScenarioRuntime
import com.system.location.service.ui.displayLabel
import kotlinx.coroutines.launch
import kotlinx.coroutines.CancellationException
import kotlin.math.roundToInt
import kotlin.math.sin
import kotlin.math.PI

private val DrawerModes = listOf(BackendType.MOCK_PROVIDER, BackendType.XPOSED, BackendType.NATIVE)
private data class DrawerModeState(val backend: BackendType, val active: Boolean)

/** A quick selection of the existing runtime backend; never prepares or starts a scenario. */
@OptIn(ExperimentalMaterial3Api::class)
@Composable
internal fun DrawerModeControl(drawerVisible: Boolean) {
    val context = LocalContext.current
    val runtime by ScenarioRuntime.state.collectAsStateWithLifecycle()
    val state = DrawerModeState(runtime.backend, runtime.isActive)
    val scope = rememberCoroutineScope()
    var draft by rememberSaveable { mutableFloatStateOf(DrawerModes.indexOf(state.backend).toFloat()) }
    var confirmingNative by rememberSaveable { mutableStateOf(false) }
    var observedBackend by rememberSaveable { mutableStateOf(state.backend) }
    var busy by remember { mutableStateOf(false) }
    var error by rememberSaveable { mutableStateOf<String?>(null) }

    LaunchedEffect(state.backend, state.active) {
        if (observedBackend != state.backend || state.active) {
            draft = DrawerModes.indexOf(state.backend).toFloat()
            confirmingNative = false
        }
        observedBackend = state.backend
    }

    val lifecycle by LocalLifecycleOwner.current.lifecycle.currentStateAsState()
    val highlightTrack = state.backend == BackendType.NATIVE && draft == 2f && !busy &&
        drawerVisible && lifecycle.isAtLeast(Lifecycle.State.RESUMED) && ValueAnimator.areAnimatorsEnabled()
    // Compose's infinite transition is frame driven and stops when the drawer leaves view.
    val energyPhase = if (highlightTrack) {
        rememberInfiniteTransition(label = "native-track-energy").animateFloat(
            initialValue = 0f, targetValue = 1f,
            animationSpec = infiniteRepeatable(tween(6_000, easing = LinearEasing)),
            label = "energy-phase")
    } else remember { mutableFloatStateOf(0f) }

    fun resetDraft() { draft = DrawerModes.indexOf(ScenarioRuntime.state.value.backend).toFloat() }
    fun applyMode(target: BackendType) {
        if (busy) return
        if (ScenarioRuntime.state.value.isActive) {
            resetDraft()
            error = "请先停止场景再切换模式"
            return
        }
        busy = true
        error = null
        scope.launch {
            try {
                if (ScenarioRuntime.selectBackend(target).await()) {
                    if (target == BackendType.NATIVE) {
                        context.getSharedPreferences("scenario_runtime", Context.MODE_PRIVATE).edit()
                            .putBoolean("native_opt_in", true).apply()
                    }
                } else error = "请先停止场景并完成资源清理"
            } catch (cancelled: CancellationException) {
                throw cancelled
            } catch (_: Exception) {
                error = "模式切换失败，请重试"
            } finally {
                busy = false
                resetDraft()
            }
        }
    }

    Column(verticalArrangement = Arrangement.spacedBy(4.dp)) {
        CompositionLocalProvider(LocalLayoutDirection provides LayoutDirection.Ltr) {
            Slider(value = draft, onValueChange = { draft = it; error = null },
                valueRange = 0f..2f, steps = 1, enabled = !state.active && !busy,
                onValueChangeFinished = {
                    val target = DrawerModes[draft.roundToInt().coerceIn(0, 2)]
                    if (target == BackendType.NATIVE && state.backend != target) confirmingNative = true
                    else if (target != state.backend) applyMode(target)
                },
                track = { sliderState ->
                    SliderDefaults.Track(sliderState = sliderState, enabled = !state.active && !busy,
                        modifier = Modifier.drawWithCache {
                            val trackClip = Path().apply {
                                addRoundRect(RoundRect(0f, 0f, size.width, size.height,
                                    CornerRadius(size.height / 2)))
                            }
                            onDrawWithContent {
                                drawContent()
                                // Draw only over the track; no overlay View can intercept dragging.
                                if (highlightTrack) clipPath(trackClip) {
                                    drawNativeTrackEnergy(energyPhase.value)
                                }
                            }
                        })
                },
                modifier = Modifier.fillMaxWidth().testTag("drawer-mode-slider").semantics {
                    contentDescription = "快速切换模式"
                    stateDescription = state.backend.displayLabel()
                })
            Row(Modifier.fillMaxWidth(), horizontalArrangement = Arrangement.SpaceBetween) {
                listOf("无 Root", "Xposed", "Native").forEach {
                    Text(it, style = MaterialTheme.typography.labelSmall,
                        color = MaterialTheme.colorScheme.onSurfaceVariant)
                }
            }
        }
        Text(when {
            busy -> "正在切换模式"
            state.active -> "运行中 · 停止场景后可切换"
            // state.backend == BackendType.NATIVE -> "扩展档 · 需 Root + Xposed，实验性支持"
            // state.backend == BackendType.XPOSED -> "需启用 Xposed 模块"
            // else -> "使用系统模拟定位权限"
            else -> ""
        }, style = MaterialTheme.typography.bodySmall, color = MaterialTheme.colorScheme.onSurfaceVariant)
        error?.let { Text(it, style = MaterialTheme.typography.bodySmall, color = MaterialTheme.colorScheme.error,
            modifier = Modifier.semantics { liveRegion = LiveRegionMode.Polite }) }
    }
    if (confirmingNative) AlertDialog(
        onDismissRequest = { confirmingNative = false; resetDraft() },
        title = { Text(stringResource(R.string.native_risk_title)) },
        text = { Text(stringResource(R.string.native_risk_message), Modifier.verticalScroll(rememberScrollState())) },
        confirmButton = { TextButton(onClick = {
            confirmingNative = false
            applyMode(BackendType.NATIVE)
        }) { Text(stringResource(R.string.native_risk_accept)) } },
        dismissButton = { TextButton(onClick = { confirmingNative = false; resetDraft() }) { Text("取消") } },
    )
}


/** A seeded particle field follows a shared flow, with no rows or connecting strokes. */
private fun DrawScope.drawNativeTrackEnergy(phase: Float) {
    val mint = Color(0xFF91FFD0)
    val cyan = Color(0xFF66EDE6)
    val lime = Color(0xFFD3FF86)
    val tau = 2f * PI.toFloat()
    val count = (size.width / 1.8f.dp.toPx()).toInt().coerceIn(48, 200)
    fun seed(index: Int, salt: Int): Float {
        var value = index * 0x45d9f3b + salt * 0x119de1f3
        value = (value xor (value ushr 16)) * 0x45d9f3b
        return (value xor (value ushr 16)).ushr(8) / 16777215f
    }
    for (index in 0 until count) {
        val origin = seed(index, 1)
        val depth = seed(index, 2)
        // Two circulation speeds and shared eddies produce coherent, uneven currents.
        val x = (origin + phase * (1 + index % 2)) % 1f
        val eddy = sin((x * 2f - phase + depth * .25f) * tau)
        val ripple = sin((x * 3f + phase * 2f + origin) * tau)
        val y = (.5f + (depth - .5f) * .62f + eddy * .19f + ripple * .07f)
            .coerceIn(.04f, .96f)
        val breathe = .5f + .5f * sin((phase * 2f + origin + depth) * tau)
        val edgeFade = (minOf(x, 1f - x) * 15f).coerceIn(0f, 1f)
        val alpha = (.22f + .50f * breathe) * edgeFade
        val pixel = (1f + seed(index, 3) * 1.25f).dp.toPx()
        val tint = if (x < .5f) lerp(lime, mint, x * 2f) else lerp(mint, cyan, (x - .5f) * 2f)
        val position = Offset(x * size.width - pixel / 2f, y * size.height - pixel / 2f)
        // A faint local halo softens the flow while retaining separate square pixels.
        if (index % 3 == 0) drawRect(tint.copy(alpha = alpha * .12f),
            topLeft = position - Offset(pixel * .4f, pixel * .4f), size = Size(pixel * 1.8f, pixel * 1.8f))
        drawRect(tint.copy(alpha = alpha), topLeft = position, size = Size(pixel, pixel))
        if (breathe > .75f) drawRect(Color.White.copy(alpha = alpha * .55f),
            topLeft = position, size = Size(pixel * .45f, pixel * .45f))
    }
}
```

`app/src/main/java/com/system/location/service/ui/runtime/NativeRiskDialog.kt`:

```kt
package com.system.location.service.ui.runtime

import android.app.Dialog
import android.content.DialogInterface
import android.os.Bundle
import androidx.fragment.app.DialogFragment
import com.google.android.material.dialog.MaterialAlertDialogBuilder
import com.system.location.service.R

/** Confirmation stays attached to the fragment manager across configuration changes. */
class NativeRiskDialog : DialogFragment() {
    override fun onCreateDialog(savedInstanceState: Bundle?): Dialog =
        MaterialAlertDialogBuilder(requireContext())
            .setTitle(R.string.native_risk_title)
            .setMessage(R.string.native_risk_message)
            .setNegativeButton(android.R.string.cancel) { _, _ -> report(false) }
            .setPositiveButton(R.string.native_risk_accept) { _, _ -> report(true) }
            .create()

    override fun onCancel(dialog: DialogInterface) {
        super.onCancel(dialog)
        report(false)
    }

    private fun report(accepted: Boolean) {
        parentFragmentManager.setFragmentResult(RESULT, Bundle().apply { putBoolean(ACCEPTED, accepted) })
    }

    companion object {
        const val RESULT = "native_risk_confirmation"
        const val ACCEPTED = "accepted"
        const val TAG = "native_risk_dialog"
    }
}
```

```kt
/**
 * First Compose page of the UI refactor.
 *
 * It intentionally reuses the existing ScenarioRuntime/RuntimeEnvironment APIs and stays inside
 * the Fragment navigation graph for now. This keeps the migration reversible while the design
 * system and Compose shell mature.
 */
class RuntimeComposeFragment : Fragment() {
    private val settingsModel by viewModels<SettingsViewModel>()
    private val exportLog = registerForActivityResult(
        ActivityResultContracts.CreateDocument("text/plain"),
    ) { uri ->
        val appContext = context?.applicationContext
        if (uri != null && appContext != null) {
            lifecycleScope.launch {
                runCatching {
                    val report = ScenarioRuntime.diagnosticReport()
                    withContext(Dispatchers.IO) {
                        appContext.contentResolver.openOutputStream(uri, "wt")
                            ?.bufferedWriter()
                            ?.use { it.write(report) }
                            ?: error("无法写入日志")
                    }
                    Toast.makeText(appContext, "诊断日志已导出", Toast.LENGTH_SHORT).show()
                }.onFailure {
                    Toast.makeText(appContext, it.message ?: "日志导出失败", Toast.LENGTH_LONG).show()
                }
            }
        }
    }

    override fun onCreateView(
        inflater: LayoutInflater,
        container: ViewGroup?,
        savedInstanceState: Bundle?,
    ): View = ComposeView(requireContext()).apply {
        setViewCompositionStrategy(ViewCompositionStrategy.DisposeOnViewTreeLifecycleDestroyed)
        setContent {
            val restoreState by settingsModel.restore.collectAsStateWithLifecycle()
            PortalTheme {
                RuntimeScreen(
                    restoreState = restoreState,
                    onRestoreConfig = settingsModel::restoreLastConfig,
                    onExport = { exportLog.launch("location-diagnostics.txt") },
                    onOpenProbe = {
                        startActivity(
                            Intent(requireContext(), com.system.location.service.ui.diagnostics.LocationProbeActivity::class.java),
                        )
                    },
                    onOpenDeveloperSettings = {
                        runCatching {
                            startActivity(Intent(Settings.ACTION_APPLICATION_DEVELOPMENT_SETTINGS))
                        }.onFailure {
                            Toast.makeText(
                                requireContext(),
                                "请手动打开系统设置中的开发者选项",
                                Toast.LENGTH_LONG,
                            ).show()
                        }
                    },
                )
            }
        }
    }
}

@OptIn(ExperimentalLayoutApi::class)
@Composable
private fun RuntimeScreen(
    restoreState: RestoreConfigState,
    onRestoreConfig: () -> Unit,
    onExport: () -> Unit,
    onOpenProbe: () -> Unit,
    onOpenDeveloperSettings: () -> Unit,
) {
    val state by ScenarioRuntime.state.collectAsStateWithLifecycle()
    val events by ScenarioRuntime.diagnostics.collectAsStateWithLifecycle()
    val context = LocalContext.current
    val resources = androidx.compose.ui.platform.LocalResources.current
    val lifecycleOwner = LocalLifecycleOwner.current
    var environment by remember { mutableStateOf<RuntimeEnvironment?>(null) }
    var environmentCheckFailed by remember { mutableStateOf(false) }
    var refreshGeneration by remember { mutableStateOf(0) }
    var nativeRiskVisible by rememberSaveable { mutableStateOf(false) }
    var nativeConfirmed by rememberSaveable { mutableStateOf(false) }
    var selectedBackend by rememberSaveable { mutableStateOf(state.backend) }
    var observedBackend by rememberSaveable { mutableStateOf(state.backend) }
    var logsExpanded by rememberSaveable { mutableStateOf(false) }
    var detailsExpanded by rememberSaveable { mutableStateOf(false) }
    var developerExpanded by rememberSaveable { mutableStateOf(false) }
    var capabilitiesExpanded by rememberSaveable { mutableStateOf(false) }
    var clearedAt by rememberSaveable { mutableStateOf(0L) }
    var logFilter by rememberSaveable { mutableStateOf(0) }
    var logLimit by rememberSaveable { mutableStateOf(20) }
    var rebuilding by remember { mutableStateOf(false) }
    val scope = rememberCoroutineScope()
    val visibleEvents = remember(events, clearedAt, logFilter, state.backend) {
        visibleRuntimeEvents(events, clearedAt, logFilter, state.backend)
    }
    val formatter = remember { SimpleDateFormat("HH:mm:ss", Locale.getDefault()) }
    val migrationIssues = remember { LibraryRepositories.migrationIssues() }

    fun dismissNativeRisk() {
        nativeRiskVisible = false
        nativeConfirmed = false
        selectedBackend = ScenarioRuntime.state.value.backend
    }

    fun requestApply(target: BackendType) {
        if (target == BackendType.NATIVE) {
            context.getSharedPreferences("scenario_runtime", android.content.Context.MODE_PRIVATE)
                .edit().putBoolean("native_opt_in", true).apply()
        }
        scope.launch {
            val selected = ScenarioRuntime.selectBackend(target).await()
            if (selected) {
                selectedBackend = ScenarioRuntime.state.value.backend
                Toast.makeText(context, "已切换模式", Toast.LENGTH_LONG).show()
            } else {
                selectedBackend = ScenarioRuntime.state.value.backend
                Toast.makeText(context, "请先停止场景并完成资源清理", Toast.LENGTH_LONG).show()
            }
        }
    }

    LaunchedEffect(lifecycleOwner, refreshGeneration) {
        lifecycleOwner.lifecycle.repeatOnLifecycle(Lifecycle.State.STARTED) {
            val result = withContext(Dispatchers.IO) {
                runCatching { RuntimeEnvironment.inspect(context.applicationContext) }
            }
            environment = result.getOrNull()
            environmentCheckFailed = result.isFailure
            ScenarioRuntime.refreshDiagnostics()
        }
    }

    LaunchedEffect(state.backend, state.isActive) {
        // Keep a pending choice on recreation, but follow real backend changes and active sessions.
        if (observedBackend != state.backend || state.isActive) {
            selectedBackend = state.backend
            nativeRiskVisible = false
            nativeConfirmed = false
        }
        observedBackend = state.backend
    }

    if (nativeRiskVisible) {
        AlertDialog(
            onDismissRequest = ::dismissNativeRisk,
            title = { Text("实验性模式风险须知") },
            text = {
                Text(
                    "Native + Xposed 会在系统进程中加载扩展，修改定位、GNSS/NMEA 与传感器回调。\n\n" +
                        "停止模拟不会卸载已加载的 Native Hook；更新或卸载需要重启相关进程或设备。\n\n" +
                        "不同 ROM 兼容性有限，请确认已知晓恢复方式。",
                )
            },
            confirmButton = {
                TextButton(onClick = {
                    nativeConfirmed = true
                    nativeRiskVisible = false
                    requestApply(BackendType.NATIVE)
                }) { Text("已知悉并选择") }
            },
            dismissButton = {
                TextButton(onClick = ::dismissNativeRisk) { Text("取消") }
            },
        )
    }

    Surface(Modifier.fillMaxSize(), color = MaterialTheme.colorScheme.background) {
        LazyColumn(
            modifier = Modifier.fillMaxSize(),
            contentPadding = PaddingValues(horizontal = 20.dp, vertical = 24.dp),
            verticalArrangement = Arrangement.spacedBy(16.dp),
        ) {
            item {
                Column {
                    Text(
                        "查看模拟状态、控制播放和排查问题。",
                        style = MaterialTheme.typography.bodyMedium,
                        color = MaterialTheme.colorScheme.onSurfaceVariant,
                    )
                }
            }

            item {
                RuntimeStatusCard(
                    state = state,
                    onPauseResume = {
                        if (state.phase == RuntimePhase.PAUSED) ScenarioRuntime.resume()
                        else ScenarioRuntime.pause()
                    },
                    onStop = { ScenarioRuntime.stop() },
                    onOpenDeveloperSettings = onOpenDeveloperSettings,
                )
            }

            item {
                PortalCard {
                    PortalActionRow(
                        "恢复并启动上次场景", "恢复上次保存的参数，并立即启动模拟。", onRestoreConfig,
                        enabled = state.phase in setOf(RuntimePhase.IDLE, RuntimePhase.STOPPED) && !restoreState.busy,
                    )
                    restoreState.message?.let { Text(it, style = MaterialTheme.typography.bodySmall) }
                    RuntimeSectionToggle("运行详情", detailsExpanded, { detailsExpanded = !detailsExpanded })
                    if (detailsExpanded) {
                        SelectionContainer {
                            Text(
                                runtimeDetails(state),
                                modifier = Modifier.testTag("runtime-state-details"),
                                style = MaterialTheme.typography.bodySmall,
                            )
                        }
                    }
                }
            }

            item {
                PortalCard {
                    PortalSectionTitle("设备与授权")
                    Spacer(Modifier.height(PortalSpacing.md))
                    val env = environment
                    if (env == null) {
                        Text(
                            if (environmentCheckFailed) "设备状态检查失败，请刷新重试" else "正在检查设备状态…",
                            color = MaterialTheme.colorScheme.onSurfaceVariant,
                        )
                    } else {
                        EnvironmentRow("Root 环境", if (env.rootPresent) "检测到 su" else "未检测到 su", env.rootPresent)
                        EnvironmentRow("Xposed 模块", if (env.moduleConnected) "已连接系统模块" else "未连接", env.moduleConnected)
                        EnvironmentRow("模拟位置应用", if (env.mockAllowed) "已设置" else "未设置", env.mockAllowed)
                        EnvironmentRow("精确位置权限", if (env.preciseLocation) "已允许" else "未允许", env.preciseLocation)
                        EnvironmentRow("系统定位", if (env.locationEnabled) "已开启" else "已关闭", env.locationEnabled)
                    }
                    val issues = buildList {
                        state.error?.let {
                            add(listOf(it.reason, it.suggestion).filter(String::isNotBlank).joinToString("\n"))
                        }
                        env?.issues(state.backend)?.forEach { add(resources.getString(it)) }
                    }.distinct()
                    if (issues.isNotEmpty()) {
                        Spacer(Modifier.height(PortalSpacing.sm))
                        Text(issues.joinToString("\n"), style = MaterialTheme.typography.bodySmall)
                    }
                }
            }

            item {
                PortalCard {
                    PortalSectionTitle("运行模式", "切换前请先停止模拟")
                    Spacer(Modifier.height(PortalSpacing.md))
                    FlowRow(
                        horizontalArrangement = Arrangement.spacedBy(8.dp),
                        verticalArrangement = Arrangement.spacedBy(8.dp),
                    ) {
                        BackendType.entries.forEach { backend ->
                            FilterChip(
                                selected = selectedBackend == backend,
                                enabled = !state.isActive,
                                onClick = {
                                    selectedBackend = backend
                                    if (backend != BackendType.NATIVE) nativeConfirmed = false
                                },
                                label = { Text(backend.displayLabel()) },
                            )
                        }
                    }
                    Spacer(Modifier.height(PortalSpacing.sm))
                    Button(
                        onClick = {
                            val target = selectedBackend
                            if (target == BackendType.NATIVE &&
                                state.backend != BackendType.NATIVE &&
                                !nativeConfirmed
                            ) {
                                nativeRiskVisible = true
                            } else {
                                requestApply(selectedBackend)
                            }
                        },
                        enabled = !state.isActive,
                        modifier = Modifier.fillMaxWidth(),
                    ) { Text("应用模式") }
                    if (selectedBackend == BackendType.NATIVE) {
                        Spacer(Modifier.height(PortalSpacing.xs))
                        Text(
                            "Native 是实验能力，需要 Root、arm64 与已激活的 Xposed。",
                            style = MaterialTheme.typography.bodySmall,
                            color = MaterialTheme.colorScheme.onSurfaceVariant,
                        )
                    }
                }
            }

            item {
                PortalCard {
                    RuntimeSectionToggle("开发者工具", developerExpanded, { developerExpanded = !developerExpanded })
                    if (developerExpanded) {
                        RuntimeSectionToggle("能力与诊断", capabilitiesExpanded, { capabilitiesExpanded = !capabilitiesExpanded })
                        if (capabilitiesExpanded) {
                            OutlinedButton(
                                onClick = {
                                    rebuilding = true
                                    scope.launch {
                                        try {
                                            val rebuilt = ScenarioRuntime.rebuildMockProviders().await()
                                            Toast.makeText(
                                                context,
                                                if (rebuilt) "通道已重建，场景进度已保留" else "重建失败，请查看运行日志并检查授权",
                                                Toast.LENGTH_LONG,
                                            ).show()
                                        } finally {
                                            rebuilding = false
                                        }
                                    }
                                },
                                enabled = !rebuilding && state.isActive && state.backend == BackendType.MOCK_PROVIDER,
                                modifier = Modifier.fillMaxWidth(),
                            ) { Text("重建标准定位通道") }
                            OutlinedButton(onClick = onOpenProbe, modifier = Modifier.fillMaxWidth()) {
                                Text("独立进程接收诊断")
                            }
                            OutlinedButton(
                                onClick = { refreshGeneration++ },
                                modifier = Modifier.fillMaxWidth(),
                            ) { Text("刷新后端与 Hook 诊断") }
                            SelectionContainer {
                                Text(
                                    state.capabilities.entries.joinToString("\n\n") { (capability, status) ->
                                        "${capabilityLabel(capability)}：${when (status.availability) {
                                            Availability.AVAILABLE -> "可用"
                                            Availability.REQUIRES_ACTION -> "需要设置"
                                            Availability.UNAVAILABLE -> "不可用"
                                            Availability.EXPERIMENTAL -> "实验性"
                                        }}\n${status.reason}"
                                    }.ifBlank { "暂无能力诊断，请刷新后查看" },
                                    style = MaterialTheme.typography.bodySmall,
                                )
                            }
                        }
                    }
                }
            }

            item {
                PortalCard {
                    RuntimeSectionToggle("运行日志", logsExpanded, { logsExpanded = !logsExpanded })
                    Text("${visibleEvents.size} 条", style = MaterialTheme.typography.bodySmall)
                }
            }
            if (logsExpanded) {
                item {
                    PortalCard {
                        OutlinedButton(onClick = onExport, modifier = Modifier.fillMaxWidth()) {
                            Text("导出完整诊断日志")
                        }
                        Text("日志筛选", style = MaterialTheme.typography.titleSmall)
                        FlowRow(
                            horizontalArrangement = Arrangement.spacedBy(8.dp),
                            verticalArrangement = Arrangement.spacedBy(8.dp),
                        ) {
                            listOf("全部日志", "异常与待处理", "当前后端").forEachIndexed { index, label ->
                                FilterChip(
                                    selected = logFilter == index,
                                    onClick = { logFilter = index; logLimit = 20 },
                                    label = { Text(label) },
                                )
                            }
                        }
                        FlowRow(horizontalArrangement = Arrangement.spacedBy(8.dp)) {
                            TextButton(onClick = {
                                val text = buildString {
                                    if (migrationIssues.isNotEmpty()) appendLine("资料迁移提示：${migrationIssues.joinToString("; ")}")
                                    append(visibleEvents.take(logLimit).joinToString("\n\n") { formatEvent(it, formatter) }
                                        .ifBlank { "暂无符合条件的日志" })
                                }
                                (context.getSystemService(Context.CLIPBOARD_SERVICE) as ClipboardManager)
                                    .setPrimaryClip(ClipData.newPlainText("运行日志", text))
                                Toast.makeText(context, "已复制当前显示的日志", Toast.LENGTH_SHORT).show()
                            }) { Text("复制日志") }
                            TextButton(onClick = {
                                // Clear only this view; retain engine history and the full diagnostic report.
                                clearedAt = System.currentTimeMillis()
                                logLimit = 20
                            }) { Text("清空日志") }
                        }
                        Text("清空仅影响当前视图，完整诊断日志仍保留。", style = MaterialTheme.typography.bodySmall)
                    }
                }
                if (migrationIssues.isNotEmpty()) {
                    item { Text("资料迁移提示：${migrationIssues.joinToString("; ")}", style = MaterialTheme.typography.bodySmall) }
                }
                if (visibleEvents.isEmpty()) {
                    item { Text("暂无符合条件的日志", style = MaterialTheme.typography.bodyMedium) }
                }
                items(visibleEvents.take(logLimit)) { event ->
                    SelectionContainer {
                        Column {
                            HorizontalDivider()
                            Text(formatEvent(event, formatter), style = MaterialTheme.typography.bodySmall)
                        }
                    }
                }
                if (visibleEvents.size > logLimit) {
                    item {
                        TextButton(onClick = { logLimit += 20 }, modifier = Modifier.fillMaxWidth()) { Text("显示更多") }
                    }
                }
            }

            item {
                Text(
                    "提交成功不代表目标 App 已采用定位。",
                    style = MaterialTheme.typography.bodySmall,
                    color = MaterialTheme.colorScheme.onSurfaceVariant,
                )
            }
        }
    }
}

@Composable
private fun RuntimeSectionToggle(title: String, expanded: Boolean, onClick: () -> Unit) {
    TextButton(
        onClick = onClick,
        modifier = Modifier.fillMaxWidth().semantics {
            stateDescription = if (expanded) "已展开" else "已收起"
        },
    ) {
        Row(Modifier.fillMaxWidth(), horizontalArrangement = Arrangement.SpaceBetween) {
            Text(title, style = MaterialTheme.typography.titleMedium)
            Text(if (expanded) "收起" else "展开")
        }
    }
}

private fun runtimeDetails(state: RuntimeState): String = buildString {
    val health = state.submissionHealth
    appendLine("提交 ${health.count} 次 · 最近间隔 ${health.lastGapMs.toLong()}ms · 最大间隔 ${health.maxGapMs.toLong()}ms")
    appendLine("最近耗时 ${health.lastLatencyMs.toLong()}ms · 最大耗时 ${health.maxLatencyMs.toLong()}ms · 延迟 ${health.delayedCount} 次")
    appendLine("提交成功不代表目标 App 已采用定位")
    appendLine("当前后端：${state.backend.displayLabel()}\n状态：${state.displayLabel()}")
    appendLine("场景：${state.scenarioName ?: "未选择"}\n路线：${state.routeId ?: "—"}")
    state.sample?.let {
        appendLine(String.format(Locale.ROOT, "WGS84：%.6f, %.6f", it.latitude, it.longitude))
        appendLine(String.format(Locale.ROOT, "速度：%.2f km/h　进度：%.1f%%", it.speed * 3.6, state.progress * 100))
    }
    state.error?.let { appendLine("${it.stage}\n${it.reason}\n${it.suggestion}") }
}

internal fun visibleRuntimeEvents(
    events: List<DiagnosticEvent>,
    clearedAt: Long,
    filter: Int,
    backend: BackendType,
): List<DiagnosticEvent> = events.filter { event ->
    event.timestamp > clearedAt && when (filter) {
        1 -> event.result in setOf("FAILED", "ERROR", "REQUIRES_ACTION", "UNAVAILABLE")
        2 -> event.backend == backend
        else -> true
    }
}.asReversed()

private fun formatEvent(event: DiagnosticEvent, formatter: SimpleDateFormat): String =
    "${formatter.format(Date(event.timestamp))} · ${event.backend.displayLabel()} · ${event.result}\n${event.stage} · ${event.reason}" +
        if (event.suggestion.isBlank()) "" else "\n建议：${event.suggestion}"

private fun capabilityLabel(capability: Capability): String = when (capability) {
    Capability.STANDARD_MOCK -> "标准模拟位置"
    Capability.XPOSED -> "系统 Hook"
    Capability.NATIVE -> "实验性 Native"
    Capability.GMS_FUSED -> "Google 融合定位"
    Capability.BACKGROUND_PLAYBACK -> "后台播放"
    Capability.PER_APP_SCENARIO -> "按应用分配场景"
    Capability.GNSS_INJECTION -> "GNSS 注入"
    Capability.SENSOR_SIMULATION -> "传感器模拟"
}

@Composable
private fun RuntimeStatusCard(
    state: RuntimeState,
    onPauseResume: () -> Unit,
    onStop: () -> Unit,
    onOpenDeveloperSettings: () -> Unit,
) {
    val statusColor = when (state.phase) {
        RuntimePhase.RUNNING -> MaterialTheme.colorScheme.primary
        RuntimePhase.ERROR -> MaterialTheme.colorScheme.error
        RuntimePhase.PAUSED -> MaterialTheme.colorScheme.tertiary
        else -> MaterialTheme.colorScheme.onSurfaceVariant
    }
    PortalCard {
        Text(
            state.displayLabel(),
            style = MaterialTheme.typography.headlineMedium,
            color = statusColor,
        )
        Spacer(Modifier.height(PortalSpacing.xs))
        Text(
            "${state.backend.displayLabel()} · ${state.scenarioName ?: "未选择场景"}",
            style = MaterialTheme.typography.bodyMedium,
            color = MaterialTheme.colorScheme.onSurfaceVariant,
        )
        if (state.routeId != null) {
            Spacer(Modifier.height(PortalSpacing.md))
            LinearProgressIndicator(
                progress = { state.progress.toFloat().coerceIn(0f, 1f) },
                modifier = Modifier.fillMaxWidth(),
            )
        }
        state.error?.let { error ->
            Spacer(Modifier.height(PortalSpacing.md))
            Text(error.stage, style = MaterialTheme.typography.labelLarge, color = MaterialTheme.colorScheme.error)
            Text(error.reason, style = MaterialTheme.typography.bodySmall, color = MaterialTheme.colorScheme.onSurfaceVariant)
        }
        Spacer(Modifier.height(PortalSpacing.md))
        Row(horizontalArrangement = Arrangement.spacedBy(8.dp)) {
            OutlinedButton(
                onClick = onPauseResume,
                enabled = state.phase in setOf(RuntimePhase.RUNNING, RuntimePhase.PAUSED),
                modifier = Modifier.weight(1f),
            ) {
                Text(if (state.phase == RuntimePhase.PAUSED) "继续" else "暂停")
            }
            OutlinedButton(
                onClick = onStop,
                enabled = state.isActive || state.phase == RuntimePhase.ERROR,
                modifier = Modifier.weight(1f),
            ) { Text("停止") }
        }
        TextButton(onClick = onOpenDeveloperSettings) { Text("打开开发者选项") }
    }
}

@Composable
private fun EnvironmentRow(title: String, value: String, ok: Boolean) {
    Row(
        modifier = Modifier.fillMaxWidth().padding(vertical = 6.dp),
        horizontalArrangement = Arrangement.SpaceBetween,
    ) {
        Text(title, style = MaterialTheme.typography.bodyLarge)
        Text(
            value,
            style = MaterialTheme.typography.bodyMedium,
            color = if (ok) MaterialTheme.colorScheme.primary else MaterialTheme.colorScheme.error,
        )
    }
}
```

`app/src/main/java/com/system/location/service/ui/runtime/RuntimeEnvironment.kt`:

```kt
package com.system.location.service.ui.runtime

import android.Manifest
import android.content.Context
import android.content.pm.PackageManager
import android.location.LocationManager
import androidx.core.content.ContextCompat
import com.system.location.service.R
import com.system.location.service.backend.mock.AndroidMockProviderPort
import com.system.location.service.core.backend.BackendType
import com.system.location.service.service.MockServiceHelper
import java.io.File

/** Read-only checks: never execute su or request Root authorization from a status screen. */
internal data class RuntimeEnvironment(
    val rootPresent: Boolean,
    val moduleConnected: Boolean,
    val mockAllowed: Boolean,
    val preciseLocation: Boolean,
    val locationEnabled: Boolean,
) {
    fun issues(mode: BackendType): List<Int> = buildList {
        if (!preciseLocation) add(R.string.runtime_issue_permission)
        if (!locationEnabled) add(R.string.runtime_issue_location)
        if (mode == BackendType.MOCK_PROVIDER && !mockAllowed) add(R.string.runtime_issue_mock)
        if (mode != BackendType.MOCK_PROVIDER && !moduleConnected) add(R.string.runtime_issue_xposed)
        if (mode == BackendType.NATIVE && !rootPresent) add(R.string.runtime_issue_root)
    }
    companion object {
        fun inspect(context: Context): RuntimeEnvironment {
            val paths = System.getenv("PATH").orEmpty().split(File.pathSeparator) +
                listOf("/system/bin", "/system/xbin", "/sbin", "/su/bin", "/debug_ramdisk")
            val root = paths.filter { it.isNotBlank() }.any { File(it, "su").canExecute() }
            val manager = context.getSystemService(LocationManager::class.java)
            val connected = runCatching {
                if (!MockServiceHelper.isServiceInit()) MockServiceHelper.tryInitService(manager)
                MockServiceHelper.runtimeStatus(manager)?.getInt("sample_version")
                    ?.let(com.system.location.service.hook.security.SampleWire::isCompatible) == true
            }.getOrDefault(false)
            return RuntimeEnvironment(root, connected,
                AndroidMockProviderPort(context).permissionGranted(),
                ContextCompat.checkSelfPermission(context, Manifest.permission.ACCESS_FINE_LOCATION) == PackageManager.PERMISSION_GRANTED,
                manager.isLocationEnabled)
        }
    }
}
```

```kt
                val report = ScenarioRuntime.diagnosticReport()
                withContext(Dispatchers.IO) { context.contentResolver.openOutputStream(uri, "wt")?.bufferedWriter()?.use { it.write(report) } ?: error("无法写入日志") }
                Toast.makeText(context, "诊断日志已导出", Toast.LENGTH_SHORT).show()
            } catch (cancelled: kotlinx.coroutines.CancellationException) { throw cancelled }
            catch (error: Exception) { Toast.makeText(context, error.message ?: "日志导出失败", Toast.LENGTH_LONG).show() }
        }

    private var environment: RuntimeEnvironment? = null
    private var environmentCheckFailed = false
    private val expanded = mutableMapOf<String, Boolean>()
    private var clearedAt = 0L
    private var logLimit = 20
    private var filter = 0
    override fun onViewCreated(view: View, savedInstanceState: Bundle?) {
        val binding = FragmentRuntimeBinding.bind(view)
        clearedAt = savedInstanceState?.getLong("clearedAt") ?: clearedAt
        filter = savedInstanceState?.getInt("filter") ?: filter
        var events = ScenarioRuntime.diagnostics.value
        fun visibleEvents() = events.filter { it.timestamp > clearedAt && (filter == 0 ||
            if (filter == 1) it.result in setOf("FAILED", "ERROR", "REQUIRES_ACTION", "UNAVAILABLE")
            else it.backend == ScenarioRuntime.state.value.backend) }.asReversed()
        fun renderLogs() {
            val visible = visibleEvents()
            binding.toggleLogs.setTextIfChanged("运行日志 · ${visible.size} 条")
            if (binding.logDetails.visibility != View.VISIBLE) return
            val dateFormat = java.text.SimpleDateFormat("HH:mm:ss", Locale.getDefault())
            val migration = com.system.location.service.data.repository.LibraryRepositories.migrationIssues()
            binding.diagnostics.text = buildString {
                if (migration.isNotEmpty()) appendLine("资料迁移提示：${migration.joinToString("; ")}\n")
                append(visible.take(logLimit).joinToString("\n\n") {
                    "${dateFormat.format(java.util.Date(it.timestamp))} · ${backendLabel(it.backend)} · ${it.result}\n${it.stage} · ${it.reason}" +
                        if (it.suggestion.isBlank()) "" else "\n建议：${it.suggestion}"
                }.ifBlank { "暂无符合条件的日志" })
            }
            binding.moreLogs.visibility = if (visible.size > logLimit) View.VISIBLE else View.GONE
        }
        var renderRuntime: () -> Unit = {}
        fun section(key: String, button: MaterialButton, content: View, title: String) {
            fun update(open: Boolean) {
                expanded[key] = open
                content.visibility = if (open) View.VISIBLE else View.GONE
                button.setTextIfChanged(title)
                button.setIconResource(if (open) R.drawable.baseline_keyboard_arrow_up_24 else R.drawable.baseline_keyboard_arrow_down_24)
                button.contentDescription = "$title，${if (open) "已展开，点击收起" else "已收起，点击展开"}"

            update(savedInstanceState?.getBoolean(key) ?: expanded[key] ?: false)

                update(open)

                if (open) content.doOnLayout {

                    content.requestRectangleOnScreen(android.graphics.Rect(0, 0, content.width, height), true)
                }
            }
        }
        section("state", binding.toggleState, binding.stateDetails, "运行详情")
        section("developer", binding.toggleDeveloper, binding.developerDetails, getString(R.string.runtime_developer_title))
        section("capabilities", binding.toggleCapabilities, binding.capabilityDetails, "能力与诊断")
        section("logs", binding.toggleLogs, binding.logDetails, "运行日志")
        binding.logFilter.adapter = ArrayAdapter(requireContext(), android.R.layout.simple_spinner_dropdown_item,
            listOf("全部日志", "异常与待处理", "当前后端"))
        binding.logFilter.setSelection(filter)
        binding.logFilter.onItemSelectedListener = object : AdapterView.OnItemSelectedListener {
            override fun onNothingSelected(parent: AdapterView<*>?) = Unit
            override fun onItemSelected(parent: AdapterView<*>?, view: View?, position: Int, id: Long) {
                filter = position; logLimit = 20; renderLogs()
            }
        }
        binding.moreLogs.setOnClickListener { logLimit += 20; renderLogs() }
        binding.exportLogs.setOnClickListener { exportLog.launch("location-diagnostics.txt") }
        binding.clearLogs.setOnClickListener { clearedAt = System.currentTimeMillis(); logLimit = 20; renderLogs() }
        binding.copyLogs.setOnClickListener {

                .setPrimaryClip(ClipData.newPlainText("运行日志", binding.diagnostics.text))

        binding.backend.setSelection(types.indexOf(ScenarioRuntime.state.value.backend).coerceAtLeast(0))
        var nativeConfirmed = false
        fun restoreBackendSelection() {
            binding.backend.setSelection(types.indexOf(ScenarioRuntime.state.value.backend).coerceAtLeast(0))
        }
        fun confirmNative() {

                NativeRiskDialog().showNow(childFragmentManager, NativeRiskDialog.TAG)
            }
        }

            nativeConfirmed = result.getBoolean(NativeRiskDialog.ACCEPTED)

        binding.backend.onItemSelectedListener = object : AdapterView.OnItemSelectedListener {
            override fun onNothingSelected(parent: AdapterView<*>?) = Unit
            override fun onItemSelected(parent: AdapterView<*>?, selectedView: View?, position: Int, id: Long) {
                if (types[position] != BackendType.NATIVE) nativeConfirmed = false
                else if (ScenarioRuntime.state.value.backend != BackendType.NATIVE && !nativeConfirmed) confirmNative()
            }
        }
        binding.applyBackend.setOnClickListener {

            }

                .onFailure { Toast.makeText(requireContext(), "请手动打开系统设置中的开发者选项", Toast.LENGTH_LONG).show() }
        }
        binding.pauseResume.setOnClickListener {
            if (ScenarioRuntime.state.value.phase == RuntimePhase.PAUSED) ScenarioRuntime.resume() else ScenarioRuntime.pause()
        }
        binding.stopRuntime.setOnClickListener { ScenarioRuntime.stop() }
        binding.rebuildProviders.setOnClickListener {
            binding.rebuildProviders.isEnabled = false
            viewLifecycleOwner.lifecycleScope.launch {
                val rebuilt = ScenarioRuntime.rebuildMockProviders().await()
                binding.rebuildProviders.isEnabled = ScenarioRuntime.state.value.isActive &&
                    ScenarioRuntime.state.value.backend == BackendType.MOCK_PROVIDER
                Toast.makeText(context, if (rebuilt) "通道已重建，场景进度已保留" else "重建失败，请查看运行日志并检查授权", Toast.LENGTH_LONG).show()
            }

        binding.openEnvironmentTools.setOnClickListener {
            androidx.navigation.Navigation.findNavController(view).navigate(R.id.nav_environment)
        }
        binding.openLocationProbe.setOnClickListener {

        }
        binding.refreshDiagnostics.setOnClickListener {
            ScenarioRuntime.refreshDiagnostics()
            refreshEnvironment(binding, view)
        }
        fun renderState(state: com.system.location.service.core.runtime.RuntimeState) {
            binding.phaseTitle.setTextIfChanged(state.displayLabel())
            binding.phaseTitle.setTextColor(androidx.core.content.ContextCompat.getColor(requireContext(),
                when (state.phase) { RuntimePhase.RUNNING -> R.color.status_success; RuntimePhase.ERROR -> R.color.status_error; else -> R.color.text_primary }))
            binding.overview.setTextIfChanged("${backendLabel(state.backend)} · ${state.scenarioName ?: "未选择场景"}")
            renderEnvironment(binding, state)
            binding.routeProgress.visibility = if (state.routeId != null) View.VISIBLE else View.GONE
            val progress = (state.progress * 1000).toInt().coerceIn(0, 1000)
            if (binding.routeProgress.progress != progress) binding.routeProgress.progress = progress
            binding.applyBackend.isEnabled = !state.isActive
            binding.backend.isEnabled = !state.isActive
            binding.modeHint.setTextIfChanged(getString(if (state.isActive) R.string.runtime_mode_running else R.string.runtime_mode_hint))
            binding.rebuildProviders.isEnabled = state.isActive && state.backend == BackendType.MOCK_PROVIDER
            binding.stopRuntime.isEnabled = state.isActive || state.phase == RuntimePhase.ERROR
            if (binding.stateDetails.visibility == View.VISIBLE) binding.runtimeState.setTextIfChanged(buildString {
                val health = state.submissionHealth
                appendLine("提交 ${health.count} 次 · 最近间隔 ${health.lastGapMs.toLong()}ms · 最大间隔 ${health.maxGapMs.toLong()}ms")
                appendLine("最近耗时 ${health.lastLatencyMs.toLong()}ms · 最大耗时 ${health.maxLatencyMs.toLong()}ms · 延迟 ${health.delayedCount} 次")
                appendLine("提交成功不代表目标 App 已采用定位")
                appendLine("当前后端：${backendLabel(state.backend)}\n状态：${binding.phaseTitle.text}")
                appendLine("场景：${state.scenarioName ?: "未选择"}\n路线：${state.routeId ?: "—"}")
                state.sample?.let {
                    appendLine(String.format(Locale.ROOT, "WGS84：%.6f, %.6f", it.latitude, it.longitude))
                    appendLine(String.format(Locale.ROOT, "速度：%.2f km/h　进度：%.1f%%", it.speed * 3.6, state.progress * 100))
                }
                state.error?.let { appendLine("${it.stage}\n${it.reason}\n${it.suggestion}") }
            })
            binding.pauseResume.isEnabled = state.phase in setOf(RuntimePhase.RUNNING, RuntimePhase.PAUSED)
            val action = if (state.phase == RuntimePhase.PAUSED) "继续" else "暂停"
            if (binding.pauseResume.text != action) {
                binding.pauseResume.text = action
                binding.pauseResume.setIconResource(if (state.phase == RuntimePhase.PAUSED) R.drawable.baseline_play_24 else R.drawable.ic_pause)
            }
            if (binding.capabilityDetails.visibility == View.VISIBLE) binding.capabilities.setTextIfChanged(
                state.capabilities.entries.joinToString("\n\n") { (capability, status) ->
                    "${capabilityLabel(capability)}：${when (status.availability) {
                        Availability.AVAILABLE -> "可用"; Availability.REQUIRES_ACTION -> "需要设置"
                        Availability.UNAVAILABLE -> "不可用"; Availability.EXPERIMENTAL -> "实验性"
                    }}\n${status.reason}"
                })
        }
        renderRuntime = { renderState(ScenarioRuntime.state.value) }
        viewLifecycleOwner.lifecycleScope.launch {
            viewLifecycleOwner.repeatOnLifecycle(Lifecycle.State.STARTED) {
                refreshEnvironment(binding, view)
                launch {
                    ScenarioRuntime.state.displayStates().collect { state ->
                        renderState(state)
                    }
                }
                launch {
                    ScenarioRuntime.diagnostics.collect { latest ->
                        events = latest
                        renderLogs()
                    }
                }
            }
        }
    }
    private fun refreshEnvironment(binding: FragmentRuntimeBinding, owner: View) {
        val app = requireContext().applicationContext
        viewLifecycleOwner.lifecycleScope.launch {
            val result = withContext(Dispatchers.IO) { runCatching { RuntimeEnvironment.inspect(app) } }
            if (view !== owner) return@launch
            environment = result.getOrNull()
            environmentCheckFailed = result.isFailure
            renderEnvironment(binding, ScenarioRuntime.state.value)
        }
    }

    private var environmentRenderKey: String? = null
    private fun renderEnvironment(binding: FragmentRuntimeBinding, state: com.system.location.service.core.runtime.RuntimeState) {
        val env = environment
        val key = "$env/${state.backend}/${state.error}/$environmentCheckFailed"
        if (environmentRenderKey == key && binding.environmentRows.childCount > 0) return
        environmentRenderKey = key
        val ctx = binding.root.context
        val density = resources.displayMetrics.density
        fun dp(value: Int) = (value * density).toInt()
        binding.environmentRows.removeAllViews()
        fun row(title: Int, value: Int, ready: Boolean?) {
            val line = android.widget.LinearLayout(ctx).apply {
                orientation = android.widget.LinearLayout.HORIZONTAL
                gravity = android.view.Gravity.CENTER_VERTICAL
                setPadding(0, dp(10), 0, dp(10))
            }
            val color = androidx.core.content.ContextCompat.getColor(ctx,
                if (ready == true) R.color.status_success else R.color.text_secondary)
            val icon = android.widget.ImageView(ctx).apply {
                setImageResource(if (ready == true) R.drawable.ic_runtime_check else R.drawable.ic_runtime_circle)
                imageTintList = android.content.res.ColorStateList.valueOf(color)
                importantForAccessibility = View.IMPORTANT_FOR_ACCESSIBILITY_NO
            }
            line.addView(icon, android.widget.LinearLayout.LayoutParams(dp(20), dp(20)).apply { marginEnd = dp(12) })
            val labels = android.widget.LinearLayout(ctx).apply {
                orientation = android.widget.LinearLayout.VERTICAL
            }
            labels.addView(android.widget.TextView(ctx).apply {
                text = getString(title)
                textSize = 14f
                setTextColor(androidx.core.content.ContextCompat.getColor(ctx, R.color.text_primary))
            })
            labels.addView(android.widget.TextView(ctx).apply {
                text = getString(value)
                textSize = 12f
                setPadding(0, dp(3), 0, 0)
                setTextColor(color)
            })
            line.addView(labels, android.widget.LinearLayout.LayoutParams(0, android.view.ViewGroup.LayoutParams.WRAP_CONTENT, 1f))
            binding.environmentRows.addView(line)
        }
        if (env == null) {
            row(R.string.runtime_environment_title, if (environmentCheckFailed) R.string.runtime_check_failed else R.string.runtime_checking, null)
        } else {
            row(R.string.runtime_root, if (env.rootPresent) R.string.runtime_root_detected else R.string.runtime_root_absent, null)
            row(R.string.runtime_xposed, if (env.moduleConnected) R.string.runtime_connected else R.string.runtime_disconnected, env.moduleConnected)
            row(R.string.runtime_mock, if (env.mockAllowed) R.string.runtime_configured else R.string.runtime_not_configured, env.mockAllowed)
            row(R.string.runtime_permission, if (env.preciseLocation) R.string.runtime_granted else R.string.runtime_not_granted, env.preciseLocation)
            row(R.string.runtime_location, if (env.locationEnabled) R.string.runtime_enabled else R.string.runtime_disabled, env.locationEnabled)
        }
        val issues = buildList {
            state.error?.let { add(listOf(it.reason, it.suggestion).filter { text -> text.isNotBlank() }.joinToString("\n")) }
            env?.issues(state.backend)?.forEach { add(getString(it)) }
        }.distinct()
        binding.currentIssues.visibility = if (issues.isEmpty()) View.GONE else View.VISIBLE
        binding.currentIssues.setTextIfChanged(issues.joinToString("\n"))
    }

    override fun onSaveInstanceState(outState: Bundle) {
        super.onSaveInstanceState(outState)
        expanded.forEach { (key, value) -> outState.putBoolean(key, value) }
        outState.putLong("clearedAt", clearedAt)
        outState.putInt("filter", filter)
    }
    private fun backendLabel(type: BackendType) = when (type) {
        BackendType.MOCK_PROVIDER -> "标准模拟位置"
        BackendType.XPOSED -> "Xposed"
        BackendType.NATIVE -> "Native + Xposed"
    }
    private fun capabilityLabel(capability: Capability) = when (capability) {
        Capability.STANDARD_MOCK -> "标准模拟位置"
        Capability.XPOSED -> "系统 Hook"
        Capability.NATIVE -> "实验性 Native"
        Capability.GMS_FUSED -> "Google 融合定位"
        Capability.BACKGROUND_PLAYBACK -> "后台播放"
        Capability.PER_APP_SCENARIO -> "按应用分配场景"
        Capability.GNSS_INJECTION -> "GNSS 注入"
        Capability.SENSOR_SIMULATION -> "传感器模拟"
    }
}
```

`app/src/main/java/com/system/location/service/ui/settings/AppSelectionFragment.kt`:

```kt
package com.system.location.service.ui.settings

import android.content.Intent
import android.content.pm.ApplicationInfo
import android.os.Bundle
import android.view.LayoutInflater
import android.view.View
import android.view.ViewGroup
import androidx.compose.foundation.layout.*
import androidx.compose.foundation.lazy.LazyColumn
import androidx.compose.foundation.lazy.items
import androidx.compose.foundation.selection.toggleable

import androidx.compose.runtime.*

import androidx.compose.ui.Modifier
import androidx.compose.ui.platform.ComposeView
import androidx.compose.ui.platform.ViewCompositionStrategy
import androidx.compose.ui.semantics.Role
import androidx.compose.ui.unit.dp
import androidx.fragment.app.Fragment
import androidx.navigation.fragment.findNavController
import com.system.location.service.R
import com.system.location.service.designsystem.theme.PortalTheme
import kotlinx.coroutines.Dispatchers
import kotlinx.coroutines.withContext

private data class SelectableApp(val packageName: String, val label: String)

/** Drafts survive recreation; only Save sends a result to the owning settings page. */
class AppSelectionFragment : Fragment() {
    override fun onCreateView(inflater: LayoutInflater, container: ViewGroup?, savedInstanceState: Bundle?): View =
        ComposeView(requireContext()).apply {
            setViewCompositionStrategy(ViewCompositionStrategy.DisposeOnViewTreeLifecycleDestroyed)
            val arguments = requireArguments()
            val initial = arguments.getStringArrayList("selected") ?: arrayListOf()
            val appContext = requireContext().applicationContext
            setContent {
                PortalTheme {
                    var selected by rememberSaveable { mutableStateOf(ArrayList(initial)) }
                    var query by rememberSaveable { mutableStateOf("") }
                    var selectedOnly by rememberSaveable { mutableStateOf(false) }
                    var generation by remember { mutableIntStateOf(0) }
                    var error by remember { mutableStateOf<String?>(null) }
                    var loading by remember { mutableStateOf(true) }
                    var apps by remember { mutableStateOf<List<SelectableApp>>(emptyList()) }
                    LaunchedEffect(generation) {
                        loading = true
                        error = null
                        runCatching {
                            withContext(Dispatchers.IO) {
                                val pm = appContext.packageManager
                                val installed = pm.queryIntentActivities(
                                    Intent(Intent.ACTION_MAIN).addCategory(Intent.CATEGORY_LAUNCHER), 0,
                                ).map { it.activityInfo.applicationInfo }
                                    .filter { it.flags and ApplicationInfo.FLAG_SYSTEM == 0 }
                                    .distinctBy { it.packageName }
                                    .map { SelectableApp(it.packageName, pm.getApplicationLabel(it).toString()) }
                                val visible = installed.map { it.packageName }.toSet()
                                (installed + initial.filterNot { it in visible }.map {
                                    SelectableApp(it, "已保存的包名")
                                }).sortedBy { it.label.lowercase() }
                            }
                        }.onSuccess { apps = it }.onFailure { failure ->
                            if (failure is kotlinx.coroutines.CancellationException) throw failure
                            error = "无法加载应用列表，请重试"
                        }
                        loading = false
                    }
                    val visible = remember(apps, selected, query, selectedOnly) {
                        apps.filter { app ->
                            (!selectedOnly || app.packageName in selected) &&
                                (app.label.contains(query, true) || app.packageName.contains(query, true))
                        }
                    }
                    Column(Modifier.fillMaxSize().padding(horizontal = 20.dp)) {
                        OutlinedTextField(query, { query = it }, label = { Text("搜索应用名称或包名") },
                            singleLine = true, modifier = Modifier.fillMaxWidth())
                        Row(horizontalArrangement = Arrangement.spacedBy(12.dp)) {
                            FilterChip(selectedOnly, { selectedOnly = !selectedOnly },
                                label = { Text("仅已选 · ${selected.size}") })
                            TextButton(onClick = { selected = arrayListOf() }) { Text("清空选择") }
                        }
                        Text("未保存的修改在返回时放弃", style = MaterialTheme.typography.bodySmall,
                            color = MaterialTheme.colorScheme.onSurfaceVariant)
                        LazyColumn(Modifier.weight(1f).fillMaxWidth(), contentPadding = PaddingValues(vertical = 12.dp)) {
                            when {
                                loading -> item { LinearProgressIndicator(Modifier.fillMaxWidth()) }
                                error != null -> item {
                                    Text(error!!, color = MaterialTheme.colorScheme.error)
                                    TextButton(onClick = { generation++ }) { Text("重新加载") }
                                }
                                visible.isEmpty() -> item { Text("没有符合条件的应用") }
                                else -> items(visible, key = { it.packageName }) { app ->
                                    val checked = app.packageName in selected
                                    ListItem(
                                        headlineContent = { Text(app.label) },
                                        supportingContent = { Text(app.packageName) },
                                        trailingContent = { Checkbox(checked, onCheckedChange = null) },
                                        modifier = Modifier.toggleable(checked, role = Role.Checkbox) { enabled ->
                                            selected = ArrayList(selected.toMutableSet().apply {
                                                if (enabled) add(app.packageName) else remove(app.packageName)
                                            })
                                        },
                                    )
                                }
                            }
                        }
                        val limit = when (arguments.getString("purpose")) {
                            "sensors" -> 128
                            "carrier" -> com.system.location.service.core.carrier.CarrierIdentityConfig.MAX_ROUTES
                            else -> Int.MAX_VALUE
                        }
                        val overLimit = selected.size > limit
                        if (overLimit) Text("最多选择 $limit 个应用", color = MaterialTheme.colorScheme.error)
                        Button(onClick = {
                            parentFragmentManager.setFragmentResult(RESULT, Bundle(arguments).apply {
                                putStringArrayList("selected", selected)
                            })
                            val nav = findNavController()
                            if (nav.previousBackStackEntry?.destination?.id == R.id.nav_point_selection) {
                                nav.popBackStack(R.id.nav_point_selection, true)
                            } else nav.popBackStack()
                        }, enabled = !loading && error == null && !overLimit,
                            modifier = Modifier.fillMaxWidth().padding(vertical = 12.dp)) {
                            Text("保存选择（${selected.size}）")
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
        }

    companion object { const val RESULT = "portal-app-selection" }
}
```
