```kt
import com.system.location.service.privacy.SdkPrivacy
import com.system.location.service.runtime.ScenarioRuntime
import com.system.location.service.ui.preferenceRevision
import com.system.location.service.update.UpdateChannel
import com.system.location.service.update.UpdateChecker
import com.system.location.service.update.UpdateDialogFragment
import kotlinx.coroutines.Dispatchers
import kotlinx.coroutines.flow.MutableStateFlow
import kotlinx.coroutines.launch
import kotlinx.coroutines.withContext
import kotlinx.serialization.json.Json

/** Settings presentation; preference writes continue through the existing configuration API. */
class SettingsComposeFragment : Fragment() {
    private val captureModel by viewModels<GnssCaptureViewModel>()
    private val revision = MutableStateFlow(0)
    private var updateRequest = 0L
    override fun onCreate(savedInstanceState: Bundle?) {
        super.onCreate(savedInstanceState)
        parentFragmentManager.setFragmentResultListener(AppSelectionFragment.RESULT, this) { _, result ->
            val selected = result.getStringArrayList("selected")?.toSet() ?: return@setFragmentResultListener
            val context = requireContext()
            when (result.getString("purpose")) {
                "sensors" -> {
                    if (selected.size > 128) { showToast("最多选择 128 个应用"); return@setFragmentResultListener }
                    context.sensorTargetPackages = selected
                }
                "excluded", "point" -> {
                    val existing = runCatching {
                        readRoutingSettings(context.routingJson)
                    }.getOrElse { showToast("原有应用规则无法读取，未覆盖配置"); return@setFragmentResultListener }
                    val next = if (result.getString("purpose") == "excluded") existing.withDeniedPackages(selected)
                    else existing.withPointAssignments(
                        com.system.location.service.core.geo.Wgs84(result.getDouble("latitude"), result.getDouble("longitude")), selected)
                    context.routingJson = Json.encodeToString(RoutingConfig.serializer(), next)
                }
                else -> return@setFragmentResultListener
            }
            refresh()
            applyConfigNowWithToast()
        }
    }

    override fun onCreateView(
        inflater: LayoutInflater,
        container: ViewGroup?,
        savedInstanceState: Bundle?,
    ): View = ComposeView(requireContext()).apply {
        setViewCompositionStrategy(ViewCompositionStrategy.DisposeOnViewTreeLifecycleDestroyed)
        setContent {
            val revisionState = revision.collectAsStateWithLifecycle()
            var numberSetting by rememberSaveable { mutableStateOf<NumberSetting?>(null) }
            PortalTheme {
                SettingsScreen(
                    category = arguments?.getString("category")?.let(SettingsCategory::valueOf),
                    onCategory = { findNavController().navigate(it.destination) },
                    captureModel = captureModel,
                    revision = revisionState.value,
                    onMapProvider = ::showMapProvider,
                    onMapKeys = { findNavController().navigate(R.id.nav_map_keys) },
                    onCarrierIdentity = { findNavController().navigate(R.id.nav_carrier_identity) },
                    onEditAltitude = { numberSetting = NumberSetting.ALTITUDE },
                    onEditAccuracy = { numberSetting = NumberSetting.ACCURACY },
                    onEditReportInterval = { numberSetting = NumberSetting.INTERVAL },
                    onEditSpeed = { numberSetting = NumberSetting.SPEED },
                    onEditSatelliteCount = { numberSetting = NumberSetting.SATELLITES },
                    onRouteEndPosition = ::showRouteEndPosition,
                    onAppRouting = ::showAppRouting,
                    onSensorTargets = {
                        val context = requireContext()
                        openAppSelection("sensors", "传感器目标应用", context.sensorTargetPackages)
                    },
                    onEditSensorPackages = {
                        findNavController().navigate(R.id.nav_sensor_packages, Bundle().apply {
                            putStringArrayList("selected", ArrayList(requireContext().sensorTargetPackages.sorted()))
                        })
                    },
                    onAppPoint = ::showAppPoint,
                    onBackgroundGuidance = { com.system.location.service.runtime.BackgroundGuidance.show(requireContext()) },
                    onCrashReporting = { enabled -> setCrashReporting(enabled) },
                    onUpdateChannel = ::showUpdateChannel,
                    onCheckUpdate = ::checkForUpdate,
                    onConfigChanged = ::applyConfigNowWithToast,
                    onRestartRequired = { showToast("已保存，停止后重新启动场景生效") },
                    refresh = ::refresh,
                )
                numberSetting?.let { setting ->
                    val initial = when (setting) {
                        NumberSetting.ALTITUDE -> context.altitude.toString()
                        NumberSetting.ACCURACY -> context.accuracy.toString()
                        NumberSetting.INTERVAL -> context.reportDuration.toString()
                        NumberSetting.SPEED -> context.speed.toString()
                        NumberSetting.SATELLITES -> context.minSatelliteCount.toString()
                    }
                    NumberSettingDialog(setting, initial, onDismiss = { numberSetting = null },
                        onSave = { raw -> saveNumber(setting, raw) })
                }
            }
        }
    }

    private fun refresh() {
        revision.value += 1
    }

    private fun showToast(message: String) {
        if (!isAdded) return
        Toast.makeText(requireContext(), message, Toast.LENGTH_SHORT).show()
    }

    private fun saveNumber(setting: NumberSetting, raw: String): String? = runCatching {
        val context = requireContext()
        when (setting) {
            NumberSetting.ALTITUDE -> {
                val value = raw.toDoubleOrNull() ?: error("海拔高度不合法")
                require(value in 0.0..10_000.0) { "海拔需在 0–10000 米之间" }
                context.altitude = value
                refresh()
            }
            NumberSetting.ACCURACY -> {
                val value = raw.toFloatOrNull() ?: error("精度不合法")
                require(value > 0f && value <= 1_000f) { "精度需大于 0 且不超过 1000 米" }
                context.accuracy = value
                refresh()
            }
            NumberSetting.INTERVAL -> {
                val value = raw.toIntOrNull() ?: error("上报间隔不合法")
                require(value in 50..1_000) { "上报间隔需在 50–1000 ms 之间" }
                context.reportDuration = value
                refresh()
            }
            NumberSetting.SPEED -> {
                val value = raw.toDoubleOrNull() ?: error("速度不合法")
                require(value in 0.0..com.system.location.service.core.location.LocationSanitizer.MAX_SPEED_MPS) {
                    "速度需在 0–1000 米/秒之间"
                }
                lifecycleScope.launch {
                    val accepted = ScenarioRuntime.setSpeed(value).await()
                    showToast(if (accepted) "速度已更新" else "速度更新失败，请重试")
                }
            }
            NumberSetting.SATELLITES -> {
                val value = raw.toIntOrNull() ?: error("数量不合法")
                require(value in 0..128) { "卫星数量需在 0–128 之间；0 表示自动生成" }
                context.minSatelliteCount = value
                refresh()
                applyConfigNowWithToast()
            }
        }
    }.exceptionOrNull()?.let { it.message ?: "输入不合法" }

    private fun showMapProvider() {
        val context = requireContext()
        val selected = context.mapProvider
        MaterialAlertDialogBuilder(context)
            .setTitle("地图服务")
            .setSingleChoiceItems(com.system.location.service.maps.MapProvider.entries.map { it.label }.toTypedArray(), selected.ordinal) { dialog, which ->
                dialog.dismiss()
                val next = com.system.location.service.maps.MapProvider.entries[which]
                if (next != selected) {
                    val message = if (next == com.system.location.service.maps.MapProvider.TENCENT) {
                        getString(R.string.tencent_privacy_message)
                    } else getString(R.string.map_privacy_message)
                    MaterialAlertDialogBuilder(context)
                        .setTitle("切换到${next.label}")
                        .setMessage(message)
                        .setNeutralButton("查看政策") { _, _ ->
                            runCatching {
                                startActivity(Intent(Intent.ACTION_VIEW, android.net.Uri.parse(
                                    if (next == com.system.location.service.maps.MapProvider.TENCENT) {
                                        "https://lbs.qq.com/userAgreements/agreements/privacy"
                                    } else "https://lbs.amap.com/pages/privacy/",
                                )))
                            }
                        }
                        .setNegativeButton("取消", null)
                        .setPositiveButton("同意并切换") { _, _ ->
                            runCatching {
                                if (next == com.system.location.service.maps.MapProvider.TENCENT) {
                                    com.system.location.service.privacy.TencentPrivacy.accept(context)
                                } else SdkPrivacy.acceptMaps()
                                context.mapProvider = next
                                requireActivity().recreate()
                            }.onFailure { showToast(it.message ?: "切换失败") }
                        }.show()
                }
            }
            .setNegativeButton("取消", null)
            .show()
    }

    private fun showAppRouting() {
        val context = requireContext()
        val existing = runCatching {
            readRoutingSettings(context.routingJson)
        }.getOrNull()
        if (existing == null) { showToast("原有应用规则无法读取，未覆盖配置"); return }
        openAppSelection("excluded", "分应用排除", existing.deniedPackages)
    }

    private fun showAppPoint() {
        findNavController().navigate(R.id.nav_point_selection)
    }

    private fun openAppSelection(purpose: String, title: String, selected: Set<String>, extra: Bundle = Bundle()) {
        findNavController().navigate(R.id.nav_app_selection, extra.apply {
            putString("purpose", purpose)
            putString("title", title)
            putStringArrayList("selected", ArrayList(selected.sorted()))
        })
    }

    private fun setCrashReporting(enabled: Boolean) {
        runCatching { SdkPrivacy.setCrashReporting(enabled) }
            .onSuccess {
                refresh()
                showToast(when {
                    SdkPrivacy.crashReportingPendingRestart -> "重启应用后开启崩溃报告"
                    enabled -> "崩溃报告已开启"
                    else -> "崩溃报告已关闭"
                })
            }
            .onFailure { showToast(it.message ?: "无法修改崩溃报告设置") }
    }

    private fun showUpdateChannel() {
        val current = UpdateChecker.currentChannel()
        val options = arrayOf(getString(R.string.update_channel_stable), getString(R.string.update_channel_beta))
        MaterialAlertDialogBuilder(requireContext())
            .setTitle(R.string.update_channel_label)
            .setSingleChoiceItems(options, if (current == UpdateChannel.BETA) 1 else 0) { dialog, which ->
                dialog.dismiss()
                val next = if (which == 1) UpdateChannel.BETA else UpdateChannel.STABLE
                runCatching { UpdateChecker.setChannel(next) }
                    .onSuccess {
                        refresh()
                        showToast("更新通道已切换")
                        (activity as? MainActivity)?.onUpdateChannelChanged()
                    }
                    .onFailure { showToast(it.message ?: "无法保存更新通道") }
            }
            .setNegativeButton(android.R.string.cancel, null)
            .show()
    }

    private fun showRouteEndPosition() {
        val context = requireContext()
        val options = RouteEndPosition.entries.toTypedArray()
        val selected = options.indexOf(context.routeEndPosition).coerceAtLeast(0)
        MaterialAlertDialogBuilder(context)
            .setTitle("路线结束后停留位置")
            .setSingleChoiceItems(options.map(::routeEndPositionLabel).toTypedArray(), selected) { dialog, which ->
                context.routeEndPosition = options[which]
                dialog.dismiss()
                refresh()
            }
            .setNegativeButton("取消", null)
            .show()
    }

    private fun checkForUpdate() {
        val request = ++updateRequest
        val channel = UpdateChecker.currentChannel()
        lifecycleScope.launch {
            val result = UpdateChecker.check(channel)
            if (!isAdded || request != updateRequest) return@launch
            when (result) {
                is UpdateChecker.Result.UpdateAvailable -> UpdateDialogFragment.show(requireActivity().supportFragmentManager, result.info)
                is UpdateChecker.Result.UpToDate -> showToast("当前已是最新版本")
                is UpdateChecker.Result.Error -> showToast("检查更新失败：${result.message}")
            }
        }
    }

    private fun applyConfigNowWithToast() {
        lifecycleScope.launch {
            val applied = withContext(Dispatchers.IO) { ScenarioRuntime.applyConfigNow() }
            showToast(if (applied) "配置已应用" else "已保存，下次启动场景生效")
        }
    }
}

private const val NEXT_SCENE = "下次启动场景生效"
private const val APPLY_WHILE_RUNNING = "运行中尝试立即应用"

private fun routeEndPositionLabel(value: RouteEndPosition) = when (value) {
    RouteEndPosition.START -> "起点"
    RouteEndPosition.END -> "终点"
    RouteEndPosition.REAL_LOCATION -> "真实定位"
}

private data class SettingsValues(
    val altitude: Double,
    val accuracy: Float,
    val reportDuration: Int,
    val speed: Double,
    val minSatelliteCount: Int,
    val mapProviderLabel: String,
    val updateChannelLabel: String,
    val smoothRouteMotion: Boolean,
    val routeEndPosition: RouteEndPosition,
    val physicalNoise: Boolean,
    val gmsMockEnabled: Boolean,
    val platformFusedEnabled: Boolean,
    val startupBurstEnabled: Boolean,
    val experimentalClearMockFlag: Boolean,
    val simReady: Boolean,
    val debug: Boolean,
    val disableGetCurrentLocation: Boolean,
    val disableRegisterLocationListener: Boolean,
    val disableFusedProvider: Boolean,
    val needDowngradeToCdma: Boolean,
    val hideMock: Boolean,
    val carrierIdentityEnabled: Boolean,
    val antiDetectEnabled: Boolean,
    val stackTraceCleanEnabled: Boolean,
    val mockWifiEnabled: Boolean,
    val loopBroadcastlocation: Boolean,
    val crashReporting: Boolean,
    val crashReportingEnabled: Boolean,
    val crashReportingPendingRestart: Boolean,
)

@Composable
private fun SettingsScreen(
    category: SettingsCategory?,
    onCategory: (SettingsCategory) -> Unit,
    captureModel: GnssCaptureViewModel,
    revision: Int,
    onMapProvider: () -> Unit,
    onMapKeys: () -> Unit,
    onCarrierIdentity: () -> Unit,
    onEditAltitude: () -> Unit,
    onEditAccuracy: () -> Unit,
    onEditReportInterval: () -> Unit,
    onEditSpeed: () -> Unit,
    onEditSatelliteCount: () -> Unit,
    onRouteEndPosition: () -> Unit,
    onAppRouting: () -> Unit,
    onSensorTargets: () -> Unit,
    onEditSensorPackages: () -> Unit,
    onAppPoint: () -> Unit,
    onBackgroundGuidance: () -> Unit,
    onCrashReporting: (Boolean) -> Unit,
    onUpdateChannel: () -> Unit,
    onCheckUpdate: () -> Unit,
    onConfigChanged: () -> Unit,
    onRestartRequired: () -> Unit,
    refresh: () -> Unit,
) {
    val context = LocalContext.current
    // Lazy item lambdas are memoized. Capture immutable values that change with the
    // revision, rather than reading non-observable preferences inside skipped items.
    val preferencesRevision = preferenceRevision()
    val values = remember(context, revision, preferencesRevision) {
        SettingsValues(
            altitude = context.altitude,
            accuracy = context.accuracy,
            reportDuration = context.reportDuration,
            speed = context.speed,
            minSatelliteCount = context.minSatelliteCount,
            mapProviderLabel = context.mapProvider.label,
            updateChannelLabel = if (UpdateChecker.currentChannel() == UpdateChannel.BETA) "Beta" else "正式版",
            smoothRouteMotion = context.smoothRouteMotion,
            routeEndPosition = context.routeEndPosition,
            physicalNoise = context.physicalNoise,
            gmsMockEnabled = context.gmsMockEnabled,
            platformFusedEnabled = context.platformFusedEnabled,
            startupBurstEnabled = context.startupBurstEnabled,
            experimentalClearMockFlag = context.experimentalClearMockFlag,
            simReady = context.simReady,
            debug = context.debug,
            disableGetCurrentLocation = context.disableGetCurrentLocation,
            disableRegisterLocationListener = context.disableRegisterLocationListener,
            disableFusedProvider = context.disableFusedProvider,
            needDowngradeToCdma = context.needDowngradeToCdma,
            hideMock = context.hideMock,
            carrierIdentityEnabled = context.carrierIdentityEnabled,
            antiDetectEnabled = context.antiDetectEnabled,
            stackTraceCleanEnabled = context.stackTraceCleanEnabled,
            mockWifiEnabled = context.mockWifiEnabled,
            loopBroadcastlocation = context.loopBroadcastlocation,
            crashReporting = SdkPrivacy.crashReportingRequested,
            crashReportingEnabled = SdkPrivacy.crashReportingEnabled,
            crashReportingPendingRestart = SdkPrivacy.crashReportingPendingRestart,
        )
    }
    val runtime by ScenarioRuntime.state.collectAsStateWithLifecycle()
    val backend = runtime.backend
    val sensorTargets = remember(context, revision, preferencesRevision) { context.sensorTargetPackages }
    val routingSummary by produceState("正在读取应用规则" to "正在读取应用规则", preferencesRevision, category) {
        if (category == SettingsCategory.APPS) value = withContext(Dispatchers.IO) {
            runCatching { readRoutingSettings(context.routingJson) }.fold(
                onSuccess = { rules ->
                    "已排除 ${rules.deniedPackages.size} 个应用" to
                        "已固定 ${rules.routes.count { it.point != null }} 个应用"
                },
                onFailure = { "无法读取已有规则" to "无法读取已有规则" },
            )
        }
    }
    val hooksEnabled = backend != BackendType.MOCK_PROVIDER
    fun hookAction(block: (Boolean) -> Unit): ((Boolean) -> Unit)? = if (hooksEnabled) {
        { checked -> block(checked); refresh(); onConfigChanged() }
    } else null

    Surface(Modifier.fillMaxSize(), color = MaterialTheme.colorScheme.background) {
        Box(Modifier.fillMaxSize(), contentAlignment = Alignment.TopCenter) {
            LazyColumn(
                modifier = Modifier.widthIn(max = 720.dp).fillMaxSize(),
                contentPadding = PaddingValues(20.dp, 16.dp, 20.dp, 32.dp),
                verticalArrangement = Arrangement.spacedBy(16.dp),
            ) {
                if (category == null) {
                    item(key = "directory") {
                        SettingsDirectory(onCategory = onCategory, hooksEnabled = hooksEnabled,
                            mapProvider = values.mapProviderLabel, updateChannel = values.updateChannelLabel)
                    }
                }
                if (category == SettingsCategory.LOCATION) {
                    item(key = "maps") {
                        PortalSettingGroup("地图服务", 2) { index, rowModifier ->
                            if (index == 0) PortalActionRow("地图提供方", values.mapProviderLabel, onMapProvider, modifier = rowModifier, status = "切换后重建地图")
                            else PortalActionRow("地图 Key", runCatching {
                                val amap = com.system.location.service.maps.AMapKeySettings.customKey(context)
                                val tencent = com.system.location.service.maps.TencentKeySettings.customKey(context)
                                when {
                                    amap != null && tencent != null -> "高德、腾讯均使用自定义 Key"
                                    amap != null -> "高德使用自定义 Key"
                                    tencent != null -> "腾讯使用自定义 Key"
                                    else -> "使用内置 Key"
                                }
                            }.getOrElse { "Key 读取失败" }, onMapKeys, modifier = rowModifier,
                                status = "包名与 SHA1 可复制到申请页")
                        }
                    }
                    item(key = "location") {
                        val parameters = listOf(
                            Triple("定位海拔", "%.2f 米".format(values.altitude), onEditAltitude),
                            Triple("定位精度", "%.2f 米".format(values.accuracy), onEditAccuracy),
                            Triple("位置上报间隔", "${values.reportDuration} ms", onEditReportInterval),
                        )
                        Column {
                            PortalSettingGroup("定位参数", parameters.size) { index, rowModifier ->
                                val (title, value, edit) = parameters[index]
                                PortalActionRow(title, value, edit, modifier = rowModifier, status = NEXT_SCENE)
                            }
                        }
                    }
                }
                if (category == SettingsCategory.MOTION) {
                    item(key = "motion") {
                        PortalSettingGroup("运动与摇杆", 4) { index, rowModifier ->
                            when (index) {
                                0 -> PortalActionRow("摇杆速度", "%.2f 米/秒".format(values.speed), onEditSpeed, status = "保存后立即更新",
                                    modifier = rowModifier,
                                )
                                1 -> PortalSwitchRow(
                                    title = "路线平滑运动",
                                    status = NEXT_SCENE,
                                    subtitle = "弯道减速、平滑加减速。",
                                    checked = values.smoothRouteMotion,
                                    onCheckedChange = { context.smoothRouteMotion = it; refresh() },
                                    modifier = rowModifier,
                                )
                                2 -> PortalActionRow(
                                    title = "路线结束后停留位置",
                                    status = routeEndPositionLabel(values.routeEndPosition),
```

```kt
package com.system.location.service.ui.settings

import androidx.compose.foundation.layout.Arrangement

internal enum class SettingsCategory(val title: String, val summary: String, val destination: Int, val icon: Int) {
    LOCATION("地图与定位", "地图服务、海拔、精度与上报间隔", R.id.nav_settings_location, R.drawable.ic_portal_map),
    MOTION("运动与摇杆", "速度、路线平滑与结束位置", R.id.nav_settings_motion, R.drawable.ic_portal_motion),
    GNSS("卫星与 GNSS", "卫星生成、数量策略与接收环境", R.id.nav_settings_gnss, R.drawable.ic_portal_satellite),
    APPS("分应用规则", "应用路由、固定点与传感器目标", R.id.nav_settings_apps, R.drawable.ic_portal_apps),
    SYSTEM("系统与环境模拟", "SIM、Wi-Fi、网络类型与环境配置", R.id.nav_settings_system, R.drawable.ic_portal_system),
    ADVANCED("高级与实验", "定位通道、兼容选项与实验功能", R.id.nav_settings_advanced, R.drawable.ic_portal_experiment),
    PRIVACY("后台与隐私", "后台运行与崩溃报告", R.id.nav_settings_privacy, R.drawable.ic_portal_privacy),
    UPDATES("关于与更新", "应用图标、检查更新与更新通道", R.id.nav_settings_updates, R.drawable.ic_portal_update),
}

@Composable
internal fun SettingsDirectory(
    onCategory: (SettingsCategory) -> Unit,
    hooksEnabled: Boolean,
    mapProvider: String,
    updateChannel: String,
) {
    Column(verticalArrangement = Arrangement.spacedBy(16.dp)) {
        PortalSectionTitle("偏好与服务", "按使用场景管理设置与模拟能力")
        listOf(
            "常用设置" to listOf(SettingsCategory.LOCATION, SettingsCategory.MOTION),
            "模拟能力" to listOf(SettingsCategory.GNSS, SettingsCategory.APPS, SettingsCategory.SYSTEM, SettingsCategory.ADVANCED),
            "应用" to listOf(SettingsCategory.PRIVACY, SettingsCategory.UPDATES),
        ).forEach { (title, categories) ->
            PortalSettingGroup(title, categories.size) { index, rowModifier ->
                val category = categories[index]
                val status = when (category) {
                    SettingsCategory.LOCATION -> "当前地图：$mapProvider"
                    SettingsCategory.GNSS, SettingsCategory.SYSTEM -> if (hooksEnabled) "Xposed / Native" else "需 Xposed / Native"
                    SettingsCategory.APPS -> "应用传感器需 Xposed"
                    SettingsCategory.UPDATES -> "当前通道：$updateChannel"
                    else -> null
                }
                PortalActionRow(
                    title = category.title,
                    modifier = rowModifier,
                    subtitle = listOfNotNull(category.summary, status).joinToString("\n"),
                    onClick = { onCategory(category) },
                    leadingContent = {
                        PortalIconBadge {
                            Icon(painterResource(category.icon), null, Modifier.size(22.dp))
                        }
                    },
                )
            }
        }
    }
}
```

`app/src/main/java/com/system/location/service/ui/viewmodel/AMapViewModel.kt`:

```kt
package com.system.location.service.ui.viewmodel

import android.app.Notification
import androidx.lifecycle.ViewModel

class AMapViewModel: ViewModel() {
    var isExists = false

    /**
     * Current location
     * WGS84
     */
    var currentLocation: Pair<Double, Double>? = null
    // First trusted real fix for this app session. Never assigned from simulation samples.
    var originalLocation: Pair<Double, Double>? = null
        private set

    fun rememberOriginalLocation(point: Pair<Double, Double>, isMock: Boolean, simulationActive: Boolean): Boolean {
        if (originalLocation != null || isMock || simulationActive ||
            point.first !in -90.0..90.0 || point.second !in -180.0..180.0) return false
        originalLocation = point
        return true
    }

    var markName: String? = null

    /**
     * Marked location
     * WGS84
     * first => latitude
     * second => longitude
     */
    var markedLoc: Pair<Double, Double>? = null
    var showDetailView = false

    /* Notification */
    var mNotification: Notification? = null

    // Kept for the legacy AMap configuration extension; map views own SDK resources.
    enum class Perspective { NORMAL, FOLLOWING }
}
```

`app/src/main/java/com/system/location/service/ui/viewmodel/GnssCaptureViewModel.kt`:

```kt
package com.system.location.service.ui.viewmodel

import android.app.Application
import android.os.SystemClock
import android.provider.Settings
import androidx.lifecycle.AndroidViewModel
import androidx.lifecycle.viewModelScope
import com.system.location.service.core.gnss.GnssObservationProfile
import com.system.location.service.core.gnss.GnssCapture
import com.system.location.service.core.gnss.GnssCapturePreview
import com.system.location.service.core.gnss.GnssCapturePreviewer
import com.system.location.service.gnss.GnssCaptureRepository
import com.system.location.service.gnss.GnssReceiverCollector
import kotlinx.coroutines.Dispatchers
import kotlinx.coroutines.currentCoroutineContext
import kotlinx.coroutines.delay
import kotlinx.coroutines.isActive
import kotlinx.coroutines.withContext
import kotlinx.coroutines.flow.flow
import kotlinx.coroutines.flow.Flow
import kotlinx.coroutines.sync.Mutex
import kotlinx.coroutines.sync.withLock
import kotlinx.coroutines.CancellationException
import kotlinx.coroutines.Job
import kotlinx.coroutines.flow.MutableStateFlow
import kotlinx.coroutines.flow.asStateFlow
import kotlinx.coroutines.launch

data class GnssCaptureUiState(
    val loading: Boolean = true,
    val collecting: Boolean = false,
    val frames: Int = 0,
    val profile: GnssObservationProfile? = null,
    val message: String? = null,
)

class GnssCaptureViewModel(application: Application) : AndroidViewModel(application) {
    private val repository = GnssCaptureRepository(application)
    private val collector = GnssReceiverCollector(application)
    private val mutableState = MutableStateFlow(GnssCaptureUiState())
    val state = mutableState.asStateFlow()
    private var captureJob: Job? = null

    private val captureMutex = Mutex()
    private var previewer = GnssCapturePreviewer(null)

    init { viewModelScope.launch { reload() } }

    /** A cold flow runs only while the visible screen collects it; eligibility is reevaluated. */
    fun preview(minimumSatellites: Int): Flow<GnssCapturePreview> = flow {
        reload()
        // This process cannot survive a reboot; a visible preview session uses one boot identity.
        val bootCount = withContext(Dispatchers.IO) {
            runCatching { Settings.Global.getInt(getApplication<Application>().contentResolver,
                Settings.Global.BOOT_COUNT).takeIf { it >= 0 } }.getOrNull()
        }
        while (currentCoroutineContext().isActive) {
            val source = previewer
            emit(withContext(Dispatchers.Default) { source.current(System.currentTimeMillis(), minimumSatellites,
                SystemClock.elapsedRealtimeNanos(), bootCount) })
            delay(1000)
        }
    }

    private suspend fun accept(capture: GnssCapture?) {
        val profile = withContext(Dispatchers.Default) { capture?.profile() }
        previewer = GnssCapturePreviewer(capture)
        mutableState.value = state.value.copy(profile = profile)
    }

    private suspend fun reload() = captureMutex.withLock {
        try {
            accept(repository.load())
        } catch (cancelled: CancellationException) {
            throw cancelled
        } catch (error: Exception) {
            previewer = GnssCapturePreviewer(null)
            mutableState.value = state.value.copy(profile = null, message = "采集记录读取失败：${error.message}")
        } finally { mutableState.value = state.value.copy(loading = false) }
    }

    fun capture() {
        if (state.value.loading || state.value.collecting) return
        mutableState.value = state.value.copy(collecting = true, frames = 0, message = null)
        captureJob = viewModelScope.launch {
            try {
                val capture = collector.capture { frames -> mutableState.value = state.value.copy(frames = frames) }
                captureMutex.withLock {
                    repository.save(capture)
                    accept(capture)
                }
                mutableState.value = state.value.copy(
                    message = "已保存真实采集：${capture.frames.size} 帧，原始测量 ${capture.measurements.size} 批，导航电文 ${capture.navigation.size} 条")
            } catch (cancelled: CancellationException) {
                mutableState.value = state.value.copy(message = "采集已取消，保留上次记录")
                throw cancelled
            } catch (error: Exception) {
                mutableState.value = state.value.copy(message = error.message ?: "真实卫星采集失败")
            } finally { mutableState.value = state.value.copy(collecting = false) }
        }
    }

    fun cancel() { captureJob?.cancel() }
}
```

`app/src/main/java/com/system/location/service/ui/viewmodel/GnssSkyPreviewViewModel.kt`:

```kt
package com.system.location.service.ui.viewmodel

import android.app.Application
import androidx.lifecycle.AndroidViewModel
import androidx.lifecycle.viewModelScope
import com.system.location.service.core.gnss.GnssSimulationMode
import com.system.location.service.core.gnss.ReceiverGnssFrame
import com.system.location.service.core.gnss.RinexNavigationResource
import com.system.location.service.core.gnss.RinexNavigationResourceStore
import com.system.location.service.core.runtime.PreparedRuntimeConfiguration
import com.system.location.service.data.persistence.HookConfigurationPreferences
import com.system.location.service.ext.sharedPrefs
import com.system.location.service.gnss.GnssSkyPreview
import com.system.location.service.gnss.GnssNavigationSyncStatus
import com.system.location.service.hook.utils.FakeLoc
import com.system.location.service.runtime.ScenarioRuntime
import java.io.File
import kotlinx.coroutines.CancellationException
import kotlinx.coroutines.Dispatchers
import kotlinx.coroutines.currentCoroutineContext
import kotlinx.coroutines.delay
import kotlinx.coroutines.flow.SharingStarted
import kotlinx.coroutines.flow.flow
import kotlinx.coroutines.flow.stateIn
import kotlinx.coroutines.isActive
import kotlinx.coroutines.withContext

data class GnssSkyPreviewState(
    val frame: ReceiverGnssFrame? = null,
    val message: String = "等待模拟目标坐标",
    val resourceWarning: String? = null,
)

/** Visible-screen prediction only. Does not publish or advance a receiver route. */
class GnssSkyPreviewViewModel(application: Application) : AndroidViewModel(application) {
    internal val navigationSync = GnssNavigationSyncStatus.shared.state
    val state = flow {
        val engine = GnssSkyPreview()
        val file = File(application.noBackupFilesDir, "gnss/navigation-resource.json")
        val store = RinexNavigationResourceStore(file)
        var navigation: RinexNavigationResource? = null
        var resourceWarning: String? = null
        var previousStamp: Pair<Long, Long>? = null
        var ticksSinceRead = 30
        while (currentCoroutineContext().isActive) {
            val next = try {
                val configuration = withContext(Dispatchers.IO) {
                    val fallback = FakeLoc.runtimeSnapshots.current()
                    val stamp = file.lastModified() to file.length()
                    // Atomic replacements usually change the stamp. Also probe periodically for
                    // same-size, same-timestamp replacements; never decode a megabyte each tick.
                    if (stamp != previousStamp || ticksSinceRead >= 30) {
                        try {
                            navigation = store.load()
                            resourceWarning = null
                        } catch (cancelled: CancellationException) {
                            throw cancelled
                        } catch (error: Exception) {
                            navigation = navigation ?: fallback.configuration.gnssNavigation
                            resourceWarning = "导航缓存读取失败，保留已接受资源；无适用轨道时使用虚拟兜底：${error.message}"
                        }
                        previousStamp = stamp
                        ticksSinceRead = 0
                    }
                    ticksSinceRead++
                    PreparedRuntimeConfiguration.prepare(
                        HookConfigurationPreferences.readGnss(application.sharedPrefs.all, fallback)
                    ).applyTo(fallback).configuration
                }
                val runtime = ScenarioRuntime.state.value
                val sample = runtime.sample?.takeIf { runtime.isActive }
                when {
                    configuration.gnssSimulation.mode == GnssSimulationMode.OFF ->
                        GnssSkyPreviewState(message = "卫星模拟已关闭，保留真实 GNSS 回调")
                    configuration.gnssSimulation.mode == GnssSimulationMode.REPLAY ->
                        GnssSkyPreviewState(message = "当前为实测回放；请查看采集地回放参考")
                    sample == null -> GnssSkyPreviewState(message = "运行场景后，按模拟目标坐标与时间预测天空")
                    else -> GnssSkyPreviewState(
                        frame = withContext(Dispatchers.Default) {
                            engine.frame(sample, configuration.minimumSatellites,
                                configuration.gnssSimulation, navigation, configuration.gnssSource,
                                System.currentTimeMillis())
                        },
                        message = "运行场景目标 · 本地预测，不代表接收端已收到",
                        resourceWarning = resourceWarning,
                    )
                }
            } catch (cancelled: CancellationException) {
                throw cancelled
            } catch (error: Exception) {
                // Drop the previous frame when the target/configuration cannot be evaluated.
                GnssSkyPreviewState(message = "目标天空预测失败：${error.message}", resourceWarning = resourceWarning)
            }
            emit(next)
            delay(1000)
        }
    }.stateIn(viewModelScope, SharingStarted.WhileSubscribed(stopTimeoutMillis = 0, replayExpirationMillis = 0),
        GnssSkyPreviewState())
}
```

`app/src/main/java/com/system/location/service/ui/viewmodel/GnssViewModel.kt`:

```kt
package com.system.location.service.ui.viewmodel

import android.app.Application
import androidx.lifecycle.AndroidViewModel
import androidx.lifecycle.viewModelScope
import com.system.location.service.ext.*
import com.system.location.service.runtime.ScenarioRuntime
import com.system.location.service.gnss.gnssReplayOnStart
import kotlinx.coroutines.CancellationException
import kotlinx.coroutines.flow.MutableStateFlow
import kotlinx.coroutines.flow.asStateFlow
import kotlinx.coroutines.launch

data class GnssUiState(
    val running: Boolean = false,
    val busy: Boolean = false,
    val geofence: Boolean = true,
    val fromLocation: Boolean = true,
    val nmea: Boolean = true,
    val message: String? = null,
)

enum class GnssSetting { GEOFENCE, FROM_LOCATION, NMEA }

/** Owns control commands and saved preferences independently of the satellite tab's composition. */
class GnssViewModel(application: Application) : AndroidViewModel(application) {
    private val mutableState = MutableStateFlow(readPreferences())
    val state = mutableState.asStateFlow()

    private fun readPreferences() = getApplication<Application>().let { context ->
        GnssUiState(geofence = context.enableRequestGeofence, fromLocation = context.enableGetFromLocation,
            nmea = context.enableNMEA)
    }

    suspend fun refresh() {
        if (state.value.busy) return
        val running = ScenarioRuntime.gnssMockRunning()
        // A command may have begun while the query was suspended.
        if (!state.value.busy) mutableState.value = readPreferences().copy(running = running)
    }

    fun toggle() {
        if (state.value.busy) return
        val enabled = !state.value.running
        runCommand {
            val accepted = ScenarioRuntime.setGnssMock(enabled).await()
            if (accepted) getApplication<Application>().gnssReplayOnStart = enabled
            mutableState.value = state.value.copy(
                running = ScenarioRuntime.gnssMockRunning(),
                message = if (accepted) null else "GNSS 操作失败，请检查系统模块连接和场景状态",
            )
        }
    }

    fun setPreference(setting: GnssSetting, enabled: Boolean) {
        if (state.value.busy) return
        val context = getApplication<Application>()
        when (setting) {
            GnssSetting.GEOFENCE -> context.enableRequestGeofence = enabled
            GnssSetting.FROM_LOCATION -> context.enableGetFromLocation = enabled
            GnssSetting.NMEA -> context.enableNMEA = enabled
        }
        mutableState.value = readPreferences().copy(running = state.value.running)
        runCommand {
            val applied = ScenarioRuntime.applyConfigNow()
            mutableState.value = state.value.copy(running = ScenarioRuntime.gnssMockRunning(), message = if (applied) "设置已应用"
                else "已保存，下次启动 Xposed/Native 场景生效")
        }
    }

    private fun runCommand(action: suspend () -> Unit) {
        mutableState.value = state.value.copy(busy = true, message = null)
        viewModelScope.launch {
            try { action() }
            catch (cancelled: CancellationException) { throw cancelled }
            catch (error: Exception) { mutableState.value = state.value.copy(message = error.message ?: "GNSS 操作失败") }
            finally { mutableState.value = state.value.copy(busy = false) }
        }
    }
}
```

`app/src/main/java/com/system/location/service/ui/viewmodel/LibraryViewModel.kt`:

```kt
package com.system.location.service.ui.viewmodel

import android.app.Application
import android.net.Uri
import androidx.lifecycle.AndroidViewModel
import androidx.lifecycle.viewModelScope
import com.system.location.service.core.repository.*
import com.system.location.service.core.scenario.*
import com.system.location.service.data.repository.LibraryRepositories
import com.system.location.service.ext.*
import com.system.location.service.runtime.ScenarioRuntime
import kotlinx.coroutines.*
import kotlinx.coroutines.channels.Channel
import kotlinx.coroutines.flow.MutableStateFlow
import kotlinx.coroutines.flow.asStateFlow

enum class LibraryKind { ROUTES, SCENARIOS, LOCATIONS }
data class LibraryItem(val id: String, val title: String, val detail: String)
data class LibraryUiState(val kind: LibraryKind = LibraryKind.ROUTES, val items: List<LibraryItem> = emptyList(),
    val message: String? = null, val busy: Boolean = false)

/** All persistence, import and scene construction occur off the UI thread. */
class LibraryViewModel(application: Application) : AndroidViewModel(application) {
    private val mutable = MutableStateFlow(LibraryUiState())
    val state = mutable.asStateFlow()
    private val events = Channel<suspend () -> Unit>(Channel.UNLIMITED)
    init {
        viewModelScope.launch(Dispatchers.IO) {
            for (action in events) {
                mutable.value = state.value.copy(busy = true)
                try { LibraryRepositories.ensureMigrated(); action(); reload() }
                catch (cancelled: CancellationException) { throw cancelled }
                catch (error: Exception) { mutable.value = state.value.copy(message = error.message ?: "资料库操作失败") }
                finally { mutable.value = state.value.copy(busy = false) }
            }
        }
        refresh()
    }
    private fun submit(action: suspend () -> Unit) { events.trySend(action) }
    fun refresh() = submit { }
    fun kind(kind: LibraryKind) = submit { mutable.value = state.value.copy(kind = kind, message = null) }
    private fun reload() {
        val items = when (state.value.kind) {
            LibraryKind.ROUTES -> LibraryRepositories.routes.list().sortedWith(compareByDescending<SavedRoute> { it.favorite }.thenBy { it.route.name })
                .map { LibraryItem(it.route.id, (if (it.favorite) "★ " else "") + it.route.name, "${it.route.points.size} 个点 · ${modeLabel(it.mode)}") }
            LibraryKind.SCENARIOS -> LibraryRepositories.scenarios.list().map { LibraryItem(it.id, it.name,
                "${if (it.route != null) "路线" else "单点"} · ${modeLabel(it.mode)} · ${it.profile.speedMps} m/s") }
            LibraryKind.LOCATIONS -> LibraryRepositories.locations.list().map { LibraryItem(it.id, (if (it.favorite) "★ " else "") + it.name,
                "${it.coordinate.latitude}, ${it.coordinate.longitude}\n${it.address}") }
        }
        mutable.value = state.value.copy(items = items)
    }
    private fun modeLabel(mode: RouteMode) = when (mode) {
        RouteMode.ONCE -> "单次"
        RouteMode.LOOP -> "循环"
        RouteMode.PING_PONG -> "往返"
    }
    fun rename(id: String, name: String) = submit {
        require(name.isNotBlank()) { "名称不能为空" }
        when (state.value.kind) {
            LibraryKind.ROUTES -> LibraryRepositories.routes.rename(id, name)
            LibraryKind.SCENARIOS -> LibraryRepositories.scenarios.run { update(get(id)!!.copy(name = name)) }
            LibraryKind.LOCATIONS -> LibraryRepositories.locations.run { update(get(id)!!.copy(name = name)) }
        }
    }
    fun copy(id: String, name: String) = submit {
        when (state.value.kind) {
            LibraryKind.ROUTES -> LibraryRepositories.routes.copy(id, name)
            LibraryKind.SCENARIOS -> LibraryRepositories.scenarios.copy(id, name)
            LibraryKind.LOCATIONS -> LibraryRepositories.locations.copy(id, name)
        }
    }
    fun delete(id: String) = submit {
        when (state.value.kind) {
            LibraryKind.ROUTES -> LibraryRepositories.routes.delete(id)
            LibraryKind.SCENARIOS -> LibraryRepositories.scenarios.delete(id)
            LibraryKind.LOCATIONS -> LibraryRepositories.locations.delete(id)
        }
    }
    fun favorite(id: String) = submit {
        when (state.value.kind) {
            LibraryKind.ROUTES -> LibraryRepositories.routes.run { favorite(id, !get(id)!!.favorite) }
            LibraryKind.LOCATIONS -> LibraryRepositories.locations.run { get(id)!!.let { update(it.copy(favorite = !it.favorite)) } }
            LibraryKind.SCENARIOS -> error("场景未提供收藏标记")
        }
    }
    fun mode(id: String, mode: RouteMode) = submit {
        when (state.value.kind) {
            LibraryKind.ROUTES -> LibraryRepositories.routes.mode(id, mode)
            LibraryKind.SCENARIOS -> LibraryRepositories.scenarios.run { update(get(id)!!.copy(mode = mode)) }
            LibraryKind.LOCATIONS -> error("单点没有路线播放模式")
        }
    }
    fun start(id: String) = submit {
        val context = getApplication<Application>()
        fun profile() = context.movementProfile()
        val scene = when (state.value.kind) {
            LibraryKind.ROUTES -> LibraryRepositories.routes.get(id)!!.let { Scenario(it.route.id, it.route.name, route = it.route, mode = it.mode, profile = profile()) }
            LibraryKind.SCENARIOS -> LibraryRepositories.scenarios.get(id)!!
            LibraryKind.LOCATIONS -> LibraryRepositories.locations.get(id)!!.let { Scenario(it.id, it.name, point = it.coordinate, profile = profile()) }
        }.frozen()
        mutable.value = state.value.copy(message = if (ScenarioRuntime.start(scene).await()) "场景已启动"
            else ScenarioRuntime.state.value.error?.let { "${it.stage}: ${it.reason}\n${it.suggestion}" } ?: "启动失败")
    }
    fun import(uri: Uri, kind: LibraryKind) = submit {
        val text = getApplication<Application>().contentResolver.openInputStream(uri)?.bufferedReader()?.use { reader ->
            val output = StringBuilder(); val buffer = CharArray(8192)
            while (true) {
                val count = reader.read(buffer)
                if (count < 0) break
                require(output.length + count <= VersionedRepository.MAX_DOCUMENT_CHARS) { "导入文件过大" }
                output.append(buffer, 0, count)
            }
            output.toString()
        } ?: error("无法读取文件")
        val count = when (kind) {
            LibraryKind.ROUTES -> LibraryRepositories.routes.importJson(text).size
            LibraryKind.SCENARIOS -> LibraryRepositories.scenarios.importJson(text).size
            LibraryKind.LOCATIONS -> LibraryRepositories.locations.importJson(text).size
        }
        mutable.value = state.value.copy(message = "已导入 $count 条记录，重复 ID 已复制为新记录")
    }
    fun export(uri: Uri, kind: LibraryKind) = submit {
        val text = when (kind) {
            LibraryKind.ROUTES -> LibraryRepositories.routes.exportJson()
            LibraryKind.SCENARIOS -> LibraryRepositories.scenarios.exportJson()
            LibraryKind.LOCATIONS -> LibraryRepositories.locations.exportJson()
        }
        getApplication<Application>().contentResolver.openOutputStream(uri, "wt")?.bufferedWriter()?.use { it.write(text) }
            ?: error("无法写入导出文件")
        mutable.value = state.value.copy(message = "导出完成")
    }
    fun importGpx(uri: Uri) = submit {
        val text = getApplication<Application>().contentResolver.openInputStream(uri)?.bufferedReader()?.use { reader ->
            val buffer = CharArray(8192); val output = StringBuilder()
            while (true) {
                val count = reader.read(buffer)
                if (count < 0) break
                require(output.length + count <= com.system.location.service.core.gpx.GpxCodec.MAX_CHARS) { "GPX 文件过大" }
                output.append(buffer, 0, count)
            }
            output.toString()
        } ?: error("无法读取 GPX")
        val routes = com.system.location.service.core.gpx.GpxCodec.decode(text).map { SavedRoute(it) }
        LibraryRepositories.routes.importItems(routes)
        mutable.value = state.value.copy(kind = LibraryKind.ROUTES, message = "已导入 ${routes.size} 条 GPX 路线（WGS84）；不同轨迹段分别保存")
    }
    fun exportGpx(uri: Uri, id: String? = null) = submit {
        val routes = if (id == null) LibraryRepositories.routes.list().map { it.route }
            else listOf(LibraryRepositories.routes.get(id)?.route ?: error("路线不存在"))
        val text = com.system.location.service.core.gpx.GpxCodec.encode(routes)
        getApplication<Application>().contentResolver.openOutputStream(uri, "wt")?.bufferedWriter()?.use { it.write(text) }
            ?: error("无法写入 GPX")
        mutable.value = state.value.copy(message = "GPX 导出完成；仅路线名称与 WGS84 坐标，播放参数请使用 JSON")
    }
    override fun onCleared() { events.close(); super.onCleared() }
}
```

```kt
package com.system.location.service.ui.viewmodel

import android.location.LocationManager
import androidx.lifecycle.ViewModel
import androidx.lifecycle.viewModelScope
import com.system.location.service.LocationServiceApp
import com.system.location.service.core.geo.Wgs84
import com.system.location.service.core.runtime.RuntimePhase
import com.system.location.service.core.scenario.*
import com.system.location.service.ext.*
import com.system.location.service.runtime.ScenarioRuntime
import com.system.location.service.ui.mock.HistoricalLocation
import com.system.location.service.ui.mock.HistoricalRoute
import java.util.UUID
import kotlinx.coroutines.Dispatchers
import kotlinx.coroutines.async
import com.system.location.service.data.repository.LibraryRepositories
import com.system.location.service.core.repository.SavedLocation

/** UI selections and event dispatch only. The service owns the running frozen scene. */
class MockServiceViewModel : ViewModel() {
    var locationManager: LocationManager? = null
    var selectedLocation: HistoricalLocation? = null
    var selectedRoute: HistoricalRoute? = null
    val runtimeState = ScenarioRuntime.state
    private fun profile() = with(LocationServiceApp.appContext) {
        movementProfile()
    }
    suspend fun startPoint(point: Pair<Double, Double>, name: String = "单点场景"): Boolean {
        return ScenarioRuntime.start(Scenario(UUID.randomUUID().toString(), name.ifBlank { "单点场景" },
            point = Wgs84(point.first, point.second), profile = profile())).await()
    }
    suspend fun startRoute(route: HistoricalRoute): Boolean {
        val id = route.id
        return ScenarioRuntime.start(Scenario(id, route.name,
            route = Route(id, route.name, route.route.map { Wgs84(it.first, it.second) }), mode = route.mode, profile = profile())).await()
    }
    suspend fun stopScenario() = ScenarioRuntime.stop().await()
    fun pauseScenario() { ScenarioRuntime.pause() }
    fun resumeScenario() { ScenarioRuntime.resume() }
    fun isServiceStart() = runtimeState.value.isActive
    fun isPaused() = runtimeState.value.phase == RuntimePhase.PAUSED
    fun failureMessage() = runtimeState.value.error?.let { "${it.stage}: ${it.reason}\n${it.suggestion}" } ?: "场景启动失败"
    fun saveLocation(name: String, address: String, latitude: Double, longitude: Double) = viewModelScope.async(Dispatchers.IO) {
        runCatching {
            LibraryRepositories.ensureMigrated()
            LibraryRepositories.locations.create(SavedLocation(UUID.randomUUID().toString(), name, Wgs84(latitude, longitude), address))
        }
    }
}
```

`app/src/main/java/com/system/location/service/ui/viewmodel/QuickReplayViewModel.kt`:

```kt
package com.system.location.service.ui.viewmodel

import android.app.Application
import androidx.lifecycle.AndroidViewModel
import androidx.lifecycle.viewModelScope
import com.system.location.service.core.environment.EnvironmentProfileCodec
import com.system.location.service.core.backend.BackendType
import com.system.location.service.core.gnss.GnssCaptureValidator
import com.system.location.service.core.gnss.GnssSimulationMode
import com.system.location.service.environment.EnvironmentStore
import com.system.location.service.ext.sharedPrefs
import com.system.location.service.gnss.GnssCaptureRepository
import com.system.location.service.gnss.gnssReplayProblem
import com.system.location.service.runtime.ScenarioRuntime
import kotlinx.coroutines.CancellationException
import kotlinx.coroutines.Dispatchers
import kotlinx.coroutines.Job
import kotlinx.coroutines.flow.MutableStateFlow
import kotlinx.coroutines.flow.asStateFlow
import kotlinx.coroutines.launch
import kotlinx.coroutines.withContext

data class QuickReplayState(
    val names: List<String> = emptyList(),
    val loading: Boolean = true,
    val busy: Boolean = false,
    val message: String? = null,
    val failed: Boolean = false,
)

/** Activity-owned so accepting a choice survives closing the map sheet or changing tabs. */
class QuickReplayViewModel(application: Application) : AndroidViewModel(application) {
    private val context get() = getApplication<Application>()
    private val mutableState = MutableStateFlow(QuickReplayState())
    val state = mutableState.asStateFlow()

    suspend fun refresh() {
        mutableState.value = state.value.copy(loading = true, message = null, failed = false)
        try {
            val names = withContext(Dispatchers.IO) { EnvironmentStore(context).list() }
            mutableState.value = state.value.copy(names = names, message = null, failed = false)
        } catch (cancelled: CancellationException) { throw cancelled }
        catch (_: Exception) {
            mutableState.value = state.value.copy(message = "环境列表读取失败，请重试", failed = true)
        } finally {
            mutableState.value = state.value.copy(loading = false)
        }
    }

    /** An empty name selects the procedural source. Selecting a profile also enables Wi-Fi. */
    fun environment(name: String) = change {
        val json = if (name.isNotEmpty()) withContext(Dispatchers.IO) {
            EnvironmentProfileCodec.encode(EnvironmentStore(context).load(name))
        } else null
        context.sharedPrefs.edit().apply {
            putBoolean("enableMockWifi", true)
            putBoolean("disableWifiScan", true)
            putString("environmentSourceMode", if (name.isEmpty()) "PROCEDURAL" else "REPLAY")
            putString("replayEnvironmentName", name)
            if (json != null) putString("environmentReplayJson", json)
            else remove("environmentReplayJson")
        }.apply()
    }

    fun disableEnvironment() = change {
        context.sharedPrefs.edit().apply {
            putBoolean("enableMockWifi", false)
            putBoolean("disableWifiScan", false)
            putString("environmentSourceMode", "AUTO")
            putString("replayEnvironmentName", "")
            remove("environmentReplayJson")
        }.apply()
    }

    fun satellite(mode: GnssSimulationMode?) {
        change {
            if (mode == GnssSimulationMode.REPLAY) {
                val capture = GnssCaptureRepository(context).load() ?: error("尚无卫星采集，请先采集")
                val quality = withContext(Dispatchers.Default) {
                    GnssCaptureValidator.validate(capture, System.currentTimeMillis())
                }
                check(quality.eligible) { "采集已不可用，请重新采集：${quality.issues.joinToString("；")}" }
            }
            context.sharedPrefs.edit().apply {
                putBoolean("gnssReplayOnStart", mode != null)
                putString("gnssSimulationMode", mode?.name ?: "OFF")
            }.apply()
        }
    }

    fun replay() {
        change { withContext(Dispatchers.IO) { context.gnssReplayProblem() }?.let { error(it) } }
    }

    private fun change(save: suspend () -> Unit): Job? {
        if (state.value.busy) return null
        mutableState.value = state.value.copy(busy = true, message = null, failed = false)
        return viewModelScope.launch {
            try {
                save()
                val active = ScenarioRuntime.state.value.isActive
                val applied = ScenarioRuntime.applyReplaySettings().await()
                val sourceProblem = if (!applied) withContext(Dispatchers.IO) { context.gnssReplayProblem() } else null
                mutableState.value = state.value.copy(message = when {
                    applied -> "回放设置已应用"
                    sourceProblem != null -> "设置已保存；$sourceProblem"
                    active && ScenarioRuntime.state.value.backend != BackendType.MOCK_PROVIDER ->
                        "设置已保存，应用失败，请检查系统模块连接"
                    else -> "已保存，随 Xposed / Native 定位启动"
                })
            } catch (cancelled: CancellationException) { throw cancelled }
            catch (error: Exception) { mutableState.value = state.value.copy(message = error.message ?: "回放设置失败", failed = true) }
            finally { mutableState.value = state.value.copy(busy = false) }
        }
    }
}
```

`app/src/main/java/com/system/location/service/ui/viewmodel/RouteEditViewModel.kt`:

```kt
package com.system.location.service.ui.viewmodel

import android.app.Application
import androidx.lifecycle.AndroidViewModel
import androidx.lifecycle.viewModelScope
import com.system.location.service.amap.AMapRoutePlanner
import com.system.location.service.core.geo.Gcj02
import com.system.location.service.core.planning.*
import com.system.location.service.core.repository.SavedRoute
import com.system.location.service.core.scenario.*
import com.system.location.service.data.persistence.AtomicDocumentStore
import com.system.location.service.data.repository.LibraryRepositories
import com.system.location.service.data.repository.toHistorical
import com.system.location.service.ext.*
import com.system.location.service.runtime.ScenarioRuntime
import kotlinx.coroutines.*
import kotlinx.coroutines.channels.Channel
import kotlinx.coroutines.flow.MutableStateFlow
import kotlinx.coroutines.flow.asStateFlow
import java.io.File

/** Serializes editor events; async planning is generation-checked by the pure draft controller. */
class RouteEditViewModel(application: Application) : AndroidViewModel(application) {
    private val events = Channel<suspend (RouteDraftController) -> Unit>(Channel.UNLIMITED)
    private val mutable = MutableStateFlow(RouteDraft(message = "正在恢复草稿"))
    val state = mutable.asStateFlow()
    private val mutableMessage = MutableStateFlow<String?>(null)
    val message = mutableMessage.asStateFlow()
    private var planning: Job? = null
    init {
        viewModelScope.launch(Dispatchers.IO) {
            val draft = RouteDraftController(AtomicDocumentStore(File(application.filesDir, "route_draft.json")))
            launch { draft.state.collect { mutable.value = it } }
            for (event in events) {
                try { event(draft) } catch (cancelled: CancellationException) { throw cancelled }
                catch (error: Exception) { mutableMessage.value = error.message ?: "路线操作失败" }
            }
        }
    }
    fun select(endpoint: Endpoint) { events.trySend { it.select(endpoint) } }
    fun pick(point: Gcj02) { events.trySend { planning?.cancel(); it.pick(point) } }
    fun camera(camera: MapCamera) { events.trySend { it.camera(camera) } }
    fun cancel() { events.trySend { planning?.cancel(); it.cancel() } }
    fun mode(mode: DrawingMode) { events.trySend { planning?.cancel(); it.mode(mode) } }
    fun stroke(points: List<Gcj02>) { val snapshot = points.toList(); events.trySend { it.appendStroke(snapshot) } }
    fun undo() { events.trySend { it.undo() } }
    fun plan() {
        events.trySend { draft ->
            planning?.cancel()
            val request = draft.beginPlan() ?: return@trySend
            planning = viewModelScope.launch(Dispatchers.IO) {
                try {
                    val segments = withTimeout(30_000) { com.system.location.service.maps.MapServices(getApplication()).walk(request) }
                    draft.complete(request, segments)
                } catch (timeout: TimeoutCancellationException) { draft.fail(request, "路线规划超时，请重试") }
                catch (cancelled: CancellationException) { throw cancelled }
                catch (error: Exception) { draft.fail(request, error.message ?: "路线规划失败") }
            }
        }
    }
    fun save(snapshot: Route, name: String, mode: RouteMode, start: Boolean) {
        val frozen = snapshot.copy(name = name).frozen()
        events.trySend {
            LibraryRepositories.ensureMigrated()
            val saved = SavedRoute(frozen, mode)
            with(LibraryRepositories.routes) { if (get(frozen.id) == null) create(saved) else update(saved) }
            val context = getApplication<Application>()
            val scene = Scenario(frozen.id, name, route = frozen, mode = mode,
                profile = context.movementProfile())
            with(LibraryRepositories.scenarios) { if (get(scene.id) == null) create(scene) else update(scene) }
            context.selectRoute = saved.toHistorical()
            mutableMessage.value = if (start) {
                if (ScenarioRuntime.start(scene).await()) "路线已保存，场景已启动" else ScenarioRuntime.state.value.error?.reason ?: "启动失败"
            } else "路线已保存"
        }
    }
    fun clearMessage() { mutableMessage.value = null }
    override fun onCleared() { events.close(); super.onCleared() }
}
```

```kt
package com.system.location.service.ui.viewmodel

import androidx.lifecycle.ViewModel

class SettingsViewModel : ViewModel() {
    private val mutableRestore = MutableStateFlow(RestoreConfigState())
    val restore = mutableRestore.asStateFlow()

    fun restoreLastConfig() {
        if (restore.value.busy) return
        mutableRestore.value = RestoreConfigState(busy = true)
        viewModelScope.launch {
            try {
                val restored = ScenarioRuntime.restoreLastConfig()
                mutableRestore.value = RestoreConfigState(message = if (restored) "已恢复并启动上次场景"
                    else "没有可恢复的配置，或场景正在运行")
            } catch (cancelled: CancellationException) { throw cancelled }
            catch (error: Exception) { mutableRestore.value = RestoreConfigState(message = error.message ?: "恢复失败，请重试") }
            finally { mutableRestore.value = restore.value.copy(busy = false) }
        }
    }
```

`app/src/main/java/com/system/location/service/update/ReleaseChannelPolicy.kt`:

```kt
package com.system.location.service.update

internal enum class UpdateChannel { STABLE, BETA }

/** Uses existing tag/versionCode conventions; channel is release metadata, never a version suffix. */
internal object ReleaseChannelPolicy {
    data class Release(val tag: String, val prerelease: Boolean, val draft: Boolean, val publishedAt: Long, val versionCode: Int? = null)

    fun accepts(channel: UpdateChannel, release: Release): Boolean =
        !release.draft && (channel == UpdateChannel.BETA || !release.prerelease) &&
            ReleaseVersion.parse(release.tag)?.let { it.prerelease == null || release.prerelease } == true

    /** Missing metadata is legacy: only a strictly higher semantic version is defensible. */
    fun isInstallable(channel: UpdateChannel, release: Release, installedVersion: String, installedCode: Int): Boolean {
        if (!accepts(channel, release)) return false
        val remote = ReleaseVersion.parse(release.tag) ?: return false
        val local = ReleaseVersion.parse(installedVersion) ?: return false
        return release.versionCode?.let { it > installedCode }
            ?: (compareValuesBy(remote, local, { it.major }, { it.minor }, { it.patch }) > 0)
    }

    fun select(channel: UpdateChannel, releases: List<Release>): Release? = releases
        .asSequence()
        .filter { accepts(channel, it) }
        .sortedWith { left, right ->
            val codeOrder = when {
                left.versionCode != null && right.versionCode != null -> right.versionCode.compareTo(left.versionCode)
                left.versionCode != null -> -1
                right.versionCode != null -> 1
                else -> 0
            }
            if (codeOrder != 0) return@sortedWith codeOrder
            val versionOrder = ReleaseVersion.compare(left.tag, right.tag)
            if (versionOrder != 0) -versionOrder else right.publishedAt.compareTo(left.publishedAt)
        }
        .firstOrNull()

    fun isCandidate(channel: UpdateChannel, release: Release, installedVersion: String): Boolean {
        if (!accepts(channel, release)) return false
        return ReleaseVersion.isNewer(release.tag, installedVersion, release.publishedAt, 0)
    }
}
```

`app/src/main/java/com/system/location/service/update/ReleaseTransport.kt`:

```kt
package com.system.location.service.update

import kotlinx.serialization.json.*
import java.net.HttpURLConnection
import java.net.URI
import java.net.URL
import java.time.Instant

/** Read-only, bounded GitHub transport. Redirects are validated before following them. */
internal fun interface ReleaseTransport {
    fun get(url: String): Response
    data class Response(val status: Int, val body: String)
}

internal object GitHubReleaseUrls {
    const val API = "https://api.github.com/repos/Lecheeel/Portal/releases"
    const val PAGE = "https://github.com/Lecheeel/Portal/releases"
    fun trusted(url: String, redirect: Boolean = false): Boolean = runCatching {
        val uri = URI(url)
        if (uri.scheme != "https" || uri.rawUserInfo != null || uri.port != -1 || uri.rawFragment != null || uri.normalize() != uri || uri.rawPath != uri.path) return false
        when (uri.host) {
            "api.github.com" -> uri.path == "/repos/Lecheeel/Portal/releases/latest" || uri.path == "/repos/Lecheeel/Portal/releases"
            "github.com" -> (uri.path == "/Lecheeel/Portal/releases" || uri.path.startsWith("/Lecheeel/Portal/releases/")) && uri.rawQuery == null
            "release-assets.githubusercontent.com", "objects.githubusercontent.com" -> redirect
            else -> false
        }
    }.getOrDefault(false)
}

internal class HttpsReleaseTransport : ReleaseTransport {
    override fun get(url: String): ReleaseTransport.Response {
        require(GitHubReleaseUrls.trusted(url)) { "不可信的 GitHub 地址" }
        var target = url
        repeat(4) { hop ->
            require(GitHubReleaseUrls.trusted(target, redirect = hop > 0)) { "不可信的 GitHub 重定向" }
            val connection = URI(target).toURL().openConnection() as HttpURLConnection
            try {
                connection.instanceFollowRedirects = false
                connection.connectTimeout = 5_000
                connection.readTimeout = 5_000
                connection.setRequestProperty("Accept", "application/vnd.github+json")
                connection.setRequestProperty("User-Agent", "Portal-Updater")
                val status = connection.responseCode
                if (status in listOf(301, 302, 303, 307, 308)) {
                    val location = connection.getHeaderField("Location") ?: error("GitHub 重定向缺少地址")
                    target = URI(target).resolve(location).toString()
                } else {
                    if (status != 200) return ReleaseTransport.Response(status, "")
                    require(connection.contentLengthLong <= MAX_BYTES) { "GitHub 响应过大" }
                    val bytes = connection.inputStream.use { stream ->
                        val out = java.io.ByteArrayOutputStream()
                        val buffer = ByteArray(8192)
                        val deadline = System.nanoTime() + 10_000_000_000L
                        while (true) {
                            check(System.nanoTime() < deadline) { "GitHub 响应超时" }
                            val count = stream.read(buffer)
                            if (count < 0) break
                            require(out.size() + count <= MAX_BYTES) { "GitHub 响应过大" }
                            out.write(buffer, 0, count)
                        }
                        out.toByteArray()
                    }
                    return ReleaseTransport.Response(status, bytes.toString(Charsets.UTF_8))
                }
            } finally {
                connection.disconnect()
            }
        }
        error("GitHub 重定向次数过多")
    }
    private companion object { const val MAX_BYTES = 2 * 1024 * 1024 }
}

/** Android-free seam; malformed present metadata always fails, never becomes legacy. */
internal class ReleaseFeed(private val transport: ReleaseTransport) {
    data class Asset(val name: String, val url: String)
    data class Release(
        val tag: String, val body: String, val htmlUrl: String,
        val prerelease: Boolean, val draft: Boolean, val publishedAt: Long, val assets: List<Asset>,
        val versionCode: Int? = null,
    ) {
        fun policy() = ReleaseChannelPolicy.Release(tag, prerelease, draft, publishedAt, versionCode)
        fun apk(abi: String) = assets.singleOrNull { it.name == "LocationService-v${tag.removePrefix("v")}-${abi}.apk" }
    }

    fun load(channel: UpdateChannel, abi: String): List<Release> {
        val latest = transport.get("${GitHubReleaseUrls.API}/latest")
        val stable = when (latest.status) {
            200 -> parseRelease(Json.parseToJsonElement(latest.body).jsonObject).also {
                require(!it.prerelease && !it.draft) { "稳定版接口返回了非稳定版本" }
            }
            404 -> null
            else -> error("GitHub 返回 ${latest.status}")
        }
        val releases = mutableListOf<Release>()
        if (stable != null) releases += stable
        if (channel == UpdateChannel.BETA) {
            for (page in 1..MAX_PAGES) {
                val response = transport.get("${GitHubReleaseUrls.API}?per_page=$PAGE_SIZE&page=$page")
                check(response.status == 200) { "GitHub 返回 ${response.status}（Beta 第 $page 页）" }
                val entries = Json.parseToJsonElement(response.body).jsonArray
                require(entries.size <= PAGE_SIZE) { "GitHub 分页响应过大" }
                releases += entries.map { parseRelease(it.jsonObject) }
                if (entries.size < PAGE_SIZE) break
            }
        }
        return releases.distinctBy { it.tag }.filter {
            ReleaseChannelPolicy.accepts(channel, it.policy()) && it.apk(abi) != null
        }.map { release ->
            val metadata = release.assets.filter { it.name == "verification.json" }
            require(metadata.size <= 1) { "重复的 verification.json" }
            if (metadata.isEmpty()) release else {
                val response = transport.get(metadata.single().url)
                check(response.status == 200) { "verification.json 下载失败：${response.status}" }
                release.copy(versionCode = verificationCode(response.body, release, abi))
            }
        }
    }

    private fun parseRelease(json: JsonObject): Release {
        val tag = json.string("tag_name")
        val html = json.string("html_url")
        require(GitHubReleaseUrls.trusted(html) && URI(html).path == "/Lecheeel/Portal/releases/tag/$tag") { "无效的 Release 页面" }
        val assets = json.getValue("assets").jsonArray.map { value ->
            val asset = value.jsonObject
            val name = asset.string("name")
            val url = asset.string("browser_download_url")
            require(GitHubReleaseUrls.trusted(url) && URI(url).path == "/Lecheeel/Portal/releases/download/$tag/$name") { "无效的 Release 资源地址" }
            Asset(name, url)
        }
        require(assets.map { it.name }.distinct().size == assets.size) { "重复的 Release 资源" }
        return Release(tag, json["body"]?.let { if (it == JsonNull) "" else it.jsonPrimitive.content }.orEmpty(), html,
            json.boolean("prerelease"), json.boolean("draft"),
            json["published_at"]?.let { if (it == JsonNull) 0 else Instant.parse(it.jsonPrimitive.content).epochSecond } ?: 0, assets)
    }

    internal fun verificationCode(text: String, release: Release, abi: String): Int {
        val report = Json.parseToJsonElement(text).jsonObject
        require(report.string("version") == release.tag.removePrefix("v")) { "verification.json 版本不匹配" }
        // Channel is historical: promotion deliberately preserves the exact Beta report and APK.
        report["channel"]?.let { require(it.jsonPrimitive.isString && it.jsonPrimitive.content in setOf("stable", "beta")) { "verification.json 通道无效" } }
        require(report.string("certificateSha256").lowercase() == CERTIFICATE) { "verification.json 签名证书不匹配" }
        val code = report.getValue("versionCode").jsonPrimitive
        require(!code.isString && Regex("[1-9][0-9]*").matches(code.content)) { "verification.json versionCode 无效" }
        val versionCode = code.content.toIntOrNull() ?: error("verification.json versionCode 越界")
        val artifacts = report.getValue("artifacts").jsonArray.map { it.jsonObject }
        require(artifacts.map { it.string("file") }.distinct().size == artifacts.size) { "verification.json 包含重复资源" }
        val artifact = artifacts.single { it.string("file") == release.apk(abi)?.name }
        require(Regex("[0-9a-fA-F]{64}").matches(artifact.string("sha256"))) { "verification.json SHA-256 无效" }
        val bytes = artifact.getValue("bytes").jsonPrimitive
        require(!bytes.isString && bytes.longOrNull?.let { it > 0 } == true) { "verification.json 文件大小无效" }
        val expectedAbi = when (abi) { "arm64" -> "arm64-v8a"; "x86_64" -> "x86_64"; else -> error("不支持的 ABI") }
        require(artifact.getValue("abis").jsonArray.map { it.jsonPrimitive.content } == listOf(expectedAbi)) { "verification.json ABI 不匹配" }
        return versionCode
    }

    private fun JsonObject.string(key: String): String = getValue(key).jsonPrimitive.let {
        require(it.isString) { "$key 必须为字符串" }; it.content
    }
    private fun JsonObject.boolean(key: String): Boolean = getValue(key).jsonPrimitive.let {
        require(!it.isString) { "$key 必须为布尔值" }; it.boolean
    }
    companion object {
        const val MAX_PAGES = 3
        const val PAGE_SIZE = 30
        const val CERTIFICATE = "fa4547514e795b2daca48bd05e9a5f9348e62531d791d746e0ffe93bb90247a3"
    }
}
```

`app/src/main/java/com/system/location/service/update/ReleaseVersion.kt`:

```kt
package com.system.location.service.update

internal data class ReleaseVersion(
    val major: Int,
    val minor: Int,
    val patch: Int,
    val revision: Int,
    val hash: String,
    val prerelease: String?,
) {
    companion object {
        private val pattern = Regex("""^v?(0|[1-9][0-9]*)\.(0|[1-9][0-9]*)\.(0|[1-9][0-9]*)(?:-([0-9A-Za-z-]+(?:\.[0-9A-Za-z-]+)*?))?(?:\.r(0|[1-9][0-9]*)\.([0-9a-fA-F]+))?$""")

        fun parse(value: String): ReleaseVersion? {
            val clean = value.removeSuffix("-debug")
            val match = pattern.matchEntire(clean) ?: return null
            val (major, minor, patch, prerelease, revision, hash) = match.destructured
            if (Regex("""\.r[0-9]+\.[0-9a-fA-F]+$""").containsMatchIn(clean) && revision.isEmpty()) return null
            if (prerelease.split('.').any { it.length > 1 && it.all(Char::isDigit) && it.startsWith('0') }) return null
            if (revision.isNotEmpty() && revision.toIntOrNull() == null) return null
            return ReleaseVersion(
                major.toIntOrNull() ?: return null,
                minor.toIntOrNull() ?: return null,
                patch.toIntOrNull() ?: return null,
                revision.toIntOrNull() ?: 0,
                hash.lowercase(),
                prerelease.ifEmpty { null },
            )
        }

        fun isNewer(remote: String, local: String, publishedAt: Long = 0, localBuildTime: Long = 0): Boolean {
            val candidate = parse(remote) ?: return false
            val installed = parse(local) ?: return false
            val semantic = compareSemantic(candidate, installed)
            if (semantic != 0) return semantic > 0
            if (candidate == installed) return false
            if (candidate.prerelease != installed.prerelease) return candidate.prerelease != null
            if (candidate.hash.isNotEmpty() && candidate.hash == installed.hash) return false
            // Release revisions are useful only with timestamps: shallow checkouts can have lower counts.
            if (publishedAt > 0 && localBuildTime > 0) return publishedAt > localBuildTime
            return candidate.revision > installed.revision
        }

        fun compare(left: String, right: String): Int {
            val a = parse(left)
            val b = parse(right)
            if (a == null) return if (b == null) 0 else -1
            if (b == null) return 1
            val semantic = compareSemantic(a, b)
            if (semantic != 0) return semantic
            val preOrder = when {
                a.prerelease == null && b.prerelease == null -> 0
                a.prerelease == null -> 1
                b.prerelease == null -> -1
                else -> comparePrerelease(a.prerelease, b.prerelease)
            }
            return if (preOrder != 0) preOrder else a.revision.compareTo(b.revision)
        }

        private fun compareSemantic(a: ReleaseVersion, b: ReleaseVersion): Int {
            val base = compareValuesBy(a, b, { it.major }, { it.minor }, { it.patch })
            if (base != 0) return base
            if (a.prerelease == null) return if (b.prerelease == null) 0 else 1
            if (b.prerelease == null) return -1
            return comparePrerelease(a.prerelease, b.prerelease)
        }

        private fun comparePrerelease(a: String, b: String): Int {
            val left = a.split('.')
            val right = b.split('.')
            for (index in 0 until minOf(left.size, right.size)) {
                val l = left[index]
                val r = right[index]
                val ln = l.all(Char::isDigit)
                val rn = r.all(Char::isDigit)
                val order = when {
                    ln && rn -> l.length.compareTo(r.length).takeIf { it != 0 } ?: l.compareTo(r)
                    ln -> -1
                    rn -> 1
                    else -> l.compareTo(r)
                }
                if (order != 0) return order
            }
            return left.size.compareTo(right.size)
        }
    }
}
```
