`app/src/main/java/com/system/location/service/update/StartupUpdateViewModel.kt`:

```kt
package com.system.location.service.update

import androidx.lifecycle.ViewModel
import androidx.lifecycle.viewModelScope
import kotlinx.coroutines.flow.MutableStateFlow
import kotlinx.coroutines.flow.asStateFlow
import kotlinx.coroutines.launch

class StartupUpdateViewModel : ViewModel() {
    private val pending = MutableStateFlow<UpdateChecker.UpdateInfo?>(null)
    val pendingUpdate = pending.asStateFlow()
    private val requests = UpdateRequestGate<UpdateChannel>(UpdateChecker.currentChannel())
    private var checkedThisVisit = false
    private var checking = false

    fun check() {
        if (checkedThisVisit || checking) return
        val channel = UpdateChecker.currentChannel()
        requests.select(channel)
        val request = requests.begin() ?: return
        checkedThisVisit = true
        checking = true
        viewModelScope.launch {
            try {
                val result = UpdateChecker.check(channel)
                if (requests.accepts(request, channel) && result is UpdateChecker.Result.UpdateAvailable) pending.value = result.info
            } finally {
                if (requests.accepts(request, channel)) checking = false
            }
        }
    }

    fun channelChanged() {
        val channel = UpdateChecker.currentChannel()
        requests.select(channel)
        pending.value = null
        checkedThisVisit = false
        checking = false
        check()
    }

    fun onBackgrounded() {
        checkedThisVisit = false
    }

    fun onPromptShown() {
        pending.value = null
    }
}
```

`app/src/main/java/com/system/location/service/update/UpdateChannelSettings.kt`:

```kt
package com.system.location.service.update

import android.content.Context
import android.content.SharedPreferences

/** The stable channel is the safe default, including when an invalid stored value is found. */
internal class UpdateChannelSettings(private val preferences: SharedPreferences) {
    private val store = UpdateChannelStore(read = {
        runCatching { UpdateChannel.valueOf(preferences.getString(KEY, UpdateChannel.STABLE.name)!!) }
            .getOrDefault(UpdateChannel.STABLE)
    }, write = { channel ->
        check(preferences.edit().putString(KEY, channel.name).commit()) { "无法保存更新通道" }
    })
    fun get(): UpdateChannel = store.get()
    fun set(channel: UpdateChannel) = store.set(channel)

    companion object {
        private const val KEY = "update_channel"
        @Volatile private var instance: UpdateChannelSettings? = null
        fun from(context: Context): UpdateChannelSettings = instance ?: synchronized(this) {
            instance ?: UpdateChannelSettings(context.applicationContext.getSharedPreferences(
                "update_settings", Context.MODE_PRIVATE)).also { instance = it }
        }
    }
}
```

`app/src/main/java/com/system/location/service/update/UpdateChannelStore.kt`:

```kt
package com.system.location.service.update

/** Confirmed choice remains authoritative when storage mutates memory then reports failure. */
internal class UpdateChannelStore<C>(private val read: () -> C, private val write: (C) -> Unit) {
    private var confirmed = read()
    @Synchronized fun get(): C = confirmed
    @Synchronized fun set(value: C) {
        val old = confirmed
        try { write(value) } catch (failure: Exception) {
            try { write(old) } catch (rollback: Exception) { failure.addSuppressed(rollback) }
            throw failure
        }
        confirmed = value
    }
}
```

`app/src/main/java/com/system/location/service/update/UpdateChecker.kt`:

```kt
package com.system.location.service.update

import android.content.Context
import android.content.Intent
import android.net.Uri
import android.os.Build
import android.util.Log
import com.system.location.service.BuildConfig
import kotlinx.coroutines.Dispatchers
import kotlinx.coroutines.CancellationException
import kotlinx.coroutines.withContext

/** GitHub Release 检查更新；已验证的 Android versionCode 是安装顺序依据。 */
object UpdateChecker {

    private const val TAG = "UpdateChecker"
    private const val RELEASES_API = "https://api.github.com/repos/Lecheeel/Portal/releases"
    private const val RELEASES_PAGE = "https://github.com/Lecheeel/Portal/releases"

    data class UpdateInfo(
        val tagName: String,
        val versionName: String,   // tag 去掉 v 前缀
        val body: String,
        val apkUrl: String?,       // 与当前 ABI 匹配的 APK 直链（浏览器可下载）
        val htmlUrl: String,
        val commitCount: Int,
        val commitHash: String,
        val publishedAt: Long = 0,
        val prerelease: Boolean = false,
        val draft: Boolean = false,
    )

    sealed class Result {
        data class UpdateAvailable(val info: UpdateInfo) : Result()
        data object UpToDate : Result()
        data class Error(val message: String) : Result()
    }

    internal suspend fun check(channel: UpdateChannel = currentChannel()): Result = withContext(Dispatchers.IO) {
        try {
            val abi = when (Build.SUPPORTED_ABIS.firstOrNull()) {
                "arm64-v8a" -> "arm64"
                "x86_64" -> "x86_64"
                else -> return@withContext Result.Error("当前设备 ABI 不受支持")
            }
            val releases = ReleaseFeed(HttpsReleaseTransport()).load(channel, abi)
            if (releases.isEmpty()) return@withContext Result.Error("所选通道中没有可用的 APK")
            val candidates = releases.filter {
                ReleaseChannelPolicy.isInstallable(channel, it.policy(), BuildConfig.VERSION_NAME, BuildConfig.VERSION_CODE)
            }
            // Verified Android codes are authoritative; equal-code promotion never prompts again.
            val selected = candidates.filter { it.versionCode != null }.maxByOrNull { it.versionCode!! }
                ?: ReleaseChannelPolicy.select(channel, candidates.map { it.policy() })?.let { policy ->
                    candidates.first { it.tag == policy.tag }
                }
            if (selected == null) return@withContext Result.UpToDate
            val parsed = ReleaseVersion.parse(selected.tag) ?: return@withContext Result.Error("Release 版本无效")
            Result.UpdateAvailable(UpdateInfo(
                tagName = selected.tag,
                versionName = selected.tag.removePrefix("v"),
                body = selected.body,
                // Legacy metadata cannot prove installability. Open its Release page for manual review.
                apkUrl = if (selected.versionCode == null) null else selected.apk(abi)?.url,
                htmlUrl = selected.htmlUrl,
                commitCount = parsed.revision,
                commitHash = parsed.hash,
                publishedAt = selected.publishedAt,
                prerelease = selected.prerelease,
                draft = selected.draft,
            ))
        } catch (e: CancellationException) {
            throw e
        } catch (e: Exception) {
            Log.e(TAG, "check failed", e)
            Result.Error(e.message ?: "网络请求失败")
        }
    }

    private fun applicationContext(): Context = com.system.location.service.LocationServiceApp.appContext

    internal fun currentChannel() = UpdateChannelSettings.from(applicationContext()).get()

    internal fun setChannel(channel: UpdateChannel) = UpdateChannelSettings.from(applicationContext()).set(channel)

    fun parseLocalVersion(): UpdateInfo {
        val v = BuildConfig.VERSION_NAME  // 1.0.4.r<count>.<hash>
        val parts = v.split(".")
        val rIndex = parts.indexOfFirst { it.startsWith("r") && it.drop(1).toIntOrNull() != null }
        val commitCount = if (rIndex >= 0) parts[rIndex].drop(1).toInt() else 0
        val commitHash = BuildConfig.GIT_REVISION
        return UpdateInfo(
            tagName = "v$v",
            versionName = v,
            body = "",
            apkUrl = null,
            htmlUrl = RELEASES_PAGE,
            commitCount = commitCount,
            commitHash = commitHash,
        )
    }

    fun openDownload(context: Context, info: UpdateInfo) {
        openDownload(context, info.apkUrl ?: info.htmlUrl)
    }

    fun openDownload(context: Context, url: String) {
        runCatching {
            require(GitHubReleaseUrls.trusted(url)) { "不可信的下载地址" }
            context.startActivity(Intent(Intent.ACTION_VIEW, Uri.parse(url)))
        }.onFailure {
            Log.e(TAG, "open download failed", it)
        }
    }
}
```

`app/src/main/java/com/system/location/service/update/UpdateDialogFragment.kt`:

```kt
package com.system.location.service.update

import android.app.Dialog
import android.os.Bundle
import androidx.core.os.bundleOf
import androidx.fragment.app.DialogFragment
import androidx.fragment.app.FragmentManager
import com.google.android.material.dialog.MaterialAlertDialogBuilder

class UpdateDialogFragment : DialogFragment() {
    override fun onCreateDialog(savedInstanceState: Bundle?): Dialog {
        val args = requireArguments()
        return MaterialAlertDialogBuilder(requireContext())
            .setTitle(if (args.getBoolean("beta")) getString(com.system.location.service.R.string.update_release_beta) else getString(com.system.location.service.R.string.update_channel_stable))
            .setMessage(
                "最新版本：${args.getString("version")}\n" +
                    "当前版本：${UpdateChecker.parseLocalVersion().versionName}\n\n" +
                    args.getString("body").orEmpty().take(600).ifBlank { "查看 Release 页获取更新说明" }
            )
            .setPositiveButton("下载更新") { _, _ ->
                UpdateChecker.openDownload(requireContext(), args.getString("url")!!)
            }
            .setNegativeButton("下次再说", null)
            .create()
    }

    companion object {
        private const val TAG = "release-update"

        fun show(manager: FragmentManager, info: UpdateChecker.UpdateInfo): Boolean {
            if (manager.isStateSaved) return false
            if (manager.findFragmentByTag(TAG) == null) {
                UpdateDialogFragment().apply {
                    arguments = bundleOf(
                        "version" to info.versionName,
                        "body" to info.body,
                        "url" to (info.apkUrl ?: info.htmlUrl),
                        "beta" to info.prerelease,
                    )
                }.show(manager, TAG)
            }
            return true
        }
    }
}
```

`app/src/main/java/com/system/location/service/update/UpdateRequestGate.kt`:

```kt
package com.system.location.service.update

/** Rejects stale asynchronous results after a channel or request change. */
internal class UpdateRequestGate<C>(initialChannel: C?) {
    private var channel: C? = initialChannel
    private var generation = 0L

    @Synchronized fun select(value: C?) {
        if (channel != value) {
            channel = value
            generation++
        }
    }

    @Synchronized fun begin(): Long? {
        if (channel == null) return null
        return ++generation
    }

    @Synchronized fun accepts(request: Long, requestedChannel: C) =
        channel == requestedChannel && generation == request
}
```

```xml
<?xml version="1.0" encoding="utf-8"?><!--
   Sample backup rules file; uncomment and customize as necessary.
   See https://developer.android.com/guide/topics/data/autobackup

   Note: This file is ignored for devices older that API 31
```

`app/src/test/java/com/system/location/service/backend/FusedMockBackendTest.kt`:

```kt
package com.system.location.service.backend

import com.system.location.service.backend.mock.*
import com.system.location.service.core.backend.*
import com.system.location.service.core.geo.Wgs84
import com.system.location.service.core.location.LocationSample
import kotlinx.coroutines.runBlocking
import org.junit.Assert.*
import org.junit.Test

class FusedMockBackendTest {
    private class Base : LocationBackend {
        var published = 0; var stopped = 0; var fail = false
        override val type = BackendType.MOCK_PROVIDER
        override val capabilities = emptyMap<Capability, CapabilityStatus>()
        override suspend fun prepare() = BackendResult.Success
        override suspend fun start() = BackendResult.Success
        override suspend fun publish(sample: LocationSample, scenarioId: String?): BackendResult { published++; return if (fail) BackendResult.Failure("PUBLISH", "denied") else BackendResult.Success }
        override suspend fun stop(): BackendResult { stopped++; return BackendResult.Success }
        override suspend fun release() = stop()
    }
    private class Fused : FusedMockPort {
        var failStart = false; var failPublish = false; var failStop = false
        var published = 0; var stopped = 0; var pending = false
        override val capability = CapabilityStatus(Availability.EXPERIMENTAL)
        override fun diagnostics() = emptyList<BackendDiagnostic>()
        override suspend fun prepare() { if (pending) stop() }
        override suspend fun start() { pending = true; if (failStart) error("unavailable") }
        override suspend fun publish(sample: LocationSample) { published++; if (failPublish) error("failed") }
        override suspend fun stop() { stopped++; if (failStop) error("cleanup unavailable"); pending = false }
    }
    private val sample = LocationSample(Wgs84(1.0, 2.0), 10.0, 5f, 0f, 0f, 1, 1)
    @Test fun optionalStartupAndPublishFailureDoNotStopStandardProviders() = runBlocking {
        for (onStart in listOf(true, false)) {
            val base = Base(); val fused = Fused().apply { failStart = onStart; failPublish = !onStart }
            val backend = FusedMockBackend(base, fused)
            backend.prepare(); assertEquals(BackendResult.Success, backend.start())
            repeat(3) { assertEquals(BackendResult.Success, backend.publish(sample)) }
            assertEquals(3, base.published); assertEquals(if (onStart) 0 else 1, fused.published)
            assertFalse("Degradation must disable stale fused mock data", fused.pending)
            assertTrue(backend.diagnose().any { it.stage == "GMS_DEGRADED" })
            assertEquals(BackendResult.Success, backend.stop()); assertFalse(fused.pending)
        }
    }
    @Test fun failedCleanupRetainsPendingStateAndRetriesWithoutStartingNewSession() = runBlocking {
        val base = Base(); val fused = Fused().apply { pending = true; failStop = true }
        val backend = FusedMockBackend(base, fused)
        assertTrue(backend.prepare() is BackendResult.Failure); assertTrue(fused.pending)
        assertTrue(backend.stop() is BackendResult.Failure); assertEquals(1, base.stopped)
        fused.failStop = false
        assertEquals(BackendResult.Success, backend.stop()); assertFalse(fused.pending)
        assertEquals(BackendResult.Success, backend.release())
    }
    @Test fun standardFailureIsAuthoritativeAndSkipsFusedPublishing() = runBlocking {
        val base = Base(); val fused = Fused(); val backend = FusedMockBackend(base, fused)
        backend.prepare(); backend.start(); base.fail = true
        assertTrue(backend.publish(sample) is BackendResult.Failure); assertEquals(0, fused.published)
        backend.stop(); assertEquals(1, base.stopped); assertFalse(fused.pending)
    }
}
```

`app/src/test/java/com/system/location/service/backend/GmsMockSessionTest.kt`:

```kt
package com.system.location.service.backend

import com.system.location.service.backend.mock.*
import com.system.location.service.core.geo.Wgs84
import com.system.location.service.core.location.LocationSample
import kotlinx.coroutines.runBlocking
import org.junit.Assert.*
import org.junit.Test

class GmsMockSessionTest {
    /** Only the external Task completion is controlled; lifecycle logic is production code. */
    private class Operation(completed: Boolean = false) : GmsOperation {
        var deferCallbacks = false
        private var complete = completed
        private var error: Exception? = null
        private val listeners = mutableListOf<() -> Unit>()
        override val isComplete get() = complete
        override val isSuccessful get() = complete && error == null
        override val failure get() = error
        fun finish(failure: Exception? = null) {
            check(!complete)
            error = failure; complete = true
            if (!deferCallbacks) releaseCallbacks()
        }
        fun releaseCallbacks() { listeners.toList().also { listeners.clear() }.forEach { it() } }
        override fun then(action: () -> GmsOperation?): GmsOperation {
            var next: GmsOperation? = null
            val callback = { next = action() ?: Operation(true); Unit }
            if (complete) callback() else listeners += callback
            return object : GmsOperation {
                override val isComplete get() = next?.isComplete == true
                override val isSuccessful get() = next?.isSuccessful == true
                override val failure get() = next?.failure
                override fun then(action: () -> GmsOperation?): GmsOperation = error("unused")
            }
        }
    }
    private class Ownership : GmsOwnership {
        override var pending = false
        override fun record(pending: Boolean) { this.pending = pending }
    }
    private class Port {
        val ownership = Ownership()
        val modes = mutableListOf<Boolean>()
        var enable = Operation(true)
        var disable: () -> Operation = { Operation(true) }
        var publication = Operation()
        var time = 0L
        fun session() = GmsMockSession(true, { true }, ownership, { mode ->
            modes += mode
            if (mode) enable else disable()
        }, { publication }, { time }, 20)
    }
    private val sample = LocationSample(Wgs84(1.0, 2.0), 10.0, 5f, 0f, 0f, 1, 1)

    @Test fun deferredEnableContinuationBlocksReplacementUntilCompensationCompletes() = runBlocking {
        val port = Port().apply { enable = Operation().apply { deferCallbacks = true } }
        val oldEnable = port.enable
        val session = port.session()
        assertTrue(runCatching { session.start() }.isFailure)
        assertTrue(runCatching { session.stop() }.isFailure)
        oldEnable.finish()
        repeat(2) { assertTrue(runCatching { session.stop() }.isFailure) }
        val before = port.modes.toList()
        assertTrue(runCatching { session.start() }.isFailure)
        assertEquals(before, port.modes)
        assertTrue(port.ownership.pending)
        oldEnable.releaseCallbacks()
        session.stop()
        assertFalse(port.ownership.pending)
        port.enable = Operation(true)
        session.start()
        assertEquals(com.system.location.service.core.backend.Availability.AVAILABLE, session.capability.availability)
    }

    @Test fun failedLateCompensationKeepsOwnershipUntilFreshDisableSucceeds() = runBlocking {
        val port = Port().apply { enable = Operation() }
        val session = port.session()
        assertTrue(runCatching { session.start() }.isFailure)
        assertTrue(runCatching { session.stop() }.isFailure)
        val lateDisable = Operation()
        port.disable = { lateDisable }
        port.enable.finish()
        assertTrue(runCatching { session.stop() }.isFailure)
        assertTrue(port.ownership.pending)
        port.disable = { Operation(true) }
        assertTrue(runCatching { session.stop() }.isFailure)
        assertTrue(port.ownership.pending)
        val before = port.modes.toList()
        assertTrue(runCatching { session.start() }.isFailure)
        assertEquals(before, port.modes)
        lateDisable.finish(IllegalStateException("obsolete compensation"))
        session.stop()
        assertFalse(port.ownership.pending)
        session.start()
        assertEquals(com.system.location.service.core.backend.Availability.AVAILABLE, session.capability.availability)
    }

    @Test fun lateSuccessfulCompensationBlocksReplacementUntilItFinishes() = runBlocking {
        val port = Port().apply { enable = Operation() }
        val session = port.session()
        assertTrue(runCatching { session.start() }.isFailure)
        val lateDisable = Operation()
        port.disable = { lateDisable }
        port.enable.finish()
        // Subsequent stop attempts have their own successful disable Tasks.
        port.disable = { Operation(true) }
        repeat(3) { assertTrue(runCatching { session.stop() }.isFailure) }
        assertTrue(port.ownership.pending)
        val before = port.modes.toList()
        assertTrue(runCatching { session.start() }.isFailure)
        assertEquals(before, port.modes)
        lateDisable.finish()
        session.stop()
        assertFalse(port.ownership.pending)
        session.start()
        assertEquals(com.system.location.service.core.backend.Availability.AVAILABLE, session.capability.availability)
    }

    @Test fun unfinishedCleanupBlocksNewEnableUntilLateEnableCompensates() = runBlocking {
        val port = Port().apply { enable = Operation() }
        val session = port.session()
        assertTrue(runCatching { session.start() }.isFailure)
        assertTrue(runCatching { session.stop() }.isFailure)
        val calls = port.modes.toList()
        assertTrue(runCatching { session.start() }.isFailure)
        assertEquals(calls, port.modes)
        port.enable.finish()
        session.stop()
        session.start()
        assertEquals(com.system.location.service.core.backend.Availability.AVAILABLE, session.capability.availability)
    }

    @Test fun pendingPublicationDegradesThroughRealFusedBackendAndDisablesGms() = runBlocking {
        val port = Port(); val session = port.session()
        var basePublishes = 0
        val base = object : com.system.location.service.core.backend.LocationBackend {
            override val type = com.system.location.service.core.backend.BackendType.MOCK_PROVIDER
            override val capabilities = emptyMap<com.system.location.service.core.backend.Capability, com.system.location.service.core.backend.CapabilityStatus>()
            override suspend fun prepare() = com.system.location.service.core.backend.BackendResult.Success
            override suspend fun start() = com.system.location.service.core.backend.BackendResult.Success
            override suspend fun publish(sample: LocationSample, scenarioId: String?) = com.system.location.service.core.backend.BackendResult.Success.also { basePublishes++ }
            override suspend fun stop() = com.system.location.service.core.backend.BackendResult.Success
            override suspend fun release() = stop()
        }
        val backend = FusedMockBackend(base, session)
        backend.prepare(); backend.start(); backend.publish(sample)
        port.time = 3_000_000_000
        assertEquals(com.system.location.service.core.backend.BackendResult.Success, backend.publish(sample))
        assertEquals(2, basePublishes)
        assertEquals(listOf(true, false), port.modes)
        assertFalse(port.ownership.pending)
        assertTrue(backend.diagnose().any { it.stage == "GMS_DEGRADED" })
    }

    @Test fun recreatedSessionCleansRetainedOwnershipBeforeStarting() = runBlocking {
        val port = Port(); val session = port.session()
        val failedDisable = Operation()
        session.start(); port.disable = { failedDisable }
        assertTrue(runCatching { session.stop() }.isFailure)
        failedDisable.finish(IllegalStateException("previous cleanup failed"))
        port.disable = { Operation(true) }
        val recovered = port.session()
        recovered.prepare()
        assertFalse(port.ownership.pending)
        recovered.start()
        assertEquals(listOf(true, false, false, true), port.modes)
    }

    @Test fun latePublicationFailureCannotReplaceNewSessionSubmission() = runBlocking {
        val port = Port(); val session = port.session()
        session.start(); session.publish(sample)
        val oldPublication = port.publication
        session.stop()
        port.publication = Operation(true)
        session.start(); session.publish(sample)
        oldPublication.finish(IllegalStateException("old failure"))
        session.publish(sample)
        assertTrue(port.ownership.pending)
        assertEquals(com.system.location.service.core.backend.Availability.AVAILABLE, session.capability.availability)
    }

    @Test fun pendingEnableGetsImmediateDisableAndLateCompletionCompensation() = runBlocking {
        val port = Port().apply { enable = Operation() }
        val session = port.session()
        assertTrue(runCatching { session.start() }.isFailure)
        assertTrue(runCatching { session.stop() }.isFailure)
        assertEquals(listOf(true, false), port.modes)
        assertTrue(port.ownership.pending)
        port.enable.finish()
        assertEquals(listOf(true, false, false), port.modes)
        session.stop()
        assertFalse(port.ownership.pending)
        session.start()
        port.publication.finish(IllegalStateException("old publication"))
        assertEquals(com.system.location.service.core.backend.Availability.AVAILABLE, session.capability.availability)
    }

    @Test fun timedOutDisablesAreRetriedButAllMustFinishBeforeNewEnable() = runBlocking {
        listOf<Exception?>(null, IllegalStateException("late failure")).forEach { lateFailure ->
            val port = Port(); val session = port.session()
            val firstDisable = Operation()
            val secondDisable = Operation()
            port.disable = { firstDisable }
            session.start(); session.publish(sample)
            assertTrue(runCatching { session.stop() }.isFailure)
            port.disable = { secondDisable }
            assertTrue(runCatching { session.stop() }.isFailure)
            port.disable = { Operation(true) }
            assertTrue(runCatching { session.stop() }.isFailure)
            assertEquals(listOf(true, false, false, false), port.modes)
            assertTrue(port.ownership.pending)
            assertFalse(port.publication.isComplete)
            val before = port.modes.toList()
            assertTrue(runCatching { session.start() }.isFailure)
            assertEquals(before, port.modes)
            secondDisable.finish()
            assertTrue(runCatching { session.stop() }.isFailure)
            firstDisable.finish(lateFailure)
            session.stop()
            assertFalse(port.ownership.pending)
            session.start()
            assertEquals(com.system.location.service.core.backend.Availability.AVAILABLE, session.capability.availability)
        }
    }

    @Test fun permanentlyPendingPublicationDoesNotBlockDisable() = runBlocking {
        val port = Port(); val session = port.session()
        session.start(); session.publish(sample)
        runCatching { session.stop() }
        assertEquals(listOf(true, false), port.modes)
        assertFalse(port.ownership.pending)
        assertFalse(port.publication.isComplete)
    }
}
```

`app/src/test/java/com/system/location/service/backend/MockProviderBackendTest.kt`:

```kt
package com.system.location.service.backend

import com.system.location.service.backend.mock.*
import com.system.location.service.core.backend.BackendResult
import com.system.location.service.core.backend.BackendDiagnostic
import com.system.location.service.core.geo.Wgs84
import com.system.location.service.core.location.LocationSample
import com.system.location.service.core.providers.ProviderSample
import kotlinx.coroutines.runBlocking
import org.junit.Assert.*
import org.junit.Test

class MockProviderBackendTest {
    private class Port : MockProviderPort {
        var allowed = true
        val registered = linkedSetOf<String>()
        val enabled = mutableSetOf<String>()
        val fixes = mutableListOf<Pair<String, LocationSample>>()
        val providerSamples = mutableListOf<Pair<String, ProviderSample>>()
        var failRegister: String? = null
        var failEnable: String? = null
        var failPublish = false
        var failRemove = false
        var missing: String? = null
        var missingAlways = false
        var registrations = 0
        var flushes = 0
        var optional = false
        var rejectUnauthorizedCleanup = false
        var afterPublish: ((String) -> Unit)? = null
        override fun optionalProviders() = if (optional) setOf("fused") else emptySet()
        var extraDiagnostics: List<BackendDiagnostic> = emptyList()
        override fun diagnostics() = extraDiagnostics
        override fun permissionGranted() = allowed
        override fun pendingProviders() = registered.toSet()
        override fun register(provider: String) {
            registrations++
            registered += provider
            if (failRegister == provider) error("register failed after allocation")
        }
        override fun enable(provider: String, enabled: Boolean) {
            if (enabled && failEnable == provider) error("enable failed")
            if (enabled) this.enabled += provider else this.enabled -= provider
        }
        override fun publish(provider: String, sample: LocationSample) {
            if (missing == provider) { if (!missingAlways) missing = null; throw MissingMockProviderException(provider) }
            if (failPublish) throw SecurityException("mock authorization revoked")
            fixes += provider to sample
            afterPublish?.invoke(provider)
        }
        override fun publish(provider: String, sample: ProviderSample) {
            providerSamples += provider to sample
            publish(provider, sample.sample)
        }
        override fun remove(provider: String) {
            if (rejectUnauthorizedCleanup && !allowed) throw MockAuthorizationException("cleanup")
            if (failRemove) throw SecurityException("cleanup denied")
            registered -= provider
        }
        override fun flushRealLocation() { flushes++ }
    }
    private val sample = LocationSample(Wgs84(25.123456789123, 119.12345678912), 15.0, 2f, 3f, 45f, 1, 1)
    @Test fun stoppingTheTestProviderFlushesTheRealProviderCache() = runBlocking {
        val port = Port()
        val backend = MockProviderBackend(port)
        backend.prepare(); backend.start()
        assertEquals(BackendResult.Success, backend.stop())
        assertEquals(1, port.flushes)
    }

    @Test fun revokedAuthorizationStopsBeforeAnySubmissionAndRetainsCleanupForRetry() = runBlocking {
        val port = Port().apply { rejectUnauthorizedCleanup = true }
        val backend = MockProviderBackend(port)
        backend.prepare(); backend.start(); port.allowed = false
        val result = backend.publish(sample) as BackendResult.Failure
        assertEquals("MOCK_PERMISSION_REVOKED", result.stage)
        assertTrue(port.fixes.isEmpty())
        assertEquals(2, port.registrations)
        assertEquals(setOf("gps", "network"), port.registered)
        port.allowed = true
        assertEquals(BackendResult.Success, backend.stop())
        assertTrue(port.registered.isEmpty())
    }
    @Test fun authorizationLossBetweenProvidersCannotReportSuccessOrReregister() = runBlocking {
        val port = Port().apply { afterPublish = { allowed = false } }
        val backend = MockProviderBackend(port)
        backend.prepare(); backend.start()
        val result = backend.publish(sample) as BackendResult.Failure
        assertEquals("MOCK_PERMISSION_REVOKED", result.stage)
        assertEquals(listOf("gps"), port.fixes.map { it.first })
        assertEquals(2, port.registrations)
    }
    @Test fun optionalPlatformFusedFailureDoesNotDisableGpsOrNetworkAndStillCleans() = runBlocking {
        val port = Port().apply { optional = true; failRegister = "fused" }
        val backend = MockProviderBackend(port)
        backend.prepare(); assertEquals(BackendResult.Success, backend.start())
        assertEquals(BackendResult.Success, backend.publish(sample))
        assertEquals(setOf("gps", "network"), port.enabled)
        assertTrue(backend.diagnose().any { it.stage == "OPTIONAL_FUSED" })
        assertEquals(BackendResult.Success, backend.stop()); assertTrue(port.registered.isEmpty())
    }
    @Test fun missingProviderRetriesOnceButPermissionFailureNeverRetries() = runBlocking {
        val port = Port(); val backend = MockProviderBackend(port)
        backend.prepare(); backend.start(); port.missing = "gps"
        assertEquals(BackendResult.Success, backend.publish(sample))
        assertEquals(3, port.registrations)
        port.failPublish = true
        assertTrue(backend.publish(sample) is BackendResult.Failure)
        assertEquals(3, port.registrations)
        assertTrue(port.registered.isEmpty())
    }
    @Test fun recoveryIsBoundedAndCannotReviveAStoppedSession() = runBlocking {
        val port = Port(); val backend = MockProviderBackend(port)
        backend.prepare(); backend.start(); port.missing = "gps"; port.missingAlways = true
        assertTrue(backend.publish(sample) is BackendResult.Failure)
        assertEquals(3, port.registrations)
        backend.stop()
        assertTrue(backend.publish(sample) is BackendResult.Failure)
        assertEquals(3, port.registrations)
    }

    @Test fun providerFieldMasksReachThePortWithEachProviderSample() = runBlocking {
        val port = Port()
        val backend = MockProviderBackend(port)
        backend.prepare(); backend.start()
        assertEquals(BackendResult.Success, backend.publish(sample))

        val gps = port.providerSamples.first { it.first == "gps" }.second
        val network = port.providerSamples.first { it.first == "network" }.second
        assertTrue(gps.has(com.system.location.service.core.providers.ProviderFieldMask.ALTITUDE))
        assertTrue(gps.has(com.system.location.service.core.providers.ProviderFieldMask.SPEED))
        assertFalse(network.has(com.system.location.service.core.providers.ProviderFieldMask.ALTITUDE))
        assertFalse(network.has(com.system.location.service.core.providers.ProviderFieldMask.SPEED))
        assertNull(gps.mslAltitudeMeters)
        backend.stop()
        Unit
    }

    @Test fun reflectionDiagnosticDoesNotClaimDownstreamAcceptanceOrBlockPublishing() = runBlocking {
        val port = Port()
        port.extraDiagnostics = listOf(BackendDiagnostic("MOCK_FLAG_EXPERIMENT", "UNAVAILABLE", "reflection blocked"))
        val backend = MockProviderBackend(port)
        assertTrue(backend.diagnose().contains(port.extraDiagnostics.single()))
        assertEquals(BackendResult.Success, backend.prepare())
        assertEquals(BackendResult.Success, backend.start())
        assertEquals(BackendResult.Success, backend.publish(sample))
        assertEquals(setOf("gps", "network"), port.fixes.map { it.first }.toSet())
        assertEquals(sample.accuracy, port.fixes.first { it.first == "gps" }.second.accuracy, 0f)
        assertEquals(sample.accuracy * 10f, port.fixes.first { it.first == "network" }.second.accuracy, 0f)
        assertTrue(port.fixes.first { it.first == "network" }.second.timeMillis <
            port.fixes.first { it.first == "gps" }.second.timeMillis)
    }

    @Test fun pointAndPausedSamplesShareCompleteLifecycle() = runBlocking {
        val port = Port(); val backend = MockProviderBackend(port)
        assertTrue(backend.start() is BackendResult.Failure)
        assertEquals(BackendResult.Success, backend.prepare())
        assertEquals(BackendResult.Success, backend.start())
        backend.publish(sample)
        assertEquals(setOf("gps", "network"), port.enabled)
        assertEquals(setOf("gps", "network"), port.fixes.map { it.first }.toSet())
        assertEquals(sample.accuracy, port.fixes.first { it.first == "gps" }.second.accuracy, 0f)
        assertEquals(sample.accuracy * 10f, port.fixes.first { it.first == "network" }.second.accuracy, 0f)
        assertEquals(BackendResult.Success, backend.pause())
        backend.publish(sample)
        assertEquals(0f, port.fixes.last().second.speed)
        assertEquals(sample.coordinate, port.fixes.last().second.coordinate)
        assertEquals(BackendResult.Success, backend.resume())
        assertEquals(BackendResult.Success, backend.stop())
        assertEquals(BackendResult.Success, backend.release())
        assertTrue(port.registered.isEmpty()); assertTrue(port.enabled.isEmpty())
    }
    @Test fun permissionDeniedDoesNotAllocateProviders() = runBlocking {
        val port = Port().apply { allowed = false }; val backend = MockProviderBackend(port)
        assertTrue(backend.prepare() is BackendResult.Failure)
        assertTrue(backend.start() is BackendResult.Failure)
        assertTrue(port.registered.isEmpty())
    }
    @Test fun partialRegistrationAndEnableFailuresRollbackBothProviders() = runBlocking {
        for (failEnable in listOf(false, true)) {
            val port = Port().apply { if (failEnable) this.failEnable = "network" else failRegister = "network" }
            val backend = MockProviderBackend(port)
            backend.prepare()
            assertTrue(backend.start() is BackendResult.Failure)
            assertTrue(port.registered.isEmpty()); assertTrue(port.enabled.isEmpty())
        }
    }
    @Test fun publishFailureCleansProvidersAndCleanupCanRetry() = runBlocking {
        val port = Port(); val backend = MockProviderBackend(port)
        backend.prepare(); backend.start(); port.failPublish = true; port.failRemove = true
        assertTrue(backend.publish(sample) is BackendResult.Failure)
        assertTrue(backend.release() is BackendResult.Failure)
        assertEquals(2, port.registered.size)
        port.failRemove = false
        assertEquals(BackendResult.Success, backend.release())
        assertTrue(port.registered.isEmpty())
    }
    @Test fun preparingAfterProcessInterruptionCleansJournaledProviders() = runBlocking {
        val port = Port().apply { registered += "gps" }
        val backend = MockProviderBackend(port)
        assertEquals(BackendResult.Success, backend.prepare())
        assertTrue(port.registered.isEmpty())
        backend.start(); backend.stop()
        assertTrue(port.registered.isEmpty())
    }

    @Test fun stopAfterProcessRecreationCleansJournalWithoutStartingProviders() = runBlocking {
        val port = Port().apply { registered += "gps"; failRemove = true }
        val backend = MockProviderBackend(port)
        assertTrue(backend.stop() is BackendResult.Failure)
        port.failRemove = false
        assertEquals(BackendResult.Success, backend.stop())
        assertTrue(port.registered.isEmpty())
        assertTrue(port.fixes.isEmpty())
    }

    @Test fun sameRouteRuntimePublishesBothProvidersAndFreezesAcrossPause() = runBlocking {
        val port = Port()
        var elapsed = 0L
        val clock = object : com.system.location.service.core.runtime.RuntimeClock {
            override fun nanos() = elapsed * 1_000_000
            override fun millis() = elapsed
        }
        val controller = com.system.location.service.core.runtime.ScenarioController({ MockProviderBackend(port) }, clock)
        val scene = com.system.location.service.core.scenario.Scenario("route", "route", route =
            com.system.location.service.core.scenario.Route("r", "r", listOf(Wgs84(25.0, 119.0), Wgs84(25.01, 119.01))))
        assertTrue(controller.start(scene))
        elapsed = 1000; controller.tick()
        assertTrue(controller.pause())
        val point = controller.state.value.sample!!.coordinate
        elapsed = 90_000; controller.tick()
        val paused = port.fixes.takeLast(2)
        assertEquals(point, paused[0].second.coordinate)
        assertEquals(point, paused[1].second.coordinate)
        assertEquals(0f, paused[0].second.speed)
        assertEquals(0f, paused[1].second.speed)
        controller.resume(); elapsed = 91_000; controller.tick()
        assertNotEquals(point, port.fixes.last().second.coordinate)
        val resumed = port.fixes.takeLast(2)
        assertEquals(resumed[0].second.coordinate, resumed[1].second.coordinate)
        assertTrue(resumed[0].second.speed > 0f)
        assertNotEquals(resumed[0].second.accuracy, resumed[1].second.accuracy)
        assertTrue(controller.stop()); assertTrue(port.registered.isEmpty())
    }
}
```

`app/src/test/java/com/system/location/service/backend/RecoveringMockBackendTest.kt`:

```kt
package com.system.location.service.backend

import com.system.location.service.backend.mock.*
import com.system.location.service.core.backend.*
import com.system.location.service.core.location.LocationSample
import kotlinx.coroutines.runBlocking
import org.junit.Assert.*
import org.junit.Test

class RecoveringMockBackendTest {
    @Test fun recoveryWaitsForSuccessfulCleanupAndIsNotRepeated() = runBlocking {
        val events = mutableListOf<String>()
        var fail = true
        val delegate = object : LocationBackend {
            override val type = BackendType.MOCK_PROVIDER
            override val capabilities = emptyMap<Capability, CapabilityStatus>()
            override suspend fun prepare() = BackendResult.Success
            override suspend fun start() = BackendResult.Success
            override suspend fun publish(sample: LocationSample, scenarioId: String?) = BackendResult.Success
            override suspend fun stop(): BackendResult {
                events += "cleanup"
                return if (fail) BackendResult.Failure("CLEANUP", "pending") else BackendResult.Success
            }
            override suspend fun release() = stop()
        }
        val recovery = object : PhysicalLocationRecovery {
            override fun cancel() { events += "cancel" }
            override fun request() { events += "physical" }
        }
        val backend = RecoveringMockBackend(delegate, recovery)
        backend.prepare(); backend.start()
        assertTrue(backend.stop() is BackendResult.Failure)
        assertEquals(listOf("cancel", "cleanup"), events)
        fail = false
        backend.release(); backend.stop()
        assertEquals(listOf("cancel", "cleanup", "cleanup", "physical", "cleanup"), events)
        backend.prepare()
        assertEquals("cancel", events.last())
    }
}
```

```kt
package com.system.location.service.backend

import com.system.location.service.backend.xposed.ReplayActivation

class ReplayActivationTest {
    @Test fun clearsPreviousSwitchesWhenDisabled() {
        val calls = mutableListOf<Pair<String, Boolean>>()
        assertTrue(ReplayActivation.apply(false, false,
            { calls += "environment" to it; true }, { calls += "satellite" to it; true }))
        assertEquals(listOf("environment" to false, "satellite" to false), calls)
    }

    @Test fun enablesBothSelectedSources() {
        val calls = mutableListOf<Boolean>()
        assertTrue(ReplayActivation.apply(true, true, { calls += it; true }, { calls += it; true }))
        assertEquals(listOf(true, true), calls)
    }

    @Test fun activationFailureIsNotReportedAsSuccess() {

        assertFalse(ReplayActivation.apply(true, true, { false }, { satelliteCalled = true; true }))
        assertFalse(satelliteCalled)
        assertFalse(ReplayActivation.apply(true, true, { true }, { false }))
    }
```

`app/src/test/java/com/system/location/service/backend/mock/HookLocationConversionTest.kt`:

```kt
package com.system.location.service.backend.mock

import android.app.Application
import android.os.Build
import com.system.location.service.core.geo.Wgs84
import com.system.location.service.core.location.LocationSample
import com.system.location.service.core.providers.ProviderFieldMask
import com.system.location.service.core.providers.ProviderKind
import com.system.location.service.core.providers.ProviderMixer
import com.system.location.service.core.runtime.HookConfiguration
import com.system.location.service.core.runtime.RuntimeSnapshot
import com.system.location.service.hook.utils.toLocation
import org.junit.Assert.*
import org.junit.Test
import org.junit.runner.RunWith
import org.robolectric.RobolectricTestRunner
import org.robolectric.annotation.Config

/** Tests the Hook converter without activating Xposed or changing global runtime settings. */
@RunWith(RobolectricTestRunner::class)
@Config(sdk = [31, 32, 33, 34], manifest = Config.NONE, application = Application::class)
class HookLocationConversionTest {
    private val sample = LocationSample(Wgs84(31.0, 121.0), 20.0, 5f, 2f, 90f,
        10_000L, 10_000_000_000L)
    private val state = RuntimeSnapshot(configuration = HookConfiguration(gnssEnabled = false))
    private val gps = ProviderMixer().mix(sample).getValue(ProviderKind.GPS)

    @Test fun providerMasksMatchStandardConverterForEveryProviderAndMotionState() {
        for (speed in listOf(0f, 2f)) {
            val fix = sample.copy(speed = speed)
            for (view in ProviderMixer().mix(fix).values) {
                val provider = view.profile.kind.name.lowercase()
                val standard = view.toLocation(provider)
                val hook = view.sample.toLocation(provider, state = state, providerSample = view)
                assertEquals(standard.provider, hook.provider)
                assertEquals(standard.latitude, hook.latitude, 0.0)
                assertEquals(standard.longitude, hook.longitude, 0.0)
                assertEquals(standard.time, hook.time)
                assertEquals(standard.elapsedRealtimeNanos, hook.elapsedRealtimeNanos)
                assertEquals(standard.accuracy, hook.accuracy, 0f)
                assertEquals(standard.hasAltitude(), hook.hasAltitude())
                assertEquals(standard.hasSpeed(), hook.hasSpeed())
                assertEquals(standard.hasBearing(), hook.hasBearing())
                assertEquals(standard.hasVerticalAccuracy(), hook.hasVerticalAccuracy())
                assertEquals(standard.hasSpeedAccuracy(), hook.hasSpeedAccuracy())
                assertEquals(standard.hasBearingAccuracy(), hook.hasBearingAccuracy())
                assertEquals(standard.hasElapsedRealtimeUncertaintyNanos(), hook.hasElapsedRealtimeUncertaintyNanos())
                if (Build.VERSION.SDK_INT >= 34) assertFalse(hook.hasMslAltitude())
            }
        }
    }

    @Test fun emptyMaskLeavesAllOptionalFieldsAbsent() {
        val location = sample.toLocation("network", state = state, providerSample = gps.copy(fieldsMask = 0))
        assertFalse(location.hasAltitude())
        assertFalse(location.hasSpeed())
        assertFalse(location.hasBearing())
        assertFalse(location.hasVerticalAccuracy())
        assertFalse(location.hasSpeedAccuracy())
        assertFalse(location.hasBearingAccuracy())
        assertFalse(location.hasElapsedRealtimeUncertaintyNanos())
        assertNull(location.extras)
    }

    @Test fun mslAltitudeOnlyUsesNativeFieldOnApi34WithPresentNonNullValue() {
        val msl = gps.copy(fieldsMask = gps.fieldsMask or ProviderFieldMask.MSL_ALTITUDE,
            mslAltitudeMeters = 12.5)
        val location = sample.toLocation("gps", state = state, providerSample = msl)
        if (Build.VERSION.SDK_INT >= 34) {
            assertTrue(location.hasMslAltitude())
            assertEquals(12.5, location.mslAltitudeMeters, 0.0)
            assertFalse(sample.toLocation("gps", state = state,
                providerSample = msl.copy(mslAltitudeMeters = null)).hasMslAltitude())
            assertFalse(sample.toLocation("gps", state = state,
                providerSample = msl.copy(fieldsMask = gps.fieldsMask)).hasMslAltitude())
        }
        assertEquals(sample.altitude, location.altitude, 0.0)
    }

    @Test fun conversionWithoutProviderSamplePreservesDefaultsExtrasAndMockPolicy() {
        val location = sample.toLocation(null, state = state)
        assertEquals("gps", location.provider)
        assertTrue(location.hasAltitude())
        assertTrue(location.hasSpeed())
        assertTrue(location.hasBearing())
        assertTrue(location.hasVerticalAccuracy())
        assertTrue(location.hasSpeedAccuracy())
        assertTrue(location.hasBearingAccuracy())
        assertTrue(location.hasElapsedRealtimeUncertaintyNanos())
        assertFalse(location.isMock)
        val extras = requireNotNull(location.extras)
        assertEquals(0, extras.getInt("satellites"))
        assertEquals(0f, extras.getFloat("meanCn0"), 0f)
        assertEquals(0f, extras.getFloat("maxCn0"), 0f)
        assertTrue(sample.toLocation("gps", state = state.copy(
            configuration = state.configuration.copy(hideMock = false))).isMock)
    }
}
```

`app/src/test/java/com/system/location/service/backend/mock/ProviderLocationFieldsTest.kt`:

```kt
package com.system.location.service.backend.mock

import android.app.Application
import android.os.Build
import com.system.location.service.core.geo.Wgs84
import com.system.location.service.core.location.LocationSample
import com.system.location.service.core.providers.ProviderFieldMask
import com.system.location.service.core.providers.ProviderKind
import com.system.location.service.core.providers.ProviderMixer
import org.junit.Assert.*
import org.junit.Test
import org.junit.runner.RunWith
import org.robolectric.RobolectricTestRunner
import org.robolectric.annotation.Config

/** Exercise Android Location itself, including SDKs that lack the newer removal/MSL APIs. */
@RunWith(RobolectricTestRunner::class)
@Config(sdk = [31, 32, 33, 34], manifest = Config.NONE, application = Application::class)
class ProviderLocationFieldsTest {
    private val sample = LocationSample(Wgs84(31.0, 121.0), 20.0, 5f, 2f, 90f,
        10_000L, 10_000_000_000L)
    private val gps = ProviderMixer().mix(sample).getValue(ProviderKind.GPS)

    @Test fun movingGpsRetainsCoordinatesTimingAndOptionalValues() {
        val location = gps.toLocation("gps")
        assertEquals("gps", location.provider)
        assertEquals(gps.sample.latitude, location.latitude, 0.0)
        assertEquals(gps.sample.longitude, location.longitude, 0.0)
        assertEquals(gps.sample.timeMillis, location.time)
        assertEquals(gps.sample.elapsedNanos, location.elapsedRealtimeNanos)
        assertEquals(gps.sample.accuracy, location.accuracy, 0f)
        assertTrue(location.hasAltitude())
        assertEquals(gps.sample.altitude, location.altitude, 0.0)
        assertTrue(location.hasSpeed())
        assertEquals(gps.sample.speed, location.speed, 0f)
        assertTrue(location.hasBearing())
        assertEquals(gps.sample.bearing, location.bearing, 0f)
        assertTrue(location.hasVerticalAccuracy())
        assertEquals(gps.verticalAccuracyMeters!!, location.verticalAccuracyMeters, 0f)
        assertTrue(location.hasSpeedAccuracy())
        assertTrue(location.hasBearingAccuracy())
        assertTrue(location.hasElapsedRealtimeUncertaintyNanos())
        if (Build.VERSION.SDK_INT >= 34) assertFalse(location.hasMslAltitude())
    }

    @Test fun stationaryAndNetworkSamplesLeaveMotionFieldsAbsent() {
        for (view in ProviderMixer().mix(sample.copy(speed = 0f)).values) {
            val location = view.toLocation(view.profile.kind.name.lowercase())
            assertFalse(location.hasSpeed())
            assertFalse(location.hasBearing())
            assertFalse(location.hasSpeedAccuracy())
            assertFalse(location.hasBearingAccuracy())
        }
        val network = ProviderMixer().mix(sample).getValue(ProviderKind.NETWORK).toLocation("network")
        assertFalse(network.hasAltitude())
        assertFalse(network.hasSpeed())
        assertFalse(network.hasBearing())
    }

    @Test fun absentFieldsNeverLeakFromPreviousPublication() {
        val populated = gps.toLocation("fused")
        val empty = gps.copy(fieldsMask = 0).toLocation("fused")
        assertNotSame(populated, empty)
        assertFalse(empty.hasAltitude())
        assertFalse(empty.hasSpeed())
        assertFalse(empty.hasBearing())
        assertFalse(empty.hasVerticalAccuracy())
        assertFalse(empty.hasSpeedAccuracy())
        assertFalse(empty.hasBearingAccuracy())
        assertFalse(empty.hasElapsedRealtimeUncertaintyNanos())
        if (Build.VERSION.SDK_INT >= 34) assertFalse(empty.hasMslAltitude())
    }

    @Test fun mslAltitudeRequiresBothPlatformSupportAndFieldPresence() {
        val msl = gps.copy(fieldsMask = gps.fieldsMask or ProviderFieldMask.MSL_ALTITUDE,
            mslAltitudeMeters = 12.5)
        val location = msl.toLocation("gps") // Must also succeed on API 31–33.
        if (Build.VERSION.SDK_INT >= 34) {
            assertTrue(location.hasMslAltitude())
            assertEquals(12.5, location.mslAltitudeMeters, 0.0)
            assertFalse(msl.copy(mslAltitudeMeters = null).toLocation("gps").hasMslAltitude())
            assertFalse(msl.copy(fieldsMask = gps.fieldsMask).toLocation("gps").hasMslAltitude())
        }
        assertEquals(gps.sample.altitude, location.altitude, 0.0)
    }
}
```

`app/src/test/java/com/system/location/service/data/persistence/CoordinatePreferencesTest.kt`:

```kt
package com.system.location.service.data.persistence

import com.system.location.service.ui.mock.HistoricalRoute
import com.system.location.service.ui.mock.RouteJson
import org.junit.Assert.*
import org.junit.Test

class CoordinatePreferencesTest {
    @Test fun doubleSurvivesSaveAndNewReaderExactly() {
        val storage = mutableMapOf<String, Any>()
        fun reader() = CoordinatePreferences({ storage.toMap() }) { storage.putAll(it) }
        val lat = 25.123456789012345
        val lon = 119.12345678901234
        reader().set(CoordinatePreferences.LATITUDE, lat)
        reader().set(CoordinatePreferences.LONGITUDE, lon)
        assertEquals(lat.toBits(), reader().get(CoordinatePreferences.LATITUDE).toBits())
        assertEquals(lon.toBits(), reader().get(CoordinatePreferences.LONGITUDE).toBits())
        assertEquals(1, storage[CoordinatePreferences.VERSION])
    }

    @Test fun migratesBothLegacyFloatsWithoutRequantizingNewWrites() {
        val storage = mutableMapOf<String, Any>("last_known_lat" to 25.12345f, "last_known_lng" to 119.12345f)
        val preferences = CoordinatePreferences({ storage.toMap() }) { storage.putAll(it) }
        assertEquals(25.12345f.toDouble(), preferences.get("last_known_lat"), 0.0)
        assertTrue(storage["last_known_lng"] is String)
        preferences.set("last_known_lat", 25.123456789012345)
        assertEquals(25.123456789012345, preferences.get("last_known_lat"), 0.0)
        assertThrows(IllegalArgumentException::class.java) { preferences.set("last_known_lat", Double.NaN) }
    }

    @Test fun routeVersionAndDoubleCoordinatesRoundTripAndLegacyMigration() {
        val route = HistoricalRoute("精度", listOf(25.123456789012345 to 119.12345678901234, 25.123456789012346 to 119.12345678901235))
        val json = RouteJson.encodeRoutes(listOf(route))
        assertTrue(json.contains("\"schemaVersion\":1"))
        assertEquals(route, RouteJson.decodeRoutes(json).single())
        assertEquals(emptyList<HistoricalRoute>(), RouteJson.decodeRoutes("[]"))
        assertThrows(IllegalArgumentException::class.java) { RouteJson.decodeRoutes("{\"schemaVersion\":2,\"routes\":[]}") }
    }
}
```

`app/src/test/java/com/system/location/service/data/persistence/HookConfigurationDisclosureTest.kt`:

```kt
package com.system.location.service.data.persistence

import com.system.location.service.core.runtime.HookConfiguration
import com.system.location.service.core.runtime.PreparedRuntimeConfiguration
import com.system.location.service.core.runtime.RuntimeSnapshot
import org.junit.Assert.assertEquals
import org.junit.Assert.assertFalse
import org.junit.Test

class HookConfigurationDisclosureTest {
    @Test fun hideMockDefaultsToTrueAndCanBeDisabledForABTesting() {
        val defaults = HookConfigurationPreferences.read(emptyMap<String, Any>(), RuntimeSnapshot())
        assertEquals(true, defaults["hide_mock"])
        assertEquals(
            true,
            PreparedRuntimeConfiguration.prepare(defaults).applyTo(RuntimeSnapshot()).configuration.hideMock,
        )

        val off = HookConfigurationPreferences.read(mapOf("hideMock" to false), RuntimeSnapshot())
        assertEquals(false, off["hide_mock"])
        assertEquals(
            false,
            PreparedRuntimeConfiguration.prepare(off).applyTo(RuntimeSnapshot()).configuration.hideMock,
        )
    }

    @Test fun experimentalAntiDetectionDefaultsOffAndIsWireControlled() {
        val defaults = HookConfigurationPreferences.read(emptyMap<String, Any>(), RuntimeSnapshot())
        assertEquals(false, defaults["experimental_anti_detect"])
        assertEquals(false, defaults["experimental_stack_trace"])
        assertEquals(false, defaults["experimental_stack_trace_replace"])
        val configuration =
            PreparedRuntimeConfiguration.prepare(defaults).applyTo(RuntimeSnapshot()).configuration
        assertEquals(false, configuration.antiDetectEnabled)
        assertEquals(false, configuration.stackTraceCleanEnabled)
        assertEquals(false, configuration.stackTraceReplaceEnabled)

        val enabled = HookConfigurationPreferences.read(
            mapOf("antiDetectEnabled" to true, "stackTraceCleanEnabled" to true),
            RuntimeSnapshot(),
        )
        val enabledConfiguration =
            PreparedRuntimeConfiguration.prepare(enabled).applyTo(RuntimeSnapshot()).configuration
        assertEquals(true, enabledConfiguration.antiDetectEnabled)
        assertEquals(true, enabledConfiguration.stackTraceCleanEnabled)
        // Replace is an independent switch: enabling it alone must not silently turn on cleaning.
        val replaceOnly = HookConfigurationPreferences.read(
            mapOf("stackTraceReplaceEnabled" to true),
            RuntimeSnapshot(),
        )
        val replaceOnlyConfiguration =
            PreparedRuntimeConfiguration.prepare(replaceOnly).applyTo(RuntimeSnapshot()).configuration
        assertEquals(false, replaceOnlyConfiguration.stackTraceCleanEnabled)
        assertEquals(true, replaceOnlyConfiguration.stackTraceReplaceEnabled)

        val replaced = HookConfigurationPreferences.read(
            mapOf("stackTraceCleanEnabled" to true, "stackTraceReplaceEnabled" to true),
            RuntimeSnapshot(),
        )
        val replacedConfiguration =
            PreparedRuntimeConfiguration.prepare(replaced).applyTo(RuntimeSnapshot()).configuration
        assertEquals(true, replacedConfiguration.stackTraceCleanEnabled)
        assertEquals(true, replacedConfiguration.stackTraceReplaceEnabled)
    }

    @Test fun networkLocationIsNotRelabelledByDefault() {
        assertFalse(HookConfiguration().disableNetworkLocation)
    }
}
```

`app/src/test/java/com/system/location/service/data/persistence/HookConfigurationPreferencesTest.kt`:

```kt
package com.system.location.service.data.persistence

import com.system.location.service.core.runtime.*
import com.system.location.service.core.gnss.*
import org.junit.Assert.*
import org.junit.Test

class HookConfigurationPreferencesTest {
    @Test fun localSkyReadsTheSameGnssBatchWithoutParsingUnrelatedPreferences() {
        val preferences = mapOf("gnssSimulationMode" to "AUTONOMOUS", "gnssVirtualSeed" to 12L,
            "minSatelliteCount" to 32)
        val fallback = RuntimeSnapshot()
        val gnss = HookConfigurationPreferences.readGnss(preferences + ("accuracy" to "invalid"), fallback)
        val full = HookConfigurationPreferences.read(preferences, fallback)
        assertEquals(full.filterKeys { it in gnss }, gnss)
        assertEquals(32, PreparedRuntimeConfiguration.prepare(gnss).applyTo(fallback).configuration.minimumSatellites)
        assertThrows(ClassCastException::class.java) {
            HookConfigurationPreferences.readGnss(mapOf("minSatelliteCount" to "32"), fallback)
        }
    }

    @Test fun emptyPreferencesUseStableDefaultsAndExplicitlyClearOptionalPayloads() {
        val wire = HookConfigurationPreferences.read(emptyMap<String, Any>(), RuntimeSnapshot())
        val result = PreparedRuntimeConfiguration.prepare(wire).applyTo(RuntimeSnapshot())
        assertEquals(59, result.configuration.minimumSatellites)
        assertEquals(GnssSimulationMode.AUTONOMOUS, result.configuration.gnssSimulation.mode)
        assertEquals(GnssMinimumPolicy.GUARANTEE_QUANTITY, result.configuration.gnssSimulation.minimumPolicy)
        assertEquals(GnssSimulationEnvironment.OPEN_SKY, result.configuration.gnssSimulation.environment)
        assertEquals(2.5f, result.accuracyMeters)
        assertEquals(500L, result.configuration.reportIntervalMs)
        for (key in listOf("wifi_fingerprint_json", "routing_json", "environment_json")) {
            assertTrue(wire.containsKey(key))
            assertNull(wire[key])
        }
    }

    @Test fun legacyPreferenceKeysAndInvertedFlagsKeepTheirMeaning() {
        val wire = HookConfigurationPreferences.read(mapOf("disableRegitserLocationListener" to true,
            "disableWifiScan" to false, "enableRequestGeofence" to false,
            "enableGetFromLocation" to true, "minSatelliteCount" to 24, "loopBroadcastLocation" to true,
            "reportDuration" to 100, "environmentApCount" to 1, "speed" to 7f), RuntimeSnapshot())
        val result = PreparedRuntimeConfiguration.prepare(wire).applyTo(RuntimeSnapshot())
        assertTrue(result.configuration.disableRegisterLocationListener)
        assertFalse(result.configuration.wifiEnabled)
        assertTrue(result.configuration.disableRequestGeofence)
        assertFalse(result.configuration.disableGetFromLocation)
        assertEquals(24, result.configuration.minimumSatellites)
        assertEquals(100L, result.configuration.reportIntervalMs)
        assertEquals(3, result.environmentApCount)
        assertEquals(7.0, result.speedMps, 0.0)
    }

    @Test fun batchDoesNotFollowLaterPreferenceOrFallbackChanges() {
        val preferences = mutableMapOf<String, Any>("minSatelliteCount" to 18)
        val fallback = RuntimeSnapshot(configuration = HookConfiguration(debugLog = true, disableFusedLocation = true))
        val wire = HookConfigurationPreferences.read(preferences.toMap(), fallback)
        preferences["minSatelliteCount"] = 30
        assertEquals(18, wire["min_satellites"])
        assertEquals(true, wire["enable_debug_log"])
        assertEquals(true, wire["disable_fused_location"])
        assertFalse(wire.containsKey("enable"))
    }

    @Test fun canonicalWifiPreferenceTakesPrecedenceOverLegacyAlias() {
        val wire = HookConfigurationPreferences.read(mapOf(
            "enableMockWifi" to true,
            "disableWifiScan" to false,
        ), RuntimeSnapshot())
        assertEquals(true, wire["enable_mock_wifi"])
    }

    @Test fun staleMinimumSatellitePreferenceIsClampedAtTheWireBoundary() {
        val wire = HookConfigurationPreferences.read(mapOf("minSatelliteCount" to 999), RuntimeSnapshot())
        assertEquals(128, wire["min_satellites"])
    }

    @Test fun staleAccuracyPreferenceIsClampedAtTheWireBoundary() {
        assertEquals(0.1f, HookConfigurationPreferences.read(mapOf("accuracy" to -5f), RuntimeSnapshot())["accuracy"])
        assertEquals(10_000f, HookConfigurationPreferences.read(mapOf("accuracy" to 50_000f), RuntimeSnapshot())["accuracy"])
    }

    @Test fun persistedGnssPolicyReachesTypedRuntimeWithoutLosingOtherPreferences() {
        val wire = HookConfigurationPreferences.read(mapOf("gnssSimulationMode" to "AUTONOMOUS",
            "gnssMinimumPolicy" to "GUARANTEE_QUANTITY", "gnssSimulationEnvironment" to "INDOOR",
            "gnssVirtualSeed" to Long.MIN_VALUE, "minSatelliteCount" to 32), RuntimeSnapshot())
        val result = PreparedRuntimeConfiguration.prepare(wire).applyTo(RuntimeSnapshot())
        assertEquals(GnssSimulationPolicy(GnssSimulationMode.AUTONOMOUS, GnssMinimumPolicy.GUARANTEE_QUANTITY,
            GnssSimulationEnvironment.INDOOR, Long.MIN_VALUE), result.configuration.gnssSimulation)
        assertEquals(32, result.configuration.minimumSatellites)
    }

    @Test fun missingGnssPreferencesPreserveFallbackPolicyAndNewInstallDefaultsToAutonomous() {
        val auto = HookConfigurationPreferences.read(emptyMap<String, Any>(), RuntimeSnapshot())
        assertEquals("AUTONOMOUS", auto["gnss_mode"])
        val policy = GnssSimulationPolicy(mode = GnssSimulationMode.REPLAY, virtualSeed = 42)
        val fallback = RuntimeSnapshot(configuration = HookConfiguration(gnssSimulation = policy))
        val wire = HookConfigurationPreferences.read(emptyMap<String, Any>(), fallback)
        assertEquals(policy, PreparedRuntimeConfiguration.prepare(wire).applyTo(fallback).configuration.gnssSimulation)
    }
}
```

`app/src/test/java/com/system/location/service/environment/BleScanWindowTest.kt`:

```kt
package com.system.location.service.environment

import com.system.location.service.core.environment.BleBeacon
import kotlinx.coroutines.CompletableDeferred
import kotlinx.coroutines.cancelAndJoin
import kotlinx.coroutines.launch
import kotlinx.coroutines.runBlocking
import org.junit.Assert.assertEquals
import org.junit.Assert.assertTrue
import org.junit.Test
import java.util.concurrent.CountDownLatch
import java.util.concurrent.Executors
import java.util.concurrent.TimeUnit

class BleScanWindowTest {
    private fun beacon(address: String) = BleBeacon(address, "test", -60)

    @Test fun timeoutReturnsCollectedBeaconsAndStopsScan() = runBlocking {
        var stopped = false
        val result = collectBleScanWindow(
            timeoutMillis = 10,
            maxResults = 256,
            startScan = { onResult, _ ->
                onResult(beacon("00:11:22:33:44:55"))
                onResult(beacon("00:11:22:33:44:66"))
            },
            stopScan = { stopped = true },
        )

        assertEquals(2, result.size)
        assertTrue(stopped)
    }

    @Test fun resultLimitCompletesEarlyAndDeduplicatesByAddress() = runBlocking {
        var stopped = false
        val result = collectBleScanWindow(
            timeoutMillis = 5_000,
            maxResults = 2,
            startScan = { onResult, _ ->
                onResult(beacon("00:11:22:33:44:55"))
                onResult(beacon("00:11:22:33:44:55"))
                onResult(beacon("00:11:22:33:44:66"))
            },
            stopScan = { stopped = true },
        )

        assertEquals(listOf("00:11:22:33:44:55", "00:11:22:33:44:66"), result.map { it.address })
        assertTrue(stopped)
    }

    @Test fun cancellationStopsAnActiveScan() = runBlocking {
        val started = CompletableDeferred<Unit>()
        var stopped = false
        val job = launch {
            collectBleScanWindow(
                timeoutMillis = 5_000,
                maxResults = 256,
                startScan = { _, _ -> started.complete(Unit) },
                stopScan = { stopped = true },
            )
        }
        started.await()
        job.cancelAndJoin()

        assertTrue(stopped)
    }

    @Test fun scanFailureKeepsPartialResultsAndStopsScan() = runBlocking {
        var stopped = false
        val result = collectBleScanWindow(
            timeoutMillis = 5_000,
            maxResults = 256,
            startScan = { onResult, onFailure ->
                onResult(beacon("00:11:22:33:44:55"))
                onFailure()
            },
            stopScan = { stopped = true },
        )

        assertEquals(listOf("00:11:22:33:44:55"), result.map { it.address })
        assertTrue(stopped)
    }

    @Test fun synchronousStartFailureKeepsPartialResultsAndStopsScan() = runBlocking {
        var stopped = false
        val result = collectBleScanWindow(
            timeoutMillis = 5_000,
            maxResults = 256,
            startScan = { onResult, _ ->
                onResult(beacon("00:11:22:33:44:55"))
                throw SecurityException("scan permission revoked")
            },
            stopScan = { stopped = true },
        )

        assertEquals(listOf("00:11:22:33:44:55"), result.map { it.address })
        assertTrue(stopped)
    }

    @Test fun concurrentCallbacksNeverExceedResultLimit() = runBlocking {
        val callbacks = 24
        val maximum = 8
        val ready = CountDownLatch(callbacks)
        val start = CountDownLatch(1)
        val executor = Executors.newFixedThreadPool(callbacks)
        val stopped = java.util.concurrent.atomic.AtomicBoolean(false)
        try {
            val result = collectBleScanWindow(
                timeoutMillis = 5_000,
                maxResults = maximum,
                startScan = { onResult, _ ->
                    val tasks = (0 until callbacks).map { index ->
                        executor.submit {
                            ready.countDown()
                            check(start.await(5, TimeUnit.SECONDS))
                            onResult(beacon("00:11:22:33:44:${"%02X".format(index)}"))
                        }
                    }
                    check(ready.await(5, TimeUnit.SECONDS))
                    start.countDown()
                    tasks.forEach { it.get(5, TimeUnit.SECONDS) }
                },
                stopScan = { stopped.set(true) },
            )

            assertEquals(maximum, result.size)
            assertTrue(stopped.get())
        } finally {
            start.countDown()
            executor.shutdownNow()
        }
    }
}
```

```kt
package com.system.location.service.environment

import org.junit.Assert.assertEquals
import org.junit.Assert.assertFalse
import org.junit.Assert.assertNull
import org.junit.Assert.assertTrue

class EnvironmentCaptureFreshnessTest {
    private val fix = 90_000_000_000L

    @Test fun acceptsRadioSamplesInsideTheFixWindow() {
        assertTrue(EnvironmentCaptureFreshness.matchesFix(fix, fix))
        assertTrue(EnvironmentCaptureFreshness.matchesFix(fix - 15_000_000_000L, fix))
        assertTrue(EnvironmentCaptureFreshness.matchesFix(fix + 15_000_000_000L, fix))
    }

    @Test fun rejectsOldFutureAndMissingSampleTimes() {
        assertFalse(EnvironmentCaptureFreshness.matchesFix(fix - 15_000_000_001L, fix))
        assertFalse(EnvironmentCaptureFreshness.matchesFix(fix + 15_000_000_001L, fix))
        assertFalse(EnvironmentCaptureFreshness.matchesFix(0L, fix))
        assertFalse(EnvironmentCaptureFreshness.matchesFix(fix, 0L))
    }

    @Test fun convertsPlatformUnitsWithoutOverflow() {
        assertEquals(fix, EnvironmentCaptureFreshness.wifiTimestampNanos(fix / 1_000L))
        assertEquals(fix, EnvironmentCaptureFreshness.cellTimestampNanos(fix / 1_000_000L))
        assertNull(EnvironmentCaptureFreshness.wifiTimestampNanos(Long.MAX_VALUE))
        assertNull(EnvironmentCaptureFreshness.cellTimestampNanos(Long.MAX_VALUE))
    }
}
```

`app/src/test/java/com/system/location/service/environment/EnvironmentStoreTest.kt`:

```kt
package com.system.location.service.environment

import com.system.location.service.core.environment.EnvironmentProfile
import com.system.location.service.core.environment.EnvironmentCodecException
import com.system.location.service.core.environment.EnvironmentProfileCodec
import com.system.location.service.core.environment.EnvironmentSourceType
import com.system.location.service.core.environment.WifiAp
import com.system.location.service.core.geo.Wgs84
import org.junit.Assert.assertEquals
import org.junit.Assert.assertThrows
import org.junit.Assert.assertTrue
import org.junit.Test
import java.nio.file.Files
import java.util.concurrent.CountDownLatch
import java.util.concurrent.Executors
import java.util.concurrent.TimeUnit

class EnvironmentStoreTest {
    private val directory = Files.createTempDirectory("environment-store").toFile()
    private val store = EnvironmentStore(directory)
    private val profile = EnvironmentProfile(
        source = EnvironmentSourceType.REPLAY,
        origin = Wgs84(31.2304, 121.4737),
        generatedAtMillis = 1,
        seed = 1,
        wifi = listOf(WifiAp("ChinaNet", "A4:50:46:12:34:56", -55, 2412, 1, connected = true)),
    )

    @Test fun saveLoadListDelete() {
        val file = store.save("home", profile)
        assertTrue(file.exists())
        assertEquals(profile, store.load("home"))
        assertEquals(listOf("home"), store.list())
        assertTrue(store.delete("home"))
        assertTrue(store.list().isEmpty())
    }

    @Test fun oversizedSaveKeepsExistingProfileAndLeavesNoTemporaryFile() {
        store.save("home", profile)
        val oversized = profile.copy(wifi = listOf(profile.wifi.single().copy(
            capabilities = "x".repeat(EnvironmentProfileCodec.MAX_PROFILE_BYTES),
        )))
        assertThrows(IllegalArgumentException::class.java) { store.save("home", oversized) }
        assertEquals(profile, store.load("home"))
        assertEquals(listOf("home.json"), directory.listFiles()!!.map { it.name })
    }

    @Test fun missingDirectoryIsEmptyButAFileAtItsPathIsAnError() {
        val path = java.io.File(directory, "blocked")
        val other = EnvironmentStore(path)
        assertEquals(emptyList<String>(), other.list())
        path.writeText("preserve this file")
        assertThrows(IllegalArgumentException::class.java) { other.list() }
        assertEquals("preserve this file", path.readText())
    }

    @Test fun unsafeNameIsSanitized() {
        val file = store.save("../evil name", profile)
        assertEquals(".._evil_name.json", file.name)
        assertEquals(profile, store.load("../evil name"))
    }

    @Test fun replaceIsAtomicFromCallerView() {
        store.save("home", profile)
        val changed = profile.copy(seed = 2)
        store.save("home", changed)
        assertEquals(changed, store.load("home"))
    }

    @Test fun saveNewKeepsExistingProfilesAndAddsStableSuffixes() {
        store.save("import-20261115-120000", profile)

        val second = store.saveNew("import-20261115-120000", profile.copy(seed = 2))
        val third = store.saveNew("import-20261115-120000", profile.copy(seed = 3))

        assertEquals("import-20261115-120000-2", second)
        assertEquals("import-20261115-120000-3", third)
        assertEquals(profile, store.load("import-20261115-120000"))
        assertEquals(2L, store.load(second).seed)
        assertEquals(3L, store.load(third).seed)
    }

    @Test fun saveNewWithMaximumLengthNameKeepsSuffixAndNeverOverwrites() {
        val name = "a".repeat(64)
        store.save(name, profile)

        val importedName = store.saveNew(name, profile.copy(seed = 2))

        assertTrue(importedName.length <= 64)
        assertTrue(importedName != name)
        assertEquals(profile, store.load(name))
        assertEquals(2L, store.load(importedName).seed)
    }

    @Test fun concurrentImportsReceiveDifferentNames() {
        val executor = Executors.newFixedThreadPool(6)
        try {
            val names = (1..6).map { seed ->
                executor.submit<String> {
                    EnvironmentStore(directory).saveNew("same-import-time", profile.copy(seed = seed.toLong()))
                }
            }.map { it.get(5, TimeUnit.SECONDS) }

            assertEquals(6, names.toSet().size)
            assertEquals(6, store.list().size)
            assertTrue(names.all { store.load(it).seed in 1L..6L })
        } finally {
            executor.shutdownNow()
        }
    }

    @Test fun concurrentImportAndRenameNeverReplaceTheRenamedProfile() {
        repeat(20) { iteration ->
            val baseName = "capture-$iteration"
            val sourceName = "pending-$iteration"
            store.save(baseName, profile)
            store.save(sourceName, profile.copy(seed = 3))

            val ready = CountDownLatch(2)
            val start = CountDownLatch(1)
            val executor = Executors.newFixedThreadPool(2)
            try {
                val imported = executor.submit<String> {
                    ready.countDown()
                    check(start.await(5, TimeUnit.SECONDS))
                    EnvironmentStore(directory).saveNew(baseName, profile.copy(seed = 2))
                }
                val renamed = executor.submit<Boolean> {
                    ready.countDown()
                    check(start.await(5, TimeUnit.SECONDS))
                    runCatching { EnvironmentStore(directory).rename(sourceName, "$baseName-2") }.isSuccess
                }

                assertTrue(ready.await(5, TimeUnit.SECONDS))
                start.countDown()
                val importedName = imported.get(5, TimeUnit.SECONDS)
                val renameSucceeded = renamed.get(5, TimeUnit.SECONDS)

                assertEquals(2L, store.load(importedName).seed)
                if (renameSucceeded) assertEquals(3L, store.load("$baseName-2").seed)
            } finally {
                start.countDown()
                executor.shutdownNow()
            }
            store.delete(baseName)
            store.delete("$baseName-2")
            store.delete("$baseName-3")
        }
    }

    @Test fun failedReplacementPreservesExistingPathAndCleansTemporaryFile() {
        val blockedDirectory = java.io.File(directory, "blocked.json")
        assertTrue(blockedDirectory.mkdir())
        val marker = java.io.File(blockedDirectory, "keep.txt")
        marker.writeText("preserve")

        assertThrows(java.io.IOException::class.java) { store.save("blocked", profile) }

        assertTrue(blockedDirectory.isDirectory)
        assertEquals("preserve", marker.readText())
        assertTrue(directory.listFiles()?.none { it.name.endsWith(".tmp") } == true)
    }

    @Test fun loadRejectsOversizedAndInvalidUtf8Profiles() {
        val oversized = java.io.File(directory, "oversized.json")
        oversized.writeBytes(ByteArray(EnvironmentProfileCodec.MAX_PROFILE_BYTES + 1) { ' '.code.toByte() })
        assertThrows(EnvironmentCodecException::class.java) { store.load("oversized") }

        val invalidUtf8 = java.io.File(directory, "invalid-utf8.json")
        invalidUtf8.writeBytes(byteArrayOf('{'.code.toByte(), 0xC3.toByte(), 0x28))
        assertThrows(EnvironmentCodecException::class.java) { store.load("invalid-utf8") }
    }

    @Test fun concurrentWritersUseIndependentTemporaryFilesAndLeaveAReadableProfile() {
        val workers = 8
        val ready = CountDownLatch(workers)
        val start = CountDownLatch(1)
        val executor = Executors.newFixedThreadPool(workers)
        try {
            val writes = (1..workers).map { seed ->
                executor.submit {
                    ready.countDown()
                    check(start.await(5, TimeUnit.SECONDS))
                    EnvironmentStore(directory).save("parallel", profile.copy(seed = seed.toLong()))
                }
            }
            assertTrue(ready.await(5, TimeUnit.SECONDS))
            start.countDown()
            writes.forEach { it.get(5, TimeUnit.SECONDS) }

            assertTrue(store.load("parallel").seed in 1L..workers.toLong())
            assertTrue(directory.listFiles()?.none { it.name.endsWith(".tmp") } == true)
        } finally {
            start.countDown()
            executor.shutdownNow()
        }
    }

    @Test fun renameMovesProfile() {
        store.save("home", profile)
        val renamed = store.rename("home", "office")
        assertEquals("office.json", renamed.name)
        assertEquals(listOf("office"), store.list())
        assertEquals(profile, store.load("office"))
        assertThrows(java.io.FileNotFoundException::class.java) { store.load("home") }
    }

    @Test fun renameRejectsMissingOrExistingTarget() {
        assertThrows(IllegalArgumentException::class.java) { store.rename("missing", "office") }
        store.save("home", profile)
        store.save("office", profile)
        assertThrows(IllegalArgumentException::class.java) { store.rename("home", "office") }
        assertEquals(listOf("home", "office"), store.list())
    }
}
```
