`app/src/test/java/com/system/location/service/gnss/GnssCaptureSessionGuardTest.kt`:

```kt
package com.system.location.service.gnss

import org.junit.Assert.*
import org.junit.Test

class GnssCaptureSessionGuardTest {
    private val stopped = GnssCaptureSystemState("system-instance", 12, false)
    private fun guard(remote: GnssCaptureSystemState? = stopped, required: Boolean = true) =
        GnssCaptureSessionGuard(7, false, required, remote)
    private fun rejects(block: () -> Unit) {
        assertThrows(IllegalStateException::class.java) { block() }
    }

    @Test fun knownStoppedStateIsRequiredForHookBackendsAndActiveStatesAreRejected() {
        rejects { guard(null) }
        rejects { guard(stopped.copy(active = true)) }
        rejects { GnssCaptureSessionGuard(7, true, true, stopped) }
        val session = guard()
        session.checkLocal(7, false)
        session.checkSystem(stopped)
    }

    @Test fun aCompleteLocalStartStopBetweenPollsCannotBeAcceptedAsAnUnchangedWindow() {
        rejects { guard().checkLocal(8, false) }
        rejects { guard().checkLocal(7, true) }
    }

    @Test fun remoteStartStopRestartAndLostAuthorityAllDiscardTheWindow() {
        val session = guard()
        rejects { session.checkSystem(stopped.copy(generation = 14)) }
        rejects { session.checkSystem(stopped.copy(active = true)) }
        rejects { session.checkSystem(stopped.copy(instance = "reloaded-system-instance")) }
        rejects { session.checkSystem(null) }
    }

    @Test fun standardProviderCanRunWithoutAHookButAuthorityCannotChangeMidCapture() {
        val session = guard(null, required = false)
        session.checkSystem(null)
        session.checkLocal(7, false)
        rejects { session.checkSystem(stopped) }
        // Selecting the standard backend does not excuse an observable active Hook.
        rejects { guard(stopped.copy(active = true), required = false) }
    }
}
```

```kt
package com.system.location.service.gnss

import com.system.location.service.core.gnss.RinexNavigationResource
import java.time.Instant
import org.junit.Assert.*
import org.junit.Test

class GnssNavigationDownloadTest {
    @Test fun utcDayAndYearRolloverDoNotFollowTheHandsetsLocalZone() {
        val at = Instant.parse("2027-01-01T00:00:00Z").toEpochMilli()
        val urls = GnssNavigationUrls.candidates(at)
        assertTrue(urls[0].endsWith("2027/001/BRDC00WRD_R_20270010000_01D_MN.rnx.gz"))
        assertTrue(urls[1].endsWith("2026/365/BRDC00WRD_R_20263650000_01D_MN.rnx.gz"))
        assertTrue(GnssNavigationUrls.candidates(Instant.parse("2024-12-31T23:59:59Z").toEpochMilli())[0]
            .contains("2024/366/"))
    }

    @Test fun unpublishedDayFallsBackButCorruptPublishedArchiveCannotMasqueradeAsMissing() {
        val calls = mutableListOf<String>()
        val now = Instant.parse("2026-11-11T00:00:00Z").toEpochMilli()
        val result = GnssNavigationDownload { url ->
            calls += url
            if (calls.size == 1) null else archive()
        }.fetch(now)
        assertEquals(2, calls.size)
        assertEquals(calls[1], result.sourceUrl)
        assertEquals(now, result.downloadedAtMillis)
        assertEquals(result, RinexNavigationResource.decodeWire(RinexNavigationResource.encodeWire(result)))
        calls.clear()
        assertThrows(IllegalArgumentException::class.java) {
            GnssNavigationDownload { url -> calls += url; "corrupt" }.fetch(now)
        }
        assertEquals(1, calls.size)
        assertThrows(IllegalStateException::class.java) { GnssNavigationDownload { null }.fetch(now) }
    }

    private fun archive() = "     3.05           NAVIGATION DATA     M".padEnd(60) + "RINEX VERSION / TYPE\n" +
        "".padEnd(60) + "END OF HEADER\n" + """
R01 2026 11 11 00 15 00 1.000000000000D-04 2.000000000000D-12 4.320000000000D+05
     1.910000000000D+04 1.100000000000D+00 1.000000000000D-09 0.000000000000D+00
     1.340000000000D+04-2.200000000000D+00-2.000000000000D-09-7.000000000000D+00
     1.090000000000D+04 3.000000000000D-01 3.000000000000D-09 1.000000000000D+00
     1.920000000000D+02 0.000000000000D+00 1.500000000000D+01 5.000000000000D+00
""".trimIndent()
}
```

`app/src/test/java/com/system/location/service/gnss/GnssNavigationRepositoryTest.kt`:

```kt
package com.system.location.service.gnss

import com.system.location.service.core.gnss.RinexNavigationResourceStore
import com.system.location.service.core.gnss.BeiDouCatalogResource
import kotlinx.coroutines.runBlocking
import org.junit.Assert.*
import org.junit.Rule
import org.junit.Test
import org.junit.rules.TemporaryFolder

class GnssNavigationRepositoryTest {
    @get:Rule val temporary = TemporaryFolder()

    @Test fun metadataUpdatesIndependentlyAndAnOutageCannotEraseAcceptedCatalog() = runBlocking {
        val file = temporary.root.resolve("metadata-navigation.json")
        val now = 1794369600000L
        val text = requireNotNull(javaClass.getResource("/gnss/igs-beidou-metadata.snx")).readText()
        var metadata = BeiDouCatalogResource.import(text, now)
        var metadataFails = false
        var navigationFails = false
        val status = GnssNavigationSyncStatus()
        val repository = GnssNavigationRepository(file,
            GnssNavigationDownload { if (navigationFails) error("archive down") else archive() }, status,
            GnssBeiDouCatalogDownload { if (metadataFails) error("metadata down") else metadata })
        assertTrue(repository.refresh(now))
        assertEquals(metadata, RinexNavigationResourceStore(file).load()!!.beiDouCatalog)
        assertFalse(repository.refresh(now + 1000))
        metadata = BeiDouCatalogResource.import(text.replace("26:295:28054", "26:296:28054"), now)
        assertTrue(repository.refresh(now + 2000)) // Same RINEX bytes; metadata alone changes sky.
        metadataFails = true
        assertFalse(repository.refresh(now + 3000))
        assertNotNull(status.state.value.problem)
        assertEquals(metadata, RinexNavigationResourceStore(file).load()!!.beiDouCatalog)
        metadataFails = false
        navigationFails = true
        metadata = BeiDouCatalogResource.import(text.replace("26:295:28054", "26:297:28054"), now)
        assertTrue(repository.refresh(now + 4000)) // Metadata server is independent of BKG.
        assertEquals(metadata, RinexNavigationResourceStore(file).load()!!.beiDouCatalog)
        assertTrue(status.state.value.problem!!.contains("广播导航下载失败"))
        val bytes = file.readBytes()
        metadataFails = true
        try { repository.refresh(now + 5000); fail("both downloads failed") } catch (_: IllegalStateException) { }
        assertArrayEquals(bytes, file.readBytes())
    }

    @Test fun failedDownloadsAndValidationDoNotReplaceCacheAndIdenticalUploadsDoNotRestartSky() = runBlocking {
        val file = temporary.root.resolve("navigation.json")
        var fail = false
        val status = GnssNavigationSyncStatus()
        val repository = GnssNavigationRepository(file, GnssNavigationDownload {
            if (fail) error("network down") else archive()
        }, status, catalogDownload = null)
        assertTrue(repository.refresh(1794369600000))
        assertEquals(1794369600000L, status.state.value.acceptedAtMillis)
        val old = file.readBytes()
        fail = true
        try { repository.refresh(1794369601000); fail("refresh should fail") } catch (_: IllegalStateException) { }
        assertArrayEquals(old, file.readBytes())
        assertFalse(status.state.value.refreshing)
        assertNotNull(status.state.value.problem)
        assertEquals(1794369600000L, status.state.value.acceptedAtMillis)
        fail = false
        assertFalse(repository.refresh(1794369602000))
        assertNull(status.state.value.problem)
        assertEquals(1794369602000L, status.state.value.acceptedAtMillis)
        val resource = RinexNavigationResourceStore(file).load()!!
        assertEquals(1794369602000, resource.downloadedAtMillis)
        val broken = GnssNavigationRepository(file, GnssNavigationDownload { "corrupt" }, catalogDownload = null)
        try { broken.refresh(1794369603000); fail("invalid archive should fail") } catch (_: IllegalArgumentException) { }
        assertEquals(resource, RinexNavigationResourceStore(file).load())
    }

    private fun archive() = "     3.04           NAVIGATION DATA     M".padEnd(60) + "RINEX VERSION / TYPE\n" +
        "".padEnd(60) + "END OF HEADER\n" + """
R01 2026 11 11 00 15 00 1.000000000000D-04 2.000000000000D-12 4.320000000000D+05
     1.910000000000D+04 1.100000000000D+00 1.000000000000D-09 0.000000000000D+00
     1.340000000000D+04-2.200000000000D+00-2.000000000000D-09-7.000000000000D+00
     1.090000000000D+04 3.000000000000D-01 3.000000000000D-09 1.000000000000D+00
""".trimIndent()
}
```

`app/src/test/java/com/system/location/service/gnss/GnssSkyPreviewTest.kt`:

```kt
package com.system.location.service.gnss

import com.system.location.service.core.geo.Wgs84
import com.system.location.service.core.gnss.*
import com.system.location.service.core.location.LocationSample
import org.junit.Assert.*
import org.junit.Test

class GnssSkyPreviewTest {
    @Test fun metadataOnlyRefreshRebuildsPreviewToMatchProductionSource() {
        fun fields(values: List<Double?>) = values.joinToString("") { value ->
            value?.let { "%19.12E".format(java.util.Locale.ROOT, it) } ?: " ".repeat(19)
        }
        val at = java.time.Instant.parse("2026-11-07T23:59:55.750Z").toEpochMilli()
        val header = "BDUT %17.10E%16.9E %6d%5d".format(java.util.Locale.ROOT, .25, 0.0, 0, 1088).padEnd(60)
        val orbit = listOf(listOf(7.0, 0.0, 0.0, 0.0), listOf(0.0, 0.0, 0.0, kotlin.math.sqrt(27800000.0)),
            listOf(0.0, 0.0, 0.0, 0.0), listOf(0.95, 0.0, 0.0, 0.0),
            listOf(0.0, null, 1088.0, null), listOf(2.4, 0.0, 0.0, 0.0), listOf(-30.0, 7.0, null, null))
        val text = "     3.05           NAVIGATION DATA     M".padEnd(60) + "RINEX VERSION / TYPE\n" +
            header + "TIME SYSTEM CORR\n" + "".padEnd(60) + "END OF HEADER\n" +
            "C19 2026 11 08 00 00 00" + fields(listOf(0.0, 0.0, 0.0)) + "\n" +
            orbit.joinToString("\n", postfix = "\n") { "    " + fields(it) }
        val navigation = RinexNavigationResource.import(text, "https://example.org/nav", at)
        val preview = GnssSkyPreview()
        val policy = GnssSimulationPolicy()
        val location = sample.copy(coordinate = Wgs84(0.0, 0.0), timeMillis = at)
        val before = preview.frame(location, 0, policy, navigation)!!
        val subset = requireNotNull(javaClass.getResource("/gnss/igs-beidou-metadata.snx")).readText()
        // Same creation epoch as the bundle; accepted upstream provenance still takes priority.
        val catalog = BeiDouCatalogResource.import(subset, at)
        val updated = navigation.copy(beiDouCatalog = catalog)
        val after = preview.frame(location, 0, policy, updated)!!
        assertNotEquals(before.diagnostics, after.diagnostics)
        assertTrue(after.diagnostics.any { catalog.manifest.originalSha256 in it })
        assertEquals(GnssSourceSelection.source(policy, null, updated)!!.frame(location, 0,
            GnssFrameRoute.Global, at)!!.frame, after)
    }

    @Test fun previewMatchesAutoSignalCalibrationAndUsesRealValidationTimeForExpiry() {
        val at = sample.timeMillis
        val capture = CapturedGnssSource.prepare(GnssCaptureWire.encode(GnssCapture(
            deviceModel = "test", osVersion = "test", startedAtMillis = at, endedAtMillis = at,
            frames = listOf(GnssObservationFrame(at, Wgs84(0.0, 0.0), satellites = listOf(
                GnssSatellite(Constellation.GALILEO, 1, 0f, 0f, 25f, false, false, true, 1_575_420_000f),
                GnssSatellite(Constellation.GALILEO, 2, 90f, 0f, 25f, false, false, true, 1_575_420_000f)))))))!!
        val policy = GnssSimulationPolicy(mode = GnssSimulationMode.AUTO, virtualSeed = 1234568)
        val preview = GnssSkyPreview()
        val predicted = preview.frame(sample, 0, policy, null, capture, at)!!
        val production = GnssSourceSelection.source(policy, capture)!!.frame(sample, 0,
            GnssFrameRoute.Global, at)!!.frame
        assertEquals(production, predicted)
        val expired = preview.frame(sample, 0, policy, null, capture,
            at + GnssCaptureValidator.MAX_AGE_MILLIS + 1)!!
        val uncalibrated = GnssSkyPreview().frame(sample, 0, policy, null)!!
        assertEquals(uncalibrated.satellites, expired.satellites)
        assertNotEquals(predicted.satellites.map { it.cn0DbHz }, expired.satellites.map { it.cn0DbHz })
    }

    private val sample = LocationSample(Wgs84(31.0, 121.0), 20.0, 5f, 0f, 0f, 1830297600000, 1_000_000_000)

    @Test fun previewOfOfflineSkyReflectsTargetEnvironmentAndQuantityWithoutCapture() {
        val preview = GnssSkyPreview()
        val policy = GnssSimulationPolicy(minimumPolicy = GnssMinimumPolicy.GUARANTEE_QUANTITY)
        val frame = preview.frame(sample, 32, policy, null)!!
        assertEquals(sample.coordinate, frame.observer)
        assertEquals(32, frame.satellites.size)
        val indoor = preview.frame(sample, 32, policy.copy(environment = GnssSimulationEnvironment.INDOOR), null)!!
        assertEquals(32, indoor.satellites.size)
        assertEquals(0, indoor.trackedSatelliteCount)
        assertNull(indoor.geometry.dop)
        val remote = preview.frame(sample.copy(coordinate = Wgs84(-31.0, -59.0)), 32, policy, null)!!
        assertNotEquals(frame.satellites, remote.satellites)
        assertNull(preview.frame(sample, 32, policy.copy(mode = GnssSimulationMode.OFF), null))
        assertNull(preview.frame(sample, 32, policy.copy(mode = GnssSimulationMode.REPLAY), null))
    }

    @Test fun previewCannotAnchorProductionPublicationToTheUiSample() {
        val policy = GnssSimulationPolicy(virtualSeed = 1234567)
        val source = GnssSourceSelection.source(policy, null)!!
        val previewPoint = sample.copy(coordinate = Wgs84(0.0, 0.0))
        val prediction = GnssSkyPreview().frame(previewPoint, 0, policy, null)!!
        val publication = source.frame(sample, 0, GnssFrameRoute.Scenario("preview-isolation"), sample.timeMillis)!!
        assertEquals(sample.coordinate, publication.frame.observer)
        assertNotEquals(prediction.observer, publication.frame.observer)
        assertEquals(GnssSkyPreview().frame(sample, 0, policy, null), publication.frame)
    }
}
```

```kt
package com.system.location.service.gnss

import org.junit.Assert.*
import org.junit.Test

class SatelliteStartupDefaultsTest {
    @Test fun rootedAndActiveSystemModuleDefaultsToTargetSky() {
        assertEquals(mapOf("gnssReplayOnStart" to true, "gnssSimulationMode" to "AUTONOMOUS"),
            SatelliteStartupDefaults.additions(emptyMap<String, Any>(), true, true))
    }

    @Test fun missingRootOrAnInactiveModuleDoesNotChangeChoices() {
        for ((root, module) in listOf(false to false, false to true, true to false)) {
            assertTrue(SatelliteStartupDefaults.additions(emptyMap<String, Any>(), root, module).isEmpty())
        }
    }

    @Test fun explicitReplayAndAutomaticPoliciesKeepTheirSources() {
        for (mode in listOf("REPLAY", "AUTO", "AUTONOMOUS")) {
            assertEquals(mapOf("gnssReplayOnStart" to true),
                SatelliteStartupDefaults.additions(mapOf("gnssSimulationMode" to mode), true, true))
        }
    }

    @Test fun explicitDisableAndExistingStartupChoicesArePreserved() {
        for (preferences in listOf(mapOf("gnssSimulationMode" to "OFF"),
            mapOf("gnssReplayOnStart" to false, "gnssSimulationMode" to "AUTONOMOUS"),
            mapOf("gnssReplayOnStart" to true, "gnssSimulationMode" to "REPLAY"))) {
            assertTrue(SatelliteStartupDefaults.additions(preferences, true, true).isEmpty())
        }
    }

    @Test fun applyingDefaultsAgainDoesNotOverwriteALaterChoice() {
        val initial = SatelliteStartupDefaults.additions(emptyMap<String, Any>(), true, true)
        assertTrue(SatelliteStartupDefaults.additions(initial, true, true).isEmpty())
        assertTrue(SatelliteStartupDefaults.additions(initial + ("gnssSimulationMode" to "REPLAY"), true, true).isEmpty())
    }
}
```

`app/src/test/java/com/system/location/service/maps/AMapKeyPolicyTest.kt`:

```kt
package com.system.location.service.maps

import org.junit.Assert.assertEquals
import org.junit.Assert.assertArrayEquals
import org.junit.Assert.assertNull
import org.junit.Assert.assertThrows
import org.junit.Test
import java.io.ByteArrayInputStream

class AMapKeyPolicyTest {
    @Test fun boundedReadAcceptsLimitAndRejectsOversizedInput() {
        val bytes = ByteArray(1024) { it.toByte() }
        assertArrayEquals(bytes, AMapKeyPolicy.readBounded(ByteArrayInputStream(bytes), bytes.size))
        assertThrows(IllegalArgumentException::class.java) {
            AMapKeyPolicy.readBounded(ByteArrayInputStream(bytes), bytes.size - 1)
        }
    }

    @Test fun invalidStoredKeyFallsBackToBundledKeyWithoutLosingValidCustomKey() {
        assertEquals("bundled", AMapKeyPolicy.effectiveKey(true, { error("keystore unavailable") }, { "bundled" }))
        assertEquals("bundled", AMapKeyPolicy.effectiveKey(true, { null }, { "bundled" }))
        assertEquals("custom", AMapKeyPolicy.effectiveKey(true, { "custom" }, { "bundled" }))
        assertEquals("bundled", AMapKeyPolicy.effectiveKey(false, { "ignored" }, { "bundled" }))
        assertEquals("", AMapKeyPolicy.effectiveKey(false, { "ignored" }, { "" }))
    }

    @Test fun emptyValueSelectsBundledKeyAndNonEmptyValueIsTrimmed() {
        assertNull(AMapKeyPolicy.normalize("  "))
        assertEquals("Abcdef12-xy_Z", AMapKeyPolicy.normalize(" Abcdef12-xy_Z "))
    }

    @Test fun invalidKeyCharactersAndLengthsAreRejected() {
        assertThrows(IllegalArgumentException::class.java) { AMapKeyPolicy.normalize("short") }
        assertThrows(IllegalArgumentException::class.java) { AMapKeyPolicy.normalize("valid.key-1") }
        assertThrows(IllegalArgumentException::class.java) { AMapKeyPolicy.normalize("x".repeat(257)) }
    }

    @Test fun signerSha1MatchesStandardFingerprintFormatting() {
        assertEquals("A9:99:3E:36:47:06:81:6A:BA:3E:25:71:78:50:C2:6C:9C:D0:D8:9D",
            AMapKeyPolicy.signerSha1(listOf("abc".toByteArray())))
    }

    @Test fun signerSha1IsStableForMultipleSignersAndRejectsMissingCertificates() {
        val first = "86:F7:E4:37:FA:A5:A7:FC:E1:5D:1D:DC:B9:EA:EA:EA:37:76:67:B8"
        val second = "A9:99:3E:36:47:06:81:6A:BA:3E:25:71:78:50:C2:6C:9C:D0:D8:9D"
        assertEquals("$first\n$second", AMapKeyPolicy.signerSha1(listOf("abc".toByteArray(), "a".toByteArray())))
        assertEquals("$first\n$second", AMapKeyPolicy.signerSha1(listOf("a".toByteArray(), "abc".toByteArray())))
        assertThrows(IllegalArgumentException::class.java) { AMapKeyPolicy.signerSha1(emptyList()) }
    }
}
```

`app/src/test/java/com/system/location/service/maps/MapViewLifecycleTest.kt`:

```kt
package com.system.location.service.maps

import com.system.location.service.maps.MapViewLifecycle.Event.*
import org.junit.Assert.assertEquals
import org.junit.Test

class MapViewLifecycleTest {
    @Test fun stoppedFragmentKeepsRenderingItsVisibleExitTransitionUntilTheViewDisappears() {
        val events = mutableListOf<MapViewLifecycle.Event>()
        val lifecycle = MapViewLifecycle { events += it }
        lifecycle.resume()
        lifecycle.stop(visible = true)
        lifecycle.visibilityChanged(true)
        assertEquals(listOf(START, RESUME), events)
        lifecycle.visibilityChanged(false)
        assertEquals(listOf(START, RESUME, PAUSE, STOP), events)
    }

    @Test fun returningBeforeTheExitFinishesCancelsThePendingStop() {
        val events = mutableListOf<MapViewLifecycle.Event>()
        val lifecycle = MapViewLifecycle { events += it }
        lifecycle.resume()
        lifecycle.stop(visible = true)
        lifecycle.resume()
        lifecycle.visibilityChanged(false)
        assertEquals(listOf(START, RESUME), events)
        lifecycle.close()
        assertEquals(listOf(START, RESUME, PAUSE, STOP), events)
    }

    @Test fun compositionAndLifecycleCatchupDoNotResumeTheSdkTwice() {
        val events = mutableListOf<MapViewLifecycle.Event>()
        val lifecycle = MapViewLifecycle { events += it }
        lifecycle.start()
        lifecycle.resume()
        lifecycle.start()
        lifecycle.resume()
        assertEquals(listOf(START, RESUME), events)
    }

    @Test fun returningAfterTheViewStopsCreatesOneNewRenderingSession() {
        val events = mutableListOf<MapViewLifecycle.Event>()
        val lifecycle = MapViewLifecycle { events += it }
        lifecycle.resume()
        lifecycle.stop()
        lifecycle.stop()
        lifecycle.resume()
        lifecycle.pause()
        lifecycle.stop()
        assertEquals(listOf(START, RESUME, PAUSE, STOP, START, RESUME, PAUSE, STOP), events)
    }

    @Test fun releasingAVisibleMapStopsRenderingAndPreventsLateCallbacksFromRestartingIt() {
        val events = mutableListOf<MapViewLifecycle.Event>()
        val lifecycle = MapViewLifecycle { events += it }
        lifecycle.resume()
        lifecycle.close()
        lifecycle.close()
        lifecycle.start()
        lifecycle.resume()
        assertEquals(listOf(START, RESUME, PAUSE, STOP), events)
    }
}
```

`app/src/test/java/com/system/location/service/maps/RealPositionLifecycleTest.kt`:

```kt
package com.system.location.service.maps

import org.junit.Assert.*
import org.junit.Test

class RealPositionLifecycleTest {
    @Test fun simulationSuspendsFixesAndResumesOnlyWhileVisible() {
        val events = mutableListOf<Boolean>()
        val gate = RealPositionLifecycle { events += it }
        gate.resume(false)
        assertTrue(gate.acceptsFix())
        gate.simulation(true)
        assertFalse(gate.acceptsFix())
        gate.pause()
        gate.simulation(false)
        assertEquals(listOf(true, false), events)
        gate.resume(false)
        assertTrue(gate.acceptsFix())
        assertEquals(listOf(true, false, true), events)
    }
    @Test fun destroyingViewRejectsLateFixAndCannotRestart() {
        val events = mutableListOf<Boolean>()
        val gate = RealPositionLifecycle { events += it }
        gate.resume(false)
        gate.destroy()
        gate.resume(false)
        gate.simulation(false)
        gate.destroy()
        assertFalse(gate.acceptsFix())
        assertEquals(listOf(true, false), events)
    }
    @Test fun recreationDuringSimulationNeverStartsRealPositioning() {
        val events = mutableListOf<Boolean>()
        val old = RealPositionLifecycle { events += it }
        old.resume(false); old.simulation(true); old.destroy()
        val restored = RealPositionLifecycle { events += it }
        restored.resume(true)
        assertFalse(restored.acceptsFix())
        assertEquals(listOf(true, false), events)
        restored.simulation(false)
        restored.simulation(false)
        assertEquals(listOf(true, false, true), events)
    }
}
```

`app/src/test/java/com/system/location/service/privacy/SdkConsentControllerTest.kt`:

```kt
package com.system.location.service.privacy

import org.junit.Assert.*
import org.junit.Test

class SdkConsentControllerTest {
    private class Store(var state: SdkConsent = SdkConsent(), var writable: Boolean = true) : SdkConsentStore {
        override fun read() = state
        override fun write(value: SdkConsent) { check(writable) { "Storage unavailable" }; state = value }
    }
    private class Sdk : ConsentSdk {
        var mapsStarts = 0
        val crashChanges = mutableListOf<Boolean>()
        var failCrashStart = false
        var failMaps = false
        var failCrashStop = false
        override fun initializeMaps() { mapsStarts++; check(!failMaps) { "Maps unavailable" } }
        override fun setCrashReporting(enabled: Boolean) {
            crashChanges += enabled
            check(!enabled || !failCrashStart) { "Crash SDK unavailable" }
            check(enabled || !failCrashStop) { "Crash SDK stop failed" }
        }
    }
    @Test fun freshInstallDoesNotInitializeThirdPartySdks() {
        val sdk = Sdk()
        SdkConsentController(Store(), sdk).restore()
        assertEquals(0, sdk.mapsStarts)
        assertTrue(sdk.crashChanges.isEmpty())
    }
    @Test fun acceptingMapsDoesNotOptIntoCrashReporting() {
        val store = Store(); val sdk = Sdk(); val controller = SdkConsentController(store, sdk)
        controller.acceptMaps()
        assertEquals(SdkConsent(mapsAccepted = true), store.state)
        assertEquals(1, sdk.mapsStarts)
        assertTrue(sdk.crashChanges.isEmpty())
    }
    @Test fun withdrawalNeverRequiresMapConsent() {
        val store = Store(SdkConsent(false, true)); val sdk = Sdk()
        val controller = SdkConsentController(store, sdk)
        controller.restore()
        controller.setCrashReporting(false)
        assertFalse(store.state.crashReporting)
        assertEquals(0, sdk.mapsStarts)
    }

    @Test fun crashReportingRequiresMapConsent() {
        val store = Store(); val sdk = Sdk()
        try { SdkConsentController(store, sdk).setCrashReporting(true); fail("Consent required") }
        catch (_: IllegalStateException) { }
        assertFalse(store.state.crashReporting)
        assertTrue(sdk.crashChanges.isEmpty())
    }
    @Test fun optInAndOptOutApplyImmediatelyAndSurviveRestart() {
        val store = Store(SdkConsent(mapsAccepted = true)); val sdk = Sdk()
        val controller = SdkConsentController(store, sdk)
        controller.restore()
        controller.setCrashReporting(true)
        controller.setCrashReporting(true)
        controller.setCrashReporting(false)
        assertEquals(listOf(true, false), sdk.crashChanges)
        val restarted = Sdk()
        SdkConsentController(store, restarted).restore()
        assertEquals(1, restarted.mapsStarts)
        assertTrue(restarted.crashChanges.isEmpty())
    }
    @Test fun restoredOptInStartsCrashSdkOnlyOnce() {
        val sdk = Sdk(); val controller = SdkConsentController(Store(SdkConsent(true, true)), sdk)
        controller.restore(); controller.restore()
        assertEquals(1, sdk.mapsStarts)
        assertEquals(listOf(true), sdk.crashChanges)
    }
    @Test fun failedMapInitializationDuringOptInCannotLeaveReportingRequested() {
        val store = Store(SdkConsent(true)); val sdk = Sdk().apply { failMaps = true }
        val controller = SdkConsentController(store, sdk)
        controller.restore()
        assertTrue(runCatching { controller.setCrashReporting(true) }.isFailure)
        assertFalse(controller.crashReportingRequested)
        assertFalse(store.state.crashReporting)
        assertTrue(sdk.crashChanges.isEmpty())
    }

    @Test fun sdkStopFailureStillSavesWithdrawalAndCannotShowEnabled() {
        val store = Store(SdkConsent(true, true))
        val sdk = Sdk(); val controller = SdkConsentController(store, sdk)
        controller.restore()
        sdk.failCrashStop = true
        val result = runCatching { controller.setCrashReporting(false) }
        assertTrue(result.isFailure)
        assertFalse(controller.crashReportingRequested)
        assertFalse(controller.crashReportingEnabled)
        assertFalse(store.state.crashReporting)
        sdk.failCrashStop = false
        controller.setCrashReporting(false)
        assertEquals("A failed stop must be retried", listOf(true, false, false), sdk.crashChanges)
    }

    @Test fun failedMapRestoreDoesNotClaimSdkReadyOrStartCrashSdk() {
        val sdk = Sdk().apply { failMaps = true }
        val controller = SdkConsentController(Store(SdkConsent(true, true)), sdk)
        controller.restore()
        assertTrue(controller.mapsAccepted)
        assertFalse(controller.mapsReady)
        assertFalse(controller.crashReportingEnabled)
        assertNotNull(controller.lastFailure)
        assertTrue(sdk.crashChanges.isEmpty())
    }

    @Test fun restoreFailureAndFailedCleanupSaveKeepEffectiveReportingOff() {
        val sdk = Sdk().apply { failCrashStart = true }
        val store = Store(SdkConsent(true, true), writable = false)
        val controller = SdkConsentController(store, sdk)
        controller.restore()
        assertFalse(controller.crashReportingEnabled)
        assertFalse(controller.crashReportingRequested)
        assertNotNull(controller.lastFailure)
    }

    @Test fun failedEnableWriteRollsBackVisibleStateWithoutStartingCrashSdk() {
        val store = object : SdkConsentStore {
            var state = SdkConsent(true)
            override fun read() = state
            override fun write(value: SdkConsent) { state = value; error("Disk full") }
        }
        val sdk = Sdk(); val controller = SdkConsentController(store, sdk)
        controller.restore()
        runCatching { controller.setCrashReporting(true) }
        assertFalse(controller.crashReportingRequested)
        assertFalse(controller.crashReportingEnabled)
        assertFalse(store.read().crashReporting)
        assertTrue(sdk.crashChanges.isEmpty())
    }

    @Test fun failedRollbackCannotGrantConsentThroughStoreMemory() {
        val sdk = Sdk()
        val store = object : SdkConsentStore {
            var state = SdkConsent()
            override fun read() = state
            override fun write(value: SdkConsent) { state = value; error("Disk unavailable") }
        }
        val controller = SdkConsentController(store, sdk)
        runCatching { controller.acceptMaps() }
        // Even a subsequent unrelated SDK request must use confirmed consent.
        runCatching { controller.setCrashReporting(true) }
        assertEquals(0, sdk.mapsStarts)
        assertTrue(sdk.crashChanges.isEmpty())
    }

    @Test fun failedCrashStartCannotBeRetriedAfterSdkShutdown() {
        val sdk = Sdk().apply { failCrashStart = true }
        val controller = SdkConsentController(Store(SdkConsent(true)), sdk)
        controller.restore()
        runCatching { controller.setCrashReporting(true) }
        sdk.failCrashStart = false
        controller.setCrashReporting(true)
        assertEquals(listOf(true, false), sdk.crashChanges)
    }

    @Test fun unreadablePreferencesDoNotAbortApplicationRestore() {
        val sdk = Sdk()
        val store = object : SdkConsentStore {
            override fun read(): SdkConsent = error("Unreadable preferences")
            override fun write(value: SdkConsent) = error("Unreadable preferences")
        }
        SdkConsentController(store, sdk).restore()
        assertEquals(0, sdk.mapsStarts)
        assertTrue(sdk.crashChanges.isEmpty())
    }

    @Test fun closedCrashSdkIsNotRestartedUntilNextProcess() {
        val store = Store(SdkConsent(true, true)); val sdk = Sdk()
        val controller = SdkConsentController(store, sdk)
        controller.restore()
        controller.setCrashReporting(false)
        controller.setCrashReporting(true)
        controller.restore()
        assertFalse(controller.crashReportingEnabled)
        assertTrue(controller.crashReportingPendingRestart)
        assertTrue(controller.crashReportingRequested)
        assertEquals("closeBugly shuts down its executor permanently", listOf(true, false), sdk.crashChanges)
        assertTrue("New opt-in is saved for next process", store.state.crashReporting)
        val nextProcess = Sdk()
        SdkConsentController(store, nextProcess).restore()
        assertEquals(listOf(true), nextProcess.crashChanges)
    }

    @Test fun restoreIsolatesOptionalSdkFailureAndDisablesSavedOptIn() {
        val store = Store(SdkConsent(true, true))
        val sdk = Sdk().apply { failCrashStart = true }
        SdkConsentController(store, sdk).restore()
        assertFalse("A failed SDK must not be shown as enabled", store.state.crashReporting)
        assertEquals(listOf(true, false), sdk.crashChanges)
        assertEquals(1, sdk.mapsStarts)
    }

    @Test fun disableStillStopsSdkWhenSavingFails() {
        val sdk = Sdk(); val store = Store(SdkConsent(true, true))
        val controller = SdkConsentController(store, sdk)
        controller.restore()
        store.writable = false
        try { controller.setCrashReporting(false); fail("Write should fail") }
        catch (_: IllegalStateException) { }
        assertEquals("Withdrawal must precede disk write", listOf(true, false), sdk.crashChanges)
    }

    @Test fun commitThatChangesMemoryBeforeFailingRollsBackConsent() {
        val store = object : SdkConsentStore {
            var state = SdkConsent()
            var failNext = true
            override fun read() = state
            override fun write(value: SdkConsent) {
                state = value // SharedPreferences.commit updates memory even when disk write fails.
                if (failNext) { failNext = false; error("Disk full") }
            }
        }
        val sdk = Sdk()
        val controller = SdkConsentController(store, sdk)
        try { controller.acceptMaps(); fail("Write should fail") }
        catch (_: IllegalStateException) { }
        assertFalse("Failed agreement must not remain visible in preferences", store.read().mapsAccepted)
        assertEquals(0, sdk.mapsStarts)
    }

    @Test fun failedConsentWriteDoesNotInitializeSdk() {
        val sdk = Sdk(); val store = Store(writable = false)
        try { SdkConsentController(store, sdk).acceptMaps(); fail("Write should fail") }
        catch (_: IllegalStateException) { }
        assertEquals(0, sdk.mapsStarts)
        assertFalse(store.state.mapsAccepted)
    }
}
```

`app/src/test/java/com/system/location/service/runtime/RuntimeCommandLifecycleTest.kt`:

```kt
package com.system.location.service.runtime

import com.system.location.service.core.backend.*
import com.system.location.service.core.geo.Wgs84
import com.system.location.service.core.location.LocationSample
import com.system.location.service.core.runtime.*
import com.system.location.service.core.scenario.*
import kotlinx.coroutines.runBlocking
import org.junit.Assert.*
import org.junit.Test

class RuntimeCommandLifecycleTest {
    private class Clock : RuntimeClock {
        var time = 0L
        override fun nanos() = time * 1_000_000
        override fun millis() = time
    }
    private class Backend : LocationBackend {
        var failPublish = false
        var failCleanup = false
        override val type = BackendType.MOCK_PROVIDER
        override val capabilities = emptyMap<Capability, CapabilityStatus>()
        override suspend fun prepare() = BackendResult.Success
        override suspend fun start() = BackendResult.Success
        override suspend fun publish(sample: LocationSample, scenarioId: String?): BackendResult =
            if (failPublish) BackendResult.Failure("PUBLISH", "failed") else BackendResult.Success
        override suspend fun stop(): BackendResult =
            if (failCleanup) BackendResult.Failure("CLEANUP", "denied") else BackendResult.Success
        override suspend fun release() = stop()
    }
    @Test fun failedCommandsCloseServiceButRetainOwnershipForCleanupRetry() = runBlocking {
        for (command in listOf("pause", "resume", "motion", "speed", "stop", "tick")) {
            val backend = Backend()
            val clock = Clock()
            val controller = ScenarioController({ backend }, clock)
            var interrupted = true
            var finishes = 0
            val commands = RuntimeCommandLifecycle({ controller.state.value }, { interrupted = false }, { finishes++ })
            assertTrue(controller.start(Scenario("s", "point", point = Wgs84(0.0, 0.0))))
            if (command == "resume") assertTrue(controller.pause())
            backend.failPublish = true
            backend.failCleanup = true
            commands.execute {
                when (command) {
                    "pause" -> controller.pause()
                    "resume" -> controller.resume()
                    "motion" -> controller.setMotion(90.0, true)
                    "speed" -> controller.setSpeed(5.0)
                    "stop" -> controller.stop()
                    else -> controller.tick()
                }
            }
            assertEquals(command, RuntimePhase.ERROR, controller.state.value.phase)
            assertEquals(command, 1, finishes)
            assertTrue(command, interrupted)
            assertFalse(command, controller.selectBackend(BackendType.XPOSED))
            // Recreated process reads the retained marker and retries authoritative cleanup.
            val recovered = ScenarioController({ backend }, clock)
            recovered.recoverInterrupted(BackendType.MOCK_PROVIDER, "process died")
            assertEquals(RuntimePhase.ERROR, recovered.state.value.phase)
            assertFalse(recovered.selectBackend(BackendType.XPOSED))
            backend.failCleanup = false
            assertTrue(commands.execute { controller.stop() })
            assertFalse(interrupted)
            assertEquals(2, finishes)
            assertTrue(controller.selectBackend(BackendType.XPOSED))
            assertTrue(recovered.stop())
        }
    }

    @Test fun activeRejectedCommandDoesNotFinishService() = runBlocking {
        val controller = ScenarioController({ Backend() }, Clock())
        var finishes = 0
        val commands = RuntimeCommandLifecycle({ controller.state.value }, { fail("active marker cleared") }, { finishes++ })
        controller.start(Scenario("s", "point", point = Wgs84(0.0, 0.0)))
        assertFalse(commands.execute { controller.setMotion(Double.NaN, true) })
        assertEquals(0, finishes)
    }

    @Test fun inactiveTickStillFinishesService() = runBlocking {
        val controller = ScenarioController({ Backend() }, Clock())
        var finishes = 0
        val commands = RuntimeCommandLifecycle({ controller.state.value }, {}, { finishes++ })
        commands.execute { if (controller.state.value.isActive) controller.tick() }
        assertEquals(1, finishes)
    }

    @Test fun terminalExceptionStillFinishesService() = runBlocking {
        val controller = ScenarioController({ Backend() }, Clock())
        var finishes = 0
        val commands = RuntimeCommandLifecycle({ controller.state.value }, {}, { finishes++ })
        controller.start(Scenario("s", "point", point = Wgs84(0.0, 0.0)))
        assertTrue(runCatching { commands.execute { controller.stop(); error("after stop") } }.isFailure)
        assertEquals(1, finishes)
    }

    @Test fun pauseCompletingRouteClosesServiceAndClearsInterruptedMarker() = runBlocking {
        val clock = Clock()
        val controller = ScenarioController({ Backend() }, clock)
        var interrupted = true
        var finishes = 0
        val commands = RuntimeCommandLifecycle({ controller.state.value }, { interrupted = false }, { finishes++ })
        assertTrue(controller.start(Scenario("s", "route", route = Route("r", "route",
            listOf(Wgs84(0.0, 0.0), Wgs84(0.00001, 0.0))))))
        clock.time = 1_000_000
        commands.execute { controller.pause() }
        assertEquals(RuntimePhase.STOPPED, controller.state.value.phase)
        assertEquals(1, finishes)
        assertFalse(interrupted)
    }
}
```

```kt
        journal.message("middle", "keep me")
        journal.message("latest", "keep me too")

        assertTrue(journal.report().indexOf("latest") < journal.report().indexOf("middle"))
```

```kt
    @Test fun multibandSpacecraftCountsOnceWhileEqualSvidsAcrossSystemsRemainDistinct() {

            good.copy(azimuth = 360f), good.copy(elevation = Float.POSITIVE_INFINITY))

        assertTrue(displaySpacecraft(invalid).isEmpty())
    }
```

`app/src/test/java/com/system/location/service/ui/home/DebouncedSearchTest.kt`:

```kt
package com.system.location.service.ui.home

import com.system.location.service.ui.CallbackScheduler
import org.junit.Assert.*
import org.junit.Test

class DebouncedSearchTest {
    private class Clock : CallbackScheduler {
        var now = 0L
        val tasks = linkedMapOf<Runnable, Long>()
        override fun post(delayMillis: Long, callback: Runnable) { tasks[callback] = now + delayMillis }
        override fun remove(callback: Runnable) { tasks.remove(callback) }
        fun advance(millis: Long) {
            now += millis
            tasks.filterValues { it <= now }.keys.toList().forEach { tasks.remove(it); it.run() }
        }
    }

    @Test fun `clear removes queued task and invalidates already dispatched reply`() {
        val clock = Clock()
        var query = "beijing"
        val callbacks = mutableListOf<(String) -> Unit>()
        val rendered = mutableListOf<String>()
        val search = DebouncedSearch<String>(clock, { query }, { true }, { _, reply -> callbacks += reply }, { rendered += it })
        search.textChanged()
        clock.advance(300)
        search.textChanged()
        query = ""
        search.textChanged()
        callbacks.single()("stale")
        clock.advance(300)
        assertTrue(rendered.isEmpty())
        assertEquals(1, callbacks.size)
        assertTrue(clock.tasks.isEmpty())
    }

    @Test fun `completion checks live query and view before rendering`() {
        val clock = Clock()
        var query = "beijing"
        var active = true
        lateinit var reply: (String) -> Unit
        val rendered = mutableListOf<String>()
        val search = DebouncedSearch<String>(clock, { query }, { active }, { _, callback -> reply = callback }, { rendered += it })
        search.submit()
        query = "changed without watcher"
        reply("wrong query")
        query = "beijing"
        active = false
        reply("inactive view")
        assertTrue(rendered.isEmpty())
    }

    @Test fun `selection with unchanged name still invalidates old result`() {
        val clock = Clock()
        lateinit var reply: (String) -> Unit
        val rendered = mutableListOf<String>()
        val search = DebouncedSearch<String>(clock, { "beijing" }, { true }, { _, callback -> reply = callback }, { rendered += it })
        search.submit()
        search.select {}
        reply("stale")
        assertTrue(rendered.isEmpty())
    }

    @Test fun `destroy cancels pending work and rejects callbacks even if view becomes active again`() {
        val clock = Clock()
        val callbacks = mutableListOf<(String) -> Unit>()
        val rendered = mutableListOf<String>()
        var active = true
        val search = DebouncedSearch<String>(clock, { "beijing" }, { active }, { _, reply -> callbacks += reply }, { rendered += it })
        search.textChanged()
        clock.advance(300)
        search.textChanged()
        search.destroy()
        active = false
        active = true
        callbacks.single()("old view")
        clock.advance(300)
        search.textChanged()
        search.submit()
        clock.advance(300)
        assertTrue(rendered.isEmpty())
        assertEquals(1, callbacks.size)
        assertTrue(clock.tasks.isEmpty())
    }

    @Test fun `explicit search runs immediately once and cancels queued typing search`() {
        val clock = Clock()
        val requested = mutableListOf<String>()
        val search = DebouncedSearch<String>(clock, { "beijing" }, { true }, { text, _ -> requested += text }, {})
        search.textChanged()
        search.submit()
        assertEquals(listOf("beijing"), requested)
        clock.advance(300)
        assertEquals(listOf("beijing"), requested)
    }

    @Test fun `selection invalidates replies and suppresses programmatic text query`() {
        val clock = Clock()
        var query = "beijing"
        val callbacks = mutableListOf<(String) -> Unit>()
        val rendered = mutableListOf<String>()
        val search = DebouncedSearch<String>(clock, { query }, { true }, { _, reply -> callbacks += reply }, { rendered += it })
        search.textChanged()
        clock.advance(300)
        search.select {
            query = "Beijing station"
            search.textChanged()
        }
        callbacks.single()("stale")
        clock.advance(300)
        assertTrue(rendered.isEmpty())
        assertEquals(1, callbacks.size)
    }

    @Test fun `old callback cannot render after same query is requested again`() {
        val clock = Clock()
        var query = "beijing"
        val callbacks = mutableListOf<(String) -> Unit>()
        val rendered = mutableListOf<String>()
        val search = DebouncedSearch<String>(clock, { query }, { true }, { _, reply -> callbacks += reply }, { rendered += it })
        search.textChanged()
        clock.advance(300)
        query = "shanghai"
        search.textChanged()
        query = "beijing"
        search.textChanged()
        clock.advance(300)
        callbacks[1]("new")
        callbacks[0]("old")
        assertEquals(listOf("new"), rendered)
    }

    @Test fun `typing waits for quiet period and requests only latest query`() {
        val clock = Clock()
        var query = "b"
        val requested = mutableListOf<String>()
        val search = DebouncedSearch<String>(clock, { query }, { true }, { text, _ -> requested += text }, {})
        search.textChanged()
        clock.advance(200)
        query = "beijing"
        search.textChanged()
        clock.advance(299)
        assertTrue(requested.isEmpty())
        clock.advance(1)
        assertEquals(listOf("beijing"), requested)
    }
}
```

`app/src/test/java/com/system/location/service/ui/home/HomeCameraPolicyTest.kt`:

```kt
package com.system.location.service.ui.home

import org.junit.Assert.*
import org.junit.Test

class HomeCameraPolicyTest {
    @Test fun `mock stale and simulated fixes cannot resolve initial camera`() {
        for (bad in listOf(
            Triple(0L, true, false), Triple(0L, false, true),
            Triple(120_001L, false, false), Triple(-1L, false, false),
        )) {
            val policy = HomeCameraPolicy()
            assertNull(policy.accept(31.2, 121.5, bad.first, 200_000, bad.second, bad.third))
            assertNotNull(policy.accept(31.2, 121.5, 0, 200_001, false, false))
        }
        val policy = HomeCameraPolicy()
        for ((lat, lon) in listOf(Double.NaN to 1.0, 91.0 to 1.0, 1.0 to 181.0, 0.0 to 0.0)) {
            assertNull(policy.accept(lat, lon, 0, 200_000, false, false))
        }
        assertNotNull(policy.accept(0.0, 12.0, 0, 200_001, false, false))
    }

    @Test fun `locate always recenters and restores zoom without following later updates`() {
        val policy = HomeCameraPolicy()
        policy.accept(31.2, 121.5, 0, 1_000, false, false)
        assertNull(policy.accept(31.3, 121.6, 0, 2_000, false, false))
        repeat(3) {
            val move = policy.locate(3_000)
            assertEquals(HomeCameraPolicy.Position(31.3, 121.6), move?.position)
            assertEquals(16.5f, move!!.zoom)
        }
        assertNull(policy.accept(31.4, 121.7, 0, 4_000, false, false))
    }

    @Test fun `locate waits for fresh fix when cache expired`() {
        val policy = HomeCameraPolicy()
        policy.accept(31.2, 121.5, 0, 1_000, false, false)
        assertNull(policy.locate(122_000))
        assertNotNull(policy.accept(31.3, 121.6, 0, 123_000, false, false))
    }

    @Test fun `explicit target interaction cancels pending automatic centering`() {
        val policy = HomeCameraPolicy()
        policy.userMovedCamera()
        assertNull(policy.accept(31.2, 121.5, 0, 1_000, false, false))
        assertNotNull(policy.locate(2_000))
    }

    @Test fun `first real fix centers at street zoom`() {
        val policy = HomeCameraPolicy()
        val move = policy.accept(31.2, 121.5, 0, 1_000, false, false)
        assertNotNull("The first real fix must move the camera", move)
        assertEquals(HomeCameraPolicy.Position(31.2, 121.5), move!!.position)
        assertEquals(16.5f, move.zoom)
    }
}
```

`app/src/test/java/com/system/location/service/ui/mock/RouteEditorActionsTest.kt`:

```kt
package com.system.location.service.ui.mock

import com.system.location.service.core.geo.Wgs84
import com.system.location.service.core.geo.Gcj02

class RouteEditorActionsTest {

    @Test fun `failed persistence cannot save a stale route`() {
        val route = Route("saved", "route", listOf(Wgs84(30.0, 120.0), Wgs84(30.1, 120.1)))
        val actions = RouteEditorActions.from(RouteDraft(route = route, phase = DraftPhase.ERROR))
        assertFalse(actions.canSave)
    }

    @Test fun `restoration blocks editor actions until saved draft arrives`() {
        val actions = RouteEditorActions.from(RouteDraft(message = "正在恢复草稿", start = start, end = end))
        assertTrue(actions.restoring)
        assertFalse(actions.canPlan)
        assertFalse(actions.canUndo)
        assertFalse(actions.canSave)
    }

    @Test fun `planning cannot be submitted twice`() {
        val draft = RouteDraft(start = start, end = end, phase = DraftPhase.ENDPOINTS)
        assertTrue(RouteEditorActions.from(draft).canPlan)
        val planning = RouteEditorActions.from(draft.copy(phase = DraftPhase.PLANNING))
        assertTrue(planning.planning)
        assertFalse(planning.canPlan)
        assertFalse(planning.canSave)
    }

    @Test fun `planning requires two different endpoints and plan mode`() {
        assertFalse(RouteEditorActions.from(RouteDraft(start = start)).canPlan)
        assertFalse(RouteEditorActions.from(RouteDraft(start = start, end = start)).canPlan)
        assertFalse(RouteEditorActions.from(RouteDraft(start = start, end = end, mode = DrawingMode.FREEHAND)).canPlan)
    }

    @Test fun `one manual point can be undone or cleared before a route exists`() {
        val actions = RouteEditorActions.from(RouteDraft(mode = DrawingMode.POINTS, start = start, strokes = listOf(listOf(start))))
        assertTrue(actions.hasGeometry)
        assertTrue(actions.canUndo)
        assertFalse(actions.canSave)
        assertFalse(RouteEditorActions.from(RouteDraft()).hasGeometry)
    }

    @Test fun `only planned geometry can be saved`() {
        val route = Route("saved", "route", listOf(Wgs84(30.0, 120.0), Wgs84(30.1, 120.1)))
        for (phase in DraftPhase.entries) {
            val actions = RouteEditorActions.from(RouteDraft(route = route, phase = phase))
            if (phase == DraftPhase.PLANNED) assertTrue(actions.canSave) else assertFalse(actions.canSave)
        }
        assertFalse(RouteEditorActions.from(RouteDraft(phase = DraftPhase.PLANNED)).canSave)
    }
}
```

`app/src/test/java/com/system/location/service/ui/mock/RouteJsonTest.kt`:

```kt
package com.system.location.service.ui.mock

import org.junit.Assert.assertEquals
import org.junit.Assert.assertNull
import org.junit.Assert.assertThrows
import org.junit.Test

class RouteJsonTest {
    private val points = listOf(39.908822 to 116.397465, 39.907951 to 116.397500)
    private val route = HistoricalRoute("默认路线", points)

    @Test
    fun defaultRouteSurvivesPersistence() {
        assertEquals(listOf(route), RouteJson.decodeRoutes(RouteJson.encodeRoutes(listOf(route))))
    }

    @Test
    fun selectedRouteAndClearedSelectionRoundTrip() {
        assertEquals(route, RouteJson.decodeRoute(RouteJson.encodeRoute(route)))
        assertNull(RouteJson.decodeRoute(RouteJson.encodeRoute(null)))
    }

    @Test
    fun readsDocumentedPairCoordinatesWithoutReflection() {
        val json = """[{"name":"默认路线","route":[{"first":39.908822,"second":116.397465},{"first":39.907951,"second":116.3975}]}]"""
        assertEquals(listOf(route), RouteJson.decodeRoutes(json))
    }

    @Test
    fun editedCoordinatesAreTheCoordinatesSaved() {
        val editedPoints = RouteJson.decodePoints(
            """[{"first":31.2304,"second":121.4737},{"first":31.2305,"second":121.4738}]"""
        )
        val edited = HistoricalRoute("编辑后的路线", editedPoints)
        val stored = RouteJson.decodeRoutes(RouteJson.encodeRoutes(listOf(route) + edited))
        assertEquals(editedPoints, stored.last().route)
        assertEquals(31.2304, stored.last().route.first().first, 0.0)
    }

    @Test
    fun emptyHistoryAndDeletedLastRouteRemainEmpty() {
        assertEquals(emptyList<HistoricalRoute>(), RouteJson.decodeRoutes(""))
        assertEquals(emptyList<HistoricalRoute>(), RouteJson.decodeRoutes(RouteJson.encodeRoutes(emptyList())))
    }

    @Test
    fun unicodeNamesAndEscapesRoundTrip() {
        val named = HistoricalRoute("上海\"路线\"\\测试\n第二行", points)
        assertEquals(named, RouteJson.decodeRoute(RouteJson.encodeRoute(named)))
    }

    @Test
    fun rejectsMalformedOrInvalidCoordinates() {
        val invalidInputs = listOf(
            "not json", "null", "[]",
            """[{"first":39.9,"second":116.3}]""",
            """[{"first":91,"second":116.3},{"first":39.9,"second":116.3}]""",
            """[{"first":39.9,"second":181},{"first":39.9,"second":116.3}]""",
            """[{"first":39.9},{"first":39.9,"second":116.3}]""",
            """[{"first":null,"second":116.3},{"first":39.9,"second":116.3}]""",
            """[{"first":NaN,"second":116.3},{"first":39.9,"second":116.3}]"""
        )
        invalidInputs.forEach { json ->
            assertThrows(json, IllegalArgumentException::class.java) { RouteJson.decodePoints(json) }
        }
    }

    @Test
    fun rejectsInvalidStoredRoutesBeforePlayback() {
        listOf(
            """[{"name":"空路线","route":[]}]""",
            """[{"name":"单点","route":[{"first":39.9,"second":116.3}]}]""",
            """[{"name":" ","route":[{"first":39.9,"second":116.3},{"first":40.0,"second":116.4}]}]"""
        ).forEach { json ->
            assertThrows(json, IllegalArgumentException::class.java) { RouteJson.decodeRoutes(json) }
        }
    }

    @Test
    fun coordinateBoundariesRoundTrip() {
        val boundaries = listOf(-90.0 to -180.0, 90.0 to 180.0)
        assertEquals(boundaries, RouteJson.decodePoints(RouteJson.encodePoints(boundaries)))
    }
}
```

`app/src/test/java/com/system/location/service/ui/mock/StrokePreviewCoordinatorTest.kt`:

```kt
package com.system.location.service.ui.mock

import com.system.location.service.ui.CallbackScheduler
import org.junit.Assert.*
import org.junit.Test

class StrokePreviewCoordinatorTest {
    private class Frames : CallbackScheduler {
        val tasks = linkedSetOf<Runnable>()
        override fun post(delayMillis: Long, callback: Runnable) { tasks += callback }
        override fun remove(callback: Runnable) { tasks -= callback }
        fun frame() { tasks.toList().also { tasks.clear() }.forEach { it.run() } }
    }

    @Test fun `duplicate points and samples beyond safety limit do not reconvert or enter model`() {
        val frames = Frames()
        var conversions = 0
        val committed = mutableListOf<List<Int>>()
        val stroke = StrokePreviewCoordinator<Int, Int>(frames, { conversions++; it }, {}, {}, { committed += it })
        repeat(10_001) { stroke.add(it); stroke.add(it) }
        stroke.finish()
        assertEquals(10_000, conversions)
        assertEquals((0 until 10_000).toList(), committed.single())
    }

    @Test fun `single point never renders or commits a route`() {
        val frames = Frames()
        val previews = mutableListOf<List<Int>>()
        val committed = mutableListOf<List<Int>>()
        val stroke = StrokePreviewCoordinator<Int, Int>(frames, { it }, { previews += it }, {}, { committed += it })
        stroke.add(1)
        frames.frame()
        stroke.finish()
        assertTrue(previews.isEmpty())
        assertTrue(committed.isEmpty())
    }

    @Test fun `cancel removes frame callback and cannot redraw cancelled stroke`() {
        val frames = Frames()
        val previews = mutableListOf<List<Int>>()
        val committed = mutableListOf<List<String>>()
        var clears = 0
        val stroke = StrokePreviewCoordinator<Int, String>(frames, { "p$it" }, { previews += it }, { clears++ }, { committed += it })
        stroke.add(1)
        stroke.add(2)
        val stale = frames.tasks.single()
        stroke.cancel()
        assertTrue(frames.tasks.isEmpty())
        stroke.add(3)
        stroke.add(4)
        stale.run()
        assertTrue(previews.isEmpty())
        frames.frame()
        assertEquals(listOf(3, 4), previews.single())
        assertTrue(committed.isEmpty())
        assertEquals(1, clears)
    }

    @Test fun `finish cancels frame and clears preview while preserving committed snapshot`() {
        val frames = Frames()
        val committed = mutableListOf<List<String>>()
        var clears = 0
        val stroke = StrokePreviewCoordinator<Int, String>(frames, { "p$it" }, {}, { clears++ }, { committed += it })
        stroke.add(1)
        stroke.add(2)
        stroke.finish()
        assertTrue(frames.tasks.isEmpty())
        assertEquals(1, clears)
        stroke.add(3)
        assertEquals(listOf("p1", "p2"), committed.single())
        stroke.cancel()
    }

    @Test fun `long stroke preview is bounded while finish commits all points including endpoint`() {
        val frames = Frames()
        val previews = mutableListOf<List<Int>>()
        val committed = mutableListOf<List<String>>()
        val stroke = StrokePreviewCoordinator<Int, String>(frames, { "p$it" }, { previews += it }, {}, { committed += it })
        repeat(10_000) { stroke.add(it) }
        frames.frame()
        assertTrue(previews.single().size <= 512)
        assertEquals(0, previews.single().first())
        assertEquals(9_999, previews.single().last())
        stroke.finish()
        assertEquals((0 until 10_000).map { "p$it" }, committed.single())
    }

    @Test fun `many samples update preview once per frame and convert each point only once`() {
        val frames = Frames()
        var conversions = 0
        val previews = mutableListOf<List<Int>>()
        val stroke = StrokePreviewCoordinator<Int, String>(frames, { conversions++; "p$it" }, { previews += it }, {}, {})
        repeat(100) { stroke.add(it) }
        assertTrue(previews.isEmpty())
        assertEquals(1, frames.tasks.size)
        frames.frame()
        assertEquals(1, previews.size)
        assertEquals((0 until 100).toList(), previews.single())
        stroke.add(100)
        frames.frame()
        assertEquals(2, previews.size)
        assertEquals(101, conversions)
    }
}
```

`app/src/test/java/com/system/location/service/ui/runtime/RuntimeLogViewTest.kt`:

```kt
package com.system.location.service.ui.runtime

import com.system.location.service.core.backend.BackendType
import com.system.location.service.core.runtime.DiagnosticEvent
import org.junit.Assert.assertEquals
import org.junit.Assert.assertTrue
import org.junit.Test

class RuntimeLogViewTest {
    private val mock = BackendType.MOCK_PROVIDER
    private val xposed = BackendType.XPOSED
    private fun event(time: Long, backend: BackendType = mock, result: String = "OK") =
        DiagnosticEvent(time, backend, "PUBLISH", result, "event-$time")

    @Test fun allLogsRetainHistoryAndShowNewestFirstBeyondEightRows() {
        val history = (1L..25L).map { event(it) }
        val original = history.toList()
        assertEquals(history.asReversed(), visibleRuntimeEvents(history, 0, 0, mock))
        assertEquals(original, history)
    }

    @Test fun exceptionFilterIncludesFailuresAndActionableStatesAcrossBackends() {
        val results = listOf("OK", "FAILED", "ERROR", "REQUIRES_ACTION", "UNAVAILABLE", "AVAILABLE", "EXPERIMENTAL")
        val history = results.mapIndexed { index, result -> event(index + 1L, xposed, result) }
        assertEquals(
            listOf("UNAVAILABLE", "REQUIRES_ACTION", "ERROR", "FAILED"),
            visibleRuntimeEvents(history, 0, 1, mock).map { it.result },
        )
    }

    @Test fun currentBackendFilterTracksActualBackend() {
        val history = listOf(event(1), event(2, xposed), event(3))
        assertEquals(listOf(history[2], history[0]), visibleRuntimeEvents(history, 0, 2, mock))
        assertEquals(listOf(history[1]), visibleRuntimeEvents(history, 0, 2, xposed))
    }

    @Test fun clearHidesExistingRowsWithoutDeletingHistoryAndLaterEventsRemainVisible() {
        val history = listOf(event(10), event(20, xposed, "FAILED"))
        val original = history.toList()
        assertTrue(visibleRuntimeEvents(history, 20, 0, mock).isEmpty())
        assertEquals(original, history)
        val next = event(21)
        assertEquals(listOf(next), visibleRuntimeEvents(history + next, 20, 0, mock))
        assertTrue(visibleRuntimeEvents(history + next, 20, 1, mock).isEmpty())
    }
}
```

`app/src/test/java/com/system/location/service/update/ReleaseChannelPolicyTest.kt`:

```kt
package com.system.location.service.update

import org.junit.Assert.assertEquals
import org.junit.Assert.assertFalse
import org.junit.Assert.assertTrue
import org.junit.Assert.assertNull
import org.junit.Test

class ReleaseChannelPolicyTest {
    private fun release(tag: String, prerelease: Boolean, publishedAt: Long = 1) =
        ReleaseChannelPolicy.Release(tag, prerelease, draft = false, publishedAt)

    @Test fun stableChannelNeverSelectsPreRelease() {
        val beta = release("1.9.0.r9.abcdef0", prerelease = true, publishedAt = 300)
        val stable = release("1.8.0.r8.1234567", prerelease = false, publishedAt = 200)
        assertEquals(stable, ReleaseChannelPolicy.select(UpdateChannel.STABLE, listOf(beta, stable)))
        assertNull(ReleaseChannelPolicy.select(UpdateChannel.STABLE, listOf(beta)))
    }

    @Test fun betaChannelSeesBetaAndPromotedStableAndSelectsHighestVersion() {
        val beta = release("1.9.0.r9.abcdef0", prerelease = true, publishedAt = 300)
        val stable = release("1.8.0.r8.1234567", prerelease = false, publishedAt = 200)
        assertEquals(beta, ReleaseChannelPolicy.select(UpdateChannel.BETA, listOf(stable, beta)))
        val promoted = release("1.9.0.r9.abcdef0", prerelease = false, publishedAt = 400)
        assertEquals(promoted, ReleaseChannelPolicy.select(UpdateChannel.BETA, listOf(beta, promoted)))
    }

    @Test fun draftsAndMalformedTagsAreNeverSelected() {
        assertEquals(null, ReleaseChannelPolicy.select(UpdateChannel.BETA, listOf(
            ReleaseChannelPolicy.Release("1.9.0.r9.abcdef0", true, draft = true, 300),
            release("not-a-version", true),
        )))
    }

    @Test fun betaVersionIsNewerThanCurrentStableButStableNeverTreatsBetaAsCandidate() {
        val beta = release("1.9.0.r9.abcdef0", true)
        val currentStable = "1.8.0.r8.1234567"
        assertTrue(ReleaseChannelPolicy.isCandidate(UpdateChannel.BETA, beta, currentStable))
        assertFalse(ReleaseChannelPolicy.isCandidate(UpdateChannel.STABLE, beta, currentStable))
    }

    @Test fun samePromotedBuildDoesNotReinstallWhenChangingChannel() {
        val promoted = release("1.9.0.r9.abcdef0", prerelease = false)
        assertFalse(ReleaseChannelPolicy.isCandidate(UpdateChannel.STABLE, promoted, "1.9.0.r9.abcdef0"))
    }

    @Test fun draftsAndMalformedTagsAreIgnored() {
        assertNull(ReleaseChannelPolicy.select(UpdateChannel.BETA, listOf(
            ReleaseChannelPolicy.Release("1.9.0.r9.abcdef0", true, draft = true, publishedAt = 300),
            release("latest", true),
        )))
    }

    @Test fun betaCanAdvanceFromStableWhileStableRejectsBeta() {
        val beta = release("1.9.0.r9.abcdef0", true)
        val currentStable = "1.8.0.r8.1234567"
        assertTrue(ReleaseChannelPolicy.isCandidate(UpdateChannel.BETA, beta, currentStable))
        assertFalse(ReleaseChannelPolicy.isCandidate(UpdateChannel.STABLE, beta, currentStable))
        assertTrue(ReleaseChannelPolicy.isCandidate(UpdateChannel.STABLE,
            release("1.10.0.r1.1234567", false), "1.9.0.r9.abcdef0"))
    }
}
```

`app/src/test/java/com/system/location/service/update/ReleaseTransportTest.kt`:

```kt
package com.system.location.service.update

import kotlinx.serialization.json.*
import org.junit.Assert.*
import org.junit.Test

class ReleaseTransportTest {
    private val tag = "v1.9.0.r10.abcdef0"
    private val apk = "LocationService-$tag-arm64.apk"
    private fun release(metadata: Boolean = true, version: String = tag): String = buildJsonObject {
        put("tag_name", version); put("html_url", "${GitHubReleaseUrls.PAGE}/tag/$version")
        put("prerelease", false); put("draft", false); put("body", "notes"); put("published_at", "2026-01-01T00:00:00Z")
        putJsonArray("assets") {
            for (name in listOf("LocationService-$version-arm64.apk") + if (metadata) listOf("verification.json") else emptyList()) add(buildJsonObject {
                put("name", name); put("browser_download_url", "${GitHubReleaseUrls.PAGE}/download/$version/$name")
            })
        }
    }.toString()
    private fun report(code: JsonElement = JsonPrimitive(200)) = buildJsonObject {
        put("version", tag.removePrefix("v")); put("versionCode", code); put("channel", "beta")
        put("certificateSha256", ReleaseFeed.CERTIFICATE)
        putJsonArray("artifacts") { add(buildJsonObject {
            put("file", apk); put("sha256", "a".repeat(64)); put("bytes", 1024)
            putJsonArray("abis") { add("arm64-v8a") }
        }) }
    }.toString()
    private fun failed(block: () -> Unit) { try { block(); fail("Expected failure") } catch (e: Exception) { } }

    @Test fun stableOnlyUsesLatestAndAcceptsPreservedBetaReportAfterPromotion() {
        val requests = mutableListOf<String>()
        val feed = ReleaseFeed(ReleaseTransport { url ->
            requests += url
            ReleaseTransport.Response(200, if (url.endsWith("latest")) release() else report())
        })
        val result = feed.load(UpdateChannel.STABLE, "arm64").single()
        assertEquals(200, result.versionCode)
        assertEquals(2, requests.size)
        assertTrue(requests.first().endsWith("/latest"))
    }
    @Test fun acceptsHistoricalVerificationWithoutChannelField() {
        val historical = JsonObject(Json.parseToJsonElement(report()).jsonObject.filterKeys { it != "channel" }).toString()
        val feed = ReleaseFeed(ReleaseTransport { url ->
            ReleaseTransport.Response(200, if (url.endsWith("latest")) release() else historical)
        })
        assertEquals(200, feed.load(UpdateChannel.STABLE, "arm64").single().versionCode)
    }
    @Test fun betaBoundsPagesAndKeepsLatestOutsideScan() {
        val requests = mutableListOf<String>()
        val feed = ReleaseFeed(ReleaseTransport { url ->
            requests += url
            ReleaseTransport.Response(200, when {
                url.endsWith("latest") -> release(false)
                else -> "[" + List(ReleaseFeed.PAGE_SIZE) { release(false, "v1.8.0.r1.1234567") }.joinToString(",") + "]"
            })
        })
        assertEquals(2, feed.load(UpdateChannel.BETA, "arm64").size)
        assertEquals(1 + ReleaseFeed.MAX_PAGES, requests.size)
    }
    @Test fun metadataMissingIsExplicitLegacyButMissingDownloadIsFailure() {
        val legacy = ReleaseFeed(ReleaseTransport { ReleaseTransport.Response(200, release(false)) })
        assertNull(legacy.load(UpdateChannel.STABLE, "arm64").single().versionCode)
        val broken = ReleaseFeed(ReleaseTransport { url -> if (url.endsWith("latest")) ReleaseTransport.Response(200, release()) else ReleaseTransport.Response(404, "") })
        failed { broken.load(UpdateChannel.STABLE, "arm64") }
    }
    @Test fun malformedMetadataNeverFallsBack() {
        for (invalid in listOf("{}", report(JsonPrimitive("200")), report(JsonPrimitive(0)), report(JsonPrimitive(2147483648L)), report().replace("abcdef0", "abcdef1"), report().replace(ReleaseFeed.CERTIFICATE, "0".repeat(64)), report().replace("arm64-v8a", "x86_64"))) {
            val feed = ReleaseFeed(ReleaseTransport { url -> ReleaseTransport.Response(200, if (url.endsWith("latest")) release() else invalid) })
            failed { feed.load(UpdateChannel.STABLE, "arm64") }
        }
    }
    @Test fun lowerAndEqualCodesNeverInstallEvenWithNewerNamesOrPublication() {
        for (code in listOf(99, 100)) assertFalse(ReleaseChannelPolicy.isInstallable(UpdateChannel.BETA,
            ReleaseChannelPolicy.Release(tag, false, false, Long.MAX_VALUE, code), "1.0.0", 100))
        assertTrue(ReleaseChannelPolicy.isInstallable(UpdateChannel.STABLE,
            ReleaseChannelPolicy.Release("1.8.0", false, false, 1, 101), "1.9.0", 100))
    }
    @Test fun legacyRequiresHigherSemanticBaseAndRejectsSameBuildAndChannelDowngrade() {
        assertFalse(ReleaseChannelPolicy.isInstallable(UpdateChannel.BETA,
            ReleaseChannelPolicy.Release(tag, false, false, 999), "1.9.0.r1.1234567", 100))
        assertFalse(ReleaseChannelPolicy.isInstallable(UpdateChannel.STABLE,
            ReleaseChannelPolicy.Release("1.8.0", false, false, 999), "1.9.0", 100))
        assertTrue(ReleaseChannelPolicy.isInstallable(UpdateChannel.STABLE,
            ReleaseChannelPolicy.Release("1.10.0", false, false, 999), "1.9.0", 100))
    }
    @Test fun rejectsUntrustedUrls() {
        for (url in listOf("http://github.com/Lecheeel/Portal/releases/latest", "https://github.com.evil/Lecheeel/Portal/releases/latest", "https://user@github.com/Lecheeel/Portal/releases/latest", "https://github.com:444/Lecheeel/Portal/releases/latest", "https://github.com/other/Portal/releases/latest", "https://evil.test/file", "https://objects.githubusercontent.com/file")) assertFalse(url, GitHubReleaseUrls.trusted(url))
        assertTrue(GitHubReleaseUrls.trusted("https://release-assets.githubusercontent.com/file?token=x", true))
    }
    @Test fun paginationFailureIsNotUpToDate() {
        val feed = ReleaseFeed(ReleaseTransport { url -> if (url.endsWith("latest")) ReleaseTransport.Response(200, release(false)) else ReleaseTransport.Response(403, "") })
        failed { feed.load(UpdateChannel.BETA, "arm64") }
    }
    @Test fun strictSemanticsAndHugeNumericPrereleases() {
        assertEquals("beta.2", ReleaseVersion.parse("1.2.3-beta.2.r10.abcdef0")?.prerelease)
        assertEquals(10, ReleaseVersion.parse("1.2.3-beta.2.r10.abcdef0")?.revision)
        for (value in listOf("01.2.3", "1.2.3-beta.01", "1.2.3-beta..1", "1.2.3.r999999999999.abc", "1.2.3-beta.r999999999999.abc")) assertNull(value, ReleaseVersion.parse(value))
        assertTrue(ReleaseVersion.compare("1.2.3-beta.100000000000000000000", "1.2.3-beta.99999999999999999999") > 0)
        assertEquals(0, ReleaseVersion.compare("1.2.3.r1.fffffff", "1.2.3.r1.aaaaaaa"))
    }
}
```

`app/src/test/java/com/system/location/service/update/ReleaseVersionTest.kt`:

```kt
package com.system.location.service.update

import org.junit.Assert.assertFalse
import org.junit.Assert.assertTrue
import org.junit.Test

class ReleaseVersionTest {
    @Test
    fun semanticVersionTakesPriorityOverRevisionCounts() {
        assertTrue(ReleaseVersion.isNewer("1.0.5.r1.abcdef0", "1.0.4.r99.1234567"))
        assertFalse(ReleaseVersion.isNewer("1.0.4.r99.1234567", "1.0.5.r1.abcdef0", 200, 100))
    }

    @Test
    fun numericVersionComparisonHandlesMultipleDigits() {
        assertTrue(ReleaseVersion.isNewer("v1.10.0", "1.9.99"))
        assertFalse(ReleaseVersion.isNewer("1.9.99", "1.10.0"))
        assertTrue(ReleaseVersion.isNewer("2.0.0", "1.99.99"))
    }

    @Test
    fun sameCommitDoesNotPromptAfterPublishingOrWithDifferentCheckoutDepth() {
        assertFalse(ReleaseVersion.isNewer("1.0.5.r1.ABCDEF0", "1.0.5.r20.abcdef0-debug", 200, 100))
    }

    @Test
    fun publicationTimeHandlesShallowActionsCheckouts() {
        assertTrue(ReleaseVersion.isNewer("1.0.5.r1.abcdef0", "1.0.5.r20.1234567", 200, 100))
        assertFalse(ReleaseVersion.isNewer("1.0.5.r1.abcdef0", "1.0.5.r20.1234567", 100, 200))
    }

    @Test
    fun fallsBackToRevisionAndHashWhenNoPublicationTimeIsAvailable() {
        assertTrue(ReleaseVersion.isNewer("1.0.5.r2.abcdef0", "1.0.5.r1.1234567"))
        assertFalse(ReleaseVersion.isNewer("1.0.5.r1.abcdef0", "1.0.5.r1.1234567"))
        assertFalse(ReleaseVersion.isNewer("1.0.5.r1.abcdef0", "1.0.5.r2.1234567"))
    }

    @Test
    fun shallowCheckoutAndSameCommitDoNotUseHashOrRevisionAsVersionOrder() {
        assertFalse(ReleaseVersion.isNewer("1.0.5.r1.abcdef0", "1.0.5.r20.1234567"))
        assertTrue(ReleaseVersion.isNewer("1.0.5.r20.1234567", "1.0.5.r1.abcdef0"))
        assertFalse(ReleaseVersion.isNewer("1.0.5.r20.abcdef0", "1.0.5.r1.abcdef0"))
    }

    @Test
    fun prereleaseOrderingTreatsStableAsPromotionOfSameBinary() {
        assertTrue(ReleaseVersion.isNewer("1.2.0-beta.2", "1.2.0-beta.1"))
        assertTrue(ReleaseVersion.isNewer("1.2.0", "1.2.0-rc.1"))
        assertFalse(ReleaseVersion.isNewer("1.2.0", "1.2.0"))
    }

    @Test
    fun malformedOrEqualVersionsDoNotPrompt() {
        assertFalse(ReleaseVersion.isNewer("latest", "1.0.5"))
        assertFalse(ReleaseVersion.isNewer("1.0.5", "unknown"))
        assertFalse(ReleaseVersion.isNewer("1.0.5", "1.0.5"))
        assertFalse(ReleaseVersion.isNewer("1.0.5", "1.0.5", 200, 100))
        assertFalse(ReleaseVersion.isNewer("999999999999.0.0", "1.0.5"))
    }

    @Test fun betaPrereleasesSortBelowStableAndAboveEarlierBeta() {
        assertTrue(ReleaseVersion.compare("1.8.1-beta.2.r12.abcdef0", "1.8.1-beta.1.r11.1234567") > 0)
        assertTrue(ReleaseVersion.compare("1.8.1", "1.8.1-beta.2.r12.abcdef0") > 0)
        assertTrue(ReleaseVersion.compare("1.8.2-canary.1.r1.1234567", "1.8.1") > 0)
    }

    @Test fun prereleaseIdentifiersUseNumericOrdering() {
        assertTrue(ReleaseVersion.compare("1.8.1-beta.10.r10.abcdef0", "1.8.1-beta.2.r2.1234567") > 0)
        assertTrue(ReleaseVersion.compare("1.8.1-rc.1.r1.abcdef0", "1.8.1-beta.9.r9.1234567") > 0)
    }
}
```

```kt
        assertEquals("beta", store.get())
```

`core/src/main/kotlin/com/system/location/service/core/activity/ActivityRecognitionPolicy.kt`:

```kt
package com.system.location.service.core.activity

import com.system.location.service.core.sensors.ActivityKind
import com.system.location.service.core.sensors.MotionMode

/**
 * P7-03: deterministic activity-recognition distribution for the current motion mode.
 *
 * This is the policy layer only; the GMS/AOSP adapter is intentionally absent until a device
 * validates the callback surface. Probabilities always sum to 100.
 */
object ActivityRecognitionPolicy {
    fun probabilities(mode: MotionMode): Map<ActivityKind, Int> = when (mode) {
        MotionMode.STILL -> mapOf(
            ActivityKind.STILL to 90,
            ActivityKind.UNKNOWN to 10,
        )
        MotionMode.WALK -> mapOf(
            ActivityKind.WALKING to 80,
            ActivityKind.STILL to 10,
            ActivityKind.RUNNING to 10,
        )
        MotionMode.RUN -> mapOf(
            ActivityKind.RUNNING to 80,
            ActivityKind.WALKING to 15,
            ActivityKind.IN_VEHICLE to 5,
        )
        MotionMode.VEHICLE -> mapOf(
            ActivityKind.IN_VEHICLE to 80,
            ActivityKind.ON_BICYCLE to 5,
            ActivityKind.RUNNING to 5,
            ActivityKind.UNKNOWN to 10,
        )
    }

    fun mostProbable(mode: MotionMode): ActivityKind =
        probabilities(mode).maxByOrNull { it.value }?.key ?: ActivityKind.UNKNOWN
}
```

`core/src/main/kotlin/com/system/location/service/core/carrier/CarrierCellIdentity.kt`:

```kt
package com.system.location.service.core.carrier

import com.system.location.service.core.environment.CellTower
import com.system.location.service.core.environment.CellType

/** Bind explicit captured cells to an identity; never convert an LTE channel/CI into invented NR. */
object CarrierCellIdentity {
    fun overlay(cells: List<CellTower>, profile: SimCarrierProfile): List<CellTower> {
        val type = if (profile.radio == CarrierRadio.NR) CellType.NR else CellType.LTE
        val matching = cells.filter { it.type == type }
        if (matching.isEmpty()) return emptyList()
        // One serving cell for this selected subscription. Keep captured serving choice when
        // available; otherwise the strongest eligible record is the modeled serving candidate.
        val serving = matching.indexOfFirst { it.registered }.takeIf { it >= 0 }
            ?: matching.indices.maxBy { matching[it].rsrp }
        return matching.mapIndexed { index, cell -> cell.copy(
            mcc = profile.mcc,
            mnc = profile.mnc,
            mncDigits = profile.mncDigits,
            operatorName = profile.operatorName,
            registered = index == serving,
        ) }
    }
}
```

`core/src/main/kotlin/com/system/location/service/core/carrier/CarrierCellPublicationGate.kt`:

```kt
package com.system.location.service.core.carrier

/** Coalesces rapid location publications and emits only after the modeled geographic tile changes. */
class CarrierCellPublicationGate(private val intervalNanos: Long = 1_500_000_000L) {
    private var lastTile: Pair<Long, Long>? = null
    private var lastNanos: Long? = null

    @Synchronized
    fun changed(latitude: Double, longitude: Double, now: Long): Boolean {
        if (!latitude.isFinite() || !longitude.isFinite() || now < 0) return false
        val tile = kotlin.math.floor(latitude * 200).toLong() to kotlin.math.floor(longitude * 200).toLong()
        val before = lastNanos
        if (tile == lastTile) return false
        if (before != null && now >= before && now - before < intervalNanos) return false
        lastTile = tile
        lastNanos = now
        return true
    }
}
```
