`core/src/main/kotlin/com/system/location/service/core/carrier/CarrierIdentity.kt`:

```kt
package com.system.location.service.core.carrier

import java.util.Locale
import kotlinx.serialization.Serializable

private val ISO_COUNTRY_CODES = Locale.getISOCountries().toSet()

/** How a caller sees the simulated SIM/operator identity. */
@Serializable
enum class CarrierIdentityMode { GLOBAL, PER_APP }

/** Radio profile exposed to the framework; CDMA/GSM legacy profiles are intentionally absent. */
@Serializable
enum class CarrierRadio { NR, LTE }

/** Which configured SIM a per-app route should expose. */
@Serializable
enum class CarrierTarget { INHERIT, SIM1, SIM2, REAL }

@Serializable
data class SimCarrierProfile(
    val slot: Int,
    val enabled: Boolean = true,
    /** Stored: permit virtual SIM when empty. Resolved snapshot: whether this slot is virtual now. */
    val virtual: Boolean = false,
    val countryIso: String,
    val mcc: Int,
    val mnc: Int,
    val mncDigits: Int = 3,
    val carrierName: String,
    val operatorName: String = carrierName,
    val radio: CarrierRadio = CarrierRadio.NR,
    val nrBand: Int = 78,
    val nrArfcn: Int = CarrierNrChannel.defaultArfcn(nrBand),
    /** Persisted by the controller, not regenerated in injected processes. Zero is legacy input. */
    val identitySeed: Long = 0L,
    /** Controller-allocated opaque ID; zero is an unassigned legacy profile. */
    val virtualSubscriptionId: Int = 0,
    /** Optional modeled subscriber number, stable until explicitly edited or regenerated. */
    val phoneNumber: String = "",
    val phoneNumberCity: String = "",
) {
    init {
        require(phoneNumber.isEmpty() || phoneNumber.matches(Regex("\\+?[1-9][0-9]{5,14}"))) { "Invalid modeled phone number" }
        require(phoneNumberCity.length <= 80 && phoneNumberCity.none { it.isISOControl() }) { "Invalid phone number city" }
        require(virtualSubscriptionId in 0 until Int.MAX_VALUE) { "Invalid virtual subscription id" }
        require(CarrierNrChannel.valid(nrBand, nrArfcn)) { "NR band and ARFCN are inconsistent" }
        require(slot in 1..2) { "SIM slot must be 1 or 2" }
        require(countryIso.length == 2 && countryIso.all(Char::isLetter)) {
            "countryIso must be a two-letter ISO code"
        }
        require(countryIso.uppercase(Locale.ROOT) == countryIso) {
            "countryIso must be uppercase"
        }
        require(countryIso in ISO_COUNTRY_CODES) { "Unknown ISO 3166-1 country code" }
        require(mcc in 1..999) { "MCC out of range" }
        require(mnc in 0..999) { "MNC out of range" }
        require(mncDigits in 2..3) { "MNC must have 2 or 3 digits" }
        require(mnc < powerOfTen(mncDigits)) { "MNC does not fit mncDigits" }
        require(carrierName.isNotBlank() && carrierName.toByteArray(Charsets.UTF_8).size <= 128) {
            "carrierName must be 1..128 UTF-8 bytes"
        }
        require(operatorName.isNotBlank() && operatorName.toByteArray(Charsets.UTF_8).size <= 128) {
            "operatorName must be 1..128 UTF-8 bytes"
        }
    }

    val operatorNumeric: String
        get() = mcc.toString().padStart(3, '0') + mnc.toString().padStart(mncDigits, '0')

    private fun powerOfTen(digits: Int): Int = if (digits == 2) 100 else 1_000
}

@Serializable
data class CarrierAppRoute(
    val packageName: String,
    val target: CarrierTarget = CarrierTarget.INHERIT,
) {
    init {
        require(packageName.isNotBlank() && packageName.length <= 255) {
            "packageName must be 1..255 characters"
        }
    }
}

/**
 * Per-scenario SIM/operator identity. The master enable switch is stored separately so turning the
 * feature off leaves the saved profiles intact.
 */
@Serializable
data class CarrierIdentityConfig(
    val mode: CarrierIdentityMode = CarrierIdentityMode.GLOBAL,
    val sims: List<SimCarrierProfile> = emptyList(),
    val appRoutes: List<CarrierAppRoute> = emptyList(),
) {
    init {
        require(sims.size <= 2) { "At most two SIM profiles are supported" }
        require(sims.map { it.slot }.distinct().size == sims.size) { "Duplicate SIM slot" }
        val assigned = sims.map { it.virtualSubscriptionId }.filter { it != 0 }
        require(assigned.distinct().size == assigned.size) { "Duplicate virtual subscription id" }
        require(appRoutes.size <= MAX_ROUTES) { "Too many carrier routes" }
        val packages = appRoutes.map { it.packageName.lowercase(Locale.ROOT) }
        require(packages.distinct().size == packages.size) { "Duplicate carrier package route" }
    }

    fun profileForSlot(slot: Int): SimCarrierProfile? = sims.firstOrNull { it.slot == slot && it.enabled }

    fun profileForTarget(target: CarrierTarget): SimCarrierProfile? = when (target) {
        CarrierTarget.SIM1 -> profileForSlot(1)
        CarrierTarget.SIM2 -> profileForSlot(2)
        CarrierTarget.INHERIT, CarrierTarget.REAL -> null
    }

    /**
     * Resolve a caller-facing route without turning the system phone stack synthetic in PER_APP
     * mode. GLOBAL is deliberately the default and applies to all callers.
     */
    fun targetFor(packageName: String?, isSystemApp: Boolean): CarrierTarget {
        if (mode == CarrierIdentityMode.GLOBAL) return CarrierTarget.INHERIT
        if (isSystemApp) return CarrierTarget.REAL
        val normalized = packageName?.lowercase(Locale.ROOT) ?: return CarrierTarget.REAL
        return appRoutes.firstOrNull { it.packageName.lowercase(Locale.ROOT) == normalized }?.target
            ?: CarrierTarget.REAL
    }

    companion object {
        const val MAX_ROUTES = 1_024
        val EMPTY = CarrierIdentityConfig()
    }
}

/** Displayable country metadata; every ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 code is selectable. */
data class CarrierCountry(
    val iso: String,
    val displayName: String,
    val mcc: Int?,
)

object CarrierCountries {
    private val knownMcc = mapOf(
        "CN" to 460,
        "HK" to 454,
        "MO" to 455,
        "TW" to 466,
        "US" to 310,
        "GB" to 234,
        "JP" to 440,
        "KR" to 450,
        "SG" to 525,
        "MY" to 502,
        "TH" to 520,
        "VN" to 452,
        "ID" to 510,
        "PH" to 515,
        "IN" to 404,
        "AU" to 505,
        "CA" to 302,
        "DE" to 262,
        "FR" to 208,
        "IT" to 222,
        "ES" to 214,
        "RU" to 250,
        "BR" to 724,
        "MX" to 334,
        "ZA" to 655,
    )

    val all: List<CarrierCountry> by lazy {
        val display = Locale.getDefault()
        Locale.getISOCountries()
            .map { iso ->
                CarrierCountry(
                    iso = iso,
                    // The receiver is the target country; the argument is the display language.
                    displayName = Locale("", iso).getDisplayCountry(display)
                        .takeIf { it.isNotBlank() && it != iso }
                        ?: iso,
                    mcc = knownMcc[iso],
                )
            }
            .sortedWith(compareBy({ it.displayName.lowercase(display) }, { it.iso }))
    }

    fun byIso(iso: String): CarrierCountry? =
        all.firstOrNull { it.iso.equals(iso, ignoreCase = true) }

    fun isValid(iso: String): Boolean = all.any { it.iso.equals(iso, ignoreCase = true) }

    fun defaultMcc(iso: String): Int? = byIso(iso)?.mcc
}
```

```kt
package com.system.location.service.core.carrier

import kotlinx.serialization.json.Json

/** One persisted/wire format and one size limit, validated before preferences are changed. */
object CarrierIdentityCodec {
    const val MAX_LENGTH = 65_536
    fun encode(config: CarrierIdentityConfig): String =
        Json.encodeToString(CarrierIdentityConfig.serializer(), config).also(::validateSize)

    fun decode(encoded: String): CarrierIdentityConfig {
        validateSize(encoded)
        require(encoded.isNotBlank()) { "运营商配置为空" }
        return Json.decodeFromString(CarrierIdentityConfig.serializer(), encoded)
    }

    private fun validateSize(encoded: String) {
        require(encoded.length <= MAX_LENGTH) { "运营商配置超过大小上限，请减少应用规则" }
    }
}
```

`core/src/main/kotlin/com/system/location/service/core/carrier/CarrierIdentityEdits.kt`:

```kt
package com.system.location.service.core.carrier

import java.util.Locale

/** Reconcile a multi-select result without resetting an existing application's SIM target. */
fun reconcileCarrierRoutes(
    existing: List<CarrierAppRoute>,
    selectedPackages: Collection<String>,
): List<CarrierAppRoute> {
    val selected = selectedPackages.distinctBy { it.lowercase(Locale.ROOT) }
    require(selected.size <= CarrierIdentityConfig.MAX_ROUTES) { "Too many carrier routes" }
    val byPackage = existing.associateBy { it.packageName.lowercase(Locale.ROOT) }
    return selected.map { name ->
        byPackage[name.lowercase(Locale.ROOT)] ?: CarrierAppRoute(name)
    }
}
```

`core/src/main/kotlin/com/system/location/service/core/carrier/CarrierIdentityResolver.kt`:

```kt
package com.system.location.service.core.carrier

/** Resolves real slots first; empty slots require the profile's explicit virtual-SIM permission. */
object CarrierIdentityResolver {
    fun profile(
        config: CarrierIdentityConfig,
        requestedSlot: Int,
        activeSlots: Set<Int>,
        callerPackages: Collection<String>,
        systemCaller: Boolean,
    ): SimCarrierProfile? {
        if (requestedSlot !in 1..2) return null
        val physical = requestedSlot in activeSlots
        val configured = config.profileForSlot(requestedSlot)
        if (config.mode == CarrierIdentityMode.GLOBAL) {
            if (!physical && (configured?.virtual != true || configured.virtualSubscriptionId == 0)) return null
            return configured?.copy(virtual = !physical)
        }
        if (systemCaller) return null
        val targets = callerPackages.map { config.targetFor(it, false) }.distinct()
        // Shared UIDs cannot securely distinguish their packages. Preserve real identity if any
        // sibling package is excluded/unlisted or their configured targets disagree.
        if (targets.size != 1 || targets.single() == CarrierTarget.REAL) return null
        val slot = when (targets.single()) {
            CarrierTarget.SIM1 -> 1
            CarrierTarget.SIM2 -> 2
            CarrierTarget.INHERIT -> requestedSlot
            CarrierTarget.REAL -> return null
        }
        val profile = config.profileForSlot(slot) ?: return null
        if (slot !in activeSlots && (!profile.virtual || profile.virtualSubscriptionId == 0)) return null
        return profile.copy(virtual = slot !in activeSlots)
    }
}
```

`core/src/main/kotlin/com/system/location/service/core/carrier/CarrierListPropertyOwnership.kt`:

```kt
package com.system.location.service.core.carrier

import kotlinx.serialization.Serializable

@Serializable
data class CarrierListPropertyState(
    val baseline: Map<String, String?> = emptyMap(),
    val written: Map<String, String?> = emptyMap(),
) {
    fun validate() {
        require(baseline.size <= 16 && baseline.keys.all { key ->
            key.toIntOrNull()?.let { it in 0..15 && it.toString() == key } == true
        })
        require(written.size <= 2 && written.keys.all { key ->
            key.toIntOrNull()?.let { it in 0..1 && it.toString() == key } == true
        })
        require((baseline.values + written.values).all { it == null || it.length <= 1024 })
    }
}

data class CarrierListPropertyPlan(val values: List<String>, val state: CarrierListPropertyState)

/** Per-index ownership for framework telephony list properties. No persistent property is used. */
class CarrierListPropertyOwnership {
    private var baseline: Map<String, Any?> = emptyMap()
    private var written: Map<String, Any?> = emptyMap()

    fun plan(current: List<String>, next: Map<Int, String>): CarrierListPropertyPlan {
        require(current.size <= 16)
        require(next.keys.all { it in 0..1 })
        val values: Map<String, Any?> = current.mapIndexed { index, value -> index.toString() to value }.toMap()
        val restore = CarrierOverrideOwnership.restorePlan(baseline, values, written)
        val unpatched = values.toMutableMap().apply {
            restore.remove.forEach(::remove)
            putAll(restore.restore)
        }
        val nextBaseline = unpatched.toMap()
        val nextWritten = next.mapKeys { it.key.toString() }.toMutableMap()
        for (index in 0..(next.keys.maxOrNull() ?: -1)) {
            val key = index.toString()
            if (key !in unpatched && key !in nextWritten) nextWritten[key] = ""
        }
        unpatched.putAll(nextWritten)
        val last = unpatched.keys.maxOfOrNull { it.toInt() } ?: -1
        val result = (0..last).map { unpatched[it.toString()] as? String ?: "" }
        val state = CarrierListPropertyState(nextBaseline.mapValues { it.value as? String }, nextWritten)
        state.validate()
        return CarrierListPropertyPlan(result, state)
    }

    fun snapshot(): CarrierListPropertyState = CarrierListPropertyState(
        baseline.mapValues { it.value as? String }, written.mapValues { it.value as? String })

    fun restore(state: CarrierListPropertyState) {
        state.validate()
        baseline = state.baseline.toMap()
        written = state.written.toMap()
    }

    fun update(current: List<String>, next: Map<Int, String>, write: (List<String>) -> Unit): List<String> {
        val proposal = plan(current, next)
        if (proposal.values != current) write(proposal.values)
        restore(proposal.state)
        return proposal.values
    }

    fun ownsValues(): Boolean = written.isNotEmpty()
}
```

```kt
package com.system.location.service.core.carrier

/** Best-effort carrier band hints; a hint is editable and never asserted as live deployment. */
object CarrierNrBandCatalog {
    private val global = listOf(78)
    private val china = listOf(1, 3, 5, 8, 28, 41, 78, 79)
    private val unitedStates = listOf(2, 5, 7, 12, 13, 14, 25, 26, 41, 48, 66, 71, 77, 78)
    private val australia = listOf(1, 3, 5, 8, 28, 40, 41, 78, 79)

    fun commonBands(countryIso: String, mcc: Int, mnc: Int): List<Int> {
        return when (countryIso.uppercase(java.util.Locale.ROOT)) {
            "CN" -> when (mnc) {
                0, 2, 4, 7, 8 -> china
                1, 6, 9 -> listOf(1, 3, 8, 78)
                3, 5, 11 -> listOf(1, 3, 5, 8, 28, 78)
                else -> china
            }
            "US" -> when {
                mcc == 310 && mnc == 260 -> listOf(41, 66, 71, 77, 78)
                mcc == 310 && mnc == 410 -> listOf(2, 5, 12, 14, 25, 26, 66, 77)
                mcc == 311 && mnc == 480 -> listOf(2, 5, 13, 66, 77, 78)
                else -> unitedStates
            }
            "AU" -> australia
            else -> global
        }.filter { it in CarrierNrChannel.bands }
    }

    /** A valid default band for a country/carrier, preferring the catalog head. */
    fun defaultBand(countryIso: String, mcc: Int, mnc: Int): Int =
        commonBands(countryIso, mcc, mnc).firstOrNull() ?: 78
}
```

`core/src/main/kotlin/com/system/location/service/core/carrier/CarrierNrCellSource.kt`:

```kt
package com.system.location.service.core.carrier

import com.system.location.service.core.environment.CellTower
import com.system.location.service.core.environment.CellType
import com.system.location.service.core.geo.Wgs84
import kotlin.math.floor

/**
 * Offline NR SA generator. LTE references supply only relative signal ordering and cell count;
 * their CI, TAC, PCI and EARFCN are never reinterpreted as NR fields. Stable geographic tiles and
 * SIM identity seed a separate synthetic gNB/cell model. This is modeled data, not a tower lookup.
 */
object CarrierNrCellSource {
    fun cellsAt(point: Wgs84, seed: Long, profile: SimCarrierProfile,
        references: List<CellTower> = emptyList()): List<CellTower> {
        require(profile.radio == CarrierRadio.NR)
        val candidates = references.filter { it.type == CellType.LTE }
            .sortedByDescending { it.rsrp }.take(5)
        val count = if (candidates.isEmpty()) 4 else (candidates.size + 1).coerceIn(2, 6)
        var base = seed
        listOf(floor(point.latitude * 200).toLong(), floor(point.longitude * 200).toLong(),
            profile.mcc.toLong(), profile.mnc.toLong(), profile.slot.toLong()).forEach {
            base = mix(base xor it)
        }
        val area = 1 + positive(base) % 16777214
        val pciStart = (positive(mix(base)) % 1008).toInt()
        return (0 until count).map { index ->
            val hash = mix(base + index * 104729L)
            // A fixed 28-bit gNB component and 8-bit local cell ID form a 36-bit NCI.
            val gnb = 1L + positive(hash) % 268435454L
            val nci = (gnb shl 8) or (index + 1).toLong()
            val referenceSignal = candidates.getOrNull(index)?.rsrp
            val signal = if (index == 0) (referenceSignal ?: -85).coerceIn(-100, -65)
                else minOf(referenceSignal ?: (-95 - index * 3), -90 - index * 2).coerceAtLeast(-130)
            CellTower(type = CellType.NR, mcc = profile.mcc, mnc = profile.mnc,
                areaCode = area.toInt(), cellId = nci,
                pci = (pciStart + index * 37) % 1008,
                arfcn = profile.nrArfcn, rsrp = signal, rsrq = -10 - index,
                rssnr = 22 - index * 3, registered = index == 0,
                mncDigits = profile.mncDigits, operatorName = profile.operatorName,
                bands = listOf(profile.nrBand))
        }
    }

    private fun positive(value: Long): Long = value and Long.MAX_VALUE
    private fun mix(value: Long): Long {
        var v = value + -7046029254386353131L
        v = (v xor (v ushr 30)) * -4658895280553007687L
        v = (v xor (v ushr 27)) * -7723592293110705685L
        return v xor (v ushr 31)
    }
}
```

```kt
package com.system.location.service.core.carrier

/** FR1 downlink NR-ARFCN channel rasters, TS 38.101-1 table 5.4.2.3-1.
 * Uses the supported 100/15 kHz raster, not bandwidth-dependent valid carrier-center limits.
 * https://www.etsi.org/deliver/etsi_ts/138100_138199/13810101/18.08.00_60/ts_13810101v180800p.pdf
 */
object CarrierNrChannel {
    private data class Raster(val first: Int, val last: Int, val step: Int)
    private val rasters = mapOf(
        1 to Raster(422000, 434000, 20), 2 to Raster(386000, 398000, 20),
        3 to Raster(361000, 376000, 20), 5 to Raster(173800, 178800, 20),
        7 to Raster(524000, 538000, 20), 8 to Raster(185000, 192000, 20),
        12 to Raster(145800, 149200, 20), 13 to Raster(149200, 151200, 20),
        14 to Raster(151600, 153600, 20), 20 to Raster(158200, 164200, 20),
        25 to Raster(386000, 399000, 20), 26 to Raster(171800, 178800, 20),
        28 to Raster(151600, 160600, 20), 30 to Raster(470000, 472000, 20),
        38 to Raster(514000, 524000, 20), 40 to Raster(460000, 480000, 20),
        41 to Raster(499200, 537999, 3), 48 to Raster(636667, 646666, 1),
        66 to Raster(422000, 440000, 20), 71 to Raster(123400, 130400, 20),
        77 to Raster(620000, 680000, 1), 78 to Raster(620000, 653333, 1),
        79 to Raster(693334, 733333, 1),
    )
    val bands: Set<Int> = rasters.keys

    fun valid(band: Int, arfcn: Int): Boolean = rasters[band]?.let {
        arfcn in it.first..it.last && (arfcn - it.first) % it.step == 0
    } ?: false

    fun defaultArfcn(band: Int): Int = when (band) {
        1 -> 430000; 2 -> 390000; 3 -> 370000; 5 -> 176000
        7 -> 530000; 8 -> 188000; 12 -> 147000; 13 -> 150000
        14 -> 152500; 20 -> 159000; 25 -> 392000; 26 -> 175000
        28 -> 156000; 30 -> 471000; 38 -> 519000; 40 -> 470000
        41 -> 520002; 48 -> 645000; 66 -> 430000; 71 -> 127000
        77 -> 650000; 78 -> 640000; 79 -> 713334
        else -> error("Unsupported NR band")
    }
}
```

`core/src/main/kotlin/com/system/location/service/core/carrier/CarrierOverrideOwnership.kt`:

```kt
package com.system.location.service.core.carrier

/** Changes needed to undo an overlay while preserving updates made by another writer. */
data class CarrierOverrideRestorePlan(
    val remove: Set<String>,
    val restore: Map<String, Any?>,
)

object CarrierOverrideOwnership {
    /** Update the restore baseline only where the temporary layer no longer matches our write. */
    fun rebase(
        baseline: Map<String, Any?>,
        current: Map<String, Any?>,
        written: Map<String, Any?>,
        nextKeys: Set<String>,
    ): Map<String, Any?> = baseline.toMutableMap().apply {
        nextKeys.forEach { key ->
            val stillOwned = written.containsKey(key) && current.containsKey(key) &&
                current[key] == written[key]
            if (!stillOwned) {
                if (current.containsKey(key)) put(key, current[key]) else remove(key)
            }
        }
    }

    fun restorePlan(
        baseline: Map<String, Any?>,
        current: Map<String, Any?>,
        written: Map<String, Any?>,
    ): CarrierOverrideRestorePlan {
        val matching = written.keys.filterTo(linkedSetOf()) { key ->
            current.containsKey(key) && current[key] == written[key]
        }
        return CarrierOverrideRestorePlan(matching, baseline.filterKeys { it in matching })
    }
}
```

`core/src/main/kotlin/com/system/location/service/core/carrier/CarrierPhoneNumbers.kt`:

```kt
package com.system.location.service.core.carrier

import java.security.SecureRandom
import java.util.zip.GZIPInputStream
import kotlinx.serialization.Serializable
import kotlinx.serialization.builtins.ListSerializer
import kotlinx.serialization.json.Json

@Serializable
data class CarrierPhoneRegion(val iso: String, val callingCode: String, val example: String,
    val pattern: String, val kind: String)

data class CarrierPhoneCity(val name: String, val operator: String)

/** Offline allocation/format data; generated numbers are not assigned network credentials. */
object CarrierPhoneNumbers {
    private val random = SecureRandom()
    val regions: List<CarrierPhoneRegion> by lazy {
        val text = checkNotNull(javaClass.getResourceAsStream("/carrier/phone-regions.json"))
            .bufferedReader().use { it.readText() }
        Json.decodeFromString(ListSerializer(CarrierPhoneRegion.serializer()), text)
    }
    private val cityPrefixes: Map<CarrierPhoneCity, List<String>> by lazy {
        val stream = checkNotNull(javaClass.getResourceAsStream("/carrier/cn-mobile-cities.tsv.gz"))
        GZIPInputStream(stream).bufferedReader().useLines { lines ->
            lines.map { line -> line.split('|').let { CarrierPhoneCity(it[0], it[1]) to it[2] } }
                .groupBy({ it.first }, { it.second })
        }
    }
    private val patterns by lazy { regions.associate { it.iso to Regex(it.pattern) } }

    fun chinaOperator(mcc: Int, mnc: Int, mncDigits: Int): String? = when (
        mcc.toString().padStart(3, '0') + mnc.toString().padStart(mncDigits, '0')) {
        "46000", "46002", "46004", "46007", "46008" -> "CMCC"
        "46001", "46006", "46009" -> "CUCC"
        "46003", "46005", "46011" -> "CTCC"
        "46015" -> "CBN"
        else -> null
    }

    fun cities(operator: String?): List<CarrierPhoneCity> = cityPrefixes.keys
        .filter { operator == null || it.operator == operator }.sortedBy { it.name }

    fun normalize(input: String): String {
        if (input.isBlank()) return ""
        val value = input.trim().filterNot { it == ' ' || it == '-' || it == '(' || it == ')' }
        require(value.matches(Regex("\\+?[1-9][0-9]{5,14}"))) { "号码需为 6–15 位数字，可带 + 国家码" }
        return value
    }

    fun matchesRegion(number: String, iso: String): Boolean {
        val region = regions.firstOrNull { it.iso == iso } ?: return false
        return number.startsWith("+" + region.callingCode) &&
            patterns.getValue(iso).matches(number.removePrefix("+" + region.callingCode))
    }

    fun generate(iso: String, city: String = "", operator: String? = null): String {
        if (iso == "CN") {
            require(operator != null) { "请先选择可识别的中国运营商预设，再选择城市" }
            val prefixes = cityPrefixes[CarrierPhoneCity(city, operator)]
                ?: error("所选城市没有匹配此运营商的可用号段")
            val prefix = prefixes[random.nextInt(prefixes.size)]
            return "+86" + prefix + random.nextInt(10_000).toString().padStart(4, '0')
        }
        val region = regions.firstOrNull { it.iso == iso }
            ?: error("该国家/地区暂无可用号码规则，请手动填写")
        val pattern = patterns.getValue(iso)
        // Keep the example's regional allocation prefix (notably shared +1 country codes),
        // randomize at least the last four subscriber digits, and validate the complete pattern.
        val suffixSize = minOf(6, maxOf(1, region.example.length - 3))
        repeat(2048) {
            val candidate = region.example.dropLast(suffixSize) + buildString {
                repeat(suffixSize) { append(random.nextInt(10)) }
            }
            if (candidate != region.example && pattern.matches(candidate)) return "+${region.callingCode}$candidate"
        }
        error("该国家/地区的号码规则暂不能生成，请手动填写")
    }

    fun belongsToCity(number: String, city: CarrierPhoneCity): Boolean =
        number.startsWith("+86") && number.length == 14 &&
            cityPrefixes[city]?.contains(number.substring(3, 10)) == true
}
```

```kt
package com.system.location.service.core.carrier

import kotlinx.serialization.Serializable

/** Pending and committed footprints cover a crash on either side of the property setter. */
@Serializable
data class CarrierPropertyJournalEntry(
    val committed: CarrierListPropertyState,
    val pending: CarrierListPropertyState? = null,
) {
    fun recover(current: List<String>): List<String> {
        val owner = CarrierListPropertyOwnership()
        val candidate = pending?.let {
            owner.restore(it)
            owner.plan(current, emptyMap()).values
        } ?: current
        owner.restore(committed)
        return owner.plan(candidate, emptyMap()).values
    }
}

@Serializable

    val bootCount: Int,
    val version: Int = 1,
    val fields: Map<String, CarrierPropertyJournalEntry> = emptyMap(),
)
```

`core/src/main/kotlin/com/system/location/service/core/carrier/CarrierSubscriptionSelection.kt`:

```kt
package com.system.location.service.core.carrier

/** Platform IDs are not interchangeable: phone IDs are zero-based slots, sub IDs are opaque. */
object CarrierSubscriptionSelection {
    const val DEFAULT_SUBSCRIPTION_ID = Int.MAX_VALUE
    fun slot(method: String, requestedId: Int?, subscriptions: Map<Int, Int>, defaultSubId: Int): Int? {
        val phoneIndex = method.endsWith("ForPhone") || method.endsWith("ForSlot")
        val result = if (phoneIndex) {
            requestedId?.takeIf { it in 0..1 }?.plus(1)
        } else {
            val subId = if (requestedId == null || requestedId == DEFAULT_SUBSCRIPTION_ID) defaultSubId
                else requestedId
            subscriptions[subId]
        }
        return result?.takeIf { it in 1..2 && it in subscriptions.values }
    }
}
```

`core/src/main/kotlin/com/system/location/service/core/carrier/CarrierVirtualIdentity.kt`:

```kt
package com.system.location.service.core.carrier

/** Stable modeled identifiers derived from a controller-persisted seed and slot/PLMN.
 * A valid checksum and format do not imply an assigned issuer or a network credential.
 */
object CarrierVirtualIdentity {
    const val VIRTUAL_SUB_ID_BASE = 900_000_000
    const val UNKNOWN_CARRIER_ID = -1

    fun subscriptionId(profile: SimCarrierProfile): Int =
        profile.virtualSubscriptionId.takeIf { it > 0 } ?: subscriptionId(profile.slot)

    /** Legacy compatibility only; controllers assign and persist a profile ID before sending. */
    fun subscriptionId(slot: Int): Int {
        require(slot in 1..2) { "SIM slot must be 1 or 2" }
        return VIRTUAL_SUB_ID_BASE + slot
    }

    fun slotForSubscriptionId(subId: Int, profiles: List<SimCarrierProfile> = emptyList()): Int? =
        if (profiles.isNotEmpty()) profiles.firstOrNull { subscriptionId(it) == subId }?.slot
        else (subId - VIRTUAL_SUB_ID_BASE).takeIf { it in 1..2 }

    /** Base MNO identities from AOSP carrier_list.textpb (no MVNO GID/SPN matching).
     * Unknown PLMNs retain Android's -1; a positive arbitrary number is not a carrier identity.
     * https://android.googlesource.com/platform/packages/providers/TelephonyProvider/+/refs/heads/main/assets/latest_carrier_id/carrier_list.textpb
     */
    fun carrierId(profile: SimCarrierProfile): Int = when (profile.operatorNumeric) {
        "310260" -> 1 // T-Mobile US
        "310410" -> 1187 // AT&T
        "311480" -> 1839 // Verizon Wireless
        "50501", "50539", "50571", "50572" -> 1345 // Telstra
        "50502", "50590" -> 30 // Optus
        "50503" -> 15 // Vodafone AU
        "46000", "46002", "46004", "46007", "46008" -> 1435
        "46001", "46006", "46009" -> 1436
        "46003", "46011" -> 2237
        else -> UNKNOWN_CARRIER_ID
    }

    /** Modeled E.118-shaped 20-digit ICCID, not an assigned issuer credential. */
    fun iccid(profile: SimCarrierProfile): String {
        // Country calling code, not MCC. Unknown issuers use a neutral modeled prefix rather
        // than claiming every SIM was issued in the United Kingdom (the old fixed 8944).
        val callingCode = when (profile.countryIso) {
            "CN" -> "86"; "US", "CA" -> "1"; "AU" -> "61"
            "GB" -> "44"; "DE" -> "49"; "FR" -> "33"
            "JP" -> "81"; "KR" -> "82"; "HK" -> "852"; "TW" -> "886"
            "SG" -> "65"; "NZ" -> "64"; else -> "00"
        }
        val prefix = "89$callingCode"
        val body = prefix + digits(profile, "iccid", 19 - prefix.length)
        return body + luhnCheckDigit(body)
    }

    /** MCC/MNC plus stable per-profile subscriber digits; names and radio edits preserve identity. */
    fun imsi(profile: SimCarrierProfile): String =
        profile.operatorNumeric + digits(profile, "imsi", 15 - profile.operatorNumeric.length)

    private fun digits(profile: SimCarrierProfile, kind: String, count: Int): String {
        val input = "$kind:${profile.identitySeed}:${profile.slot}:${profile.operatorNumeric}"
        val digest = java.security.MessageDigest.getInstance("SHA-256")
            .digest(input.toByteArray(Charsets.UTF_8))
        return digest.take(count).joinToString("") { ((it.toInt() and 255) % 10).toString() }
    }

    private fun luhnCheckDigit(body: String): Char {
        var sum = 0
        for ((index, char) in body.reversed().withIndex()) {
            var digit = char.digitToIntOrNull() ?: 0
            if (index % 2 == 0) {
                digit *= 2
                if (digit > 9) digit -= 9
            }
            sum += digit
        }
        return ((10 - sum % 10) % 10).digitToChar()
    }
}
```

```kt
package com.system.location.service.core.carrier

/** Only explicitly visible virtual profiles participate; absent slots remain absent. */
object CarrierVirtualTopology {
    fun slotForSubscription(profiles: List<SimCarrierProfile>, subId: Int): Int? =
        profiles.firstOrNull { it.virtual && it.enabled && it.virtualSubscriptionId > 0 &&
            CarrierVirtualIdentity.subscriptionId(it) == subId }?.slot

    fun subscriptionForPhone(profiles: List<SimCarrierProfile>, phoneId: Int): Int? =
        profiles.firstOrNull { it.virtual && it.enabled && it.virtualSubscriptionId > 0 && it.slot == phoneId + 1 }
            ?.let { CarrierVirtualIdentity.subscriptionId(it) }

    fun activeIds(physicalIds: IntArray, profiles: List<SimCarrierProfile>): IntArray =
        (physicalIds.toList() + profiles.filter { it.virtual && it.enabled && it.virtualSubscriptionId > 0 }
```

`core/src/main/kotlin/com/system/location/service/core/config/ConfigEnvelope.kt`:

```kt
package com.system.location.service.core.config

import com.system.location.service.core.environment.EnvironmentConfig
import com.system.location.service.core.playback.NoiseProfile
import com.system.location.service.core.providers.ProviderProfile
import com.system.location.service.core.routing.RoutingConfig
import com.system.location.service.core.scenario.Scenario
import kotlinx.serialization.Serializable
import kotlinx.serialization.json.Json
import kotlinx.serialization.json.JsonObject
import kotlinx.serialization.json.JsonPrimitive
import kotlinx.serialization.json.intOrNull
import kotlinx.serialization.json.jsonObject

@Serializable
data class ConfigEnvelope(
    val schemaVersion: Int = CURRENT_SCHEMA_VERSION,
    val revision: Long = 0L,
    val scenario: Scenario,
    val routing: RoutingConfig = RoutingConfig(),
    val environment: EnvironmentConfig = EnvironmentConfig(),
    val noise: NoiseProfile = NoiseProfile(),
    val providers: List<ProviderProfile> = ProviderProfile.defaults(),
    val updatedAtMillis: Long = 0L,
    val replayEnvironmentJson: String? = null,
) {
    init {
        require(schemaVersion == CURRENT_SCHEMA_VERSION) { "Unsupported schemaVersion: $schemaVersion" }
        require(revision >= 0L) { "revision must be non-negative" }
        require(updatedAtMillis >= 0L) { "updatedAtMillis must be non-negative" }
        require(providers.isNotEmpty()) { "providers must not be empty" }
        require(providers.map { it.kind }.distinct().size == providers.size) { "duplicate provider kind" }
        require(providers.size <= MAX_PROVIDERS) { "Too many providers: ${providers.size}" }
        require(replayEnvironmentJson == null || replayEnvironmentJson.length <= MAX_REPLAY_JSON_CHARS) {
            "replayEnvironmentJson is too large"
        }
    }

    companion object {
        const val CURRENT_SCHEMA_VERSION = 3
        const val MAX_PROVIDERS = 16
        const val MAX_REPLAY_JSON_CHARS = 64 * 1024
    }
}

class ConfigException(message: String, cause: Throwable? = null) : IllegalArgumentException(message, cause)

/**
 * Versioned config codec (P5-03).
 *
 * v1 (legacy) only carried scenario/revision/timestamp; v2 adds routing, environment and noise
 * blocks; v3 adds the replay environment JSON. Readers accept v1/v2/v3 and fill defaults; writers
 * always emit the current version. Unknown fields are ignored so an older app can still open a
 * config written by a newer build as long as the schema version is known.
 */
object ConfigCodec {
    const val CURRENT_SCHEMA_VERSION = ConfigEnvelope.CURRENT_SCHEMA_VERSION
    const val VERSION_FIELD = "schemaVersion"

    private val json = Json {
        ignoreUnknownKeys = true
        encodeDefaults = true
        explicitNulls = false
    }

    fun encode(config: ConfigEnvelope): String = json.encodeToString(ConfigEnvelope.serializer(), config)

    fun decode(raw: String): ConfigEnvelope {
        val root: JsonObject = runCatching { json.parseToJsonElement(raw).jsonObject }
            .getOrElse { throw ConfigException("Config is not a JSON object", it) }
        val version = (root[VERSION_FIELD] as? JsonPrimitive)?.intOrNull
            ?: throw ConfigException("Missing $VERSION_FIELD")
        return when (version) {
            1 -> migrateV1(json.decodeFromJsonElement(LegacyConfigV1.serializer(), root))
            2 -> runCatching { json.decodeFromJsonElement(LegacyConfigV2.serializer(), root) }
                .getOrElse { throw ConfigException("Invalid v2 config", it) }
                .let(::migrateV2)
            3 -> runCatching { json.decodeFromJsonElement(ConfigEnvelope.serializer(), root) }
                .getOrElse { throw ConfigException("Invalid v3 config", it) }
            else -> throw ConfigException("Unsupported schemaVersion: $version")
        }
    }

    private fun migrateV1(legacy: LegacyConfigV1): ConfigEnvelope = ConfigEnvelope(
        schemaVersion = CURRENT_SCHEMA_VERSION,
        revision = legacy.revision,
        scenario = legacy.scenario,
        updatedAtMillis = legacy.updatedAtMillis,
    )

    private fun migrateV2(legacy: LegacyConfigV2): ConfigEnvelope = ConfigEnvelope(
        schemaVersion = CURRENT_SCHEMA_VERSION,
        revision = legacy.revision,
        scenario = legacy.scenario,
        routing = legacy.routing,
        environment = legacy.environment,
        noise = legacy.noise,
        providers = legacy.providers,
        updatedAtMillis = legacy.updatedAtMillis,
    )

    @Serializable
    private data class LegacyConfigV2(
        val schemaVersion: Int = 2,
        val revision: Long = 0L,
        val scenario: Scenario,
        val routing: RoutingConfig = RoutingConfig(),
        val environment: EnvironmentConfig = EnvironmentConfig(),
        val noise: NoiseProfile = NoiseProfile(),
        val providers: List<ProviderProfile> = ProviderProfile.defaults(),
        val updatedAtMillis: Long = 0L,
    )

    @Serializable
    private data class LegacyConfigV1(
        val schemaVersion: Int = 1,
        val revision: Long = 0L,
        val scenario: Scenario,
        val updatedAtMillis: Long = 0L,
    )
}
```

`core/src/main/kotlin/com/system/location/service/core/config/SampleEnvelope.kt`:

```kt
package com.system.location.service.core.config

import com.system.location.service.core.location.LocationSample
import com.system.location.service.core.providers.ProviderKind
import kotlinx.serialization.Serializable
import kotlinx.serialization.json.Json
import kotlinx.serialization.json.JsonObject
import kotlinx.serialization.json.JsonPrimitive
import kotlinx.serialization.json.intOrNull
import kotlinx.serialization.json.jsonObject

/**
 * Versioned sample envelope (P5-03).
 *
 * v2 adds provider/field/environment metadata to the raw `LocationSample`. A raw v1
 * `LocationSample` JSON object is still accepted and wrapped with defaults, so an old producer can
 * keep publishing while a new consumer starts using the extra metadata.
 */
@Serializable
data class SampleEnvelope(
    val schemaVersion: Int = CURRENT_SCHEMA_VERSION,
    val sample: LocationSample,
    val provider: ProviderKind? = null,
    val fieldsMask: Int = 0,
    val environmentVersion: Long = 0L,
    val configRevision: Long = 0L,
) {
    init {
        require(schemaVersion == CURRENT_SCHEMA_VERSION) { "Unsupported sample schemaVersion: $schemaVersion" }
        require(fieldsMask >= 0) { "fieldsMask must be non-negative" }
        require(environmentVersion >= 0L) { "environmentVersion must be non-negative" }
        require(configRevision >= 0L) { "configRevision must be non-negative" }
    }

    companion object {
        const val CURRENT_SCHEMA_VERSION = 2
    }
}

object SampleCodec {
    private val json = Json {
        ignoreUnknownKeys = true
        encodeDefaults = true
        explicitNulls = false
    }

    fun encode(envelope: SampleEnvelope): String = json.encodeToString(SampleEnvelope.serializer(), envelope)

    fun decode(raw: String): SampleEnvelope {
        val root: JsonObject = runCatching { json.parseToJsonElement(raw).jsonObject }
            .getOrElse { throw ConfigException("Sample is not a JSON object", it) }
        val version = (root[ConfigCodec.VERSION_FIELD] as? JsonPrimitive)?.intOrNull
        if (version == null) {
            val sample = runCatching { json.decodeFromJsonElement(LocationSample.serializer(), root) }
                .getOrElse { throw ConfigException("Invalid v1 sample", it) }
            return SampleEnvelope(sample = sample)
        }
        return when (version) {
            SampleEnvelope.CURRENT_SCHEMA_VERSION -> runCatching {
                json.decodeFromJsonElement(SampleEnvelope.serializer(), root)
            }.getOrElse { throw ConfigException("Invalid v2 sample", it) }
            1 -> {
                val sample = runCatching { json.decodeFromJsonElement(LocationSample.serializer(), root) }
                    .getOrElse { throw ConfigException("Invalid v1 sample", it) }
                SampleEnvelope(sample = sample)
            }
            else -> throw ConfigException("Unsupported sample schemaVersion: $version")
        }
    }
}
```

```kt
package com.system.location.service.core.environment

import com.system.location.service.core.geo.Wgs84
import kotlinx.serialization.Serializable

/** Where the slow environment (WiFi/cell/BLE) comes from. */
enum class EnvironmentSourceType { PROCEDURAL, REPLAY, DATABASE }

/** Cell profile selected by [EnvironmentConfig.cellMode]; AUTO resolves at runtime. */
enum class CellMode { AUTO, FULL_REPLAY, NO_SIM_WIFI_ONLY, LEGACY_CDMA }

/** Pure AUTO resolution shared by the hook and future collection/replay tooling (P2-05). */
object CellModePolicy {
    fun resolve(configured: CellMode, simReady: Boolean): CellMode = when (configured) {
        CellMode.AUTO -> if (simReady) CellMode.FULL_REPLAY else CellMode.NO_SIM_WIFI_ONLY
        else -> configured
    }

    fun isLegacyCdma(mode: CellMode): Boolean = mode == CellMode.LEGACY_CDMA
}

enum class CellType { GSM, WCDMA, LTE, NR }

@Serializable
data class EnvironmentConfig(
    val source: EnvironmentSourceType = EnvironmentSourceType.PROCEDURAL,
    val apPerCell: Int = 4,
    val cellMode: CellMode = CellMode.AUTO,
    val enableBle: Boolean = false,
) {
    init {
        require(apPerCell in MIN_AP_PER_CELL..MAX_AP_PER_CELL) {
            "apPerCell must be in $MIN_AP_PER_CELL..$MAX_AP_PER_CELL"
        }
    }

    companion object {
        const val MIN_AP_PER_CELL = 3
        const val MAX_AP_PER_CELL = 8
    }
}

@Serializable
data class WifiAp(
    val ssid: String,
    val bssid: String,
    val rssi: Int,
    val frequencyMhz: Int,
    val channel: Int,
    val capabilities: String = "[WPA2-PSK-CCMP][ESS]",
    val standard: Int = 4,
    val connected: Boolean = false,
) {
    init {
        require(ssid.isNotBlank() && ssid.toByteArray(Charsets.UTF_8).size <= MAX_SSID_BYTES) {
            "SSID must contain 1..$MAX_SSID_BYTES UTF-8 bytes"
        }
        require(BSSID_PATTERN.matches(bssid)) { "Invalid BSSID: $bssid" }
        require(!bssid.equals(SENTINEL_BSSID, ignoreCase = true)) { "Sentinel BSSID is not a valid AP" }
        require(rssi in MIN_RSSI..MAX_RSSI) { "RSSI out of range: $rssi" }
        require(frequencyMhz in MIN_FREQUENCY_MHZ..MAX_FREQUENCY_MHZ) {
            "Frequency out of range: $frequencyMhz"
        }
        require(channel in MIN_CHANNEL..MAX_CHANNEL) { "Channel out of range: $channel" }
        require(standard in MIN_STANDARD..MAX_STANDARD) { "Wi-Fi standard out of range: $standard" }
    }

    companion object {
        const val MAX_SSID_BYTES = 32
        const val MIN_RSSI = -100
        const val MAX_RSSI = 0
        const val MIN_FREQUENCY_MHZ = 2_400
        const val MAX_FREQUENCY_MHZ = 7_125
        const val MIN_CHANNEL = 1
        const val MAX_CHANNEL = 233
        const val MIN_STANDARD = 0
        const val MAX_STANDARD = 8
        const val SENTINEL_BSSID = "02:00:00:00:00:00"
        val BSSID_PATTERN = Regex("^([0-9A-Fa-f]{2}:){5}[0-9A-Fa-f]{2}$")

        fun channelForFrequencyMhz(frequencyMhz: Int): Int? = when {
            frequencyMhz == 2484 -> 14
            frequencyMhz in 2412..2472 && (frequencyMhz - 2407) % 5 == 0 ->
                (frequencyMhz - 2407) / 5
            frequencyMhz in 4910..4980 && (frequencyMhz - 4000) % 5 == 0 ->
                (frequencyMhz - 4000) / 5
            frequencyMhz in 5005..5895 && (frequencyMhz - 5000) % 5 == 0 ->
                (frequencyMhz - 5000) / 5
            frequencyMhz == 5935 -> 2
            frequencyMhz in 5955..7115 && (frequencyMhz - 5950) % 20 == 5 ->
                (frequencyMhz - 5950) / 5
            else -> null
        }
    }
}

@Serializable
data class CellTower(
    val type: CellType,
    val mcc: Int,
    val mnc: Int,
    val areaCode: Int,
    val cellId: Long,
    val pci: Int? = null,
    val arfcn: Int? = null,
    val rsrp: Int,
    val rsrq: Int? = null,
    val rssnr: Int? = null,
    val registered: Boolean = false,
    val mncDigits: Int? = null,
    val operatorName: String? = null,
    val bands: List<Int> = emptyList(),
) {
    init {
        require(bands.size <= 16 && bands.all { it in 1..1024 } && bands.distinct().size == bands.size) {
            "Invalid cell bands"
        }
        require(mcc in 1..999) { "mcc out of range: $mcc" }
        require(mnc in 0..999) { "mnc out of range: $mnc" }
        mncDigits?.let {
            require(it in MIN_MNC_DIGITS..MAX_MNC_DIGITS) { "mncDigits out of range: $it" }
            require(mnc < powerOfTen(it)) { "mnc does not fit mncDigits: $mnc / $it" }
        }
        operatorName?.let {
            require(it.isNotBlank() && it.toByteArray(Charsets.UTF_8).size <= MAX_OPERATOR_NAME_BYTES) {
                "operatorName must contain 1..$MAX_OPERATOR_NAME_BYTES UTF-8 bytes"
            }
        }
        require(areaCode >= 0) { "areaCode must be non-negative" }
        val maxCellId = when (type) {
            CellType.GSM -> MAX_GSM_CID
            CellType.WCDMA, CellType.LTE -> MAX_LTE_CID
            CellType.NR -> MAX_NR_NCI
        }
        require(cellId in 1..maxCellId) { "cellId out of range for $type: $cellId" }
        val maxAreaCode = if (type == CellType.GSM || type == CellType.WCDMA) MAX_LAC else MAX_TAC
        require(areaCode <= maxAreaCode) { "areaCode out of range for $type: $areaCode" }
        val signalRange = when (type) {
            CellType.GSM -> MIN_GSM_RSSI..MAX_GSM_RSSI
            CellType.WCDMA -> MIN_WCDMA_RSCP..MAX_WCDMA_RSCP
            CellType.LTE, CellType.NR -> MIN_RSRP..MAX_RSRP
        }
        require(rsrp in signalRange) { "signal out of range for $type: $rsrp" }
        pci?.let {
            val maxPci = when (type) {
                CellType.GSM -> MAX_GSM_BSIC
                CellType.WCDMA -> MAX_WCDMA_PSC
                CellType.LTE -> MAX_LTE_PCI
                CellType.NR -> MAX_NR_PCI
            }
            require(it in 0..maxPci) { "pci out of range for $type: $it" }
        }
        arfcn?.let {
            val maxArfcn = when (type) {
                CellType.GSM -> MAX_GSM_ARFCN
                CellType.WCDMA -> MAX_WCDMA_UARFCN
                CellType.LTE -> MAX_LTE_EARFCN
                CellType.NR -> MAX_NR_ARFCN
            }
            require(it in 0..maxArfcn) { "arfcn out of range for $type: $it" }
        }
    }

    val operatorNumeric: String?
        get() = mncDigits?.let { "${mcc.toString().padStart(3, '0')}${mnc.toString().padStart(it, '0')}" }

    private fun powerOfTen(digits: Int): Int = when (digits) {
        2 -> 100
        3 -> 1_000
        else -> 0
    }

    companion object {
        const val MIN_MNC_DIGITS = 2
        const val MAX_MNC_DIGITS = 3
        const val MAX_OPERATOR_NAME_BYTES = 128
        const val MAX_GSM_CID = 65_535L
        const val MAX_LTE_CID = 268_435_455L
        const val MAX_NR_NCI = 68_719_476_735L
        const val MAX_LAC = 65_535
        const val MAX_TAC = 16_777_215
        const val MIN_GSM_RSSI = -113
        const val MAX_GSM_RSSI = -51
        const val MIN_WCDMA_RSCP = -120
        const val MAX_WCDMA_RSCP = -25
        const val MAX_GSM_BSIC = 63
        const val MAX_WCDMA_PSC = 511
        const val MAX_LTE_PCI = 503
        const val MAX_NR_PCI = 1_007
        const val MAX_GSM_ARFCN = 1_023
        const val MAX_WCDMA_UARFCN = 16_383
        const val MAX_LTE_EARFCN = 262_143
        const val MAX_NR_ARFCN = 3_279_165
        const val MIN_RSRP = -156
        const val MAX_RSRP = -31
        const val MIN_LTE_RSRP = -140
        const val MAX_LTE_RSRP = -43
        const val MIN_NR_RSRP = -156
        const val MAX_NR_RSRP = -31
        const val MIN_LTE_RSRQ = -20
        const val MAX_LTE_RSRQ = -3
        const val MIN_NR_RSRQ = -43
        const val MAX_NR_RSRQ = 20
        const val MIN_LTE_RSSNR = -20
        const val MAX_LTE_RSSNR = 30
        const val MIN_NR_SINR = -23
        const val MAX_NR_SINR = 40
    }
}

data class CellSignalMetrics(val rsrp: Int, val rsrq: Int?, val rssnr: Int?)

/** Converts platform radio measurements without turning unavailable sentinels into plausible values. */
object CellSignalPolicy {
    private const val UNAVAILABLE = Int.MAX_VALUE

    fun lte(rsrp: Int, rsrq: Int, rssnr: Int): CellSignalMetrics? {
        if (rsrp !in CellTower.MIN_LTE_RSRP..CellTower.MAX_LTE_RSRP) return null
        return CellSignalMetrics(
            rsrp = rsrp,
            rsrq = rsrq.takeIf { it != UNAVAILABLE && it in CellTower.MIN_LTE_RSRQ..CellTower.MAX_LTE_RSRQ },
            rssnr = rssnr.takeIf { it != UNAVAILABLE && it in CellTower.MIN_LTE_RSSNR..CellTower.MAX_LTE_RSSNR },
        )
    }

    fun nr(rsrp: Int, rsrq: Int, sinr: Int): CellSignalMetrics? {
        if (rsrp !in CellTower.MIN_NR_RSRP..CellTower.MAX_NR_RSRP) return null
        return CellSignalMetrics(
            rsrp = rsrp,
            rsrq = rsrq.takeIf { it != UNAVAILABLE && it in CellTower.MIN_NR_RSRQ..CellTower.MAX_NR_RSRQ },
            rssnr = sinr.takeIf { it != UNAVAILABLE && it in CellTower.MIN_NR_SINR..CellTower.MAX_NR_SINR },
        )
    }
}

/** CDMA uses SID/NID/BID identity and does not share the MCC/MNC/LAC/CID fields above. */
@Serializable
data class CdmaTower(
    val systemId: Int,
    val networkId: Int,
    val baseStationId: Int,
    val latitudeQuarterSeconds: Int? = null,
    val longitudeQuarterSeconds: Int? = null,
    val cdmaDbm: Int? = null,
    val cdmaEcio: Int? = null,
    val evdoDbm: Int? = null,
    val evdoEcio: Int? = null,
    val evdoSnr: Int? = null,
    val registered: Boolean = false,
) {
    init {
        require(systemId in MIN_SYSTEM_ID..MAX_SYSTEM_ID) { "systemId out of range: $systemId" }
        require(networkId in MIN_NETWORK_ID..MAX_NETWORK_ID) { "networkId out of range: $networkId" }
        require(baseStationId in MIN_BASE_STATION_ID..MAX_BASE_STATION_ID) {
            "baseStationId out of range: $baseStationId"
        }
        require((latitudeQuarterSeconds == null) == (longitudeQuarterSeconds == null)) {
            "CDMA latitude and longitude must be set together"
        }
        latitudeQuarterSeconds?.let { require(it in MIN_LATITUDE_QUARTER_SECONDS..MAX_LATITUDE_QUARTER_SECONDS) }
        longitudeQuarterSeconds?.let { require(it in MIN_LONGITUDE_QUARTER_SECONDS..MAX_LONGITUDE_QUARTER_SECONDS) }
        cdmaDbm?.let { require(it in MIN_SIGNAL_DBM..MAX_SIGNAL_DBM) }
        cdmaEcio?.let { require(it in MIN_ECIO_DB..MAX_ECIO_DB) }
        evdoDbm?.let { require(it in MIN_SIGNAL_DBM..MAX_SIGNAL_DBM) }
        evdoEcio?.let { require(it in MIN_ECIO_DB..MAX_ECIO_DB) }
        evdoSnr?.let { require(it in MIN_EVDO_SNR..MAX_EVDO_SNR) }
    }

    companion object {
        const val MIN_SYSTEM_ID = 0
        const val MAX_SYSTEM_ID = 32_767
        const val MIN_NETWORK_ID = 0
        const val MAX_NETWORK_ID = 65_535
        const val MIN_BASE_STATION_ID = 0
        const val MAX_BASE_STATION_ID = 65_535
        const val MIN_LATITUDE_QUARTER_SECONDS = -1_296_000
        const val MAX_LATITUDE_QUARTER_SECONDS = 1_296_000
        const val MIN_LONGITUDE_QUARTER_SECONDS = -2_592_000
        const val MAX_LONGITUDE_QUARTER_SECONDS = 2_592_000
        const val MIN_SIGNAL_DBM = -160
        const val MAX_SIGNAL_DBM = -1
        const val MIN_ECIO_DB = -160
        const val MAX_ECIO_DB = 0
        const val MIN_EVDO_SNR = 0
        const val MAX_EVDO_SNR = 8
    }
}

@Serializable
data class BleBeacon(
    val address: String,
    val name: String,
    val rssi: Int,
    val scanRecordHex: String? = null,
    val txPowerDbm: Int? = null,
) {
    init {
        require(BSSID_PATTERN.matches(address)) { "Invalid BLE address: $address" }
        require(name.toByteArray(Charsets.UTF_8).size <= MAX_NAME_BYTES) {
            "BLE name exceeds $MAX_NAME_BYTES UTF-8 bytes"
        }
        require(rssi in -100..0) { "BLE RSSI out of range: $rssi" }
        scanRecordHex?.let {
            require(it.length % 2 == 0 && it.length <= MAX_SCAN_RECORD_BYTES * 2 &&
                it.all { c -> c in '0'..'9' || c.lowercaseChar() in 'a'..'f' }) {
                "Invalid BLE advertisement hex"
            }
        }
        txPowerDbm?.let { require(it in MIN_TX_POWER_DBM..MAX_TX_POWER_DBM) }
    }

    companion object {
        const val MAX_NAME_BYTES = 248
        const val MAX_SCAN_RECORD_BYTES = 1_650
        const val MIN_TX_POWER_DBM = -127
        const val MAX_TX_POWER_DBM = 126
        private val BSSID_PATTERN = Regex("^([0-9A-Fa-f]{2}:){5}[0-9A-Fa-f]{2}$")

        fun isValidAdvertisementHex(hex: String): Boolean {
            if (hex.isEmpty() || hex.length % 2 != 0 || hex.length > MAX_SCAN_RECORD_BYTES * 2 ||
                !hex.all { c -> c in '0'..'9' || c.lowercaseChar() in 'a'..'f' }) return false
            val bytes = hex.chunked(2).map { it.toInt(16) }
            var offset = 0
            var structures = 0
            while (offset < bytes.size) {
                val length = bytes[offset]
                if (length == 0) return structures > 0
                if (length > bytes.size - offset - 1) return false
                offset += length + 1
                structures++
            }
            return structures > 0
        }
    }
}

/**
 * Slow-variable environment snapshot; GNSS is a fast variable and is modeled separately (P3-01).
 * Bounded lists keep an imported/replayed profile from becoming an unbounded IPC payload.
 */
@Serializable
data class EnvironmentProfile(
    val source: EnvironmentSourceType,
    val origin: Wgs84? = null,
    val originAccuracyMeters: Double? = null,
    val generatedAtMillis: Long,
    val seed: Long,
    val wifi: List<WifiAp> = emptyList(),
    val cells: List<CellTower> = emptyList(),
    val cdmaCells: List<CdmaTower> = emptyList(),
    val ble: List<BleBeacon> = emptyList(),
    val schemaVersion: Int = SCHEMA_VERSION,
) {
    init {
        require(schemaVersion == SCHEMA_VERSION) { "Unsupported environment schemaVersion: $schemaVersion" }
        require(generatedAtMillis >= 0L) { "generatedAtMillis must be non-negative" }
        require(originAccuracyMeters == null || origin != null) { "origin accuracy requires an origin" }
        originAccuracyMeters?.let { require(it.isFinite() && it > 0.0) { "originAccuracyMeters must be positive and finite" } }
        require(wifi.size <= MAX_WIFI) { "Too many WiFi APs: ${wifi.size}" }
        require(cells.size + cdmaCells.size <= MAX_CELLS) { "Too many cells: ${cells.size + cdmaCells.size}" }
        require(ble.size <= MAX_BLE) { "Too many BLE beacons: ${ble.size}" }
        require(wifi.count { it.connected } <= 1) { "At most one connected AP is allowed" }
        require(cells.count { it.registered } + cdmaCells.count { it.registered } <= 1) {
            "At most one registered cell is allowed"
        }
    }

    fun connectedWifi(): WifiAp? = wifi.firstOrNull { it.connected }

    fun registeredCell(): CellTower? = cells.firstOrNull { it.registered }

    fun registeredCdmaCell(): CdmaTower? = cdmaCells.firstOrNull { it.registered }

    companion object {
        const val SCHEMA_VERSION = 1
        const val MAX_WIFI = 256
        const val MAX_CELLS = 128
        const val MAX_BLE = 256
    }
}

/** Deterministic contract for procedural/replay/database sources (ADR-022). */
interface EnvironmentSource {
    fun profileAt(point: Wgs84, seed: Long, atMillis: Long): EnvironmentProfile
}
```

`core/src/main/kotlin/com/system/location/service/core/environment/EnvironmentProfileCodec.kt`:

```kt
package com.system.location.service.core.environment

import kotlinx.serialization.json.Json

class EnvironmentCodecException(message: String, cause: Throwable? = null) : IllegalArgumentException(message, cause)

/**
 * JSON import/export for captured or procedural environment profiles (P2-02).
 *
 * The profile carries its own schemaVersion; unknown keys are ignored for forward-compatible
 * readers, but an unknown version is rejected instead of silently producing a wrong environment.
 */
object EnvironmentProfileCodec {
    private val json = Json {
        ignoreUnknownKeys = true
        encodeDefaults = true
        explicitNulls = false
    }

    const val MAX_PROFILE_BYTES = 2 * 1024 * 1024

    fun encode(profile: EnvironmentProfile): String {
        val encoded = json.encodeToString(EnvironmentProfile.serializer(), profile)
        require(encoded.toByteArray(Charsets.UTF_8).size <= MAX_PROFILE_BYTES) {
            "Environment profile exceeds $MAX_PROFILE_BYTES bytes"
        }
        return encoded
    }

    fun decode(raw: String): EnvironmentProfile {
        if (raw.toByteArray(Charsets.UTF_8).size > MAX_PROFILE_BYTES) {
            throw EnvironmentCodecException("Environment profile exceeds $MAX_PROFILE_BYTES bytes")
        }
        val profile = runCatching { json.decodeFromString(EnvironmentProfile.serializer(), raw) }
            .getOrElse { throw EnvironmentCodecException("Invalid environment profile", it) }
        if (profile.schemaVersion != EnvironmentProfile.SCHEMA_VERSION) {
            throw EnvironmentCodecException("Unsupported environment schemaVersion: ${profile.schemaVersion}")
        }
        return profile
    }
}
```

`core/src/main/kotlin/com/system/location/service/core/environment/EnvironmentReplayPolicy.kt`:

```kt
package com.system.location.service.core.environment

import com.system.location.service.core.geo.Wgs84
import kotlin.math.asin
import kotlin.math.cos
import kotlin.math.sin
import kotlin.math.sqrt

/** A captured radio profile is usable only within its measured location uncertainty. */
object EnvironmentReplayPolicy {
    const val MIN_RADIUS_METERS = 25.0

    fun isApplicable(profile: EnvironmentProfile, point: Wgs84): Boolean {
        val origin = profile.origin ?: return false
        val accuracy = profile.originAccuracyMeters?.takeIf { it.isFinite() && it > 0.0 } ?: return false
        return distanceMeters(origin, point) <= maxOf(MIN_RADIUS_METERS, accuracy * 2.0)
    }

    fun distanceMeters(a: Wgs84, b: Wgs84): Double {
        val lat1 = Math.toRadians(a.latitude)
        val lat2 = Math.toRadians(b.latitude)
        val dLat = lat2 - lat1
        val dLon = Math.toRadians(b.longitude - a.longitude)
        val h = sin(dLat / 2) * sin(dLat / 2) + cos(lat1) * cos(lat2) * sin(dLon / 2) * sin(dLon / 2)
        return 2 * EARTH_RADIUS_METERS * asin(sqrt(h.coerceIn(0.0, 1.0)))
    }

    private const val EARTH_RADIUS_METERS = 6_371_000.0
}
```

```kt
package com.system.location.service.core.environment

/** P5-06: restore policy for the environment source after loading an active config. */
object EnvironmentRestorePolicy {
    fun savedSource(configured: EnvironmentSourceMode, replayJson: String?): EnvironmentSourceType =
        if (configured != EnvironmentSourceMode.PROCEDURAL && !replayJson.isNullOrBlank()) {
            EnvironmentSourceType.REPLAY
        } else EnvironmentSourceType.PROCEDURAL

    fun sourceMode(saved: EnvironmentSourceType, replayJson: String?): String =
        if (!replayJson.isNullOrBlank() && saved != EnvironmentSourceType.PROCEDURAL) "REPLAY" else "PROCEDURAL"
}
```

```kt
package com.system.location.service.core.environment

import com.system.location.service.core.geo.Wgs84
import kotlin.math.asin
import kotlin.math.cos
import kotlin.math.pow
import kotlin.math.sin
import kotlin.math.sqrt

/**
 * P2-06: experimental fingerprint replay. Selects recent observations near the target point and
 * turns them into a deterministic WiFi profile; returns null when nothing is in range.
 */
class FingerprintWifiSource(
    private val database: WifiFingerprintDb,
    private val radiusMeters: Double = DEFAULT_RADIUS_METERS,
    private val maxAps: Int = DEFAULT_MAX_APS,
) {
    init {
        require(radiusMeters > 0.0 && radiusMeters.isFinite()) { "radiusMeters must be positive" }
        require(maxAps in 1..8) { "maxAps out of range" }
    }

    fun profileAt(
        point: Wgs84,
        seed: Long,
        nowMillis: Long,
        maxAgeMillis: Long = WifiFingerprintDb.DEFAULT_MAX_AGE_MILLIS,
    ): EnvironmentProfile? {
        require(nowMillis >= 0L) { "nowMillis must be non-negative" }
        require(maxAgeMillis >= 0L) { "maxAgeMillis must be non-negative" }
        val candidates = database.entries
            .filter { nowMillis - it.observedAtMillis in 0..maxAgeMillis }
            .filter { distanceMeters(point, it.position) <= radiusMeters }
            .groupBy { it.bssid.uppercase() }
            .mapNotNull { (bssid, entries) -> entries.maxByOrNull { it.rssi }?.let { bssid to it.rssi } }
            .sortedByDescending { it.second }
            .take(maxAps)
        if (candidates.isEmpty()) return null
        val wifi = candidates.mapIndexed { index, (bssid, rssi) ->
            WifiAp(
                ssid = "FP-${bssid.takeLast(5).replace(":", "")}",
                bssid = bssid,
                rssi = rssi,
                frequencyMhz = 2412,
                channel = 1,
                connected = index == 0,
            )
        }
        return EnvironmentProfile(
            source = EnvironmentSourceType.REPLAY,
            origin = point,
            generatedAtMillis = nowMillis,
            seed = seed,
            wifi = wifi,
        )
    }

    private fun distanceMeters(a: Wgs84, b: Wgs84): Double {
        val radius = 6_371_000.0
        val phi1 = Math.toRadians(a.latitude)
        val phi2 = Math.toRadians(b.latitude)
        val dPhi = Math.toRadians(b.latitude - a.latitude)
        val dLambda = Math.toRadians(b.longitude - a.longitude)
        val h = sin(dPhi / 2).pow(2) + cos(phi1) * cos(phi2) * sin(dLambda / 2).pow(2)
        return 2 * radius * asin(sqrt(h.coerceIn(0.0, 1.0)))
    }

    companion object {
        const val DEFAULT_RADIUS_METERS = 500.0
        const val DEFAULT_MAX_APS = 8
    }
}
```

`core/src/main/kotlin/com/system/location/service/core/environment/ProceduralBleSource.kt`:

```kt
package com.system.location.service.core.environment

import com.system.location.service.core.geo.Wgs84
import kotlin.math.cos
import kotlin.math.floor
import kotlin.math.log10
import kotlin.math.max

/** Deterministic destination beacons with internally consistent advertisement records. */
class ProceduralBleSource {
    fun beaconsAt(point: Wgs84, seed: Long): List<BleBeacon> {
        val latCell = floor(point.latitude / CELL_DEGREES).toLong()
        val lonCell = floor(point.longitude / longitudeCell(point.latitude)).toLong()
        return (0 until BEACON_COUNT).map { index ->
            val random = Random64(cellSeed(seed, latCell, lonCell, index))
            val latitude = (latCell + random.nextDouble()) * CELL_DEGREES
            val longitude = (lonCell + random.nextDouble()) * longitudeCell(point.latitude)
            val distance = distanceMeters(point, latitude, longitude)
            val name = "Beacon-${hex(random.nextInt(256))}${hex(random.nextInt(256))}"
            val txPower = -59
            val rssi = (-35.0 - PATH_LOSS_EXPONENT * log10(max(1.0, distance)) + random.nextDouble() * JITTER_DB)
                .toInt().coerceIn(MIN_RSSI, MAX_RSSI)
            val address = buildString {
                append("02")
                repeat(5) { append(':').append(hex(random.nextInt(256))) }
            }
            BleBeacon(
                address = address,
                name = name,
                rssi = rssi,
                scanRecordHex = advertisement(name, txPower),
                txPowerDbm = txPower,
            )
        }
    }

    private fun advertisement(name: String, txPower: Int): String {
        val nameBytes = name.toByteArray(Charsets.UTF_8)
        val bytes = byteArrayOf(
            2, 0x01, 0x06,
            2, 0x0A, txPower.toByte(),
            (nameBytes.size + 1).toByte(), 0x09,
        ) + nameBytes
        return bytes.joinToString(separator = "") { hex(it.toInt() and 0xff) }
    }

    private fun distanceMeters(point: Wgs84, latitude: Double, longitude: Double): Double {
        val dy = (latitude - point.latitude) * METERS_PER_DEGREE
        val dx = (longitude - point.longitude) * METERS_PER_DEGREE * cos(Math.toRadians(point.latitude))
        return kotlin.math.sqrt(dy * dy + dx * dx)
    }

    private fun longitudeCell(latitude: Double): Double =
        CELL_DEGREES / cos(Math.toRadians(latitude)).coerceAtLeast(MIN_COS)

    private fun cellSeed(seed: Long, latitude: Long, longitude: Long, index: Int): Long =
        (seed * 31 + latitude) * 31 + longitude * 31 + index

    private fun hex(value: Int): String = value.toString(16).padStart(2, '0')

    private class Random64(seed: Long) {
        private var state = seed

        fun nextLong(): Long {
            state += -0x61c8864680b583ebL
            var value = state
            value = (value xor (value ushr 30)) * -0x40a7b892e31b1a47L
            value = (value xor (value ushr 27)) * -0x6b2fb644ecceee15L
            return value xor (value ushr 31)
        }

        fun nextInt(bound: Int): Int = ((nextLong() ushr 1) % bound).toInt()
        fun nextDouble(): Double = (nextLong() ushr 11) * (1.0 / (1L shl 53))
    }

    private companion object {
        const val CELL_DEGREES = 0.0007
        const val METERS_PER_DEGREE = 110_540.0
        const val MIN_COS = 0.2
        const val PATH_LOSS_EXPONENT = 2.1
        const val JITTER_DB = 8.0
        const val MIN_RSSI = -95
        const val MAX_RSSI = -35
        const val BEACON_COUNT = 6
    }
}
```

`core/src/main/kotlin/com/system/location/service/core/environment/ProceduralCellSource.kt`:

```kt
package com.system.location.service.core.environment

import com.system.location.service.core.geo.Wgs84
import kotlin.math.cos
import kotlin.math.floor

data class SimProfile(
    val mcc: Int = 460,
    val mnc: Int = 0,
    val simReady: Boolean = false,
    val operatorName: String? = null,
) {
    init {
        require(mcc in 1..999) { "mcc out of range: $mcc" }
        require(mnc in 0..999) { "mnc out of range: $mnc" }
    }
}

/**
 * Deterministic cell profile (P2-05, ADR-005).
 *
 * FULL_REPLAY returns one registered LTE cell plus LTE neighbours and one NR cell, all under the
 * supplied MCC/MNC. NO_SIM_WIFI_ONLY returns no cells (the device profile has no SIM). LEGACY_CDMA
 * is deprecated and currently yields no cells; the hook keeps its old path behind a feature flag.
 */
class ProceduralCellSource(
    private val config: EnvironmentConfig = EnvironmentConfig(),
) {
    fun cellsAt(point: Wgs84, seed: Long, sim: SimProfile): List<CellTower> {
        val mode = CellModePolicy.resolve(config.cellMode, sim.simReady)
        return when (mode) {
            CellMode.NO_SIM_WIFI_ONLY, CellMode.LEGACY_CDMA -> emptyList()
            CellMode.AUTO, CellMode.FULL_REPLAY -> replayCells(point, seed, sim)
        }
    }

    private fun replayCells(point: Wgs84, seed: Long, sim: SimProfile): List<CellTower> {
        val latStep = 0.005
        val lonStep = latStep / cos(Math.toRadians(point.latitude)).coerceAtLeast(0.2)
        val latIndex = floor(point.latitude / latStep).toLong()
        val lonIndex = floor(point.longitude / lonStep).toLong()
        val random = SplitMix64(cellSeed(seed, latIndex, lonIndex))
        val areaCode = 1 + random.nextInt(65_534)
        val cells = mutableListOf<CellTower>()
        val registered = CellTower(
            type = CellType.LTE,
            mcc = sim.mcc,
            mnc = sim.mnc,
            areaCode = areaCode,
            cellId = 1L + random.nextInt(268_435_454),
            pci = random.nextInt(CellTower.MAX_LTE_PCI + 1),
            arfcn = 1_200 + random.nextInt(300),
            rsrp = -78 - random.nextInt(24),
            rsrq = -8 - random.nextInt(8),
            rssnr = 8 + random.nextInt(12),
            registered = true,
        )
        cells += registered
        repeat(NEIGHBOURS) { index ->
            cells += CellTower(
                type = CellType.LTE,
                mcc = sim.mcc,
                mnc = sim.mnc,
                areaCode = areaCode,
                cellId = 1L + random.nextInt(268_435_454),
                pci = random.nextInt(CellTower.MAX_LTE_PCI + 1),
                arfcn = registered.arfcn!! + (index + 1) * 2,
                rsrp = -88 - random.nextInt(20),
                rsrq = -10 - random.nextInt(8),
                rssnr = 2 + random.nextInt(10),
                registered = false,
            )
        }
        cells += CellTower(
            type = CellType.NR,
            mcc = sim.mcc,
            mnc = sim.mnc,
            areaCode = areaCode,
            cellId = 1L + random.nextInt(1_000_000),
            pci = random.nextInt(CellTower.MAX_NR_PCI + 1),
            arfcn = 620_000 + random.nextInt(10_000),
            rsrp = -92 - random.nextInt(20),
            rsrq = -12 - random.nextInt(6),
            rssnr = 4 + random.nextInt(10),
            registered = false,
        )
        return cells
    }

    private fun cellSeed(seed: Long, latIndex: Long, lonIndex: Long): Long {
        var hash = seed
        hash = hash * 31 + latIndex
        hash = hash * 31 + lonIndex
        hash = hash xor (hash ushr 33)
        return hash * -0x61c8864680b583ebL
    }

    private class SplitMix64(seed: Long) {
        private var state = seed

        fun nextLong(): Long {
            state += -0x61c8864680b583ebL
            var z = state
            z = (z xor (z ushr 30)) * -0x40a7b892e31b1a47L
            z = (z xor (z ushr 27)) * -0x6b2fb644ecceee15L
            return z xor (z ushr 31)
        }

        fun nextInt(bound: Int): Int = ((nextLong() ushr 1) % bound).toInt()
    }

    private companion object {
        const val NEIGHBOURS = 3
    }
}
```

`core/src/main/kotlin/com/system/location/service/core/environment/ProceduralWifiSource.kt`:

```kt
package com.system.location.service.core.environment

import com.system.location.service.core.geo.Wgs84
import kotlin.math.cos
import kotlin.math.floor
import kotlin.math.log10
import kotlin.math.max

/**
 * Deterministic procedural WiFi environment (P2-03, ADR-004/022).
 *
 * The world is split into ~100 m cells. Each `(cell, seed)` generates the same fixed set of APs
 * with fixed positions; moving the observer only changes the distance-derived RSSI, so nearby
 * samples are smooth and no `Random()` state leaks between calls.
 */
class ProceduralWifiSource(
    private val config: EnvironmentConfig = EnvironmentConfig(),
) : EnvironmentSource {

    override fun profileAt(point: Wgs84, seed: Long, atMillis: Long): EnvironmentProfile {
        require(atMillis >= 0L) { "atMillis must be non-negative" }
        val latIndex = floor(point.latitude / LAT_STEP_METERS).toLong()
        val lonStep = longitudeStep(point.latitude)
        val lonIndex = floor(point.longitude / lonStep).toLong()

        val candidates = (0 until config.apPerCell).map { index ->
            val rng = SplitMix64(cellSeed(seed, latIndex, lonIndex, index))
            val apLat = latIndex * LAT_STEP_METERS + rng.nextDouble() * LAT_STEP_METERS
            val apLon = lonIndex * lonStep + rng.nextDouble() * lonStep
            val distance = distanceMeters(point, apLat, apLon)
            val channel = CHANNELS[rng.nextInt(CHANNELS.size)]
            val oui = OUIS[rng.nextInt(OUIS.size)]
            val bssid = "$oui:${hex(rng.nextInt(256))}:${hex(rng.nextInt(256))}:${hex(rng.nextInt(256))}"
            val ssid = SSIDS[rng.nextInt(SSIDS.size)] + "-" + hex(rng.nextInt(256)) + hex(rng.nextInt(256))
            val rssi = rssiForDistance(distance, rng.nextDouble())
            Candidate(
                WifiAp(
                    ssid = ssid,
                    bssid = bssid,
                    rssi = rssi,
                    frequencyMhz = channel.first,
                    channel = channel.second,
                ),
                distance,
            )
        }
        val connectedIndex = candidates.indices.minByOrNull { candidates[it].distance } ?: 0
        val wifi = candidates.mapIndexed { index, candidate ->
            candidate.ap.copy(connected = index == connectedIndex)
        }
        return EnvironmentProfile(
            source = EnvironmentSourceType.PROCEDURAL,
            origin = point,
            generatedAtMillis = atMillis,
            seed = seed,
            wifi = wifi,
        )
    }

    private data class Candidate(val ap: WifiAp, val distance: Double)

    private fun rssiForDistance(distanceMeters: Double, jitter01: Double): Int {
        val base = -30.0 - PATH_LOSS_EXPONENT * log10(max(1.0, distanceMeters))
        val jitter = jitter01 * JITTER_DB * 2.0 - JITTER_DB
        return (base + jitter).toInt().coerceIn(MIN_RSSI, MAX_RSSI)
    }

    private fun distanceMeters(point: Wgs84, latitude: Double, longitude: Double): Double {
        val dy = (latitude - point.latitude) * METERS_PER_DEGREE_LAT
        val dx = (longitude - point.longitude) * METERS_PER_DEGREE_LAT * cos(Math.toRadians(point.latitude))
        return kotlin.math.sqrt(dy * dy + dx * dx)
    }

    private fun longitudeStep(latitude: Double): Double =
        LAT_STEP_METERS / cos(Math.toRadians(latitude)).coerceAtLeast(MIN_COS)

    private fun cellSeed(seed: Long, latIndex: Long, lonIndex: Long, index: Int): Long {
        var hash = seed
        hash = hash * 31 + latIndex
        hash = hash * 31 + lonIndex
        hash = hash * 31 + index
        hash = hash xor (hash ushr 33)
        return hash * -0x61c8864680b583ebL
    }

    private fun hex(value: Int): String = value.toString(16).lowercase().padStart(2, '0')

    private class SplitMix64(seed: Long) {
        private var state = seed

        fun nextLong(): Long {
            state += -0x61c8864680b583ebL
            var z = state
            z = (z xor (z ushr 30)) * -0x40a7b892e31b1a47L
            z = (z xor (z ushr 27)) * -0x6b2fb644ecceee15L
            return z xor (z ushr 31)
        }

        fun nextInt(bound: Int): Int = ((nextLong() ushr 1) % bound).toInt()

        fun nextDouble(): Double = (nextLong() ushr 11) * (1.0 / (1L shl 53))
    }

    private companion object {
        const val LAT_STEP_METERS = 0.0009
        const val METERS_PER_DEGREE_LAT = 110_540.0
        const val MIN_COS = 0.2
        const val PATH_LOSS_EXPONENT = 2.7
        const val JITTER_DB = 3.0
        const val MIN_RSSI = -92
        const val MAX_RSSI = -30

        val CHANNELS = listOf(
            2412 to 1,
            2437 to 6,
            2462 to 11,
            5180 to 36,
            5200 to 40,
            5745 to 149,
            5765 to 153,
        )

        val OUIS = listOf(
            "a4:50:46",
            "00:1a:11",
            "f0:9f:c2",
            "ac:84:c6",
            "d8:47:32",
            "3c:5a:b4",
            "f4:f2:6d",
            "50:64:2b",
            "e4:95:6e",
            "c8:3a:35",
        )

        val SSIDS = listOf(
            "ChinaNet",
            "CMCC",
            "TP-LINK",
            "Xiaomi",
            "HUAWEI",
            "Starbucks",
            "iPhone",
            "MERCURY",
            "Tenda",
        )
    }
}
```
