`core/src/main/kotlin/com/system/location/service/core/environment/ReplayEnvironmentSource.kt`:

```kt
package com.system.location.service.core.environment

import com.system.location.service.core.geo.Wgs84
import kotlin.math.ln

/**
 * Replays a captured environment while re-calibrating RSSI for a new target point (P2-02).
 *
 * Captured identities are only applicable near the measured origin. Outside its accuracy-derived
 * radius, callers must select a procedural source instead of moving the captured fingerprint.
 */
class ReplayEnvironmentSource(
    private val captured: EnvironmentProfile,
    private val pathLossExponent: Double = 2.0,
) : EnvironmentSource {
    init {
        require(captured.source == EnvironmentSourceType.REPLAY) { "captured profile must be REPLAY" }
        require(pathLossExponent > 0.0) { "pathLossExponent must be positive" }
    }

    override fun profileAt(point: Wgs84, seed: Long, atMillis: Long): EnvironmentProfile {
        require(atMillis >= 0L) { "atMillis must be non-negative" }
        require(EnvironmentReplayPolicy.isApplicable(captured, point)) {
            "Captured environment has no reliable origin or target is outside its measured range"
        }
        val origin = checkNotNull(captured.origin)
        val distance = EnvironmentReplayPolicy.distanceMeters(origin, point)
        val deltaDb = if (distance <= REFERENCE_METERS) 0.0 else {
            -10.0 * pathLossExponent * ln((distance + REFERENCE_METERS) / REFERENCE_METERS) / ln(10.0)
        }
        return captured.copy(
            origin = point,
            generatedAtMillis = atMillis,
            seed = seed,
            wifi = captured.wifi.map { ap ->
                ap.copy(rssi = (ap.rssi + deltaDb).toInt().coerceIn(WifiAp.MIN_RSSI, WifiAp.MAX_RSSI))
            },
        )
    }

    private companion object {
        const val REFERENCE_METERS = 10.0
    }
}

```

`core/src/main/kotlin/com/system/location/service/core/environment/WifiFingerprintDb.kt`:

```kt
package com.system.location.service.core.environment

import com.system.location.service.core.geo.Wgs84
import kotlinx.serialization.Serializable
import kotlin.math.abs

@Serializable
data class WifiObservation(
    val bssid: String,
    val rssi: Int,
) {
    init {
        require(WifiFingerprint.BSSID_PATTERN.matches(bssid)) { "Invalid BSSID: $bssid" }
        require(rssi in WifiFingerprint.MIN_RSSI..WifiFingerprint.MAX_RSSI) { "rssi out of range: $rssi" }
    }
}

@Serializable
data class WifiFingerprint(
    val bssid: String,
    val position: Wgs84,
    val rssi: Int,
    val observedAtMillis: Long,
) {
    init {
        require(BSSID_PATTERN.matches(bssid)) { "Invalid BSSID: $bssid" }
        require(rssi in MIN_RSSI..MAX_RSSI) { "rssi out of range: $rssi" }
        require(observedAtMillis >= 0L) { "observedAtMillis must be non-negative" }
    }

    companion object {
        val BSSID_PATTERN = Regex("^[0-9A-Fa-f]{2}(:[0-9A-Fa-f]{2}){5}\$")
        const val MIN_RSSI = -100
        const val MAX_RSSI = 0
    }
}

/**
 * Experimental WiFi fingerprint database (P2-06).
 *
 * Query matches observations to the closest stored RSSI per BSSID, then takes a distance-weighted
 * centroid. Stale fingerprints are ignored; there is no interpolation outside the stored samples.
 */
@Serializable
data class WifiFingerprintDb(
    val entries: List<WifiFingerprint> = emptyList(),
) {
    init {
        require(entries.size <= MAX_ENTRIES) { "Too many fingerprints: ${entries.size}" }
    }

    fun add(fingerprint: WifiFingerprint): WifiFingerprintDb =
        WifiFingerprintDb((entries + fingerprint).takeLast(MAX_ENTRIES))

    fun remove(bssid: String): WifiFingerprintDb =
        WifiFingerprintDb(entries.filterNot { it.bssid.equals(bssid, ignoreCase = true) })

    fun query(
        observations: List<WifiObservation>,
        nowMillis: Long,
        maxAgeMillis: Long = DEFAULT_MAX_AGE_MILLIS,
    ): Wgs84? {
        require(nowMillis >= 0L) { "nowMillis must be non-negative" }
        require(maxAgeMillis >= 0L) { "maxAgeMillis must be non-negative" }
        if (observations.isEmpty()) return null
        val matches = observations.mapNotNull { observation ->
            val fingerprint = entries
                .filter { it.bssid.equals(observation.bssid, ignoreCase = true) }
                .filter { nowMillis - it.observedAtMillis in 0..maxAgeMillis }
                .minByOrNull { abs(it.rssi - observation.rssi) }
                ?: return@mapNotNull null
            val weight = 1.0 / (abs(fingerprint.rssi - observation.rssi) + 1.0)
            fingerprint.position to weight
        }
        if (matches.isEmpty()) return null
        val total = matches.sumOf { it.second }
        if (total <= 0.0) return null
        val latitude = matches.sumOf { it.first.latitude * it.second } / total
        val longitude = matches.sumOf { it.first.longitude * it.second } / total
        return Wgs84(latitude.coerceIn(-90.0, 90.0), longitude.coerceIn(-180.0, 180.0))
    }

    companion object {
        const val MAX_ENTRIES = 10_000
        const val DEFAULT_MAX_AGE_MILLIS = 30L * 24 * 60 * 60 * 1_000
    }
}

```

`core/src/main/kotlin/com/system/location/service/core/environment/WifiFingerprintImport.kt`:

```kt
package com.system.location.service.core.environment

import kotlinx.serialization.Serializable
import kotlinx.serialization.json.Json

/**
 * Importable WiFi fingerprint catalog (P2-06).
 *
 * Disabled by default; enabling requires non-blank source/license/attribution so a third-party
 * dump cannot be activated silently. The wire schema is versioned and unknown keys are ignored.
 */
@Serializable
data class WifiFingerprintCatalog(
    val schemaVersion: Int = SCHEMA_VERSION,
    val enabled: Boolean = false,
    val source: String = "",
    val license: String = "",
    val attribution: String = "",
    val entries: List<WifiFingerprint> = emptyList(),
) {
    init {
        require(schemaVersion == SCHEMA_VERSION) { "Unsupported fingerprint schema: $schemaVersion" }
        require(entries.size <= WifiFingerprintDb.MAX_ENTRIES) { "Too many fingerprints: ${entries.size}" }
        if (enabled) {
            require(source.isNotBlank()) { "source is required when enabled" }
            require(license.isNotBlank()) { "license is required when enabled" }
            require(attribution.isNotBlank()) { "attribution is required when enabled" }
        }
    }

    fun database(): WifiFingerprintDb = WifiFingerprintDb(entries)

    companion object {
        const val SCHEMA_VERSION = 1
    }
}

data class WifiFingerprintImportResult(
    val catalog: WifiFingerprintCatalog,
    val imported: Int,
    val skipped: Int,
)

class WifiFingerprintImportException(message: String, cause: Throwable? = null) : IllegalArgumentException(message, cause)

object WifiFingerprintImporter {
    private val json = Json {
        ignoreUnknownKeys = true
        encodeDefaults = true
        explicitNulls = false
    }

    const val MAX_CATALOG_BYTES = 2 * 1024 * 1024

    fun importJson(raw: String): WifiFingerprintImportResult {
        if (raw.toByteArray(Charsets.UTF_8).size > MAX_CATALOG_BYTES) {
            throw WifiFingerprintImportException("Fingerprint catalog exceeds $MAX_CATALOG_BYTES bytes")
        }
        val catalog = runCatching { json.decodeFromString(WifiFingerprintCatalog.serializer(), raw) }
            .getOrElse { throw WifiFingerprintImportException("Invalid fingerprint JSON", it) }
        return WifiFingerprintImportResult(catalog, catalog.entries.size, 0)
    }

    fun encodeJson(catalog: WifiFingerprintCatalog): String {
        val encoded = json.encodeToString(WifiFingerprintCatalog.serializer(), catalog)
        require(encoded.toByteArray(Charsets.UTF_8).size <= MAX_CATALOG_BYTES) {
            "Fingerprint catalog exceeds $MAX_CATALOG_BYTES bytes"
        }
        return encoded
    }

    /**
     * CSV columns: bssid,latitude,longitude,rssi,observedAtMillis. An optional header line is
     * accepted. Invalid rows are skipped and counted; an all-invalid file is rejected.
     */
    fun importCsv(
        raw: String,
        source: String,
        license: String,
        attribution: String,
    ): WifiFingerprintImportResult {
        require(source.isNotBlank() && license.isNotBlank() && attribution.isNotBlank()) {
            "source/license/attribution are required"
        }
        val entries = mutableListOf<WifiFingerprint>()
        var skipped = 0
        raw.lineSequence().forEachIndexed { index, line ->
            val trimmed = line.trim()
            if (trimmed.isBlank()) return@forEachIndexed
            if (index == 0 && trimmed.startsWith("bssid,", ignoreCase = true)) return@forEachIndexed
            val parts = trimmed.split(',').map { it.trim() }
            if (parts.size != 5) {
                skipped++
                return@forEachIndexed
            }
            val fingerprint = runCatching {
                WifiFingerprint(
                    bssid = parts[0],
                    position = com.system.location.service.core.geo.Wgs84(
                        parts[1].toDouble(),
                        parts[2].toDouble(),
                    ),
                    rssi = parts[3].toInt(),
                    observedAtMillis = parts[4].toLong(),
                )
            }.getOrNull()
            if (fingerprint == null) {
                skipped++
            } else if (entries.size < WifiFingerprintDb.MAX_ENTRIES) {
                entries += fingerprint
            } else {
                skipped++
            }
        }
        if (entries.isEmpty()) throw WifiFingerprintImportException("No valid fingerprint rows")
        val catalog = WifiFingerprintCatalog(
            enabled = false,
            source = source,
            license = license,
            attribution = attribution,
            entries = entries,
        )
        return WifiFingerprintImportResult(catalog, entries.size, skipped)
    }
}
```

`core/src/main/kotlin/com/system/location/service/core/geo/CoordinateTransform.kt`:

```kt
package com.system.location.service.core.geo

object CoordinateTransform {
    fun toWgs84(point: Gcj02): Wgs84 = gcj2wgs(point.latitude, point.longitude).let { Wgs84(it.first, it.second) }
    fun toGcj02(point: Wgs84): Gcj02 = wgs2gcj(point.latitude, point.longitude).let { Gcj02(it.first, it.second) }
    fun toBd09(point: Gcj02): Bd09 {
        val x = point.longitude
        val y = point.latitude
        val z = kotlin.math.sqrt(x * x + y * y) + 0.00002 * kotlin.math.sin(y * X_PI)
        val theta = kotlin.math.atan2(y, x) + 0.000003 * kotlin.math.cos(x * X_PI)
        return Bd09(z * kotlin.math.sin(theta) + 0.006, z * kotlin.math.cos(theta) + 0.0065)
    }
    fun toGcj02(point: Bd09): Gcj02 {
        val x = point.longitude - 0.0065
        val y = point.latitude - 0.006
        val z = kotlin.math.sqrt(x * x + y * y) - 0.00002 * kotlin.math.sin(y * X_PI)
        val theta = kotlin.math.atan2(y, x) - 0.000003 * kotlin.math.cos(x * X_PI)
        return Gcj02(z * kotlin.math.sin(theta), z * kotlin.math.cos(theta))
    }

    private const val PI = Math.PI
    private const val X_PI = PI * 3000.0 / 180.0
    private const val A = 6378245.0               // 长半轴
    private const val EE = 0.00669342162296594326 // 偏心率平方

    private fun gcj2wgs(lat: Double, lon: Double): Pair<Double, Double> {
        if (outOfChina(lat, lon)) return lat to lon
        var wLat = lat
        var wLon = lon
        repeat(3) {
            val (dLat, dLon) = delta(wLat, wLon)
            wLat = lat - dLat
            wLon = lon - dLon
        }
        return wLat to wLon
    }

    private fun wgs2gcj(lat: Double, lon: Double): Pair<Double, Double> {
        if (outOfChina(lat, lon)) return lat to lon
        val (dLat, dLon) = delta(lat, lon)
        return lat + dLat to lon + dLon
    }

    private fun delta(lat: Double, lon: Double): Pair<Double, Double> {
        var dLat = transformLat(lon - 105.0, lat - 35.0)
        var dLon = transformLon(lon - 105.0, lat - 35.0)
        val radLat = lat / 180.0 * PI
        var magic = Math.sin(radLat)
        magic = 1 - EE * magic * magic
        val sqrtMagic = Math.sqrt(magic)
        dLat = (dLat * 180.0) / ((A * (1 - EE)) / (magic * sqrtMagic) * PI)
        dLon = (dLon * 180.0) / (A / sqrtMagic * Math.cos(radLat) * PI)
        return dLat to dLon
    }

    private fun transformLat(x: Double, y: Double): Double {
        var ret = -100.0 + 2.0 * x + 3.0 * y + 0.2 * y * y + 0.1 * x * y +
                0.2 * Math.sqrt(Math.abs(x))
        ret += (20.0 * Math.sin(6.0 * x * PI) + 20.0 * Math.sin(2.0 * x * PI)) * 2.0 / 3.0
        ret += (20.0 * Math.sin(y * PI) + 40.0 * Math.sin(y / 3.0 * PI)) * 2.0 / 3.0
        ret += (160.0 * Math.sin(y / 12.0 * PI) + 320 * Math.sin(y * PI / 30.0)) * 2.0 / 3.0
        return ret
    }

    private fun transformLon(x: Double, y: Double): Double {
        var ret = 300.0 + x + 2.0 * y + 0.1 * x * x + 0.1 * x * y +
                0.1 * Math.sqrt(Math.abs(x))
        ret += (20.0 * Math.sin(6.0 * x * PI) + 20.0 * Math.sin(2.0 * x * PI)) * 2.0 / 3.0
        ret += (20.0 * Math.sin(x * PI) + 40.0 * Math.sin(x / 3.0 * PI)) * 2.0 / 3.0
        ret += (150.0 * Math.sin(x / 12.0 * PI) + 300.0 * Math.sin(x / 30.0 * PI)) * 2.0 / 3.0
        return ret
    }

    private fun outOfChina(lat: Double, lon: Double): Boolean {
        return lon < 72.004 || lon > 137.8347 || lat < 0.8293 || lat > 55.8271
    }
}
```

`core/src/main/kotlin/com/system/location/service/core/gnss/BeiDouBroadcastEphemeris.kt`:

```kt
package com.system.location.service.core.gnss

import kotlinx.serialization.Serializable

/** Full BeiDou Time since its own week origin; no GPS/GST/UTC conversion is implicit. */
@Serializable
data class BeiDouTime(val week: Int, val secondsOfWeek: Double) {
    init { require(week >= 0 && secondsOfWeek.isFinite() && secondsOfWeek >= 0 && secondsOfWeek < 604800) }
    fun secondsSince(other: BeiDouTime) = (week.toLong() - other.week.toLong()) * 604800.0 + secondsOfWeek - other.secondsOfWeek
    fun plusSeconds(seconds: Double): BeiDouTime {
        require(seconds.isFinite())
        val result = requireNotNull(GnssWeekTime.normalize(week.toLong(), secondsOfWeek + seconds))
        return BeiDouTime(result.first, result.second)
    }
}

@Serializable
enum class BeiDouOrbitType { GEO, IGSO, MEO }

/**
 * B1I 3.0 Table 5-10 decoded orbital/clock parameters. All angles are radians.
 * Orbit type is explicit evidence, never a heuristic based on a historical PRN range.
 * Validity must be independently established; an hourly update period/AODE is not a fit flag.
 * Raw D1/D2 validation, assembly, health and per-signal TGD are separate requirements.
 */
@Serializable
data class BeiDouBroadcastEphemeris(
    val svid: Int,
    val orbitType: BeiDouOrbitType,
    val toe: BeiDouTime,
    val toc: BeiDouTime,
    val validFrom: BeiDouTime,
    val validUntil: BeiDouTime,
    val sqrtSemiMajorAxis: Double,
    val eccentricity: Double,
    val inclinationRad: Double,
    val ascendingNodeRad: Double,
    val argumentOfPerigeeRad: Double,
    val meanAnomalyRad: Double,
    val deltaMeanMotionRadPerSecond: Double,
    val ascendingNodeRateRadPerSecond: Double,
    val inclinationRateRadPerSecond: Double,
    val cucRad: Double,
    val cusRad: Double,
    val crcMeters: Double,
    val crsMeters: Double,
    val cicRad: Double,
    val cisRad: Double,
    val af0Seconds: Double,
    val af1SecondsPerSecond: Double,
    val af2SecondsPerSecondSquared: Double,
) {
    init {
        require(svid in 1..63)
        require(validUntil.secondsSince(validFrom) > 0)
        require(sqrtSemiMajorAxis.isFinite() && sqrtSemiMajorAxis > 0 && sqrtSemiMajorAxis < 8192)
        require(eccentricity >= 0 && eccentricity < 0.5)
        require(listOf(inclinationRad, ascendingNodeRad, argumentOfPerigeeRad, meanAnomalyRad,
            deltaMeanMotionRadPerSecond, ascendingNodeRateRadPerSecond, inclinationRateRadPerSecond,
            cucRad, cusRad, crcMeters, crsMeters, cicRad, cisRad, af0Seconds, af1SecondsPerSecond,
            af2SecondsPerSecondSquared).all(Double::isFinite))
    }
}
```

`core/src/main/kotlin/com/system/location/service/core/gnss/BeiDouBroadcastEvidence.kt`:

```kt
package com.system.location.service.core.gnss

import kotlinx.serialization.Serializable

@Serializable
enum class BeiDouReceiverFrame { BDCS }

@Serializable
data class BeiDouElapsedClockEvidence(
    val bootCount: Int,
    val week: Int,
    val secondsOfWeek: Double,
    val elapsedRealtimeNanos: Long,
) {
    init {
        require(bootCount >= 0 && elapsedRealtimeNanos >= 0)
        BeiDouTime(week, secondsOfWeek)
    }

    fun at(elapsedNanos: Long, currentBootCount: Int?): BeiDouTime? {
        if (currentBootCount != bootCount || elapsedNanos < elapsedRealtimeNanos) return null
        return runCatching { BeiDouTime(week, secondsOfWeek).plusSeconds((elapsedNanos - elapsedRealtimeNanos) / 1e9) }
            .getOrNull()
    }
}

/** Explicit BDT evidence; unlike GPS/Galileo it never assumes an inter-system offset. */
@Serializable
data class BeiDouBroadcastEvidence(
    val clock: BeiDouElapsedClockEvidence,
    val receiverFrame: BeiDouReceiverFrame,
    val serviceValidity: BeiDouServiceValidity,
    val d1: List<BeiDouD1Decoded> = emptyList(),
    val d2: List<BeiDouD2Decoded> = emptyList(),
    val receiverTransform: GnssReceiverDatumTransform? = null,
) {
    init {
        require(receiverTransform == null || receiverTransform.bootCount == clock.bootCount)
        require(d1.isNotEmpty() || d2.isNotEmpty()) { "BeiDou evidence is empty" }
        require(d1.map { it.ephemeris.svid }.distinct().size == d1.size)
        require(d2.map { it.ephemeris.svid }.distinct().size == d2.size)
        require((d1.map { it.ephemeris.svid } + d2.map { it.ephemeris.svid }).all { it in 1..63 })
    }

    val identities: Set<Int>
        get() = (d1.map { it.ephemeris.svid } + d2.map { it.ephemeris.svid }).toSet()
}
```

`core/src/main/kotlin/com/system/location/service/core/gnss/BeiDouBroadcastPropagator.kt`:

```kt
package com.system.location.service.core.gnss

import kotlin.math.*

/** BDCS ECEF at transmission BDT; polynomial plus relativity clock without signal TGD. */
data class BeiDouSatelliteState(val xMeters: Double, val yMeters: Double, val zMeters: Double,
    val clockBiasSeconds: Double)
data class BeiDouPropagationResult(val state: BeiDouSatelliteState?, val reason: String? = null)

/**
 * BDS-SIS-ICD-B1I-3.0 §§5.2.4.9/12, Table 5-11. Mathematical propagation only.
 * GEO uses the specified user-defined inertial coordinates, Rx(-5 degrees), then Rz(Omega_e*tk).
 * MEO/IGSO use the broadcast BDCS ascending-node equation directly; no extra ECI rotation.
 * https://en.beidou.gov.cn/SYSTEMS/ICD/201902/P020190227702348791891.pdf
 */
object BeiDouBroadcastPropagator {
    const val EARTH_MU = 3.986004418e14
    const val EARTH_ROTATION_RAD_PER_SECOND = 7.2921150e-5
    private const val SPEED_OF_LIGHT = 299792458.0

    fun propagate(e: BeiDouBroadcastEphemeris, transmission: BeiDouTime): BeiDouPropagationResult {
        fun invalid(reason: String) = BeiDouPropagationResult(null, reason)
        if (transmission.secondsSince(e.validFrom) < 0 || e.validUntil.secondsSince(transmission) < 0)
            return invalid("outside absolute BeiDou validity interval")
        val tk = transmission.secondsSince(e.toe)
        val a = e.sqrtSemiMajorAxis * e.sqrtSemiMajorAxis
        val n = sqrt(EARTH_MU / (a * a * a)) + e.deltaMeanMotionRadPerSecond
        if (!n.isFinite() || n <= 0) return invalid("invalid BeiDou mean motion")
        val mean = (e.meanAnomalyRad + n * tk) % (2 * PI)
        var eccentric = mean
        var converged = false
        for (iteration in 1..30) {
            val delta = (eccentric - e.eccentricity * sin(eccentric) - mean) /
                (1 - e.eccentricity * cos(eccentric))
            eccentric -= delta
            if (iteration >= 3 && abs(delta) <= 1e-14) { converged = true; break }
        }
        if (!converged || !eccentric.isFinite()) return invalid("BeiDou Kepler equation did not converge")
        val anomaly = atan2(sqrt(1 - e.eccentricity * e.eccentricity) * sin(eccentric), cos(eccentric) - e.eccentricity)
        val phi = anomaly + e.argumentOfPerigeeRad
        val sine = sin(2 * phi)
        val cosine = cos(2 * phi)
        val u = phi + e.cusRad * sine + e.cucRad * cosine
        val radius = a * (1 - e.eccentricity * cos(eccentric)) + e.crsMeters * sine + e.crcMeters * cosine
        val i = e.inclinationRad + e.inclinationRateRadPerSecond * tk + e.cisRad * sine + e.cicRad * cosine
        val nodeRate = e.ascendingNodeRateRadPerSecond -
            if (e.orbitType == BeiDouOrbitType.GEO) 0.0 else EARTH_ROTATION_RAD_PER_SECOND
        val node = e.ascendingNodeRad + nodeRate * tk - EARTH_ROTATION_RAD_PER_SECOND * e.toe.secondsOfWeek
        val x = radius * cos(u)
        val y = radius * sin(u)
        var px = x * cos(node) - y * cos(i) * sin(node)
        var py = x * sin(node) + y * cos(i) * cos(node)
        var pz = y * sin(i)
        if (e.orbitType == BeiDouOrbitType.GEO) {
            // ICD matrices use passive rotations: Rx(phi)[y,z]=[cos* y+sin* z,-sin* y+cos* z].
            val tilt = Math.toRadians(-5.0)
            val tiltedY = cos(tilt) * py + sin(tilt) * pz
            val tiltedZ = -sin(tilt) * py + cos(tilt) * pz
            val angle = EARTH_ROTATION_RAD_PER_SECOND * tk
            py = -sin(angle) * px + cos(angle) * tiltedY
            px = cos(angle) * px + sin(angle) * tiltedY
            pz = tiltedZ
        }
        val dt = transmission.secondsSince(e.toc)
        val relativity = -2 * sqrt(EARTH_MU) / (SPEED_OF_LIGHT * SPEED_OF_LIGHT) *
            e.eccentricity * e.sqrtSemiMajorAxis * sin(eccentric)
        val clock = e.af0Seconds + e.af1SecondsPerSecond * dt + e.af2SecondsPerSecondSquared * dt * dt + relativity
        if (radius <= 0 || !listOf(px, py, pz, clock).all(Double::isFinite))
            return invalid("invalid BeiDou propagation result")
        return BeiDouPropagationResult(BeiDouSatelliteState(px, py, pz, clock))
    }
}
```

`core/src/main/kotlin/com/system/location/service/core/gnss/BeiDouCatalogManifest.kt`:

```kt
package com.system.location.service.core.gnss

import java.net.URI
import java.security.MessageDigest
import kotlinx.serialization.Serializable
import kotlinx.serialization.json.Json

/** Version and source-era evidence stored alongside the original SINEX subset. */
@Serializable
data class BeiDouCatalogManifest(
    val formatVersion: Int,
    val metadataSpecification: String,
    val fullCreationYear: Int,
    val sourceUrl: String,
    /** Attribution fingerprint of the full upstream file; the subset cannot reverify its body. */
    val originalSha256: String,
    /** SHA-256 of UTF-8 subset text with CRLF canonically converted to LF. */
    val subsetSha256: String,
) {
    init {
        require(formatVersion == 1 && metadataSpecification == "1.10" && fullCreationYear in 2006..9999)
        val uri = URI(sourceUrl)
        require(uri.scheme == "https" && !uri.host.isNullOrBlank() && uri.userInfo == null && uri.fragment == null)
        require(sourceUrl.length <= 2048 && originalSha256.matches(Regex("[a-f0-9]{64}")) &&
            subsetSha256.matches(Regex("[a-f0-9]{64}")))
    }

    fun catalog(text: String, utc: GnssUtcTimeScale, maximumOpenIntervalAgeSeconds: Long): BeiDouSkyCatalog {
        require(text.length <= 2 * 1024 * 1024)
        val canonical = text.replace("\r\n", "\n")
        val digest = MessageDigest.getInstance("SHA-256").digest(canonical.toByteArray(Charsets.UTF_8))
            .joinToString("") { "%02x".format(it.toInt() and 255) }
        require(digest == subsetSha256) { "BeiDou metadata subset digest mismatch" }
        val metadata = BeiDouSatelliteMetadata.parse(canonical)
        return BeiDouSkyCatalog(metadata, fullCreationYear, maximumOpenIntervalAgeSeconds, utc,
            "$sourceUrl; SINEX $metadataSpecification; ${metadata.creationAt(fullCreationYear)}; SHA-256 $originalSha256")
    }

    companion object {
        fun decode(text: String): BeiDouCatalogManifest {
            require(text.length <= 4096)
            return Json.decodeFromString(serializer(), text)
        }
    }
}
```

`core/src/main/kotlin/com/system/location/service/core/gnss/BeiDouCatalogResource.kt`:

```kt
package com.system.location.service.core.gnss

import java.security.MessageDigest
import java.time.Duration
import java.time.Instant
import java.time.ZoneOffset
import kotlinx.serialization.Serializable

/** Compact, verifiable subset; neither download time nor HTTP date replaces the SINEX epoch. */
@Serializable
data class BeiDouCatalogResource(val manifest: BeiDouCatalogManifest, val subset: String) {
    init { require(subset.length <= 65536) { "BeiDou catalog subset exceeds IPC budget" } }

    val creationLabel: java.time.LocalDateTime get() = metadata.creationAt(manifest.fullCreationYear)
    private val metadata by lazy {
        require(digest(subset.replace("\r\n", "\n")) == manifest.subsetSha256) { "BeiDou catalog digest mismatch" }
        BeiDouSatelliteMetadata.parse(subset).also { it.creationAt(manifest.fullCreationYear) }
    }

    fun validate(): BeiDouCatalogResource = apply { metadata }
    fun catalog(utc: GnssUtcTimeScale, maximumAgeSeconds: Long): BeiDouSkyCatalog =
        manifest.catalog(subset, utc, maximumAgeSeconds)

    companion object {
        const val SOURCE_URL = "https://files.igs.org/pub/station/general/igs_satellite_metadata.snx"

        /** Last-Modified supplies independent full-year evidence, including December/January. */
        fun import(text: String, lastModifiedMillis: Long): BeiDouCatalogResource {
            require(lastModifiedMillis > 0)
            val original = BeiDouSatelliteMetadata.parse(text)
            val modified = Instant.ofEpochMilli(lastModifiedMillis).atOffset(ZoneOffset.UTC).toLocalDateTime()
            val year = (modified.year - 1..modified.year + 1).mapNotNull { year ->
                runCatching { original.creationAt(year) }.getOrNull()
            }.singleOrNull { creation ->
                val distance = Duration.between(creation, modified).seconds
                // Allow a producer's unspecified epoch scale and a small publication clock skew.
                distance in -86400L..366 * 86400L
            }?.year ?: error("Missing unambiguous SINEX source-era evidence")
            val lines = mutableListOf(text.lineSequence().first())
            var block: String? = null
            for (raw in text.lineSequence().drop(1)) {
                val line = raw.trimEnd()
                when {
                    line in listOf("+SATELLITE/IDENTIFIER", "+SATELLITE/PRN") -> { block = line.drop(1); lines += line }
                    block != null && line == "-$block" -> { lines += line; block = null }
                    block != null && line.startsWith(" C") -> lines += line
                }
            }
            lines += "%ENDSNX"
            val subset = lines.joinToString("\n", postfix = "\n")
            return BeiDouCatalogResource(BeiDouCatalogManifest(1, "1.10", year, SOURCE_URL,
                digest(text), digest(subset)), subset).validate()
        }

        private fun digest(text: String): String = MessageDigest.getInstance("SHA-256")
            .digest(text.toByteArray(Charsets.UTF_8)).joinToString("") { "%02x".format(it.toInt() and 255) }
    }
}
```

`core/src/main/kotlin/com/system/location/service/core/gnss/BeiDouD1Assembler.kt`:

```kt
package com.system.location.service.core.gnss

import kotlin.math.abs

/** One bounded capture domain; D1 parts are joined only within the same 30-second frame. */
class BeiDouD1Assembler(
    private val captureFrom: BeiDouTime,
    private val captureUntil: BeiDouTime,
    private val validFrom: BeiDouTime,
    private val validUntil: BeiDouTime,
    orbitTypes: Map<Int, BeiDouOrbitType>,
) {
    private val types = orbitTypes.toMap()
    private data class Key(val svid: Int, val week: Int, val frameStart: Int)
    private data class Part(val frame: BeiDouNavigationSubframe, val reference: BeiDouTime)
    private data class Candidate(val parts: MutableMap<Int, Part> = linkedMapOf(), var conflict: Boolean = false)
    private val candidates = linkedMapOf<Key, Candidate>()
    private val latest = mutableMapOf<Int, Key>()

    init {
        require(captureUntil.secondsSince(captureFrom) in 0.0..120.0)
        require(validUntil.secondsSince(validFrom) > 0)
        require(types.all { (svid, type) -> svid in 1..63 && type != BeiDouOrbitType.GEO })
    }

    @Synchronized
    fun clear() { candidates.clear(); latest.clear() }

    /** Recompute after late arrivals: an earlier returned value is not a final capture result. */
    @Synchronized
    fun completed(): List<BeiDouD1Decoded> = latest.toSortedMap().values.mapNotNull { candidates[it] }
        .filter { !it.conflict && it.parts.size == 3 }.mapNotNull { decode(it).decoded }

    private fun decode(candidate: Candidate) = BeiDouD1EphemerisDecoder.decode(
        candidate.parts.values.map { it.frame }, validFrom, validUntil,
        types.getValue(candidate.parts.getValue(1).frame.svid), candidate.parts.getValue(1).reference)

    @Synchronized
    fun offer(observation: GnssNavigationObservation, trustedBdtAtCapture: BeiDouTime): BeiDouD1DecodeResult {
        fun invalid(reason: String) = BeiDouD1DecodeResult(null, reason)
        if (trustedBdtAtCapture.secondsSince(captureFrom) < 0 || captureUntil.secondsSince(trustedBdtAtCapture) < 0)
            return invalid("BDT reference outside D1 capture window")
        val checked = BeiDouNavigationWords.decode(observation)
        val frame = checked.subframe ?: return invalid(checked.reason ?: "invalid BeiDou words")
        if (frame.format != BeiDouNavigationFormat.D1 || frame.id !in 1..3)
            return invalid("requires BeiDou D1 ephemeris component")
        if (frame.svid !in types) return invalid("missing independent MEO/IGSO orbit-type evidence")
        val sow = frame.secondsOfWeek.toDouble()
        val ref = trustedBdtAtCapture
        val week = (ref.week.toLong() - 1..ref.week.toLong() + 1).filter { it in 0..Int.MAX_VALUE.toLong() }
            .minByOrNull { abs(BeiDouTime(it.toInt(), sow).secondsSince(ref)) }?.toInt()
            ?: return invalid("cannot resolve D1 frame week")
        if (abs(BeiDouTime(week, sow).secondsSince(ref)) > 120)
            return invalid("D1 SOW disagrees with trusted BDT capture reference")
        // D1's first three subframes fit entirely inside one week (604800 is divisible by 30).
        val key = Key(frame.svid, week, frame.secondsOfWeek - (frame.id - 1) * 6)
        val previousSelection = latest[frame.svid]
        if (previousSelection == null || key.week > previousSelection.week ||
            (key.week == previousSelection.week && key.frameStart > previousSelection.frameStart)) latest[frame.svid] = key
        val candidate = candidates[key] ?: run {
            // Retain conflicting candidates. Flooding and replay cannot erase their evidence.
            // Selection has already advanced, so a rejected newer frame still withdraws old output.
            if (candidates.size >= 64) return invalid("BeiDou D1 candidate capacity exceeded")
            Candidate().also { candidates[key] = it }
        }
        if (candidate.conflict) return invalid("conflicting BeiDou D1 candidate")
        val previous = candidate.parts[frame.id]
        if (previous != null) {
            if ((0 until 28).any { previous.frame.unsigned(it * 8, 8) != frame.unsigned(it * 8, 8) }) {
                candidate.conflict = true
                candidate.parts.clear()
                return invalid("conflicting duplicate BeiDou D1 component")
            }
        } else candidate.parts[frame.id] = Part(frame, ref)
        if (latest[frame.svid] != key) return invalid("BeiDou D1 transmission frame superseded")
        if (candidate.parts.size != 3) return invalid("waiting for BeiDou D1 subframes 1/2/3")
        return decode(candidate)
    }
}
```

`core/src/main/kotlin/com/system/location/service/core/gnss/BeiDouD1EphemerisDecoder.kt`:

```kt
package com.system.location.service.core.gnss

import kotlin.math.pow
import kotlinx.serialization.Serializable

@Serializable
data class BeiDouD1Decoded(
    val ephemeris: BeiDouBroadcastEphemeris,
    val health: Int,
    val uraIndex: Int,
    val tgd1Seconds: Double,
    val tgd2Seconds: Double,
    val transmissionTime: BeiDouTime,
    val ageOfDataClock: Int,
    val ageOfDataEphemeris: Int,
)
data class BeiDouD1DecodeResult(val decoded: BeiDouD1Decoded?, val reason: String? = null)

/**
 * B1I 3.0 D1 subframes 1-3, Figures 5-7/8/9 and Tables 5-7/10. Full capture BDT
 * resolves the transmitted 13-bit week. Validity and MEO/IGSO type require external evidence;
 * AODC/AODE are ages, not issue identifiers or curve-fit durations. Health is returned as evidence.
 */
object BeiDouD1EphemerisDecoder {
    // B1I 3.0 Table 5-11 supplies this value for broadcast semicircle conversion.
    private const val SEMICIRCLE_TO_RADIANS = 3.1415926535898
    fun decode(subframes: Collection<BeiDouNavigationSubframe>, validFrom: BeiDouTime,
        validUntil: BeiDouTime, orbitType: BeiDouOrbitType,
        referenceAtSubframeOneCapture: BeiDouTime): BeiDouD1DecodeResult {
        fun invalid(reason: String) = BeiDouD1DecodeResult(null, reason)
        if (validUntil.secondsSince(validFrom) <= 0) return invalid("invalid external BeiDou validity interval")
        if (orbitType == BeiDouOrbitType.GEO) return invalid("D1 ephemeris cannot describe a GEO satellite")
        if (subframes.size != 3 || subframes.map { it.id }.toSet() != setOf(1, 2, 3) ||
            subframes.any { it.format != BeiDouNavigationFormat.D1 }) return invalid("requires D1 subframes 1/2/3")
        if (subframes.map { it.svid }.distinct().size != 1) return invalid("mixed BeiDou satellite identities")
        if (subframes.maxOf { it.capturedAtMillis } - subframes.minOf { it.capturedAtMillis } > 60_000)
            return invalid("D1 subframes are not contemporaneous")
        val ordered = subframes.sortedBy { it.id }
        val one = ordered[0]; val two = ordered[1]; val three = ordered[2]
        val sow1 = (one.rawUnsigned(18, 8) shl 12) or one.rawUnsigned(30, 12)
        val sow2 = (two.rawUnsigned(18, 8) shl 12) or two.rawUnsigned(30, 12)
        val sow3 = (three.rawUnsigned(18, 8) shl 12) or three.rawUnsigned(30, 12)
        fun follows(previous: Long, current: Long) = (current - previous + 604800L) % 604800L == 6L
        if (!follows(sow1, sow2) || !follows(sow2, sow3)) return invalid("inconsistent BeiDou D1 SOW sequence")
        val week13 = one.rawUnsigned(60, 13).toInt()
        val tocUnits = (one.rawUnsigned(73, 9) shl 8) or one.rawUnsigned(90, 8)
        val toc = tocUnits * 8.0
        val toeUnits = (two.rawUnsigned(290, 2) shl 15) or
            (three.rawUnsigned(42, 10) shl 5) or three.rawUnsigned(60, 5)
        val toe = toeUnits * 8.0
        val transmission = BeiDouDecodeEpochs.transmission(week13, sow1.toDouble(), referenceAtSubframeOneCapture)
            ?: return invalid("D1 transmission disagrees with trusted capture BDT")
        val toeEpoch = BeiDouDecodeEpochs.epoch(toe, transmission) ?: return invalid("invalid or ambiguous BeiDou toe")
        val tocEpoch = BeiDouDecodeEpochs.epoch(toc, transmission) ?: return invalid("invalid or ambiguous BeiDou toc")
        if (transmission.secondsSince(validFrom) < 0 || validUntil.secondsSince(transmission) < 0)
            return invalid("D1 transmission outside supplied validity evidence")
        return try {
            fun signedParts(source: BeiDouNavigationSubframe, a: Int, al: Int, b: Int, bl: Int): Long {
                val value = (source.rawUnsigned(a, al) shl bl) or source.rawUnsigned(b, bl)
                return if (source.rawUnsigned(a, 1) != 0L) value - (1L shl (al + bl)) else value
            }
            fun s2(a: Int, al: Int, b: Int, bl: Int) = signedParts(two, a, al, b, bl)
            fun s3(a: Int, al: Int, b: Int, bl: Int) = signedParts(three, a, al, b, bl)
            val e = BeiDouBroadcastEphemeris(one.svid, orbitType, toeEpoch,
                tocEpoch, validFrom, validUntil,
                ((two.rawUnsigned(250, 12) shl 20) or two.rawUnsigned(270, 20)) * 2.0.pow(-19),
                ((two.rawUnsigned(132, 10) shl 22) or two.rawUnsigned(150, 22)) * 2.0.pow(-33),
                s3(65, 17, 90, 15) * 2.0.pow(-31) * SEMICIRCLE_TO_RADIANS,
                s3(211, 21, 240, 11) * 2.0.pow(-31) * SEMICIRCLE_TO_RADIANS,
                s3(251, 11, 270, 21) * 2.0.pow(-31) * SEMICIRCLE_TO_RADIANS,
                s2(92, 20, 120, 12) * 2.0.pow(-31) * SEMICIRCLE_TO_RADIANS,
                s2(42, 10, 60, 6) * 2.0.pow(-43) * SEMICIRCLE_TO_RADIANS,
                s3(131, 11, 150, 13) * 2.0.pow(-43) * SEMICIRCLE_TO_RADIANS,
                s3(189, 13, 210, 1) * 2.0.pow(-43) * SEMICIRCLE_TO_RADIANS,
                s2(66, 16, 90, 2) * 2.0.pow(-31), two.rawSigned(180, 18) * 2.0.pow(-31),
                s2(198, 4, 210, 14) * 2.0.pow(-6), s2(224, 8, 240, 10) * 2.0.pow(-6),
                s3(105, 7, 120, 11) * 2.0.pow(-31), s3(163, 9, 180, 9) * 2.0.pow(-31),
                signedParts(one, 225, 7, 240, 17) * 2.0.pow(-33),
                signedParts(one, 257, 5, 270, 17) * 2.0.pow(-50),
                one.rawSigned(214, 11) * 2.0.pow(-66))
            BeiDouD1DecodeResult(BeiDouD1Decoded(e, one.rawUnsigned(42, 1).toInt(), one.rawUnsigned(48, 4).toInt(),
                one.rawSigned(98, 10) * 0.1e-9,
                signedParts(one, 108, 4, 120, 6) * 0.1e-9,
                transmission, one.rawUnsigned(43, 5).toInt(), one.rawUnsigned(287, 5).toInt()))
        } catch (error: IllegalArgumentException) { invalid(error.message ?: "invalid BeiDou D1 parameters") }
    }
}
```

`core/src/main/kotlin/com/system/location/service/core/gnss/BeiDouD2Assembler.kt`:

```kt
package com.system.location.service.core.gnss

import kotlin.math.abs

/** Bounded D2 GEO assembly: nine required pages from one 30-second broadcast cycle. */
class BeiDouD2Assembler(
    private val captureFrom: BeiDouTime,
    private val captureUntil: BeiDouTime,
    private val validFrom: BeiDouTime,
    private val validUntil: BeiDouTime,
) {
    private data class Key(val svid: Int, val week: Int, val cycleStart: Double)
    private data class Part(val page: BeiDouNavigationSubframe, val reference: BeiDouTime)
    private data class Candidate(val parts: MutableMap<Int, Part> = linkedMapOf(), var conflict: Boolean = false)
    private val candidates = linkedMapOf<Key, Candidate>()
    private val latest = mutableMapOf<Int, Key>()

    init {
        require(captureUntil.secondsSince(captureFrom) in 0.0..120.0)
        require(validUntil.secondsSince(validFrom) > 0)
    }

    @Synchronized
    fun clear() { candidates.clear(); latest.clear() }

    @Synchronized
    fun completed(): List<BeiDouD2Decoded> = latest.toSortedMap().values.mapNotNull { candidates[it] }
        .filter { !it.conflict && it.parts.keys.containsAll(BeiDouD2EphemerisDecoder.requiredPages) }
        .mapNotNull { decode(it).decoded }

    private fun decode(candidate: Candidate) = BeiDouD2EphemerisDecoder.decode(
        candidate.parts.values.map { it.page }, validFrom, validUntil, candidate.parts.getValue(1).reference)

    @Synchronized
    fun offer(observation: GnssNavigationObservation, trustedBdtAtCapture: BeiDouTime): BeiDouD2DecodeResult {
        fun invalid(reason: String) = BeiDouD2DecodeResult(null, reason)
        if (trustedBdtAtCapture.secondsSince(captureFrom) < 0 || captureUntil.secondsSince(trustedBdtAtCapture) < 0)
            return invalid("BDT reference outside D2 capture window")
        val checked = BeiDouNavigationWords.decode(observation)
        val page = checked.subframe ?: return invalid(checked.reason ?: "invalid BeiDou words")
        if (page.format != BeiDouNavigationFormat.D2 || page.id != 1)
            return invalid("requires BeiDou D2 subframe 1")
        val number = page.rawUnsigned(42, 4).toInt()
        if (number !in BeiDouD2EphemerisDecoder.requiredPages) return invalid("D2 page is not an ephemeris component")
        val sow = page.secondsOfWeek.toDouble()
        val ref = trustedBdtAtCapture
        val full = (ref.week.toLong() - 1..ref.week.toLong() + 1).filter { it in 0..Int.MAX_VALUE.toLong() }
            .map { BeiDouTime(it.toInt(), sow) }.minByOrNull { abs(it.secondsSince(ref)) }
            ?: return invalid("cannot resolve D2 page week")
        if (abs(full.secondsSince(ref)) > 120) return invalid("D2 SOW disagrees with trusted BDT capture reference")
        val cycle = try { full.plusSeconds(-(number - 1) * 3.0) }
            catch (_: IllegalArgumentException) { return invalid("D2 cycle lies before BDT epoch") }
        val key = Key(page.svid, cycle.week, cycle.secondsOfWeek)
        val selection = latest[page.svid]
        if (selection == null || key.week > selection.week ||
            (key.week == selection.week && key.cycleStart > selection.cycleStart)) latest[page.svid] = key
        val candidate = candidates[key] ?: run {
            if (candidates.size >= 64) return invalid("BeiDou D2 candidate capacity exceeded")
            Candidate().also { candidates[key] = it }
        }
        if (candidate.conflict) return invalid("conflicting BeiDou D2 candidate")
        val previous = candidate.parts[number]
        if (previous != null) {
            if ((0 until 28).any { previous.page.unsigned(it * 8, 8) != page.unsigned(it * 8, 8) }) {
                candidate.conflict = true
                candidate.parts.clear()
                return invalid("conflicting duplicate BeiDou D2 page")
            }
        } else candidate.parts[number] = Part(page, ref)
        if (latest[page.svid] != key) return invalid("BeiDou D2 broadcast cycle superseded")
        if (!candidate.parts.keys.containsAll(BeiDouD2EphemerisDecoder.requiredPages))
            return invalid("waiting for BeiDou D2 pages 1 and 3..10")
        return decode(candidate)
    }
}
```

`core/src/main/kotlin/com/system/location/service/core/gnss/BeiDouD2EphemerisDecoder.kt`:

```kt
package com.system.location.service.core.gnss

import kotlin.math.pow
import kotlinx.serialization.Serializable

@Serializable
data class BeiDouD2Decoded(
    val ephemeris: BeiDouBroadcastEphemeris,
    val health: Int,
    val uraIndex: Int,
    val tgd1Seconds: Double,
    val tgd2Seconds: Double,
    val transmissionTimeOfPageOne: BeiDouTime,
    val ageOfDataClock: Int,
    val ageOfDataEphemeris: Int,
)
data class BeiDouD2DecodeResult(val decoded: BeiDouD2Decoded?, val reason: String? = null)

/**
 * B1I 3.0 Figures 5-14-1..10: GEO subframe 1 pages 1 and 3..10 carry orbit/clock.
 * Page 2 is optional ionospheric evidence, not required to complete an ephemeris. Parameters
 * split across pages are joined before signed conversion. External validity remains mandatory.
 */
object BeiDouD2EphemerisDecoder {
    private const val SEMICIRCLE_TO_RADIANS = 3.1415926535898
    internal val requiredPages: Set<Int> = setOf(1, 3, 4, 5, 6, 7, 8, 9, 10)

    fun decode(pages: Collection<BeiDouNavigationSubframe>, validFrom: BeiDouTime,
        validUntil: BeiDouTime, referenceAtPageOneCapture: BeiDouTime): BeiDouD2DecodeResult {
        fun invalid(reason: String) = BeiDouD2DecodeResult(null, reason)
        if (validUntil.secondsSince(validFrom) <= 0) return invalid("invalid external BeiDou validity interval")
        if (pages.any { it.format != BeiDouNavigationFormat.D2 || it.id != 1 })
            return invalid("requires BeiDou D2 subframe 1 pages")
        val numbered = pages.map { it.rawUnsigned(42, 4).toInt() to it }
        if (numbered.map { it.first }.distinct().size != numbered.size ||
            numbered.any { it.first !in 1..10 } || !numbered.map { it.first }.containsAll(requiredPages))
            return invalid("requires unique D2 pages 1 and 3..10")
        if (pages.map { it.svid }.distinct().size != 1) return invalid("mixed BeiDou satellite identities")
        if (pages.maxOf { it.capturedAtMillis } - pages.minOf { it.capturedAtMillis } > 60_000)
            return invalid("D2 pages are not contemporaneous")
        val p = numbered.toMap()
        val one = p.getValue(1)
        val sow1 = one.secondsOfWeek
        for ((number, page) in numbered) {
            val expectedSow = (sow1 + (number - 1) * 3) % 604800
            if (page.secondsOfWeek != expectedSow) return invalid("inconsistent D2 page SOW sequence")
        }
        val transmission = BeiDouDecodeEpochs.transmission(one.rawUnsigned(64, 13).toInt(),
            sow1.toDouble(), referenceAtPageOneCapture)
            ?: return invalid("D2 transmission disagrees with trusted capture BDT")
        if (transmission.secondsSince(validFrom) < 0 || validUntil.secondsSince(transmission) < 27)
            return invalid("D2 transmission cycle outside supplied validity evidence")
        // Each triplet is (page, ICD diagram offset, bit length); no wire interleaving here.
        fun bits(vararg fields: Int, signed: Boolean = false): Long {
            var value = 0L
            var length = 0
            for (i in fields.indices step 3) {
                value = (value shl fields[i + 2]) or p.getValue(fields[i]).rawUnsigned(fields[i + 1], fields[i + 2])
                length += fields[i + 2]
            }
            return if (signed && value and (1L shl (length - 1)) != 0L) value - (1L shl length) else value
        }
        fun scaled(power: Int, vararg fields: Int) = bits(*fields, signed = true) * 2.0.pow(power)
        val toe = BeiDouDecodeEpochs.epoch(bits(7, 80, 2, 7, 90, 15) * 8.0, transmission)
            ?: return invalid("invalid or ambiguous BeiDou D2 toe")
        val toc = BeiDouDecodeEpochs.epoch(bits(1, 77, 5, 1, 90, 12) * 8.0, transmission)
            ?: return invalid("invalid or ambiguous BeiDou D2 toc")
        return try {
            val e = BeiDouBroadcastEphemeris(one.svid, BeiDouOrbitType.GEO, toe, toc, validFrom, validUntil,
                bits(6, 76, 6, 6, 90, 22, 6, 120, 4) * 2.0.pow(-19),
                bits(5, 124, 10, 6, 46, 6, 6, 60, 16) * 2.0.pow(-33),
                scaled(-31, 7, 105, 7, 7, 120, 14, 8, 46, 6, 8, 60, 5) * SEMICIRCLE_TO_RADIANS,
                scaled(-31, 9, 51, 1, 9, 60, 22, 9, 90, 9) * SEMICIRCLE_TO_RADIANS,
                scaled(-31, 9, 99, 13, 9, 120, 14, 10, 46, 5) * SEMICIRCLE_TO_RADIANS,
                scaled(-31, 5, 50, 2, 5, 60, 22, 5, 90, 8) * SEMICIRCLE_TO_RADIANS,
                scaled(-43, 4, 96, 16) * SEMICIRCLE_TO_RADIANS,
                scaled(-43, 8, 109, 3, 8, 120, 16, 9, 46, 5) * SEMICIRCLE_TO_RADIANS,
                scaled(-43, 10, 51, 1, 10, 60, 13) * SEMICIRCLE_TO_RADIANS,
                scaled(-31, 4, 120, 14, 5, 46, 4), scaled(-31, 5, 98, 14, 5, 120, 4),
                scaled(-6, 8, 65, 17, 8, 90, 1), scaled(-6, 8, 91, 18),
                scaled(-31, 6, 124, 10, 7, 46, 6, 7, 60, 2), scaled(-31, 7, 62, 18),
                scaled(-33, 3, 100, 12, 3, 120, 12), scaled(-50, 3, 132, 4, 4, 46, 6, 4, 60, 12),
                scaled(-66, 4, 72, 10, 4, 90, 1))
            BeiDouD2DecodeResult(BeiDouD2Decoded(e, bits(1, 46, 1).toInt(), bits(1, 60, 4).toInt(),
                bits(1, 102, 10, signed = true) * 0.1e-9, bits(1, 120, 10, signed = true) * 0.1e-9,
                transmission, bits(1, 47, 5).toInt(), bits(4, 91, 5).toInt()))
        } catch (error: IllegalArgumentException) { invalid(error.message ?: "invalid BeiDou D2 parameters") }
    }
}
```

`core/src/main/kotlin/com/system/location/service/core/gnss/BeiDouDecodeEpochs.kt`:

```kt
package com.system.location.service.core.gnss

import kotlin.math.abs

/** B1I truncated week and weekless clock/orbit epoch association, not a validity policy. */
internal object BeiDouDecodeEpochs {
    fun transmission(week13: Int, sow: Double, reference: BeiDouTime): BeiDouTime? {
        if (week13 !in 0..8191 || sow !in 0.0..<604800.0) return null
        val era = reference.week / 8192
        val week = (era - 1..era + 1).map { it.toLong() * 8192 + week13 }
            .filter { it in 0..Int.MAX_VALUE.toLong() }.minByOrNull { abs(it - reference.week) }?.toInt()
            ?: return null
        return BeiDouTime(week, sow).takeIf { abs(it.secondsSince(reference)) <= 120 }
    }

    fun epoch(seconds: Double, transmission: BeiDouTime): BeiDouTime? {
        if (seconds !in 0.0..<604800.0) return null
        val week = transmission.week.toLong()
        val candidates = (week - 1..week + 1).filter { it in 0..Int.MAX_VALUE.toLong() }
            .map { BeiDouTime(it.toInt(), seconds) }
        val closest = candidates.minByOrNull { abs(it.secondsSince(transmission)) } ?: return null
        val distance = abs(closest.secondsSince(transmission))
        if (distance >= 302400) return null // exactly half a week is ambiguous, including at the epoch
        return closest
    }
}
```

`core/src/main/kotlin/com/system/location/service/core/gnss/BeiDouNavigationWords.kt`:

```kt
package com.system.location.service.core.gnss

import java.util.Base64

enum class BeiDouNavigationFormat { D1, D2 }

/** 224 information bits after BCH verification/deinterleaving (26 + 9*22), MSB first. */
class BeiDouNavigationSubframe internal constructor(
    val svid: Int,
    val capturedAtMillis: Long,
    val format: BeiDouNavigationFormat,
    val id: Int,
    /** D1: this subframe's first bit. D2: subframe 1's first bit in the containing frame. */
    val secondsOfWeek: Int,
    information: ByteArray,
) {
    private val bytes = information.copyOf()
    /** Read the ICD's deinterleaved 300-bit diagram layout; parity positions are rejected. */
    fun rawUnsigned(start: Int, length: Int): Long {
        require(start >= 0 && length in 1..63 && start + length <= 300)
        var value = 0L
        repeat(length) { offset ->
            val raw = start + offset
            val word = raw / 30
            val within = raw % 30
            require(if (word == 0) within < 26 else within < 22) { "range includes BeiDou BCH parity" }
            val info = if (word == 0) within else 26 + (word - 1) * 22 + within
            value = (value shl 1) or ((bytes[info / 8].toInt() ushr (7 - info % 8)) and 1).toLong()
        }
        return value
    }

    fun rawSigned(start: Int, length: Int): Long {
        val raw = rawUnsigned(start, length)
        return if (raw and (1L shl (length - 1)) != 0L) raw - (1L shl length) else raw
    }
    fun unsigned(start: Int, length: Int): Long {
        require(start >= 0 && length in 1..63 && start + length <= 224)
        var value = 0L
        repeat(length) { offset ->
            val bit = start + offset
            value = (value shl 1) or ((bytes[bit / 8].toInt() ushr (7 - bit % 8)) and 1).toLong()
        }
        return value
    }
    fun signed(start: Int, length: Int): Long {
        val raw = unsigned(start, length)
        return if (raw and (1L shl (length - 1)) != 0L) raw - (1L shl length) else raw
    }
}

data class BeiDouNavigationWordResult(val subframe: BeiDouNavigationSubframe?, val reason: String? = null)

/**
 * B1I 3.0 §§5.1.3, 5.2.2/4, 5.3.1/3. Android packs ten 30-bit transmitted words
 * into 40 bytes, MSB first, with two leading padding bits per word. First-word leading
 * 15 bits are unprotected; its lower 15 bits use BCH. Remaining words interleave two
 * systematic BCH(15,11) codewords using g(x)=x^4+x+1. We verify every syndrome, including
 * payloads labelled PARITY_PASSED/REBUILT by the HAL, and do not silently correct bad bits.
 */
object BeiDouNavigationWords {
    fun decode(observation: GnssNavigationObservation): BeiDouNavigationWordResult {
        fun invalid(reason: String) = BeiDouNavigationWordResult(null, reason)
        val format = when (observation.type) {
            0x0501 -> BeiDouNavigationFormat.D1
            0x0502 -> BeiDouNavigationFormat.D2
            else -> return invalid("requires BeiDou D1 or D2 navigation data")
        }
        if (observation.svid !in 1..63 || observation.status !in 0..2)
            return invalid("invalid BeiDou identity or parity status")
        val payload = Base64.getDecoder().decode(observation.dataBase64)
        if (payload.size != 40) return invalid("BeiDou Android payload must contain ten padded 30-bit words")
        val words = IntArray(10) { index ->
            (0..3).fold(0) { word, byte -> (word shl 8) or (payload[index * 4 + byte].toInt() and 255) }
        }
        if (words.any { it ushr 30 != 0 }) return invalid("nonzero BeiDou Android word padding")
        if (words[0] ushr 19 != 0x712) return invalid("invalid BeiDou preamble")
        val information = ByteArray(28)
        var position = 0
        fun append(value: Int, count: Int) = repeat(count) { offset ->
            val bit = (value ushr (count - offset - 1)) and 1
            information[position / 8] = (information[position / 8].toInt() or (bit shl (7 - position % 8))).toByte()
            position++
        }
        if (syndrome(words[0] and 0x7fff) != 0) return invalid("BeiDou word 1 BCH failure")
        append(words[0] ushr 4, 26)
        for (index in 1..9) {
            var first = 0
            var second = 0
            repeat(15) { bit ->
                first = (first shl 1) or ((words[index] ushr (29 - bit * 2)) and 1)
                second = (second shl 1) or ((words[index] ushr (28 - bit * 2)) and 1)
            }
            if (syndrome(first) != 0 || syndrome(second) != 0) return invalid("BeiDou word ${index + 1} BCH failure")
            append(first ushr 4, 11)
            append(second ushr 4, 11)
        }
        val preliminary = BeiDouNavigationSubframe(observation.svid, observation.capturedAtMillis, format, 0, 0, information)
        val id = preliminary.unsigned(15, 3).toInt()
        val sow = (preliminary.rawUnsigned(18, 8) shl 12 or preliminary.rawUnsigned(30, 12)).toInt()
        if (id !in 1..5 || id != observation.submessageId) return invalid("BeiDou subframe/metadata identity mismatch")
        if (sow >= 604800) return invalid("BeiDou SOW outside week")
        if (format == BeiDouNavigationFormat.D1 && sow % 30 != (id - 1) * 6)
            return invalid("BeiDou D1 SOW/subframe phase mismatch")
        if (format == BeiDouNavigationFormat.D2 && sow % 3 != 0)
            return invalid("BeiDou D2 containing-frame SOW phase mismatch")
        return BeiDouNavigationWordResult(BeiDouNavigationSubframe(observation.svid, observation.capturedAtMillis,
            format, id, sow, information))
    }

    private fun syndrome(codeword: Int): Int {
        var remainder = codeword
        for (bit in 14 downTo 4) if (remainder and (1 shl bit) != 0)
            remainder = remainder xor (0x13 shl (bit - 4))
        return remainder and 15
    }
}
```

`core/src/main/kotlin/com/system/location/service/core/gnss/BeiDouReceptionGeometry.kt`:

```kt
package com.system.location.service.core.gnss

import kotlin.math.*

/** Position and ellipsoid-normal orientation in BDCS at reception. No WGS84 conversion is implied. */
data class BdcsReceiver(val position: EcefPosition, val orientation: GeodeticOrientation)

data class BeiDouReceptionObservation(
    val transmissionTime: BeiDouTime,
    val propagationSeconds: Double,
    /** Transmission position rotated into the BDCS ECEF axes at reception. */
    val satelliteInReceptionEcef: EcefPosition,
    val lineOfSight: GnssLineOfSight,
    /** Polynomial plus relativity for the B1I/B2I clock model; no single-frequency TGD correction. */
    val clockBiasSeconds: Double,
)

data class BeiDouReceptionResult(val observation: BeiDouReceptionObservation?, val reason: String? = null)

/**
 * Geometric vacuum light-time using the B1I 3.0 Table 5-11 BDCS transmission position.
 * Reception and transmission epochs are BDT, not receiver/satellite clock readings.
 * The ECEF rotation is Rz(-Omega_e * flightTime), into reception axes; it is applied once.
 * This mathematical geometry does not establish signal usability, atmospheric corrections,
 * pseudorange, coordinate-frame transformation, or the provenance of the validity interval.
 */
object BeiDouReceptionGeometry {
    const val SPEED_OF_LIGHT_METERS_PER_SECOND = 299792458.0

    fun observe(e: BeiDouBroadcastEphemeris, receptionTime: BeiDouTime,
        receiver: BdcsReceiver): BeiDouReceptionResult {
        fun invalid(reason: String) = BeiDouReceptionResult(null, reason)
        // Bound orbital radius by a(1+e) and the two radial harmonic amplitudes.
        val maximumRadius = e.sqrtSemiMajorAxis * e.sqrtSemiMajorAxis * (1 + e.eccentricity) +
            abs(e.crsMeters) + abs(e.crcMeters)
        val r = receiver.position
        val maximumDelay = (maximumRadius + hypot(hypot(r.xMeters, r.yMeters), r.zMeters)) /
            SPEED_OF_LIGHT_METERS_PER_SECOND
        if (!maximumDelay.isFinite()) return invalid("non-finite BeiDou reception bound")
        var lower = max(0.0, receptionTime.secondsSince(e.validUntil))
        var upper = min(maximumDelay, receptionTime.secondsSince(e.validFrom))
        if (lower > upper) return invalid("no transmission inside absolute BeiDou validity interval")

        fun evaluate(delay: Double): BeiDouReceptionObservation? {
            val transmission = receptionTime.plusSeconds(-delay)
            val state = BeiDouBroadcastPropagator.propagate(e, transmission).state ?: return null
            val angle = BeiDouBroadcastPropagator.EARTH_ROTATION_RAD_PER_SECOND * delay
            val position = EcefPosition(cos(angle) * state.xMeters + sin(angle) * state.yMeters,
                -sin(angle) * state.xMeters + cos(angle) * state.yMeters, state.zMeters)
            val los = GnssObserverGeometry.lineOfSight(r, receiver.orientation, position) ?: return null
            return BeiDouReceptionObservation(transmission, delay, position, los,
                state.clockBiasSeconds)
        }
        fun residual(o: BeiDouReceptionObservation) =
            o.lineOfSight.rangeMeters / SPEED_OF_LIGHT_METERS_PER_SECOND - o.propagationSeconds
        val atLower = evaluate(lower) ?: return invalid("unavailable BeiDou state at reception bracket")
        val atUpper = evaluate(upper) ?: return invalid("unavailable BeiDou state at reception bracket")
        if (residual(atLower) < -1e-13 || residual(atUpper) > 1e-13)
            return invalid("light-time solution outside absolute BeiDou validity interval")
        // All trials stay inside the explicit validity interval. Bisection has a finite budget.
        repeat(50) {
            val result = evaluate(lower + (upper - lower) / 2)
                ?: return invalid("BeiDou light-time evaluation failed")
            val error = residual(result)
            if (abs(error) <= 1e-13) return BeiDouReceptionResult(result)
            if (error > 0) lower = result.propagationSeconds else upper = result.propagationSeconds
        }
        return invalid("BeiDou light-time equation did not converge")
    }
}
```

`core/src/main/kotlin/com/system/location/service/core/gnss/BeiDouSatelliteMetadata.kt`:

```kt
package com.system.location.service.core.gnss

import java.time.LocalDate
import java.time.LocalDateTime

data class BeiDouSatelliteIdentity(val svn: String, val block: String, val orbitType: BeiDouOrbitType?)

/**
 * IGS Metadata SINEX 1.10 §§2.2/2.4, Table 1. PRNs are time-varying assignments, not
 * orbit classes. Epochs remain calendar labels: this parser does not invent their time scale.
 * An adapter must supply resolved labels (or a conservative closed uncertainty interval).
 * Catalog membership is NOT signal health, availability of navigation data or orbital validity.
 * https://files.igs.org/pub/resource/working_groups/multi_gnss/Metadata_SINEX_1.10.pdf
 */
class BeiDouSatelliteMetadata private constructor(
    val creationLabel: String,
    val identities: Map<String, BeiDouSatelliteIdentity>,
    private val assignments: List<Assignment>,
) {
    private data class Assignment(val svn: String, val prn: Int, val from: LocalDateTime, val until: LocalDateTime?)

    /** Reject gaps, overlaps, unknown blocks and uncertainty crossing a reassignment boundary. */
    fun identityAt(prn: Int, earliestLabel: LocalDateTime, latestLabel: LocalDateTime = earliestLabel): BeiDouSatelliteIdentity? {
        require(prn in 1..63 && !latestLabel.isBefore(earliestLabel))
        val intersecting = assignments.filter { it.prn == prn && !it.from.isAfter(latestLabel) &&
            (it.until == null || it.until.isAfter(earliestLabel)) }
        val match = intersecting.singleOrNull() ?: return null
        if (match.from.isAfter(earliestLabel) || (match.until != null && !match.until.isAfter(latestLabel))) return null
        if (assignments.any { it.svn == match.svn && it.prn != prn && !it.from.isAfter(latestLabel) &&
                (it.until == null || it.until.isAfter(earliestLabel)) }) return null
        return identities[match.svn]?.takeIf { it.orbitType != null }
    }

    /** Resolve the header's two-digit year only against independently supplied source-era evidence. */
    fun creationAt(fullYear: Int): LocalDateTime {
        require(fullYear in 1..9999 && fullYear % 100 == creationLabel.take(2).toInt())
        return epoch("%04d:%s".format(java.util.Locale.ROOT, fullYear, creationLabel.drop(3)))
    }

    companion object {
        private val orbitTypes = mapOf(
            "BDS-2G" to BeiDouOrbitType.GEO, "BDS-3G" to BeiDouOrbitType.GEO,
            "BDS-2I" to BeiDouOrbitType.IGSO, "BDS-3I" to BeiDouOrbitType.IGSO,
            "BDS-3SI-CAST" to BeiDouOrbitType.IGSO, "BDS-3SI-SECM" to BeiDouOrbitType.IGSO,
            "BDS-2M" to BeiDouOrbitType.MEO, "BDS-3SM-CAST" to BeiDouOrbitType.MEO,
            "BDS-3SM-SECM" to BeiDouOrbitType.MEO, "BDS-3M-CAST" to BeiDouOrbitType.MEO,
            "BDS-3M-SECM-A" to BeiDouOrbitType.MEO, "BDS-3M-SECM-B" to BeiDouOrbitType.MEO,
        )
        private fun epoch(label: String): LocalDateTime {
            require(label.matches(Regex("[0-9]{4}:[0-9]{3}:[0-9]{5}")))
            val year = label.substring(0, 4).toInt()
            val day = label.substring(5, 8).toInt()
            val seconds = label.substring(9).toInt()
            require(year in 1..9999 && seconds in 0..86399)
            require(day in 1..LocalDate.of(year, 1, 1).lengthOfYear())
            return LocalDate.ofYearDay(year, day).atStartOfDay().plusSeconds(seconds.toLong())
        }

        fun parse(text: String): BeiDouSatelliteMetadata {
            require(text.toByteArray(Charsets.UTF_8).size <= 2 * 1024 * 1024) { "Satellite metadata too large" }
            require(text.all { it == '\r' || it == '\n' || it in ' '..'~' })
            val lines = text.lines()
            val header = lines.first().trim().split(Regex("\\s+"))
            require(header.size >= 5 && header[0] == "%=SNX" && header[1] == "2.02") { "Unsupported metadata SINEX header" }
            val creation = header[3]
            require(creation.matches(Regex("[0-9]{2}:[0-9]{3}:[0-9]{5}")))
            val identities = linkedMapOf<String, BeiDouSatelliteIdentity>()
            val assignments = mutableListOf<Assignment>()
            val seen = mutableSetOf<String>()
            var block: String? = null
            var ended = false
            for (line in lines.drop(1)) {
                require(line.length <= 256)
                if (ended) { require(line.isBlank()); continue }
                when {
                    line.startsWith("%ENDSNX") -> { require(block == null && line.trim() == "%ENDSNX"); ended = true }
                    line.startsWith("+") -> {
                        require(block == null)
                        block = line.drop(1).trim()
                        require(seen.add(block)) { "Duplicate metadata block" }
                    }
                    line.startsWith("-") -> { require(block != null && line.drop(1).trim() == block); block = null }
                    line.startsWith(" C") && block in setOf("SATELLITE/IDENTIFIER", "SATELLITE/PRN") -> {
                        require(line.length >= 39 && line[5] == ' ')
                        val svn = line.substring(1, 5)
                        require(svn.matches(Regex("C[0-9]{3}")))
                        if (block == "SATELLITE/IDENTIFIER") {
                            require(line[22] == ' ')
                            val name = line.substring(23, 38).trim()
                            require(name.isNotEmpty() && !identities.containsKey(svn))
                            identities[svn] = BeiDouSatelliteIdentity(svn, name, orbitTypes[name])
                        } else {
                            require(line[20] == ' ' && line[35] == ' ' && line[36] == 'C')
                            val from = epoch(line.substring(6, 20))
                            val endLabel = line.substring(21, 35)
                            val until = if (endLabel == "0000:000:00000") null else epoch(endLabel)
                            val prn = line.substring(37, 39).toInt()
                            require(prn in 1..63 && (until == null || until.isAfter(from)))
                            assignments += Assignment(svn, prn, from, until)
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
            require(ended && block == null && seen.containsAll(listOf("SATELLITE/IDENTIFIER", "SATELLITE/PRN")))
            require(identities.isNotEmpty() && assignments.isNotEmpty() && assignments.all { it.svn in identities })
            return BeiDouSatelliteMetadata(creation, identities.toMap(), assignments.distinct())
        }
    }
}
```

`core/src/main/kotlin/com/system/location/service/core/gnss/BeiDouSignalClock.kt`:

```kt
package com.system.location.service.core.gnss

import kotlinx.serialization.Serializable

enum class BeiDouLegacySignal { B1I, B2I }

/** Independently established service applicability; an orbit fit interval is not health evidence. */
@Serializable
data class BeiDouServiceValidity(val from: BeiDouTime, val until: BeiDouTime) {
    init { require(until.secondsSince(from) > 0) }
    fun contains(time: BeiDouTime) = time.secondsSince(from) >= 0 && until.secondsSince(time) >= 0
}

data class BeiDouSignalClockResult(val correctionSeconds: Double?, val reason: String? = null)

/** B1I 3.0 §§5.2.4.5/6/9/10: B1I clock minus TGD1; B2I clock minus TGD2. */
object BeiDouSignalClock {
    fun correction(decoded: BeiDouD1Decoded, transmission: BeiDouTime, signal: BeiDouLegacySignal,
        serviceValidity: BeiDouServiceValidity): BeiDouSignalClockResult {
        if (decoded.ephemeris.orbitType == BeiDouOrbitType.GEO)
            return BeiDouSignalClockResult(null, "D1 service evidence cannot describe GEO")
        return evaluate(decoded.ephemeris, decoded.health, decoded.uraIndex, decoded.tgd1Seconds, decoded.tgd2Seconds,
            decoded.transmissionTime, transmission, signal, serviceValidity)
    }

    fun correction(decoded: BeiDouD2Decoded, transmission: BeiDouTime, signal: BeiDouLegacySignal,
        serviceValidity: BeiDouServiceValidity): BeiDouSignalClockResult {
        if (decoded.ephemeris.orbitType != BeiDouOrbitType.GEO)
            return BeiDouSignalClockResult(null, "D2 service evidence requires GEO")
        return evaluate(decoded.ephemeris, decoded.health, decoded.uraIndex, decoded.tgd1Seconds, decoded.tgd2Seconds,
            decoded.transmissionTimeOfPageOne, transmission, signal, serviceValidity)
    }

    private fun evaluate(e: BeiDouBroadcastEphemeris, health: Int, ura: Int, tgd1: Double, tgd2: Double,
        serviceBroadcast: BeiDouTime, transmission: BeiDouTime, signal: BeiDouLegacySignal,
        serviceValidity: BeiDouServiceValidity): BeiDouSignalClockResult {
        fun invalid(reason: String) = BeiDouSignalClockResult(null, reason)
        if (!serviceValidity.contains(serviceBroadcast) || !serviceValidity.contains(transmission))
            return invalid("BeiDou service evidence outside independently supplied applicability interval")
        if (health != 0) return invalid("BeiDou autonomous health flag is not good")
        if (ura !in 0..14) return invalid("BeiDou URAI indicates maneuver, no accuracy prediction or invalid data")
        val tgd = if (signal == BeiDouLegacySignal.B1I) tgd1 else tgd2
        if (!tgd.isFinite() || tgd < -512 * 0.1e-9 || tgd > 511 * 0.1e-9)
            return invalid("BeiDou signal TGD outside broadcast field range")
        val propagated = BeiDouBroadcastPropagator.propagate(e, transmission)
        val state = propagated.state ?: return invalid(propagated.reason ?: "unavailable BeiDou orbit/clock")
        val bias = state.clockBiasSeconds - tgd
        if (!bias.isFinite()) return invalid("non-finite BeiDou single-frequency clock")
        return BeiDouSignalClockResult(bias)
    }
}
```

```kt
package com.system.location.service.core.gnss

data class BeiDouSignalReceptionObservation(
    val geometry: BeiDouReceptionObservation,
    val signal: BeiDouLegacySignal,
    val signalClockBiasSeconds: Double,
)
data class BeiDouSignalReceptionResult(val observation: BeiDouSignalReceptionObservation?, val reason: String? = null)

/** Apply service validity, SatH1/URAI and TGD at the solved BDT transmission epoch. */
object BeiDouSignalReception {
    fun observe(decoded: BeiDouD1Decoded, receptionTime: BeiDouTime, receiver: BdcsReceiver,
        signal: BeiDouLegacySignal, serviceValidity: BeiDouServiceValidity): BeiDouSignalReceptionResult =
        evaluate(decoded.ephemeris, receptionTime, receiver, signal) { transmission ->
            BeiDouSignalClock.correction(decoded, transmission, signal, serviceValidity)
        }

    fun observe(decoded: BeiDouD2Decoded, receptionTime: BeiDouTime, receiver: BdcsReceiver,
        signal: BeiDouLegacySignal, serviceValidity: BeiDouServiceValidity): BeiDouSignalReceptionResult =
        evaluate(decoded.ephemeris, receptionTime, receiver, signal) { transmission ->
            BeiDouSignalClock.correction(decoded, transmission, signal, serviceValidity)
        }

    private fun evaluate(e: BeiDouBroadcastEphemeris, receptionTime: BeiDouTime, receiver: BdcsReceiver,
        signal: BeiDouLegacySignal, clock: (BeiDouTime) -> BeiDouSignalClockResult): BeiDouSignalReceptionResult {
        val result = BeiDouReceptionGeometry.observe(e, receptionTime, receiver)
        val geometry = result.observation ?: return BeiDouSignalReceptionResult(null, result.reason)
        val correction = clock(geometry.transmissionTime)
        val bias = correction.correctionSeconds ?: return BeiDouSignalReceptionResult(null, correction.reason)
        return BeiDouSignalReceptionResult(BeiDouSignalReceptionObservation(geometry, signal, bias))
    }
}
```

`core/src/main/kotlin/com/system/location/service/core/gnss/BeiDouSkyCatalog.kt`:

```kt
package com.system.location.service.core.gnss

import java.time.LocalDateTime
import java.time.ZoneOffset

/**
 * Conservative adapter for a SINEX producer whose epoch time scale is not explicitly stated.
 * Only accept an assignment invariant over nominal UTC through TAI (covering BDT/GPS/GST),
 * plus one second on either side for fractional realizations/rounding. This is not a conversion
 * claiming all these time scales coincide. A boundary, overlap or gap makes identity unknown.
 * Creation-year evidence comes from the source manifest. Open-ended assignments have a caller-
 * supplied maximum catalog age; publication age never changes actual assignment intervals.
 */
class BeiDouSkyCatalog(
    private val metadata: BeiDouSatelliteMetadata,
    fullCreationYear: Int,
    maximumOpenIntervalAgeSeconds: Long,
    private val utc: GnssUtcTimeScale,
    val description: String = "caller-supplied IGS satellite metadata",
) {
    private val lastAcceptedLabel: LocalDateTime
    init {
        require(maximumOpenIntervalAgeSeconds in 1..366 * 86400L)
        lastAcceptedLabel = metadata.creationAt(fullCreationYear).plusSeconds(maximumOpenIntervalAgeSeconds)
    }

    fun identityAt(svid: Int, utcMillis: Long): BeiDouSatelliteIdentity? {
        if (svid !in 1..63) return null
        val gps = utc.gpsAtUtcMillis(utcMillis).time ?: return null
        val utcLabel = java.time.Instant.ofEpochMilli(utcMillis).atOffset(ZoneOffset.UTC).toLocalDateTime()
        val gpsLabel = java.time.Instant.ofEpochMilli(GnssUtcTimeScale.GPS_EPOCH_MILLIS)
            .atOffset(ZoneOffset.UTC).toLocalDateTime().plusWeeks(gps.week.toLong())
            .plusNanos(kotlin.math.round(gps.secondsOfWeek * 1e9).toLong())
        val taiLabel = gpsLabel.plusSeconds(19)
        // Include every supported nominal scale explicitly, even if future leap history
        // changes their order; do not silently narrow the uncertainty interval.
        val bdtLabel = gpsLabel.minusSeconds(14)
        val earliest = minOf(utcLabel, taiLabel, gpsLabel, bdtLabel).minusSeconds(1)
        val latest = maxOf(utcLabel, taiLabel, gpsLabel, bdtLabel).plusSeconds(1)
        // Treat the creation label with the same uncertainty, conservatively at its earliest.
        val uncertainty = java.time.Duration.between(earliest, latest)
        if (latest.isAfter(lastAcceptedLabel.minus(uncertainty))) return null
        return metadata.identityAt(svid, earliest, latest)
    }
}
```
