`core/src/main/kotlin/com/system/location/service/core/gnss/BroadcastSignalCalibration.kt`:

```kt
package com.system.location.service.core.gnss

import kotlinx.serialization.Serializable
import kotlin.math.abs

@Serializable
data class BroadcastEmpiricalSignal(val cn0: Double, val used: Double, val almanac: Boolean, val carrier: Float?) {
    init {
        require(cn0.isFinite() && cn0 > 0.0 && cn0 <= 63.0)
        require(used.isFinite() && used in 0.0..1.0)
        require(carrier == null || carrier.isFinite() && carrier > 0f)
    }
}

@Serializable
data class BroadcastSignalKnot(val elevation: Double, val signal: BroadcastEmpiricalSignal) {
    init { require(elevation.isFinite() && elevation in 0.0..90.0) }
}

/** Galileo/BeiDou calibration is per service band; GLONASS FDMA carrier evidence is per slot. */
@Serializable
data class BroadcastSignalCurve(val constellation: Constellation, val nominalCarrierHz: Double?, val svid: Int?,
    val knots: List<BroadcastSignalKnot>) {
    init {
        require(when (constellation) {
            Constellation.GALILEO -> nominalCarrierHz in GALILEO_BANDS && svid == null
            Constellation.BEIDOU -> nominalCarrierHz == BEIDOU_B1I && svid == null
            Constellation.GLONASS -> nominalCarrierHz == null && svid != null && svid in 1..31
            else -> false
        })
        require(knots.isNotEmpty() && knots.size <= GnssCapture.MAX_FRAMES * 512)
        require(knots.zipWithNext().all { (a, b) -> a.elevation < b.elevation })
        require(knots.all { knot -> knot.signal.carrier?.let { carrier ->
            if (nominalCarrierHz != null) abs(carrier.toDouble() - nominalCarrierHz) <= CARRIER_BAND_TOLERANCE_HZ
            else isGlonassL1(carrier)
        } ?: true })
    }

    internal fun at(elevation: Double): BroadcastEmpiricalSignal? {
        if (elevation < knots.first().elevation || elevation > knots.last().elevation) return null
        val index = knots.indexOfFirst { it.elevation >= elevation }
        val right = knots[index]
        if (elevation == right.elevation) return right.signal
        val left = knots[index - 1]
        val fraction = (elevation - left.elevation) / (right.elevation - left.elevation)
        fun mix(a: Double, b: Double) = a + (b - a) * fraction
        return BroadcastEmpiricalSignal(mix(left.signal.cn0, right.signal.cn0), mix(left.signal.used, right.signal.used),
            if (fraction < 0.5) left.signal.almanac else right.signal.almanac,
            left.signal.carrier.takeIf { it == right.signal.carrier })
    }
}

/** Sufficient empirical statistics retained when raw multi-band evidence stays on the device. */
@Serializable
data class BroadcastSignalCalibration(val curves: List<BroadcastSignalCurve>) {
    init {
        require(curves.size <= 35) // Three Galileo bands, B1I and at most 31 GLONASS slots.
        require(curves.map { Triple(it.constellation, it.nominalCarrierHz, it.svid) }.distinct().size == curves.size)
        require(curves.sumOf { it.knots.size.toLong() } <= GnssCapture.MAX_FRAMES.toLong() * 512)
    }

    fun at(constellation: Constellation, elevation: Double, nominalCarrierHz: Double? = null,
        svid: Int? = null): BroadcastEmpiricalSignal? {
        require(elevation.isFinite() && elevation in 0.0..90.0)
        return curves.firstOrNull { it.constellation == constellation && it.nominalCarrierHz == nominalCarrierHz && it.svid == svid }
            ?.at(elevation)
    }

    companion object {
        fun fit(capture: GnssCapture): BroadcastSignalCalibration {
            val samples = capture.frames.flatMap { frame ->
                if (frame.signalObservations.isNotEmpty()) frame.signalObservations.map { it.satellite } else frame.satellites
            }.filter(GnssCaptureValidator::isUsableSatellite)
            val keyed = samples.mapNotNull { sample ->
                val key = when (sample.constellation) {
                    Constellation.GALILEO -> sample.carrierHz?.let { carrier ->
                        GALILEO_BANDS.firstOrNull { abs(carrier.toDouble() - it) <= CARRIER_BAND_TOLERANCE_HZ }
                    }?.let { Triple(sample.constellation, it, null as Int?) }
                    Constellation.BEIDOU -> sample.carrierHz?.takeIf {
                        abs(it.toDouble() - BEIDOU_B1I) <= CARRIER_BAND_TOLERANCE_HZ
                    }?.let { Triple(sample.constellation, BEIDOU_B1I, null as Int?) }
                    Constellation.GLONASS -> if (sample.svid in 1..31 &&
                        (sample.carrierHz == null || isGlonassL1(sample.carrierHz)))
                        Triple(sample.constellation, null as Double?, sample.svid) else null
                    else -> null
                }
                key?.let { it to sample }
            }
            return BroadcastSignalCalibration(keyed.groupBy({ it.first }, { it.second }).map { (key, records) ->
                // Unknown carrier does not prove L1. Preserve a legacy unknown-only fit, but
                // never dilute identified L1 evidence with samples from an unidentified band.
                val retained = if (key.first == Constellation.GLONASS && records.any { it.carrierHz != null })
                    records.filter { it.carrierHz != null } else records
                BroadcastSignalCurve(key.first, key.second, key.third,
                    retained.groupBy { it.elevationDeg }.toSortedMap().map { (elevation, bandSamples) ->
                        BroadcastSignalKnot(elevation.toDouble(), BroadcastEmpiricalSignal(
                            bandSamples.map { it.cn0DbHz.toDouble() }.average(),
                            bandSamples.count { it.usedInFix }.toDouble() / bandSamples.size,
                            bandSamples.count { it.hasAlmanac } * 2 >= bandSamples.size,
                            bandSamples.map { it.carrierHz }.distinct().singleOrNull()))
                    })
            }.sortedWith(compareBy({ it.constellation.ordinal }, { it.nominalCarrierHz }, { it.svid })))
        }
    }
}

private val GALILEO_BANDS = listOf(1_575_420_000.0, 1_176_450_000.0, 1_207_140_000.0)
private const val BEIDOU_B1I = 1_561_098_000.0
// RF band identification tolerance only; not a measurement uncertainty or accuracy claim.
private const val CARRIER_BAND_TOLERANCE_HZ = 100_000.0
private fun isGlonassL1(carrier: Float) = (-7..6).any {
    abs(carrier.toDouble() - (1_602_000_000.0 + it * 562_500.0)) <= CARRIER_BAND_TOLERANCE_HZ
}
```

`core/src/main/kotlin/com/system/location/service/core/gnss/BundledGnssFallback.kt`:

```kt
package com.system.location.service.core.gnss

import java.io.ByteArrayInputStream
import java.util.Base64
import java.util.zip.ZipInputStream

/**
 * Last-resort copy of the small immutable GNSS resources for injected processes whose class
 * loader does not expose the module APK (LSPosed system_server). It is generated from
 * core/src/main/resources/gnss and must stay byte-identical to those files.
 */
internal object BundledGnssFallback {
    private val files: Map<String, String> by lazy {
        val decoded = Base64.getDecoder().decode(ARCHIVE)
        val result = LinkedHashMap<String, String>()
        ZipInputStream(ByteArrayInputStream(decoded)).use { input ->
            while (true) {
                val entry = input.nextEntry ?: break
                result[entry.name] = input.readBytes().toString(Charsets.UTF_8)
            }
        }
        result
    }

    fun read(name: String): String? = files[name]

    private const val ARCHIVE = ""
}
```

`core/src/main/kotlin/com/system/location/service/core/gnss/CaptureGpsClockAssociation.kt`:

```kt
package com.system.location.service.core.gnss

import kotlin.math.abs

data class CaptureGpsReference(val time: GpsTime, val hardwareDiscontinuityCount: Int)
data class CaptureGpsReferenceResult(val reference: CaptureGpsReference?, val reason: String? = null)

/**
 * Approximate GPS era/time association at navigation callback ARRIVAL. It is not the signal
 * emission time, a precise reception epoch, or a bound on the navigation callback's latency.
 * Known clock uncertainties and contemporaneous monotonic anchors are required.
 */
class CaptureGpsClockAssociation(batches: List<GnssMeasurementBatch>) {
    private val anchors = batches.mapNotNull { batch ->
        val epoch = GpsReceiverClock.decode(batch).epoch ?: return@mapNotNull null
        val elapsed = epoch.elapsedRealtimeNanos ?: return@mapNotNull null
        val arrival = batch.capturedElapsedRealtimeNanos ?: return@mapNotNull null
        val uncertainty = epoch.timeUncertaintySeconds ?: return@mapNotNull null
        val elapsedUncertainty = epoch.elapsedRealtimeUncertaintySeconds ?: return@mapNotNull null
        if (uncertainty > 1 || elapsedUncertainty > 1 || arrival < elapsed || arrival - elapsed > 10_000_000_000L)
            return@mapNotNull null
        epoch
    }

    fun atArrival(elapsedNanos: Long?): CaptureGpsReferenceResult {
        fun invalid(reason: String) = CaptureGpsReferenceResult(null, reason)
        if (elapsedNanos == null || elapsedNanos < 0) return invalid("导航电文缺少有效单调到达时刻，未推测完整周号")
        val nearby = anchors.filter { abs(elapsedNanos - it.elapsedRealtimeNanos!!) <= 10_000_000_000L }
        if (nearby.isEmpty()) return invalid("电文附近没有具有已知不确定度的完整接收机时钟")
        if (nearby.map { it.hardwareDiscontinuityCount }.distinct().size != 1)
            return invalid("电文附近接收机时钟发生不连续，未跨重置关联")
        val estimates = nearby.map { anchor ->
            runCatching { anchor.time.plusSeconds((elapsedNanos - anchor.elapsedRealtimeNanos!!).toDouble() / 1e9) }
                .getOrNull() ?: return invalid("接收机时钟关联超出完整 GPS 周号范围")
        }
        val time = estimates.first()
        if (estimates.any { abs(it.secondsSince(time)) > 1 }) return invalid("接收机时钟与单调时钟关联不一致")
        return CaptureGpsReferenceResult(CaptureGpsReference(time, nearby.first().hardwareDiscontinuityCount))
    }
}
```

`core/src/main/kotlin/com/system/location/service/core/gnss/CapturedGnssSource.kt`:

```kt
package com.system.location.service.core.gnss

import com.system.location.service.core.location.LocationSample
import java.security.MessageDigest

/**
 * One immutable receiver-evidence identity with its own synchronized publication cache.
 * Prepare a replacement before publishing configuration; old readers keep their original
 * source, including its frame cache. No method can reconfigure an already published source.
 * This process-local handle is deliberately not serializable. Only GnssCaptureWire crosses IPC.
 */
class CapturedGnssSource private constructor(private val payload: String) : GnssFrameSource {
    private val capture = GnssCaptureWire.decode(payload)
    /** Small registry key; a cache must not retain an obsolete capture just to identify it. */
    internal val digest: String by lazy {
        MessageDigest.getInstance("SHA-256").digest(payload.toByteArray(Charsets.UTF_8))
            .joinToString("") { "%02x".format(it.toInt() and 255) }
    }
    val signalCalibration by lazy { GnssAutonomousSignalCalibration(capture) }
    private val frames = GnssFrameStore(sequences).apply { configure(capture) }
    override val requiresBootIdentity: Boolean = capture.bootCount != null &&
        (capture.gpsBroadcastEvidence != null || capture.galileoBroadcastEvidence != null ||
            capture.beiDouBroadcastEvidence != null ||
            capture.glonassBroadcastEvidence != null ||
            capture.measurements.isNotEmpty() || capture.navigation.isNotEmpty())

    override fun frame(sample: LocationSample, minimumSatellites: Int, route: GnssFrameRoute,
        validationAtMillis: Long, currentBootCount: Int?): PublishedGnssFrame? =
        frames.current(sample.timeMillis, sample.coordinate, sample.altitude, minimumSatellites,
            sample.speed.toDouble(), sample.bearing.toDouble(), validationAtMillis, route,
            sample.elapsedNanos, currentBootCount)

    /** Bounded status/compact broadcast evidence for an authenticated peer's synchronization. */
    fun wirePayload(): String = payload

    companion object {
        private val sequences = GnssPublicationSequences.counter

        fun prepare(payload: String?, previous: CapturedGnssSource? = null): CapturedGnssSource? = when {
            payload == null -> null
            payload == previous?.payload -> previous
            else -> CapturedGnssSource(payload)
        }
    }
}
```

`core/src/main/kotlin/com/system/location/service/core/gnss/GalileoBroadcastEphemeris.kt`:

```kt
package com.system.location.service.core.gnss

import kotlinx.serialization.Serializable

/** Full Galileo System Time (GST) week/seconds, never a GPS-week or UTC alias. */
@Serializable
data class GalileoTime(val week: Int, val secondsOfWeek: Double) {
    init { require(week >= 0 && secondsOfWeek.isFinite() && secondsOfWeek >= 0 && secondsOfWeek < 604800) }
    fun secondsSince(other: GalileoTime) = (week.toLong() - other.week.toLong()) * 604800.0 + secondsOfWeek - other.secondsOfWeek
    fun plusSeconds(seconds: Double): GalileoTime {
        require(seconds.isFinite())
        val normalized = requireNotNull(GnssWeekTime.normalize(week.toLong(), secondsOfWeek + seconds)) {
            "GST outside supported full-week range"
        }
        return GalileoTime(normalized.first, normalized.second)
    }
}

@Serializable
enum class GalileoClockReference { INAV_E1_E5B, FNAV_E1_E5A }

/**
 * Galileo OS SIS ICD 2.2 Tables 67/70/78. CRC/page assembly and IODnav consistency must be
 * established before constructing this decoded model. Absolute validity is supplied by the
 * decoder using Galileo's forward age limit and any additional independent restrictions.
 * Reference epochs toe/toc need not lie inside a shortened operational interval.
 * All angular parameters are radians; rates use seconds. No GPS/GST/UTC conversion is implicit.
 */
@Serializable
data class GalileoBroadcastEphemeris(
    val svid: Int,
    val toe: GalileoTime,
    val toc: GalileoTime,
    val validFrom: GalileoTime,
    val validUntil: GalileoTime,
    val iodnav: Int,
    val clockReference: GalileoClockReference,
    val sqrtSemiMajorAxis: Double,
    val eccentricity: Double,
    val inclinationRad: Double,
    val ascendingNodeRad: Double,
    val argumentOfPerigeeRad: Double,
    val meanAnomalyRad: Double,
    val deltaMeanMotionRadPerSecond: Double,
    val ascendingNodeRateRadPerSecond: Double,
    val inclinationRateRadPerSecond: Double,
    val cucRad: Double,
    val cusRad: Double,
    val crcMeters: Double,
    val crsMeters: Double,
    val cicRad: Double,
    val cisRad: Double,
    val af0Seconds: Double,
    val af1SecondsPerSecond: Double,
    val af2SecondsPerSecondSquared: Double,
) {
    init {
        require(svid in 1..36 && iodnav in 0..1023)
        require(validUntil.secondsSince(validFrom) > 0)
        // Unsigned bit widths/scales in Table 67; no invented nominal MEO radius/eccentricity.
        require(sqrtSemiMajorAxis.isFinite() && sqrtSemiMajorAxis > 0 && sqrtSemiMajorAxis < 8192)
        require(eccentricity >= 0 && eccentricity < 0.5)
        require(listOf(inclinationRad, ascendingNodeRad, argumentOfPerigeeRad, meanAnomalyRad,
            deltaMeanMotionRadPerSecond, ascendingNodeRateRadPerSecond, inclinationRateRadPerSecond,
            cucRad, cusRad, crcMeters, crsMeters, cicRad, cisRad, af0Seconds, af1SecondsPerSecond,
            af2SecondsPerSecondSquared).all(Double::isFinite))
    }
}
```

`core/src/main/kotlin/com/system/location/service/core/gnss/GalileoBroadcastEvidence.kt`:

```kt
package com.system.location.service.core.gnss

import kotlinx.serialization.Serializable

/** Coordinate realization required by Galileo geometry; no WGS-84 to GTRF conversion is guessed. */
@Serializable
enum class GalileoReceiverFrame { GTRF }

/**
 * Compact Galileo orbit evidence that is safe to move across the app/system boundary.
 * The GPS elapsed clock and independently decoded GGTO keep GST in its own time domain;
 * no UTC or zero-offset assumption is allowed here.
 */
@Serializable
data class GalileoBroadcastEvidence(
    val clock: GpsElapsedClockEvidence,
    val gpsToGst: GalileoGpsTimeOffset,
    val receiverFrame: GalileoReceiverFrame,
    val inav: List<DecodedGalileoInav> = emptyList(),
    val fnav: List<DecodedGalileoFnav> = emptyList(),
    /** Frame names alone cannot convert a WGS 84 route into GTRF. */
    val receiverTransform: GnssReceiverDatumTransform? = null,
    val serviceValidity: List<GalileoServiceValidity> = emptyList(),
) {
    init {
        require(receiverTransform == null || receiverTransform.bootCount == clock.bootCount)
        require(inav.isNotEmpty() || fnav.isNotEmpty()) { "Galileo evidence is empty" }
        require(inav.map { it.ephemeris.svid }.distinct().size == inav.size) { "duplicate Galileo I/NAV identity" }
        require(fnav.map { it.ephemeris.svid }.distinct().size == fnav.size) { "duplicate Galileo F/NAV identity" }
        require((inav.map { it.ephemeris.svid } + fnav.map { it.ephemeris.svid }).all { it in 1..36 }) {
            "invalid Galileo evidence SVID"
        }
        require(serviceValidity.size <= 72)
        require(serviceValidity.map { it.svid to it.format }.distinct().size == serviceValidity.size)
        require(serviceValidity.all { service ->
            when (service.format) {
                GalileoClockReference.INAV_E1_E5B -> inav.any {
                    it.ephemeris.svid == service.svid && it.transmissionTimeOfWordFive == service.broadcastAt
                }
                GalileoClockReference.FNAV_E1_E5A -> fnav.any {
                    it.ephemeris.svid == service.svid && it.transmissionTimeOfPageOne == service.broadcastAt
                }
            }
        }) { "Galileo service applicability is not bound to the decoded status snapshot" }
    }

    val identities: Set<Int>
        get() = (inav.map { it.ephemeris.svid } + fnav.map { it.ephemeris.svid }).toSet()

    fun serviceRejection(svid: Int, format: GalileoClockReference, broadcastAt: GalileoTime,
        transmission: GalileoTime): String? {
        val service = serviceValidity.singleOrNull { it.svid == svid && it.format == format && it.broadcastAt == broadcastAt }
            ?: return "缺少与当前健康广播绑定的独立服务适用期"
        return if (service.contains(transmission)) null else "发射时刻超出独立服务适用期"
    }

    companion object {
        /**
         * Decode only when an independently established GGTO is supplied. A missing offset
         * returns null instead of treating GPS and GST as the same clock.
         */
        fun fromCapture(capture: GnssCapture, gpsToGst: GalileoGpsTimeOffset?,
            receiverFrame: GalileoReceiverFrame? = null,
            receiverTransform: GnssReceiverDatumTransform? = null,
            serviceValidity: List<GalileoServiceValidity> = emptyList()): GalileoBroadcastEvidence? {
            val offset = gpsToGst ?: return null
            val frame = receiverFrame ?: return null
            val clock = GpsElapsedClockEvidence.fromCapture(capture) ?: return null
            val visible = capture.frames.flatMap { it.satellites }.filter {
                it.constellation == Constellation.GALILEO && it.elevationDeg >= 0f &&
                    it.azimuthDeg in 0f..<360f && it.cn0DbHz > 0f
            }.map { it.svid }.toSet()
            if (visible.isEmpty()) return null
            val decoded = GalileoCaptureEphemerisDecoder.decode(capture, offset)
            val inav = decoded.inav.filter { it.ephemeris.svid in visible }
            val fnav = decoded.fnav.filter { it.ephemeris.svid in visible }
            return if (inav.isEmpty() && fnav.isEmpty()) null
                else GalileoBroadcastEvidence(clock, offset, frame, inav, fnav, receiverTransform, serviceValidity)
        }
    }
}
```

`core/src/main/kotlin/com/system/location/service/core/gnss/GalileoBroadcastPropagator.kt`:

```kt
package com.system.location.service.core.gnss

import kotlin.math.*

/** GTRF ECEF at transmission GST; clock is the decoded dual-frequency clock, without BGD. */
data class GalileoSatelliteState(val xMeters: Double, val yMeters: Double, val zMeters: Double,
    val clockBiasSeconds: Double, val clockReference: GalileoClockReference)
data class GalileoPropagationResult(val state: GalileoSatelliteState?, val reason: String? = null)

/**
 * Galileo OS SIS ICD 2.2 Table 68, Eqs 14–16. Mathematical orbit/clock propagation only;
 * signal health/DVS/SISA, CRC assembly and signal usability are separate required checks.
 * This function neither converts GST to GPS/UTC nor implies a usable physical GNSS frame.
 * https://www.gsc-europa.eu/sites/default/files/sites/all/files/Galileo_OS_SIS_ICD_in_force.pdf
 */
object GalileoBroadcastPropagator {
    const val EARTH_MU = 3.986004418e14
    const val EARTH_ROTATION_RAD_PER_SECOND = 7.2921151467e-5
    private const val SPEED_OF_LIGHT = 299792458.0

    fun propagate(e: GalileoBroadcastEphemeris, transmission: GalileoTime): GalileoPropagationResult {
        fun invalid(reason: String) = GalileoPropagationResult(null, reason)
        if (transmission.secondsSince(e.validFrom) < 0 || e.validUntil.secondsSince(transmission) < 0)
            return invalid("outside absolute Galileo validity interval")
        val tk = transmission.secondsSince(e.toe)
        val a = e.sqrtSemiMajorAxis * e.sqrtSemiMajorAxis
        val n = sqrt(EARTH_MU / (a * a * a)) + e.deltaMeanMotionRadPerSecond
        if (!n.isFinite() || n <= 0) return invalid("invalid Galileo mean motion")
        val mean = (e.meanAnomalyRad + n * tk) % (2 * PI)
        var eccentric = mean
        var converged = false
        for (iteration in 1..30) {
            val delta = (eccentric - e.eccentricity * sin(eccentric) - mean) /
                (1 - e.eccentricity * cos(eccentric))
            eccentric -= delta
            if (iteration >= 3 && abs(delta) <= 1e-14) { converged = true; break }
        }
        if (!converged || !eccentric.isFinite()) return invalid("Galileo Kepler equation did not converge")
        val anomaly = atan2(sqrt(1 - e.eccentricity * e.eccentricity) * sin(eccentric),
            cos(eccentric) - e.eccentricity)
        val phi = anomaly + e.argumentOfPerigeeRad
        val sine = sin(2 * phi)
        val cosine = cos(2 * phi)
        val u = phi + e.cusRad * sine + e.cucRad * cosine
        val radius = a * (1 - e.eccentricity * cos(eccentric)) + e.crsMeters * sine + e.crcMeters * cosine
        val i = e.inclinationRad + e.inclinationRateRadPerSecond * tk + e.cisRad * sine + e.cicRad * cosine
        val node = e.ascendingNodeRad + (e.ascendingNodeRateRadPerSecond - EARTH_ROTATION_RAD_PER_SECOND) * tk -
            EARTH_ROTATION_RAD_PER_SECOND * e.toe.secondsOfWeek
        val x = radius * cos(u)
        val y = radius * sin(u)
        val dt = transmission.secondsSince(e.toc)
        // Compute Eq 16 from its defining constants, without borrowing GPS's relativity F.
        val relativity = -2 * sqrt(EARTH_MU) / (SPEED_OF_LIGHT * SPEED_OF_LIGHT) *
            e.eccentricity * e.sqrtSemiMajorAxis * sin(eccentric)
        val clock = e.af0Seconds + e.af1SecondsPerSecond * dt + e.af2SecondsPerSecondSquared * dt * dt + relativity
        val state = GalileoSatelliteState(x * cos(node) - y * cos(i) * sin(node),
            x * sin(node) + y * cos(i) * cos(node), y * sin(i), clock, e.clockReference)
        if (radius <= 0 || !listOf(state.xMeters, state.yMeters, state.zMeters, state.clockBiasSeconds).all(Double::isFinite))
            return invalid("non-finite or invalid Galileo propagation result")
        return GalileoPropagationResult(state)
    }
}
```

`core/src/main/kotlin/com/system/location/service/core/gnss/GalileoCaptureEphemerides.kt`:

```kt
package com.system.location.service.core.gnss

data class GalileoCaptureEphemerides(
    val inav: List<DecodedGalileoInav>,
    val fnav: List<DecodedGalileoFnav>,
    val diagnostics: List<String>,
)

/**
 * Connects captured Android clocks/navigation to the bounded Galileo assemblers.
 * A separately established, currently applicable GGTO model is mandatory; no zero-offset
 * fallback or hardcoded UTC leap offset is used. Callback arrival supplies only approximate
 * full GST for era/page association, never exact transmission time or a latency bound.
 * Captures spanning clock resets or more than the 120s assembly policy are rejected.
 */
object GalileoCaptureEphemerisDecoder {
    fun decode(capture: GnssCapture, gpsToGst: GalileoGpsTimeOffset?): GalileoCaptureEphemerides {
        val diagnostics = linkedSetOf<String>()
        fun empty(reason: String) = GalileoCaptureEphemerides(emptyList(), emptyList(), (diagnostics + reason).toList())
        val messages = capture.navigation.filter { it.type == 0x0601 || it.type == 0x0602 }
        if (messages.isEmpty()) return empty("采集窗口没有 Galileo I/NAV 或 F/NAV 电文")
        if (gpsToGst == null) return empty("缺少有适用时段依据的 GGTO，未将 GPS 时钟冒充 GST")
        val clock = CaptureGpsClockAssociation(capture.measurements)
        val quarantined = mutableSetOf<Pair<Int, Int>>() // satellite + message format
        data class Associated(val message: GnssNavigationObservation, val time: GalileoTime, val domain: Int)
        val associated = messages.mapNotNull { message ->
            val result = clock.atArrival(message.capturedElapsedRealtimeNanos)
            val reference = result.reference
            val converted = reference?.let { gpsToGst.gpsToGalileo(it.time) }
            val time = converted?.time
            if (time == null) {
                diagnostics += "Galileo ${message.svid}：${result.reason ?: converted?.reason ?: "时标关联失败"}"
                // Missing timing of a possibly newer service page must not restore older healthy evidence.
                quarantined += message.svid to message.type
                null
            } else Associated(message, time, reference.hardwareDiscontinuityCount)
        }
        if (associated.isEmpty()) return empty("没有可关联完整 GST 的 Galileo 导航电文")
        if (associated.map { it.domain }.distinct().size != 1)
            return empty("Galileo 采集跨接收机时钟重置，未拼接不同连续时钟域的星历")
        val earliest = associated.minWith(compareBy<Associated> { it.time.week }.thenBy { it.time.secondsOfWeek }).time
        val latest = associated.maxWith(compareBy<Associated> { it.time.week }.thenBy { it.time.secondsOfWeek }).time
        if (latest.secondsSince(earliest) > 120) return empty("Galileo 采集超过 120 秒有界组帧窗口")
        val inav = GalileoInavAssembler(earliest, latest)
        val fnav = GalileoFnavAssembler(earliest, latest)
        associated.forEach { (message, time) ->
            val reason = if (message.type == 0x0601) inav.offer(message, time).reason else fnav.offer(message, time).reason
            reason?.let { diagnostics += "Galileo ${message.svid}：$it" }
        }
        return GalileoCaptureEphemerides(
            inav.completed().filter { (it.ephemeris.svid to 0x0601) !in quarantined },
            fnav.completed().filter { (it.ephemeris.svid to 0x0602) !in quarantined }, diagnostics.toList())
    }
}
```

`core/src/main/kotlin/com/system/location/service/core/gnss/GalileoEphemerisValidity.kt`:

```kt
package com.system.location.service.core.gnss

data class GalileoValidityInterval(val from: GalileoTime, val until: GalileoTime) {
    init { require(until.secondsSince(from) > 0) }
    fun contains(time: GalileoTime) = time.secondsSince(from) >= 0 && until.secondsSince(time) >= 0
}

/**
 * Galileo OS SDD 1.3 p.17 and Annex C.4.4.1, footnote 22: 0 <= t-toe <= 4 hours.
 * This is an upper limit on age of ephemeris, NOT four hours around toe, an IOD lifetime,
 * a GGTO validity duration, or proof that health/DVS/service state remains current.
 * Full resolved GST epochs are used; modulo-week arithmetic must not revive expired data.
 * https://www.gsc-europa.eu/sites/default/files/sites/all/files/Galileo-OS-SDD_in_force.pdf
 */
object GalileoEphemerisValidity {
    const val MAXIMUM_AGE_SECONDS = 14400.0

    /** Additional independently established limits may only shorten the standard age interval. */
    fun resolve(toe: GalileoTime, suppliedFrom: GalileoTime? = null,
        suppliedUntil: GalileoTime? = null): GalileoValidityInterval? {
        if ((suppliedFrom == null) != (suppliedUntil == null)) return null
        val expiration = runCatching { toe.plusSeconds(MAXIMUM_AGE_SECONDS) }.getOrNull() ?: return null
        val from = if (suppliedFrom != null && suppliedFrom.secondsSince(toe) > 0) suppliedFrom else toe
        val until = if (suppliedUntil != null && suppliedUntil.secondsSince(expiration) < 0) suppliedUntil else expiration
        return if (until.secondsSince(from) > 0) GalileoValidityInterval(from, until) else null
    }
}
```

`core/src/main/kotlin/com/system/location/service/core/gnss/GalileoFnavAssembler.kt`:

```kt
package com.system.location.service.core.gnss

import kotlin.math.abs

/**
 * Capture-scoped F/NAV accumulation (OS SIS ICD 2.2 §§4.1.2, 5.1.9.2; Tables 30–33).
 * Pages may arrive in any order. IOD identifies only orbit/clock/SISA, not BGD or health.
 * The caller supplies independently established full GST; the decoder applies OS SDD's
 * forward age limit from toe, optionally shortened by independent validity evidence.
 * This class neither derives GST from UTC nor authenticates navigation data. The
 * 120-second window is the assembly policy, NOT an ephemeris validity duration.
 *
 * Results are provisional until completed() rechecks all evidence, including late conflicts.
 * Start a new instance for another capture window; no eviction can rehabilitate a conflict.
 */
class GalileoFnavAssembler(
    private val captureFrom: GalileoTime,
    private val captureUntil: GalileoTime,
    private val validFrom: GalileoTime? = null,
    private val validUntil: GalileoTime? = null,
) {
    init {
        require(captureUntil.secondsSince(captureFrom) in 0.0..120.0)
        require((validFrom == null && validUntil == null) ||
            (validFrom != null && validUntil != null && validUntil.secondsSince(validFrom) > 0))
    }

    private data class Key(val svid: Int, val iod: Int)
    private data class PageEpoch(val type: Int, val time: GalileoTime)
    private data class Part(val page: GalileoNavigationPage, val time: GalileoTime, val reference: GalileoTime)
    private class Candidate {
        val latest = mutableMapOf<Int, Part>()
        val seen = mutableMapOf<PageEpoch, GalileoNavigationPage>()
        var conflict = false
    }
    private data class Service(val key: Key, val part: Part, val conflict: Boolean = false)
    private val candidates = linkedMapOf<Key, Candidate>()
    // Health/BGD are not scoped by IOD. Never fall back to an older healthy page 1 when a
    // newer page 1 belongs to an incomplete, invalid, conflicting, or capacity-rejected issue.
    private val services = mutableMapOf<Int, Service>()
    private var retainedPages = 0

    @Synchronized
    fun completed(): List<DecodedGalileoFnav> = services.toSortedMap().values.mapNotNull { decode(it).decoded }

    @Synchronized
    fun offer(observation: GnssNavigationObservation, trustedTimeAtCapture: GalileoTime): GalileoFnavDecodeResult {
        fun invalid(reason: String) = GalileoFnavDecodeResult(null, reason)
        if (trustedTimeAtCapture.secondsSince(captureFrom) < 0 ||
            captureUntil.secondsSince(trustedTimeAtCapture) < 0)
            return invalid("trusted GST is outside this assembly capture window")
        val checked = GalileoNavigationPages.decode(observation)
        val page = checked.page ?: return invalid(checked.reason ?: "invalid Galileo page")
        if (page.format != GalileoClockReference.FNAV_E1_E5A || page.wordType !in 1..4)
            return invalid("requires an F/NAV ephemeris page 1/2/3/4")
        if (page.wordType == 1 && page.unsigned(6, 6).toInt() != page.svid)
            return invalid("F/NAV SVID disagrees with receiver metadata")
        val time = transmissionTime(page, trustedTimeAtCapture)
            ?: return invalid("F/NAV page time disagrees with trusted GST")
        if (validFrom != null && validUntil != null &&
            (time.secondsSince(validFrom) < 0 || validUntil.secondsSince(time) < 0))
            return invalid("F/NAV transmission outside supplied validity evidence")
        val key = Key(page.svid, page.unsigned(if (page.wordType == 1) 12 else 6, 10).toInt())
        val part = Part(page, time, trustedTimeAtCapture)
        if (page.wordType == 1) {
            val previous = services[page.svid]
            if (previous == null || time.secondsSince(previous.part.time) > 0) services[page.svid] = Service(key, part)
            else if (time == previous.part.time && !sameBits(page, previous.part.page, 0, 214))
                services[page.svid] = previous.copy(conflict = true)
        }
        val candidate = candidates[key] ?: run {
            if (candidates.size >= 64) return invalid("F/NAV candidate capacity exceeded")
            Candidate().also { candidates[key] = it }
        }
        if (candidate.conflict) return invalid("conflicting F/NAV issue")
        val previous = candidate.latest[page.wordType]
        // Only CED/SISA are immutable within an IOD. Exclude GST, BGD, health, ionosphere,
        // UTC/GGTO conversion, and spare fields from this comparison.
        val cedEnd = when (page.wordType) { 1 -> 102; 2 -> 182; 3 -> 174; else -> 48 }
        if (previous != null && !sameBits(page, previous.page, 6, cedEnd)) {
            candidate.conflict = true
            return invalid("conflicting F/NAV orbit/clock/SISA within one issue")
        }
        val epoch = PageEpoch(page.wordType, time)
        val duplicate = candidate.seen[epoch]
        if (duplicate != null && !sameBits(page, duplicate, 0, 214)) {
            candidate.conflict = true
            return invalid("conflicting F/NAV page at the same transmission epoch")
        }
        if (duplicate == null) {
            if (retainedPages >= 512) {
                candidate.conflict = true
                return invalid("F/NAV retained page capacity exceeded")
            }
            candidate.seen[epoch] = page
            retainedPages++
        }
        if (previous == null || time.secondsSince(previous.time) > 0) candidate.latest[page.wordType] = part
        val service = services[page.svid] ?: return invalid("waiting for F/NAV page 1")
        if (service.key != key) return invalid("F/NAV issue superseded by newer service evidence")
        return decode(service)
    }

    private fun decode(service: Service): GalileoFnavDecodeResult {
        fun invalid(reason: String) = GalileoFnavDecodeResult(null, reason)
        if (service.conflict) return invalid("conflicting F/NAV service evidence")
        val candidate = candidates[service.key] ?: return invalid("F/NAV service issue was not retained")
        if (candidate.conflict) return invalid("conflicting F/NAV issue")
        if (candidate.latest.size != 4) return invalid("waiting for F/NAV pages 1/2/3/4")
        val parts = candidate.latest.values
        val earliest = parts.minWith(compareBy<Part> { it.time.week }.thenBy { it.time.secondsOfWeek })
        if (parts.any { it.time.secondsSince(earliest.time) > 120 })
            return invalid("F/NAV transmission epochs are not contemporaneous")
        return GalileoFnavEphemerisDecoder.decode(parts.map { it.page }, service.part.reference, validFrom, validUntil)
    }

    private fun transmissionTime(page: GalileoNavigationPage, ref: GalileoTime): GalileoTime? {
        val weekStart = when (page.wordType) { 1 -> 155; 2 -> 182; 3 -> 174; else -> null }
        val towStart = when (page.wordType) { 1 -> 167; 2 -> 194; 3 -> 186; else -> 189 }
        val tow = page.unsigned(towStart, 20).toDouble()
        if (tow >= 604800) return null
        val weeks = if (weekStart == null) (ref.week.toLong() - 1..ref.week.toLong() + 1).toList()
            else (ref.week / 4096 - 1..ref.week / 4096 + 1).map {
                it.toLong() * 4096 + page.unsigned(weekStart, 12)
            }
        return weeks.filter { it in 0..Int.MAX_VALUE.toLong() }.map { GalileoTime(it.toInt(), tow) }
            .minByOrNull { abs(it.secondsSince(ref)) }?.takeIf { abs(it.secondsSince(ref)) <= 120 }
    }

    private fun sameBits(a: GalileoNavigationPage, b: GalileoNavigationPage, start: Int, end: Int): Boolean =
        (start until end).all { a.unsigned(it, 1) == b.unsigned(it, 1) }
}
```

`core/src/main/kotlin/com/system/location/service/core/gnss/GalileoFnavEphemerisDecoder.kt`:

```kt
package com.system.location.service.core.gnss

import kotlin.math.abs
import kotlin.math.pow
import kotlinx.serialization.Serializable

@Serializable
data class DecodedGalileoFnav(
    val ephemeris: GalileoBroadcastEphemeris,
    val transmissionTimeOfPageOne: GalileoTime,
    val e5aStatus: GalileoSignalStatus,
    val sisaIndex: Int,
    val bgdE1E5aSeconds: Double,
)
data class GalileoFnavDecodeResult(val decoded: DecodedGalileoFnav?, val reason: String? = null)

/** OS SIS ICD 2.2 Tables 30–33 and OS SDD 1.3 ephemeris age limit, as for I/NAV. */
object GalileoFnavEphemerisDecoder {
    private const val SEMICIRCLE_TO_RADIANS = 3.1415926535898

    fun decode(pages: Collection<GalileoNavigationPage>, trustedTimeAtPageOneCapture: GalileoTime,
        validFrom: GalileoTime? = null, validUntil: GalileoTime? = null): GalileoFnavDecodeResult {
        fun invalid(reason: String) = GalileoFnavDecodeResult(null, reason)
        if (pages.size != 4 || pages.map { it.wordType }.toSet() != (1..4).toSet() ||
            pages.any { it.format != GalileoClockReference.FNAV_E1_E5A })
            return invalid("requires exactly F/NAV pages 1/2/3/4")
        if (pages.map { it.svid }.distinct().size != 1) return invalid("mixed Galileo satellite identities")
        if (pages.maxOf { it.capturedAtMillis } - pages.minOf { it.capturedAtMillis } > 120_000)
            return invalid("F/NAV pages are not contemporaneous")
        val sorted = pages.sortedBy { it.wordType }
        val one = sorted[0]; val two = sorted[1]; val three = sorted[2]; val four = sorted[3]
        val iod = one.unsigned(12, 10).toInt()
        if (sorted.drop(1).any { it.unsigned(6, 10).toInt() != iod }) return invalid("inconsistent F/NAV IODnav")
        if (one.unsigned(6, 6).toInt() != one.svid) return invalid("F/NAV SVID disagrees with receiver metadata")
        val sisa = one.unsigned(94, 8).toInt()
        if (sisa !in 0..125) return invalid("F/NAV SISA is spare or NAPA")
        val ref = trustedTimeAtPageOneCapture
        fun resolve(week12: Int, tow: Double): GalileoTime? {
            if (tow >= 604800) return null
            val era = ref.week / 4096
            return (era - 1..era + 1).map { it.toLong() * 4096 + week12 }
                .filter { it in 0..Int.MAX_VALUE.toLong() }.map { GalileoTime(it.toInt(), tow) }
                .minByOrNull { abs(it.secondsSince(ref)) }
        }
        val transmission = resolve(one.unsigned(155, 12).toInt(), one.unsigned(167, 20).toDouble())
            ?: return invalid("invalid F/NAV GST epoch")
        if (abs(transmission.secondsSince(ref)) > 120) return invalid("F/NAV GST disagrees with trusted reference")
        val otherEpochs = listOf(resolve(two.unsigned(182, 12).toInt(), two.unsigned(194, 20).toDouble()),
            resolve(three.unsigned(174, 12).toInt(), three.unsigned(186, 20).toDouble()))
        if (otherEpochs.any { it == null || abs(it.secondsSince(transmission)) > 120 })
            return invalid("inconsistent F/NAV page week/time")
        fun nearest(seconds: Double): GalileoTime? = if (seconds >= 604800) null else
            (transmission.week.toLong() - 1..transmission.week.toLong() + 1)
                .filter { it in 0..Int.MAX_VALUE.toLong() }.map { GalileoTime(it.toInt(), seconds) }
                .minByOrNull { abs(it.secondsSince(transmission)) }
        val fourth = nearest(four.unsigned(189, 20).toDouble())
        if (fourth == null || abs(fourth.secondsSince(transmission)) > 120) return invalid("inconsistent F/NAV page 4 time")
        val toe = nearest(three.unsigned(160, 14) * 60.0) ?: return invalid("invalid F/NAV toe")
        val toc = nearest(one.unsigned(22, 14) * 60.0) ?: return invalid("invalid F/NAV toc")
        val validity = GalileoEphemerisValidity.resolve(toe, validFrom, validUntil)
            ?: return invalid("invalid Galileo ephemeris age interval")
        val allEpochs = listOf(transmission, fourth) + otherEpochs.filterNotNull()
        if (allEpochs.any { !validity.contains(it) })
            return invalid("F/NAV transmission outside Galileo ephemeris age/supplied validity interval")
        return try {
            val e = GalileoBroadcastEphemeris(one.svid, toe, toc, validity.from, validity.until, iod,
                GalileoClockReference.FNAV_E1_E5A, two.unsigned(104, 32) * 2.0.pow(-19),
                two.unsigned(72, 32) * 2.0.pow(-33), three.scale(16, 32, -31, true),
                two.scale(136, 32, -31, true), three.scale(48, 32, -31, true), two.scale(16, 32, -31, true),
                three.scale(80, 16, -43, true), two.scale(48, 24, -43, true), two.scale(168, 14, -43, true),
                three.scale(96, 16, -29), three.scale(112, 16, -29), three.scale(128, 16, -5), three.scale(144, 16, -5),
                four.scale(16, 16, -29), four.scale(32, 16, -29), one.scale(36, 31, -34), one.scale(67, 21, -46),
                one.scale(88, 6, -59))
            GalileoFnavDecodeResult(DecodedGalileoFnav(e, transmission,
                GalileoSignalStatus(one.unsigned(153, 2).toInt(), one.unsigned(187, 1).toInt()),
                sisa, one.scale(143, 10, -32)))
        } catch (error: IllegalArgumentException) { invalid(error.message ?: "invalid F/NAV parameters") }
    }

    private fun GalileoNavigationPage.scale(start: Int, length: Int, power: Int, semicircles: Boolean = false) =
        signed(start, length) * 2.0.pow(power) * if (semicircles) SEMICIRCLE_TO_RADIANS else 1.0
}
```

`core/src/main/kotlin/com/system/location/service/core/gnss/GalileoGpsOffsetDecoder.kt`:

```kt
package com.system.location.service.core.gnss

import kotlin.math.abs

data class DecodedGalileoGpsOffset(
    val offset: GalileoGpsTimeOffset,
    /** F/NAV page 4 includes TOW; I/NAV word 10 has no transmission timestamp. */
    val transmissionTime: GalileoTime?,
)
data class GalileoGpsOffsetDecodeResult(val decoded: DecodedGalileoGpsOffset?, val reason: String? = null)

/**
 * CRC-checked I/NAV word 10 or F/NAV page 4, OS SIS ICD 2.2 Tables 33/51/76, Eq. 24.
 * The caller must establish a GPS interval containing the broadcast time-tag epoch, including
 * transmitter-clock uncertainty, not merely callback arrival. A decoded GST tag is not a
 * precision physical emission epoch. This decoder invents no callback delay bound. The 120s interval is
 * a bounded association policy, not a GGTO validity duration or timestamp accuracy claim.
 *
 * Resolve six-bit WN0G by evaluating candidate models against independent GPS evidence;
 * do not require an already-converted GST clock to bootstrap GPS-to-GST conversion.
 * The ±31-week constraint applies at broadcast, including a window that crosses a week.
 */
object GalileoGpsOffsetDecoder {
    fun decode(page: GalileoNavigationPage, broadcastGpsFrom: GpsTime, broadcastGpsUntil: GpsTime,
        validFrom: GalileoTime, validUntil: GalileoTime): GalileoGpsOffsetDecodeResult {
        fun invalid(reason: String) = GalileoGpsOffsetDecodeResult(null, reason)
        val inav = page.format == GalileoClockReference.INAV_E1_E5B && page.wordType == 10
        val fnav = page.format == GalileoClockReference.FNAV_E1_E5A && page.wordType == 4
        if (!inav && !fnav) return invalid("page does not contain broadcast GGTO")
        if (broadcastGpsUntil.secondsSince(broadcastGpsFrom) !in 0.0..120.0)
            return invalid("invalid or excessive GPS transmission association window")
        if (validUntil.secondsSince(validFrom) <= 0) return invalid("invalid external GGTO validity evidence")
        val a0 = page.signed(if (inav) 86 else 155, 16).toInt()
        val a1 = page.signed(if (inav) 102 else 171, 12).toInt()
        val hour = page.unsigned(if (inav) 114 else 147, 8).toInt()
        val week6 = page.unsigned(if (inav) 122 else 183, 6).toInt()
        if (a0 == -1 && a1 == -1 && hour == 255 && week6 == 63)
            return invalid("broadcast GGTO is unavailable")
        val tow = if (fnav) page.unsigned(189, 20).toDouble() else null
        if (tow != null && tow >= 604800) return invalid("invalid F/NAV transmission TOW")
        val nominalWeek = broadcastGpsFrom.week.toLong() - GalileoGpsTimeOffset.GPS_WEEK_ORIGIN
        val era = Math.floorDiv(nominalWeek, 64L)
        val possible = (era - 1..era + 1).map { it * 64 + week6 }
            .filter { it in 0..Int.MAX_VALUE.toLong() }.mapNotNull { referenceWeek ->
                val model = GalileoGpsTimeOffset(referenceWeek.toInt(), hour, a0, a1, validFrom, validUntil)
                val from = model.gpsToGalileo(broadcastGpsFrom).time ?: return@mapNotNull null
                val until = model.gpsToGalileo(broadcastGpsUntil).time ?: return@mapNotNull null
                if (tow == null) {
                    // Word 10 has no GST timestamp. Existence within the supplied transmission
                    // interval resolves the reference week; it does not timestamp the word.
                    val firstWeek = maxOf(from.week.toLong(), referenceWeek - 31)
                    val lastWeek = minOf(until.week.toLong(), referenceWeek + 31)
                    if (firstWeek > lastWeek) null else DecodedGalileoGpsOffset(model, null)
                } else {
                    val transmission = (from.week..until.week).map { GalileoTime(it, tow) }.filter {
                        it.secondsSince(from) >= 0 && until.secondsSince(it) >= 0 &&
                            abs(it.week.toLong() - referenceWeek) <= 31
                    }.singleOrNull() ?: return@mapNotNull null
                    DecodedGalileoGpsOffset(model, transmission)
                }
            }
        return when (possible.size) {
            1 -> GalileoGpsOffsetDecodeResult(possible.single())
            0 -> invalid("no full GGTO reference week agrees with supplied GPS transmission and validity evidence")
            else -> invalid("ambiguous full GGTO reference week")
        }
    }
}
```

`core/src/main/kotlin/com/system/location/service/core/gnss/GalileoGpsTimeOffset.kt`:

```kt
package com.system.location.service.core.gnss

import kotlinx.serialization.Serializable

data class GpsToGalileoResult(val time: GalileoTime?, val reason: String? = null)
data class GalileoToGpsResult(val time: GpsTime?, val reason: String? = null)

/**
 * Galileo OS SIS ICD 2.2 Eq. 24/Table 76. Full WN0G must already be resolved from
 * independent time evidence. Raw signed coefficient units preserve the broadcast field bounds.
 * Validity is external evidence, not an invented 31-week fit interval: the ±31-week rule
 * constrains WN0G resolution at broadcast, not the lifetime of this polynomial.
 *
 * GPS week 1024 and GST week 0 share the nominal epoch. Changing the week origin is NOT
 * applying GGTO. No UTC/leap-second constant, satellite-clock correction, or receiver bias
 * is folded into this inter-system time conversion. It does not establish time accuracy.
 */
@Serializable
data class GalileoGpsTimeOffset(
    val referenceWeek: Int,
    val referenceHour: Int,
    val a0Units: Int,
    val a1Units: Int,
    val validFrom: GalileoTime,
    val validUntil: GalileoTime,
) {
    init {
        require(referenceWeek >= 0 && referenceHour in 0..255)
        require(a0Units in -32768..32767 && a1Units in -2048..2047)
        require(validUntil.secondsSince(validFrom) > 0)
        require(!(a0Units == -1 && a1Units == -1 && referenceHour == 255 && referenceWeek % 64 == 63)) {
            "broadcast GGTO unavailable sentinel"
        }
    }

    val a0Seconds: Double get() = Math.scalb(a0Units.toDouble(), -35)
    val a1SecondsPerSecond: Double get() = Math.scalb(a1Units.toDouble(), -51)

    fun gpsToGalileo(time: GpsTime): GpsToGalileoResult {
        val nominalWeek = time.week.toLong() - GPS_WEEK_ORIGIN
        val delta = (nominalWeek - referenceWeek) * 604800.0 + time.secondsOfWeek - referenceHour * 3600.0
        // GST - GPS = a0 + a1*(GST - t0). Solve for GST, rather than evaluating
        // the right-hand side at GPS and silently omitting the (1-a1) denominator.
        val correction = (a0Seconds + a1SecondsPerSecond * delta) / (1.0 - a1SecondsPerSecond)
        val normalized = GnssWeekTime.normalize(nominalWeek, time.secondsOfWeek + correction)
            ?: return GpsToGalileoResult(null, "converted GST is outside supported full-week range")
        val result = GalileoTime(normalized.first, normalized.second)
        return if (withinValidity(result)) GpsToGalileoResult(result)
            else GpsToGalileoResult(null, "GGTO conversion outside supplied validity evidence")
    }

    fun galileoToGps(time: GalileoTime): GalileoToGpsResult {
        if (!withinValidity(time)) return GalileoToGpsResult(null, "GGTO conversion outside supplied validity evidence")
        val delta = (time.week.toLong() - referenceWeek) * 604800.0 + time.secondsOfWeek - referenceHour * 3600.0
        val correction = a0Seconds + a1SecondsPerSecond * delta
        val normalized = GnssWeekTime.normalize(time.week.toLong() + GPS_WEEK_ORIGIN, time.secondsOfWeek - correction)
            ?: return GalileoToGpsResult(null, "converted GPS time is outside supported full-week range")
        return GalileoToGpsResult(GpsTime(normalized.first, normalized.second))
    }

    private fun withinValidity(time: GalileoTime) =
        time.secondsSince(validFrom) >= 0 && validUntil.secondsSince(time) >= 0

    companion object {
        // An epoch-number relation, never an assumption that the physical time offset is zero.
        const val GPS_WEEK_ORIGIN = 1024L
    }
}

```

`core/src/main/kotlin/com/system/location/service/core/gnss/GalileoInavAssembler.kt`:

```kt
package com.system.location.service.core.gnss

import kotlin.math.abs

/**
 * Capture-scoped I/NAV assembly, OS SIS ICD 2.2 §§4.1.2/5.1.9.2 and Tables 42–46.
 * Words 1–4 carry IODnav but no GST; word 5 carries GST/BGD/health but no IODnav.
 * Consequently an independent trusted GST reference is required for EVERY input, and word 5
 * is maintained per satellite, never copied into an issue as permanently valid service state.
 * The 120s assembly policy is not a fit interval. The decoder applies OS SDD's forward age
 * limit from the decoded toe; optional independent validity limits can only shorten it.
 * No UTC/GPS alias, fixed page order, or OSNMA authenticity is assumed.
 */
class GalileoInavAssembler(
    private val captureFrom: GalileoTime,
    private val captureUntil: GalileoTime,
    private val validFrom: GalileoTime? = null,
    private val validUntil: GalileoTime? = null,
) {
    init {
        require(captureUntil.secondsSince(captureFrom) in 0.0..120.0)
        require((validFrom == null && validUntil == null) ||
            (validFrom != null && validUntil != null && validUntil.secondsSince(validFrom) > 0))
    }

    private data class Key(val svid: Int, val iod: Int)
    private data class Part(val page: GalileoNavigationPage, val reference: GalileoTime)
    private class Candidate {
        val parts = mutableMapOf<Int, Part>()
        var conflict = false
    }
    private data class Issue(val key: Key, val reference: GalileoTime, val conflict: Boolean = false)
    private data class Service(val part: Part, val transmission: GalileoTime, val conflict: Boolean = false)
    private val candidates = linkedMapOf<Key, Candidate>()
    private val issues = mutableMapOf<Int, Issue>()
    private val services = mutableMapOf<Int, Service>()

    /** Re-evaluate after late conflicts. At most one currently selected issue per satellite. */
    @Synchronized
    fun completed(): List<DecodedGalileoInav> = issues.keys.sorted().mapNotNull { decode(it).decoded }

    @Synchronized
    fun offer(observation: GnssNavigationObservation, trustedTimeAtCapture: GalileoTime): GalileoInavDecodeResult {
        fun invalid(reason: String) = GalileoInavDecodeResult(null, reason)
        val ref = trustedTimeAtCapture
        if (ref.secondsSince(captureFrom) < 0 || captureUntil.secondsSince(ref) < 0)
            return invalid("trusted GST is outside this assembly capture window")
        val checked = GalileoNavigationPages.decode(observation)
        val page = checked.page ?: return invalid(checked.reason ?: "invalid Galileo page")
        if (page.format != GalileoClockReference.INAV_E1_E5B || page.wordType !in 1..5)
            return invalid("requires an I/NAV word 1/2/3/4/5")
        val part = Part(page, ref)
        if (page.wordType == 5) {
            val time = transmissionTime(page, ref) ?: return invalid("I/NAV word 5 time disagrees with trusted GST")
            if (validFrom != null && validUntil != null &&
                (time.secondsSince(validFrom) < 0 || validUntil.secondsSince(time) < 0))
                return invalid("I/NAV transmission outside supplied validity evidence")
            val previous = services[page.svid]
            if (previous == null || time.secondsSince(previous.transmission) > 0) services[page.svid] = Service(part, time)
            else if (time == previous.transmission && !sameBits(page, previous.part.page, 128))
                services[page.svid] = previous.copy(conflict = true)
            return decode(page.svid)
        }
        if (page.wordType == 4 && page.unsigned(16, 6).toInt() != page.svid)
            return invalid("I/NAV SVID disagrees with receiver metadata")
        val key = Key(page.svid, page.unsigned(6, 10).toInt())
        val selected = issues[page.svid]
        // IOD is not an increasing integer across rollover. Use trusted capture order, and
        // reject simultaneous evidence for different issues instead of choosing by arrival.
        if (selected == null || ref.secondsSince(selected.reference) > 0) issues[page.svid] = Issue(key, ref)
        else if (ref == selected.reference && key != selected.key) issues[page.svid] = selected.copy(conflict = true)
        val candidate = candidates[key] ?: run {
            if (candidates.size >= 64) return invalid("I/NAV candidate capacity exceeded")
            Candidate().also { candidates[key] = it }
        }
        if (candidate.conflict) return invalid("conflicting I/NAV issue")
        val previous = candidate.parts[page.wordType]
        val cedEnd = if (page.wordType == 3) 128 else 126
        if (previous != null && !sameBits(page, previous.page, cedEnd)) {
            candidate.conflict = true
            return invalid("conflicting I/NAV orbit/clock/SISA within one issue")
        }
        if (previous == null || ref.secondsSince(previous.reference) > 0) candidate.parts[page.wordType] = part
        return decode(page.svid)
    }

    private fun decode(svid: Int): GalileoInavDecodeResult {
        fun invalid(reason: String) = GalileoInavDecodeResult(null, reason)
        val issue = issues[svid] ?: return invalid("waiting for I/NAV orbit/clock issue")
        if (issue.conflict) return invalid("ambiguous simultaneous I/NAV issues")
        val candidate = candidates[issue.key] ?: return invalid("I/NAV selected issue was not retained")
        if (candidate.conflict) return invalid("conflicting I/NAV issue")
        if (candidate.parts.size != 4) return invalid("waiting for I/NAV words 1/2/3/4")
        val service = services[svid] ?: return invalid("waiting for I/NAV GST/BGD/health word 5")
        if (service.conflict) return invalid("conflicting I/NAV service evidence")
        if (candidate.parts.values.any { abs(it.reference.secondsSince(service.transmission)) > 120 })
            return invalid("I/NAV service time is not contemporaneous with orbit/clock capture")
        return GalileoInavEphemerisDecoder.decode(candidate.parts.values.map { it.page } + service.part.page,
            service.part.reference, validFrom, validUntil)
    }

    private fun transmissionTime(page: GalileoNavigationPage, ref: GalileoTime): GalileoTime? {
        val tow = page.unsigned(85, 20).toDouble()
        if (tow >= 604800) return null
        val week12 = page.unsigned(73, 12)
        return (ref.week / 4096 - 1..ref.week / 4096 + 1).map { it.toLong() * 4096 + week12 }
            .filter { it in 0..Int.MAX_VALUE.toLong() }.map { GalileoTime(it.toInt(), tow) }
            .minByOrNull { abs(it.secondsSince(ref)) }?.takeIf { abs(it.secondsSince(ref)) <= 120 }
    }

    private fun sameBits(a: GalileoNavigationPage, b: GalileoNavigationPage, end: Int): Boolean =
        (0 until end).all { a.unsigned(it, 1) == b.unsigned(it, 1) }
}
```

`core/src/main/kotlin/com/system/location/service/core/gnss/GalileoInavEphemerisDecoder.kt`:

```kt
package com.system.location.service.core.gnss

import kotlin.math.abs
import kotlin.math.pow
import kotlinx.serialization.Serializable

@Serializable
data class GalileoSignalStatus(val health: Int, val dataValidity: Int) {
    init { require(health in 0..3 && dataValidity in 0..1) }
    val usable: Boolean get() = health == 0 && dataValidity == 0
}

@Serializable
data class DecodedGalileoInav(
    val ephemeris: GalileoBroadcastEphemeris,
    val transmissionTimeOfWordFive: GalileoTime,
    val e1Status: GalileoSignalStatus,
    val e5bStatus: GalileoSignalStatus,
    val sisaIndex: Int,
    val bgdE1E5aSeconds: Double,
    val bgdE1E5bSeconds: Double,
)
data class GalileoInavDecodeResult(val decoded: DecodedGalileoInav?, val reason: String? = null)

/**
 * OS SIS ICD 2.2 Tables 42–46/67/70/78/91. Decode complete CRC-checked I/NAV words 1–5.
 * Galileo carries no GPS LNAV fit flag. OS SDD 1.3 limits age to [toe,toe+4h]; optional
 * independent limits may only shorten that interval. This does not establish future signal
 * health or OSNMA authentication. Health/DVS are never merged into one healthy bit.
 */
object GalileoInavEphemerisDecoder {
    private const val SEMICIRCLE_TO_RADIANS = 3.1415926535898

    fun decode(pages: Collection<GalileoNavigationPage>, trustedTimeAtWordFiveCapture: GalileoTime,
        validFrom: GalileoTime? = null, validUntil: GalileoTime? = null): GalileoInavDecodeResult {
        fun invalid(reason: String) = GalileoInavDecodeResult(null, reason)
        if (pages.size != 5 || pages.map { it.wordType }.toSet() != (1..5).toSet() ||
            pages.any { it.format != GalileoClockReference.INAV_E1_E5B })
            return invalid("requires exactly I/NAV words 1/2/3/4/5")
        if (pages.map { it.svid }.distinct().size != 1) return invalid("mixed Galileo satellite identities")
        if (pages.maxOf { it.capturedAtMillis } - pages.minOf { it.capturedAtMillis } > 120_000)
            return invalid("I/NAV pages are not contemporaneous")
        val sorted = pages.sortedBy { it.wordType }
        val one = sorted[0]; val two = sorted[1]; val three = sorted[2]; val four = sorted[3]; val five = sorted[4]
        val issues = sorted.take(4).map { it.unsigned(6, 10).toInt() }
        if (issues.distinct().size != 1) return invalid("inconsistent Galileo IODnav")
        if (four.unsigned(16, 6).toInt() != one.svid) return invalid("I/NAV SVID disagrees with receiver metadata")
        val sisa = three.unsigned(120, 8).toInt()
        if (sisa !in 0..125) return invalid("Galileo SISA is spare or NAPA")
        val week12 = five.unsigned(73, 12).toInt()
        val tow = five.unsigned(85, 20).toDouble()
        if (tow >= 604800) return invalid("invalid GST time of week")
        val ref = trustedTimeAtWordFiveCapture
        val era = ref.week / 4096
        val week = (era - 1..era + 1).map { it.toLong() * 4096 + week12 }
            .filter { it in 0..Int.MAX_VALUE.toLong() }
            .minByOrNull { abs(it - ref.week) }?.toInt() ?: return invalid("cannot resolve full GST week")
        val transmission = GalileoTime(week, tow)
        if (abs(transmission.secondsSince(ref)) > 120) return invalid("GST page time disagrees with trusted capture reference")
        fun resolveEpoch(seconds: Double): GalileoTime? {
            if (seconds >= 604800) return null
            return (week.toLong() - 1..week.toLong() + 1).filter { it in 0..Int.MAX_VALUE.toLong() }
                .map { GalileoTime(it.toInt(), seconds) }.minByOrNull { abs(it.secondsSince(transmission)) }
        }
        val toe = resolveEpoch(one.unsigned(16, 14) * 60.0) ?: return invalid("invalid Galileo toe")
        val toc = resolveEpoch(four.unsigned(54, 14) * 60.0) ?: return invalid("invalid Galileo toc")
        val validity = GalileoEphemerisValidity.resolve(toe, validFrom, validUntil)
            ?: return invalid("invalid Galileo ephemeris age interval")
        if (!validity.contains(transmission))
            return invalid("transmission outside Galileo ephemeris age/supplied validity interval")
        return try {
            val e = GalileoBroadcastEphemeris(one.svid, toe, toc, validity.from, validity.until, issues.first(),
                GalileoClockReference.INAV_E1_E5B, one.unsigned(94, 32) * 2.0.pow(-19),
                one.unsigned(62, 32) * 2.0.pow(-33), two.scale(48, 32, -31, true),
                two.scale(16, 32, -31, true), two.scale(80, 32, -31, true), one.scale(30, 32, -31, true),
                three.scale(40, 16, -43, true), three.scale(16, 24, -43, true), two.scale(112, 14, -43, true),
                three.scale(56, 16, -29), three.scale(72, 16, -29), three.scale(88, 16, -5), three.scale(104, 16, -5),
                four.scale(22, 16, -29), four.scale(38, 16, -29), four.scale(68, 31, -34),
                four.scale(99, 21, -46), four.scale(120, 6, -59))
            GalileoInavDecodeResult(DecodedGalileoInav(e, transmission,
                GalileoSignalStatus(five.unsigned(69, 2).toInt(), five.unsigned(72, 1).toInt()),
                GalileoSignalStatus(five.unsigned(67, 2).toInt(), five.unsigned(71, 1).toInt()),
                sisa, five.scale(47, 10, -32), five.scale(57, 10, -32)))
        } catch (error: IllegalArgumentException) { invalid(error.message ?: "invalid Galileo parameters") }
    }

    private fun GalileoNavigationPage.scale(start: Int, length: Int, power: Int, semicircles: Boolean = false) =
        signed(start, length) * 2.0.pow(power) * if (semicircles) SEMICIRCLE_TO_RADIANS else 1.0
}
```

`core/src/main/kotlin/com/system/location/service/core/gnss/GalileoNavigationPages.kt`:

```kt
package com.system.location.service.core.gnss

import java.util.Base64

/** CRC-checked payload: 128-bit I/NAV word or 214-bit F/NAV information block. */
class GalileoNavigationPage internal constructor(
    val svid: Int,
    val capturedAtMillis: Long,
    val format: GalileoClockReference,
    val wordType: Int,
    private val data: ByteArray,
    private val bitLength: Int,
) {
    fun unsigned(start: Int, length: Int): Long {
        require(start >= 0 && length in 1..32 && start + length <= bitLength)
        var result = 0L
        repeat(length) { result = (result shl 1) or
            ((data[(start + it) / 8].toInt() ushr (7 - (start + it) % 8)) and 1).toLong() }
        return result
    }
    fun signed(start: Int, length: Int): Long {
        val result = unsigned(start, length)
        return if (result and (1L shl (length - 1)) != 0L) result - (1L shl length) else result
    }
}

data class GalileoPageResult(val page: GalileoNavigationPage?, val reason: String? = null)

/** Android sync/tail-free packing, Galileo OS SIS ICD 2.2 Tables 28/38, 5.1.9.4 CRC-24Q. */
object GalileoNavigationPages {
    fun decode(observation: GnssNavigationObservation): GalileoPageResult {
        fun invalid(reason: String) = GalileoPageResult(null, reason)
        if (observation.svid !in 1..36 || observation.type !in listOf(0x0601, 0x0602))
            return invalid("not a supported Galileo I/NAV or F/NAV message")
        if (observation.status !in 0..2) return invalid("invalid receiver parity status")
        val input = Base64.getDecoder().decode(observation.dataBase64)
        val inav = observation.type == 0x0601
        if (input.size != if (inav) 29 else 30) return invalid("invalid Android Galileo page length")
        val padding = if (inav) 4 else 2
        if (input.last().toInt() and ((1 shl padding) - 1) != 0) return invalid("nonzero Galileo page padding")
        fun bit(index: Int) = (input[index / 8].toInt() ushr (7 - index % 8)) and 1
        if (inav && (bit(0) != 0 || bit(114) != 1)) return invalid("invalid even/odd I/NAV page parts")
        if (inav && (bit(1) != 0 || bit(115) != 0)) return invalid("I/NAV alert page is not nominal navigation")
        val protectedBits = if (inav) 196 else 214
        var crc = 0
        repeat(protectedBits) { index ->
            val feedback = (crc ushr 23) xor bit(index)
            crc = (crc shl 1) and 0xFFFFFF
            if (feedback != 0) crc = crc xor 0x864CFB
        }
        val transmitted = (0 until 24).fold(0) { value, index -> (value shl 1) or bit(protectedBits + index) }
        if (crc != transmitted) return invalid("Galileo CRC-24Q mismatch")
        val dataBits = if (inav) 128 else 214
        val data = ByteArray((dataBits + 7) / 8)
        repeat(dataBits) { index ->
            val source = if (!inav) index else if (index < 112) index + 2 else index + 4
            data[index / 8] = (data[index / 8].toInt() or (bit(source) shl (7 - index % 8))).toByte()
        }
        val wordType = data[0].toInt().and(255) ushr 2
        if (wordType != observation.submessageId) return invalid("Galileo word/submessage identity mismatch")
        if (wordType == 63) return invalid("Galileo dummy page contains no navigation solution")
        return GalileoPageResult(GalileoNavigationPage(observation.svid, observation.capturedAtMillis,
            if (inav) GalileoClockReference.INAV_E1_E5B else GalileoClockReference.FNAV_E1_E5A,
            wordType, data, dataBits))
    }
}
```

`core/src/main/kotlin/com/system/location/service/core/gnss/GalileoReceptionGeometry.kt`:

```kt
package com.system.location.service.core.gnss

import kotlin.math.*

/** Position and ellipsoid-normal orientation in GTRF at reception. No WGS84 conversion is implied. */
data class GtrfReceiver(val position: EcefPosition, val orientation: GeodeticOrientation)

data class GalileoReceptionObservation(
    val transmissionTime: GalileoTime,
    val propagationSeconds: Double,
    /** Transmission position rotated into the GTRF ECEF axes at reception. */
    val satelliteInReceptionEcef: EcefPosition,
    val lineOfSight: GnssLineOfSight,
    /** Polynomial plus relativity for clockReference; no single-frequency BGD correction. */
    val clockBiasSeconds: Double,
    val clockReference: GalileoClockReference,
)

data class GalileoReceptionResult(val observation: GalileoReceptionObservation?, val reason: String? = null)

/**
 * Geometric vacuum light-time using the Galileo OS SIS ICD Table 68 transmission position.
 * Reception and transmission epochs are GST, not receiver/satellite clock readings.
 * The ECEF rotation is Rz(-Omega_e * flightTime), into reception axes; it is applied once.
 * This mathematical geometry does not establish signal usability, atmospheric corrections,
 * pseudorange, coordinate-frame transformation, or the provenance of the validity interval.
 */
object GalileoReceptionGeometry {
    const val SPEED_OF_LIGHT_METERS_PER_SECOND = 299792458.0

    fun observe(e: GalileoBroadcastEphemeris, receptionTime: GalileoTime,
        receiver: GtrfReceiver): GalileoReceptionResult {
        fun invalid(reason: String) = GalileoReceptionResult(null, reason)
        // Bound orbital radius by a(1+e) and the two radial harmonic amplitudes.
        val maximumRadius = e.sqrtSemiMajorAxis * e.sqrtSemiMajorAxis * (1 + e.eccentricity) +
            abs(e.crsMeters) + abs(e.crcMeters)
        val r = receiver.position
        val maximumDelay = (maximumRadius + hypot(hypot(r.xMeters, r.yMeters), r.zMeters)) /
            SPEED_OF_LIGHT_METERS_PER_SECOND
        if (!maximumDelay.isFinite()) return invalid("non-finite Galileo reception bound")
        var lower = max(0.0, receptionTime.secondsSince(e.validUntil))
        var upper = min(maximumDelay, receptionTime.secondsSince(e.validFrom))
        if (lower > upper) return invalid("no transmission inside absolute Galileo validity interval")

        fun evaluate(delay: Double): GalileoReceptionObservation? {
            val transmission = receptionTime.plusSeconds(-delay)
            val state = GalileoBroadcastPropagator.propagate(e, transmission).state ?: return null
            val angle = GalileoBroadcastPropagator.EARTH_ROTATION_RAD_PER_SECOND * delay
            val position = EcefPosition(cos(angle) * state.xMeters + sin(angle) * state.yMeters,
                -sin(angle) * state.xMeters + cos(angle) * state.yMeters, state.zMeters)
            val los = GnssObserverGeometry.lineOfSight(r, receiver.orientation, position) ?: return null
            return GalileoReceptionObservation(transmission, delay, position, los,
                state.clockBiasSeconds, state.clockReference)
        }
        fun residual(o: GalileoReceptionObservation) =
            o.lineOfSight.rangeMeters / SPEED_OF_LIGHT_METERS_PER_SECOND - o.propagationSeconds
        val atLower = evaluate(lower) ?: return invalid("unavailable Galileo state at reception bracket")
        val atUpper = evaluate(upper) ?: return invalid("unavailable Galileo state at reception bracket")
        if (residual(atLower) < -1e-13 || residual(atUpper) > 1e-13)
            return invalid("light-time solution outside absolute Galileo validity interval")
        // All trials stay inside the explicit validity interval. Bisection has a finite budget.
        repeat(50) {
            val result = evaluate(lower + (upper - lower) / 2)
                ?: return invalid("Galileo light-time evaluation failed")
            val error = residual(result)
            if (abs(error) <= 1e-13) return GalileoReceptionResult(result)
            if (error > 0) lower = result.propagationSeconds else upper = result.propagationSeconds
        }
        return invalid("Galileo light-time equation did not converge")
    }
}
```

```kt
package com.system.location.service.core.gnss

import kotlinx.serialization.Serializable

/**
 * Independently established applicability of a decoded Galileo health/DVS/SISA/BGD snapshot.
 * The exact word-5/page-1 epoch and format identify the snapshot. Neither the orbital age
 * limit nor the GGTO/receiver-transform lifetime establishes this service interval.
 */
@Serializable
data class GalileoServiceValidity(
    val svid: Int,
    val format: GalileoClockReference,
    val broadcastAt: GalileoTime,
    val from: GalileoTime,
    val until: GalileoTime,
) {
    init {
        require(svid in 1..36)
        require(broadcastAt.secondsSince(from) >= 0.0 && until.secondsSince(broadcastAt) > 0.0)
    }

    /** End-exclusive; these are full GST epochs, never modulo-week ages. */
    fun contains(transmission: GalileoTime): Boolean =
        transmission.secondsSince(from) >= 0.0 && until.secondsSince(transmission) > 0.0
}
```

`core/src/main/kotlin/com/system/location/service/core/gnss/GalileoSignalClock.kt`:

```kt
package com.system.location.service.core.gnss

enum class GalileoOpenServiceSignal { E1, E5A, E5B }

data class GalileoSignalClockResult(val correctionSeconds: Double?, val reason: String? = null)

/**
 * OS SIS ICD 2.2 §5.1.5, Eqs 18/19, Tables 2/71/73. Single-frequency clock correction
 * for the services supported by each decoded message, including that signal's SHS/DVS.
 * This is the satellite correction subtracted from a measured TOT, not a pseudorange model.
 * Dual-frequency clock propagation remains in GalileoBroadcastPropagator without a BGD term.
 */
object GalileoSignalClock {
    private const val E1_HZ = 1575420000.0
    private const val E5A_HZ = 1176450000.0
    private const val E5B_HZ = 1207140000.0

    fun correction(decoded: DecodedGalileoInav, transmission: GalileoTime,
        signal: GalileoOpenServiceSignal): GalileoSignalClockResult {
        if (decoded.ephemeris.clockReference != GalileoClockReference.INAV_E1_E5B)
            return invalid("I/NAV parameters have an inconsistent clock reference")
        if (signal == GalileoOpenServiceSignal.E5A)
            return invalid("I/NAV single-frequency service does not supply E5a clock/status evidence")
        if (decoded.sisaIndex !in 0..125) return invalid("I/NAV SISA is spare or NAPA")
        val status = if (signal == GalileoOpenServiceSignal.E1) decoded.e1Status else decoded.e5bStatus
        val factor = if (signal == GalileoOpenServiceSignal.E1) 1.0 else squaredRatio(E1_HZ, E5B_HZ)
        return evaluate(decoded.ephemeris, transmission, status, decoded.bgdE1E5bSeconds, factor)
    }

    fun correction(decoded: DecodedGalileoFnav, transmission: GalileoTime,
        signal: GalileoOpenServiceSignal): GalileoSignalClockResult {
        if (decoded.ephemeris.clockReference != GalileoClockReference.FNAV_E1_E5A)
            return invalid("F/NAV parameters have an inconsistent clock reference")
        if (signal != GalileoOpenServiceSignal.E5A)
            return invalid("F/NAV single-frequency service supplies only E5a clock/status evidence")
        if (decoded.sisaIndex !in 0..125) return invalid("F/NAV SISA is spare or NAPA")
        return evaluate(decoded.ephemeris, transmission, decoded.e5aStatus, decoded.bgdE1E5aSeconds,
            squaredRatio(E1_HZ, E5A_HZ))
    }

    private fun evaluate(e: GalileoBroadcastEphemeris, transmission: GalileoTime,
        status: GalileoSignalStatus, bgd: Double, factor: Double): GalileoSignalClockResult {
        if (!status.usable) return invalid("requested signal health/data validity is unusable")
        // A decoded BGD is a signed ten-bit value scaled by 2^-32 seconds (Table 72).
        if (!bgd.isFinite() || bgd < -512 * Math.scalb(1.0, -32) || bgd > 511 * Math.scalb(1.0, -32))
            return invalid("group delay outside broadcast field range")
        val propagation = GalileoBroadcastPropagator.propagate(e, transmission)
        val state = propagation.state ?: return invalid(propagation.reason ?: "Galileo propagation unavailable")
        val clock = state.clockBiasSeconds - factor * bgd
        return if (clock.isFinite()) GalileoSignalClockResult(clock) else invalid("non-finite signal clock")
    }

    private fun squaredRatio(a: Double, b: Double) = (a / b) * (a / b)
    private fun invalid(reason: String) = GalileoSignalClockResult(null, reason)
}
```

`core/src/main/kotlin/com/system/location/service/core/gnss/GalileoSignalReception.kt`:

```kt
package com.system.location.service.core.gnss

data class GalileoSignalReceptionObservation(
    val geometry: GalileoReceptionObservation,
    val signal: GalileoOpenServiceSignal,
    /** Single-frequency satellite clock evaluated at geometry.transmissionTime, including BGD. */
    val signalClockBiasSeconds: Double,
)

data class GalileoSignalReceptionResult(val observation: GalileoSignalReceptionObservation?, val reason: String? = null)

/** Joins decoded per-signal usability/clock evidence to geometric vacuum light-time. */
object GalileoSignalReception {
    fun observe(decoded: DecodedGalileoInav, receptionTime: GalileoTime, receiver: GtrfReceiver,
        signal: GalileoOpenServiceSignal): GalileoSignalReceptionResult =
        evaluate(decoded.ephemeris, receptionTime, receiver, signal) { transmission ->
            GalileoSignalClock.correction(decoded, transmission, signal)
        }

    fun observe(decoded: DecodedGalileoFnav, receptionTime: GalileoTime, receiver: GtrfReceiver,
        signal: GalileoOpenServiceSignal): GalileoSignalReceptionResult =
        evaluate(decoded.ephemeris, receptionTime, receiver, signal) { transmission ->
            GalileoSignalClock.correction(decoded, transmission, signal)
        }

    private fun evaluate(e: GalileoBroadcastEphemeris, receptionTime: GalileoTime, receiver: GtrfReceiver,
        signal: GalileoOpenServiceSignal, clock: (GalileoTime) -> GalileoSignalClockResult): GalileoSignalReceptionResult {
        val result = GalileoReceptionGeometry.observe(e, receptionTime, receiver)
        val geometry = result.observation ?: return GalileoSignalReceptionResult(null, result.reason)
        // Reception can follow the validity end; the propagated transmission epoch is authoritative.
        val correction = clock(geometry.transmissionTime)
        val bias = correction.correctionSeconds ?: return GalileoSignalReceptionResult(null, correction.reason)
        return GalileoSignalReceptionResult(GalileoSignalReceptionObservation(geometry, signal, bias))
    }
}
```

`core/src/main/kotlin/com/system/location/service/core/gnss/GlonassAlmanacHealth.kt`:

```kt
package com.system.location.service.core.gnss

/**
 * Raw almanac health for targetSlot, which may differ from the satellite broadcasting it.
 * Cn=1 means operational at the almanac upload epoch; Cn=0 means non-operational.
 * This is NOT current service acceptance: immediate Bn/ln and independently associated
 * almanac epoch/applicability evidence are also required (ICD 5.1 §5.3/Table 5.1).
 */
data class GlonassAlmanacHealth(
    val sourceSlot: Int,
    val targetSlot: Int,
    val frameId: Int,
    val stringId: Int,
    val capturedAtMillis: Long,
    val satelliteTypeBits: Int,
    val healthCn: Int,
)

data class GlonassAlmanacHealthResult(val health: GlonassAlmanacHealth?, val reason: String? = null)

/** ICD 5.1 §4.5/Table 4.11, almanac even strings. Does not infer an NA epoch from arrival time. */
object GlonassAlmanacHealthDecoder {
    fun decode(string: GlonassNavigationString): GlonassAlmanacHealthResult {
        fun invalid(reason: String) = GlonassAlmanacHealthResult(null, reason)
        if (string.stringId !in setOf(6, 8, 10, 12, 14)) return invalid("requires an even GLONASS almanac string")
        // Superframe string 74 carries B1/B2/KP, not a fifth almanac entry.
        if (string.frameId == 5 && string.stringId == 14) return invalid("GLONASS superframe string 74 is not almanac health")
        val target = string.unsigned(77, 5).toInt()
        // Table 4.9 defines nA=1..24 for this legacy message format. This is an address-field
        // validity check, not a production satellite catalog or a simulated constellation size.
        if (target !in 1..24) return invalid("GLONASS almanac target outside ICD 5.1 nA range")
        val type = string.unsigned(79, 2).toInt()
        if (type !in 0..1) return invalid("reserved GLONASS almanac satellite type")
        return GlonassAlmanacHealthResult(GlonassAlmanacHealth(string.slot, target, string.frameId,
            string.stringId, string.capturedAtMillis, type, string.unsigned(80, 1).toInt()))
    }
}
```
