`core/src/main/kotlin/com/system/location/service/core/gnss/GlonassBroadcastEvidence.kt`:

```kt
package com.system.location.service.core.gnss

import java.time.LocalDate
import kotlin.math.abs
import kotlinx.serialization.Serializable

/** A serializable calendar coordinate; epoch days avoid a platform-specific LocalDate serializer. */
@Serializable
data class GlonassCoordinateEvidence(val epochDay: Long, val secondsOfDay: Double) {
    init {
        LocalDate.ofEpochDay(epochDay)
        require(secondsOfDay.isFinite() && secondsOfDay >= 0.0 && secondsOfDay < 86400.0)
    }

    fun coordinate(): GlonassCalendarCoordinate =
        GlonassCalendarCoordinate(LocalDate.ofEpochDay(epochDay), secondsOfDay)

    companion object {
        fun from(coordinate: GlonassCalendarCoordinate) =
            GlonassCoordinateEvidence(coordinate.date.toEpochDay(), coordinate.secondsOfDay)
    }
}

/**
 * Receiver clock evidence on the UTC(SU)+3h continuous GLONASS scale. The clock is deliberately
 * separate from Android wall time and GPS time; a missing or discontinuous domain cannot drive
 * orbital output.
 */
@Serializable
data class GlonassElapsedClockEvidence(
    val bootCount: Int,
    val domainId: String,
    val anchor: GlonassCoordinateEvidence,
    val elapsedRealtimeNanos: Long,
    val coverageFrom: GlonassCoordinateEvidence,
    val coverageUntil: GlonassCoordinateEvidence,
) {
    @kotlinx.serialization.Transient
    private var cachedDomain: GlonassTimeDomain? = null

    init {
        require(bootCount >= 0 && domainId.isNotBlank() && domainId.length <= 256)
        require(elapsedRealtimeNanos >= 0)
        val from = coverageFrom.coordinate()
        val until = coverageUntil.coordinate()
        require(until.secondsSince(from) > 0.0)
        require(anchor.coordinate().secondsSince(from) >= 0.0)
        require(until.secondsSince(anchor.coordinate()) > 0.0)
    }

    @Synchronized
    fun domain(): GlonassTimeDomain = cachedDomain ?: GlonassTimeDomain(domainId,
        coverageFrom.coordinate(), coverageUntil.coordinate()).also { cachedDomain = it }

    fun at(elapsedNanos: Long, currentBootCount: Int?, timeDomain: GlonassTimeDomain = domain()): GlonassTime? {
        if (currentBootCount != bootCount || elapsedNanos < elapsedRealtimeNanos) return null
        val delta = (elapsedNanos - elapsedRealtimeNanos) / 1e9
        return runCatching { timeDomain.at(anchor.coordinate())?.plusSeconds(delta) }.getOrNull()
    }
}

/**
 * Explicit WGS-84 ECEF -> GLONASS ECEF transform. No default or datum-name substitution is
 * supplied. The matrix is row-major and must be a proper, near-orthonormal rotation; callers
 * obtain it from an independently validated datum solution.
 */
@Serializable
data class GlonassEcefTransform(
    val rotation: List<Double>,
    val translationMeters: GlonassCartesianVector,
    /** Datum transform's explicitly supplied geodetic orientation correction. */
    val latitudeOffsetDegrees: Double,
    val longitudeOffsetDegrees: Double,
) {
    init {
        require(rotation.size == 9 && rotation.all { it.isFinite() })
        require(listOf(translationMeters.x, translationMeters.y, translationMeters.z).all(Double::isFinite))
        require(latitudeOffsetDegrees.isFinite() && longitudeOffsetDegrees.isFinite())
        val r = rotation
        fun dot(a: Int, b: Int) = (0..2).sumOf { r[a * 3 + it] * r[b * 3 + it] }
        require((0..2).all { abs(dot(it, it) - 1.0) <= 1e-6 })
        require(abs(dot(0, 1)) <= 1e-6 && abs(dot(0, 2)) <= 1e-6 && abs(dot(1, 2)) <= 1e-6)
        val determinant = r[0] * (r[4] * r[8] - r[5] * r[7]) -
            r[1] * (r[3] * r[8] - r[5] * r[6]) + r[2] * (r[3] * r[7] - r[4] * r[6])
        require(abs(determinant - 1.0) <= 1e-5)
    }

    fun apply(position: EcefPosition): EcefPosition {
        val r = rotation
        return EcefPosition(
            r[0] * position.xMeters + r[1] * position.yMeters + r[2] * position.zMeters + translationMeters.x,
            r[3] * position.xMeters + r[4] * position.yMeters + r[5] * position.zMeters + translationMeters.y,
            r[6] * position.xMeters + r[7] * position.yMeters + r[8] * position.zMeters + translationMeters.z,
        )
    }
}

/**
 * Independently established applicability of BOTH immediate and almanac health evidence.
 * This interval is not derived from tb, En, P1 or the orbital integration limit.
 */
@Serializable
data class GlonassServiceEvidence(
    val broadcastAt: GlonassCoordinateEvidence,
    val validFrom: GlonassCoordinateEvidence,
    val validUntil: GlonassCoordinateEvidence,
    val almanacHealthCn: Int,
) {
    init {
        require(almanacHealthCn in 0..1)
        require(broadcastAt.coordinate().secondsSince(validFrom.coordinate()) >= 0.0)
        require(validUntil.coordinate().secondsSince(broadcastAt.coordinate()) > 0.0)
    }
}

/** Compact, validated GLONASS evidence. It is never inferred from callback arrival timestamps. */
@Serializable
data class GlonassBroadcastEphemerisEvidence(
    val orbit: GlonassBroadcastStateVector,
    val referenceTime: GlonassCoordinateEvidence,
    val validFrom: GlonassCoordinateEvidence,
    val validUntil: GlonassCoordinateEvidence,
    val healthBn: Int,
    val healthLn: Int,
    val accuracyFt: Int,
    val ageDays: Int,
    /** Missing legacy evidence remains decodable but cannot authorize physical sky output. */
    val service: GlonassServiceEvidence? = null,
) {
    init {
        require(healthBn in 0..7 && healthLn in 0..1 && accuracyFt in 0..15 && ageDays in 0..31)
        val reference = referenceTime.coordinate()
        val from = validFrom.coordinate()
        val until = validUntil.coordinate()
        require(from.secondsSince(reference) > -900.0 && from.secondsSince(reference) <= 0.0)
        require(until.secondsSince(reference) >= 0.0 && until.secondsSince(reference) < 900.0 &&
            until.secondsSince(from) > 0.0)
    }

    fun resolve(domain: GlonassTimeDomain): GlonassOrbitalEphemeris? = runCatching {
        GlonassOrbitalEphemeris(orbit, domain.at(referenceTime.coordinate())!!,
            domain.at(validFrom.coordinate())!!, domain.at(validUntil.coordinate())!!)
    }.getOrNull()

    fun serviceRejection(transmissionTime: GlonassTime): String? {
        // ICD 5.1 §4.5: only the MSB of Bn is a malfunction flag; the two LSBs are ignored.
        if (healthBn and 4 != 0 || healthLn != 0) return "即时健康标志不允许导航使用"
        if (accuracyFt == 15) return "FT=15 未定义测距精度"
        val evidence = service ?: return "缺少独立健康适用期和年历 Cn 证据"
        if (evidence.almanacHealthCn != 1) return "年历 Cn 表明卫星不可用"
        val domain = transmissionTime.domain
        val from = domain.at(evidence.validFrom.coordinate()) ?: return "健康适用期不在当前连续时钟域内"
        val until = domain.at(evidence.validUntil.coordinate()) ?: return "健康适用期不在当前连续时钟域内"
        if (domain.at(evidence.broadcastAt.coordinate()) == null) return "健康广播标签不在当前连续时钟域内"
        return if (transmissionTime.secondsSince(from)!! < 0.0 || transmissionTime.secondsSince(until)!! >= 0.0)
            "发射时刻超出独立健康适用期" else null
    }
}

/**
 * GLONASS broadcast geometry requires a real continuous clock, datum realization and receiver
 * transform. If any of these are absent this evidence remains available for diagnostics only.
 */
@Serializable
data class GlonassBroadcastEvidence(
    val clock: GlonassElapsedClockEvidence,
    val receiverFrame: GlonassReferenceFrame,
    /** Legacy archive field: constant latitude offsets cannot resolve a moving route's normal. */
    val receiverTransform: GlonassEcefTransform? = null,
    val ephemerides: List<GlonassBroadcastEphemerisEvidence>,
    val datumTransform: GnssReceiverDatumTransform? = null,
) {
    init {
        require(datumTransform == null || datumTransform.bootCount == clock.bootCount)
        require(ephemerides.isNotEmpty() && ephemerides.size <= 31)
        require(ephemerides.map { it.orbit.slot }.distinct().size == ephemerides.size)
        val domain = clock.domain()
        require(ephemerides.all { it.orbit.referenceFrame == receiverFrame && it.resolve(domain) != null })
    }

    val identities: Set<Int> get() = ephemerides.map { it.orbit.slot }.toSet()
}
```

`core/src/main/kotlin/com/system/location/service/core/gnss/GlonassBroadcastPropagator.kt`:

```kt
package com.system.location.service.core.gnss

import kotlin.math.*

data class GlonassOrbitalState(
    val referenceFrame: GlonassReferenceFrame,
    val positionMeters: GlonassCartesianVector,
    val velocityMetersPerSecond: GlonassCartesianVector,
)

data class GlonassPropagationResult(val state: GlonassOrbitalState?, val reason: String? = null)

/**
 * ICD 5.1 A.3.1.2 simplified rotating-ECEF dynamics, with corrected y Coriolis and z J2 terms.
 * RK4 with at most 10 SI seconds per step. This is orbital mathematics, NOT a usable signal.
 * The caller supplies an independently resolved continuous SI interval from tb; subtracting
 * ambiguous civil-day/UTC/GPS labels (especially across a leap) does not establish that interval.
 * No implicit datum conversion, clock/relativity correction or signal-flight rotation is applied.
 */
object GlonassBroadcastPropagator {
    const val EARTH_MU = 3.9860044e14
    const val EARTH_RADIUS_METERS = 6_378_136.0
    const val EARTH_J2 = 1.0826257e-3
    const val EARTH_ROTATION_RAD_PER_SECOND = 7.292115e-5
    private const val STEP_SECONDS = 10.0

    fun propagate(e: GlonassBroadcastStateVector, secondsFromReference: Double): GlonassPropagationResult {
        fun invalid() = GlonassPropagationResult(null, "invalid GLONASS integration state")
        // ICD A.3.1.1 uses strict <15 minutes; no modulo-day/week revival or extrapolation.
        if (!secondsFromReference.isFinite() || abs(secondsFromReference) >= 900.0)
            return GlonassPropagationResult(null, "outside GLONASS integration interval")
        var state = doubleArrayOf(e.positionMeters.x, e.positionMeters.y, e.positionMeters.z,
            e.velocityMetersPerSecond.x, e.velocityMetersPerSecond.y, e.velocityMetersPerSecond.z)
        val acc = e.luniSolarAccelerationMetersPerSecondSquared
        val steps = ceil(abs(secondsFromReference) / STEP_SECONDS).toInt()
        var elapsed = 0.0
        repeat(steps) {
            val remaining = secondsFromReference - elapsed
            val h = sign(remaining) * min(STEP_SECONDS, abs(remaining))
            fun shifted(k: DoubleArray, scale: Double) = DoubleArray(6) { i -> state[i] + scale * k[i] }
            val k1 = derivative(state, acc) ?: return invalid()
            val k2 = derivative(shifted(k1, h / 2), acc) ?: return invalid()
            val k3 = derivative(shifted(k2, h / 2), acc) ?: return invalid()
            val k4 = derivative(shifted(k3, h), acc) ?: return invalid()
            state = DoubleArray(6) { i -> state[i] + h / 6 * (k1[i] + 2 * k2[i] + 2 * k3[i] + k4[i]) }
            elapsed += h
        }
        if (derivative(state, acc) == null) return invalid()
        return GlonassPropagationResult(GlonassOrbitalState(e.referenceFrame,
            GlonassCartesianVector(state[0], state[1], state[2]),
            GlonassCartesianVector(state[3], state[4], state[5])))
    }

    internal fun derivative(s: DoubleArray, acc: GlonassCartesianVector): DoubleArray? {
        if (s.size != 6 || !s.all(Double::isFinite)) return null
        val x = s[0]; val y = s[1]; val z = s[2]
        val r2 = x * x + y * y + z * z
        if (!r2.isFinite() || r2 <= EARTH_RADIUS_METERS * EARTH_RADIUS_METERS) return null
        val r3 = r2 * sqrt(r2)
        val j = 1.5 * EARTH_J2 * EARTH_MU * EARTH_RADIUS_METERS * EARTH_RADIUS_METERS / (r2 * r3)
        val b = 5 * z * z / r2
        val gravity = -EARTH_MU / r3
        val omega = EARTH_ROTATION_RAD_PER_SECOND
        // a_rot = a_grav - 2*Omega cross v - Omega cross (Omega cross r) + a_luniSolar.
        // J2_z has (3-5*z²/r²), unlike x/y's (1-5*z²/r²).
        return doubleArrayOf(s[3], s[4], s[5],
            (gravity - j * (1 - b) + omega * omega) * x + 2 * omega * s[4] + acc.x,
            (gravity - j * (1 - b) + omega * omega) * y - 2 * omega * s[3] + acc.y,
            (gravity - j * (3 - b)) * z + acc.z).takeIf { it.all(Double::isFinite) }
    }
}
```

`core/src/main/kotlin/com/system/location/service/core/gnss/GlonassBroadcastStateVector.kt`:

```kt
package com.system.location.service.core.gnss

import kotlin.math.abs
import kotlin.math.hypot
import kotlinx.serialization.Serializable

/** Realization is supplied by the navigation-data source; it is never inferred from a slot. */
@Serializable
enum class GlonassReferenceFrame { PZ_90_02, PZ_90_11 }

/** Components in one explicitly identified PZ-90 ECEF realization, in SI units. */
@Serializable
data class GlonassCartesianVector(val x: Double, val y: Double, val z: Double) {
    init { require(listOf(x, y, z).all(Double::isFinite)) }
    internal fun within(limit: Double) = abs(x) <= limit && abs(y) <= limit && abs(z) <= limit
    internal fun norm() = hypot(hypot(x, y), z)
}

/**
 * GLONASS FDMA immediate orbital data at tb (ICD 5.1 Table 4.5), after bit validation.
 * Acceleration is the broadcast luni-solar perturbation, NOT the total acceleration.
 * No calendar, leap-second, GPS/UTC association, health, clock or service validity is implied.
 * A caller must independently establish the requested SI interval from tb before propagation.
 */
@Serializable
data class GlonassBroadcastStateVector(
    val slot: Int,
    val referenceFrame: GlonassReferenceFrame,
    val positionMeters: GlonassCartesianVector,
    val velocityMetersPerSecond: GlonassCartesianVector,
    val luniSolarAccelerationMetersPerSecondSquared: GlonassCartesianVector,
) {
    init {
        // n is a five-bit slot field. Do not hard-code a historical operational constellation size.
        require(slot in 1..31)
        // Sign-magnitude bit capacities, not rounded nominal constellation ranges.
        require(positionMeters.within(67_108_863 * (1000.0 / 2048)))
        require(positionMeters.norm() > 6_378_136.0)
        require(velocityMetersPerSecond.within(8_388_607 * (1000.0 / 1_048_576)))
        require(luniSolarAccelerationMetersPerSecondSquared.within(15 * (1000.0 / 1_073_741_824)))
    }
}
```

`core/src/main/kotlin/com/system/location/service/core/gnss/GlonassClockRelation.kt`:

```kt
package com.system.location.service.core.gnss

import kotlin.math.abs

data class GlonassClockBiasResult(val satelliteMinusSystemSeconds: Double?, val reason: String? = null)
data class GlonassClockTimeResult(val systemTime: GlonassTime?, val reason: String? = null)

/**
 * ICD 5.1 §3.3.3 affine clock relation on one established continuous correction domain:
 * U = S + tauC + tauN - gammaN * (S - tb), where U is UTC(SU)+3h and S is onboard time.
 * tb and U share the domain of referenceTime; an onboard reading is never labelled GlonassTime.
 * tauC is mandatory; no GPS/UTC(SU) correction, integer leap offset or zero fallback is inferred.
 * gammaN already includes the broadcast gravitational/relativistic frequency prediction (§4.4).
 *
 * validFrom/validUntil must be independently established CLOCK applicability, not the orbital
 * integration limit, En or P1. This relation alone says nothing about health or signal usability.
 */
data class GlonassClockRelation(
    val referenceTime: GlonassTime,
    val tauNSeconds: Double,
    val gammaN: Double,
    val tauCSeconds: Double,
    val validFrom: GlonassTime,
    val validUntil: GlonassTime,
) {
    init {
        // Sign-magnitude field capacities in Tables 4.5 and 4.9 (GLONASS-M tauC).
        require(tauNSeconds.isFinite() && abs(tauNSeconds) <= 2_097_151 * Math.scalb(1.0, -30))
        require(gammaN.isFinite() && abs(gammaN) <= 1_023 * Math.scalb(1.0, -40))
        require(tauCSeconds.isFinite() && abs(tauCSeconds) <= 2_147_483_647 * Math.scalb(1.0, -31))
        val from = validFrom.secondsSince(referenceTime)
        val until = validUntil.secondsSince(referenceTime)
        require(from != null && until != null && from <= 0 && until >= 0 && until > from)
    }

    private fun contains(time: GlonassTime): Boolean =
        time.secondsSince(validFrom)?.let { it >= 0 } == true &&
            validUntil.secondsSince(time)?.let { it >= 0 } == true

    /** Solve the implicit onboard reading at a SYSTEM epoch; return S-U, in seconds. */
    fun biasAtSystemTime(systemTime: GlonassTime): GlonassClockBiasResult {
        if (!contains(systemTime)) return GlonassClockBiasResult(null, "outside GLONASS clock applicability or correction domain")
        val dt = systemTime.secondsSince(referenceTime)!!
        // S-U = (-tauC-tauN + gammaN*(U-tb)) / (1-gammaN).
        // Omitting the denominator substitutes a system time into a satellite-time polynomial.
        val bias = (-tauCSeconds - tauNSeconds + gammaN * dt) / (1.0 - gammaN)
        return if (bias.isFinite()) GlonassClockBiasResult(bias)
            else GlonassClockBiasResult(null, "non-finite GLONASS clock bias")
    }

    /**
     * A separately associated complete onboard reading expressed as S-tb, not a seconds-of-day
     * label. The caller must resolve its date; no nearest-day wrapping is performed here.
     */
    fun systemTimeFromSatelliteOffset(satelliteSecondsSinceReference: Double): GlonassClockTimeResult {
        if (!satelliteSecondsSinceReference.isFinite())
            return GlonassClockTimeResult(null, "non-finite GLONASS onboard time offset")
        val offset = satelliteSecondsSinceReference + tauCSeconds + tauNSeconds - gammaN * satelliteSecondsSinceReference
        val time = referenceTime.plusSeconds(offset)
            ?: return GlonassClockTimeResult(null, "GLONASS clock conversion outside continuous time coverage")
        return if (contains(time)) GlonassClockTimeResult(time)
            else GlonassClockTimeResult(null, "outside GLONASS clock applicability interval")
    }
}
```

`core/src/main/kotlin/com/system/location/service/core/gnss/GlonassImmediateDecoder.kt`:

```kt
package com.system.location.service.core.gnss

/**
 * Decoded GLONASS-M FDMA immediate fields. This is NOT an accepted absolute ephemeris.
 * tk/tb are system-local labels without a resolved four-year interval/leap association.
 * Frame-ID and arrival-window consistency do not prove that the four strings are coeval.
 * Health bits, age and update flags are evidence, not an inferred service validity interval.
 */
data class GlonassImmediateFields(
    val orbit: GlonassBroadcastStateVector,
    val frameTimeSecondsOfDay: Int,
    val referenceTimeSecondsOfDay: Int,
    val dayInFourYearInterval: Int,
    val tauNSeconds: Double,
    val gammaN: Double,
    val deltaTauNSeconds: Double,
    val healthBn: Int,
    val healthLn: Int,
    val accuracyFt: Int,
    val ageDays: Int,
    val updateP1: Int,
    val oddnessP2: Int,
    val almanacCountP3: Int,
    val ephemerisUpdateP4: Int,
    val timeParameterModeP: Int,
)

data class GlonassImmediateDecodeResult(val fields: GlonassImmediateFields?, val reason: String? = null)

/** ICD 5.1 Tables 4.5/4.6; GLONASS-M (M=01) only. No implicit epoch or frame acceptance. */
object GlonassImmediateDecoder {
    fun decode(strings: List<GlonassNavigationString>, referenceFrame: GlonassReferenceFrame): GlonassImmediateDecodeResult {
        fun invalid(reason: String) = GlonassImmediateDecodeResult(null, reason)
        if (strings.size != 4 || strings.map { it.stringId }.toSet() != setOf(1, 2, 3, 4))
            return invalid("requires exactly GLONASS immediate strings 1..4")
        if (strings.map { it.slot }.distinct().size != 1 || strings.map { it.frameId }.distinct().size != 1)
            return invalid("GLONASS slot/frame metadata mismatch")
        // Bounded transport sanity only; a later assembler must independently associate each string.
        if (strings.maxOf { it.capturedAtMillis } - strings.minOf { it.capturedAtMillis } > 30_000)
            return invalid("GLONASS immediate arrival window exceeds one frame")
        val byId = strings.associateBy { it.stringId }
        val s1 = byId.getValue(1); val s2 = byId.getValue(2)
        val s3 = byId.getValue(3); val s4 = byId.getValue(4)
        fun GlonassNavigationString.u(high: Int, length: Int) = unsigned(high, length).toInt()
        if (s4.u(10, 2) != 1) return invalid("unsupported GLONASS satellite message variant")
        if (s4.u(15, 5) != s1.slot) return invalid("GLONASS encoded slot differs from receiver identity")
        val day = s4.u(26, 11)
        val tb = s2.u(76, 7)
        val hours = s1.u(76, 5); val minutes = s1.u(71, 6)
        if (day !in 1..1461 || tb !in 1..95 || hours !in 0..23 || minutes !in 0..59)
            return invalid("invalid GLONASS date or time label")
        val axes = listOf(s1, s2, s3)
        fun vector(high: Int, bits: Int, scale: Double): GlonassCartesianVector {
            val v = axes.map { it.signMagnitude(high, bits) * scale }
            return GlonassCartesianVector(v[0], v[1], v[2])
        }
        val orbit = try {
            GlonassBroadcastStateVector(s1.slot, referenceFrame, vector(35, 27, 1000.0 / 2048),
                vector(64, 24, 1000.0 / 1_048_576), vector(40, 5, 1000.0 / 1_073_741_824))
        } catch (_: IllegalArgumentException) {
            return invalid("invalid GLONASS immediate orbital state")
        }
        return GlonassImmediateDecodeResult(GlonassImmediateFields(orbit,
            hours * 3600 + minutes * 60 + s1.u(65, 1) * 30, tb * 900, day,
            s4.signMagnitude(80, 22) / 1_073_741_824.0,
            s3.signMagnitude(79, 11) / 1_099_511_627_776.0,
            s4.signMagnitude(58, 5) / 1_073_741_824.0,
            s2.u(80, 3), s3.u(65, 1), s4.u(33, 4), s4.u(53, 5),
            s1.u(78, 2), s2.u(77, 1), s3.u(80, 1), s4.u(34, 1), s3.u(67, 2)))
    }
}
```

`core/src/main/kotlin/com/system/location/service/core/gnss/GlonassL1caAssembler.kt`:

```kt
package com.system.location.service.core.gnss

/** Joined orbital/clock fields and a resolved tb; not proof of signal/service usability. */
data class GlonassAssembledImmediate(
    val fields: GlonassImmediateFields,
    /** tb is labelled UTC(SU)+3h, per ICD §4.4. It is not the satellite's tk clock. */
    val referenceTime: GlonassTime,
    /** Nominal frame schedule on the satellite clock; NOT an exact physical emission epoch. */
    val frameScheduleCoordinate: GlonassCalendarCoordinate,
)

data class GlonassAssemblyResult(val decoded: GlonassAssembledImmediate?, val reason: String? = null)

/**
 * One bounded capture/clock domain. Each string needs independently established complete
 * SATELLITE SCHEDULE labels, not callback arrival times or physical system times substituted
 * for tk. The schedule has 30s frames/2s strings; satellite clock bias remains separate.
 * Unassociated timing, clock changes, newer incomplete frames and conflicts withdraw output.
 * completed() must be re-read after capture ends; previously returned objects are not final.
 */
class GlonassL1caAssembler(
    private val captureFrom: GlonassTime,
    private val captureUntil: GlonassTime,
    private val referenceFrame: GlonassReferenceFrame,
) {
    private data class Key(val slot: Int, val day: Long, val second: Int)
    private data class Candidate(val parts: MutableMap<Int, GlonassNavigationString> = linkedMapOf(), var conflict: Boolean = false)
    private val candidates = linkedMapOf<Key, Candidate>()
    private val latest = mutableMapOf<Int, Key>()
    private val quarantined = mutableSetOf<Int>()

    init { require(captureUntil.secondsSince(captureFrom)?.let { it in 0.0..120.0 } == true) }

    @Synchronized fun clear() { candidates.clear(); latest.clear(); quarantined.clear() }

    @Synchronized fun completed(): List<GlonassAssembledImmediate> = latest.toSortedMap().mapNotNull { (slot, key) ->
        if (slot in quarantined) null else candidates[key]?.takeIf { !it.conflict && it.parts.size == 4 }
            ?.let { assemble(key, it).decoded }
    }

    @Synchronized
    fun offer(o: GnssNavigationObservation, independentlyResolvedSchedule: GlonassTime?): GlonassAssemblyResult {
        fun invalid(reason: String) = GlonassAssemblyResult(null, reason)
        if (o.type != 0x0301 || o.svid !in 1..31 || o.submessageId !in 1..4)
            return invalid("requires GLONASS immediate string 1..4")
        val schedule = independentlyResolvedSchedule
        if (schedule == null || schedule.domain !== captureFrom.domain) {
            quarantined += o.svid
            return invalid("missing GLONASS schedule evidence or changed correction/receiver domain")
        }
        if (schedule.secondsSince(captureFrom)!! < 0 || captureUntil.secondsSince(schedule)!! < 0)
            return invalid("GLONASS schedule outside capture window")
        val frame = schedule.plusSeconds(-2.0 * (o.submessageId - 1))
        if (frame == null || frame.coordinate.secondsOfDay % 30.0 != 0.0) {
            quarantined += o.svid
            return invalid("GLONASS schedule is not a complete nominal string-start label")
        }
        val key = Key(o.svid, frame.coordinate.date.toEpochDay(), frame.coordinate.secondsOfDay.toInt())
        val previous = latest[o.svid]
        if (previous == null || key.day > previous.day || (key.day == previous.day && key.second > previous.second)) latest[o.svid] = key
        val candidate = candidates[key] ?: run {
            // Advance latest before rejecting capacity: replay must not restore older output.
            if (candidates.size >= 64) return invalid("GLONASS assembly capacity exceeded")
            Candidate().also { candidates[key] = it }
        }
        if (o.svid in quarantined || candidate.conflict) return invalid("GLONASS candidate quarantined or conflicting")
        val checked = GlonassNavigationStrings.decode(o)
        val string = checked.string
        if (string == null) {
            candidate.conflict = true; candidate.parts.clear()
            return invalid(checked.reason ?: "invalid GLONASS string")
        }
        val encodedTk = if (string.stringId == 1)
            string.unsigned(76, 5) * 3600 + string.unsigned(71, 6) * 60 + string.unsigned(65, 1) * 30 else null
        if (string.frameId != key.second / 30 % 5 + 1 || (encodedTk != null && encodedTk != key.second.toLong())) {
            candidate.conflict = true; candidate.parts.clear()
            return invalid("GLONASS string metadata/tk disagrees with independent schedule")
        }
        val old = candidate.parts[string.stringId]
        if (old != null && (old.frameId != string.frameId || (9..84).any { old.unsigned(it, 1) != string.unsigned(it, 1) })) {
            candidate.conflict = true; candidate.parts.clear()
            return invalid("conflicting duplicate GLONASS string")
        }
        if (old == null) candidate.parts[string.stringId] = string
        if (latest[o.svid] != key) return invalid("GLONASS transmission frame superseded")
        if (candidate.parts.size != 4) return invalid("waiting for GLONASS strings 1/2/3/4")
        return assemble(key, candidate)
    }

    private fun assemble(key: Key, candidate: Candidate): GlonassAssemblyResult {
        fun invalid(reason: String) = GlonassAssemblyResult(null, reason)
        val result = GlonassImmediateDecoder.decode(candidate.parts.values.toList(), referenceFrame)
        val fields = result.fields ?: return invalid(result.reason ?: "invalid GLONASS immediate fields")
        if (fields.frameTimeSecondsOfDay != key.second || candidate.parts.getValue(1).frameId != key.second / 30 % 5 + 1)
            return invalid("GLONASS tk/frame ID disagrees with independent schedule")
        val date = java.time.LocalDate.ofEpochDay(key.day)
        val nominal = GlonassCalendarCoordinate(date, key.second.toDouble())
        val epoch = GlonassReferenceEpoch.resolve(fields.dayInFourYearInterval, fields.referenceTimeSecondsOfDay, nominal, captureFrom.domain)
        val reference = epoch.time ?: return invalid(epoch.reason ?: "invalid GLONASS reference epoch")
        return GlonassAssemblyResult(GlonassAssembledImmediate(fields, reference, nominal))
    }
}
```

`core/src/main/kotlin/com/system/location/service/core/gnss/GlonassMTimeParameters.kt`:

```kt
package com.system.location.service.core.gnss

/**
 * GLONASS-M string 5 fields, not an accepted clock conversion or applicability interval.
 * tauC relates GLONASS time to UTC(SU); tauGps is ONLY the fractional GPS-minus-GLONASS
 * offset. The independent integer offset, UTC(SU)-UTC and leap/receiver domains are absent.
 * A zero coefficient is retained as a value, never evidence that an offset is available.
 */
data class GlonassMTimeParameters(
    val sourceSlot: Int,
    val frameId: Int,
    val capturedAtMillis: Long,
    val fourYearIntervalNumber: Int,
    val almanacDayNumber: Int,
    /** Beginning of NA, a calendar label, not a continuous physical transmission epoch. */
    val almanacDayStart: GlonassCalendarCoordinate,
    val tauCSeconds: Double,
    val tauGpsFractionalSeconds: Double,
    val healthLn: Int,
)

data class GlonassMTimeParametersResult(val parameters: GlonassMTimeParameters?, val reason: String? = null)

/** ICD 5.1 §4.5/Tables 4.9/4.11, GLONASS-M (M=01) only. No satellite variant guessing. */
object GlonassMTimeParametersDecoder {
    /**
     * satelliteTypeBits must come from independently associated, accepted format evidence
     * (the M field in string 4), not a historical slot list or an assumed current satellite type.
     * The string must already have passed GlonassNavigationStrings parity/metadata checks.
     */
    fun decode(string: GlonassNavigationString, satelliteTypeBits: Int): GlonassMTimeParametersResult {
        fun invalid(reason: String) = GlonassMTimeParametersResult(null, reason)
        if (satelliteTypeBits != 1) return invalid("requires independently established GLONASS-M message format")
        if (string.stringId != 5) return invalid("requires GLONASS-M time-parameter string 5")
        val n4 = string.unsigned(36, 5).toInt()
        val na = string.unsigned(80, 11).toInt()
        val day = GlonassCalendarCoordinate.fromBroadcastDate(n4, na, 0.0)
            ?: return invalid("invalid GLONASS-M N4/NA calendar date")
        return GlonassMTimeParametersResult(GlonassMTimeParameters(
            string.slot, string.frameId, string.capturedAtMillis, n4, na, day,
            string.signMagnitude(69, 32) * Math.scalb(1.0, -31),
            // §4.5 explicitly defines the fractional offset in seconds. Table 4.9's
            // printed 'day' unit does not change that definition or the 2^-30 scaling.
            string.signMagnitude(31, 22) * Math.scalb(1.0, -30),
            string.unsigned(9, 1).toInt(),
        ))
    }
}
```

`core/src/main/kotlin/com/system/location/service/core/gnss/GlonassNavigationStrings.kt`:

```kt
package com.system.location.service.core.gnss

import java.util.Base64

/** Immutable ICD-numbered information bits, after all eight Hamming checks have passed. */
class GlonassNavigationString internal constructor(
    val slot: Int,
    val capturedAtMillis: Long,
    val frameId: Int,
    val stringId: Int,
    payload: ByteArray,
) {
    private val bytes = payload.copyOf()

    /** ICD bits descend from highBit; parity bits 1..8 and idle bit 85 are excluded. */
    fun unsigned(highBit: Int, length: Int): Long {
        require(highBit in 9..84 && length in 1..32 && highBit - length + 1 >= 9)
        return (0 until length).fold(0L) { value, offset ->
            val index = 88 - highBit + offset
            (value shl 1) or ((bytes[index / 8].toInt() ushr (7 - index % 8)) and 1).toLong()
        }
    }

    /** GLONASS uses sign-magnitude, including a negative-zero representation, not two's complement. */
    fun signMagnitude(highBit: Int, length: Int): Long {
        require(length >= 2)
        val value = unsigned(highBit, length)
        val magnitude = value and ((1L shl (length - 1)) - 1)
        return if (value and (1L shl (length - 1)) != 0L) -magnitude else magnitude
    }
}

data class GlonassStringResult(val string: GlonassNavigationString?, val reason: String? = null)

/**
 * ICD 5.1 §4.7/Table 4.13. Android GLO L1 C/A uses an 11-byte big-endian 85-bit integer,
 * skipping high bits B86..B88. This differs from RTKLIB's left-aligned 85-bit buffer.
 * All syndromes must be zero, even for HAL PARITY_PASSED/REBUILT. No error correction or
 * ambiguous automatic bit alignment is performed; a parity error is rejected conservatively.
 */
object GlonassNavigationStrings {
    fun decode(o: GnssNavigationObservation): GlonassStringResult {
        fun invalid(reason: String) = GlonassStringResult(null, reason)
        if (o.type != 0x0301 || o.svid !in 1..31 || o.status !in 0..2)
            return invalid("requires GLONASS L1 C/A with a known slot and valid parity status")
        if (o.messageId !in 1..5 || o.submessageId !in 1..15)
            return invalid("invalid GLONASS frame or string metadata")
        val input = Base64.getDecoder().decode(o.dataBase64)
        if (input.size != 11 || input[0].toInt() and 0xe0 != 0)
            return invalid("invalid GLONASS Android payload length or leading padding")
        fun bit(icd: Int): Int {
            val index = 88 - icd
            return (input[index / 8].toInt() ushr (7 - index % 8)) and 1
        }
        if (bit(85) != 0) return invalid("invalid GLONASS idle chip")
        for (check in 0..6) {
            val parity = CHECK_BITS[check].fold(bit(check + 1)) { value, position -> value xor bit(position) }
            if (parity != 0) return invalid("GLONASS Hamming syndrome failure")
        }
        if ((1..85).fold(0) { value, position -> value xor bit(position) } != 0)
            return invalid("GLONASS overall parity failure")
        val id = (84 downTo 81).fold(0) { value, position -> (value shl 1) or bit(position) }
        if (id != o.submessageId) return invalid("GLONASS string identity mismatch")
        return GlonassStringResult(GlonassNavigationString(o.svid, o.capturedAtMillis, o.messageId, id, input))
    }

    // Explicit ICD bit sets, independent of the byte masks used by the C verification oracle.
    private val CHECK_BITS = listOf(
        listOf(9,10,12,13,15,17,19,20,22,24,26,28,30,32,34,35,37,39,41,43,45,47,49,51,53,55,57,59,61,63,65,66,68,70,72,74,76,78,80,82,84),
        listOf(9,11,12,14,15,18,19,21,22,25,26,29,30,33,34,36,37,40,41,44,45,48,49,52,53,56,57,60,61,64,65,67,68,71,72,75,76,79,80,83,84),
        listOf(10..12,16..19,23..26,31..34,38..41,46..49,54..57,62..65,69..72,77..80,85..85).flatMap { it },
        listOf(13..19,27..34,42..49,58..65,73..80).flatMap { it },
        listOf(20..34,50..65,81..85).flatMap { it },
        (35..65).toList(),
        (66..85).toList(),
    )
}
```

`core/src/main/kotlin/com/system/location/service/core/gnss/GlonassOrbitalEphemeris.kt`:

```kt
package com.system.location.service.core.gnss

import kotlin.math.abs

/**
 * Orbital state plus independently established absolute applicability in one continuous domain.
 * A decoded En/P1 or the mathematical 15-minute limit is not evidence for this interval.
 * No satellite clock, tauC, health, signal or datum-transformation usability is implied.
 */
data class GlonassOrbitalEphemeris(
    val orbit: GlonassBroadcastStateVector,
    val referenceTime: GlonassTime,
    val validFrom: GlonassTime,
    val validUntil: GlonassTime,
) {
    init {
        val start = validFrom.secondsSince(referenceTime)
        val end = validUntil.secondsSince(referenceTime)
        require(start != null && end != null && start <= 0 && end >= 0 && end > start)
        require(abs(start) < 900 && abs(end) < 900)
    }
}

/** Absolute-time entry point: refuse mismatched corrections, expired days and stale weeks. */
object GlonassAbsolutePropagator {
    fun propagate(e: GlonassOrbitalEphemeris, transmissionTime: GlonassTime): GlonassPropagationResult {
        val seconds = transmissionTime.secondsSince(e.referenceTime)
            ?: return GlonassPropagationResult(null, "different GLONASS correction/receiver time domain")
        if (transmissionTime.secondsSince(e.validFrom)!! < 0 || e.validUntil.secondsSince(transmissionTime)!! < 0)
            return GlonassPropagationResult(null, "outside absolute GLONASS orbital applicability interval")
        return GlonassBroadcastPropagator.propagate(e.orbit, seconds)
    }
}
```

`core/src/main/kotlin/com/system/location/service/core/gnss/GlonassReceptionGeometry.kt`:

```kt
package com.system.location.service.core.gnss

import kotlin.math.*

/** Explicit position/local ellipsoid-normal orientation in the same PZ-90 realization as the orbit. */
data class GlonassReceiver(val referenceFrame: GlonassReferenceFrame,
    val position: EcefPosition, val orientation: GeodeticOrientation)

data class GlonassReceptionObservation(
    val transmissionTime: GlonassTime,
    val propagationSeconds: Double,
    val satelliteInReceptionEcef: EcefPosition,
    val lineOfSight: GnssLineOfSight,
)

data class GlonassReceptionResult(val observation: GlonassReceptionObservation?, val reason: String? = null)

/**
 * Vacuum geometric light-time on one independently established continuous correction scale.
 * Epochs are UTC(SU)+3h coordinates on that scale, not receiver/satellite clock readings.
 * Rz(-Omega*flightTime) rotates the emission ECEF position into reception axes exactly once.
 * No tauC, satellite clock, atmospheric delay, signal usability or pseudorange is inferred.
 */
object GlonassReceptionGeometry {
    const val SPEED_OF_LIGHT_METERS_PER_SECOND = 299792458.0

    fun observe(e: GlonassOrbitalEphemeris, receptionTime: GlonassTime,
        receiver: GlonassReceiver): GlonassReceptionResult {
        fun invalid(reason: String) = GlonassReceptionResult(null, reason)
        if (receiver.referenceFrame != e.orbit.referenceFrame) return invalid("GLONASS receiver/orbit reference frames differ")
        val sinceFrom = receptionTime.secondsSince(e.validFrom)
            ?: return invalid("different GLONASS reception correction/receiver time domain")
        val sinceUntil = receptionTime.secondsSince(e.validUntil)!!
        // Use the whole independently established applicability interval as the bracket.
        // There is no invented orbital-radius or nominal signal-flight-time ceiling.
        var lower = max(0.0, sinceUntil)
        var upper = sinceFrom
        if (lower > upper) return invalid("no GLONASS emission inside orbital applicability interval")
        fun evaluate(delay: Double): GlonassReceptionObservation? {
            // Preserve exact validity endpoints rather than introduce subtract/add rounding outside them.
            val transmission = when (delay) {
                sinceFrom -> e.validFrom
                sinceUntil -> e.validUntil
                else -> receptionTime.plusSeconds(-delay) ?: return null
            }
            val state = GlonassAbsolutePropagator.propagate(e, transmission).state ?: return null
            val p = state.positionMeters
            val angle = GlonassBroadcastPropagator.EARTH_ROTATION_RAD_PER_SECOND * delay
            val rotated = EcefPosition(cos(angle) * p.x + sin(angle) * p.y,
                -sin(angle) * p.x + cos(angle) * p.y, p.z)
            val los = GnssObserverGeometry.lineOfSight(receiver.position, receiver.orientation, rotated) ?: return null
            return GlonassReceptionObservation(transmission, delay, rotated, los)
        }
        fun residual(o: GlonassReceptionObservation) = o.lineOfSight.rangeMeters / SPEED_OF_LIGHT_METERS_PER_SECOND - o.propagationSeconds
        val atLower = evaluate(lower) ?: return invalid("unavailable GLONASS state at reception bracket")
        val atUpper = evaluate(upper) ?: return invalid("unavailable GLONASS state at reception bracket")
        if (residual(atLower) < -1e-13 || residual(atUpper) > 1e-13)
            return invalid("GLONASS light-time solution outside orbital applicability interval")
        if (abs(residual(atLower)) <= 1e-13) return GlonassReceptionResult(atLower)
        if (abs(residual(atUpper)) <= 1e-13) return GlonassReceptionResult(atUpper)
        repeat(60) {
            val o = evaluate(lower + (upper - lower) / 2) ?: return invalid("GLONASS light-time evaluation failed")
            val error = residual(o)
            if (abs(error) <= 1e-13) return GlonassReceptionResult(o)
            if (error > 0) lower = o.propagationSeconds else upper = o.propagationSeconds
        }
        return invalid("GLONASS light-time equation did not converge")
    }
}
```

`core/src/main/kotlin/com/system/location/service/core/gnss/GlonassReferenceEpoch.kt`:

```kt
package com.system.location.service.core.gnss

import kotlin.math.abs

data class GlonassReferenceEpochResult(val time: GlonassTime?, val reason: String? = null)

/** Resolve the UTC(SU)+3h tb label using a complete, independently established frame schedule date. */
object GlonassReferenceEpoch {
    fun resolve(dayInFourYearInterval: Int, tbSecondsOfDay: Int, frameSchedule: GlonassCalendarCoordinate,
        domain: GlonassTimeDomain): GlonassReferenceEpochResult {
        fun invalid(reason: String) = GlonassReferenceEpochResult(null, reason)
        if (tbSecondsOfDay !in 900..85500 || tbSecondsOfDay % 900 != 0)
            return invalid("invalid GLONASS tb label")
        if (domain.at(frameSchedule) == null) return invalid("GLONASS schedule outside clock coverage")
        val date = frameSchedule.date
        val n4 = Math.floorDiv(date.year - 1996, 4) + 1
        val broadcast = GlonassCalendarCoordinate.fromBroadcastDate(n4, dayInFourYearInterval, frameSchedule.secondsOfDay)
        if (broadcast?.date != date) return invalid("GLONASS NT disagrees with complete schedule date")
        // tb may refer to an adjacent day. A full date stays attached; a stale day cannot wrap.
        val options = (-1L..1L).map { GlonassCalendarCoordinate(date.plusDays(it), tbSecondsOfDay.toDouble()) }
            .sortedBy { abs(it.secondsSince(frameSchedule)) }
        if (abs(options[0].secondsSince(frameSchedule)) == abs(options[1].secondsSince(frameSchedule)))
            return invalid("ambiguous GLONASS reference day")
        val reference = domain.at(options[0]) ?: return invalid("GLONASS tb outside independently established clock coverage")
        return GlonassReferenceEpochResult(reference)
    }
}
```

`core/src/main/kotlin/com/system/location/service/core/gnss/GlonassSkyFrameApproximation.kt`:

```kt
package com.system.location.service.core.gnss

/**
 * EPSG:7960 PZ-90.11 -> ITRF2008, EPSG:1066 coordinate-frame convention, reference epoch
 * 2010.0. Rotations are milliarcseconds, translations metres, scale zero. This is the stated
 * linearized EPSG operation, not the position-vector convention with the opposite signs.
 * https://epsg.io/7960
 *
 * A sky adapter may then explicitly approximate ITRF2008 as WGS84-compatible axes. These
 * fixed reference-epoch parameters do NOT establish an exact contemporary WGS84 realization,
 * epoch propagation, centimetre accuracy, or a precise positioning solution.
 */
object GlonassSkyFrameApproximation {
    fun pz9011ToItrf2008(position: GlonassCartesianVector): EcefPosition {
        val masToRadians = Math.PI / (180 * 3600 * 1000)
        val rx = 0.019 * masToRadians
        val ry = -0.042 * masToRadians
        val rz = 0.002 * masToRadians
        return EcefPosition(
            -0.003 + position.x + rz * position.y - ry * position.z,
            -0.001 - rz * position.x + position.y + rx * position.z,
            ry * position.x - rx * position.y + position.z,
        )
    }
}
```

`core/src/main/kotlin/com/system/location/service/core/gnss/GlonassTime.kt`:

```kt
package com.system.location.service.core.gnss

import java.time.DateTimeException
import java.time.LocalDate
import kotlin.math.floor

/**
 * A calendar coordinate on ONE continuous GLONASS correction scale, with uniform 86400s days.
 * This is not a civil UTC leap-second representation. ICD Appendix 2 requires pre-correction
 * ephemerides to retain the old continuous scale until superseded; corrected labels form a
 * different domain. Neither UTC(SU)/UTC/GPS offsets nor leap transitions are inferred here.
 */
data class GlonassCalendarCoordinate(val date: LocalDate, val secondsOfDay: Double) {
    init { require(secondsOfDay.isFinite() && secondsOfDay >= 0 && secondsOfDay < 86400) }
    internal fun secondsSince(other: GlonassCalendarCoordinate) =
        (date.toEpochDay() - other.date.toEpochDay()) * 86400.0 + secondsOfDay - other.secondsOfDay

    companion object {
        /** Complete broadcast N4/NT, not a nearest-century guess or a repeated 1461-day modulo. */
        fun fromBroadcastDate(n4: Int, nt: Int, secondsOfDay: Double): GlonassCalendarCoordinate? {
            if (n4 !in 1..31 || nt !in 1..1461 || !secondsOfDay.isFinite() || secondsOfDay < 0 || secondsOfDay >= 86400)
                return null
            val start = LocalDate.of(1996 + 4 * (n4 - 1), 1, 1)
            val date = start.plusDays((nt - 1).toLong())
            if (!date.isBefore(start.plusYears(4))) return null
            return GlonassCalendarCoordinate(date, secondsOfDay)
        }
    }
}

/**
 * Independently established continuous clock coverage [from, until). The caller must provide
 * actual correction/clock evidence for this entire interval; a diagnostic ID is not proof.
 * Create distinct instances for pre/post UTC corrections and receiver discontinuities.
 * This object makes no claim that a particular navigation callback has an emission timestamp.
 */
class GlonassTimeDomain(val evidenceId: String, val from: GlonassCalendarCoordinate, val until: GlonassCalendarCoordinate) {
    init { require(evidenceId.isNotBlank() && evidenceId.length <= 256 && until.secondsSince(from) > 0) }

    fun at(coordinate: GlonassCalendarCoordinate): GlonassTime? =
        atParts(coordinate.date, floor(coordinate.secondsOfDay).toInt(), coordinate.secondsOfDay % 1.0)

    internal fun atParts(date: LocalDate, second: Int, fraction: Double): GlonassTime? {
        val candidate = GlonassTime(this, date, second, fraction)
        return candidate.takeIf { it.secondsSinceCoordinate(from) >= 0 && it.secondsSinceCoordinate(until) < 0 }
    }
}

/** Full date and fractional seconds, tied to an explicit continuous correction/receiver domain. */
class GlonassTime internal constructor(val domain: GlonassTimeDomain, private val date: LocalDate,
    private val secondOfDay: Int, private val fraction: Double) {
    init { require(secondOfDay in 0..86399 && fraction.isFinite() && fraction >= 0 && fraction < 1) }
    /** Calendar label for display/schedule use; near-day-sized Doubles round fractional precision. */
    val coordinate: GlonassCalendarCoordinate get() {
        // Avoid exposing an invalid 86400 label if the display Double rounds just below midnight up.
        val displaySeconds = minOf(secondOfDay + fraction, Math.nextDown(86400.0))
        return GlonassCalendarCoordinate(date, displaySeconds)
    }

    fun secondsSince(other: GlonassTime): Double? = if (domain !== other.domain) null else
        (date.toEpochDay() - other.date.toEpochDay()) * 86400.0 + (secondOfDay - other.secondOfDay) + (fraction - other.fraction)

    internal fun secondsSinceCoordinate(other: GlonassCalendarCoordinate): Double =
        (date.toEpochDay() - other.date.toEpochDay()) * 86400.0 +
            (secondOfDay - floor(other.secondsOfDay).toInt()) + (fraction - other.secondsOfDay % 1.0)

    fun plusSeconds(seconds: Double): GlonassTime? {
        if (!seconds.isFinite()) return null
        val integer = floor(seconds)
        if (integer < Long.MIN_VALUE.toDouble() || integer >= Long.MAX_VALUE.toDouble()) return null
        val combinedFraction = fraction + (seconds - integer)
        val carry = floor(combinedFraction).toLong()
        val whole = try { Math.addExact(Math.addExact(integer.toLong(), secondOfDay.toLong()), carry) }
        catch (_: ArithmeticException) { return null }
        val days = Math.floorDiv(whole, 86400)
        val nextDate = try { date.plusDays(days) } catch (_: DateTimeException) { return null }
        catch (_: ArithmeticException) { return null }
        return domain.atParts(nextDate, Math.floorMod(whole, 86400), combinedFraction - carry)
    }
}
```

`core/src/main/kotlin/com/system/location/service/core/gnss/GnssAutonomousSignalCalibration.kt`:

```kt
package com.system.location.service.core.gnss

/**
 * Optional transfer of a captured signal environment, never of its satellite geometry or usage.
 * Conditional CN0 means include the source receiver, obstructions and propagation. They cannot
 * identify a hardware gain or prove the target site's reception. In the hypothetical receiver
 * they replace the nominal elevation-dependent signal baseline; target range, selected scenario
 * attenuation and deterministic fading are then applied independently. No extrapolation or
 * forced monotonic fit is performed. A signal outside the captured band/elevation uses the model.
 */
class GnssAutonomousSignalCalibration(private val capture: GnssCapture) {
    private val gps = GpsEmpiricalSignalModel(capture)
    private val broadcast = capture.broadcastSignalCalibration ?: BroadcastSignalCalibration.fit(capture)

    fun isCurrent(validationAtMillis: Long): Boolean = validationAtMillis >= capture.endedAtMillis &&
        validationAtMillis - capture.endedAtMillis <= GnssCaptureValidator.MAX_AGE_MILLIS

    fun cn0At(orbit: GnssOrbitPosition, elevation: Double): Double? {
        val carrier = orbit.carrierHz ?: when (orbit.constellation) {
            Constellation.GPS, Constellation.GALILEO -> 1_575_420_000f
            Constellation.BEIDOU -> 1_561_098_000f
            else -> return null
        }
        return when (orbit.constellation) {
            Constellation.GPS -> gps.at(elevation)?.takeIf {
                it.carrierHz != null && kotlin.math.abs(it.carrierHz - carrier) <= 100_000f
            }?.cn0DbHz
            Constellation.GALILEO, Constellation.BEIDOU -> broadcast.curves.firstOrNull { curve ->
                curve.constellation == orbit.constellation && curve.nominalCarrierHz?.let {
                    kotlin.math.abs(it - carrier.toDouble()) <= 100_000.0
                } == true
            }?.at(elevation)?.cn0
            // A capture's slot-to-FCN assignment cannot establish the target epoch's channel.
            Constellation.GLONASS -> broadcast.at(orbit.constellation, elevation, svid = orbit.svid)?.takeIf {
                it.carrier != null && kotlin.math.abs(it.carrier - carrier) <= 100_000f
            }?.cn0
            else -> null
        }
    }
}
```

`core/src/main/kotlin/com/system/location/service/core/gnss/GnssBundledOrbitResources.kt`:

```kt
package com.system.location.service.core.gnss

/** Resource loading is separate from frame caches; immutable orbit adapters can be shared. */
object GnssBundledOrbitResources {
    /**
     * Injection hosts (LSPosed system_server) can load the module dex without exposing the
     * module APK's Java resources on the class loader. The xposed side installs a reader that
     * opens the bundled GNSS files from the module APK so the same resources remain available.
     */
    @Volatile private var externalReader: ((String) -> String?)? = null

    fun installExternalReader(reader: ((String) -> String?)?) {
        externalReader = reader
    }

    private fun read(name: String): String {
        javaClass.getResourceAsStream("/gnss/$name")?.bufferedReader(Charsets.UTF_8)?.use {
            return it.readText()
        }
        readFromCodeSource(name)?.let { return it }
        externalReader?.invoke(name)?.let { return it }
        BundledGnssFallback.read(name)?.let { return it }
        error("Missing bundled GNSS resource: $name")
    }

    /** Injected classes often have no resource path; their code source still points at the APK. */
    private fun readFromCodeSource(name: String): String? = runCatching {
        val location = javaClass.protectionDomain?.codeSource?.location ?: return@runCatching null
        val file = java.io.File(location.toURI())
        if (file.isDirectory) {
            return@runCatching java.io.File(file, "gnss/$name").takeIf { it.isFile }
                ?.readText(Charsets.UTF_8)
        }
        if (!file.isFile) return@runCatching null
        java.util.zip.ZipFile(file).use { zip ->
            val entry = zip.getEntry("gnss/$name") ?: zip.getEntry("assets/gnss/$name")
                ?: return@runCatching null
            zip.getInputStream(entry).bufferedReader(Charsets.UTF_8).use { it.readText() }
        }
    }.getOrNull()

    private val virtual by lazy { VirtualWalkerResource.decode(read("virtual-walker.json")) }
    private val utc by lazy { runCatching { GnssUtcTimeScale.parseIers(read("leap-seconds.list")) } }
    private val gps by lazy { runCatching { GpsAlmanacResource.decode(read("gps-yuma.json")) } }
    private val beiDouCatalog by lazy { runCatching {
        BeiDouCatalogResource(BeiDouCatalogManifest.decode(read("igs-beidou-metadata-source.json")),
            read("igs-beidou-metadata.snx")).validate()
    } }

    /** Shared UTC/GPS conversion for synthetic raw observations; null when the bundle is invalid. */
    fun utcTimeScale(): GnssUtcTimeScale? = utc.getOrNull()

    /** Bundled GPS almanac records used as the production fallback for LNAV-shaped ephemerides. */
    fun gpsAlmanac(): List<GpsYumaAlmanac>? = gps.getOrNull()?.let { resource ->
        runCatching { GpsYumaParser.parse(resource.yuma, resource.resolvedReferenceWeek).toList() }.getOrNull()
    }

    /**
     * No network or local receiver access. The caller supplies its tested output envelope and
     * GPS-specific approximate-geometry age budget, rather than inheriting capture expiry.
     * Corrupt optional downloaded/bundled GPS data cannot disable the independent virtual model.
     */
    fun model(policy: GnssSimulationPolicy, outputLimits: GnssOutputLimits,
        gpsAlmanacAgeBudgetSeconds: Double, downloadedGps: GpsAlmanacResource? = null,
        navigation: RinexNavigationResource? = null,
        signalCalibration: GnssAutonomousSignalCalibration? = null): ReceiverAutonomousSkyModel {
        require(gpsAlmanacAgeBudgetSeconds.isFinite() && gpsAlmanacAgeBudgetSeconds >= 0)
        val providers = mutableListOf<GnssOrbitProvider>()
        val diagnostics = mutableListOf<String>()
        val timeScale = utc.getOrNull()
        if (timeScale == null) diagnostics += "离线 UTC 资源不可用，真实轨道来源已降级"
        if (timeScale != null && navigation != null) {
            runCatching { navigation.gpsProvider(timeScale) }
                .onSuccess { providers += it }
                .onFailure { diagnostics += "RINEX GPS 广播来源不可用，保留历书与虚拟兜底" }
            // Sky-only approximation, explicitly separate from capture's 24-hour eligibility.
            // This limits header extrapolation; it is not a claimed broadcast GGTO expiry.
            runCatching { navigation.galileoProvider(timeScale, RinexGalileoSkyPolicy(86400.0, true)) }
                .onSuccess { providers += it }
                .onFailure { diagnostics += "RINEX Galileo 广播来源不可用：${it.message}；保留其他来源与虚拟兜底" }
            // EPSG:7679 identifies PZ-90.11 as replacing PZ-90.02 from 2014-01-15.
            // Earlier/ambiguous-era archives are not silently treated as modern GLONASS.
            runCatching { navigation.glonassProvider(timeScale, RinexGlonassSkyPolicy(
                java.time.Instant.parse("2014-01-15T00:00:00Z").toEpochMilli(), true)) }
                .onSuccess { providers += it }
                .onFailure { diagnostics += "RINEX GLONASS 广播来源不可用：${it.message}；保留其他来源与虚拟兜底" }
            // These are separate sky-approximation budgets: one hour from toe, one week from
            // the BDUT header reference, and a dated catalog with a 30-day freshness policy.
            // None is an inferred broadcast fit duration or the capture expiry setting.
            runCatching {
                // Prefer accepted upstream corrections when creation labels tie with the bundle.
                val catalog = listOfNotNull(navigation.beiDouCatalog?.validate(), beiDouCatalog.getOrNull())
                    .maxByOrNull { it.creationLabel } ?: error("No valid BeiDou identity catalog")
                navigation.beiDouProvider(timeScale, catalog.catalog(timeScale, 30 * 86400L),
                    RinexBeiDouSkyPolicy(3600.0, 7 * 86400.0, true))
            }
                .onSuccess { providers += it }
                .onFailure { diagnostics += "RINEX 北斗广播来源不可用：${it.message}；保留其他来源与虚拟兜底" }
        }
        val candidates = listOfNotNull(downloadedGps, gps.getOrNull())
            .sortedByDescending { it.referenceEpochMillis }
        if (gps.isFailure) diagnostics += "内置 GPS 历书资源损坏，保留其他来源"
        if (timeScale != null) for (resource in candidates) {
            runCatching { resource.provider(timeScale, gpsAlmanacAgeBudgetSeconds) }
                .onSuccess { providers += it }
                .onFailure { diagnostics += "GPS 历书 ${resource.sha256.take(12)} 校验失败，保留其他来源" }
        }
        if (diagnostics.isNotEmpty()) providers += object : GnssOrbitProvider {
            override val kind = GnssOrbitSourceKind.OFFLINE_ORBIT
            override fun positions(request: GnssSkyRequest) = GnssOrbitBatch(emptyList(), diagnostics.toList())
        }
        // This enumerates protocol identity space, not the population of real orbiting satellites.
        val identities = Constellation.entries.flatMap { constellation -> (1..999).mapNotNull { svid ->
            GnssSatelliteIds.nmeaId(constellation, svid)?.let { constellation to svid }
        } }
        return ReceiverAutonomousSkyModel(providers, VirtualWalkerOrbitProvider(virtual, policy.virtualSeed), policy,
            quantitySupplement = GnssVirtualSkySupplement(identities, outputLimits, policy.virtualSeed),
            signalCalibration = signalCalibration)
    }
}
```

`core/src/main/kotlin/com/system/location/service/core/gnss/GnssCapture.kt`:

```kt
package com.system.location.service.core.gnss

import java.util.Base64
import kotlinx.serialization.Serializable

/** Receiver evidence is retained separately from statistics so correlations can be replayed. */
@Serializable
data class GnssCapture(
    val schemaVersion: Int = 1,
    val deviceModel: String,
    val osVersion: String,
    val startedAtMillis: Long,
    val endedAtMillis: Long,
    val frames: List<GnssObservationFrame>,
    val measurements: List<GnssMeasurementBatch> = emptyList(),
    val navigation: List<GnssNavigationObservation> = emptyList(),
    val notes: List<String> = emptyList(),
    /** Android BOOT_COUNT; missing in legacy captures. Elapsed-time evidence cannot cross boots. */
    val bootCount: Int? = null,
    /** Decoded compact evidence; populated at the authenticated transport boundary. */
    val gpsBroadcastEvidence: GpsBroadcastEvidence? = null,
    /** Per-signal GPS L1/unknown-carrier calibration retained when raw status signals leave IPC. */
    val gpsSignalCalibration: GpsSignalCalibration? = null,
    /** Optional Galileo evidence; requires independently decoded GGTO and GST validity. */
    val galileoBroadcastEvidence: GalileoBroadcastEvidence? = null,
    /** Optional BeiDou evidence; BDT is carried directly and is never inferred from GPS. */
    val beiDouBroadcastEvidence: BeiDouBroadcastEvidence? = null,
    /** Optional GLONASS evidence; UTC(SU)+3h, PZ-90 and receiver datum are explicit. */
    val glonassBroadcastEvidence: GlonassBroadcastEvidence? = null,
    /** Per-band conditional signal fits survive removal of raw multi-frequency status in IPC. */
    val broadcastSignalCalibration: BroadcastSignalCalibration? = null,
) {
    init {
        require(schemaVersion == 1) { "unsupported GNSS capture version" }
        require(bootCount == null || bootCount >= 0) { "invalid capture boot count" }
        gpsBroadcastEvidence?.let { evidence ->
            require(evidence.clock.bootCount == bootCount) { "GPS evidence belongs to another boot" }
            val observedGps = GpsBroadcastEvidence.visibleGpsIdentities(frames)
            require(evidence.ephemerides.all { it.ephemeris.svid in observedGps }) {
                "GPS evidence contains a satellite without valid visible status"
            }
        }
        galileoBroadcastEvidence?.let { evidence ->
            require(evidence.clock.bootCount == bootCount) { "Galileo evidence belongs to another boot" }
            val observedGalileo = frames.flatMap { it.satellites }.filter {
                it.constellation == Constellation.GALILEO && it.elevationDeg >= 0f &&
                    it.azimuthDeg in 0f..<360f && it.cn0DbHz > 0f
            }.map { it.svid }.toSet()
            require(evidence.identities.all { it in observedGalileo }) {
                "Galileo evidence contains a satellite without valid visible status"
            }
        }
        beiDouBroadcastEvidence?.let { evidence ->
            require(evidence.clock.bootCount == bootCount) { "BeiDou evidence belongs to another boot" }
            val observed = frames.flatMap { it.satellites }.filter {
                it.constellation == Constellation.BEIDOU && it.elevationDeg >= 0f &&
                    it.azimuthDeg in 0f..<360f && it.cn0DbHz > 0f
            }.map { it.svid }.toSet()
            require(evidence.identities.all { it in observed }) {
                "BeiDou evidence contains a satellite without valid visible status"
            }
        }
        glonassBroadcastEvidence?.let { evidence ->
            require(evidence.clock.bootCount == bootCount) { "GLONASS evidence belongs to another boot" }
            val observed = frames.flatMap { it.satellites }.filter {
                it.constellation == Constellation.GLONASS && it.elevationDeg >= 0f &&
                    it.azimuthDeg in 0f..<360f && it.cn0DbHz > 0f
            }.map { it.svid }.toSet()
            require(evidence.identities.all { it in observed }) {
                "GLONASS evidence contains a satellite without valid visible status"
            }
        }
        require(deviceModel.isNotBlank() && osVersion.isNotBlank()) { "missing device metadata" }
        require(startedAtMillis >= 0 && endedAtMillis >= startedAtMillis) { "invalid capture interval" }
        require(frames.isNotEmpty() && frames.size <= MAX_FRAMES) { "invalid frame count" }
        require(frames.all { it.capturedAtMillis in startedAtMillis..endedAtMillis }) {
            "observation outside capture interval"
        }
        require(frames.zipWithNext().all { (a, b) -> a.capturedAtMillis <= b.capturedAtMillis }) {
            "frames must be chronological"
        }
        require(measurements.size <= MAX_FRAMES && navigation.size <= MAX_NAVIGATION_MESSAGES) {
            "capture exceeds raw data limit"
        }
    }

    fun profile(): GnssObservationProfile = GnssObservationProfileBuilder.build(frames, deviceModel, osVersion)

    companion object {
        const val MAX_FRAMES = 600
        const val MAX_NAVIGATION_MESSAGES = 4096
    }
}

@Serializable
data class GnssMeasurementBatch(
    val capturedAtMillis: Long,
    val timeNanos: Long,
    val fullBiasNanos: Long?,
    val biasNanos: Double?,
    val hardwareClockDiscontinuityCount: Int,
    val measurements: List<GnssMeasurementObservation>,
    val timeUncertaintyNanos: Double? = null,
    val biasUncertaintyNanos: Double? = null,
    val driftNanosPerSecond: Double? = null,
    val driftUncertaintyNanosPerSecond: Double? = null,
    val leapSecond: Int? = null,
    /** Receiver event's epoch on Android's elapsed realtime clock, API 29+. */
    val elapsedRealtimeNanos: Long? = null,
    val elapsedRealtimeUncertaintyNanos: Double? = null,
    /** Callback arrival time, distinct from the receiver event epoch. */
    val capturedElapsedRealtimeNanos: Long? = null,
    /** Raw Android reference identifiers for inter-signal biases; absent is not GPS/L1/C/A. */
    val referenceConstellationTypeForIsb: Int? = null,
    val referenceCarrierHzForIsb: Double? = null,
    val referenceCodeTypeForIsb: String? = null,
) {
    init {
        require(capturedAtMillis >= 0 && measurements.size <= 512) { "invalid measurement batch" }
        require(biasNanos == null || biasNanos.isFinite()) { "invalid clock bias" }
        require(listOf(timeUncertaintyNanos, biasUncertaintyNanos, driftUncertaintyNanosPerSecond,
            elapsedRealtimeUncertaintyNanos).all { it == null || it.isFinite() && it >= 0 }) {
            "invalid clock uncertainty"
        }
        require(driftNanosPerSecond == null || driftNanosPerSecond.isFinite()) { "invalid clock drift" }
        require(elapsedRealtimeNanos == null || elapsedRealtimeNanos >= 0)
        require(capturedElapsedRealtimeNanos == null || capturedElapsedRealtimeNanos >= 0)
        require(referenceConstellationTypeForIsb == null || referenceConstellationTypeForIsb >= 0)
        require(referenceCarrierHzForIsb == null || referenceCarrierHzForIsb.isFinite() && referenceCarrierHzForIsb > 0)
    }
}

@Serializable
data class GnssMeasurementObservation(
    val constellation: Constellation,
    val svid: Int,
    val state: Int,
    val timeOffsetNanos: Double,
    val receivedSvTimeNanos: Long,
    val receivedSvTimeUncertaintyNanos: Long,
    val cn0DbHz: Double,
    val pseudorangeRateMetersPerSecond: Double,
    val pseudorangeRateUncertaintyMetersPerSecond: Double,
    val accumulatedDeltaRangeState: Int,
    val accumulatedDeltaRangeMeters: Double,
    val accumulatedDeltaRangeUncertaintyMeters: Double,
    val carrierHz: Double? = null,
    val codeType: String? = null,
    /**
     * Android full ISB includes receiver and space-segment components, including time-system,
     * frequency/code and group delays not already compensated in receivedSvTimeNanos.
     * It is not an isolated GGTO. Satellite ISB is part of full ISB, not an additive correction.
     * Raw values/independent availability flags are preserved; no corrections are applied here.
     */
    val fullInterSignalBiasNanos: Double? = null,
    val fullInterSignalBiasUncertaintyNanos: Double? = null,
    val satelliteInterSignalBiasNanos: Double? = null,
    val satelliteInterSignalBiasUncertaintyNanos: Double? = null,
) {
    init {
        require(svid in 1..999) { "invalid measurement SVID" }
        require(listOf(timeOffsetNanos, cn0DbHz, pseudorangeRateMetersPerSecond,
            pseudorangeRateUncertaintyMetersPerSecond, accumulatedDeltaRangeMeters,
            accumulatedDeltaRangeUncertaintyMeters).all { it.isFinite() }) { "non-finite measurement" }
        require(carrierHz == null || carrierHz.isFinite() && carrierHz > 0) { "invalid carrier" }
        require(listOf(fullInterSignalBiasNanos, satelliteInterSignalBiasNanos).all { it == null || it.isFinite() })
        require(listOf(fullInterSignalBiasUncertaintyNanos, satelliteInterSignalBiasUncertaintyNanos)
            .all { it == null || it.isFinite() && it >= 0 }) { "invalid inter-signal bias uncertainty" }
    }
}

@Serializable
data class GnssNavigationObservation(
    val capturedAtMillis: Long,
    val type: Int,
    val svid: Int,
    val status: Int,
    val messageId: Int,
    val submessageId: Int,
    val dataBase64: String,
    val capturedElapsedRealtimeNanos: Long? = null,
) {
    init {
        require(capturedAtMillis >= 0 && svid in 1..999) { "invalid navigation metadata" }
        require(dataBase64.length <= 8192) { "navigation payload too large" }
        require(Base64.getDecoder().decode(dataBase64).isNotEmpty()) { "empty navigation payload" }
        require(capturedElapsedRealtimeNanos == null || capturedElapsedRealtimeNanos >= 0)
    }
}
```

```kt
package com.system.location.service.core.gnss

enum class GnssCapturePlaybackState { WAITING_FOR_CAPTURE, INVALID_CAPTURE, READY }

data class GnssCapturePreview(
    val state: GnssCapturePlaybackState,
    val frame: ReceiverGnssFrame? = null,
    val issues: List<String> = emptyList(),
)

/** Production model evaluated at the captured observer, not the active route's target location. */
class GnssCapturePreviewer(private val capture: GnssCapture?) {
    private val model by lazy { capture?.let(::ReceiverBroadcastSkyModel) }

    fun current(atMillis: Long, minimumSatellites: Int, elapsedRealtimeNanos: Long? = null,
        currentBootCount: Int? = null): GnssCapturePreview {
        require(atMillis >= 0 && minimumSatellites in 0..GnssFrame.MAX_SATELLITES)
        val source = capture ?: return GnssCapturePreview(GnssCapturePlaybackState.WAITING_FOR_CAPTURE,
            issues = listOf("等待采集，当前透传真实卫星数据"))
        val quality = GnssCaptureValidator.validate(source, atMillis)
        if (!quality.eligible) return GnssCapturePreview(GnssCapturePlaybackState.INVALID_CAPTURE,
            issues = quality.issues)
        val observed = source.frames.last { it.observer != null }
        val frame = checkNotNull(model?.frame(atMillis, observed.observer!!,
            observed.altitudeMeters ?: 0.0, minimumSatellites, elapsedRealtimeNanos, currentBootCount))
        return GnssCapturePreview(GnssCapturePlaybackState.READY, frame)
    }
}
```

`core/src/main/kotlin/com/system/location/service/core/gnss/GnssCaptureQuality.kt`:

```kt
package com.system.location.service.core.gnss

/** Explicit eligibility: raw messages being present does not mean a complete ephemeris exists. */
data class GnssCaptureQuality(val eligible: Boolean, val issues: List<String>)

object GnssCaptureValidator {
    const val MIN_FRAMES = 20
    const val MIN_WINDOW_MILLIS = 30_000L
    const val MAX_AGE_MILLIS = 24 * 60 * 60 * 1000L

    fun validate(capture: GnssCapture, nowMillis: Long): GnssCaptureQuality {
        val issues = mutableListOf<String>()
        val usable = capture.frames.filter { it.satellites.any(::isUsableSatellite) }
        if (usable.size < MIN_FRAMES) issues += "有效帧不足 $MIN_FRAMES 帧"
        if (usable.isEmpty() || usable.last().capturedAtMillis - usable.first().capturedAtMillis < MIN_WINDOW_MILLIS) {
            issues += "有效观测窗口不足 30 秒（需要仰角、方位角和正 CN0）"
        }
        if (nowMillis < capture.endedAtMillis || nowMillis - capture.endedAtMillis > MAX_AGE_MILLIS) {
            issues += "采集画像已过期或系统时间异常"
        }
        if (capture.frames.none { it.observer != null }) issues += "缺少真实观测坐标"
        else if (usable.isNotEmpty() && usable.none { it.observer != null })
            issues += "有效卫星帧缺少同步观测坐标"
        if (capture.frames.any { it.satellites.any { satellite -> satellite.elevationDeg < 0f } }) {
            issues += "采集包含地平线以下卫星，请重新采集"
        }
        return GnssCaptureQuality(issues.isEmpty(), issues)
    }

    /** CN0=0 is an Android placeholder, not evidence of a received signal. */
    fun isUsableSatellite(satellite: GnssSatellite): Boolean =
        satellite.elevationDeg >= 0f && satellite.azimuthDeg in 0f..<360f && satellite.cn0DbHz > 0f
}
```

`core/src/main/kotlin/com/system/location/service/core/gnss/GnssCaptureStore.kt`:

```kt
package com.system.location.service.core.gnss

import java.io.File
import java.nio.file.Files
import java.nio.file.StandardCopyOption
import kotlinx.serialization.json.Json

object GnssCaptureCodec {
    private val json = Json { ignoreUnknownKeys = true; encodeDefaults = true }
    const val MAX_BYTES = 8 * 1024 * 1024

    fun encode(capture: GnssCapture): String = json.encodeToString(GnssCapture.serializer(), capture)

    fun decode(raw: String): GnssCapture {
        require(raw.toByteArray(Charsets.UTF_8).size <= MAX_BYTES) { "GNSS capture too large" }
        return json.decodeFromString(GnssCapture.serializer(), raw)
    }
}

/** Keep the old capture intact on any failure; callers perform disk I/O off the UI thread. */
class GnssCaptureStore(private val file: File) {
    fun load(): GnssCapture? {
        if (!file.isFile) return null
        require(file.length() <= GnssCaptureCodec.MAX_BYTES) { "GNSS capture too large" }
        return GnssCaptureCodec.decode(file.readText(Charsets.UTF_8))
    }

    /** Production promotion is distinct from retaining incomplete receiver evidence. */
    @Synchronized
    fun saveForPlayback(capture: GnssCapture, nowMillis: Long) {
        val quality = GnssCaptureValidator.validate(capture, nowMillis)
        require(quality.eligible) { "采集未达到回放条件：${quality.issues.joinToString("；")}" }
        save(capture)
    }

    @Synchronized
    fun save(capture: GnssCapture) {
        val bytes = GnssCaptureCodec.encode(capture).toByteArray(Charsets.UTF_8)
        require(bytes.size <= GnssCaptureCodec.MAX_BYTES) { "GNSS capture too large" }
        val parent = file.absoluteFile.parentFile
        require(parent.isDirectory || parent.mkdirs()) { "cannot create GNSS capture directory" }
        val temporary = File.createTempFile("gnss-capture-", ".tmp", parent)
        try {
            temporary.outputStream().use { output -> output.write(bytes); output.fd.sync() }
            Files.move(temporary.toPath(), file.toPath(),
                StandardCopyOption.ATOMIC_MOVE, StandardCopyOption.REPLACE_EXISTING)
        } finally {
            temporary.delete()
        }
    }
}
```

`core/src/main/kotlin/com/system/location/service/core/gnss/GnssCaptureWire.kt`:

```kt
package com.system.location.service.core.gnss

import java.io.ByteArrayInputStream
import java.io.ByteArrayOutputStream
import java.util.Base64
import java.util.zip.GZIPInputStream
import java.util.zip.GZIPOutputStream

/** Bounded Binder payload. Raw evidence stays local; validated compact GPS evidence can cross IPC. */
object GnssCaptureWire {
    const val MAX_ENCODED_LENGTH = 262_144

    fun encode(capture: GnssCapture): String {
        // Fresh raw input always supersedes compact input, including when it invalidates it.
        // Peers may re-encode an already compact snapshot without losing its evidence.
        val evidence = if (capture.measurements.isNotEmpty() || capture.navigation.isNotEmpty())
            GpsBroadcastEvidence.fromCapture(capture) else capture.gpsBroadcastEvidence
        // Legacy projected-only captures already reproduce their fit from the retained frames.
        // Preserve explicit empty fits from raw signals too: empty is not permission to refit L5.
        val calibration = if (capture.gpsSignalCalibration != null || capture.frames.any { it.signalObservations.isNotEmpty() })
            GpsEmpiricalSignalModel(capture).calibration else null
        val broadcastCalibration = if (capture.frames.any { it.signalObservations.isNotEmpty() })
            BroadcastSignalCalibration.fit(capture) else capture.broadcastSignalCalibration
        val compact = capture.copy(measurements = emptyList(), navigation = emptyList(),
            gpsBroadcastEvidence = evidence,
            gpsSignalCalibration = calibration,
            broadcastSignalCalibration = broadcastCalibration,
            frames = capture.frames.map { it.copy(signalObservations = emptyList()) })
        val data = GnssCaptureCodec.encode(compact).toByteArray(Charsets.UTF_8)
        require(data.size <= GnssCaptureCodec.MAX_BYTES) { "GNSS compact capture too large" }
        val compressed = ByteArrayOutputStream()
        GZIPOutputStream(compressed).use { it.write(data) }
        val encoded = Base64.getEncoder().encodeToString(compressed.toByteArray())
        require(encoded.length <= MAX_ENCODED_LENGTH) { "GNSS capture exceeds Binder budget" }
        return encoded
    }

    fun decode(encoded: String): GnssCapture {
        require(encoded.length <= MAX_ENCODED_LENGTH) { "GNSS capture exceeds Binder budget" }
        val compressed = Base64.getDecoder().decode(encoded)
        val output = ByteArrayOutputStream()
        GZIPInputStream(ByteArrayInputStream(compressed)).use { input ->
            val chunk = ByteArray(8192)
            while (true) {
                val count = input.read(chunk)
                if (count < 0) break
                require(output.size() + count <= GnssCaptureCodec.MAX_BYTES) { "GNSS decompression limit exceeded" }
                output.write(chunk, 0, count)
            }
        }
        return GnssCaptureCodec.decode(output.toString(Charsets.UTF_8.name()))
    }
}
```

```kt
package com.system.location.service.core.gnss

import com.system.location.service.core.geo.Wgs84

/** Stable observer identity, independent of movement, provider latency and physical noise. */
sealed interface GnssFrameRoute {
    data object Global : GnssFrameRoute
    data class FixedPoint(val point: Wgs84) : GnssFrameRoute
    data class Scenario(val id: String) : GnssFrameRoute {
        init { require(id.isNotBlank()) }
    }

    companion object {
        fun forObserver(scenarioId: String? = null, point: Wgs84? = null): GnssFrameRoute {
            require(scenarioId == null || point == null)
            return point?.let(::FixedPoint) ?: scenarioId?.let(::Scenario) ?: Global
        }
    }
}
```
