`core/src/main/kotlin/com/system/location/service/core/gnss/GnssFrameSource.kt`:

```kt
package com.system.location.service.core.gnss

import com.system.location.service.core.location.LocationSample
import java.util.concurrent.atomic.AtomicLong
import java.lang.ref.WeakReference

/** Process-local immutable source handle. Runtime IPC carries data and policy, not frame caches. */
interface GnssFrameSource {
    val requiresBootIdentity: Boolean
    fun frame(sample: LocationSample, minimumSatellites: Int, route: GnssFrameRoute,
        validationAtMillis: Long, currentBootCount: Int? = null): PublishedGnssFrame?
}

internal object GnssPublicationSequences { val counter = AtomicLong() }

class AutonomousGnssSource internal constructor(policy: GnssSimulationPolicy,
    navigation: RinexNavigationResource? = null, calibration: GnssAutonomousSignalCalibration? = null) : GnssFrameSource {
    override val requiresBootIdentity = false
    private val frames = GnssFrameStore(GnssPublicationSequences.counter).apply {
        configureAutonomous(GnssBundledOrbitResources.model(policy,
            // Legacy arrays/NMEA and Xiaomi Android 14 Builder/independent-receiver coverage.
            // Other platform/vendor receiver limits still need their own device validation.
            GnssOutputLimits(maxVisible = 128, maxPerTalker = 36, maxUsed = 32),
            // GPS-only application budget for approximate sky geometry, not an accuracy claim.
            gpsAlmanacAgeBudgetSeconds = 7 * 86400.0, navigation = navigation, signalCalibration = calibration))
    }

    override fun frame(sample: LocationSample, minimumSatellites: Int, route: GnssFrameRoute,
        validationAtMillis: Long, currentBootCount: Int?): PublishedGnssFrame? =
        frames.current(sample.timeMillis, sample.coordinate, sample.altitude, minimumSatellites,
            sample.speed.toDouble(), sample.bearing.toDouble(), validationAtMillis, route,
            sample.elapsedNanos, currentBootCount)
}

/**
 * Live immutable configurations own their source handles. The registry only interns sources:
 * it must not pin up to 64 obsolete navigation resources and their 4096-publication caches.
 * Old configuration readers still retain their original publications through their own handles.
 */
object GnssSourceSelection {
    private data class Key(val policy: GnssSimulationPolicy, val navigationDigest: String?, val navigationSource: String?,
        val captureDigest: String?, val catalog: BeiDouCatalogManifest?)
    private val autonomous = object : LinkedHashMap<Key, WeakReference<AutonomousGnssSource>>(16, 0.75f, true) {
        override fun removeEldestEntry(eldest: MutableMap.MutableEntry<Key, WeakReference<AutonomousGnssSource>>?) = size > 64
    }

    @Synchronized
    fun source(policy: GnssSimulationPolicy, capture: CapturedGnssSource?,
        navigation: RinexNavigationResource? = null): GnssFrameSource? = when (policy.mode) {
        GnssSimulationMode.OFF -> null
        GnssSimulationMode.REPLAY -> capture
        GnssSimulationMode.AUTO, GnssSimulationMode.AUTONOMOUS ->
            // Validate before key reuse: an asserted digest is not proof that bytes match.
            navigation.let { resource ->
                resource?.validate()
                val signalSource = capture.takeIf { policy.mode == GnssSimulationMode.AUTO }
                val key = Key(policy, resource?.sha256, resource?.sourceUrl, signalSource?.digest,
                    resource?.beiDouCatalog?.manifest)
                autonomous[key]?.get() ?: AutonomousGnssSource(policy, resource, signalSource?.signalCalibration)
                    .also { autonomous[key] = WeakReference(it) }
            }
    }
}
```

`core/src/main/kotlin/com/system/location/service/core/gnss/GnssFrameStore.kt`:

```kt
package com.system.location.service.core.gnss

import com.system.location.service.core.geo.Wgs84
import java.util.concurrent.atomic.AtomicLong

data class PublishedGnssFrame(
    val sequence: Long,
    val frame: ReceiverGnssFrame,
    val speedMps: Double,
    val bearingDeg: Double,
)

/** First sample of each route/clock-second anchors one immutable publication for all adapters. */
class GnssFrameStore(private val sequence: AtomicLong = AtomicLong()) {
    private sealed interface ObserverIdentity {
        data class Routed(val route: GnssFrameRoute) : ObserverIdentity
        data class Exact(val observer: Wgs84, val altitude: Double, val speed: Double,
            val bearing: Double) : ObserverIdentity
    }
    private data class Key(val utcEpochMillis: Long?, val identity: ObserverIdentity, val minimum: Int,
        val receiverSecond: Long?, val bootCount: Int?)
    private var capture: GnssCapture? = null
    private var model: ReceiverBroadcastSkyModel? = null
    private var autonomous: ReceiverAutonomousSkyModel? = null
    private val cache = object : LinkedHashMap<Key, PublishedGnssFrame?>(16, 0.75f, true) {
        // Covers adjacent seconds for all configured routes (RoutingConfig permits 1024).
        override fun removeEldestEntry(eldest: MutableMap.MutableEntry<Key, PublishedGnssFrame?>?): Boolean = size > 4096
    }

    @Synchronized
    fun configure(observation: GnssCapture?, seed: Long = 0) {
        capture = observation
        autonomous = null
        model = observation?.let { ReceiverBroadcastSkyModel(it, seed) }
        cache.clear()
    }

    /** Autonomous geometry has its own resource lifecycle and never requires a capture. */
    @Synchronized
    fun configureAutonomous(sky: ReceiverAutonomousSkyModel) {
        capture = null
        model = null
        autonomous = sky
        cache.clear()
    }

    @Synchronized
    fun current(atMillis: Long, observer: Wgs84, altitudeMeters: Double,
        minimumSatellites: Int, speedMps: Double, bearingDeg: Double,
        validationAtMillis: Long = atMillis, route: GnssFrameRoute? = null,
        elapsedRealtimeNanos: Long? = null, currentBootCount: Int? = null): PublishedGnssFrame? {
        require(atMillis >= 0 && validationAtMillis >= 0 && speedMps.isFinite() && speedMps >= 0 && bearingDeg.isFinite())
        require(altitudeMeters.isFinite() && minimumSatellites in 0..GnssFrame.MAX_SATELLITES)
        require(elapsedRealtimeNanos == null || elapsedRealtimeNanos >= 0)
        require(currentBootCount == null || currentBootCount >= 0)
        val sky = autonomous
        if (sky == null) {
            val source = capture ?: return null
            if (!GnssCaptureValidator.validate(source, validationAtMillis).eligible) { cache.clear(); return null }
            // A delayed provider sample cannot use evidence that had not finished at its epoch.
            // Do not cache this rejection: a later sample in the same second can be eligible.
            if (atMillis < source.endedAtMillis) return null
        }
        val bearing = ((bearingDeg % 360) + 360) % 360
        // Null is for explicit sample previews; production must supply its stable route.
        val identity = route?.let(ObserverIdentity::Routed)
            ?: ObserverIdentity.Exact(observer, altitudeMeters, speedMps, bearing)
        // A frozen/adjusted wall clock cannot keep a physical frame alive after elapsed evidence
        // expires. Missing or changed boot identity must not reuse a physically propagated frame.
        val hasBroadcast = model?.broadcastBootCount != null
        val utcEpochMillis = atMillis / 1000 * 1000
        val receiverSecond = if (hasBroadcast || sky != null) elapsedRealtimeNanos?.div(1_000_000_000L) else null
        // Choose one clock boundary: intersecting UTC and elapsed seconds would publish twice
        // per receiver second when their boundaries differ. UTC remains the first sample's label.
        val key = Key(if (receiverSecond == null) utcEpochMillis else null, identity, minimumSatellites,
            receiverSecond,
            if (hasBroadcast || sky != null) currentBootCount else null)
        if (cache.containsKey(key)) return cache[key]
        // The second identifies a cache bucket, not the observation epoch. Keep the first
        // sample's exact time for every source; rounding could precede capture completion.
        val frame = if (sky != null) sky.frame(GnssSkyRequest(atMillis, observer, altitudeMeters), minimumSatellites, validationAtMillis)
            else model?.frame(atMillis, observer, altitudeMeters, minimumSatellites,
                elapsedRealtimeNanos, currentBootCount)
        val published = frame?.let { PublishedGnssFrame(sequence.incrementAndGet(), it, speedMps, bearing) }
        cache[key] = published
        return published
    }
}
```

`core/src/main/kotlin/com/system/location/service/core/gnss/GnssGeometry.kt`:

```kt
package com.system.location.service.core.gnss

import kotlin.math.abs
import kotlin.math.cos
import kotlin.math.sin
import kotlin.math.sqrt
import kotlinx.serialization.Serializable

@Serializable
data class GnssDop(val hdop: Double, val vdop: Double, val pdop: Double, val tdop: Double, val gdop: Double) {
    init { require(listOf(hdop, vdop, pdop, tdop, gdop).all { it.isFinite() && it > 0 }) }
}

data class GnssGeometryResult(val dop: GnssDop?, val reason: String? = null, val conditionNumber: Double? = null)

/**
 * Equal-variance geometric DOP (W = I), not a CN0-derived accuracy estimate.
 * H is in local ENU, so Qee/Qnn/Quu directly yield HDOP/VDOP.
 * https://gssc.esa.int/navipedia/index.php/Positioning_Error
 *
 * Each constellation gets a separate receiver clock column: absent measured inter-system time
 * offsets, sharing one clock would overstate the information provided by mixed constellations.
 * Q = R^-1 R^-T is computed by Householder QR instead of inverting H^T H (which squares conditioning).
 */
object GnssGeometry {
    fun solve(satellites: List<GnssSatellite>): GnssGeometryResult {
        val used = satellites.filter { it.usedInFix && GnssCaptureValidator.isUsableSatellite(it) }
        if (used.map { it.constellation to it.svid }.distinct().size != used.size) {
            return GnssGeometryResult(null, "duplicate satellite identity")
        }
        val systems = used.map { it.constellation }.distinct().sortedBy { it.ordinal }
        val columns = 3 + systems.size
        if (used.size < maxOf(4, columns)) return GnssGeometryResult(null, "insufficient observations for position and receiver clocks")
        val matrix = Array(used.size) { index ->
            val satellite = used[index]
            val elevation = Math.toRadians(satellite.elevationDeg.toDouble())
            val azimuth = Math.toRadians(satellite.azimuthDeg.toDouble())
            DoubleArray(columns).apply {
                this[0] = cos(elevation) * sin(azimuth)
                this[1] = cos(elevation) * cos(azimuth)
                this[2] = sin(elevation)
                this[3 + systems.indexOf(satellite.constellation)] = 1.0
            }
        }
        for (column in 0 until columns) {
            val norm = sqrt((column until matrix.size).sumOf { matrix[it][column] * matrix[it][column] })
            if (!norm.isFinite() || norm < 1e-10) return GnssGeometryResult(null, "rank deficient satellite geometry")
            val reflector = DoubleArray(matrix.size - column) { matrix[column + it][column] }
            reflector[0] += if (reflector[0] >= 0) norm else -norm
            val normSquared = reflector.sumOf { it * it }
            for (target in column until columns) {
                val projection = 2 * reflector.indices.sumOf { reflector[it] * matrix[column + it][target] } / normSquared
                for (row in reflector.indices) matrix[column + row][target] -= projection * reflector[row]
            }
        }
        val r = Array(columns) { row -> DoubleArray(columns) { column -> if (column >= row) matrix[row][column] else 0.0 } }
        val inverse = Array(columns) { DoubleArray(columns) }
        for (column in 0 until columns) {
            for (row in columns - 1 downTo 0) {
                var value = if (row == column) 1.0 else 0.0
                for (other in row + 1 until columns) value -= r[row][other] * inverse[other][column]
                inverse[row][column] = value / r[row][row]
            }
        }
        fun infinityNorm(values: Array<DoubleArray>) = values.maxOf { row -> row.sumOf { abs(it) } }
        val condition = infinityNorm(r) * infinityNorm(inverse)
        // Accuracy worse than roughly 1e-6 relative is rejected rather than capped to a plausible DOP.
        if (!condition.isFinite() || condition > 1e6) return GnssGeometryResult(null, "ill-conditioned satellite geometry", condition)
        val diagonal = DoubleArray(columns) { row -> inverse[row].sumOf { it * it } }
        val horizontal = diagonal[0] + diagonal[1]
        val vertical = diagonal[2]
        val time = diagonal[3] // Reference constellation clock; additional clocks are nuisance states.
        return GnssGeometryResult(GnssDop(sqrt(horizontal), sqrt(vertical), sqrt(horizontal + vertical),
            sqrt(time), sqrt(horizontal + vertical + time)), conditionNumber = condition)
    }
}
```

```kt
package com.system.location.service.core.gnss

import kotlinx.serialization.Serializable

enum class Constellation { GPS, BEIDOU, GLONASS, GALILEO, QZSS, SBAS, IRNSS }

@Serializable
data class GnssSatellite(
    val constellation: Constellation,
    val svid: Int,
    val elevationDeg: Float,
    val azimuthDeg: Float,
    val cn0DbHz: Float,
    val usedInFix: Boolean,
    val hasEphemeris: Boolean,
    val hasAlmanac: Boolean,
    val carrierHz: Float? = null,
) {
    init {
        require(svid in 1..999) { "svid out of range: $svid" }
        require(elevationDeg in -90f..90f) { "elevation out of range: $elevationDeg" }
        require(azimuthDeg in 0f..360f) { "azimuth out of range: $azimuthDeg" }
        require(cn0DbHz in 0f..GnssFrame.MAX_CN0_DB_HZ) { "CN0 out of range: $cn0DbHz" }
    }
}

@Serializable
data class GnssFrame(
    val generatedAtMillis: Long,
    val satellites: List<GnssSatellite>,
    val hdop: Float,
    val vdop: Float,
    val pdop: Float,
) {
    init {
        require(generatedAtMillis >= 0L) { "generatedAtMillis must be non-negative" }
        require(satellites.size <= MAX_SATELLITES) { "Too many satellites: ${satellites.size}" }
        require(satellites.map { it.constellation to it.svid }.distinct().size == satellites.size) {
            "Duplicate constellation/svid"
        }
        require(hdop > 0f && vdop > 0f && pdop > 0f) { "DOP values must be positive" }
    }

    val usedInFix: List<GnssSatellite> get() = satellites.filter { it.usedInFix }

    fun countFor(constellation: Constellation): Int = satellites.count { it.constellation == constellation }

    companion object {
        const val MAX_SATELLITES = 128
        // Android GnssStatus.getCn0DbHz is specified in the inclusive range 0..63 dB-Hz.
        const val MAX_CN0_DB_HZ = 63f
    }
}
```

```kt
package com.system.location.service.core.gnss

import com.system.location.service.core.geo.Wgs84
import kotlinx.serialization.Serializable
import kotlin.random.Random

/** One receiver status frame captured before synthetic GNSS is enabled. */
@Serializable
data class GnssObservationFrame(
    val capturedAtMillis: Long,
    val observer: Wgs84? = null,
    val altitudeMeters: Double? = null,
    val satellites: List<GnssSatellite>,
    val measurementsAvailable: Boolean = false,
    val navigationMessagesAvailable: Boolean = false,
    /** Original per-signal status records. Empty means legacy evidence was not captured. */
    val signalObservations: List<GnssSignalObservation> = emptyList(),
    /** Status callback arrival on the capture device's Android elapsed realtime clock. */
    val capturedElapsedRealtimeNanos: Long? = null,
    /** Epoch of the actual Location used as observer; never the status callback arrival. */
    val observerElapsedRealtimeNanos: Long? = null,
    val observerElapsedRealtimeUncertaintyNanos: Double? = null,
    /** Android's reported horizontal/vertical accuracy, not a deterministic error bound. */
    val observerHorizontalAccuracyMeters: Double? = null,
    val observerVerticalAccuracyMeters: Double? = null,
) {
    init {
        require(signalObservations.size <= 512) { "too many signal observations" }
        require(capturedAtMillis >= 0L) { "capturedAtMillis must be non-negative" }
        require(altitudeMeters == null || altitudeMeters.isFinite()) { "invalid altitude" }
        require(capturedElapsedRealtimeNanos == null || capturedElapsedRealtimeNanos >= 0)
        if (observerElapsedRealtimeNanos != null) {
            require(observer != null && capturedElapsedRealtimeNanos != null &&
                observerElapsedRealtimeNanos in 0..capturedElapsedRealtimeNanos) {
                "observer epoch must precede status arrival on the same elapsed clock"
            }
        }
        require(listOf(observerElapsedRealtimeUncertaintyNanos, observerHorizontalAccuracyMeters,
            observerVerticalAccuracyMeters).all { it == null || it.isFinite() && it >= 0 }) {
            "invalid observer uncertainty/accuracy"
        }
        require(observerElapsedRealtimeUncertaintyNanos == null || observerElapsedRealtimeNanos != null)
        require(observerHorizontalAccuracyMeters == null || observer != null)
        require(observerVerticalAccuracyMeters == null || observer != null && altitudeMeters != null)
        require(satellites.map { it.constellation to it.svid }.distinct().size == satellites.size) {
            "duplicate constellation/svid"
        }
    }
}

@Serializable
data class GnssConstellationProfile(
    val constellation: Constellation,
    val frameCount: Int,
    val satelliteSamples: Int,
    val usedSamples: Int,
    val frameCountHistogram: Map<Int, Int>,
    val elevationHistogram: Map<Int, Int>,
    val cn0Histogram: Map<Int, Int>,
    val identities: List<GnssSatelliteIdentity>,
    val ratio: Double,
    val ratioConfidenceLow: Double,
    val ratioConfidenceHigh: Double,
) {
    init {
        require(frameCount > 0) { "frameCount must be positive" }
        require(satelliteSamples >= 0 && usedSamples in 0..satelliteSamples) {
            "invalid satellite sample counts"
        }
        require(ratio in 0.0..1.0) { "ratio out of range" }
        require(ratioConfidenceLow in 0.0..1.0 && ratioConfidenceHigh in 0.0..1.0) {
            "confidence interval out of range"
        }
        require(ratioConfidenceLow <= ratio && ratio <= ratioConfidenceHigh) {
            "ratio outside confidence interval"
        }
        require(identities.map { it.constellation to it.svid }.distinct().size == identities.size) {
            "duplicate satellite identity"
        }
    }

    val meanSatellitesPerFrame: Double
        get() = satelliteSamples.toDouble() / frameCount

    val usedRatio: Double
        get() = if (satelliteSamples == 0) 0.0 else usedSamples.toDouble() / satelliteSamples
}

@Serializable
data class GnssSatelliteIdentity(
    val constellation: Constellation,
    val svid: Int,
    val hasEphemeris: Boolean,
    val hasAlmanac: Boolean,
    val carrierHz: Float? = null,
) {
    init {
        require(svid in 1..999) { "svid out of range: $svid" }
        require(carrierHz == null || carrierHz.isFinite() && carrierHz > 0f) {
            "invalid carrier frequency"
        }
    }
}

@Serializable
data class GnssObservationProfile(
    val schemaVersion: Int = CURRENT_SCHEMA_VERSION,
    val deviceModel: String,
    val osVersion: String,
    val capturedAtMillis: Long,
    val captureEndedAtMillis: Long,
    val observer: Wgs84? = null,
    val altitudeMeters: Double? = null,
    val frameCount: Int,
    val constellations: List<GnssConstellationProfile>,
    val measurementsAvailable: Boolean,
    val navigationMessagesAvailable: Boolean,
) {
    init {
        require(schemaVersion == CURRENT_SCHEMA_VERSION) { "unsupported schemaVersion: $schemaVersion" }
        require(deviceModel.isNotBlank()) { "deviceModel must not be blank" }
        require(osVersion.isNotBlank()) { "osVersion must not be blank" }
        require(capturedAtMillis >= 0L && captureEndedAtMillis >= capturedAtMillis) {
            "invalid capture interval"
        }
        require(frameCount > 0) { "frameCount must be positive" }
        require(altitudeMeters == null || altitudeMeters.isFinite()) { "invalid altitude" }
        require(constellations.map { it.constellation }.distinct().size == constellations.size) {
            "duplicate constellation profile"
        }
        require(constellations.all { it.frameCount == frameCount }) {
            "constellation frame count must match profile frame count"
        }
    }

    val totalSatelliteSamples: Int
        get() = constellations.sumOf { it.satelliteSamples }

    fun profileFor(constellation: Constellation): GnssConstellationProfile? =
        constellations.firstOrNull { it.constellation == constellation }

    companion object {
        const val CURRENT_SCHEMA_VERSION = 1
    }
}

/** Aggregates frames without giving a busy frame more weight than its satellite samples. */
object GnssObservationProfileBuilder {
    fun build(
        frames: List<GnssObservationFrame>,
        deviceModel: String,
        osVersion: String,
    ): GnssObservationProfile {
        require(frames.isNotEmpty()) { "at least one observation frame is required" }
        val ordered = frames.sortedBy { it.capturedAtMillis }
        val first = ordered.first().capturedAtMillis
        val last = ordered.last().capturedAtMillis
        val constellations = Constellation.values().mapNotNull { constellation ->
            val observations = ordered.map { frame ->
                frame.satellites.filter(GnssCaptureValidator::isUsableSatellite)
                    .filter { it.constellation == constellation }
            }
            if (observations.all { it.isEmpty() }) return@mapNotNull null
            val satellites = observations.flatten()
            val totalSatelliteSamples = satellites.size
            val totalSamples = ordered.sumOf { frame ->
                frame.satellites.count(GnssCaptureValidator::isUsableSatellite)
            }
            val ratio = if (totalSamples == 0) 0.0 else totalSatelliteSamples.toDouble() / totalSamples
            val interval = blockBootstrapInterval(ordered, constellation, ratio)
            GnssConstellationProfile(
                constellation = constellation,
                frameCount = ordered.size,
                satelliteSamples = totalSatelliteSamples,
                usedSamples = satellites.count { it.usedInFix },
                frameCountHistogram = observations.groupingBy { it.size }.eachCount(),
                elevationHistogram = satellites.groupingBy { it.elevationDeg.toInt().coerceIn(-90, 90) }.eachCount(),
                cn0Histogram = satellites.groupingBy { it.cn0DbHz.toInt().coerceIn(0, GnssFrame.MAX_CN0_DB_HZ.toInt()) }.eachCount(),
                identities = satellites
                    .distinctBy { it.constellation to it.svid }
                    .map { satellite ->
                        GnssSatelliteIdentity(
                            constellation = satellite.constellation,
                            svid = satellite.svid,
                            hasEphemeris = satellite.hasEphemeris,
                            hasAlmanac = satellite.hasAlmanac,
                            carrierHz = satellite.carrierHz,
                        )
                    }
                    .sortedWith(compareBy({ it.constellation.ordinal }, { it.svid })),
                ratio = ratio,
                ratioConfidenceLow = interval.first,
                ratioConfidenceHigh = interval.second,
            )
        }
        val observers = ordered.mapNotNull { it.observer }
        val altitudes = ordered.mapNotNull { it.altitudeMeters }
        return GnssObservationProfile(
            capturedAtMillis = first,
            captureEndedAtMillis = last,
            observer = observers.firstOrNull(),
            altitudeMeters = altitudes.firstOrNull(),
            frameCount = ordered.size,
            deviceModel = deviceModel,
            osVersion = osVersion,
            constellations = constellations,
            measurementsAvailable = ordered.any { it.measurementsAvailable },
            navigationMessagesAvailable = ordered.any { it.navigationMessagesAvailable },
        )
    }

    private fun blockBootstrapInterval(
        frames: List<GnssObservationFrame>, constellation: Constellation, ratio: Double,
    ): Pair<Double, Double> {
        // Satellite observations in adjacent frames are correlated. Resample whole ten-second
        // temporal blocks rather than treating every tracked satellite as a Bernoulli trial.
        // This describes this capture only; it is not a confidence claim about other regions.
        val start = frames.first().capturedAtMillis
        val blocks = frames.groupBy { (it.capturedAtMillis - start) / 10_000L }.values.map { block ->
            block.sumOf { frame -> frame.satellites.count {
                GnssCaptureValidator.isUsableSatellite(it) && it.constellation == constellation
            } } to
                block.sumOf { frame -> frame.satellites.count(GnssCaptureValidator::isUsableSatellite) }
        }
        if (blocks.size < 3) return 0.0 to 1.0
        val random = Random(0)
        val ratios = DoubleArray(1000) {
            var selected = 0L
            var total = 0L
            repeat(blocks.size) {
                val block = blocks[random.nextInt(blocks.size)]
                selected += block.first
                total += block.second
            }
            if (total == 0L) 0.0 else selected.toDouble() / total
        }.sorted()
        return minOf(ratio, ratios[24]) to maxOf(ratio, ratios[974])
    }
}
```

`core/src/main/kotlin/com/system/location/service/core/gnss/GnssObserverGeometry.kt`:

```kt
package com.system.location.service.core.gnss

import com.system.location.service.core.geo.Wgs84
import kotlin.math.*

data class EcefPosition(val xMeters: Double, val yMeters: Double, val zMeters: Double) {
    init { require(listOf(xMeters, yMeters, zMeters).all(Double::isFinite)) }
}

/** Local ellipsoid-normal orientation in the supplied ECEF frame, not geocentric latitude. */
data class GeodeticOrientation(val latitudeDegrees: Double, val longitudeDegrees: Double) {
    init {
        require(latitudeDegrees.isFinite() && latitudeDegrees in -90.0..90.0)
        require(longitudeDegrees.isFinite() && longitudeDegrees in -180.0..180.0)
    }
}

data class GnssLineOfSight(
    val eastMeters: Double,
    val northMeters: Double,
    val upMeters: Double,
    val rangeMeters: Double,
    val elevationDegrees: Double,
    /** Undefined at exact zenith/nadir; callers must make any presentation convention explicit. */
    val azimuthDegrees: Double?,
) {
    val aboveHorizon: Boolean get() = elevationDegrees >= 0
}

/** WGS 84 geodetic latitude and ellipsoid height, not geocentric latitude or MSL height. */
object GnssObserverGeometry {
    const val SEMI_MAJOR_AXIS_METERS = 6378137.0
    const val INVERSE_FLATTENING = 298.257223563
    private val flattening = 1 / INVERSE_FLATTENING
    private val eccentricitySquared = flattening * (2 - flattening)

    fun ecef(observer: Wgs84, ellipsoidHeightMeters: Double): EcefPosition {
        require(ellipsoidHeightMeters.isFinite())
        val latitude = Math.toRadians(observer.latitude)
        val longitude = Math.toRadians(observer.longitude)
        val sinLatitude = sin(latitude)
        val normal = SEMI_MAJOR_AXIS_METERS / sqrt(1 - eccentricitySquared * sinLatitude * sinLatitude)
        return EcefPosition((normal + ellipsoidHeightMeters) * cos(latitude) * cos(longitude),
            (normal + ellipsoidHeightMeters) * cos(latitude) * sin(longitude),
            (normal * (1 - eccentricitySquared) + ellipsoidHeightMeters) * sinLatitude)
    }

    /** Both positions must use the same ECEF axes and epoch (apply transit rotation first). */
    fun lineOfSight(observer: Wgs84, ellipsoidHeightMeters: Double, satellite: EcefPosition): GnssLineOfSight? {
        val receiver = ecef(observer, ellipsoidHeightMeters)
        return lineOfSight(receiver, GeodeticOrientation(observer.latitude, observer.longitude), satellite)
    }

    /**
     * Explicit origin and local normal permit frames such as GTRF without a silent datum conversion.
     * Receiver, satellite and orientation must refer to the same ECEF axes at reception.
     * The caller supplies the orientation from its frame/ellipsoid model; no ellipsoid is assumed here.
     */
    fun lineOfSight(receiver: EcefPosition, orientation: GeodeticOrientation,
        satellite: EcefPosition): GnssLineOfSight? {
        val latitude = Math.toRadians(orientation.latitudeDegrees)
        val longitude = Math.toRadians(orientation.longitudeDegrees)
        val x = satellite.xMeters - receiver.xMeters
        val y = satellite.yMeters - receiver.yMeters
        val z = satellite.zMeters - receiver.zMeters
        val east = -sin(longitude) * x + cos(longitude) * y
        val north = -sin(latitude) * cos(longitude) * x - sin(latitude) * sin(longitude) * y + cos(latitude) * z
        val up = cos(latitude) * cos(longitude) * x + cos(latitude) * sin(longitude) * y + sin(latitude) * z
        val horizontal = hypot(east, north)
        val range = hypot(horizontal, up)
        if (!range.isFinite() || range <= 0) return null
        // atan2 is equivalent to asin(up/range), without roundoff outside [-1,1].
        val elevation = Math.toDegrees(atan2(up, horizontal))
        // A relative tolerance handles floating-point residue at poles/zenith; no orbit is moved.
        val azimuth = if (horizontal <= range * 1e-14) null
            else (Math.toDegrees(atan2(east, north)) + 360) % 360
        return GnssLineOfSight(east, north, up, range, elevation, azimuth)
    }
}
```

`core/src/main/kotlin/com/system/location/service/core/gnss/GnssReceiverDatumTransform.kt`:

```kt
package com.system.location.service.core.gnss

import com.system.location.service.core.geo.Wgs84
import kotlinx.serialization.Serializable
import kotlin.math.*

data class GnssDatumReceiver(val position: EcefPosition, val orientation: GeodeticOrientation)

/**
 * An independently established WGS 84 ECEF -> target ECEF similarity transform, evaluated
 * over the supplied same-boot elapsed interval [from, until). Coefficients are a full proper
 * rotation, positive scale and translation, not small-angle Helmert parameters with an
 * ambiguous position-vector/coordinate-frame convention. Target ellipsoid parameters are
 * explicit. No identity transform, frame realization, epoch, or applicability is inferred.
 */
@Serializable
data class GnssReceiverDatumTransform(
    val evidenceId: String,
    val bootCount: Int,
    val validFromElapsedNanos: Long,
    val validUntilElapsedNanos: Long,
    val rotation: List<Double>,
    val translationMeters: List<Double>,
    val scale: Double,
    val targetSemiMajorAxisMeters: Double,
    val targetInverseFlattening: Double,
) {
    init {
        require(evidenceId.isNotBlank() && evidenceId.length <= 256)
        require(bootCount >= 0 && validFromElapsedNanos >= 0 && validUntilElapsedNanos > validFromElapsedNanos)
        require(rotation.size == 9 && rotation.all(Double::isFinite))
        require(translationMeters.size == 3 && translationMeters.all(Double::isFinite))
        require(scale.isFinite() && scale > 0.0)
        require(targetSemiMajorAxisMeters.isFinite() && targetSemiMajorAxisMeters > 0.0)
        require(targetInverseFlattening.isFinite() && targetInverseFlattening > 1.0)
        fun dot(a: Int, b: Int) = (0..2).sumOf { rotation[3 * a + it] * rotation[3 * b + it] }
        require((0..2).all { abs(dot(it, it) - 1.0) <= 1e-12 })
        require(abs(dot(0, 1)) <= 1e-12 && abs(dot(0, 2)) <= 1e-12 && abs(dot(1, 2)) <= 1e-12)
        val r = rotation
        val determinant = r[0] * (r[4] * r[8] - r[5] * r[7]) -
            r[1] * (r[3] * r[8] - r[5] * r[6]) + r[2] * (r[3] * r[7] - r[4] * r[6])
        require(abs(determinant - 1.0) <= 1e-12)
    }

    fun receiver(observer: Wgs84, altitudeMeters: Double, elapsedNanos: Long?, currentBootCount: Int?): GnssDatumReceiver? {
        if (currentBootCount != bootCount || elapsedNanos == null ||
            elapsedNanos < validFromElapsedNanos || elapsedNanos >= validUntilElapsedNanos || !altitudeMeters.isFinite())
            return null
        return runCatching {
            val wgs = GnssObserverGeometry.ecef(observer, altitudeMeters)
            val input = listOf(wgs.xMeters, wgs.yMeters, wgs.zMeters)
            val output = (0..2).map { row ->
                scale * (0..2).sumOf { column -> rotation[row * 3 + column] * input[column] } + translationMeters[row]
            }
            val position = EcefPosition(output[0], output[1], output[2])
            val orientation = orientation(position) ?: return null
            GnssDatumReceiver(position, orientation)
        }.getOrNull()
    }

    private fun orientation(position: EcefPosition): GeodeticOrientation? {
        val p = hypot(position.xMeters, position.yMeters)
        val z = position.zMeters
        val f = 1.0 / targetInverseFlattening
        val e2 = f * (2.0 - f)
        // A pole has no uniquely defined azimuth reference. Deep interior points may have
        // multiple ellipsoid normals: do not choose an arbitrary branch for a receiver.
        if (p == 0.0 || hypot(p, z) <= targetSemiMajorAxisMeters * e2) return null
        var latitude = atan2(z, p * (1.0 - e2))
        repeat(64) {
            val sine = sin(latitude)
            val n = targetSemiMajorAxisMeters / sqrt(1.0 - e2 * sine * sine)
            val next = atan2(z + e2 * n * sine, p)
            if (abs(next - latitude) <= 1e-14) {
                val normal = targetSemiMajorAxisMeters / sqrt(1.0 - e2 * sin(next).pow(2))
                val residual = p * sin(next) - z * cos(next) - e2 * normal * sin(next) * cos(next)
                if (abs(residual) > hypot(p, z) * 1e-12) return null
                return GeodeticOrientation(Math.toDegrees(next), Math.toDegrees(atan2(position.yMeters, position.xMeters)))
            }
            latitude = next
        }
        return null
    }
}
```

`core/src/main/kotlin/com/system/location/service/core/gnss/GnssSatelliteIds.kt`:

```kt
package com.system.location.service.core.gnss

/**
 * Android SVID -> NMEA local talker ID. All adapters consume the same supported subset.
 * Sources: Android GnssStatus.getSvid and https://docs.novatel.com/OEM7/Content/Logs/GPGSV.htm
 * GLONASS FCN-only IDs and extended SBAS/QZSS IDs have no unambiguous mapping in this format;
 * keep them in raw evidence but exclude them from every generated output with a diagnostic.
 */
object GnssSatelliteIds {
    fun nmeaId(constellation: Constellation, svid: Int): Int? = when (constellation) {
        Constellation.GPS -> svid.takeIf { it in 1..32 }
        Constellation.GLONASS -> svid.takeIf { it in 1..25 }?.plus(64)
        Constellation.BEIDOU -> svid.takeIf { it in 1..63 }
        Constellation.GALILEO -> svid.takeIf { it in 1..36 }
        Constellation.QZSS -> svid.takeIf { it in 193..202 }?.minus(192)
        Constellation.IRNSS -> svid.takeIf { it in 1..14 }
        Constellation.SBAS -> svid.takeIf { it in 120..151 }?.minus(87)
    }
}
```

`core/src/main/kotlin/com/system/location/service/core/gnss/GnssSignalObservation.kt`:

```kt
package com.system.location.service.core.gnss

import kotlinx.serialization.Serializable

/** One valid GnssStatus record, including a repeated SVID on another carrier. */
@Serializable
data class GnssSignalObservation(
    val satellite: GnssSatellite,
    val basebandCn0DbHz: Float? = null,
) {
    init {
        require(basebandCn0DbHz == null || basebandCn0DbHz in 0f..GnssFrame.MAX_CN0_DB_HZ) {
            "invalid baseband CN0"
        }
        require(satellite.carrierHz == null || satellite.carrierHz.isFinite() && satellite.carrierHz > 0f) {
            "invalid signal carrier"
        }
    }
}

/**
 * Spacecraft statistics and geometry count an identity once, independent of callback array order.
 * Prefer a usable signal, then a used signal and the lowest reported frequency. Keep all fields from that same record;
 * neither CN0 nor geometry is averaged across bands. Original records remain in the capture.
 */
object GnssSignalProjection {
    fun spacecraft(signals: List<GnssSignalObservation>): List<GnssSatellite> = signals
        .map { it.satellite }
        .groupBy { it.constellation to it.svid }
        .values.map { candidates -> candidates.minWith(compareBy<GnssSatellite>(
            { !GnssCaptureValidator.isUsableSatellite(it) },
            { !it.usedInFix }, { it.carrierHz ?: Float.POSITIVE_INFINITY },
            { -it.cn0DbHz }, { it.elevationDeg }, { it.azimuthDeg },
            { !it.hasEphemeris }, { !it.hasAlmanac },
        )) }
        .sortedWith(compareBy({ it.constellation.ordinal }, { it.svid }))
}
```

`core/src/main/kotlin/com/system/location/service/core/gnss/GnssSimulatedNavigation.kt`:

```kt
package com.system.location.service.core.gnss

/** Ideal clock in a hypothetical navigation world; never decoded broadcast clock parameters. */
data class GnssVirtualClock(
    val referenceEpochMillis: Long,
    val offsetSeconds: Double = 0.0,
    val driftSecondsPerSecond: Double = 0.0,
) {
    init {
        require(referenceEpochMillis >= 0)
        require(offsetSeconds.isFinite() && driftSecondsPerSecond.isFinite())
    }

    fun offsetAt(atMillis: Long): Double = offsetSeconds +
        (atMillis.toDouble() - referenceEpochMillis.toDouble()) / 1000.0 * driftSecondsPerSecond
}

/**
 * A continuous trajectory and clock owned by a virtual source, not an instantaneous position.
 * The source defines its validity domain. Ideal deterministic worlds may cover all nonnegative
 * epochs; that says nothing about the validity of a real broadcast upload or an almanac.
 * A local quantity scenario may depend on the observer as part of its hypothetical world.
 */
class GnssSimulatedNavigation(
    val constellation: Constellation,
    val svid: Int,
    val provenance: GnssOrbitProvenance,
    val validFromMillis: Long,
    val validUntilMillis: Long,
    val clock: GnssVirtualClock,
    private val trajectory: (GnssSkyRequest) -> EcefPosition,
) {
    init {
        require(provenance.kind == GnssOrbitSourceKind.VIRTUAL)
        require(GnssSatelliteIds.nmeaId(constellation, svid) != null)
        require(validFromMillis >= 0 && validUntilMillis >= validFromMillis)
    }

    fun positionAt(request: GnssSkyRequest): EcefPosition? {
        if (request.atMillis !in validFromMillis..validUntilMillis || !clock.offsetAt(request.atMillis).isFinite())
            return null
        return trajectory(request)
    }

    fun matches(orbit: GnssOrbitPosition, request: GnssSkyRequest): Boolean =
        orbit.constellation == constellation && orbit.svid == svid && orbit.provenance == provenance &&
            positionAt(request) == orbit.position
}
```

`core/src/main/kotlin/com/system/location/service/core/gnss/GnssSimulatedReceiver.kt`:

```kt
package com.system.location.service.core.gnss

import kotlin.math.*

data class GnssReceiverSignal(
    val satellite: GnssSatellite,
    val tracked: Boolean,
    val simulatedNavigation: Boolean,
)

/**
 * A steady-state hypothetical receiver, not a claim about measured CN0 or navigation bits.
 * Slant-range loss, bounded atmospheric loss, environment attenuation and slow deterministic
 * fading are separate from orbit geometry. A captured cold-start window is never looped here.
 */
class GnssSimulatedReceiver(private val seed: Long) {
    fun observe(orbit: GnssOrbitPosition, request: GnssSkyRequest,
        environment: GnssSimulationEnvironment, navigation: GnssSimulatedNavigation? = null,
        calibration: GnssAutonomousSignalCalibration? = null): GnssReceiverSignal? {
        require(navigation == null || navigation.matches(orbit, request)) {
            "Synthetic trajectory/clock does not match this orbit source, identity or epoch"
        }
        val line = GnssObserverGeometry.lineOfSight(request.observer, request.altitudeMeters, orbit.position)
            ?: return null
        if (!line.aboveHorizon) return null
        // At exact zenith the azimuth is undefined; use an explicit presentation convention.
        val azimuth = line.azimuthDegrees ?: 0.0
        val elevation = line.elevationDegrees
        val identity = seed xor (orbit.constellation.ordinal.toLong() shl 32) xor orbit.svid.toLong()
        val phase = java.util.Random(identity).nextDouble() * 2 * PI
        val environmentPhase = java.util.Random(seed).nextDouble() * 2 * PI
        val clockPhase = (request.atMillis % 240_000) / 240_000.0 * 2 * PI
        val fading = 1.5 * sin(clockPhase + phase) + 0.5 * sin(clockPhase * 2 + phase * 3)
        val sine = sin(Math.toRadians(elevation))
        val atmosphericLoss = 1.5 * (1 / sqrt(sine * sine + 0.01) - 1 / sqrt(1.01))
        val environmentLoss = when (environment) {
            GnssSimulationEnvironment.OPEN_SKY -> 0.0
            GnssSimulationEnvironment.INDOOR -> 30.0
            GnssSimulationEnvironment.URBAN -> 6.0 + 12.0 *
                (0.5 + 0.5 * sin(Math.toRadians(azimuth) * 2 + environmentPhase)) * exp(-elevation / 25)
        }
        val baseline = calibration?.cn0At(orbit, elevation) ?: (45.0 - atmosphericLoss)
        val cn0 = (baseline - 20 * log10(line.rangeMeters / 20_200_000.0) -
            environmentLoss + fading).coerceIn(0.0, GnssFrame.MAX_CN0_DB_HZ.toDouble()).toFloat()
        val tracked = cn0 >= 18f
        val hasNavigation = orbit.hasEphemeris || navigation != null
        // These are candidate usage flags. The final combined observation matrix must still
        // have sufficient independent observations and rank before output can claim a fix.
        val usedCandidate = tracked && cn0 >= 25f && elevation >= 5.0 && hasNavigation
        val displayAzimuth = azimuth.toFloat().let { if (it >= 360f) 0f else it }
        val satellite = GnssSatellite(orbit.constellation, orbit.svid, elevation.toFloat(), displayAzimuth,
            cn0, usedCandidate, hasNavigation, orbit.hasAlmanac, orbit.carrierHz ?: carrier(orbit.constellation))
        return GnssReceiverSignal(satellite, tracked, navigation != null)
    }

    private fun carrier(constellation: Constellation): Float? = when (constellation) {
        Constellation.GPS, Constellation.GALILEO, Constellation.QZSS, Constellation.SBAS -> 1_575_420_000f
        Constellation.BEIDOU -> 1_561_098_000f
        Constellation.IRNSS -> 1_176_450_000f
        // A GLONASS slot number does not establish its FDMA channel.
        Constellation.GLONASS -> null
    }
}
```

`core/src/main/kotlin/com/system/location/service/core/gnss/GnssSimulationPolicy.kt`:

```kt
package com.system.location.service.core.gnss

import com.system.location.service.core.geo.Wgs84
import kotlinx.serialization.Serializable

/** Replay preserves the recording's sky; AUTO and AUTONOMOUS compute the target sky. */
@Serializable
enum class GnssSimulationMode { AUTO, REPLAY, AUTONOMOUS, OFF }

@Serializable
enum class GnssMinimumPolicy { PHYSICAL_FIRST, GUARANTEE_QUANTITY }

/** The simulated environment is independent of the handset's actual reception environment. */
@Serializable
enum class GnssSimulationEnvironment { OPEN_SKY, URBAN, INDOOR }

@Serializable
data class GnssSimulationPolicy(
    val mode: GnssSimulationMode = GnssSimulationMode.AUTONOMOUS,
    val minimumPolicy: GnssMinimumPolicy = GnssMinimumPolicy.GUARANTEE_QUANTITY,
    val environment: GnssSimulationEnvironment = GnssSimulationEnvironment.OPEN_SKY,
    val virtualSeed: Long = 0,
) {
    companion object { const val DEFAULT_MINIMUM_SATELLITES = 59 }
}

enum class GnssOrbitSourceKind { BROADCAST_EPHEMERIS, ALMANAC, OFFLINE_ORBIT, VIRTUAL }

/** Resource identity describes its original epoch, never the last download attempt. */
data class GnssOrbitProvenance(
    val resourceId: String,
    val revision: String,
    val source: String,
    val referenceEpochMillis: Long,
    val kind: GnssOrbitSourceKind,
) {
    init {
        require(resourceId.isNotBlank() && revision.isNotBlank() && source.isNotBlank())
        require(referenceEpochMillis >= 0)
    }
}

data class GnssSkyRequest(
    val atMillis: Long,
    val observer: Wgs84,
    val altitudeMeters: Double,
) {
    init { require(atMillis >= 0 && altitudeMeters.isFinite()) }
}

/** No angles or measured receiver state: those are computed after orbital selection. */
data class GnssOrbitPosition(
    val constellation: Constellation,
    val svid: Int,
    val position: EcefPosition,
    val provenance: GnssOrbitProvenance,
    val hasEphemeris: Boolean,
    val hasAlmanac: Boolean,
    /** Signal selected by the adapter; a GLONASS slot does not itself establish an FCN. */
    val carrierHz: Float? = null,
    /** Only explicit virtual-world trajectory/clock knowledge can supply synthetic navigation. */
    val simulatedNavigation: GnssSimulatedNavigation? = null,
) {
    init {
        require(GnssSatelliteIds.nmeaId(constellation, svid) != null)
        require(carrierHz == null || (carrierHz.isFinite() && carrierHz > 0))
    }
}

/**
 * Each adapter owns its system-specific time, health and age checks. Unusable records must
 * be omitted with diagnostics, permitting other sources to supply the same identity.
 * Positions use WGS84-compatible ECEF axes at the requested epoch; adapters must explicitly
 * transform their native frame. This contract is approximate sky geometry, not pseudorange.
 */
interface GnssOrbitProvider {
    val kind: GnssOrbitSourceKind
    fun positions(request: GnssSkyRequest): GnssOrbitBatch
}

data class GnssOrbitBatch(
    val positions: List<GnssOrbitPosition>,
    val diagnostics: List<String> = emptyList(),
    /** Includes known unhealthy/stale identities omitted from positions; never reuse as additions. */
    val reservedIdentities: Set<Pair<Constellation, Int>> = positions.map { it.constellation to it.svid }.toSet(),
    /** Applicable negative health/service evidence blocks lower-priority fallbacks. */
    val blockedIdentities: Set<Pair<Constellation, Int>> = emptySet(),
) {
    init {
        require(positions.map { it.constellation to it.svid }.distinct().size == positions.size)
        require(positions.all { (it.constellation to it.svid) in reservedIdentities })
        require(reservedIdentities.containsAll(blockedIdentities))
        require(positions.none { (it.constellation to it.svid) in blockedIdentities })
    }
}

/**
 * Resolves satellite orbits across providers using explicit source priorities.
 *
 * Selects the highest-priority available position per satellite identity,
 * preserves reserved identities, and prevents lower-priority fallbacks
 * from overriding applicable negative health evidence.
 *
 * Future improvements may include structured diagnostics, reduced
 * intermediate allocations, and more granular provider failure handling.
 */
class GnssOrbitResolver(providers: List<GnssOrbitProvider>) {
    private val providers = providers.sortedBy { it.kind.ordinal }.toList()

    fun positions(request: GnssSkyRequest): GnssOrbitBatch {
        val selected = linkedMapOf<Pair<Constellation, Int>, GnssOrbitPosition>()
        val diagnostics = mutableListOf<String>()
        val reserved = mutableSetOf<Pair<Constellation, Int>>()
        val blocked = mutableSetOf<Pair<Constellation, Int>>()
        for (provider in providers) {
            val batch = provider.positions(request)
            require(batch.positions.all { it.provenance.kind == provider.kind }) {
                "Orbit provider returned an inconsistent source kind"
            }
            diagnostics += batch.diagnostics
            reserved += batch.reservedIdentities
            for (position in batch.positions) {
                val identity = position.constellation to position.svid
                if (identity !in blocked) selected.putIfAbsent(identity, position)
            }
            blocked += batch.blockedIdentities
        }
        return GnssOrbitBatch(selected.values.toList(), diagnostics, reserved.toSet(), blocked - selected.keys)
    }
}
```

`core/src/main/kotlin/com/system/location/service/core/gnss/GnssUtcTimeScale.kt`:

```kt
package com.system.location.service.core.gnss

/** An effective offset at a POSIX UTC instant, from a versioned IERS leap-second resource. */
data class GnssUtcOffset(val effectiveAtMillis: Long, val taiMinusUtcSeconds: Int)

data class UtcGpsConversion(val time: GpsTime?, val reason: String? = null)
data class GpsUtcConversion(val utcMillis: Long?, val reason: String? = null)

/**
 * Converts representable POSIX UTC instants to nominal GPS time using TAI-GPS = 19 seconds.
 * POSIX cannot represent 23:59:60; this API does not invent a UTC leap-second timestamp.
 * Expired tables do not silently assume that no future leap second has occurred.
 * Sub-microsecond system-clock realizations require separate broadcast time corrections.
 * Resource format: https://hpiers.obspm.fr/iers/bul/bulc/ntp/leap-seconds.list
 */
class GnssUtcTimeScale(offsets: List<GnssUtcOffset>, val expiresAtMillis: Long) {
    private val offsets = offsets.toList()

    init {
        require(offsets.isNotEmpty() && offsets.first().effectiveAtMillis <= GPS_EPOCH_MILLIS)
        require(offsets.all { it.taiMinusUtcSeconds in 0..1000 })
        require(offsets.zipWithNext().all { (a, b) ->
            b.effectiveAtMillis > a.effectiveAtMillis &&
                kotlin.math.abs(b.taiMinusUtcSeconds - a.taiMinusUtcSeconds) == 1
        })
        require(expiresAtMillis > offsets.last().effectiveAtMillis && expiresAtMillis > GPS_EPOCH_MILLIS)
        require(offsets.last { it.effectiveAtMillis <= GPS_EPOCH_MILLIS }.taiMinusUtcSeconds == 19)
    }

    fun gpsAtUtcMillis(utcMillis: Long): UtcGpsConversion {
        if (utcMillis < GPS_EPOCH_MILLIS) return UtcGpsConversion(null, "UTC precedes GPS epoch")
        if (utcMillis >= expiresAtMillis) return UtcGpsConversion(null, "UTC leap-second resource expired")
        val offset = offsets.last { it.effectiveAtMillis <= utcMillis }.taiMinusUtcSeconds - 19
        return convert(utcMillis, offset)
    }

    /**
     * Last-known-offset conversion used only when the bundled IERS table has expired.
     *
     * A future leap second cannot be inferred; the caller gets a deterministic GPS time from the
     * last published TAI-UTC value instead of losing the whole synthetic receiver. This is a
     * degraded fallback, not a claim that the table is current.
     */
    fun gpsAtUtcMillisClamped(utcMillis: Long): UtcGpsConversion {
        if (utcMillis < GPS_EPOCH_MILLIS) return UtcGpsConversion(null, "UTC precedes GPS epoch")
        val offset = offsets.last().taiMinusUtcSeconds - 19
        return convert(utcMillis, offset).copy(
            reason = "UTC leap-second resource expired; using last known offset",
        )
    }

    private fun convert(utcMillis: Long, offsetSeconds: Int): UtcGpsConversion {
        // Work in milliseconds relative to the origin; preserve sub-second precision before
        // converting only the within-week remainder to Double.
        val gpsMillis = utcMillis - GPS_EPOCH_MILLIS + offsetSeconds * 1000L
        val week = gpsMillis / MILLIS_PER_WEEK
        if (week > Int.MAX_VALUE) return UtcGpsConversion(null, "GPS week outside supported range")
        return UtcGpsConversion(GpsTime(week.toInt(), gpsMillis % MILLIS_PER_WEEK / 1000.0))
    }

    /** Millisecond-resolution inverse; the inserted leap second has no POSIX representation. */
    fun utcAtGpsTime(time: GpsTime): GpsUtcConversion {
        val gpsMillis = time.week * MILLIS_PER_WEEK + kotlin.math.round(time.secondsOfWeek * 1000).toLong()
        val candidates = offsets.map { it.taiMinusUtcSeconds - 19 }.distinct().map { offset ->
            GPS_EPOCH_MILLIS + gpsMillis - offset * 1000L
        }.filter { candidate ->
            val decoded = gpsAtUtcMillis(candidate).time
            decoded != null && kotlin.math.abs(decoded.secondsSince(time)) <= 0.000501
        }
        return if (candidates.size == 1) GpsUtcConversion(candidates.single())
        else GpsUtcConversion(null, "GPS instant outside UTC resource or not representable in POSIX UTC")
    }

    companion object {
        const val GPS_EPOCH_MILLIS = 315_964_800_000L
        private const val MILLIS_PER_WEEK = 604_800_000L
        private const val NTP_UNIX_OFFSET_SECONDS = 2_208_988_800L

        fun parseIers(text: String): GnssUtcTimeScale {
            require(text.toByteArray(Charsets.UTF_8).size <= 65536) { "UTC resource too large" }
            var expiry: Long? = null
            val offsets = mutableListOf<GnssUtcOffset>()
            fun ntpMillis(token: String): Long = Math.multiplyExact(
                Math.subtractExact(token.toLong(), NTP_UNIX_OFFSET_SECONDS), 1000)
            for (raw in text.lineSequence()) {
                val line = raw.trim()
                if (line.startsWith("#@")) {
                    require(expiry == null) { "Duplicate UTC expiry" }
                    expiry = ntpMillis(line.substring(2).trim().substringBefore('#').trim())
                } else if (line.isNotEmpty() && !line.startsWith('#')) {
                    val parts = line.substringBefore('#').trim().split(Regex("\\s+"))
                    require(parts.size == 2 && offsets.size < 256) { "Invalid UTC offset record" }
                    offsets += GnssUtcOffset(ntpMillis(parts[0]), parts[1].toInt())
                }
            }
            return GnssUtcTimeScale(offsets, requireNotNull(expiry) { "Missing UTC resource expiry" })
        }
    }
}
```

`core/src/main/kotlin/com/system/location/service/core/gnss/GnssVirtualSkySupplement.kt`:

```kt
package com.system.location.service.core.gnss

import kotlin.math.*

/** Supplied by the output adapters after verification, not inferred from a UI slider. */
data class GnssOutputLimits(val maxVisible: Int, val maxPerTalker: Int, val maxUsed: Int) {
    init { require(maxVisible > 0 && maxPerTalker > 0 && maxUsed in 1..minOf(maxVisible, 99)) }
}

data class GnssVirtualSupplementResult(
    val positions: List<GnssOrbitPosition>,
    val availableCapacity: Int,
    val diagnostics: List<String>,
)

/**
 * Explicit observer-relative hypothetical sky for quantity tests. This is not a Walker orbit
 * or a claim about actual in-orbit satellites. Reserved identities include hidden orbital
 * records, so supplementation never lifts one of those records above the horizon.
 */
class GnssVirtualSkySupplement(
    identities: List<Pair<Constellation, Int>>,
    val outputLimits: GnssOutputLimits,
    private val seed: Long,
) {
    private val identities = identities.toList()
    private val provenance = GnssOrbitProvenance("virtual-quantity-sky", "1",
        "Portal observer-relative hypothetical quantity scenario", 0, GnssOrbitSourceKind.VIRTUAL)
    private val navigationModels by lazy {
        this.identities.associateWith { identity ->
            GnssSimulatedNavigation(identity.first, identity.second, provenance,
                0, Long.MAX_VALUE, GnssVirtualClock(0)) { at -> trajectory(at, identity) }
        }
    }

    init {
        require(identities.distinct().size == identities.size)
        require(identities.all { (constellation, svid) -> GnssSatelliteIds.nmeaId(constellation, svid) != null })
    }

    fun supplement(request: GnssSkyRequest, visible: List<GnssOrbitPosition>,
        reserved: Set<Pair<Constellation, Int>>, minimum: Int): GnssVirtualSupplementResult {
        require(minimum >= 0)
        require(visible.map { it.constellation to it.svid }.distinct().size == visible.size)
        val occupied = reserved + visible.map { it.constellation to it.svid }
        val counts = visible.groupingBy { talker(it.constellation) }.eachCount().toMutableMap()
        if (visible.size > outputLimits.maxVisible || counts.values.any { it > outputLimits.maxPerTalker })
            return GnssVirtualSupplementResult(emptyList(), visible.size,
                listOf("原始天空超出已验证输出限制，不能执行数量保证；保留原始天空供诊断"))
        val free = identities.filter { it !in occupied }.filter { identity ->
            val group = talker(identity.first)
            val count = counts[group] ?: 0
            if (count >= outputLimits.maxPerTalker) false else { counts[group] = count + 1; true }
        }
        val capacity = minOf(outputLimits.maxVisible, visible.size + free.size)
        if (minimum > capacity) return GnssVirtualSupplementResult(emptyList(), capacity,
            listOf("无法保证卫星下限 $minimum：当前身份空间和输出限制最多支持 $capacity 颗；保留原始天空"))
        val shortage = (minimum - visible.size).coerceAtLeast(0)
        val additions = free.take(shortage).map { identity -> position(request, identity) }
        val diagnostics = if (additions.isEmpty()) emptyList() else
            listOf("数量保证：增加 ${additions.size} 颗观察者局部虚拟卫星，不代表真实轨道")
        return GnssVirtualSupplementResult(additions, capacity, diagnostics)
    }

    private fun position(request: GnssSkyRequest, identity: Pair<Constellation, Int>): GnssOrbitPosition {
        val navigation = navigationModels.getValue(identity)
        return GnssOrbitPosition(identity.first, identity.second, requireNotNull(navigation.positionAt(request)), provenance,
            hasEphemeris = false, hasAlmanac = false, simulatedNavigation = navigation)
    }

    private fun trajectory(request: GnssSkyRequest, identity: Pair<Constellation, Int>): EcefPosition {
        val index = identities.indexOf(identity)
        val phase = java.util.Random(seed).nextDouble() * 2 * PI
        val longitude = Math.toRadians(request.observer.longitude)
        val latitude = Math.toRadians(request.observer.latitude)
        val azimuth = phase + index * PI * (3 - sqrt(5.0)) +
            (request.atMillis % 43_200_000) / 43_200_000.0 * 2 * PI + 0.5 * sin(longitude)
        val elevation = Math.toRadians(15 + 65 * (0.5 + 0.5 * sin(index * 1.71 + phase +
            (request.atMillis % 50_400_000) / 50_400_000.0 * 2 * PI + 0.3 * sin(latitude))))
        val range = 23_000_000.0
        val east = range * cos(elevation) * sin(azimuth)
        val north = range * cos(elevation) * cos(azimuth)
        val up = range * sin(elevation)
        val origin = GnssObserverGeometry.ecef(request.observer, request.altitudeMeters)
        return EcefPosition(
            origin.xMeters - sin(longitude) * east - sin(latitude) * cos(longitude) * north + cos(latitude) * cos(longitude) * up,
            origin.yMeters + cos(longitude) * east - sin(latitude) * sin(longitude) * north + cos(latitude) * sin(longitude) * up,
            origin.zMeters + cos(latitude) * north + sin(latitude) * up,
        )
    }

    private fun talker(constellation: Constellation) = when (constellation) {
        Constellation.SBAS -> Constellation.GPS
        else -> constellation
    }
}
```

`core/src/main/kotlin/com/system/location/service/core/gnss/GnssWeekTime.kt`:

```kt
package com.system.location.service.core.gnss

import kotlin.math.floor

/** Canonical Double week/TOW representation, shared by system-time arithmetic and GGTO. */
internal object GnssWeekTime {
    fun normalize(week: Long, seconds: Double): Pair<Int, Double>? {
        if (!seconds.isFinite()) return null
        var change = floor(seconds / 604800.0)
        // Division of the smallest negative subnormal values can underflow to -0.0.
        if (seconds < 0.0 && change == 0.0) change = -1.0
        // Check before converting arbitrarily large Double shifts to Long or adding weeks.
        if (change < -week.toDouble() || change > Int.MAX_VALUE.toDouble() - week) return null
        var normalizedWeek = week + change.toLong()
        var tow = seconds - change * 604800.0
        // A negative sub-ULP offset can round the preceding week's remainder to 604800.
        // Canonicalize that rounded representation, without accepting a negative epoch.
        if (tow == 604800.0) { normalizedWeek++; tow = 0.0 }
        if (normalizedWeek > Int.MAX_VALUE || tow !in 0.0..<604800.0) return null
        return normalizedWeek.toInt() to tow
    }
}

```

`core/src/main/kotlin/com/system/location/service/core/gnss/GpsAlmanacOrbitProvider.kt`:

```kt
package com.system.location.service.core.gnss

/** A complete immutable Yuma upload, independent of local receiver capture or boot identity. */
class GpsAlmanacOrbitProvider(
    records: List<GpsYumaAlmanac>,
    private val provenance: GnssOrbitProvenance,
    private val utc: GnssUtcTimeScale,
    private val maximumEpochDistanceSeconds: Double,
) : GnssOrbitProvider {
    private val records = records.toList()
    override val kind = GnssOrbitSourceKind.ALMANAC

    init {
        require(records.isNotEmpty() && records.size <= 32)
        require(records.map { it.svid }.distinct().size == records.size)
        require(records.map { it.referenceTime }.distinct().size == 1)
        require(provenance.kind == kind)
        require(maximumEpochDistanceSeconds.isFinite() && maximumEpochDistanceSeconds >= 0)
        // Metadata and orbital epoch must describe the same resource, including resolved era.
        val reference = utc.gpsAtUtcMillis(provenance.referenceEpochMillis).time
        require(reference != null && kotlin.math.abs(reference.secondsSince(records.first().referenceTime)) <= 0.001)
    }

    override fun positions(request: GnssSkyRequest): GnssOrbitBatch {
        val reserved = records.map { Constellation.GPS to it.svid }.toSet()
        val conversion = utc.gpsAtUtcMillis(request.atMillis)
        val time = conversion.time ?: return GnssOrbitBatch(emptyList(), listOf(requireNotNull(conversion.reason)), reserved)
        val diagnostics = mutableListOf<String>()
        val positions = records.mapNotNull { record ->
            val result = GpsAlmanacPropagator.position(record, time, maximumEpochDistanceSeconds)
            val position = result.position
            if (position == null) {
                diagnostics += "GPS:${record.svid}: ${result.reason}"
                null
            } else GnssOrbitPosition(Constellation.GPS, record.svid, position, provenance,
                hasEphemeris = false, hasAlmanac = true)
        }
        val blocked = records.filter { it.health != 0 &&
            kotlin.math.abs(time.secondsSince(it.referenceTime)) <= maximumEpochDistanceSeconds }
            .map { Constellation.GPS to it.svid }.toSet()
        return GnssOrbitBatch(positions, diagnostics, reserved, blocked)
    }
}
```

`core/src/main/kotlin/com/system/location/service/core/gnss/GpsAlmanacPropagator.kt`:

```kt
package com.system.location.service.core.gnss

import kotlin.math.*

data class GpsAlmanacPositionResult(val position: EcefPosition?, val reason: String? = null)

/**
 * IS-GPS-200N 20.3.3.5.2.1 / Table 20-IV with omitted correction terms zero.
 * Yuma inclination is already absolute. Output is approximate ECEF sky geometry at the
 * supplied GPS epoch, not a measured signal or precision reception-time observable.
 * The caller chooses a finite age budget for its application; this is not an accuracy warranty
 * or a universal normative almanac lifetime. Absolute age is checked before angle reduction.
 * https://archive.gps.gov/technical/icwg/IS-GPS-200N.pdf
 */
object GpsAlmanacPropagator {
    fun position(almanac: GpsYumaAlmanac, time: GpsTime,
        maximumEpochDistanceSeconds: Double): GpsAlmanacPositionResult {
        require(maximumEpochDistanceSeconds.isFinite() && maximumEpochDistanceSeconds >= 0)
        val age = time.secondsSince(almanac.referenceTime)
        if (abs(age) > maximumEpochDistanceSeconds)
            return GpsAlmanacPositionResult(null, "outside configured GPS almanac age budget")
        if (almanac.health != 0)
            return GpsAlmanacPositionResult(null, "GPS almanac satellite is not healthy")
        val axis = almanac.sqrtSemiMajorAxis * almanac.sqrtSemiMajorAxis
        val meanMotion = sqrt(GpsBroadcastPropagator.EARTH_MU / (axis * axis * axis))
        val meanAnomaly = (almanac.meanAnomalyRad + meanMotion * age) % (2 * PI)
        var eccentricAnomaly = meanAnomaly
        var converged = false
        for (iteration in 1..20) {
            val step = (eccentricAnomaly - almanac.eccentricity * sin(eccentricAnomaly) - meanAnomaly) /
                (1 - almanac.eccentricity * cos(eccentricAnomaly))
            eccentricAnomaly -= step
            if (abs(step) <= 1e-14) { converged = true; break }
        }
        if (!converged || !eccentricAnomaly.isFinite())
            return GpsAlmanacPositionResult(null, "GPS almanac Kepler equation did not converge")
        // Orbital-plane Cartesian coordinates avoid a second angular conversion near perigee.
        val x = axis * (cos(eccentricAnomaly) - almanac.eccentricity)
        val y = axis * sqrt(1 - almanac.eccentricity * almanac.eccentricity) * sin(eccentricAnomaly)
        val argument = almanac.argumentOfPerigeeRad
        val orbitalX = x * cos(argument) - y * sin(argument)
        val orbitalY = x * sin(argument) + y * cos(argument)
        val rotation = GpsBroadcastPropagator.EARTH_ROTATION_RAD_PER_SECOND
        val node = almanac.ascendingNodeRad + (almanac.ascendingNodeRateRadPerSecond - rotation) * age -
            rotation * almanac.referenceTime.secondsOfWeek
        val inclination = almanac.inclinationRad
        val output = listOf(
            orbitalX * cos(node) - orbitalY * cos(inclination) * sin(node),
            orbitalX * sin(node) + orbitalY * cos(inclination) * cos(node),
            orbitalY * sin(inclination),
        )
        if (!output.all(Double::isFinite))
            return GpsAlmanacPositionResult(null, "non-finite GPS almanac position")
        return GpsAlmanacPositionResult(EcefPosition(output[0], output[1], output[2]))
    }
}
```

`core/src/main/kotlin/com/system/location/service/core/gnss/GpsAlmanacResource.kt`:

```kt
package com.system.location.service.core.gnss

import java.security.MessageDigest
import kotlinx.serialization.Serializable
import kotlinx.serialization.json.Json

/** Download time is metadata, never the orbital reference epoch or an age reset. */
@Serializable
data class GpsAlmanacResource(
    val formatVersion: Int = 1,
    val sourceUrl: String,
    val sha256: String,
    val resolvedReferenceWeek: Int,
    val referenceEpochMillis: Long,
    val downloadedAtMillis: Long,
    val yuma: String,
) {
    init {
        require(formatVersion == 1 && sourceUrl.startsWith("https://") && sourceUrl.length <= 2048)
        require(sha256.matches(Regex("[a-f0-9]{64}")))
        require(resolvedReferenceWeek >= 0 && referenceEpochMillis >= 0 && downloadedAtMillis >= 0)
        require(yuma.toByteArray(Charsets.UTF_8).size <= GpsYumaParser.MAX_BYTES)
    }

    fun provider(utc: GnssUtcTimeScale, maximumEpochDistanceSeconds: Double): GpsAlmanacOrbitProvider {
        require(digest(yuma) == sha256) { "GPS resource digest mismatch" }
        val records = GpsYumaParser.parse(yuma, resolvedReferenceWeek)
        require(records.first().referenceTime.week == resolvedReferenceWeek)
        return GpsAlmanacOrbitProvider(records, GnssOrbitProvenance("gps-yuma", sha256, sourceUrl,
            referenceEpochMillis, GnssOrbitSourceKind.ALMANAC), utc, maximumEpochDistanceSeconds)
    }

    companion object {
        private val json = Json { encodeDefaults = true }
        const val MAX_BYTES = 524_288

        fun importYuma(yuma: String, sourceUrl: String, approximateEpochMillis: Long,
            downloadedAtMillis: Long, utc: GnssUtcTimeScale): GpsAlmanacResource {
            val anchor = requireNotNull(utc.gpsAtUtcMillis(approximateEpochMillis).time) { "Unknown UTC week anchor" }
            val records = GpsYumaParser.parse(yuma, anchor.week)
            val reference = records.first().referenceTime
            val referenceUtc = requireNotNull(utc.utcAtGpsTime(reference).utcMillis) { "Unknown almanac UTC epoch" }
            return GpsAlmanacResource(sourceUrl = sourceUrl, sha256 = digest(yuma),
                resolvedReferenceWeek = reference.week, referenceEpochMillis = referenceUtc,
                downloadedAtMillis = downloadedAtMillis, yuma = yuma)
        }

        fun decode(text: String): GpsAlmanacResource {
            require(text.toByteArray(Charsets.UTF_8).size <= MAX_BYTES) { "GPS resource too large" }
            return json.decodeFromString(serializer(), text)
        }

        fun encode(resource: GpsAlmanacResource): String = json.encodeToString(serializer(), resource).also {
            require(it.toByteArray(Charsets.UTF_8).size <= MAX_BYTES) { "GPS resource too large" }
        }

        private fun digest(text: String): String = MessageDigest.getInstance("SHA-256")
            .digest(text.toByteArray(Charsets.UTF_8)).joinToString("") { "%02x".format(it.toInt() and 255) }
    }
}
```

`core/src/main/kotlin/com/system/location/service/core/gnss/GpsAlmanacResourceStore.kt`:

```kt
package com.system.location.service.core.gnss

import java.io.File
import java.nio.file.Files
import java.nio.file.StandardCopyOption

/**
 * Validate before atomic promotion. Readers hold immutable providers; failed updates leave
 * the previous on-disk resource and any already published provider untouched.
 */
class GpsAlmanacResourceStore(private val file: File, private val utc: GnssUtcTimeScale) {
    @Synchronized
    fun load(): GpsAlmanacResource? {
        if (!file.exists()) return null
        require(file.isFile && file.length() <= GpsAlmanacResource.MAX_BYTES) { "Invalid GPS resource file" }
        return validated(file.readText(Charsets.UTF_8))
    }

    /** Import the complete candidate before touching disk, including its digest and epoch. */
    @Synchronized
    fun update(text: String): GpsAlmanacResource {
        val candidate = validated(text)
        // A delayed download must not roll a valid cache backwards. Same-epoch uploads may
        // change health and are allowed; download timestamps do not establish orbit freshness.
        val previous = runCatching { load() }.getOrNull()
        require(previous == null || candidate.referenceEpochMillis >= previous.referenceEpochMillis) {
            "GPS resource would roll back the cached orbital epoch"
        }
        val bytes = GpsAlmanacResource.encode(candidate).toByteArray(Charsets.UTF_8)
        val parent = requireNotNull(file.absoluteFile.parentFile)
        require(parent.isDirectory || parent.mkdirs()) { "Cannot create GPS resource directory" }
        val temporary = File.createTempFile("gps-orbit-", ".tmp", parent)
        try {
            temporary.outputStream().use { output -> output.write(bytes); output.fd.sync() }
            Files.move(temporary.toPath(), file.toPath(), StandardCopyOption.ATOMIC_MOVE,
                StandardCopyOption.REPLACE_EXISTING)
        } finally {
            temporary.delete()
        }
        return candidate
    }

    private fun validated(text: String): GpsAlmanacResource = GpsAlmanacResource.decode(text).also {
        // This checks completeness and metadata without asserting usefulness at today's epoch.
        // Zero age budget permits the resource's own reference epoch; per-use policy is separate.
        it.provider(utc, maximumEpochDistanceSeconds = 0.0)
    }
}

```

`core/src/main/kotlin/com/system/location/service/core/gnss/GpsBroadcastEphemeris.kt`:

```kt
package com.system.location.service.core.gnss

import kotlinx.serialization.Serializable

/** Full GPS system time, not UTC, Android elapsed time, or a truncated broadcast week. */
@Serializable
data class GpsTime(val week: Int, val secondsOfWeek: Double) {
    init {
        require(week >= 0 && secondsOfWeek.isFinite() && secondsOfWeek >= 0 && secondsOfWeek < SECONDS_PER_WEEK)
    }

    fun secondsSince(other: GpsTime): Double =
        (week.toLong() - other.week.toLong()).toDouble() * SECONDS_PER_WEEK + secondsOfWeek - other.secondsOfWeek

    fun plusSeconds(seconds: Double): GpsTime {
        require(seconds.isFinite())
        val normalized = requireNotNull(GnssWeekTime.normalize(week.toLong(), secondsOfWeek + seconds)) {
            "GPS time outside supported full-week range"
        }
        return GpsTime(normalized.first, normalized.second)
    }

    companion object { const val SECONDS_PER_WEEK = 604_800.0 }
}

/**
 * GPS LNAV parameters after parity, full-week resolution and subframe assembly.
 * Angular fields are radians, rates radians/second, clock coefficients seconds/second^n.
 * The decoder must supply the actual absolute fit interval; it cannot infer completeness from
 * GnssStatus.hasEphemeris. This type does not represent Galileo, BDS GEO or GLONASS ephemerides.
 * IS-GPS-200N 20.3.3.4, Tables 20-II/III/IV.
 */
@Serializable
data class GpsLnavEphemeris(
    val svid: Int,
    val toe: GpsTime,
    val toc: GpsTime,
    val validFrom: GpsTime,
    val validUntil: GpsTime,
    val iode2: Int,
    val iode3: Int,
    val iodc: Int,
    val health: Int,
    val sqrtSemiMajorAxis: Double,
    val eccentricity: Double,
    val inclinationRad: Double,
    val ascendingNodeRad: Double,
    val argumentOfPerigeeRad: Double,
    val meanAnomalyRad: Double,
    val deltaMeanMotionRadPerSecond: Double,
    val ascendingNodeRateRadPerSecond: Double,
    val inclinationRateRadPerSecond: Double,
    val cucRad: Double,
    val cusRad: Double,
    val crcMeters: Double,
    val crsMeters: Double,
    val cicRad: Double,
    val cisRad: Double,
    val af0Seconds: Double,
    val af1SecondsPerSecond: Double,
    val af2SecondsPerSecondSquared: Double,
    val tgdSeconds: Double,
) {
    init {
        require(svid in 1..32)
        require(iode2 in 0..255 && iode3 == iode2 && iodc in 0..1023 && iodc and 255 == iode2) {
            "inconsistent LNAV issue of data"
        }
        require(health in 0..63)
        require(toe.secondsSince(validFrom) >= 0 && validUntil.secondsSince(toe) >= 0 &&
            validUntil.secondsSince(validFrom) > 0) { "invalid absolute fit interval" }
        require(sqrtSemiMajorAxis in 2530.0..8192.0 && eccentricity in 0.0..0.03) {
            "GPS LNAV orbit outside specified range"
        }
        require(listOf(inclinationRad, ascendingNodeRad, argumentOfPerigeeRad, meanAnomalyRad,
            deltaMeanMotionRadPerSecond, ascendingNodeRateRadPerSecond, inclinationRateRadPerSecond,
            cucRad, cusRad, crcMeters, crsMeters, cicRad, cisRad,
            af0Seconds, af1SecondsPerSecond, af2SecondsPerSecondSquared, tgdSeconds).all(Double::isFinite))
    }
}
```

`core/src/main/kotlin/com/system/location/service/core/gnss/GpsBroadcastEvidence.kt`:

```kt
package com.system.location.service.core.gnss

import kotlinx.serialization.Serializable

/** Compact decoded evidence for authenticated IPC; not raw measurements or a live health service. */
@Serializable
data class GpsBroadcastEvidence(
    val clock: GpsElapsedClockEvidence,
    val ephemerides: List<DecodedGpsLnav>,
) {
    init {
        require(ephemerides.isNotEmpty() && ephemerides.size <= 32)
        require(ephemerides.map { it.ephemeris.svid }.distinct().size == ephemerides.size)
        val anchor = GpsTime(clock.gpsWeek, clock.gpsSecondsOfWeek)
        require(ephemerides.all {
            // Three CEI subframes end 18 seconds after the frame's transmission start.
            anchor.secondsSince(it.frameTransmissionTime.plusSeconds(18.0)) in
                -GpsElapsedClockEvidence.MAX_ANCHOR_UNCERTAINTY_SECONDS..MAX_BROADCAST_AGE_SECONDS
        }) { "broadcast evidence is not contemporaneous with receiver clock" }
    }

    companion object {
        // Simulation evidence freshness policy, not orbit fit or a guarantee of future health.
        const val MAX_BROADCAST_AGE_SECONDS = 1800.0

        fun fromCapture(capture: GnssCapture): GpsBroadcastEvidence? {
            val clock = GpsElapsedClockEvidence.fromCapture(capture) ?: return null
            // A navigation message alone does not prove that the receiver observed the identity
            // as visible. Only valid above-horizon status samples may authorize physical output.
            val observed = visibleGpsIdentities(capture.frames)
            val anchor = GpsTime(clock.gpsWeek, clock.gpsSecondsOfWeek)
            val decoded = GpsCaptureEphemerisDecoder.decode(capture).decoded.filter {
                it.ephemeris.svid in observed && anchor.secondsSince(it.frameTransmissionTime.plusSeconds(18.0)) in
                    -GpsElapsedClockEvidence.MAX_ANCHOR_UNCERTAINTY_SECONDS..MAX_BROADCAST_AGE_SECONDS
            }
            return if (decoded.isEmpty()) null else GpsBroadcastEvidence(clock, decoded)
        }

        internal fun visibleGpsIdentities(frames: List<GnssObservationFrame>): Set<Int> =
            frames.flatMap { it.satellites }.filter {
                it.constellation == Constellation.GPS && GnssCaptureValidator.isUsableSatellite(it) &&
                    (it.carrierHz == null || it.carrierHz.isFinite() && it.carrierHz > 0f)
            }.map { it.svid }.toSet()
    }
}
```
