`core/src/main/kotlin/com/system/location/service/core/gnss/GpsBroadcastPropagator.kt`:

```kt
package com.system.location.service.core.gnss

import kotlin.math.*

/** ECEF at GPS transmission time. clockBiasSeconds includes relativity, excludes signal TGD. */
data class GpsSatelliteState(val xMeters: Double, val yMeters: Double, val zMeters: Double,
    val clockBiasSeconds: Double)

data class GpsPropagationResult(val state: GpsSatelliteState?, val reason: String? = null)

/**
 * IS-GPS-200N Table 20-IV and 20.3.3.3.3.1. GPS LNAV only; broadcast harmonic parameters
 * already describe Earth-fixed coordinates. Never rotate these through a generic ECI orbit.
 * Input is full GPS TRANSMISSION time, after solving propagation delay/receiver-clock timing.
 * This component does not claim to decode raw messages or produce a complete observable frame.
 * https://archive.gps.gov/technical/icwg/IS-GPS-200N.pdf
 */
object GpsBroadcastPropagator {
    const val EARTH_MU = 3.986005e14
    const val EARTH_ROTATION_RAD_PER_SECOND = 7.2921151467e-5
    private const val RELATIVITY_F = -4.442807633e-10

    fun propagate(ephemeris: GpsLnavEphemeris, transmissionTime: GpsTime): GpsPropagationResult {
        val e = ephemeris
        // Check absolute fit validity BEFORE any periodic reduction; stale weeks cannot alias now.
        if (transmissionTime.secondsSince(e.validFrom) < 0 || e.validUntil.secondsSince(transmissionTime) < 0)
            return GpsPropagationResult(null, "outside absolute GPS ephemeris fit interval")
        if (e.health != 0) return GpsPropagationResult(null, "GPS satellite is not healthy")
        if (e.toc.secondsSince(e.validFrom) < 0 || e.validUntil.secondsSince(e.toc) < 0)
            return GpsPropagationResult(null, "clock reference outside validated fit interval")
        val tk = transmissionTime.secondsSince(e.toe)
        val axis = e.sqrtSemiMajorAxis * e.sqrtSemiMajorAxis
        val meanMotion = sqrt(EARTH_MU / (axis * axis * axis)) + e.deltaMeanMotionRadPerSecond
        if (!meanMotion.isFinite() || meanMotion <= 0) return GpsPropagationResult(null, "invalid GPS mean motion")
        val meanAnomaly = (e.meanAnomalyRad + meanMotion * tk) % (2 * PI)
        var eccentricAnomaly = meanAnomaly
        var converged = false
        for (iteration in 1..20) {
            val correction = (eccentricAnomaly - e.eccentricity * sin(eccentricAnomaly) - meanAnomaly) /
                (1 - e.eccentricity * cos(eccentricAnomaly))
            eccentricAnomaly -= correction
            if (iteration >= 3 && abs(correction) <= 1e-14) { converged = true; break }
        }
        if (!converged || !eccentricAnomaly.isFinite()) return GpsPropagationResult(null, "Kepler equation did not converge")
        val trueAnomaly = atan2(sqrt(1 - e.eccentricity * e.eccentricity) * sin(eccentricAnomaly),
            cos(eccentricAnomaly) - e.eccentricity)
        val phi = trueAnomaly + e.argumentOfPerigeeRad
        val sin2Phi = sin(2 * phi)
        val cos2Phi = cos(2 * phi)
        val u = phi + e.cusRad * sin2Phi + e.cucRad * cos2Phi
        val radius = axis * (1 - e.eccentricity * cos(eccentricAnomaly)) + e.crsMeters * sin2Phi + e.crcMeters * cos2Phi
        val inclination = e.inclinationRad + e.inclinationRateRadPerSecond * tk + e.cisRad * sin2Phi + e.cicRad * cos2Phi
        val node = e.ascendingNodeRad + (e.ascendingNodeRateRadPerSecond - EARTH_ROTATION_RAD_PER_SECOND) * tk -
            EARTH_ROTATION_RAD_PER_SECOND * e.toe.secondsOfWeek
        val orbitalX = radius * cos(u)
        val orbitalY = radius * sin(u)
        val dtClock = transmissionTime.secondsSince(e.toc)
        val clockBias = e.af0Seconds + e.af1SecondsPerSecond * dtClock + e.af2SecondsPerSecondSquared * dtClock * dtClock +
            RELATIVITY_F * e.eccentricity * e.sqrtSemiMajorAxis * sin(eccentricAnomaly)
        val state = GpsSatelliteState(
            orbitalX * cos(node) - orbitalY * cos(inclination) * sin(node),
            orbitalX * sin(node) + orbitalY * cos(inclination) * cos(node),
            orbitalY * sin(inclination), clockBias,
        )
        if (!listOf(state.xMeters, state.yMeters, state.zMeters, state.clockBiasSeconds).all(Double::isFinite) || radius <= 0)
            return GpsPropagationResult(null, "non-finite or invalid GPS propagation result")
        return GpsPropagationResult(state)
    }
}

```

`core/src/main/kotlin/com/system/location/service/core/gnss/GpsCaptureEphemerides.kt`:

```kt
package com.system.location.service.core.gnss

data class GpsCaptureEphemerides(
    val decoded: List<DecodedGpsLnav>,
    val diagnostics: List<String>,
)

/** Decode local capture evidence; no network orbit download, UTC offset guess, or catalog fallback. */
object GpsCaptureEphemerisDecoder {

    fun decode(capture: GnssCapture): GpsCaptureEphemerides {
        val diagnostics = linkedSetOf<String>()
        val clock = CaptureGpsClockAssociation(capture.measurements)
        val assembler = GpsLnavAssembler()
        val quarantined = mutableSetOf<Int>()
        val clockDomains = mutableSetOf<Int>()
        capture.navigation.filter { it.type == 0x0101 }.forEach { message ->
            // Arrival is only an approximate era/HOW reference. The actual orbit epoch comes
            // from parity-checked HOW/toe/toc, never from treating callback time as transmission.
            val associated = clock.atArrival(message.capturedElapsedRealtimeNanos)
            val reference = associated.reference
            if (reference == null) {
                associated.reason?.let { diagnostics += "GPS $it" }
                quarantined += message.svid
                return@forEach
            }
            clockDomains += reference.hardwareDiscontinuityCount
            val result = assembler.offer(message, reference.time)
            // Waiting for another subframe is diagnostic evidence, not a corrupt capture.
            result.reason?.let { diagnostics += "GPS ${message.svid}：$it" }
        }
        if (clockDomains.size > 1) return GpsCaptureEphemerides(emptyList(),
            (diagnostics + "GPS 采集跨接收机时钟重置，未拼接不同连续时钟域的星历").toList())
        val decoded = assembler.completed().groupBy { data ->
            val e = data.ephemeris
            Triple(e.svid, e.toe.week, e.toe.secondsOfWeek)
        }.mapNotNull { (_, repeated) ->
            if (repeated.first().ephemeris.svid in quarantined) return@mapNotNull null
            if (repeated.map { it.ephemeris }.distinct().size != 1) {
                diagnostics += "GPS ${repeated.first().ephemeris.svid}：同一星历历元存在冲突参数"
                null
            } else repeated.last()
        }
        return GpsCaptureEphemerides(decoded, diagnostics.toList())
    }
}
```

`core/src/main/kotlin/com/system/location/service/core/gnss/GpsElapsedClockEvidence.kt`:

```kt
package com.system.location.service.core.gnss

import kotlinx.serialization.Serializable
import kotlin.math.abs

/**
 * Receiver epoch associated with Android's elapsed clock on one boot. Advancing by elapsed SI
 * seconds is a geometric simulation time model, not a disciplined real-time GPS clock. Reported
 * uncertainties describe the anchor only; they are not a bound on future oscillator error.
 * No wall-clock, UTC, leap-second or week-number guess enters this association.
 */
@Serializable
data class GpsElapsedClockEvidence(
    val bootCount: Int,
    val gpsWeek: Int,
    val gpsSecondsOfWeek: Double,
    val elapsedRealtimeNanos: Long,
    val timeUncertaintySeconds: Double,
    val elapsedUncertaintySeconds: Double,
) {
    init {
        require(bootCount >= 0 && elapsedRealtimeNanos >= 0)
        GpsTime(gpsWeek, gpsSecondsOfWeek)
        require(timeUncertaintySeconds.isFinite() && timeUncertaintySeconds in 0.0..MAX_ANCHOR_UNCERTAINTY_SECONDS)
        require(elapsedUncertaintySeconds.isFinite() && elapsedUncertaintySeconds in 0.0..MAX_ANCHOR_UNCERTAINTY_SECONDS)
    }

    fun at(elapsedNanos: Long, currentBootCount: Int?): GpsTime? {
        if (currentBootCount != bootCount || elapsedNanos < elapsedRealtimeNanos) return null
        val delta = (elapsedNanos - elapsedRealtimeNanos) / 1e9
        if (delta > MAX_EXTRAPOLATION_SECONDS) return null
        return runCatching { GpsTime(gpsWeek, gpsSecondsOfWeek).plusSeconds(delta) }.getOrNull()
    }

    companion object {
        // Simulation clock freshness/quality policies, not broadcast fit or guaranteed clock accuracy.
        const val MAX_EXTRAPOLATION_SECONDS = 1800.0
        const val MAX_ANCHOR_UNCERTAINTY_SECONDS = 1e-3

        fun fromCapture(capture: GnssCapture): GpsElapsedClockEvidence? {
            val boot = capture.bootCount ?: return null
            if (capture.measurements.isEmpty()) return null
            // Do not hide a reset in a batch which was unusable as an anchor.
            if (capture.measurements.map { it.hardwareClockDiscontinuityCount }.distinct().size != 1) return null
            val anchors = capture.measurements.mapNotNull { batch ->
                if (batch.capturedAtMillis !in capture.startedAtMillis..capture.endedAtMillis) return@mapNotNull null
                val e = GpsReceiverClock.decode(batch).epoch ?: return@mapNotNull null
                val elapsed = e.elapsedRealtimeNanos ?: return@mapNotNull null
                val arrival = batch.capturedElapsedRealtimeNanos ?: return@mapNotNull null
                val clockUncertainty = e.timeUncertaintySeconds ?: return@mapNotNull null
                val elapsedUncertainty = e.elapsedRealtimeUncertaintySeconds ?: return@mapNotNull null
                if (arrival < elapsed || arrival - elapsed > 10_000_000_000L ||
                    clockUncertainty > MAX_ANCHOR_UNCERTAINTY_SECONDS || elapsedUncertainty > MAX_ANCHOR_UNCERTAINTY_SECONDS)
                    return@mapNotNull null
                e
            }.sortedBy { it.elapsedRealtimeNanos }
            if (anchors.size < 2) return null
            val last = anchors.last()
            if (last.elapsedRealtimeNanos!! - anchors.first().elapsedRealtimeNanos!! < 30_000_000_000L) return null
            if (anchors.any { e ->
                val delta = (last.elapsedRealtimeNanos - e.elapsedRealtimeNanos!!) / 1e9
                abs(last.time.secondsSince(e.time) - delta) > MAX_ANCHOR_UNCERTAINTY_SECONDS
            }) return null
            return GpsElapsedClockEvidence(boot, last.time.week, last.time.secondsOfWeek, last.elapsedRealtimeNanos,
                last.timeUncertaintySeconds!!, last.elapsedRealtimeUncertaintySeconds!!)
        }
    }
}
```

`core/src/main/kotlin/com/system/location/service/core/gnss/GpsEmpiricalSignalModel.kt`:

```kt
package com.system.location.service.core.gnss

import kotlin.math.abs
import kotlinx.serialization.Serializable

@Serializable
data class GpsEmpiricalSignal(
    val cn0DbHz: Double,
    /** Captured usage frequency, not a prediction of live receiver lock or future health. */
    val usedFraction: Double,
    val hasAlmanac: Boolean,
    val carrierHz: Float?,
) {
    init {
        require(cn0DbHz.isFinite() && cn0DbHz in 0.0..63.0)
        require(usedFraction.isFinite() && usedFraction in 0.0..1.0)
        require(carrierHz == null || carrierHz.isFinite() && carrierHz > 0f &&
            abs(carrierHz.toDouble() - GPS_L1_HZ) <= GPS_CARRIER_TOLERANCE_HZ)
    }
}

@Serializable
data class GpsEmpiricalSignalKnot(val elevation: Double, val signal: GpsEmpiricalSignal) {
    init { require(elevation.isFinite() && elevation in 0.0..90.0) }
}

/** Compact sufficient statistics for exactly the same empirical interpolator across IPC. */
@Serializable
data class GpsSignalCalibration(val knots: List<GpsEmpiricalSignalKnot>) {
    init {
        require(knots.size <= GnssCapture.MAX_FRAMES * 512)
        require(knots.zipWithNext().all { (a, b) -> a.elevation < b.elevation })
    }
}

private const val GPS_L1_HZ = 1_575_420_000.0
private const val GPS_CARRIER_TOLERANCE_HZ = 100_000.0

/**
 * Piecewise-linear conditional empirical means of GPS status CN0/usage versus elevation.
 * Uses this capture's environment only; it does not infer target-site obstructions or RF power.
 * No extrapolation outside observed elevations, no synthetic sine curve or signal-strength floor.
 * Known non-L1 carriers are excluded; unknown carriers stay unknown in the output.
 */
class GpsEmpiricalSignalModel(capture: GnssCapture) {
    internal val calibration: GpsSignalCalibration =
        if (capture.frames.none { it.signalObservations.isNotEmpty() } && capture.gpsSignalCalibration != null)
            capture.gpsSignalCalibration else fit(capture)
    private val knots = calibration.knots

    fun at(elevationDegrees: Double): GpsEmpiricalSignal? {
        require(elevationDegrees.isFinite() && elevationDegrees in 0.0..90.0)
        if (knots.isEmpty() || elevationDegrees < knots.first().elevation || elevationDegrees > knots.last().elevation)
            return null
        val rightIndex = knots.indexOfFirst { it.elevation >= elevationDegrees }
        val right = knots[rightIndex]
        if (right.elevation == elevationDegrees) return right.signal
        val left = knots[rightIndex - 1]
        val fraction = (elevationDegrees - left.elevation) / (right.elevation - left.elevation)
        fun mix(a: Double, b: Double) = a + (b - a) * fraction
        return GpsEmpiricalSignal(mix(left.signal.cn0DbHz, right.signal.cn0DbHz),
            mix(left.signal.usedFraction, right.signal.usedFraction),
            if (fraction < 0.5) left.signal.hasAlmanac else right.signal.hasAlmanac,
            left.signal.carrierHz.takeIf { it == right.signal.carrierHz })
    }

    private fun fit(capture: GnssCapture): GpsSignalCalibration = GpsSignalCalibration(capture.frames.flatMap { frame ->
        // Spacecraft projection may prefer a used L5 signal. It cannot replace captured L1 RF evidence.
        if (frame.signalObservations.isNotEmpty()) frame.signalObservations.map { it.satellite } else frame.satellites
    }.filter {
        it.constellation == Constellation.GPS && it.elevationDeg >= 0f && it.azimuthDeg < 360f &&
            it.cn0DbHz > 0f &&
            (it.carrierHz == null || abs(it.carrierHz.toDouble() - GPS_L1_HZ) <= GPS_CARRIER_TOLERANCE_HZ)
    }.groupBy { it.elevationDeg }.toSortedMap().map { (elevation, samples) ->
        GpsEmpiricalSignalKnot(elevation.toDouble(), GpsEmpiricalSignal(samples.map { it.cn0DbHz.toDouble() }.average(),
            samples.count { it.usedInFix }.toDouble() / samples.size,
            samples.count { it.hasAlmanac } * 2 >= samples.size,
            samples.map { it.carrierHz }.distinct().singleOrNull()))
    })
}
```

`core/src/main/kotlin/com/system/location/service/core/gnss/GpsIndependentPositionSolver.kt`:

```kt
package com.system.location.service.core.gnss

import kotlin.math.abs
import kotlin.math.hypot
import kotlin.math.sqrt

/** One code-phase range used by the independent receiver-side check. */
data class GpsRangeObservation(val satellite: EcefPosition, val meters: Double) {
    init {
        require(meters.isFinite() && meters > 0.0)
    }
}

data class GpsPositionSolution(
    val position: EcefPosition,
    val receiverClockBiasMeters: Double,
    val iterations: Int,
)

/**
 * Small independent least-squares GPS L1 position solver.
 *
 * It deliberately consumes only code ranges and satellite ECEF positions, not the target point or
 * Portal's synthetic receiver state. The device canary uses it to prove that the observations it
 * received actually converge to the configured target; production location injection does not call
 * this solver.
 */
object GpsIndependentPositionSolver {
    fun solve(
        observations: List<GpsRangeObservation>,
        initial: EcefPosition,
        maxIterations: Int = 100,
    ): GpsPositionSolution? {
        if (observations.size < 4 || maxIterations <= 0) return null
        var receiver = initial
        var clockMeters = 0.0
        repeat(maxIterations) { iteration ->
            val matrix = Array(observations.size) { row ->
                val observation = observations[row]
                val dx = receiver.xMeters - observation.satellite.xMeters
                val dy = receiver.yMeters - observation.satellite.yMeters
                val dz = receiver.zMeters - observation.satellite.zMeters
                val distance = hypot(hypot(dx, dy), dz)
                if (!distance.isFinite() || distance <= 0.0) return null
                doubleArrayOf(dx / distance, dy / distance, dz / distance, 1.0)
            }
            val residuals = DoubleArray(observations.size) { row ->
                val observation = observations[row]
                observation.meters - hypot(hypot(
                    receiver.xMeters - observation.satellite.xMeters,
                    receiver.yMeters - observation.satellite.yMeters,
                ), receiver.zMeters - observation.satellite.zMeters) - clockMeters
            }
            val step = leastSquaresQr(matrix, residuals) ?: return null
            receiver = EcefPosition(
                receiver.xMeters + step[0],
                receiver.yMeters + step[1],
                receiver.zMeters + step[2],
            )
            clockMeters += step[3]
            if (step.take(3).all { abs(it) < 1e-5 }) {
                return GpsPositionSolution(receiver, clockMeters, iteration + 1)
            }
        }
        return null
    }

    private fun leastSquaresQr(matrix: Array<DoubleArray>, values: DoubleArray): DoubleArray? {
        if (matrix.size < 4 || matrix.any { it.size != 4 }) return null
        val a = Array(matrix.size) { row -> matrix[row].copyOf() }
        val b = values.copyOf()
        for (column in 0..3) {
            val norm = sqrt((column until a.size).sumOf { a[it][column] * a[it][column] })
            if (!norm.isFinite() || norm <= 1e-10) return null
            val reflector = DoubleArray(a.size - column) { a[column + it][column] }
            reflector[0] += if (reflector[0] >= 0) norm else -norm
            val normSquared = reflector.sumOf { it * it }
            if (!normSquared.isFinite() || normSquared <= 1e-20) return null
            for (target in column..3) {
                val projection = 2 * reflector.indices.sumOf { reflector[it] * a[column + it][target] } / normSquared
                for (row in reflector.indices) a[column + row][target] -= projection * reflector[row]
            }
            val projection = 2 * reflector.indices.sumOf { reflector[it] * b[column + it] } / normSquared
            for (row in reflector.indices) b[column + row] -= projection * reflector[row]
        }
        val solution = DoubleArray(4)
        for (row in 3 downTo 0) {
            val diagonal = a[row][row]
            if (!diagonal.isFinite() || abs(diagonal) <= 1e-12) return null
            solution[row] = (b[row] - (row + 1..3).sumOf { a[row][it] * solution[it] }) / diagonal
            if (!solution[row].isFinite()) return null
        }
        return solution
    }
}
```

`core/src/main/kotlin/com/system/location/service/core/gnss/GpsL1RawMeasurementSynthesizer.kt`:

```kt
package com.system.location.service.core.gnss

import com.system.location.service.core.geo.Wgs84
import java.math.BigDecimal
import java.math.RoundingMode
import kotlin.math.abs

/** Target state and clock at one GPS-system epoch; all delays are positive excess path lengths. */
data class GpsL1ReceiverState(
    val observer: Wgs84,
    val ellipsoidHeightMeters: Double,
    val clockBiasSeconds: Double,
    val clockDriftSecondsPerSecond: Double,
    val ionosphericDelayMeters: Double,
    val troposphericDelayMeters: Double,
    val clockUncertaintyNanos: Double,
    val clockBiasUncertaintyNanos: Double,
    val clockDriftUncertaintyNanosPerSecond: Double,
    val elapsedRealtimeUncertaintyNanos: Double,
) {
    init {
        require(ellipsoidHeightMeters.isFinite() && clockBiasSeconds.isFinite() &&
            clockDriftSecondsPerSecond.isFinite())
        require(ionosphericDelayMeters.isFinite() && ionosphericDelayMeters >= 0.0)
        require(troposphericDelayMeters.isFinite() && troposphericDelayMeters >= 0.0)
        require(listOf(clockUncertaintyNanos, clockBiasUncertaintyNanos,
            clockDriftUncertaintyNanosPerSecond, elapsedRealtimeUncertaintyNanos)
            .all { it.isFinite() && it >= 0.0 })
    }
}

/** Measurement quality is supplied by a target-environment signal model, never copied from hardware. */
data class GpsL1SignalQuality(
    val cn0DbHz: Double,
    val receivedSvTimeUncertaintyNanos: Long,
    val pseudorangeRateUncertaintyMetersPerSecond: Double,
    val accumulatedDeltaRangeUncertaintyMeters: Double,
) {
    init {
        require(cn0DbHz.isFinite() && cn0DbHz in 0.0..GnssFrame.MAX_CN0_DB_HZ.toDouble())
        require(receivedSvTimeUncertaintyNanos >= 0L)
        require(pseudorangeRateUncertaintyMetersPerSecond.isFinite() &&
            pseudorangeRateUncertaintyMetersPerSecond >= 0.0)
        require(accumulatedDeltaRangeUncertaintyMeters.isFinite() &&
            accumulatedDeltaRangeUncertaintyMeters >= 0.0)
    }
}

/**
 * GPS L1 C/A raw observations from explicit target-world inputs. This is a vacuum/orbit model
 * plus caller-supplied atmospheric delays and signal quality; it does not claim RF propagation
 * or generate navigation bits. Missing any required input fails closed.
 */
class GpsL1RawMeasurementSynthesizer(
    ephemerides: List<GpsLnavEphemeris>,
    private val receiverAt: (GpsTime) -> GpsL1ReceiverState?,
    private val qualityAt: (GpsLnavEphemeris, Double) -> GpsL1SignalQuality?,
) {
    private data class PhaseTrack(val firstPhaseRangeMeters: Double, val lastTime: GpsTime)

    private val ephemerides = ephemerides.toList()
    private val tracks = mutableMapOf<Int, PhaseTrack>()
    private var lastEpoch: GpsTime? = null
    private var lastDiscontinuityCount: Int? = null

    /** Last bounded refusal reason; null after a successful batch. */
    @Volatile var lastFailure: String? = null
        private set

    init {
        require(this.ephemerides.isNotEmpty())
        require(this.ephemerides.all { it.health == 0 }) { "unhealthy GPS ephemeris cannot be synthesized" }
        require(this.ephemerides.map { it.svid }.distinct().size == this.ephemerides.size)
    }

    @Synchronized
    fun synthesize(
        receptionTime: GpsTime,
        elapsedRealtimeNanos: Long,
        capturedAtMillis: Long,
        hardwareClockDiscontinuityCount: Int,
    ): GnssMeasurementBatch? {
        require(elapsedRealtimeNanos >= 0L && capturedAtMillis >= 0L && hardwareClockDiscontinuityCount >= 0)
        val previousEpoch = lastEpoch
        if (previousEpoch != null && receptionTime.secondsSince(previousEpoch) <= 0.0) {
            lastFailure = "non-monotonic epoch"
            return null
        }
        val clockReset = lastDiscontinuityCount?.let { it != hardwareClockDiscontinuityCount } ?: true
        if (clockReset || previousEpoch?.let { receptionTime.secondsSince(it) > MAX_TRACK_GAP_SECONDS } == true) {
            tracks.clear()
        }
        val nextTracks = tracks.toMutableMap()
        val measurements = ephemerides.mapNotNull { ephemeris ->
            val center = observationAt(ephemeris, receptionTime) ?: return@mapNotNull null
            if (!center.geometry.lineOfSight.aboveHorizon) return@mapNotNull null
            val quality = qualityAt(ephemeris, center.geometry.lineOfSight.elevationDegrees) ?: return@mapNotNull null
            val rate = pseudorangeRate(ephemeris, receptionTime) ?: return@mapNotNull null
            val phaseTrack = nextTracks[ephemeris.svid]
            val reset = phaseTrack == null || receptionTime.secondsSince(phaseTrack.lastTime) > MAX_TRACK_GAP_SECONDS
            val anchor = if (reset) center.carrierRangeMeters else requireNotNull(phaseTrack).firstPhaseRangeMeters
            val adr = center.carrierRangeMeters - anchor
            nextTracks[ephemeris.svid] = PhaseTrack(anchor, receptionTime)

            val satelliteClockTime = receptionTime.plusSeconds(
                center.receiver.clockBiasSeconds - center.codePseudorangeMeters / SPEED_OF_LIGHT,
            )
            val svTimeNanos = secondsOfWeekNanos(satelliteClockTime.secondsOfWeek)
            GnssMeasurementObservation(
                constellation = Constellation.GPS,
                svid = ephemeris.svid,
                state = STATE_CODE_LOCK or STATE_TOW_KNOWN,
                timeOffsetNanos = 0.0,
                receivedSvTimeNanos = svTimeNanos,
                receivedSvTimeUncertaintyNanos = quality.receivedSvTimeUncertaintyNanos,
                cn0DbHz = quality.cn0DbHz,
                pseudorangeRateMetersPerSecond = rate,
                pseudorangeRateUncertaintyMetersPerSecond = quality.pseudorangeRateUncertaintyMetersPerSecond,
                accumulatedDeltaRangeState = ADR_STATE_VALID or if (reset) ADR_STATE_RESET else 0,
                accumulatedDeltaRangeMeters = adr,
                accumulatedDeltaRangeUncertaintyMeters = quality.accumulatedDeltaRangeUncertaintyMeters,
                carrierHz = GPS_L1_CA_HZ,
                codeType = GPS_L1_CA_CODE_TYPE,
            )
        }.sortedBy { it.svid }

        if (measurements.size < MIN_MEASUREMENTS) {
            lastFailure = "measurements=${measurements.size}"
            return null
        }
        val receiver = receiverAt(receptionTime) ?: run {
            lastFailure = "receiver state unavailable"
            return null
        }
        val localGpsNanos = gpsEpochNanos(receptionTime).add(secondsNanos(receiver.clockBiasSeconds))
        val fullBiasDecimal = BigDecimal.valueOf(elapsedRealtimeNanos).subtract(localGpsNanos)
        val fullBias = fullBiasDecimal.setScale(0, RoundingMode.FLOOR).longValueExact()
        val biasNanos = fullBiasDecimal.subtract(BigDecimal.valueOf(fullBias)).toDouble()
        val batch = GnssMeasurementBatch(
            capturedAtMillis = capturedAtMillis,
            timeNanos = elapsedRealtimeNanos,
            fullBiasNanos = fullBias,
            biasNanos = biasNanos,
            hardwareClockDiscontinuityCount = hardwareClockDiscontinuityCount,
            measurements = measurements,
            timeUncertaintyNanos = receiver.clockUncertaintyNanos,
            biasUncertaintyNanos = receiver.clockBiasUncertaintyNanos,
            driftNanosPerSecond = receiver.clockDriftSecondsPerSecond * 1e9,
            driftUncertaintyNanosPerSecond = receiver.clockDriftUncertaintyNanosPerSecond,
            elapsedRealtimeNanos = elapsedRealtimeNanos,
            elapsedRealtimeUncertaintyNanos = receiver.elapsedRealtimeUncertaintyNanos,
            referenceConstellationTypeForIsb = GPS_CONSTELLATION_TYPE,
            referenceCarrierHzForIsb = GPS_L1_CA_HZ,
            referenceCodeTypeForIsb = GPS_L1_CA_CODE_TYPE,
        )
        tracks.clear()
        tracks.putAll(nextTracks)
        lastEpoch = receptionTime
        lastDiscontinuityCount = hardwareClockDiscontinuityCount
        lastFailure = null
        return batch
    }

    private data class Observation(
        val geometry: GpsReceptionObservation,
        val receiver: GpsL1ReceiverState,
        val codePseudorangeMeters: Double,
        val carrierRangeMeters: Double,
    )

    private fun observationAt(ephemeris: GpsLnavEphemeris, time: GpsTime): Observation? {
        val receiver = receiverAt(time) ?: return null
        val geometry = GpsReceptionGeometry.observe(ephemeris, time, receiver.observer,
            receiver.ellipsoidHeightMeters).observation ?: return null
        if (!geometry.lineOfSight.aboveHorizon) return null
        val common = SPEED_OF_LIGHT * (receiver.clockBiasSeconds - geometry.l1CaClockBiasSeconds) +
            receiver.troposphericDelayMeters
        val codeRange = geometry.lineOfSight.rangeMeters + common + receiver.ionosphericDelayMeters
        val carrierRange = geometry.lineOfSight.rangeMeters +
            SPEED_OF_LIGHT * (receiver.clockBiasSeconds - geometry.clockBiasSeconds) +
            receiver.troposphericDelayMeters - receiver.ionosphericDelayMeters
        if (!codeRange.isFinite() || codeRange <= 0.0 || !carrierRange.isFinite()) return null
        return Observation(geometry, receiver, codeRange, carrierRange)
    }

    private fun pseudorangeRate(ephemeris: GpsLnavEphemeris, time: GpsTime): Double? {
        val before = observationAt(ephemeris, time.plusSeconds(-RATE_HALF_INTERVAL_SECONDS))
            ?: return null
        val after = observationAt(ephemeris, time.plusSeconds(RATE_HALF_INTERVAL_SECONDS))
            ?: return null
        val rate = (after.codePseudorangeMeters - before.codePseudorangeMeters) /
            (2 * RATE_HALF_INTERVAL_SECONDS)
        return rate.takeIf(Double::isFinite)
    }

    private fun gpsEpochNanos(time: GpsTime): BigDecimal =
        BigDecimal.valueOf(time.week.toLong()).multiply(BigDecimal.valueOf(GPS_WEEK_NANOS))
            .add(secondsNanos(time.secondsOfWeek))

    private fun secondsOfWeekNanos(seconds: Double): Long =
        BigDecimal.valueOf(seconds).movePointRight(9).setScale(0, RoundingMode.HALF_EVEN)
            .longValueExact().mod(GPS_WEEK_NANOS)

    private fun secondsNanos(seconds: Double): BigDecimal =
        BigDecimal.valueOf(seconds).movePointRight(9)

    companion object {
        const val GPS_L1_CA_HZ = 1_575_420_000.0
        const val GPS_L1_CA_CODE_TYPE = "C"
        const val GPS_CONSTELLATION_TYPE = 1
        const val MIN_MEASUREMENTS = 4
        const val MAX_TRACK_GAP_SECONDS = 2.0
        private const val SPEED_OF_LIGHT = GpsReceptionGeometry.SPEED_OF_LIGHT_METERS_PER_SECOND
        private const val GPS_WEEK_NANOS = 604_800_000_000_000L
        private const val RATE_HALF_INTERVAL_SECONDS = 0.05
        private const val STATE_CODE_LOCK = 1 shl 0
        private const val STATE_TOW_KNOWN = 1 shl 14
        private const val ADR_STATE_VALID = 1 shl 0
        private const val ADR_STATE_RESET = 1 shl 1
    }
}
```

`core/src/main/kotlin/com/system/location/service/core/gnss/GpsLnavAssembler.kt`:

```kt
package com.system.location.service.core.gnss

import kotlin.math.abs

/**
 * Bounded CEI assembly, one satellite/transmission frame per candidate. Each input requires a
 * caller-supplied trusted full GPS reference; capture UTC is never silently treated as GPS time.
 * The returned ephemeris is evidence, not permission to publish a complete multi-system sky.
 */
class GpsLnavAssembler {
    private data class Key(val svid: Int, val week: Int, val frameStartSeconds: Int)
    private data class Part(val frame: GpsLnavSubframe, val reference: GpsTime)
    private data class Candidate(val parts: MutableMap<Int, Part> = linkedMapOf(), var conflict: Boolean = false)
    private val candidates = linkedMapOf<Key, Candidate>()
    private val latest = mutableMapOf<Int, Key>()

    @Synchronized
    fun clear() { candidates.clear(); latest.clear() }

    /** Re-evaluate at the end of a capture, after late conflicts have invalidated candidates. */
    @Synchronized
    fun completed(): List<DecodedGpsLnav> = latest.toSortedMap().values.mapNotNull { candidates[it] }
        .filter { !it.conflict && it.parts.size == 3 }
        .mapNotNull { candidate ->
            GpsLnavEphemerisDecoder.decode(candidate.parts.values.map { it.frame },
                candidate.parts.getValue(1).reference).decoded
        }

    @Synchronized
    fun offer(observation: GnssNavigationObservation, trustedGpsTimeAtCapture: GpsTime): GpsLnavDecodeResult {
        val checked = GpsLnavWords.decode(observation)
        val frame = checked.subframe ?: return GpsLnavDecodeResult(null, checked.reason)
        if (frame.id !in 1..3) return GpsLnavDecodeResult(null, "GPS subframe does not contain a CEI component")
        val start = frame.nextTowSeconds - frame.id * 6
        val ref = trustedGpsTimeAtCapture
        // GPS subframes 1/2/3 fit entirely within one week and one 30-second frame.
        val week = (ref.week.toLong() - 1..ref.week.toLong() + 1)
            .filter { it in 0..Int.MAX_VALUE.toLong() }
            .minByOrNull { abs(GpsTime(it.toInt(), (start + frame.id * 6).toDouble()).secondsSince(ref)) }
            ?.toInt() ?: return GpsLnavDecodeResult(null, "cannot resolve transmission frame week")
        if (abs(GpsTime(week, (start + frame.id * 6).toDouble()).secondsSince(ref)) > 120)
            return GpsLnavDecodeResult(null, "HOW disagrees with trusted capture reference")
        val key = Key(frame.svid, week, start)
        val selected = latest[frame.svid]
        if (selected == null || week > selected.week || (week == selected.week && start > selected.frameStartSeconds))
            latest[frame.svid] = key
        val candidate = candidates[key] ?: run {
            // Never evict poisoned evidence: a flood must not rehabilitate a conflicting frame.
            // The newer selected frame still withdraws older output if capacity prevents retention.
            if (candidates.size >= 64) return GpsLnavDecodeResult(null, "GPS candidate capacity exceeded")
            Candidate().also { candidates[key] = it }
        }
        if (candidate.conflict) return GpsLnavDecodeResult(null, "conflicting GPS subframe candidate")
        val previous = candidate.parts[frame.id]
        if (previous != null) {
            // A duplicate with different parity-free information poisons this candidate. Do not
            // pick whichever page happened to arrive last during upload/corruption.
            if ((0 until 30).any { previous.frame.unsigned(it * 8, 8) != frame.unsigned(it * 8, 8) }) {
                candidate.conflict = true
                candidate.parts.clear()
                return GpsLnavDecodeResult(null, "conflicting duplicate GPS subframe")
            }
        } else candidate.parts[frame.id] = Part(frame, ref)
        if (latest[frame.svid] != key) return GpsLnavDecodeResult(null, "GPS transmission frame superseded")
        if (candidate.parts.size != 3) return GpsLnavDecodeResult(null, "waiting for GPS subframes 1/2/3")
        return GpsLnavEphemerisDecoder.decode(candidate.parts.values.map { it.frame },
            candidate.parts.getValue(1).reference)
    }
}
```

`core/src/main/kotlin/com/system/location/service/core/gnss/GpsLnavEphemerisDecoder.kt`:

```kt
package com.system.location.service.core.gnss

import kotlin.math.abs
import kotlin.math.pow
import kotlinx.serialization.Serializable

@Serializable
data class DecodedGpsLnav(
    val ephemeris: GpsLnavEphemeris,
    val uraIndex: Int,
    val frameTransmissionTime: GpsTime,
) {
    init {
        require(uraIndex in 0..14 && ephemeris.health == 0)
        require(frameTransmissionTime.secondsSince(ephemeris.validFrom) >= 0 &&
            ephemeris.validUntil.secondsSince(frameTransmissionTime) >= 0)
    }
}

data class GpsLnavDecodeResult(val decoded: DecodedGpsLnav?, val reason: String? = null)

/**
 * IS-GPS-200N Figures 20-1, Tables 20-II/III/XII. Only a complete, same-frame CEI set is
 * accepted. [referenceAtSubframeOneCapture] must be trusted full GPS time at the capture of
 * subframe 1, not UTC or a modulo week. It resolves the 10-bit week, never supplies orbit data.
 */
object GpsLnavEphemerisDecoder {
    // IS-GPS-200N Table 20-IV specifies this constant for semi-circle conversion.
    private const val SEMICIRCLE_TO_RADIANS = 3.1415926535898
    fun decode(subframes: Collection<GpsLnavSubframe>,
        referenceAtSubframeOneCapture: GpsTime): GpsLnavDecodeResult {
        fun invalid(reason: String) = GpsLnavDecodeResult(null, reason)
        if (subframes.size != 3 || subframes.map { it.id }.toSet() != setOf(1, 2, 3))
            return invalid("requires exactly GPS subframes 1, 2 and 3")
        if (subframes.map { it.svid }.distinct().size != 1) return invalid("mixed satellite identities")
        if (subframes.maxOf { it.capturedAtMillis } - subframes.minOf { it.capturedAtMillis } > 60_000)
            return invalid("subframe captures are not contemporaneous")
        if (subframes.any { it.alert }) return invalid("GPS HOW alert is raised")
        val (one, two, three) = subframes.sortedBy { it.id }
        val start = one.nextTowSeconds - 6
        if (two.nextTowSeconds - 12 != start || three.nextTowSeconds - 18 != start)
            return invalid("subframes belong to different transmission frames")

        val week10 = one.unsigned(48, 10).toInt()
        val ref = referenceAtSubframeOneCapture
        val era = ref.week / 1024
        val week = (era - 1..era + 1).map { it.toLong() * 1024 + week10 }
            .filter { it in 0..Int.MAX_VALUE.toLong() }
            .minByOrNull { abs(it - ref.week) }?.toInt() ?: return invalid("cannot resolve GPS week")
        val transmission = GpsTime(week, start.toDouble())
        if (abs(transmission.plusSeconds(6.0).secondsSince(ref)) > 120)
            return invalid("HOW week/time disagrees with trusted capture time")
        val iode2 = two.unsigned(48, 8).toInt()
        val iode3 = three.unsigned(216, 8).toInt()
        val iodc = (one.unsigned(70, 2).toInt() shl 8) or one.unsigned(168, 8).toInt()
        if (iode2 != iode3 || iode2 != iodc and 255) return invalid("inconsistent IODC/IODE")
        val health = one.unsigned(64, 6).toInt()
        val ura = one.unsigned(60, 4).toInt()
        if (health != 0 || ura == 15) return invalid("unhealthy GPS satellite or unavailable accuracy")
        val fit = fitHours(iodc, two.unsigned(232, 1) != 0L)
            ?: return invalid("reserved or inconsistent IODC/fit interval")
        val toeSeconds = two.unsigned(216, 16) * 16.0
        val tocSeconds = one.unsigned(176, 16) * 16.0
        if (toeSeconds >= 604800 || tocSeconds != toeSeconds)
            return invalid("invalid GPS toe/toc CEI epochs")
        // Resolve toe against transmission before any periodic propagator arithmetic.
        var toe = GpsTime(week, toeSeconds)
        if (toe.secondsSince(transmission) > 302400) {
            if (week == 0) return invalid("GPS epoch before week zero")
            toe = GpsTime(week - 1, toeSeconds)
        } else if (toe.secondsSince(transmission) < -302400) {
            if (week == Int.MAX_VALUE) return invalid("GPS week overflow")
            toe = GpsTime(week + 1, toeSeconds)
        }
        val halfFitSeconds = fit * 1800.0
        if (abs(transmission.secondsSince(toe)) > halfFitSeconds)
            return invalid("transmission lies outside orbit fit interval")
        if (one.signed(160, 8) == -128L) return invalid("GPS TGD is unavailable")

        return try {
            val e = GpsLnavEphemeris(one.svid, toe, toe, toe.plusSeconds(-halfFitSeconds),
                toe.plusSeconds(halfFitSeconds), iode2, iode3, iodc, health,
                two.unsigned(184, 32) * 2.0.pow(-19), two.unsigned(136, 32) * 2.0.pow(-33),
                three.scale(112, 32, -31, true), three.scale(64, 32, -31, true),
                three.scale(160, 32, -31, true), two.scale(88, 32, -31, true),
                two.scale(72, 16, -43, true), three.scale(192, 24, -43, true),
                three.scale(224, 14, -43, true), two.scale(120, 16, -29), two.scale(168, 16, -29),
                three.scale(144, 16, -5), two.scale(56, 16, -5),
                three.scale(48, 16, -29), three.scale(96, 16, -29),
                one.scale(216, 22, -31), one.scale(200, 16, -43), one.scale(192, 8, -55),
                one.scale(160, 8, -31))
            GpsLnavDecodeResult(DecodedGpsLnav(e, ura, transmission))
        } catch (error: IllegalArgumentException) {
            invalid(error.message ?: "invalid GPS broadcast parameters")
        }
    }

    private fun GpsLnavSubframe.scale(start: Int, length: Int, power: Int, semicircles: Boolean = false) =
        signed(start, length) * 2.0.pow(power) * if (semicircles) SEMICIRCLE_TO_RADIANS else 1.0

    /** Modern GPS blocks, Table 20-XII including reserved ranges (not old heuristic fallbacks). */
    internal fun fitHours(iodc: Int, extended: Boolean): Int? {
        if (iodc !in 0..1023 || iodc in 504..511 || iodc in 752..767 || iodc in 1008..1020) return null
        val normal = iodc in 0..239 || iodc in 256..495 || iodc in 512..751 || iodc in 768..1007
        if (!extended) return if (normal) 4 else null
        return when {
            normal -> 6
            iodc in 240..247 -> 8
            iodc in 248..255 || iodc == 496 -> 14
            iodc in 497..503 || iodc in 1021..1023 -> 26
            else -> null
        }
    }
}
```

`core/src/main/kotlin/com/system/location/service/core/gnss/GpsLnavWords.kt`:

```kt
package com.system.location.service.core.gnss

import java.util.Base64

/** A parity-checked GPS L1 C/A subframe, with inversion and parity removed. */
class GpsLnavSubframe internal constructor(
    val svid: Int,
    val capturedAtMillis: Long,
    val id: Int,
    val nextTowSeconds: Int,
    val alert: Boolean,
    data: ByteArray,
) {
    private val bits = data.copyOf()

    /** Zero-based bit position in the 240-bit parity-free subframe, MSB first. */
    fun unsigned(start: Int, length: Int): Long {
        require(start >= 0 && length in 1..32 && start + length <= 240)
        var value = 0L
        repeat(length) { offset ->
            val index = start + offset
            value = (value shl 1) or ((bits[index / 8].toInt() ushr (7 - index % 8)) and 1).toLong()
        }
        return value
    }

    fun signed(start: Int, length: Int): Long {
        val value = unsigned(start, length)
        return if (value and (1L shl (length - 1)) != 0L) value - (1L shl length) else value
    }
}

data class GpsLnavWordResult(val subframe: GpsLnavSubframe?, val reason: String? = null)

/**
 * Android's 40-byte GPS LNAV format: ten big-endian words with two zero padding bits.
 * IS-GPS-200N 20.3.5 / Table 20-XIV: D30* inverts data only, not the six parity bits.
 * Receiver status never substitutes for checking the actual words. No error correction is attempted.
 */
object GpsLnavWords {
    private val parityMasks = longArrayOf(0xBB1F3480, 0x5D8F9A40, 0xAEC7CD00,
        0x5763E680, 0x6BB1F340, 0x8B7A89C0)

    fun decode(observation: GnssNavigationObservation): GpsLnavWordResult {
        fun invalid(reason: String) = GpsLnavWordResult(null, reason)
        if (observation.type != 0x0101 || observation.svid !in 1..32)
            return invalid("not a GPS L1 C/A message")
        if (observation.status !in 0..2) return invalid("invalid navigation parity status")
        val payload = Base64.getDecoder().decode(observation.dataBase64)
        if (payload.size != 40) return invalid("GPS LNAV requires exactly ten 30-bit words")
        val words = LongArray(10) { index ->
            (0..3).fold(0L) { value, byte -> (value shl 8) or (payload[index * 4 + byte].toLong() and 255) }
        }
        if (words.any { it ushr 30 != 0L }) return invalid("nonzero Android word padding")
        // These two parity bits are forced to zero by the non-information bits in HOW/word 10.
        if (words[1] and 3 != 0L || words[9] and 3 != 0L) return invalid("invalid HOW/subframe parity termination")

        // Previous word's D29*/D30* are absent from Android's payload. Recover them by testing
        // all four possibilities against the first word's parity and preamble, never by guessing.
        val first = (0L..3L).mapNotNull { previous ->
            decodeWord(words[0], previous)?.takeIf { it ushr 16 == 0x8B }
        }.singleOrNull() ?: return invalid("TLM preamble or parity failure")
        val data = ByteArray(30)
        for (index in words.indices) {
            val decoded = if (index == 0) first else decodeWord(words[index], words[index - 1] and 3)
                ?: return invalid("word ${index + 1} parity failure")
            for (byte in 0..2) data[index * 3 + byte] = (decoded ushr (16 - byte * 8)).toByte()
        }
        val how = ((data[3].toInt() and 255) shl 16) or ((data[4].toInt() and 255) shl 8) or
            (data[5].toInt() and 255)
        val id = (how ushr 2) and 7
        val towCount = how ushr 7
        if (id !in 1..5 || id != observation.submessageId) return invalid("HOW/submessage identity mismatch")
        if (towCount >= 100800 || towCount % 5 != id % 5) return invalid("invalid HOW time/subframe phase")
        return GpsLnavWordResult(GpsLnavSubframe(observation.svid, observation.capturedAtMillis,
            id, towCount * 6, how and 64 != 0, data))
    }

    private fun decodeWord(transmitted: Long, previous: Long): Int? {
        var word = (previous shl 30) or transmitted
        if (previous and 1 != 0L) word = word xor 0x3FFFFFC0
        var parity = 0
        for (mask in parityMasks) parity = (parity shl 1) or (java.lang.Long.bitCount(word and mask) and 1)
        return if (parity.toLong() == transmitted and 63) ((word ushr 6) and 0xFFFFFF).toInt() else null
    }
}
```

`core/src/main/kotlin/com/system/location/service/core/gnss/GpsReceiverClock.kt`:

```kt
package com.system.location.service.core.gnss

import java.math.BigDecimal

data class GpsClockEpoch(
    val time: GpsTime,
    val elapsedRealtimeNanos: Long?,
    val hardwareDiscontinuityCount: Int,
    /** Sum of reported 1-sigma terms; null when any necessary term is unknown. */
    val timeUncertaintySeconds: Double?,
    val elapsedRealtimeUncertaintySeconds: Double?,
)

data class GpsClockResult(val epoch: GpsClockEpoch?, val reason: String? = null)

/** Android GnssClock: GPS time = TimeNanos - FullBiasNanos - BiasNanos (when present). */
object GpsReceiverClock {
    private val nanosPerWeek = BigDecimal("604800000000000")
    private val nanosPerSecond = BigDecimal("1000000000")

    fun decode(batch: GnssMeasurementBatch): GpsClockResult {
        val fullBias = batch.fullBiasNanos ?: return GpsClockResult(null, "receiver has no full GPS clock bias")
        // Subtract as integers/decimal BEFORE conversion to Double. Epoch-sized nanoseconds
        // would otherwise lose hundreds of nanoseconds, including the fractional bias entirely.
        val nanos = BigDecimal.valueOf(batch.timeNanos).subtract(BigDecimal.valueOf(fullBias))
            .subtract(BigDecimal.valueOf(batch.biasNanos ?: 0.0))
        if (nanos.signum() < 0) return GpsClockResult(null, "receiver clock precedes GPS epoch")
        val parts = nanos.divideAndRemainder(nanosPerWeek)
        if (parts[0] > BigDecimal.valueOf(Int.MAX_VALUE.toLong()))
            return GpsClockResult(null, "receiver GPS week overflows supported range")
        var week = parts[0].toInt()
        var seconds = parts[1].divide(nanosPerSecond).toDouble()
        if (seconds == GpsTime.SECONDS_PER_WEEK) {
            if (week == Int.MAX_VALUE) return GpsClockResult(null, "receiver GPS week overflow")
            week++
            seconds = 0.0
        }
        val uncertainty = if (batch.timeUncertaintyNanos != null && batch.biasUncertaintyNanos != null)
            batch.timeUncertaintyNanos / 1e9 + batch.biasUncertaintyNanos / 1e9 else null
        return GpsClockResult(GpsClockEpoch(GpsTime(week, seconds), batch.elapsedRealtimeNanos,
            batch.hardwareClockDiscontinuityCount, uncertainty,
            batch.elapsedRealtimeUncertaintyNanos?.div(1e9)))
    }
}
```

`core/src/main/kotlin/com/system/location/service/core/gnss/GpsReceptionGeometry.kt`:

```kt
package com.system.location.service.core.gnss

import com.system.location.service.core.geo.Wgs84
import kotlin.math.*

data class GpsReceptionObservation(
    val transmissionTime: GpsTime,
    val propagationSeconds: Double,
    /** Satellite at transmission, rotated into the ECEF axes at reception. */
    val satelliteInReceptionEcef: EcefPosition,
    val lineOfSight: GnssLineOfSight,
    /** Polynomial plus relativity, without any signal-dependent group delay. */
    val clockBiasSeconds: Double,
    val l1CaClockBiasSeconds: Double,
)

data class GpsReceptionResult(val observation: GpsReceptionObservation?, val reason: String? = null)

/**
 * Geometric vacuum light-time, IS-GPS-200N 20.3.3.4.3.3/4.3.4. Both epochs are GPS
 * SYSTEM time; receiver/satellite clock readings are not accepted as these epochs.
 * This is not a pseudorange/phase model: atmosphere, antenna and receiver biases are absent.
 */
object GpsReceptionGeometry {
    const val SPEED_OF_LIGHT_METERS_PER_SECOND = 299792458.0

    fun observe(ephemeris: GpsLnavEphemeris, receptionTime: GpsTime,
        observer: Wgs84, ellipsoidHeightMeters: Double): GpsReceptionResult {
        fun invalid(reason: String) = GpsReceptionResult(null, reason)
        val receiver = GnssObserverGeometry.ecef(observer, ellipsoidHeightMeters)
        val e = ephemeris
        // A physical upper bound on path length, not an assumed 70/75ms flight time.
        val maximumRadius = e.sqrtSemiMajorAxis * e.sqrtSemiMajorAxis * (1 + e.eccentricity) +
            abs(e.crsMeters) + abs(e.crcMeters)
        val maximumDelay = (maximumRadius + hypot(hypot(receiver.xMeters, receiver.yMeters), receiver.zMeters)) /
            SPEED_OF_LIGHT_METERS_PER_SECOND
        if (!maximumDelay.isFinite()) return invalid("non-finite reception geometry bound")
        var lower = max(0.0, receptionTime.secondsSince(e.validUntil))
        var upper = min(maximumDelay, receptionTime.secondsSince(e.validFrom))
        if (lower > upper) return invalid("no possible transmission inside absolute GPS fit interval")

        fun evaluate(delay: Double): GpsReceptionObservation? {
            val transmission = receptionTime.plusSeconds(-delay)
            val state = GpsBroadcastPropagator.propagate(e, transmission).state ?: return null
            val angle = GpsBroadcastPropagator.EARTH_ROTATION_RAD_PER_SECOND * delay
            // Choose the coincident ECI frame at reception: theta=(tT-tR)*Omega_e.
            val position = EcefPosition(cos(angle) * state.xMeters + sin(angle) * state.yMeters,
                -sin(angle) * state.xMeters + cos(angle) * state.yMeters, state.zMeters)
            val los = GnssObserverGeometry.lineOfSight(observer, ellipsoidHeightMeters, position) ?: return null
            return GpsReceptionObservation(transmission, delay, position, los,
                state.clockBiasSeconds, state.clockBiasSeconds - e.tgdSeconds)
        }
        fun residual(observation: GpsReceptionObservation) =
            observation.lineOfSight.rangeMeters / SPEED_OF_LIGHT_METERS_PER_SECOND - observation.propagationSeconds
        val atLower = evaluate(lower) ?: return invalid("unavailable GPS state at reception bracket")
        val atUpper = evaluate(upper) ?: return invalid("unavailable GPS state at reception bracket")
        if (residual(atLower) < -1e-13 || residual(atUpper) > 1e-13)
            return invalid("light-time solution outside absolute GPS fit interval")
        // Bracketing handles fit-interval edges without propagating an invalid trial epoch.
        repeat(50) {
            val result = evaluate(lower + (upper - lower) / 2)
                ?: return invalid("GPS light-time evaluation failed")
            val error = residual(result)
            if (abs(error) <= 1e-13) return GpsReceptionResult(result)
            if (error > 0) lower = result.propagationSeconds else upper = result.propagationSeconds
        }
        return invalid("GPS light-time equation did not converge")
    }
}
```

`core/src/main/kotlin/com/system/location/service/core/gnss/GpsYumaAlmanac.kt`:

```kt
package com.system.location.service.core.gnss

import kotlinx.serialization.Serializable
import kotlin.math.PI

/** Yuma supplies absolute inclination in radians, unlike LNAV's transmitted delta-i. */
@Serializable
data class GpsYumaAlmanac(
    val svid: Int,
    val health: Int,
    val referenceTime: GpsTime,
    val eccentricity: Double,
    val inclinationRad: Double,
    val ascendingNodeRateRadPerSecond: Double,
    val sqrtSemiMajorAxis: Double,
    val ascendingNodeRad: Double,
    val argumentOfPerigeeRad: Double,
    val meanAnomalyRad: Double,
    val af0Seconds: Double,
    val af1SecondsPerSecond: Double,
) {
    init {
        require(svid in 1..32 && health in 0..255)
        require(eccentricity in 0.0..0.03 && inclinationRad in 0.0..PI)
        require(sqrtSemiMajorAxis in 2530.0..8192.0)
        require(listOf(ascendingNodeRateRadPerSecond, ascendingNodeRad, argumentOfPerigeeRad,
            meanAnomalyRad, af0Seconds, af1SecondsPerSecond).all(Double::isFinite))
    }
}

/**
 * Strict transactional import: a partial/corrupt update must not replace a complete resource.
 * The caller supplies an independently known approximate full week (e.g. archive date).
 * Truncated weeks are resolved once at import; they are never re-resolved at simulation time.
 * Format: https://celestrak.org/GPS/almanac/Yuma/definition.php
 */
object GpsYumaParser {
    const val MAX_BYTES = 262_144
    private val fields = setOf("ID", "Health", "Eccentricity", "Time of Applicability(s)",
        "Orbital Inclination(rad)", "Rate of Right Ascen(r/s)", "SQRT(A)  (m 1/2)",
        "Right Ascen at Week(rad)", "Argument of Perigee(rad)", "Mean Anom(rad)",
        "Af0(s)", "Af1(s/s)", "week")

    fun parse(text: String, approximateFullWeek: Int): List<GpsYumaAlmanac> {
        require(approximateFullWeek >= 0)
        require(text.toByteArray(Charsets.UTF_8).size <= MAX_BYTES) { "Yuma resource too large" }
        val records = mutableListOf<GpsYumaAlmanac>()
        val record = linkedMapOf<String, String>()
        fun finish() {
            if (record.isEmpty()) return
            require(record.keys == fields) { "Incomplete Yuma record" }
            fun number(key: String) = record.getValue(key).replace('D', 'E').replace('d', 'e').toDouble()
            val rawWeek = record.getValue("week").toInt()
            require(rawWeek >= 0)
            val fullWeek = if (rawWeek >= 1024) rawWeek.toLong() else {
                val cycles = Math.floorDiv(approximateFullWeek.toLong() - rawWeek + 512, 1024)
                rawWeek + cycles * 1024
            }
            require(fullWeek in 0..Int.MAX_VALUE.toLong()) { "Unresolvable Yuma week" }
            // An exactly half-cycle anchor is ambiguous; do not silently select an era.
            require(kotlin.math.abs(fullWeek - approximateFullWeek) < 512) { "Ambiguous Yuma week anchor" }
            records += GpsYumaAlmanac(record.getValue("ID").toInt(), record.getValue("Health").toInt(),
                GpsTime(fullWeek.toInt(), number("Time of Applicability(s)")), number("Eccentricity"),
                number("Orbital Inclination(rad)"), number("Rate of Right Ascen(r/s)"),
                number("SQRT(A)  (m 1/2)"), number("Right Ascen at Week(rad)"),
                number("Argument of Perigee(rad)"), number("Mean Anom(rad)"), number("Af0(s)"), number("Af1(s/s)"))
            require(records.size <= 32) { "Too many GPS almanac records" }
            record.clear()
        }
        for (rawLine in text.lineSequence()) {
            val line = rawLine.trim()
            if (line.isEmpty() || line.startsWith("********")) {
                finish()
                continue
            }
            val split = line.indexOf(':')
            require(split > 0) { "Invalid Yuma line" }
            val key = line.substring(0, split).trim()
            require(key in fields && key !in record) { "Unknown or duplicate Yuma field: $key" }
            record[key] = line.substring(split + 1).trim()
        }
        finish()
        require(records.isNotEmpty()) { "Empty Yuma resource" }
        require(records.map { it.svid }.distinct().size == records.size) { "Duplicate GPS almanac identity" }
        // A downloaded set must have one reference epoch; never assemble mismatched uploads.
        require(records.map { it.referenceTime }.distinct().size == 1) { "Mixed Yuma reference epochs" }
        return records.toList()
    }
}
```

`core/src/main/kotlin/com/system/location/service/core/gnss/KeplerOrbit.kt`:

```kt
package com.system.location.service.core.gnss

import kotlinx.serialization.Serializable
import kotlin.math.PI
import kotlin.math.atan2
import kotlin.math.cos
import kotlin.math.sin
import kotlin.math.sqrt

@Serializable
data class KeplerElements(
    val semiMajorAxisMeters: Double,
    val eccentricity: Double,
    val inclinationRad: Double,
    val raanRad: Double,
    val argumentOfPerigeeRad: Double,
    val meanAnomalyRad: Double,
    val epochSeconds: Double,
    val meanMotionRadPerSec: Double? = null,
) {
    init {
        require(semiMajorAxisMeters in MIN_SEMI_MAJOR..MAX_SEMI_MAJOR) { "semiMajorAxis out of range" }
        require(eccentricity in 0.0..0.9) { "eccentricity out of range" }
        require(inclinationRad.isFinite() && raanRad.isFinite() && argumentOfPerigeeRad.isFinite()) {
            "angles must be finite"
        }
        require(meanAnomalyRad.isFinite() && epochSeconds.isFinite()) { "mean anomaly/epoch must be finite" }
        meanMotionRadPerSec?.let { require(it > 0.0) { "meanMotion must be positive" } }
    }

    companion object {
        const val MIN_SEMI_MAJOR = 6_400_000.0
        const val MAX_SEMI_MAJOR = 60_000_000.0
    }
}

data class EciPosition(val x: Double, val y: Double, val z: Double) {
    val radiusMeters: Double get() = sqrt(x * x + y * y + z * z)
}

/** P3-05 Kepler/Doppler spike: deterministic two-body propagation, no perturbations. */
class KeplerOrbit(val elements: KeplerElements) {
    val meanMotionRadPerSec: Double =
        elements.meanMotionRadPerSec ?: sqrt(EARTH_MU / (elements.semiMajorAxisMeters * elements.semiMajorAxisMeters * elements.semiMajorAxisMeters))

    fun positionAt(seconds: Double): EciPosition {
        require(seconds.isFinite()) { "seconds must be finite" }
        val elapsed = seconds - elements.epochSeconds
        val meanAnomaly = normalize(elements.meanAnomalyRad + meanMotionRadPerSec * elapsed)
        var eccentricAnomaly = meanAnomaly
        repeat(12) {
            eccentricAnomaly -= (eccentricAnomaly - elements.eccentricity * sin(eccentricAnomaly) - meanAnomaly) /
                (1.0 - elements.eccentricity * cos(eccentricAnomaly))
        }
        val a = elements.semiMajorAxisMeters
        val xv = a * (cos(eccentricAnomaly) - elements.eccentricity)
        val yv = a * sqrt(1.0 - elements.eccentricity * elements.eccentricity) * sin(eccentricAnomaly)
        val radius = sqrt(xv * xv + yv * yv)
        val trueAnomaly = atan2(yv, xv)
        val argumentOfLatitude = trueAnomaly + elements.argumentOfPerigeeRad
        val cosU = cos(argumentOfLatitude)
        val sinU = sin(argumentOfLatitude)
        val cosO = cos(elements.raanRad)
        val sinO = sin(elements.raanRad)
        val cosI = cos(elements.inclinationRad)
        val sinI = sin(elements.inclinationRad)
        return EciPosition(
            x = radius * (cosO * cosU - sinO * sinU * cosI),
            y = radius * (sinO * cosU + cosO * sinU * cosI),
            z = radius * (sinU * sinI),
        )
    }

    fun orbitalPeriodSeconds(): Double = 2.0 * PI / meanMotionRadPerSec

    private fun normalize(angle: Double): Double {
        val twoPi = 2.0 * PI
        return ((angle % twoPi) + twoPi) % twoPi
    }

    companion object {
        const val EARTH_MU = 3.986004418e14
        const val SPEED_OF_LIGHT_MPS = 299_792_458.0
    }
}

object DopplerShift {
    /** Positive range rate (receding) lowers the observed frequency. */
    fun observedHz(carrierHz: Double, rangeRateMps: Double): Double {
        require(carrierHz > 0.0) { "carrierHz must be positive" }
        require(rangeRateMps.isFinite()) { "rangeRateMps must be finite" }
        return carrierHz * (1.0 - rangeRateMps / KeplerOrbit.SPEED_OF_LIGHT_MPS)
    }
}
```

`core/src/main/kotlin/com/system/location/service/core/gnss/RawGnssSynthesis.kt`:

```kt
package com.system.location.service.core.gnss

import com.system.location.service.core.runtime.HookConfiguration
import java.util.concurrent.ConcurrentHashMap

/**
 * Production inputs for GPS L1 C/A raw observations.
 *
 * Preferred input is the uploaded RINEX broadcast navigation resource. When it has no applicable
 * GPS ephemerides, the bundled Yuma almanac is promoted into an LNAV-shaped orbit with zero
 * harmonic/clock corrections. The result is explicitly an approximate, self-consistent model, not
 * a claim that the receiver observed the real broadcast upload.
 */
object RawGnssSynthesis {
    const val MIN_MEASUREMENTS = GpsL1RawMeasurementSynthesizer.MIN_MEASUREMENTS
    // GPS almanac orbits are approximate by definition. Keep the synthetic model usable for a
    // year so offline installs do not silently lose raw support shortly after the bundle epoch;
    // uploaded RINEX remains the preferred source whenever it covers the requested time.
    private const val ALMANAC_VALIDITY_SECONDS = 365 * 86400.0
    private val rinexCache = ConcurrentHashMap<String, List<GpsLnavEphemeris>>()
    private val almanacCache = ConcurrentHashMap<String, List<GpsLnavEphemeris>>()

    fun gpsTime(nowMillis: Long): GpsTime? {
        if (nowMillis < 0) return null
        val scale = GnssBundledOrbitResources.utcTimeScale() ?: return null
        return scale.gpsAtUtcMillis(nowMillis).time
            ?: if (nowMillis >= scale.expiresAtMillis) scale.gpsAtUtcMillisClamped(nowMillis).time
            else null
    }

    /**
     * RINEX ephemerides first, then bundled almanac identities not already supplied. The caller
     * still filters this list against the published sky and requires four usable measurements.
     */
    fun ephemerides(
        navigation: RinexNavigationResource?,
        nowMillis: Long,
    ): List<GpsLnavEphemeris> = runCatching {
        val time = gpsTime(nowMillis) ?: return emptyList()
        val rinex = navigation?.let { resource ->
            runCatching {
                rinexCache.getOrPut(resource.sha256) {
                    val file = RinexNavigationReader.read(resource.navigation)
                    file.records
                        .filter { it.system == RinexNavigationSystem.GPS }
                        .mapNotNull { record ->
                            runCatching { RinexGpsImporter.decode(record).ephemeris }.getOrNull()
                        }
                        .filter { it.health == 0 }
                        .distinctBy { it.svid }
                }
            }.getOrDefault(emptyList())
        }.orEmpty().filter { ephemerisUsable(it, time) }
        val almanac = almanacEphemerides().filterNot { candidate ->
            rinex.any { it.svid == candidate.svid }
        }.filter { ephemerisUsable(it, time) }
        (rinex + almanac).distinctBy { it.svid }
    }.getOrDefault(emptyList())

    fun canSynthesize(configuration: HookConfiguration, nowMillis: Long): Boolean = runCatching {
        configuration.enabled && configuration.gnssEnabled &&
            configuration.gnssFrameSource() != null &&
            ephemerides(configuration.gnssNavigation, nowMillis).size >= MIN_MEASUREMENTS
    }.getOrDefault(false)

    private fun ephemerisUsable(ephemeris: GpsLnavEphemeris, time: GpsTime): Boolean =
        ephemeris.validFrom.secondsSince(time) <= 0.0 && time.secondsSince(ephemeris.validUntil) <= 0.0

    private fun almanacEphemerides(): List<GpsLnavEphemeris> =
        GnssBundledOrbitResources.gpsAlmanac()?.let { records ->
            val key = records.joinToString("|") { "${it.svid}:${it.referenceTime.week}:${it.referenceTime.secondsOfWeek}" }
            almanacCache.getOrPut(key) {
                records.filter { it.health == 0 }.mapNotNull(::fromAlmanac).distinctBy { it.svid }
            }
        }.orEmpty()

    internal fun fromAlmanac(almanac: GpsYumaAlmanac): GpsLnavEphemeris? = runCatching {
        val toe = almanac.referenceTime
        GpsLnavEphemeris(
            svid = almanac.svid,
            toe = toe,
            toc = toe,
            validFrom = toe.plusSeconds(-ALMANAC_VALIDITY_SECONDS),
            validUntil = toe.plusSeconds(ALMANAC_VALIDITY_SECONDS),
            iode2 = 0,
            iode3 = 0,
            iodc = 0,
            health = almanac.health,
            sqrtSemiMajorAxis = almanac.sqrtSemiMajorAxis,
            eccentricity = almanac.eccentricity,
            inclinationRad = almanac.inclinationRad,
            ascendingNodeRad = almanac.ascendingNodeRad,
            argumentOfPerigeeRad = almanac.argumentOfPerigeeRad,
            meanAnomalyRad = almanac.meanAnomalyRad,
            // Yuma has no harmonic corrections or delta-n; the vacuum Kepler model is exact for
            // these zero corrections and the same almanac elements used by the published sky.
            deltaMeanMotionRadPerSecond = 0.0,
            ascendingNodeRateRadPerSecond = almanac.ascendingNodeRateRadPerSecond,
            inclinationRateRadPerSecond = 0.0,
            cucRad = 0.0,
            cusRad = 0.0,
            crcMeters = 0.0,
            crsMeters = 0.0,
            cicRad = 0.0,
            cisRad = 0.0,
            af0Seconds = almanac.af0Seconds,
            af1SecondsPerSecond = almanac.af1SecondsPerSecond,
            af2SecondsPerSecondSquared = 0.0,
            tgdSeconds = 0.0,
        )
    }.getOrNull()
}
```

`core/src/main/kotlin/com/system/location/service/core/gnss/ReceiverAutonomousSkyModel.kt`:

```kt
package com.system.location.service.core.gnss

/**
 * Whole-frame target sky. No capture, replay clock or capture expiry participates in geometry.
 * Physical resources are resolved per identity. Only an unavailable orbital pool selects the
 * virtual world; an individually hidden real satellite is never moved above the horizon.
 */
class ReceiverAutonomousSkyModel(
    providers: List<GnssOrbitProvider>,
    private val virtualFallback: GnssOrbitProvider,
    private val policy: GnssSimulationPolicy,
    /** Steady simulated navigation knowledge; never a claim to emit raw navigation messages. */
    private val simulateNavigation: Boolean = true,
    private val quantitySupplement: GnssVirtualSkySupplement? = null,
    private val signalCalibration: GnssAutonomousSignalCalibration? = null,
) {
    private val resolver = GnssOrbitResolver(providers)
    private val receiver = GnssSimulatedReceiver(policy.virtualSeed)

    init {
        require(providers.none { it.kind == GnssOrbitSourceKind.VIRTUAL })
        require(virtualFallback.kind == GnssOrbitSourceKind.VIRTUAL)
    }

    fun frame(request: GnssSkyRequest, minimumSatellites: Int = 0,
        validationAtMillis: Long = request.atMillis): ReceiverGnssFrame? {
        require(minimumSatellites in 0..GnssFrame.MAX_SATELLITES)
        if (policy.mode == GnssSimulationMode.OFF || policy.mode == GnssSimulationMode.REPLAY) return null
        val resolved = resolver.positions(request)
        val batch = if (resolved.positions.isEmpty()) {
            val fallback = virtualFallback.positions(request)
            // Whole-frame fallback must not erase real negative/hidden identity reservations.
            // Otherwise all-unhealthy or expired resources revive their IDs as virtual satellites,
            // and quantity supplementation can claim the same reserved identities again.
            val allowed = fallback.positions.filter { (it.constellation to it.svid) !in resolved.reservedIdentities }
            val excluded = fallback.positions.size - allowed.size
            GnssOrbitBatch(allowed,
                fallback.diagnostics + if (excluded > 0) listOf("虚拟兜底避让 $excluded 个真实资源保留身份") else emptyList(),
                fallback.reservedIdentities + resolved.reservedIdentities,
                fallback.blockedIdentities + resolved.blockedIdentities)
        } else resolved
        val diagnostics = resolved.diagnostics.toMutableList()
        val calibration = signalCalibration?.takeIf { policy.mode == GnssSimulationMode.AUTO && it.isCurrent(validationAtMillis) }
        if (calibration != null) diagnostics += "AUTO 迁移采集信号环境：仅匹配频段与观测仰角范围；不代表目标地实测接收情况"
        else if (signalCalibration != null) diagnostics += "采集信号校准未启用或已过期，继续自主信号模型"
        if (batch !== resolved) diagnostics += batch.diagnostics
        fun observe(orbit: GnssOrbitPosition): Pair<GnssOrbitPosition, GnssReceiverSignal>? {
            val navigation = orbit.simulatedNavigation.takeIf { simulateNavigation && !orbit.hasEphemeris }
            return receiver.observe(orbit, request, policy.environment, navigation, calibration)?.let { orbit to it }
        }
        val observations = batch.positions.mapNotNull(::observe).toMutableList()
        quantitySupplement?.outputLimits?.let { limits ->
            val talkerCounts = observations.groupingBy {
                if (it.first.constellation == Constellation.SBAS) Constellation.GPS else it.first.constellation
            }.eachCount()
            if (observations.size > limits.maxVisible || talkerCounts.values.any { it > limits.maxPerTalker })
                diagnostics += "原始天空超出已验证输出能力（总数 ${limits.maxVisible}，每 talker ${limits.maxPerTalker}）；保留完整天空，输出端兼容性未保证"
        }
        var capacity = observations.size
        if (policy.minimumPolicy == GnssMinimumPolicy.GUARANTEE_QUANTITY && quantitySupplement != null) {
            val addition = quantitySupplement.supplement(request, observations.map { it.first },
                batch.reservedIdentities, minimumSatellites)
            capacity = addition.availableCapacity
            diagnostics += addition.diagnostics
            observations += addition.positions.mapNotNull(::observe)
        }
        if (observations.size < minimumSatellites)
            diagnostics += "卫星下限 $minimumSatellites 未满足，当前可见 ${observations.size} 颗；策略 ${policy.minimumPolicy}"
        // GGA's used-count field is at most two digits. A visible floor never forces every
        // visible satellite into the navigation solution or silently changes its geometry.
        val maximumUsed = quantitySupplement?.outputLimits?.maxUsed ?: 99
        val used = observations.map { it.second.satellite }.filter { it.usedInFix }
            .sortedByDescending { it.cn0DbHz }.take(maximumUsed).map { it.constellation to it.svid }.toSet()
        val satellites = observations.map { it.second.satellite.let { satellite ->
            satellite.copy(usedInFix = (satellite.constellation to satellite.svid) in used)
        } }
        val geometry = GnssGeometry.solve(satellites)
        geometry.reason?.let { diagnostics += "无有效三维定位解：$it" }
        val output = if (geometry.dop == null) satellites.map { it.copy(usedInFix = false) } else satellites
        val simulatedNavigationCount = observations.count { it.second.simulatedNavigation }
        if (simulatedNavigationCount > 0)
            diagnostics += "${simulatedNavigationCount} 颗使用显式仿真导航状态，不代表接收到广播导航电文"
        diagnostics += "模拟环境：${policy.environment}；可见 ${output.size}，跟踪 ${observations.count { it.second.tracked }}，在用 ${output.count { it.usedInFix }}"
        val origins = observations.associate { (orbit, _) -> (orbit.constellation to orbit.svid) to orbit.provenance }
        return ReceiverGnssFrame(request.atMillis, request.observer, request.altitudeMeters, output,
            geometry, ReceiverGnssSource.AUTONOMOUS, diagnostics.toList(), capacity, minimumSatellites,
            orbitProvenance = origins, trackedSatelliteCount = observations.count { it.second.tracked },
            simulatedNavigationSatelliteCount = simulatedNavigationCount)
    }
}
```
