`core/src/main/kotlin/com/system/location/service/core/gnss/ReceiverBroadcastSkyModel.kt`:

```kt
package com.system.location.service.core.gnss

import com.system.location.service.core.geo.Wgs84

/**
 * GPS broadcast geometry with capture-calibrated signal statistics. Other identities retain
 * explicitly labelled statistical geometry. A known broadcast identity is never resurrected
 * from the statistical pool after horizon, fit, freshness or calibration rejection.
 * This generates simulated status, not raw observables or proof of live signal availability.
 */
class ReceiverBroadcastSkyModel(private val capture: GnssCapture, seed: Long = 0) {
    private val replay = ReceiverGnssSkyModel(capture, seed)
    private val signal = GpsEmpiricalSignalModel(capture)
    private val broadcastSignal = if (capture.frames.none { it.signalObservations.isNotEmpty() } &&
        capture.broadcastSignalCalibration != null) capture.broadcastSignalCalibration else BroadcastSignalCalibration.fit(capture)
    private val evidence = if (capture.measurements.isNotEmpty() || capture.navigation.isNotEmpty())
        GpsBroadcastEvidence.fromCapture(capture) else capture.gpsBroadcastEvidence
    private val galileoEvidence = capture.galileoBroadcastEvidence
    private val beiDouEvidence = capture.beiDouBroadcastEvidence
    private val glonassEvidence = capture.glonassBroadcastEvidence
    internal val broadcastBootCount: Int?
        get() = evidence?.clock?.bootCount ?: galileoEvidence?.clock?.bootCount
            ?: beiDouEvidence?.clock?.bootCount ?: glonassEvidence?.clock?.bootCount
    private val ratios = capture.profile().constellations.associate { it.constellation to it.ratio }

    fun frame(atMillis: Long, observer: Wgs84, altitudeMeters: Double, minimumSatellites: Int = 0,
        elapsedRealtimeNanos: Long? = null, currentBootCount: Int? = null): ReceiverGnssFrame? {
        require(atMillis >= 0 && altitudeMeters.isFinite())
        require(minimumSatellites in 0..GnssFrame.MAX_SATELLITES)
        if (evidence == null && galileoEvidence == null && beiDouEvidence == null && glonassEvidence == null)
            return replay.frame(atMillis, observer, altitudeMeters, minimumSatellites)
        val time = evidence?.let { e -> elapsedRealtimeNanos?.let { e.clock.at(it, currentBootCount) } }
        val galileoTime = galileoEvidence?.let { e ->
            elapsedRealtimeNanos?.let { elapsed ->
                e.clock.at(elapsed, currentBootCount)?.let { gps -> e.gpsToGst.gpsToGalileo(gps).time }
            }
        }
        val beiDouTime = beiDouEvidence?.let { e -> elapsedRealtimeNanos?.let { e.clock.at(it, currentBootCount) } }
        val glonassDomain = glonassEvidence?.clock?.domain()
        val glonassTime = glonassEvidence?.let { e ->
            elapsedRealtimeNanos?.let { e.clock.at(it, currentBootCount, glonassDomain!!) }
        }
        val base = replay.selection(atMillis, 0) ?: return null
        val diagnostics = mutableListOf<String>()
        if (evidence != null) diagnostics += "GPS 方位/仰角来自广播轨道和真空光程；CN0、在用候选来自本次采集的经验校准，非实时接收状态"
        if (galileoEvidence != null) diagnostics += "Galileo 方位/仰角来自经 GGTO 对齐的广播轨道；坐标系和时标证据均需独立建立"
        if (beiDouEvidence != null) diagnostics += "北斗方位/仰角来自 BDT 广播轨道；BDCS 坐标和服务有效期均来自显式证据"
        if (evidence != null && time == null) diagnostics += "GPS 广播几何未启用：缺少同次开机的有效单调时间，当前明确使用统计回放"
        if (galileoEvidence != null && galileoTime == null) diagnostics += "Galileo 广播几何未启用：缺少同次开机的有效 GPS/GST 时标，当前明确使用统计回放"
        if (beiDouEvidence != null && beiDouTime == null) diagnostics += "北斗广播几何未启用：缺少同次开机的有效 BDT 时标，当前明确使用统计回放"
        if (glonassEvidence != null && glonassTime == null) diagnostics += "GLONASS 广播几何未启用：缺少同次开机的 UTC(SU)+3h 连续时标，当前明确使用统计回放"
        val broadcastIds = evidence?.ephemerides?.map { it.ephemeris.svid }?.toSet().orEmpty()
        val galileoIds = galileoEvidence?.identities.orEmpty()
        val beiDouIds = beiDouEvidence?.identities.orEmpty()
        val glonassIds = glonassEvidence?.identities.orEmpty()
        fun statistical(s: GnssSatellite) = when (s.constellation) {
            Constellation.GPS -> s.svid !in broadcastIds
            Constellation.GALILEO -> s.svid !in galileoIds
            Constellation.BEIDOU -> s.svid !in beiDouIds
            Constellation.GLONASS -> s.svid !in glonassIds
            else -> true
        }
        val physicalGps = if (evidence != null && time != null) evidence.ephemerides.mapNotNull { decoded ->
            val id = decoded.ephemeris.svid
            val age = time.secondsSince(decoded.frameTransmissionTime.plusSeconds(18.0))
            if (age !in 0.0..GpsBroadcastEvidence.MAX_BROADCAST_AGE_SECONDS) {
                diagnostics += "GPS $id：广播状态证据超出模拟新鲜度窗口，未回退同身份统计几何"
                return@mapNotNull null
            }
            val result = GpsReceptionGeometry.observe(decoded.ephemeris, time, observer, altitudeMeters)
            val los = result.observation?.lineOfSight
            if (los == null) {
                diagnostics += "GPS $id：${result.reason}"
                return@mapNotNull null
            }
            if (!los.aboveHorizon) return@mapNotNull null
            val azimuth = los.azimuthDegrees
            if (azimuth == null) {
                diagnostics += "GPS $id：天顶方位未定义，当前状态适配器排除此观测"
                return@mapNotNull null
            }
            val calibration = signal.at(los.elevationDegrees)
            if (calibration == null) {
                diagnostics += "GPS $id：仰角超出本次 GPS L1/未知载波实测校准范围，未外推 CN0"
                return@mapNotNull null
            }
            GnssSatellite(Constellation.GPS, id, los.elevationDegrees.toFloat(),
                azimuth.toGnssAzimuthFloat(), calibration.cn0DbHz.toFloat(),
                calibration.usedFraction >= 0.5 && calibration.cn0DbHz > 0.0,
                hasEphemeris = true, hasAlmanac = calibration.hasAlmanac, carrierHz = calibration.carrierHz)
        }.sortedBy { it.svid } else emptyList()
        val galileoReceiver = galileoEvidence?.receiverTransform
            ?.receiver(observer, altitudeMeters, elapsedRealtimeNanos, currentBootCount)
            ?.let { GtrfReceiver(it.position, it.orientation) }
        if (galileoEvidence != null && galileoReceiver == null)
            diagnostics += "Galileo 广播几何未启用：缺少适用的 WGS 84 → GTRF 接收机变换，未回退同身份统计几何"
        val physicalGalileo = if (galileoEvidence != null && galileoTime != null &&
            galileoEvidence.receiverFrame == GalileoReceiverFrame.GTRF && galileoReceiver != null) {
            val inav = galileoEvidence.inav.mapNotNull { decoded ->
                val result = GalileoReceptionGeometry.observe(decoded.ephemeris, galileoTime, galileoReceiver)
                val los = result.observation?.lineOfSight
                if (los == null || !los.aboveHorizon || los.azimuthDegrees == null) {
                    diagnostics += "Galileo ${decoded.ephemeris.svid}：${result.reason ?: "地平线以下或方位未定义"}"
                    return@mapNotNull null
                }
                galileoEvidence.serviceRejection(decoded.ephemeris.svid, GalileoClockReference.INAV_E1_E5B,
                    decoded.transmissionTimeOfWordFive, result.observation.transmissionTime)?.let { reason ->
                    diagnostics += "Galileo ${decoded.ephemeris.svid}：$reason，未回退同身份统计几何"
                    return@mapNotNull null
                }
                val calibration = listOf(GalileoOpenServiceSignal.E1 to 1_575_420_000.0,
                    GalileoOpenServiceSignal.E5B to 1_207_140_000.0).firstNotNullOfOrNull { (band, frequency) ->
                    if (GalileoSignalClock.correction(decoded, result.observation.transmissionTime, band).correctionSeconds == null)
                        null else broadcastSignal.at(Constellation.GALILEO, los.elevationDegrees, frequency)
                } ?: run {
                    diagnostics += "Galileo ${decoded.ephemeris.svid}：没有健康、数据有效且具备同频实测校准的 I/NAV 信号"
                    return@mapNotNull null
                }
                GnssSatellite(Constellation.GALILEO, decoded.ephemeris.svid, los.elevationDegrees.toFloat(),
                    los.azimuthDegrees.toGnssAzimuthFloat(), calibration.cn0.toFloat(), calibration.used >= 0.5 && calibration.cn0 > 0,
                    true, calibration.almanac, calibration.carrier)
            }
            val fnav = galileoEvidence.fnav.mapNotNull { decoded ->
                val result = GalileoReceptionGeometry.observe(decoded.ephemeris, galileoTime, galileoReceiver)
                val los = result.observation?.lineOfSight
                if (los == null || !los.aboveHorizon || los.azimuthDegrees == null) {
                    diagnostics += "Galileo ${decoded.ephemeris.svid}：${result.reason ?: "地平线以下或方位未定义"}"
                    return@mapNotNull null
                }
                galileoEvidence.serviceRejection(decoded.ephemeris.svid, GalileoClockReference.FNAV_E1_E5A,
                    decoded.transmissionTimeOfPageOne, result.observation.transmissionTime)?.let { reason ->
                    diagnostics += "Galileo ${decoded.ephemeris.svid}：$reason，未回退同身份统计几何"
                    return@mapNotNull null
                }
                val correction = GalileoSignalClock.correction(decoded, result.observation.transmissionTime,
                    GalileoOpenServiceSignal.E5A)
                if (correction.correctionSeconds == null) {
                    diagnostics += "Galileo ${decoded.ephemeris.svid}：${correction.reason}"
                    return@mapNotNull null
                }
                val calibration = broadcastSignal.at(Constellation.GALILEO, los.elevationDegrees, 1_176_450_000.0)
                    ?: run { diagnostics += "Galileo ${decoded.ephemeris.svid}：缺少 E5a 同频实测校准"; return@mapNotNull null }
                GnssSatellite(Constellation.GALILEO, decoded.ephemeris.svid, los.elevationDegrees.toFloat(),
                    los.azimuthDegrees.toGnssAzimuthFloat(), calibration.cn0.toFloat(), calibration.used >= 0.5 && calibration.cn0 > 0,
                    true, calibration.almanac, calibration.carrier)
            }
            (inav + fnav).distinctBy { it.constellation to it.svid }
        } else emptyList()
        if (galileoEvidence != null && galileoEvidence.receiverFrame != GalileoReceiverFrame.GTRF)
            diagnostics += "Galileo 广播证据坐标系不受支持，未输出物理几何"
        val receiverBdcs = beiDouEvidence?.receiverTransform
            ?.receiver(observer, altitudeMeters, elapsedRealtimeNanos, currentBootCount)
            ?.let { BdcsReceiver(it.position, it.orientation) }
        if (beiDouEvidence != null && receiverBdcs == null)
            diagnostics += "北斗广播几何未启用：缺少适用的 WGS 84 → BDCS 接收机变换，未回退同身份统计几何"
        val physicalBeiDou = if (beiDouEvidence != null && beiDouTime != null &&
            beiDouEvidence.receiverFrame == BeiDouReceiverFrame.BDCS && receiverBdcs != null) {
            (beiDouEvidence.d1.mapNotNull { decoded ->
                val result = BeiDouSignalReception.observe(decoded, beiDouTime, receiverBdcs,
                    BeiDouLegacySignal.B1I, beiDouEvidence.serviceValidity)
                val los = result.observation?.geometry?.lineOfSight
                if (los == null || !los.aboveHorizon || los.azimuthDegrees == null) {
                    diagnostics += "北斗 ${decoded.ephemeris.svid}：${result.reason ?: "地平线以下或方位未定义"}"
                    return@mapNotNull null
                }
                val calibration = broadcastSignal.at(Constellation.BEIDOU, los.elevationDegrees, 1_561_098_000.0)
                    ?: run { diagnostics += "北斗 ${decoded.ephemeris.svid}：仰角超出实测校准范围，未外推 CN0"; return@mapNotNull null }
                GnssSatellite(Constellation.BEIDOU, decoded.ephemeris.svid, los.elevationDegrees.toFloat(),
                    los.azimuthDegrees.toGnssAzimuthFloat(), calibration.cn0.toFloat(), calibration.used >= 0.5 && calibration.cn0 > 0,
                    true, calibration.almanac, calibration.carrier)
            } + beiDouEvidence.d2.mapNotNull { decoded ->
                val result = BeiDouSignalReception.observe(decoded, beiDouTime, receiverBdcs,
                    BeiDouLegacySignal.B1I, beiDouEvidence.serviceValidity)
                val los = result.observation?.geometry?.lineOfSight
                if (los == null || !los.aboveHorizon || los.azimuthDegrees == null) {
                    diagnostics += "北斗 ${decoded.ephemeris.svid}：${result.reason ?: "地平线以下或方位未定义"}"
                    return@mapNotNull null
                }
                val calibration = broadcastSignal.at(Constellation.BEIDOU, los.elevationDegrees, 1_561_098_000.0)
                    ?: run { diagnostics += "北斗 ${decoded.ephemeris.svid}：仰角超出实测校准范围，未外推 CN0"; return@mapNotNull null }
                GnssSatellite(Constellation.BEIDOU, decoded.ephemeris.svid, los.elevationDegrees.toFloat(),
                    los.azimuthDegrees.toGnssAzimuthFloat(), calibration.cn0.toFloat(), calibration.used >= 0.5 && calibration.cn0 > 0,
                    true, calibration.almanac, calibration.carrier)
            }).distinctBy { it.constellation to it.svid }
        } else emptyList()
        if (beiDouEvidence != null && beiDouEvidence.receiverFrame != BeiDouReceiverFrame.BDCS)
            diagnostics += "北斗广播证据坐标系不受支持，未输出物理几何"
        val glonassReceiver = glonassEvidence?.datumTransform
            ?.receiver(observer, altitudeMeters, elapsedRealtimeNanos, currentBootCount)
        if (glonassEvidence != null && glonassReceiver == null)
            diagnostics += "GLONASS 广播几何未启用：缺少适用的 WGS 84 → PZ-90 接收机变换，未回退同身份统计几何"
        val physicalGlonass = if (glonassEvidence != null && glonassTime != null && glonassReceiver != null) {
            val receiver = GlonassReceiver(glonassEvidence.receiverFrame, glonassReceiver.position,
                glonassReceiver.orientation)
            val domain = glonassDomain!!
            glonassEvidence.ephemerides.mapNotNull { encoded ->
                val ephemeris = encoded.resolve(domain)
                if (ephemeris == null) {
                    diagnostics += "GLONASS ${encoded.orbit.slot}：广播有效期不在独立时钟覆盖内"
                    return@mapNotNull null
                }
                val result = GlonassReceptionGeometry.observe(ephemeris, glonassTime, receiver)
                result.observation?.let { observation ->
                    encoded.serviceRejection(observation.transmissionTime)?.let { reason ->
                        diagnostics += "GLONASS ${encoded.orbit.slot}：$reason，未回退同身份统计几何"
                        return@mapNotNull null
                    }
                }
                val los = result.observation?.lineOfSight
                if (los == null || !los.aboveHorizon || los.azimuthDegrees == null) {
                    diagnostics += "GLONASS ${encoded.orbit.slot}：${result.reason ?: "地平线以下或方位未定义"}"
                    return@mapNotNull null
                }
                val calibration = broadcastSignal.at(Constellation.GLONASS, los.elevationDegrees, svid = encoded.orbit.slot)
                    ?: run { diagnostics += "GLONASS ${encoded.orbit.slot}：仰角超出实测校准范围，未外推 CN0"; return@mapNotNull null }
                GnssSatellite(Constellation.GLONASS, encoded.orbit.slot, los.elevationDegrees.toFloat(),
                    los.azimuthDegrees.toGnssAzimuthFloat(), calibration.cn0.toFloat(), calibration.used >= 0.5 && calibration.cn0 > 0,
                    true, calibration.almanac, calibration.carrier)
            }
        } else emptyList()
        if (glonassEvidence != null && glonassTime == null)
            diagnostics += "GLONASS 广播证据保留但未生成几何：时钟域不完整或已过期"
        // All genuinely observed, valid broadcast identities may contribute, including those
        // absent from the current statistical window. The remaining pool stays local empirical.
        val physical = physicalGps + physicalGalileo + physicalBeiDou + physicalGlonass
        val pool = physical + base.evidencePool.filter(::statistical)
        val selected = (physical + base.satellites.filter(::statistical)).toMutableList()
        while (selected.size < minimumSatellites) {
            val ids = selected.map { it.constellation to it.svid }.toSet()
            val next = pool.filter { (it.constellation to it.svid) !in ids }.maxByOrNull {
                (ratios[it.constellation] ?: 0.0) * (selected.size + 1) -
                    selected.count { s -> s.constellation == it.constellation }
            } ?: break
            selected += next
        }
        if (selected.size < minimumSatellites)
            diagnostics += "卫星下限 $minimumSatellites 无法满足，当前有效池仅 ${pool.size} 颗"
        val usesReplay = selected.any(::statistical)
        if (usesReplay) {
            diagnostics += "混合来源：其余卫星保留统计回放几何；星座比例会随 GPS 可见性变化"
            diagnostics += base.diagnostics.map { "统计分量：$it" }
        }
        val geometry = GnssGeometry.solve(selected)
        geometry.reason?.let { diagnostics += "无有效三维定位解：$it" }
        val output = selected.sortedWith(compareBy({ it.constellation.ordinal }, { it.svid })).map {
            if (geometry.dop == null) it.copy(usedInFix = false) else it
        }
        val hasPhysical = physical.isNotEmpty()
        val source = when {
            !hasPhysical -> ReceiverGnssSource.STATISTICAL_REPLAY
            usesReplay -> ReceiverGnssSource.HYBRID_BROADCAST_REPLAY
            else -> ReceiverGnssSource.BROADCAST_EPHEMERIS
        }
        return ReceiverGnssFrame(atMillis, observer, altitudeMeters, output, geometry,
            source,
            diagnostics, pool.size, minimumSatellites)
    }

}
```

`core/src/main/kotlin/com/system/location/service/core/gnss/ReceiverGnssSkyModel.kt`:

```kt
package com.system.location.service.core.gnss

import com.system.location.service.core.geo.Wgs84
import kotlin.math.abs

enum class ReceiverGnssSource { STATISTICAL_REPLAY, BROADCAST_EPHEMERIS, HYBRID_BROADCAST_REPLAY, AUTONOMOUS }

/** Candidate usage is retained until the final combined sky has been solved. */
internal data class ReceiverGnssSelection(
    val satellites: List<GnssSatellite>,
    val diagnostics: List<String>,
    val capacity: Int,
    /** Complete local empirical pool; requesting a lower bound must not truncate evidence. */
    val evidencePool: List<GnssSatellite>,
)

data class ReceiverGnssFrame(
    val generatedAtMillis: Long,
    val observer: Wgs84,
    val altitudeMeters: Double,
    val satellites: List<GnssSatellite>,
    val geometry: GnssGeometryResult,
    val source: ReceiverGnssSource,
    val diagnostics: List<String> = emptyList(),
    val availableSatelliteCapacity: Int = satellites.size,
    val requestedMinimumSatellites: Int = 0,
    val orbitProvenance: Map<Pair<Constellation, Int>, GnssOrbitProvenance> = emptyMap(),
    val trackedSatelliteCount: Int? = null,
    val simulatedNavigationSatelliteCount: Int = 0,
) {
    init {
        require(generatedAtMillis >= 0 && altitudeMeters.isFinite())
        // The legacy minimum-setting range is not a ceiling on a measured visible sky.
        require(availableSatelliteCapacity >= satellites.size)
        require(requestedMinimumSatellites in 0..GnssFrame.MAX_SATELLITES)
        require(satellites.all { it.elevationDeg >= 0f && it.azimuthDeg < 360f })
        require(satellites.map { it.constellation to it.svid }.distinct().size == satellites.size)
        require(orbitProvenance.isEmpty() || orbitProvenance.keys == satellites.map { it.constellation to it.svid }.toSet())
        require(trackedSatelliteCount == null || trackedSatelliteCount in 0..satellites.size)
        require(simulatedNavigationSatelliteCount in 0..satellites.size)
    }
}

/**
 * Empirical statistical replay, explicitly not orbital propagation. A triangular replay clock
 * traverses the capture forward/backward, so a loop never jumps from the final sky to the first.
 * CN0 and its joint relationship with constellation/elevation come from actual paired samples;
 * interpolation retains that measured relationship instead of fitting an invented sine curve.
 */
class ReceiverGnssSkyModel(private val capture: GnssCapture, private val seed: Long = 0) {
    private val ratios = capture.profile().constellations.associate { it.constellation to it.ratio }
    private val frames = capture.frames.map { frame -> frame.copy(satellites = frame.satellites.filter {
        GnssCaptureValidator.isUsableSatellite(it) && GnssSatelliteIds.nmeaId(it.constellation, it.svid) != null
    }) }
    private val excluded = capture.frames.flatMap { it.satellites }.filter {
        GnssSatelliteIds.nmeaId(it.constellation, it.svid) == null
    }.map { "${it.constellation}:${it.svid}" }.distinct()
    fun frame(atMillis: Long, observer: Wgs84, altitudeMeters: Double, minimumSatellites: Int = 0): ReceiverGnssFrame? {
        require(atMillis >= 0 && altitudeMeters.isFinite())
        val selected = selection(atMillis, minimumSatellites) ?: return null
        val geometry = GnssGeometry.solve(selected.satellites)
        val diagnostics = selected.diagnostics.toMutableList()
        geometry.reason?.let { diagnostics += "无有效三维定位解：$it" }
        val output = if (geometry.dop == null) selected.satellites.map { it.copy(usedInFix = false) } else selected.satellites
        return ReceiverGnssFrame(atMillis, observer, altitudeMeters, output, geometry,
            ReceiverGnssSource.STATISTICAL_REPLAY, diagnostics, selected.capacity, minimumSatellites)
    }

    internal fun selection(atMillis: Long, minimumSatellites: Int): ReceiverGnssSelection? {
        require(atMillis >= 0)
        require(minimumSatellites in 0..GnssFrame.MAX_SATELLITES)
        if (!GnssCaptureValidator.validate(capture, atMillis).eligible) return null
        val first = frames.first().capturedAtMillis
        val duration = frames.last().capturedAtMillis - first
        val period = duration * 2
        val phase = (Math.floorMod(atMillis - first, period) + Math.floorMod(seed, period)) % period
        val replayAt = first + if (phase <= duration) phase else period - phase
        val rightIndex = frames.indexOfFirst { it.capturedAtMillis >= replayAt }.coerceAtLeast(0)
        val left = frames[maxOf(0, rightIndex - 1)]
        val right = frames[rightIndex]
        val span = right.capturedAtMillis - left.capturedAtMillis
        val fraction = if (span == 0L) 0.0 else (replayAt - left.capturedAtMillis).toDouble() / span
        val base = if (fraction < 0.5) left else right
        val leftById = left.satellites.associateBy { it.constellation to it.svid }
        val rightById = right.satellites.associateBy { it.constellation to it.svid }
        val selected = base.satellites.filter { it.elevationDeg >= 0f }.map { satellite ->
            val identity = satellite.constellation to satellite.svid
            val a = leftById[identity]
            val b = rightById[identity]
            if (a == null || b == null) satellite.copy(azimuthDeg = satellite.azimuthDeg % 360f)
            else interpolate(a, b, fraction)
        }.toMutableList()
        val diagnostics = mutableListOf("统计回放：局部天空形态来自实测画像，不代表目标地点的精确星历")
        if (excluded.isNotEmpty()) diagnostics += "统一排除无明确 NMEA 编号映射的卫星：${excluded.joinToString()}"
        // Capacity uses the same local evidence pool as allocation, including the current frame.
        val pool = (selected + frames.filter { abs(it.capturedAtMillis - replayAt) <= POOL_WINDOW_MILLIS }
            .sortedBy { abs(it.capturedAtMillis - replayAt) }
            .flatMap { it.satellites }).filter { it.elevationDeg >= 0f }
            .distinctBy { it.constellation to it.svid }
        val capacity = pool.size
        if (selected.size < minimumSatellites) {
            // Only reuse genuinely observed identities. Never lift a below-horizon observation.
            while (selected.size < minimumSatellites) {
                val identities = selected.map { it.constellation to it.svid }.toSet()
                val candidate = pool.filter { (it.constellation to it.svid) !in identities }.maxByOrNull { satellite ->
                    (ratios[satellite.constellation] ?: 0.0) * (selected.size + 1) -
                        selected.count { it.constellation == satellite.constellation }
                } ?: break
                selected += candidate.copy(azimuthDeg = candidate.azimuthDeg % 360f)
            }
            if (selected.size < minimumSatellites) diagnostics += "卫星下限 $minimumSatellites 无法满足，当前实测池仅 ${selected.size} 颗"
        }
        val ordered = selected.sortedWith(compareBy({ it.constellation.ordinal }, { it.svid }))
        return ReceiverGnssSelection(ordered, diagnostics, capacity, pool)
    }

    private companion object { const val POOL_WINDOW_MILLIS = 10_000L }

    private fun interpolate(a: GnssSatellite, b: GnssSatellite, fraction: Double): GnssSatellite {
        fun mix(x: Float, y: Float) = (x + (y - x) * fraction).toFloat()
        val arc = ((b.azimuthDeg - a.azimuthDeg + 540f) % 360f) - 180f
        val nearest = if (fraction < 0.5) a else b
        return nearest.copy(elevationDeg = mix(a.elevationDeg, b.elevationDeg),
            azimuthDeg = ((a.azimuthDeg + arc * fraction + 360.0) % 360.0).toGnssAzimuthFloat(),
            cn0DbHz = mix(a.cn0DbHz, b.cn0DbHz))
    }
}
```

`core/src/main/kotlin/com/system/location/service/core/gnss/RinexBeiDouImporter.kt`:

```kt
package com.system.location.service.core.gnss

import kotlin.math.abs

data class RinexBeiDouBroadcast(
    val ephemeris: BeiDouBroadcastEphemeris,
    val availableFrom: BeiDouTime,
    val health: Int,
    val accuracyMeters: Double,
    val tgd1Seconds: Double,
    val tgd2Seconds: Double,
    val ageOfDataClock: Int,
    val ageOfDataEphemeris: Int,
)

/**
 * RINEX 3.05 Table A14 carries neither an orbit-class field nor an absolute fit interval.
 * Both must be supplied independently. PRN, inclination and AODE/AODC are not substitutes.
 * Epochs are native BDT; no GPS/UTC clock conversion or BDCS datum transform is implied.
 */
object RinexBeiDouImporter {
    fun decode(record: RinexNavigationRecord, orbitType: BeiDouOrbitType,
        validFrom: BeiDouTime, validUntil: BeiDouTime): RinexBeiDouBroadcast {
        require(record.system == RinexNavigationSystem.BEIDOU && record.orbit.size == 7)
        require(validUntil.secondsSince(validFrom) > 0) { "Missing absolute BeiDou applicability" }
        val f = RinexOrbitFields(record)
        val nominal = RinexNativeEpoch.gps(record.epoch)
        // BDT calendar origin is 2006-01-01. This is an epoch-number relation, not GPS-BDT.
        val toc = BeiDouTime(nominal.week - 1356, nominal.secondsOfWeek)
        val toe = BeiDouTime(f.integer(4, 2, 0..Int.MAX_VALUE), f.orbit(2, 0))
        require(abs(toc.secondsSince(toe)) <= 302400) { "BeiDou calendar/full-week mismatch" }
        val transmissionSeconds = f.orbit(6, 0)
        require(transmissionSeconds >= -604800 && transmissionSeconds < 1209600) {
            "Missing or out-of-range BeiDou transmission time"
        }
        val available = BeiDouTime(toe.week, 0.0).plusSeconds(transmissionSeconds)
        require(available.secondsSince(validFrom) >= 0 && validUntil.secondsSince(available) >= 0) {
            "BeiDou transmission outside supplied applicability"
        }
        val e = BeiDouBroadcastEphemeris(record.svid, orbitType, toe, toc, validFrom, validUntil,
            f.orbit(1, 3), f.orbit(1, 1), f.orbit(3, 0), f.orbit(2, 2), f.orbit(3, 2), f.orbit(0, 3),
            f.orbit(0, 2), f.orbit(3, 3), f.orbit(4, 0),
            f.orbit(1, 0), f.orbit(1, 2), f.orbit(3, 1), f.orbit(0, 1), f.orbit(2, 1), f.orbit(2, 3),
            f.clock(0), f.clock(1), f.clock(2))
        val accuracy = f.orbit(5, 0)
        require(accuracy >= 0) { "Invalid BeiDou accuracy" }
        return RinexBeiDouBroadcast(e, available, f.integer(5, 1, 0..1), accuracy,
            f.orbit(5, 2), f.orbit(5, 3), f.integer(6, 1, 0..31), f.integer(0, 0, 0..31))
    }
}
```

`core/src/main/kotlin/com/system/location/service/core/gnss/RinexBeiDouOrbitProvider.kt`:

```kt
package com.system.location.service.core.gnss

/**
 * Explicit application bounds for approximate sky geometry. RINEX A14 supplies no fit field;
 * this age budget is NOT an inferred fit duration or a promise of broadcast orbit accuracy.
 * BDCS and WGS84-compatible ECEF axes are approximated only with explicit permission, without
 * claiming an exact realization/epoch transformation, pseudoranges or precise clock solutions.
 */
data class RinexBeiDouSkyPolicy(val maximumEphemerisDistanceSeconds: Double,
    val maximumTimeCorrectionDistanceSeconds: Double, val allowAlignedFrameApproximation: Boolean) {
    init {
        require(maximumEphemerisDistanceSeconds.isFinite() && maximumEphemerisDistanceSeconds > 0)
        require(maximumTimeCorrectionDistanceSeconds.isFinite() && maximumTimeCorrectionDistanceSeconds > 0)
    }
}

/** Native BDT propagation with dated SVN orbit classes and B1I health, never PRN heuristics. */
class RinexBeiDouOrbitProvider(file: RinexNavigationFile, private val provenance: GnssOrbitProvenance,
    private val utc: GnssUtcTimeScale, private val catalog: BeiDouSkyCatalog,
    private val policy: RinexBeiDouSkyPolicy) : GnssOrbitProvider {
    override val kind = GnssOrbitSourceKind.BROADCAST_EPHEMERIS
    private val diagnostics = mutableListOf<String>()
    private val reserved = file.records.filter { it.system == RinexNavigationSystem.BEIDOU && it.svid in 1..63 }
        .map { Constellation.BEIDOU to it.svid }.toSet()
    private val timeScale = runCatching {
        RinexBeiDouTimeScale(utc, requireNotNull(RinexTimeSystemCorrection.beiDouCorrection(file.timeSystemCorrections)) {
            "Missing BeiDou BDUT correction"
        }, policy.maximumTimeCorrectionDistanceSeconds)
    }
    private data class Upload(val transmitted: BeiDouTime?, val decoded: RinexBeiDouBroadcast?,
        val identity: BeiDouSatelliteIdentity?, val referenceUtcMillis: Long?)
    private val records = file.records.filter { it.system == RinexNavigationSystem.BEIDOU }.groupBy { it.svid }
        .mapValues { (_, rows) -> rows.map { record ->
            // The numeric week is already native BDT; this helper only reads and normalizes
            // the adjusted transmission fields, without a physical GPS/BDT conversion.
            val transmission = record.gpsAlignedTransmission()?.let { BeiDouTime(it.week, it.secondsOfWeek) }
            var identity: BeiDouSatelliteIdentity? = null
            var epoch: Long? = null
            val decoded = runCatching {
                val clock = timeScale.getOrThrow()
                val fields = RinexOrbitFields(record)
                val nominal = RinexNativeEpoch.gps(record.epoch)
                val toc = BeiDouTime(nominal.week - 1356, nominal.secondsOfWeek)
                val toe = BeiDouTime(fields.integer(4, 2, 0..Int.MAX_VALUE), fields.orbit(2, 0))
                val tocUtc = requireNotNull(clock.utcAt(toc)) { "BDT clock epoch outside time evidence" }
                epoch = requireNotNull(clock.utcAt(toe)) { "BDT orbit epoch outside time evidence" }
                identity = requireNotNull(catalog.identityAt(record.svid, tocUtc)) { "Unknown dated BeiDou SVN/orbit class" }
                require(catalog.identityAt(record.svid, requireNotNull(epoch)) == identity) { "BeiDou identity changed between toe/toc" }
                val transmittedUtc = requireNotNull(transmission?.let { clock.utcAt(it) }) { "BDT upload time unavailable" }
                require(catalog.identityAt(record.svid, transmittedUtc) == identity) { "BeiDou upload crosses identity boundary" }
                RinexBeiDouImporter.decode(record, requireNotNull(identity.orbitType),
                    toe.plusSeconds(-policy.maximumEphemerisDistanceSeconds), toe.plusSeconds(policy.maximumEphemerisDistanceSeconds))
            }.getOrElse { diagnostics += "BeiDou:${record.svid}: ${it.message}"; null }
            Upload(transmission, decoded, identity, epoch)
        } }

    init { require(provenance.kind == kind) }

    override fun positions(request: GnssSkyRequest): GnssOrbitBatch {
        fun unavailable(reason: String) = GnssOrbitBatch(emptyList(), diagnostics + reason, reserved)
        if (!policy.allowAlignedFrameApproximation)
            return unavailable("BeiDou: approximate BDCS/WGS84 sky alignment was not permitted")
        val clock = timeScale.getOrNull() ?: return unavailable("BeiDou: missing, damaged or conflicting BDUT correction")
        val time = clock.atUtcMillis(request.atMillis) ?: return unavailable("BeiDou: UTC/BDUT evidence outside application age limit")
        val messages = diagnostics.toMutableList()
        messages += "BeiDou orbit class catalog: ${catalog.description}"
        messages += "BeiDou: approximate BDCS/WGS84 sky axes; ephemeris and BDUT age bounded by application policy, not an inferred broadcast fit"
        val blocked = mutableSetOf<Pair<Constellation, Int>>()
        fun applicable(upload: Upload): Boolean = upload.decoded?.ephemeris?.let {
            time.secondsSince(it.validFrom) >= 0 && it.validUntil.secondsSince(time) >= 0
        } == true
        val positions = records.mapNotNull { (svid, candidates) ->
            val currentIdentity = catalog.identityAt(svid, request.atMillis)
            if (currentIdentity == null || candidates.any { it.transmitted == null }) {
                messages += "BeiDou:$svid: dated identity/catalog age or upload ordering unavailable"
                return@mapNotNull null
            }
            val transmitted = candidates.filter { time.secondsSince(requireNotNull(it.transmitted)) >= 0 }
            val latestTime = transmitted.maxByOrNull { requireNotNull(it.transmitted).let { t -> t.week * 604800.0 + t.secondsOfWeek } }?.transmitted
            val latest = transmitted.filter { it.transmitted == latestTime }.distinct()
            if (latest.any { it.identity == currentIdentity && applicable(it) && it.decoded?.health != 0 })
                blocked += Constellation.BEIDOU to svid
            val selected = latest.singleOrNull()
            val message = selected?.decoded
            if (selected == null || !applicable(selected) || selected.identity != currentIdentity || message == null || message.health != 0) {
                messages += "BeiDou:$svid: no unique applicable healthy B1I upload for the current SVN"
                return@mapNotNull null
            }
            val state = BeiDouBroadcastPropagator.propagate(message.ephemeris, time).state
            if (state == null) {
                messages += "BeiDou:$svid: propagation unavailable"
                null
            } else GnssOrbitPosition(Constellation.BEIDOU, svid,
                EcefPosition(state.xMeters, state.yMeters, state.zMeters),
                provenance.copy(referenceEpochMillis = requireNotNull(selected.referenceUtcMillis)),
                hasEphemeris = true, hasAlmanac = false, carrierHz = 1_561_098_000f)
        }
        return GnssOrbitBatch(positions, messages, reserved, blocked)
    }
}
```

`core/src/main/kotlin/com/system/location/service/core/gnss/RinexBeiDouTimeScale.kt`:

```kt
package com.system.location.service.core.gnss

/**
 * RINEX 3.05 A5 BDUT is a fractional BDT-UTC polynomial at a native BDT reference week.
 * BDT is continuous, with TAI-BDT=33 seconds from its 2006-01-01 UTC origin. GPS-BDT's
 * nominal 14-second relation is NOT the full fractional time correction.
 *
 * Solve b = nominalBDT + a0 + a1*(b-reference), including the (1-a1) denominator.
 * The caller supplies an application age bound, not an invented broadcast validity duration.
 * Nominal UTC realizations and millisecond-resolution inverse are suitable for sky geometry,
 * not a precision timing claim or a raw UTC/BDT leap-transition navigation decoder.
 * https://files.igs.org/pub/data/format/rinex305.pdf
 * https://en.beidou.gov.cn/SYSTEMS/ICD/201902/P020190227702348791891.pdf
 */
class RinexBeiDouTimeScale(
    private val utc: GnssUtcTimeScale,
    private val correction: RinexTimeSystemCorrection,
    private val maximumCorrectionDistanceSeconds: Double,
) {
    val reference = BeiDouTime(correction.referenceWeek, correction.referenceSeconds.toDouble())

    init {
        require(correction.type == "BDUT")
        require(maximumCorrectionDistanceSeconds.isFinite() && maximumCorrectionDistanceSeconds > 0)
    }

    fun atUtcMillis(utcMillis: Long): BeiDouTime? {
        if (correction.a1SecondsPerSecond >= 1) return null
        val gps = utc.gpsAtUtcMillis(utcMillis).time ?: return null
        val nominal = GnssWeekTime.normalize(gps.week.toLong() - GPS_WEEK_ORIGIN, gps.secondsOfWeek - GPS_BDT_SECONDS)
            ?.let { BeiDouTime(it.first, it.second) } ?: return null
        val offset = (correction.a0Seconds + correction.a1SecondsPerSecond * nominal.secondsSince(reference)) /
            (1 - correction.a1SecondsPerSecond)
        if (!offset.isFinite()) return null
        val result = GnssWeekTime.normalize(nominal.week.toLong(), nominal.secondsOfWeek + offset)
            ?.let { BeiDouTime(it.first, it.second) } ?: return null
        return result.takeIf { withinAge(it) }
    }

    fun utcAt(time: BeiDouTime): Long? {
        if (correction.a1SecondsPerSecond >= 1 || !withinAge(time)) return null
        val offset = correction.a0Seconds + correction.a1SecondsPerSecond * time.secondsSince(reference)
        if (!offset.isFinite()) return null
        val gps = GnssWeekTime.normalize(time.week.toLong() + GPS_WEEK_ORIGIN,
            time.secondsOfWeek - offset + GPS_BDT_SECONDS)?.let { GpsTime(it.first, it.second) } ?: return null
        return utc.utcAtGpsTime(gps).utcMillis
    }

    private fun withinAge(time: BeiDouTime) = kotlin.math.abs(time.secondsSince(reference)) <= maximumCorrectionDistanceSeconds

    companion object {
        private const val GPS_WEEK_ORIGIN = 1356L
        private const val GPS_BDT_SECONDS = 14.0
    }
}

```

`core/src/main/kotlin/com/system/location/service/core/gnss/RinexGalileoImporter.kt`:

```kt
package com.system.location.service.core.gnss

import kotlin.math.abs

/** Only the signals actually represented by this RINEX navigation message are reported. */
data class RinexGalileoService(
    val e1bHealthy: Boolean?,
    val e5aHealthy: Boolean?,
    val e5bHealthy: Boolean?,
    val accuracyAvailable: Boolean,
)

data class RinexGalileoBroadcast(
    val ephemeris: GalileoBroadcastEphemeris,
    val availableFrom: GalileoTime,
    val service: RinexGalileoService,
    val bgdE5aE1Seconds: Double,
    val bgdE5bE1Seconds: Double?,
)

/**
 * RINEX 3.05 Table A8. Parsing a native GST epoch establishes no GPS–GST offset or GTRF
 * transformation; a provider must independently supply those before combining other systems.
 */
object RinexGalileoImporter {
    fun decode(record: RinexNavigationRecord): RinexGalileoBroadcast {
        require(record.system == RinexNavigationSystem.GALILEO && record.orbit.size == 7)
        val f = RinexOrbitFields(record)
        val nominal = RinexNativeEpoch.gps(record.epoch)
        // Calendar origin relation only. The record's calendar is already GAL, never UTC/GPS.
        val toc = GalileoTime(nominal.week - 1024, nominal.secondsOfWeek)
        val toe = GalileoTime(f.integer(4, 2, 1024..Int.MAX_VALUE) - 1024, f.orbit(2, 0))
        require(abs(toc.secondsSince(toe)) <= 302400) { "Galileo calendar/full-week mismatch" }
        val source = f.integer(4, 1, 0..1023)
        require(source and 0x31f.inv() == 0) { "Unknown Galileo data source bits" }
        val format = source and 7
        val reference = when {
            format in listOf(1, 4, 5) && source and 0x300 == 0x200 -> GalileoClockReference.INAV_E1_E5B
            format == 2 && source and 0x300 == 0x100 -> GalileoClockReference.FNAV_E1_E5A
            else -> throw IllegalArgumentException("Inconsistent Galileo message and clock source")
        }
        val health = f.integer(5, 1, 0..511)
        val inav = reference == GalileoClockReference.INAV_E1_E5B
        val sisa = f.orbit(5, 0)
        require(sisa >= 0 || sisa == -1.0) { "Invalid Galileo SISA" }
        val service = RinexGalileoService(
            e1bHealthy = if (inav) health and 7 == 0 else null,
            e5aHealthy = if (!inav) health and 0x38 == 0 else null,
            e5bHealthy = if (inav) health and 0x1c0 == 0 else null,
            accuracyAvailable = sisa != -1.0)
        val transmissionSeconds = f.orbit(6, 0)
        require(transmissionSeconds >= -604800 && transmissionSeconds < 1209600) {
            "Missing or out-of-range Galileo transmission time"
        }
        val available = GalileoTime(toe.week, 0.0).plusSeconds(transmissionSeconds)
        val interval = requireNotNull(GalileoEphemerisValidity.resolve(toe))
        require(available.secondsSince(interval.until) <= 0 && abs(available.secondsSince(toe)) <= 604800) {
            "Galileo transmission time inconsistent with ephemeris"
        }
        val e = GalileoBroadcastEphemeris(record.svid, toe, toc, interval.from, interval.until,
            f.integer(0, 0, 0..1023), reference,
            f.orbit(1, 3), f.orbit(1, 1), f.orbit(3, 0), f.orbit(2, 2), f.orbit(3, 2), f.orbit(0, 3),
            f.orbit(0, 2), f.orbit(3, 3), f.orbit(4, 0),
            f.orbit(1, 0), f.orbit(1, 2), f.orbit(3, 1), f.orbit(0, 1), f.orbit(2, 1), f.orbit(2, 3),
            f.clock(0), f.clock(1), f.clock(2))
        return RinexGalileoBroadcast(e, available, service, f.orbit(5, 2),
            if (inav) f.orbit(5, 3) else null)
    }
}
```

`core/src/main/kotlin/com/system/location/service/core/gnss/RinexGalileoOrbitProvider.kt`:

```kt
package com.system.location.service.core.gnss

/**
 * Application limits for approximate sky geometry, not a broadcast GGTO validity guarantee.
 * RINEX A5 supplies no expiry. A missing/conflicting/too-distant GAGP must cause fallback.
 * Frame approximation is opt-in: Galileo OS SDD §1.6.5 describes GPS/GTRF interoperability
 * without further receiver action for most OS applications. This does NOT establish an exact
 * realization/epoch transformation, centimetre accuracy, pseudoranges or satellite clock accuracy.
 * https://www.gsc-europa.eu/sites/default/files/sites/all/files/Galileo-OS-SDD_in_force.pdf
 */
data class RinexGalileoSkyPolicy(
    val maximumTimeCorrectionDistanceSeconds: Double,
    val allowAlignedFrameApproximation: Boolean,
) {
    init { require(maximumTimeCorrectionDistanceSeconds.isFinite() && maximumTimeCorrectionDistanceSeconds > 0) }
}

/** Galileo E1 sky adapter; F/NAV alone cannot establish E1-B service health. */
class RinexGalileoOrbitProvider(
    file: RinexNavigationFile,
    private val provenance: GnssOrbitProvenance,
    private val utc: GnssUtcTimeScale,
    private val policy: RinexGalileoSkyPolicy,
) : GnssOrbitProvider {
    override val kind = GnssOrbitSourceKind.BROADCAST_EPHEMERIS
    private val reserved = file.records.filter { it.system == RinexNavigationSystem.GALILEO && it.svid in 1..36 }
        .map { Constellation.GALILEO to it.svid }.toSet()
    private val diagnostics = mutableListOf<String>()
    private val correction = runCatching { RinexTimeSystemCorrection.galileoCorrection(file.timeSystemCorrections) }
    private data class Upload(val transmittedAt: GalileoTime?, val decoded: RinexGalileoBroadcast?)
    private val records = file.records.filter { it.system == RinexNavigationSystem.GALILEO }
        .filterNot {
            // RINEX A8 bit 1 F/NAV plus bit 8 E1/E5a clock reference. Even a malformed
            // F/NAV orbit cannot supersede E1 I/NAV; an unknown source cannot be ignored.
            it.orbit.getOrNull(4)?.getOrNull(1) == 0x102.toDouble()
        }.groupBy { it.svid }.mapValues { (_, rows) -> rows.map { record ->
            val stamp = record.gpsAlignedTransmission()?.let {
                if (it.week >= 1024) GalileoTime(it.week - 1024, it.secondsOfWeek) else null
            }
            Upload(stamp, runCatching { RinexGalileoImporter.decode(record) }.getOrElse {
                diagnostics += "Galileo:${record.svid}: ${it.message}"
                null
            })
        } }

    init { require(provenance.kind == kind) }

    override fun positions(request: GnssSkyRequest): GnssOrbitBatch {
        fun unavailable(reason: String) = GnssOrbitBatch(emptyList(), diagnostics + reason, reserved)
        if (!policy.allowAlignedFrameApproximation)
            return unavailable("Galileo: approximate GTRF/WGS84 sky alignment was not permitted")
        val c = correction.getOrNull()
            ?: return unavailable("Galileo: missing, damaged or conflicting RINEX GAGP correction")
        if (c.referenceWeek < 1024) return unavailable("Galileo: GAGP reference precedes GST origin")
        val reference = GalileoTime(c.referenceWeek - 1024, c.referenceSeconds.toDouble())
        val interval = runCatching { reference.plusSeconds(-policy.maximumTimeCorrectionDistanceSeconds) to
            reference.plusSeconds(policy.maximumTimeCorrectionDistanceSeconds) }.getOrNull()
            ?: return unavailable("Galileo: unsupported correction policy interval")
        val gps = utc.gpsAtUtcMillis(request.atMillis)
        val gpsTime = gps.time ?: return unavailable("Galileo: ${gps.reason}")
        val time = c.gpsToGalileo(gpsTime, interval.first, interval.second)
            ?: return unavailable("Galileo: GAGP outside application age limit or not invertible")
        val messages = diagnostics.toMutableList()
        messages += "Galileo: approximate GTRF/WGS84 sky alignment; GAGP age limited by application policy, not guaranteed broadcast validity"
        val blocked = mutableSetOf<Pair<Constellation, Int>>()
        val positions = records.mapNotNull { (svid, candidates) ->
            if (candidates.any { it.transmittedAt == null }) {
                messages += "Galileo:$svid: upload ordering unavailable; no older broadcast may be revived"
                return@mapNotNull null
            }
            val transmitted = candidates.filter { time.secondsSince(requireNotNull(it.transmittedAt)) >= 0 }
            val latestTime = transmitted.maxByOrNull {
                requireNotNull(it.transmittedAt).let { stamp -> stamp.week * 604800.0 + stamp.secondsOfWeek }
            }?.transmittedAt
            val latest = transmitted.filter { it.transmittedAt == latestTime }.distinct()
            fun applicable(record: RinexGalileoBroadcast) = time.secondsSince(record.ephemeris.validFrom) >= 0 &&
                record.ephemeris.validUntil.secondsSince(time) >= 0
            if (latest.mapNotNull { it.decoded }.any { applicable(it) && it.service.e1bHealthy == false })
                blocked += Constellation.GALILEO to svid
            val accepted = latest.singleOrNull()?.decoded
            if (accepted == null || !applicable(accepted) || accepted.service.e1bHealthy != true ||
                !accepted.service.accuracyAvailable) {
                messages += "Galileo:$svid: no unique applicable healthy E1 RINEX upload with SISA"
                return@mapNotNull null
            }
            val state = GalileoBroadcastPropagator.propagate(accepted.ephemeris, time).state
            val referenceGps = c.galileoToGps(accepted.ephemeris.toe, interval.first, interval.second)
            val epoch = referenceGps?.let { utc.utcAtGpsTime(it).utcMillis }
            if (state == null || epoch == null) {
                messages += "Galileo:$svid: propagation or reference time conversion unavailable"
                null
            } else GnssOrbitPosition(Constellation.GALILEO, svid,
                EcefPosition(state.xMeters, state.yMeters, state.zMeters),
                provenance.copy(referenceEpochMillis = epoch), hasEphemeris = true, hasAlmanac = false)
        }
        return GnssOrbitBatch(positions, messages, reserved, blocked)
    }
}
```

`core/src/main/kotlin/com/system/location/service/core/gnss/RinexGlonassImporter.kt`:

```kt
package com.system.location.service.core.gnss

data class RinexGlonassBroadcast(
    val orbit: GlonassBroadcastStateVector,
    val referenceUtc: RinexNavigationEpoch,
    /** RINEX already stores -tauN; do not negate it a second time. */
    val clockBiasSeconds: Double,
    val relativeFrequencyBias: Double,
    val frameTimeUtcWeekSeconds: Double,
    val unhealthy: Boolean,
    val frequencyNumber: Int,
    val ageDays: Int,
    val statusFlags: Int?,
    val l1L2GroupDelaySeconds: Double?,
    val accuracyIndex: Int?,
    val healthFlags: Int?,
)

/**
 * RINEX 3.05 A10: km, km/s and km/s² become SI exactly once; UTC labels are NOT UTC+3.
 * The caller supplies the PZ-90 realization. Health/status and message age do not establish
 * a continuous time domain, an applicability interval or a WGS84 datum transformation.
 */
object RinexGlonassImporter {
    fun decode(record: RinexNavigationRecord, referenceFrame: GlonassReferenceFrame): RinexGlonassBroadcast {
        require(record.system == RinexNavigationSystem.GLONASS && record.orbit.size in 3..4)
        val f = RinexOrbitFields(record)
        fun vector(column: Int) = GlonassCartesianVector(f.orbit(0, column) * 1000,
            f.orbit(1, column) * 1000, f.orbit(2, column) * 1000)
        val state = GlonassBroadcastStateVector(record.svid, referenceFrame, vector(0), vector(1), vector(2))
        val frameTime = f.clock(2)
        require(frameTime >= 0 && frameTime < 604801) { "Invalid GLONASS UTC frame time" }
        val extra = record.orbit.size == 4
        fun optionalInteger(column: Int, range: IntRange): Int? =
            if (extra && record.orbit[3][column] != null) f.integer(3, column, range) else null
        val status = optionalInteger(0, 0..511)
        val delay = if (extra) record.orbit[3][1]?.also { require(it.isFinite()) }
            ?.takeUnless { it == 999999999.999 } else null
        val accuracy = optionalInteger(2, 0..15)?.takeUnless { it == 15 }
        return RinexGlonassBroadcast(state, record.epoch, f.clock(0), f.clock(1), frameTime,
            f.integer(0, 3, 0..1) != 0,
            // RINEX permits -7..+13; +7..+13 do not establish a usable FDMA carrier.
            f.integer(1, 3, -7..13), f.integer(2, 3, 0..31), status, delay, accuracy,
            optionalInteger(3, 0..7))
    }
}
```

`core/src/main/kotlin/com/system/location/service/core/gnss/RinexGlonassOrbitProvider.kt`:

```kt
package com.system.location.service.core.gnss

import java.time.ZoneOffset
import kotlin.math.abs

/** Source-era evidence and explicit sky-only frame approximation, never inferred from slot. */
data class RinexGlonassSkyPolicy(
    val pz9011OperationalFromUtcMillis: Long,
    val allowApproximateItrfAlignment: Boolean,
) {
    init { require(pz9011OperationalFromUtcMillis >= 0) }
}

/**
 * RINEX 3 A10 UTC epochs -> continuous SI elapsed seconds -> native GLONASS RK4.
 * UTC labels are not UTC+3 and POSIX subtraction is not used for integration across a leap.
 * Nominal UTC is used for sky timing; fractional UTC(SU)/UTC corrections, ranging/clock
 * observables and exact contemporary WGS84 realization transformations are outside this adapter.
 */
class RinexGlonassOrbitProvider(file: RinexNavigationFile, private val provenance: GnssOrbitProvenance,
    private val utc: GnssUtcTimeScale, private val policy: RinexGlonassSkyPolicy) : GnssOrbitProvider {
    override val kind = GnssOrbitSourceKind.BROADCAST_EPHEMERIS
    private val diagnostics = mutableListOf<String>()
    private val reserved = file.records.filter { it.system == RinexNavigationSystem.GLONASS }
        .mapNotNull { r -> GnssSatelliteIds.nmeaId(Constellation.GLONASS, r.svid)?.let { Constellation.GLONASS to r.svid } }.toSet()
    private data class Upload(val referenceUtcMillis: Long?, val reference: GpsTime?,
        val transmitted: GpsTime?, val decoded: RinexGlonassBroadcast?)
    private val records = file.records.filter { it.system == RinexNavigationSystem.GLONASS }.groupBy { it.svid }
        .mapValues { (_, rows) -> rows.map { record ->
            val referenceMillis = runCatching {
                require(record.epoch.second < 60) { "UTC leap-second label is not representable in POSIX" }
                record.epoch.date.atTime(record.epoch.hour, record.epoch.minute, record.epoch.second)
                    .toInstant(ZoneOffset.UTC).toEpochMilli()
            }.getOrNull()
            val reference = referenceMillis?.let { utc.gpsAtUtcMillis(it).time }
            val transmission = runCatching {
                val frame = requireNotNull(record.clock.getOrNull(2))
                require(frame.isFinite() && frame >= 0 && frame < 604800 && frame == frame.toLong().toDouble())
                val sunday = record.epoch.date.minusDays((record.epoch.date.dayOfWeek.value % 7).toLong())
                // Resolve the nearest civil week to tb, not the week containing the request.
                // This disambiguates Saturday/Sunday uploads without reviving data next week.
                requireNotNull(reference)
                (-1..1).mapNotNull { shift ->
                    val stamp = sunday.plusWeeks(shift.toLong()).atStartOfDay().toInstant(ZoneOffset.UTC)
                        .toEpochMilli() + frame.toLong() * 1000
                    utc.gpsAtUtcMillis(stamp).time
                }.minByOrNull { abs(it.secondsSince(reference)) }
            }.getOrNull()
            val decoded = runCatching { RinexGlonassImporter.decode(record, GlonassReferenceFrame.PZ_90_11) }
                .getOrElse { diagnostics += "GLONASS:${record.svid}: ${it.message}"; null }
            Upload(referenceMillis, reference, transmission, decoded)
        } }

    init { require(provenance.kind == kind) }

    override fun positions(request: GnssSkyRequest): GnssOrbitBatch {
        fun unavailable(reason: String) = GnssOrbitBatch(emptyList(), diagnostics + reason, reserved)
        if (!policy.allowApproximateItrfAlignment)
            return unavailable("GLONASS: approximate ITRF2008/WGS84 alignment was not permitted")
        val conversion = utc.gpsAtUtcMillis(request.atMillis)
        val time = conversion.time ?: return unavailable("GLONASS: ${conversion.reason}")
        val messages = diagnostics.toMutableList()
        messages += "GLONASS: PZ-90.11 via EPSG:7960 (epoch 2010.0), approximate ITRF2008/WGS84 sky axes and nominal UTC timing"
        val blocked = mutableSetOf<Pair<Constellation, Int>>()
        fun applicable(upload: Upload): Boolean = upload.referenceUtcMillis != null && upload.reference != null &&
            upload.transmitted != null && upload.referenceUtcMillis >= policy.pz9011OperationalFromUtcMillis &&
            abs(time.secondsSince(upload.reference)) < 900 &&
            // Frame starts can be exactly 15 minutes before tb; this is distinct from the
            // propagator's strict |t-tb| < 15-minute integration applicability.
            abs(upload.transmitted.secondsSince(upload.reference)) <= 900
        fun unhealthy(message: RinexGlonassBroadcast): Boolean {
            // RINEX 3.05 GLO-M/K-only flags are meaningful only when M (bits 7-8) is 01.
            val modern = message.statusFlags?.let { (it ushr 7) and 3 == 1 } == true
            val flags = message.healthFlags
            return message.unhealthy || (modern && flags != null &&
                (flags and 4 != 0 || (flags and 2 != 0 && flags and 1 == 0)))
        }
        val positions = records.mapNotNull { (svid, candidates) ->
            if (GnssSatelliteIds.nmeaId(Constellation.GLONASS, svid) == null) {
                messages += "GLONASS:$svid: unsupported output slot identity"
                return@mapNotNull null
            }
            if (candidates.any { it.transmitted == null }) {
                messages += "GLONASS:$svid: upload ordering unavailable; no older broadcast may be revived"
                return@mapNotNull null
            }
            val transmitted = candidates.filter { time.secondsSince(requireNotNull(it.transmitted)) >= 0 }
            val latestTime = transmitted.maxByOrNull { requireNotNull(it.transmitted).let { t -> t.week * 604800.0 + t.secondsOfWeek } }?.transmitted
            val latest = transmitted.filter { it.transmitted == latestTime }.distinct()
            if (latest.any { applicable(it) && it.decoded?.let(::unhealthy) == true }) blocked += Constellation.GLONASS to svid
            val selected = latest.singleOrNull()
            val message = selected?.decoded
            if (selected == null || !applicable(selected) || message == null || unhealthy(message) ||
                message.frequencyNumber !in -7..6 || GnssSatelliteIds.nmeaId(Constellation.GLONASS, svid) == null) {
                messages += "GLONASS:$svid: no unique applicable healthy L1 FDMA upload in supported PZ-90.11 era"
                return@mapNotNull null
            }
            val state = GlonassBroadcastPropagator.propagate(message.orbit,
                time.secondsSince(requireNotNull(selected.reference))).state
            if (state == null) {
                messages += "GLONASS:$svid: integration unavailable"
                null
            } else GnssOrbitPosition(Constellation.GLONASS, svid,
                GlonassSkyFrameApproximation.pz9011ToItrf2008(state.positionMeters),
                provenance.copy(referenceEpochMillis = requireNotNull(selected.referenceUtcMillis)),
                hasEphemeris = true, hasAlmanac = false,
                carrierHz = (1_602_000_000.0 + message.frequencyNumber * 562_500.0).toFloat())
        }
        return GnssOrbitBatch(positions, messages, reserved, blocked)
    }
}
```

`core/src/main/kotlin/com/system/location/service/core/gnss/RinexGpsOrbitProvider.kt`:

```kt
package com.system.location.service.core.gnss

import java.time.ZoneOffset
import kotlin.math.abs

/** Native system calendar conversion. This deliberately does not add UTC leap seconds. */
internal object RinexNativeEpoch {
    fun gps(epoch: RinexNavigationEpoch): GpsTime {
        require(epoch.second < 60) { "Leap-second label is not a GPS calendar epoch" }
        val seconds = epoch.date.atTime(epoch.hour, epoch.minute, epoch.second).toEpochSecond(ZoneOffset.UTC) -
            GnssUtcTimeScale.GPS_EPOCH_MILLIS / 1000
        require(seconds >= 0 && seconds / 604800 <= Int.MAX_VALUE)
        return GpsTime((seconds / 604800).toInt(), (seconds % 604800).toDouble())
    }
}

/** RINEX numeric presence/range checks are independent of the text parser. */
internal class RinexOrbitFields(private val record: RinexNavigationRecord) {
    fun orbit(row: Int, column: Int): Double = requireNotNull(record.orbit.getOrNull(row)?.getOrNull(column)) {
        "Missing orbit field ${row + 1}/${column + 1}"
    }.also { require(it.isFinite()) }
    fun clock(column: Int): Double = requireNotNull(record.clock.getOrNull(column)) { "Missing clock field" }
        .also { require(it.isFinite()) }
    fun integer(row: Int, column: Int, range: IntRange): Int {
        val value = orbit(row, column)
        require(value >= range.first && value <= range.last && value == value.toInt().toDouble()) {
            "Invalid integer orbit field ${row + 1}/${column + 1}"
        }
        return value.toInt()
    }
}

data class RinexGpsBroadcast(val ephemeris: GpsLnavEphemeris, val availableFrom: GpsTime)

/** Ordering survives an invalid orbit/clock payload; rejecting it must not revive an old upload. */
internal fun RinexNavigationRecord.gpsAlignedTransmission(): GpsTime? = runCatching {
    val fields = RinexOrbitFields(this)
    val week = fields.integer(4, 2, 0..Int.MAX_VALUE)
    val seconds = fields.orbit(6, 0)
    require(seconds >= -604800 && seconds < 1209600)
    GpsTime(week, 0.0).plusSeconds(seconds)
}.getOrNull()

/** IS-GPS-200N fit duration is supplied by RINEX A6 in HOURS, not a one-bit flag. */
object RinexGpsImporter {
    fun decode(record: RinexNavigationRecord): RinexGpsBroadcast {
        require(record.system == RinexNavigationSystem.GPS && record.orbit.size == 7)
        val f = RinexOrbitFields(record)
        val toc = RinexNativeEpoch.gps(record.epoch)
        val toe = GpsTime(f.integer(4, 2, 0..Int.MAX_VALUE), f.orbit(2, 0))
        require(abs(toc.secondsSince(toe)) <= 302400) { "GPS calendar/full-week mismatch" }
        val fitHours = f.orbit(6, 1)
        require(fitHours > 0) { "Unknown GPS fit duration" }
        val from = toe.plusSeconds(-fitHours * 1800)
        val until = toe.plusSeconds(fitHours * 1800)
        // RINEX already adjusts transmission seconds relative to the reported full week.
        val transmissionSeconds = f.orbit(6, 0)
        require(transmissionSeconds >= -604800 && transmissionSeconds < 1209600) {
            "Missing or out-of-range GPS transmission time"
        }
        val available = GpsTime(toe.week, 0.0).plusSeconds(transmissionSeconds)
        require(available.secondsSince(until) <= 0 && abs(available.secondsSince(toe)) <= 604800) {
            "GPS transmission time inconsistent with ephemeris"
        }
        val iode = f.integer(0, 0, 0..255)
        val e = GpsLnavEphemeris(record.svid, toe, toc, from, until, iode, iode,
            f.integer(5, 3, 0..1023), f.integer(5, 1, 0..63),
            f.orbit(1, 3), f.orbit(1, 1), f.orbit(3, 0), f.orbit(2, 2), f.orbit(3, 2), f.orbit(0, 3),
            f.orbit(0, 2), f.orbit(3, 3), f.orbit(4, 0),
            f.orbit(1, 0), f.orbit(1, 2), f.orbit(3, 1), f.orbit(0, 1), f.orbit(2, 1), f.orbit(2, 3),
            f.clock(0), f.clock(1), f.clock(2), f.orbit(5, 2))
        require(toc == toe) { "GPS LNAV clock/orbit reference epochs differ" }
        return RinexGpsBroadcast(e, available)
    }
}

/** Native GPS orbit at the requested system epoch; approximate sky geometry, not observables. */
class RinexGpsOrbitProvider(file: RinexNavigationFile, private val provenance: GnssOrbitProvenance,
    private val utc: GnssUtcTimeScale) : GnssOrbitProvider {
    override val kind = GnssOrbitSourceKind.BROADCAST_EPHEMERIS
    private val reserved = file.records.filter { it.system == RinexNavigationSystem.GPS && it.svid in 1..32 }
        .map { Constellation.GPS to it.svid }.toSet()
    private val diagnostics = mutableListOf<String>()
    private data class Upload(val transmittedAt: GpsTime?, val decoded: RinexGpsBroadcast?)
    private val records = file.records.filter { it.system == RinexNavigationSystem.GPS }.groupBy { it.svid }.mapValues { (_, rows) ->
        rows.map { record -> Upload(record.gpsAlignedTransmission(), runCatching { RinexGpsImporter.decode(record) }.getOrElse {
            diagnostics += "GPS:${record.svid}: ${it.message}"
            null
        }) }
    }

    init { require(provenance.kind == kind) }

    override fun positions(request: GnssSkyRequest): GnssOrbitBatch {
        val conversion = utc.gpsAtUtcMillis(request.atMillis)
        val time = conversion.time ?: return GnssOrbitBatch(emptyList(),
            diagnostics + requireNotNull(conversion.reason), reserved)
        val messages = diagnostics.toMutableList()
        val blocked = mutableSetOf<Pair<Constellation, Int>>()
        val positions = records.mapNotNull { (svid, candidates) ->
            // Do not look ahead to a future transmission or revive a prior healthy upload after
            // a newer applicable unhealthy one. Expired uploads can fall back to other sources.
            if (candidates.any { it.transmittedAt == null }) {
                messages += "GPS:$svid: upload ordering unavailable; no older broadcast may be revived"
                return@mapNotNull null
            }
            val transmitted = candidates.filter { time.secondsSince(requireNotNull(it.transmittedAt)) >= 0 }
            val latestTime = transmitted.maxByOrNull {
                requireNotNull(it.transmittedAt).let { stamp -> stamp.week * 604800.0 + stamp.secondsOfWeek }
            }?.transmittedAt
            val latest = transmitted.filter { it.transmittedAt == latestTime }.distinct()
            val decoded = latest.mapNotNull { it.decoded }
            if (decoded.any { time.secondsSince(it.ephemeris.validFrom) >= 0 &&
                    it.ephemeris.validUntil.secondsSince(time) >= 0 && it.ephemeris.health != 0 })
                blocked += Constellation.GPS to svid
            val accepted = latest.singleOrNull()?.decoded
            if (accepted == null || time.secondsSince(accepted.ephemeris.validFrom) < 0 ||
                accepted.ephemeris.validUntil.secondsSince(time) < 0) {
                messages += "GPS:$svid: no applicable RINEX broadcast upload"
                return@mapNotNull null
            }
            if (accepted.ephemeris.health != 0) blocked += Constellation.GPS to svid
            val result = GpsBroadcastPropagator.propagate(accepted.ephemeris, time)
            val state = result.state
            if (state == null) {
                messages += "GPS:$svid: ${result.reason}"
                null
            } else GnssOrbitPosition(Constellation.GPS, svid,
                EcefPosition(state.xMeters, state.yMeters, state.zMeters), provenance,
                hasEphemeris = true, hasAlmanac = false)
        }
        return GnssOrbitBatch(positions, messages, reserved, blocked)
    }
}
```

`core/src/main/kotlin/com/system/location/service/core/gnss/RinexNavigationFile.kt`:

```kt
package com.system.location.service.core.gnss

import java.time.LocalDate

/** Native calendar labels; not UTC timestamps. GLONASS labels alone use UTC in RINEX 3. */
data class RinexNavigationEpoch(val date: LocalDate, val hour: Int, val minute: Int, val second: Int) {
    init { require(date.year in 1..9999 && hour in 0..23 && minute in 0..59 && second in 0..60) }
}

enum class RinexNavigationSystem(val code: Char, internal val ordinaryRows: Int) {
    GPS('G', 7), GALILEO('E', 7), BEIDOU('C', 7), GLONASS('R', 3),
    QZSS('J', 7), SBAS('S', 3), IRNSS('I', 7);
}

/**
 * Lossless numeric fields including absent/spare fields. Presence is not evidence of health,
 * fit, clock correction, orbit class or propagation suitability; system adapters decide those.
 * In particular Galileo's RINEX week is GPS-aligned, NOT the native GST week.
 */
data class RinexNavigationRecord(
    val system: RinexNavigationSystem,
    val svid: Int,
    val epoch: RinexNavigationEpoch,
    val clock: List<Double?>,
    val orbit: List<List<Double?>>,
)

data class RinexNavigationFile(
    val version: String,
    val timeSystemCorrections: List<String>,
    val leapSecondHeaders: List<String>,
    val records: List<RinexNavigationRecord>,
)

/**
 * Bounded fixed-column RINEX 3.02–3.05 navigation reader, Tables A5–A18.
 * https://files.igs.org/pub/data/format/rinex305.pdf
 * No RINEX 2/4 guessing, whitespace tokenization, week modulo, unit or epoch conversion.
 * A damaged resource is rejected atomically so the resource store can retain its last good file.
 */
object RinexNavigationReader {
    const val MAX_BYTES = 32 * 1024 * 1024
    const val MAX_RECORDS = 50_000
    private const val MAX_HEADER_LINES = 2048
    private val number = Regex("[+-]?(?:[0-9]+(?:\\.[0-9]*)?|\\.[0-9]+)(?:[EeDd][+-]?[0-9]+)?")
    private val firstLine = Regex("([GECRJSI])([0-9]{2}) ([0-9]{4}) ([ 0-9][0-9]) ([ 0-9][0-9]) ([ 0-9][0-9]) ([ 0-9][0-9]) ([ 0-9][0-9])")

    fun read(text: String): RinexNavigationFile {
        require(text.length <= MAX_BYTES && text.toByteArray(Charsets.UTF_8).size <= MAX_BYTES) {
            "RINEX navigation resource exceeds size limit"
        }
        require(text.all { it == '\r' || it == '\n' || it in ' '..'~' }) { "Non-ASCII RINEX content" }
        val lines = text.lineSequence().iterator()
        var lineNumber = 0
        fun next(): String {
            require(lines.hasNext()) { "Truncated RINEX navigation at line ${lineNumber + 1}" }
            val line = lines.next()
            lineNumber++
            require(line.length <= 80) { "RINEX line $lineNumber exceeds 80 columns" }
            return line
        }
        val header = next().padEnd(80)
        require(header.substring(60).trim() == "RINEX VERSION / TYPE" && header[20] == 'N') {
            "Not a RINEX navigation file"
        }
        val version = header.substring(0, 9).trim()
        require(version in listOf("3.02", "3.03", "3.04", "3.05")) { "Unsupported RINEX version $version" }
        val declaredSystem = header[40]
        require(declaredSystem == 'M' || RinexNavigationSystem.entries.any { it.code == declaredSystem }) {
            "Unknown RINEX header satellite system"
        }
        val corrections = mutableListOf<String>()
        val leaps = mutableListOf<String>()
        while (true) {
            require(lineNumber < MAX_HEADER_LINES) { "RINEX header exceeds line limit" }
            val line = next().padEnd(80)
            when (line.substring(60).trim()) {
                "RINEX VERSION / TYPE" -> error("Duplicate RINEX version header")
                "TIME SYSTEM CORR" -> corrections += line.substring(0, 60)
                "LEAP SECONDS" -> leaps += line.substring(0, 60)
                "END OF HEADER" -> break
                "" -> error("Missing RINEX header label at line $lineNumber")
            }
        }
        fun numericFields(line: String, start: Int, count: Int): List<Double?> {
            require(line.drop(start + 19 * count).isBlank()) { "Extra RINEX numeric fields at line $lineNumber" }
            val padded = line.padEnd(start + 19 * count)
            return (0 until count).map { column ->
                val token = padded.substring(start + column * 19, start + (column + 1) * 19).trim()
                if (token.isEmpty()) null else {
                    require(number.matches(token)) { "Invalid RINEX number at line $lineNumber, field ${column + 1}" }
                    token.replace('D', 'E').replace('d', 'e').toDouble().also {
                        require(it.isFinite()) { "Non-finite RINEX number at line $lineNumber" }
                    }
                }
            }
        }
        val records = mutableListOf<RinexNavigationRecord>()
        while (lines.hasNext()) {
            val line = next()
            // A single terminating newline is not another record. Interior empty lines are invalid.
            if (line.isEmpty() && !lines.hasNext()) break
            require(records.size < MAX_RECORDS) { "RINEX record limit exceeded" }
            require(line.length >= 23) { "Missing RINEX satellite epoch at line $lineNumber" }
            val match = requireNotNull(firstLine.matchEntire(line.substring(0, 23))) {
                "Invalid RINEX satellite epoch at line $lineNumber"
            }.groupValues
            val system = RinexNavigationSystem.entries.single { it.code == match[1].single() }
            require(declaredSystem == 'M' || declaredSystem == system.code) { "RINEX header/record system mismatch" }
            val svid = match[2].toInt()
            require(svid in 1..99) { "Invalid RINEX satellite number" }
            val epoch = RinexNavigationEpoch(LocalDate.of(match[3].toInt(), match[4].trim().toInt(),
                match[5].trim().toInt()), match[6].trim().toInt(), match[7].trim().toInt(), match[8].trim().toInt())
            val clock = numericFields(line, 23, 3)
            val rows = system.ordinaryRows + if (system == RinexNavigationSystem.GLONASS && version == "3.05") 1 else 0
            val orbit = (0 until rows).map {
                val continuation = next()
                require(continuation.length >= 4 && continuation.take(4) == "    ") {
                    "Invalid RINEX continuation at line $lineNumber"
                }
                numericFields(continuation, 4, 4)
            }
            records += RinexNavigationRecord(system, svid, epoch, clock, orbit)
        }
        require(records.isNotEmpty()) { "RINEX navigation file contains no records" }
        return RinexNavigationFile(version, corrections.toList(), leaps.toList(), records.toList())
    }
}
```
