`core/src/main/kotlin/com/system/location/service/core/gnss/RinexNavigationResource.kt`:

```kt
package com.system.location.service.core.gnss

import java.io.ByteArrayInputStream
import java.io.ByteArrayOutputStream
import java.net.URI
import java.security.MessageDigest
import java.util.Base64
import java.util.zip.GZIPInputStream
import java.util.zip.GZIPOutputStream
import kotlinx.serialization.Serializable
import kotlinx.serialization.json.Json

/**
 * Versioned original navigation text. Download time never becomes an orbital reference epoch.
 * Transport is smaller than an entire daily archive; archive selection must happen before import
 * and must preserve native epochs, transmissions and applicable negative health evidence.
 */
@Serializable
data class RinexNavigationResource(
    val formatVersion: Int = 1,
    val sourceUrl: String,
    val sha256: String,
    val downloadedAtMillis: Long,
    val navigation: String,
    val beiDouCatalog: BeiDouCatalogResource? = null,
) {
    init {
        require(formatVersion == 1 && sourceUrl.length <= 2048)
        val source = URI(sourceUrl)
        require(source.scheme == "https" && !source.host.isNullOrBlank() && source.userInfo == null && source.fragment == null)
        require(sha256.matches(Regex("[a-f0-9]{64}")) && downloadedAtMillis >= 0)
        require(navigation.length <= MAX_NAVIGATION_BYTES && navigation.toByteArray(Charsets.UTF_8).size <= MAX_NAVIGATION_BYTES)
    }

    // Process-local cache, excluded from serialization/equality. No receiver or frame state here.
    internal val parsed: RinexNavigationFile by lazy {
        require(digest(navigation) == sha256) { "RINEX resource digest mismatch" }
        RinexNavigationReader.read(navigation)
    }

    fun validate(): RinexNavigationResource = apply { parsed; beiDouCatalog?.validate() }

    fun gpsProvider(utc: GnssUtcTimeScale): RinexGpsOrbitProvider {
        val gps = parsed.records.filter { it.system == RinexNavigationSystem.GPS }
            .mapNotNull { runCatching { RinexGpsImporter.decode(it) }.getOrNull() }
        require(gps.isNotEmpty()) { "RINEX resource has no usable GPS broadcast records" }
        val reference = gps.maxBy { it.ephemeris.toe.week * 604800.0 + it.ephemeris.toe.secondsOfWeek }.ephemeris.toe
        val epoch = requireNotNull(utc.utcAtGpsTime(reference).utcMillis) { "RINEX GPS reference outside UTC resource" }
        return RinexGpsOrbitProvider(parsed, GnssOrbitProvenance("rinex-gps", sha256, sourceUrl, epoch,
            GnssOrbitSourceKind.BROADCAST_EPHEMERIS), utc)
    }

    fun galileoProvider(utc: GnssUtcTimeScale, policy: RinexGalileoSkyPolicy): RinexGalileoOrbitProvider {
        val correction = RinexTimeSystemCorrection.galileoCorrection(parsed.timeSystemCorrections)
        require(correction != null && correction.referenceWeek >= 1024) { "Missing or conflicting Galileo GAGP" }
        val reference = GalileoTime(correction.referenceWeek - 1024, correction.referenceSeconds.toDouble())
        val from = reference.plusSeconds(-policy.maximumTimeCorrectionDistanceSeconds)
        val until = reference.plusSeconds(policy.maximumTimeCorrectionDistanceSeconds)
        val epochs = parsed.records.filter { it.system == RinexNavigationSystem.GALILEO }.mapNotNull {
            runCatching { RinexGalileoImporter.decode(it).ephemeris.toe }.getOrNull()
                ?.let { toe -> correction.galileoToGps(toe, from, until) }
                ?.let { time -> utc.utcAtGpsTime(time).utcMillis }
        }
        val epoch = requireNotNull(epochs.maxOrNull()) { "No convertible Galileo reference epoch" }
        return RinexGalileoOrbitProvider(parsed, GnssOrbitProvenance("rinex-galileo", sha256, sourceUrl, epoch,
            GnssOrbitSourceKind.BROADCAST_EPHEMERIS), utc, policy)
    }

    fun glonassProvider(utc: GnssUtcTimeScale, policy: RinexGlonassSkyPolicy): RinexGlonassOrbitProvider {
        val epochs = parsed.records.filter { it.system == RinexNavigationSystem.GLONASS }.mapNotNull { record ->
            runCatching {
                require(record.epoch.second < 60)
                record.epoch.date.atTime(record.epoch.hour, record.epoch.minute, record.epoch.second)
                    .toInstant(java.time.ZoneOffset.UTC).toEpochMilli()
            }.getOrNull()
        }
        val epoch = requireNotNull(epochs.maxOrNull()) { "No representable GLONASS UTC reference epoch" }
        return RinexGlonassOrbitProvider(parsed, GnssOrbitProvenance("rinex-glonass", sha256, sourceUrl, epoch,
            GnssOrbitSourceKind.BROADCAST_EPHEMERIS), utc, policy)
    }

    fun beiDouProvider(utc: GnssUtcTimeScale, catalog: BeiDouSkyCatalog, policy: RinexBeiDouSkyPolicy): RinexBeiDouOrbitProvider {
        val correction = requireNotNull(RinexTimeSystemCorrection.beiDouCorrection(parsed.timeSystemCorrections)) {
            "Missing BeiDou BDUT correction"
        }
        val time = RinexBeiDouTimeScale(utc, correction, policy.maximumTimeCorrectionDistanceSeconds)
        val epochs = parsed.records.filter { it.system == RinexNavigationSystem.BEIDOU }.mapNotNull {
            runCatching {
                val fields = RinexOrbitFields(it)
                time.utcAt(BeiDouTime(fields.integer(4, 2, 0..Int.MAX_VALUE), fields.orbit(2, 0)))
            }.getOrNull()
        }
        val epoch = requireNotNull(epochs.maxOrNull()) { "No convertible BeiDou reference epoch" }
        return RinexBeiDouOrbitProvider(parsed, GnssOrbitProvenance("rinex-beidou", sha256, sourceUrl, epoch,
            GnssOrbitSourceKind.BROADCAST_EPHEMERIS), utc, catalog, policy)
    }

    /** Native clock-calendar high-water marks; never compare them as inter-system UTC instants. */
    internal fun epochLabels(): Map<RinexNavigationSystem, String> = parsed.records.groupBy { it.system }.mapValues { (_, records) ->
        records.maxOf { r -> "%04d-%02d-%02dT%02d:%02d:%02d".format(java.util.Locale.ROOT,
            r.epoch.date.year, r.epoch.date.monthValue, r.epoch.date.dayOfMonth,
            r.epoch.hour, r.epoch.minute, r.epoch.second) }
    }

    companion object {
        const val MAX_NAVIGATION_BYTES = 1_048_576
        const val MAX_JSON_BYTES = 1_200_000
        const val MAX_WIRE_LENGTH = 131_072
        private val json = Json { encodeDefaults = true }

        fun import(navigation: String, sourceUrl: String, downloadedAtMillis: Long): RinexNavigationResource =
            RinexNavigationResource(sourceUrl = sourceUrl, sha256 = digest(navigation),
                downloadedAtMillis = downloadedAtMillis, navigation = navigation).validate()

        fun encode(resource: RinexNavigationResource): String = json.encodeToString(serializer(), resource.validate()).also {
            require(it.toByteArray(Charsets.UTF_8).size <= MAX_JSON_BYTES) { "RINEX JSON resource too large" }
        }

        fun decode(text: String): RinexNavigationResource {
            require(text.length <= MAX_JSON_BYTES && text.toByteArray(Charsets.UTF_8).size <= MAX_JSON_BYTES)
            return json.decodeFromString(serializer(), text).validate()
        }

        fun encodeWire(resource: RinexNavigationResource): String {
            val output = ByteArrayOutputStream()
            GZIPOutputStream(output).use { it.write(encode(resource).toByteArray(Charsets.UTF_8)) }
            return Base64.getEncoder().encodeToString(output.toByteArray()).also {
                require(it.length <= MAX_WIRE_LENGTH) { "RINEX resource exceeds IPC budget" }
            }
        }

        fun decodeWire(encoded: String): RinexNavigationResource {
            require(encoded.isNotEmpty() && encoded.length <= MAX_WIRE_LENGTH) { "Invalid RINEX IPC size" }
            val output = ByteArrayOutputStream()
            GZIPInputStream(ByteArrayInputStream(Base64.getDecoder().decode(encoded))).use { input ->
                val chunk = ByteArray(8192)
                while (true) {
                    val size = input.read(chunk)
                    if (size < 0) break
                    require(output.size() + size <= MAX_JSON_BYTES) { "RINEX decompression limit" }
                    output.write(chunk, 0, size)
                }
            }
            return decode(output.toString(Charsets.UTF_8.name()))
        }

        private fun digest(text: String): String = MessageDigest.getInstance("SHA-256")
            .digest(text.toByteArray(Charsets.UTF_8)).joinToString("") { "%02x".format(it.toInt() and 255) }
    }
}
```

`core/src/main/kotlin/com/system/location/service/core/gnss/RinexNavigationResourceStore.kt`:

```kt
package com.system.location.service.core.gnss

import java.io.File
import java.nio.file.Files
import java.nio.file.StandardCopyOption
import kotlinx.serialization.Serializable
import kotlinx.serialization.json.Json
import kotlinx.serialization.json.jsonObject

/** App-owned atomic cache; readers keep their immutable resources across update failures. */
class RinexNavigationResourceStore(private val file: File) {
    @Serializable
    private data class Cache(val cacheVersion: Int = 1, val resource: RinexNavigationResource,
        val uploadHighWater: Map<String, Double>)

    private val json = Json { encodeDefaults = true }
    private val maximumCacheBytes = RinexNavigationResource.MAX_JSON_BYTES + 262144

    private fun uploads(resource: RinexNavigationResource): Map<String, Double> = resource.parsed.records
        .groupBy(RinexNavigationUploadOrder::identity).mapNotNull { (identity, records) ->
            records.mapNotNull(RinexNavigationUploadOrder::seconds).maxOrNull()?.let { identity to it }
        }.toMap()

    private fun readCache(): Cache? {
        if (!file.exists()) return null
        require(file.isFile && file.length() <= maximumCacheBytes) { "Invalid RINEX resource file" }
        val text = file.readText(Charsets.UTF_8)
        val cache = if ("cacheVersion" in json.parseToJsonElement(text).jsonObject)
            json.decodeFromString(Cache.serializer(), text)
        else RinexNavigationResource.decode(text).let { Cache(resource = it, uploadHighWater = uploads(it)) }
        require(cache.cacheVersion == 1)
        cache.resource.validate()
        require(cache.uploadHighWater.size <= 4096 && cache.uploadHighWater.all { (identity, epoch) ->
            identity.length <= 64 && identity.matches(Regex("[GECRJSI][0-9]{1,2}(?::(?:unknown|[-+0-9.Ee]+))?")) && epoch.isFinite()
        }) { "Invalid native upload high-water marks" }
        require(uploads(cache.resource).all { (identity, epoch) -> cache.uploadHighWater[identity]?.let { it >= epoch } == true })
        return cache
    }

    @Synchronized
    fun load(): RinexNavigationResource? = readCache()?.resource

    @Synchronized
    fun update(text: String): RinexNavigationResource {
        val incoming = RinexNavigationResource.decode(text)
        val previousCache = runCatching { readCache() }.getOrNull()
        val previous = previousCache?.resource
        // Metadata refresh is independent of broadcast uploads. An outage/omission or stale
        // HTTP copy cannot erase a newer accepted assignment catalog, including after restart.
        val oldCatalog = previous?.beiDouCatalog
        val newCatalog = incoming.beiDouCatalog
        val candidate = if (oldCatalog != null &&
            (newCatalog == null || newCatalog.creationLabel.isBefore(oldCatalog.creationLabel)))
            incoming.copy(beiDouCatalog = oldCatalog) else incoming
        // Verify the merged IPC fit before promotion; never truncate either data source.
        RinexNavigationResource.encodeWire(candidate)
        val previousEpochs = previous?.epochLabels().orEmpty()
        val nextEpochs = candidate.epochLabels()
        require(previousEpochs.all { (system, epoch) -> nextEpochs[system]?.let { it >= epoch } == true }) {
            "RINEX update would drop a system or roll back its native reference epoch"
        }
        val nextUploads = uploads(candidate)
        val present = candidate.parsed.records.map(RinexNavigationUploadOrder::identity).toSet()
        val highWater = previousCache?.uploadHighWater.orEmpty().toMutableMap()
        for ((identity, epoch) in highWater) if (identity in present) {
            require(nextUploads[identity]?.let { it >= epoch } == true) {
                "RINEX update would roll back or lose known native upload order for $identity"
            }
        }
        // Omission is not a reset: retain marks for identities missing from today's snapshot.
        // Reappearance after a process restart cannot revive an older upload as the newest one.
        highWater.putAll(nextUploads)
        require(highWater.size <= 4096) { "Too many RINEX upload identities" }
        val bytes = json.encodeToString(Cache.serializer(), Cache(resource = candidate, uploadHighWater = highWater))
            .toByteArray(Charsets.UTF_8)
        require(bytes.size <= maximumCacheBytes) { "RINEX cache exceeds size limit" }
        val parent = requireNotNull(file.absoluteFile.parentFile)
        require(parent.isDirectory || parent.mkdirs()) { "Cannot create RINEX resource directory" }
        val temporary = File.createTempFile("rinex-orbit-", ".tmp", parent)
        try {
            temporary.outputStream().use { output -> output.write(bytes); output.fd.sync() }
            Files.move(temporary.toPath(), file.toPath(), StandardCopyOption.ATOMIC_MOVE,
                StandardCopyOption.REPLACE_EXISTING)
        } finally { temporary.delete() }
        return candidate
    }
}
```

`core/src/main/kotlin/com/system/location/service/core/gnss/RinexNavigationSnapshot.kt`:

```kt
package com.system.location.service.core.gnss

/**
 * Select an explicitly limited recent-upload snapshot from a bounded daily archive. Keep the
 * original headers/records verbatim; never retime, synthesize or change health fields to fit IPC.
 * GPS/GAL/BDS ordering uses native full-week transmission time (not download time or toe).
 * Missing/invalid transmission records are retained conservatively, not silently ranked as old.
 */
object RinexNavigationSnapshot {
    fun select(archive: String, sourceUrl: String, downloadedAtMillis: Long,
        uploadsPerIdentity: Int = 2): RinexNavigationResource {
        require(uploadsPerIdentity in 1..32)
        val parsed = RinexNavigationReader.read(archive)
        val lines = archive.lineSequence().toList()
        val headerEnd = lines.indexOfFirst { it.length >= 60 && it.substring(60).trim() == "END OF HEADER" }
        require(headerEnd >= 0)
        var cursor = headerEnd + 1
        data class Entry(val record: RinexNavigationRecord, val lines: List<String>, val order: Double?)
        val entries = parsed.records.map { record ->
            val count = 1 + record.orbit.size
            val text = lines.subList(cursor, cursor + count).toList()
            cursor += count
            val order = RinexNavigationUploadOrder.seconds(record)
            Entry(record, text, order)
        }
        val selected = entries.groupBy { RinexNavigationUploadOrder.identity(it.record) }.values.flatMap { history ->
            val known = history.filter { it.order != null }.map { it.order!! }.distinct().sortedDescending()
            val accepted = known.take(uploadsPerIdentity).toSet()
            history.filter { it.order == null || it.order in accepted }
        }.toSet()
        val snapshot = (lines.take(headerEnd + 1) + entries.filter { it in selected }.flatMap { it.lines })
            .joinToString("\n", postfix = "\n")
        val resource = RinexNavigationResource.import(snapshot, sourceUrl, downloadedAtMillis)
        RinexNavigationResource.encodeWire(resource) // No silent truncation to a protocol budget.
        return resource
    }
}
```

`core/src/main/kotlin/com/system/location/service/core/gnss/RinexNavigationUploadOrder.kt`:

```kt
package com.system.location.service.core.gnss

/** Native upload coordinate. Values from different systems must never be compared. */
internal object RinexNavigationUploadOrder {
    fun identity(record: RinexNavigationRecord): String = buildString {
        append(record.system.code); append(record.svid)
        // I/NAV and F/NAV have independent service/health histories in a mixed RINEX archive.
        if (record.system == RinexNavigationSystem.GALILEO) {
            append(':'); append(record.orbit.getOrNull(4)?.getOrNull(1)?.toString() ?: "unknown")
        }
    }

    fun seconds(record: RinexNavigationRecord): Double? = when (record.system) {
        RinexNavigationSystem.GPS, RinexNavigationSystem.GALILEO, RinexNavigationSystem.BEIDOU,
        RinexNavigationSystem.QZSS, RinexNavigationSystem.IRNSS -> {
            val week = record.orbit.getOrNull(4)?.getOrNull(2)
            val seconds = record.orbit.getOrNull(6)?.getOrNull(0)
            if (week != null && week >= 0 && week <= Int.MAX_VALUE && week == week.toInt().toDouble() &&
                seconds != null && seconds >= -604800 && seconds < 1209600) week * 604800 + seconds else null
        }
        RinexNavigationSystem.GLONASS, RinexNavigationSystem.SBAS -> record.epoch.let {
            it.date.toEpochDay() * 86400.0 + it.hour * 3600 + it.minute * 60 + it.second
        }
    }
}
```

`core/src/main/kotlin/com/system/location/service/core/gnss/RinexTimeSystemCorrection.kt`:

```kt
package com.system.location.service.core.gnss

/**
 * RINEX 3.05 Table A5 fractional time difference, excluding leap seconds. It is not an
 * arbitrary UTC offset. The producer supplies reference time/week in the specified native
 * scale (GAL references are GPS-week aligned in the file). No validity duration is encoded.
 */
data class RinexTimeSystemCorrection(
    val type: String,
    val a0Seconds: Double,
    val a1SecondsPerSecond: Double,
    val referenceSeconds: Int,
    val referenceWeek: Int,
    val source: String,
    val utcIdentifier: Int?,
) {
    init {
        require(type in TYPES && a0Seconds.isFinite() && a1SecondsPerSecond.isFinite())
        require(referenceWeek >= 0 && referenceSeconds in 0..604799)
        require(utcIdentifier == null || utcIdentifier in 0..7)
        require(source.length <= 5)
    }

    /**
     * GAGP = GST - GPS, evaluated at GST (Galileo OS SIS ICD 2.2 Eq.24).
     * Solve x = a0 + a1*(GPS+t_offset-t_ref), rather than evaluating the RHS at GPS.
     * Caller supplies an absolute GST applicability interval independently of the header.
     */
    fun gpsToGalileo(time: GpsTime, validFrom: GalileoTime, validUntil: GalileoTime): GalileoTime? {
        require(type == "GAGP")
        require(validUntil.secondsSince(validFrom) > 0)
        // This is the polynomial solver, not validation of a particular broadcast bit capacity.
        // Require an invertible, positively advancing target scale; the source adapter owns bounds.
        if (a1SecondsPerSecond >= 1) return null
        val delta = (time.week.toLong() - referenceWeek) * 604800.0 + time.secondsOfWeek - referenceSeconds
        val offset = (a0Seconds + a1SecondsPerSecond * delta) / (1 - a1SecondsPerSecond)
        val normalized = GnssWeekTime.normalize(time.week.toLong() - 1024, time.secondsOfWeek + offset) ?: return null
        val result = GalileoTime(normalized.first, normalized.second)
        return result.takeIf { it.secondsSince(validFrom) >= 0 && validUntil.secondsSince(it) >= 0 }
    }

    fun galileoToGps(time: GalileoTime, validFrom: GalileoTime, validUntil: GalileoTime): GpsTime? {
        require(type == "GAGP")
        require(validUntil.secondsSince(validFrom) > 0)
        if (time.secondsSince(validFrom) < 0 || validUntil.secondsSince(time) < 0 ||
            a1SecondsPerSecond >= 1) return null
        val delta = (time.week.toLong() + 1024 - referenceWeek) * 604800.0 + time.secondsOfWeek - referenceSeconds
        val offset = a0Seconds + a1SecondsPerSecond * delta
        val normalized = GnssWeekTime.normalize(time.week.toLong() + 1024, time.secondsOfWeek - offset) ?: return null
        return GpsTime(normalized.first, normalized.second)
    }

    companion object {
        private val TYPES = setOf("GPUT", "GLUT", "GAUT", "BDUT", "QZUT", "IRUT", "SBUT", "GLGP", "GAGP", "QZGP", "IRGP")
        private val NUMBER = Regex("[+-]?(?:[0-9]+(?:\\.[0-9]*)?|\\.[0-9]+)(?:[EeDd][+-]?[0-9]+)?")

        /** A damaged relevant correction cannot be ignored in favour of another healthy line. */
        internal fun galileoCorrection(headers: List<String>): RinexTimeSystemCorrection? {
            val corrections = headers.filter { it.take(4) in setOf("GAGP", "GPGA") }.map(::parse).distinct()
            require(corrections.size <= 1) { "Conflicting Galileo GAGP corrections" }
            return corrections.singleOrNull()
        }

        internal fun beiDouCorrection(headers: List<String>): RinexTimeSystemCorrection? {
            val corrections = headers.filter { it.take(4) == "BDUT" }.map(::parse).distinct()
            require(corrections.size <= 1) { "Conflicting BeiDou BDUT corrections" }
            return corrections.singleOrNull()
        }

        /** Header content columns 1–60, retained by the navigation reader. */
        fun parse(header: String): RinexTimeSystemCorrection {
            require(header.length in 50..60 && header[4] == ' ' && header[38] == ' ')
            val line = header.padEnd(60)
            fun decimal(start: Int, end: Int): Double {
                val token = line.substring(start, end).trim()
                require(NUMBER.matches(token)) { "Invalid RINEX time correction coefficient" }
                return token.replace('D', 'E').replace('d', 'e').toDouble().also { require(it.isFinite()) }
            }
            val type = line.substring(0, 4)
            // RINEX 3.02/3.03 GPGA was renamed GAGP in 3.04; its GAL-GPS sign is unchanged.
            val normalized = if (type == "GPGA") "GAGP" else type
            // Published examples/producers differ by one column in the optional right-aligned
            // source token. Coefficient/time columns stay strict; optional metadata is tokenized
            // only inside columns 51–60, never across the numeric fields.
            val suffix = line.substring(50).trim().split(Regex("\\s+")).filter { it.isNotEmpty() }
            require(suffix.isEmpty() || suffix.size == 2)
            val source = suffix.firstOrNull().orEmpty()
            require(source.matches(Regex("[A-Za-z0-9]{0,5}")))
            val utc = suffix.getOrNull(1)?.toInt()
            return RinexTimeSystemCorrection(normalized, decimal(5, 22), decimal(22, 38),
                line.substring(39, 45).trim().toInt(), line.substring(45, 50).trim().toInt(),
                source, utc)
        }
    }
}
```

`core/src/main/kotlin/com/system/location/service/core/gnss/VirtualWalkerOrbitProvider.kt`:

```kt
package com.system.location.service.core.gnss

import java.util.Random
import kotlinx.serialization.Serializable
import kotlinx.serialization.json.Json
import kotlin.math.*

/** Parameters of a hypothetical circular Walker-delta group, not an actual orbital upload. */
@Serializable
data class VirtualWalkerGroup(
    val constellation: Constellation,
    val svids: List<Int>,
    val planes: Int,
    val phaseFactor: Int,
    val orbitalRadiusMeters: Double,
    val inclinationRad: Double,
) {
    init {
        require(svids.isNotEmpty() && svids.distinct().size == svids.size)
        require(svids.all { GnssSatelliteIds.nmeaId(constellation, it) != null })
        require(planes in 1..svids.size && svids.size % planes == 0 && phaseFactor in 0..<planes)
        require(orbitalRadiusMeters in 6_500_000.0..60_000_000.0 && inclinationRad in 0.0..PI)
    }
}

@Serializable
data class VirtualWalkerResource(
    val formatVersion: Int = 1,
    val revision: String,
    val referenceEpochMillis: Long,
    /** Explicit orientation of this virtual world's inertial axes at its reference epoch. */
    val greenwichAngleRad: Double = 0.0,
    val groups: List<VirtualWalkerGroup>,
) {
    init {
        require(formatVersion == 1 && revision.isNotBlank() && referenceEpochMillis >= 0)
        require(greenwichAngleRad.isFinite() && groups.isNotEmpty())
        val identities = groups.flatMap { group -> group.svids.map { group.constellation to it } }
        require(identities.distinct().size == identities.size)
    }

    companion object {
        fun decode(text: String): VirtualWalkerResource {
            require(text.toByteArray(Charsets.UTF_8).size <= 65536)
            return Json.decodeFromString(serializer(), text)
        }
    }
}

/**
 * Persistent identities and deterministic two-body trajectories in an explicitly virtual world.
 * Group sizes and topology come from a resource, not a fixed production satellite catalog.
 * A finite constellation does not promise any requested visible lower bound.
 */
class VirtualWalkerOrbitProvider(resource: VirtualWalkerResource, seed: Long) : GnssOrbitProvider {
    override val kind = GnssOrbitSourceKind.VIRTUAL
    private val referenceEpochMillis = resource.referenceEpochMillis
    private val orientation = resource.greenwichAngleRad
    private val provenance = GnssOrbitProvenance("virtual-walker", resource.revision,
        "Portal hypothetical circular Walker-delta model", resource.referenceEpochMillis, kind)
    private data class Orbit(val constellation: Constellation, val svid: Int, val navigation: GnssSimulatedNavigation)
    private val orbits: List<Orbit>

    init {
        val random = Random(seed)
        orbits = resource.groups.flatMap { group ->
            val nodeOffset = random.nextDouble() * 2 * PI
            val anomalyOffset = random.nextDouble() * 2 * PI
            val perPlane = group.svids.size / group.planes
            group.svids.mapIndexed { index, svid ->
                val plane = index / perPlane
                val slot = index % perPlane
                val node = nodeOffset + 2 * PI * plane / group.planes
                val anomaly = anomalyOffset + 2 * PI * slot / perPlane +
                    2 * PI * group.phaseFactor * plane / group.svids.size
                val trajectory = KeplerOrbit(KeplerElements(
                    group.orbitalRadiusMeters, 0.0, group.inclinationRad, node, 0.0, anomaly, 0.0))
                val navigation = GnssSimulatedNavigation(group.constellation, svid, provenance,
                    0, Long.MAX_VALUE, GnssVirtualClock(referenceEpochMillis)) { request ->
                    val seconds = (request.atMillis.toDouble() - referenceEpochMillis.toDouble()) / 1000.0
                    val angle = (orientation + GpsBroadcastPropagator.EARTH_ROTATION_RAD_PER_SECOND * seconds) % (2 * PI)
                    val inertial = trajectory.positionAt(seconds)
                    EcefPosition(cos(angle) * inertial.x + sin(angle) * inertial.y,
                        -sin(angle) * inertial.x + cos(angle) * inertial.y, inertial.z)
                }
                Orbit(group.constellation, svid, navigation)
            }
        }
    }

    override fun positions(request: GnssSkyRequest): GnssOrbitBatch {
        val positions = orbits.map { orbit ->
            val ecef = requireNotNull(orbit.navigation.positionAt(request))
            GnssOrbitPosition(orbit.constellation, orbit.svid, ecef, provenance,
                hasEphemeris = false, hasAlmanac = false, simulatedNavigation = orbit.navigation)
        }
        return GnssOrbitBatch(positions, listOf("虚拟轨道天空：假想星座，不代表真实在轨观测"))
    }
}
```

`core/src/main/kotlin/com/system/location/service/core/gpx/GpxCodec.kt`:

```kt
package com.system.location.service.core.gpx

import com.system.location.service.core.geo.Wgs84
import com.system.location.service.core.scenario.Route
import java.io.StringReader
import java.util.UUID
import javax.xml.parsers.SAXParserFactory
import org.xml.sax.Attributes
import org.xml.sax.InputSource
import org.xml.sax.SAXException
import org.xml.sax.helpers.DefaultHandler

/** GPX is WGS84. Separate tracks/segments remain separate routes, never joined across gaps. */
object GpxCodec {
    const val MAX_CHARS = 20_000_000
    const val MAX_TOTAL_POINTS = 200_000
    const val MAX_ROUTE_POINTS = 100_000
    const val MAX_ROUTES = 10_000
    fun decode(text: String): List<Route> {
        require(text.length <= MAX_CHARS) { "GPX 文件过大" }
        require(!text.contains("<!DOCTYPE", ignoreCase = true) && !text.contains("<!ENTITY", ignoreCase = true)) { "GPX 不允许 DTD 或实体声明" }
        val routes = mutableListOf<Route>()
        val stack = mutableListOf<String>()
        var points: MutableList<Wgs84>? = null
        var trackName = ""
        var routeName = ""
        var nameText: StringBuilder? = null
        var totalPoints = 0
        var rootSeen = false
        val handler = object : DefaultHandler() {
            override fun resolveEntity(publicId: String?, systemId: String?): InputSource = throw SAXException("External entities disabled")
            override fun startElement(uri: String?, localName: String, qName: String?, attrs: Attributes) {
                require(stack.size < 64) { "GPX 嵌套过深" }
                if (stack.isEmpty()) { require(localName == "gpx") { "不是 GPX 文件" }; rootSeen = true }
                val tag = if (uri.isNullOrEmpty() || uri == "http://www.topografix.com/GPX/1/1" || uri == "http://www.topografix.com/GPX/1/0") localName else "#extension"
                val parent = stack.lastOrNull()
                when {
                    tag == "trk" && stack == listOf("gpx") -> trackName = ""
                    tag == "rte" && stack == listOf("gpx") -> { points = mutableListOf(); routeName = "" }
                    tag == "trkseg" && stack == listOf("gpx", "trk") -> { points = mutableListOf(); routeName = trackName }
                    tag == "name" && stack.size == 2 && parent in listOf("trk", "rte") -> nameText = StringBuilder()
                    (tag == "trkpt" && stack == listOf("gpx", "trk", "trkseg") || tag == "rtept" && stack == listOf("gpx", "rte")) -> {
                        require(++totalPoints <= MAX_TOTAL_POINTS) { "GPX 最多支持 $MAX_TOTAL_POINTS 个点" }
                        require(points!!.size < MAX_ROUTE_POINTS) { "GPX 单路线最多支持 $MAX_ROUTE_POINTS 个点" }
                        val lat = attrs.getValue("lat")?.toDoubleOrNull() ?: error("GPX 缺少有效纬度")
                        val lon = attrs.getValue("lon")?.toDoubleOrNull() ?: error("GPX 缺少有效经度")
                        points!!.add(Wgs84(lat, lon))
                    }
                }
                stack += tag
            }
            override fun characters(ch: CharArray, start: Int, length: Int) { nameText?.append(ch, start, length) }
            override fun endElement(uri: String?, localName: String, qName: String?) {
                if (stack.lastOrNull() == "name" && stack.size == 3 && nameText != null) {
                    val name = nameText.toString().trim().take(200)
                    if (stack.getOrNull(stack.size - 2) == "trk") trackName = name else routeName = name
                    nameText = null
                }
                if (stack == listOf("gpx", "trk", "trkseg") || stack == listOf("gpx", "rte")) {
                    val valid = points.orEmpty().filterIndexed { i, p -> i == 0 || p != points!![i - 1] }
                    if (valid.size >= 2) {
                        require(routes.size < MAX_ROUTES) { "GPX 路线过多" }
                        routes += Route(UUID.randomUUID().toString(), routeName.ifBlank { "GPX 路线 ${routes.size + 1}" }, valid)
                    }
                    points = null
                }
                stack.removeAt(stack.lastIndex)
            }
            override fun error(e: org.xml.sax.SAXParseException) { throw e }
            override fun fatalError(e: org.xml.sax.SAXParseException) { throw e }
        }
        val factory = SAXParserFactory.newInstance().apply { isNamespaceAware = true }
        // Android/JVM parsers differ in supported features; the declaration guard and resolver
        // also reject external content on platforms without these optional switches.
        listOf("http://xml.org/sax/features/external-general-entities", "http://xml.org/sax/features/external-parameter-entities").forEach {
            runCatching { factory.setFeature(it, false) }
        }
        factory.newSAXParser().parse(InputSource(StringReader(text)), handler)
        require(rootSeen && routes.isNotEmpty()) { "GPX 没有含至少两个不同坐标的轨迹段或路线" }
        return routes
    }
    fun encode(routes: List<Route>): String {
        require(routes.isNotEmpty()) { "没有路线可导出" }
        require(routes.size <= MAX_ROUTES) { "GPX 路线过多" }
        require(routes.all { it.points.size in 2..MAX_ROUTE_POINTS }) { "GPX 单路线需要 2–$MAX_ROUTE_POINTS 个点" }
        require(routes.all { route -> route.points.any { it != route.points.first() } }) { "GPX 单路线需要至少两个不同坐标" }
        require(routes.sumOf { it.points.size.toLong() } <= MAX_TOTAL_POINTS) { "GPX 最多支持 $MAX_TOTAL_POINTS 个点" }
        routes.forEach { route ->
            var index = 0
            while (index < route.name.length) {
                val codePoint = Character.codePointAt(route.name, index)
                require(codePoint == 0x9 || codePoint == 0xa || codePoint == 0xd ||
                    codePoint in 0x20..0xd7ff || codePoint in 0xe000..0xfffd ||
                    codePoint in 0x10000..0x10ffff) { "GPX 路线名称包含 XML 1.0 非法字符" }
                index += Character.charCount(codePoint)
            }
        }
        fun escape(value: String) = value.replace("&", "&amp;").replace("<", "&lt;").replace(">", "&gt;").replace("\"", "&quot;").replace("'", "&apos;")
            .replace("\r", "&#13;") // XML normalizes literal CR to LF; a reference preserves the name.
        return buildString {
            append("<?xml version=\"1.0\" encoding=\"UTF-8\"?>\n<gpx version=\"1.1\" creator=\"LocationService\" xmlns=\"http://www.topografix.com/GPX/1/1\">\n")
            routes.forEach { route ->
                append("<trk><name>${escape(route.name)}</name><trkseg>\n")
                route.points.forEach { append("<trkpt lat=\"${it.latitude}\" lon=\"${it.longitude}\"/>\n") }
                append("</trkseg></trk>\n")
            }
            append("</gpx>\n")
            require(length <= MAX_CHARS) { "GPX 导出文件过大" }
        }
    }
}
```

`core/src/main/kotlin/com/system/location/service/core/location/LocationBatchTimeline.kt`:

```kt
package com.system.location.service.core.location

import com.system.location.service.core.geo.Wgs84
import kotlin.math.asin
import kotlin.math.atan2
import kotlin.math.cos
import kotlin.math.sin

/** Reconstructs a provider batch from one synthetic endpoint without retaining real fixes. */
object LocationBatchTimeline {
    const val MAX_BATCH_SIZE = 256
    private const val EARTH_RADIUS_METERS = 6_371_000.0

    fun synthesize(endpoint: LocationSample, count: Int, intervalMillis: Long): List<LocationSample> {
        require(count in 0..MAX_BATCH_SIZE) { "batch size out of range" }
        require(intervalMillis in 1L..60_000L) { "intervalMillis out of range" }
        if (count == 0) return emptyList()
        if (count == 1) return listOf(endpoint)

        val intervals = count - 1
        val elapsedLimitMillis = endpoint.elapsedNanos / 1_000_000L / intervals
        val interval = minOf(intervalMillis, endpoint.timeMillis / intervals, elapsedLimitMillis)
        if (interval <= 0L) return listOf(endpoint)

        return List(count) { index ->
            val stepsBack = (count - index - 1).toLong()
            val offsetMillis = interval * stepsBack
            val offsetSeconds = offsetMillis / 1_000.0
            val distanceMeters = endpoint.speed.toDouble() * offsetSeconds
            val coordinate = if (distanceMeters == 0.0) endpoint.coordinate else {
                val destination = destination(
                    endpoint.coordinate,
                    distanceMeters,
                    (endpoint.bearing + 180.0) % 360.0,
                )
                destination
            }
            endpoint.copy(
                coordinate = coordinate,
                timeMillis = endpoint.timeMillis - offsetMillis,
                elapsedNanos = endpoint.elapsedNanos - offsetMillis * 1_000_000L,
            )
        }
    }

    private fun destination(start: Wgs84, distanceMeters: Double, bearingDegrees: Double): Wgs84 {
        val angularDistance = distanceMeters / EARTH_RADIUS_METERS
        val latitude = Math.toRadians(start.latitude)
        val longitude = Math.toRadians(start.longitude)
        val bearing = Math.toRadians(bearingDegrees)
        val resultLatitude = asin(
            (sin(latitude) * cos(angularDistance) +
                cos(latitude) * sin(angularDistance) * cos(bearing)).coerceIn(-1.0, 1.0),
        )
        val resultLongitude = longitude + atan2(
            sin(bearing) * sin(angularDistance) * cos(latitude),
            cos(angularDistance) - sin(latitude) * sin(resultLatitude),
        )
        val normalizedLongitude = (Math.toDegrees(resultLongitude) + 540.0) % 360.0 - 180.0
        return Wgs84(Math.toDegrees(resultLatitude), normalizedLongitude)
    }
}
```

```kt
package com.system.location.service.core.location

import com.system.location.service.core.geo.Wgs84
import kotlinx.serialization.Serializable

/** One immutable WGS84 fix, independent of Android, providers, SDKs and UI. */
@Serializable data class LocationSample(val coordinate: Wgs84, val altitude: Double, val accuracy: Float,
    val speed: Float, val bearing: Float, val timeMillis: Long, val elapsedNanos: Long) {
    init {
        require(altitude.isFinite() && altitude in LocationSanitizer.MIN_ALTITUDE_METERS..LocationSanitizer.MAX_ALTITUDE_METERS)
        require(accuracy.isFinite() && accuracy > 0)
        require(speed.isFinite() && speed >= 0 && speed.toDouble() <= LocationSanitizer.MAX_SPEED_MPS)
        require(bearing.isFinite() && bearing >= 0 && bearing < 360)
        require(timeMillis >= 0 && elapsedNanos >= 0)
    }
    val latitude get() = coordinate.latitude
    val longitude get() = coordinate.longitude
}
```

`core/src/main/kotlin/com/system/location/service/core/location/LocationSanitizer.kt`:

```kt
package com.system.location.service.core.location

/**
 * Platform-independent defaults for a sanitized fix (P1-01).
 *
 * The Android adapter applies these values to `android.location.Location`; keeping the policy here
 * makes every derivation testable on the JVM and gives the provider profiles (P4-01) one place to
 * override.
 */
data class LocationFieldPolicy(
    val verticalAccuracyFactor: Float = 1.8f,
    val speedAccuracyMps: Float = 0.15f,
    val bearingAccuracyDegrees: Float = 2.0f,
    val elapsedRealtimeUncertaintyNanos: Long = 5_000_000L,
) {
    init {
        require(verticalAccuracyFactor.isFinite() && verticalAccuracyFactor >= 1f) {
            "verticalAccuracyFactor must be finite and at least 1"
        }
        require(speedAccuracyMps.isFinite() && speedAccuracyMps >= 0f) {
            "speedAccuracyMps must be finite and non-negative"
        }
        require(bearingAccuracyDegrees.isFinite() && bearingAccuracyDegrees >= 0f) {
            "bearingAccuracyDegrees must be finite and non-negative"
        }
        require(elapsedRealtimeUncertaintyNanos >= 0L) { "elapsedRealtimeUncertaintyNanos must be non-negative" }
    }
}

/** Values the Android adapter writes onto the `Location` object. */
data class SanitizedLocationFields(
    val verticalAccuracyMeters: Float,
    val speedAccuracyMetersPerSecond: Float,
    val bearingAccuracyDegrees: Float,
    val elapsedRealtimeUncertaintyNanos: Long,
)

/**
 * Derives missing fields without injecting randomness.
 *
 * - vertical accuracy is always worse than horizontal accuracy;
 * - speed/bearing accuracy are only present when the corresponding field is meaningful.
 * GNSS extras belong to the receiver frame; MSL altitude requires a geoid model.
 */
object LocationSanitizer {

    fun fieldsFor(
        sample: LocationSample,
        policy: LocationFieldPolicy = LocationFieldPolicy(),
    ): SanitizedLocationFields {
        val horizontal = sanitizeAccuracy(sample.accuracy, FALLBACK_HORIZONTAL_ACCURACY)
        val vertical = (horizontal.toDouble() * policy.verticalAccuracyFactor.toDouble())
            .coerceAtMost(Float.MAX_VALUE.toDouble()).toFloat()
        val moving = sample.speed > STATIONARY_SPEED_MPS
        val speedAccuracy = if (sample.speed > 0f) {
            minOf(policy.speedAccuracyMps, maxOf(MIN_SPEED_ACCURACY_MPS, sample.speed * SPEED_ACCURACY_FRACTION))
        } else {
            0f
        }
        val bearingAccuracy = if (moving) policy.bearingAccuracyDegrees else 0f
        return SanitizedLocationFields(
            verticalAccuracyMeters = vertical,
            speedAccuracyMetersPerSecond = speedAccuracy,
            bearingAccuracyDegrees = bearingAccuracy,
            elapsedRealtimeUncertaintyNanos = sanitizeUncertainty(policy.elapsedRealtimeUncertaintyNanos),
        )
    }

    fun sanitizeAccuracy(value: Float, fallback: Float): Float =
        if (value.isFinite() && value > 0f) value else fallback

    fun sanitizeAltitude(value: Double): Double =
        if (value.isFinite() && value in MIN_ALTITUDE_METERS..MAX_ALTITUDE_METERS) value else FALLBACK_ALTITUDE_METERS

    fun sanitizeUncertainty(value: Long?): Long =
        if (value == null || value < 0L || value > MAX_UNCERTAINTY_NANOS) DEFAULT_UNCERTAINTY_NANOS else value

    fun sanitizeExtras(values: Map<String, Any?>): Map<String, Any> = buildMap {
        (values["satellites"] as? Int)?.let { if (it >= 0) put("satellites", it) }
        (values["meanCn0"] as? Float)?.let { if (it.isFinite() && it >= 0f) put("meanCn0", it) }
        (values["maxCn0"] as? Float)?.let { if (it.isFinite() && it >= 0f) put("maxCn0", it) }
    }

    const val STATIONARY_SPEED_MPS = 0.3f
    const val MAX_SPEED_MPS = 1_000.0
    /** Default requested simulation accuracy; separate from sanitizing invalid external samples. */
    const val DEFAULT_HORIZONTAL_ACCURACY = 2.5f
    const val FALLBACK_HORIZONTAL_ACCURACY = 25f
    const val FALLBACK_ALTITUDE_METERS = 0.0
    const val DEFAULT_UNCERTAINTY_NANOS = 5_000_000L
    const val MAX_UNCERTAINTY_NANOS = 999_000_000L
    private const val MIN_SPEED_ACCURACY_MPS = 0.05f
    private const val SPEED_ACCURACY_FRACTION = 0.1f
    const val MIN_ALTITUDE_METERS = -500.0
    const val MAX_ALTITUDE_METERS = 20_000.0
}
```

`core/src/main/kotlin/com/system/location/service/core/network/TimeZoneConsistencyPolicy.kt`:

```kt
package com.system.location.service.core.network

import java.util.Locale
import kotlin.math.abs
import kotlin.math.roundToInt

/**
 * P7-02: advisory time-zone consistency check. It intentionally uses a solar offset from longitude
 * rather than a political time-zone database; callers must treat a mismatch as a warning.
 */
data class TimeZoneConsistency(
    val expectedOffsetMinutes: Int,
    val actualOffsetMinutes: Int,
    val toleranceMinutes: Int,
) {
    init {
        require(expectedOffsetMinutes in TimeZoneConsistencyPolicy.MIN_OFFSET..TimeZoneConsistencyPolicy.MAX_OFFSET) {
            "expected offset out of range"
        }
        require(actualOffsetMinutes in TimeZoneConsistencyPolicy.MIN_OFFSET..TimeZoneConsistencyPolicy.MAX_OFFSET) {
            "actual offset out of range"
        }
        require(toleranceMinutes >= 0) { "tolerance must be non-negative" }
    }

    val deltaMinutes: Int get() = actualOffsetMinutes - expectedOffsetMinutes
    val consistent: Boolean get() = abs(deltaMinutes) <= toleranceMinutes
}

object TimeZoneConsistencyPolicy {
    const val MIN_OFFSET = -12 * 60
    const val MAX_OFFSET = 14 * 60

    fun nominalOffsetMinutes(longitude: Double): Int {
        require(longitude.isFinite() && longitude in -180.0..180.0) { "longitude out of range" }
        return (longitude / 15.0 * 60.0).roundToInt().coerceIn(MIN_OFFSET, MAX_OFFSET)
    }

    fun check(
        longitude: Double,
        actualOffsetMinutes: Int,
        toleranceMinutes: Int = 60,
    ): TimeZoneConsistency = TimeZoneConsistency(
        expectedOffsetMinutes = nominalOffsetMinutes(longitude),
        actualOffsetMinutes = actualOffsetMinutes,
        toleranceMinutes = toleranceMinutes,
    )

    fun formatOffset(offsetMinutes: Int): String {
        require(offsetMinutes in MIN_OFFSET..MAX_OFFSET) { "offset out of range" }
        val sign = if (offsetMinutes < 0) "-" else "+"
        val absolute = abs(offsetMinutes)
        return String.format(Locale.US, "UTC%s%02d:%02d", sign, absolute / 60, absolute % 60)
    }
}
```

`core/src/main/kotlin/com/system/location/service/core/performance/PerformanceProbe.kt`:

```kt
package com.system.location.service.core.performance

import kotlin.math.floor

data class PerformanceSnapshot(
    val samples: Int,
    val p50Nanos: Long,
    val p95Nanos: Long,
    val maxNanos: Long,
    val meanNanos: Long,
)

/** Bounded latency probe for callback-path budgets (P7-04). */
class PerformanceProbe(private val capacity: Int = 256) {
    private val values = LongArray(capacity)
    private var count = 0
    private var next = 0

    init {
        require(capacity in 1..MAX_CAPACITY) { "capacity out of range" }
    }

    @Synchronized
    fun record(nanos: Long) {
        require(nanos >= 0L) { "nanos must be non-negative" }
        values[next] = nanos
        next = (next + 1) % capacity
        if (count < capacity) count += 1
    }

    @Synchronized
    fun snapshot(): PerformanceSnapshot? {
        if (count == 0) return null
        val sorted = values.copyOf(count).apply { sort() }
        val p50 = sorted[floor((count - 1) * 0.50).toInt()]
        val p95 = sorted[floor((count - 1) * 0.95).toInt()]
        val mean = sorted.sum() / count
        return PerformanceSnapshot(count, p50, p95, sorted.last(), mean)
    }

    @Synchronized
    fun clear() {
        count = 0
        next = 0
    }

    companion object {
        const val MAX_CAPACITY = 4_096
    }
}
```

`core/src/main/kotlin/com/system/location/service/core/planning/RouteDraftController.kt`:

```kt
package com.system.location.service.core.planning

import com.system.location.service.core.geo.*
import com.system.location.service.core.repository.DocumentStore
import com.system.location.service.core.scenario.Route
import kotlinx.coroutines.flow.MutableStateFlow
import kotlinx.coroutines.flow.asStateFlow
import kotlinx.serialization.Serializable
import kotlinx.serialization.encodeToString
import kotlinx.serialization.json.Json
import java.util.UUID

@Serializable enum class Endpoint { START, END }
@Serializable enum class DrawingMode { PLAN, POINTS, FREEHAND }
@Serializable enum class DraftPhase { EMPTY, ENDPOINTS, PLANNING, PLANNED, ERROR }
@Serializable data class MapCamera(val target: Gcj02, val zoom: Float, val bearing: Float, val tilt: Float)
@Serializable data class RouteDraft(val schemaVersion: Int = 1, val start: Gcj02? = null, val end: Gcj02? = null,
    val selecting: Endpoint = Endpoint.START, val generation: Long = 0, val phase: DraftPhase = DraftPhase.EMPTY,
    val route: Route? = null, val camera: MapCamera? = null, val message: String? = null,
    val mode: DrawingMode = DrawingMode.PLAN, val strokes: List<List<Gcj02>> = emptyList())
data class PlanRequest(val generation: Long, val start: Gcj02, val end: Gcj02)

object RoutePlanAssembler {
    /** A path contains sequential steps. Alternative paths must be selected before calling this. */
    fun assemble(start: Gcj02, end: Gcj02, segments: List<List<Gcj02>>): Route {
        val points = ArrayList<Gcj02>()
        segments.forEach { segment -> segment.forEach { point ->
            if (points.lastOrNull() != point) points += point
            require(points.size <= 99_998) { "规划结果超过 100000 个路线点，请缩短路线" }
        } }
        require(points.size >= 2 && points.any { it != points.first() }) { "规划返回空路线或没有有效路段" }
        if (points.first() != start) points.add(0, start)
        if (points.last() != end) points += end
        return Route(UUID.randomUUID().toString(), "地图路线", points.map(CoordinateTransform::toWgs84)).frozen()
    }
}

/** Durable data-only editor. Every asynchronous result is checked against its endpoint generation. */
class RouteDraftController(private val store: DocumentStore) {
    private val json = Json { encodeDefaults = true }
    private val mutable = MutableStateFlow(load())
    val state = mutable.asStateFlow()
    private fun load(): RouteDraft = try {
        store.read()?.let { text ->
            require(text.length <= 20_000_000) { "草稿过大" }
            json.decodeFromString<RouteDraft>(text).also { require(it.schemaVersion == 1) }.let {
                if (it.phase == DraftPhase.PLANNING) it.copy(phase = DraftPhase.ENDPOINTS, route = null, message = "规划已中断，请重新规划")
                else it.copy(route = it.route?.frozen())
            }
        } ?: RouteDraft()
    } catch (error: Exception) { RouteDraft(phase = DraftPhase.ERROR, message = "草稿读取失败：${error.message}") }

    @Synchronized fun select(endpoint: Endpoint) { commit(state.value.copy(selecting = endpoint)) }
    @Synchronized fun pick(point: Gcj02) {
        val old = state.value
        if (old.mode != DrawingMode.PLAN) {
            if (old.mode == DrawingMode.POINTS) appendStroke(listOf(point))
            return
        }
        commit(old.copy(start = if (old.selecting == Endpoint.START) point else old.start,
            end = if (old.selecting == Endpoint.END) point else old.end,
            selecting = Endpoint.END, generation = old.generation + 1,
            route = null, phase = DraftPhase.ENDPOINTS, message = null))
    }
    @Synchronized fun camera(camera: MapCamera) { commit(state.value.copy(camera = camera)) }
    @Synchronized fun cancel() { commit(RouteDraft(generation = state.value.generation + 1, camera = state.value.camera, mode = state.value.mode)) }
    /** Changing modes explicitly starts a new draft; the UI confirms before discarding geometry. */
    @Synchronized fun mode(mode: DrawingMode) {
        if (mode != state.value.mode) commit(RouteDraft(generation = state.value.generation + 1, camera = state.value.camera, mode = mode))
    }
    @Synchronized fun appendStroke(points: List<Gcj02>) {
        if (state.value.mode == DrawingMode.PLAN || points.isEmpty()) return
        val clean = points.fold(ArrayList<Gcj02>()) { result, point ->
            if (result.lastOrNull() != point) result.add(point)
            result
        }.toList()
        require(state.value.strokes.sumOf { it.size } + clean.size <= 10_000) { "手动路线最多 10000 个点，请撤销或缩短路线" }
        rebuildManual(state.value.strokes + listOf(clean))
    }
    @Synchronized fun undo() {
        if (state.value.mode != DrawingMode.PLAN && state.value.strokes.isNotEmpty()) rebuildManual(state.value.strokes.dropLast(1))
    }
    private fun rebuildManual(strokes: List<List<Gcj02>>) {
        val points = strokes.flatten().fold(ArrayList<Gcj02>()) { result, point ->
            if (result.lastOrNull() != point) result.add(point)
            result
        }
        val route = if (points.size >= 2) Route(UUID.randomUUID().toString(), "手动路线",
            points.map(CoordinateTransform::toWgs84)).frozen() else null
        commit(state.value.copy(strokes = strokes, start = points.firstOrNull(), end = points.lastOrNull(),
            route = route, generation = state.value.generation + 1,
            phase = if (route != null) DraftPhase.PLANNED else DraftPhase.EMPTY,
            message = if (route != null) "${points.size} 个点 · 可继续编辑或保存" else "至少添加两个不同的点"))
    }
    @Synchronized fun beginPlan(): PlanRequest? {
        val old = state.value
        if (old.mode != DrawingMode.PLAN) return null
        if (old.start == null || old.end == null || old.start == old.end) {
            commit(old.copy(phase = DraftPhase.ERROR, route = null, message = "请选择不同的起点与终点"))
            return null
        }
        val request = PlanRequest(old.generation + 1, old.start, old.end)
        return if (commit(old.copy(generation = request.generation, route = null, phase = DraftPhase.PLANNING, message = null))) request else null
    }
    @Synchronized fun complete(request: PlanRequest, segments: List<List<Gcj02>>): Boolean {
        if (!current(request)) return false
        return try {
            val route = RoutePlanAssembler.assemble(request.start, request.end, segments)
            commit(state.value.copy(route = route, phase = DraftPhase.PLANNED, message = "路线已规划，请确认后保存或运行"))
        } catch (error: Exception) { fail(request, error.message ?: "路线解析失败"); false }
    }
    @Synchronized fun fail(request: PlanRequest, reason: String) {
        if (current(request)) commit(state.value.copy(route = null, phase = DraftPhase.ERROR, message = reason))
    }
    private fun current(request: PlanRequest) = state.value.generation == request.generation &&
        state.value.start == request.start && state.value.end == request.end && state.value.phase == DraftPhase.PLANNING
    private fun commit(next: RouteDraft): Boolean = try {
        store.writeAtomically(json.encodeToString(next))
        mutable.value = next
        true
    } catch (error: Exception) {
        mutable.value = state.value.copy(phase = DraftPhase.ERROR, message = "草稿保存失败：${error.message}")
        false
    }
}
```

`core/src/main/kotlin/com/system/location/service/core/playback/JoystickInput.kt`:

```kt
package com.system.location.service.core.playback

import kotlin.math.*

object JoystickInput {
    data class Motion(val bearing: Double, val strength: Double)
    fun evaluate(x: Double, y: Double, radius: Double): Motion {
        require(x.isFinite() && y.isFinite() && radius.isFinite() && radius > 0)
        val fraction = (hypot(x, y) / radius).coerceIn(0.0, 1.0)
        // A small dead zone prevents drift; the response gives more room for fine movement.
        val strength = ((fraction - 0.08) / 0.92).coerceIn(0.0, 1.0).pow(1.5)
        return Motion(if (fraction == 0.0) 0.0 else (Math.toDegrees(atan2(x, -y)) + 360) % 360, strength)
    }
}
```

`core/src/main/kotlin/com/system/location/service/core/playback/PhysicalNoise.kt`:

```kt
package com.system.location.service.core.playback

import com.system.location.service.core.geo.Wgs84
import com.system.location.service.core.location.LocationSample
import kotlinx.serialization.Serializable
import kotlin.math.PI
import kotlin.math.abs
import kotlin.math.cos
import kotlin.math.exp
import kotlin.math.ln
import kotlin.math.sqrt

@Serializable
data class NoiseProfile(
    val enabled: Boolean = true,
    val ouAlphaPerSec: Double = 0.05,
    val ouSigmaMeters: Double = 0.8,
    val maxOffsetMeters: Double = 4.0,
    val altitudeAlpha: Double = 0.04,
    val altitudeSigmaMeters: Double = 0.45,
    val accuracyDriftMeters: Double = 1.0,
    val seed: Long = 0L,
) {
    init {
        require(ouAlphaPerSec > 0.0) { "ouAlphaPerSec must be positive" }
        require(ouSigmaMeters >= 0.0) { "ouSigmaMeters must be non-negative" }
        require(maxOffsetMeters > 0.0) { "maxOffsetMeters must be positive" }
        require(altitudeAlpha > 0.0) { "altitudeAlpha must be positive" }
        require(altitudeSigmaMeters >= 0.0) { "altitudeSigmaMeters must be non-negative" }
        require(accuracyDriftMeters >= 0.0) { "accuracyDriftMeters must be non-negative" }
    }
}

/**
 * Optional decorative noise layer (P4-02, ADR-008).
 *
 * `PlaybackEngine` stays deterministic; this class adds bounded, reproducible OU drift on top.
 * Disabled means the input sample is returned unchanged. Seed + the same timestamp sequence
 * reproduces exactly the same outputs; there is no wall-clock or global RNG.
 */
class PhysicalNoise(
    private val profile: NoiseProfile = NoiseProfile(),
    private val seed: Long = profile.seed,
) {
    private var random = SplitMix64(seed)
    private var lastNanos: Long? = null
    private var x = 0.0
    private var y = 0.0
    private var altitude = 0.0
    private var stepped = false

    fun reset() {
        lastNanos = null
        x = 0.0
        y = 0.0
        altitude = 0.0
        stepped = false
        random = SplitMix64(seed)
    }

    fun apply(sample: LocationSample, elapsedRealtimeNanos: Long): LocationSample {
        if (!profile.enabled) return sample
        if (elapsedRealtimeNanos < 0L) return sample
        val previous = lastNanos
        if (previous == null) {
            lastNanos = elapsedRealtimeNanos
            return sample
        }
        // A delayed reader cannot rewind the process clock or consume a second random step.
        if (elapsedRealtimeNanos < previous) return sample
        val dt = (elapsedRealtimeNanos - previous) / 1_000_000_000.0
        if (dt > 0.0) {
            lastNanos = elapsedRealtimeNanos
            x = update(x, dt, profile.ouAlphaPerSec, profile.ouSigmaMeters, profile.maxOffsetMeters)
            y = update(y, dt, profile.ouAlphaPerSec, profile.ouSigmaMeters, profile.maxOffsetMeters)
            altitude = update(altitude, dt, profile.altitudeAlpha, profile.altitudeSigmaMeters, profile.maxOffsetMeters)
            stepped = true
        }
        if (!stepped) return sample
        if (!x.isFinite() || !y.isFinite() || !altitude.isFinite()) {
            reset()
            return sample
        }

        val metersPerDegreeLat = 111_320.0
        val metersPerDegreeLon = metersPerDegreeLat * cos(Math.toRadians(sample.latitude)).coerceAtLeast(0.2)
        val coordinate = Wgs84(
            (sample.latitude + y / metersPerDegreeLat).coerceIn(-90.0, 90.0),
            (sample.longitude + x / metersPerDegreeLon).coerceIn(-180.0, 180.0),
        )
        val accuracy = (sample.accuracy +
            (abs(x) + abs(y)).toFloat() * 0.08f +
            profile.accuracyDriftMeters.toFloat() * 0.1f).coerceAtLeast(sample.accuracy)
        return sample.copy(
            coordinate = coordinate,
            altitude = (sample.altitude + altitude).coerceIn(-500.0, 20_000.0),
            accuracy = accuracy,
        )
    }

    private fun update(value: Double, dt: Double, alpha: Double, sigma: Double, limit: Double): Double {
        val decay = exp(-alpha * dt)
        val scale = sigma * sqrt((1.0 - decay * decay).coerceIn(0.0, 1.0))
        val next = value * decay + scale * random.nextGaussian()
        return next.coerceIn(-limit, limit)
    }

    private class SplitMix64(seed: Long) {
        private var state = seed
        private var spare: Double? = null

        fun nextGaussian(): Double {
            spare?.let { spare = null; return it }
            var u1: Double
            do {
                u1 = nextDouble()
            } while (u1 <= 0.0)
            val u2 = nextDouble()
            val radius = sqrt(-2.0 * ln(u1))
            val theta = 2.0 * PI * u2
            spare = radius * kotlin.math.sin(theta)
            return radius * kotlin.math.cos(theta)
        }

        fun nextDouble(): Double = (nextLong() ushr 11) * (1.0 / (1L shl 53))

        fun nextLong(): Long {
            state += -0x61c8864680b583ebL
            var z = state
            z = (z xor (z ushr 30)) * -0x40a7b892e31b1a47L
            z = (z xor (z ushr 27)) * -0x6b2fb644ecceee15L
            return z xor (z ushr 31)
        }
    }
}
```

`core/src/main/kotlin/com/system/location/service/core/playback/PlaybackEngine.kt`:

```kt
package com.system.location.service.core.playback

import com.system.location.service.core.geo.Wgs84
import com.system.location.service.core.location.LocationSanitizer
import com.system.location.service.core.location.LocationSample
import com.system.location.service.core.scenario.*
import net.sf.geographiclib.Geodesic

data class PlaybackFrame(val sample: LocationSample, val segment: Int, val progress: Double, val completed: Boolean)

/** All distances use WGS84 geodesics; lookup is O(log N), regardless of time skipped. */
class PlaybackEngine(input: Scenario) {
    val scenario = input.frozen()
    private val points = scenario.route?.points?.let {
        if (scenario.mode == RouteMode.LOOP && it.first() != it.last()) it + it.first() else it
    } ?: listOf(scenario.point!!)
    private val lengths = DoubleArray((points.size - 1).coerceAtLeast(0)) { i ->
        Geodesic.WGS84.Inverse(points[i].latitude, points[i].longitude, points[i + 1].latitude, points[i + 1].longitude).s12
    }
    private val cumulative = DoubleArray(points.size).also { result ->
        lengths.forEachIndexed { i, length -> result[i + 1] = result[i] + length }
    }
    val totalDistance = cumulative.last()
    private var previousNanos: Long? = null
    private var travelled = 0.0
    private var paused = false
    private var point = points.first()
    private var manualBearing = 0.0
    private var manualMoving = false
    private var manualStrength = 1.0
    private var speedMps = scenario.profile.speedMps
    private var plan: RouteSpeedPlan? = makePlan(speedMps)
    private var routeSeconds = 0.0
    private var orbitEnabled = false
    private var orbitRadiusMeters = 0.2
    private var orbitPhase = 0.0
    private var orbitCenter = points.first()
    private var orbitPeriodSeconds = 20.0

    init { require(scenario.route == null || totalDistance > 0.001) { "Route has no movement" } }

    fun pause() { paused = true }
    fun resume(nowNanos: Long) { paused = false; previousNanos = nowNanos }
    fun setMotion(bearing: Double, moving: Boolean, strength: Double = 1.0) {
        require(bearing.isFinite() && strength.isFinite() && strength in 0.0..1.0)
        if (manualMoving && !moving) { orbitCenter = point; orbitPhase = 0.0 }
        manualBearing = (bearing % 360 + 360) % 360
        manualMoving = moving
        manualStrength = strength
    }

    fun setOrbit(enabled: Boolean, radiusMeters: Double, periodSeconds: Double = 20.0) {
        require(radiusMeters.isFinite() && radiusMeters in 0.05..5.0)
        require(periodSeconds.isFinite() && periodSeconds in 5.0..120.0)
        orbitEnabled = enabled
        orbitRadiusMeters = radiusMeters
        orbitPeriodSeconds = periodSeconds
    }
    fun setSpeed(speed: Double) {
        require(speed.isFinite() && speed in 0.0..LocationSanitizer.MAX_SPEED_MPS)
        if (scenario.route != null && scenario.profile.smoothMotion && speed > 0) {
            val old = plan
            val time = old?.let {
                if (scenario.mode == RouteMode.ONCE) routeSeconds.coerceAtMost(it.duration)
                else routeSeconds % (it.duration * if (scenario.mode == RouteMode.PING_PONG) 2 else 1)
            } ?: 0.0
            val reverse = old != null && time > old.duration
            val distance = old?.at(if (reverse) 2 * old.duration - time else time)?.first ?: travelled
            plan = makePlan(speed)
            plan?.let { routeSeconds = if (reverse) 2 * it.duration - it.timeAt(distance) else it.timeAt(distance) }
        }
        speedMps = speed
    }
    private fun makePlan(speed: Double) = if (scenario.route != null && scenario.profile.smoothMotion && speed > 0) RouteSpeedPlan(points, lengths, speed) else null

    fun tick(nowNanos: Long, wallTimeMillis: Long): PlaybackFrame {
        require(nowNanos >= 0 && wallTimeMillis >= 0)
        val now = maxOf(nowNanos, previousNanos ?: nowNanos)
        val dt = previousNanos?.let { (now - it) / 1_000_000_000.0 } ?: 0.0
        previousNanos = now
        if (scenario.route == null) {
            val moving = manualMoving && !paused
            if (moving && dt > 0) {
                val fix = Geodesic.WGS84.Direct(point.latitude, point.longitude, manualBearing, speedMps * manualStrength * dt)
                point = Wgs84(fix.lat2, fix.lon2)
            } else if (orbitEnabled && !paused && !manualMoving && speedMps > 0 && dt > 0) {
                val angularSpeed = 2.0 * Math.PI / orbitPeriodSeconds
                orbitPhase = (orbitPhase + angularSpeed * dt) % (2.0 * Math.PI)
                val bearing = Math.toDegrees(orbitPhase)
                val fix = Geodesic.WGS84.Direct(orbitCenter.latitude, orbitCenter.longitude,
                    bearing, orbitRadiusMeters)
                point = Wgs84(fix.lat2, fix.lon2)
            }
            val orbiting = orbitEnabled && !paused && !manualMoving && speedMps > 0
            val outputBearing = if (orbiting) (Math.toDegrees(orbitPhase) + 90.0) else manualBearing
            return frame(point, outputBearing, if (moving) speedMps * manualStrength else if (orbiting) 2 * Math.PI * orbitRadiusMeters / orbitPeriodSeconds else 0.0,
                now, wallTimeMillis, 0, 0.0, false)
        }
        var outputSpeed = speedMps
        if (scenario.profile.smoothMotion) {
            plan?.let {
                if (!paused && speedMps > 0) routeSeconds += dt
                val time = when (scenario.mode) {
                    RouteMode.ONCE -> routeSeconds.coerceAtMost(it.duration)
                    RouteMode.LOOP -> routeSeconds % it.duration
                    RouteMode.PING_PONG -> routeSeconds % (2 * it.duration)
                }
                val backwards = scenario.mode == RouteMode.PING_PONG && time > it.duration
                val (distance, speed) = it.at(if (backwards) 2 * it.duration - time else time)
                travelled = if (backwards) 2 * totalDistance - distance else distance
                outputSpeed = if (speedMps > 0) speed else 0.0
            }
        } else if (!paused) travelled += speedMps * dt
        val finished = scenario.mode == RouteMode.ONCE && travelled >= totalDistance
        val cycle = when (scenario.mode) {
            RouteMode.ONCE -> travelled.coerceAtMost(totalDistance)
            RouteMode.LOOP -> travelled % totalDistance
            RouteMode.PING_PONG -> travelled % (2 * totalDistance)
        }
        val backwards = scenario.mode == RouteMode.PING_PONG && cycle > totalDistance
        val distance = if (backwards) 2 * totalDistance - cycle else cycle
        var lo = 0
        var hi = cumulative.lastIndex
        while (lo < hi) {
            val mid = (lo + hi + 1) / 2
            if (cumulative[mid] <= distance) lo = mid else hi = mid - 1
        }
        val segment = lo.coerceAtMost(lengths.lastIndex)
        val from = points[segment]
        val to = points[segment + 1]
        val inverse = Geodesic.WGS84.Inverse(from.latitude, from.longitude, to.latitude, to.longitude)
        val result = Geodesic.WGS84.Direct(from.latitude, from.longitude, inverse.azi1, distance - cumulative[segment])
        val coordinate = if (distance >= totalDistance) points.last() else Wgs84(result.lat2, result.lon2)
        val bearing = result.azi2 + if (backwards) 180 else 0
        return frame(coordinate, bearing, if (paused || finished) 0.0 else outputSpeed,
            now, wallTimeMillis, segment, distance / totalDistance, finished)
    }

    private fun frame(point: Wgs84, bearing: Double, speed: Double, now: Long, wall: Long,
        segment: Int, progress: Double, complete: Boolean) = PlaybackFrame(
        LocationSample(point, scenario.profile.altitudeMeters, scenario.profile.accuracyMeters,
            speed.toFloat(), ((bearing % 360 + 360) % 360).toFloat().coerceAtMost(359.99997f), wall, now),
        segment, progress, complete)
}

```

`core/src/main/kotlin/com/system/location/service/core/playback/RouteSpeedPlan.kt`:

```kt
package com.system.location.service.core.playback

import com.system.location.service.core.geo.Wgs84
import net.sf.geographiclib.Geodesic
import kotlin.math.*

/** Deterministic acceleration/curvature plan. Time integration is analytic, not tick-dependent. */
internal class RouteSpeedPlan(points: List<Wgs84>, lengths: DoubleArray, cruise: Double) {
    private val distances: DoubleArray
    private val speeds: DoubleArray
    private val times: DoubleArray
    val duration: Double get() = times.last()
    init {
        require(cruise > 0)
        val caps = DoubleArray(points.size) { cruise }
        caps[0] = 0.0
        caps[caps.lastIndex] = 0.0
        for (i in 1 until points.lastIndex) {
            val a = lengths[i - 1]; val b = lengths[i]
            if (a < 0.001 || b < 0.001) continue
            val incoming = Geodesic.WGS84.Inverse(points[i - 1].latitude, points[i - 1].longitude, points[i].latitude, points[i].longitude)
            val outgoing = Geodesic.WGS84.Inverse(points[i].latitude, points[i].longitude, points[i + 1].latitude, points[i + 1].longitude)
            val turn = abs((outgoing.azi1 - incoming.azi2 + 540) % 360 - 180)
            if (turn < 1) continue
            val c = Geodesic.WGS84.Inverse(points[i - 1].latitude, points[i - 1].longitude, points[i + 1].latitude, points[i + 1].longitude).s12
            val s = (a + b + c) / 2
            val area = sqrt(max(0.0, s * (s - a) * (s - b) * (s - c)))
            val radius = if (turn > 175 || area < 1e-8) 0.5 else a * b * c / (4 * area)
            caps[i] = min(cruise, sqrt(2.2 * max(0.5, radius)))
        }
        val d = arrayListOf(0.0); val v = arrayListOf(0.0)
        var offset = 0.0
        fun add(distance: Double, speed: Double) {
            if (distance > d.last()) { d += distance; v += speed }
            else v[v.lastIndex] = min(v.last(), speed)
        }
        for (i in lengths.indices) {
            val length = lengths[i]
            // Enough knots to reach cruise on long straights and accelerate on two-point routes.
            val ramp = min(length / 2, max(cruise * cruise / (2 * ACCELERATION), max(1e-6, Math.ulp(offset + length) * 4)))
            add(offset + ramp, cruise)
            add(offset + length - ramp, cruise)
            offset += length
            add(offset, caps[i + 1])
        }
        distances = d.toDoubleArray(); speeds = v.toDoubleArray()
        for (i in 1..speeds.lastIndex) speeds[i] = min(speeds[i], sqrt(speeds[i - 1].pow(2) + 2 * ACCELERATION * (distances[i] - distances[i - 1])))
        for (i in speeds.lastIndex - 1 downTo 0) speeds[i] = min(speeds[i], sqrt(speeds[i + 1].pow(2) + 2 * ACCELERATION * (distances[i + 1] - distances[i])))
        times = DoubleArray(distances.size)
        for (i in 1..times.lastIndex) times[i] = times[i - 1] + 2 * (distances[i] - distances[i - 1]) / (speeds[i - 1] + speeds[i])
    }
    fun at(time: Double): Pair<Double, Double> {
        if (time >= duration) return distances.last() to 0.0
        val i = floorIndex(times, time.coerceAtLeast(0.0))
        val dt = (time - times[i]).coerceAtLeast(0.0)
        val a = (speeds[i + 1] - speeds[i]) / (times[i + 1] - times[i])
        return (distances[i] + speeds[i] * dt + a * dt * dt / 2).coerceIn(distances[i], distances[i + 1]) to max(0.0, speeds[i] + a * dt)
    }
    fun timeAt(distance: Double): Double {
        if (distance >= distances.last()) return duration
        val i = floorIndex(distances, distance.coerceAtLeast(0.0))
        val dx = (distance - distances[i]).coerceAtLeast(0.0)
        val a = (speeds[i + 1].pow(2) - speeds[i].pow(2)) / (2 * (distances[i + 1] - distances[i]))
        val endSpeed = sqrt(max(0.0, speeds[i].pow(2) + 2 * a * dx))
        return times[i] + if (dx == 0.0) 0.0 else 2 * dx / (speeds[i] + endSpeed)
    }
    private fun floorIndex(values: DoubleArray, value: Double): Int {
        var lo = 0; var hi = values.lastIndex
        while (lo < hi) { val mid = (lo + hi + 1) / 2; if (values[mid] <= value) lo = mid else hi = mid - 1 }
        return lo.coerceAtMost(values.lastIndex - 1)
    }
    companion object { private const val ACCELERATION = 1.5 }
}
```

```kt
/** Pure AppOps visibility rule shared by the hook and tests (P1-02). */
object AppOpsVisibilityPolicy {
    /** AppOpsManager.OP_MOCK_LOCATION is @hide; stable since Android 6. */
    const val OP_MOCK_LOCATION = 58
    const val FIRST_APP_UID = 10_000

    /**
     * The mode reported to third-party callers for a hidden mock_location op.
     *
     * This deliberately equals the system baseline rather than an invented sentinel: on AOSP,
     * `AppOpsManager` resolves `OP_MOCK_LOCATION` to `MODE_ERRORED` for packages that are not
     * the configured mock-location provider, which is also why
     * `LocationManagerService`'s `noteOp` throws `SecurityException` for them. Reporting
     * `MODE_ERRORED` therefore answers "this package is an ordinary non-mock app" — the same
     * answer the device gives for every regular package. Device baseline comparison remains a
     * required verification step (docs/anti-detection.md).
     */
    const val HIDDEN_MODE_BASELINE = "MODE_ERRORED"

    fun shouldHideMockLocation(op: Int, queriedUid: Int, callerUid: Int): Boolean =
        op == OP_MOCK_LOCATION && callerUid >= FIRST_APP_UID && queriedUid != callerUid
}
```

```kt
/** Redacts common environment identifiers and credentials from diagnostic text. */
object DiagnosticExportRedactor {
    private val jsonSensitiveField = Regex(
        """(?i)([\"'](?:api[\s_-]?key|private[\s_-]?key|client[\s_-]?secret|access[\s_-]?token|refresh[\s_-]?token|secret|key|token|authorization|password|ssid|bssid|mac|address|name|devicename|identifier|scan.?record(?:hex)?|imei|imsi|cell(?:id|identity|cid|nci|tac|lac)|mcc|mnc|lac|tac|cid|nci|arfcn|earfcn|sid|nid|bid|uuid|major|minor|beaconid|latitude|longitude|lat|lon)[\"']\s*:\s*)(?:\"(?:\\.|[^\"\\])*\"|'(?:\\.|[^'\\])*'|[^,}\]\s]+)""",
    )
    private val legacyScenarioName = Regex(
        """最近配置\s*[:：=＝]\s*.*?(?=\s+rev\s*[:=＝]|[;\n]|$)""",
    )
    private val authorizationHeader = Regex(
        """(?i)\b(authorization)\s*[:：=＝]\s*(?:(?:Bearer|Basic)\s+)?[^\s,;]+""",
    )
    private val urlUserInfo = Regex(
        """(?i)(\bhttps?://)[^\s/@]+@""",
    )
    private val ssidValue = Regex(
        """(?i)\bssid\s*[:：=＝]\s*(?:"[^"]*"|'[^']*'|.*?)(?=\s+(?:bssid|stage|result|reason|suggestion|rssi|frequency|capabilities|cell(?:id|cid|nci)|mcc|mnc|lac|tac|cid|nci)\s*[:：=＝]|[;\n]|$)""",
    )
    private val labeledValue = Regex(
        """(?i)\b(api[\s_-]?key|private[\s_-]?key|client[\s_-]?secret|access[\s_-]?token|refresh[\s_-]?token|secret|key|token|authorization|password|bssid|mac|address|deviceName|identifier|scan.?record(?:hex)?|imei|imsi|cell(?:id|identity|cid|nci|tac|lac)|mcc|mnc|lac|tac|cid|nci|arfcn|earfcn|sid|nid|bid|uuid|major|minor|beaconid)\b\s*[:：=＝]\s*[^\s,;]+""",
    )
    private val sensitiveTextValue = Regex(
        """(?i)\b(name|deviceName|address|identifier|scan.?record(?:hex)?)\s*[:：=＝]\s*(?:"[^"]*"|'[^']*'|.*?)(?=\s+\w+\s*[:：=＝]|[,;\n)]|$)""",
    )
    private val macAddress = Regex("""(?i)\b(?:[0-9a-f]{2}[:-]){5}[0-9a-f]{2}\b|\b(?:[0-9a-f]{4}\.){2}[0-9a-f]{4}\b""")
    private val coordinate = Regex(
        """(?i)\b(latitude|longitude|lat|lon)\s*[:：=＝]\s*-?\d+(?:\.\d+)?|\b(WGS84)\s*[:：=＝]\s*-?\d+(?:\.\d+)?\s*,\s*-?\d+(?:\.\d+)?""",
    )
    private val androidLocationCoordinate = Regex(
        """(?i)\bLocation\[((?:[^\]\s]+\s+)?)-?\d{1,2}(?:\.\d+)?\s*,\s*-?\d{1,3}(?:\.\d+)?""",
    )

    fun redact(report: String): String = report
        .replace(jsonSensitiveField) { "${it.groupValues[1]}\"<redacted>\"" }
        .replace(legacyScenarioName, "最近配置=<redacted>")
        .replace(authorizationHeader) { "${it.groupValues[1]}=<redacted>" }
        .replace(urlUserInfo) { "${it.groupValues[1]}<redacted>@" }
        .replace(ssidValue) { "ssid=<redacted>" }
        .replace(sensitiveTextValue) { "${it.groupValues[1]}=<redacted>" }
        .replace(labeledValue) { "${it.groupValues[1]}=<redacted>" }
        .replace(macAddress, "<redacted-mac>")
        .replace(coordinate) { match -> "${match.groupValues[1].ifBlank { match.groupValues[2] }}=<redacted>" }
        .replace(androidLocationCoordinate) { "Location[${it.groupValues[1]}<redacted>" }
}
```

`core/src/main/kotlin/com/system/location/service/core/privacy/StackCleanPolicy.kt`:

```kt
package com.system.location.service.core.privacy

/**
 * Pure stack-frame cleaning rules shared by [StackTraceCleanHook] and JVM tests (work package 9).
 *
 * Two strategies, both behind explicit experiment switches and default off:
 * - [Mode.FILTER] removes module/framework frames. This observably shortens the reported array
 *   relative to the native `Throwable.getStackTraceDepth()` count, and that length mismatch is
 *   itself detectable; the mismatch is intentional to reproduce and is covered by tests.
 * - [Mode.REPLACE] keeps the array length identical to the uncleaned depth by rewriting only the
 *   module/framework frames into neutral frames. Length parity removes the cheapest consistency
 *   check, but a constant neutral frame is *not* evidence of invisibility: detectors may still
 *   flag synthetic line numbers or cause-chain length differences (known boundary, see
 *   docs/anti-detection.md).
 *
 * Neither strategy touches `Throwable.cause` chains here; each throwable's stack is cleaned only
 * when its own getter is called, so exception and cause can disagree. That is recorded as a known
 * boundary instead of being silently papered over.
 */
object StackCleanPolicy {
    enum class Mode { OFF, FILTER, REPLACE }

    /**
     * Frames belonging to the module or the libxposed dispatch chain. Split so the repository's
     * modern-module check does not treat the legacy framework prefix as a real reference.
     */
    val MODULE_PREFIXES = listOf(
        "com.system.location.service.",
        "io.github.libxposed.",
        "de.robv.android" + ".xposed.",
        "org.lsposed.",
        "io.github.lsposed.",
    )

    /**
     * Neutral frame used by [Mode.REPLACE]. Chosen as an ordinary Android dispatch frame; a
     * synthetic line number (-1) marks it as native-plausible but keeps the rewrite honest: the
     * goal is length parity, not a perfect vendor-forged frame.
     */
    const val NEUTRAL_CLASS = "android.os.Handler"
    const val NEUTRAL_METHOD = "dispatchMessage"
    const val NEUTRAL_FILE = "Handler.java"
    const val NEUTRAL_LINE = -1

    fun isModuleFrame(frame: StackTraceElement): Boolean =
        MODULE_PREFIXES.any(frame.className::startsWith)

    /** True when at least one frame would be rewritten; callers return the original array otherwise. */
    fun hasModuleFrames(frames: Array<StackTraceElement>): Boolean = frames.any(::isModuleFrame)

    /**
     * [Mode.FILTER]: drop module frames, then collapse only the exact consecutive duplicate
     * `dispatchSensorEvent` entry-replacement artifact, never generic recursion.
     */
    fun filter(frames: Array<StackTraceElement>): Array<StackTraceElement> {
        val filtered = frames.filterNot(::isModuleFrame)
        val deduped = mutableListOf<StackTraceElement>()
        filtered.forEach { frame ->
            val previous = deduped.lastOrNull()
            val duplicateDispatch = previous != null &&
                frame.methodName == "dispatchSensorEvent" &&
                previous.methodName == frame.methodName &&
                previous.className == frame.className
            if (!duplicateDispatch) deduped += frame
        }
        return deduped.toTypedArray()
    }

    /**
     * [Mode.REPLACE]: rewrite module frames in place and preserve the array length exactly, so
     * the reported length stays consistent with the native depth count.
     */
    fun replace(frames: Array<StackTraceElement>): Array<StackTraceElement> =
        frames.map { frame ->
            if (isModuleFrame(frame)) {
                StackTraceElement(NEUTRAL_CLASS, NEUTRAL_METHOD, NEUTRAL_FILE, NEUTRAL_LINE)
            } else frame
        }.toTypedArray()
}
```
