`core/src/main/kotlin/com/system/location/service/core/providers/ProviderMixer.kt`:

```kt
package com.system.location.service.core.providers

import com.system.location.service.core.location.LocationSample
import kotlinx.serialization.Serializable

enum class ProviderKind { GPS, NETWORK, FUSED }

/** Per-provider accuracy/frequency/field policy (P4-01, ADR-007). */
@Serializable
data class ProviderProfile(
    val kind: ProviderKind,
    val intervalMs: Long,
    val accuracyMeters: Float,
    val verticalAccuracyFactor: Float,
    val latencyMs: Long,
    val supportsBearing: Boolean,
    val supportsAltitude: Boolean,
    val supportsSpeed: Boolean,
    val accuracyDriftMeters: Float = 0f,
) {
    init {
        require(intervalMs in 100L..60_000L) { "intervalMs out of range: $intervalMs" }
        require(accuracyMeters > 0f) { "accuracyMeters must be positive" }
        require(verticalAccuracyFactor >= 1f) { "verticalAccuracyFactor must be >= 1" }
        require(latencyMs in 0L..30_000L) { "latencyMs out of range: $latencyMs" }
        require(accuracyDriftMeters >= 0f) { "accuracyDriftMeters must be non-negative" }
    }

    companion object {
        val GPS = ProviderProfile(
            kind = ProviderKind.GPS,
            intervalMs = 1_000,
            accuracyMeters = 6f,
            verticalAccuracyFactor = 2f,
            latencyMs = 0,
            supportsBearing = true,
            supportsAltitude = true,
            supportsSpeed = true,
            accuracyDriftMeters = 1.5f,
        )
        val NETWORK = ProviderProfile(
            kind = ProviderKind.NETWORK,
            intervalMs = 3_000,
            accuracyMeters = 60f,
            verticalAccuracyFactor = 2.5f,
            latencyMs = 400,
            supportsBearing = false,
            supportsAltitude = false,
            supportsSpeed = false,
            accuracyDriftMeters = 8f,
        )
        val FUSED = ProviderProfile(
            kind = ProviderKind.FUSED,
            intervalMs = 1_000,
            accuracyMeters = 10f,
            verticalAccuracyFactor = 1.8f,
            latencyMs = 120,
            supportsBearing = true,
            supportsAltitude = true,
            supportsSpeed = true,
            accuracyDriftMeters = 2.5f,
        )

        fun defaults(): List<ProviderProfile> = listOf(GPS, NETWORK, FUSED)
    }
}

@Serializable
data class StationaryPolicy(
    val speedThresholdMps: Double = 0.3,
    val bearingHoldSeconds: Double = 2.0,
    val accuracyDriftMeters: Float = 0.5f,
    val stepRatePerMin: Int = 0,
) {
    init {
        require(speedThresholdMps >= 0.0) { "speedThresholdMps must be non-negative" }
        require(bearingHoldSeconds >= 0.0) { "bearingHoldSeconds must be non-negative" }
        require(accuracyDriftMeters >= 0f) { "accuracyDriftMeters must be non-negative" }
        require(stepRatePerMin >= 0) { "stepRatePerMin must be non-negative" }
    }
}

object ProviderFieldMask {
    const val SPEED = 1 shl 0
    const val BEARING = 1 shl 1
    const val ALTITUDE = 1 shl 2
    const val MSL_ALTITUDE = 1 shl 3
    const val VERTICAL_ACCURACY = 1 shl 4
    const val SPEED_ACCURACY = 1 shl 5
    const val BEARING_ACCURACY = 1 shl 6
    const val ELAPSED_REALTIME_UNCERTAINTY = 1 shl 7
    const val SATELLITES = 1 shl 8
    const val CN0 = 1 shl 9
}

data class ProviderSample(
    val profile: ProviderProfile,
    val sample: LocationSample,
    val fieldsMask: Int,
    val verticalAccuracyMeters: Float?,
    val speedAccuracyMps: Float?,
    val bearingAccuracyDeg: Float?,
    val mslAltitudeMeters: Double?,
    val elapsedRealtimeUncertaintyNanos: Long?,
    val satellites: Int?,
    val meanCn0: Float?,
    val maxCn0: Float?,
) {
    init {
        require(fieldsMask >= 0) { "fieldsMask must be non-negative" }
    }

    fun has(mask: Int): Boolean = fieldsMask and mask != 0
}

/**
 * Splits one deterministic fix into provider-specific samples (P4-01).
 *
 * The mixer is stateless: scheduling is the runtime's job. It only guarantees that the three
 * provider views differ in accuracy, latency and field availability, and that a stationary fix
 * never exposes a 0° bearing or a fake speed.
 */
class ProviderMixer(
    private val profiles: List<ProviderProfile> = ProviderProfile.defaults(),
    private val stationaryPolicy: StationaryPolicy = StationaryPolicy(),
    private val useSampleAccuracy: Boolean = false,
) {
    init {
        require(profiles.isNotEmpty()) { "profiles must not be empty" }
        require(profiles.map { it.kind }.distinct().size == profiles.size) { "duplicate provider kind" }
    }

    fun mix(
        sample: LocationSample,
        satellites: Int? = null,
        meanCn0: Float? = null,
        maxCn0: Float? = null,
    ): Map<ProviderKind, ProviderSample> {
        val moving = sample.speed > stationaryPolicy.speedThresholdMps
        return profiles.associate { profile ->
            // Standard Mock uses the configured GPS radius as its baseline. Other providers
            // retain their relative uncertainty; system Hook callers keep their existing policy.
            val accuracy = if (useSampleAccuracy) {
                (sample.accuracy * profile.accuracyMeters / ProviderProfile.GPS.accuracyMeters)
                    .coerceIn(0.1f, 10_000f)
            } else if (moving) profile.accuracyMeters else {
                profile.accuracyMeters + stationaryPolicy.accuracyDriftMeters
            }
            val useBearing = moving && profile.supportsBearing && sample.speed > 0f
            val useSpeed = profile.supportsSpeed && moving
            val useAltitude = profile.supportsAltitude
            val latencyMillis = profile.latencyMs
            val timeMillis = (sample.timeMillis - latencyMillis).coerceAtLeast(0L)
            val elapsedNanos = (sample.elapsedNanos - latencyMillis * 1_000_000L).coerceAtLeast(0L)
            var mask = ProviderFieldMask.VERTICAL_ACCURACY or
                ProviderFieldMask.ELAPSED_REALTIME_UNCERTAINTY
            if (useSpeed) mask = mask or ProviderFieldMask.SPEED or ProviderFieldMask.SPEED_ACCURACY
            if (useBearing) mask = mask or ProviderFieldMask.BEARING or ProviderFieldMask.BEARING_ACCURACY
            if (useAltitude) mask = mask or ProviderFieldMask.ALTITUDE
            if (satellites != null) mask = mask or ProviderFieldMask.SATELLITES
            if (meanCn0 != null || maxCn0 != null) mask = mask or ProviderFieldMask.CN0

            val adjusted = sample.copy(
                timeMillis = timeMillis,
                elapsedNanos = elapsedNanos,
                accuracy = accuracy,
                speed = if (useSpeed) sample.speed else 0f,
                bearing = if (useBearing) sample.bearing else 0f,
                altitude = if (useAltitude) sample.altitude else 0.0,
            )
            profile.kind to ProviderSample(
                profile = profile,
                sample = adjusted,
                fieldsMask = mask,
                verticalAccuracyMeters = accuracy * profile.verticalAccuracyFactor,
                speedAccuracyMps = if (useSpeed) 0.15f else null,
                bearingAccuracyDeg = if (useBearing) 2f else null,
                // Ellipsoidal source altitude is not MSL altitude without a geoid model.
                mslAltitudeMeters = null,
                elapsedRealtimeUncertaintyNanos = if (profile.kind == ProviderKind.NETWORK) 50_000_000L else 5_000_000L,
                satellites = if (profile.kind == ProviderKind.NETWORK) null else satellites,
                meanCn0 = if (profile.kind == ProviderKind.NETWORK) null else meanCn0,
                maxCn0 = if (profile.kind == ProviderKind.NETWORK) null else maxCn0,
            )
        }
    }
}
```

`core/src/main/kotlin/com/system/location/service/core/repository/Repositories.kt`:

```kt
package com.system.location.service.core.repository

import com.system.location.service.core.geo.Wgs84
import com.system.location.service.core.scenario.*
import kotlinx.serialization.KSerializer
import kotlinx.serialization.Serializable
import kotlinx.serialization.builtins.ListSerializer
import kotlinx.serialization.json.*
import java.util.UUID

/** Implementations must replace the complete document atomically or leave the old one intact. */
interface DocumentStore {
    fun read(): String?
    fun writeAtomically(text: String)
}

interface Repository<T> {
    fun list(): List<T>
    fun get(id: String): T?
    fun create(item: T): T
    fun update(item: T): T
    fun delete(id: String): Boolean
    fun copy(id: String, name: String): T
    fun importJson(text: String): List<T>
    fun importItems(items: List<T>): List<T>
    fun exportJson(): String
    fun replaceAll(items: List<T>)
}

/** No cached mutable collections: reads and failed writes never mutate the saved library. */
abstract class VersionedRepository<T>(private val store: DocumentStore, serializer: KSerializer<T>,
    private val kind: String) : Repository<T> {
    private val listSerializer = ListSerializer(serializer)
    protected abstract fun id(item: T): String
    protected abstract fun freeze(item: T): T
    protected abstract fun duplicate(item: T, id: String, name: String? = null): T
    @Synchronized override fun list(): List<T> = read().map(::freeze)
    @Synchronized override fun get(id: String): T? = read().find { id(it) == id }?.let(::freeze)
    @Synchronized override fun create(item: T): T {
        val frozen = freeze(item); val old = read()
        require(old.none { id(it) == id(frozen) }) { "Record already exists" }
        write(old + frozen)
        return freeze(frozen)
    }
    @Synchronized override fun update(item: T): T {
        val frozen = freeze(item); val old = read()
        require(old.any { id(it) == id(frozen) }) { "Record does not exist" }
        write(old.map { if (id(it) == id(frozen)) frozen else it })
        return freeze(frozen)
    }
    @Synchronized override fun delete(id: String): Boolean {
        val old = read(); val next = old.filterNot { id(it) == id }
        if (old.size == next.size) return false
        write(next)
        return true
    }
    @Synchronized override fun copy(id: String, name: String): T {
        require(name.isNotBlank())
        val source = get(id) ?: error("Record does not exist")
        return create(duplicate(source, UUID.randomUUID().toString(), name))
    }
    @Synchronized override fun importJson(text: String): List<T> = importItems(decode(text))
    /** Validate and append the entire batch while holding the same lock as CRUD operations. */
    @Synchronized override fun importItems(items: List<T>): List<T> {
        val incoming = items.map(::freeze)
        validate(incoming)
        val old = read()
        val identifiers = old.map(::id).toMutableSet()
        val imported = incoming.map { item ->
            val next = if (id(item) in identifiers) duplicate(item, UUID.randomUUID().toString()) else item
            identifiers += id(next)
            freeze(next)
        }
        write(old + imported)
        return imported.map(::freeze)
    }
    @Synchronized override fun exportJson() = encode(read())
    @Synchronized override fun replaceAll(items: List<T>) { write(items.map(::freeze)) }
    private fun read(): List<T> = store.read()?.let(::decode) ?: emptyList()
    private fun decode(text: String): List<T> {
        require(text.length <= MAX_DOCUMENT_CHARS) { "Library exceeds size limit" }
        val root = Json.parseToJsonElement(text).jsonObject
        require(root["schemaVersion"]?.jsonPrimitive?.intOrNull == 1) { "Unsupported library schema" }
        require(root["kind"]?.jsonPrimitive?.content == kind) { "Wrong library type" }
        val items = Json.decodeFromJsonElement(listSerializer, root["items"] ?: error("Missing records"))
        validate(items)
        return items.map(::freeze)
    }
    private fun validate(items: List<T>) {
        require(items.size <= 10_000) { "Too many records" }
        require(items.all { id(it).isNotBlank() } && items.map(::id).distinct().size == items.size) { "Invalid or duplicate IDs" }
    }
    private fun encode(items: List<T>): String = buildJsonObject {
        put("schemaVersion", 1); put("kind", kind); put("items", Json.encodeToJsonElement(listSerializer, items))
    }.toString()
    private fun write(items: List<T>) {
        validate(items)
        val text = encode(items)
        require(text.length <= MAX_DOCUMENT_CHARS) { "Library exceeds size limit" }
        store.writeAtomically(text)
    }
    companion object { const val MAX_DOCUMENT_CHARS = 20_000_000 }
}

@Serializable data class SavedRoute(val route: Route, val mode: RouteMode = RouteMode.ONCE, val favorite: Boolean = false)
@Serializable data class SavedLocation(val id: String, val name: String, val coordinate: Wgs84,
    val address: String = "", val favorite: Boolean = false) {
    init { require(id.isNotBlank() && name.isNotBlank()) }
}

class RouteRepository(store: DocumentStore) : VersionedRepository<SavedRoute>(store, SavedRoute.serializer(), "routes") {
    override fun id(item: SavedRoute) = item.route.id
    override fun freeze(item: SavedRoute) = item.copy(route = item.route.frozen())
    override fun duplicate(item: SavedRoute, id: String, name: String?) = item.copy(route = item.route.copy(id = id, name = name ?: item.route.name))
    fun rename(id: String, name: String) = get(id)!!.let { update(it.copy(route = it.route.copy(name = name))) }
    fun favorite(id: String, value: Boolean) = get(id)!!.let { update(it.copy(favorite = value)) }
    fun mode(id: String, value: RouteMode) = get(id)!!.let { update(it.copy(mode = value)) }
}
class ScenarioRepository(store: DocumentStore) : VersionedRepository<Scenario>(store, Scenario.serializer(), "scenarios") {
    override fun id(item: Scenario) = item.id
    override fun freeze(item: Scenario) = item.frozen()
    override fun duplicate(item: Scenario, id: String, name: String?) = item.copy(id = id, name = name ?: item.name)
}

    override fun freeze(item: SavedLocation) = item.copy()
```

```kt
package com.system.location.service.core.routing

/** PackageManager view used by the system_server caller resolver (P5-02). */
interface PackageUidLookup {
    fun packagesForUid(uid: Int): List<String>

    fun isSystemPackage(packageName: String): Boolean
}

/**
 * Resolves a Binder caller UID to the routing table without touching Android APIs.
 *
 * Shared UIDs can own several packages; a route matches if any package matches, and a system
 * package in the UID wins over the per-app table so framework services keep real locations.
 */
class CallerRouter(
    private val table: RoutingTable,
    private val lookup: PackageUidLookup,
) {
    fun decision(uid: Int): RoutingDecision {
        val packages = lookup.packagesForUid(uid)
        val isSystem = packages.any(lookup::isSystemPackage)
        return table.decision(uid, packages, isSystem)
    }
}
```

```kt
package com.system.location.service.core.routing

/** Change only the exclusion list; fixed points and scenario assignments belong to other editors. */
fun RoutingConfig.withDeniedPackages(packages: Set<String>): RoutingConfig = copy(
    mode = if (packages.isNotEmpty() || routes.isNotEmpty() || globalScenarioId != null) {
        RoutingMode.PER_APP
    } else RoutingMode.GLOBAL,
    deniedPackages = packages,
)

/** Replace assignments for this point, including removals, without disturbing other points. */
fun RoutingConfig.withPointAssignments(
    point: com.system.location.service.core.geo.Wgs84,
    packages: Set<String>,
): RoutingConfig {
    val selected = packages.distinctBy { it.lowercase() }
    val normalized = selected.map { it.lowercase() }.toSet()
    val nextRoutes = routes.filterNot { it.point == point || it.packageName.lowercase() in normalized } +
        selected.map { AppRoute(it, point = point) }
    return copy(routes = nextRoutes).withDeniedPackages(deniedPackages)
}
```

`core/src/main/kotlin/com/system/location/service/core/routing/RoutingTable.kt`:

```kt
package com.system.location.service.core.routing

import kotlinx.serialization.Serializable

@Serializable
enum class RoutingMode { GLOBAL, PER_APP }

@Serializable
data class AppRoute(
    val packageName: String,
    val scenarioId: String = "",
    val uid: Int? = null,
    val enabled: Boolean = true,
    val point: com.system.location.service.core.geo.Wgs84? = null,
) {
    init {
        require(packageName.isNotBlank()) { "packageName must not be blank" }
        require(packageName.length <= 255) { "packageName too long" }
        require(scenarioId.isNotBlank() || point != null) { "scenarioId or point is required" }
        require(scenarioId.isBlank() || point == null) { "scenarioId and point are mutually exclusive" }
        uid?.let { require(it >= 0) { "uid must be non-negative" } }
    }
}

@Serializable
data class RoutingConfig(
    val schemaVersion: Int = SCHEMA_VERSION,
    val mode: RoutingMode = RoutingMode.GLOBAL,
    val globalScenarioId: String? = null,
    val routes: List<AppRoute> = emptyList(),
    val deniedPackages: Set<String> = emptySet(),
) {
    init {
        require(schemaVersion == SCHEMA_VERSION) { "Unsupported routing schema: $schemaVersion" }
        require(globalScenarioId == null || globalScenarioId.isNotBlank()) { "globalScenarioId must not be blank" }
        require(routes.size <= MAX_ROUTES) { "Too many routes: ${routes.size}" }
        require(deniedPackages.size <= MAX_DENIED) { "Too many denied packages: ${deniedPackages.size}" }
        val enabled = routes.filter { it.enabled }
        require(enabled.map { it.packageName.lowercase() }.distinct().size == enabled.size) {
            "Duplicate package route"
        }
        val enabledUids = enabled.mapNotNull { it.uid }
        require(enabledUids.distinct().size == enabledUids.size) { "Duplicate uid route" }
    }

    companion object {
        const val SCHEMA_VERSION = 1
        const val MAX_ROUTES = 1_024
        const val MAX_DENIED = 256
    }
}

sealed class RoutingDecision {
    data class Scenario(val scenarioId: String) : RoutingDecision()
    data class Point(val point: com.system.location.service.core.geo.Wgs84) : RoutingDecision()
    data object Global : RoutingDecision()
    data object Deny : RoutingDecision()
}

/**
 * Pure per-app routing table (P5-01).
 *
 * Precedence: disabled/only-GLOBAL → system caller bypass → explicit deny → exact package route →
 * UID route → global scenario → real global location. The table never decides *which* scenario a
 * package should get; it only resolves a stable ID supplied by the config.
 */
class RoutingTable(private val config: RoutingConfig = RoutingConfig()) {
    private val packageRoutes: Map<String, AppRoute>
    private val uidRoutes: Map<Int, AppRoute>
    private val deniedPackages: Set<String>

    init {
        val enabledRoutes = config.routes.filter { it.enabled }
        val packages = enabledRoutes.map { it.packageName.lowercase() }
        require(packages.distinct().size == packages.size) { "Duplicate package route" }
        val uids = enabledRoutes.mapNotNull { it.uid }
        require(uids.distinct().size == uids.size) { "Duplicate uid route" }
        packageRoutes = enabledRoutes.associateBy { it.packageName.lowercase() }
        uidRoutes = enabledRoutes.mapNotNull { route -> route.uid?.let { it to route } }.toMap()
        deniedPackages = config.deniedPackages.map { it.lowercase() }.toSet()
    }

    fun decision(uid: Int, packageName: String?, isSystemApp: Boolean): RoutingDecision =
        decision(uid, listOfNotNull(packageName), isSystemApp)

    fun decision(uid: Int, packageNames: Collection<String>, isSystemApp: Boolean): RoutingDecision {
        if (config.mode == RoutingMode.GLOBAL) return RoutingDecision.Global
        if (isSystemApp || uid < 0 || uid % 100000 < FIRST_APP_UID) return RoutingDecision.Global
        val normalized = packageNames.map { it.lowercase() }
        if (normalized.any { it in deniedPackages }) return RoutingDecision.Deny
        val packageRoute = normalized.firstNotNullOfOrNull { packageRoutes[it] }
        if (packageRoute != null) return packageRoute.decision()
        uidRoutes[uid]?.let { return it.decision() }
        return config.globalScenarioId?.let { RoutingDecision.Scenario(it) } ?: RoutingDecision.Global
    }

    private fun AppRoute.decision(): RoutingDecision =
        point?.let { RoutingDecision.Point(it) } ?: RoutingDecision.Scenario(scenarioId)

    fun routes(): List<AppRoute> = config.routes.toList()

    fun config(): RoutingConfig = config

    companion object {
        const val FIRST_APP_UID = 10_000
    }
}

```

`core/src/main/kotlin/com/system/location/service/core/runtime/DiagnosticJournal.kt`:

```kt
package com.system.location.service.core.runtime

import com.system.location.service.core.privacy.DiagnosticExportRedactor
import com.system.location.service.core.repository.DocumentStore
import kotlinx.serialization.builtins.ListSerializer
import kotlinx.serialization.json.Json

/** Bounded, atomic local history. Failed writes leave persisted and cached history intact. */
class DiagnosticJournal(private val store: DocumentStore, private val maxEvents: Int = 300, private val maxChars: Int = 300_000) {
    private val codec = Json { ignoreUnknownKeys = true }
    private val serializer = ListSerializer(DiagnosticEvent.serializer())
    private var cached: List<DiagnosticEvent>? = null
    init { require(maxEvents > 0 && maxChars >= 1024) }
    @Synchronized fun read(): List<DiagnosticEvent> {
        cached?.let { return it.toList() }
        val text = store.read()
        require(text == null || text.length <= maxChars) { "诊断历史文件过大" }
        val decoded = text?.let { codec.decodeFromString(serializer, it) } ?: emptyList()
        val sanitized = decoded.takeLast(maxEvents).map(::sanitizeDiagnosticEvent)
        if (sanitized != decoded) store.writeAtomically(codec.encodeToString(serializer, sanitized))
        return sanitized.also { cached = it }.toList()
    }
    fun append(event: DiagnosticEvent) = appendAll(listOf(event))

    /** One atomic replacement per batch; publish cache only after success. */
    @Synchronized fun appendAll(events: List<DiagnosticEvent>) {
        if (events.isEmpty()) return
        val bounded = events.takeLast(maxEvents).map(::sanitizeDiagnosticEvent).map { event ->
            event.copy(stage = event.stage.take(128), result = event.result.take(64), reason = event.reason.take(2048), suggestion = event.suggestion.take(512))
        }
        var next = (read() + bounded).takeLast(maxEvents)
        var text = codec.encodeToString(serializer, next)
        while (text.length > maxChars && next.size > 1) { next = next.drop(1); text = codec.encodeToString(serializer, next) }
        require(text.length <= maxChars) { "诊断记录过大" }
        store.writeAtomically(text)
        cached = next
    }

    private fun sanitizeDiagnosticEvent(event: DiagnosticEvent): DiagnosticEvent {
        val withoutLegacyScenarioName = if (event.stage == "CONFIG_STORE" && event.result == "INFO" &&
            event.reason.startsWith("最近配置：")) {
            event.copy(reason = "最近配置已恢复")
        } else event
        return withoutLegacyScenarioName.copy(
            reason = DiagnosticExportRedactor.redact(withoutLegacyScenarioName.reason),
            suggestion = DiagnosticExportRedactor.redact(withoutLegacyScenarioName.suggestion),
        )
    }
}
```

`core/src/main/kotlin/com/system/location/service/core/runtime/DiagnosticWriter.kt`:

```kt
package com.system.location.service.core.runtime

import java.util.concurrent.RejectedExecutionException
import kotlinx.coroutines.*
import kotlinx.coroutines.channels.Channel
import kotlinx.coroutines.flow.MutableStateFlow
import kotlinx.coroutines.flow.asStateFlow
import kotlinx.coroutines.sync.Mutex
import kotlinx.coroutines.sync.withLock

/**
 * Process-owned single writer. enqueue never performs IO or waits for IO. Capacity counts
 * queued AND in-flight events; a full queue rejects the entire batch without dropping history.
 * Call flush outside runtime locks, and close before disposing the owner. Failed writes retain
 * their batch; the next enqueue/flush retries. A failed close may be retried after storage recovers.
 */
class DiagnosticWriter(
    private val journal: DiagnosticJournal,
    private val capacity: Int = 600,
    private val dispatcher: CoroutineDispatcher = Dispatchers.IO,
) {
    private val guard = Any()
    private val pending = ArrayDeque<DiagnosticEvent>()
    private val writes = Mutex()
    private val signal = Channel<Unit>(Channel.CONFLATED)
    private val owner = SupervisorJob()
    private val scope = CoroutineScope(owner + dispatcher)
    private val mutableFailure = MutableStateFlow<Throwable?>(null)
    val failure = mutableFailure.asStateFlow()
    private var accepting = true
    private var submitted = 0L
    private var persisted = 0L
    val pendingCount: Int get() = synchronized(guard) { pending.size }
    val isClosed: Boolean get() = worker.isCompleted

    init { require(capacity > 0) }

    fun enqueue(events: List<DiagnosticEvent>) {
        synchronized(guard) {
            check(accepting) { "Diagnostic writer is closed" }
            if (events.size > capacity - pending.size) {
                // A prior write may have failed while keeping the queue full. Retry that
                // accepted history even though this entire incoming batch is rejected.
                if (pending.isNotEmpty()) signal.trySend(Unit)
                throw RejectedExecutionException("Diagnostic queue is full ($capacity events)")
            }
            events.forEach { event -> pending.addLast(event.copy(stage = event.stage.take(128),
                result = event.result.take(64), reason = event.reason.take(2048), suggestion = event.suggestion.take(512))) }
            submitted += events.size
            if (events.isNotEmpty()) signal.trySend(Unit)
        }
    }

    private val worker = scope.launch {
        for (ignored in signal) {
            val target = synchronized(guard) { submitted }
            persistThrough(target)
        }
    }

    /** Barrier for all events accepted before this call. Failure is explicit and data is retained. */
    suspend fun flush(): Result<Unit> {
        val target = synchronized(guard) { submitted }
        return withContext(NonCancellable + dispatcher) { persistThrough(target) }
    }

    /** Stop accepting, persist the final batch, then release the owned worker. Idempotent. */
    suspend fun close(): Result<Unit> = withContext(NonCancellable) {
        synchronized(guard) { accepting = false }
        val result = flush()
        signal.cancel()
        worker.cancelAndJoin()
        owner.cancel()
        result
    }

    private suspend fun persistThrough(target: Long): Result<Unit> = writes.withLock {
        try {
            while (true) {
                val batch = synchronized(guard) {
                    if (persisted >= target) emptyList() else pending.take((target - persisted).toInt())
                }
                if (batch.isEmpty()) break
                journal.appendAll(batch)
                synchronized(guard) {
                    repeat(batch.size) { pending.removeFirst() }
                    persisted += batch.size
                }
                mutableFailure.value = null
            }
            Result.success(Unit)
        } catch (error: Exception) {
            mutableFailure.value = error
            Result.failure(error)
        }
    }
}
```

`core/src/main/kotlin/com/system/location/service/core/runtime/LatestStateWorker.kt`:

```kt
package com.system.location.service.core.runtime

/** Only complete replacement states may be coalesced. Delivery never holds the mailbox lock. */
class LatestStateWorker<T : Any>(
    private val deliver: (T) -> Unit,
    private val onFailure: (Throwable) -> Unit,
) : AutoCloseable {
    private val monitor = Object()
    private var pending: T? = null
    private var running = false
    private var closed = false

    /** At most one in-flight state and one pending latest state, even when the receiver stalls. */
    fun offer(state: T): Boolean = synchronized(monitor) {
        if (closed) return false
        pending = state
        monitor.notifyAll()
        if (!running) {
            running = true
            Thread(::drain, "RuntimePeerDelivery").apply { isDaemon = true }.start()
        }
        true
    }

    private fun drain() {
        while (true) {
            val next = synchronized(monitor) {
                while (!closed && pending == null) monitor.wait()
                if (closed) return
                val state = checkNotNull(pending)
                pending = null
                state
            }
            try {
                deliver(next)
            } catch (failure: Throwable) {
                close()
                onFailure(failure)
                return
            }
        }
    }

    override fun close() = synchronized(monitor) {
        closed = true
        pending = null
        monitor.notifyAll()
    }
}
```

`core/src/main/kotlin/com/system/location/service/core/runtime/OrderedRuntimeReceiver.kt`:

```kt
package com.system.location.service.core.runtime

import com.system.location.service.core.gnss.CapturedGnssSource

/** Decode and validate a complete message before changing any live receiver state. */
class OrderedRuntimeReceiver(
    private val currentSource: () -> CapturedGnssSource?,
    private val restore: (RuntimeTransfer, Long) -> Unit,
) {
    private val gate = SessionSequenceGate()

    fun begin(session: String) = gate.reset(session)

    fun receive(session: String, sequence: Long, encoded: ByteArray, nowNanos: Long): Boolean =
        gate.apply(session, sequence) {
            val prepared = RuntimeTransferWire.decode(encoded, currentSource()).atReception(nowNanos)
            restore(prepared, nowNanos)
            true
        }
}
```

`core/src/main/kotlin/com/system/location/service/core/runtime/PreparedRuntimeConfiguration.kt`:

```kt
package com.system.location.service.core.runtime

import com.system.location.service.core.environment.CellMode
import com.system.location.service.core.environment.EnvironmentProfile
import com.system.location.service.core.environment.EnvironmentProfileCodec
import com.system.location.service.core.environment.EnvironmentSourceMode
import com.system.location.service.core.carrier.CarrierIdentityConfig
import com.system.location.service.core.environment.WifiFingerprintImporter
import com.system.location.service.core.gnss.CapturedGnssSource
import com.system.location.service.core.gnss.GnssSimulationMode
import com.system.location.service.core.gnss.GnssMinimumPolicy
import com.system.location.service.core.gnss.GnssSimulationEnvironment
import com.system.location.service.core.gnss.RinexNavigationResource
import com.system.location.service.core.routing.RoutingConfig
import com.system.location.service.core.settings.PortalSettingsSchema
import com.system.location.service.core.settings.SettingType
import kotlinx.serialization.json.Json

/**
 * Prepared outside the publication CAS: all wire values are copied, type checked and decoded here.
 * Missing keys preserve the latest state; explicit null clears nullable evidence/configuration.
 * [applyTo] is side-effect free and may be retried against a newer sample or control state.
 */
class PreparedRuntimeConfiguration private constructor(
    private val values: Map<String, Any?>,
    private val source: CapturedGnssSource?,
    private val captureRejected: Boolean,
    private val routing: RoutingConfig?,
    private val environment: EnvironmentProfile?,
    private val navigation: RinexNavigationResource?,
    private val carrierIdentity: CarrierIdentityConfig?,
) {
    @Suppress("UNCHECKED_CAST")
    private fun <T> value(key: String, fallback: T): T =
        if (values.containsKey(key)) values[key] as T else fallback

    fun applyTo(current: RuntimeSnapshot): RuntimeSnapshot {
        val old = current.configuration
        val policy = old.copy(
            enabled = value("enable", old.enabled),
            wifiEnabled = value("enable_mock_wifi", old.wifiEnabled),
            debugLog = value("enable_debug_log", old.debugLog),
            disableGetCurrentLocation = value("disable_get_current_location", old.disableGetCurrentLocation),
            disableRegisterLocationListener = value("disable_register_location_listener", old.disableRegisterLocationListener),
            disableFusedLocation = value("disable_fused_location", old.disableFusedLocation),
            downgradeToCdma = value("need_downgrade_to_2g", old.downgradeToCdma),
            minimumSatellites = value("min_satellites", old.minimumSatellites),
            gnssSimulation = old.gnssSimulation.copy(
                mode = value("gnss_mode", old.gnssSimulation.mode),
                minimumPolicy = value("gnss_minimum_policy", old.gnssSimulation.minimumPolicy),
                environment = value("gnss_environment", old.gnssSimulation.environment),
                virtualSeed = value("gnss_virtual_seed", old.gnssSimulation.virtualSeed),
            ),
            nmeaEnabled = value("enable_nmea", old.nmeaEnabled),
            hideMock = value("hide_mock", old.hideMock),
            carrierIdentityEnabled = value("carrier_identity_enabled", old.carrierIdentityEnabled),
            carrierIdentity = if ("carrier_identity_json" in values) carrierIdentity else old.carrierIdentity,
            antiDetectEnabled = value("experimental_anti_detect", old.antiDetectEnabled),
            stackTraceCleanEnabled = value("experimental_stack_trace", old.stackTraceCleanEnabled),
            stackTraceReplaceEnabled = value("experimental_stack_trace_replace", old.stackTraceReplaceEnabled),
            disableRequestGeofence = value("disable_request_geofence", old.disableRequestGeofence),
            disableGetFromLocation = value("disable_get_from_location", old.disableGetFromLocation),
            reportIntervalMs = value("report_interval", old.reportIntervalMs),
            sensorCadenceScale = value("sensor_cadence_scale", old.sensorCadenceScale),
            sensorVariation = value("sensor_variation", old.sensorVariation),
            sensorTargets = value("sensor_targets", old.sensorTargets),
            wifiFingerprintEnabled = value("wifi_fingerprint_enabled", old.wifiFingerprintEnabled),
            wifiFingerprintCatalogJson = value("wifi_fingerprint_json", old.wifiFingerprintCatalogJson),
            gnssSource = if ("gnss_capture" in values) source else old.gnssSource,
            gnssCaptureRejected = if ("gnss_capture" in values) captureRejected else old.gnssCaptureRejected,
            gnssNavigation = if ("gnss_navigation" in values) navigation else old.gnssNavigation,
        )
        return current.copy(
            configRevision = Math.addExact(current.configRevision, 1),
            configuration = policy,
            speedMps = if (!policy.enabled) value("speed", current.speedMps) else current.speedMps,
            altitudeMeters = value("altitude", current.altitudeMeters),
            accuracyMeters = value("accuracy", current.accuracyMeters),
            physicalNoise = value("enable_physical_noise", current.physicalNoise),
            physicalNoiseSeed = value("physical_noise_seed", current.physicalNoiseSeed),
            simReady = value("sim_ready", current.simReady),
            environmentApCount = value("environment_ap_count", current.environmentApCount),
            cellMode = value("cell_mode", current.cellMode),
            environmentSourceMode = value("environment_source", current.environmentSourceMode),
            routing = if ("routing_json" in values) routing else current.routing,
            environment = if ("environment_json" in values) environment else current.environment,
            environmentVersion = if ("environment_json" in values)
                Math.addExact(current.environmentVersion, 1) else current.environmentVersion,
        )
    }

    companion object {
        private val nullableStrings = setOf(
            "gnss_capture", "gnss_navigation", "routing_json", "environment_json",
            "wifi_fingerprint_json", "carrier_identity_json",
        )
        private val extraKeys = nullableStrings + "enable"
        val keys: Set<String> = PortalSettingsSchema.schema.keys() + extraKeys

        fun prepare(input: Map<String, Any?>, previousSource: CapturedGnssSource? = null): PreparedRuntimeConfiguration {
            val schema = PortalSettingsSchema.schema
            val values = input.filterKeys { it in keys }.toMutableMap()
            values.toMap().forEach { (key, raw) ->
                val type = schema.spec(key)?.type ?: if (key == "enable") SettingType.BOOLEAN else SettingType.STRING
                if (key in nullableStrings && raw == null) return@forEach
                val validType = when (type) {
                    SettingType.BOOLEAN -> raw is Boolean
                    SettingType.INT -> raw is Int
                    SettingType.LONG -> raw is Long
                    SettingType.FLOAT -> raw is Float
                    SettingType.DOUBLE -> raw is Double
                    SettingType.STRING, SettingType.ENUM -> raw is String
                }
                require(validType) { "Invalid wire type for $key" }
                if (type == SettingType.STRING) require((raw as String).length <= 262_144) { "$key too large" }
                if (key in nullableStrings && (raw as String).isBlank()) {
                    values[key] = null
                } else {
                    if (schema.spec(key) != null) require(schema.validate(key, raw.toString()) == null) {
                        "Invalid value for $key"
                    }
                }
            }
            var captureRejected = false
            val source = if ("gnss_capture" in values) try {
                CapturedGnssSource.prepare(values["gnss_capture"] as String?, previousSource)
            } catch (_: Exception) {
                // Only optional evidence is recoverable. Wire types, sizes, required settings,
                // authorization and transport errors still follow their original failure paths.
                captureRejected = true
                previousSource
            } else null
            val routing = (values["routing_json"] as String?)?.let {
                Json.decodeFromString(RoutingConfig.serializer(), it)
            }
            val environment = (values["environment_json"] as String?)?.let(EnvironmentProfileCodec::decode)
            (values["wifi_fingerprint_json"] as String?)?.let { WifiFingerprintImporter.importJson(it) }
            (values["cell_mode"] as String?)?.let { values["cell_mode"] = CellMode.valueOf(it) }
            (values["environment_source"] as String?)?.let { values["environment_source"] = EnvironmentSourceMode.valueOf(it) }
            (values["gnss_mode"] as String?)?.let { values["gnss_mode"] = GnssSimulationMode.valueOf(it) }
            (values["gnss_minimum_policy"] as String?)?.let { values["gnss_minimum_policy"] = GnssMinimumPolicy.valueOf(it) }
            (values["gnss_environment"] as String?)?.let { values["gnss_environment"] = GnssSimulationEnvironment.valueOf(it) }
            val navigation = (values["gnss_navigation"] as String?)?.let(RinexNavigationResource::decodeWire)
            val carrierIdentity = (values["carrier_identity_json"] as String?)?.let {
                com.system.location.service.core.carrier.CarrierIdentityCodec.decode(it)
            }
            (values["sensor_targets"] as String?)?.let {
                values["sensor_targets"] = com.system.location.service.core.sensors.SensorTargets.parse(it)
            }
            return PreparedRuntimeConfiguration(
                values.toMap(), source, captureRejected, routing, environment, navigation, carrierIdentity,
            )
        }
    }
}
```

`core/src/main/kotlin/com/system/location/service/core/runtime/RuntimeSnapshot.kt`:

```kt
package com.system.location.service.core.runtime

import com.system.location.service.core.environment.EnvironmentConfig
import com.system.location.service.core.environment.CellMode
import com.system.location.service.core.environment.EnvironmentProfile
import com.system.location.service.core.environment.EnvironmentSourceMode
import com.system.location.service.core.location.LocationSample
import com.system.location.service.core.location.LocationSanitizer
import com.system.location.service.core.providers.ProviderKind
import com.system.location.service.core.routing.RoutingConfig
import java.util.concurrent.atomic.AtomicReference
import java.util.UUID
import kotlinx.serialization.Serializable

/** P5-07: immutable hand-off between config/sample/environment producers and hook readers. */
@Serializable
data class RuntimeSnapshot(
    val configRevision: Long = 0L,
    val environmentVersion: Long = 0L,
    val sample: LocationSample? = null,
    val environment: EnvironmentProfile? = null,
    val provider: ProviderKind? = null,
    val routing: RoutingConfig? = null,
    val environmentSeed: Long = 0L,
    val environmentApCount: Int = 4,
    val cellMode: CellMode = CellMode.FULL_REPLAY,
    val environmentSourceMode: EnvironmentSourceMode = EnvironmentSourceMode.AUTO,
    val simReady: Boolean = true,
    val physicalNoise: Boolean = false,
    val physicalNoiseSeed: Long = 0L,
    val latitude: Double = 0.0,
    val longitude: Double = 0.0,
    val altitudeMeters: Double = 0.0,
    val speedMps: Double = 3.05,
    val accuracyMeters: Float = LocationSanitizer.DEFAULT_HORIZONTAL_ACCURACY,
    val bearingDeg: Double = 0.0,
    val hasBearings: Boolean = false,
    val configuration: HookConfiguration = HookConfiguration(),
) {
    init {
        require(configRevision >= 0L) { "configRevision must be non-negative" }
        require(environmentVersion >= 0L) { "environmentVersion must be non-negative" }
        require(environmentApCount in EnvironmentConfig.MIN_AP_PER_CELL..EnvironmentConfig.MAX_AP_PER_CELL) { "environmentApCount out of range" }
        require(latitude in -90.0..90.0 && longitude in -180.0..180.0) { "coordinate out of range" }
        require(altitudeMeters.isFinite() && altitudeMeters in
            LocationSanitizer.MIN_ALTITUDE_METERS..LocationSanitizer.MAX_ALTITUDE_METERS) {
            "altitudeMeters out of range"
        }
        require(speedMps.isFinite() && speedMps in 0.0..LocationSanitizer.MAX_SPEED_MPS) {
            "speedMps out of range"
        }
        require(accuracyMeters.isFinite() && accuracyMeters > 0f) { "accuracyMeters must be positive" }
        require(bearingDeg.isFinite()) { "bearingDeg must be finite" }
    }

    companion object {
        val EMPTY = RuntimeSnapshot()
    }
}

/** Coherent process-local evidence; simulationGeneration is never restored from a peer snapshot. */
data class RuntimeSnapshotObservation(val state: RuntimeSnapshot, val simulationGeneration: Long)

/** Atomic snapshot and simulation-transition holder; readers observe both from the same CAS. */
class RuntimeSnapshotStore(initial: RuntimeSnapshot = RuntimeSnapshot.EMPTY) {
    val instanceId: String = UUID.randomUUID().toString()
    private val ref = AtomicReference(RuntimeSnapshotObservation(initial, 0))

    fun current(): RuntimeSnapshot = ref.get().state

    fun observation(): RuntimeSnapshotObservation = ref.get()

    fun set(snapshot: RuntimeSnapshot) {
        update { snapshot }
    }

    fun update(transform: (RuntimeSnapshot) -> RuntimeSnapshot): RuntimeSnapshot =
        ref.updateAndGet { previous ->
            val next = transform(previous.state)
            val generation = if (previous.state.configuration.enabled != next.configuration.enabled)
                Math.addExact(previous.simulationGeneration, 1) else previous.simulationGeneration
            RuntimeSnapshotObservation(next, generation)
        }.state

    fun publishSample(
        sample: LocationSample,
        provider: ProviderKind? = null,
    ): RuntimeSnapshot = update {
        // Samples do not own configuration versions. In particular, a CAS retry must retain the
        // configuration published by a concurrent writer, rather than restoring an earlier version.
        it.copy(sample = sample, provider = provider)
    }

    fun clearSample(): RuntimeSnapshot = update { it.copy(sample = null, provider = null) }
}
```

`core/src/main/kotlin/com/system/location/service/core/runtime/RuntimeTransferWire.kt`:

```kt
package com.system.location.service.core.runtime

import com.system.location.service.core.environment.WifiFingerprintImporter
import com.system.location.service.core.gnss.CapturedGnssSource
import com.system.location.service.core.gnss.RinexNavigationResource
import com.system.location.service.core.location.LocationSample
import com.system.location.service.core.location.LocationSanitizer
import java.io.ByteArrayInputStream
import java.io.ByteArrayOutputStream
import java.util.zip.GZIPInputStream
import java.util.zip.GZIPOutputStream
import kotlinx.serialization.Serializable
import kotlinx.serialization.json.Json

/** Prepared full state, not a partial patch. Only authenticated initialization may restore it. */
data class RuntimeTransfer(
    val state: RuntimeSnapshot,
    val externallyDriven: Boolean,
    val scenarios: Map<String, LocationSample> = emptyMap(),
    val movementSpeedMps: Float = 0f,
    val lastMovementNanos: Long = 0L,
) {
    init {
        require(movementSpeedMps.isFinite() &&
            movementSpeedMps in 0f..LocationSanitizer.MAX_SPEED_MPS.toFloat() && lastMovementNanos >= 0L)
        require(scenarios.size <= ScenarioSampleStore.MAX_SCENARIOS)
        require(scenarios.keys.all { it.isNotBlank() && it.length <= ScenarioSampleStore.MAX_ID_LENGTH })
        require(if (externallyDriven) state.configuration.enabled && state.sample != null else state.sample == null)
    }

    /** IPC latency does not renew samples. All peers use the original monotonic sample deadline. */
    fun atReception(nowNanos: Long, maxAgeNanos: Long = SampleStore.DEFAULT_MAX_AGE_NANOS): RuntimeTransfer {
        require(nowNanos >= 0L && maxAgeNanos > 0L)
        fun fresh(sample: LocationSample) = sample.elapsedNanos <= Long.MAX_VALUE - maxAgeNanos &&
            sample.elapsedNanos <= nowNanos && nowNanos - sample.elapsedNanos < maxAgeNanos
        val active = externallyDriven && fresh(state.sample!!)
        val received = if (externallyDriven && !active) state.copy(sample = null, provider = null,
            configuration = state.configuration.copy(enabled = false), hasBearings = false) else state
        return copy(state = received, externallyDriven = active, scenarios = scenarios.filterValues(::fresh),
            movementSpeedMps = if (lastMovementNanos <= nowNanos) movementSpeedMps else 0f)
    }
}

/** Versioned bounded binary IPC; neither publication caches nor raw GNSS observations are sent. */
object RuntimeTransferWire {
    const val MAX_COMPRESSED_BYTES = 262_144
    const val MAX_DECODED_BYTES = 2_097_152
    private const val VERSION = 1
    private val json = Json { encodeDefaults = true }

    @Serializable
    private data class Envelope(
        val version: Int,
        val state: RuntimeSnapshot,
        val externallyDriven: Boolean,
        val scenarios: Map<String, LocationSample>,
        val gnssCapture: String?,
        val movementSpeedMps: Float = 0f,
        val lastMovementNanos: Long = 0L,
        val gnssNavigation: String? = null,
    )

    fun encode(transfer: RuntimeTransfer): ByteArray {
        val envelope = Envelope(VERSION, transfer.state, transfer.externallyDriven, transfer.scenarios,
            transfer.state.configuration.gnssSource?.wirePayload(), transfer.movementSpeedMps, transfer.lastMovementNanos,
            transfer.state.configuration.gnssNavigation?.let(RinexNavigationResource::encodeWire))
        val raw = json.encodeToString(Envelope.serializer(), envelope).toByteArray(Charsets.UTF_8)
        require(raw.size <= MAX_DECODED_BYTES) { "Runtime transfer exceeds decoded budget" }
        val output = ByteArrayOutputStream()
        GZIPOutputStream(output).use { it.write(raw) }
        return output.toByteArray().also {
            require(it.size <= MAX_COMPRESSED_BYTES) { "Runtime transfer exceeds IPC budget" }
        }
    }

    fun decode(encoded: ByteArray, previousSource: CapturedGnssSource? = null): RuntimeTransfer {
        require(encoded.isNotEmpty() && encoded.size <= MAX_COMPRESSED_BYTES) { "Invalid runtime transfer size" }
        val output = ByteArrayOutputStream()
        GZIPInputStream(ByteArrayInputStream(encoded)).use { input ->
            val chunk = ByteArray(8192)
            while (true) {
                val count = input.read(chunk)
                if (count < 0) break
                require(output.size() + count <= MAX_DECODED_BYTES) { "Runtime transfer decompression limit" }
                output.write(chunk, 0, count)
            }
        }
        val envelope = json.decodeFromString(Envelope.serializer(), output.toString(Charsets.UTF_8.name()))
        require(envelope.version == VERSION) { "Unsupported runtime transfer version" }
        envelope.state.configuration.wifiFingerprintCatalogJson?.let { WifiFingerprintImporter.importJson(it) }
        require(envelope.gnssCapture == null || envelope.gnssCapture.length <=
            com.system.location.service.core.gnss.GnssCaptureWire.MAX_ENCODED_LENGTH) { "GNSS capture exceeds IPC budget" }
        var captureRejected = envelope.state.configuration.gnssCaptureRejected
        val source = try {
            CapturedGnssSource.prepare(envelope.gnssCapture, previousSource)
        } catch (_: Exception) {
            captureRejected = true
            previousSource
        }
        // Orbit resource corruption rejects this update atomically: peers must not silently
        // switch to a different sky than the authenticated sender. Receiver capture is optional.
        val navigation = envelope.gnssNavigation?.let(RinexNavigationResource::decodeWire)
        val state = envelope.state.copy(configuration = envelope.state.configuration.copy(
            gnssSource = source, gnssCaptureRejected = captureRejected, gnssNavigation = navigation))
        return RuntimeTransfer(state, envelope.externallyDriven, envelope.scenarios.toMap(),
            envelope.movementSpeedMps, envelope.lastMovementNanos)
    }
}
```

`core/src/main/kotlin/com/system/location/service/core/runtime/SampleStore.kt`:

```kt
package com.system.location.service.core.runtime

import com.system.location.service.core.config.ConfigCodec
import com.system.location.service.core.config.ConfigEnvelope
import com.system.location.service.core.location.LocationSample
import java.io.File
import java.nio.file.Files
import java.nio.file.StandardCopyOption

data class StoredSample(
    val sequence: Long,
    val sample: LocationSample,
    val storedAtElapsedNanos: Long,
)

/**
 * Versioned sample hand-off abstraction (P5-06).
 *
 * Hooks read `latest()` on a callback path; a store must be O(1) and must not touch disk. The lease
 * check is explicit so a stale sample can never be published after the controller stopped.
 */
interface SampleStore {
    fun publish(sample: LocationSample, elapsedRealtimeNanos: Long): Long

    fun latest(nowElapsedNanos: Long, maxAgeNanos: Long = DEFAULT_MAX_AGE_NANOS): StoredSample?

    fun clear()

    companion object {
        const val DEFAULT_MAX_AGE_NANOS = 5_000_000_000L
    }
}

class InMemorySampleStore : SampleStore {
    private var sequence = 0L
    private var latest: StoredSample? = null

    @Synchronized
    override fun publish(sample: LocationSample, elapsedRealtimeNanos: Long): Long {
        require(elapsedRealtimeNanos >= 0L) { "elapsedRealtimeNanos must be non-negative" }
        sequence += 1L
        latest = StoredSample(sequence, sample, elapsedRealtimeNanos)
        return sequence
    }

    @Synchronized
    override fun latest(nowElapsedNanos: Long, maxAgeNanos: Long): StoredSample? {
        require(maxAgeNanos >= 0L) { "maxAgeNanos must be non-negative" }
        val entry = latest ?: return null
        if (nowElapsedNanos < entry.storedAtElapsedNanos) return null
        return entry.takeIf { nowElapsedNanos - it.storedAtElapsedNanos <= maxAgeNanos }
    }

    @Synchronized
    override fun clear() {
        latest = null
    }
}

/** Versioned config hand-off abstraction; persistence/Binder implementations land in P5-06 later. */
interface ConfigStore {
    fun load(): ConfigEnvelope?
    fun save(config: ConfigEnvelope)
    fun clear()
}

class InMemoryConfigStore(initial: ConfigEnvelope? = null) : ConfigStore {
    private var config: ConfigEnvelope? = initial

    @Synchronized
    override fun load(): ConfigEnvelope? = config

    @Synchronized
    override fun save(config: ConfigEnvelope) {
        this.config = config
    }

    @Synchronized
    override fun clear() {
        config = null
    }
}

/** P5-06: atomic JSON-backed config store; corrupt files are ignored, not fatal. */
class FileConfigStore(private val file: File) : ConfigStore {
    @Synchronized
    override fun load(): ConfigEnvelope? {
        if (!file.isFile) return null
        val raw = runCatching { file.readText() }.getOrNull() ?: return null
        return runCatching { ConfigCodec.decode(raw) }.getOrNull()
    }

    @Synchronized
    override fun save(config: ConfigEnvelope) {
        val parent = file.absoluteFile.parentFile
        if (parent != null && !parent.exists()) require(parent.mkdirs()) { "Cannot create config directory" }
        val temp = File(parent, "${file.name}.tmp")
        temp.writeText(ConfigCodec.encode(config))
        try {
            Files.move(
                temp.toPath(), file.toPath(),
                StandardCopyOption.REPLACE_EXISTING, StandardCopyOption.ATOMIC_MOVE,
            )
        } catch (_: Exception) {
            Files.move(temp.toPath(), file.toPath(), StandardCopyOption.REPLACE_EXISTING)
        }
    }

    @Synchronized
    override fun clear() {
        file.delete()
    }
}
```

`core/src/main/kotlin/com/system/location/service/core/runtime/ScenarioController.kt`:

```kt
package com.system.location.service.core.runtime

import com.system.location.service.core.backend.*
import com.system.location.service.core.location.LocationSanitizer
import com.system.location.service.core.playback.PlaybackEngine
import com.system.location.service.core.scenario.Scenario
import kotlinx.coroutines.CancellationException
import kotlinx.coroutines.NonCancellable
import kotlinx.coroutines.flow.MutableStateFlow
import kotlinx.coroutines.flow.asStateFlow
import kotlinx.coroutines.sync.Mutex
import kotlinx.coroutines.sync.withLock
import kotlinx.coroutines.withContext

/** Owns the only runtime state. A service supplies ticks; UI only sends commands and observes. */
class ScenarioController(private val factory: (BackendType) -> LocationBackend, private val clock: RuntimeClock,
    private val diagnosticSink: (DiagnosticEvent) -> Unit = {},
    private val diagnosticBatchSink: ((List<DiagnosticEvent>) -> Unit)? = null) {
    private val mutex = Mutex()
    private val mutableState = MutableStateFlow(RuntimeState())
    val state = mutableState.asStateFlow()
    private val mutableDiagnostics = MutableStateFlow<List<DiagnosticEvent>>(emptyList())
    val diagnostics = mutableDiagnostics.asStateFlow()
    private var backend: LocationBackend? = null
    private var engine: PlaybackEngine? = null
    private var orbitEnabled = false
    private var orbitRadiusMeters = 0.2
    private var orbitPeriodSeconds = 20.0
    private var routeEndPosition = RouteEndPosition.REAL_LOCATION
    private var previousSubmissionNanos: Long? = null
    private var healthRecordedAt: Long? = null
    private var storageFailureReported = false
    private var asyncStorageFailureReported = false
    private val lastRecords = linkedMapOf<DiagnosticEvent, Long>()
    @Volatile var intervalMs = 500L
        private set
    /** Retains even a complete start/stop between observers; never reset by backend selection. */
    @Volatile var startGeneration = 0L
        private set

    suspend fun selectBackend(type: BackendType): Boolean = mutex.withLock {
        if (backend != null || state.value.isActive) return@withLock false
        val instance = createBackend(type) ?: return@withLock false
        mutableState.value = RuntimeState(backend = type, capabilities = instance.capabilities)
        true
    }

    suspend fun start(input: Scenario, type: BackendType = state.value.backend,
        holdAtEndpoint: Boolean = false,
        routeEndPosition: RouteEndPosition = RouteEndPosition.REAL_LOCATION): Boolean = mutex.withLock {
        // Freeze/validate before touching an already-running scenario.
        val next = try { PlaybackEngine(input) } catch (error: IllegalArgumentException) {
            event(BackendResult.Failure("VALIDATE_SCENARIO", error.message ?: "Invalid scenario"))
            if (!state.value.isActive) mutableState.value = state.value.copy(phase = RuntimePhase.ERROR,
                error = BackendResult.Failure("VALIDATE_SCENARIO", error.message ?: "Invalid scenario"))
            return@withLock false
        }
        // Advance before any backend lifecycle work: even a partially failed start can expose
        // simulated data. A StateFlow collector may miss a short PREPARING/RUNNING interval.
        startGeneration = Math.addExact(startGeneration, 1)
        if (!stopLocked()) return@withLock false
        val instance = createBackend(type) ?: return@withLock false
        backend = instance
        engine = next
        this.routeEndPosition = if (holdAtEndpoint) RouteEndPosition.END else routeEndPosition
            .takeIf { next.scenario.route != null && next.scenario.mode == com.system.location.service.core.scenario.RouteMode.ONCE }
            ?: RouteEndPosition.REAL_LOCATION
        next.setOrbit(orbitEnabled, orbitRadiusMeters, orbitPeriodSeconds)
        intervalMs = next.scenario.profile.intervalMs
        previousSubmissionNanos = null
        healthRecordedAt = null
        mutableState.value = RuntimeState(RuntimePhase.PREPARING, type, input.id, input.name,
            input.route?.id, capabilities = instance.capabilities, configuredSpeedMps = next.scenario.profile.speedMps)
        record("SCENARIO_PARAMETERS", "INFO", "路线点数=${input.route?.points?.size ?: 0}；速度上限=${input.profile.speedMps}m/s；平滑运动=${input.profile.smoothMotion}；间隔=${intervalMs}ms；圆周=$orbitEnabled 半径=${orbitRadiusMeters}m 周期=${orbitPeriodSeconds}s")
        if (!step("PREPARE") { instance.prepare() }) return@withLock false
        mutableState.value = state.value.copy(phase = RuntimePhase.READY, capabilities = instance.capabilities)
        if (!step("START") { instance.start() }) return@withLock false
        mutableState.value = state.value.copy(phase = RuntimePhase.RUNNING, startedAt = clock.millis())
        publishLocked()
    }

    suspend fun tick(): Boolean = mutex.withLock { publishLocked() }

    /** Explicit recovery only; retain the engine, route progress and paused state. */
    suspend fun rebuildMockProviders(): Boolean = mutex.withLock {
        if (state.value.backend != BackendType.MOCK_PROVIDER || !state.value.isActive) return@withLock false
        val instance = backend ?: return@withLock false
        val paused = state.value.phase == RuntimePhase.PAUSED
        val holding = state.value.phase == RuntimePhase.HOLDING
        if (!step("REBUILD_STOP") { instance.stop() }) return@withLock false
        if (!step("REBUILD_PREPARE") { instance.prepare() }) return@withLock false
        if (!step("REBUILD_START") { instance.start() }) return@withLock false
        if (paused && !step("REBUILD_PAUSE") { instance.pause() }) return@withLock false
        previousSubmissionNanos = null
        healthRecordedAt = null
        val published = if (holding) {
            val heldSample = state.value.sample ?: return@withLock false
            step("REBUILD_PUBLISH") { instance.publish(heldSample, state.value.scenarioId) }
        } else publishLocked()
        published.also { published ->
            if (published) record("REBUILD_PROVIDER", "SUCCESS", "定位通道已重建并完成首次提交；保留场景、进度及暂停状态，不代表接收端采用或标记已清除")
        }
    }
    suspend fun restoreDiagnostics(history: List<DiagnosticEvent>) = mutex.withLock {
        mutableDiagnostics.value = (history.takeLast(300).map { it.bounded() } + mutableDiagnostics.value).takeLast(300)
    }
    suspend fun note(stage: String, result: String, reason: String) = mutex.withLock { record(stage, result, reason) }

    /** Observe writer.failure here; reporting must not enqueue into the failing writer again. */
    suspend fun reportDiagnosticStorageFailure(error: Throwable?) = mutex.withLock {
        if (error == null) {
            asyncStorageFailureReported = false
        } else if (!asyncStorageFailureReported) {
            asyncStorageFailureReported = true
            mutableDiagnostics.value = (mutableDiagnostics.value + DiagnosticEvent(clock.millis(), state.value.backend,
                "DIAGNOSTIC_STORAGE", "FAILED", error.message ?: "诊断日志保存失败").bounded()).takeLast(300)
        }
    }

    suspend fun pause(): Boolean = mutex.withLock {
        if (state.value.phase != RuntimePhase.RUNNING) return@withLock false
        // Account for movement up to the pause event, then freeze it.
        if (!publishLocked() || state.value.phase != RuntimePhase.RUNNING) return@withLock false
        if (!step("PAUSE") { backend!!.pause() }) return@withLock false
        engine!!.pause()
        mutableState.value = state.value.copy(phase = RuntimePhase.PAUSED)
        publishLocked()
    }

    suspend fun resume(): Boolean = mutex.withLock {
        if (state.value.phase != RuntimePhase.PAUSED) return@withLock false
        if (!step("RESUME") { backend!!.resume() }) return@withLock false
        engine!!.resume(clock.nanos())
        mutableState.value = state.value.copy(phase = RuntimePhase.RUNNING)
        publishLocked()
    }

    suspend fun setMotion(bearing: Double, moving: Boolean, strength: Double = 1.0): Boolean = mutex.withLock {
        if (engine?.scenario?.route != null || !state.value.isActive || !bearing.isFinite() || !strength.isFinite() || strength !in 0.0..1.0) return@withLock false
        if (!publishLocked()) return@withLock false
        engine?.setMotion(bearing, moving, strength)
        true
    }

    suspend fun configureOrbit(enabled: Boolean, radiusMeters: Double, periodSeconds: Double = 20.0): Boolean = mutex.withLock {
        if (!radiusMeters.isFinite() || radiusMeters !in 0.05..5.0 || !periodSeconds.isFinite() || periodSeconds !in 5.0..120.0) return@withLock false
        orbitEnabled = enabled
        orbitRadiusMeters = radiusMeters
        orbitPeriodSeconds = periodSeconds
        engine?.setOrbit(enabled, radiusMeters, periodSeconds)
        true
    }
    suspend fun setSpeed(speed: Double): Boolean = mutex.withLock {
        if (!speed.isFinite() || speed !in 0.0..LocationSanitizer.MAX_SPEED_MPS ||
            state.value.phase !in setOf(RuntimePhase.RUNNING, RuntimePhase.PAUSED)) return@withLock false
        // Settle elapsed movement at the old speed before changing it.
        if (!publishLocked() || !state.value.isActive) return@withLock false
        engine!!.setSpeed(speed)
        mutableState.value = state.value.copy(configuredSpeedMps = speed)
        publishLocked()
    }

    suspend fun stop(): Boolean = mutex.withLock { stopLocked() }

    suspend fun reportFailure(failure: BackendResult.Failure) = mutex.withLock {
        stopLocked()
        mutableState.value = state.value.copy(phase = RuntimePhase.ERROR, error = failure)
        event(failure)
    }

    suspend fun refreshDiagnostics() = mutex.withLock {
        val instance = backend ?: createBackend(state.value.backend) ?: return@withLock
        try {
            recordDiagnostics(instance.diagnose())
            mutableState.value = state.value.copy(capabilities = instance.capabilities)
        } catch (cancelled: CancellationException) { throw cancelled }
        catch (error: Exception) { event(BackendResult.Failure("DIAGNOSE", error.message ?: "诊断失败")) }
    }

    private fun createBackend(type: BackendType): LocationBackend? = try { factory(type) }
    catch (cancelled: CancellationException) { throw cancelled }
    catch (error: Exception) {
        val failure = BackendResult.Failure("CREATE_BACKEND", error.message ?: error.javaClass.simpleName)
        mutableState.value = RuntimeState(phase = RuntimePhase.ERROR, backend = type, error = failure)
        event(failure)
        null
    }

    suspend fun interrupted(reason: String) = mutex.withLock {
        stopLocked()
        val failure = BackendResult.Failure("PROCESS_INTERRUPTED", reason, "重新选择后端并启动场景")
        mutableState.value = state.value.copy(phase = RuntimePhase.ERROR, error = failure)
        event(failure)
    }

    /** On process recreation, retain a failing backend so the user can retry cleanup. */
    suspend fun recoverInterrupted(type: BackendType, reason: String) = mutex.withLock {
        backend = createBackend(type) ?: return@withLock
        val clean = stopLocked()
        val failure = BackendResult.Failure("PROCESS_INTERRUPTED", reason +
            if (clean) "; 后端残留资源已清理" else "; 清理未完成: ${state.value.error?.reason}",
            if (clean) "重新启动场景" else "恢复后端授权或连接，然后重试停止")
        mutableState.value = state.value.copy(backend = type, phase = RuntimePhase.ERROR, error = failure)
        event(failure)
    }

    private suspend fun publishLocked(): Boolean {
        if (state.value.phase !in setOf(RuntimePhase.RUNNING, RuntimePhase.PAUSED)) return false
        val frame = engine!!.tick(clock.nanos(), clock.millis())
        val started = clock.nanos()
        if (!step("PUBLISH") { backend!!.publish(frame.sample, state.value.scenarioId) }) return false
        val ended = clock.nanos()
        val gap = previousSubmissionNanos?.let { (frame.sample.elapsedNanos - it).coerceAtLeast(0) / 1_000_000.0 } ?: 0.0
        val latency = (ended - started).coerceAtLeast(0) / 1_000_000.0
        previousSubmissionNanos = frame.sample.elapsedNanos
        val old = state.value.submissionHealth
        val health = SubmissionHealth(old.count + 1, gap, maxOf(old.maxGapMs, gap), latency, maxOf(old.maxLatencyMs, latency),
            old.delayedCount + if (gap > maxOf(1000.0, intervalMs * 3.0)) 1 else 0)
        mutableState.value = state.value.copy(sample = frame.sample, currentPoint = frame.segment,
            progress = frame.progress, lastUpdateAt = frame.sample.timeMillis, submissionHealth = health)
        record("PUBLISH", "SUCCESS", "最近定位样本已提交至后端")
        if (healthRecordedAt == null || ended - healthRecordedAt!! >= 5_000_000_000) {
            healthRecordedAt = ended
            record("SUBMISSION_HEALTH", "INFO", "提交=${health.count}；设定间隔=${intervalMs}ms；最近间隔=${gap.toLong()}ms；最大间隔=${health.maxGapMs.toLong()}ms；最近耗时=${latency.toLong()}ms；延迟次数=${health.delayedCount}；仅表示后端 API 提交，不表示目标应用采用")
            try { recordDiagnostics(backend!!.diagnose()) }
            catch (cancelled: CancellationException) { throw cancelled }
            catch (error: Exception) { record("DIAGNOSE", "FAILED", error.message ?: "诊断失败") }
            mutableState.value = state.value.copy(capabilities = backend!!.capabilities)
        }
        if (frame.completed) {
            val heldAt = routeEndPosition
            if (heldAt == RouteEndPosition.REAL_LOCATION) return stopLocked()
            val route = engine?.scenario?.route ?: return stopLocked()
            val target = if (heldAt == RouteEndPosition.START) route.points.first() else route.points.last()
            val heldSample = frame.sample.copy(coordinate = target, speed = 0f)
            if (heldSample.coordinate != frame.sample.coordinate &&
                !step("PUBLISH_ROUTE_END_POSITION") { backend!!.publish(heldSample, state.value.scenarioId) }) return false
            mutableState.value = state.value.copy(
                phase = RuntimePhase.HOLDING,
                currentPoint = if (heldAt == RouteEndPosition.START) 0 else route.points.lastIndex,
                progress = if (heldAt == RouteEndPosition.START) 0.0 else 1.0,
                sample = heldSample,
                holdingPosition = heldAt,
            )
            record("ROUTE_COMPLETE", "SUCCESS", "路线已结束；已停留在${if (heldAt == RouteEndPosition.START) "起点" else "终点"}，停止模拟可清理定位通道")
            return true
        }
        return true
    }

    private suspend fun step(stage: String, action: suspend () -> BackendResult): Boolean {
        val result = try { action() } catch (cancelled: CancellationException) {
            withContext(NonCancellable) { stopLocked() }
            throw cancelled
        } catch (error: Exception) {
            BackendResult.Failure(stage, error.message ?: error.javaClass.simpleName)
        }
        if (result is BackendResult.Failure) {
            stopLocked()
            mutableState.value = state.value.copy(phase = RuntimePhase.ERROR, error = result)
            event(result)
            return false
        }
        if (stage != "PUBLISH") record(stage, "SUCCESS", "后端操作完成")
        return true
    }

    private suspend fun stopLocked(): Boolean = withContext(NonCancellable) {
        val active = backend ?: run {
            if (state.value.phase != RuntimePhase.IDLE) mutableState.value = state.value.copy(phase = RuntimePhase.STOPPED, error = null)
            return@withContext true
        }
        mutableState.value = state.value.copy(phase = RuntimePhase.STOPPING)
        suspend fun cleanup(action: suspend () -> BackendResult): BackendResult = try { action() }
        catch (error: Exception) { BackendResult.Failure("CLEANUP", error.message ?: error.javaClass.simpleName) }
        val stopped = cleanup { active.stop() }
        // Backends use stop() as the authoritative external cleanup operation. Only retry
        // through release() after a failed stop; calling both on success duplicates Binder/API
        // cleanup for every current backend implementation.
        val released = if (stopped is BackendResult.Failure) cleanup { active.release() } else BackendResult.Success
        val failure = (released as? BackendResult.Failure) ?: (stopped as? BackendResult.Failure)
        if (released is BackendResult.Success) { backend = null; engine = null }
        mutableState.value = state.value.copy(phase = if (failure == null) RuntimePhase.STOPPED else RuntimePhase.ERROR,
            error = failure, sample = state.value.sample?.copy(speed = 0f), holdingPosition = null)
        failure?.let(::event)
        if (failure == null) record("CLEANUP", "SUCCESS", "后端已停止并释放资源")
        failure == null
    }

    private fun event(failure: BackendResult.Failure) {
        record(failure.stage, "FAILED", failure.reason, failure.suggestion)
    }
    private fun recordDiagnostics(details: List<BackendDiagnostic>) {
        val boundedDetails = details.take(300)
        val currentHooks = boundedDetails.filter { it.stage == "HOOK_POINT" }.map {
            DiagnosticEvent(0, state.value.backend, it.stage, it.result, it.reason, it.suggestion).bounded()
        }.toSet()
        // Remove disappeared/changed details so a later return to an older status is visible.
        lastRecords.keys.removeAll { it.backend == state.value.backend && it.stage == "HOOK_POINT" && it !in currentHooks }
        val batch = mutableListOf<DiagnosticEvent>()
        boundedDetails.forEach { record(it.stage, it.result, it.reason, it.suggestion, batch) }
        if (batch.isNotEmpty()) persist(batch)
    }

    private fun record(stage: String, result: String, reason: String, suggestion: String = "",
        batch: MutableList<DiagnosticEvent>? = null) {
        val now = clock.millis()
        val monotonic = clock.nanos()
        val event = DiagnosticEvent(now, state.value.backend, stage, result, reason, suggestion).bounded()
        // Hook details have independent content identities across polls and list reordering.
        // Ordinary stages compare only with their latest state, so A -> B -> A stays visible.
        val key = event.copy(timestamp = 0)
        if (stage != "HOOK_POINT") {
            lastRecords.keys.removeAll { it.backend == event.backend && it.stage == stage && it != key }
        }
        val previous = lastRecords[key]
        val duplicate = previous != null && (stage == "HOOK_POINT" || monotonic - previous in 0 until 5_000_000_000)
        if (duplicate && stage !in setOf("PREPARE", "START", "CLEANUP", "SCENARIO_PARAMETERS")) {
            lastRecords.remove(key)
            lastRecords[key] = previous
            return
        }
        lastRecords.remove(key)
        lastRecords[key] = monotonic
        while (lastRecords.size > 300) lastRecords.remove(lastRecords.keys.first())
        mutableDiagnostics.value = (mutableDiagnostics.value + event).takeLast(300)
        if (batch != null) batch += event else persist(listOf(event))
    }

    /** Sinks must only enqueue in memory; never perform IO under the controller mutex. */
    private fun persist(events: List<DiagnosticEvent>) {
        try {
            diagnosticBatchSink?.invoke(events) ?: events.forEach(diagnosticSink)
            storageFailureReported = false
        }
        catch (error: Exception) {
            events.forEach { lastRecords.remove(it.copy(timestamp = 0)) }
            if (!storageFailureReported) {
                storageFailureReported = true
                mutableDiagnostics.value = (mutableDiagnostics.value + DiagnosticEvent(clock.millis(), state.value.backend,
                    "DIAGNOSTIC_STORAGE", "FAILED", error.message ?: "诊断日志保存失败").bounded()).takeLast(300)
            }
        }
    }

    private fun DiagnosticEvent.bounded() = copy(
        stage = stage.take(128),
        result = result.take(64),
        reason = reason.take(2048),
        suggestion = suggestion.take(512),
    )
}
```

`core/src/main/kotlin/com/system/location/service/core/runtime/ScenarioSampleStore.kt`:

```kt
package com.system.location.service.core.runtime

import com.system.location.service.core.location.LocationSample

/**
 * Per-scenario sample hand-off (P5-02).
 *
 * Each scenario has an independent latest sample and insertion sequence; the map is bounded so a
 * noisy producer cannot grow the system_server heap. Lease checks mirror [SampleStore].
 */
class ScenarioSampleStore(private val maxScenarios: Int = MAX_SCENARIOS) {
    private val entries = LinkedHashMap<String, StoredSample>()
    private var sequence = 0L

    init {
        require(maxScenarios in 1..MAX_SCENARIOS) { "maxScenarios out of range: $maxScenarios" }
    }

    @Synchronized
    fun publish(scenarioId: String, sample: LocationSample, elapsedRealtimeNanos: Long): Long {
        require(scenarioId.isNotBlank() && scenarioId.length <= MAX_ID_LENGTH) { "Invalid scenarioId" }
        require(elapsedRealtimeNanos >= 0L) { "elapsedRealtimeNanos must be non-negative" }
        sequence = Math.addExact(sequence, 1L)
        entries.remove(scenarioId)
        entries[scenarioId] = StoredSample(sequence, sample, elapsedRealtimeNanos)
        while (entries.size > maxScenarios) {
            entries.remove(entries.keys.first())
        }
        return sequence
    }

    @Synchronized
    fun latest(
        scenarioId: String,
        nowElapsedNanos: Long,
        maxAgeNanos: Long = SampleStore.DEFAULT_MAX_AGE_NANOS,
    ): StoredSample? {
        require(maxAgeNanos >= 0L) { "maxAgeNanos must be non-negative" }
        val entry = entries[scenarioId] ?: return null
        if (nowElapsedNanos < entry.storedAtElapsedNanos) return null
        return entry.takeIf { nowElapsedNanos - it.storedAtElapsedNanos < maxAgeNanos }
    }

    @Synchronized
    fun clear(scenarioId: String) {
        entries.remove(scenarioId)
    }

    @Synchronized
    fun scenarioIds(): Set<String> = entries.keys.toSet()

    /** One bounded, lease-checked view for a delivery tick; later publications cannot change it. */
    @Synchronized
    fun snapshot(nowElapsedNanos: Long, maxAgeNanos: Long = SampleStore.DEFAULT_MAX_AGE_NANOS): Map<String, LocationSample> {
        require(maxAgeNanos >= 0L) { "maxAgeNanos must be non-negative" }
        return entries.filterValues {
            nowElapsedNanos >= it.storedAtElapsedNanos && nowElapsedNanos - it.storedAtElapsedNanos < maxAgeNanos
        }.mapValues { it.value.sample }
    }

    /** Full authenticated restore. Preserve original sample deadlines, never receipt time. */
    @Synchronized
    fun replace(samples: Map<String, LocationSample>) {
        require(samples.size <= maxScenarios)
        require(samples.keys.all { it.isNotBlank() && it.length <= MAX_ID_LENGTH })
        var nextSequence = sequence
        val prepared = samples.mapValues { (_, sample) ->
            StoredSample(Math.addExact(nextSequence, 1L).also { nextSequence = it }, sample, sample.elapsedNanos)
        }
        entries.clear()
        entries.putAll(prepared)
        sequence = nextSequence
    }

    companion object {
        const val MAX_SCENARIOS = 64
        const val MAX_ID_LENGTH = 255
    }
}
```

`core/src/main/kotlin/com/system/location/service/core/runtime/SeqlockSampleStore.kt`:

```kt
package com.system.location.service.core.runtime

import com.system.location.service.core.location.LocationSample

/**
 * P5-06: JVM model of the double-buffered/seqlock sample exchange proposed in
 * `10-store-transport.md`. It is not shared memory itself; it validates the ordering rules a
 * future ashmem implementation must preserve: one writer, two slots, sequence retry on read.
 */
class SeqlockSampleStore : SampleStore {
    private val slots = arrayOfNulls<StoredSample>(2)

    @Volatile
    private var sequence = 0L

    @Volatile
    private var publishedIndex = -1

    @Synchronized
    override fun publish(sample: LocationSample, elapsedRealtimeNanos: Long): Long {
        require(elapsedRealtimeNanos >= 0L) { "elapsedRealtimeNanos must be non-negative" }
        val next = sequence + 1L
        val index = (next and 1L).toInt()
        slots[index] = StoredSample(next, sample, elapsedRealtimeNanos)
        publishedIndex = index
        sequence = next
        return next
    }

    override fun latest(nowElapsedNanos: Long, maxAgeNanos: Long): StoredSample? {
        require(maxAgeNanos >= 0L) { "maxAgeNanos must be non-negative" }
        repeat(MAX_RETRIES) {
            val before = sequence
            val index = publishedIndex
            if (index < 0) return null
            val entry = slots[index] ?: return null
            if (entry.sequence != before || sequence != before) return@repeat
            if (nowElapsedNanos < entry.storedAtElapsedNanos) return null
            return entry.takeIf { nowElapsedNanos - it.storedAtElapsedNanos <= maxAgeNanos }
        }
        return null
    }

    @Synchronized
    override fun clear() {
        slots[0] = null
        slots[1] = null
        publishedIndex = -1
        sequence = 0L
    }

    private companion object {
        const val MAX_RETRIES = 8
    }
}
```
