`core/src/test/kotlin/com/system/location/service/core/BeiDouNavigationWordsTest.kt`:

```kt
package com.system.location.service.core

import com.system.location.service.core.gnss.*
import java.util.Base64
import kotlin.math.pow
import org.junit.Assert.*
import org.junit.Test

class BeiDouNavigationWordsTest {
    @Test fun verifiesAndExtractsD1AndD2WordsWithoutTrustingHalParityLabel() {
        for (format in listOf(BeiDouNavigationFormat.D1, BeiDouNavigationFormat.D2)) {
            val observation = observation(format)
            val decoded = BeiDouNavigationWords.decode(observation)
            assertNotNull(decoded.reason, decoded.subframe)
            assertEquals(format, decoded.subframe!!.format)
            assertEquals(24, decoded.subframe!!.svid)
            assertEquals(3, decoded.subframe!!.id)
            assertEquals(if (format == BeiDouNavigationFormat.D1) 432012 else 432000,
                decoded.subframe!!.secondsOfWeek)
            assertEquals(3L, decoded.subframe!!.rawUnsigned(15, 3))
        }
    }

    @Test fun rejectsPreamblePaddingPhaseIdentityLengthAndSingleBitBchErrors() {
        val original = observation(BeiDouNavigationFormat.D1)
        val payload = Base64.getDecoder().decode(original.dataBase64)
        val invalid = listOf(
            original.copy(dataBase64 = Base64.getEncoder().encodeToString(payload.copyOf().also { it[0] = (it[0].toInt() xor 1).toByte() })),
            original.copy(dataBase64 = Base64.getEncoder().encodeToString(payload.copyOf().also { it[3] = (it[3].toInt() xor 1).toByte() })),
            original.copy(submessageId = 2),
            original.copy(dataBase64 = Base64.getEncoder().encodeToString(payload.copyOfRange(0, 39))),
        )
        invalid.forEach { assertNull(BeiDouNavigationWords.decode(it).subframe) }
        val unknown = original.copy(type = 0x0503)
        assertNull(BeiDouNavigationWords.decode(unknown).subframe)
    }

    @Test fun keepsD2FrameSowDistinctFromD1SubframeSow() {
        val d1 = BeiDouNavigationWords.decode(observation(BeiDouNavigationFormat.D1)).subframe!!
        val d2 = BeiDouNavigationWords.decode(observation(BeiDouNavigationFormat.D2)).subframe!!
        assertNotEquals(d1.secondsOfWeek, d2.secondsOfWeek)
        assertEquals(432000, d2.secondsOfWeek)
    }

    @Test fun decodesD1EphemerisOnlyWhenThreeConsistentSubframesAndExternalValidityExist() {
        val subframes = (1..3).map { id ->
            BeiDouNavigationWords.decode(observation(BeiDouNavigationFormat.D1, id, 432000 + (id - 1) * 6)).subframe!!
        }
        val result = BeiDouD1EphemerisDecoder.decode(subframes, BeiDouTime(700, 431000.0), BeiDouTime(700, 433000.0),
            BeiDouOrbitType.MEO, BeiDouTime(700, 432006.0))
        assertNotNull(result.reason, result.decoded)
        val decoded = result.decoded!!
        assertEquals(24, decoded.ephemeris.svid)
        assertEquals(700, decoded.ephemeris.toe.week)
        assertEquals(432000.0, decoded.ephemeris.toe.secondsOfWeek, 0.0)
        assertEquals(432008.0, decoded.ephemeris.toc.secondsOfWeek, 0.0)
        assertEquals(5440.0, decoded.ephemeris.sqrtSemiMajorAxis, 1e-9)
        assertEquals(5000 * 2.0.pow(-33), decoded.ephemeris.eccentricity, 1e-15)
        assertEquals(3 * 2.0.pow(-31), decoded.ephemeris.cucRad, 1e-15)
        assertEquals(3 * 0.1e-9, decoded.tgd2Seconds, 1e-15)
        assertEquals(0, decoded.health)
        assertEquals(5, decoded.uraIndex)
        assertEquals(432000.0, decoded.transmissionTime.secondsOfWeek, 0.0)
        assertNull(BeiDouD1EphemerisDecoder.decode(subframes, BeiDouTime(700, 432001.0),
            BeiDouTime(700, 432002.0), BeiDouOrbitType.MEO, BeiDouTime(700, 432006.0)).decoded)
        val inconsistent = subframes.toMutableList()
        inconsistent[2] = BeiDouNavigationWords.decode(observation(BeiDouNavigationFormat.D1, 3, 432042)).subframe!!
        assertNull(BeiDouD1EphemerisDecoder.decode(inconsistent, BeiDouTime(700, 431000.0),
            BeiDouTime(700, 433000.0), BeiDouOrbitType.MEO, BeiDouTime(700, 432006.0)).decoded)
    }

    @Test fun resolvesReferenceWeeksAndEpochsAndRejectsMissingOrAmbiguousTimingEvidence() {
        fun frames(week: Int = 700, toe: Int = 432000, toc: Int = 432008, captureGap: Long = 0) = (1..3).map { id ->
            val message = observation(BeiDouNavigationFormat.D1, id, week = week, toe = toe, toc = toc)
                .copy(capturedAtMillis = 1 + captureGap * (id - 1))
            BeiDouNavigationWords.decode(message).subframe!!
        }
        fun decode(frames: List<BeiDouNavigationSubframe>, ref: BeiDouTime = BeiDouTime(700, 432006.0),
            type: BeiDouOrbitType = BeiDouOrbitType.MEO) = BeiDouD1EphemerisDecoder.decode(frames,
                ref.plusSeconds(-1000.0), ref.plusSeconds(1000.0), type, ref)
        assertNull(decode(frames(), type = BeiDouOrbitType.GEO).decoded)
        assertNull(decode(frames(), ref = BeiDouTime(701, 432006.0)).decoded)
        assertNull(decode(frames(captureGap = 30_001)).decoded)
        assertNull(decode(frames(toe = 604800)).decoded)
        assertNull(decode(frames(toc = 604800)).decoded)
        assertNull(decode(frames(toe = 129600)).decoded) // exactly half a week from transmission
        val resolved = decode(frames(), ref = BeiDouTime(8892, 432006.0)).decoded!!
        assertEquals(8892, resolved.ephemeris.toe.week)
        assertEquals(8892, resolved.transmissionTime.week)
        // toe/toc close to the start of next week belong to that week, not transmission's week.
        val nextWeek = decode(frames(toe = 0, toc = 8)).decoded!!
        assertEquals(701, nextWeek.ephemeris.toe.week)
        assertEquals(701, nextWeek.ephemeris.toc.week)
        assertThrows(IllegalArgumentException::class.java) { frames()[0].rawUnsigned(25, 3) }
    }

    private fun observation(format: BeiDouNavigationFormat, id: Int = 3,
        sow: Int = if (format == BeiDouNavigationFormat.D1) 432000 + (id - 1) * 6 else 432000,
        week: Int = 700, toe: Int = 432000, toc: Int = 432008): GnssNavigationObservation {
        val information = BooleanArray(224)
        fun infoIndex(raw: Int): Int {
            val word = raw / 30; val within = raw % 30
            return if (word == 0) within else 26 + (word - 1) * 22 + within
        }
        fun setRaw(start: Int, length: Int, value: Long) = repeat(length) { bit ->
            information[infoIndex(start + bit)] = value ushr (length - bit - 1) and 1L != 0L
        }
        fun setParts(a: Int, al: Int, b: Int, bl: Int, value: Long) {
            setRaw(a, al, value ushr bl); setRaw(b, bl, value and ((1L shl bl) - 1))
        }
        setRaw(0, 11, 0b11100010010)
        setRaw(15, 3, id.toLong())
        setParts(18, 8, 30, 12, sow.toLong())
        setRaw(42, 1, 0); setRaw(48, 4, 5)
        if (id == 1) {
            setRaw(43, 5, 3); setRaw(60, 13, week.toLong()); setParts(73, 9, 90, 8, toc / 8L)
            setRaw(98, 10, 2); setParts(108, 4, 120, 6, 3); setRaw(214, 11, 0)
            setParts(225, 7, 240, 17, 1000); setParts(257, 5, 270, 17, 2000); setRaw(287, 5, 4)
        } else if (id == 2) {
            setParts(42, 10, 60, 6, 2); setParts(66, 16, 90, 2, 3); setParts(92, 20, 120, 12, 4)
            setParts(132, 10, 150, 22, 5000); setRaw(180, 18, 6); setParts(198, 4, 210, 14, 7)
            setParts(224, 8, 240, 10, 8); setParts(250, 12, 270, 20, 5440L * 524288)
            setRaw(290, 2, toe.toLong() / 8 ushr 15)
        } else {
            setParts(42, 10, 60, 5, toe.toLong() / 8 and 0x7fff); setParts(65, 17, 90, 15, 515396)
            setParts(105, 7, 120, 11, 2)
            setParts(131, 11, 150, 13, 3); setParts(163, 9, 180, 9, 4); setParts(189, 13, 210, 1, 5)
            setParts(211, 21, 240, 11, 6); setParts(251, 11, 270, 21, 7)
        }
        val words = IntArray(10)
        fun get(start: Int, length: Int): Int = (0 until length).fold(0) { value, bit ->
            (value shl 1) or if (information[start + bit]) 1 else 0
        }
        words[0] = (get(0, 26) shl 4) or bch(get(15, 11))
        var cursor = 26
        for (index in 1..9) {
            val first = get(cursor, 11); val second = get(cursor + 11, 11); cursor += 22
            var word = 0
            repeat(11) { bit -> word = word or ((first ushr (10 - bit) and 1) shl (29 - bit * 2)) }
            repeat(11) { bit -> word = word or ((second ushr (10 - bit) and 1) shl (28 - bit * 2)) }
            val p1 = bch(first); val p2 = bch(second)
            repeat(4) { bit -> word = word or ((p1 ushr (3 - bit) and 1) shl (7 - bit * 2)) }
            repeat(4) { bit -> word = word or ((p2 ushr (3 - bit) and 1) shl (6 - bit * 2)) }
            words[index] = word
        }
        val bytes = ByteArray(40)
        words.forEachIndexed { index, word -> repeat(4) { byte ->
            bytes[index * 4 + byte] = (word ushr (24 - byte * 8)).toByte()
        } }
        return GnssNavigationObservation(1, if (format == BeiDouNavigationFormat.D1) 0x0501 else 0x0502,
            24, 1, id, id, Base64.getEncoder().encodeToString(bytes))
    }

    private fun bch(data: Int): Int {
        var remainder = data shl 4
        for (bit in 14 downTo 4) if (remainder and (1 shl bit) != 0) remainder = remainder xor (0x13 shl (bit - 4))
        return remainder and 15
    }
}
```

`core/src/test/kotlin/com/system/location/service/core/BeiDouReceptionGeometryTest.kt`:

```kt
package com.system.location.service.core

import com.system.location.service.core.gnss.*
import kotlinx.serialization.json.*
import org.junit.Assert.*
import org.junit.Test
import kotlin.math.hypot

class BeiDouReceptionGeometryTest {
    private fun resource(name: String) = Json.parseToJsonElement(javaClass.getResource("/gnss/$name")!!.readText()).jsonObject
    private val records = resource("beidou-reference.json").getValue("records").jsonArray.map { it.jsonObject }
    private val cases = resource("beidou-reception-reference.json").getValue("cases").jsonArray.map { it.jsonObject }
    private fun JsonObject.n(name: String) = getValue(name).jsonPrimitive.double
    private fun ephemeris(index: Int = 0): BeiDouBroadcastEphemeris {
        val r = records[index]
        fun n(name: String) = r.n(name)
        val toe = BeiDouTime(n("week").toInt(), n("toe"))
        return BeiDouBroadcastEphemeris(n("svid").toInt(), BeiDouOrbitType.valueOf(r.getValue("orbitType").jsonPrimitive.content),
            toe, BeiDouTime(toe.week, n("toc")), toe.plusSeconds(-7200.0), toe.plusSeconds(7200.0),
            n("sqrtA"), n("e"), n("i0"), n("omega0"), n("omega"), n("m0"), n("deltaN"), n("omegaDot"), n("iDot"),
            n("cuc"), n("cus"), n("crc"), n("crs"), n("cic"), n("cis"), n("af0"), n("af1"), n("af2"))
    }
    private val receiver = BdcsReceiver(EcefPosition(-2850000.0, 4650000.0, 3290000.0), GeodeticOrientation(31.2, 121.5))

    @Test fun signalClocksMatchIndependentTransmissionClockForEveryOrbitTypeAndLegacySignal() {
        cases.forEach { c ->
            val e = ephemeris(c.n("recordIndex").toInt())
            val xyz = c.getValue("receiverEcefMeters").jsonArray.map { it.jsonPrimitive.double }
            val point = BdcsReceiver(EcefPosition(xyz[0], xyz[1], xyz[2]),
                GeodeticOrientation(c.n("latitudeDegrees"), c.n("longitudeDegrees")))
            val clock = c.getValue("expected").jsonObject.n("clockBiasSeconds")
            val time = e.toe.plusSeconds(c.n("offsetSeconds"))
            val validity = BeiDouServiceValidity(e.validFrom, e.validUntil)
            for ((signal, tgd) in listOf(BeiDouLegacySignal.B1I to -34.5e-9, BeiDouLegacySignal.B2I to 23.4e-9)) {
                val result = if (e.orbitType == BeiDouOrbitType.GEO) {
                    BeiDouSignalReception.observe(BeiDouD2Decoded(e, 0, 5, -34.5e-9, 23.4e-9, e.toe, 3, 4),
                        time, point, signal, validity)
                } else {
                    BeiDouSignalReception.observe(BeiDouD1Decoded(e, 0, 5, -34.5e-9, 23.4e-9, e.toe, 3, 4),
                        time, point, signal, validity)
                }
                assertNotNull(result.reason, result.observation)
                assertEquals(clock - tgd, result.observation!!.signalClockBiasSeconds, 1e-16)
                assertEquals(BeiDouReceptionGeometry.observe(e, time, point).observation, result.observation!!.geometry)
            }
        }
    }

    @Test fun signalServiceAndOrbitLimitsApplyAtSolvedTransmissionRatherThanReception() {
        val e = ephemeris().let { it.copy(validFrom = it.toe.plusSeconds(-1.0), validUntil = it.toe.plusSeconds(1.0)) }
        val d = BeiDouD2Decoded(e, 0, 5, 0.0, 0.0, e.toe, 3, 4)
        val service = BeiDouServiceValidity(e.validFrom, e.validUntil)
        fun observe(decoded: BeiDouD2Decoded = d, validity: BeiDouServiceValidity = service) =
            BeiDouSignalReception.observe(decoded, e.validUntil.plusSeconds(0.05), receiver, BeiDouLegacySignal.B1I, validity)
        val result = observe()
        assertNotNull(result.reason, result.observation)
        assertTrue(result.observation!!.geometry.transmissionTime.secondsSince(service.until) < 0)
        assertNull(observe(d.copy(health = 1)).observation)
        assertNull(observe(d.copy(uraIndex = 15)).observation)
        assertNull(observe(d.copy(tgd1Seconds = Double.NaN)).observation)
        assertNull(observe(validity = BeiDouServiceValidity(e.validFrom, e.toe.plusSeconds(0.5))).observation)
    }

    @Test fun matchesIndependentCLightTimeRotationAndEnuForAllTwelveCases() {
        cases.forEach { c ->
            val e = ephemeris(c.n("recordIndex").toInt())
            val xyz = c.getValue("receiverEcefMeters").jsonArray.map { it.jsonPrimitive.double }
            val receiver = BdcsReceiver(EcefPosition(xyz[0], xyz[1], xyz[2]),
                GeodeticOrientation(c.n("latitudeDegrees"), c.n("longitudeDegrees")))
            val result = BeiDouReceptionGeometry.observe(e, e.toe.plusSeconds(c.n("offsetSeconds")), receiver)
            assertNotNull(result.reason, result.observation)
            val o = result.observation!!
            val expected = c.getValue("expected").jsonObject
            val values = mapOf("xMeters" to o.satelliteInReceptionEcef.xMeters,
                "yMeters" to o.satelliteInReceptionEcef.yMeters, "zMeters" to o.satelliteInReceptionEcef.zMeters,
                "rangeMeters" to o.lineOfSight.rangeMeters, "eastMeters" to o.lineOfSight.eastMeters,
                "northMeters" to o.lineOfSight.northMeters, "upMeters" to o.lineOfSight.upMeters)
            values.forEach { (name, value) -> assertEquals(name, expected.n(name), value, 1e-5) }
            assertEquals(expected.n("propagationSeconds"), o.propagationSeconds, 1e-12)
            assertEquals(expected.n("elevationDegrees"), o.lineOfSight.elevationDegrees, 1e-9)
            assertEquals(expected.n("azimuthDegrees"), o.lineOfSight.azimuthDegrees!!, 1e-9)
            assertEquals(expected.n("clockBiasSeconds"), o.clockBiasSeconds, 1e-16)
            assertEquals(o.lineOfSight.rangeMeters,
                o.propagationSeconds * BeiDouReceptionGeometry.SPEED_OF_LIGHT_METERS_PER_SECOND, 0.00004)
        }
    }

    @Test fun validatesTransmissionEpochInsteadOfReceptionEpochAndRejectsOldFullWeeks() {
        val e = ephemeris().let { it.copy(validFrom = it.toe.plusSeconds(-1.0), validUntil = it.toe.plusSeconds(1.0)) }
        fun at(t: BeiDouTime) = BeiDouReceptionGeometry.observe(e, t, receiver)
        val after = at(e.validUntil.plusSeconds(0.05))
        assertNotNull(after.reason, after.observation)
        assertTrue(after.observation!!.transmissionTime.secondsSince(e.validUntil) < 0)
        assertNotNull(at(e.validFrom.plusSeconds(0.2)).observation)
        assertNull(at(e.validFrom.plusSeconds(0.001)).observation)
        assertNull(at(e.validUntil.plusSeconds(0.5)).observation)
        assertNull(at(e.toe.plusSeconds(604800.0)).observation)
    }

    @Test fun rotationIsAppliedExactlyOnceAndClockDoesNotChangeVacuumGeometry() {
        val e = ephemeris()
        val o = BeiDouReceptionGeometry.observe(e, e.toe, receiver).observation!!
        val transmitted = BeiDouBroadcastPropagator.propagate(e, o.transmissionTime).state!!
        assertTrue(hypot(transmitted.xMeters - o.satelliteInReceptionEcef.xMeters,
            transmitted.yMeters - o.satelliteInReceptionEcef.yMeters) > 1.0)
        assertEquals(transmitted.zMeters, o.satelliteInReceptionEcef.zMeters, 0.0)
        assertEquals(transmitted.clockBiasSeconds, o.clockBiasSeconds, 0.0)
        val shifted = BeiDouReceptionGeometry.observe(e.copy(af0Seconds = e.af0Seconds + 1e-6), e.toe, receiver).observation!!
        assertEquals(o.satelliteInReceptionEcef, shifted.satelliteInReceptionEcef)
        assertEquals(o.propagationSeconds, shifted.propagationSeconds, 0.0)
        assertEquals(o.clockBiasSeconds + 1e-6, shifted.clockBiasSeconds, 1e-18)
    }

    @Test fun fullBdtWeekBoundaryAndFirstEpochAreHandledWithoutWeekAliasing() {
        val base = ephemeris()
        val toe = BeiDouTime(1081, 604799.0)
        val e = base.copy(toe = toe, toc = toe, validFrom = toe.plusSeconds(-1.0), validUntil = toe.plusSeconds(2.0))
        val a = BeiDouReceptionGeometry.observe(e, toe.plusSeconds(0.999), receiver).observation!!
        val b = BeiDouReceptionGeometry.observe(e, toe.plusSeconds(1.001), receiver).observation!!
        assertTrue(kotlin.math.abs(b.lineOfSight.rangeMeters - a.lineOfSight.rangeMeters) < 10)
        assertTrue(b.transmissionTime.secondsSince(a.transmissionTime) in 0.0019..0.0021)
        val origin = BeiDouTime(0, 0.0)
        val first = base.copy(toe = origin, toc = origin, validFrom = origin, validUntil = origin.plusSeconds(1.0))
        assertNull(BeiDouReceptionGeometry.observe(first, origin, receiver).observation)
        assertNotNull(BeiDouReceptionGeometry.observe(first, origin.plusSeconds(0.2), receiver).observation)
    }
}
```

`core/src/test/kotlin/com/system/location/service/core/BeiDouSatelliteMetadataTest.kt`:

```kt
package com.system.location.service.core

import com.system.location.service.core.gnss.*
import java.time.LocalDateTime
import org.junit.Assert.*
import org.junit.Test

class BeiDouSatelliteMetadataTest {
    private fun text(extra: String = "", block: String = "BDS-3I") = """
%=SNX 2.02 DLR 26:295:28054 DLR 78:053:00000 00:000:00000 P 00000 0
+SATELLITE/IDENTIFIER
${" C005 2010-036A  36828 " + "BDS-2I".padEnd(15) + " old"}
${" C220 2019-023A  44204 " + block.padEnd(15) + " new"}
-SATELLITE/IDENTIFIER
+SATELLITE/PRN
 C005 2010:212:00000 2026:100:43200 C06
 C220 2026:100:57600 0000:000:00000 C06
$extra
-SATELLITE/PRN
%ENDSNX
""".trimIndent()
    private val old = LocalDateTime.of(2026, 4, 10, 11, 59, 59)
    private val start = LocalDateTime.of(2026, 4, 10, 16, 0, 0)

    @Test fun assignmentUsesSvnAndHalfOpenIntervalsRatherThanPrnRange() {
        val metadata = BeiDouSatelliteMetadata.parse(text())
        assertEquals("26:295:28054", metadata.creationLabel)
        assertEquals("C005", metadata.identityAt(6, old)?.svn)
        assertNull(metadata.identityAt(6, old.plusSeconds(1)))
        assertNull(metadata.identityAt(6, start.minusSeconds(1)))
        assertEquals("C220", metadata.identityAt(6, start)?.svn)
        assertEquals(BeiDouOrbitType.IGSO, metadata.identityAt(6, start)?.orbitType)
        assertNull(metadata.identityAt(5, start))
        assertNull(metadata.identityAt(6, start.minusSeconds(1), start.plusSeconds(1)))
        assertEquals("C220", metadata.identityAt(6, start.plusSeconds(1), start.plusSeconds(60))?.svn)
    }

    @Test fun ambiguousAssignmentsAndUnknownBlocksDoNotGuessAnOrbitClass() {
        assertNull(BeiDouSatelliteMetadata.parse(text(" C005 2026:100:57600 0000:000:00000 C06"))
            .identityAt(6, start))
        assertNull(BeiDouSatelliteMetadata.parse(text(block = "BDS-NEW" )).identityAt(6, start))
        assertNull(BeiDouSatelliteMetadata.parse(text(" C220 2026:100:57600 0000:000:00000 C07"))
            .identityAt(6, start))
        assertThrows(IllegalArgumentException::class.java) {
            BeiDouSatelliteMetadata.parse(text()).identityAt(6, start, old)
        }
    }

    @Test fun truncationMissingIdentityAndMalformedEpochsFailTheWholeCatalog() {
        for (invalid in listOf(text().replace("%ENDSNX", ""),
            text().replace(" C220 2026:", " C999 2026:"), text().replace("2026:100:57600", "2026:366:57600"),
            text().replace("2026:100:57600", "2026:100:86400"), text().replace("2.02 DLR", "9.99 DLR"))) {
            assertThrows(IllegalArgumentException::class.java) { BeiDouSatelliteMetadata.parse(invalid) }
        }
    }

    @Test fun bundledRealMetadataPreservesThe2026ReassignmentsAndOriginalReleaseLabel() {
        val metadata = BeiDouSatelliteMetadata.parse(requireNotNull(javaClass.getResource("/gnss/igs-beidou-metadata.snx")).readText())
        assertEquals("26:295:28054", metadata.creationLabel)
        assertEquals(LocalDateTime.of(2026, 10, 22, 7, 47, 34), metadata.creationAt(2026))
        assertThrows(IllegalArgumentException::class.java) { metadata.creationAt(2025) }
        val before = LocalDateTime.of(2026, 1, 1, 0, 0)
        val after = LocalDateTime.of(2026, 11, 11, 3, 0)
        assertEquals("C006", metadata.identityAt(4, before)?.svn)
        assertEquals("C217", metadata.identityAt(4, after)?.svn)
        assertEquals(BeiDouOrbitType.GEO, metadata.identityAt(4, after)?.orbitType)
        assertEquals("C005", metadata.identityAt(6, before)?.svn)
        assertEquals("C220", metadata.identityAt(6, after)?.svn)
        assertEquals(BeiDouOrbitType.IGSO, metadata.identityAt(6, after)?.orbitType)
        assertNull(metadata.identityAt(59, after))
    }
}
```

`core/src/test/kotlin/com/system/location/service/core/BeiDouSignalClockTest.kt`:

```kt
package com.system.location.service.core

import com.system.location.service.core.gnss.*
import java.math.BigDecimal
import kotlinx.serialization.json.*
import org.junit.Assert.*
import org.junit.Test

class BeiDouSignalClockTest {
    private val records = Json.parseToJsonElement(javaClass.getResource("/gnss/beidou-reference.json")!!.readText())
        .jsonObject.getValue("records").jsonArray.map { it.jsonObject }
    private fun JsonObject.n(name: String) = getValue(name).jsonPrimitive.double
    private fun ephemeris(r: JsonObject): BeiDouBroadcastEphemeris {
        val toe = BeiDouTime(r.n("week").toInt(), r.n("toe"))
        return BeiDouBroadcastEphemeris(r.n("svid").toInt(), BeiDouOrbitType.valueOf(r.getValue("orbitType").jsonPrimitive.content),
            toe, BeiDouTime(toe.week, r.n("toc")), toe.plusSeconds(-1000.0), toe.plusSeconds(1000.0),
            r.n("sqrtA"), r.n("e"), r.n("i0"), r.n("omega0"), r.n("omega"), r.n("m0"), r.n("deltaN"),
            r.n("omegaDot"), r.n("iDot"), r.n("cuc"), r.n("cus"), r.n("crc"), r.n("crs"), r.n("cic"),
            r.n("cis"), r.n("af0"), r.n("af1"), r.n("af2"))
    }

    @Test fun matchesIndependentCBaseClockMinusEachSignalTgdWithoutGalileoFrequencyFactors() {
        for (r in records) {
            val e = ephemeris(r)
            val applicability = BeiDouServiceValidity(e.validFrom, e.validUntil)
            for (vector in r.getValue("expected").jsonArray.map { it.jsonObject }) {
                val time = e.toe.plusSeconds(vector.n("offsetSeconds"))
                for ((signal, delay) in listOf(BeiDouLegacySignal.B1I to BigDecimal("-0.0000000345"),
                    BeiDouLegacySignal.B2I to BigDecimal("0.0000000234"))) {
                    val result = if (e.orbitType == BeiDouOrbitType.GEO) {
                        val decoded = BeiDouD2Decoded(e, 0, 5, -345 * 0.1e-9, 234 * 0.1e-9, e.toe, 3, 4)
                        BeiDouSignalClock.correction(decoded, time, signal, applicability)
                    } else {
                        val decoded = BeiDouD1Decoded(e, 0, 5, -345 * 0.1e-9, 234 * 0.1e-9, e.toe, 3, 4)
                        BeiDouSignalClock.correction(decoded, time, signal, applicability)
                    }
                    assertNotNull(result.reason, result.correctionSeconds)
                    val expected = vector.getValue("clockBiasSeconds").jsonPrimitive.content.toBigDecimal() - delay
                    assertEquals(expected.toDouble(), result.correctionSeconds!!, 1e-16)
                }
            }
        }
    }

    @Test fun requiresBothOrbitAndServiceValidityAndRejectsUnhealthyOrUnavailableSignalEvidence() {
        val e = ephemeris(records.last())
        val d = BeiDouD1Decoded(e, 0, 5, 0.0, 0.0, e.toe, 3, 4)
        val service = BeiDouServiceValidity(e.toe.plusSeconds(-1.0), e.toe.plusSeconds(1.0))
        fun correction(decoded: BeiDouD1Decoded = d, t: BeiDouTime = e.toe, signal: BeiDouLegacySignal = BeiDouLegacySignal.B1I) =
            BeiDouSignalClock.correction(decoded, t, signal, service)
        assertNotNull(correction().correctionSeconds)
        assertNull(correction(d.copy(health = 1)).correctionSeconds)
        assertNull(correction(d.copy(uraIndex = 15)).correctionSeconds)
        assertNull(correction(d.copy(tgd1Seconds = Double.NaN)).correctionSeconds)
        assertNull(correction(d.copy(tgd1Seconds = 512 * 0.1e-9)).correctionSeconds)
        assertNotNull(correction(d.copy(tgd1Seconds = -512 * 0.1e-9)).correctionSeconds)
        assertNotNull(correction(d.copy(tgd1Seconds = 511 * 0.1e-9)).correctionSeconds)
        assertNotNull(correction(d.copy(tgd1Seconds = Double.NaN), signal = BeiDouLegacySignal.B2I).correctionSeconds)
        assertNull(correction(t = e.toe.plusSeconds(1.001)).correctionSeconds)
        assertNull(correction(d.copy(transmissionTime = e.toe.plusSeconds(-2.0))).correctionSeconds)
        assertNull(correction(d.copy(ephemeris = e.copy(validUntil = e.toe.plusSeconds(-0.1)))).correctionSeconds)
        assertNull(correction(d.copy(ephemeris = e.copy(orbitType = BeiDouOrbitType.GEO))).correctionSeconds)
        val d2 = BeiDouD2Decoded(e, 0, 5, 0.0, 0.0, e.toe, 3, 4)
        assertNull(BeiDouSignalClock.correction(d2, e.toe, BeiDouLegacySignal.B1I, service).correctionSeconds)
    }
}
```

```kt
package com.system.location.service.core

class BeiDouSkyCatalogTest {

    private val utc = GnssUtcTimeScale.parseIers(requireNotNull(javaClass.getResource("/gnss/leap-seconds.list")).readText())

    @Test fun epochAmbiguityCannotChooseAnIdentityAcrossTheActual2026Switch() {

        assertEquals("C220", catalog.identityAt(6, at("2026-04-10T16:00:02Z"))?.svn)
        assertEquals(BeiDouOrbitType.GEO, catalog.identityAt(4, at("2026-11-11T03:00:00Z"))?.orbitType)
    }

    @Test fun sourceAgeAndTimeEvidenceAreRequiredEvenForOpenEndedAssignments() {

        assertNull(catalog.identityAt(4, at("2026-11-22T00:00:00Z")))

        assertNull(catalog.identityAt(64, at("2026-11-11T03:00:00Z")))
        assertThrows(IllegalArgumentException::class.java) { BeiDouSkyCatalog(metadata, 2025, 86400, utc) }
    }
```

`core/src/test/kotlin/com/system/location/service/core/BroadcastSignalCalibrationTest.kt`:

```kt
package com.system.location.service.core

import com.system.location.service.core.gnss.*
import org.junit.Assert.*
import org.junit.Test

class BroadcastSignalCalibrationTest {
    private fun signal(system: Constellation, elevation: Float, cn0: Float, carrier: Float?, id: Int = 1,
        used: Boolean = true) = GnssSatellite(system, id, elevation, 90f, cn0, used, true, used, carrier)

    private fun capture(samples: List<GnssSatellite>) = GnssCapture(deviceModel = "synthetic RF fixture",
        osVersion = "test", startedAtMillis = 0, endedAtMillis = 60_000,
        frames = listOf(GnssObservationFrame(0L, satellites = GnssSignalProjection.spacecraft(samples.map(::GnssSignalObservation)),
            signalObservations = samples.map(::GnssSignalObservation))))

    @Test fun jointMeansInterpolateOnlyInsideObservedElevationSupport() {
        val calibration = BroadcastSignalCalibration.fit(capture(listOf(
            signal(Constellation.GALILEO, 10f, 20f, 1_575_420_000f, used = false),
            signal(Constellation.GALILEO, 30f, 40f, 1_575_420_000f))))
        assertNull(calibration.at(Constellation.GALILEO, 9.999, 1_575_420_000.0))
        assertNull(calibration.at(Constellation.GALILEO, 30.001, 1_575_420_000.0))
        val midpoint = calibration.at(Constellation.GALILEO, 20.0, 1_575_420_000.0)!!
        assertEquals(30.0, midpoint.cn0, 1e-12)
        assertEquals(0.5, midpoint.used, 1e-12)
        assertEquals(20.0, calibration.at(Constellation.GALILEO, 10.0, 1_575_420_000.0)!!.cn0, 0.0)
    }

    @Test fun multibandAndConstellationFitsRemainDistinctAndOrderIndependent() {
        val samples = listOf(signal(Constellation.GALILEO, 20f, 21f, 1_575_420_000f),
            signal(Constellation.GALILEO, 20f, 43f, 1_207_140_000f),
            signal(Constellation.GALILEO, 20f, 32f, 1_176_450_000f),
            signal(Constellation.BEIDOU, 20f, 35f, 1_561_098_000f),
            signal(Constellation.BEIDOU, 20f, 60f, 1_575_420_000f),
            signal(Constellation.GALILEO, 20f, 60f, null),
            signal(Constellation.GALILEO, 20f, 0f, 1_575_420_000f),
            signal(Constellation.GALILEO, -1f, 63f, 1_575_420_000f))
        val fitted = BroadcastSignalCalibration.fit(capture(samples))
        assertEquals(fitted, BroadcastSignalCalibration.fit(capture(samples.reversed())))
        assertEquals(4, fitted.curves.size)
        assertEquals(21.0, fitted.at(Constellation.GALILEO, 20.0, 1_575_420_000.0)!!.cn0, 0.0)
        assertEquals(43.0, fitted.at(Constellation.GALILEO, 20.0, 1_207_140_000.0)!!.cn0, 0.0)
        assertEquals(35.0, fitted.at(Constellation.BEIDOU, 20.0, 1_561_098_000.0)!!.cn0, 0.0)
    }

    @Test fun glonassRetainsSlotCarrierEvidenceAndDoesNotMixL2OrBorrowAnotherSlot() {
        val fitted = BroadcastSignalCalibration.fit(capture(listOf(
            signal(Constellation.GLONASS, 20f, 25f, 1_602_000_000f),
            signal(Constellation.GLONASS, 20f, 61f, null),
            signal(Constellation.GLONASS, 20f, 63f, 1_246_000_000f),
            signal(Constellation.GLONASS, 20f, 45f, 1_602_562_500f, id = 2),
            signal(Constellation.GLONASS, 20f, 32f, null, id = 3))))
        assertEquals(25.0, fitted.at(Constellation.GLONASS, 20.0, svid = 1)!!.cn0, 0.0)
        assertEquals(1_602_000_000f, fitted.at(Constellation.GLONASS, 20.0, svid = 1)!!.carrier)
        assertEquals(45.0, fitted.at(Constellation.GLONASS, 20.0, svid = 2)!!.cn0, 0.0)
        assertEquals(32.0, fitted.at(Constellation.GLONASS, 20.0, svid = 3)!!.cn0, 0.0)
        assertNull(fitted.at(Constellation.GLONASS, 20.0, svid = 3)!!.carrier)
        assertNull(fitted.at(Constellation.GLONASS, 20.0, svid = 4))
    }

    @Test fun compactTransportRetainsUnprojectedBandsAndIsStableWhenReencoded() {
        val source = capture(listOf(signal(Constellation.GALILEO, 10f, 20f, 1_575_420_000f, used = false),
            signal(Constellation.GALILEO, 30f, 40f, 1_575_420_000f),
            signal(Constellation.GALILEO, 20f, 55f, 1_207_140_000f)))
        val fit = BroadcastSignalCalibration.fit(source)
        val wire = GnssCaptureWire.decode(GnssCaptureWire.encode(source))
        assertTrue(wire.frames.all { it.signalObservations.isEmpty() })
        assertEquals(fit, wire.broadcastSignalCalibration)
        assertEquals(30.0, wire.broadcastSignalCalibration!!.at(Constellation.GALILEO, 20.0, 1_575_420_000.0)!!.cn0, 1e-12)
        assertEquals(fit, GnssCaptureWire.decode(GnssCaptureWire.encode(wire)).broadcastSignalCalibration)
    }

    @Test fun freshUnsupportedSignalEvidenceReplacesStaleCalibrationWithExplicitEmptyFit() {
        val supported = capture(listOf(signal(Constellation.BEIDOU, 20f, 30f, 1_561_098_000f)))
        val stale = BroadcastSignalCalibration.fit(supported)
        val source = supported.copy(broadcastSignalCalibration = stale, frames = supported.frames.map {
            // Raw B1C cannot support the B1I service, even if a legacy projected row says B1I.
            it.copy(signalObservations = listOf(GnssSignalObservation(
                signal(Constellation.BEIDOU, 20f, 60f, 1_575_420_000f))))
        })
        val wire = GnssCaptureWire.decode(GnssCaptureWire.encode(source))
        assertEquals(emptyList<BroadcastSignalCurve>(), wire.broadcastSignalCalibration!!.curves)
        assertEquals(wire.broadcastSignalCalibration,
            GnssCaptureWire.decode(GnssCaptureWire.encode(wire)).broadcastSignalCalibration)
    }
}
```

`core/src/test/kotlin/com/system/location/service/core/CallerRouterTest.kt`:

```kt
package com.system.location.service.core

import com.system.location.service.core.routing.AppRoute
import com.system.location.service.core.routing.CallerRouter
import com.system.location.service.core.routing.PackageUidLookup
import com.system.location.service.core.routing.RoutingConfig
import com.system.location.service.core.routing.RoutingDecision
import com.system.location.service.core.routing.RoutingMode
import com.system.location.service.core.routing.RoutingTable
import org.junit.Assert.assertEquals
import org.junit.Test

class CallerRouterTest {
    private val table = RoutingTable(
        RoutingConfig(
            mode = RoutingMode.PER_APP,
            globalScenarioId = "global",
            routes = listOf(
                AppRoute("com.example.map", "map"),
                AppRoute("com.example.shared", "shared"),
            ),
            deniedPackages = setOf("com.example.denied"),
        ),
    )

    private class Lookup(
        private val packages: Map<Int, List<String>>,
        private val system: Set<String> = emptySet(),
    ) : PackageUidLookup {
        override fun packagesForUid(uid: Int): List<String> = packages[uid].orEmpty()
        override fun isSystemPackage(packageName: String): Boolean = packageName in system
    }

    @Test fun resolvesPackageRouteFromUid() {
        val router = CallerRouter(table, Lookup(mapOf(10_123 to listOf("com.example.map"))))
        assertEquals(RoutingDecision.Scenario("map"), router.decision(10_123))
    }

    @Test fun sharedUidMatchesAnyRoutedPackage() {
        val router = CallerRouter(table, Lookup(mapOf(10_123 to listOf("com.other", "com.example.shared"))))
        assertEquals(RoutingDecision.Scenario("shared"), router.decision(10_123))
    }

    @Test fun systemPackageInUidBypassesRoutes() {
        val router = CallerRouter(
            table,
            Lookup(mapOf(10_123 to listOf("com.example.map")), system = setOf("com.example.map")),
        )
        assertEquals(RoutingDecision.Global, router.decision(10_123))
    }

    @Test fun deniedPackageWins() {
        val router = CallerRouter(table, Lookup(mapOf(10_123 to listOf("com.example.denied"))))
        assertEquals(RoutingDecision.Deny, router.decision(10_123))
    }

    @Test fun unknownUidUsesGlobalScenario() {
        val router = CallerRouter(table, Lookup(emptyMap()))
        assertEquals(RoutingDecision.Scenario("global"), router.decision(10_999))
    }
}
```

`core/src/test/kotlin/com/system/location/service/core/CaptureGpsClockAssociationTest.kt`:

```kt
package com.system.location.service.core

import com.system.location.service.core.gnss.*
import org.junit.Assert.*
import org.junit.Test

class CaptureGpsClockAssociationTest {
    private fun batch(elapsed: Long, gpsNanos: Long = 1316L * 604800_000_000_000L) =
        GnssMeasurementBatch(1, 0, -gpsNanos, 0.0, 0, emptyList(), timeUncertaintyNanos = 0.0,
            biasUncertaintyNanos = 10.0, elapsedRealtimeNanos = elapsed,
            elapsedRealtimeUncertaintyNanos = 10.0, capturedElapsedRealtimeNanos = elapsed)

    @Test fun associationDistanceUsesIntegerNanosecondsAtLongUptimes() {
        val elapsed = 9_007_199_254_740_992L // beyond exact nanosecond resolution of Double.
        val clock = CaptureGpsClockAssociation(listOf(batch(elapsed)))
        assertNotNull(clock.atArrival(elapsed + 10_000_000_000L).reference)
        assertNull(clock.atArrival(elapsed + 10_000_000_001L).reference)
        assertNotNull(clock.atArrival(elapsed - 10_000_000_000L).reference)
        assertNull(clock.atArrival(elapsed - 10_000_000_001L).reference)
    }

    @Test fun invalidEraAndUnknownOrDelayedClockEvidenceReturnDiagnosticInsteadOfThrowing() {
        val b = batch(20_000_000_000L)
        for (invalid in listOf(b.copy(biasUncertaintyNanos = null), b.copy(elapsedRealtimeNanos = null),
            b.copy(capturedElapsedRealtimeNanos = b.elapsedRealtimeNanos!! + 10_000_000_001L))) {
            assertNull(CaptureGpsClockAssociation(listOf(invalid)).atArrival(b.elapsedRealtimeNanos).reference)
        }
        val clock = CaptureGpsClockAssociation(listOf(batch(20_000_000_000L, gpsNanos = 0)))
        val beforeOrigin = clock.atArrival(19_999_999_999L)
        assertNull(beforeOrigin.reference)
        assertNotNull(beforeOrigin.reason)
        assertNull(clock.atArrival(null).reference)
    }
}
```

```kt
package com.system.location.service.core

import com.system.location.service.core.carrier.*
import com.system.location.service.core.environment.*
import org.junit.Assert.*
import org.junit.Test

class CarrierCellIdentityTest {
    private val profile = SimCarrierProfile(1, countryIso = "US", mcc = 310, mnc = 260,
        carrierName = "Test Carrier")
    private fun cell(type: CellType, id: Long, registered: Boolean, rsrp: Int = -95) =
        CellTower(type, 460, 0, 12, id, pci = 7,
            arfcn = if (type == CellType.NR) 620000 else 1200, rsrp = rsrp,
            registered = registered, mncDigits = 2)

    @Test fun nrProfileExposesOnlyNrAndRebindsIdentityWithoutChangingRadioFields() {
        val nr = cell(CellType.NR, 50, true)
        val original = listOf(cell(CellType.LTE, 1, true), nr, cell(CellType.NR, 51, false))
        val result = CarrierCellIdentity.overlay(original, profile)
        assertEquals(2, result.size)
        assertTrue(result.all { it.type == CellType.NR && it.operatorNumeric == "310260" })
        assertEquals(1, result.count { it.registered })
        assertEquals(nr.arfcn, result.first().arfcn)
        assertEquals(nr.cellId, result.first().cellId)
        assertEquals(nr.pci, result.first().pci)
        assertEquals("46000", nr.operatorNumeric)
    }

    @Test fun doesNotReinterpretLteFieldsAsNrWhenNoNrEvidenceExists() {
        assertTrue(CarrierCellIdentity.overlay(listOf(cell(CellType.LTE, 1, true)), profile).isEmpty())
    }

    @Test fun strongestMatchingCellIsServingWhenCaptureContainsOnlyNrNeighbors() {
        val result = CarrierCellIdentity.overlay(listOf(cell(CellType.NR, 1, false, -100),
            cell(CellType.NR, 2, false, -80)), profile)
        assertEquals(2L, result.single { it.registered }.cellId)
    }
}
```

`core/src/test/kotlin/com/system/location/service/core/CarrierIdentityResolverTest.kt`:

```kt
package com.system.location.service.core

import com.system.location.service.core.carrier.*
import org.junit.Assert.*
import org.junit.Test

class CarrierIdentityResolverTest {
    private val sim1 = SimCarrierProfile(1, countryIso = "CN", mcc = 460, mnc = 0,
        mncDigits = 2, carrierName = "Test CN", virtualSubscriptionId = 71)
    private val sim2 = SimCarrierProfile(2, countryIso = "US", mcc = 310, mnc = 260,
        carrierName = "Test US", virtualSubscriptionId = 83)
    private val config = CarrierIdentityConfig(sims = listOf(sim1.copy(virtual = true), sim2.copy(virtual = true)))

    @Test fun globalUsesPhysicalSlotAndVirtualizesOnlyAnExplicitEmptySlotProfile() {
        assertEquals(sim2, CarrierIdentityResolver.profile(config, 2, setOf(2), listOf("android"), true))
        assertEquals(sim1.copy(virtual = true),
            CarrierIdentityResolver.profile(config, 1, setOf(2), listOf("android"), true))
        assertNull(CarrierIdentityResolver.profile(config, 3, setOf(1, 2, 3), listOf("app"), false))
    }

    @Test fun perAppRoutesCanUseAnExplicitVirtualSlotWithoutInventingUnconfiguredSlots() {
        val routed = config.copy(mode = CarrierIdentityMode.PER_APP,
            appRoutes = listOf(CarrierAppRoute("target.app", CarrierTarget.SIM2)))
        assertEquals(sim2, CarrierIdentityResolver.profile(routed, 1, setOf(1, 2), listOf("target.app"), false))
        assertEquals(sim2.copy(virtual = true),
            CarrierIdentityResolver.profile(routed, 1, setOf(1), listOf("target.app"), false))
        assertNull(CarrierIdentityResolver.profile(routed, 1, setOf(1, 2), listOf("other.app"), false))
        assertNull(CarrierIdentityResolver.profile(routed, 1, setOf(1, 2), listOf("target.app"), true))
    }

    @Test fun emptySlotRequiresPermissionAndPhysicalSimAlwaysWins() {
        val physicalOnly = CarrierIdentityConfig(sims = listOf(sim1))
        assertNull(CarrierIdentityResolver.profile(physicalOnly, 1, emptySet(), listOf("app"), false))
        assertEquals(sim1, CarrierIdentityResolver.profile(config, 1, setOf(1), listOf("android"), true))
        assertNull(CarrierIdentityResolver.profile(config.copy(sims = listOf(sim1.copy(enabled = false, virtual = true))),
            1, emptySet(), listOf("app"), false))
        val routed = CarrierIdentityConfig(mode = CarrierIdentityMode.PER_APP,
            sims = listOf(sim2.copy(virtual = true)),
            appRoutes = listOf(CarrierAppRoute("app", CarrierTarget.SIM2)))
        assertEquals(sim2.copy(virtual = true), CarrierIdentityResolver.profile(routed, 1, emptySet(), listOf("app"), false))
        assertNull(CarrierIdentityResolver.profile(routed.copy(sims = listOf(sim2)), 1, emptySet(), listOf("app"), false))
    }

    @Test fun unassignedLegacyVirtualProfileMustWaitForControllerMigration() {
        val legacy = config.copy(sims = listOf(sim1.copy(virtual = true, virtualSubscriptionId = 0)))
        assertNull(CarrierIdentityResolver.profile(legacy, 1, emptySet(), listOf("app"), false))
        val routed = legacy.copy(mode = CarrierIdentityMode.PER_APP,
            appRoutes = listOf(CarrierAppRoute("app", CarrierTarget.SIM1)))
        assertNull(CarrierIdentityResolver.profile(routed, 2, emptySet(), listOf("app"), false))
        assertEquals(sim1.copy(virtualSubscriptionId = 0),
            CarrierIdentityResolver.profile(legacy, 1, setOf(1), listOf("app"), false))
    }

    @Test fun sharedUidRequiresUnambiguousRulesAndExplicitInheritKeepsSlot() {
        val routed = config.copy(mode = CarrierIdentityMode.PER_APP,
            appRoutes = listOf(CarrierAppRoute("a.app"), CarrierAppRoute("b.app")))
        assertEquals(sim2, CarrierIdentityResolver.profile(routed, 2, setOf(1, 2), listOf("a.app", "b.app"), false))
        assertNull(CarrierIdentityResolver.profile(routed, 2, setOf(1, 2), listOf("a.app", "unlisted.app"), false))
        assertNull(CarrierIdentityResolver.profile(routed, 2, setOf(1, 2), emptyList(), false))
    }
}
```

```kt
package com.system.location.service.core

import com.system.location.service.core.carrier.CarrierAppRoute
import com.system.location.service.core.carrier.CarrierCountries
import com.system.location.service.core.carrier.CarrierIdentityConfig
import com.system.location.service.core.carrier.CarrierIdentityMode
import com.system.location.service.core.carrier.CarrierPresetCatalog
import com.system.location.service.core.carrier.CarrierRadio
import com.system.location.service.core.carrier.CarrierTarget
import com.system.location.service.core.carrier.SimCarrierProfile
import kotlinx.serialization.json.Json
import org.junit.Assert.assertEquals
import org.junit.Assert.assertFalse
import org.junit.Assert.assertNotNull
import org.junit.Assert.assertNull
import org.junit.Assert.assertTrue
import org.junit.Assert.assertThrows
import org.junit.Test

class CarrierIdentityTest {
    private val chinaMobile = SimCarrierProfile(
        slot = 1, countryIso = "CN", mcc = 460, mnc = 0, mncDigits = 2,
        carrierName = "中国移动", operatorName = "China Mobile",
    )
    private val tMobile = SimCarrierProfile(
        slot = 2, countryIso = "US", mcc = 310, mnc = 260, mncDigits = 3,
        carrierName = "T-Mobile", operatorName = "T-Mobile USA", radio = CarrierRadio.NR,
    )

    @Test fun globalIsDefaultAndDoesNotTearDownSystemCallers() {
        val config = CarrierIdentityConfig(sims = listOf(chinaMobile, tMobile))
        assertEquals(CarrierIdentityMode.GLOBAL, config.mode)
        assertEquals(CarrierTarget.INHERIT, config.targetFor("com.example.app", isSystemApp = false))
        assertEquals(CarrierTarget.INHERIT, config.targetFor("android", isSystemApp = true))
        assertEquals("46000", chinaMobile.operatorNumeric)
        assertEquals("310260", tMobile.operatorNumeric)
        assertNotNull(config.profileForSlot(1))
        assertNotNull(config.profileForSlot(2))
    }

    @Test fun perAppModeLeavesUnlistedAndSystemAppsReal() {
        val config = CarrierIdentityConfig(
            mode = CarrierIdentityMode.PER_APP,
            sims = listOf(chinaMobile, tMobile),
            appRoutes = listOf(
                CarrierAppRoute("com.example.one", CarrierTarget.SIM2),
                CarrierAppRoute("com.example.two", CarrierTarget.REAL),
            ),
        )
        assertEquals(CarrierTarget.SIM2, config.targetFor("com.example.one", false))
        assertEquals(CarrierTarget.REAL, config.targetFor("com.example.two", false))
        assertEquals(CarrierTarget.REAL, config.targetFor("com.example.three", false))
        assertEquals(CarrierTarget.REAL, config.targetFor("com.example.one", isSystemApp = true))
        assertEquals(tMobile, config.profileForTarget(CarrierTarget.SIM2))
    }

    @Test fun serializationRoundTripsDualSimAndRoutes() {
        val original = CarrierIdentityConfig(
            mode = CarrierIdentityMode.PER_APP,
            sims = listOf(chinaMobile, tMobile),
            appRoutes = listOf(CarrierAppRoute("com.example.one", CarrierTarget.SIM1)),
        )
        val json = Json.encodeToString(CarrierIdentityConfig.serializer(), original)
        assertEquals(original, Json.decodeFromString(CarrierIdentityConfig.serializer(), json))
    }

    @Test fun rejectsInvalidProfilesAndDuplicateRoutes() {
        assertThrows(IllegalArgumentException::class.java) {
            chinaMobile.copy(mcc = 1_000)
        }
        assertThrows(IllegalArgumentException::class.java) {
            chinaMobile.copy(countryIso = "ZZ")
        }
        assertThrows(IllegalArgumentException::class.java) {
            chinaMobile.copy(countryIso = "cn")
        }
        assertThrows(IllegalArgumentException::class.java) {
            CarrierIdentityConfig(
                sims = listOf(chinaMobile, chinaMobile.copy(mnc = 1)),
            )
        }
        assertThrows(IllegalArgumentException::class.java) {
            CarrierIdentityConfig(
                appRoutes = listOf(
                    CarrierAppRoute("com.example.one"),
                    CarrierAppRoute("com.example.one"),
                ),
            )
        }
    }

    @Test fun allIsoCountriesAreSelectableAndKnownPresetsResolve() {
        assertTrue(CarrierCountries.all.any { it.iso == "CN" })
        assertTrue(CarrierCountries.all.any { it.iso == "US" })
        assertTrue(CarrierCountries.all.size > 200)
        assertTrue(CarrierCountries.isValid("us"))
        assertFalse(CarrierCountries.isValid("ZZ"))
        assertNull(CarrierCountries.defaultMcc("ZZ"))
        assertTrue(CarrierPresetCatalog.forCountry("US").any { it.carrierName == "T-Mobile" })
    }

    @Test fun disabledProfilesAreNotResolvedButRemainSerializable() {
        val config = CarrierIdentityConfig(sims = listOf(chinaMobile.copy(enabled = false)))
        assertNull(config.profileForSlot(1))
        assertTrue(config.sims.single().enabled.not())
    }
}
```

```kt
package com.system.location.service.core

import com.system.location.service.core.carrier.CarrierListPropertyOwnership
import org.junit.Assert.*
import org.junit.Test

class CarrierListPropertyOwnershipTest {
    @Test fun dualSlotsRestoreMissingOriginalElementsAndPreserveUnownedUpdates() {
        val owner = CarrierListPropertyOwnership()
        var current = listOf("real")
        fun set(next: Map<Int, String>) { owner.update(current, next) { current = it } }
        set(mapOf(0 to "One", 1 to "Two"))
        assertEquals(listOf("One", "Two"), current)
        set(mapOf(1 to "New two"))
        assertEquals(listOf("real", "New two"), current)
        current = listOf("external", "New two", "third slot untouched")
        set(emptyMap())
        assertEquals(listOf("external", "", "third slot untouched"), current)
        assertFalse(owner.ownsValues())
    }
    @Test fun externalSameSlotChangeBecomesLatestBaselineOnReapply() {
        val owner = CarrierListPropertyOwnership()
        var current = listOf("original")
        owner.update(current, mapOf(0 to "Portal")) { current = it }
        current = listOf("external")
        owner.update(current, mapOf(0 to "Portal again")) { current = it }
        owner.update(current, emptyMap()) { current = it }
        assertEquals(listOf("external"), current)
    }
    @Test fun failedWriteDoesNotLosePreviousOwnershipAndEmptyOriginalRestoresEmpty() {
        val owner = CarrierListPropertyOwnership()
        var current = emptyList<String>()
        owner.update(current, mapOf(0 to "Portal")) { current = it }
        assertThrows(IllegalStateException::class.java) {
            owner.update(current, emptyMap()) { error("property denied") }
        }
        assertTrue(owner.ownsValues())
        owner.update(current, emptyMap()) { current = it }
        assertTrue(current.isEmpty())
    }
}
```

`core/src/test/kotlin/com/system/location/service/core/CarrierNrCellSourceTest.kt`:

```kt
package com.system.location.service.core

import com.system.location.service.core.carrier.*
import com.system.location.service.core.environment.*
import com.system.location.service.core.geo.Wgs84
import org.junit.Assert.*
import org.junit.Test

class CarrierNrCellSourceTest {
    private val profile = SimCarrierProfile(1, countryIso = "US", mcc = 310, mnc = 260,
        carrierName = "Test NR", nrBand = 77, nrArfcn = 650000)
    private val point = Wgs84(40.7128, -74.0060)

    @Test fun sameInputIsStableAndSimSlotsHaveSeparateIdentities() {
        val first = CarrierNrCellSource.cellsAt(point, 42, profile)
        assertEquals(first, CarrierNrCellSource.cellsAt(point, 42, profile))
        assertNotEquals(first.map { it.cellId },
            CarrierNrCellSource.cellsAt(point, 42, profile.copy(slot = 2)).map { it.cellId })
        assertEquals(1, first.count { it.registered })
        assertEquals(first.size, first.map { it.pci }.distinct().size)
        assertEquals(first.size, first.map { it.cellId }.distinct().size)
        assertTrue(first.all { it.type == CellType.NR && it.operatorNumeric == "310260" &&
            it.arfcn == 650000 && it.bands == listOf(77) && it.pci!! in 0..1007 &&
            it.cellId in 1..CellTower.MAX_NR_NCI })
    }

    @Test fun lteReferencesDoNotReuseLteIdentifiersOrChannelsAsNr() {
        val refs = listOf(CellTower(CellType.LTE, 460, 0, 12, 1234,
            pci = 10, arfcn = 1200, rsrp = -82, registered = true, mncDigits = 2))
        val generated = CarrierNrCellSource.cellsAt(point, 42, profile, refs)
        assertEquals(2, generated.size)
        assertTrue(generated.all { it.type == CellType.NR && it.arfcn != refs[0].arfcn &&
            it.cellId != refs[0].cellId })
        assertEquals(-82, generated.single { it.registered }.rsrp)
    }

    @Test fun channelValidationRejectsWrongBandAndRaster() {
        assertTrue(CarrierNrChannel.valid(41, 520002))
        assertFalse(CarrierNrChannel.valid(41, 520001))
        assertFalse(CarrierNrChannel.valid(78, 680000))
        assertThrows(IllegalArgumentException::class.java) { profile.copy(nrBand = 78, nrArfcn = 680000) }
        val encoded = EnvironmentProfileCodec.encode(EnvironmentProfile(EnvironmentSourceType.PROCEDURAL,
            generatedAtMillis = 0, seed = 42, cells = CarrierNrCellSource.cellsAt(point, 42, profile)))
        assertEquals(listOf(77), EnvironmentProfileCodec.decode(encoded).cells.first().bands)
    }
}
```

```kt
package com.system.location.service.core

import com.system.location.service.core.carrier.CarrierNrChannel
import org.junit.Assert.*
import org.junit.Test

class CarrierNrChannelBoundaryTest {
    @Test fun downlinkRangesDoNotAcceptUplinkOrOutOfBandNumbers() {
        assertTrue(CarrierNrChannel.valid(26, 171800))
        assertTrue(CarrierNrChannel.valid(26, 178800))
        assertFalse(CarrierNrChannel.valid(26, 165000))
        assertTrue(CarrierNrChannel.valid(30, 472000))
        assertFalse(CarrierNrChannel.valid(30, 475000))
        assertTrue(CarrierNrChannel.valid(20, 164200))
        assertFalse(CarrierNrChannel.valid(48, 636666))
        assertTrue(CarrierNrChannel.valid(48, 636667))
    }
    @Test fun fddBandsRequire100KhzRasterNotJustFrequencyWithinRange() {
        for (band in listOf(1, 2, 3, 5, 7, 8, 12, 13, 14, 20, 25, 26, 28, 30, 66, 71)) {
            val channel = CarrierNrChannel.defaultArfcn(band)
            assertTrue("n$band default", CarrierNrChannel.valid(band, channel))
            assertFalse("n$band off raster", CarrierNrChannel.valid(band, channel + 1))
        }
        for (band in CarrierNrChannel.bands) {
            assertTrue("n$band default must be usable", CarrierNrChannel.valid(band, CarrierNrChannel.defaultArfcn(band)))
        }
    }
}
```

`core/src/test/kotlin/com/system/location/service/core/CarrierOverrideOwnershipTest.kt`:

```kt
package com.system.location.service.core

import com.system.location.service.core.carrier.CarrierOverrideOwnership
import org.junit.Assert.*
import org.junit.Test

class CarrierOverrideOwnershipTest {
    private fun restored(baseline: Map<String, Any?>, current: Map<String, Any?>,
        written: Map<String, Any?>): Map<String, Any?> {
        val plan = CarrierOverrideOwnership.restorePlan(baseline, current, written)
        return current.toMutableMap().apply { plan.remove.forEach(::remove); putAll(plan.restore) }
    }

    @Test fun absentOriginalKeysAreRemovedWithoutRemovingOtherOverrides() {
        val baseline = mapOf("volte" to true)
        val patch = mapOf("name" to "Test", "home" to true)
        assertEquals(baseline, restored(baseline, baseline + patch, patch))
    }

    @Test fun restoresExistingOverridesAndPreservesNewUnrelatedValues() {
        val baseline = mapOf("name" to "Original", "home" to false, "volte" to true)
        val patch = mapOf("name" to "Test", "home" to true)
        val current = baseline + patch + mapOf("wifi_calling" to true, "volte" to false)
        assertEquals(mapOf("name" to "Original", "home" to false,
            "volte" to false, "wifi_calling" to true), restored(baseline, current, patch))
    }

    @Test fun preservesAnotherWritersReplacementOrRemovalOfOwnedFields() {
        val baseline = mapOf("name" to "Original", "home" to false)
        val patch = mapOf("name" to "Test", "home" to true)
        assertEquals(mapOf("name" to "Other tool", "home" to false),
            restored(baseline, mapOf("name" to "Other tool", "home" to true), patch))
        assertTrue(restored(baseline, emptyMap(), patch).isEmpty())
    }

    @Test fun repeatedApplyRebasesExternalChangesButKeepsOwnedOriginalValues() {
        val baseline = mapOf("name" to "Original", "home" to false)
        val written = mapOf("name" to "Portal", "home" to true)
        val current = mapOf("name" to "External update", "home" to true)
        val next = mapOf("name" to "Portal new", "home" to true)
        val rebased = CarrierOverrideOwnership.rebase(baseline, current, written, next.keys)
        assertEquals(mapOf("name" to "External update", "home" to false),
            restored(rebased, current + next, next))
        assertEquals("Original", baseline["name"])
    }

    @Test fun repeatedApplyPreservesExternalDeletionAndExplicitNull() {
        val baseline = mapOf("name" to "Original")
        val written = mapOf("name" to "Portal")
        val next = mapOf("name" to "Portal new")
        val deleted = CarrierOverrideOwnership.rebase(baseline, emptyMap(), written, next.keys)
        assertFalse(restored(deleted, next, next).containsKey("name"))
        val nulled = CarrierOverrideOwnership.rebase(baseline, mapOf("name" to null), written, next.keys)
        assertTrue(restored(nulled, next, next).containsKey("name"))
        assertNull(restored(nulled, next, next)["name"])
    }

    @Test fun ownRepeatedUpdatesDoNotReplaceBaselineWithPreviousPortalValue() {
        val baseline = mapOf("name" to "Original")
        val written = mapOf("name" to "Portal")
        assertEquals(baseline, CarrierOverrideOwnership.rebase(baseline, written, written, written.keys))
    }

    @Test fun absentAndExplicitNullHaveDifferentRestorationSemantics() {
        val patch = mapOf("name" to "Test")
        val result = restored(mapOf("name" to null), patch, patch)
        assertTrue(result.containsKey("name"))
        assertNull(result["name"])
        assertTrue(restored(emptyMap(), patch, patch).isEmpty())
    }
}
```

```kt
package com.system.location.service.core

import com.system.location.service.core.carrier.*
import org.junit.Assert.*
import org.junit.Test

class CarrierPhoneNumbersTest {
    @Test fun cityNumbersRespectSevenDigitCityAndOriginalOperatorAllocation() {
        assertTrue(CarrierPhoneNumbers.cities(null).map { it.name }.distinct().size >= 300)
        for (operator in listOf("CMCC", "CUCC", "CTCC")) {
            for (city in CarrierPhoneNumbers.cities(operator)) {
                val number = CarrierPhoneNumbers.generate("CN", city.name, operator)
                assertTrue("$city $number", CarrierPhoneNumbers.belongsToCity(number, city))
                assertTrue(number, CarrierPhoneNumbers.matchesRegion(number, "CN"))
            }
        }
        val numbers = (1..24).map { CarrierPhoneNumbers.generate("CN", "北京市", "CMCC") }.toSet()
        assertTrue(numbers.size > 1)
        assertThrows(IllegalArgumentException::class.java) { CarrierPhoneNumbers.generate("CN", "北京市") }
        assertThrows(IllegalStateException::class.java) { CarrierPhoneNumbers.generate("CN", "不存在城市", "CMCC") }
    }
    @Test fun everyAvailableInternationalRegionGeneratesMatchingNumbers() {
        assertTrue(CarrierPhoneNumbers.regions.size >= 240)
        CarrierPhoneNumbers.regions.filter { it.iso != "CN" }.forEach { region ->
            repeat(4) {
                val number = CarrierPhoneNumbers.generate(region.iso)
                assertTrue("${region.iso}: $number", CarrierPhoneNumbers.matchesRegion(number, region.iso))
                assertEquals(number, CarrierPhoneNumbers.normalize(number))
            }
        }
    }
    @Test fun phoneNumberPersistsAndLegacyConfigDefaultsToEmpty() {
        val old = CarrierIdentityCodec.decode("""{"sims":[{"slot":1,"countryIso":"US","mcc":310,"mnc":260,"carrierName":"Test"}]}""")
        assertEquals("", old.sims.single().phoneNumber)
        val updated = old.copy(sims = listOf(old.sims.single().copy(phoneNumber = "+12025550123")))
        assertEquals(updated, CarrierIdentityCodec.decode(CarrierIdentityCodec.encode(updated)))
        assertEquals("+12025550123", CarrierPhoneNumbers.normalize("+1 (202) 555-0123"))
        assertThrows(IllegalArgumentException::class.java) { CarrierPhoneNumbers.normalize("１３８００１３８０００") }
        assertThrows(IllegalArgumentException::class.java) { updated.sims.single().copy(phoneNumber = "abc") }
    }
}
```

`core/src/test/kotlin/com/system/location/service/core/CarrierPropertyJournalTest.kt`:

```kt
package com.system.location.service.core

import com.system.location.service.core.carrier.*
import kotlinx.serialization.json.Json
import org.junit.Assert.*
import org.junit.Test

class CarrierPropertyJournalTest {
    private fun roundTrip(entry: CarrierPropertyJournalEntry): CarrierPropertyJournalEntry =
        Json.decodeFromString(CarrierPropertyJournalEntry.serializer(),
            Json.encodeToString(CarrierPropertyJournalEntry.serializer(), entry))

    @Test fun crashBeforeOrAfterSetterRestoresOldAndPendingFootprints() {
        val owner = CarrierListPropertyOwnership()
        val old = owner.plan(listOf("real"), mapOf(0 to "old modeled")).state
        owner.restore(old)
        val next = owner.plan(listOf("old modeled"), mapOf(0 to "new modeled", 1 to "two"))
        val journal = roundTrip(CarrierPropertyJournalEntry(old, next.state))
        assertEquals(listOf("real"), journal.recover(listOf("old modeled")))
        assertEquals(listOf("real"), journal.recover(next.values))
        assertEquals(listOf("outside", "outside two"), journal.recover(listOf("outside", "outside two")))
    }

    @Test fun crashDuringWithdrawalAndEmptyOriginalPreserveAbsence() {
        val owner = CarrierListPropertyOwnership()
        val proposal = owner.plan(emptyList(), mapOf(1 to "modeled"))
        owner.restore(proposal.state)
        val withdrawal = owner.plan(proposal.values, emptyMap())
        val journal = roundTrip(CarrierPropertyJournalEntry(owner.snapshot(), withdrawal.state))
        assertTrue(journal.recover(proposal.values).isEmpty())
        assertTrue(journal.recover(withdrawal.values).isEmpty())
    }

    @Test fun planningDoesNotCommitAndRecoveryPreservesOutsidePartialEdits() {
        val owner = CarrierListPropertyOwnership()
        val next = owner.plan(listOf("base one", "base two"), mapOf(0 to "One", 1 to "Two"))
        assertFalse(owner.ownsValues())
        val journal = CarrierPropertyJournalEntry(CarrierListPropertyState(), next.state)
        assertEquals(listOf("outside", "base two"), journal.recover(listOf("outside", "Two")))
    }

    @Test fun malformedStateCannotSelectArbitraryListPositions() {
        val owner = CarrierListPropertyOwnership()
        assertThrows(IllegalArgumentException::class.java) {
            owner.restore(CarrierListPropertyState(written = mapOf("40" to "modeled")))
        }
        assertThrows(IllegalArgumentException::class.java) {
            owner.restore(CarrierListPropertyState(baseline = mapOf("invalid" to "value")))
        }
        assertThrows(IllegalArgumentException::class.java) {
            owner.restore(CarrierListPropertyState(written = mapOf("0" to "a".repeat(1025))))
        }
    }
}
```

`core/src/test/kotlin/com/system/location/service/core/CarrierVirtualIdentityTest.kt`:

```kt
package com.system.location.service.core

import com.system.location.service.core.carrier.CarrierIdentityConfig
import com.system.location.service.core.carrier.CarrierIdentityMode
import com.system.location.service.core.carrier.CarrierNrBandCatalog
import com.system.location.service.core.carrier.CarrierNrChannel
import com.system.location.service.core.carrier.CarrierVirtualIdentity
import com.system.location.service.core.carrier.SimCarrierProfile
import org.junit.Assert.*
import org.junit.Test

class CarrierVirtualIdentityTest {
    private val cn = SimCarrierProfile(1, virtual = true, countryIso = "CN", mcc = 460, mnc = 0,
        mncDigits = 2, carrierName = "China Mobile", nrBand = 41, nrArfcn = 520002)
    private val us = SimCarrierProfile(2, virtual = true, countryIso = "US", mcc = 310, mnc = 260,
        carrierName = "T-Mobile", nrBand = 71, nrArfcn = 127000)
    private val au = SimCarrierProfile(1, virtual = true, countryIso = "AU", mcc = 505, mnc = 1,
        mncDigits = 2, carrierName = "Telstra", nrBand = 78, nrArfcn = 640000)

    @Test fun virtualIdsAreStableValidLengthsAndLuhnChecked() {
        val assigned = us.copy(virtualSubscriptionId = 47)
        assertEquals(47, CarrierVirtualIdentity.subscriptionId(assigned))
        assertEquals(2, CarrierVirtualIdentity.slotForSubscriptionId(47, listOf(assigned)))
        assertNull(CarrierVirtualIdentity.slotForSubscriptionId(900_000_002, listOf(assigned)))
        assertEquals(1, CarrierVirtualIdentity.slotForSubscriptionId(900_000_001)) // legacy recognition
        assertNull(CarrierVirtualIdentity.slotForSubscriptionId(42))
        assertThrows(IllegalArgumentException::class.java) {
            CarrierIdentityConfig(sims = listOf(assigned, assigned.copy(slot = 1)))
        }
        val iccid = CarrierVirtualIdentity.iccid(us)
        assertEquals(20, iccid.length)
        assertTrue(iccid.all(Char::isDigit))
        assertTrue(luhn(iccid))
        val imsi = CarrierVirtualIdentity.imsi(us)
        assertEquals(15, imsi.length)
        assertTrue(imsi.startsWith("310260"))
        assertEquals(iccid, CarrierVirtualIdentity.iccid(us))
        val carrierId = CarrierVirtualIdentity.carrierId(us)
        assertEquals(1, carrierId)
        assertEquals(carrierId, CarrierVirtualIdentity.carrierId(us.copy(slot = 1)))
        assertEquals(1345, CarrierVirtualIdentity.carrierId(au))
        assertEquals(1435, CarrierVirtualIdentity.carrierId(cn))
        assertEquals(-1, CarrierVirtualIdentity.carrierId(us.copy(mcc = 999, mnc = 999)))
    }

    @Test fun seedsSeparateInstallationsAndSurviveDisplayAndRadioChanges() {
        val first = us.copy(identitySeed = 123456789L)
        val second = us.copy(identitySeed = -987654321L)
        assertNotEquals(CarrierVirtualIdentity.imsi(first), CarrierVirtualIdentity.imsi(second))
        assertNotEquals(CarrierVirtualIdentity.iccid(first), CarrierVirtualIdentity.iccid(second))
        val renamed = first.copy(carrierName = "Renamed", operatorName = "Other", nrBand = 77, nrArfcn = 650000)
        assertEquals(CarrierVirtualIdentity.imsi(first), CarrierVirtualIdentity.imsi(renamed))
        assertEquals(CarrierVirtualIdentity.iccid(first), CarrierVirtualIdentity.iccid(renamed))
        val decoded = com.system.location.service.core.carrier.CarrierIdentityCodec.decode(
            com.system.location.service.core.carrier.CarrierIdentityCodec.encode(CarrierIdentityConfig(sims = listOf(first))))
        assertEquals(first, decoded.sims.single())
        assertTrue(CarrierVirtualIdentity.iccid(first).startsWith("891"))
        assertTrue(CarrierVirtualIdentity.iccid(au).startsWith("8961"))
        assertTrue(CarrierVirtualIdentity.iccid(cn).startsWith("8986"))
        for (profile in listOf(first, second, cn, au)) {
            assertTrue(luhn(CarrierVirtualIdentity.iccid(profile)))
            assertEquals(15, CarrierVirtualIdentity.imsi(profile).length)
        }
    }

    @Test fun usAustraliaAndChinaBandCatalogsUseSupportedRasters() {
        assertTrue(CarrierNrBandCatalog.commonBands("US", 310, 260).containsAll(listOf(41, 71, 77, 78)))
        assertTrue(CarrierNrBandCatalog.commonBands("AU", 505, 1).containsAll(listOf(1, 3, 28, 40, 78, 79)))
        assertTrue(CarrierNrBandCatalog.commonBands("CN", 460, 0).containsAll(listOf(41, 78, 79)))
        for (band in CarrierNrChannel.bands) {
            val arfcn = CarrierNrChannel.defaultArfcn(band)
            assertTrue("n$band default $arfcn", CarrierNrChannel.valid(band, arfcn))
        }
        assertTrue(CarrierNrChannel.valid(71, 127000))
        assertTrue(CarrierNrChannel.valid(5, 176000))
        assertTrue(CarrierNrChannel.valid(66, 430000))
        assertFalse(CarrierNrChannel.valid(71, 140000))
    }

    @Test fun virtualProfilesAreSerializableWithoutChangingPhysicalDefaults() {
        val config = CarrierIdentityConfig(mode = CarrierIdentityMode.GLOBAL, sims = listOf(us))
        val encoded = com.system.location.service.core.carrier.CarrierIdentityCodec.encode(config)
        assertTrue(encoded.contains("\"virtual\":true"))
        val decoded = com.system.location.service.core.carrier.CarrierIdentityCodec.decode(encoded)
        assertTrue(decoded.sims.single().virtual)
        assertFalse(SimCarrierProfile(2, countryIso = "US", mcc = 310, mnc = 260,
            carrierName = "x").virtual)
    }

    private fun luhn(number: String): Boolean {
        var sum = 0
        for ((index, char) in number.reversed().withIndex()) {
            var value = char.digitToInt()
            if (index % 2 == 1) {
                value *= 2
                if (value > 9) value -= 9
            }
            sum += value
        }
        return sum % 10 == 0
    }
}
```

```kt
package com.system.location.service.core

class CarrierVirtualTopologyTest {

        mcc = 505, mnc = 1, mncDigits = 2, carrierName = "Test", virtualSubscriptionId = 57 + slot * 13)

        assertNull(CarrierVirtualTopology.subscriptionForPhone(listOf(profile(1).copy(enabled = false)), 0))
        assertNull(CarrierVirtualTopology.subscriptionForPhone(listOf(profile(1).copy(virtual = false)), 0))
        assertArrayEquals(intArrayOf(42, CarrierVirtualIdentity.subscriptionId(profile(2))),
            CarrierVirtualTopology.activeIds(intArrayOf(42, 42), profiles))
        assertArrayEquals(intArrayOf(42), CarrierVirtualTopology.activeIds(intArrayOf(42), emptyList()))
    }
```

`core/src/test/kotlin/com/system/location/service/core/ConfigEnvelopeTest.kt`:

```kt
package com.system.location.service.core

import com.system.location.service.core.config.ConfigCodec
import com.system.location.service.core.config.ConfigEnvelope
import com.system.location.service.core.config.ConfigException
import com.system.location.service.core.geo.Wgs84
import com.system.location.service.core.providers.ProviderKind
import com.system.location.service.core.providers.ProviderProfile
import com.system.location.service.core.routing.AppRoute
import com.system.location.service.core.routing.RoutingConfig
import com.system.location.service.core.routing.RoutingMode
import com.system.location.service.core.scenario.Scenario
import org.junit.Assert.assertEquals
import org.junit.Assert.assertThrows
import org.junit.Assert.assertTrue
import org.junit.Test

class ConfigEnvelopeTest {
    private val scenario = Scenario("point", "point", point = Wgs84(31.2304, 121.4737))
    private val config = ConfigEnvelope(
        revision = 7,
        scenario = scenario,
        routing = RoutingConfig(
            mode = RoutingMode.PER_APP,
            routes = listOf(AppRoute("com.example.map", "point")),
        ),
        updatedAtMillis = 1_790_000_000_000,
    )

    @Test
    fun v3RoundTrips() {
        val withReplay = config.copy(replayEnvironmentJson = """{"wifi":[]}""")
        val decoded = ConfigCodec.decode(ConfigCodec.encode(withReplay))
        assertEquals(withReplay, decoded)
        assertEquals(ConfigEnvelope.CURRENT_SCHEMA_VERSION, decoded.schemaVersion)
        assertEquals("""{"wifi":[]}""", decoded.replayEnvironmentJson)
    }

    @Test
    fun v2IsMigratedWithoutReplayJson() {
        val v2 = ConfigCodec.encode(config).replace(
            "\"schemaVersion\":${ConfigEnvelope.CURRENT_SCHEMA_VERSION}",
            "\"schemaVersion\":2",
        )
        val decoded = ConfigCodec.decode(v2)
        assertEquals(ConfigEnvelope.CURRENT_SCHEMA_VERSION, decoded.schemaVersion)
        assertEquals(7L, decoded.revision)
        assertEquals(null, decoded.replayEnvironmentJson)
        assertEquals(config.routing, decoded.routing)
    }

    @Test
    fun v1IsMigratedWithDefaults() {
        val v1 = """{"schemaVersion":1,"revision":3,"scenario":{"id":"point","name":"point","point":{"latitude":31.2304,"longitude":121.4737}},"updatedAtMillis":123}"""
        val decoded = ConfigCodec.decode(v1)
        assertEquals(ConfigEnvelope.CURRENT_SCHEMA_VERSION, decoded.schemaVersion)
        assertEquals(3L, decoded.revision)
        assertEquals(123L, decoded.updatedAtMillis)
        assertEquals("point", decoded.scenario.id)
        assertEquals(RoutingMode.GLOBAL, decoded.routing.mode)
        assertEquals(3, decoded.providers.size)
    }

    @Test
    fun unknownFieldsAreIgnored() {
        val encoded = ConfigCodec.encode(config).trimEnd().removeSuffix("}") +
            ",\"futureField\":{\"a\":1}}"
        assertEquals(config, ConfigCodec.decode(encoded))
    }

    @Test
    fun futureVersionAndMissingVersionAreRejected() {
        assertThrows(ConfigException::class.java) { ConfigCodec.decode("""{"schemaVersion":99}""") }
        assertThrows(ConfigException::class.java) { ConfigCodec.decode("""{"revision":1}""") }
        assertThrows(ConfigException::class.java) { ConfigCodec.decode("not-json") }
    }

    @Test
    fun invalidEnvelopeIsRejected() {
        assertThrows(IllegalArgumentException::class.java) { config.copy(revision = -1) }
        assertThrows(IllegalArgumentException::class.java) {
            config.copy(providers = listOf(ProviderProfile.GPS, ProviderProfile.GPS))
        }
        assertThrows(IllegalArgumentException::class.java) {
            config.copy(routing = RoutingConfig(mode = RoutingMode.PER_APP, routes = listOf(AppRoute("a", "s"), AppRoute("A", "t"))))
        }
    }

    @Test
    fun encodedJsonCarriesCurrentVersionAndDefaults() {
        val decoded = ConfigCodec.decode(ConfigCodec.encode(config))
        assertTrue(decoded.providers.any { it.kind == ProviderKind.GPS })
        assertTrue(decoded.routing.routes.isNotEmpty())
    }
}
```

`core/src/test/kotlin/com/system/location/service/core/DiagnosticJournalTest.kt`:

```kt
package com.system.location.service.core

import com.system.location.service.core.backend.*
import com.system.location.service.core.repository.DocumentStore
import com.system.location.service.core.runtime.*
import com.system.location.service.core.geo.Wgs84
import com.system.location.service.core.scenario.Scenario
import com.system.location.service.core.location.LocationSample
import kotlinx.coroutines.runBlocking
import kotlinx.serialization.builtins.ListSerializer
import kotlinx.serialization.json.Json
import org.junit.Assert.*
import org.junit.Test

class DiagnosticJournalTest {
    private class Store : DocumentStore {
        var text: String? = null; var fail = false
        override fun read() = text
        override fun writeAtomically(text: String) { if (fail) error("disk full"); this.text = text }
    }
    private fun event(i: Long) = DiagnosticEvent(i, BackendType.MOCK_PROVIDER, "TEST", "INFO", "message $i")
    @Test fun batchUsesOneAtomicWriteAndKeepsCacheOnFailure() {
        var writes = 0
        val store = object : DocumentStore {
            var text: String? = null
            var fail = false
            override fun read() = text
            override fun writeAtomically(text: String) {
                writes++
                if (fail) error("disk full")
                this.text = text
            }
        }
        val journal = DiagnosticJournal(store, maxEvents = 5)
        journal.appendAll((1L..60L).map(::event))
        assertEquals(1, writes)
        assertEquals((56L..60L).toList(), DiagnosticJournal(store).read().map { it.timestamp })
        store.fail = true
        assertThrows(Exception::class.java) { journal.appendAll(listOf(event(61), event(62))) }
        assertEquals((56L..60L).toList(), journal.read().map { it.timestamp })
        assertEquals(journal.read(), DiagnosticJournal(store).read())
        journal.appendAll(emptyList())
        assertEquals(2, writes)
    }
    @Test fun boundedHistorySurvivesRecreationAndFailedWrites() {
        val store = Store(); val journal = DiagnosticJournal(store, maxEvents = 5)
        for (i in 1L..10L) journal.append(event(i))
        assertEquals((6L..10L).toList(), DiagnosticJournal(store).read().map { it.timestamp })
        store.fail = true
        assertThrows(Exception::class.java) { journal.append(event(11)) }
        assertEquals(10L, journal.read().last().timestamp)
        assertEquals(10L, DiagnosticJournal(store).read().last().timestamp)
    }
    @Test fun historyIsAlsoBoundedBySizeAndCorruptionIsReported() {
        val store = Store(); val journal = DiagnosticJournal(store, maxChars = 3000)
        for (i in 1L..10L) journal.append(event(i).copy(reason = "x".repeat(1800)))
        assertTrue(store.text!!.length <= 3000)
        assertEquals(10L, journal.read().last().timestamp)
        store.text = "broken"
        assertThrows(Exception::class.java) { DiagnosticJournal(store).read() }
    }
    @Test fun legacyScenarioNamesAreRemovedFromRestoredAndPersistedHistory() {
        val store = Store()
        val oldEvent = event(1).copy(stage = "CONFIG_STORE", reason = "最近配置：Home address rev=42")
        store.text = Json.encodeToString(ListSerializer(DiagnosticEvent.serializer()), listOf(oldEvent))

        val restored = DiagnosticJournal(store).read().single()

        assertEquals("最近配置已恢复", restored.reason)
        assertFalse(store.text!!.contains("Home address"))
        assertTrue(store.text!!.contains("最近配置已恢复"))
    }
    @Test fun environmentIdentifiersAreRedactedBeforeDiagnosticPersistence() {
        val store = Store()
        val journal = DiagnosticJournal(store)

        journal.append(event(1).copy(reason =
            "ssid=Office Guest bssid=AA:BB:CC:DD:EE:FF cellId=12345 api_key=SecretKey lat=31.2 lon=121.5"))

        for (privateValue in listOf("Office Guest", "AA:BB:CC:DD:EE:FF", "cellId=12345", "SecretKey", "31.2", "121.5")) {
            assertFalse("Persisted diagnostic leaked $privateValue", store.text!!.contains(privateValue))
        }
        assertTrue(DiagnosticJournal(store).read().single().reason.contains("ssid=<redacted>"))
    }
    @Test fun healthTracksRealGapsAndLatencyAndStorageFailureDoesNotStopPlayback() = runBlocking {
        var nanos = 0L
        val backend = object : LocationBackend {
            override val type = BackendType.MOCK_PROVIDER
            override val capabilities = emptyMap<Capability, CapabilityStatus>()
            override suspend fun prepare() = BackendResult.Success
            override suspend fun start() = BackendResult.Success
            override suspend fun publish(sample: LocationSample, scenarioId: String?): BackendResult { nanos += 20_000_000; return BackendResult.Success }
            override suspend fun stop() = BackendResult.Success
            override suspend fun release() = BackendResult.Success
        }
        val controller = ScenarioController({ backend }, object : RuntimeClock {
            override fun nanos() = nanos
            override fun millis() = nanos / 1_000_000
        }, { error("disk full") })
        assertTrue(controller.start(Scenario("s", "s", point = Wgs84(1.0, 2.0))))
        nanos = 5_000_000_000; assertTrue(controller.tick())
        assertEquals(5000.0, controller.state.value.submissionHealth.maxGapMs, 0.0)
        assertEquals(20.0, controller.state.value.submissionHealth.lastLatencyMs, 0.0)
        assertEquals(1L, controller.state.value.submissionHealth.delayedCount)
        assertEquals(1, controller.diagnostics.value.count { it.stage == "DIAGNOSTIC_STORAGE" })
        assertEquals(RuntimePhase.RUNNING, controller.state.value.phase)
    }
}
```
