`core/src/test/kotlin/com/system/location/service/core/GpsLnavAssemblerTest.kt`:

```kt
package com.system.location.service.core

import com.system.location.service.core.gnss.*
import java.util.Base64
import kotlinx.serialization.json.*
import org.junit.Assert.*
import org.junit.Test

class GpsLnavAssemblerTest {
    private val fixture = Json.parseToJsonElement(javaClass.getResource("/gnss/gps-lnav-words-reference.json")!!
        .readText()).jsonObject.getValue("subframes").jsonArray.map { it.jsonObject }
    private fun observation(index: Int): GnssNavigationObservation {
        val f = fixture[index]
        val id = f.getValue("id").jsonPrimitive.int
        val bytes = f.getValue("payloadHex").jsonPrimitive.content.chunked(2).map { it.toInt(16).toByte() }.toByteArray()
        return GnssNavigationObservation(id * 6000L, 0x0101, f.getValue("svid").jsonPrimitive.int,
            1, -1, id, Base64.getEncoder().encodeToString(bytes))
    }
    private fun reference(index: Int) = GpsTime(1316, fixture[index].getValue("nextTowSeconds").jsonPrimitive.double)

    @Test fun acceptsAnyArrivalOrderAndKeepsSatellitesAndFramesIsolated() {
        val assembler = GpsLnavAssembler()
        assertNull(assembler.offer(observation(2), reference(2)).decoded)
        assertNull(assembler.offer(observation(4), reference(4)).decoded)
        assertNull(assembler.offer(observation(0), reference(0)).decoded)
        val result = assembler.offer(observation(1), reference(1))
        assertNotNull(result.reason, result.decoded)
        assertEquals(1, result.decoded!!.ephemeris.svid)
        assertNull(assembler.offer(observation(3), reference(3)).decoded)
        assertEquals(3, assembler.offer(observation(5), reference(5)).decoded!!.ephemeris.svid)
        assertEquals(setOf(1, 3), assembler.completed().map { it.ephemeris.svid }.toSet())
        assembler.clear()
        assertTrue(assembler.completed().isEmpty())
        assertNull(assembler.offer(observation(2), reference(2)).decoded)
    }

    @Test fun duplicateAndInvalidWordsCannotReplaceValidComponents() {
        val assembler = GpsLnavAssembler()
        val first = observation(0)
        assertNull(assembler.offer(first, reference(0)).decoded)
        assertTrue(assembler.completed().isEmpty())
        assertNull(assembler.offer(first, reference(0)).decoded)
        assertNull(assembler.offer(first.copy(dataBase64 = Base64.getEncoder().encodeToString(ByteArray(40))), reference(0)).decoded)
        assertNull(assembler.offer(observation(1), reference(1)).decoded)
        assertNotNull(assembler.offer(observation(2), reference(2)).decoded)
    }

    @Test fun wrongWeekCannotJoinAnOtherwiseMatchingTowAndIssue() {
        val assembler = GpsLnavAssembler()
        assertNull(assembler.offer(observation(0), reference(0)).decoded)
        assertNull(assembler.offer(observation(1), GpsTime(1317, reference(1).secondsOfWeek)).decoded)
        assertNull(assembler.offer(observation(2), reference(2)).decoded)
        assertNull(assembler.offer(observation(1), reference(1)).decoded)
        assertTrue(assembler.completed().isEmpty())
        // A new capture can establish its own coherent full-week domain.
        assembler.clear()
        (0..2).forEach { assembler.offer(observation(it), reference(it)) }
        assertEquals(1, assembler.completed().size)
        assertNull(assembler.offer(observation(0), reference(0).plusSeconds(121.0)).decoded)
    }

    @Test fun conflictingButParityValidDuplicatePoisonsCandidateUntilExplicitReset() {
        val assembler = GpsLnavAssembler()
        val first = observation(0)
        val conflict = conflictingTlm(first)
        assertNotNull(GpsLnavWords.decode(conflict).subframe)
        assertNull(assembler.offer(first, reference(0)).decoded)
        assertTrue(assembler.offer(conflict, reference(0)).reason!!.contains("conflicting"))
        assertNull(assembler.offer(observation(1), reference(1)).decoded)
        assertNull(assembler.offer(observation(2), reference(2)).decoded)
        assertNull(assembler.offer(first, reference(0)).decoded)
        assembler.clear()
        assembler.offer(first, reference(0))
        assembler.offer(observation(1), reference(1))
        assertNotNull(assembler.offer(observation(2), reference(2)).decoded)
    }

    @Test fun lateParityValidConflictRetractsAnAlreadyCompletedEphemeris() {
        val assembler = GpsLnavAssembler()
        (0..2).forEach { assembler.offer(observation(it), reference(it)) }
        assertEquals(1, assembler.completed().size)
        val conflict = conflictingTlm(observation(0))
        assertNotNull(GpsLnavWords.decode(conflict).subframe)
        assertTrue(assembler.offer(conflict, reference(0)).reason!!.contains("conflicting"))
        assertTrue(assembler.completed().isEmpty())
        // Replaying the original complete set cannot silently rehabilitate poisoned evidence.
        (0..2).forEach { assertNull(assembler.offer(observation(it), reference(it)).decoded) }
        assertTrue(assembler.completed().isEmpty())
    }

    private fun conflictingTlm(observation: GnssNavigationObservation) = reencoded(observation, flipTlm = true)

    /** Independently encode Table 20-XIV parity after editing information fields. */
    private fun reencoded(observation: GnssNavigationObservation, flipTlm: Boolean = false,
        shiftSeconds: Int = 0, unhealthy: Boolean = false): GnssNavigationObservation {
        val frame = GpsLnavWords.decode(observation).subframe!!
        val equations = listOf(
            listOf(29,1,2,3,5,6,10,11,12,13,14,17,18,20,23),
            listOf(30,2,3,4,6,7,11,12,13,14,15,18,19,21,24),
            listOf(29,1,3,4,5,7,8,12,13,14,15,16,19,20,22),
            listOf(30,2,4,5,6,8,9,13,14,15,16,17,20,21,23),
            listOf(30,1,3,5,6,7,9,10,14,15,16,17,18,21,22,24),
            listOf(29,3,5,6,8,9,10,11,13,15,19,22,23,24))
        var previous = 0
        val bytes = ByteArray(40)
        repeat(10) { index ->
            var data = frame.unsigned(index * 24, 24).toInt()
            if (index == 0 && flipTlm) data = data xor 0x1000
            if (index == 1) data = (((data ushr 7) + shiftSeconds / 6) shl 7) or (data and 127)
            if (index == 2 && frame.id == 1 && unhealthy) data = data or 4
            fun encoded(value: Int): Int {
                var parity = 0
                equations.forEach { terms ->
                    val bit = terms.fold(0) { acc, term -> acc xor when (term) {
                        29 -> previous ushr 1
                        30 -> previous and 1
                        else -> value ushr (24 - term) and 1
                    } }
                    parity = (parity shl 1) or bit
                }
                val transmitted = value xor if (previous and 1 != 0) 0xFFFFFF else 0
                return (transmitted shl 6) or parity
            }
            if (index == 1 || index == 9) data = (0..3).map { (data and 3.inv()) or it }
                .first { encoded(it) and 3 == 0 }
            val word = encoded(data)
            repeat(4) { bytes[index * 4 + it] = (word ushr (24 - it * 8)).toByte() }
            previous = word and 3
        }
        return observation.copy(dataBase64 = Base64.getEncoder().encodeToString(bytes))
    }

    @Test fun capacityRejectsNewCandidatesAndNeverRehabilitatesConflictOrFallsBackToOldOutput() {
        val assembler = GpsLnavAssembler()
        assertNull(assembler.offer(observation(0), reference(0)).decoded)
        assembler.offer(conflictingTlm(observation(0)), reference(0))
        // Distinct full weeks fill the bounded state without evicting the original poison.
        for (week in 1317..1381) {
            assertNull(assembler.offer(observation(0), GpsTime(week, reference(0).secondsOfWeek)).decoded)
        }
        assertTrue(assembler.offer(observation(0), GpsTime(1382, reference(0).secondsOfWeek)).reason!!.contains("capacity"))
        assertNull(assembler.offer(observation(1), reference(1)).decoded)
        assertNull(assembler.offer(observation(2), reference(2)).decoded)
        assertTrue(assembler.offer(observation(0), reference(0)).reason!!.contains("conflicting"))
        assertTrue(assembler.completed().isEmpty())
    }

    @Test fun incompleteNewerFrameWithdrawsOldCompletedOutputAndLateOldPagesCannotRestoreIt() {
        val assembler = GpsLnavAssembler()
        (0..2).forEach { assembler.offer(observation(it), reference(it)) }
        assertEquals(1, assembler.completed().size)
        val newer = reencoded(observation(0), shiftSeconds = 30, unhealthy = true)
        assertNotNull(GpsLnavWords.decode(newer).subframe)
        assembler.offer(newer, reference(0).plusSeconds(30.0))
        assertTrue(assembler.completed().isEmpty())
        (0..2).forEach { assertNull(assembler.offer(observation(it), reference(it)).decoded) }
        assertTrue(assembler.completed().isEmpty())
        (1..2).forEach { assembler.offer(reencoded(observation(it), shiftSeconds = 30), reference(it).plusSeconds(30.0)) }
        assertTrue(assembler.completed().isEmpty())
    }
}
```

`core/src/test/kotlin/com/system/location/service/core/GpsLnavEphemerisDecoderTest.kt`:

```kt
package com.system.location.service.core

import com.system.location.service.core.gnss.*
import java.util.Base64
import kotlinx.serialization.json.*
import org.junit.Assert.*
import org.junit.Test

class GpsLnavEphemerisDecoderTest {
    private val fixture = Json.parseToJsonElement(javaClass.getResource("/gnss/gps-lnav-words-reference.json")!!
        .readText()).jsonObject
    private val words = fixture.getValue("subframes").jsonArray.map { it.jsonObject }
    private val references = fixture.getValue("decodedEphemerides").jsonArray.map { it.jsonObject }
    private fun JsonObject.n(name: String) = getValue(name).jsonPrimitive.double
    private fun frames(index: Int = 0) = words.drop(index * 3).take(3).map { f ->
        val payload = f.getValue("payloadHex").jsonPrimitive.content.chunked(2).map { it.toInt(16).toByte() }.toByteArray()
        GpsLnavWords.decode(GnssNavigationObservation(1000 + f.n("id").toLong() * 6000,
            0x0101, f.n("svid").toInt(), 1, -1, f.n("id").toInt(),
            Base64.getEncoder().encodeToString(payload))).subframe!!
    }
    private fun reference(frames: List<GpsLnavSubframe>) = GpsTime(1316, frames.first().nextTowSeconds.toDouble())
    private fun altered(frame: GpsLnavSubframe, start: Int = 0, length: Int = 1,
        value: Long = frame.unsigned(start, length), svid: Int = frame.svid,
        nextTow: Int = frame.nextTowSeconds, capturedAt: Long = frame.capturedAtMillis,
        alert: Boolean = frame.alert): GpsLnavSubframe {
        val bytes = ByteArray(30) { frame.unsigned(it * 8, 8).toByte() }
        repeat(length) { i ->
            val bit = start + i
            val mask = 1 shl (7 - bit % 8)
            bytes[bit / 8] = ((bytes[bit / 8].toInt() and mask.inv()) or
                (if (value ushr (length - i - 1) and 1 == 1L) mask else 0)).toByte()
        }
        return GpsLnavSubframe(svid, capturedAt, frame.id, nextTow, alert, bytes)
    }

    @Test fun decodesAllParametersAgainstIndependentPinnedRtkLibCDecoder() {
        references.forEachIndexed { index, r ->
            val f = frames(index)
            val result = GpsLnavEphemerisDecoder.decode(f.reversed(), reference(f))
            assertNotNull(result.reason, result.decoded)
            val e = result.decoded!!.ephemeris
            assertEquals(r.n("week").toInt(), e.toe.week)
            assertEquals(r.n("toe"), e.toe.secondsOfWeek, 0.0)
            assertEquals(e.toe, e.toc)
            assertEquals(r.n("svid").toInt(), e.svid)
            assertEquals(r.n("iodc").toInt(), e.iodc)
            assertEquals(r.n("iode").toInt(), e.iode2)
            assertEquals(e.iode2, e.iode3)
            assertEquals(r.n("health").toInt(), e.health)
            assertEquals(7200.0, e.toe.secondsSince(e.validFrom), 0.0)
            assertEquals(7200.0, e.validUntil.secondsSince(e.toe), 0.0)
            val values = mapOf("sqrtA" to e.sqrtSemiMajorAxis, "e" to e.eccentricity,
                "i0" to e.inclinationRad, "omega0" to e.ascendingNodeRad,
                "omega" to e.argumentOfPerigeeRad, "m0" to e.meanAnomalyRad,
                "deltaN" to e.deltaMeanMotionRadPerSecond, "omegaDot" to e.ascendingNodeRateRadPerSecond,
                "iDot" to e.inclinationRateRadPerSecond, "crc" to e.crcMeters, "crs" to e.crsMeters,
                "cuc" to e.cucRad, "cus" to e.cusRad, "cic" to e.cicRad, "cis" to e.cisRad,
                "af0" to e.af0Seconds, "af1" to e.af1SecondsPerSecond,
                "af2" to e.af2SecondsPerSecondSquared, "tgd" to e.tgdSeconds)
            values.forEach { (name, value) ->
                assertEquals(name, r.n(name), value, Math.ulp(r.n(name)) * 4)
            }
            assertNotNull(GpsBroadcastPropagator.propagate(e, e.toe).state)
        }
    }

    @Test fun refusesPartialMixedStaleAndDifferentTransmissionFramesEvenWithSameIod() {
        val f = frames()
        fun rejected(candidate: List<GpsLnavSubframe>, ref: GpsTime = reference(f)) {
            val result = GpsLnavEphemerisDecoder.decode(candidate, ref)
            assertNotNull(result.reason)
            assertNull(result.decoded)
        }
        rejected(f.take(2))
        rejected(listOf(f[0], f[1], f[1]))
        rejected(listOf(f[0], f[1], altered(f[2], svid = 2)))
        rejected(listOf(f[0], f[1], altered(f[2], nextTow = f[2].nextTowSeconds + 30)))
        rejected(listOf(f[0], f[1], altered(f[2], capturedAt = 100_000)))
        rejected(f, GpsTime(1317, reference(f).secondsOfWeek))
        rejected(f, reference(f).plusSeconds(121.0))
        rejected(listOf(f[0], altered(f[1], 48, 8, 141), f[2]))
        rejected(listOf(f[0], f[1], altered(f[2], 216, 8, 141)))
    }

    @Test fun rejectsAlertUnhealthyReservedUnavailableOrInvalidOrbitData() {
        val f = frames()
        val malformed = listOf(
            listOf(altered(f[0], alert = true), f[1], f[2]),
            listOf(altered(f[0], 64, 6, 1), f[1], f[2]),
            listOf(altered(f[0], 60, 4, 15), f[1], f[2]),
            listOf(altered(f[0], 160, 8, 128), f[1], f[2]),
            listOf(altered(f[0], 176, 16, 0), f[1], f[2]),
            listOf(f[0], altered(f[1], 136, 32, 0xFFFFFFFF), f[2]),
            listOf(f[0], altered(f[1], 184, 32, 0), f[2]),
            listOf(f[0], altered(f[1], 216, 16, 65535), f[2]),
        )
        malformed.forEach { assertNull(GpsLnavEphemerisDecoder.decode(it, reference(f)).decoded) }
    }

    @Test fun resolvesModuloWeekAgainstExplicitTrustedEra() {
        val f = frames()
        val decoded = GpsLnavEphemerisDecoder.decode(f, GpsTime(2340, reference(f).secondsOfWeek)).decoded!!
        assertEquals(2340, decoded.ephemeris.toe.week)
        // Era resolution cannot certify the supplied clock; no wall-clock guess exists here.
        assertNull(GpsLnavEphemerisDecoder.decode(f, GpsTime(2341, reference(f).secondsOfWeek)).decoded)
    }

    @Test fun fitIntervalsFollowAllModernBlockTableRangesAndRejectReservedValues() {
        for (iodc in 0..1023) {
            val normal = iodc in 0..239 || iodc in 256..495 || iodc in 512..751 || iodc in 768..1007
            val expected = when {
                normal -> 6
                iodc in 240..247 -> 8
                iodc in 248..255 || iodc == 496 -> 14
                iodc in 497..503 || iodc in 1021..1023 -> 26
                else -> null
            }
            assertEquals(expected, GpsLnavEphemerisDecoder.fitHours(iodc, true))
            assertEquals(if (normal) 4 else null, GpsLnavEphemerisDecoder.fitHours(iodc, false))
        }
    }
}
```

`core/src/test/kotlin/com/system/location/service/core/GpsLnavWordsTest.kt`:

```kt
package com.system.location.service.core

import com.system.location.service.core.gnss.*
import java.util.Base64
import kotlinx.serialization.json.*
import org.junit.Assert.*
import org.junit.Test

class GpsLnavWordsTest {
    private val fixtures = Json.parseToJsonElement(javaClass.getResource("/gnss/gps-lnav-words-reference.json")!!
        .readText()).jsonObject.getValue("subframes").jsonArray.map { it.jsonObject }
    private fun JsonObject.int(name: String) = getValue(name).jsonPrimitive.int
    private fun String.hexBytes() = chunked(2).map { it.toInt(16).toByte() }.toByteArray()
    private fun observation(f: JsonObject = fixtures.first(), payload: ByteArray =
        f.getValue("payloadHex").jsonPrimitive.content.hexBytes()) =
        GnssNavigationObservation(1_000, 0x0101, f.int("svid"), 1, -1, f.int("id"),
            Base64.getEncoder().encodeToString(payload))

    @Test fun matchesAllNinetyIndependentlyDecodedWordsIncludingDataInversion() {
        fixtures.forEach { f ->
            val result = GpsLnavWords.decode(observation(f))
            assertNotNull(result.reason, result.subframe)
            val frame = result.subframe!!
            assertEquals(f.int("id"), frame.id)
            assertEquals(f.int("nextTowSeconds"), frame.nextTowSeconds)
            assertFalse(frame.alert)
            val expected = f.getValue("decodedHex").jsonPrimitive.content.hexBytes()
            expected.forEachIndexed { i, b -> assertEquals((b.toInt() and 255).toLong(), frame.unsigned(i * 8, 8)) }
        }
    }

    @Test fun everySingleBitCorruptionInThe300BitSubframeIsRejectedEvenWhenReceiverClaimsPassed() {
        val f = fixtures.first()
        val original = f.getValue("payloadHex").jsonPrimitive.content.hexBytes()
        repeat(10) { word -> repeat(30) { bit ->
            val corrupted = original.copyOf()
            val index = word * 4 + 3 - bit / 8
            corrupted[index] = (corrupted[index].toInt() xor (1 shl (bit % 8))).toByte()
            assertNull("word=$word bit=$bit", GpsLnavWords.decode(observation(f, corrupted)).subframe)
        } }
    }

    @Test fun rejectsPaddingTruncationForeignTypesAndConflictingMetadata() {
        val o = observation()
        val bytes = Base64.getDecoder().decode(o.dataBase64)
        bytes[0] = (bytes[0].toInt() or 0x80).toByte()
        assertNull(GpsLnavWords.decode(observation(payload = bytes)).subframe)
        assertNull(GpsLnavWords.decode(observation(payload = bytes.copyOf(39))).subframe)
        assertNull(GpsLnavWords.decode(o.copy(type = 0x0601)).subframe)
        assertNull(GpsLnavWords.decode(o.copy(svid = 33)).subframe)
        assertNull(GpsLnavWords.decode(o.copy(submessageId = 2)).subframe)
        assertNull(GpsLnavWords.decode(o.copy(status = 4)).subframe)
        // An unknown/rebuilt receiver flag is usable only if the actual parity also passes.
        assertNotNull(GpsLnavWords.decode(o.copy(status = 0)).subframe)
        assertNotNull(GpsLnavWords.decode(o.copy(status = 2)).subframe)
    }

    @Test fun signedFieldsPreserveTwosComplementAcrossWordBoundaries() {
        val frame = GpsLnavWords.decode(observation(fixtures[1])).subframe!!
        assertEquals(-1670L, frame.signed(56, 16)) // Crs = -52.1875 m at 2^-5.
        assertEquals(32850L, frame.unsigned(216, 16)) // toe = 525600 seconds at 2^4.
        val third = GpsLnavWords.decode(observation(fixtures[2])).subframe!!
        assertTrue(third.signed(64, 32) < 0) // Omega0 spans two parity-free words.
        assertThrows(IllegalArgumentException::class.java) { frame.unsigned(239, 2) }
        assertThrows(IllegalArgumentException::class.java) { frame.signed(0, 33) }
    }
}
```

`core/src/test/kotlin/com/system/location/service/core/GpsReceiverClockTest.kt`:

```kt
package com.system.location.service.core

import com.system.location.service.core.gnss.*
import org.junit.Assert.*
import org.junit.Test

class GpsReceiverClockTest {
    private fun clock(time: Long, fullBias: Long?, bias: Double?) =
        GnssMeasurementBatch(1, time, fullBias, bias, 4, emptyList())

    @Test fun integerSubtractionPreservesFractionalBiasAtModernGpsEpochs() {
        val result = GpsReceiverClock.decode(clock(100_000_000_123, -1_399_507_100_000_000_000, 0.25)).epoch!!
        assertEquals(2314, result.time.week)
        assertEquals(0.00000012275, result.time.secondsOfWeek, 1e-22)
        assertEquals(4, result.hardwareDiscontinuityCount)
        assertNull(result.timeUncertaintySeconds)
    }

    @Test fun fractionalBiasCanMoveEpochIntoPreviousWeekWithoutLosingPrecision() {
        val result = GpsReceiverClock.decode(clock(100_000_000_000, -1_399_507_100_000_000_000, 0.25)).epoch!!
        assertEquals(2313, result.time.week)
        assertEquals(604800.0 - 0.25e-9, result.time.secondsOfWeek, 0.0)
        assertEquals(GpsTime(2314, 0.0), GpsReceiverClock.decode(clock(100_000_000_000,
            -1_399_507_100_000_000_000, null)).epoch!!.time)
    }

    @Test fun missingFullBiasOrNegativeGpsTimeCannotBecomeAnEpoch() {
        assertNull(GpsReceiverClock.decode(clock(123, null, null)).epoch)
        assertNull(GpsReceiverClock.decode(clock(0, 1, null)).epoch)
        // Integer arithmetic also handles subtracting Long.MIN_VALUE without signed overflow.
        assertNotNull(GpsReceiverClock.decode(clock(Long.MAX_VALUE, Long.MIN_VALUE, null)).epoch)
    }

    @Test fun reportedUncertaintyIsPreservedWithoutAssumingIndependentClockErrors() {
        val batch = clock(100_000_000_000, -1_399_507_100_000_000_000, null).copy(
            timeUncertaintyNanos = 3.0, biasUncertaintyNanos = 4.0,
            elapsedRealtimeNanos = 1_000, elapsedRealtimeUncertaintyNanos = 5.0)
        val epoch = GpsReceiverClock.decode(batch).epoch!!
        assertEquals(7e-9, epoch.timeUncertaintySeconds!!, 0.0)
        assertEquals(5e-9, epoch.elapsedRealtimeUncertaintySeconds!!, 0.0)
        assertEquals(1_000L, epoch.elapsedRealtimeNanos)
        assertNull(GpsReceiverClock.decode(batch.copy(biasUncertaintyNanos = null)).epoch!!.timeUncertaintySeconds)
    }

    @Test fun finiteUncertaintyTermsAreScaledBeforeAdditionToAvoidIntermediateOverflow() {
        val batch = clock(100_000_000_000, -1_399_507_100_000_000_000, null).copy(
            timeUncertaintyNanos = Double.MAX_VALUE, biasUncertaintyNanos = Double.MAX_VALUE)
        val uncertainty = GpsReceiverClock.decode(batch).epoch!!.timeUncertaintySeconds!!
        assertTrue(uncertainty.isFinite())
        assertEquals(Double.MAX_VALUE / 1e9 * 2, uncertainty, 0.0)
    }
}
```

`core/src/test/kotlin/com/system/location/service/core/GpsReceptionGeometryTest.kt`:

```kt
package com.system.location.service.core

import com.system.location.service.core.geo.Wgs84
import com.system.location.service.core.gnss.*
import kotlinx.serialization.json.*
import org.junit.Assert.*
import org.junit.Test

class GpsReceptionGeometryTest {
    private fun resource(name: String) = Json.parseToJsonElement(javaClass.getResource("/gnss/$name")!!.readText()).jsonObject
    private val records = resource("gps-lnav-reference.json").getValue("records").jsonArray.map { it.jsonObject }
    private val cases = resource("gps-reception-reference.json").getValue("cases").jsonArray.map { it.jsonObject }
    private fun JsonObject.n(name: String) = getValue(name).jsonPrimitive.double
    private fun ephemeris(index: Int = 0): GpsLnavEphemeris {
        val r = records[index]
        fun n(name: String) = r.n(name)
        val toe = GpsTime(n("week").toInt(), n("toe"))
        return GpsLnavEphemeris(n("prn").toInt(), toe, GpsTime(n("tocWeek").toInt(), n("tocSeconds")),
            toe.plusSeconds(-7200.0), toe.plusSeconds(7200.0), n("iode").toInt(), n("iode").toInt(),
            n("iodc").toInt(), n("health").toInt(), n("sqrtA"), n("e"), n("i0"), n("omega0"), n("omega"), n("m0"),
            n("deltaN"), n("omegaDot"), n("iDot"), n("cuc"), n("cus"), n("crc"), n("crs"), n("cic"), n("cis"),
            n("af0"), n("af1"), n("af2"), n("tgd"))
    }

    @Test fun matchesIndependentCLightTimeEciRotationAndEnuReferenceAtNineReceptionPoints() {
        cases.forEach { c ->
            val e = ephemeris(c.n("recordIndex").toInt())
            val result = GpsReceptionGeometry.observe(e, e.toe.plusSeconds(c.n("offsetSeconds")),
                Wgs84(c.n("latitude"), c.n("longitude")), c.n("ellipsoidHeightMeters"))
            assertNotNull(result.reason, result.observation)
            val observation = result.observation!!
            val expected = c.getValue("expected").jsonObject
            val values = mapOf("xMeters" to observation.satelliteInReceptionEcef.xMeters,
                "yMeters" to observation.satelliteInReceptionEcef.yMeters,
                "zMeters" to observation.satelliteInReceptionEcef.zMeters,
                "rangeMeters" to observation.lineOfSight.rangeMeters,
                "eastMeters" to observation.lineOfSight.eastMeters,
                "northMeters" to observation.lineOfSight.northMeters, "upMeters" to observation.lineOfSight.upMeters)
            values.forEach { (name, value) -> assertEquals(name, expected.n(name), value, 1e-5) }
            assertEquals(expected.n("propagationSeconds"), observation.propagationSeconds, 1e-12)
            assertEquals(expected.n("elevationDegrees"), observation.lineOfSight.elevationDegrees, 1e-9)
            assertEquals(expected.n("azimuthDegrees"), observation.lineOfSight.azimuthDegrees!!, 1e-9)
            assertEquals(expected.n("clockBiasSeconds"), observation.clockBiasSeconds, 1e-16)
            assertEquals(observation.lineOfSight.rangeMeters,
                observation.propagationSeconds * GpsReceptionGeometry.SPEED_OF_LIGHT_METERS_PER_SECOND, 0.00004)
        }
    }

    @Test fun receptionCanFollowFitEndIfActualTransmissionIsStillInsideFit() {
        val e = ephemeris().let { it.copy(validFrom = it.toe.plusSeconds(-1.0), validUntil = it.toe.plusSeconds(1.0)) }
        val point = Wgs84(31.2304, 121.4737)
        fun at(time: GpsTime) = GpsReceptionGeometry.observe(e, time, point, 50.0)
        val after = at(e.validUntil.plusSeconds(0.05))
        assertNotNull(after.reason, after.observation)
        assertTrue(after.observation!!.transmissionTime.secondsSince(e.validUntil) < 0)
        assertNotNull(at(e.validFrom.plusSeconds(0.15)).observation)
        assertNull(at(e.validFrom.plusSeconds(0.001)).observation)
        assertNull(at(e.validUntil.plusSeconds(0.5)).observation)
        assertNull(at(e.toe.plusSeconds(604800.0)).observation)
        assertNull(GpsReceptionGeometry.observe(e.copy(health = 1), e.toe, point, 50.0).observation)
    }

    @Test fun groupDelayChangesSignalClockOnlyAndEarthRotationIsAppliedOnce() {
        val e = ephemeris()
        val observer = Wgs84(31.2304, 121.4737)
        val a = GpsReceptionGeometry.observe(e, e.toe, observer, 50.0).observation!!
        val b = GpsReceptionGeometry.observe(e.copy(tgdSeconds = e.tgdSeconds + 1e-8), e.toe, observer, 50.0).observation!!
        assertEquals(a.satelliteInReceptionEcef, b.satelliteInReceptionEcef)
        assertEquals(a.clockBiasSeconds, b.clockBiasSeconds, 0.0)
        assertEquals(a.l1CaClockBiasSeconds - 1e-8, b.l1CaClockBiasSeconds, 1e-19)
        val transmitted = GpsBroadcastPropagator.propagate(e, a.transmissionTime).state!!
        val displacement = kotlin.math.hypot(transmitted.xMeters - a.satelliteInReceptionEcef.xMeters,
            transmitted.yMeters - a.satelliteInReceptionEcef.yMeters)
        assertTrue("nonzero flight time must rotate the ECEF axes", displacement > 1.0)
        assertEquals(transmitted.zMeters, a.satelliteInReceptionEcef.zMeters, 0.0)
    }

    @Test fun receptionAcrossFullWeekBoundaryRemainsContinuous() {
        val base = ephemeris()
        val toe = GpsTime(1316, 604799.0)
        val e = base.copy(toe = toe, toc = toe, validFrom = toe.plusSeconds(-7200.0), validUntil = toe.plusSeconds(7200.0))
        val observer = Wgs84(20.0, 40.0)
        val before = GpsReceptionGeometry.observe(e, toe.plusSeconds(0.999), observer, 0.0).observation!!
        val after = GpsReceptionGeometry.observe(e, toe.plusSeconds(1.001), observer, 0.0).observation!!
        assertTrue(kotlin.math.abs(after.lineOfSight.rangeMeters - before.lineOfSight.rangeMeters) < 10)
        assertTrue(after.transmissionTime.secondsSince(before.transmissionTime) in 0.0019..0.0021)
    }
}
```

`core/src/test/kotlin/com/system/location/service/core/GpsTimeTest.kt`:

```kt
package com.system.location.service.core

import com.system.location.service.core.gnss.GpsTime
import org.junit.Assert.*
import org.junit.Test

class GpsTimeTest {
    @Test fun fullWeekBoundaryPreservesTheActualElapsedInterval() {
        val previous = GpsTime(2000, 604799.75)
        val next = previous.plusSeconds(0.5)
        assertEquals(GpsTime(2001, 0.25), next)
        assertEquals(0.5, next.secondsSince(previous), 0.0)
        assertEquals(previous, next.plusSeconds(-0.5))
        // Equal time-of-week one week later is old evidence, not a zero-age orbit.
        assertEquals(604800.0, GpsTime(2001, 42.0).secondsSince(GpsTime(2000, 42.0)), 0.0)
    }

    @Test fun rejectsNonFiniteAmbiguousAndOutOfDomainTime() {
        for (seconds in listOf(-1.0, 604800.0, Double.NaN, Double.POSITIVE_INFINITY)) {
            assertThrows(IllegalArgumentException::class.java) { GpsTime(2000, seconds) }
        }
        assertThrows(IllegalArgumentException::class.java) { GpsTime(-1, 0.0) }
        assertThrows(IllegalArgumentException::class.java) { GpsTime(0, 0.0).plusSeconds(-1.0) }
        assertThrows(IllegalArgumentException::class.java) { GpsTime(2000, 0.0).plusSeconds(Double.POSITIVE_INFINITY) }
    }
}
```

`core/src/test/kotlin/com/system/location/service/core/GpsYumaParserTest.kt`:

```kt
package com.system.location.service.core

import com.system.location.service.core.gnss.*
import org.junit.Assert.*
import org.junit.Test

class GpsYumaParserTest {
    // Synthetic parameters in the published CelesTrak Yuma format; not handset observations.
    private val record = """
        ******** Week 396 almanac for PRN-01 ********
        ID:                         01
        Health:                     000
        Eccentricity:               0.002
        Time of Applicability(s):   503808.0000
        Orbital Inclination(rad):   0.955
        Rate of Right Ascen(r/s):  -0.8E-008
        SQRT(A)  (m 1/2):           5153.68
        Right Ascen at Week(rad):  -1.37
        Argument of Perigee(rad):   0.14
        Mean Anom(rad):            -1.18
        Af0(s):                     0.1E-003
        Af1(s/s):                  -0.7E-011
        week:                      396
    """.trimIndent()

    @Test fun resolvesTruncatedWeekOnceAndPreservesAbsoluteInclination() {
        val parsed = GpsYumaParser.parse(record, 2444).single()
        assertEquals(GpsTime(2444, 503808.0), parsed.referenceTime)
        assertEquals(0.955, parsed.inclinationRad, 0.0)
        assertEquals(-8e-9, parsed.ascendingNodeRateRadPerSecond, 1e-24)
        assertEquals(0, parsed.health)
        assertEquals(1, parsed.svid)
        assertEquals(parsed, GpsYumaParser.parse(record.replace("E-", "D-"), 2444).single())
    }

    @Test fun fullWeeksAndRolloverAreUnambiguousWithExternalAnchor() {
        assertEquals(2048, GpsYumaParser.parse(record.replace("week:                      396",
            "week: 0"), 2047).single().referenceTime.week)
        assertEquals(2444, GpsYumaParser.parse(record.replace("week:                      396",
            "week: 2444"), 2444).single().referenceTime.week)
        assertThrows(IllegalArgumentException::class.java) { GpsYumaParser.parse(record, 1932) }
        assertThrows(IllegalArgumentException::class.java) { GpsYumaParser.parse(record, -1) }
    }

    @Test fun rejectsPartialDuplicateUnknownAndNonFiniteRecords() {
        val invalid = listOf("", record.substringBefore("Af1(s/s)"), "$record\n$record",
            "$record\nHealth: 0", record.replace("Health:", "Mystery:"),
            record.replace("0.955", "NaN"), record.replace("503808.0000", "604800"),
            record.replace("0.002", "-0.1"), record.replace("01\nHealth", "33\nHealth"),
            record.replace("0.8E-008", "Infinity"))
        for (text in invalid) assertThrows(IllegalArgumentException::class.java) {
            GpsYumaParser.parse(text, 2444)
        }
        assertThrows(IllegalArgumentException::class.java) {
            GpsYumaParser.parse(" ".repeat(GpsYumaParser.MAX_BYTES + 1), 2444)
        }
    }

    @Test fun entireUpdateRejectsMixedEpochsButDoesNotDiscardUnhealthyRecords() {
        val second = record.replace("ID:                         01", "ID: 02")
            .replace("Health:                     000", "Health: 63")
        val parsed = GpsYumaParser.parse("$record\n\n$second", 2444)
        assertEquals(listOf(1, 2), parsed.map { it.svid })
        assertEquals(63, parsed.last().health)
        assertThrows(IllegalArgumentException::class.java) {
            GpsYumaParser.parse("$record\n\n${second.replace("503808.0000", "409600")}", 2444)
        }
    }
}
```

`core/src/test/kotlin/com/system/location/service/core/GpxCodecTest.kt`:

```kt
package com.system.location.service.core

import com.system.location.service.core.gpx.GpxCodec
import com.system.location.service.core.geo.Wgs84
import com.system.location.service.core.scenario.Route
import org.junit.Assert.*
import org.junit.Test

class GpxCodecTest {
    @Test fun exportRejectsXml10IllegalCharactersAndUnpairedSurrogates() {
        val illegal = (0..0x1f).filter { it !in listOf(0x9, 0xa, 0xd) }.map { it.toChar().toString() } +
            listOf("\uFFFE", "\uFFFF", "\uD800", "\uDC00", "\uD800x", "\uDC00\uD800")
        illegal.forEach { value ->
            val name = "路线${value}名称"
            val route = largeRoute("a", 2).copy(name = name)
            assertThrows("XML 1.0 must reject ${value.toCharArray().map { it.code }}",
                IllegalArgumentException::class.java) { GpxCodec.encode(listOf(route)) }
        }
    }

    @Test fun exportPreservesLegalUnicodeIncludingSupplementaryCodePointsAndXmlWhitespace() {
        val name = "路线\t\n\r & < > \" ' \u007F\u0085\uD7FF\uE000\uFFFD" +
            String(Character.toChars(0x10000)) + "🚶" + String(Character.toChars(0x10ffff)) + "终"
        val route = largeRoute("a", 2).copy(name = name)
        val xml = GpxCodec.encode(listOf(route))
        assertTrue(xml.contains("🚶"))
        assertEquals(name, GpxCodec.decode(xml).single().name)
    }

    @Test fun roundTripPreservesCoordinatesNamesAndSeparateTracks() {
        val routes = listOf(Route("a", "A & <路线>", listOf(Wgs84(25.1234567890123, 119.1), Wgs84(25.2, 119.2))),
            Route("b", "B", listOf(Wgs84(-30.0, 150.0), Wgs84(-30.1, 150.1))))
        val parsed = GpxCodec.decode(GpxCodec.encode(routes))
        assertEquals(routes.map { it.points }, parsed.map { it.points })
        assertEquals(routes.map { it.name }, parsed.map { it.name })
    }
    @Test fun twoSixtyThousandPointRoutesRoundTripTogether() {
        val routes = listOf(largeRoute("a", 60_000), largeRoute("b", 60_000))
        val decoded = GpxCodec.decode(GpxCodec.encode(routes))
        assertEquals(routes.map { it.name }, decoded.map { it.name })
        assertEquals(routes.map { it.points }, decoded.map { it.points })
    }

    @Test fun totalPointLimitIsTheSameForImportAndExport() {
        val atLimit = listOf(largeRoute("a", 100_000), largeRoute("b", 100_000))
        assertEquals(atLimit.map { it.points }, GpxCodec.decode(GpxCodec.encode(atLimit)).map { it.points })
        val overLimit = atLimit + largeRoute("c", 2)
        assertThrows(IllegalArgumentException::class.java) { GpxCodec.encode(overLimit) }
        val xml = GpxCodec.encode(atLimit).replace("</gpx>",
            "<rte><rtept lat=\"1\" lon=\"3\"/><rtept lat=\"2\" lon=\"3\"/></rte></gpx>")
        assertThrows(IllegalArgumentException::class.java) { GpxCodec.decode(xml) }
    }

    @Test fun routeCountLimitIsTheSameForImportAndExport() {
        val route = largeRoute("a", 2)
        val atLimit = List(10_000) { route }
        assertEquals(10_000, GpxCodec.decode(GpxCodec.encode(atLimit)).size)
        assertThrows(IllegalArgumentException::class.java) { GpxCodec.encode(atLimit + route) }
        val xml = GpxCodec.encode(atLimit).replace("</gpx>",
            "<rte><rtept lat=\"1\" lon=\"3\"/><rtept lat=\"2\" lon=\"3\"/></rte></gpx>")
        assertThrows(IllegalArgumentException::class.java) { GpxCodec.decode(xml) }
    }

    @Test fun eachRouteIsLimitedBeforeDuplicateCoordinatesAreRemoved() {
        val xml = "<gpx><rte>" + "<rtept lat=\"1\" lon=\"3\"/>".repeat(100_000) +
            "<rtept lat=\"2\" lon=\"3\"/></rte></gpx>"
        assertThrows(IllegalArgumentException::class.java) { GpxCodec.decode(xml) }
        val mutablePoints = largeRoute("a", 2).points.toMutableList()
        val route = Route("a", "a", mutablePoints)
        repeat(99_999) { mutablePoints += Wgs84(1.0, 3.0) }
        assertThrows(IllegalArgumentException::class.java) { GpxCodec.encode(listOf(route)) }
    }

    @Test fun exportRejectsRoutesThatWouldDisappearDuringImport() {
        val point = Wgs84(1.0, 3.0)
        val collapsed = Route("a", "a", listOf(point, point))
        assertThrows(IllegalArgumentException::class.java) { GpxCodec.encode(listOf(collapsed)) }
        assertThrows(IllegalArgumentException::class.java) { GpxCodec.encode(listOf(largeRoute("b", 2), collapsed)) }
    }

    private fun largeRoute(id: String, count: Int) = Route(id, id,
        List(count) { Wgs84(if (it % 2 == 0) 1.0 else 2.0, 3.0) })

    @Test fun extensionsCannotCloseOrInjectTrackSegments() {
        val parsed = GpxCodec.decode("""<gpx xmlns="http://www.topografix.com/GPX/1/1" xmlns:e="urn:extension"><trk><name>T</name><trkseg><trkpt lat="1" lon="2"><extensions><e:trkseg><e:trkpt lat="8" lon="9"/></e:trkseg></extensions></trkpt><trkpt lat="1.1" lon="2"/></trkseg></trk></gpx>""")
        assertEquals(listOf(Wgs84(1.0, 2.0), Wgs84(1.1, 2.0)), parsed.single().points)
    }
    @Test fun segmentsAreNotConnectedAndWaypointsAreNotInventedAsARoute() {
        val parsed = GpxCodec.decode("""<gpx><wpt lat="0" lon="0"/><trk><name>T</name><trkseg><trkpt lat="1" lon="2"/><trkpt lat="1.1" lon="2"/></trkseg><trkseg><trkpt lat="8" lon="9"/><trkpt lat="8.1" lon="9"/></trkseg></trk><rte><name>R</name><rtept lat="10" lon="20"/><rtept lat="10" lon="21"/></rte></gpx>""")
        assertEquals(3, parsed.size)
        assertEquals(Wgs84(8.0, 9.0), parsed[1].points.first())
    }
    @Test fun invalidCoordinatesMalformedXmlAndEntitiesFailTheWholeImport() {
        listOf("<gpx><rte><rtept lat=\"NaN\" lon=\"1\"/></rte></gpx>",
            "<gpx><rte><rtept lat=\"91\" lon=\"1\"/></rte></gpx>", "<gpx>",
            "<!DOCTYPE gpx [<!ENTITY x SYSTEM 'file:///secret'>]><gpx>&x;</gpx>",
            "<gpx><wpt lat=\"1\" lon=\"2\"/></gpx>").forEach { xml ->
            assertThrows(Exception::class.java) { GpxCodec.decode(xml) }
        }
    }
}
```

`core/src/test/kotlin/com/system/location/service/core/HookConfigurationTest.kt`:

```kt
package com.system.location.service.core

import com.system.location.service.core.geo.Wgs84
import com.system.location.service.core.gnss.*
import com.system.location.service.core.location.LocationSample
import com.system.location.service.core.runtime.*
import kotlinx.serialization.json.Json
import org.junit.Assert.*
import org.junit.Test

class HookConfigurationTest {
    private val point = Wgs84(31.0, 121.0)
    private val sample = LocationSample(point, 10.0, 5f, 0f, 0f, 62000, 1000)
    private fun payload(svid: Int): String = GnssCaptureWire.encode(GnssCapture(deviceModel = "receiver", osVersion = "os",
        startedAtMillis = 1000, endedAtMillis = 61000,
        frames = (0..60).map { GnssObservationFrame(1000 + it * 1000L, point,
            satellites = listOf(GnssSatellite(Constellation.GPS, svid, 30f, 120f, 35f, true, true, true))) }))

    @Test fun replacingConfigurationKeepsOldSourceAndDistinctMonotonicPublications() {
        val firstPayload = payload(1)
        val firstSource = CapturedGnssSource.prepare(firstPayload)!!
        val original = RuntimeSnapshot(configuration = HookConfiguration(enabled = true, gnssSource = firstSource))
        val store = RuntimeSnapshotStore(original)
        val before = firstSource.frame(sample, 0, GnssFrameRoute.Global, 62000)!!
        val secondSource = CapturedGnssSource.prepare(payload(2), firstSource)!!
        store.update { it.copy(configuration = it.configuration.copy(gnssSource = secondSource, minimumSatellites = 8)) }
        val after = secondSource.frame(sample, 8, GnssFrameRoute.Global, 62000)!!
        assertEquals(1, before.frame.satellites.single().svid)
        assertEquals(2, after.frame.satellites.single().svid)
        assertTrue(after.sequence > before.sequence)
        assertSame(before, original.configuration.gnssSource!!.frame(sample, 0, GnssFrameRoute.Global, 62000))
        assertSame(firstSource, CapturedGnssSource.prepare(firstPayload, firstSource))
        assertThrows(IllegalArgumentException::class.java) { CapturedGnssSource.prepare("!!", secondSource) }
        assertSame(secondSource, store.current().configuration.gnssSource)
    }

    @Test fun sourceEvidenceAndPublicationCacheCannotEnterSerializedRuntimeState() {
        val source = CapturedGnssSource.prepare(payload(1))!!
        val state = RuntimeSnapshot(configuration = HookConfiguration(enabled = true, minimumSatellites = 7, gnssSource = source))
        val json = Json { encodeDefaults = true }
        val encoded = json.encodeToString(RuntimeSnapshot.serializer(), state)
        assertFalse(encoded.contains("gnssSource"))
        assertFalse(encoded.contains("receiver"))
        val restored = json.decodeFromString(RuntimeSnapshot.serializer(), encoded)
        assertTrue(restored.configuration.enabled)
        assertEquals(7, restored.configuration.minimumSatellites)
        assertNull(restored.configuration.gnssSource)
    }

    @Test fun boundsCannotBeBypassedByAnAtomicConfigurationCopy() {
        assertThrows(IllegalArgumentException::class.java) { HookConfiguration(minimumSatellites = -1) }
        assertThrows(IllegalArgumentException::class.java) { HookConfiguration(minimumSatellites = 129) }
        assertThrows(IllegalArgumentException::class.java) { HookConfiguration(reportIntervalMs = 49) }
        assertThrows(IllegalArgumentException::class.java) { HookConfiguration(sensorCadenceScale = Double.NaN) }
        assertThrows(IllegalArgumentException::class.java) { HookConfiguration(sensorVariation = 0.6) }
    }
}
```

`core/src/test/kotlin/com/system/location/service/core/KeplerOrbitTest.kt`:

```kt
package com.system.location.service.core

import com.system.location.service.core.gnss.DopplerShift
import com.system.location.service.core.gnss.KeplerElements
import com.system.location.service.core.gnss.KeplerOrbit
import org.junit.Assert.assertEquals
import org.junit.Assert.assertThrows
import org.junit.Assert.assertTrue
import org.junit.Test
import kotlin.math.PI

class KeplerOrbitTest {
    private val circular = KeplerElements(
        semiMajorAxisMeters = 7_000_000.0,
        eccentricity = 0.0,
        inclinationRad = 0.0,
        raanRad = 0.0,
        argumentOfPerigeeRad = 0.0,
        meanAnomalyRad = 0.0,
        epochSeconds = 0.0,
    )

    @Test fun circularOrbitStartsOnXAxis() {
        val position = KeplerOrbit(circular).positionAt(0.0)
        assertEquals(7_000_000.0, position.x, 1.0)
        assertEquals(0.0, position.y, 1.0)
        assertEquals(0.0, position.z, 1.0)
        assertEquals(7_000_000.0, position.radiusMeters, 1.0)
    }

    @Test fun onePeriodReturnsToStart() {
        val orbit = KeplerOrbit(circular)
        val start = orbit.positionAt(0.0)
        val end = orbit.positionAt(orbit.orbitalPeriodSeconds())
        assertEquals(start.x, end.x, 10.0)
        assertEquals(start.y, end.y, 10.0)
        assertEquals(start.z, end.z, 10.0)
    }

    @Test fun inclinedOrbitHasZComponent() {
        val inclined = circular.copy(inclinationRad = PI / 2)
        val position = KeplerOrbit(inclined).positionAt(0.0)
        assertEquals(0.0, position.z, 1.0)
        val quarter = KeplerOrbit(inclined).positionAt(KeplerOrbit(inclined).orbitalPeriodSeconds() / 4)
        assertTrue(quarter.z > 6_000_000.0)
    }

    @Test fun eccentricOrbitRadiusStaysWithinBounds() {
        val eccentric = circular.copy(eccentricity = 0.2)
        val orbit = KeplerOrbit(eccentric)
        (0..10).forEach { step ->
            val radius = orbit.positionAt(step * orbit.orbitalPeriodSeconds() / 10).radiusMeters
            assertTrue(radius >= 7_000_000.0 * 0.8 - 10)
            assertTrue(radius <= 7_000_000.0 * 1.2 + 10)
        }
    }

    @Test fun dopplerShiftSignFollowsRangeRate() {
        assertTrue(DopplerShift.observedHz(1_575_420_000.0, 100.0) < 1_575_420_000.0)
        assertTrue(DopplerShift.observedHz(1_575_420_000.0, -100.0) > 1_575_420_000.0)
    }

    @Test fun invalidElementsAndTimeAreRejected() {
        assertThrows(IllegalArgumentException::class.java) { circular.copy(eccentricity = 1.0) }
        assertThrows(IllegalArgumentException::class.java) { circular.copy(semiMajorAxisMeters = 1.0) }
        assertThrows(IllegalArgumentException::class.java) { KeplerOrbit(circular).positionAt(Double.NaN) }
        assertThrows(IllegalArgumentException::class.java) { DopplerShift.observedHz(0.0, 1.0) }
    }
}
```

`core/src/test/kotlin/com/system/location/service/core/LatestStateWorkerTest.kt`:

```kt
package com.system.location.service.core

import com.system.location.service.core.runtime.LatestStateWorker
import java.util.concurrent.CopyOnWriteArrayList
import java.util.concurrent.CountDownLatch
import java.util.concurrent.TimeUnit
import org.junit.Assert.*
import org.junit.Test

class LatestStateWorkerTest {
    @Test fun oneWorkerThreadServesSuccessivePublicationsWithoutOverlappingDelivery() {
        val threads = CopyOnWriteArrayList<Thread>()
        val completed = java.util.concurrent.LinkedBlockingQueue<Int>()
        val worker = LatestStateWorker<Int>({ state ->
            threads.add(Thread.currentThread())
            completed.put(state)
        }, { throw AssertionError(it) })
        try {
            repeat(100) { state ->
                assertTrue(worker.offer(state))
                assertEquals(state, completed.poll(5, TimeUnit.SECONDS))
            }
            assertEquals(1, threads.toSet().size)
        } finally { worker.close() }
    }

    @Test fun blockedReceiverOnlyGetsInFlightAndLatestCompleteState() {
        val entered = CountDownLatch(1)
        val release = CountDownLatch(1)
        val done = CountDownLatch(1)
        val received = CopyOnWriteArrayList<Int>()
        val failures = CopyOnWriteArrayList<Throwable>()
        val worker = LatestStateWorker<Int>({ state ->
            received.add(state)
            if (state == 1) {
                entered.countDown()
                check(release.await(5, TimeUnit.SECONDS))
            } else done.countDown()
        }, failures::add)
        try {
            assertTrue(worker.offer(1))
            assertTrue(entered.await(5, TimeUnit.SECONDS))
            (2..10_000).forEach { assertTrue(worker.offer(it)) }
            assertEquals(listOf(1), received.toList())
            release.countDown()
            assertTrue(done.await(5, TimeUnit.SECONDS))
            assertEquals(listOf(1, 10_000), received.toList())
            assertTrue(failures.isEmpty())
        } finally { release.countDown(); worker.close() }
    }

    @Test fun closeDiscardsPendingAndNeverRestartsWhileOldDeliveryIsInFlight() {
        val entered = CountDownLatch(1)
        val release = CountDownLatch(1)
        val done = CountDownLatch(1)
        val received = CopyOnWriteArrayList<Int>()
        val worker = LatestStateWorker<Int>({ state ->
            received.add(state)
            entered.countDown()
            check(release.await(5, TimeUnit.SECONDS))
            done.countDown()
        }, { throw AssertionError(it) })
        try {
            worker.offer(1)
            assertTrue(entered.await(5, TimeUnit.SECONDS))
            worker.offer(2)
            worker.close()
            assertFalse(worker.offer(3))
            release.countDown()
            assertTrue(done.await(5, TimeUnit.SECONDS))
            assertEquals(listOf(1), received.toList())
        } finally { release.countDown(); worker.close() }
    }

    @Test fun failedDeliveryClosesMailboxAndNotifiesOwner() {
        val failed = CountDownLatch(1)
        val error = IllegalStateException("dead peer")
        val worker = LatestStateWorker<Int>({ throw error }, { assertSame(error, it); failed.countDown() })
        worker.offer(1)
        assertTrue(failed.await(5, TimeUnit.SECONDS))
        assertFalse(worker.offer(2))
    }
}
```

```kt
package com.system.location.service.core

import com.system.location.service.core.geo.Wgs84
import com.system.location.service.core.location.LocationBatchTimeline
import com.system.location.service.core.location.LocationSample
import org.junit.Assert.assertEquals
import org.junit.Assert.assertNotEquals
import org.junit.Assert.assertThrows
import org.junit.Assert.assertTrue
import org.junit.Test

class LocationBatchTimelineTest {
    private val endpoint = LocationSample(
        coordinate = Wgs84(31.0, 121.0),
        altitude = 20.0,
        accuracy = 5f,
        speed = 2f,
        bearing = 90f,
        timeMillis = 10_000L,
        elapsedNanos = 10_000_000_000L,
    )

    @Test fun batchUsesSyntheticMotionAndPairedMonotonicClocks() {
        val batch = LocationBatchTimeline.synthesize(endpoint, count = 3, intervalMillis = 1_000L)

        assertEquals(3, batch.size)
        assertEquals(listOf(8_000L, 9_000L, 10_000L), batch.map { it.timeMillis })
        assertEquals(listOf(8_000_000_000L, 9_000_000_000L, 10_000_000_000L),
            batch.map { it.elapsedNanos })
        assertNotEquals(batch[0].coordinate, batch[1].coordinate)
        assertNotEquals(batch[1].coordinate, batch[2].coordinate)
        assertEquals(endpoint.coordinate, batch.last().coordinate)
        assertTrue(batch.all { it.speed == endpoint.speed && it.bearing == endpoint.bearing })
    }

    @Test fun stationaryBatchKeepsCoordinatesButStillHasDistinctTimes() {
        val batch = LocationBatchTimeline.synthesize(endpoint.copy(speed = 0f), count = 3, intervalMillis = 500L)

        assertEquals(listOf(endpoint.coordinate, endpoint.coordinate, endpoint.coordinate),
            batch.map { it.coordinate })
        assertEquals(listOf(9_000L, 9_500L, 10_000L), batch.map { it.timeMillis })
    }

    @Test fun insufficientClockHistoryFallsBackToOneValidEndpoint() {
        val recent = endpoint.copy(timeMillis = 1L, elapsedNanos = 1L)

        assertEquals(listOf(recent), LocationBatchTimeline.synthesize(recent, count = 4, intervalMillis = 1_000L))
    }

    @Test fun oversizedBatchesAreRejected() {
        assertThrows(IllegalArgumentException::class.java) {
            LocationBatchTimeline.synthesize(endpoint, LocationBatchTimeline.MAX_BATCH_SIZE + 1, 100L)
        }
    }
}
```

```kt
package com.system.location.service.core

import com.system.location.service.core.geo.Wgs84
import com.system.location.service.core.location.LocationFieldPolicy
import com.system.location.service.core.location.LocationSample
import com.system.location.service.core.location.LocationSanitizer
import com.system.location.service.core.scenario.MovementProfile
import org.junit.Assert.assertEquals
import org.junit.Assert.assertThrows
import org.junit.Assert.assertTrue
import org.junit.Test

class LocationSanitizerTest {

    private fun sample(
        speed: Float = 0f,
        accuracy: Float = 8f,
        altitude: Double = 80.0,
    ) = LocationSample(
        coordinate = Wgs84(31.2304, 121.4737),
        altitude = altitude,
        accuracy = accuracy,
        speed = speed,
        bearing = 0f,
        timeMillis = 1_790_000_000_000,
        elapsedNanos = 1_000_000_000,
    )

    @Test
    fun verticalAccuracyIsWorseThanHorizontal() {
        val fields = LocationSanitizer.fieldsFor(sample(accuracy = 8f))
        assertTrue(fields.verticalAccuracyMeters > 8f)
    }

    @Test
    fun stationaryFixHasNoBearingOrSpeedAccuracy() {
        val fields = LocationSanitizer.fieldsFor(sample(speed = 0f))
        assertEquals(0f, fields.speedAccuracyMetersPerSecond, 0f)
        assertEquals(0f, fields.bearingAccuracyDegrees, 0f)
    }

    @Test
    fun movingFixHasSpeedAndBearingAccuracy() {
        val fields = LocationSanitizer.fieldsFor(sample(speed = 12f))
        assertTrue(fields.speedAccuracyMetersPerSecond > 0f)
        assertEquals(2f, fields.bearingAccuracyDegrees, 0f)
    }

    @Test
    fun missingFieldsUseFiniteDefaults() {
        val fields = LocationSanitizer.fieldsFor(sample())
        assertTrue(fields.verticalAccuracyMeters.isFinite())
        assertTrue(fields.elapsedRealtimeUncertaintyNanos in 0..LocationSanitizer.MAX_UNCERTAINTY_NANOS)
    }

    @Test
    fun locationFieldPolicyRejectsNonFiniteAndInconsistentAccuracyValues() {
        assertThrows(IllegalArgumentException::class.java) {
            LocationFieldPolicy(verticalAccuracyFactor = Float.NaN)
        }
        assertThrows(IllegalArgumentException::class.java) {
            LocationFieldPolicy(verticalAccuracyFactor = Float.POSITIVE_INFINITY)
        }
        assertThrows(IllegalArgumentException::class.java) {
            LocationFieldPolicy(verticalAccuracyFactor = 0.5f)
        }
        assertThrows(IllegalArgumentException::class.java) {
            LocationFieldPolicy(speedAccuracyMps = Float.POSITIVE_INFINITY)
        }
        assertThrows(IllegalArgumentException::class.java) {
            LocationFieldPolicy(bearingAccuracyDegrees = Float.NaN)
        }
    }

    @Test
    fun verticalAccuracyRemainsFiniteWhenMultiplicationWouldOverflow() {
        val fields = LocationSanitizer.fieldsFor(
            sample(accuracy = Float.MAX_VALUE),
            LocationFieldPolicy(verticalAccuracyFactor = Float.MAX_VALUE),
        )

        assertTrue(fields.verticalAccuracyMeters.isFinite())
        assertEquals(Float.MAX_VALUE, fields.verticalAccuracyMeters, 0f)
    }

    @Test
    fun invalidAccuracyFallsBackToFinitePositiveValue() {
        assertEquals(25f, LocationSanitizer.sanitizeAccuracy(Float.NaN, 25f), 0f)
        assertEquals(25f, LocationSanitizer.sanitizeAccuracy(-1f, 25f), 0f)
        assertEquals(5f, LocationSanitizer.sanitizeAccuracy(5f, 25f), 0f)
    }

    @Test
    fun outOfRangeAltitudeFallsBack() {
        assertEquals(0.0, LocationSanitizer.sanitizeAltitude(Double.NaN), 0.0)
        assertEquals(0.0, LocationSanitizer.sanitizeAltitude(1e9), 0.0)
        assertEquals(80.0, LocationSanitizer.sanitizeAltitude(80.0), 0.0)
    }

    @Test
    fun scenarioAndLocationSampleEnforceSupportedAltitudeRange() {
        assertEquals(LocationSanitizer.MIN_ALTITUDE_METERS,
            MovementProfile(altitudeMeters = LocationSanitizer.MIN_ALTITUDE_METERS).altitudeMeters, 0.0)
        assertEquals(LocationSanitizer.MAX_ALTITUDE_METERS,
            sample(altitude = LocationSanitizer.MAX_ALTITUDE_METERS).altitude, 0.0)
        assertThrows(IllegalArgumentException::class.java) {
            MovementProfile(altitudeMeters = LocationSanitizer.MIN_ALTITUDE_METERS - 0.1)
        }
        assertThrows(IllegalArgumentException::class.java) {
            sample(altitude = LocationSanitizer.MAX_ALTITUDE_METERS + 0.1)
        }
    }

    @Test
    fun scenarioAndLocationSampleEnforceSupportedSpeedRange() {
        assertEquals(LocationSanitizer.MAX_SPEED_MPS,
            MovementProfile(speedMps = LocationSanitizer.MAX_SPEED_MPS).speedMps, 0.0)
        assertEquals(LocationSanitizer.MAX_SPEED_MPS.toFloat(),
            sample(speed = LocationSanitizer.MAX_SPEED_MPS.toFloat()).speed, 0f)
        assertThrows(IllegalArgumentException::class.java) {
            MovementProfile(speedMps = LocationSanitizer.MAX_SPEED_MPS + 0.1)
        }
        assertThrows(IllegalArgumentException::class.java) {
            sample(speed = LocationSanitizer.MAX_SPEED_MPS.toFloat() + 1f)
        }
    }

    @Test
    fun extrasDropInvalidValues() {
        val extras = LocationSanitizer.sanitizeExtras(
            mapOf("satellites" to 12, "meanCn0" to Float.NaN, "maxCn0" to 44f, "unexpected" to "x"),
        )
        assertEquals(setOf("satellites", "maxCn0"), extras.keys)
        assertEquals(12, extras["satellites"])
        assertEquals(44f, extras["maxCn0"])
    }
}
```

`core/src/test/kotlin/com/system/location/service/core/MotionModelTest.kt`:

```kt
package com.system.location.service.core

import com.system.location.service.core.geo.Wgs84
import com.system.location.service.core.playback.*
import com.system.location.service.core.scenario.*
import org.junit.Assert.*
import org.junit.Test
import net.sf.geographiclib.Geodesic

class MotionModelTest {
    private val points = listOf(Wgs84(0.0, 0.0), Wgs84(0.0, 0.0001), Wgs84(0.0001, 0.0001), Wgs84(0.0001, 0.001))
    private fun engine(mode: RouteMode = RouteMode.ONCE, route: List<Wgs84> = points) = PlaybackEngine(Scenario("s", "s", route = Route("r", "r", route), mode = mode, profile = MovementProfile(speedMps = 15.0, smoothMotion = true)))
    @Test fun smoothMovementUsesActualTimeAndHonorsAccelerationAndCornerSpeed() {
        val a = engine(); val b = engine()
        a.tick(0, 0); b.tick(0, 0)
        var previousSpeed = 0f
        for (i in 1..100) {
            val frame = b.tick(i * 100_000_000L, i * 100L)
            assertTrue(frame.sample.speed <= 15)
            assertTrue(kotlin.math.abs(frame.sample.speed - previousSpeed) <= 0.151)
            previousSpeed = frame.sample.speed
        }
        val irregular = a.tick(10_000_000_000, 10_000)
        val regular = b.tick(10_000_000_000, 10_000)
        assertEquals(regular.sample.longitude, irregular.sample.longitude, 1e-12)
        assertEquals(regular.sample.latitude, irregular.sample.latitude, 1e-12)
        assertTrue(irregular.sample.speed < 15)
        val end = a.tick(1_000_000_000_000, 1_000_000)
        assertTrue(end.completed); assertEquals(points.last(), end.sample.coordinate)
    }
    @Test fun changingSpeedAndZeroRetainProgressAndReverseDirection() {
        val e = engine(RouteMode.PING_PONG)
        e.tick(0, 0)
        var frame = e.tick(0, 0)
        var i = 0L
        while (frame.sample.bearing < 180 && i < 1000) { i++; frame = e.tick(i * 1_000_000_000, i * 1000) }
        assertTrue(frame.sample.bearing >= 180)
        e.setSpeed(0.0)
        val stopped = e.tick((i + 50) * 1_000_000_000, (i + 50) * 1000)
        assertEquals(frame.sample.coordinate, stopped.sample.coordinate); assertEquals(0f, stopped.sample.speed)
        e.setSpeed(8.0)
        val same = e.tick((i + 50) * 1_000_000_000, (i + 50) * 1000)
        assertEquals(stopped.sample.longitude, same.sample.longitude, 1e-12)
        assertTrue(same.sample.bearing >= 180)
        e.pause(); e.tick((i + 100) * 1_000_000_000, (i + 100) * 1000)
        e.resume((i + 200) * 1_000_000_000)
        assertEquals(same.sample.coordinate, e.tick((i + 200) * 1_000_000_000, (i + 200) * 1000).sample.coordinate)
    }
    @Test fun duplicatesTwoPointRoutesAndLoopRemainFinite() {
        for (mode in RouteMode.entries) {
            val e = engine(mode, listOf(points[0], points[0], points[1], points[1]))
            e.tick(0, 0)
            val frame = e.tick(10_000_000_000, 10_000)
            assertTrue(frame.progress.isFinite()); assertTrue(frame.sample.speed.isFinite())
            assertEquals(mode == RouteMode.ONCE, frame.completed)
        }
    }
    @Test fun extremelySlowSpeedsAndSpeedChangesDoNotProduceNanOrResetProgress() {
        val e = engine()
        e.tick(0, 0); val before = e.tick(10_000_000_000, 10000)
        e.setSpeed(0.00001)
        val same = e.tick(10_000_000_000, 10000)
        assertEquals(before.progress, same.progress, 1e-12)
        val after = e.tick(20_000_000_000, 20000)
        assertTrue(after.progress.isFinite()); assertTrue(after.sample.speed <= 0.00001f)
        assertTrue(after.progress > before.progress)
    }
    @Test fun joystickHasDeadZoneFiniteCenterAndFineResponse() {
        assertEquals(0.0, JoystickInput.evaluate(0.0, 0.0, 100.0).strength, 0.0)
        assertEquals(0.0, JoystickInput.evaluate(5.0, 0.0, 100.0).strength, 0.0)
        val half = JoystickInput.evaluate(50.0, 0.0, 100.0)
        assertEquals(90.0, half.bearing, 0.0); assertTrue(half.strength in 0.0..0.5)
        assertEquals(1.0, JoystickInput.evaluate(200.0, 0.0, 100.0).strength, 0.0)
        val e = PlaybackEngine(Scenario("p", "p", point = points[0], profile = MovementProfile(speedMps = 10.0)))
        e.tick(0, 0); e.setMotion(90.0, true, 0.25)
        val moved = e.tick(1_000_000_000, 1000).sample
        assertEquals(2.5, Geodesic.WGS84.Inverse(0.0, 0.0, moved.latitude, moved.longitude).s12, 1e-5)
        assertEquals(2.5f, moved.speed)
    }
    @Test fun orbitUsesIndependentPeriodAndFollowsReleasedPosition() {
        val e = PlaybackEngine(Scenario("p", "p", point = points[0], profile = MovementProfile(speedMps = 10.0)))
        e.setOrbit(true, 0.2, 20.0); e.tick(0, 0)
        e.setMotion(90.0, true); val moved = e.tick(10_000_000_000, 10000).sample
        e.setMotion(90.0, false)
        val orbit = e.tick(11_000_000_000, 11000).sample
        assertEquals(0.2, Geodesic.WGS84.Inverse(moved.latitude, moved.longitude, orbit.latitude, orbit.longitude).s12, 0.002)
        assertEquals((2 * Math.PI * 0.2 / 20).toFloat(), orbit.speed)
    }
}
```

`core/src/test/kotlin/com/system/location/service/core/OrderedRuntimeReceiverTest.kt`:

```kt
package com.system.location.service.core

import com.system.location.service.core.geo.Wgs84
import com.system.location.service.core.location.LocationSample
import com.system.location.service.core.runtime.*
import org.junit.Assert.*
import org.junit.Test

class OrderedRuntimeReceiverTest {
    @Test fun badNewerMessageDoesNotChangeLiveStateOrConsumeItsSequence() {
        var live = RuntimeTransfer(RuntimeSnapshot(), false)
        var restores = 0
        val receiver = OrderedRuntimeReceiver({ live.state.configuration.gnssSource }) { state, _ ->
            live = state; restores++
        }
        receiver.begin("session")
        val enabled = RuntimeTransfer(RuntimeSnapshot(configuration = HookConfiguration(enabled = true,
            minimumSatellites = 24, nmeaEnabled = false)), false)
        val good = RuntimeTransferWire.encode(enabled)
        assertTrue(receiver.receive("session", 1, good, 1))
        assertThrows(Exception::class.java) { receiver.receive("session", 2, byteArrayOf(0), 2) }
        assertSame(enabled.state.configuration.gnssSource, live.state.configuration.gnssSource)
        assertEquals(enabled, live)
        assertEquals(1, restores)
        val disabled = RuntimeTransferWire.encode(enabled.copy(state = enabled.state.copy(
            configuration = enabled.state.configuration.copy(enabled = false))))
        assertTrue(receiver.receive("session", 2, disabled, 3))
        assertFalse(live.state.configuration.enabled)
        assertFalse(receiver.receive("session", 1, good, 4))
        assertEquals(2, restores)
    }

    @Test fun delayedSamplesAreDisabledBeforeRestoreAndOldSessionNeverDecodes() {
        val sample = LocationSample(Wgs84(31.0, 121.0), 10.0, 5f, 2f, 90f, 1000, 1000)
        val encoded = RuntimeTransferWire.encode(RuntimeTransfer(RuntimeSnapshot(sample = sample,
            configuration = HookConfiguration(enabled = true)), true, mapOf("route" to sample)))
        var live: RuntimeTransfer? = null
        val receiver = OrderedRuntimeReceiver({ null }) { state, _ -> live = state }
        receiver.begin("new")
        assertFalse(receiver.receive("old", Long.MAX_VALUE, byteArrayOf(0), 2000))
        assertNull(live)
        assertTrue(receiver.receive("new", 1, encoded, 5_000_001_000))
        assertFalse(live!!.state.configuration.enabled)
        assertNull(live!!.state.sample)
        assertTrue(live!!.scenarios.isEmpty())
    }
}
```

```kt
package com.system.location.service.core

import com.system.location.service.core.performance.PerformanceProbe
import org.junit.Assert.assertEquals
import org.junit.Assert.assertNull

class PerformanceProbeTest {

        assertNull(PerformanceProbe().snapshot())
    }

    @Test fun percentilesUseSortedSamples() {

        (1..100).forEach { probe.record(it.toLong()) }
        val snapshot = probe.snapshot()!!
        assertEquals(100, snapshot.samples)
        assertEquals(50L, snapshot.p50Nanos)
        assertEquals(95L, snapshot.p95Nanos)
        assertEquals(100L, snapshot.maxNanos)
        assertEquals(50L, snapshot.meanNanos)
    }

    @Test fun ringBufferKeepsMostRecentSamples() {
        val probe = PerformanceProbe(capacity = 3)
        listOf(100L, 200L, 300L, 1L).forEach { probe.record(it) }
        val snapshot = probe.snapshot()!!
        assertEquals(3, snapshot.samples)
        assertEquals(300L, snapshot.maxNanos)
        assertEquals(200L, snapshot.p50Nanos)
    }

    @Test fun clearResetsAndValidation() {
        val probe = PerformanceProbe()
        probe.record(10)
        probe.clear()
        assertNull(probe.snapshot())
        assertThrows(IllegalArgumentException::class.java) { probe.record(-1) }
        assertThrows(IllegalArgumentException::class.java) { PerformanceProbe(0) }
    }
```

`core/src/test/kotlin/com/system/location/service/core/PhysicalNoiseTest.kt`:

```kt
package com.system.location.service.core

import com.system.location.service.core.geo.Wgs84
import com.system.location.service.core.location.LocationSample
import com.system.location.service.core.playback.NoiseProfile
import com.system.location.service.core.playback.PhysicalNoise
import org.junit.Assert.assertEquals
import org.junit.Assert.assertNotEquals
import org.junit.Assert.assertTrue
import org.junit.Test
import kotlin.math.sqrt

class PhysicalNoiseTest {
    private val sample = LocationSample(
        coordinate = Wgs84(31.2304, 121.4737),
        altitude = 80.0,
        accuracy = 8f,
        speed = 5f,
        bearing = 90f,
        timeMillis = 1_790_000_000_000,
        elapsedNanos = 1_000_000_000,
    )

    @Test
    fun disabledNoiseIsExactIdentity() {
        val noise = PhysicalNoise(NoiseProfile(enabled = false))
        val output = noise.apply(sample, 1_000_000_000)
        assertEquals(sample, output)
    }

    @Test
    fun sameSeedAndTimestampSequenceIsReproducible() {
        val first = PhysicalNoise(NoiseProfile(seed = 42))
        val second = PhysicalNoise(NoiseProfile(seed = 42))
        val firstOutputs = timestamps().map { first.apply(sample, it) }
        val secondOutputs = timestamps().map { second.apply(sample, it) }
        assertEquals(firstOutputs, secondOutputs)
    }

    @Test
    fun differentSeedChangesDrift() {
        val first = PhysicalNoise(NoiseProfile(seed = 1))
        val second = PhysicalNoise(NoiseProfile(seed = 2))
        val firstOutput = timestamps().map { first.apply(sample, it) }.last()
        val secondOutput = timestamps().map { second.apply(sample, it) }.last()
        assertNotEquals(firstOutput.coordinate, secondOutput.coordinate)
    }

    @Test
    fun driftIsBoundedAndFinite() {
        val profile = NoiseProfile(seed = 7, maxOffsetMeters = 4.0)
        val noise = PhysicalNoise(profile)
        timestamps(seconds = 300).map { noise.apply(sample, it) }.forEach { output ->
            assertTrue(output.latitude in -90.0..90.0)
            assertTrue(output.longitude in -180.0..180.0)
            assertTrue(output.altitude.isFinite())
            assertTrue(output.accuracy.isFinite() && output.accuracy > 0f)
            val metersLat = (output.latitude - sample.latitude) * 111_320.0
            val metersLon = (output.longitude - sample.longitude) * 111_320.0 * kotlin.math.cos(Math.toRadians(sample.latitude))
            assertTrue(sqrt(metersLat * metersLat + metersLon * metersLon) <= profile.maxOffsetMeters * 1.5)
        }
    }

    @Test
    fun resetRestartsTheDeterministicSequence() {
        val noise = PhysicalNoise(NoiseProfile(seed = 9))
        val before = timestamps().map { noise.apply(sample, it) }
        noise.reset()
        val after = timestamps().map { noise.apply(sample, it) }
        assertEquals(before, after)
    }

    @Test fun repeatedReadersOfOneTimestampReceiveTheSameDrift() {
        val noise = PhysicalNoise(NoiseProfile(seed = 42))
        assertEquals(sample, noise.apply(sample, 1_000_000_000))
        assertEquals(sample, noise.apply(sample, 1_000_000_000))
        val output = noise.apply(sample, 2_000_000_000)
        assertNotEquals(sample.coordinate, output.coordinate)
        repeat(10) { assertEquals(output, noise.apply(sample, 2_000_000_000)) }
    }

    @Test fun delayedReaderCannotChangeTheNextNoiseStep() {
        val first = PhysicalNoise(NoiseProfile(seed = 42))
        val reference = PhysicalNoise(NoiseProfile(seed = 42))
        for (time in listOf(1_000_000_000L, 2_000_000_000L)) {
            assertEquals(reference.apply(sample, time), first.apply(sample, time))
        }
        assertEquals(sample, first.apply(sample, 1_000_000_000))
        assertEquals(reference.apply(sample, 3_000_000_000), first.apply(sample, 3_000_000_000))
    }

    private fun timestamps(seconds: Int = 60): List<Long> =
        (1..seconds).map { it * 1_000_000_000L }
}
```

`core/src/test/kotlin/com/system/location/service/core/PlaybackEngineTest.kt`:

```kt
package com.system.location.service.core

import com.system.location.service.core.geo.*
import com.system.location.service.core.scenario.*
import com.system.location.service.core.playback.PlaybackEngine
import org.junit.Assert.*
import org.junit.Test
import net.sf.geographiclib.Geodesic

class PlaybackEngineTest {
    private val points = listOf(Wgs84(0.0, 0.0), Wgs84(0.0, 0.001), Wgs84(0.001, 0.001))
    private fun engine(mode: RouteMode = RouteMode.ONCE, route: List<Wgs84> = points) =
        PlaybackEngine(Scenario("s", "场景", route = Route("r", "路线", route), mode = mode,
            profile = MovementProfile(speedMps = 10.0)))

    @Test fun irregularTicksTravelAccordingToActualElapsedTime() {
        val slow = engine(); val fast = engine()
        slow.tick(0, 0); fast.tick(0, 0)
        listOf(50L, 150L, 190L, 500L, 900L).forEach { fast.tick(it * 1_000_000, it) }
        val a = slow.tick(1_000_000_000, 1000)
        val b = fast.tick(1_000_000_000, 1000)
        assertEquals(a.sample.latitude, b.sample.latitude, 1e-12)
        assertEquals(a.sample.longitude, b.sample.longitude, 1e-12)
        assertEquals(10.0, Geodesic.WGS84.Inverse(0.0, 0.0, a.sample.latitude, a.sample.longitude).s12, 1e-6)
    }

    @Test fun pauseAndResumeDoNotChargePausedTime() {
        val e = engine(); e.tick(0, 0)
        val before = e.tick(1_000_000_000, 1000)
        e.pause()
        val paused = e.tick(50_000_000_000, 50000)
        assertEquals(before.sample.coordinate, paused.sample.coordinate)
        assertEquals(0f, paused.sample.speed)
        e.resume(100_000_000_000)
        assertEquals(before.sample.coordinate, e.tick(100_000_000_000, 100000).sample.coordinate)
        assertTrue(e.tick(101_000_000_000, 101000).progress > before.progress)
    }

    @Test fun onceFinishesExactlyAtTheLastPointAcrossSeveralSegments() {
        val e = engine(); e.tick(0, 0)
        val end = e.tick(1_000_000_000_000, 1_000_000)
        assertTrue(end.completed)
        assertEquals(points.last(), end.sample.coordinate)
        assertEquals(1.0, end.progress, 0.0)
        assertEquals(0f, end.sample.speed)
    }

    @Test fun loopClosesRouteAndPingPongReverses() {
        val loop = engine(RouteMode.LOOP); loop.tick(0, 0)
        assertFalse(loop.tick(1_000_000_000_000, 1_000_000).completed)
        val ping = engine(RouteMode.PING_PONG); ping.tick(0, 0)
        val halfwayBack = (ping.totalDistance * 1.5 / 10 * 1e9).toLong()
        val reverse = ping.tick(halfwayBack, halfwayBack / 1_000_000)
        assertEquals(0.5, reverse.progress, 1e-8)
        assertFalse(reverse.completed)
    }

    @Test fun routeIsFrozenAndLongRoutesRemainValid() {
        val mutable = points.toMutableList()
        val e = engine(route = mutable)
        mutable.clear()
        assertEquals(3, e.scenario.route!!.points.size)
        val long = engine(route = (0..20000).map { Wgs84(0.0, it * 0.00001) })
        long.tick(0, 0)
        assertTrue(long.tick(100_000_000_000, 100000).progress > 0)
        assertThrows(IllegalArgumentException::class.java) { engine(route = listOf(points[0], points[0])) }
    }

    @Test fun stationaryFixNeverJittersAndJoystickUsesActualTime() {
        val e = PlaybackEngine(Scenario("p", "点", point = Wgs84(25.1, 119.1)))
        val a = e.tick(0, 0)
        assertEquals(a.sample.coordinate, e.tick(500_000_000_000, 500000).sample.coordinate)
        e.setMotion(90.0, true)
        val moved = e.tick(501_000_000_000, 501000)
        assertTrue(moved.sample.longitude > a.sample.longitude)
        assertEquals(3.05, Geodesic.WGS84.Inverse(a.sample.latitude, a.sample.longitude,
            moved.sample.latitude, moved.sample.longitude).s12, 1e-5)
    }

    @Test fun orbitExperimentStaysWithinConfiguredRadius() {
        val center = Wgs84(25.1, 119.1)
        val e = PlaybackEngine(Scenario("p", "点", point = center,
            profile = MovementProfile(speedMps = 0.2)))
        e.setOrbit(true, 0.2)
        e.tick(0, 0)
        val sample = e.tick(1_000_000_000, 1000).sample
        val distance = Geodesic.WGS84.Inverse(center.latitude, center.longitude,
            sample.latitude, sample.longitude).s12
        assertEquals(0.2, distance, 0.002)
        e.setSpeed(0.0)
        val stopped = e.tick(5_000_000_000, 5000).sample
        assertEquals(sample.coordinate, stopped.coordinate)
        assertEquals(0f, stopped.speed)
    }

    @Test fun invalidProfilesAndScenariosAreRejected() {
        assertThrows(IllegalArgumentException::class.java) { MovementProfile(speedMps = Double.NaN) }
        assertThrows(IllegalArgumentException::class.java) { Scenario("s", "name") }
        assertThrows(IllegalArgumentException::class.java) { Wgs84(91.0, 0.0) }
        assertThrows(IllegalArgumentException::class.java) { Route("r", "r", emptyList()) }
    }
}
```

```kt
package com.system.location.service.core

import com.system.location.service.core.carrier.CarrierIdentityConfig
import com.system.location.service.core.carrier.CarrierIdentityMode
import com.system.location.service.core.carrier.SimCarrierProfile

import com.system.location.service.core.geo.Wgs84
```
