```kt
import com.system.location.service.core.routing.*
import com.system.location.service.core.runtime.*
import kotlinx.serialization.json.Json
import org.junit.Assert.*
import org.junit.Test

class PreparedRuntimeConfigurationTest {
    @Test fun orbitUpdatesArePreparedAtomicallyAndAbsentKeyPreservesAcceptedResource() {
        val resource = com.system.location.service.core.gnss.RinexNavigationResource.import(
            RinexNavigationResourceTest.navigation(), "https://example.org/nav", 1794096000000)
        val payload = com.system.location.service.core.gnss.RinexNavigationResource.encodeWire(resource)
        val original = RuntimeSnapshot()
        val prepared = PreparedRuntimeConfiguration.prepare(mapOf("gnss_navigation" to payload))
        val updated = prepared.applyTo(original)
        assertNull(original.configuration.gnssNavigation)
        assertEquals(resource, updated.configuration.gnssNavigation)
        assertSame(updated.configuration.gnssNavigation,
            PreparedRuntimeConfiguration.prepare(mapOf("min_satellites" to 32)).applyTo(updated).configuration.gnssNavigation)
        assertNull(PreparedRuntimeConfiguration.prepare(mapOf("gnss_navigation" to null)).applyTo(updated).configuration.gnssNavigation)
        for (value in listOf<Any>("broken", 123, "x".repeat(131073))) {
            assertThrows(Exception::class.java) { PreparedRuntimeConfiguration.prepare(mapOf("gnss_navigation" to value)) }
        }
        assertEquals(resource, updated.configuration.gnssNavigation)
    }

    private val route = RoutingConfig(mode = RoutingMode.PER_APP, routes = listOf(AppRoute("test.app", point = Wgs84(1.0, 2.0))))
    private val environment = EnvironmentProfile(EnvironmentSourceType.REPLAY, generatedAtMillis = 100, seed = 42)
    private val initial = RuntimeSnapshot(configRevision = 7, environmentVersion = 3, routing = route,
        environment = environment, configuration = HookConfiguration(wifiFingerprintEnabled = true,
            wifiFingerprintCatalogJson = WifiFingerprintImporter.encodeJson(WifiFingerprintCatalog())))

    @Test fun partialUpdatePreservesUnspecifiedConfigurationAndOneRevision() {
        val result = PreparedRuntimeConfiguration.prepare(mapOf("min_satellites" to 20)).applyTo(initial)
        assertEquals(20, result.configuration.minimumSatellites)
        assertEquals(8L, result.configRevision)
        assertSame(route, result.routing)
        assertSame(environment, result.environment)
        assertEquals(3L, result.environmentVersion)
        assertTrue(result.configuration.wifiFingerprintEnabled)
        assertEquals(initial.configuration.wifiFingerprintCatalogJson, result.configuration.wifiFingerprintCatalogJson)
    }

    @Test fun carrierIdentityIsDecodedAndCanBeClearedAtomically() {
        val config = CarrierIdentityConfig(
            mode = CarrierIdentityMode.GLOBAL,
            sims = listOf(SimCarrierProfile(
                slot = 1, countryIso = "CN", mcc = 460, mnc = 0, mncDigits = 2,
                carrierName = "中国移动", operatorName = "China Mobile",
            )),
        )
        val json = Json.encodeToString(CarrierIdentityConfig.serializer(), config)
        val result = PreparedRuntimeConfiguration.prepare(mapOf(
            "carrier_identity_enabled" to true,
            "carrier_identity_json" to json,
        )).applyTo(initial)
        assertTrue(result.configuration.carrierIdentityEnabled)
        assertEquals(config, result.configuration.carrierIdentity)
        val cleared = PreparedRuntimeConfiguration.prepare(mapOf(
            "carrier_identity_enabled" to false,
            "carrier_identity_json" to "",
        )).applyTo(result)
        assertFalse(cleared.configuration.carrierIdentityEnabled)
        assertNull(cleared.configuration.carrierIdentity)
    }

    @Test fun gnssPolicyUpdatesAtomicallyAndSurvivesRuntimeSerialization() {
        val changed = PreparedRuntimeConfiguration.prepare(mapOf("gnss_mode" to "AUTONOMOUS",
            "gnss_minimum_policy" to "GUARANTEE_QUANTITY", "gnss_environment" to "INDOOR",
            "gnss_virtual_seed" to 123L)).applyTo(initial)
        val policy = changed.configuration.gnssSimulation
        assertEquals(GnssSimulationMode.AUTONOMOUS, policy.mode)
        assertEquals(GnssMinimumPolicy.GUARANTEE_QUANTITY, policy.minimumPolicy)
        assertEquals(GnssSimulationEnvironment.INDOOR, policy.environment)
        assertEquals(123L, policy.virtualSeed)
        val partial = PreparedRuntimeConfiguration.prepare(mapOf("gnss_mode" to "REPLAY")).applyTo(changed)
        assertEquals(policy.copy(mode = GnssSimulationMode.REPLAY), partial.configuration.gnssSimulation)
        val wire = Json.encodeToString(HookConfiguration.serializer(), changed.configuration)
        assertEquals(policy, Json.decodeFromString(HookConfiguration.serializer(), wire).gnssSimulation)
        assertEquals(GnssSimulationPolicy(), Json.decodeFromString(HookConfiguration.serializer(), "{}").gnssSimulation)
        for (invalid in listOf(mapOf("gnss_mode" to "UNKNOWN"), mapOf("gnss_minimum_policy" to "UNKNOWN"),
            mapOf("gnss_environment" to true), mapOf("gnss_virtual_seed" to 123))) {
            assertThrows(IllegalArgumentException::class.java) { PreparedRuntimeConfiguration.prepare(invalid) }
        }
    }

    @Test fun explicitNullClearsAndBlankLegacyStringsClear() {
        for (clear in listOf(null, "", " ")) {
            val result = PreparedRuntimeConfiguration.prepare(mapOf("routing_json" to clear,
                "environment_json" to clear, "wifi_fingerprint_json" to clear, "gnss_capture" to clear)).applyTo(initial)
            assertNull(result.routing)
            assertNull(result.environment)
            assertNull(result.configuration.wifiFingerprintCatalogJson)
            assertNull(result.configuration.gnssSource)
            assertEquals(4L, result.environmentVersion)
        }
    }

    @Test fun invalidFieldRejectsWholeBatchWithoutPublication() {
        val badValues = mapOf<String, Any?>("min_satellites" to 129, "accuracy" to Float.NaN,
            "report_interval" to 49L, "sensor_variation" to 0.6, "environment_ap_count" to 2,
            "altitude" to Double.POSITIVE_INFINITY, "speed" to -1.0, "enable" to "true",
            "disable_fused_location" to null, "cell_mode" to "UNKNOWN", "environment_source" to null,
            "routing_json" to "{bad", "environment_json" to "{}", "wifi_fingerprint_json" to "broken",
            "gnss_capture" to 123)
        val store = RuntimeSnapshotStore(initial)
        for ((key, bad) in badValues) {
            assertThrows("Must reject $key", IllegalArgumentException::class.java) {
                val prepared = PreparedRuntimeConfiguration.prepare(mapOf("enable" to true, key to bad))
                store.update(prepared::applyTo)
            }
            assertSame(initial, store.current())
        }
    }

    @Test fun corruptOptionalCaptureDoesNotRejectRequiredConfiguration() {
        val result = PreparedRuntimeConfiguration.prepare(mapOf("enable" to true,
            "min_satellites" to 20, "gnss_capture" to "{broken")).applyTo(initial)
        assertTrue(result.configuration.enabled)
        assertEquals(20, result.configuration.minimumSatellites)
        assertNull(result.configuration.gnssSource)
        assertTrue(result.configuration.gnssCaptureRejected)
        val partial = PreparedRuntimeConfiguration.prepare(mapOf("min_satellites" to 21)).applyTo(result)
        assertTrue(partial.configuration.gnssCaptureRejected)

        assertFalse(cleared.configuration.gnssCaptureRejected)
        assertEquals(21, cleared.configuration.minimumSatellites)
    }

    @Test fun corruptOptionalCaptureCannotHideInvalidRequiredSettingOrOversizePayload() {
        assertThrows(IllegalArgumentException::class.java) {
            PreparedRuntimeConfiguration.prepare(mapOf("gnss_capture" to "broken", "min_satellites" to -1))
        }
        assertThrows(IllegalArgumentException::class.java) {

        }
    }

    @Test fun corruptReplacementPreservesLastDecodedSourceAndSuccessfulReplacementClearsDiagnostic() {
        val capture = GnssCapture(deviceModel = "test", osVersion = "test", startedAtMillis = 1000,
            endedAtMillis = 61000, frames = (0..60).map {
                GnssObservationFrame(1000L + it * 1000, Wgs84(30.0, 120.0), satellites = listOf(
                    GnssSatellite(Constellation.GPS, 1, 30f, 100f, 35f, true, true, true)))
            })
        val payload = GnssCaptureWire.encode(capture)
        val previous = CapturedGnssSource.prepare(payload)!!
        val ready = initial.copy(configuration = initial.configuration.copy(gnssSource = previous))
        val rejected = PreparedRuntimeConfiguration.prepare(mapOf("gnss_capture" to "broken"), previous)
            .applyTo(ready)
        assertSame(previous, rejected.configuration.gnssSource)
        assertTrue(rejected.configuration.gnssCaptureRejected)
        val repaired = PreparedRuntimeConfiguration.prepare(mapOf("gnss_capture" to payload), previous)
            .applyTo(rejected)
        assertSame(previous, repaired.configuration.gnssSource)
        assertFalse(repaired.configuration.gnssCaptureRejected)
    }

    @Test fun decodesCompleteBatchAndKeepsExistingActiveSpeed() {
        val prepared = PreparedRuntimeConfiguration.prepare(mapOf("enable" to true, "speed" to 100.0,
            "accuracy" to 8f, "enable_nmea" to false, "min_satellites" to 30,
            "routing_json" to Json.encodeToString(RoutingConfig.serializer(), route),

        assertFalse(result.configuration.nmeaEnabled)

        assertEquals(CellMode.AUTO, result.cellMode)

        assertEquals(1.5, result.configuration.sensorCadenceScale, 0.0)
        val stopped = PreparedRuntimeConfiguration.prepare(mapOf("enable" to false, "speed" to 100.0)).applyTo(result)
        assertEquals(100.0, stopped.speedMps, 0.0)
    }

    @Test fun preparedPatchMergesAgainstLatestStateAndCopiesCallerInput() {
        val input = mutableMapOf<String, Any?>("min_satellites" to 22)
        val prepared = PreparedRuntimeConfiguration.prepare(input)
        input["min_satellites"] = 33
        val sample = LocationSample(Wgs84(3.0, 4.0), 10.0, 5f, 2f, 90f, 1000, 1000)
        val latest = initial.copy(configRevision = 20, sample = sample, latitude = 3.0,
            configuration = initial.configuration.copy(enabled = true, nmeaEnabled = false))

        assertEquals(21L, result.configRevision)
        assertEquals(22, result.configuration.minimumSatellites)
        assertTrue(result.configuration.enabled)
        assertFalse(result.configuration.nmeaEnabled)
        assertEquals(result, prepared.applyTo(latest))
    }
```

`core/src/test/kotlin/com/system/location/service/core/ProceduralCellSourceTest.kt`:

```kt
package com.system.location.service.core

import com.system.location.service.core.environment.CellMode
import com.system.location.service.core.environment.CellType
import com.system.location.service.core.environment.EnvironmentConfig
import com.system.location.service.core.environment.ProceduralCellSource
import com.system.location.service.core.environment.SimProfile
import com.system.location.service.core.geo.Wgs84
import org.junit.Assert.assertEquals
import org.junit.Assert.assertNotEquals
import org.junit.Assert.assertTrue
import org.junit.Test

class ProceduralCellSourceTest {
    private val point = Wgs84(31.2304, 121.4737)
    private val sim = SimProfile(mcc = 460, mnc = 0, simReady = true)

    @Test
    fun fullReplayHasOneRegisteredLteAndNeighbours() {
        val source = ProceduralCellSource(EnvironmentConfig(cellMode = CellMode.FULL_REPLAY))
        val cells = source.cellsAt(point, seed = 1, sim = sim)
        val registered = cells.filter { it.registered }
        assertEquals(1, registered.size)
        assertEquals(CellType.LTE, registered.single().type)
        assertEquals(1, cells.count { it.type == CellType.NR })
        assertTrue(cells.size >= 4)
        cells.forEach {
            assertEquals(460, it.mcc)
            assertEquals(0, it.mnc)
            assertTrue(it.areaCode > 0)
            assertTrue(it.cellId > 0)
            assertTrue(it.rsrp in -156..-31)
        }
    }

    @Test
    fun autoWithoutSimProducesNoCells() {
        val source = ProceduralCellSource(EnvironmentConfig(cellMode = CellMode.AUTO))
        assertTrue(source.cellsAt(point, seed = 1, sim = SimProfile(simReady = false)).isEmpty())
    }

    @Test
    fun autoWithSimUsesFullReplay() {
        val source = ProceduralCellSource(EnvironmentConfig(cellMode = CellMode.AUTO))
        val cells = source.cellsAt(point, seed = 1, sim = sim)
        assertTrue(cells.any { it.registered })
    }

    @Test
    fun legacyCdmaProducesNothing() {
        val source = ProceduralCellSource(EnvironmentConfig(cellMode = CellMode.LEGACY_CDMA))
        assertTrue(source.cellsAt(point, seed = 1, sim = sim).isEmpty())
    }

    @Test
    fun samePointAndSeedIsDeterministic() {
        val source = ProceduralCellSource()
        assertEquals(source.cellsAt(point, 7, sim), source.cellsAt(point, 7, sim))
        assertNotEquals(source.cellsAt(point, 7, sim), source.cellsAt(point, 8, sim))
    }

    @Test
    fun neighboursDifferFromRegisteredCell() {
        val cells = ProceduralCellSource().cellsAt(point, 2, sim)
        val ids = cells.map { it.cellId }
        assertEquals(ids.size, ids.distinct().size)
        val pcIs = cells.mapNotNull { it.pci }
        assertEquals(pcIs.size, pcIs.distinct().size)
    }

    @Test
    fun simProfileIsValidated() {
        assertThrows { SimProfile(mcc = 0) }
        assertThrows { SimProfile(mnc = 1000) }
    }

    private fun assertThrows(block: () -> Unit) {
        try {
            block()
        } catch (_: IllegalArgumentException) {
            return
        }
        throw AssertionError("Expected IllegalArgumentException")
    }
}
```

`core/src/test/kotlin/com/system/location/service/core/ProceduralWifiSourceTest.kt`:

```kt
package com.system.location.service.core

import com.system.location.service.core.environment.EnvironmentConfig
import com.system.location.service.core.environment.EnvironmentSourceType
import com.system.location.service.core.environment.ProceduralWifiSource
import com.system.location.service.core.environment.WifiAp
import com.system.location.service.core.geo.Wgs84
import org.junit.Assert.assertEquals
import org.junit.Assert.assertNotEquals
import org.junit.Assert.assertTrue
import org.junit.Test

class ProceduralWifiSourceTest {
    private val source = ProceduralWifiSource(EnvironmentConfig(apPerCell = 4))
    private val point = Wgs84(31.2304, 121.4737)
    private val atMillis = 1_790_000_000_000L

    @Test
    fun samePointAndSeedIsDeterministic() {
        val first = source.profileAt(point, seed = 42, atMillis = atMillis)
        val second = source.profileAt(point, seed = 42, atMillis = atMillis)
        assertEquals(first, second)
        assertEquals(EnvironmentSourceType.PROCEDURAL, first.source)
        assertEquals(4, first.wifi.size)
        assertEquals(1, first.wifi.count { it.connected })
        assertEquals(point, first.origin)
    }

    @Test
    fun differentSeedChangesAccessPointIdentity() {
        val first = source.profileAt(point, seed = 1, atMillis = atMillis)
        val second = source.profileAt(point, seed = 2, atMillis = atMillis)
        assertNotEquals(first.wifi.map { it.bssid }, second.wifi.map { it.bssid })
    }

    @Test
    fun generatedAccessPointsAreValidAndBounded() {
        val wifi = source.profileAt(point, seed = 7, atMillis = atMillis).wifi
        assertEquals(wifi.size, wifi.map { it.bssid.lowercase() }.distinct().size)
        wifi.forEach { ap ->
            assertTrue(WifiAp.BSSID_PATTERN.matches(ap.bssid))
            assertTrue(ap.bssid.lowercase() != WifiAp.SENTINEL_BSSID)
            assertTrue(ap.ssid.isNotBlank() && ap.ssid.toByteArray(Charsets.UTF_8).size <= WifiAp.MAX_SSID_BYTES)
            assertTrue(ap.rssi in WifiAp.MIN_RSSI..WifiAp.MAX_RSSI)
            assertTrue(ap.frequencyMhz in WifiAp.MIN_FREQUENCY_MHZ..WifiAp.MAX_FREQUENCY_MHZ)
            assertTrue(ap.channel in WifiAp.MIN_CHANNEL..WifiAp.MAX_CHANNEL)
        }
    }

    @Test
    fun nearbyPointsKeepTheSameApsAndSmoothRssi() {
        val near = Wgs84(point.latitude + 0.00001, point.longitude + 0.00001)
        val first = source.profileAt(point, seed = 11, atMillis = atMillis)
        val second = source.profileAt(near, seed = 11, atMillis = atMillis)
        assertEquals(first.wifi.map { it.bssid }, second.wifi.map { it.bssid })
        first.wifi.zip(second.wifi).forEach { (a, b) ->
            assertTrue("RSSI jumped ${a.rssi} -> ${b.rssi}", kotlin.math.abs(a.rssi - b.rssi) <= 6)
        }
    }

    @Test
    fun timeOnlyAffectsGenerationTimestamp() {
        val first = source.profileAt(point, seed = 11, atMillis = atMillis)
        val later = source.profileAt(point, seed = 11, atMillis = atMillis + 60_000)
        assertEquals(first.wifi, later.wifi)
        assertEquals(atMillis, first.generatedAtMillis)
        assertEquals(atMillis + 60_000, later.generatedAtMillis)
    }

    @Test
    fun noCellsOrBleAreProducedByWifiSource() {
        val profile = source.profileAt(point, seed = 1, atMillis = atMillis)
        assertTrue(profile.cells.isEmpty())
        assertTrue(profile.ble.isEmpty())
    }
}
```

`core/src/test/kotlin/com/system/location/service/core/ProviderMixerTest.kt`:

```kt
package com.system.location.service.core

import com.system.location.service.core.geo.Wgs84
import com.system.location.service.core.location.LocationSample
import com.system.location.service.core.providers.ProviderFieldMask
import com.system.location.service.core.providers.ProviderKind
import com.system.location.service.core.providers.ProviderMixer
import com.system.location.service.core.providers.ProviderProfile
import com.system.location.service.core.providers.StationaryPolicy
import org.junit.Assert.assertEquals
import org.junit.Assert.assertFalse
import org.junit.Assert.assertNotNull
import org.junit.Assert.assertNull
import org.junit.Assert.assertTrue
import org.junit.Test

class ProviderMixerTest {
    private val mixer = ProviderMixer()
    private val moving = LocationSample(
        coordinate = Wgs84(31.2304, 121.4737),
        altitude = 80.0,
        accuracy = 25f,
        speed = 12f,
        bearing = 87f,
        timeMillis = 1_790_000_000_000,
        elapsedNanos = 1_000_000_000,
    )

    @Test
    fun threeProvidersDifferInAccuracyLatencyAndFields() {
        val samples = mixer.mix(moving, satellites = 12, meanCn0 = 32f, maxCn0 = 44f)
        assertEquals(3, samples.size)
        val gps = samples.getValue(ProviderKind.GPS)
        val network = samples.getValue(ProviderKind.NETWORK)
        val fused = samples.getValue(ProviderKind.FUSED)

        assertTrue(gps.profile.accuracyMeters < fused.profile.accuracyMeters)
        assertTrue(fused.profile.accuracyMeters < network.profile.accuracyMeters)
        assertEquals(0L, gps.profile.latencyMs)
        assertEquals(120L, fused.profile.latencyMs)
        assertEquals(400L, network.profile.latencyMs)
        assertTrue(gps.has(ProviderFieldMask.BEARING))
        assertTrue(gps.has(ProviderFieldMask.SPEED))
        assertTrue(gps.has(ProviderFieldMask.ALTITUDE))
        assertFalse(network.has(ProviderFieldMask.BEARING))
        assertFalse(network.has(ProviderFieldMask.SPEED))
        assertFalse(network.has(ProviderFieldMask.ALTITUDE))
        assertFalse(gps.has(ProviderFieldMask.MSL_ALTITUDE))
        assertFalse(fused.has(ProviderFieldMask.MSL_ALTITUDE))
        assertFalse(network.has(ProviderFieldMask.MSL_ALTITUDE))
        assertNull(gps.mslAltitudeMeters)
        assertNull(network.satellites)
        assertNotNull(gps.satellites)
    }

    @Test
    fun networkTimeIsOlderThanGpsTime() {
        val samples = mixer.mix(moving)
        assertTrue(samples.getValue(ProviderKind.NETWORK).sample.timeMillis <
            samples.getValue(ProviderKind.GPS).sample.timeMillis)
        assertTrue(samples.getValue(ProviderKind.FUSED).sample.timeMillis <
            samples.getValue(ProviderKind.GPS).sample.timeMillis)
    }

    @Test
    fun stationaryFixHasNoBearingOrSpeed() {
        val stationary = moving.copy(speed = 0f, bearing = 0f)
        mixer.mix(stationary).values.forEach { sample ->
            assertFalse(sample.has(ProviderFieldMask.BEARING))
            assertFalse(sample.has(ProviderFieldMask.SPEED))
            assertEquals(0f, sample.sample.speed, 0f)
            assertEquals(0f, sample.sample.bearing, 0f)
        }
    }

    @Test
    fun stationaryAccuracyDriftsButStaysBounded() {
        val stationary = moving.copy(speed = 0f)
        val samples = mixer.mix(stationary)
        samples.values.forEach { sample ->
            assertTrue(sample.sample.accuracy > sample.profile.accuracyMeters)
            assertTrue(sample.sample.accuracy <= sample.profile.accuracyMeters + 0.5f + 0.001f)
        }
    }

    @Test
    fun latencyNeverProducesNegativeTimestamps() {
        val early = moving.copy(timeMillis = 100L, elapsedNanos = 50L)
        val samples = mixer.mix(early)
        samples.values.forEach { sample ->
            assertTrue(sample.sample.timeMillis >= 0L)
            assertTrue(sample.sample.elapsedNanos >= 0L)
        }
        assertEquals(0L, samples.getValue(ProviderKind.NETWORK).sample.timeMillis)
        assertEquals(0L, samples.getValue(ProviderKind.FUSED).sample.timeMillis)
        assertEquals(100L, samples.getValue(ProviderKind.GPS).sample.timeMillis)
    }

    @Test
    fun standardMockPreservesConfiguredGpsAccuracyAndScalesOtherProviders() {
        val standard = ProviderMixer(useSampleAccuracy = true)
        for (speed in listOf(0f, 5f)) {
            val samples = standard.mix(moving.copy(accuracy = 2.5f, speed = speed))
            assertEquals(2.5f, samples.getValue(ProviderKind.GPS).sample.accuracy, 0f)
            assertEquals(25f, samples.getValue(ProviderKind.NETWORK).sample.accuracy, 0.001f)
            assertEquals(2.5f * 10f / 6f, samples.getValue(ProviderKind.FUSED).sample.accuracy, 0.001f)
        }
        assertEquals(10_000f, standard.mix(moving.copy(accuracy = 10_000f))
            .getValue(ProviderKind.NETWORK).sample.accuracy, 0f)
    }

    @Test
    fun invalidProfilesAreRejected() {
        assertThrows { ProviderProfile(ProviderKind.GPS, 0, 5f, 1f, 0, true, true, true) }
        assertThrows { ProviderProfile(ProviderKind.GPS, 1_000, -1f, 1f, 0, true, true, true) }
        assertThrows { StationaryPolicy(speedThresholdMps = -1.0) }
        assertThrows { ProviderMixer(listOf(ProviderProfile.GPS, ProviderProfile.GPS)) }
    }

    private fun assertThrows(block: () -> Unit) {
        try {
            block()
        } catch (_: IllegalArgumentException) {
            return
        }
        throw AssertionError("Expected IllegalArgumentException")
    }
}
```

`core/src/test/kotlin/com/system/location/service/core/RawGnssSynthesisTest.kt`:

```kt
package com.system.location.service.core

import com.system.location.service.core.gnss.BundledGnssFallback
import com.system.location.service.core.gnss.GnssBundledOrbitResources
import com.system.location.service.core.gnss.RawGnssSynthesis
import org.junit.Assert.assertEquals
import org.junit.Assert.assertTrue
import org.junit.Test

class RawGnssSynthesisTest {
    @Test fun bundledAlmanacPromotesToUsableGpsEphemerides() {
        val almanac = requireNotNull(GnssBundledOrbitResources.gpsAlmanac())
        val reference = almanac.first().referenceTime
        val now = requireNotNull(GnssBundledOrbitResources.utcTimeScale())
            .utcAtGpsTime(reference).utcMillis
        val ephemerides = RawGnssSynthesis.ephemerides(null, requireNotNull(now))
        assertTrue("Expected a usable GPS constellation", ephemerides.size >= 4)
        assertTrue("Every ephemeris must be healthy", ephemerides.all { it.health == 0 })
        assertEquals(ephemerides.size, ephemerides.map { it.svid }.distinct().size)
        assertTrue(ephemerides.all { it.sqrtSemiMajorAxis in 2530.0..8192.0 })
    }

    @Test fun embeddedFallbackMatchesBundledResources() {
        val virtual = requireNotNull(BundledGnssFallback.read("virtual-walker.json"))
        val utc = requireNotNull(BundledGnssFallback.read("leap-seconds.list"))
        val yuma = requireNotNull(BundledGnssFallback.read("gps-yuma.json"))
        assertTrue(virtual.startsWith("{"))
        assertTrue(utc.length > 100)
        assertTrue(yuma.contains("almanac"))
    }

    @Test fun malformedOrExpiredTimeDoesNotInventEphemerides() {
        assertTrue(RawGnssSynthesis.ephemerides(null, Long.MAX_VALUE).isEmpty())
    }
}
```

`core/src/test/kotlin/com/system/location/service/core/ReceiverAutonomousSkyModelTest.kt`:

```kt
package com.system.location.service.core

import com.system.location.service.core.geo.Wgs84
import com.system.location.service.core.gnss.*
import org.junit.Assert.*
import org.junit.Test

class ReceiverAutonomousSkyModelTest {
    @Test fun physicalPolicyReportsOutputEnvelopeOverflowWithoutSilentlyTruncatingSky() {
        val provider = almanac.provider(utc, 604800.0)
        val original = ReceiverAutonomousSkyModel(listOf(provider), virtual, GnssSimulationPolicy()).frame(request)!!
        assertTrue(original.satellites.size > 1)
        for (limits in listOf(GnssOutputLimits(1, 36, 1), GnssOutputLimits(128, 1, 32))) {
            val frame = ReceiverAutonomousSkyModel(listOf(provider), virtual, GnssSimulationPolicy(),
                quantitySupplement = GnssVirtualSkySupplement(emptyList(), limits, 123)).frame(request)!!
            assertEquals(original.satellites, frame.satellites)
            assertTrue(frame.diagnostics.any { "超出已验证输出能力" in it })
        }
    }

    @Test fun emptyRealPoolKeepsUnhealthyAndStaleReservationsThroughFallbackAndSupplement() {
        val reserved = (1..32).map { Constellation.GPS to it }.toSet()
        for (blocked in listOf(reserved, emptySet())) {
            val unavailable = object : GnssOrbitProvider {
                override val kind = GnssOrbitSourceKind.BROADCAST_EPHEMERIS
                override fun positions(request: GnssSkyRequest) = GnssOrbitBatch(emptyList(),
                    listOf("real resource unavailable"), reserved, blocked)
            }
            val identities = reserved.toList() + (1..36).map { Constellation.GALILEO to it } +
                (1..63).map { Constellation.BEIDOU to it }
            val model = ReceiverAutonomousSkyModel(listOf(unavailable), virtual,
                GnssSimulationPolicy(minimumPolicy = GnssMinimumPolicy.GUARANTEE_QUANTITY),
                quantitySupplement = GnssVirtualSkySupplement(identities, GnssOutputLimits(64, 36, 16), 123))
            val frame = model.frame(request, 32)!!
            assertEquals(32, frame.satellites.size)
            assertTrue(frame.satellites.none { it.constellation == Constellation.GPS })
            assertTrue(frame.orbitProvenance.keys.none { it in reserved })
            assertTrue(frame.diagnostics.any { it.contains("保留身份") })
            assertTrue(frame.diagnostics.any { it.contains("real resource unavailable") })
            val insufficient = model.frame(request, 80)!!
            assertTrue(insufficient.satellites.size < 80)
            assertTrue(insufficient.satellites.none { (it.constellation to it.svid) in reserved })
        }
    }

    private val utc = GnssUtcTimeScale.parseIers(requireNotNull(
        javaClass.getResource("/gnss/leap-seconds.list")).readText())
    private val almanac = GpsAlmanacResource.decode(requireNotNull(
        javaClass.getResource("/gnss/gps-yuma.json")).readText())
    private val request = GnssSkyRequest(almanac.referenceEpochMillis, Wgs84(31.0, 121.0), 10.0)
    private val virtual = VirtualWalkerOrbitProvider(VirtualWalkerResource(revision = "test",
        referenceEpochMillis = 0, groups = listOf(
            VirtualWalkerGroup(Constellation.GPS, (1..32).toList(), 8, 1, 26_560_000.0, 0.95),
            VirtualWalkerGroup(Constellation.GALILEO, (1..36).toList(), 3, 1, 29_600_000.0, 0.98))), 123)

    @Test fun noCaptureNetworkOrResourceStillGeneratesTargetSkyAfterManyDays() {
        val model = ReceiverAutonomousSkyModel(emptyList(), virtual, GnssSimulationPolicy())
        val first = model.frame(request)!!
        val later = model.frame(request.copy(atMillis = request.atMillis + 10 * 86400000L))!!
        assertTrue(first.satellites.isNotEmpty() && later.satellites.isNotEmpty())
        assertTrue(first.orbitProvenance.values.all { it.kind == GnssOrbitSourceKind.VIRTUAL })
        assertEquals(first, model.frame(request))
        assertEquals(first.satellites.size, first.orbitProvenance.size)
        assertNotEquals(first.satellites, later.satellites)
    }

    @Test fun healthyAlmanacIsUsedAndExpirationSelectsVirtualWholeFrame() {
        val model = ReceiverAutonomousSkyModel(listOf(almanac.provider(utc, 604800.0)), virtual, GnssSimulationPolicy())
        val physical = model.frame(request)!!
        assertTrue(physical.satellites.isNotEmpty())
        assertTrue(physical.orbitProvenance.values.all { it.kind == GnssOrbitSourceKind.ALMANAC })
        assertTrue(physical.satellites.none { it.hasEphemeris || it.usedInFix })
        assertEquals(0, physical.simulatedNavigationSatelliteCount)
        val fallback = model.frame(request.copy(atMillis = request.atMillis + 8 * 86400000L))!!
        assertTrue(fallback.orbitProvenance.values.all { it.kind == GnssOrbitSourceKind.VIRTUAL })
        assertTrue(fallback.diagnostics.any { it.contains("age budget") })
    }

    @Test fun targetLocationChangesGeometryRatherThanOnlyFrameLabel() {
        val model = ReceiverAutonomousSkyModel(emptyList(), virtual, GnssSimulationPolicy())
        val local = model.frame(request)!!
        val remote = model.frame(request.copy(observer = Wgs84(-31.0, -59.0)))!!
        assertNotEquals(local.satellites.map { it.constellation to it.svid }, remote.satellites.map { it.constellation to it.svid })
        assertTrue(local.satellites.all { it.elevationDeg >= 0 && it.azimuthDeg < 360 })
    }

    @Test fun indoorEnvironmentCanHaveVisibleSkyWithoutTrackingOrFix() {
        val model = ReceiverAutonomousSkyModel(emptyList(), virtual,
            GnssSimulationPolicy(environment = GnssSimulationEnvironment.INDOOR))
        val frame = model.frame(request)!!
        assertTrue(frame.satellites.isNotEmpty())
        assertEquals(0, frame.trackedSatelliteCount)
        assertTrue(frame.satellites.none { it.usedInFix })
        assertNull(frame.geometry.dop)
        assertTrue(frame.simulatedNavigationSatelliteCount > 0)
    }

    @Test fun noNavigationDoesNotGainUsedFlagsFromCountAndReplayOffDoNotRunAutonomousEngine() {
        val frame = ReceiverAutonomousSkyModel(emptyList(), virtual, GnssSimulationPolicy(),
            simulateNavigation = false).frame(request)!!
        assertTrue(frame.satellites.isNotEmpty())
        assertTrue(frame.satellites.none { it.usedInFix || it.hasEphemeris })
        assertNull(frame.geometry.dop)
        for (mode in listOf(GnssSimulationMode.OFF, GnssSimulationMode.REPLAY)) {
            assertNull(ReceiverAutonomousSkyModel(emptyList(), virtual, GnssSimulationPolicy(mode = mode)).frame(request))
        }
    }

    @Test fun physicalFloorReportsShortageWhileQuantityPolicyUsesOnlyUnreservedVirtualIds() {
        val identities = (1..32).map { Constellation.GPS to it } + (1..36).map { Constellation.GALILEO to it }
        val provider = almanac.provider(utc, 604800.0)
        val physical = ReceiverAutonomousSkyModel(listOf(provider), virtual, GnssSimulationPolicy()).frame(request, 32)!!
        assertTrue(physical.satellites.size < 32)
        assertTrue(physical.diagnostics.any { it.contains("未满足") })
        val model = ReceiverAutonomousSkyModel(listOf(provider), virtual,
            GnssSimulationPolicy(minimumPolicy = GnssMinimumPolicy.GUARANTEE_QUANTITY),
            quantitySupplement = GnssVirtualSkySupplement(identities, GnssOutputLimits(64, 36, 16), 123))
        val guaranteed = model.frame(request, 32)!!
        assertEquals(32, guaranteed.satellites.size)
        assertEquals(32, guaranteed.requestedMinimumSatellites)
        assertTrue(guaranteed.satellites.count { it.usedInFix } <= 16)
        assertEquals(physical.satellites.map { it.constellation to it.svid }.toSet(),
            guaranteed.orbitProvenance.filterValues { it.kind != GnssOrbitSourceKind.VIRTUAL }.keys)
        // All GPS identities, including the hidden ones, are reserved by the real upload.
        assertTrue(guaranteed.orbitProvenance.filterValues { it.kind == GnssOrbitSourceKind.VIRTUAL }
            .keys.all { it.first == Constellation.GALILEO })
        assertTrue(guaranteed.availableSatelliteCapacity >= 32)
        val unsupported = model.frame(request, 64)!!
        assertTrue(unsupported.satellites.size < 64)
        assertTrue(unsupported.diagnostics.any { it.contains("无法保证") })
    }

    @Test fun guaranteedIndoorVisibleFloorStillDoesNotPromiseTrackingOrFiniteDop() {
        val identities = (1..36).map { Constellation.GALILEO to it }
        val model = ReceiverAutonomousSkyModel(listOf(almanac.provider(utc, 604800.0)), virtual,
            GnssSimulationPolicy(minimumPolicy = GnssMinimumPolicy.GUARANTEE_QUANTITY,
                environment = GnssSimulationEnvironment.INDOOR),
            quantitySupplement = GnssVirtualSkySupplement(identities, GnssOutputLimits(64, 36, 32), 123))
        val frame = model.frame(request, 32)!!
        assertEquals(32, frame.satellites.size)
        assertEquals(0, frame.trackedSatelliteCount)
        assertTrue(frame.satellites.none { it.usedInFix })
        assertNull(frame.geometry.dop)
    }
}
```

`core/src/test/kotlin/com/system/location/service/core/ReceiverBroadcastSkyModelTest.kt`:

```kt
package com.system.location.service.core

import com.system.location.service.core.geo.Wgs84
import com.system.location.service.core.gnss.*
import com.system.location.service.core.location.LocationSample
import java.util.Base64
import kotlinx.serialization.json.*
import org.junit.Assert.*
import org.junit.Test

class ReceiverBroadcastSkyModelTest {
    private val point = Wgs84(89.999, -179.9)
    private val elapsed = 100_000_000_000L
    private fun decoded(): DecodedGpsLnav {
        val words = Json.parseToJsonElement(javaClass.getResource("/gnss/gps-lnav-words-reference.json")!!
            .readText()).jsonObject.getValue("subframes").jsonArray.take(3)
        val frames = words.map { value ->
            val f = value.jsonObject
            val id = f.getValue("id").jsonPrimitive.int
            val bytes = f.getValue("payloadHex").jsonPrimitive.content.chunked(2).map { it.toInt(16).toByte() }.toByteArray()
            GpsLnavWords.decode(GnssNavigationObservation(id * 6000L, 0x0101, 1, 1, -1, id,
                Base64.getEncoder().encodeToString(bytes))).subframe!!
        }
        return GpsLnavEphemerisDecoder.decode(frames, GpsTime(1316, frames.first().nextTowSeconds.toDouble())).decoded!!
    }

    private fun capture(): GnssCapture {
        val d = decoded()
        return GnssCapture(deviceModel = "synthetic test receiver", osVersion = "test", startedAtMillis = 1000,
            endedAtMillis = 61000, bootCount = 42,
            gpsBroadcastEvidence = GpsBroadcastEvidence(GpsElapsedClockEvidence(42, d.ephemeris.toe.week,
                d.ephemeris.toe.secondsOfWeek, elapsed, 1e-8, 1e-8), listOf(d)),
            frames = (0..60).map { index -> GnssObservationFrame(1000L + index * 1000, point,
                satellites = buildList {
                    // GPS 1 is genuine evidence in the capture, but outside the local replay pool.
                    if (index == 0) add(GnssSatellite(Constellation.GPS, 1, 10f, 10f, 20f, true, true, true))
                    add(GnssSatellite(Constellation.GPS, 9, if (index % 2 == 0) 0f else 90f,
                        90f, if (index % 2 == 0) 20f else 50f, true, true, true))
                    repeat(3) { add(GnssSatellite(Constellation.BEIDOU, it + 1, 30f, it * 120f, 35f, true, true, true)) }
                }) })
    }

    @Test fun broadcastGeometryChangesWithObserverAndRecombinesCandidateDop() {
        val c = capture()
        val m = ReceiverBroadcastSkyModel(c)
        assertNull(ReceiverGnssSkyModel(c).frame(62000, point, 0.0)!!.geometry.dop)
        val result = m.frame(62000, point, 0.0, elapsedRealtimeNanos = elapsed, currentBootCount = 42)!!
        assertEquals(ReceiverGnssSource.HYBRID_BROADCAST_REPLAY, result.source)
        val gps = result.satellites.single { it.constellation == Constellation.GPS && it.svid == 1 }
        val expected = GpsReceptionGeometry.observe(decoded().ephemeris, decoded().ephemeris.toe, point, 0.0).observation!!
        assertEquals(expected.lineOfSight.elevationDegrees, gps.elevationDeg.toDouble(), 1e-5)
        assertEquals(expected.lineOfSight.azimuthDegrees!!, gps.azimuthDeg.toDouble(), 1e-5)
        assertNotEquals(10f, gps.elevationDeg)
        assertNotNull(result.geometry.dop)
        assertEquals(result.geometry.dop, GnssGeometry.solve(result.satellites).dop)
        assertEquals(result, m.frame(62000, point, 0.0, elapsedRealtimeNanos = elapsed, currentBootCount = 42))
        val hidden = m.frame(62000, Wgs84(0.0, 0.0), 0.0, 128, elapsed, 42)!!
        assertFalse(hidden.satellites.any { it.constellation == Constellation.GPS && it.svid == 1 })
        assertEquals(4, hidden.availableSatelliteCapacity)
        assertTrue(hidden.diagnostics.any { it.contains("无法满足") })
        assertNull(hidden.geometry.dop)
        assertTrue(hidden.satellites.none { it.usedInFix })
    }

    @Test fun oldBootMissingTimeAndExpiredClockUseExplicitStatisticalSource() {
        val m = ReceiverBroadcastSkyModel(capture())
        listOf(null to 42, elapsed to null, elapsed to 43, elapsed + 1801_000_000_000L to 42).forEach { (t, boot) ->
            val result = m.frame(62000, point, 0.0, elapsedRealtimeNanos = t, currentBootCount = boot)!!
            assertEquals(ReceiverGnssSource.STATISTICAL_REPLAY, result.source)
            assertTrue(result.diagnostics.any { it.contains("同次开机") })
        }
    }

    @Test fun mixedSkyDoesNotTruncateMeasuredIdentitiesAtTheMinimumSettingCeiling() {
        val source = capture()
        val others = listOf(Constellation.BEIDOU to 63, Constellation.GALILEO to 36,
            Constellation.GLONASS to 25, Constellation.IRNSS to 14).flatMap { (system, count) ->
            (1..count).map { id -> GnssSatellite(system, id, (id % 75 + 5).toFloat(),
                (id * 11 % 360).toFloat(), 35f, true, true, true) }
        }
        val c = source.copy(frames = source.frames.map { frame ->
            frame.copy(satellites = frame.satellites.filter { it.constellation == Constellation.GPS } + others)
        })
        val frame = ReceiverBroadcastSkyModel(c).frame(62000, point, 0.0,
            elapsedRealtimeNanos = elapsed, currentBootCount = 42)!!
        assertEquals(140, frame.satellites.size)
        assertEquals(140, frame.availableSatelliteCapacity)
        assertTrue(frame.satellites.any { it.constellation == Constellation.GPS && it.svid == 1 })
        assertTrue(others.all { s -> frame.satellites.any { it.constellation == s.constellation && it.svid == s.svid } })
        assertEquals(ReceiverGnssSource.HYBRID_BROADCAST_REPLAY, frame.source)
    }

    @Test fun capturePreviewUsesTheProductionModelAndExposesItsSource() {
        val c = capture()
        val previewer = GnssCapturePreviewer(c)
        val preview = previewer.current(62000, 0, elapsed, 42)
        assertEquals(GnssCapturePlaybackState.READY, preview.state)
        assertEquals(ReceiverBroadcastSkyModel(c).frame(62000, point, 0.0, 0, elapsed, 42), preview.frame)
        assertEquals(ReceiverGnssSource.HYBRID_BROADCAST_REPLAY, preview.frame!!.source)
        assertEquals(ReceiverGnssSource.STATISTICAL_REPLAY, previewer.current(62000, 0).frame!!.source)
    }

    @Test fun fitAndCalibrationFailuresCannotResurrectStatisticalGeometryForSameIdentity() {
        val c = capture()
        val e = c.gpsBroadcastEvidence!!
        val old = e.ephemerides.single()
        val shortFit = old.copy(ephemeris = old.ephemeris.copy(validUntil = old.ephemeris.toe.plusSeconds(1.0)))
        val invalidFit = c.copy(gpsBroadcastEvidence = e.copy(ephemerides = listOf(shortFit)))
        val after = ReceiverBroadcastSkyModel(invalidFit).frame(62000, point, 0.0, 128, elapsed + 2_000_000_000, 42)!!
        assertFalse(after.satellites.any { it.constellation == Constellation.GPS && it.svid == 1 })
        assertTrue(after.diagnostics.any { it.contains("fit interval") })
        val noCalibration = c.copy(frames = c.frames.map { f -> f.copy(satellites = f.satellites.map {
            if (it.constellation == Constellation.GPS) it.copy(elevationDeg = 5f) else it
        }) })
        val excluded = ReceiverBroadcastSkyModel(noCalibration).frame(62000, point, 0.0, 128, elapsed, 42)!!
        assertFalse(excluded.satellites.any { it.constellation == Constellation.GPS && it.svid == 1 })
        assertTrue(excluded.diagnostics.any { it.contains("未外推 CN0") })
    }

    @Test fun productionSourceSharesOneFrameButNeverReusesItAcrossBootOrElapsedSecond() {
        val source = CapturedGnssSource.prepare(GnssCaptureWire.encode(capture()))!!
        assertTrue(source.requiresBootIdentity)
        val sample = LocationSample(point, 0.0, 5f, 0f, 0f, 62000, elapsed)
        val first = source.frame(sample, 0, GnssFrameRoute.Global, 62000, 42)!!
        assertEquals(ReceiverGnssSource.HYBRID_BROADCAST_REPLAY, first.frame.source)
        assertSame(first, source.frame(sample.copy(timeMillis = 62900, elapsedNanos = elapsed + 900_000_000L),
            0, GnssFrameRoute.Global, 62900, 42))
        // Crossing UTC's boundary inside one elapsed second must not publish an extra frame.
        assertSame(first, source.frame(sample.copy(timeMillis = 63000, elapsedNanos = elapsed + 950_000_000L),
            0, GnssFrameRoute.Global, 63000, 42))
        val next = source.frame(sample.copy(elapsedNanos = elapsed + 1_000_000_000L),
            0, GnssFrameRoute.Global, 62000, 42)!!
        assertNotEquals(first.sequence, next.sequence)
        assertNotEquals(first.frame.satellites, next.frame.satellites)
        val otherBoot = source.frame(sample, 0, GnssFrameRoute.Global, 62000, 43)!!
        assertNotEquals(first.sequence, otherBoot.sequence)
        assertEquals(ReceiverGnssSource.STATISTICAL_REPLAY, otherBoot.frame.source)
        val missingBoot = source.frame(sample, 0, GnssFrameRoute.Global, 62000)!!
        assertEquals(ReceiverGnssSource.STATISTICAL_REPLAY, missingBoot.frame.source)
        // A frozen Location UTC timestamp cannot retain physical output indefinitely.
        val expired = source.frame(sample.copy(elapsedNanos = elapsed + 1801_000_000_000L),
            0, GnssFrameRoute.Global, 62000, 42)!!
        assertEquals(ReceiverGnssSource.STATISTICAL_REPLAY, expired.frame.source)
        assertNotEquals(first.sequence, expired.sequence)
        val fixed = source.frame(sample, 0, GnssFrameRoute.FixedPoint(point), 62000, 42)!!
        assertNotEquals(first.sequence, fixed.sequence)
        assertSame(first, source.frame(sample, 0, GnssFrameRoute.Global, 62000, 42))
    }

    @Test fun physicalFrameRetainsTheExactFirstSampleUtcLabelForItsElapsedEpoch() {
        val source = CapturedGnssSource.prepare(GnssCaptureWire.encode(capture()))!!
        val sample = LocationSample(point, 0.0, 5f, 0f, 0f, 62125, elapsed + 125_000_000L)
        val publication = source.frame(sample, 0, GnssFrameRoute.Global, 62125, 42)!!
        assertEquals(62125L, publication.frame.generatedAtMillis)
        val expected = GpsReceptionGeometry.observe(decoded().ephemeris,
            decoded().ephemeris.toe.plusSeconds(0.125), point, 0.0).observation!!.lineOfSight
        val gps = publication.frame.satellites.single { it.constellation == Constellation.GPS && it.svid == 1 }
        assertEquals(expected.elevationDegrees, gps.elevationDeg.toDouble(), 1e-5)
        val same = source.frame(sample.copy(timeMillis = 62800, elapsedNanos = elapsed + 800_000_000L),
            0, GnssFrameRoute.Global, 62800, 42)!!
        assertSame(publication, same)
        assertEquals(62125L, same.frame.generatedAtMillis)
    }
}
```

`core/src/test/kotlin/com/system/location/service/core/ReceiverGnssSkyModelTest.kt`:

```kt
package com.system.location.service.core

import com.system.location.service.core.geo.Wgs84
import com.system.location.service.core.gnss.*
import org.junit.Assert.*
import org.junit.Test

class ReceiverGnssSkyModelTest {
    @Test fun interpolationNearNorthDoesNotRoundToAnInvalid360DegreeFrame() {
        val source = capture().let { source -> source.copy(frames = source.frames.mapIndexed { index, frame ->
            frame.copy(satellites = frame.satellites.map {
                it.copy(azimuthDeg = if (index < 30) 359.99997f else 0f)
            })
        }) }
        val frame = ReceiverGnssSkyModel(source).frame(91500, observer, 0.0)!!
        assertTrue(frame.satellites.all { it.azimuthDeg in 0f..<360f })
        assertEquals(0f, frame.satellites.first().azimuthDeg, 0f)
    }

    private val observer = Wgs84(31.0, 121.0)
    private fun satellite(id: Int, system: Constellation = Constellation.GPS) =
        GnssSatellite(system, id, 20f + id, 100f, 30f + id, true, true, true)
    private fun capture() = GnssCapture(deviceModel = "device", osVersion = "os", startedAtMillis = 1000, endedAtMillis = 61000,
        frames = (0..60).map { index -> GnssObservationFrame(1000L + index * 1000, observer,
            satellites = buildList {
                add(satellite(1).copy(azimuthDeg = if (index < 30) 359f else 1f))
                add(satellite(1, Constellation.BEIDOU))
                if (index % 4 == 0) add(satellite(2))
            }) })

    @Test fun automaticCountsAndConstellationSamplesFollowTheCapture() {
        val model = ReceiverGnssSkyModel(capture())
        // A complete reverse traversal retains every captured frame's joint empirical distribution.
        val observed = (0..60).map { model.frame(61000L + it * 1000, observer, 0.0)!! }
        assertEquals(capture().frames.sumOf { it.satellites.size }, observed.sumOf { it.satellites.size })
        assertEquals(setOf(2, 3), observed.map { it.satellites.size }.toSet())
        assertTrue(observed.all { it.source == ReceiverGnssSource.STATISTICAL_REPLAY })
    }

    @Test fun minimumUsesOnlyObservedIdentitiesAndReportsUnavailableCapacity() {
        val model = ReceiverGnssSkyModel(capture())
        val automatic = model.frame(62000, observer, 0.0)!!
        assertEquals(2, automatic.satellites.size)
        assertEquals(3, automatic.availableSatelliteCapacity)
        assertEquals(0, automatic.requestedMinimumSatellites)
        assertEquals(3, model.frame(62000, observer, 0.0, 3)!!.satellites.size)
        val excessive = model.frame(62000, observer, 0.0, 30)!!
        assertEquals(3, excessive.satellites.size)
        assertEquals(automatic.availableSatelliteCapacity, excessive.availableSatelliteCapacity)
        assertEquals(30, excessive.requestedMinimumSatellites)
        assertTrue(excessive.diagnostics.any { it.contains("无法满足") })
        assertNull(excessive.geometry.dop)
    }

    @Test fun capacityExcludesIdentitiesOutsideTheCurrentEvidenceWindow() {
        val source = capture()
        val withOldIdentity = source.copy(frames = source.frames.mapIndexed { index, frame ->
            if (index == 0) frame.copy(satellites = frame.satellites + satellite(3)) else frame
        })
        val model = ReceiverGnssSkyModel(withOldIdentity)
        assertEquals(3, model.frame(62000, observer, 0.0, 10)!!.availableSatelliteCapacity)
        assertEquals(4, model.frame(121000, observer, 0.0, 10)!!.availableSatelliteCapacity)
    }

    @Test fun interpolationCrossesNorthViaTheShortestArcAndIsDeterministic() {
        val model = ReceiverGnssSkyModel(capture(), 0)
        val first = model.frame(91500, observer, 0.0)!!
        assertEquals(first, model.frame(91500, observer, 0.0))
        assertEquals(0f, first.satellites.first().azimuthDeg, 1e-5f)
        assertTrue(first.satellites.all { it.elevationDeg >= 0 && it.azimuthDeg < 360 })
    }

    @Test fun invalidOrExpiredCaptureReturnsNoFrame() {
        val expired = ReceiverGnssSkyModel(capture()).frame(61001 + GnssCaptureValidator.MAX_AGE_MILLIS, observer, 0.0)
        assertNull(expired)
        val sparse = capture().copy(frames = capture().frames.take(1))
        assertNull(ReceiverGnssSkyModel(sparse).frame(62000, observer, 0.0))
    }

    @Test fun visibleCapacityComesFromEvidenceAndIsNotTheMinimumSettingCeiling() {
        val identities = listOf(Constellation.GPS to 32, Constellation.BEIDOU to 63, Constellation.GALILEO to 36)
            .flatMap { (system, count) -> (1..count).map { id ->
                GnssSatellite(system, id, (id % 80 + 5).toFloat(), (id * 13 % 360).toFloat(), 30f,
                    true, true, true)
            } }
        val source = capture().copy(frames = capture().frames.map { it.copy(satellites = identities) })
        val model = ReceiverGnssSkyModel(source)
        val automatic = model.frame(62000, observer, 0.0)!!
        assertEquals(131, automatic.satellites.size)
        assertEquals(131, automatic.availableSatelliteCapacity)
        assertEquals(identities.map { it.constellation to it.svid }.toSet(),
            automatic.satellites.map { it.constellation to it.svid }.toSet())
        // A lower bound of 128 must not act as an upper bound on a larger measured sky.
        assertEquals(automatic.satellites, model.frame(62000, observer, 0.0, 128)!!.satellites)
    }
}
```

`core/src/test/kotlin/com/system/location/service/core/ReplayEnvironmentSourceTest.kt`:

```kt
package com.system.location.service.core

import com.system.location.service.core.environment.EnvironmentProfile
import com.system.location.service.core.environment.EnvironmentReplayPolicy
import com.system.location.service.core.environment.EnvironmentSourceType
import com.system.location.service.core.environment.ReplayEnvironmentSource
import com.system.location.service.core.environment.WifiAp
import com.system.location.service.core.geo.Wgs84
import org.junit.Assert.assertEquals
import org.junit.Assert.assertThrows
import org.junit.Assert.assertFalse
import org.junit.Assert.assertTrue
import org.junit.Test

class ReplayEnvironmentSourceTest {
    private val origin = Wgs84(31.2304, 121.4737)
    private val ap = WifiAp(
        ssid = "ChinaNet-1234",
        bssid = "A4:50:46:12:34:56",
        rssi = -55,
        frequencyMhz = 2412,
        channel = 1,
        connected = true,
    )
    private val captured = EnvironmentProfile(
        source = EnvironmentSourceType.REPLAY,
        origin = origin,
        originAccuracyMeters = 10.0,
        generatedAtMillis = 1,
        seed = 1,
        wifi = listOf(ap),
    )

    @Test
    fun sameOriginKeepsRssiAndIdentity() {
        val replay = ReplayEnvironmentSource(captured)
        val result = replay.profileAt(origin, seed = 2, atMillis = 100)
        assertEquals(ap, result.connectedWifi())
        assertEquals(EnvironmentSourceType.REPLAY, result.source)
        assertEquals(origin, result.origin)
        assertEquals(2L, result.seed)
    }

    @Test
    fun nearbyTargetKeepsProfileWithinMeasuredRange() {
        val replay = ReplayEnvironmentSource(captured)
        val nearby = Wgs84(origin.latitude + 0.00004, origin.longitude) // ~4 m
        val result = replay.profileAt(nearby, seed = 1, atMillis = 100).connectedWifi()!!
        assertEquals(ap.rssi, result.rssi)
        assertEquals(ap.bssid, result.bssid)
        assertEquals(ap.ssid, result.ssid)
        assertTrue(result.rssi in WifiAp.MIN_RSSI..WifiAp.MAX_RSSI)
    }

    @Test
    fun missingOriginOrAccuracyIsNotApplicable() {
        val unlocated = captured.copy(origin = null, originAccuracyMeters = null)
        assertFalse(EnvironmentReplayPolicy.isApplicable(unlocated, origin))
        assertFalse(EnvironmentReplayPolicy.isApplicable(captured.copy(originAccuracyMeters = null), origin))
        assertThrows(IllegalArgumentException::class.java) {
            ReplayEnvironmentSource(unlocated).profileAt(origin, 1, 100)
        }
    }

    @Test
    fun targetOutsideMeasuredRangeIsRejected() {
        val far = Wgs84(origin.latitude + 0.01, origin.longitude)
        assertFalse(EnvironmentReplayPolicy.isApplicable(captured, far))
        assertThrows(IllegalArgumentException::class.java) {
            ReplayEnvironmentSource(captured).profileAt(far, 1, 100)
        }
    }

    @Test
    fun onlyReplayProfilesAreAccepted() {
        assertThrows(IllegalArgumentException::class.java) {
            ReplayEnvironmentSource(captured.copy(source = EnvironmentSourceType.PROCEDURAL))
        }
    }
}
```

`core/src/test/kotlin/com/system/location/service/core/RepositoryTest.kt`:

```kt
package com.system.location.service.core

import com.system.location.service.core.repository.*
import com.system.location.service.core.geo.Wgs84
import com.system.location.service.core.scenario.*
import org.junit.Assert.*
import org.junit.Test
import java.util.concurrent.CountDownLatch
import java.util.concurrent.Executors
import java.util.concurrent.TimeUnit

class RepositoryTest {
    private class Store : DocumentStore {
        var text: String? = null
        var fail = false
        override fun read() = text
        override fun writeAtomically(text: String) { if (fail) error("disk full"); this.text = text }
    }
    private val points = listOf(Wgs84(25.123456789012345, 119.12345678901234), Wgs84(25.2, 119.3))
    private val route = SavedRoute(Route("route1", "路线\"一\",二", points))

    @Test fun routeCrudCopyModesAndDoublePersistence() {
        val store = Store(); val repository = RouteRepository(store)
        repository.create(route)
        repository.rename("route1", "新名称")
        repository.favorite("route1", true)
        repository.mode("route1", RouteMode.PING_PONG)
        val restored = RouteRepository(store).get("route1")!!
        assertEquals(points.first().latitude.toBits(), restored.route.points.first().latitude.toBits())
        assertTrue(restored.favorite); assertEquals(RouteMode.PING_PONG, restored.mode)
        val copy = repository.copy("route1", "副本")
        assertNotEquals("route1", copy.route.id)
        assertTrue(repository.delete("route1")); assertNull(repository.get("route1"))
        assertEquals(1, repository.list().size)
    }
    @Test fun failedImportOrWritePreservesTheOriginalDocument() {
        val store = Store(); val repo = RouteRepository(store); repo.create(route)
        val original = store.text
        assertThrows(IllegalArgumentException::class.java) { repo.importJson(original!!.replace("\"schemaVersion\":1", "\"schemaVersion\":2")) }
        assertThrows(IllegalArgumentException::class.java) { repo.importJson(original!!.replace("25.2", "95.2")) }
        store.fail = true
        assertThrows(IllegalStateException::class.java) { repo.delete("route1") }
        assertEquals(original, store.text); assertEquals(route, repo.get("route1"))
    }
    @Test fun importsCopyConflictingIdsAndRejectWrongLibraryKind() {
        val repo = RouteRepository(Store()); repo.create(route)
        val imported = repo.importJson(repo.exportJson())
        assertNotEquals(route.route.id, imported.single().route.id)
        assertEquals(2, repo.list().size)
        val appended = repo.importItems(listOf(route)).single()
        assertNotEquals(route.route.id, appended.route.id)
        assertEquals(route.route.points, appended.route.points)
        assertEquals(3, repo.list().size)
        assertThrows(IllegalArgumentException::class.java) { LocationRepository(Store()).importJson(repo.exportJson()) }
    }
    @Test fun invalidBatchOrFailedAppendLeavesTheWholeDocumentUnchanged() {
        val store = Store(); val repo = RouteRepository(store); repo.create(route)
        val original = store.text
        val mutable = points.toMutableList()
        val invalid = SavedRoute(Route("invalid", "invalid", mutable))
        mutable.clear()
        assertThrows(IllegalArgumentException::class.java) { repo.importItems(listOf(route, invalid)) }
        assertEquals(original, store.text)
        assertThrows(IllegalArgumentException::class.java) { repo.importItems(listOf(route, route)) }
        assertEquals(original, store.text)
        assertThrows(IllegalArgumentException::class.java) { repo.importItems(List(10_001) { i ->
            route.copy(route = route.route.copy(id = "batch$i"))
        }) }
        assertEquals(original, store.text)
        store.fail = true
        assertThrows(IllegalStateException::class.java) { repo.importItems(listOf(route)) }
        assertEquals(original, store.text)
        assertEquals(listOf(route), repo.list())
    }
    @Test fun sceneAndLocationLibrariesRoundTripAndSupportCrud() {
        val scenes = ScenarioRepository(Store())
        val scene = Scenario("s", "场景", point = points.first())
        scenes.create(scene); scenes.update(scene.copy(name = "重命名")); scenes.copy("s", "副本")
        val imported = ScenarioRepository(Store()); imported.importJson(scenes.exportJson())
        assertEquals(scenes.list(), imported.list()); assertTrue(scenes.delete("s"))
        val locations = LocationRepository(Store())
        val location = SavedLocation("l", "地址,\"含引号\"", points.first(), "第二行\n街道")
        locations.create(location); locations.update(location.copy(favorite = true)); locations.copy("l", "副本")
        val restored = LocationRepository(Store()); restored.importJson(locations.exportJson())
        assertEquals(locations.list(), restored.list()); assertTrue(locations.delete("l"))
    }
    @Test fun mutatingAnEditorAfterSaveCannotChangeStoredRoute() {
        val mutable = points.toMutableList()
        val repo = RouteRepository(Store()); repo.create(route.copy(route = route.route.copy(points = mutable)))
        mutable[0] = Wgs84(0.0, 0.0)
        assertEquals(points, repo.get("route1")!!.route.points)
    }

    @Test fun batchImportPreservesConcurrentCreateAndExistingSettings() {
        val repo = RouteRepository(Store())
        val original = route.copy(mode = RouteMode.PING_PONG, favorite = true)
        repo.create(original)

        val readingIncoming = CountDownLatch(1)
        val releaseIncoming = CountDownLatch(1)
        val creating = CountDownLatch(1)
        val created = CountDownLatch(1)
        val incoming = object : AbstractList<SavedRoute>() {
            override val size = 1
            override fun get(index: Int): SavedRoute {
                readingIncoming.countDown()
                check(releaseIncoming.await(5, TimeUnit.SECONDS))
                return route.copy(route = route.route.copy(id = "imported"))
            }
        }
        val executor = Executors.newFixedThreadPool(2)
        try {
            val imported = executor.submit { repo.importItems(incoming) }
            assertTrue(readingIncoming.await(5, TimeUnit.SECONDS))
            val concurrent = executor.submit {
                creating.countDown()
                repo.create(route.copy(route = route.route.copy(id = "concurrent")))
                created.countDown()
            }
            assertTrue(creating.await(5, TimeUnit.SECONDS))
            // If import releases the lock between its snapshot and write, let create finish first.
            created.await(200, TimeUnit.MILLISECONDS)
            releaseIncoming.countDown()
            imported.get(5, TimeUnit.SECONDS)
            concurrent.get(5, TimeUnit.SECONDS)
            assertEquals(setOf("route1", "imported", "concurrent"), repo.list().map { it.route.id }.toSet())
            assertEquals(original, repo.get("route1"))
        } finally {
            releaseIncoming.countDown()
            executor.shutdownNow()
        }
    }
}
```

`core/src/test/kotlin/com/system/location/service/core/RinexBeiDouImporterTest.kt`:

```kt
package com.system.location.service.core

import com.system.location.service.core.gnss.*
import java.time.LocalDate
import kotlin.math.sqrt
import org.junit.Assert.*
import org.junit.Test

class RinexBeiDouImporterTest {
    private val toe = BeiDouTime(1088, 0.0)
    private val from = toe.plusSeconds(-3600.0)
    private val until = toe.plusSeconds(3600.0)
    private val record = RinexNavigationRecord(RinexNavigationSystem.BEIDOU, 6,
        RinexNavigationEpoch(LocalDate.of(2026, 11, 8), 0, 0, 0), listOf(1e-4, 2e-12, 3e-20),
        listOf(listOf(4.0, 10.0, 2e-9, 0.5), listOf(1e-6, 0.01, 2e-6, sqrt(42164000.0)),
            listOf(0.0, 3e-8, 0.8, 4e-8), listOf(0.1, 20.0, 1.0, -6e-9),
            listOf(7e-10, null, 1088.0, null), listOf(2.4, 0.0, 5e-9, -6e-9),
            listOf(-30.0, 5.0, null, null)))
    private fun change(row: Int, column: Int, value: Double?) = record.copy(orbit = record.orbit.mapIndexed { r, values ->
        if (r == row) values.mapIndexed { c, old -> if (c == column) value else old } else values
    })

    @Test fun bdtWeekIsNotGpsAndAgeFieldsAreNotFitOrIssueIdentifiers() {
        val imported = RinexBeiDouImporter.decode(record, BeiDouOrbitType.IGSO, from, until)
        assertEquals(toe, imported.ephemeris.toe)
        assertEquals(toe, imported.ephemeris.toc)
        assertEquals(toe.plusSeconds(-30.0), imported.availableFrom)
        assertEquals(from, imported.ephemeris.validFrom)
        assertEquals(until, imported.ephemeris.validUntil)
        assertEquals(4, imported.ageOfDataEphemeris)
        assertEquals(5, imported.ageOfDataClock)
        assertEquals(2.4, imported.accuracyMeters, 0.0)
        assertEquals(5e-9, imported.tgd1Seconds, 0.0)
        assertEquals(-6e-9, imported.tgd2Seconds, 0.0)
        assertEquals(1e-4, imported.ephemeris.af0Seconds, 0.0)
        assertEquals(10.0, imported.ephemeris.crsMeters, 0.0)
        assertEquals(20.0, imported.ephemeris.crcMeters, 0.0)
    }

    @Test fun geoAndIgsoUseExplicitClassificationInsteadOfPrnHeuristics() {
        val geo = RinexBeiDouImporter.decode(record, BeiDouOrbitType.GEO, from, until).ephemeris
        val igso = RinexBeiDouImporter.decode(record, BeiDouOrbitType.IGSO, from, until).ephemeris
        assertEquals(geo.svid, igso.svid)
        assertNotEquals(BeiDouBroadcastPropagator.propagate(geo, toe.plusSeconds(100.0)).state,
            BeiDouBroadcastPropagator.propagate(igso, toe.plusSeconds(100.0)).state)
        assertNull(BeiDouBroadcastPropagator.propagate(geo, until.plusSeconds(1.0)).state)
    }

    @Test fun missingOrInconsistentExternalApplicabilityAndFieldsAreRejected() {
        assertThrows(IllegalArgumentException::class.java) {
            RinexBeiDouImporter.decode(record, BeiDouOrbitType.GEO, toe, until)
        }
        for (bad in listOf(change(4, 2, 2444.0), change(6, 0, 999999999.999), change(6, 0, null),
            change(6, 1, 32.0), change(0, 0, 4.5), change(5, 1, 2.0), change(5, 3, null))) {
            assertThrows(IllegalArgumentException::class.java) {
                RinexBeiDouImporter.decode(bad, BeiDouOrbitType.GEO, from, until)
            }
        }
        assertEquals(1, RinexBeiDouImporter.decode(change(5, 1, 1.0), BeiDouOrbitType.GEO, from, until).health)
    }
}
```

`core/src/test/kotlin/com/system/location/service/core/RinexBeiDouOrbitProviderTest.kt`:

```kt
package com.system.location.service.core

import com.system.location.service.core.geo.Wgs84
import com.system.location.service.core.gnss.*
import java.time.Instant
import java.time.LocalDate
import java.util.Locale
import kotlin.math.sqrt
import org.junit.Assert.*
import org.junit.Test

class RinexBeiDouOrbitProviderTest {
    private val utc = GnssUtcTimeScale.parseIers(requireNotNull(javaClass.getResource("/gnss/leap-seconds.list")).readText())
    private val catalog = BeiDouSkyCatalog(BeiDouSatelliteMetadata.parse(
        requireNotNull(javaClass.getResource("/gnss/igs-beidou-metadata.snx")).readText()), 2026, 30 * 86400L, utc)
    private val epoch = Instant.parse("2026-11-07T23:59:55.750Z").toEpochMilli()
    private val record = RinexNavigationRecord(RinexNavigationSystem.BEIDOU, 19,
        RinexNavigationEpoch(LocalDate.of(2026, 11, 8), 0, 0, 0), listOf(0.0, 0.0, 0.0),
        listOf(listOf(7.0, 0.0, 0.0, 0.0), listOf(0.0, 0.0, 0.0, sqrt(27800000.0)),
            listOf(0.0, 0.0, 0.0, 0.0), listOf(0.95, 0.0, 0.0, 0.0),
            listOf(0.0, null, 1088.0, null), listOf(2.4, 0.0, 0.0, 0.0), listOf(-30.0, 7.0, null, null)))
    private val provenance = GnssOrbitProvenance("test-beidou", "1", "test", epoch, GnssOrbitSourceKind.BROADCAST_EPHEMERIS)
    private val policy = RinexBeiDouSkyPolicy(3600.0, 604800.0, true)
    private val request = GnssSkyRequest(epoch, Wgs84(31.0, 121.0), 0.0)
    private fun header(offset: Double = .25) = String.format(Locale.ROOT,
        "BDUT %17.10E%16.9E %6d%5d", offset, 0.0, 0, 1088).padEnd(60)
    private fun provider(records: List<RinexNavigationRecord> = listOf(record), headers: List<String> = listOf(header()),
        policy: RinexBeiDouSkyPolicy = this.policy) = RinexBeiDouOrbitProvider(
        RinexNavigationFile("3.05", headers, emptyList(), records), provenance, utc, catalog, policy)
    private fun change(row: Int, column: Int, value: Double?) = record.copy(orbit = record.orbit.mapIndexed { r, values ->
        if (r == row) values.mapIndexed { c, old -> if (c == column) value else old } else values
    })

    @Test fun fractionalBdtHealthAndNativeOrbitReachTheTargetEpochWithoutCaptureGeometry() {
        val position = provider().positions(request).positions.single()
        assertEquals(27800000.0, position.position.xMeters, 1e-7)
        assertEquals(0.0, position.position.yMeters, 1e-7)
        assertEquals(0.0, position.position.zMeters, 1e-7)
        assertEquals(epoch, position.provenance.referenceEpochMillis)
        assertEquals(1_561_098_000f, position.carrierHz)
        assertTrue(position.hasEphemeris)
        assertFalse(position.hasAlmanac)
        assertEquals(position, provider().positions(request.copy(observer = Wgs84(-31.0, -59.0))).positions.single())
        for (at in listOf(epoch + 3600001, epoch + 604800000, utc.expiresAtMillis))
            assertTrue(provider().positions(request.copy(atMillis = at)).positions.isEmpty())
    }

    @Test fun lowPrnGeoComesFromDatedSvnMetadataRatherThanHistoricalNumberRanges() {
        val geo = record.copy(svid = 4, orbit = record.orbit.mapIndexed { row, values -> when (row) {
            1 -> listOf(0.0, 0.0, 0.0, sqrt(42164000.0))
            3 -> listOf(0.0, 0.0, 0.0, 0.0)
            else -> values
        } })
        val position = provider(listOf(geo)).positions(request.copy(atMillis = epoch + 600000)).positions.single().position
        val decoded = RinexBeiDouImporter.decode(geo, BeiDouOrbitType.GEO, BeiDouTime(1087, 601200.0), BeiDouTime(1088, 3600.0))
        val expected = BeiDouBroadcastPropagator.propagate(decoded.ephemeris, BeiDouTime(1088, 600.0)).state!!
        assertEquals(EcefPosition(expected.xMeters, expected.yMeters, expected.zMeters), position)
        val wrong = BeiDouBroadcastPropagator.propagate(decoded.ephemeris.copy(orbitType = BeiDouOrbitType.MEO), BeiDouTime(1088, 600.0)).state!!
        assertTrue(kotlin.math.abs(position.zMeters - wrong.zMeters) > 1000)
        assertTrue(provider(listOf(record.copy(svid = 59))).positions(request).positions.isEmpty())
    }

    @Test fun latestMalformedConflictingUnhealthyOrFutureUploadNeverRevivesOldBroadcast() {
        val unhealthy = change(5, 1, 1.0).copy(orbit = change(5, 1, 1.0).orbit.mapIndexed { row, values ->
            if (row == 6) listOf(60.0, 7.0, null, null) else values
        })
        val after = request.copy(atMillis = epoch + 60000)
        assertEquals(1, provider(listOf(record, unhealthy)).positions(request).positions.size)
        assertEquals(setOf(Constellation.BEIDOU to 19), provider(listOf(record, unhealthy)).positions(after).blockedIdentities)
        val conflict = provider(listOf(record, change(5, 1, 1.0))).positions(request)
        assertTrue(conflict.positions.isEmpty())
        assertEquals(setOf(Constellation.BEIDOU to 19), conflict.blockedIdentities)
        val invalid = unhealthy.copy(orbit = unhealthy.orbit.mapIndexed { row, values ->
            if (row == 1) listOf(0.0, 0.0, 0.0, null) else values
        })
        assertTrue(provider(listOf(record, invalid)).positions(after).positions.isEmpty())
        assertTrue(provider(listOf(record, change(6, 0, null))).positions(request).positions.isEmpty())
        assertTrue(provider(listOf(unhealthy)).positions(request).positions.isEmpty())
    }

    @Test fun missingDamagedConflictingTimeCorrectionOrUnpermittedFrameUsesFallback() {
        for (source in listOf(provider(headers = emptyList()), provider(headers = listOf(header(), header(.5))),
            provider(headers = listOf(header(), "BDUT damaged")),
            provider(policy = policy.copy(allowAlignedFrameApproximation = false)))) {
            val batch = source.positions(request)
            assertTrue(batch.positions.isEmpty())
            assertEquals(setOf(Constellation.BEIDOU to 19), batch.reservedIdentities)
            assertTrue(batch.diagnostics.isNotEmpty())
        }
    }

    @Test fun downloadedBeiDouReachesProductionSkyWithReferenceTimeIndependentOfDownloadTime() {
        val text = navigationText(record)
        val resource = RinexNavigationResource.import(text, "https://example.org/navigation.rnx", epoch + 60000)
        val position = resource.beiDouProvider(utc, catalog, policy).positions(request).positions.single()
        assertEquals(epoch, position.provenance.referenceEpochMillis)
        val model = GnssBundledOrbitResources.model(GnssSimulationPolicy(), GnssOutputLimits(128, 36, 32),
            604800.0, navigation = resource)
        val frame = model.frame(request.copy(observer = Wgs84(0.0, 0.0)))!!
        assertEquals(GnssOrbitSourceKind.BROADCAST_EPHEMERIS, frame.orbitProvenance[Constellation.BEIDOU to 19]?.kind)
        assertEquals(epoch, frame.orbitProvenance[Constellation.BEIDOU to 19]?.referenceEpochMillis)
        assertTrue(frame.diagnostics.any { "IGS" in it || "files.igs.org" in it })
        val future = model.frame(request.copy(atMillis = Instant.parse("2028-01-01T00:00:00Z").toEpochMilli()))!!
        assertTrue(future.satellites.isNotEmpty())
        assertTrue(future.orbitProvenance.values.all { it.kind == GnssOrbitSourceKind.VIRTUAL })
    }

    @Test fun refreshedMetadataRestoresBroadcastAfterBundledCatalogExpiresWithoutExtendingItsAge() {
        // Analytic circular orbit at a later native BDT week, not a retimed real observation.
        val laterRecord = record.copy(epoch = RinexNavigationEpoch(LocalDate.of(2026, 11, 29), 0, 0, 0),
            orbit = record.orbit.mapIndexed { row, values -> if (row == 4) listOf(0.0, null, 1091.0, null) else values })
        val laterHeader = header().replace(" 1088", " 1091")
        val at = Instant.parse("2026-11-28T23:59:55.750Z").toEpochMilli()
        val navigation = RinexNavigationResource.import(navigationText(laterRecord, laterHeader),
            "https://example.org/analytic-nav", at)
        val request = GnssSkyRequest(at, Wgs84(0.0, 0.0), 0.0)
        fun frame(resource: RinexNavigationResource) = GnssBundledOrbitResources.model(GnssSimulationPolicy(),
            GnssOutputLimits(128, 36, 32), 604800.0, navigation = resource).frame(request)!!
        assertNull(frame(navigation).orbitProvenance[Constellation.BEIDOU to 19])
        val subset = requireNotNull(javaClass.getResource("/gnss/igs-beidou-metadata.snx")).readText()
            .replace("26:295:28054", "26:331:28054")
        val refreshed = BeiDouCatalogResource.import(subset, Instant.parse("2026-11-27T08:30:06Z").toEpochMilli())
        val accepted = RinexNavigationResource.decodeWire(RinexNavigationResource.encodeWire(
            navigation.copy(beiDouCatalog = refreshed)))
        val result = frame(accepted)
        assertEquals(GnssOrbitSourceKind.BROADCAST_EPHEMERIS,
            result.orbitProvenance[Constellation.BEIDOU to 19]?.kind)
        assertTrue(result.diagnostics.any { refreshed.manifest.originalSha256 in it })
        assertNull(frame(navigation).orbitProvenance[Constellation.BEIDOU to 19])
    }

    private fun navigationText(record: RinexNavigationRecord, correction: String = header()): String {
        fun fields(values: List<Double?>) = values.joinToString("") { value ->
            value?.let { String.format(Locale.ROOT, "%19.12E", it) } ?: " ".repeat(19)
        }
        val date = record.epoch.date.toString().replace('-', ' ')
        return "     3.05           NAVIGATION DATA     M".padEnd(60) + "RINEX VERSION / TYPE\n" +
            correction + "TIME SYSTEM CORR\n" + "".padEnd(60) + "END OF HEADER\n" +
            "C19 $date 00 00 00" + fields(record.clock) + "\n" +
            record.orbit.joinToString("\n") { "    " + fields(it) } + "\n"
    }
}
```

`core/src/test/kotlin/com/system/location/service/core/RinexBeiDouTimeScaleTest.kt`:

```kt
package com.system.location.service.core

import com.system.location.service.core.gnss.*
import java.time.Instant
import org.junit.Assert.*
import org.junit.Test

class RinexBeiDouTimeScaleTest {
    private val utc = GnssUtcTimeScale.parseIers(requireNotNull(javaClass.getResource("/gnss/leap-seconds.list")).readText())
    private val correction = RinexTimeSystemCorrection("BDUT", .25, 1e-5, 0, 1088, "", 7)
    private val epoch = Instant.parse("2026-11-07T23:59:56Z").toEpochMilli()

    @Test fun nonzeroPolynomialUsesBdtReferenceAndSolvesItsImplicitEquationAcrossWeekBoundary() {
        val scale = RinexBeiDouTimeScale(utc, correction, 604800.0)
        val at = epoch + 100000
        val time = scale.atUtcMillis(at)!!
        val delta = time.secondsSince(BeiDouTime(1088, 0.0))
        // Independent defining equation; do not compare only two inverse implementations.
        assertEquals(100.0 + .25 + 1e-5 * delta, delta, 1e-11)
        assertEquals(at, scale.utcAt(time))
        val before = scale.atUtcMillis(epoch - 1000)!!
        assertEquals(1087, before.week)
        assertEquals(epoch - 1000, scale.utcAt(before))
        assertEquals(.25 / (1 - 1e-5), scale.atUtcMillis(epoch)!!.secondsOfWeek, 1e-12)
    }

    @Test fun epochAndLeapSecondsComeFromIndependentUtcResourceRatherThanCurrentConstantOffset() {
        val originCorrection = RinexTimeSystemCorrection("BDUT", 0.0, 0.0, 0, 0, "", 7)
        val origin = RinexBeiDouTimeScale(utc, originCorrection, 604800.0)
        assertEquals(BeiDouTime(0, 0.0), origin.atUtcMillis(Instant.parse("2006-01-01T00:00:00Z").toEpochMilli()))
        assertNull(origin.atUtcMillis(Instant.parse("2005-12-31T23:59:59Z").toEpochMilli()))
        val leap = RinexBeiDouTimeScale(utc, RinexTimeSystemCorrection("BDUT", 0.0, 0.0, 0, 574, "", 7), 604800.0)
        val before = leap.atUtcMillis(Instant.parse("2016-12-31T23:59:59Z").toEpochMilli())!!
        val after = leap.atUtcMillis(Instant.parse("2017-01-01T00:00:00Z").toEpochMilli())!!
        assertEquals(2.0, after.secondsSince(before), 0.0)
    }

    @Test fun ageExpiredLeapTableNoninvertibleClockAndWrongCorrectionCannotBecomeValidTime() {
        val scale = RinexBeiDouTimeScale(utc, correction.copy(a0Seconds = 0.0, a1SecondsPerSecond = 0.0), 100.0)
        assertNotNull(scale.atUtcMillis(epoch + 100000))
        assertNull(scale.atUtcMillis(epoch + 100001))
        assertNull(scale.utcAt(BeiDouTime(1088, 101.0)))
        assertNull(scale.atUtcMillis(utc.expiresAtMillis))
        assertNull(RinexBeiDouTimeScale(utc, correction.copy(a1SecondsPerSecond = 1.0), 100.0).atUtcMillis(epoch))
        assertThrows(IllegalArgumentException::class.java) {
            RinexBeiDouTimeScale(utc, correction.copy(type = "GPUT"), 100.0)
        }
    }
}
```
