`core/src/test/kotlin/com/system/location/service/core/RinexFourSystemSkyTest.kt`:

```kt
package com.system.location.service.core

import com.system.location.service.core.geo.Wgs84
import com.system.location.service.core.gnss.*
import java.security.MessageDigest
import java.time.Instant
import kotlinx.serialization.json.Json
import kotlinx.serialization.json.jsonObject
import kotlinx.serialization.json.jsonPrimitive
import org.junit.Assert.*
import org.junit.Test

/** Reproducible real-data integration, distinct from analytic single-orbit fixtures. */
class RinexFourSystemSkyTest {
    private val source = Json.parseToJsonElement(requireNotNull(javaClass.getResource("/gnss/bkg-2026315-four-system-source.json")).readText()).jsonObject
    private val text = requireNotNull(javaClass.getResource("/gnss/bkg-2026315-four-system.rnx")).readText().replace("\r\n", "\n")
    private val epoch = Instant.parse(source.getValue("evaluationUtc").jsonPrimitive.content).toEpochMilli()
    private val resource = RinexNavigationResource.import(text, source.getValue("sourceUrl").jsonPrimitive.content, epoch + 60000)
    private val limits = GnssOutputLimits(128, 36, 32)
    private val systems = setOf(Constellation.GPS, Constellation.GALILEO, Constellation.BEIDOU, Constellation.GLONASS)

    @Test fun realFourSystemSkyChangesWithTargetAndKeepsNativeEpochProvenanceAndSignalCarriers() {
        val digest = MessageDigest.getInstance("SHA-256").digest(text.toByteArray(Charsets.UTF_8))
            .joinToString("") { "%02x".format(it.toInt() and 255) }
        assertEquals(source.getValue("subsetCanonicalLfSha256").jsonPrimitive.content, digest)
        val model = GnssBundledOrbitResources.model(GnssSimulationPolicy(), limits, 604800.0, navigation = resource)
        val frames = listOf(Wgs84(31.0, 121.0), Wgs84(-31.0, -59.0)).map {
            model.frame(GnssSkyRequest(epoch, it, 0.0))!!
        }
        frames.forEach { frame ->
            val broadcast = frame.orbitProvenance.filterValues { it.kind == GnssOrbitSourceKind.BROADCAST_EPHEMERIS }
            assertEquals(systems, broadcast.keys.map { it.first }.toSet())
            assertTrue(broadcast.values.all { it.referenceEpochMillis != resource.downloadedAtMillis })
            assertTrue(frame.orbitProvenance.values.none { it.kind == GnssOrbitSourceKind.VIRTUAL })
            assertTrue(frame.satellites.all { it.elevationDeg >= 0 && it.azimuthDeg < 360 })
            assertEquals(frame.satellites.size, frame.satellites.map { it.constellation to it.svid }.distinct().size)
            assertNotNull(frame.geometry.dop)
            assertTrue(frame.satellites.filter { it.constellation == Constellation.GLONASS }.all { it.carrierHz != null })
        }
        assertNotEquals(frames[0].satellites, frames[1].satellites)
        assertNotEquals(frames[0].geometry.dop, frames[1].geometry.dop)
    }

    @Test fun quantityGuaranteeAndExpiredEvidenceUseExplicitVirtualSourcesWithoutDuplicatingRealIdentities() {
        val policy = GnssSimulationPolicy(minimumPolicy = GnssMinimumPolicy.GUARANTEE_QUANTITY)
        val model = GnssBundledOrbitResources.model(policy, limits, 604800.0, navigation = resource)
        val request = GnssSkyRequest(epoch, Wgs84(31.0, 121.0), 0.0)
        val frame = model.frame(request, 64)!!
        assertEquals(64, frame.satellites.size)
        assertTrue(frame.orbitProvenance.values.any { it.kind == GnssOrbitSourceKind.BROADCAST_EPHEMERIS })
        assertTrue(frame.orbitProvenance.values.any { it.kind == GnssOrbitSourceKind.VIRTUAL })
        assertEquals(64, frame.satellites.map { it.constellation to it.svid }.distinct().size)
        assertTrue(frame.satellites.count { it.usedInFix } <= 32)
        val expired = model.frame(request.copy(atMillis = Instant.parse("2028-01-01T00:00:00Z").toEpochMilli()), 32)!!
        assertTrue(expired.satellites.size >= 32)
        assertTrue(expired.orbitProvenance.values.all { it.kind == GnssOrbitSourceKind.VIRTUAL })
    }
}
```

`core/src/test/kotlin/com/system/location/service/core/RinexGalileoImporterTest.kt`:

```kt
package com.system.location.service.core

import com.system.location.service.core.gnss.*
import java.time.LocalDate
import org.junit.Assert.*
import org.junit.Test

class RinexGalileoImporterTest {
    private val record = RinexNavigationRecord(RinexNavigationSystem.GALILEO, 1,
        RinexNavigationEpoch(LocalDate.of(2020, 5, 15), 0, 0, 0), listOf(-7.3e-4, -1.1e-11, 0.0),
        listOf(listOf(66.0, -20.9375, 2.8e-9, -2.6), listOf(-1.1e-6, 0.000135, 9.9e-6, 5440.6),
            listOf(432000.0, -2.6e-8, 2.45, -1.9e-8), listOf(0.971, 129.0, 1.18, -5.6e-9),
            listOf(2.4e-10, 517.0, 2105.0, null), listOf(3.12, 0.0, 4.9e-9, 5.1e-9),
            listOf(432650.0, null, null, null)))
    private fun change(row: Int, column: Int, value: Double?) = record.copy(orbit = record.orbit.mapIndexed { r, values ->
        if (r == row) values.mapIndexed { c, old -> if (c == column) value else old } else values
    })

    @Test fun rinexGpsAlignedWeekBecomesNativeGstWithoutAssumingInterSystemOffset() {
        val imported = RinexGalileoImporter.decode(record)
        val e = imported.ephemeris
        assertEquals(GalileoTime(1081, 432000.0), e.toe)
        assertEquals(e.toe, e.toc)
        assertEquals(GalileoTime(1081, 432650.0), imported.availableFrom)
        assertEquals(GalileoClockReference.INAV_E1_E5B, e.clockReference)
        assertEquals(e.toe, e.validFrom)
        assertEquals(14400.0, e.validUntil.secondsSince(e.toe), 0.0)
        assertEquals(-7.3e-4, e.af0Seconds, 0.0)
        assertEquals(-1.1e-11, e.af1SecondsPerSecond, 0.0)
        assertEquals(-20.9375, e.crsMeters, 0.0)
        assertEquals(129.0, e.crcMeters, 0.0)
        assertNotNull(GalileoBroadcastPropagator.propagate(e, e.toe).state)
        assertNull(GalileoBroadcastPropagator.propagate(e, e.toe.plusSeconds(-1.0)).state)
        assertNull(GalileoBroadcastPropagator.propagate(e, e.toe.plusSeconds(14401.0)).state)
    }

    @Test fun unavailableSignalFieldsAreNotMistakenForHealthyZeroBits() {
        val inav = RinexGalileoImporter.decode(change(5, 1, 1.0)).service
        assertEquals(false, inav.e1bHealthy) // E1-B data validity status set.
        assertEquals(true, inav.e5bHealthy)
        assertNull(inav.e5aHealthy)
        val fnavRecord = change(4, 1, 258.0)
        val fnav = RinexGalileoImporter.decode(fnavRecord)
        assertEquals(GalileoClockReference.FNAV_E1_E5A, fnav.ephemeris.clockReference)
        assertNull(fnav.service.e1bHealthy)
        assertNull(fnav.service.e5bHealthy)
        assertEquals(true, fnav.service.e5aHealthy)
        assertNull(fnav.bgdE5bE1Seconds)
        val unhealthyFnav = fnavRecord.copy(orbit = fnavRecord.orbit.mapIndexed { row, values ->
            if (row == 5) listOf(3.12, 8.0, 4.9e-9, null) else values
        })
        assertEquals(false, RinexGalileoImporter.decode(unhealthyFnav).service.e5aHealthy)
        assertFalse(RinexGalileoImporter.decode(change(5, 0, -1.0)).service.accuracyAvailable)
    }

    @Test fun inconsistentSourcesMissingValuesAndWrongWeekAreRejected() {
        val bad = listOf(0.0, 7.0, 256.0, 512.0, 519.0, 514.0, 769.0, 549.0, 517.5)
            .map { change(4, 1, it) } + listOf(change(4, 2, 1081.0), change(5, 1, null),
                change(6, 0, null), change(6, 0, 999999999.999), change(5, 0, -2.0))
        for (input in bad) assertThrows(IllegalArgumentException::class.java) { RinexGalileoImporter.decode(input) }
        for (source in listOf(513.0, 516.0, 517.0, 258.0)) {
            assertNotNull(RinexGalileoImporter.decode(change(4, 1, source)))
        }
    }
}
```

```kt
package com.system.location.service.core

import com.system.location.service.core.geo.Wgs84
import com.system.location.service.core.gnss.*
import java.time.Instant
import java.time.LocalDate
import java.util.Locale
import kotlin.math.sqrt
import org.junit.Assert.*
import org.junit.Test

class RinexGalileoOrbitProviderTest {
    private val utc = GnssUtcTimeScale.parseIers(requireNotNull(javaClass.getResource("/gnss/leap-seconds.list")).readText())
    private val epoch = Instant.parse("2026-11-07T23:59:42Z").toEpochMilli()
    private val record = RinexNavigationRecord(RinexNavigationSystem.GALILEO, 1,
        RinexNavigationEpoch(LocalDate.of(2026, 11, 8), 0, 0, 0), listOf(0.0, 0.0, 0.0),
        listOf(listOf(7.0, 0.0, 0.0, 0.0), listOf(0.0, 0.0, 0.0, sqrt(29600000.0)),
            listOf(0.0, 0.0, 0.0, 0.0), listOf(0.95, 0.0, 0.0, 0.0),
            listOf(0.0, 517.0, 2444.0, null), listOf(3.12, 0.0, 0.0, 0.0),
            listOf(-30.0, null, null, null)))
    private val provenance = GnssOrbitProvenance("test-rinex-galileo", "1", "test", epoch,
        GnssOrbitSourceKind.BROADCAST_EPHEMERIS)
    private val request = GnssSkyRequest(epoch - 250, Wgs84(31.0, 121.0), 0.0)
    private fun header(offset: Double = .25) = String.format(Locale.ROOT,
        "GAGP %17.10E%16.9E %6d%5d", offset, 0.0, 0, 2444).padEnd(60)
    private fun change(row: Int, column: Int, value: Double?) = record.copy(orbit = record.orbit.mapIndexed { r, values ->
        if (r == row) values.mapIndexed { c, old -> if (c == column) value else old } else values
    })
    private fun provider(records: List<RinexNavigationRecord> = listOf(record), headers: List<String> = listOf(header()),
        policy: RinexGalileoSkyPolicy = RinexGalileoSkyPolicy(86400.0, true)) =
        RinexGalileoOrbitProvider(RinexNavigationFile("3.05", headers, emptyList(), records), provenance, utc, policy)

    @Test fun downloadedResourceReachesBundledProductionModelAndExpiresIntoIndependentFallback() {
        fun fields(values: List<Double?>) = values.joinToString("") { value ->
            value?.let { String.format(Locale.ROOT, "%19.12E", it) } ?: " ".repeat(19)
        }
        val text = "     3.05           NAVIGATION DATA     M".padEnd(60) + "RINEX VERSION / TYPE\n" +
            header() + "TIME SYSTEM CORR\n" + "".padEnd(60) + "END OF HEADER\n" +
            "E01 2026 11 08 00 00 00" + fields(record.clock) + "\n" +
            record.orbit.joinToString("\n") { "    " + fields(it) } + "\n"
        val resource = RinexNavigationResource.import(text, "https://example.org/navigation.rnx", epoch + 60000)
        val position = resource.galileoProvider(utc, RinexGalileoSkyPolicy(86400.0, true)).positions(request).positions.single()
        assertEquals(epoch - 250, position.provenance.referenceEpochMillis)
        assertNotEquals(resource.downloadedAtMillis, position.provenance.referenceEpochMillis)
        val model = GnssBundledOrbitResources.model(GnssSimulationPolicy(), GnssOutputLimits(128, 36, 32),
            604800.0, navigation = resource)
        val frame = model.frame(request.copy(observer = Wgs84(0.0, 0.0)))!!
        assertEquals(GnssOrbitSourceKind.BROADCAST_EPHEMERIS,
            frame.orbitProvenance[Constellation.GALILEO to 1]?.kind)
        val expired = model.frame(request.copy(atMillis = Instant.parse("2028-01-01T00:00:00Z").toEpochMilli()))!!
        assertTrue(expired.satellites.isNotEmpty())
        assertTrue(expired.orbitProvenance.values.all { it.kind == GnssOrbitSourceKind.VIRTUAL })
    }

    @Test fun nonzeroGagpAndGstOrbitUseNativeEpochAndIndependentCircularReference() {
        val result = provider().positions(request)
        val position = result.positions.single()
        assertEquals(29600000.0, position.position.xMeters, 1e-7)
        assertEquals(0.0, position.position.yMeters, 1e-7)
        assertEquals(0.0, position.position.zMeters, 1e-7)
        assertEquals(epoch - 250, position.provenance.referenceEpochMillis)
        assertTrue(position.hasEphemeris)
        assertFalse(position.hasAlmanac)
        assertTrue(result.diagnostics.any { "approximate GTRF" in it })
        assertEquals(result.positions, provider().positions(request.copy(observer = Wgs84(-31.0, -59.0))).positions)
        assertTrue(provider().positions(request.copy(atMillis = epoch + 14400001)).positions.isEmpty())
    }

    @Test fun missingConflictingStaleCorrectionsOrUnpermittedFrameCannotPretendGpsEqualsGst() {
        for (source in listOf(provider(headers = emptyList()), provider(headers = listOf(header(), header(.5))),
            provider(headers = listOf(header(), "GAGP damaged")),
            provider(policy = RinexGalileoSkyPolicy(86400.0, false)))) {
            val rejected = source.positions(request)
            assertTrue(rejected.positions.isEmpty())
            assertEquals(setOf(Constellation.GALILEO to 1), rejected.reservedIdentities)
            assertTrue(rejected.diagnostics.isNotEmpty())
        }
        assertTrue(provider().positions(request.copy(atMillis = epoch + 86400001)).positions.isEmpty())
        assertTrue(provider().positions(request.copy(atMillis = utc.expiresAtMillis)).positions.isEmpty())
        assertEquals(1, provider(headers = listOf(header(), header())).positions(request).positions.size)
    }

    @Test fun e1HealthAndLatestUploadCannotBeReplacedByFnavOrExpiredHealthyHistory() {
        val unhealthy = change(5, 1, 1.0).let { r -> r.copy(orbit = r.orbit.mapIndexed { row, values ->
            if (row == 6) listOf(60.0, null, null, null) else values
        }) }
        val source = provider(listOf(record, unhealthy))
        assertEquals(1, source.positions(request).positions.size)
        val after = request.copy(atMillis = epoch + 60000)
        assertEquals(setOf(Constellation.GALILEO to 1), source.positions(after).blockedIdentities)
        assertTrue(source.positions(after).positions.isEmpty())
        assertTrue(source.positions(request.copy(atMillis = epoch + 14400001)).blockedIdentities.isEmpty())
        assertTrue(provider(listOf(change(4, 1, 258.0))).positions(request).positions.isEmpty())
        assertTrue(provider(listOf(change(5, 0, -1.0))).positions(request).positions.isEmpty())
        // Same-transmission conflicting health fails closed, including lower-priority sources.
        val conflict = provider(listOf(record, change(5, 1, 1.0))).positions(request)
        assertTrue(conflict.positions.isEmpty())
        assertEquals(setOf(Constellation.GALILEO to 1), conflict.blockedIdentities)
        assertTrue(provider(listOf(change(6, 0, 60.0))).positions(request).positions.isEmpty())
    }

    @Test fun malformedLatestInavCannotResurrectOlderUploadButFnavDoesNotSupersedeE1() {
        val invalid = change(1, 3, null).let { raw -> raw.copy(orbit = raw.orbit.mapIndexed { row, values ->
            if (row == 6) listOf(60.0, null, null, null) else values
        }) }
        val source = provider(listOf(record, invalid))
        assertEquals(1, source.positions(request).positions.size)
        assertTrue(source.positions(request.copy(atMillis = epoch + 60000)).positions.isEmpty())
        val fnav = invalid.copy(orbit = invalid.orbit.mapIndexed { row, values ->
            if (row == 4) listOf(0.0, 258.0, 2444.0, null) else values
        })
        assertEquals(1, provider(listOf(record, fnav)).positions(request.copy(atMillis = epoch + 60000)).positions.size)
        val unknown = provider(listOf(record, change(6, 0, null))).positions(request)
        assertTrue(unknown.positions.isEmpty())
        assertTrue(unknown.diagnostics.any { "ordering unavailable" in it })
    }
}
```

`core/src/test/kotlin/com/system/location/service/core/RinexGlonassImporterTest.kt`:

```kt
package com.system.location.service.core

import com.system.location.service.core.gnss.*
import java.time.LocalDate
import org.junit.Assert.*
import org.junit.Test

class RinexGlonassImporterTest {
    private val record = RinexNavigationRecord(RinexNavigationSystem.GLONASS, 3,
        RinexNavigationEpoch(LocalDate.of(2026, 11, 8), 0, 15, 0), listOf(-1e-4, 2e-12, 900.0),
        listOf(listOf(19100.0, 1.1, 1e-9, 0.0), listOf(13400.0, -2.2, -2e-9, -7.0),
            listOf(10900.0, 0.3, 3e-9, 1.0)))
    private fun decode(record: RinexNavigationRecord) = RinexGlonassImporter.decode(record, GlonassReferenceFrame.PZ_90_11)

    @Test fun kilometersBecomeSiButUtcEpochAndClockSignArePreserved() {
        val result = decode(record)
        assertEquals(GlonassCartesianVector(19100000.0, 13400000.0, 10900000.0), result.orbit.positionMeters)
        assertEquals(GlonassCartesianVector(1100.0, -2200.0, 300.0), result.orbit.velocityMetersPerSecond)
        val acc = result.orbit.luniSolarAccelerationMetersPerSecondSquared
        assertEquals(1e-6, acc.x, 1e-20)
        assertEquals(-2e-6, acc.y, 1e-20)
        assertEquals(3e-6, acc.z, 1e-20)
        assertEquals(record.epoch, result.referenceUtc)
        assertEquals(-1e-4, result.clockBiasSeconds, 0.0)
        assertEquals(2e-12, result.relativeFrequencyBias, 0.0)
        assertEquals(900.0, result.frameTimeUtcWeekSeconds, 0.0)
        assertEquals(-7, result.frequencyNumber)
        assertFalse(result.unhealthy)
        assertEquals(1, result.ageDays)
        assertNull(result.statusFlags)
        assertNull(result.healthFlags)
        assertNull(result.accuracyIndex)
        assertEquals(GlonassReferenceFrame.PZ_90_11, result.orbit.referenceFrame)
        assertEquals(GlonassReferenceFrame.PZ_90_02,
            RinexGlonassImporter.decode(record, GlonassReferenceFrame.PZ_90_02).orbit.referenceFrame)
    }

    @Test fun optional305FieldsPreserveUnknownAndRawSignalEvidence() {
        val unknown = decode(record.copy(orbit = record.orbit + listOf(listOf(null, 999999999.999, 15.0, null))))
        assertNull(unknown.statusFlags)
        assertNull(unknown.l1L2GroupDelaySeconds)
        assertNull(unknown.accuracyIndex)
        assertNull(unknown.healthFlags)
        val known = decode(record.copy(orbit = record.orbit + listOf(listOf(192.0, -2e-9, 3.0, 5.0))))
        assertEquals(192, known.statusFlags)
        assertEquals(-2e-9, known.l1L2GroupDelaySeconds!!, 0.0)
        assertEquals(3, known.accuracyIndex)
        assertEquals(5, known.healthFlags)
    }

    @Test fun invalidUnitsSlotsAndRequiredFieldsDoNotBecomePropagatableStates() {
        val bad = listOf(record.copy(svid = 0), record.copy(clock = listOf(0.0, 0.0, -1.0)),
            record.copy(orbit = listOf(listOf(19100.0, 1.1, 1e-9, 2.0)) + record.orbit.drop(1)),
            record.copy(orbit = listOf(listOf(19100000.0, 1.1, 1e-9, 0.0)) + record.orbit.drop(1)),
            record.copy(orbit = record.orbit + listOf(listOf(512.0, null, null, null))),
            record.copy(orbit = record.orbit + listOf(listOf(null, null, null, 0.5))))
        for (input in bad) assertThrows(IllegalArgumentException::class.java) { decode(input) }
    }
}
```

`core/src/test/kotlin/com/system/location/service/core/RinexGlonassOrbitProviderTest.kt`:

```kt
package com.system.location.service.core

import com.system.location.service.core.geo.Wgs84
import com.system.location.service.core.gnss.*
import java.time.Instant
import java.time.LocalDate
import java.util.Locale
import org.junit.Assert.*
import org.junit.Test

class RinexGlonassOrbitProviderTest {
    private val utc = GnssUtcTimeScale.parseIers(requireNotNull(javaClass.getResource("/gnss/leap-seconds.list")).readText())
    private val epoch = Instant.parse("2026-11-08T00:15:00Z").toEpochMilli()
    private val record = RinexNavigationRecord(RinexNavigationSystem.GLONASS, 3,
        RinexNavigationEpoch(LocalDate.of(2026, 11, 8), 0, 15, 0), listOf(-1e-4, 2e-12, 900.0),
        listOf(listOf(19100.0, 1.1, 1e-9, 0.0), listOf(13400.0, -2.2, -2e-9, -7.0),
            listOf(10900.0, 0.3, 3e-9, 1.0)))
    private val policy = RinexGlonassSkyPolicy(Instant.parse("2014-01-15T00:00:00Z").toEpochMilli(), true)
    private val provenance = GnssOrbitProvenance("test-glonass", "1", "test", epoch, GnssOrbitSourceKind.BROADCAST_EPHEMERIS)
    private val request = GnssSkyRequest(epoch, Wgs84(31.0, 121.0), 0.0)
    private fun provider(vararg records: RinexNavigationRecord, policy: RinexGlonassSkyPolicy = this.policy) =
        RinexGlonassOrbitProvider(RinexNavigationFile("3.04", emptyList(), emptyList(), records.toList()), provenance, utc, policy)
    private fun change(row: Int, column: Int, value: Double?) = record.copy(orbit = record.orbit.mapIndexed { r, values ->
        if (r == row) values.mapIndexed { c, old -> if (c == column) value else old } else values
    })

    @Test fun nativeUtcSiUnitsDatumAndFcntoL1CarrierReachOneGlobalOrbit() {
        val batch = provider(record).positions(request)
        val position = batch.positions.single()
        assertEquals(19099999.999349408, position.position.xMeters, 1e-8)
        assertEquals(13399999.99981885, position.position.yMeters, 1e-8)
        assertEquals(10899999.994876489, position.position.zMeters, 1e-8)
        assertEquals(epoch, position.provenance.referenceEpochMillis)
        assertEquals((1_602_000_000.0 - 7 * 562_500.0).toFloat(), position.carrierHz)
        assertTrue(position.hasEphemeris)
        assertFalse(position.hasAlmanac)
        assertEquals(1, provider(record.copy(clock = listOf(-1e-4, 2e-12, 0.0)))
            .positions(request.copy(atMillis = epoch + 1000)).positions.size)
        assertEquals(batch.positions, provider(record).positions(request.copy(observer = Wgs84(-31.0, -59.0))).positions)
        for (at in listOf(epoch - 1, epoch + 900000, epoch + 604800000, utc.expiresAtMillis))
            assertTrue(provider(record).positions(request.copy(atMillis = at)).positions.isEmpty())
        assertTrue(provider(record, policy = policy.copy(allowApproximateItrfAlignment = false)).positions(request).positions.isEmpty())
        assertTrue(provider(record, policy = policy.copy(pz9011OperationalFromUtcMillis = epoch + 1)).positions(request).positions.isEmpty())
    }

    @Test fun leapSecondCrossingUses61SiSecondsRatherThan60PosixSeconds() {
        val before = record.copy(epoch = RinexNavigationEpoch(LocalDate.of(2016, 12, 31), 23, 59, 30),
            clock = listOf(-1e-4, 2e-12, 604770.0))
        val at = Instant.parse("2017-01-01T00:00:30Z").toEpochMilli()
        val position = provider(before).positions(request.copy(atMillis = at)).positions.single().position
        val native = RinexGlonassImporter.decode(before, GlonassReferenceFrame.PZ_90_11).orbit
        val expected = GlonassSkyFrameApproximation.pz9011ToItrf2008(
            GlonassBroadcastPropagator.propagate(native, 61.0).state!!.positionMeters)
        assertEquals(expected, position)
        val wrong = GlonassSkyFrameApproximation.pz9011ToItrf2008(
            GlonassBroadcastPropagator.propagate(native, 60.0).state!!.positionMeters)
        assertTrue(kotlin.math.abs(wrong.xMeters - position.xMeters) > 100)
    }

    @Test fun futureFramesMalformedLatestAndConflictingHealthCannotReviveOldUploads() {
        val invalid = change(0, 0, null).copy(clock = listOf(-1e-4, 2e-12, 1000.0))
        val source = provider(record, invalid)
        assertEquals(1, source.positions(request).positions.size)
        assertTrue(source.positions(request.copy(atMillis = epoch + 100000)).positions.isEmpty())
        assertTrue(provider(record, record.copy(clock = listOf(0.0, 0.0, null))).positions(request).positions.isEmpty())
        val conflict = provider(record, change(0, 3, 1.0)).positions(request)
        assertTrue(conflict.positions.isEmpty())
        assertEquals(setOf(Constellation.GLONASS to 3), conflict.blockedIdentities)
        assertTrue(provider(record, change(0, 3, 1.0)).positions(request.copy(atMillis = epoch + 900000)).blockedIdentities.isEmpty())
        assertTrue(provider(change(1, 3, 7.0)).positions(request).positions.isEmpty())
        assertTrue(provider(record.copy(svid = 26), change(0, 3, 1.0).copy(svid = 26)).positions(request).positions.isEmpty())
    }

    @Test fun exclusiveModernHealthFlagsAreUsedOnlyWhenTypeIsKnownAndApplicable() {
        fun extended(type: Double?, flags: Double) = record.copy(orbit = record.orbit + listOf(listOf(type, null, null, flags)))
        for (flags in listOf(2.0, 4.0, 6.0)) {
            val result = provider(extended(128.0, flags)).positions(request)
            assertTrue(result.positions.isEmpty())
            assertEquals(setOf(Constellation.GLONASS to 3), result.blockedIdentities)
        }
        assertEquals(1, provider(extended(null, 4.0)).positions(request).positions.size)
        assertEquals(1, provider(extended(0.0, 4.0)).positions(request).positions.size)
        assertEquals(1, provider(extended(128.0, 3.0)).positions(request).positions.size)
    }

    @Test fun downloadedGlonassReachesTheProductionSkyWithItsOwnCarrierAndOriginalEpoch() {
        fun fields(values: List<Double?>) = values.joinToString("") { value ->
            value?.let { String.format(Locale.ROOT, "%19.12E", it) } ?: " ".repeat(19)
        }
        val text = "     3.04           NAVIGATION DATA     M".padEnd(60) + "RINEX VERSION / TYPE\n" +
            "".padEnd(60) + "END OF HEADER\n" + "R03 2026 11 08 00 15 00" + fields(record.clock) + "\n" +
            record.orbit.joinToString("\n") { "    " + fields(it) } + "\n"
        val resource = RinexNavigationResource.import(text, "https://example.org/navigation.rnx", epoch + 60000)
        val position = resource.glonassProvider(utc, policy).positions(request).positions.single()
        val model = GnssBundledOrbitResources.model(GnssSimulationPolicy(), GnssOutputLimits(128, 36, 32),
            604800.0, navigation = resource)
        val frame = model.frame(request)!!
        assertEquals(GnssOrbitSourceKind.BROADCAST_EPHEMERIS, frame.orbitProvenance[Constellation.GLONASS to 3]?.kind)
        assertEquals(epoch, frame.orbitProvenance[Constellation.GLONASS to 3]?.referenceEpochMillis)
        assertEquals(position.carrierHz, frame.satellites.single { it.constellation == Constellation.GLONASS }.carrierHz)
        val future = model.frame(request.copy(atMillis = Instant.parse("2028-01-01T00:00:00Z").toEpochMilli()))!!
        assertTrue(future.satellites.isNotEmpty())
        assertTrue(future.orbitProvenance.values.all { it.kind == GnssOrbitSourceKind.VIRTUAL })
    }
}
```

`core/src/test/kotlin/com/system/location/service/core/RinexGpsOrbitProviderTest.kt`:

```kt
package com.system.location.service.core

import com.system.location.service.core.geo.Wgs84
import com.system.location.service.core.gnss.*
import java.time.Instant
import java.time.LocalDate
import kotlin.math.sqrt
import org.junit.Assert.*
import org.junit.Test

class RinexGpsOrbitProviderTest {
    private val utc = GnssUtcTimeScale.parseIers(requireNotNull(javaClass.getResource("/gnss/leap-seconds.list")).readText())
    private val epoch = Instant.parse("2026-11-07T23:59:42Z").toEpochMilli()
    // Native GPS midnight is 18 seconds ahead of UTC at this epoch.
    private val record = RinexNavigationRecord(RinexNavigationSystem.GPS, 1,
        RinexNavigationEpoch(LocalDate.of(2026, 11, 8), 0, 0, 0), listOf(0.0, 0.0, 0.0),
        listOf(listOf(7.0, 0.0, 0.0, 0.0), listOf(0.0, 0.0, 0.0, sqrt(26560000.0)),
            listOf(0.0, 0.0, 0.0, 0.0), listOf(0.95, 0.0, 0.0, 0.0),
            listOf(0.0, 0.0, 2444.0, 0.0), listOf(2.4, 0.0, 0.0, 7.0),
            listOf(-30.0, 4.0, null, null)))
    private val provenance = GnssOrbitProvenance("synthetic-rinex", "1", "test", epoch,
        GnssOrbitSourceKind.BROADCAST_EPHEMERIS)
    private val request = GnssSkyRequest(epoch, Wgs84(31.0, 121.0), 0.0)
    private fun file(vararg records: RinexNavigationRecord) = RinexNavigationFile("3.04", emptyList(), emptyList(), records.toList())
    private fun change(row: Int, column: Int, value: Double?): RinexNavigationRecord =
        record.copy(orbit = record.orbit.mapIndexed { r, values ->
            if (r == row) values.mapIndexed { c, old -> if (c == column) value else old } else values
        })

    @Test fun nativeGpsEpochAndFitAreNotUtcOrModuloWeek() {
        val imported = RinexGpsImporter.decode(record)
        assertEquals(GpsTime(2444, 0.0), imported.ephemeris.toe)
        assertEquals(imported.ephemeris.toe, imported.ephemeris.toc)
        assertEquals(GpsTime(2443, 604770.0), imported.availableFrom)
        assertEquals(-7200.0, imported.ephemeris.validFrom.secondsSince(imported.ephemeris.toe), 0.0)
        assertEquals(7200.0, imported.ephemeris.validUntil.secondsSince(imported.ephemeris.toe), 0.0)
        val provider = RinexGpsOrbitProvider(file(record), provenance, utc)
        val position = provider.positions(request).positions.single()
        // Analytic circular orbit at zero anomaly/node: independent of importer/propagator logic.
        assertEquals(26560000.0, position.position.xMeters, 1e-7)
        assertEquals(0.0, position.position.yMeters, 1e-7)
        assertEquals(0.0, position.position.zMeters, 1e-7)
        assertTrue(position.hasEphemeris)
        assertFalse(position.hasAlmanac)
        assertTrue(provider.positions(request.copy(atMillis = epoch + 604800000)).positions.isEmpty())
        assertTrue(provider.positions(request.copy(atMillis = utc.expiresAtMillis)).positions.isEmpty())
        // Global orbital position does not depend on a capture point or local receiver.
        assertEquals(position, provider.positions(request.copy(observer = Wgs84(-31.0, -59.0))).positions.single())
    }

    @Test fun latestApplicableNegativeHealthBlocksOlderHealthyUploadsButNotForever() {
        val unhealthy = change(5, 1, 63.0).let { old -> old.copy(orbit = old.orbit.mapIndexed { row, values ->
            if (row == 6) listOf(60.0, 4.0, null, null) else values
        }) }
        val provider = RinexGpsOrbitProvider(file(record, unhealthy), provenance, utc)
        assertEquals(1, provider.positions(request).positions.size)
        val after = provider.positions(request.copy(atMillis = epoch + 60000))
        assertTrue(after.positions.isEmpty())
        assertEquals(setOf(Constellation.GPS to 1), after.blockedIdentities)
        assertEquals(after.blockedIdentities, after.reservedIdentities)
        val expired = provider.positions(request.copy(atMillis = epoch + 7200001))
        assertTrue(expired.positions.isEmpty())
        assertTrue(expired.blockedIdentities.isEmpty())
    }

    @Test fun missingFitOrTransmissionAndWrongEraCannotBeSilentlyInvented() {
        for (bad in listOf(change(6, 1, null), change(6, 1, 0.0), change(6, 0, 999999999.999),
            change(4, 2, 1420.0), change(0, 0, 7.5), change(5, 3, 8.0), change(2, 0, 604800.0),
            record.copy(epoch = record.epoch.copy(second = 60)))) {
            assertThrows(IllegalArgumentException::class.java) { RinexGpsImporter.decode(bad) }
            val rejected = RinexGpsOrbitProvider(file(bad), provenance, utc).positions(request)
            assertTrue(rejected.positions.isEmpty())
            assertEquals(setOf(Constellation.GPS to 1), rejected.reservedIdentities)
            assertTrue(rejected.diagnostics.isNotEmpty())
        }
        val futureUpload = RinexGpsOrbitProvider(file(change(6, 0, 60.0)), provenance, utc)
        assertTrue(futureUpload.positions(request).positions.isEmpty())
        assertEquals(1, futureUpload.positions(request.copy(atMillis = epoch + 60000)).positions.size)
    }

    @Test fun supersededLongFitAndConflictingSameTransmissionCannotReviveHealthyData() {
        val longFit = change(6, 1, 26.0)
        val newer = change(5, 1, 63.0).copy(orbit = change(5, 1, 63.0).orbit.mapIndexed { row, values ->
            if (row == 6) listOf(60.0, 4.0, null, null) else values
        })
        val provider = RinexGpsOrbitProvider(file(longFit, newer), provenance, utc)
        val expiredNewer = provider.positions(request.copy(atMillis = epoch + 3 * 3600000))
        assertTrue(expiredNewer.positions.isEmpty())
        assertTrue(expiredNewer.blockedIdentities.isEmpty())
        val conflict = RinexGpsOrbitProvider(file(record, change(5, 1, 63.0)), provenance, utc).positions(request)
        assertTrue(conflict.positions.isEmpty())
        assertTrue(conflict.diagnostics.isNotEmpty())
        assertEquals(setOf(Constellation.GPS to 1), conflict.blockedIdentities)
        assertEquals(1, RinexGpsOrbitProvider(file(record, record), provenance, utc).positions(request).positions.size)
    }

    @Test fun rejectingNewerMalformedPayloadNeverRestoresAnOlderHealthyBroadcast() {
        val invalid = change(6, 1, null).let { raw -> raw.copy(orbit = raw.orbit.mapIndexed { row, values ->
            if (row == 6) listOf(60.0, null, null, null) else values
        }) }
        val source = RinexGpsOrbitProvider(file(record, invalid), provenance, utc)
        assertEquals(1, source.positions(request).positions.size)
        val after = source.positions(request.copy(atMillis = epoch + 60000))
        assertTrue(after.positions.isEmpty())
        assertEquals(setOf(Constellation.GPS to 1), after.reservedIdentities)
        val unknownOrder = RinexGpsOrbitProvider(file(record, change(6, 0, null)), provenance, utc).positions(request)
        assertTrue(unknownOrder.positions.isEmpty())
        assertTrue(unknownOrder.diagnostics.any { "ordering unavailable" in it })
    }

    @Test fun angularAndHarmonicParametersKeepTheirSpecifiedUnitsAndColumns() {
        val raw = record.copy(clock = listOf(1e-4, 2e-12, 3e-20), orbit = listOf(
            listOf(7.0, 12.0, 3e-9, 0.4), listOf(5e-6, 0.01, 6e-6, 5153.7),
            listOf(0.0, 7e-8, 0.8, 9e-8), listOf(0.95, 13.0, 1.1, -8e-9),
            listOf(2e-10, 0.0, 2444.0, 0.0), listOf(2.4, 0.0, -4e-9, 7.0), listOf(-30.0, 4.0, null, null)))
        val e = RinexGpsImporter.decode(raw).ephemeris
        assertEquals(listOf(0.95, 0.8, 1.1, 0.4, 3e-9, -8e-9, 2e-10),
            listOf(e.inclinationRad, e.ascendingNodeRad, e.argumentOfPerigeeRad, e.meanAnomalyRad,
                e.deltaMeanMotionRadPerSecond, e.ascendingNodeRateRadPerSecond, e.inclinationRateRadPerSecond))
        assertEquals(listOf(5e-6, 6e-6, 13.0, 12.0, 7e-8, 9e-8),
            listOf(e.cucRad, e.cusRad, e.crcMeters, e.crsMeters, e.cicRad, e.cisRad))
        assertEquals(listOf(1e-4, 2e-12, 3e-20, -4e-9),
            listOf(e.af0Seconds, e.af1SecondsPerSecond, e.af2SecondsPerSecondSquared, e.tgdSeconds))
    }
}
```

`core/src/test/kotlin/com/system/location/service/core/RinexNavigationReaderTest.kt`:

```kt
package com.system.location.service.core

import com.system.location.service.core.gnss.*
import java.time.LocalDate
import org.junit.Assert.*
import org.junit.Test

class RinexNavigationReaderTest {
    private fun header(version: String = "3.04", system: Char = 'M') =
        "     $version           NAVIGATION DATA     $system".padEnd(60) + "RINEX VERSION / TYPE\n" +
            "GAGP  2.2700987756E-09 1.287858709E-14 432000 2105".padEnd(60) + "TIME SYSTEM CORR\n" +
            "    18".padEnd(60) + "LEAP SECONDS\n" + "".padEnd(60) + "END OF HEADER\n"

    // Layout and adjacent signed D19.12 fields from IGS RINEX 3.05, Tables A8/A9.
    private val galileo = """
E01 2020 05 15 00 00 00-7.311511784792D-04-1.065814103640D-11 0.000000000000D+00
     6.600000000000D+01-2.093750000000D+01 2.814760101310D-09-2.614248883495D+00
    -1.059845089912D-06 1.353232655674D-04 9.920448064804D-06 5.440612745285D+03
     4.320000000000D+05-2.607703208923D-08 2.453152314225D+00-1.862645149231D-08
     9.712686443587D-01 1.290000000000D+02 1.184225012358D+00-5.608090731035D-09
     2.428672591152D-10 5.170000000000D+02 2.105000000000D+03
     3.120000000000D+00 0.000000000000D+00 4.889443516731D-09 5.122274160385D-09
     4.326500000000D+05
""".trimIndent()

    private fun state(system: Char = 'R', extra: Boolean = false): String =
        "${system}01 2020 05 15 00 15 00 1.000000000000D-04 2.000000000000D-12 4.320000000000D+05\n" +
            List(if (extra) 4 else 3) {
                "     1.234567890123D+04-1.234567890123D+00 1.234567890123D-09 0.000000000000D+00"
            }.joinToString("\n")

    @Test fun fixedColumnsPreserveNativeEpochWeekSpareAndUnits() {
        val file = RinexNavigationReader.read(header() + galileo)
        assertEquals("3.04", file.version)
        assertEquals(1, file.timeSystemCorrections.size)
        assertEquals(1, file.leapSecondHeaders.size)
        val record = file.records.single()
        assertEquals(RinexNavigationSystem.GALILEO, record.system)
        assertEquals(LocalDate.of(2020, 5, 15), record.epoch.date)
        assertEquals(-7.311511784792e-4, record.clock[0])
        assertEquals(-1.065814103640e-11, record.clock[1])
        assertEquals(2105.0, record.orbit[4][2]) // RINEX's GPS-aligned week, not GST 1081.
        assertEquals(517.0, record.orbit[4][1])
        assertNull(record.orbit[4][3])
        assertEquals(listOf(432650.0, null, null, null), record.orbit[6])
        assertEquals(5440.612745285, record.orbit[1][3]) // sqrt(m), not m or km.
    }

    @Test fun glonass305ExtraRowDoesNotConsumeNextSatelliteAnd304HasThreeRows() {
        for ((version, extra) in listOf("3.04" to false, "3.05" to true)) {
            val file = RinexNavigationReader.read(header(version) + state(extra = extra) + "\n" + galileo + "\n")
            assertEquals(listOf(RinexNavigationSystem.GLONASS, RinexNavigationSystem.GALILEO), file.records.map { it.system })
            assertEquals(if (extra) 4 else 3, file.records.first().orbit.size)
            assertEquals(-1.234567890123, file.records.first().orbit[0][1])
        }
    }

    @Test fun recognizesEveryRinex3NavigationSystemWithoutGuessingUnsupportedMessageLayouts() {
        val records = listOf('G', 'E', 'C', 'J', 'I').map { galileo.replaceFirst('E', it) } + state() + state('S')
        val file = RinexNavigationReader.read(header() + records.joinToString("\n"))
        assertEquals(RinexNavigationSystem.entries.toSet(), file.records.map { it.system }.toSet())
        assertEquals(7, file.records.size)
    }

    @Test fun malformedOrUnsupportedResourcesAreRejectedAsAWhole() {
        val badFiles = listOf(
            header("4.00") + galileo,
            header(system = 'G') + galileo,
            header() + galileo.substringBeforeLast('\n'), // incomplete record
            header() + galileo.replace("5.440612745285D+03", "5.440612745285D999"),
            header() + galileo.replace("E01 2020 05 15", "E01 2020 02 30"),
            header() + galileo.replaceFirst("    -", "   E-"),
            header() + galileo.replace("E01", "X01"),
            header() + galileo.replace("E01", "E00"),
            header() + galileo + "\n\n" + state(),
            header() + galileo + "\n" + "x".repeat(81),
            header() + galileo.replace("D+03", "D+0\t"),
        )
        for ((index, file) in badFiles.withIndex()) assertThrows("bad fixture $index", Exception::class.java) {
            RinexNavigationReader.read(file)
        }
        assertThrows(IllegalArgumentException::class.java) {
            RinexNavigationReader.read(" ".repeat(RinexNavigationReader.MAX_BYTES + 1))
        }
    }
}
```

`core/src/test/kotlin/com/system/location/service/core/RinexNavigationResourceStoreTest.kt`:

```kt
package com.system.location.service.core

import com.system.location.service.core.gnss.*
import org.junit.Assert.*
import org.junit.Rule
import org.junit.Test
import org.junit.rules.TemporaryFolder

class RinexNavigationResourceStoreTest {
    @Test fun metadataSurvivesOmissionRollbackAndRestartWithoutRetimingItsEpoch() {
        val text = requireNotNull(javaClass.getResource("/gnss/igs-beidou-metadata.snx")).readText()
        val modified = java.time.Instant.parse("2026-10-22T08:30:06Z").toEpochMilli()
        val catalog = BeiDouCatalogResource.import(text, modified)
        val file = temporary.root.resolve("catalog-navigation.json")
        val first = resource().copy(beiDouCatalog = catalog)
        RinexNavigationResourceStore(file).update(RinexNavigationResource.encode(first))
        val omitted = resource(downloadedAt = 2000)
        val retained = RinexNavigationResourceStore(file).update(RinexNavigationResource.encode(omitted))
        assertEquals(catalog, retained.beiDouCatalog)
        val older = BeiDouCatalogResource.import(text.replace("26:295:28054", "26:294:28054"), modified)
        assertEquals(catalog, RinexNavigationResourceStore(file)
            .update(RinexNavigationResource.encode(omitted.copy(beiDouCatalog = older))).beiDouCatalog)
        val newer = BeiDouCatalogResource.import(text.replace("26:295:28054", "26:296:28054"), modified + 86400000)
        assertEquals(newer, RinexNavigationResourceStore(file)
            .update(RinexNavigationResource.encode(omitted.copy(beiDouCatalog = newer))).beiDouCatalog)
        assertEquals(newer, RinexNavigationResourceStore(file).load()!!.beiDouCatalog)
    }

    @Test fun perIdentityUploadWatermarksSurviveOmissionAndRestartAndLegacyMigration() {
        val file = temporary.root.resolve("navigation.json")
        val fixture = RinexNavigationResourceTest.navigation()
        val header = fixture.substringBefore("G01")
        val body = fixture.substringAfter("END OF HEADER\n")
        fun upload(svid: String, transmission: Double) = body.replace("G01", "G$svid")
            .replace("-3.000000000000D+01", "%19.12E".format(java.util.Locale.ROOT, transmission))
        fun candidate(vararg bodies: String) = resource(header + bodies.joinToString("\n"))
        val initial = candidate(upload("01", 100.0), upload("02", 200.0))
        // Existing unwrapped cache files are read without retiming or losing upload order.
        file.writeText(RinexNavigationResource.encode(initial))
        val store = RinexNavigationResourceStore(file)
        assertEquals(initial, store.load())
        val omission = candidate(upload("02", 300.0))
        store.update(RinexNavigationResource.encode(omission))
        assertEquals(omission, RinexNavigationResourceStore(file).load())
        val acceptedBytes = file.readBytes()
        val regression = candidate(upload("01", 50.0), upload("02", 400.0))
        assertThrows(IllegalArgumentException::class.java) {
            RinexNavigationResourceStore(file).update(RinexNavigationResource.encode(regression))
        }
        assertArrayEquals(acceptedBytes, file.readBytes())
        val unknown = candidate(upload("01", 9_999_999.0), upload("02", 400.0))
        assertThrows(IllegalArgumentException::class.java) {
            RinexNavigationResourceStore(file).update(RinexNavigationResource.encode(unknown))
        }
        val recovered = candidate(upload("01", 100.0), upload("02", 400.0))
        assertEquals(recovered, RinexNavigationResourceStore(file).update(RinexNavigationResource.encode(recovered)))
        assertEquals(recovered, RinexNavigationResourceStore(file).load())
    }

    @get:Rule val temporary = TemporaryFolder()
    private fun resource(text: String = RinexNavigationResourceTest.navigation(), downloadedAt: Long = 1000) =
        RinexNavigationResource.import(text, "https://example.org/navigation.rnx", downloadedAt)

    @Test fun failedUpdatePreservesExactAcceptedFileAndReaders() {
        val file = temporary.root.resolve("gnss/navigation.json")
        val store = RinexNavigationResourceStore(file)
        assertNull(store.load())
        val original = store.update(RinexNavigationResource.encode(resource()))
        val bytes = file.readBytes()
        assertThrows(IllegalArgumentException::class.java) { store.update("{broken}") }
        assertArrayEquals(bytes, file.readBytes())
        val oldOrbit = resource(RinexNavigationResourceTest.navigation().replace("2026 11 08", "2026 11 07"), 9999)
        assertThrows(IllegalArgumentException::class.java) { store.update(RinexNavigationResource.encode(oldOrbit)) }
        assertArrayEquals(bytes, file.readBytes())
        assertEquals(original, store.load())
        assertEquals(listOf("navigation.json"), file.parentFile!!.list()!!.toList())
        // Corrupt files can be repaired with a complete validated resource.
        file.writeText("corrupt")
        assertThrows(Exception::class.java) { store.load() }
        assertEquals(original, store.update(RinexNavigationResource.encode(original)))
    }

    @Test fun sameEpochHealthChangesArePromotedAndOneSystemCannotHideAnotherRollback() {
        val file = temporary.root.resolve("navigation.json")
        val store = RinexNavigationResourceStore(file)
        val gps = RinexNavigationResourceTest.navigation()
        val body = gps.substringAfter("END OF HEADER\n")
        val mixed = resource(gps + "\n" + body.replaceFirst('G', 'E'))
        store.update(RinexNavigationResource.encode(mixed))
        assertThrows(IllegalArgumentException::class.java) { store.update(RinexNavigationResource.encode(resource(gps))) }
        val rollback = resource(gps.replace("2026 11 08", "2026 11 09") + "\n" +
            body.replaceFirst('G', 'E').replace("2026 11 08", "2026 11 07"))
        assertThrows(IllegalArgumentException::class.java) { store.update(RinexNavigationResource.encode(rollback)) }
        assertEquals(mixed, store.load())
        val updated = resource(mixed.navigation.replace("2.400000000000D+00 0.000000000000D+00", "2.400000000000D+00 1.000000000000D+00"))
        assertEquals(updated, store.update(RinexNavigationResource.encode(updated)))
        assertEquals(updated, store.load())
        // Downloading again changes metadata, never the native reference labels or digest.
        val again = updated.copy(downloadedAtMillis = 999999)
        assertEquals(again, store.update(RinexNavigationResource.encode(again)))
    }
}
```

`core/src/test/kotlin/com/system/location/service/core/RinexNavigationResourceTest.kt`:

```kt
package com.system.location.service.core

import com.system.location.service.core.geo.Wgs84
import com.system.location.service.core.gnss.*
import java.io.ByteArrayOutputStream
import java.time.Instant
import java.util.Base64
import java.util.zip.GZIPOutputStream
import org.junit.Assert.*
import org.junit.Test

class RinexNavigationResourceTest {
    private val utc = GnssUtcTimeScale.parseIers(requireNotNull(javaClass.getResource("/gnss/leap-seconds.list")).readText())
    private val at = Instant.parse("2026-11-07T23:59:42Z").toEpochMilli()
    private fun resource() = RinexNavigationResource.import(navigation(), "https://example.org/navigation.rnx", at + 60000)

    @Test fun validatedResourceAndBoundedWireRetainOriginalEpochsAndText() {
        val resource = resource()
        assertEquals(resource, RinexNavigationResource.decode(RinexNavigationResource.encode(resource)))
        assertEquals(resource, RinexNavigationResource.decodeWire(RinexNavigationResource.encodeWire(resource)))
        val request = GnssSkyRequest(at, Wgs84(31.0, 121.0), 0.0)
        val first = resource.gpsProvider(utc).positions(request).positions.single()
        assertEquals(at, first.provenance.referenceEpochMillis)
        assertNotEquals(resource.downloadedAtMillis, first.provenance.referenceEpochMillis)
        val redownloaded = resource.copy(downloadedAtMillis = at + 86400000)
        assertEquals(first, redownloaded.gpsProvider(utc).positions(request).positions.single())
        assertTrue(redownloaded.gpsProvider(utc).positions(request.copy(atMillis = at + 86400000)).positions.isEmpty())
        assertFalse(RinexNavigationResource.encode(resource).contains("parsed"))
    }

    @Test fun digestVersionSyntaxUrlsAndCompressedExpansionRemainStrict() {
        val resource = resource()
        assertThrows(IllegalArgumentException::class.java) { resource.copy(sha256 = "0".repeat(64)).validate() }
        assertThrows(IllegalArgumentException::class.java) { resource.copy(formatVersion = 2) }
        for (url in listOf("http://example.org/nav", "https:/nav", "https://user:secret@example.org/nav", "https://example.org/nav#frag")) {
            assertThrows(IllegalArgumentException::class.java) { resource.copy(sourceUrl = url) }
        }
        assertThrows(IllegalArgumentException::class.java) {
            RinexNavigationResource.import(navigation().replace("G01", "X01"), resource.sourceUrl, at)
        }
        val huge = ByteArrayOutputStream().also { output ->
            GZIPOutputStream(output).use { it.write(ByteArray(RinexNavigationResource.MAX_JSON_BYTES + 1) { 32 }) }
        }.toByteArray()
        assertThrows(IllegalArgumentException::class.java) {
            RinexNavigationResource.decodeWire(Base64.getEncoder().encodeToString(huge))
        }
        assertThrows(IllegalArgumentException::class.java) {
            RinexNavigationResource.decodeWire("x".repeat(RinexNavigationResource.MAX_WIRE_LENGTH + 1))
        }
    }

    companion object {
        // Circular orbit integration fixture; native GPS calendar midnight (not UTC midnight).
        fun navigation() = "     3.04           NAVIGATION DATA     M".padEnd(60) + "RINEX VERSION / TYPE\n" +
            "".padEnd(60) + "END OF HEADER\n" + """
G01 2026 11 08 00 00 00 0.000000000000D+00 0.000000000000D+00 0.000000000000D+00
     7.000000000000D+00 0.000000000000D+00 0.000000000000D+00 0.000000000000D+00
     0.000000000000D+00 0.000000000000D+00 0.000000000000D+00 5.153639490690D+03
     0.000000000000D+00 0.000000000000D+00 0.000000000000D+00 0.000000000000D+00
     9.500000000000D-01 0.000000000000D+00 0.000000000000D+00 0.000000000000D+00
     0.000000000000D+00 0.000000000000D+00 2.444000000000D+03 0.000000000000D+00
     2.400000000000D+00 0.000000000000D+00 0.000000000000D+00 7.000000000000D+00
    -3.000000000000D+01 4.000000000000D+00
""".trimIndent()
    }
}
```

`core/src/test/kotlin/com/system/location/service/core/RinexNavigationSnapshotTest.kt`:

```kt
package com.system.location.service.core

import com.system.location.service.core.gnss.*
import org.junit.Assert.*
import org.junit.Test

class RinexNavigationSnapshotTest {
    private val text = RinexNavigationResourceTest.navigation()
    private val header = text.substringBefore("G01")
    private val body = text.substringAfter("END OF HEADER\n")
    private fun upload(transmission: Double, health: Int = 0, svid: String = "01"): String = body
        .replace("G01", "G$svid")
        .replace("2.400000000000D+00 0.000000000000D+00", "2.400000000000D+00 ${health}.000000000000D+00")
        .replace("-3.000000000000D+01", "%19.12E".format(java.util.Locale.ROOT, transmission))

    @Test fun latestTransmissionWinsOverCalendarAndHealthIsNeverFilteredOut() {
        val archive = header + listOf(upload(10.0), upload(30.0, 1), upload(20.0), upload(5.0, svid = "02"))
            .joinToString("\n")
        val selected = RinexNavigationSnapshot.select(archive, "https://example.org/nav", 1, uploadsPerIdentity = 2)
        val records = RinexNavigationReader.read(selected.navigation).records
        assertEquals(3, records.size)
        assertEquals(listOf(30.0, 20.0), records.filter { it.svid == 1 }.map { it.orbit[6][0] })
        assertEquals(1.0, records.first().orbit[5][1])
        assertTrue(selected.navigation.startsWith(header))
        assertEquals(1L, selected.downloadedAtMillis)
        assertEquals(selected, RinexNavigationResource.decodeWire(RinexNavigationResource.encodeWire(selected)))
    }

    @Test fun sameTransmissionConflictsAndUnknownTransmissionRemainAvailableForValidation() {
        val archive = header + listOf(upload(10.0), upload(30.0, 1), upload(30.0), upload(999999999.999))
            .joinToString("\n")
        val selected = RinexNavigationSnapshot.select(archive, "https://example.org/nav", 1, uploadsPerIdentity = 1)
        val records = RinexNavigationReader.read(selected.navigation).records
        assertEquals(3, records.size)
        assertEquals(listOf(1.0, 0.0, 0.0), records.map { it.orbit[5][1] })
        assertEquals(listOf(30.0, 30.0, 999999999.999), records.map { it.orbit[6][0] })
        assertThrows(IllegalArgumentException::class.java) {
            RinexNavigationSnapshot.select(archive, "https://example.org/nav", 1, uploadsPerIdentity = 0)
        }
    }
}
```

`core/src/test/kotlin/com/system/location/service/core/RinexTimeSystemCorrectionTest.kt`:

```kt
package com.system.location.service.core

import com.system.location.service.core.gnss.*
import org.junit.Assert.*
import org.junit.Test

class RinexTimeSystemCorrectionTest {
    private val example = "GAGP  9.0221874416E-10 0.000000000E+00 259200 2444          "

    @Test fun officialHeaderColumnsAndLegacyLabelKeepGalileoMinusGpsSign() {
        val parsed = RinexTimeSystemCorrection.parse(example)
        assertEquals("GAGP", parsed.type)
        assertEquals(9.0221874416e-10, parsed.a0Seconds, 0.0)
        assertEquals(0.0, parsed.a1SecondsPerSecond, 0.0)
        assertEquals(259200, parsed.referenceSeconds)
        assertEquals(2444, parsed.referenceWeek)
        assertEquals("", parsed.source)
        assertNull(parsed.utcIdentifier)
        assertEquals(parsed, RinexTimeSystemCorrection.parse(example.replace("GAGP", "GPGA")))
        // A5 example, same fixed columns with adjacent signed coefficients and source/U fields.
        val supplied = "GAGP -2.0081643015e-09-9.769962617e-15 432000 1849    E12 0 "
        val withSource = RinexTimeSystemCorrection.parse(supplied)
        assertEquals("E12", withSource.source)
        assertEquals(0, withSource.utcIdentifier)
        assertTrue(withSource.a0Seconds < 0 && withSource.a1SecondsPerSecond < 0)
    }

    @Test fun implicitEquationIsSolvedAndRoundTripsAcrossTheNativeWeekBoundary() {
        // Deliberately amplified valid synthetic slope to distinguish direct RHS evaluation.
        val correction = RinexTimeSystemCorrection("GAGP", 0.02, 5e-7, 604799, 2443, "test", null)
        val from = GalileoTime(1419, 604790.0)
        val until = GalileoTime(1420, 100.0)
        val gps = GpsTime(2443, 604799.99)
        val gst = correction.gpsToGalileo(gps, from, until)!!
        assertEquals(1420, gst.week)
        val delta = 0.99
        val expected = 0.99 + (0.02 + 5e-7 * delta) / (1 - 5e-7) - 1.0
        assertEquals(expected, gst.secondsOfWeek, 1e-10)
        assertEquals(0.0, correction.galileoToGps(gst, from, until)!!.secondsSince(gps), 1e-10)
        assertNull(correction.gpsToGalileo(gps.plusSeconds(1000.0), from, until))
        assertNull(correction.galileoToGps(until.plusSeconds(1.0), from, until))
    }

    @Test fun parserRejectsMalformedUnknownAndNonFiniteCorrections() {
        for (bad in listOf(example.replace("GAGP", "XXXX"), example.replace("9.0221874416E-10", "9.0221874416E999"),
            example.replace("259200", "604800"), example.take(45), example.replace("2444", "-444"))) {
            assertThrows(IllegalArgumentException::class.java) { RinexTimeSystemCorrection.parse(bad) }
        }
        val wrongSystem = RinexTimeSystemCorrection("BDUT", 0.0, 0.0, 14, 1088, "", null)
        assertThrows(IllegalArgumentException::class.java) {
            wrongSystem.gpsToGalileo(GpsTime(2444, 0.0), GalileoTime(1420, 0.0), GalileoTime(1420, 1.0))
        }
    }

    @Test fun agreesWithIndependentlyDecodedBroadcastCoefficientsWithoutQuantizingRinexAgain() {
        val from = GalileoTime(1420, 0.0)
        val until = GalileoTime(1420, 604799.0)
        val decoded = GalileoGpsTimeOffset(1420, 72, 31, -17, from, until)
        val rinex = RinexTimeSystemCorrection("GAGP", decoded.a0Seconds, decoded.a1SecondsPerSecond,
            259200, 2444, "E01", null)
        for (seconds in listOf(1.0, 100000.25, 259200.0, 600000.0)) {
            val gps = GpsTime(2444, seconds)
            val expected = decoded.gpsToGalileo(gps).time!!
            val actual = rinex.gpsToGalileo(gps, from, until)!!
            assertEquals(0.0, actual.secondsSince(expected), 1e-12)
            assertEquals(0.0, rinex.galileoToGps(actual, from, until)!!.secondsSince(gps), 1e-10)
        }
        val singular = rinex.copy(a1SecondsPerSecond = 1.0)
        assertNull(singular.gpsToGalileo(GpsTime(2444, 100.0), from, until))
        assertNull(singular.galileoToGps(GalileoTime(1420, 100.0), from, until))
    }
}
```

`core/src/test/kotlin/com/system/location/service/core/RouteDraftTest.kt`:

```kt
package com.system.location.service.core

import com.system.location.service.core.geo.*
import com.system.location.service.core.planning.*
import com.system.location.service.core.repository.DocumentStore
import org.junit.Assert.*
import org.junit.Test

class RouteDraftTest {
    private class Store : DocumentStore {
        var text: String? = null
        override fun read() = text
        override fun writeAtomically(text: String) { this.text = text }
    }
    private val start = Gcj02(25.0, 119.0)
    private val mid = Gcj02(25.1, 119.1)
    private val end = Gcj02(25.2, 119.2)
    private fun ready(store: Store = Store()) = RouteDraftController(store).apply { pick(start); pick(end) }
    @Test fun assemblesAllSequentialStepsAndDeduplicatesOnlyAdjacentPoints() {
        val c = ready(); val request = c.beginPlan()!!
        assertTrue(c.complete(request, listOf(listOf(start, mid), listOf(mid, end))))
        assertEquals(listOf(start, mid, end).map(CoordinateTransform::toWgs84), c.state.value.route!!.points)
    }
    @Test fun endpointChangesAndCancelRejectLatePlanningResults() {
        val c = ready(); val old = c.beginPlan()!!
        c.pick(mid)
        assertFalse(c.complete(old, listOf(listOf(start, end))))
        val next = c.beginPlan()!!; c.cancel()
        assertFalse(c.complete(next, listOf(listOf(start, mid))))
        assertEquals(DraftPhase.EMPTY, c.state.value.phase)
    }
    @Test fun cameraAndRouteSurviveControllerRecreation() {
        val store = Store(); val c = ready(store); val request = c.beginPlan()!!
        c.complete(request, listOf(listOf(start, end)))
        c.camera(MapCamera(mid, 16f, 180f, 30f))
        val restored = RouteDraftController(store)
        assertEquals(c.state.value, restored.state.value)
        val frozen = restored.state.value.route!!.frozen()
        restored.pick(mid)
        assertEquals(listOf(start, end).map(CoordinateTransform::toWgs84), frozen.points)
    }
    @Test fun inFlightPlanningRestoresAsInterruptedAndEmptyResultsAreFailures() {
        val store = Store(); val c = ready(store); val request = c.beginPlan()!!
        assertEquals(DraftPhase.ENDPOINTS, RouteDraftController(store).state.value.phase)
        assertFalse(c.complete(request, emptyList()))
        assertEquals(DraftPhase.ERROR, c.state.value.phase); assertNull(c.state.value.route)
        val retry = c.beginPlan()!!
        assertTrue(c.complete(retry, listOf(listOf(start, end))))
    }
    @Test fun laterPlanWinsEvenWhenEndpointsDidNotChange() {
        val c = ready(); val old = c.beginPlan()!!; val latest = c.beginPlan()!!
        c.fail(old, "old network failure")
        assertFalse(c.complete(old, listOf(listOf(start, mid))))
        assertTrue(c.complete(latest, listOf(listOf(start, end))))
    }
    @Test fun manualPointsNeedTwoDistinctPointsAndUndoRestoresPreviousGeometry() {
        val c = RouteDraftController(Store())
        c.mode(DrawingMode.POINTS)
        c.pick(start); c.pick(start)
        assertNull(c.state.value.route)
        c.pick(mid); c.pick(end)
        val frozen = c.state.value.route!!.frozen()
        c.undo()
        assertEquals(listOf(start, mid).map(CoordinateTransform::toWgs84), c.state.value.route!!.points)
        assertEquals(3, frozen.points.size)
        c.undo()
        assertNull(c.state.value.route)
        assertNull(c.beginPlan())
    }
    @Test fun freehandPersistsEveryStrokeAndUndoRemovesOneWholeStroke() {
        val store = Store(); val c = RouteDraftController(store)
        c.mode(DrawingMode.FREEHAND)
        val input = mutableListOf(start, start, mid)
        c.appendStroke(input)
        input.clear()
        c.appendStroke(listOf(mid, end))
        val restored = RouteDraftController(store)
        assertEquals(DrawingMode.FREEHAND, restored.state.value.mode)
        assertEquals(listOf(start, mid, end).map(CoordinateTransform::toWgs84), restored.state.value.route!!.points)
        restored.undo()
        assertEquals(listOf(start, mid).map(CoordinateTransform::toWgs84), restored.state.value.route!!.points)
        restored.undo()
        assertNull(restored.state.value.route)
        assertTrue(restored.state.value.strokes.isEmpty())
    }
    @Test fun modeSwitchRejectsInFlightPlanAndClearKeepsModeAndCamera() {
        val c = ready(); val request = c.beginPlan()!!
        val camera = MapCamera(mid, 16f, 0f, 0f)
        c.camera(camera); c.mode(DrawingMode.FREEHAND)
        c.appendStroke(listOf(start, end))
        assertFalse(c.complete(request, listOf(listOf(start, mid, end))))
        assertEquals(2, c.state.value.route!!.points.size)
        c.cancel()
        assertEquals(DrawingMode.FREEHAND, c.state.value.mode)
        assertEquals(camera, c.state.value.camera)
        assertTrue(c.state.value.strokes.isEmpty())
        c.mode(DrawingMode.PLAN); c.pick(start); c.pick(end)
        assertNotNull(c.beginPlan())
    }
    @Test fun oversizeStrokeLeavesPreviousDraftIntact() {
        val c = RouteDraftController(Store()); c.mode(DrawingMode.FREEHAND)
        c.appendStroke(listOf(start, end))
        val before = c.state.value
        try {
            c.appendStroke(List(10_000) { if (it % 2 == 0) start else mid })
            fail("Should reject oversized draft")
        } catch (_: IllegalArgumentException) { assertEquals(before, c.state.value) }
    }
}
```

`core/src/test/kotlin/com/system/location/service/core/RoutingEditsTest.kt`:

```kt
package com.system.location.service.core

import com.system.location.service.core.geo.Wgs84
import com.system.location.service.core.routing.*
import org.junit.Assert.*
import org.junit.Test

class RoutingEditsTest {
    @Test fun exclusionEditsPreservePointAndScenarioAssignments() {
        val original = RoutingConfig(
            mode = RoutingMode.PER_APP,
            globalScenarioId = "fallback",
            routes = listOf(AppRoute("map", point = Wgs84(30.0, 120.0)), AppRoute("runner", "route")),
        )
        val updated = original.withDeniedPackages(setOf("denied"))
        assertEquals(original.routes, updated.routes)
        assertEquals("fallback", updated.globalScenarioId)
        assertEquals(RoutingDecision.Deny, RoutingTable(updated).decision(10_001, "denied", false))
        val cleared = updated.withDeniedPackages(emptySet())
        assertEquals(RoutingMode.PER_APP, cleared.mode)
        assertEquals(RoutingDecision.Point(Wgs84(30.0, 120.0)), RoutingTable(cleared).decision(10_001, "map", false))
        assertEquals(RoutingDecision.Scenario("fallback"), RoutingTable(cleared).decision(10_001, "other", false))
    }

    @Test fun clearingOnlyExclusionsReturnsToGlobalMode() {
        assertEquals(RoutingMode.GLOBAL, RoutingConfig().withDeniedPackages(setOf("app"))
            .withDeniedPackages(emptySet()).mode)
    }

    @Test fun deselectionRemovesOnlyAssignmentsForEditedPoint() {
        val point = Wgs84(30.0, 120.0)
        val other = Wgs84(31.0, 121.0)
        val original = RoutingConfig(mode = RoutingMode.PER_APP,
            routes = listOf(AppRoute("map", point = point), AppRoute("runner", point = other)),
            deniedPackages = setOf("denied"))
        val updated = original.withPointAssignments(point, emptySet())
        val table = RoutingTable(updated)
        assertEquals(RoutingDecision.Global, table.decision(10_001, "map", false))
        assertEquals(RoutingDecision.Point(other), table.decision(10_001, "runner", false))
        assertEquals(RoutingDecision.Deny, table.decision(10_001, "denied", false))
    }

    @Test fun reassigningAppToAnotherPointCreatesOnlyOneRule() {
        val point = Wgs84(30.0, 120.0)
        val updated = RoutingConfig(routes = listOf(AppRoute("MAP", "scenario")))
            .withPointAssignments(point, setOf("map", "MAP"))
        assertEquals(1, updated.routes.size)
        assertEquals(RoutingDecision.Point(point), RoutingTable(updated).decision(10_001, "MAP", false))
        assertEquals(RoutingMode.GLOBAL, updated.withPointAssignments(point, emptySet()).mode)
    }
}
```

`core/src/test/kotlin/com/system/location/service/core/RoutingTableTest.kt`:

```kt
package com.system.location.service.core

import com.system.location.service.core.routing.AppRoute
import com.system.location.service.core.routing.RoutingConfig
import com.system.location.service.core.routing.RoutingDecision
import com.system.location.service.core.routing.RoutingMode
import com.system.location.service.core.routing.RoutingTable
import kotlinx.serialization.decodeFromString
import kotlinx.serialization.encodeToString
import kotlinx.serialization.json.Json
import org.junit.Assert.assertEquals
import org.junit.Assert.assertThrows
import org.junit.Assert.assertTrue
import org.junit.Test

class RoutingTableTest {
    private val perApp = RoutingConfig(
        mode = RoutingMode.PER_APP,
        globalScenarioId = "global",
        routes = listOf(
            AppRoute("com.example.map", "map-scenario"),
            AppRoute("com.example.route-by-uid", "uid-scenario", uid = 10_123),
            AppRoute("com.example.disabled", "ignored", enabled = false),
        ),
        deniedPackages = setOf("com.example.denied"),
    )

    @Test fun globalModeAlwaysUsesGlobalLocation() {
        val table = RoutingTable(RoutingConfig(mode = RoutingMode.GLOBAL, globalScenarioId = "x"))
        assertEquals(RoutingDecision.Global, table.decision(10_123, "com.example.map", false))
    }

    @Test fun exactPackageWinsOverUidAndIsCaseInsensitive() {
        val table = RoutingTable(perApp)
        assertEquals(RoutingDecision.Scenario("map-scenario"), table.decision(10_123, "COM.EXAMPLE.MAP", false))
    }

    @Test fun uidRouteIsUsedWhenPackageIsNotConfigured() {
        val table = RoutingTable(perApp)
        assertEquals(RoutingDecision.Scenario("uid-scenario"), table.decision(10_123, "com.other.app", false))
    }

    @Test fun systemCallersAndLowUidsBypassFakeRoutes() {
        val table = RoutingTable(perApp)
        assertEquals(RoutingDecision.Global, table.decision(1000, "com.example.map", true))
        assertEquals(RoutingDecision.Global, table.decision(1000, "com.example.map", false))
        assertEquals(RoutingDecision.Global, table.decision(10_123, "com.example.map", true))
    }

    @Test fun secondaryUserSystemIdsBypassPackageRoutesAndExplicitDenials() {
        val table = RoutingTable(perApp)
        for (uid in listOf(-1, 1000, 1001, 101000, 101001, 99901000)) {
            assertEquals("uid=$uid", RoutingDecision.Global,
                table.decision(uid, "com.example.denied", false))
            assertEquals("uid=$uid", RoutingDecision.Global,
                table.decision(uid, "com.example.map", false))
        }
        assertEquals(RoutingDecision.Scenario("map-scenario"),
            table.decision(110123, "com.example.map", false))
        assertEquals(RoutingDecision.Deny, table.decision(110123, "com.example.denied", false))
    }

    @Test fun deniedPackageWinsOverRoutes() {
        val table = RoutingTable(perApp.copy(
            routes = perApp.routes + AppRoute("com.example.denied", "should-not-win"),
        ))
        assertEquals(RoutingDecision.Deny, table.decision(10_123, "com.example.denied", false))
    }

    @Test fun disabledRouteFallsBackToGlobalScenario() {
        val table = RoutingTable(perApp)
        assertEquals(RoutingDecision.Scenario("global"), table.decision(10_999, "com.example.disabled", false))
    }

    @Test fun noRouteAndNoGlobalScenarioUsesRealLocation() {
        val table = RoutingTable(perApp.copy(globalScenarioId = null))
        assertEquals(RoutingDecision.Global, table.decision(10_999, "com.unknown", false))
    }

    @Test fun invalidOrDuplicateRoutesAreRejected() {
        assertThrows(IllegalArgumentException::class.java) {
            RoutingTable(RoutingConfig(
                mode = RoutingMode.PER_APP,
                routes = listOf(AppRoute("com.example.map", "a"), AppRoute("COM.EXAMPLE.MAP", "b")),
            ))
        }
        assertThrows(IllegalArgumentException::class.java) {
            RoutingTable(RoutingConfig(
                mode = RoutingMode.PER_APP,
                routes = listOf(AppRoute("a", "s", uid = 10_123), AppRoute("b", "t", uid = 10_123)),
            ))
        }
        assertThrows(IllegalArgumentException::class.java) { AppRoute("", "s") }
        assertThrows(IllegalArgumentException::class.java) { AppRoute("pkg", "") }
        assertThrows(IllegalArgumentException::class.java) { RoutingConfig(schemaVersion = 99) }
    }

    @Test fun configRoundTripsThroughJson() {
        val json = Json { ignoreUnknownKeys = true }
        val decoded = json.decodeFromString(RoutingConfig.serializer(), json.encodeToString(RoutingConfig.serializer(), perApp))
        assertEquals(perApp, decoded)
    }

    @Test fun fixedPointRouteReturnsPoint() {
        val point = com.system.location.service.core.geo.Wgs84(31.5, 121.5)
        val config = perApp.copy(routes = perApp.routes + AppRoute("com.example.fixed", point = point))
        val decision = RoutingTable(config).decision(10_999, "com.example.fixed", false)
        assertTrue(decision is RoutingDecision.Point)
        assertEquals(point, (decision as RoutingDecision.Point).point)
    }

    @Test fun routeRequiresScenarioOrPointAndNotBoth() {
        assertThrows(IllegalArgumentException::class.java) { AppRoute("com.example.empty") }
        assertThrows(IllegalArgumentException::class.java) {
            AppRoute("com.example.both", "s", point = com.system.location.service.core.geo.Wgs84(31.0, 121.0))
        }
    }
}
```

`core/src/test/kotlin/com/system/location/service/core/RuntimePositionUpdateTest.kt`:

```kt
package com.system.location.service.core

import com.system.location.service.core.geo.Wgs84
import com.system.location.service.core.location.LocationSample
import com.system.location.service.core.location.LocationSanitizer
import com.system.location.service.core.runtime.*
import org.junit.Assert.*
import org.junit.Test

class RuntimePositionUpdateTest {
    @Test fun oneUpdateDropsCachedFixAndReplacesPositionAndOptionalHeadingTogether() {
        val original = RuntimeSnapshot(configRevision = 3, bearingDeg = 15.0, configuration = HookConfiguration(enabled = true),
            sample = LocationSample(Wgs84(30.0, 120.0), 10.0, 5f, 0f, 0f, 1000, 1000))
        val update = RuntimePositionUpdate(Wgs84(31.0, 121.0), 4f, 270.0)
        val state = update.applyTo(original)
        assertEquals(31.0, state.latitude, 0.0)
        assertEquals(121.0, state.longitude, 0.0)
        assertEquals(270.0, state.bearingDeg, 0.0)
        assertTrue(state.hasBearings)
        assertNull(state.sample)
        assertNull(state.provider)
        assertEquals(4L, state.configRevision)
        assertSame(original.configuration, state.configuration)
        assertEquals(15.0, update.copy(bearingDeg = null).applyTo(original).bearingDeg, 0.0)
    }

    @Test fun invalidMotionMetadataCannotReachPublication() {
        assertEquals(LocationSanitizer.MAX_SPEED_MPS.toFloat(),
            RuntimePositionUpdate(Wgs84(0.0, 0.0), LocationSanitizer.MAX_SPEED_MPS.toFloat()).movementSpeedMps)
        for (speed in listOf(-1f, Float.NaN, Float.POSITIVE_INFINITY,
            LocationSanitizer.MAX_SPEED_MPS.toFloat() + 1f)) {
            assertThrows(IllegalArgumentException::class.java) { RuntimePositionUpdate(Wgs84(0.0, 0.0), speed) }
        }
        assertThrows(IllegalArgumentException::class.java) { RuntimePositionUpdate(Wgs84(0.0, 0.0), bearingDeg = Double.NaN) }
    }
}
```

`core/src/test/kotlin/com/system/location/service/core/RuntimeSnapshotTest.kt`:

```kt
package com.system.location.service.core

import com.system.location.service.core.geo.Wgs84
import com.system.location.service.core.location.LocationSample
import com.system.location.service.core.providers.ProviderKind
import com.system.location.service.core.runtime.RuntimeSnapshot
import com.system.location.service.core.runtime.RuntimeSnapshotStore
import org.junit.Assert.assertEquals
import org.junit.Assert.assertNull
import org.junit.Assert.assertThrows
import org.junit.Test

class RuntimeSnapshotTest {
    private val sample = LocationSample(
        coordinate = Wgs84(31.2304, 121.4737),
        altitude = 80.0,
        accuracy = 6f,
        speed = 1f,
        bearing = 90f,
        timeMillis = 1_000,
        elapsedNanos = 1_000,
    )

    @Test fun emptySnapshotHasNoSample() {
        assertNull(RuntimeSnapshot.EMPTY.sample)
        assertEquals(0L, RuntimeSnapshot.EMPTY.configRevision)
    }

    @Test fun publishSampleUpdatesAtomically() {
        val store = RuntimeSnapshotStore(RuntimeSnapshot(configRevision = 3))
        val updated = store.publishSample(sample, ProviderKind.GPS)
        assertEquals(3L, updated.configRevision)
        assertEquals(sample, store.current().sample)
        assertEquals(ProviderKind.GPS, store.current().provider)
    }

    @Test fun concurrentSamplesNeverRollbackConfiguration() {
        val store = RuntimeSnapshotStore()
        val start = java.util.concurrent.CountDownLatch(1)
        val samples = java.util.concurrent.Executors.newSingleThreadExecutor()
        try {
            val publishing = samples.submit {
                start.await()
                repeat(10_000) { store.publishSample(sample, ProviderKind.GPS) }
            }
            start.countDown()
            repeat(10_000) { version ->
                store.update { it.copy(configRevision = it.configRevision + 1) }
                assertEquals(version + 1L, store.current().configRevision)
            }
            publishing.get(10, java.util.concurrent.TimeUnit.SECONDS)
            assertEquals(10_000L, store.current().configRevision)
            assertEquals(sample, store.current().sample)
        } finally { samples.shutdownNow() }
    }

    @Test fun updatePreservesOtherFields() {
        val store = RuntimeSnapshotStore(RuntimeSnapshot(configRevision = 2, environmentVersion = 4))
        val updated = store.update { it.copy(physicalNoise = true) }
        assertEquals(2L, updated.configRevision)
        assertEquals(4L, updated.environmentVersion)
        assertEquals(true, updated.physicalNoise)
    }

    @Test fun clearSampleKeepsConfig() {
        val store = RuntimeSnapshotStore(RuntimeSnapshot(configRevision = 5, sample = sample))
        val cleared = store.clearSample()
        assertNull(cleared.sample)
        assertNull(cleared.provider)
        assertEquals(5L, cleared.configRevision)
    }

    @Test fun invalidVersionsAreRejected() {
        assertThrows(IllegalArgumentException::class.java) { RuntimeSnapshot(configRevision = -1) }
        assertThrows(IllegalArgumentException::class.java) { RuntimeSnapshot(environmentVersion = -1) }
        assertThrows(IllegalArgumentException::class.java) { RuntimeSnapshot(environmentApCount = 0) }
    }

    @Test fun configFieldsAreCaptured() {
        val snapshot = RuntimeSnapshot(
            configRevision = 9,
            environmentApCount = 7,
            cellMode = com.system.location.service.core.environment.CellMode.AUTO,
            environmentSourceMode = com.system.location.service.core.environment.EnvironmentSourceMode.REPLAY,
            simReady = false,
            physicalNoise = true,
            physicalNoiseSeed = 42,
        )
        assertEquals(7, snapshot.environmentApCount)
        assertEquals(com.system.location.service.core.environment.CellMode.AUTO, snapshot.cellMode)
        assertEquals(com.system.location.service.core.environment.EnvironmentSourceMode.REPLAY, snapshot.environmentSourceMode)
        assertEquals(false, snapshot.simReady)
        assertEquals(true, snapshot.physicalNoise)
        assertEquals(42L, snapshot.physicalNoiseSeed)
    }

    @Test fun simulationObservationRetainsRapidTransitionsAcrossFullSnapshotRestoration() {
        val store = RuntimeSnapshotStore()
        val before = store.observation()
        store.update { it.copy(configuration = it.configuration.copy(enabled = true)) }
        assertEquals(1L, store.observation().simulationGeneration)
        store.publishSample(sample)
        assertEquals(1L, store.observation().simulationGeneration)
        store.set(before.state)
        val after = store.observation()
        assertEquals(false, after.state.configuration.enabled)
        assertEquals(2L, after.simulationGeneration)
        store.set(before.state)
        assertEquals(2L, store.observation().simulationGeneration)
        org.junit.Assert.assertNotEquals(store.instanceId, RuntimeSnapshotStore().instanceId)
    }

    @Test fun simulationGenerationAndEnabledFlagAreOneAtomicObservation() {
        val store = RuntimeSnapshotStore()
        val writer = java.util.concurrent.Executors.newSingleThreadExecutor()
        try {
            val future = writer.submit {
                repeat(10_000) { store.update { it.copy(configuration = it.configuration.copy(enabled = !it.configuration.enabled)) } }
            }
            repeat(10_000) {
                val observed = store.observation()
                assertEquals(observed.simulationGeneration % 2 == 1L, observed.state.configuration.enabled)
            }
            future.get(10, java.util.concurrent.TimeUnit.SECONDS)
            assertEquals(10_000L, store.observation().simulationGeneration)
        } finally { writer.shutdownNow() }
    }
}
```
