`core/src/test/kotlin/com/system/location/service/core/RuntimeStartTest.kt`:

```kt
package com.system.location.service.core

import com.system.location.service.core.geo.Wgs84
import com.system.location.service.core.location.LocationSample
import com.system.location.service.core.providers.ProviderKind
import com.system.location.service.core.runtime.*
import org.junit.Assert.*
import org.junit.Test

class RuntimeStartTest {
    @Test fun startReplacesTheFixAndEnablesItsPolicyInOneTransition() {
        val oldPoint = Wgs84(31.0, 121.0)
        val state = RuntimeSnapshot(configRevision = 9, latitude = 31.0, longitude = 121.0,
            sample = LocationSample(oldPoint, 10.0, 5f, 2f, 90f, 1000, 1000), provider = ProviderKind.GPS,
            physicalNoiseSeed = 42, configuration = HookConfiguration(nmeaEnabled = false, minimumSatellites = 24))
        val result = RuntimeStart(Wgs84(40.0, 116.0), 3.0, 20.0, 8f, 200).applyTo(state)
        assertTrue(result.configuration.enabled)
        assertEquals(40.0, result.latitude, 0.0)
        assertEquals(116.0, result.longitude, 0.0)
        assertEquals(3.0, result.speedMps, 0.0)
        assertEquals(20.0, result.altitudeMeters, 0.0)
        assertEquals(8f, result.accuracyMeters)
        assertEquals(200L, result.configuration.reportIntervalMs)
        assertNull(result.sample)
        assertNull(result.provider)
        assertEquals(10L, result.configRevision)
        assertFalse(result.configuration.nmeaEnabled)
        assertEquals(24, result.configuration.minimumSatellites)
        assertEquals(42L, result.physicalNoiseSeed)
        assertFalse(state.configuration.enabled)
    }

    @Test fun omittedFieldsUseLatestStateAndRepeatedCasEvaluationHasNoSideEffects() {
        val start = RuntimeStart(Wgs84(1.0, 2.0))
        val latest = RuntimeSnapshot(configRevision = 4, speedMps = 7.0, altitudeMeters = 33.0,
            accuracyMeters = 12f)
        val result = start.applyTo(latest)
        assertEquals(7.0, result.speedMps, 0.0)
        assertEquals(33.0, result.altitudeMeters, 0.0)
        assertEquals(12f, result.accuracyMeters)
        assertEquals(result, start.applyTo(latest))
    }

    @Test fun invalidStartCannotChangeExistingState() {
        val store = RuntimeSnapshotStore()
        val before = store.current()
        val invalid = listOf<() -> RuntimeStart>(
            { RuntimeStart(Wgs84(1.0, 2.0), speedMps = -1.0) },
            { RuntimeStart(Wgs84(1.0, 2.0), speedMps = 1_000.1) },
            { RuntimeStart(Wgs84(1.0, 2.0), altitudeMeters = Double.NaN) },
            { RuntimeStart(Wgs84(1.0, 2.0), altitudeMeters = 20_000.1) },
            { RuntimeStart(Wgs84(1.0, 2.0), accuracyMeters = 0f) },
            { RuntimeStart(Wgs84(1.0, 2.0), reportIntervalMs = 0) },
        )
        invalid.forEach { prepare ->
            assertThrows(IllegalArgumentException::class.java) { store.update(prepare()::applyTo) }
            assertSame(before, store.current())
        }
        assertThrows(IllegalArgumentException::class.java) { RuntimeSnapshot(altitudeMeters = -500.1) }
        assertThrows(IllegalArgumentException::class.java) { RuntimeSnapshot(speedMps = 1_000.1) }
    }
}
```

`core/src/test/kotlin/com/system/location/service/core/RuntimeTransferWireTest.kt`:

```kt
package com.system.location.service.core

import com.system.location.service.core.environment.*
import com.system.location.service.core.geo.Wgs84
import com.system.location.service.core.gnss.*
import com.system.location.service.core.location.LocationSample
import com.system.location.service.core.location.LocationSanitizer
import com.system.location.service.core.routing.*
import com.system.location.service.core.runtime.*
import java.io.ByteArrayOutputStream
import java.util.zip.GZIPOutputStream
import org.junit.Assert.*
import org.junit.Test

class RuntimeTransferWireTest {
    @Test fun orbitResourceRoundTripPreservesExactSourceAndRejectsCorruptionAtomically() {
        val resource = RinexNavigationResource.import(RinexNavigationResourceTest.navigation(),
            "https://example.org/nav", 1794096000000)
        val original = RuntimeTransfer(RuntimeSnapshot(configuration = HookConfiguration(gnssNavigation = resource)), false)
        val encoded = RuntimeTransferWire.encode(original)
        val restored = RuntimeTransferWire.decode(encoded)
        assertEquals(resource, restored.state.configuration.gnssNavigation)
        assertEquals(original, restored)
        assertSame(original.state.configuration.gnssFrameSource(), restored.state.configuration.gnssFrameSource())
        val raw = java.util.zip.GZIPInputStream(encoded.inputStream()).bufferedReader().use { it.readText() }
        assertFalse(raw.contains("selectedGnssSource"))
        val broken = raw.replace(RinexNavigationResource.encodeWire(resource), "broken")
        val compressed = ByteArrayOutputStream().also { out -> GZIPOutputStream(out).use { it.write(broken.toByteArray()) } }.toByteArray()
        assertThrows(Exception::class.java) { RuntimeTransferWire.decode(compressed) }
        assertEquals(resource, original.state.configuration.gnssNavigation)
    }

    private val point = Wgs84(31.0, 121.0)
    private val sample = LocationSample(point, 10.0, 5f, 2f, 90f, 62000, 1_000_000_000)
    private fun source(): CapturedGnssSource = CapturedGnssSource.prepare(GnssCaptureWire.encode(GnssCapture(
        deviceModel = "receiver", osVersion = "os", startedAtMillis = 1000, endedAtMillis = 61000,
        frames = (0..60).map { GnssObservationFrame(1000 + it * 1000L, point,
            satellites = listOf(GnssSatellite(Constellation.GPS, 1, 30f, 120f, 35f, true, true, true))) })))!!

    @Test fun fullStateRoundTripRetainsConfigurationRoutingEnvironmentAndStatusEvidence() {
        val original = RuntimeSnapshot(configRevision = 12, environmentVersion = 5, sample = sample,
            latitude = 31.0, longitude = 121.0, altitudeMeters = 10.0, speedMps = 2.0, accuracyMeters = 5f,
            routing = RoutingConfig(mode = RoutingMode.PER_APP, routes = listOf(AppRoute("app", point = point))),
            environment = EnvironmentProfile(EnvironmentSourceType.REPLAY, generatedAtMillis = 1000, seed = 42),
            environmentSeed = 99, environmentApCount = 7, cellMode = CellMode.AUTO,
            environmentSourceMode = EnvironmentSourceMode.REPLAY, physicalNoise = true, physicalNoiseSeed = 123,
            simReady = false, bearingDeg = 90.0, hasBearings = true,
            configuration = HookConfiguration(enabled = true, nmeaEnabled = false, minimumSatellites = 24,
                reportIntervalMs = 200, sensorCadenceScale = 1.5, gnssSource = source()))
        val restored = RuntimeTransferWire.decode(RuntimeTransferWire.encode(RuntimeTransfer(original, true, mapOf("route" to sample))))
        assertEquals(original.copy(configuration = original.configuration.copy(gnssSource = null)),
            restored.state.copy(configuration = restored.state.configuration.copy(gnssSource = null)))
        assertTrue(restored.externallyDriven)
        assertEquals(mapOf("route" to sample), restored.scenarios)
        val before = original.configuration.gnssSource!!.frame(sample, 24, GnssFrameRoute.Global, 62000)!!
        val after = restored.state.configuration.gnssSource!!.frame(sample, 24, GnssFrameRoute.Global, 62000)!!
        assertEquals(before.frame, after.frame)
        assertTrue(after.sequence > before.sequence)
        assertNotSame(original.configuration.gnssSource, restored.state.configuration.gnssSource)
    }

    @Test fun restorationCanReuseEvidenceWithoutMutatingPreviouslyPublishedSource() {
        val source = source()
        val state = RuntimeSnapshot(configuration = HookConfiguration(gnssSource = source))
        val restored = RuntimeTransferWire.decode(RuntimeTransferWire.encode(RuntimeTransfer(state, false)), source)
        assertSame(source, restored.state.configuration.gnssSource)
    }

    @Test fun boundedCorruptOptionalCaptureDoesNotDiscardRequiredPeerStateOrPreviousSource() {
        fun compressed(raw: String): ByteArray = ByteArrayOutputStream().also { output ->
            GZIPOutputStream(output).use { it.write(raw.toByteArray()) }
        }.toByteArray()
        val json = """{"version":1,"state":{"configRevision":12,"configuration":{"minimumSatellites":32,"gnssSimulation":{"mode":"AUTONOMOUS"}}},"externallyDriven":false,"scenarios":{},"gnssCapture":"broken"}"""
        val previous = source()
        val restored = RuntimeTransferWire.decode(compressed(json), previous)
        assertSame(previous, restored.state.configuration.gnssSource)
        assertEquals(12L, restored.state.configRevision)
        assertEquals(32, restored.state.configuration.minimumSatellites)
        assertEquals(GnssSimulationMode.AUTONOMOUS, restored.state.configuration.gnssSimulation.mode)
        assertTrue(restored.state.configuration.gnssCaptureRejected)
        assertNull(RuntimeTransferWire.decode(compressed(json)).state.configuration.gnssSource)
        assertThrows(IllegalArgumentException::class.java) {
            RuntimeTransferWire.decode(compressed(json.replace("broken", "x".repeat(GnssCaptureWire.MAX_ENCODED_LENGTH + 1))))
        }
        val flagged = RuntimeSnapshot(configuration = HookConfiguration(gnssSource = previous, gnssCaptureRejected = true))
        assertTrue(RuntimeTransferWire.decode(RuntimeTransferWire.encode(RuntimeTransfer(flagged, false)))
            .state.configuration.gnssCaptureRejected)
    }

    @Test fun movementRetainsOriginalClockAndRejectsInvalidSpeeds() {
        assertEquals(LocationSanitizer.MAX_SPEED_MPS.toFloat(),
            RuntimeTransfer(RuntimeSnapshot(), false,
                movementSpeedMps = LocationSanitizer.MAX_SPEED_MPS.toFloat()).movementSpeedMps)
        val transfer = RuntimeTransfer(RuntimeSnapshot(), false, movementSpeedMps = 4f, lastMovementNanos = 1000)
        assertEquals(transfer, RuntimeTransferWire.decode(RuntimeTransferWire.encode(transfer)))
        assertEquals(1000L, transfer.atReception(9000).lastMovementNanos)
        assertEquals(0f, transfer.atReception(999).movementSpeedMps)
        for (speed in listOf(-1f, Float.NaN, Float.POSITIVE_INFINITY,
            LocationSanitizer.MAX_SPEED_MPS.toFloat() + 1f)) {
            assertThrows(IllegalArgumentException::class.java) {
                RuntimeTransfer(RuntimeSnapshot(), false, movementSpeedMps = speed)
            }
        }
    }

    @Test fun delayNeverRenewsAStaleExternalSampleOrScenario() {
        val state = RuntimeSnapshot(sample = sample, hasBearings = true, configuration = HookConfiguration(enabled = true))
        val transfer = RuntimeTransfer(state, true, mapOf("route" to sample))
        assertTrue(transfer.atReception(sample.elapsedNanos).externallyDriven)
        for (now in listOf(sample.elapsedNanos - 1, sample.elapsedNanos + 5_000_000_000)) {
            val result = transfer.atReception(now)
            assertFalse(result.externallyDriven)
            assertFalse(result.state.configuration.enabled)
            assertFalse(result.state.hasBearings)
            assertNull(result.state.sample)
            assertTrue(result.scenarios.isEmpty())
        }
        val overflowing = sample.copy(elapsedNanos = Long.MAX_VALUE)
        val rejected = transfer.copy(state = state.copy(sample = overflowing), scenarios = mapOf("route" to overflowing))
            .atReception(Long.MAX_VALUE)
        assertFalse(rejected.state.configuration.enabled)
        assertNull(rejected.state.sample)
        assertTrue(rejected.scenarios.isEmpty())
    }

    @Test fun malformedUnknownVersionAndOversizedPayloadsCannotBeDecoded() {
        assertThrows(Exception::class.java) { RuntimeTransferWire.decode(byteArrayOf(1, 2, 3)) }
        assertThrows(IllegalArgumentException::class.java) { RuntimeTransferWire.decode(ByteArray(RuntimeTransferWire.MAX_COMPRESSED_BYTES + 1)) }
        fun compressed(raw: String): ByteArray = ByteArrayOutputStream().also { output ->
            GZIPOutputStream(output).use { it.write(raw.toByteArray()) }
        }.toByteArray()
        assertThrows(IllegalArgumentException::class.java) {
            RuntimeTransferWire.decode(compressed(" ".repeat(RuntimeTransferWire.MAX_DECODED_BYTES + 1)))
        }
        assertThrows(IllegalArgumentException::class.java) {
            RuntimeTransferWire.decode(compressed("""{"version":2,"state":{},"externallyDriven":false,"scenarios":{},"gnssCapture":null}"""))
        }
        assertThrows(IllegalArgumentException::class.java) { RuntimeTransfer(RuntimeSnapshot(sample = sample), false) }
        assertThrows(IllegalArgumentException::class.java) { RuntimeTransfer(RuntimeSnapshot(), true) }
    }
}
```

`core/src/test/kotlin/com/system/location/service/core/SampleEnvelopeTest.kt`:

```kt
package com.system.location.service.core

import com.system.location.service.core.config.ConfigCodec
import com.system.location.service.core.config.ConfigException
import com.system.location.service.core.config.SampleCodec
import com.system.location.service.core.config.SampleEnvelope
import com.system.location.service.core.geo.Wgs84
import com.system.location.service.core.location.LocationSample
import com.system.location.service.core.providers.ProviderKind
import kotlinx.serialization.json.Json
import kotlinx.serialization.json.jsonObject
import org.junit.Assert.assertEquals
import org.junit.Assert.assertNull
import org.junit.Assert.assertThrows
import org.junit.Test

class SampleEnvelopeTest {
    private val sample = LocationSample(
        coordinate = Wgs84(31.2304, 121.4737),
        altitude = 80.0,
        accuracy = 6f,
        speed = 5f,
        bearing = 90f,
        timeMillis = 1_790_000_000_000,
        elapsedNanos = 1_000_000_000,
    )

    @Test
    fun v2RoundTripsWithMetadata() {
        val envelope = SampleEnvelope(
            sample = sample,
            provider = ProviderKind.GPS,
            fieldsMask = 0b1010,
            environmentVersion = 9,
            configRevision = 4,
        )
        assertEquals(envelope, SampleCodec.decode(SampleCodec.encode(envelope)))
    }

    @Test
    fun rawV1SampleIsWrappedWithDefaults() {
        val raw = Json.encodeToString(LocationSample.serializer(), sample)
        val decoded = SampleCodec.decode(raw)
        assertEquals(SampleEnvelope.CURRENT_SCHEMA_VERSION, decoded.schemaVersion)
        assertEquals(sample, decoded.sample)
        assertNull(decoded.provider)
        assertEquals(0, decoded.fieldsMask)
    }

    @Test
    fun explicitV1SampleIsAccepted() {
        val raw = """{"schemaVersion":1,"coordinate":{"latitude":31.0,"longitude":121.0},"altitude":1.0,"accuracy":5.0,"speed":0.0,"bearing":0.0,"timeMillis":1,"elapsedNanos":1}"""
        val decoded = SampleCodec.decode(raw)
        assertEquals(31.0, decoded.sample.latitude, 0.0)
        assertEquals(5f, decoded.sample.accuracy, 0f)
    }

    @Test
    fun futureVersionAndInvalidJsonAreRejected() {
        assertThrows(ConfigException::class.java) { SampleCodec.decode("""{"schemaVersion":99}""") }
        assertThrows(ConfigException::class.java) { SampleCodec.decode("not-json") }
    }

    @Test
    fun invalidEnvelopeIsRejected() {
        assertThrows(IllegalArgumentException::class.java) { SampleEnvelope(sample = sample, fieldsMask = -1) }
        assertThrows(IllegalArgumentException::class.java) { SampleEnvelope(sample = sample, environmentVersion = -1) }
        assertThrows(IllegalArgumentException::class.java) { SampleEnvelope(sample = sample, configRevision = -1) }
    }

    @Test
    fun envelopeUsesV2VersionField() {
        val encoded = SampleCodec.encode(SampleEnvelope(sample = sample))
        assertEquals(2, Json.parseToJsonElement(encoded).jsonObject[ConfigCodec.VERSION_FIELD]?.toString()?.toInt())
    }
}
```

`core/src/test/kotlin/com/system/location/service/core/SampleStoreTest.kt`:

```kt
package com.system.location.service.core

import com.system.location.service.core.config.ConfigEnvelope
import com.system.location.service.core.geo.Wgs84
import com.system.location.service.core.location.LocationSample
import com.system.location.service.core.runtime.InMemoryConfigStore
import com.system.location.service.core.runtime.InMemorySampleStore
import com.system.location.service.core.runtime.SampleStore
import com.system.location.service.core.scenario.Scenario
import org.junit.Assert.assertEquals
import org.junit.Assert.assertNull
import org.junit.Assert.assertTrue
import org.junit.Test

class SampleStoreTest {
    private val sample = LocationSample(
        coordinate = Wgs84(31.2304, 121.4737),
        altitude = 80.0,
        accuracy = 8f,
        speed = 5f,
        bearing = 90f,
        timeMillis = 1_790_000_000_000,
        elapsedNanos = 1_000_000_000,
    )

    @Test
    fun publishReturnsMonotonicSequenceAndLatest() {
        val store = InMemorySampleStore()
        assertEquals(1L, store.publish(sample, 100L))
        assertEquals(2L, store.publish(sample.copy(timeMillis = 2), 200L))
        val latest = store.latest(nowElapsedNanos = 200L)!!
        assertEquals(2L, latest.sequence)
        assertEquals(2L, latest.sample.timeMillis)
        assertEquals(200L, latest.storedAtElapsedNanos)
    }

    @Test
    fun staleLeaseReturnsNull() {
        val store = InMemorySampleStore()
        store.publish(sample, 1_000L)
        assertTrue(store.latest(nowElapsedNanos = 1_000L, maxAgeNanos = 0L) != null)
        assertNull(store.latest(nowElapsedNanos = 2_000L, maxAgeNanos = 500L))
        assertTrue(store.latest(nowElapsedNanos = 1_500L, maxAgeNanos = 1_000L) != null)
        assertNull(store.latest(nowElapsedNanos = 999L))
    }

    @Test
    fun clearRemovesLatest() {
        val store = InMemorySampleStore()
        store.publish(sample, 1_000L)
        store.clear()
        assertNull(store.latest(1_000L))
    }

    @Test
    fun defaultLeaseIsFiveSeconds() {
        val store = InMemorySampleStore()
        store.publish(sample, 0L)
        assertTrue(store.latest(nowElapsedNanos = SampleStore.DEFAULT_MAX_AGE_NANOS) != null)
        assertNull(store.latest(nowElapsedNanos = SampleStore.DEFAULT_MAX_AGE_NANOS + 1))
    }

    @Test
    fun configStoreRoundTripsAndClears() {
        val config = ConfigEnvelope(
            revision = 1,
            scenario = Scenario("p", "p", point = Wgs84(31.0, 121.0)),
            updatedAtMillis = 1,
        )
        val store = InMemoryConfigStore()
        assertNull(store.load())
        store.save(config)
        assertEquals(config, store.load())
        store.clear()
        assertNull(store.load())
    }

    @Test
    fun initialConfigIsExposed() {
        val config = ConfigEnvelope(
            revision = 2,
            scenario = Scenario("p", "p", point = Wgs84(31.0, 121.0)),
        )
        assertEquals(config, InMemoryConfigStore(config).load())
    }
}
```

```kt
package com.system.location.service.core

import com.system.location.service.core.backend.*
import com.system.location.service.core.geo.Wgs84

import org.junit.Test

class ScenarioControllerTest {
    private class Clock : RuntimeClock {
        var time = 0L
        override fun nanos() = time * 1_000_000
        override fun millis() = time
    }
    private class Backend : LocationBackend {
        override val type = BackendType.MOCK_PROVIDER
        override val capabilities = emptyMap<Capability, CapabilityStatus>()
        val calls = mutableListOf<String>()
        val publishedSamples = mutableListOf<LocationSample>()
        var diagnosticDetails = emptyList<BackendDiagnostic>()
        override suspend fun diagnose() = diagnosticDetails
        var failPublish = false
        var failCleanup = false
        override suspend fun prepare() = BackendResult.Success.also { calls += "prepare" }
        override suspend fun start() = BackendResult.Success.also { calls += "start" }
        override suspend fun pause() = BackendResult.Success.also { calls += "pause" }
        override suspend fun publish(sample: LocationSample, scenarioId: String?): BackendResult {
            calls += "publish"
            publishedSamples += sample
            return if (failPublish) BackendResult.Failure("PUBLISH", "injected failure") else BackendResult.Success
        }
        override suspend fun stop(): BackendResult {
            calls += "stop"
            return if (failCleanup) BackendResult.Failure("CLEANUP", "denied") else BackendResult.Success
        }
        override suspend fun release(): BackendResult {
            calls += "release"
            return if (failCleanup) BackendResult.Failure("CLEANUP", "denied") else BackendResult.Success
        }
    }
    private val scenario = Scenario("s", "test", route = Route("r", "route", listOf(Wgs84(0.0, 0.0), Wgs84(0.01, 0.01))))

    @Test fun userScenarioNameRemainsInRuntimeStateButIsOmittedFromDiagnostics() = runBlocking {
        val backend = Backend()
        val accepted = mutableListOf<DiagnosticEvent>()
        val c = ScenarioController({ backend }, Clock(), diagnosticBatchSink = { accepted += it })
        val privateName = "Home address"

        assertTrue(c.start(scenario.copy(name = privateName)))

        assertEquals(privateName, c.state.value.scenarioName)
        assertTrue(accepted.isNotEmpty())
        assertFalse(accepted.any { it.reason.contains(privateName) || it.suggestion.contains(privateName) })
    }

    @Test fun backendDiagnosticTextIsBoundedBeforeEnteringMemoryAndExportSink() = runBlocking {
        val backend = Backend().apply {
            diagnosticDetails = listOf(BackendDiagnostic(
                stage = "S".repeat(200),
                result = "R".repeat(100),
                reason = "x".repeat(3000),
                suggestion = "y".repeat(800),
            ))
        }
        val persisted = mutableListOf<DiagnosticEvent>()
        val controller = ScenarioController({ backend }, Clock(), diagnosticBatchSink = { persisted += it })

        controller.refreshDiagnostics()

        val memoryEvent = controller.diagnostics.value.single()
        val persistedEvent = persisted.single()
        for (event in listOf(memoryEvent, persistedEvent)) {
            assertEquals(128, event.stage.length)
            assertEquals(64, event.result.length)
            assertEquals(2048, event.reason.length)
            assertEquals(512, event.suggestion.length)
        }
    }

    @Test fun startupGenerationSurvivesShortSessionsBackendSelectionAndFailedPublication() = runBlocking {
        val backend = Backend()
        val c = ScenarioController({ backend }, Clock())
        assertEquals(0L, c.startGeneration)
        repeat(3) { index ->
            assertTrue(c.start(scenario))
            assertTrue(c.stop())
            assertFalse(c.state.value.isActive)
            assertEquals(index + 1L, c.startGeneration)
        }
        assertTrue(c.selectBackend(BackendType.MOCK_PROVIDER))

        assertFalse(c.start(scenario))

    @Test fun completedOneShotRoutePublishesAndRetainsItsEndpointAfterStopping() = runBlocking {

    @Test fun completedSmoothOneShotRoutePublishesAndRetainsItsEndpointAfterStopping() = runBlocking {

    @Test fun oneShotRouteCanHoldEndpointUntilExplicitStop() = runBlocking {
        val clock = Clock()
        val backend = Backend()

        assertTrue(c.start(scenario, holdAtEndpoint = true))

        clock.time = 1_000_000

        assertEquals(0f, c.state.value.sample!!.speed)
        assertFalse("held routes must not resume playback ticks", c.tick())

    @Test fun rebuildingMockProvidersWhileHoldingRepublishesEndpointAndKeepsHoldState() = runBlocking {

    @Test fun repeatedFailureAfterRecoveryIsRecordedWithinFiveSeconds() = runBlocking {

    private suspend fun assertOrdinaryDiagnosticTransitions(results: List<String>) {
        val backend = Backend()
        val clock = Clock()
        val accepted = mutableListOf<DiagnosticEvent>()
        val c = ScenarioController({ backend }, clock, diagnosticBatchSink = { accepted += it })
        results.forEachIndexed { index, result ->
            clock.time = index * 1000L
            backend.diagnosticDetails = listOf(BackendDiagnostic("REMOTE_COMMAND", result,
                if (result == "FAILED") "connection lost" else "connection restored"))
            c.refreshDiagnostics()
        }
        assertEquals(results, accepted.map { it.result })
        assertEquals(results, c.diagnostics.value.map { it.result })
    }

    @Test fun rejectedBatchCanBeRetriedOnTheNextDiagnosis() = runBlocking {
        val backend = Backend().apply {
            diagnosticDetails = (1..60).map { BackendDiagnostic("HOOK_POINT", "INFO", "hook $it") }
        }
        var reject = true
        var hooksWritten = 0
        val c = ScenarioController({ backend }, Clock(), diagnosticBatchSink = { batch ->
            if (batch.any { it.stage == "HOOK_POINT" }) {
                if (reject) throw java.util.concurrent.RejectedExecutionException("full")
                hooksWritten += batch.size
            }
        })
        assertTrue(c.start(scenario))
        assertEquals(0, hooksWritten)
        assertTrue(c.diagnostics.value.any { it.stage == "DIAGNOSTIC_STORAGE" })
        reject = false
        c.refreshDiagnostics()
        assertEquals(60, hooksWritten)
    }

    @Test fun asynchronousStorageFailuresAreReportedWithoutReenteringTheSink() = runBlocking {
        var submitted = 0
        val c = ScenarioController({ Backend() }, Clock(), diagnosticBatchSink = { submitted += it.size })
        c.reportDiagnosticStorageFailure(IllegalStateException("x".repeat(3000)))
        c.reportDiagnosticStorageFailure(IllegalStateException("still full"))
        assertEquals(1, c.diagnostics.value.count { it.stage == "DIAGNOSTIC_STORAGE" })
        assertEquals(2048, c.diagnostics.value.single().reason.length)
        assertEquals(0, submitted)
        c.reportDiagnosticStorageFailure(null)
        c.reportDiagnosticStorageFailure(IllegalStateException("another failure"))
        assertEquals(2, c.diagnostics.value.count { it.stage == "DIAGNOSTIC_STORAGE" })
        assertEquals(0, submitted)
    }

    @Test fun hookDetailsKeepStableIdentityAcrossFiveSecondPolls() = runBlocking {
        val clock = Clock()
        val backend = Backend().apply {
            diagnosticDetails = (1..60).map { BackendDiagnostic("HOOK_POINT", "INFO", "hook $it") }
        }
        val c = ScenarioController({ backend }, clock)
        assertTrue(c.start(scenario))
        assertEquals(60, c.diagnostics.value.count { it.stage == "HOOK_POINT" })
        clock.time = 5000
        assertTrue(c.tick())
        assertEquals(60, c.diagnostics.value.count { it.stage == "HOOK_POINT" })
        backend.diagnosticDetails = backend.diagnosticDetails.reversed()
        clock.time = 10000
        assertTrue(c.tick())
        assertEquals(60, c.diagnostics.value.count { it.stage == "HOOK_POINT" })
        backend.diagnosticDetails = backend.diagnosticDetails.map {
            if (it.reason == "hook 30") it.copy(suggestion = "new guidance") else it
        }
        clock.time = 15000
        assertTrue(c.tick())
        assertEquals(61, c.diagnostics.value.count { it.stage == "HOOK_POINT" })
        backend.diagnosticDetails = backend.diagnosticDetails.map { it.copy(suggestion = "") }
        clock.time = 20000
        assertTrue(c.tick())
        assertEquals(62, c.diagnostics.value.count { it.stage == "HOOK_POINT" })
    }

    @Test fun rebuildRetainsRouteProgressSessionAndPauseState() = runBlocking {
        val clock = Clock(); val backend = Backend(); val c = ScenarioController({ backend }, clock)
        assertFalse(c.rebuildMockProviders())
        assertTrue(c.start(scenario))
        clock.time = 2000; c.tick(); c.pause()
        val previous = c.state.value
        backend.calls.clear()
        clock.time = 4000
        assertTrue(c.rebuildMockProviders())
        assertEquals(listOf("stop", "prepare", "start", "pause", "publish"), backend.calls)
        assertEquals(RuntimePhase.PAUSED, c.state.value.phase)
        assertEquals(previous.scenarioId, c.state.value.scenarioId)
        assertEquals(previous.startedAt, c.state.value.startedAt)
        assertEquals(previous.sample!!.coordinate, c.state.value.sample!!.coordinate)
        assertEquals(previous.progress, c.state.value.progress, 0.0)
        assertTrue(c.resume())
        clock.time = 5000; assertTrue(c.tick())
        assertTrue(c.state.value.progress > previous.progress)
    }

    @Test fun failedRebuildCleanupNeverRegistersAgain() = runBlocking {
        val backend = Backend(); val c = ScenarioController({ backend }, Clock())
        assertTrue(c.start(scenario)); backend.calls.clear(); backend.failCleanup = true
        assertFalse(c.rebuildMockProviders())
        assertFalse(backend.calls.contains("prepare"))
        assertFalse(backend.calls.contains("start"))
        assertEquals(RuntimePhase.ERROR, c.state.value.phase)
        backend.failCleanup = false
        assertTrue(c.stop())
        assertFalse(c.rebuildMockProviders())
    }

    @Test fun speedChangesSettleOldMotionForBothRoutesAndJoystick() = runBlocking {
        for (route in listOf(false, true)) {
            val clock = Clock()
            val c = ScenarioController({ Backend() }, clock)
            val scene = if (route) scenario else Scenario("p", "point", point = Wgs84(0.0, 0.0))
            assertTrue(c.start(scene.copy(profile = MovementProfile(speedMps = 2.0))))
            if (route) assertFalse(c.setMotion(90.0, true)) else assertTrue(c.setMotion(90.0, true))
            val startedAt = c.state.value.startedAt
            clock.time = 1000
            assertTrue(c.setSpeed(8.0))
            fun distance(): Double = c.state.value.sample!!.let {
                Geodesic.WGS84.Inverse(0.0, 0.0, it.latitude, it.longitude).s12
            }
            assertEquals(2.0, distance(), 1e-5)
            assertEquals(8f, c.state.value.sample!!.speed)
            assertEquals(8.0, c.state.value.configuredSpeedMps!!, 0.0)
            assertEquals(startedAt, c.state.value.startedAt)
            clock.time = 2000
            c.tick()
            assertEquals(10.0, distance(), 1e-5)
            assertTrue(c.pause())
            val paused = c.state.value.sample!!.coordinate
            clock.time = 50000
            assertTrue(c.setSpeed(4.0))
            assertEquals(paused, c.state.value.sample!!.coordinate)
            assertEquals(0f, c.state.value.sample!!.speed)
            assertEquals(4.0, c.state.value.configuredSpeedMps!!, 0.0)
            assertTrue(c.resume())
            clock.time = 51000
            c.tick()
            assertEquals(14.0, distance(), 1e-5)
            assertTrue(c.setSpeed(0.0))
            clock.time = 60000
            c.tick()
            assertEquals(14.0, distance(), 1e-5)
            assertFalse(c.setSpeed(Double.NaN))
            assertFalse(c.setSpeed(-1.0))
            assertFalse(c.setSpeed(1001.0))
            assertEquals(0.0, c.state.value.configuredSpeedMps!!, 0.0)
            c.stop()
            assertFalse(c.setSpeed(10.0))
        }
    }

    @Test fun speedChangeHandlesCompletionAndPublishFailure() = runBlocking {
        val clock = Clock(); val backend = Backend(); val c = ScenarioController({ backend }, clock)
        c.start(scenario)
        clock.time = 1_000_000
        assertFalse(c.setSpeed(10.0))
        assertEquals(RuntimePhase.STOPPED, c.state.value.phase)
        c.start(scenario)
        backend.failPublish = true
        assertFalse(c.setSpeed(10.0))
        assertEquals(RuntimePhase.ERROR, c.state.value.phase)
    }

    @Test fun completeLifecycleAndSingleStateSource() = runBlocking {
        val clock = Clock(); val backend = Backend(); val c = ScenarioController({ backend }, clock)
        assertTrue(c.start(scenario)); assertEquals(RuntimePhase.RUNNING, c.state.value.phase)
        clock.time = 1000; c.tick()
        assertTrue(c.pause()); val point = c.state.value.sample!!.coordinate
        clock.time = 50000; c.tick(); assertEquals(point, c.state.value.sample!!.coordinate)
        assertFalse(c.selectBackend(BackendType.XPOSED))
        assertTrue(c.resume()); assertEquals(point, c.state.value.sample!!.coordinate)
        clock.time = 51000; c.tick(); assertNotEquals(point, c.state.value.sample!!.coordinate)
        assertTrue(c.stop()); assertEquals(RuntimePhase.STOPPED, c.state.value.phase)
        assertEquals(listOf("stop"), backend.calls.takeLast(1))
        assertTrue(c.stop())
    }

    @Test fun publishFailureCleansResourcesAndCanRestart() = runBlocking {
        val backend = Backend(); val c = ScenarioController({ backend }, Clock())
        backend.failPublish = true
        assertFalse(c.start(scenario)); assertEquals(RuntimePhase.ERROR, c.state.value.phase)
        assertEquals(listOf("stop"), backend.calls.takeLast(1))
        assertEquals("PUBLISH", c.diagnostics.value.last { it.result == "FAILED" }.stage)
        backend.failPublish = false
        assertTrue(c.start(scenario))
    }

    @Test fun failedCleanupPreventsSwitchUntilRetrySucceeds() = runBlocking {
        val backend = Backend(); val c = ScenarioController({ backend }, Clock())
        c.start(scenario); backend.failCleanup = true
        assertFalse(c.stop()); assertFalse(c.selectBackend(BackendType.XPOSED))
        backend.failCleanup = false
        assertTrue(c.stop()); assertTrue(c.selectBackend(BackendType.XPOSED))
    }

    @Test fun processInterruptionNeverReportsRunning() = runBlocking {
        val c = ScenarioController({ Backend() }, Clock())
        c.interrupted("进程已退出")
        assertEquals(RuntimePhase.ERROR, c.state.value.phase)
        assertFalse(c.state.value.isActive)
        assertEquals("PROCESS_INTERRUPTED", c.state.value.error!!.stage)
        assertTrue(c.stop())
        assertEquals(RuntimePhase.STOPPED, c.state.value.phase)
        assertNull(c.state.value.error)
    }

    @Test fun backendConstructionFailureIsReportedAndCanRecover() = runBlocking {
        var fail = true
        val c = ScenarioController({ if (fail) error("service unavailable") else Backend() }, Clock())
        assertFalse(c.start(scenario))
        assertEquals("CREATE_BACKEND", c.state.value.error!!.stage)
        assertFalse(c.state.value.isActive)
        fail = false
        assertTrue(c.start(scenario))
    }

    @Test fun interruptedProcessRetainsFailedBackendUntilResourcesAreReleased() = runBlocking {
        val backend = Backend().apply { failCleanup = true }
        val c = ScenarioController({ backend }, Clock())
        c.recoverInterrupted(BackendType.MOCK_PROVIDER, "process died")
        assertFalse(c.state.value.isActive)
        assertFalse(c.selectBackend(BackendType.XPOSED))
        assertEquals(listOf("stop", "release"), backend.calls)
        backend.failCleanup = false
        assertTrue(c.stop())
        assertTrue(c.selectBackend(BackendType.XPOSED))
    }
}
```

`core/src/test/kotlin/com/system/location/service/core/ScenarioSampleStoreTest.kt`:

```kt
package com.system.location.service.core

import com.system.location.service.core.geo.Wgs84
import com.system.location.service.core.location.LocationSample
import com.system.location.service.core.runtime.ScenarioSampleStore
import org.junit.Assert.assertEquals
import org.junit.Assert.assertNull
import org.junit.Assert.assertThrows
import org.junit.Assert.assertTrue
import org.junit.Test

class ScenarioSampleStoreTest {
    private fun sample(lat: Double, elapsed: Long = 1_000L) = LocationSample(
        coordinate = Wgs84(lat, 121.47),
        altitude = 80.0,
        accuracy = 6f,
        speed = 1f,
        bearing = 90f,
        timeMillis = 1_000,
        elapsedNanos = elapsed,
    )

    @Test fun scenariosAreIsolated() {
        val store = ScenarioSampleStore()
        store.publish("a", sample(31.0), 100)
        store.publish("b", sample(32.0), 100)
        assertEquals(31.0, store.latest("a", 100)!!.sample.latitude, 0.0)
        assertEquals(32.0, store.latest("b", 100)!!.sample.latitude, 0.0)
        assertNull(store.latest("missing", 100))
    }

    @Test fun sequenceIsMonotonicAcrossScenarios() {
        val store = ScenarioSampleStore()
        assertEquals(1L, store.publish("a", sample(31.0), 100))
        assertEquals(2L, store.publish("b", sample(32.0), 100))
        assertEquals(3L, store.publish("a", sample(33.0), 200))
        assertEquals(3L, store.latest("a", 200)!!.sequence)
    }

    @Test fun staleAndFutureSamplesAreRejected() {
        val store = ScenarioSampleStore()
        store.publish("a", sample(31.0), 1_000)
        assertNull(store.latest("a", 2_000, maxAgeNanos = 500))
        assertNull(store.latest("a", 999))
        assertTrue(store.latest("a", 1_500, maxAgeNanos = 1_000) != null)
        assertNull(store.latest("a", 2_000, maxAgeNanos = 1_000))
        assertTrue(store.snapshot(2_000, 1_000).isEmpty())
        assertNull(store.latest("a", 1_000, maxAgeNanos = 0))
    }

    @Test fun oldestScenarioIsEvictedAtCapacity() {
        val store = ScenarioSampleStore(maxScenarios = 2)
        store.publish("a", sample(31.0), 100)
        store.publish("b", sample(32.0), 100)
        store.publish("c", sample(33.0), 100)
        assertEquals(setOf("b", "c"), store.scenarioIds())
        assertNull(store.latest("a", 100))
    }

    @Test fun clearAndValidation() {
        val store = ScenarioSampleStore()
        store.publish("a", sample(31.0), 100)
        store.clear("a")
        assertTrue(store.scenarioIds().isEmpty())
        assertThrows(IllegalArgumentException::class.java) { store.publish("", sample(31.0), 100) }
        assertThrows(IllegalArgumentException::class.java) { store.publish("s".repeat(256), sample(31.0), 100) }
        assertThrows(IllegalArgumentException::class.java) { ScenarioSampleStore(0) }
    }

    @Test fun tickSnapshotRetainsItsSamplesAndAppliesLeasesToAllScenarios() {
        val store = ScenarioSampleStore()
        store.publish("stale", sample(30.0), 100)
        store.publish("current", sample(31.0), 1_000)
        store.publish("future", sample(32.0), 2_000)
        val captured = store.snapshot(1_499, 500)
        assertEquals(setOf("current"), captured.keys)
        store.publish("current", sample(33.0), 1_500)
        store.clear("current")
        assertEquals(31.0, captured.getValue("current").latitude, 0.0)
        assertThrows(IllegalArgumentException::class.java) { store.snapshot(1_500, -1) }
    }

    @Test fun fullRestoreReplacesAllEntriesWithoutRenewingDeadlinesAndRejectsInvalidBatch() {
        val store = ScenarioSampleStore(maxScenarios = 2)
        store.publish("old", sample(30.0), 100)
        val restored = sample(31.0, elapsed = 1_000)
        store.replace(mapOf("new" to restored))
        assertEquals(setOf("new"), store.scenarioIds())
        assertEquals(2L, store.latest("new", 1_000)!!.sequence)
        assertNull(store.latest("new", 2_000, maxAgeNanos = 500))
        assertThrows(IllegalArgumentException::class.java) { store.replace(mapOf("" to restored)) }
        assertEquals(setOf("new"), store.scenarioIds())
        store.replace(emptyMap())
        assertTrue(store.scenarioIds().isEmpty())
    }
}
```

```kt
package com.system.location.service.core
```

```kt
        assertArrayEquals(frame.rotationVector, SensorEventValues.from(frame, 15, 4), 0f)
        assertNull(SensorEventValues.from(frame, 16, 3))
        assertNull(SensorEventValues.from(frame, 999, 16))
    }
```

`core/src/test/kotlin/com/system/location/service/core/SensorModelTest.kt`:

```kt
package com.system.location.service.core

import com.system.location.service.core.sensors.ActivityKind
import com.system.location.service.core.sensors.MotionMode
import com.system.location.service.core.sensors.MotionState
import com.system.location.service.core.sensors.SensorFrame
import com.system.location.service.core.sensors.SensorTuning
import com.system.location.service.core.sensors.SyntheticSensorModel
import org.junit.Assert.assertEquals
import org.junit.Assert.assertNotEquals
import org.junit.Assert.assertTrue
import org.junit.Test
import kotlin.math.abs
import kotlin.math.pow
import kotlin.math.sqrt

class SensorModelTest {
    private val state = MotionState(MotionMode.STILL, 0.0, 90.0, 80.0)

    @Test
    fun stillMotionHasGravityAndNoSteps() {
        val model = SyntheticSensorModel(seed = 1)
        val frames = (1..10).map { model.frame(state, it * 1_000L) }
        frames.forEach { frame ->
            val magnitude = magnitude(frame.accelerometer)
            assertTrue("magnitude=$magnitude", abs(magnitude - 9.81) < 1.0)
            assertEquals(0L, frame.stepCount)
            assertEquals(0, frame.stepCadence)
            assertEquals(ActivityKind.STILL, frame.activity)
        }
    }

    @Test
    fun walkingAdvancesStepsAtWalkingCadence() {
        val model = SyntheticSensorModel(seed = 2)
        val frames = (1..10).map { model.frame(state.copy(mode = MotionMode.WALK, speedMps = 1.4), 1_000L * it) }
        val last = frames.last()
        assertTrue("cadence=${last.stepCadence}", last.stepCadence in 90..135)
        assertTrue("steps=${last.stepCount}", last.stepCount in 14L..24L)
        assertEquals(ActivityKind.WALKING, last.activity)
    }

    @Test
    fun runningHasMoreCadenceAndMotionThanWalking() {
        val walkFrames = SyntheticSensorModel(seed = 3).let { model ->
            (1..10).map { model.frame(state.copy(mode = MotionMode.WALK, speedMps = 1.4), it * 1_000L) }
        }
        val runFrames = SyntheticSensorModel(seed = 3).let { model ->
            (1..10).map { model.frame(state.copy(mode = MotionMode.RUN, speedMps = 3.2), it * 1_000L) }
        }
        val walk = walkFrames.last()
        val run = runFrames.last()
        assertTrue("run cadence=${run.stepCadence}", run.stepCadence in 140..185)
        assertTrue("walk cadence=${walk.stepCadence}", run.stepCadence > walk.stepCadence)
        assertTrue(run.stepCount > walk.stepCount)
        assertTrue(runFrames.maxOf { amplitude(it.accelerometer) } >
            walkFrames.maxOf { amplitude(it.accelerometer) })
        assertEquals(ActivityKind.RUNNING, run.activity)
    }

    @Test
    fun cadenceScaleAndVariationAreAdjustableWithoutChangingNativeCode() {
        val stateWalk = state.copy(mode = MotionMode.WALK, speedMps = 1.4)
        val base = SyntheticSensorModel(seed = 11, tuning = SensorTuning(cadenceScale = 1.0, variability = 0.0))
            .frame(stateWalk, 8_000L)
        val faster = SyntheticSensorModel(seed = 11, tuning = SensorTuning(cadenceScale = 1.4, variability = 0.0))
            .frame(stateWalk, 8_000L)
        assertTrue(faster.stepCadence > base.stepCadence)

        val varied = SyntheticSensorModel(seed = 12, tuning = SensorTuning(cadenceScale = 1.0, variability = 0.35))
            .frame(stateWalk, 8_000L)
        assertTrue(varied.stepCadence > 0)
        assertTrue(varied.stepCadence != base.stepCadence || varied.accelerometer != base.accelerometer)
    }

    @Test
    fun vehicleHasNoStepsAndVehicleActivity() {
        val model = SyntheticSensorModel(seed = 4)
        val frame = (1..10).map { model.frame(state.copy(mode = MotionMode.VEHICLE, speedMps = 12.0), it * 1_000L) }.last()
        assertEquals(ActivityKind.IN_VEHICLE, frame.activity)
        assertEquals(0L, frame.stepCount)
        assertEquals(0, frame.stepCadence)
    }

    @Test
    fun barometerFollowsAltitude() {
        val low = SyntheticSensorModel(seed = 5).frame(state.copy(altitudeMeters = 80.0), 1_000L)
        val high = SyntheticSensorModel(seed = 5).frame(state.copy(altitudeMeters = 800.0), 1_000L)
        assertTrue(low.barometerHpa > high.barometerHpa)
        val expectedLow = 1013.25 * (1.0 - 2.25577e-5 * 80.0).pow(5.25588)
        assertTrue(abs(low.barometerHpa - expectedLow) < 1.0)
    }

    @Test
    fun sameSeedAndTimestampsProduceSameFrames() {
        val first = SyntheticSensorModel(seed = 6)
        val second = SyntheticSensorModel(seed = 6)
        val stateWalk = state.copy(mode = MotionMode.WALK, speedMps = 1.4)
        val firstFrames = (1..20).map { first.frame(stateWalk, it * 1_000L) }
        val secondFrames = (1..20).map { second.frame(stateWalk, it * 1_000L) }
        firstFrames.zip(secondFrames).forEach { (a, b) ->
            assertEquals(a.stepCount, b.stepCount)
            assertEquals(a.barometerHpa, b.barometerHpa, 0f)
            assertTrue(a.accelerometer.contentEquals(b.accelerometer))
        }
    }

    @Test
    fun differentSeedChangesNoise() {
        val first = SyntheticSensorModel(seed = 7).frame(state, 1_000L)
        val second = SyntheticSensorModel(seed = 8).frame(state, 1_000L)
        assertNotEquals(first.accelerometer.toList(), second.accelerometer.toList())
    }

    @Test
    fun frameValuesAreFiniteAndBounded() {
        val frame = SyntheticSensorModel(seed = 9).frame(
            state.copy(mode = MotionMode.RUN, speedMps = 3.0, bearingDeg = 359.0, altitudeMeters = 2500.0),
            5_000L,
        )
        assertTrue(frame.accelerometer.all(Float::isFinite))
        assertTrue(frame.gyroscope.all(Float::isFinite))
        assertTrue(frame.magnetometer.all(Float::isFinite))
        assertTrue(frame.barometerHpa in 300f..1_100f)
        assertTrue(frame.accelerometer.all { abs(it) < 30f })
    }

    private fun magnitude(values: FloatArray): Double =
        sqrt(values.take(3).sumOf { (it.toDouble() * it).toDouble() })

    private fun amplitude(values: FloatArray): Double =
        values.take(3).maxOf { abs(it.toDouble()) }
}
```

```kt
package com.system.location.service.core

import com.system.location.service.core.sensors.*
import org.junit.Assert.*
import org.junit.Test

class SensorPlaybackTest {
    private fun grant(session: String = "one", sample: Long = 1_000_000_000) =
        SensorPlaybackState(session, sample, sample + 2_000_000_000, 1.5f, 0f, 0.0)

    @Test fun expiryAndRevocationRestorePassThrough() {
        val playback = SensorPlayback()
        playback.update(grant(), 1_000_000_000)
        assertNotNull(playback.frame(1_500_000_000))
        assertNull(playback.frame(3_000_000_000))
        playback.update(null, 1_500_000_000)
        assertNull(playback.frame(1_500_000_000))
    }

    @Test fun listenersShareStepsAndNewSessionsResetThem() {
        val playback = SensorPlayback()
        playback.update(grant(), 1_000_000_000)
        playback.frame(1_000_000_000)
        val later = playback.frame(2_500_000_000)!!
        assertTrue(later.stepCount > 0)
        assertSame(later, playback.frame(2_500_000_000))
        playback.update(grant("two", 2_500_000_000), 2_500_000_000)
        assertEquals(0L, playback.frame(2_500_000_000)!!.stepCount)
    }
}
```

`core/src/test/kotlin/com/system/location/service/core/SensorTargetPolicyTest.kt`:

```kt
package com.system.location.service.core

import com.system.location.service.core.runtime.*
import com.system.location.service.core.sensors.SensorTargets
import org.junit.Assert.*
import org.junit.Test

class SensorTargetPolicyTest {
    @Test fun onlyExactApplicationUidsWithEntireSharedUidOptedInMayRead() {
        val targets = setOf("com.example.target")
        assertTrue(SensorTargets.allows(10123, targets, targets))
        assertFalse(SensorTargets.allows(1000, targets, targets))
        assertFalse(SensorTargets.allows(99123, targets, targets))
        assertFalse(SensorTargets.allows(10123, emptySet(), targets))
        assertFalse(SensorTargets.allows(10123, targets + "com.example.other", targets))
        assertFalse(SensorTargets.allows(10123, setOf("com.example.target.extra"), targets))
    }
    @Test fun updatesAreAtomicAndEmptyListDisablesInjection() {
        val old = RuntimeSnapshot(configuration = HookConfiguration(sensorTargets = setOf("com.example.target")))
        val cleared = PreparedRuntimeConfiguration.prepare(mapOf("sensor_targets" to "")).applyTo(old)
        assertTrue(cleared.configuration.sensorTargets.isEmpty())
        assertEquals(old.configuration.sensorTargets, PreparedRuntimeConfiguration.prepare(emptyMap()).applyTo(old).configuration.sensorTargets)
        try { PreparedRuntimeConfiguration.prepare(mapOf("sensor_targets" to "../bad")); fail() }
        catch (_: IllegalArgumentException) { }
        assertEquals(setOf("com.example.a", "com.example.b"), SensorTargets.parse("com.example.a, com.example.b"))
    }
}
```

`core/src/test/kotlin/com/system/location/service/core/SensorTimelineTest.kt`:

```kt
package com.system.location.service.core

import com.system.location.service.core.geo.Wgs84
import com.system.location.service.core.location.LocationSample
import com.system.location.service.core.sensors.*
import org.junit.Assert.*
import org.junit.Test
import kotlin.math.abs

class SensorTimelineTest {
    @Test fun stepDetectorBatchUsesModeledCadenceAndMonotonicTimes() {
        val events = SensorCadence.detectorEventTimestamps(
            nowNanos = 5_000_000_000L,
            eventCount = 3,
            cadencePerMinute = 120,
            previousEventNanos = 3_000_000_000L,
        )

        assertArrayEquals(longArrayOf(4_000_000_000L, 4_500_000_000L, 5_000_000_000L), events)
    }

    @Test fun delayedStepDetectorBatchFitsBetweenLastEventAndCurrentTime() {
        val events = SensorCadence.detectorEventTimestamps(
            nowNanos = 5_000_000_000L,
            eventCount = 3,
            cadencePerMinute = 120,
            previousEventNanos = 4_900_000_000L,
        )

        assertTrue(events.first() > 4_900_000_000L)
        assertEquals(5_000_000_000L, events.last())
        assertTrue((1 until events.size).all { events[it] > events[it - 1] })
    }

    @Test fun duplicateAndDelayedReadersCannotAdvanceStepsOrRewindTime() {
        val model = SyntheticSensorModel(tuning = SensorTuning(variability = 0.0))
        val walk = MotionState(MotionMode.WALK, 1.4, 0.0, 0.0)
        model.frame(walk, 0)
        val next = model.frame(walk, 1000)
        assertSame(next, model.frame(walk, 1000))
        assertSame(next, model.frame(walk, 500))
        assertTrue(model.frame(walk, 2000).stepCount > next.stepCount)
    }

    @Test fun gravityAndLinearAccelerationReconstructAccelerometerUnderTilt() {
        val frame = SyntheticSensorModel().frame(
            MotionState(MotionMode.STILL, 0.0, 80.0, 100.0, rollDeg = 40.0, pitchDeg = 20.0), 0)
        for (i in 0..2) assertEquals(frame.accelerometer[i], frame.gravity[i] + frame.linearAcceleration[i], 0.00001f)
        assertEquals(9.81, kotlin.math.sqrt(frame.gravity.sumOf { it.toDouble() * it }), 0.001)
        assertEquals(1.0, frame.rotationVector.sumOf { it.toDouble() * it }, 0.00001)
    }

    @Test fun highRateSamplingProducesWalkingWaveAndConsistentStepCount() {
        val model = SyntheticSensorModel(tuning = SensorTuning(variability = 0.0))
        val walk = MotionState(MotionMode.WALK, 1.4, 0.0, 0.0)
        val frames = (0..1000).map { model.frame(walk, it * 10L) }
        assertTrue(frames.maxOf { it.accelerometer[2] } - frames.minOf { it.accelerometer[2] } > 2.5f)
        val expected = SensorCadence.base(walk.mode, walk.speedMps) / 60 * 10
        assertTrue(abs(frames.last().stepCount - expected) < 1.0)
    }

    @Test fun turningAcrossNorthUsesShortArcAndDuplicateFixesPreserveDerivatives() {
        val tracker = SensorMotionTracker()
        val a = LocationSample(Wgs84(30.0, 120.0), 0.0, 3f, 1f, 359f, 1000, 1_000_000_000)
        tracker.accept(a)
        val b = a.copy(speed = 2f, bearing = 1f, elapsedNanos = 2_000_000_000)
        val motion = tracker.accept(b)
        assertEquals(1.0, motion.forwardAccelerationMps2, 0.001)
        assertEquals(Math.toRadians(2.0), motion.turnRateRadPerSec, 0.001)
        assertEquals(motion, tracker.accept(a))
    }
}
```

`core/src/test/kotlin/com/system/location/service/core/SeqlockSampleStoreTest.kt`:

```kt
package com.system.location.service.core

import com.system.location.service.core.geo.Wgs84
import com.system.location.service.core.location.LocationSample
import com.system.location.service.core.runtime.SampleStore
import com.system.location.service.core.runtime.SeqlockSampleStore
import java.util.concurrent.CountDownLatch
import java.util.concurrent.atomic.AtomicReference
import org.junit.Assert.assertEquals
import org.junit.Assert.assertNull
import org.junit.Assert.assertNotNull
import org.junit.Test

class SeqlockSampleStoreTest {
    private fun sample(sequence: Long): LocationSample {
        val coordinate = (sequence % 180L) - 90.0
        return LocationSample(
            Wgs84(coordinate, coordinate), 80.0, 5f, 1f, 0f, sequence, sequence,
        )
    }

    @Test fun publishesAndReadsLatest() {
        val store = SeqlockSampleStore()
        assertNull(store.latest(0))
        store.publish(sample(1), 100)
        val entry = store.latest(100)!!
        assertEquals(1L, entry.sequence)
        assertEquals(entry.sample.latitude, entry.sample.longitude, 0.0)
        assertEquals(2L, store.publish(sample(2), 200))
        assertEquals(2L, store.latest(200)!!.sequence)
    }

    @Test fun enforcesLeaseAndFutureSamples() {
        val store = SeqlockSampleStore()
        store.publish(sample(1), 100)
        assertNull(store.latest(99))
        assertNotNull(store.latest(100 + SampleStore.DEFAULT_MAX_AGE_NANOS))
        assertNull(store.latest(101 + SampleStore.DEFAULT_MAX_AGE_NANOS))
    }

    @Test fun concurrentReadersNeverSeeTornSample() {
        val store = SeqlockSampleStore()
        val failure = AtomicReference<String?>(null)
        val start = CountDownLatch(1)
        val reader = Thread {
            start.await()
            repeat(20_000) {
                val entry = store.latest(Long.MAX_VALUE) ?: return@repeat
                if (entry.sample.latitude != entry.sample.longitude) {
                    failure.set("torn sample at ${entry.sequence}")
                }
            }
        }
        reader.start()
        start.countDown()
        repeat(5_000) { store.publish(sample(it.toLong()), it.toLong()) }
        reader.join()
        assertNull(failure.get())
    }
}
```

`core/src/test/kotlin/com/system/location/service/core/SessionSequenceGateTest.kt`:

```kt
package com.system.location.service.core

import com.system.location.service.core.runtime.SessionSequenceGate
import java.util.concurrent.CountDownLatch
import java.util.concurrent.Executors
import java.util.concurrent.TimeUnit
import org.junit.Assert.*
import org.junit.Test

class SessionSequenceGateTest {
    @Test fun oldSessionsDuplicatesAndOlderStatesCannotRestore() {
        val gate = SessionSequenceGate()
        var value = 0
        fun restore(session: String, sequence: Long) = gate.apply(session, sequence) { value++; true }
        assertFalse(restore("a", 1))
        gate.reset("a")
        assertFalse(restore("a", 0))
        assertTrue(restore("a", 2))
        assertFalse(restore("a", 1))
        assertFalse(restore("a", 2))
        gate.reset("b")
        assertFalse(restore("a", 100))
        assertTrue(restore("b", 1))
        assertEquals(2, value)
    }

    @Test fun failedValidationDoesNotConsumeSequence() {
        val gate = SessionSequenceGate()
        gate.reset("a")
        assertFalse(gate.apply("a", 10) { false })
        assertThrows(IllegalStateException::class.java) { gate.apply("a", 10) { error("bad state") } }
        assertTrue(gate.apply("a", 10) { true })
    }

    @Test fun concurrentNewerStateCannotBeOverwrittenByDelayedOlderRestore() {
        val gate = SessionSequenceGate()
        gate.reset("a")
        val started = CountDownLatch(1)
        val release = CountDownLatch(1)
        val executor = Executors.newFixedThreadPool(2)
        var value = 0
        try {
            val first = executor.submit<Boolean> { gate.apply("a", 1) {
                started.countDown()
                check(release.await(5, TimeUnit.SECONDS))
                value = 1; true
            } }
            assertTrue(started.await(5, TimeUnit.SECONDS))
            val second = executor.submit<Boolean> { gate.apply("a", 2) { value = 2; true } }
            release.countDown()
            assertTrue(first.get(5, TimeUnit.SECONDS))
            assertTrue(second.get(5, TimeUnit.SECONDS))
            assertEquals(2, value)
            assertFalse(gate.apply("a", 1) { value = 1; true })
        } finally { release.countDown(); executor.shutdownNow() }
    }
}
```

```kt
        assertEquals("FULL_REPLAY", schema.defaultValue("cell_mode"))
        assertNull(schema.spec("gnss_model"))
        assertEquals("true", schema.defaultValue("enable_nmea"))
        assertNull(schema.defaultValue("missing"))
    }

    @Test fun validatesPrimitiveAndEnumValues() {
        assertNull(schema.validate("altitude", "120.5"))
        assertNotNull(schema.validate("altitude", "-1"))
        assertNull(schema.validate("environment_ap_count", "4"))
        assertNotNull(schema.validate("environment_ap_count", "0"))
        assertNull(schema.validate("enable_mock_wifi", "true"))

        assertNull(schema.validate("cell_mode", "AUTO"))

                SettingSpec("a", SettingType.INT, "2"),

        }

            SettingSpec("a", SettingType.ENUM, "X")
        }
        assertThrows(IllegalArgumentException::class.java) {
            SettingSpec("a", SettingType.ENUM, "B", choices = setOf("A"))
        }
    }
```

`core/src/test/kotlin/com/system/location/service/core/SharedSampleCodecTest.kt`:

```kt
package com.system.location.service.core

import com.system.location.service.core.geo.Wgs84
import com.system.location.service.core.location.LocationSample
import com.system.location.service.core.runtime.SharedSampleCodec
import org.junit.Assert.assertEquals
import org.junit.Assert.assertThrows
import org.junit.Test

class SharedSampleCodecTest {
    private val sample = LocationSample(
        Wgs84(31.2304, 121.4737), 80.5, 5.5f, 1.25f, 90f, 1_700_000_000_000L, 123_456L,
    )

    @Test fun roundTripPreservesFields() {
        val bytes = SharedSampleCodec.encode(sample)
        assertEquals(SharedSampleCodec.SLOT_BYTES, bytes.size)
        val decoded = SharedSampleCodec.decode(bytes)
        assertEquals(sample.latitude, decoded.latitude, 0.0)
        assertEquals(sample.longitude, decoded.longitude, 0.0)
        assertEquals(sample.altitude, decoded.altitude, 0.0)
        assertEquals(sample.accuracy, decoded.accuracy, 0f)
        assertEquals(sample.speed, decoded.speed, 0f)
        assertEquals(sample.bearing, decoded.bearing, 0f)
        assertEquals(sample.timeMillis, decoded.timeMillis)
        assertEquals(sample.elapsedNanos, decoded.elapsedNanos)
    }

    @Test fun crcAndMagicAreChecked() {
        val bytes = SharedSampleCodec.encode(sample)
        bytes[10] = (bytes[10] + 1).toByte()
        assertThrows(IllegalArgumentException::class.java) { SharedSampleCodec.decode(bytes) }

        val wrongMagic = SharedSampleCodec.encode(sample)
        wrongMagic[0] = 0
        assertThrows(IllegalArgumentException::class.java) { SharedSampleCodec.decode(wrongMagic) }
    }

    @Test fun badSizeVersionAndCoordinatesAreRejected() {
        assertThrows(IllegalArgumentException::class.java) { SharedSampleCodec.decode(ByteArray(10)) }

        val wrongVersion = SharedSampleCodec.encode(sample)
        wrongVersion[4] = 2
        assertThrows(IllegalArgumentException::class.java) { SharedSampleCodec.decode(wrongVersion) }

        val invalid = LocationSample(
            Wgs84(0.0, 0.0), 80.0, 5f, 1f, 0f, 0L, 0L,
        )
        val bytes = SharedSampleCodec.encode(invalid)
        // Corrupt latitude and recompute nothing: CRC check fires first.
        bytes[12] = (bytes[12] + 1).toByte()
        assertThrows(IllegalArgumentException::class.java) { SharedSampleCodec.decode(bytes) }
    }
}
```

`core/src/test/kotlin/com/system/location/service/core/SharedSampleHeaderTest.kt`:

```kt
package com.system.location.service.core

import com.system.location.service.core.runtime.SharedSampleHeader
import org.junit.Assert.assertEquals
import org.junit.Assert.assertThrows
import org.junit.Test

class SharedSampleHeaderTest {
    private val header = SharedSampleHeader(writeIndex = 1, sequence = 42, elapsedNanos = 123_456)

    @Test fun roundTripPreservesFields() {
        val bytes = header.encode()
        assertEquals(SharedSampleHeader.HEADER_BYTES, bytes.size)
        assertEquals(header, SharedSampleHeader.decode(bytes))
    }

    @Test fun crcMagicAndVersionAreChecked() {
        val corrupted = header.encode().also { it[10] = (it[10] + 1).toByte() }
        assertThrows(IllegalArgumentException::class.java) { SharedSampleHeader.decode(corrupted) }

        val wrongMagic = header.encode().also { it[0] = 0 }
        assertThrows(IllegalArgumentException::class.java) { SharedSampleHeader.decode(wrongMagic) }

        val wrongVersion = header.encode().also { it[4] = 2 }
        assertThrows(IllegalArgumentException::class.java) { SharedSampleHeader.decode(wrongVersion) }
    }

    @Test fun invalidFieldsAreRejected() {
        assertThrows(IllegalArgumentException::class.java) {
            SharedSampleHeader(writeIndex = 2, sequence = 1, elapsedNanos = 0)
        }
        assertThrows(IllegalArgumentException::class.java) {
            SharedSampleHeader(writeIndex = 0, sequence = 0, elapsedNanos = 0)
        }
        assertThrows(IllegalArgumentException::class.java) {
            SharedSampleHeader(writeIndex = 0, sequence = 1, elapsedNanos = -1)
        }
        assertThrows(IllegalArgumentException::class.java) { SharedSampleHeader.decode(ByteArray(4)) }
    }
}
```

```kt
package com.system.location.service.core

import com.system.location.service.core.geo.Wgs84
import com.system.location.service.core.location.LocationSample
import com.system.location.service.core.runtime.SharedSampleCodec
import com.system.location.service.core.runtime.SharedSampleHeader
import com.system.location.service.core.runtime.SharedSampleLayout
import org.junit.Assert.assertEquals
import org.junit.Assert.assertNull
import org.junit.Test

class SharedSampleLayoutTest {
    private val sample = LocationSample(Wgs84(31.0, 121.0), 80.0, 5f, 1f, 90f, 100L, 200L)

    @Test fun writesHeaderAndSlotContiguously() {
        val buffer = ByteArray(SharedSampleLayout.SIZE)
        val header = SharedSampleLayout.write(buffer, sample, sequence = 3, elapsedNanos = 200L)
        assertEquals(1, header.writeIndex)
        assertEquals(SharedSampleHeader.HEADER_BYTES + 2 * SharedSampleCodec.SLOT_BYTES, SharedSampleLayout.SIZE)
        val (decodedHeader, decodedSample) = SharedSampleLayout.read(buffer)!!
        assertEquals(header, decodedHeader)
        assertEquals(sample.latitude, decodedSample.latitude, 0.0)
        assertEquals(sample.elapsedNanos, decodedSample.elapsedNanos)
    }

    @Test fun rejectsWrongSizeAndCorruption() {
        assertNull(SharedSampleLayout.read(ByteArray(10)))

        val buffer = ByteArray(SharedSampleLayout.SIZE)
        SharedSampleLayout.write(buffer, sample, sequence = 2, elapsedNanos = 1L)
        buffer[SharedSampleHeader.HEADER_BYTES + 10] = (buffer[SharedSampleHeader.HEADER_BYTES + 10] + 1).toByte()
        assertNull(SharedSampleLayout.read(buffer))
    }
}
```

`core/src/test/kotlin/com/system/location/service/core/StackCleanPolicyTest.kt`:

```kt
package com.system.location.service.core.privacy

import org.junit.Assert.assertEquals
import org.junit.Assert.assertFalse
import org.junit.Assert.assertNotEquals
import org.junit.Assert.assertTrue
import org.junit.Test

/**
 * Work package 9: reproduce the observable artifacts of the two stack-clean strategies before
 * shipping either as an experiment.
 */
class StackCleanPolicyTest {
    private fun frame(cls: String, method: String = "call", line: Int = 10) =
        StackTraceElement(cls, method, "$cls.kt", line)

    private fun sample(): Array<StackTraceElement> = arrayOf(
        frame("com.example.detector.Main", "check"),
        // libxposed dispatch pair: module frame between two ordinary frames.
        frame("io.github.libxposed.api.XposedInterface", "handle"),
        frame("com.system.location.service.hook.privacy.StackTraceCleanHook", "clean"),
        frame("de.robv.android.xposed.XposedBridge", "invoke"),
        frame("android.hardware.SystemSensorManager\$SensorEventQueue", "dispatchSensorEvent"),
        frame("com.example.detector.SensorProbe", "onSensorChanged"),
    )

    private val moduleFrames = sample().count(StackCleanPolicy::isModuleFrame)

    @Test
    fun filterRemovesModuleFramesAndShortensTheArray() {
        val original = sample()
        val cleaned = StackCleanPolicy.filter(original)
        // The reproduction: the Java-reported array is now shorter than the native
        // getStackTraceDepth() count would still be, which is the documented detectable artifact.
        assertNotEquals(original.size, cleaned.size)
        assertEquals(original.size - moduleFrames, cleaned.size)
        cleaned.forEach { assertFalse(StackCleanPolicy.isModuleFrame(it)) }
    }

    @Test
    fun filterCollapsesOnlyExactConsecutiveDispatchDuplicates() {
        val duplicated = arrayOf(
            frame("com.example.detector.Main", "check"),
            frame("android.hardware.SystemSensorManager\$SensorEventQueue", "dispatchSensorEvent"),
            frame("android.hardware.SystemSensorManager\$SensorEventQueue", "dispatchSensorEvent"),
            frame("com.example.detector.SensorProbe", "onSensorChanged"),
        )
        val cleaned = StackCleanPolicy.filter(duplicated)
        assertEquals(duplicated.size - 1, cleaned.size)
        // Non-consecutive duplicates of other methods must survive: never generic recursion collapse.
        val spread = arrayOf(
            frame("com.example.detector.Main", "check"),
            frame("com.example.detector.Middle", "run"),
            frame("com.example.detector.Main", "check"),
        )
        assertEquals(spread.size, StackCleanPolicy.filter(spread).size)
    }

    @Test
    fun replaceKeepsArrayLengthIdenticalToTheNativeDepth() {
        val original = sample()
        val cleaned = StackCleanPolicy.replace(original)
        // Length parity: the cheapest consistency check (array length vs getStackTraceDepth)
        // now agrees, at the cost of a synthetic neutral frame.
        assertEquals(original.size, cleaned.size)
        cleaned.forEachIndexed { index, frame ->
            if (StackCleanPolicy.isModuleFrame(original[index])) {
                assertEquals(StackCleanPolicy.NEUTRAL_CLASS, frame.className)
                assertEquals(StackCleanPolicy.NEUTRAL_METHOD, frame.methodName)
            } else {
                assertEquals(original[index], frame)
            }
        }
    }

    @Test
    fun replaceReportsNoModuleFramesAfterCleaning() {
        val cleaned = StackCleanPolicy.replace(sample())
        cleaned.forEach { assertFalse(StackCleanPolicy.isModuleFrame(it)) }
    }

    @Test
    fun hasModuleFramesAllowsIdentityFastPath() {
        val clean = arrayOf(frame("com.example.detector.Main"), frame("android.os.Looper", "loop"))
        assertFalse(StackCleanPolicy.hasModuleFrames(clean))
        assertTrue(StackCleanPolicy.hasModuleFrames(sample()))
    }

    @Test
    fun emptyAndSingleElementArraysAreSafe() {
        val empty = arrayOf<StackTraceElement>()
        assertEquals(0, StackCleanPolicy.filter(empty).size)
        assertEquals(0, StackCleanPolicy.replace(empty).size)
        val single = arrayOf(frame("com.system.location.service.hook.FakeLoc", "config"))
        assertEquals(0, StackCleanPolicy.filter(single).size)
        assertEquals(1, StackCleanPolicy.replace(single).size)
    }
}
```

```kt
            val burst = StartupBurst("a", 1)

        }
```

`core/src/test/kotlin/com/system/location/service/core/VirtualWalkerOrbitProviderTest.kt`:

```kt
package com.system.location.service.core

import com.system.location.service.core.geo.Wgs84
import com.system.location.service.core.gnss.*
import kotlin.math.*
import org.junit.Assert.*
import org.junit.Test

class VirtualWalkerOrbitProviderTest {
    private val resource = VirtualWalkerResource(revision = "test-1", referenceEpochMillis = 1000,
        groups = listOf(VirtualWalkerGroup(Constellation.GPS, (1..24).toList(), 6, 1, 26_560_000.0, 0.95)))
    private val request = GnssSkyRequest(1_000_000, Wgs84(31.0, 121.0), 10.0)

    @Test fun resourceTopologyControlsCountAndAllIdentitiesRemainExplicitlyVirtual() {
        val batch = VirtualWalkerOrbitProvider(resource, 123).positions(request)
        assertEquals(24, batch.positions.size)
        assertTrue(batch.diagnostics.isNotEmpty())
        for (position in batch.positions) {
            assertEquals(GnssOrbitSourceKind.VIRTUAL, position.provenance.kind)
            assertFalse(position.hasEphemeris)
            assertFalse(position.hasAlmanac)
            val p = position.position
            assertEquals(26_560_000.0, sqrt(p.xMeters.pow(2) + p.yMeters.pow(2) + p.zMeters.pow(2)), 1e-6)
        }
        val smaller = resource.copy(groups = listOf(resource.groups.single().copy(svids = (1..12).toList())))
        assertEquals(12, VirtualWalkerOrbitProvider(smaller, 123).positions(request).positions.size)
    }

    @Test fun restartSameSeedReproducesSkyAndAdjacentEpochsPreserveIdentityAndContinuity() {
        val provider = VirtualWalkerOrbitProvider(resource, 123)
        val before = provider.positions(request).positions
        val restarted = VirtualWalkerOrbitProvider(resource, 123).positions(request).positions
        assertEquals(before.map { it.copy(simulatedNavigation = null) }, restarted.map { it.copy(simulatedNavigation = null) })
        assertNotEquals(before, VirtualWalkerOrbitProvider(resource, 124).positions(request).positions)
        val after = provider.positions(request.copy(atMillis = request.atMillis + 1000)).positions
        before.zip(after).forEach { (a, b) ->
            assertEquals(b.position, requireNotNull(a.simulatedNavigation).positionAt(request.copy(atMillis = request.atMillis + 1000)))
            assertEquals(0.0, a.simulatedNavigation!!.clock.offsetAt(request.atMillis), 0.0)
            assertEquals(a.constellation to a.svid, b.constellation to b.svid)
            val distance = sqrt((a.position.xMeters - b.position.xMeters).pow(2) +
                (a.position.yMeters - b.position.yMeters).pow(2) + (a.position.zMeters - b.position.zMeters).pow(2))
            assertTrue(distance in 1.0..6000.0)
        }
    }

    @Test fun targetProjectionChangesSkyAndFinitePoolDoesNotClaimArbitraryCapacity() {
        val positions = VirtualWalkerOrbitProvider(resource, 123).positions(request).positions
        fun visible(observer: Wgs84) = positions.filter {
            GnssObserverGeometry.lineOfSight(observer, 10.0, it.position)!!.aboveHorizon
        }.map { it.svid }.toSet()
        val local = visible(request.observer)
        val remote = visible(Wgs84(-31.0, -59.0))
        assertTrue(local.isNotEmpty() && remote.isNotEmpty())
        assertNotEquals(local, remote)
        assertTrue(local.size < positions.size)
    }

    @Test fun rejectsUnsupportedIdentitiesAndMalformedTopology() {
        assertThrows(IllegalArgumentException::class.java) { resource.groups.single().copy(svids = listOf(33)) }
        assertThrows(IllegalArgumentException::class.java) { resource.groups.single().copy(planes = 5) }
        assertThrows(IllegalArgumentException::class.java) { resource.copy(groups = resource.groups + resource.groups) }
    }
}
```

`core/src/test/kotlin/com/system/location/service/core/WifiFingerprintDbTest.kt`:

```kt
package com.system.location.service.core

import com.system.location.service.core.environment.WifiFingerprint
import com.system.location.service.core.environment.WifiFingerprintDb
import com.system.location.service.core.environment.WifiObservation
import com.system.location.service.core.geo.Wgs84
import org.junit.Assert.assertEquals
import org.junit.Assert.assertNull
import org.junit.Assert.assertThrows
import org.junit.Test

class WifiFingerprintDbTest {
    private val a = WifiFingerprint("AA:BB:CC:DD:EE:01", Wgs84(31.2300, 121.4700), -50, 1_000)
    private val b = WifiFingerprint("AA:BB:CC:DD:EE:02", Wgs84(31.2310, 121.4720), -70, 1_000)

    @Test fun exactMatchReturnsStoredPosition() {
        val result = WifiFingerprintDb(listOf(a)).query(listOf(WifiObservation(a.bssid, -50)), 2_000)
        assertEquals(a.position.latitude, result!!.latitude, 0.000001)
        assertEquals(a.position.longitude, result.longitude, 0.000001)
    }

    @Test fun unknownObservationsReturnNull() {
        assertNull(WifiFingerprintDb(listOf(a)).query(listOf(WifiObservation("AA:BB:CC:DD:EE:03", -60)), 2_000))
        assertNull(WifiFingerprintDb().query(emptyList(), 2_000))
    }

    @Test fun staleFingerprintIsIgnored() {
        val now = a.observedAtMillis + WifiFingerprintDb.DEFAULT_MAX_AGE_MILLIS + 1
        assertNull(WifiFingerprintDb(listOf(a)).query(listOf(WifiObservation(a.bssid, -50)), now))
    }

    @Test fun twoMatchesAreWeightedTowardCloserRssi() {
        val result = WifiFingerprintDb(listOf(a, b)).query(
            listOf(WifiObservation(a.bssid, -50), WifiObservation(b.bssid, -85)),
            2_000,
        )!!
        assertEquals(a.position.latitude, result.latitude, 0.0005)
        assertEquals(a.position.longitude, result.longitude, 0.001)
    }

    @Test fun addAndRemoveAreImmutableAndCaseInsensitive() {
        val original = WifiFingerprintDb()
        val added = original.add(a)
        assertEquals(1, added.entries.size)
        assertEquals(0, original.entries.size)
        assertEquals(0, added.remove("aa:bb:cc:dd:ee:01").entries.size)
    }

    @Test fun invalidObservationsAreRejected() {
        assertThrows(IllegalArgumentException::class.java) { WifiObservation("bad", -50) }
        assertThrows(IllegalArgumentException::class.java) { WifiObservation(a.bssid, 10) }
        assertThrows(IllegalArgumentException::class.java) { a.copy(observedAtMillis = -1) }
    }
}
```

`core/src/test/kotlin/com/system/location/service/core/WifiFingerprintImportTest.kt`:

```kt
package com.system.location.service.core

import com.system.location.service.core.environment.WifiFingerprint
import com.system.location.service.core.environment.WifiFingerprintCatalog
import com.system.location.service.core.environment.WifiFingerprintImportException
import com.system.location.service.core.environment.WifiFingerprintImporter
import com.system.location.service.core.geo.Wgs84
import org.junit.Assert.assertEquals
import org.junit.Assert.assertFalse
import org.junit.Assert.assertThrows
import org.junit.Assert.assertTrue
import org.junit.Test

class WifiFingerprintImportTest {
    private val fingerprint = WifiFingerprint("AA:BB:CC:DD:EE:01", Wgs84(31.23, 121.47), -55, 1_000)

    @Test fun catalogDefaultsToDisabled() {
        assertFalse(WifiFingerprintCatalog().enabled)
        assertEquals(1, WifiFingerprintCatalog.SCHEMA_VERSION)
    }

    @Test fun enabledCatalogRequiresLicenseAndAttribution() {
        assertThrows(IllegalArgumentException::class.java) {
            WifiFingerprintCatalog(enabled = true, source = "wigle", license = "", attribution = "WigLE")
        }
        assertThrows(IllegalArgumentException::class.java) {
            WifiFingerprintCatalog(enabled = true, source = "wigle", license = "CC-BY", attribution = "")
        }
        assertTrue(
            WifiFingerprintCatalog(enabled = true, source = "wigle", license = "CC-BY", attribution = "WigLE").enabled,
        )
    }

    @Test fun jsonRoundTripsWithAttribution() {
        val catalog = WifiFingerprintCatalog(
            source = "wigle",
            license = "CC-BY-4.0",
            attribution = "WigLE",
            entries = listOf(fingerprint),
        )
        val decoded = WifiFingerprintImporter.importJson(WifiFingerprintImporter.encodeJson(catalog)).catalog
        assertEquals(catalog, decoded)
        assertEquals(1, decoded.database().entries.size)
    }

    @Test fun csvImportsAndSkipsBadRows() {
        val csv = """
            bssid,latitude,longitude,rssi,observedAtMillis
            AA:BB:CC:DD:EE:01,31.23,121.47,-55,1000
            bad-row
            AA:BB:CC:DD:EE:02,31.24,121.48,-60,1000
        """.trimIndent()
        val result = WifiFingerprintImporter.importCsv(csv, "self", "CC0", "self-captured")
        assertEquals(2, result.imported)
        assertEquals(1, result.skipped)
        assertFalse(result.catalog.enabled)
        assertEquals(2, result.catalog.database().entries.size)
    }

    @Test fun csvRequiresMetadataAndValidRows() {
        assertThrows(IllegalArgumentException::class.java) {
            WifiFingerprintImporter.importCsv("AA:BB:CC:DD:EE:01,31.23,121.47,-55,1000", "", "CC0", "self")
        }
        assertThrows(WifiFingerprintImportException::class.java) {
            WifiFingerprintImporter.importCsv("bad\nworse", "self", "CC0", "self")
        }
    }

    @Test fun invalidJsonIsRejected() {
        assertThrows(WifiFingerprintImportException::class.java) {
            WifiFingerprintImporter.importJson("not-json")
        }
        assertThrows(WifiFingerprintImportException::class.java) {
            WifiFingerprintImporter.importJson("""{"schemaVersion":99}""")
        }
    }

    @Test fun oversizedCatalogIsRejectedOnImportAndExport() {
        assertThrows(WifiFingerprintImportException::class.java) {
            WifiFingerprintImporter.importJson(" ".repeat(WifiFingerprintImporter.MAX_CATALOG_BYTES + 1))
        }
        val oversized = WifiFingerprintCatalog(source = "x".repeat(WifiFingerprintImporter.MAX_CATALOG_BYTES))
        assertThrows(IllegalArgumentException::class.java) { WifiFingerprintImporter.encodeJson(oversized) }
    }
}
```
