```kt
 * The detector never uploads a report; JSON leaves the device only when the user exports or copies
 * it. Checks are blocking Binder/API reads, so the whole run happens on one worker thread.
 */
class MainActivity : Activity() {

    private lateinit var toolbar: Toolbar
    private lateinit var summaryView: TextView
    private lateinit var deviceInfoView: TextView
    private lateinit var runButton: Button
    private lateinit var exportButton: Button
    private lateinit var copyButton: Button
    private lateinit var progress: ProgressBar
    private lateinit var progressText: TextView
    private lateinit var resultsContainer: LinearLayout
    private lateinit var settings: DetectorSettings
    private var lastReportJson: String? = null
    private var lastReport: DetectorReport? = null
    private lateinit var saveReferenceButton: Button
    private lateinit var clearReferenceButton: Button
    private lateinit var referenceStatus: TextView
    private val referenceWorker = Executors.newSingleThreadExecutor()
    private var referenceBusy = false

    @Volatile private var running = false
    @Volatile private var destroyed = false

    override fun onCreate(savedInstanceState: Bundle?) {
        super.onCreate(savedInstanceState)
        setContentView(R.layout.activity_main)
        toolbar = findViewById(R.id.toolbar)
        summaryView = findViewById(R.id.summary)
        deviceInfoView = findViewById(R.id.deviceInfo)
        runButton = findViewById(R.id.runButton)
        exportButton = findViewById(R.id.exportButton)
        copyButton = findViewById(R.id.copyButton)
        progress = findViewById(R.id.progress)
        progressText = findViewById(R.id.progressText)
        resultsContainer = findViewById(R.id.resultsContainer)
        settings = DetectorSettings.get(this)
        saveReferenceButton = findViewById(R.id.saveReferenceButton)
        clearReferenceButton = findViewById(R.id.clearReferenceButton)
        referenceStatus = findViewById(R.id.referenceStatus)
        saveReferenceButton.setOnClickListener { chooseReference() }
        clearReferenceButton.setOnClickListener {
            referenceTask { GnssReferenceStore.clear(applicationContext); getString(R.string.reference_cleared) }
        }

        toolbar.title = getString(R.string.app_name)
        runButton.setOnClickListener { runChecks() }
        exportButton.setOnClickListener { exportJson() }
        copyButton.setOnClickListener { copyJson() }
        findViewById<Button>(R.id.settingsButton).setOnClickListener {
            startActivity(Intent(this, SettingsActivity::class.java))
        }
        deviceInfoView.text = deviceLine()
        referenceTask { null }
        ensurePermissions()
    }

    override fun onResume() {
        super.onResume()
        settings = DetectorSettings.get(this)
        deviceInfoView.text = deviceLine()
    }

    override fun onDestroy() {
        destroyed = true
        referenceWorker.shutdown()
        super.onDestroy()
    }

    private fun runChecks() {
        if (running || referenceBusy) return
        running = true
        val startedAt = System.currentTimeMillis()
        val runSettings = settings
        val appContext = applicationContext

        runButton.isEnabled = false
        exportButton.isEnabled = false
        copyButton.isEnabled = false
        updateReferenceButtons()
        progress.visibility = View.VISIBLE
        progress.progress = 0
        progressText.visibility = View.VISIBLE
        progressText.text = getString(R.string.progress_preparing)
        resultsContainer.removeAllViews()

        Thread({
            val report = DetectorRunner.run(appContext, runSettings)
            runOnUiThread {
                if (destroyed) return@runOnUiThread
                if (report != null) {
                    finishRun(report, startedAt)
                } else {
                    running = false
                    updateReferenceButtons()
                    runButton.isEnabled = true
                    exportButton.isEnabled = lastReportJson != null
                    copyButton.isEnabled = lastReportJson != null
                    progress.visibility = View.GONE
                    progressText.visibility = View.GONE
                }
            }
        }, "detector-run").start()
    }

    private fun finishRun(report: DetectorReport, startedAt: Long) {
        lastReportJson = DetectorRunner.lastReportJson
        lastReport = report
        render(report)
        progress.visibility = View.GONE
        progressText.text = getString(
            R.string.progress_done,
            ((System.currentTimeMillis() - startedAt) / 1_000L).toInt(),
        )
        runButton.isEnabled = true
        exportButton.isEnabled = true
        copyButton.isEnabled = true
        running = false
        updateReferenceButtons()
    }

    private fun updateReferenceButtons() {
        saveReferenceButton.isEnabled = !running && !referenceBusy && lastReport?.gnssEvidence != null
        clearReferenceButton.isEnabled = !running && !referenceBusy
    }

    private fun chooseReference() {
        val report = lastReport ?: return
        val evidence = report.gnssEvidence ?: return
        val environment = EditText(this).apply {
            hint = getString(R.string.reference_environment)
            isSingleLine = true
            filters = arrayOf(android.text.InputFilter.LengthFilter(120))
        }
        val dialog = AlertDialog.Builder(this)
            .setTitle(R.string.reference_save)
            .setMessage(R.string.reference_confirm)
            .setView(environment)
            .setNegativeButton(android.R.string.cancel, null)
            .setPositiveButton(R.string.reference_save, null)
            .create()
        dialog.setOnShowListener {
            dialog.getButton(AlertDialog.BUTTON_POSITIVE).setOnClickListener {
                val label = environment.text.toString().trim()
                if (label.isEmpty()) {
                    environment.error = getString(R.string.reference_environment)
                    return@setOnClickListener
                }
                val reference = GnssReference(Build.FINGERPRINT, label, System.currentTimeMillis(), evidence)
                dialog.dismiss()
                referenceTask {
                    GnssReferenceStore.save(applicationContext, reference)
                    getString(R.string.reference_saved)
                }
            }
        }
        dialog.show()
    }

    /** File reads, validation and atomic writes all run away from the UI thread. */
    private fun referenceTask(action: () -> String?) {
        if (referenceBusy || destroyed) return
        referenceBusy = true
        runButton.isEnabled = false
        updateReferenceButtons()
        referenceWorker.execute {
            val outcome = runCatching {
                val message = action()
                val loaded = GnssReferenceStore.load(applicationContext)
                val reference = loaded.reference
                val status = if (reference == null) loaded.note else {
                    val time = SimpleDateFormat("yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss", Locale.US).format(Date(reference.savedAtMillis))
                    getString(R.string.reference_status, time, reference.environment)
                }
                status to message
            }
            runOnUiThread {
                if (destroyed) return@runOnUiThread
                referenceBusy = false
                runButton.isEnabled = !running
                updateReferenceButtons()
                outcome.onSuccess { (status, message) ->
                    referenceStatus.text = status
                    if (message != null) Toast.makeText(this, message, Toast.LENGTH_LONG).show()
                }.onFailure {
                    Toast.makeText(this, getString(R.string.reference_failed,
                        it.message ?: it.javaClass.simpleName), Toast.LENGTH_LONG).show()
                }
            }
        }
    }

    private fun render(report: DetectorReport) {
        summaryView.text = getString(R.string.summary_counts, report.passCount, report.failCount, report.unknownCount)
        resultsContainer.removeAllViews()
        listOf(CheckStatus.FAIL, CheckStatus.UNKNOWN, CheckStatus.PASS).forEach { status ->
            val items = report.checks.filter { it.status == status }
            if (items.isEmpty()) return@forEach
            resultsContainer.addView(sectionHeader(status, items.size))
            items.forEach { result -> resultsContainer.addView(resultView(result)) }
        }
    }

    private fun sectionHeader(status: CheckStatus, count: Int): TextView = TextView(this).apply {
        text = "${status.name} · $count"
        setPadding(0, 16, 0, 8)
        setTextColor(statusColor(status))
        textSize = 14f
        setTypeface(typeface, Typeface.BOLD)
    }

    private fun resultView(result: CheckResult): View {
        val item = layoutInflater.inflate(R.layout.item_check, resultsContainer, false)
        item.findViewById<TextView>(R.id.checkId).text = result.id
        item.findViewById<TextView>(R.id.status).apply {
            text = result.status.name
            setTextColor(statusColor(result.status))
        }
        item.findViewById<TextView>(R.id.title).text =
            if (result.blocking) "${result.title} · 阻断级" else result.title
        item.findViewById<TextView>(R.id.detail).text = result.detail
        val evidenceView = item.findViewById<TextView>(R.id.evidence)
        val hint = item.findViewById<TextView>(R.id.hint)
        val evidence = result.evidence.joinToString("\n").trim()
        evidenceView.text = evidence
        evidenceView.visibility = View.GONE
        hint.visibility = if (evidence.isEmpty()) View.GONE else View.VISIBLE
        item.setOnClickListener {
            if (evidence.isEmpty()) return@setOnClickListener
            val showing = evidenceView.visibility == View.VISIBLE
            evidenceView.visibility = if (showing) View.GONE else View.VISIBLE
            hint.text = if (showing) getString(R.string.detail_hint) else ""
        }
        return item
    }

    private fun statusColor(status: CheckStatus): Int = getColor(
        when (status) {
            CheckStatus.PASS -> R.color.detector_pass
            CheckStatus.FAIL -> R.color.detector_fail
            CheckStatus.UNKNOWN -> R.color.detector_unknown
        },
    )

    private fun exportJson() {
        val json = lastReportJson
        if (json == null) {
            Toast.makeText(this, R.string.export_empty, Toast.LENGTH_SHORT).show()
            return
        }
        val stamp = SimpleDateFormat("yyyyMMdd-HHmmss", Locale.US).format(Date())
        val intent = Intent(Intent.ACTION_CREATE_DOCUMENT).apply {
            addCategory(Intent.CATEGORY_OPENABLE)
            type = "application/json"
            putExtra(Intent.EXTRA_TITLE, "detector-$stamp.json")
        }
        runCatching { startActivityForResult(intent, REQUEST_EXPORT) }.onFailure { error ->
            Toast.makeText(
                this,
                getString(R.string.export_failed, error.message ?: error.javaClass.simpleName),
                Toast.LENGTH_LONG,
            ).show()
        }
    }

    @Deprecated("Platform document picker result")
    override fun onActivityResult(requestCode: Int, resultCode: Int, data: Intent?) {
        super.onActivityResult(requestCode, resultCode, data)
        if (requestCode != REQUEST_EXPORT || resultCode != RESULT_OK) return
        val uri = data?.data ?: return
        val json = lastReportJson ?: return
        runCatching {
            contentResolver.openOutputStream(uri)?.use { stream -> stream.write(json.toByteArray(Charsets.UTF_8)) }
                ?: error("无法打开目标文件")
        }.onSuccess {
            Toast.makeText(this, getString(R.string.export_saved, uri.toString()), Toast.LENGTH_LONG).show()
        }.onFailure { error ->
            Toast.makeText(
                this,
                getString(R.string.export_failed, error.message ?: error.javaClass.simpleName),
                Toast.LENGTH_LONG,
            ).show()
        }
    }

    private fun copyJson() {
        val json = lastReportJson
        if (json == null) {
            Toast.makeText(this, R.string.export_empty, Toast.LENGTH_SHORT).show()
            return
        }
        val clipboard = getSystemService(ClipboardManager::class.java)
        clipboard?.setPrimaryClip(ClipData.newPlainText("Portal Detector", json))
        Toast.makeText(this, R.string.copy_done, Toast.LENGTH_SHORT).show()
    }

    private fun deviceLine(): String {
        val device = DeviceInfoCollector.collect(this)
        return "${device.manufacturer} ${device.model} · Android ${device.android} (SDK ${device.sdk}) · " +
            (device.abis.firstOrNull() ?: "?")
    }

    private fun ensurePermissions() {
        val required = buildList {
            add(android.Manifest.permission.ACCESS_FINE_LOCATION)
            add(android.Manifest.permission.ACCESS_COARSE_LOCATION)
            add(android.Manifest.permission.READ_PHONE_STATE)
            add(android.Manifest.permission.ACTIVITY_RECOGNITION)
            if (Build.VERSION.SDK_INT >= Build.VERSION_CODES.TIRAMISU) {
                add(android.Manifest.permission.NEARBY_WIFI_DEVICES)
            }
        }
        val missing = required.filter { checkSelfPermission(it) != PackageManager.PERMISSION_GRANTED }
        if (missing.isNotEmpty()) requestPermissions(missing.toTypedArray(), REQUEST_PERMISSIONS)
    }

    override fun onRequestPermissionsResult(
        requestCode: Int,
        permissions: Array<out String>,
        grantResults: IntArray,
    ) {
        super.onRequestPermissionsResult(requestCode, permissions, grantResults)
        if (requestCode == REQUEST_PERMISSIONS && grantResults.any { it != PackageManager.PERMISSION_GRANTED }) {
            Toast.makeText(this, R.string.permission_needed, Toast.LENGTH_LONG).show()
        }
    }

    private companion object {
        const val REQUEST_PERMISSIONS = 1001
        const val REQUEST_EXPORT = 1002
    }
}
```

```kt
package com.system.location.service.detector

import android.app.Activity
import android.os.Bundle
import android.widget.Button
import android.widget.EditText
import android.widget.Switch
import android.widget.Toast
import android.widget.Toolbar

class SettingsActivity : Activity() {

    private lateinit var targetPackage: EditText
    private lateinit var sampleSeconds: EditText
    private lateinit var testGms: Switch
    private lateinit var checkNetworkIp: Switch
    private lateinit var readInstalledApps: Switch

    override fun onCreate(savedInstanceState: Bundle?) {
        super.onCreate(savedInstanceState)
        setContentView(R.layout.activity_settings)

        val toolbar = findViewById<Toolbar>(R.id.toolbar)
        toolbar.title = getString(R.string.settings_title)
        toolbar.setNavigationIcon(R.drawable.ic_arrow_back)
        toolbar.setNavigationOnClickListener { finish() }

        targetPackage = findViewById(R.id.targetPackage)
        sampleSeconds = findViewById(R.id.sampleSeconds)
        testGms = findViewById(R.id.testGms)
        checkNetworkIp = findViewById(R.id.checkNetworkIp)
        readInstalledApps = findViewById(R.id.readInstalledApps)

        val settings = DetectorSettings.get(this)
        targetPackage.setText(settings.targetPackage)
        sampleSeconds.setText(settings.sampleSeconds.toString())
        testGms.isChecked = settings.testGms
        checkNetworkIp.isChecked = settings.checkNetworkIp
        readInstalledApps.isChecked = settings.readInstalledApps

        findViewById<Button>(R.id.saveButton).setOnClickListener { save(settings) }
    }

    private fun save(settings: DetectorSettings) {
        val packageName = targetPackage.text?.toString()?.trim().orEmpty()
        if (packageName.isEmpty()) {
            targetPackage.error = getString(R.string.settings_invalid_package)
            return
        }
        val seconds = sampleSeconds.text?.toString()?.toIntOrNull()
        if (seconds == null || seconds !in DetectorSettings.MIN_SAMPLE_SECONDS..DetectorSettings.MAX_SAMPLE_SECONDS) {
            sampleSeconds.error = getString(R.string.settings_invalid_sample)
            return
        }
        settings.targetPackage = packageName
        settings.sampleSeconds = seconds
        settings.testGms = testGms.isChecked
        settings.checkNetworkIp = checkNetworkIp.isChecked
        settings.readInstalledApps = readInstalledApps.isChecked
        Toast.makeText(this, R.string.settings_saved, Toast.LENGTH_SHORT).show()
        finish()
    }
}
```

`detector/src/main/java/com/system/location/service/detector/checks/CellChecks.kt`:

```kt
package com.system.location.service.detector.checks

import android.annotation.SuppressLint
import android.Manifest
import android.content.pm.PackageManager
import android.telephony.CellIdentityNr
import android.telephony.CellInfo
import android.telephony.CellInfoCdma
import android.telephony.CellInfoGsm
import android.telephony.CellInfoLte
import android.telephony.CellInfoNr
import android.telephony.CellInfoWcdma
import android.telephony.SignalStrength
import android.telephony.TelephonyManager
import com.system.location.service.detector.model.Check
import com.system.location.service.detector.model.CheckContext
import com.system.location.service.detector.model.CheckIds
import com.system.location.service.detector.model.CheckResult

/**
 * C09 · 蜂窝/SIM/运营商/信号。
 *
 * 期望：CellInfo、SIM operator、network operator、phone type、signal、service state 自洽；
 * 不能出现 CDMA phone type + GSM/LTE SIM、或 SIM 可用但小区为空。
 */
@SuppressLint("MissingPermission")
class CellCheck : Check {
    override val id = CheckIds.CELL
    override val title = "蜂窝/SIM/运营商"
    override val blocking = true

    override fun run(context: CheckContext): CheckResult {
        val evidence = mutableListOf<String>()
        val telephony = context.context.getSystemService(TelephonyManager::class.java)
        if (telephony == null) {
            evidence += "TelephonyManager 不可用"
            return unknown("设备未提供 TelephonyManager，无法读取蜂窝信息。", evidence)
        }

        val securityFailures = mutableListOf<String>()
        val readIssues = mutableListOf<String>()

        fun <T> read(label: String, block: () -> T?): T? = try {
            block()
        } catch (error: SecurityException) {
            securityFailures += label
            null
        } catch (error: Exception) {
            readIssues += "$label=${error.javaClass.simpleName}"
            null
        }

        val phoneType = read("phoneType") { telephony.phoneType }
        val simState = read("simState") { telephony.simState }
        val simOperator = read("simOperator") { telephony.simOperator }.orEmpty().trim()
        val simOperatorName = read("simOperatorName") { telephony.simOperatorName }.orEmpty().trim()
        val networkOperator = read("networkOperator") { telephony.networkOperator }.orEmpty().trim()
        val networkOperatorName = read("networkOperatorName") { telephony.networkOperatorName }.orEmpty().trim()
        val dataNetworkType = read("dataNetworkType") { telephony.dataNetworkType }
        val voiceNetworkType = read("voiceNetworkType") { telephony.voiceNetworkType }
        val signalStrength = read("signalStrength") { telephony.signalStrength }

        var cells = context.snapshot.cellInfo
        var cellSource = "snapshot"
        var cellsUnreadable = false
        if (cells.isEmpty()) {
            val live = read("allCellInfo") { telephony.allCellInfo }
            when {
                live != null -> {
                    cells = live
                    cellSource = "实时查询"
                }
                securityFailures.contains("allCellInfo") -> {
                    cellsUnreadable = true
                    cellSource = "实时查询失败（权限）"
                }
                readIssues.any { it.startsWith("allCellInfo=") } -> {
                    cellsUnreadable = true
                    cellSource = "实时查询失败"
                }
                else -> {
                    cellsUnreadable = true
                    cellSource = "实时查询返回 null"
                }
            }
        }

        val simPresent = simState == TelephonyManager.SIM_STATE_READY || simOperator.isNotEmpty()
        val emptyCells = cells.count { isEmptyCell(it) }
        val validCells = cells.size - emptyCells
        val registeredCells = cells.count { it.isRegistered }
        val types = cells.map(::cellType)
        val hasCdma = types.any { it == "CDMA" }
        val hasLteOrNr = types.any { it == "LTE" || it == "NR" }
        val hasGsmFamily = types.any { it == "GSM" || it == "WCDMA" }
        val hasService = hasCellularService(networkOperator, dataNetworkType, voiceNetworkType)

        evidence += "phoneType=${phoneTypeName(phoneType)}"
        evidence += "simState=${simStateName(simState)}"
        evidence += "SIM：operator=${orEmptyMarker(simOperator)} name=${nameMarker(simOperatorName)}"
        evidence += "网络：operator=${orEmptyMarker(networkOperator)} name=${nameMarker(networkOperatorName)}"
        evidence += "网络类型：data=${networkTypeName(dataNetworkType)} voice=${networkTypeName(voiceNetworkType)}"
        evidence += "CellInfo：${cells.size} 个（来源：$cellSource），registered=$registeredCells"
        evidence += "类型直方图：${histogram(cells)}"
        evidence += "有效小区=$validCells，空标识小区=$emptyCells"
        evidence += "signal：${signalSummary(signalStrength)}"
        evidence += "权限：READ_PHONE_STATE=${permissionState(context, Manifest.permission.READ_PHONE_STATE)} " +
            "ACCESS_FINE_LOCATION=${permissionState(context, Manifest.permission.ACCESS_FINE_LOCATION)}"
        if (securityFailures.isNotEmpty()) evidence += "SecurityException：${securityFailures.joinToString()}"
        if (readIssues.isNotEmpty()) evidence += "读取失败：${readIssues.joinToString()}"

        val failures = mutableListOf<String>()
        if (simPresent) {
            if (!cellsUnreadable && validCells == 0 && hasService) {
                failures += "有 SIM 但 CellInfo 为空或仅空标识（Portal 当前空 CDMA 小区）"
            }
            if (phoneType == TelephonyManager.PHONE_TYPE_CDMA) {
                if (dataNetworkType != null && dataNetworkType in GSM_FAMILY_NETWORK_TYPES) {
                    failures += "phoneType=CDMA 但 dataNetworkType=${networkTypeName(dataNetworkType)}，与 GSM/LTE/NR 矛盾"
                }
                if (isClearlyGsmSimOperator(simOperator)) {
                    failures += "phoneType=CDMA 但 simOperator=$simOperator 明显是 GSM/LTE 运营商"
                }
            }
            if (phoneType == TelephonyManager.PHONE_TYPE_GSM && hasCdma) {
                failures += "phoneType=GSM 但 CellInfo 含 CDMA 小区"
            }
            if (phoneType == TelephonyManager.PHONE_TYPE_CDMA && hasGsmFamily) {
                failures += "phoneType=CDMA 但 CellInfo 含 GSM/WCDMA/TD-SCDMA 小区"
            }
            if (hasCdma && hasLteOrNr) {
                failures += "CellInfo 同时含 CDMA 与 LTE/NR 小区，自相矛盾"
            }
            if (validCells > 0) {
                val missing = buildList {
                    if (networkOperator.isEmpty()) add("networkOperator")
                    if (simOperator.isEmpty()) add("simOperator")
                }
                if (missing.isNotEmpty()) {
                    failures += "有 $validCells 个有效小区但 ${missing.joinToString("/")} 为空，信息不完整"
                }
            }
        }

        val coreReadIssue = readIssues.any { issue ->
            CORE_READ_LABELS.any { label -> issue.startsWith("$label=") }
        }

        if (failures.isNotEmpty()) {
            return fail(failures.joinToString("；"), evidence.clipped())
        }
        if (securityFailures.isNotEmpty()) {
            return unknown(
                "读取 Telephony 被 SecurityException 拒绝（${securityFailures.joinToString()}）；" +
                    "请检查 READ_PHONE_STATE 与 ACCESS_FINE_LOCATION。",
                evidence.clipped(),
            )
        }
        if (cellsUnreadable || coreReadIssue) {
            return unknown(
                "读取 Telephony 失败（${readIssues.joinToString().ifEmpty { cellSource }}），无法完成蜂窝一致性判定。",
                evidence.clipped(),
            )
        }
        if (!simPresent) {
            return unknown(
                "未检测到可用 SIM（simState=${simStateName(simState)}，simOperator=${orEmptyMarker(simOperator)}）；" +
                    "无 SIM 设备不应据此判 FAIL。",
                evidence.clipped(),
            )
        }
        if (validCells == 0) {
            return unknown(
                "有 SIM 但无小区且无服务迹象（networkOperator=${orEmptyMarker(networkOperator)}），无法判定空小区。",
                evidence.clipped(),
            )
        }
        return pass("CellInfo、SIM/运营商、phoneType 与网络类型自洽", evidence.clipped())
    }

    /** 只有 CDMA 仍可能部署的 MCC 才视为“不明显的 GSM 运营商”；其余 MCC 视为 GSM/LTE。 */
    private fun isClearlyGsmSimOperator(operatorCode: String): Boolean {
        val digits = operatorCode.trim()
        if (digits.length !in 5..6 || digits.any { !it.isDigit() }) return false
        val mcc = digits.substring(0, 3).toIntOrNull() ?: return false
        val mnc = digits.substring(3).toIntOrNull() ?: return false
        if (mcc == CHINA_MCC) return mnc !in CHINA_CDMA_MNCS
        return mcc !in CDMA_CAPABLE_MCCS
    }

    private fun isEmptyCell(cell: CellInfo): Boolean = when (cell) {
        is CellInfoCdma -> {
            val identity = cell.cellIdentity
            identity.basestationId == CellInfo.UNAVAILABLE &&
                identity.systemId == CellInfo.UNAVAILABLE &&
                identity.networkId == CellInfo.UNAVAILABLE
        }
        is CellInfoGsm -> {
            val identity = cell.cellIdentity
            identity.lac == CellInfo.UNAVAILABLE && identity.cid == CellInfo.UNAVAILABLE
        }
        is CellInfoWcdma -> {
            val identity = cell.cellIdentity
            identity.lac == CellInfo.UNAVAILABLE && identity.cid == CellInfo.UNAVAILABLE
        }
        is CellInfoLte -> {
            val identity = cell.cellIdentity
            identity.ci == CellInfo.UNAVAILABLE && identity.tac == CellInfo.UNAVAILABLE
        }
        is CellInfoNr -> {
            val identity = cell.cellIdentity as? CellIdentityNr
            identity != null && (
                identity.nci == Long.MAX_VALUE ||
                    identity.nci == CellInfo.UNAVAILABLE.toLong() ||
                    (identity.tac == CellInfo.UNAVAILABLE && identity.pci == CellInfo.UNAVAILABLE)
                )
        }
        else -> false
    }

    private fun hasCellularService(
        networkOperator: String,
        dataNetworkType: Int?,
        voiceNetworkType: Int?,
    ): Boolean {
        if (networkOperator.isNotEmpty()) return true
        val data = dataNetworkType ?: TelephonyManager.NETWORK_TYPE_UNKNOWN
        val voice = voiceNetworkType ?: TelephonyManager.NETWORK_TYPE_UNKNOWN
        val dataOnline = data != TelephonyManager.NETWORK_TYPE_UNKNOWN && data != TelephonyManager.NETWORK_TYPE_IWLAN
        val voiceOnline = voice != TelephonyManager.NETWORK_TYPE_UNKNOWN && voice != TelephonyManager.NETWORK_TYPE_IWLAN
        return dataOnline || voiceOnline
    }

    private fun histogram(cells: List<CellInfo>): String {
        if (cells.isEmpty()) return "无"
        val counts = cells.groupingBy(::cellType).eachCount().toSortedMap()
        return counts.entries.joinToString(",") { "${it.key}=${it.value}" }
    }

    /** CellInfo subclasses are public; the numeric TYPE_* constants are hidden system API. */
    private fun cellType(cell: CellInfo): String = when (cell) {
        is CellInfoCdma -> "CDMA"
        is CellInfoGsm -> "GSM"
        is CellInfoWcdma -> "WCDMA"
        is CellInfoLte -> "LTE"
        is CellInfoNr -> "NR"
        else -> "OTHER"
    }

    private fun signalSummary(signal: SignalStrength?): String {
        if (signal == null) return "<null>"
        val level = runCatching { signal.level }.getOrNull()
        val strengths = runCatching {
            signal.cellSignalStrengths.joinToString(",") { strength ->
                val name = strength.javaClass.simpleName.removePrefix("CellSignalStrength")
                "$name:${strength.level}"
            }
        }.getOrNull().orEmpty()
        return if (strengths.isEmpty()) "level=${level ?: "?"}" else "level=${level ?: "?"} [$strengths]"
    }

    private fun phoneTypeName(type: Int?): String = when (type) {
        null -> "<读取失败>"
        TelephonyManager.PHONE_TYPE_NONE -> "0(NONE)"
        TelephonyManager.PHONE_TYPE_GSM -> "1(GSM)"
        TelephonyManager.PHONE_TYPE_CDMA -> "2(CDMA)"
        TelephonyManager.PHONE_TYPE_SIP -> "3(SIP)"
        else -> "$type"
    }

    private fun simStateName(state: Int?): String = when (state) {
        null -> "<读取失败>"
        TelephonyManager.SIM_STATE_UNKNOWN -> "0(UNKNOWN)"
        TelephonyManager.SIM_STATE_ABSENT -> "1(ABSENT)"
        TelephonyManager.SIM_STATE_PIN_REQUIRED -> "2(PIN_REQUIRED)"
        TelephonyManager.SIM_STATE_PUK_REQUIRED -> "3(PUK_REQUIRED)"
        TelephonyManager.SIM_STATE_NETWORK_LOCKED -> "4(NETWORK_LOCKED)"
        TelephonyManager.SIM_STATE_READY -> "5(READY)"
        TelephonyManager.SIM_STATE_NOT_READY -> "6(NOT_READY)"
        TelephonyManager.SIM_STATE_PERM_DISABLED -> "7(PERM_DISABLED)"
        TelephonyManager.SIM_STATE_CARD_IO_ERROR -> "8(CARD_IO_ERROR)"
        TelephonyManager.SIM_STATE_CARD_RESTRICTED -> "9(CARD_RESTRICTED)"
        else -> "$state"
    }

    private fun networkTypeName(type: Int?): String =
        if (type == null) "<读取失败>" else "$type(${networkTypeLabel(type)})"

    private fun networkTypeLabel(type: Int): String = when (type) {
        TelephonyManager.NETWORK_TYPE_GPRS -> "GPRS"
        TelephonyManager.NETWORK_TYPE_EDGE -> "EDGE"
        TelephonyManager.NETWORK_TYPE_UMTS -> "UMTS"
        TelephonyManager.NETWORK_TYPE_CDMA -> "CDMA"
        TelephonyManager.NETWORK_TYPE_EVDO_0 -> "EVDO_0"
        TelephonyManager.NETWORK_TYPE_EVDO_A -> "EVDO_A"
        TelephonyManager.NETWORK_TYPE_1xRTT -> "1xRTT"
        TelephonyManager.NETWORK_TYPE_HSDPA -> "HSDPA"
        TelephonyManager.NETWORK_TYPE_HSUPA -> "HSUPA"
        TelephonyManager.NETWORK_TYPE_HSPA -> "HSPA"
        TelephonyManager.NETWORK_TYPE_IDEN -> "IDEN"
        TelephonyManager.NETWORK_TYPE_EVDO_B -> "EVDO_B"
        TelephonyManager.NETWORK_TYPE_LTE -> "LTE"
        TelephonyManager.NETWORK_TYPE_EHRPD -> "EHRPD"
        TelephonyManager.NETWORK_TYPE_HSPAP -> "HSPAP"
        TelephonyManager.NETWORK_TYPE_GSM -> "GSM"
        TelephonyManager.NETWORK_TYPE_TD_SCDMA -> "TD_SCDMA"
        TelephonyManager.NETWORK_TYPE_IWLAN -> "IWLAN"
        19 -> "LTE_CA" // NETWORK_TYPE_LTE_CA is hidden system API.
        TelephonyManager.NETWORK_TYPE_NR -> "NR"
        TelephonyManager.NETWORK_TYPE_UNKNOWN -> "UNKNOWN"
        else -> "TYPE_$type"
    }

    private fun permissionState(context: CheckContext, permission: String): String =
        if (context.context.checkSelfPermission(permission) == PackageManager.PERMISSION_GRANTED) {
            "granted"
        } else {
            "denied"
        }

    private fun orEmptyMarker(value: String): String = value.ifEmpty { "<空>" }

    private fun nameMarker(value: String): String = value.ifEmpty { "<空>" }.clip(48)

    private fun String.clip(max: Int): String = replace('\n', ' ').take(max)

    private fun List<String>.clipped(): List<String> =
        take(MAX_EVIDENCE_LINES).map { it.clip(MAX_EVIDENCE_CHARS) }

    private companion object {
        const val CHINA_MCC = 460
        const val MAX_EVIDENCE_LINES = 20
        const val MAX_EVIDENCE_CHARS = 280

        val CHINA_CDMA_MNCS = setOf(3, 5, 11)

        val CDMA_CAPABLE_MCCS = setOf(
            302, // 加拿大
            310, 311, 312, 313, 314, 315, 316, // 美国
            334, // 墨西哥
            440, 441, // 日本
            450, // 韩国
            455, // 澳门
        )

        val GSM_FAMILY_NETWORK_TYPES = setOf(
            TelephonyManager.NETWORK_TYPE_GSM,
            TelephonyManager.NETWORK_TYPE_UMTS,
            TelephonyManager.NETWORK_TYPE_HSDPA,
            TelephonyManager.NETWORK_TYPE_HSUPA,
            TelephonyManager.NETWORK_TYPE_HSPA,
            TelephonyManager.NETWORK_TYPE_HSPAP,
            TelephonyManager.NETWORK_TYPE_LTE,
            TelephonyManager.NETWORK_TYPE_NR,
        )

        val CORE_READ_LABELS = setOf(
            "phoneType",
            "simState",
            "simOperator",
            "networkOperator",
            "dataNetworkType",
            "voiceNetworkType",
            "allCellInfo",
        )
    }
}
```

`detector/src/main/java/com/system/location/service/detector/checks/GnssChecks.kt`:

```kt
package com.system.location.service.detector.checks

import android.location.GnssStatus
import com.system.location.service.detector.model.Check
import com.system.location.service.detector.model.CheckContext
import com.system.location.service.detector.model.CheckIds
import com.system.location.service.detector.model.CheckResult
import com.system.location.service.detector.model.GnssFrameSnapshot
import com.system.location.service.detector.model.GnssSatelliteSnapshot
import com.system.location.service.detector.model.GnssEvidenceSnapshot
import com.system.location.service.detector.model.GnssReference
import com.system.location.service.detector.model.GnssWindowProfile
import com.system.location.service.detector.model.GnssProfileComparison
import com.system.location.service.detector.model.SampleSnapshot
import java.text.SimpleDateFormat
import java.util.Date
import java.util.Locale
import kotlin.math.abs
import kotlin.math.sqrt

/** C06: validate observed fields; environmental/statistical anomalies are inconclusive evidence. */
class GnssStatusCheck : Check {
    override val id = CheckIds.GNSS_STATUS
    override val title = "GnssStatus 卫星"

    override fun run(context: CheckContext): CheckResult {
        val snapshot = context.snapshot
        val frames = snapshot.gnssFrames
        val analysis = analyze(frames)
        val profileLines = profileEvidence(snapshot, context.gnssReference, context.gnssReferenceNote)
        val evidence = buildEvidence(snapshot, analysis, profileLines)
        if (analysis.issues.isNotEmpty()) return fail(analysis.issues.joinToString("；"), evidence)
        if (frames.size < MIN_FRAMES) return insufficientFrames(snapshot, frames, profileLines)
        if (analysis.observations.isNotEmpty()) return unknown(analysis.observations.joinToString("；"), evidence)
        return pass(
            buildString {
                append("GnssStatus 已采集字段未见矛盾：${frames.size} 帧、")
                append("${analysis.knownConstellations.size} 个星座、")
                append("卫星集合 Jaccard 最低 ${formatRatio(analysis.jaccardMin)}、")
                append("CN0 ${formatDb(analysis.cn0Min)}–${formatDb(analysis.cn0Max)} dB-Hz、")
                append("usedInFix ${analysis.usedInFixTotal}/${analysis.satelliteSamples}；不据此证明定位来源真实")
            },
            evidence,
        )
    }

    private fun insufficientFrames(
        snapshot: SampleSnapshot,
        frames: List<GnssFrameSnapshot>,
        profileLines: List<String>,
    ): CheckResult {
        val evidence = mutableListOf<String>()
        evidence += sampleWindowLine(snapshot)
        evidence += "GnssStatus 帧数=${frames.size}（至少需要 $MIN_FRAMES 帧）"
        if (frames.isNotEmpty()) {
            evidence += "已收到帧的独立卫星数：${sampleValues(frames.map { frame ->
                frame.satellites.filter(::isUsableSignal).map { it.constellation to it.svid }.distinct().size.toString()
            })}"
        }
        evidence += "位置样本=${snapshot.locations.size}，NMEA 句数=${snapshot.nmeaSentences.size}"
        evidence += relevantNotes(snapshot)
        evidence += profileLines
        val reason = if (frames.isEmpty()) {
            "未收到 GnssStatus 回调（0 帧，少于 $MIN_FRAMES 帧）：可能缺少定位权限、GnssStatus 注册失败或采样窗口内无卫星状态更新"
        } else {
            "仅收到 ${frames.size} 帧 GnssStatus 回调（少于 $MIN_FRAMES 帧），无法判断卫星集合是否稳定：可能缺少定位权限或采样时间过短"
        }
        return unknown(reason, evidence.filter { it.isNotEmpty() }.map { it.take(MAX_EVIDENCE_CHARS) })
    }

    internal fun analyze(frames: List<GnssFrameSnapshot>): GnssAnalysis {
        val issues = mutableListOf<String>()
        val observations = mutableListOf<String>()
        // Keep raw rows for field validation, but exclude CN0=0/invalid geometry
        // placeholders from signal counts, constellation ratios and stability metrics.
        val identitiesPerFrame = frames.map { frame ->
            frame.satellites.filter(::isUsableSignal).groupBy { it.constellation to it.svid }
        }
        val satellitesPerFrame = identitiesPerFrame.map { it.size }
        val constellationsPerFrame = identitiesPerFrame.map { identities ->
            identities.keys.map { it.first }.filter { it != GnssStatus.CONSTELLATION_UNKNOWN }.distinct().size
        }

        frames.forEachIndexed { index, frame ->
            if (frame.satellites.isEmpty()) {
                observations += "第 ${index + 1} 帧没有可见卫星，无法判断三维定位"
            } else if (identitiesPerFrame[index].isEmpty()) {
                observations += "第 ${index + 1} 帧没有可用信号（CN0=0 可能是 Android 占位值）"
            }
            val invalidElevation = frame.satellites.count { !it.elevationDegrees.isFinite() || it.elevationDegrees !in 0f..90f }
            val invalidAzimuth = frame.satellites.count { !it.azimuthDegrees.isFinite() || it.azimuthDegrees < 0f || it.azimuthDegrees >= 360f }
            val invalidCn0 = frame.satellites.count { !it.cn0DbHz.isFinite() || it.cn0DbHz !in 0f..63f }
            if (invalidElevation > 0) issues += "第 ${index + 1} 帧 $invalidElevation 个仰角无效或低于地平线"
            if (invalidAzimuth > 0) issues += "第 ${index + 1} 帧 $invalidAzimuth 个方位角不在 [0,360)"
            if (invalidCn0 > 0) issues += "第 ${index + 1} 帧 $invalidCn0 个 CN0 不在 Android 0–63 dB-Hz 范围"
            // Multiband receivers can report the same SVID more than once; geometry needs unique identities.
            val used = frame.satellites.filter { it.usedInFix }.map { it.constellation to it.svid }.distinct().size
            if (used in 1..3) observations += "第 ${index + 1} 帧仅 $used 颗独立卫星在用，不足以确认三维定位；需对照 GGA/GSA 定位类型"
        }

        val constellationHistogram = linkedMapOf<Int, Int>()
        identitiesPerFrame.forEach { identities ->
            identities.keys.forEach { (constellation, _) ->
                constellationHistogram[constellation] =
                    (constellationHistogram[constellation] ?: 0) + 1
            }
        }
        val knownConstellations = constellationHistogram.keys
            .filter { it != GnssStatus.CONSTELLATION_UNKNOWN }
        val usedInFixPerFrame = identitiesPerFrame.map { identities ->
            identities.values.count { signals -> signals.any { it.usedInFix } }
        }
        val usedInFixTotal = usedInFixPerFrame.sum()
        val satelliteSamples = satellitesPerFrame.sum()
        if (satelliteSamples > 0 && usedInFixTotal == 0) {
            observations += "全部 $satelliteSamples 个卫星样本未参与定位，当前无法验证三维解"
        }

        val cn0Positive = frames.flatMap { frame -> frame.satellites.map { it.cn0DbHz } }
            .filter { it.isFinite() && it > 0f }
        val cn0Values = cn0Positive
        val cn0Min = cn0Positive.minOrNull()
        val cn0Max = cn0Positive.maxOrNull()
        val cn0Distinct = cn0Values.distinct().size
        if (cn0Values.size >= 2 && cn0Distinct == 1) {
            observations += "所有卫星 CN0 完全相同（${formatDb(cn0Values.first())} dB-Hz）"
        } else if (cn0Positive.size >= MIN_CONSTANT_CN0_SAMPLES &&
            cn0Min != null && cn0Max != null && cn0Max - cn0Min <= CN0_CONSTANT_RANGE_DB
        ) {
            observations += "CN0 几乎为常数（${formatDb(cn0Min)}–${formatDb(cn0Max)} dB-Hz，" +
                "${cn0Positive.size} 个样本）"
        }

        val keySets = identitiesPerFrame.map { identities -> identities.keys }
        val jaccardValues = (0 until frames.size - 1).mapNotNull { index ->
            val previous = keySets[index]
            val next = keySets[index + 1]
            if (previous.isEmpty() || next.isEmpty()) null else jaccard(previous, next)
        }
        val jaccardMin = jaccardValues.minOrNull()
        val jaccardAvg = if (jaccardValues.isEmpty()) null else jaccardValues.average()
        // Identity turnover also occurs in unmodified receiver output during acquisition.
        // Keep Jaccard as descriptive evidence; no calibrated causal threshold is available.

        val correlation = correlate(frames)
        correlation.verdict?.let { observations += "$it；环境遮挡与多径也可能导致该现象，不能据此认定伪造" }

        return GnssAnalysis(
            frames = frames,
            satellitesPerFrame = satellitesPerFrame,
            constellationsPerFrame = constellationsPerFrame,
            knownConstellations = knownConstellations,
            constellationHistogram = constellationHistogram,
            usedInFixPerFrame = usedInFixPerFrame,
            usedInFixTotal = usedInFixTotal,
            satelliteSamples = satelliteSamples,
            cn0Min = cn0Min,
            cn0Max = cn0Max,
            cn0Distinct = cn0Distinct,
            cn0Samples = cn0Positive.size,
            jaccardMin = jaccardMin,
            jaccardAvg = jaccardAvg,
            jaccardPairs = jaccardValues.size,
            correlation = correlation,
            issues = issues,
            observations = observations,
        )
    }

    /**
     * 粗相关性：整体 Pearson r + 每帧“高仰角组 CN0 均值 − 低仰角组 CN0 均值”的中位数。
     * 样本不足时不判定（避免把稀疏星空误判成伪造）。
     */
    private fun correlate(frames: List<GnssFrameSnapshot>): CorrelationStats {
        val observations = frames.flatMap { frame ->
            frame.satellites.mapNotNull { satellite -> cn0ElevationPair(satellite) }
        }
        val minElevation = observations.minOfOrNull { it.first }
        val maxElevation = observations.maxOfOrNull { it.first }
        val elevationSpread = if (minElevation != null && maxElevation != null) {
            maxElevation - minElevation
        } else {
            0f
        }
        val pearson = if (observations.size >= MIN_CORRELATION_SAMPLES &&
            elevationSpread >= MIN_ELEVATION_SPREAD_DEG
        ) {
            pearsonCoefficient(observations)
        } else {
            null
        }

        val groupDeltas = frames.mapNotNull { frame ->
            val pairs = frame.satellites.mapNotNull { satellite -> cn0ElevationPair(satellite) }
                .sortedBy { it.first }
            if (pairs.size < MIN_GROUP_SATELLITES) return@mapNotNull null
            val half = pairs.size / 2
            val lowMean = pairs.take(half).map { it.second }.average()
            val highMean = pairs.takeLast(half).map { it.second }.average()
            (highMean - lowMean).toFloat()
        }
        val groupMedianDelta = median(groupDeltas)
        val verdict = if (pearson == null) {
            null
        } else if (pearson <= STRONG_NEGATIVE_CORRELATION) {
            "CN0 与仰角显著负相关（r=${formatCoefficient(pearson)}）：仰角越高 CN0 反而越低"
        } else if (groupMedianDelta != null && groupMedianDelta <= -GROUP_NOISE_DB &&
            pearson < GROUP_INVERSION_MAX_R
        ) {
            "高仰角组 CN0 比低仰角组低 ${formatDb(-groupMedianDelta)} dB" +
                "（${groupDeltas.size} 帧中位差，超过 ${formatDb(GROUP_NOISE_DB)} dB 噪声容限）"
        } else if (abs(pearson) < NO_CORRELATION_R) {
            "CN0 与仰角完全不相关（r=${formatCoefficient(pearson)}，${observations.size} 个样本）"
        } else {
            null
        }
        return CorrelationStats(
            samples = observations.size,
            elevationSpread = elevationSpread,
            pearson = pearson,
            groupFrames = groupDeltas.size,
            groupMedianDelta = groupMedianDelta,
            verdict = verdict,
        )
    }

    internal fun profileEvidence(snapshot: SampleSnapshot, reference: GnssReference?, note: String): List<String> {
        if (reference == null) return listOf("画像比较：$note")
        return runCatching {
            val a = reference.profile()
            val b = GnssWindowProfile.from(GnssEvidenceSnapshot(snapshot.startedAtMillis,
                snapshot.endedAtMillis, snapshot.gnssFrames))
            val delta = GnssProfileComparison.compare(a, b)
            val stamp = SimpleDateFormat("yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss", Locale.US).format(Date(reference.savedAtMillis))
            fun decimal(value: Double?) = value?.let { String.format(Locale.US, "%.3f", it) } ?: "未定义"
            fun ratios(profile: GnssWindowProfile): String = if (profile.satelliteCount == 0) "无可见卫星" else
                profile.constellationCounts.toSortedMap().entries.joinToString("，") { (c, n) ->
                    "${constellationName(c)}=${decimal(n.toDouble() / profile.satelliteCount)}"
                }
            buildList {
                add("画像参考：用户于 $stamp 保存；环境记录：${reference.environment.replace('\n', ' ').replace('\r', ' ')}")
                add("画像窗口：参考 ${a.receiverSeconds} 个接收秒/${a.endedAtMillis - a.startedAtMillis}ms；" +
                    "当前 ${b.receiverSeconds} 个接收秒/${b.endedAtMillis - b.startedAtMillis}ms；每 UTC 秒仅取最后帧")
                add("平均可见数：${decimal(a.meanVisible)} → ${decimal(b.meanVisible)}；" +
                    "在用比例：${decimal(a.usedFraction)} → ${decimal(b.usedFraction)}（独立卫星，任一信号在用）")
                add("参考星座比例：${ratios(a)}")
                add("当前星座比例：${ratios(b)}")
                add("经验分布总变差 TV：卫星数量=${decimal(delta.visibleCountTotalVariation)}；" +
                    "星座=${decimal(delta.constellationTotalVariation)}；" +
                    "逐信号星座/仰角/CN0 联合=${decimal(delta.signalJointTotalVariation)}（5°/5 dB-Hz 分箱）")
                if (!delta.adequateWindows) add("画像覆盖不足：至少需 20 个接收秒、跨度 30 秒、间隔≤2秒且存在可见卫星；不提供置信结论")
                add("画像仅描述两个窗口的差异，不设伪造阈值、不证明同分布；地点、遮挡、时间及卫星下限设置需另行对照，参考真实性需独立确认")
            }
        }.getOrElse { listOf("画像比较不可用：${it.message ?: it.javaClass.simpleName}") }
    }

    private fun buildEvidence(snapshot: SampleSnapshot, analysis: GnssAnalysis, profileLines: List<String>): List<String> {
        val evidence = mutableListOf<String>()
        evidence += sampleWindowLine(snapshot)
        evidence += "每帧独立卫星数：${sampleValues(analysis.satellitesPerFrame.map { it.toString() })}" +
            "（min=${analysis.satellitesPerFrame.minOrNull() ?: 0}，" +
            "max=${analysis.satellitesPerFrame.maxOrNull() ?: 0}）"
        evidence += "星座直方图：${constellationHistogramLine(analysis.constellationHistogram)}"
        evidence += "每帧星座数：${sampleValues(analysis.constellationsPerFrame.map { it.toString() })}"
        evidence += "usedInFix：每帧 ${sampleValues(analysis.usedInFixPerFrame.map { it.toString() })}；" +
            "合计 ${analysis.usedInFixTotal}/${analysis.satelliteSamples}"
        evidence += "逐信号 CN0 dB-Hz：min=${formatDb(analysis.cn0Min)}，max=${formatDb(analysis.cn0Max)}，" +
            "不同值=${analysis.cn0Distinct}，有效样本=${analysis.cn0Samples}"
        evidence += "卫星集合 Jaccard：min=${formatRatio(analysis.jaccardMin)}，" +
            "avg=${formatRatio(analysis.jaccardAvg)}（相邻 ${analysis.jaccardPairs} 对）"
        evidence += "CN0/仰角：${correlationLine(analysis.correlation)}"
        evidence += profileLines
        evidence += relevantNotes(snapshot)
        return evidence.filter { it.isNotEmpty() }
            .take(MAX_EVIDENCE_LINES)
            .map { it.take(MAX_EVIDENCE_CHARS) }
    }

    private fun sampleWindowLine(snapshot: SampleSnapshot): String {
        val durationSeconds = ((snapshot.endedAtMillis - snapshot.startedAtMillis).coerceAtLeast(0L)) / 1000
        val start = formatTime(snapshot.startedAtMillis)
        val end = formatTime(snapshot.endedAtMillis)
        return "采样窗口 $start–$end（${durationSeconds}s），位置样本=${snapshot.locations.size}，" +
            "GnssStatus 帧数=${snapshot.gnssFrames.size}"
    }

    private fun relevantNotes(snapshot: SampleSnapshot): String {
        val notes = snapshot.notes.filter { note ->
            note.contains("gnss", ignoreCase = true) ||
                note.contains("nmea", ignoreCase = true) ||
                note.contains("locationmanager", ignoreCase = true)
        }
        if (notes.isEmpty()) return ""
        return "采集备注：${notes.take(3).joinToString("；") { it.take(120) }}"
    }

    private fun constellationHistogramLine(histogram: Map<Int, Int>): String {
        if (histogram.isEmpty()) return "无卫星"
        return histogram.entries.joinToString("，") { (constellation, count) ->
            "${constellationName(constellation)}=$count"
        }
    }

    private fun correlationLine(stats: CorrelationStats): String {
        if (stats.pearson == null) {
            return "样本不足（${stats.samples} 个有效样本，仰角跨度 ${formatDegrees(stats.elevationSpread)}°），跳过相关性判定"
        }
        val medianDelta = stats.groupMedianDelta
        val group = if (medianDelta != null) {
            "高仰角组−低仰角组中位差=${formatDb(medianDelta)} dB（${stats.groupFrames} 帧）"
        } else {
            "高/低仰角分组样本不足"
        }
        return "Pearson r=${formatCoefficient(stats.pearson)}，$group，${stats.samples} 个样本"
    }

    companion object {
        /** 少于 3 帧无法判断时间稳定性，按文档给 UNKNOWN。 */
        private const val MIN_FRAMES = 3

        /** CN0 有效值少于该数时不判定“常数”。 */
        private const val MIN_CONSTANT_CN0_SAMPLES = 4

        /** 所有正 CN0 的极差不超过该值视为常数。 */
        private const val CN0_CONSTANT_RANGE_DB = 0.1f

        private const val MIN_CORRELATION_SAMPLES = 16
        private const val MIN_ELEVATION_SPREAD_DEG = 10f
        private const val MIN_GROUP_SATELLITES = 6
        private const val STRONG_NEGATIVE_CORRELATION = -0.3f
        private const val NO_CORRELATION_R = 0.05f
        private const val GROUP_NOISE_DB = 1.5f
        private const val GROUP_INVERSION_MAX_R = 0.15f

        private const val MAX_EVIDENCE_LINES = 20
        private const val MAX_EVIDENCE_CHARS = 299
    }
}

internal data class CorrelationStats(
    val samples: Int,
    val elevationSpread: Float,
    val pearson: Float?,
    val groupFrames: Int,
    val groupMedianDelta: Float?,
    val verdict: String?,
)

internal data class GnssAnalysis(
    val frames: List<GnssFrameSnapshot>,
    val satellitesPerFrame: List<Int>,
    val constellationsPerFrame: List<Int>,
    val knownConstellations: List<Int>,
    val constellationHistogram: Map<Int, Int>,
    val usedInFixPerFrame: List<Int>,
    val usedInFixTotal: Int,
    val satelliteSamples: Int,
    val cn0Min: Float?,
    val cn0Max: Float?,
    val cn0Distinct: Int,
    val cn0Samples: Int,
    val jaccardMin: Double?,
    val jaccardAvg: Double?,
    val jaccardPairs: Int,
    val correlation: CorrelationStats,
    val issues: List<String>,
    val observations: List<String>,
)

private fun constellationName(constellation: Int): String = when (constellation) {
    GnssStatus.CONSTELLATION_GPS -> "GPS"
    GnssStatus.CONSTELLATION_SBAS -> "SBAS"
    GnssStatus.CONSTELLATION_GLONASS -> "GLONASS"
    GnssStatus.CONSTELLATION_QZSS -> "QZSS"
    GnssStatus.CONSTELLATION_BEIDOU -> "BEIDOU"
    GnssStatus.CONSTELLATION_GALILEO -> "GALILEO"
    GnssStatus.CONSTELLATION_IRNSS -> "IRNSS"
    GnssStatus.CONSTELLATION_UNKNOWN -> "UNKNOWN"
    else -> "TYPE_$constellation"
}

private fun cn0ElevationPair(satellite: GnssSatelliteSnapshot): Pair<Float, Float>? {
    val elevation = satellite.elevationDegrees
    val cn0 = satellite.cn0DbHz
    if (!elevation.isFinite() || elevation < 0f || elevation > 90f) return null
    if (!cn0.isFinite() || cn0 <= 0f) return null
    return elevation to cn0
}

private fun isUsableSignal(satellite: GnssSatelliteSnapshot): Boolean =
    satellite.cn0DbHz > 0f && satellite.elevationDegrees in 0f..90f &&
        satellite.azimuthDegrees in 0f..<360f

private fun pearsonCoefficient(pairs: List<Pair<Float, Float>>): Float? {
    if (pairs.size < 2) return null
    val meanX = pairs.map { it.first.toDouble() }.average()
    val meanY = pairs.map { it.second.toDouble() }.average()
    var sumXY = 0.0
    var sumXX = 0.0
    var sumYY = 0.0
    pairs.forEach { (x, y) ->
        val dx = x.toDouble() - meanX
        val dy = y.toDouble() - meanY
        sumXY += dx * dy
        sumXX += dx * dx
        sumYY += dy * dy
    }
    if (sumXX <= 1e-9 || sumYY <= 1e-9) return null
    return (sumXY / sqrt(sumXX * sumYY)).toFloat()
}

private fun jaccard(previous: Set<Pair<Int, Int>>, next: Set<Pair<Int, Int>>): Double {
    if (previous.isEmpty() && next.isEmpty()) return 1.0
    val intersection = previous.count { it in next }
    val union = previous.size + next.size - intersection
    return if (union == 0) 1.0 else intersection.toDouble() / union
}

private fun median(values: List<Float>): Float? {
    if (values.isEmpty()) return null
    val sorted = values.sorted()
    val middle = sorted.size / 2
    return if (sorted.size % 2 == 1) {
        sorted[middle]
    } else {
        (sorted[middle - 1] + sorted[middle]) / 2f
    }
}

private fun formatTime(millis: Long): String {
    if (millis <= 0L) return "--:--:--"
    return SimpleDateFormat("HH:mm:ss.SSS", Locale.US).format(Date(millis))
}

private fun formatDb(value: Float?): String =
    value?.let { String.format(Locale.US, "%.1f", it) } ?: "n/a"

private fun formatCoefficient(value: Float?): String =
    value?.let { String.format(Locale.US, "%.2f", it) } ?: "n/a"

private fun formatRatio(value: Double?): String =
    value?.let { String.format(Locale.US, "%.2f", it) } ?: "n/a"

private fun formatDegrees(value: Float): String = String.format(Locale.US, "%.1f", value)

private fun sampleValues(values: List<String>, limit: Int = 12): String {
    if (values.isEmpty()) return "无"
    if (values.size <= limit) return values.joinToString(", ")
    return values.take(limit).joinToString(", ") + " …（共 ${values.size} 帧）"
}
```

`detector/src/main/java/com/system/location/service/detector/checks/IdentityChecks.kt`:

```kt
package com.system.location.service.detector.checks

import android.content.pm.ApplicationInfo
import android.content.pm.PackageInfo
import android.content.pm.PackageManager
import android.os.Build
import android.os.Bundle
import com.system.location.service.detector.model.Check
import com.system.location.service.detector.model.CheckContext
import com.system.location.service.detector.model.CheckIds
import com.system.location.service.detector.model.CheckResult
import java.io.File
import java.util.Locale

/**
 * C13 · PackageManager 中的 Xposed 元数据。
 *
 * 期望：目标包在四个查询面（getApplicationInfo / getPackageInfo(GET_META_DATA) /
 * getInstalledApplications(GET_META_DATA) / getInstalledPackages(GET_META_DATA)）的
 * ApplicationInfo.metaData 里都没有 `xposedmodule`/`xposedscope`/`xposeddescription`/
 * `xposedminversion`（工作包 9：入口一致性——单面漏网即隐藏层指纹）。
 * LSPosed 管理器是否安装只作为 evidence，因为检测器自己能看到管理器不等于模块身份泄漏。
 *
 * 目标包不可见/不存在 → UNKNOWN，并提示检查目标包名与 manifest `<queries>`
 * （当前 manifest 只声明了 com.system.location.service 等包，属于共享改动范围）。
 */
class PackageIdentityCheck : Check {
    override val id = CheckIds.PACKAGE_IDENTITY
    override val title = "PackageManager Xposed 元数据"

    override fun run(context: CheckContext): CheckResult = try {
        val packageManager = context.context.packageManager
        val targetPackage = context.settings.targetPackage
        val evidence = mutableListOf<String>()

        val info = try {
            loadApplicationInfo(packageManager, targetPackage)
        } catch (error: PackageManager.NameNotFoundException) {
            addIdentityEvidence(evidence, "目标包 $targetPackage 不可见/未安装：${error.javaClass.simpleName}")
            return unknown(
                "目标包 $targetPackage 不存在或对 detector 不可见；请检查目标包名设置与 manifest " +
                    "<queries>/QUERY_ALL_PACKAGES 包可见性配置，无法判定 Xposed 元数据。",
                evidence,
            )
        } catch (error: Throwable) {
            addIdentityEvidence(
                evidence,
                "读取 $targetPackage 失败：${error.javaClass.simpleName}: ${error.message}",
            )
            return unknown("读取目标包失败，无法判定 Xposed 元数据。", evidence)
        }

        val version = runCatching { packageVersion(packageManager, targetPackage) }.getOrNull() ?: "?"
        addIdentityEvidence(evidence, "目标包=$targetPackage version=$version")

        val found = mutableListOf<Pair<String, String>>()
        // 逐个查询面核对元数据（工作包 9：入口一致性）。单面漏网本身就是隐藏层的指纹，
        // 因此 FAIL 判定汇总所有面的命中；某一面读取失败只记证据，不替代判定。
        val surfaces = mutableListOf<MetaSurface>()
        surfaces += MetaSurface("getApplicationInfo", info.metaData)
        runCatching { loadPackageInfo(packageManager, targetPackage) }
            .onSuccess { surfaces += MetaSurface("getPackageInfo", it?.applicationInfo?.metaData) }
            .onFailure { surfaces += MetaSurface("getPackageInfo", null, it.javaClass.simpleName) }
        runCatching { findInstalledApplicationMeta(packageManager, targetPackage) }
            .onSuccess { surfaces += MetaSurface("getInstalledApplications", it) }
            .onFailure { surfaces += MetaSurface("getInstalledApplications", null, it.javaClass.simpleName) }
        runCatching { findInstalledPackageMeta(packageManager, targetPackage) }
            .onSuccess { surfaces += MetaSurface("getInstalledPackages", it) }
            .onFailure { surfaces += MetaSurface("getInstalledPackages", null, it.javaClass.simpleName) }

        for (surface in surfaces) {
            val hits = mutableListOf<Pair<String, String>>()
            val metaData = surface.metaData
            if (metaData != null) {
                for (key in metaData.keySet()) {
                    if (key.lowercase(Locale.ROOT) in XPOSED_META_KEYS) {
                        hits += key to formatMetaValue(metaData.get(key))
                    }
                }
            }
            val summary = when {
                surface.note != null -> "读取失败(${surface.note})"
                metaData == null -> "无 meta-data"
                hits.isEmpty() -> "未发现 Xposed 键"
                else -> "命中 ${hits.size} 个 Xposed 键"
            }
            addIdentityEvidence(evidence, "${surface.label}：$summary")
            hits.forEach { (key, value) -> found += surface.label to "$key=$value" }
        }

        for (managerPackage in LSPOSED_MANAGER_PACKAGES) {
            val version = runCatching { packageVersion(packageManager, managerPackage) }.getOrNull()
            if (version != null) {
                addIdentityEvidence(
                    evidence,
                    "LSPosed 管理器 $managerPackage version=$version（仅证据，不单独判 FAIL）",
                )
            } else {
                addIdentityEvidence(
                    evidence,
                    "LSPosed 管理器 $managerPackage 不可见/未安装（package visibility 可能影响，仅证据）",
                )
            }
        }

        if (found.isNotEmpty()) {
            val surfaces2 = found.map { it.first }.distinct().joinToString("/")
            val summary = found.joinToString("；") { "${it.first}:${it.second}" }.take(220)
            return fail(
                "目标包 $targetPackage 在 $surfaces2 查询面暴露 Xposed 元数据：$summary；" +
                    "符合当前 D13 legacy 元数据状态，P6 迁移 libxposed 后应清除。",
                evidence,
            )
        }
        return pass(
            "目标包 $targetPackage 存在，且 getApplicationInfo/getPackageInfo/" +
                "getInstalledApplications/getInstalledPackages 四个查询面均未发现 " +
                "xposedmodule/xposedscope/xposeddescription/xposedminversion；LSPosed 管理器仅作证据。",
            evidence,
        )
    } catch (error: Throwable) {
        unknown(
            "C13 检查异常：${error.javaClass.simpleName}: ${error.message}",
            listOf("异常：${error.javaClass.simpleName}"),
        )
    }
}

/**
 * C14 · root / 进程痕迹。
 *
 * 只读固定路径：`/proc/self/status`、`/proc/self/maps` 和 5 个常见 su 路径，
 * 不遍历文件系统。结果是 detector 自身进程的环境证据，不代表 target app 进程；
 * target app 当前未注入。
 *
 * TracerPid>0、maps 命中 lspd/dobby/locationext/xposed/magisk/可疑路径、su 可执行、
 * `Build.TAGS` 含 test-keys 或 `Build.TYPE` 为 eng/userdebug，均判 FAIL。
 * 没有任何痕迹但 /proc 读不到 → UNKNOWN。
 */
class RootTraceCheck : Check {
    override val id = CheckIds.ROOT_TRACE
    override val title = "root / 进程痕迹"

    override fun run(context: CheckContext): CheckResult = try {
        val evidence = mutableListOf<String>()
        val failures = mutableListOf<String>()
        addRootEvidence(
            evidence,
            "范围：detector 自身进程（${context.context.packageName}），不是 target app 进程；" +
                "target app 当前未注入",
        )

        var statusReadable = false
        var tracerPid: Int? = null
        val statusLines = runCatching {
            File("/proc/self/status").useLines { it.toList() }
        }.getOrNull()
        if (statusLines != null) {
            statusReadable = true
            tracerPid = statusLines.firstOrNull { it.startsWith("TracerPid:") }
                ?.substringAfter(':')?.trim()?.toIntOrNull()
            addRootEvidence(evidence, "TracerPid=${tracerPid ?: "解析失败"}（/proc/self/status）")
            if ((tracerPid ?: 0) > 0) failures += "TracerPid=$tracerPid，进程被 ptrace"
        } else {
            addRootEvidence(evidence, "/proc/self/status 不可读")
        }

        var mapsReadable = false
        val hits = linkedMapOf<String, String>()
        runCatching {
            File("/proc/self/maps").useLines { lines ->
                mapsReadable = true
                var inspected = 0
                for (line in lines) {
                    inspected++
                    if (inspected > ROOT_MAX_MAPS_LINES) break
                    val lower = line.lowercase(Locale.ROOT)
                    for (marker in ROOT_TRACE_MARKERS) {
                        if (hits.size >= 8) break
                        if (marker !in hits && lower.contains(marker)) {
                            hits[marker] = line.trim().take(180)
                        }
                    }
                    if (hits.size >= 8) break
                }
            }
        }.onFailure {
            addRootEvidence(evidence, "/proc/self/maps 读取失败：${it.javaClass.simpleName}")
        }
        if (mapsReadable) {
            if (hits.isEmpty()) {
                addRootEvidence(evidence, "maps：未命中 ${ROOT_TRACE_MARKERS.joinToString("/")}")
            } else {
                addRootEvidence(evidence, "maps 命中：${hits.keys.joinToString(", ")}")
                hits.entries.take(6).forEach { (marker, line) ->
                    addRootEvidence(evidence, "  [$marker] $line")
                }
                failures += "maps 含 ${hits.keys.joinToString(", ")}"
            }
        } else {
            addRootEvidence(evidence, "/proc/self/maps 不可读")
        }

        val suPresent = mutableListOf<String>()
        val suExecutable = mutableListOf<String>()
        for (path in ROOT_SU_PATHS) {
            val file = File(path)
            val exists = runCatching { file.exists() }.getOrDefault(false)
            val executable = exists && runCatching { file.canExecute() }.getOrDefault(false)
            if (exists) suPresent += path
            if (executable) suExecutable += path
        }
        if (suExecutable.isEmpty()) {
            addRootEvidence(
                evidence,
                "su 路径：无可执行文件（存在但不可执行：${suPresent.joinToString(", ").ifBlank { "无" }}）",
            )
        } else {
            addRootEvidence(evidence, "su 可执行：${suExecutable.joinToString(", ")}")
            failures += "su 可执行：${suExecutable.joinToString(", ")}"
        }

        val tags = Build.TAGS.orEmpty()
        val type = Build.TYPE.orEmpty()
        val testKeys = tags.contains("test-keys", ignoreCase = true)
        val debugType = type.contains("eng", ignoreCase = true) ||
            type.contains("userdebug", ignoreCase = true)
        addRootEvidence(
            evidence,
            "Build.TAGS=${tags.ifBlank { "<空>" }}，Build.TYPE=${type.ifBlank { "<空>" }}",
        )
        if (testKeys) failures += "Build.TAGS 含 test-keys"
        if (debugType) failures += "Build.TYPE=${type.ifBlank { "<空>" }}（eng/userdebug）"

        if (failures.isNotEmpty()) {
            return fail(
                "detector 自身进程发现 ${failures.size} 项环境痕迹：" +
                    "${failures.joinToString("；").take(220)}。" +
                    "注意：这是 detector 自身进程证据，不是 target app 进程。",
                evidence,
            )
        }
        if (!statusReadable || tracerPid == null || !mapsReadable) {
            return unknown(
                "无法完整读取 /proc/self/status 或 /proc/self/maps，不能确认无痕迹。" +
                    "注意：这是 detector 自身进程证据，不是 target app 进程。",
                evidence,
            )
        }
        return pass(
            "detector 自身进程未发现 TracerPid、maps 注入标记、可执行 su 或 test-keys/userdebug 构建痕迹。" +
                "注意：不代表 target app 进程。",
            evidence,
        )
    } catch (error: Throwable) {
        unknown(
            "C14 检查异常：${error.javaClass.simpleName}: ${error.message}",
            listOf("异常：${error.javaClass.simpleName}"),
        )
    }
}

@Suppress("DEPRECATION")
private fun loadApplicationInfo(packageManager: PackageManager, packageName: String): ApplicationInfo =
    if (Build.VERSION.SDK_INT >= Build.VERSION_CODES.TIRAMISU) {
        packageManager.getApplicationInfo(
            packageName,
            PackageManager.ApplicationInfoFlags.of(PackageManager.GET_META_DATA.toLong()),
        )
    } else {
        packageManager.getApplicationInfo(packageName, PackageManager.GET_META_DATA)
    }

@Suppress("DEPRECATION")
private fun loadPackageInfo(packageManager: PackageManager, packageName: String): PackageInfo? =
    runCatching {
        if (Build.VERSION.SDK_INT >= Build.VERSION_CODES.TIRAMISU) {
            packageManager.getPackageInfo(
                packageName,
                PackageManager.PackageInfoFlags.of(PackageManager.GET_META_DATA.toLong()),
            )
        } else {
            packageManager.getPackageInfo(packageName, PackageManager.GET_META_DATA)
        }
    }.getOrNull()

@Suppress("DEPRECATION")
private fun findInstalledApplicationMeta(
    packageManager: PackageManager,
    packageName: String,
): Bundle? =
    if (Build.VERSION.SDK_INT >= Build.VERSION_CODES.TIRAMISU) {
        packageManager.getInstalledApplications(
            PackageManager.ApplicationInfoFlags.of(PackageManager.GET_META_DATA.toLong()),
        )
    } else {
        packageManager.getInstalledApplications(PackageManager.GET_META_DATA)
    }.firstOrNull { it.packageName == packageName }?.metaData

@Suppress("DEPRECATION")
private fun findInstalledPackageMeta(
    packageManager: PackageManager,
    packageName: String,
): Bundle? =
    if (Build.VERSION.SDK_INT >= Build.VERSION_CODES.TIRAMISU) {
        packageManager.getInstalledPackages(
            PackageManager.PackageInfoFlags.of(PackageManager.GET_META_DATA.toLong()),
        )
    } else {
        packageManager.getInstalledPackages(PackageManager.GET_META_DATA)
    }.firstOrNull { it.packageName == packageName }?.applicationInfo?.metaData

private class MetaSurface(val label: String, val metaData: Bundle?, val note: String? = null)

@Suppress("DEPRECATION")
private fun packageVersion(packageManager: PackageManager, packageName: String): String? {
    val info: PackageInfo = if (Build.VERSION.SDK_INT >= Build.VERSION_CODES.TIRAMISU) {
        packageManager.getPackageInfo(packageName, PackageManager.PackageInfoFlags.of(0L))
    } else {
        packageManager.getPackageInfo(packageName, 0)
    }
    return info.versionName ?: info.longVersionCode.toString()
}

private fun formatMetaValue(value: Any?): String = when (value) {
    null -> "null"
    is String -> value
    is Int, is Long, is Boolean, is Float, is Double -> value.toString()
    is Array<*> -> value.joinToString(",") { it?.toString() ?: "" }
    is IntArray -> value.joinToString(",")
    is LongArray -> value.joinToString(",")
    is FloatArray -> value.joinToString(",")
    is DoubleArray -> value.joinToString(",")
    else -> value.toString()
}.replace('\n', ' ').take(200)

private fun addIdentityEvidence(evidence: MutableList<String>, line: String) {
    if (evidence.size < IDENTITY_MAX_EVIDENCE_LINES) {
        evidence += line.take(IDENTITY_MAX_EVIDENCE_CHARS)
    }
}

private fun addRootEvidence(evidence: MutableList<String>, line: String) {
    if (evidence.size < ROOT_MAX_EVIDENCE_LINES) {
        evidence += line.take(ROOT_MAX_EVIDENCE_CHARS)
    }
}

    "xposedscope",

    "xposedminversion",
)

    "de.robv.android.xposed.installer",
)

    "/su/bin/su",
    "/debug_ramdisk/su",
```

`detector/src/main/java/com/system/location/service/detector/checks/LocationChecks.kt`:

```kt
package com.system.location.service.detector.checks

import android.annotation.SuppressLint
import android.location.Location
import android.location.LocationManager
import com.system.location.service.detector.model.Check
import com.system.location.service.detector.model.CheckContext
import com.system.location.service.detector.model.CheckIds
import com.system.location.service.detector.model.CheckResult

/**
 * C01 · 位置模拟标记。
 *
 * 期望：`Location.isMock` / `isFromMockProvider` 以及反射字段（mMock、mIsFromMockProvider 等）
 * 对 Portal 发布的位置都不可见。Android 12–17 的字段名有差异，反射失败只记录，不伪造 PASS。
 */
@SuppressLint("MissingPermission")
class LocationMockCheck : Check {
    override val id = CheckIds.LOCATION_MOCK
    override val title = "位置模拟标记"
    override val blocking = true

    override fun run(context: CheckContext): CheckResult = try {
        val locations = collectLocations(context)
        if (locations.isEmpty()) {
            unknown(
                "没有位置样本，也没有 lastKnownLocation，无法判定 mock 标记。",
                limited(listOf("snapshot.locations=0", "lastKnown=空") + context.snapshot.notes),
            )
        } else {
            evaluate(locations)
        }
    } catch (error: Exception) {
        unknown("C01 检查异常：${error.javaClass.simpleName}: ${error.message}")
    }

    private fun collectLocations(context: CheckContext): List<Location> {
        val locations = context.snapshot.locations.toMutableList()
        if (locations.isEmpty()) {
            val manager = context.locationManager
            if (manager != null) {
                listOf(LocationManager.GPS_PROVIDER, LocationManager.NETWORK_PROVIDER, "fused").forEach { provider ->
                    runCatching { manager.getLastKnownLocation(provider) }.getOrNull()?.let { locations += it }
                }
            }
        }
        return locations
    }

    private fun evaluate(locations: List<Location>): CheckResult {
        val sampled = locations.takeLast(MAX_LOCATIONS)
        var mockCount = 0
        val lines = mutableListOf<String>()
        sampled.forEach { location ->
            val reflected = reflectMockFields(location)
            val mock = location.isMock || location.isFromMockProvider || reflected.values.any { it == true }
            if (mock) mockCount++
            lines += "provider=${location.provider ?: "?"} time=${location.time} " +
                "isMock=${location.isMock} isFromMockProvider=${location.isFromMockProvider} " +
                "reflection=$reflected"
        }
        lines += "checked=${sampled.size} mock=$mockCount"
        return if (mockCount > 0) {
            fail(
                "$mockCount/${sampled.size} 个位置仍带 mock 标记；目标 App 可直接读取。",
                limited(lines),
            )
        } else {
            pass(
                "检查 ${sampled.size} 个位置，isMock/isFromMockProvider/反射字段均未发现 mock 标记。",
                limited(lines),
            )
        }
    }

    @Suppress("DEPRECATION")
    private fun reflectMockFields(location: Location): Map<String, Boolean?> {
        val result = linkedMapOf<String, Boolean?>()
        FIELD_NAMES.forEach { name ->
            val value = runCatching {
                Location::class.java.getDeclaredField(name).apply { isAccessible = true }.get(location) as? Boolean
            }.getOrNull()
            result[name] = value
        }
        return result
    }

    private fun limited(lines: List<String>): List<String> =
        lines.take(MAX_EVIDENCE_LINES).map { it.replace('\n', ' ').take(MAX_EVIDENCE_CHARS) }

    private companion object {
        const val MAX_LOCATIONS = 50
        const val MAX_EVIDENCE_LINES = 20
        const val MAX_EVIDENCE_CHARS = 299
        val FIELD_NAMES = listOf("mMock", "mIsFromMockProvider", "mAllowed", "mMockLocation")
    }
}
```
