`detector/src/main/java/com/system/location/service/detector/checks/LocationFieldsCheck.kt`:

```kt
package com.system.location.service.detector.checks

import android.annotation.SuppressLint
import android.location.Location
import android.location.LocationManager
import android.os.Build
import com.system.location.service.detector.model.Check
import com.system.location.service.detector.model.CheckContext
import com.system.location.service.detector.model.CheckIds
import com.system.location.service.detector.model.CheckResult
import com.system.location.service.detector.model.GnssFrameSnapshot
import kotlin.math.abs

/** C05 validates supplied Location fields; optional Android fields are never mandatory. */
@SuppressLint("MissingPermission")
class LocationFieldsCheck : Check {
    override val id = CheckIds.LOCATION_FIELDS
    override val title = "Location 字段与 Availability"
    override val blocking = true

    override fun run(context: CheckContext): CheckResult = try {
        val location = context.snapshot.primaryLocation
            ?: context.snapshot.lastKnownByProvider.values.lastOrNull()
            ?: lastKnownFromManager(context)
        if (location == null) {
            unknown(
                "没有位置样本，无法检查字段完整性。",
                limited(listOf("snapshot.locations=0", "lastKnown=空") + context.snapshot.notes),
            )
        } else {
            evaluate(context, location)
        }
    } catch (error: Exception) {
        unknown("C05 检查异常：${error.javaClass.simpleName}: ${error.message}")
    }

    private fun lastKnownFromManager(context: CheckContext): Location? {
        val manager = context.locationManager ?: return null
        return runCatching {
            listOf(LocationManager.GPS_PROVIDER, LocationManager.NETWORK_PROVIDER)
                .firstNotNullOfOrNull { manager.getLastKnownLocation(it) }
        }.getOrNull()
    }

    @Suppress("DEPRECATION")
    private fun evaluate(context: CheckContext, location: Location): CheckResult {
        val issues = mutableListOf<String>()
        val lines = mutableListOf<String>()
        lines += "provider=${location.provider ?: "?"} time=${location.time} accuracy=${location.accuracy}"

        val extras = location.extras
        val satellites = extras?.getInt("satellites", -1) ?: -1
        val meanCn0 = extras?.getFloat("meanCn0", -1f) ?: -1f
        val maxCn0 = extras?.getFloat("maxCn0", -1f) ?: -1f
        lines += "extras: keys=${extras?.keySet()?.sorted() ?: "null"} satellites=$satellites meanCn0=$meanCn0 maxCn0=$maxCn0"
        val optional = suppliedFields(location)
        lines += "已提供可选字段：$optional；未提供的字段不作为异常"

        // The latest callback can be fused/network. It must not hide earlier invalid fields or
        // contradictory GPS extras from the same collection window.
        val samples = context.snapshot.locations.ifEmpty { listOf(location) }.map { sample ->
            LocationFieldSample(sample.provider, sample.time, sample.latitude, sample.longitude,
                if (sample === location) optional else suppliedFields(sample))
        }
        val epochs = nmeaStatusEpochs(context.snapshot).takeIf { it.isNotEmpty() }
        val window = LocationWindowValidation.evaluate(samples, context.snapshot.gnssFrames, epochs)
        issues += window.issues
        lines += "窗口字段检查：${samples.size} 个位置样本；GPS extras=${window.gpsExtrasCount}，同时间窗对账=${window.comparedGpsCount}"
        lines += "GPS 不同坐标=${samples.filter { it.provider == "gps" }.map { it.latitude to it.longitude }.toSet().size}"
        lines += if (epochs != null) "GNSS 配对时间：NMEA 接收机历元（${epochs.size} 组）；位置属于本历元直到下一历元"
            else "GNSS 配对时间：仅有回调到达时间，使用近邻窗口；不能确定精确接收机历元"

        val manager = context.locationManager
        val locationEnabled = runCatching { manager?.isLocationEnabled }.getOrNull()
        val gpsEnabled = runCatching { manager?.isProviderEnabled(LocationManager.GPS_PROVIDER) }.getOrNull()
        lines += "availability: isLocationEnabled=$locationEnabled gpsProviderEnabled=$gpsEnabled " +
            "sampledAvailability=${context.snapshot.availability.size}"
        lines += "可用性是当前状态；缓存位置不因 provider 后来关闭而成为无效样本"

        val discrepancies = window.discrepancies
        lines += discrepancies
        if (issues.isEmpty() && discrepancies.isNotEmpty()) {
            return unknown("同时间窗 GPS extras 与 GnssStatus 存在差异，需核对接收机输出语义和时序", limited(lines))
        }
        return if (issues.isEmpty()) {
            pass("已提供的 Location 字段取值有效；可选字段缺失不构成异常。", limited(lines))
        } else {
            fail("Location 字段非法/矛盾 ${issues.size} 项：${issues.take(3).joinToString("；")}", limited(lines + issues))
        }
    }

    /** Read only supplied optional fields, including API 34 getters which throw when absent. */
    private fun suppliedFields(location: Location): Map<String, Double> = buildMap {
        val extras = location.extras
        for (key in listOf("satellites", "meanCn0", "maxCn0")) {
            if (extras?.containsKey(key) == true) put(key, if (key == "satellites")
                extras.getInt(key).toDouble() else extras.getFloat(key).toDouble())
        }
        if (location.hasAccuracy()) put("accuracy", location.accuracy.toDouble())
        if (location.hasAltitude()) put("altitude", location.altitude)
        if (location.hasVerticalAccuracy()) put("verticalAccuracy", location.verticalAccuracyMeters.toDouble())
        if (location.hasSpeed()) put("speed", location.speed.toDouble())
        if (location.hasSpeedAccuracy()) put("speedAccuracy", location.speedAccuracyMetersPerSecond.toDouble())
        if (location.hasBearing()) put("bearing", location.bearing.toDouble())
        if (location.hasBearingAccuracy()) put("bearingAccuracy", location.bearingAccuracyDegrees.toDouble())
        if (location.hasElapsedRealtimeUncertaintyNanos()) put("elapsedUncertainty", location.elapsedRealtimeUncertaintyNanos)
        if (Build.VERSION.SDK_INT >= Build.VERSION_CODES.UPSIDE_DOWN_CAKE) {
            if (location.hasMslAltitude()) put("mslAltitude", location.mslAltitudeMeters)
            if (location.hasMslAltitudeAccuracy()) put("mslAccuracy", location.mslAltitudeAccuracyMeters.toDouble())
        }
    }

    private fun limited(lines: List<String>): List<String> =
        lines.take(MAX_EVIDENCE_LINES).map { it.replace('\n', ' ').take(MAX_EVIDENCE_CHARS) }

    private companion object {
        const val MAX_EVIDENCE_LINES = 20
        const val MAX_EVIDENCE_CHARS = 299
    }
}

internal data class LocationFieldSample(val provider: String?, val timeMillis: Long,
    val latitude: Double, val longitude: Double, val supplied: Map<String, Double>)

internal data class LocationWindowResult(val issues: List<String>, val discrepancies: List<String>,
    val gpsExtrasCount: Int, val comparedGpsCount: Int)

internal object LocationWindowValidation {
    fun evaluate(samples: List<LocationFieldSample>, frames: List<GnssFrameSnapshot>,
        epochs: List<GnssStatusEpoch>? = null): LocationWindowResult {
        val issues = linkedSetOf<String>()
        val discrepancies = linkedSetOf<String>()
        var gpsExtrasCount = 0
        var comparedGpsCount = 0
        samples.forEach { sample ->
            issues += LocationFieldValidation.issues(sample.latitude, sample.longitude, sample.supplied)
                .map { "${sample.provider}@${sample.timeMillis}: $it" }
            if (sample.provider == "gps" && sample.supplied.keys.any { it in GNSS_KEYS }) {
                gpsExtrasCount++
                if (LocationGnssReconciliation.frameFor(sample.timeMillis, frames, epochs) != null) comparedGpsCount++
            }
            discrepancies += LocationGnssReconciliation.compare(sample.provider, sample.timeMillis, sample.supplied, frames, epochs)
        }
        return LocationWindowResult(issues.toList(), discrepancies.toList(), gpsExtrasCount, comparedGpsCount)
    }

    private val GNSS_KEYS = setOf("satellites", "meanCn0", "maxCn0")
}

/** Independent numeric validation, deliberately separate from production sanitization. */
internal object LocationFieldValidation {
    fun issues(latitude: Double, longitude: Double, supplied: Map<String, Double>): List<String> {
        val issues = mutableListOf<String>()
        if (!latitude.isFinite() || latitude !in -90.0..90.0) issues += "纬度非法"
        if (!longitude.isFinite() || longitude !in -180.0..180.0) issues += "经度非法"
        supplied.forEach { (name, value) ->
            val valid = value.isFinite() && when (name) {
                "altitude", "mslAltitude" -> true
                "bearing" -> value >= 0 && value < 360
                "meanCn0", "maxCn0" -> value in 0.0..63.0
                "satellites" -> value >= 0 && value % 1.0 == 0.0
                else -> value >= 0
            }
            if (!valid) issues += "$name 字段非法：$value"
        }
        val mean = supplied["meanCn0"]
        val max = supplied["maxCn0"]
        if (mean != null && max != null && mean > max) issues += "meanCn0 超过 maxCn0"
        return issues
    }
}

/** Contemporaneous GPS-only comparison; network and stale status cannot contradict GPS extras. */
internal object LocationGnssReconciliation {
    fun frameFor(timeMillis: Long, frames: List<GnssFrameSnapshot>, epochs: List<GnssStatusEpoch>?): GnssFrameSnapshot? {
        if (epochs == null) return nearestFrame(timeMillis, frames)
        // Epochs define causal intervals. Selecting by the value of an extras field would hide
        // contradictions; selecting the nearest arrival incorrectly chooses future epochs.
        return epochs.lastOrNull { it.timeMillis <= timeMillis }
            ?.takeIf { timeMillis - it.timeMillis <= 1000 }?.frame
    }

    fun nearestFrame(timeMillis: Long, frames: List<GnssFrameSnapshot>): GnssFrameSnapshot? {
        if (timeMillis <= 0) return null
        return frames.minByOrNull { abs(it.capturedAtMillis - timeMillis) }
            ?.takeIf { abs(it.capturedAtMillis - timeMillis) <= 1000 }
    }

    fun compare(provider: String?, timeMillis: Long, extras: Map<String, Double>,
        frames: List<GnssFrameSnapshot>, epochs: List<GnssStatusEpoch>? = null): List<String> {
        if (provider != "gps" || timeMillis <= 0) return emptyList()
        val frame = frameFor(timeMillis, frames, epochs) ?: return emptyList()
        val used = frame.satellites.filter { it.usedInFix }
        val uniqueUsed = used.map { it.constellation to it.svid }.toSet().size
        val differences = mutableListOf<String>()
        extras["satellites"]?.let { count ->
            if (count != uniqueUsed.toDouble()) differences +=
                "GPS extras satellites=$count，同时间窗 GnssStatus 唯一在用=$uniqueUsed（差 ${abs(frame.capturedAtMillis - timeMillis)}ms）"
        }
        // A multiband receiver may choose one band per spacecraft for its extras. Do not average
        // all signal records and then mistake that value for a universal platform contract.
        val minimum = used.minOfOrNull { it.cn0DbHz.toDouble() }
        val maximum = used.maxOfOrNull { it.cn0DbHz.toDouble() }
        for (key in listOf("meanCn0", "maxCn0")) {
            val value = extras[key] ?: continue
            if (minimum != null && maximum != null && value !in minimum..maximum)
                differences += "GPS extras $key=$value 超出同时间窗在用信号范围 $minimum..$maximum"
            if (used.isEmpty() && value > 0)
                differences += "GPS extras $key=$value，但同时间窗 GnssStatus 没有在用信号"
        }
        return differences
    }
}
```

`detector/src/main/java/com/system/location/service/detector/checks/NetworkChecks.kt`:

```kt
package com.system.location.service.detector.checks

import android.location.Location
import android.telephony.TelephonyManager
import com.system.location.service.detector.model.Check
import com.system.location.service.detector.model.CheckContext
import com.system.location.service.detector.model.CheckIds
import com.system.location.service.detector.model.CheckResult
import org.json.JSONObject
import java.net.HttpURLConnection
import java.net.URL
import java.util.Locale
import java.util.TimeZone
import kotlin.math.abs
import kotlin.math.asin
import kotlin.math.cos
import kotlin.math.sin
import kotlin.math.sqrt

/**
 * C15 · 出口 IP / 时区 / locale / carrier 与坐标的一致性。
 *
 * 判定口径：
 * - 无 primaryLocation → UNKNOWN。
 * - 时区偏移与 round(经度/15) 的差（按 24h 归一化，避免日界线误判）|差| >=5 h → FAIL；
 *   1–4 h 只记 evidence，不 FAIL（时区可能是政治性的）。
 * - locale/SIM country/network country 只记录：没有可靠的坐标映射，不据此判 FAIL。
 * - 出口 IP 默认关闭；开启后只请求一次，连接/读取各 3 秒。距离 >500 km → FAIL；
 *   请求失败或明文 HTTP 被系统策略阻止 → UNKNOWN 子项并说明。
 */
class NetworkConsistencyCheck : Check {
    override val id = CheckIds.NETWORK_CONSISTENCY
    override val title = "网络/时区/carrier 一致性"

    override fun run(context: CheckContext): CheckResult = try {
        val location = context.snapshot.primaryLocation
        if (location == null) {
            return unknown(
                "无定位样本，无法比较时区/locale/出口 IP 与坐标的一致性。",
                listOf("primaryLocation=null"),
            )
        }

        val evidence = mutableListOf<String>()
        val failures = mutableListOf<String>()

        val zone = TimeZone.getDefault()
        val offsetHours = zone.getOffset(System.currentTimeMillis()) / 3_600_000.0
        val expectedHours = Math.round(location.longitude / 15.0).toInt()
        val deltaHours = normalizeHours(offsetHours - expectedHours)
        val absDelta = abs(deltaHours)
        addNetworkEvidence(
            evidence,
            "时区：${zone.id} offset=${formatSignedHours(offsetHours)}h，经度 " +
                "${formatNetworkDouble(location.longitude)}° 期望 ${expectedHours}h，" +
                "差 ${formatSignedHours(deltaHours)}h",
        )
        when {
            absDelta >= NETWORK_TIMEZONE_FAIL_HOURS -> failures +=
                "时区偏移与经度期望差 ${formatNetworkDouble(absDelta)}h（>=5h；阈值已放宽，仍可能因政治性时区误判）"
            absDelta >= 1.0 -> addNetworkEvidence(
                evidence,
                "  时区差 ${formatNetworkDouble(absDelta)}h（1–4h，时区可能政治性，仅记录不判 FAIL）",
            )
        }

        val locale = Locale.getDefault()
        addNetworkEvidence(evidence, "locale=${locale.toLanguageTag()}")
        val telephony = context.context.getSystemService(TelephonyManager::class.java)
        val simCountry = runCatching { telephony?.simCountryIso }.getOrNull()?.takeIf { it.isNotBlank() }
        val networkCountry = runCatching { telephony?.networkCountryIso }.getOrNull()?.takeIf { it.isNotBlank() }
        addNetworkEvidence(
            evidence,
            "SIM country=${simCountry ?: "不可用"}，network country=${networkCountry ?: "不可用"}" +
                "（无可靠坐标映射，不据此判 FAIL）",
        )

        if (!context.settings.checkNetworkIp) {
            addNetworkEvidence(evidence, "出口 IP：未开启（settings.checkNetworkIp=false），未发起任何网络请求")
            return if (failures.isNotEmpty()) {
                fail("网络/时区一致性异常：${failures.joinToString("；").take(240)}", evidence)
            } else {
                pass("时区与坐标自洽（IP 检查未开启；locale/carrier 仅记录）。", evidence)
            }
        }

        addNetworkEvidence(evidence, "出口 IP：已开启，本轮只查询一次（连接/读取各 3 s 超时，HTTPS）")

        val fetched = fetchIpLocation()
        if (fetched.isFailure) {
            val error = fetched.exceptionOrNull()
            addNetworkEvidence(
                evidence,
                "  查询失败：${error?.javaClass?.simpleName ?: "?"}: " +
                    "${(error?.message ?: "").replace('\n', ' ').take(140)}",
            )
            return if (failures.isNotEmpty()) {
                fail("网络/时区一致性异常：${failures.joinToString("；").take(240)}", evidence)
            } else {
                unknown("IP 检查已开启但查询失败，无法比较出口 IP 与坐标；时区/locale 已检查。", evidence)
            }
        }

        val ip = fetched.getOrNull()
        if (ip == null) {
            return unknown("IP 查询返回空结果，无法比较出口 IP 与坐标。", evidence)
        }
        val distanceKm = networkHaversineMeters(
            ip.latitude,
            ip.longitude,
            location.latitude,
            location.longitude,
        ) / 1000.0
        addNetworkEvidence(
            evidence,
            "  结果：country=${ip.countryCode}，坐标 (${formatNetworkDouble(ip.latitude)}, " +
                "${formatNetworkDouble(ip.longitude)})，与定位距离 ${formatNetworkDouble(distanceKm)} km",
        )
        if (distanceKm > NETWORK_MAX_IP_DISTANCE_KM) {
            failures += "出口 IP 与定位相距 ${formatNetworkDouble(distanceKm)} km（>500 km）"
        }

        return if (failures.isNotEmpty()) {
            fail("网络/时区一致性异常：${failures.joinToString("；").take(240)}", evidence)
        } else {
            pass(
                "时区与坐标自洽；出口 IP country=${ip.countryCode} 与定位相距 " +
                    "${formatNetworkDouble(distanceKm)} km（<=500 km）；locale/carrier 仅记录。",
                evidence,
            )
        }
    } catch (error: Throwable) {
        unknown(
            "C15 检查异常：${error.javaClass.simpleName}: ${error.message}",
            listOf("异常：${error.javaClass.simpleName}"),
        )
    }
}

private data class IpLocation(
    val countryCode: String,
    val latitude: Double,
    val longitude: Double,
)

/**
 * Single HTTPS request to ipinfo.io. The response is parsed in memory and never written to disk or
 * logs; the connection is always disconnected.
 */
private fun fetchIpLocation(): Result<IpLocation> = runCatching {
    val connection = (URL(IP_API_URL).openConnection() as HttpURLConnection).apply {
        requestMethod = "GET"
        connectTimeout = IP_API_TIMEOUT_MS
        readTimeout = IP_API_TIMEOUT_MS
        useCaches = false
        instanceFollowRedirects = false
        setRequestProperty("Accept", "application/json")
    }
    try {
        val code = connection.responseCode
        check(code in 200..299) { "HTTP $code" }
        val body = connection.inputStream.bufferedReader(Charsets.UTF_8).use { reader ->
            val builder = StringBuilder()
            val buffer = CharArray(512)
            var total = 0
            while (total < IP_API_MAX_RESPONSE_CHARS) {
                val count = reader.read(buffer, 0, minOf(buffer.size, IP_API_MAX_RESPONSE_CHARS - total))
                if (count <= 0) break
                builder.append(buffer, 0, count)
                total += count
            }
            builder.toString()
        }
        val json = JSONObject(body)
        val loc = json.optString("loc")
        val parts = loc.split(',')
        check(parts.size == 2) { "loc 字段缺失或格式异常：$loc" }
        val latitude = parts[0].trim().toDoubleOrNull() ?: Double.NaN
        val longitude = parts[1].trim().toDoubleOrNull() ?: Double.NaN
        check(latitude.isFinite() && longitude.isFinite()) { "lat/lon 无效" }
        IpLocation(
            countryCode = json.optString("country").ifBlank { "?" },
            latitude = latitude,
            longitude = longitude,
        )
    } finally {
        connection.disconnect()
    }
}

private fun networkHaversineMeters(
    latitude1: Double,
    longitude1: Double,
    latitude2: Double,
    longitude2: Double,
): Double {
    val lat1 = Math.toRadians(latitude1)
    val lat2 = Math.toRadians(latitude2)
    val deltaLat = lat2 - lat1
    val deltaLon = Math.toRadians(longitude2 - longitude1)
    val h = sin(deltaLat / 2) * sin(deltaLat / 2) +
        cos(lat1) * cos(lat2) * sin(deltaLon / 2) * sin(deltaLon / 2)
    return 2 * 6_371_000.0 * asin(sqrt(h.coerceIn(0.0, 1.0)))
}

/** Normalizes a UTC-offset difference to [-12, 12] hours so the date line is not a false FAIL. */
private fun normalizeHours(value: Double): Double {
    var hours = value % 24.0
    if (hours > 12.0) hours -= 24.0
    if (hours < -12.0) hours += 24.0
    return hours
}

private fun addNetworkEvidence(evidence: MutableList<String>, line: String) {
    if (evidence.size < NETWORK_MAX_EVIDENCE_LINES) {
        evidence += line.take(NETWORK_MAX_EVIDENCE_CHARS)
    }
}

private fun formatNetworkDouble(value: Double): String =
    if (!value.isFinite()) value.toString() else String.format(Locale.US, "%.2f", value)

private fun formatSignedHours(value: Double): String {
    val text = formatNetworkDouble(value)
    return if (value > 0.0) "+$text" else text
}

private const val IP_API_URL = "https://ipinfo.io/json"
private const val IP_API_TIMEOUT_MS = 3_000
private const val IP_API_MAX_RESPONSE_CHARS = 4_096
private const val NETWORK_TIMEZONE_FAIL_HOURS = 5.0
private const val NETWORK_MAX_IP_DISTANCE_KM = 500.0
private const val NETWORK_MAX_EVIDENCE_LINES = 20
private const val NETWORK_MAX_EVIDENCE_CHARS = 299

```

`detector/src/main/java/com/system/location/service/detector/checks/NmeaChecks.kt`:

```kt
package com.system.location.service.detector.checks

import android.location.GnssStatus
import com.system.location.service.detector.model.Check
import com.system.location.service.detector.model.CheckContext
import com.system.location.service.detector.model.CheckIds
import com.system.location.service.detector.model.CheckResult
import com.system.location.service.detector.model.NmeaSentenceSnapshot
import com.system.location.service.detector.model.SampleSnapshot
import com.system.location.service.detector.model.GnssFrameSnapshot
import java.text.SimpleDateFormat
import java.util.Date
import java.util.Locale
import kotlin.math.abs

/** NMEA carries the receiver epoch; GnssStatus only carries callback arrival time. */
internal data class GnssStatusEpoch(val timeMillis: Long, val frame: GnssFrameSnapshot)

internal fun nmeaStatusEpochs(snapshot: SampleSnapshot): List<GnssStatusEpoch> {
    val parsed = parseAll(snapshot.nmeaSentences).parsed
    val bursts = groupGsvBursts(parsed.filter { it.type == "GSV" })
        .filter { it.anchorMillis > 0 && it.isComplete() && validateGsvBursts(listOf(it)).issues.isEmpty() }
    // An empty sky has GGA quality=0 but no GSV. Its zero extras still require comparison.
    // Prefer the fix sentence's epoch; use complete GSV only when GGA is unavailable.
    val fixes = parsed.filter { it.type == "GGA" && it.fields.size >= 14 && it.timestampMillis > 0 }
    val anchors = (if (fixes.isNotEmpty()) fixes.map { it.timestampMillis } else bursts.map { it.anchorMillis })
        .distinct().sorted()
    return anchors.mapNotNull { epoch ->
        val frame = LocationGnssReconciliation.nearestFrame(epoch, snapshot.gnssFrames)
            ?: return@mapNotNull null
        // Missing callbacks must not let two receiver epochs claim the same status frame.
        if (anchors.minByOrNull { abs(it - frame.capturedAtMillis) } != epoch) return@mapNotNull null
        GnssStatusEpoch(epoch, frame)
    }.sortedBy { it.timeMillis }
}

/**
 * C07 · NMEA 自洽性。
 *
 * 期望：GGA/RMC/GSA/GSV 校验和正确；GGA 在用数不超过同时间窗 GSV 可见数；
 * talker ID 与星座匹配，且定位状态（GGA quality / RMC status）与位置样本不矛盾。
 *
 * 解析规则：`$` + talker+type + 逗号分隔字段 + `*HH`，按 NMEA 0183 XOR 校验和验证。
 * 完全没有 NMEA 时返回 UNKNOWN（未启用或未获得输出），
 * 语句类型不足时 UNKNOWN；校验和错误、无法解析或交叉校验矛盾时 FAIL。
 */
class NmeaCheck : Check {
    override val id = CheckIds.NMEA
    override val title = "NMEA 语句"

    override fun run(context: CheckContext): CheckResult = evaluate(context.snapshot)

    internal fun evaluate(snapshot: SampleSnapshot): CheckResult {
        val rawSentences = snapshot.nmeaSentences
        if (rawSentences.isEmpty()) {
            return unknown(
                "未收到任何 NMEA 语句：设备可能未启用 NMEA 输出、缺少定位权限或 NMEA 监听注册失败",
                emptyEvidence(snapshot),
            )
        }

        val summary = parseAll(rawSentences)
        val analysis = analyze(snapshot, summary)
        val evidence = buildEvidence(snapshot, analysis)
        if (analysis.issues.isEmpty()) {
            val missing = REQUIRED_TYPES.filter { analysis.typeCounts[it] == 0 }
            if (missing.isNotEmpty()) return unknown(
                "未收到 ${missing.joinToString("/")}，现有语句未见硬性矛盾，完整自洽性证据不足", evidence,
            )
            if (analysis.comparisons.isEmpty()) return unknown(
                "已收到语句，但没有覆盖完整星座的同时间窗 GGA/GSV 配对，无法完成数量对账", evidence,
            )
            if (analysis.gsvVsGnssDiff?.let { it > 0 } == true || analysis.sourceConcerns.isNotEmpty()) return unknown(
                "NMEA 与 GnssStatus 存在同时间窗差异，需核对信号覆盖和回调时序", evidence + analysis.sourceConcerns,
            )
            return pass(
                "NMEA 自洽：可解析 ${summary.parsed.size}/${rawSentences.size} 句，GGA/RMC/GSA/GSV 已收到，" +
                    "校验和正确，可比较的在用数/可见数未见矛盾，talker 与星座匹配",
                evidence,
            )
        }
        return fail(analysis.issues.joinToString("；"), evidence)
    }

    private fun analyze(snapshot: SampleSnapshot, summary: ParseSummary): NmeaAnalysis {
        val parsed = summary.parsed
        val byType = parsed.groupBy { it.type }
        val typeCounts = TYPE_ORDER.associateWith { type -> byType[type]?.size ?: 0 }
        val talkerCounts = parsed.groupingBy { it.talker }.eachCount().toSortedMap()
        val ggaList = byType["GGA"].orEmpty()
        val rmcList = byType["RMC"].orEmpty()
        val gsaList = byType["GSA"].orEmpty()
        val gsvList = byType["GSV"].orEmpty()
        val gstList = byType["GST"].orEmpty()
        val zdaList = byType["ZDA"].orEmpty()

        val issues = mutableListOf<String>()
        val sourceConcerns = mutableListOf<String>()
        if (summary.checksumFailures.isNotEmpty()) {
            issues += "NMEA 校验和错误 ${summary.checksumFailures.size} 条"
        }
        if (summary.unparsable.isNotEmpty()) {
            issues += "NMEA 无法解析 ${summary.unparsable.size} 条"
        }

        val ggaSatellites = ggaList.mapNotNull { sentence ->
            sentence.fields.getOrNull(6)?.trim()?.toIntOrNull()
        }
        val ggaQualities = ggaList.mapNotNull { sentence ->
            sentence.fields.getOrNull(5)?.trim()?.toIntOrNull()
        }
        val latestGgaQuality = ggaList.lastOrNull()?.fields?.getOrNull(5)?.trim()?.toIntOrNull()
        val latestRmcStatus = rmcList.lastOrNull()?.fields?.getOrNull(1)?.trim()?.uppercase(Locale.US)

        val latestGst = gstList.lastOrNull()
        if (latestGst != null) {
            val utc = latestGst.fields.getOrNull(0)?.trim()
            val sameInstantGga = ggaList.lastOrNull { it.timestampMillis == latestGst.timestampMillis }
            val ggaUtc = sameInstantGga?.fields?.getOrNull(0)?.toDoubleOrNull()
            if (ggaUtc != null && utc?.toDoubleOrNull() != ggaUtc) {
                issues += "GST 与同刻 GGA UTC 不一致"
            }
            val errors = latestGst.fields.drop(5).mapNotNull { it.trim().toDoubleOrNull() }
            if (errors.size < 3 || errors.any { it < 0.0 || !it.isFinite() }) {
                issues += "GST 误差字段缺失或为负"
            }
        }
        val latestZda = zdaList.lastOrNull()
        if (latestZda != null) {
            val utc = latestZda.fields.getOrNull(0)?.trim()
            val sameInstantGga = ggaList.lastOrNull { it.timestampMillis == latestZda.timestampMillis }
            val ggaUtc = sameInstantGga?.fields?.getOrNull(0)?.toDoubleOrNull()
            if (ggaUtc != null && utc?.toDoubleOrNull() != ggaUtc) {
                issues += "ZDA 与同刻 GGA UTC 不一致"
            }
            val day = latestZda.fields.getOrNull(1)?.trim()?.toIntOrNull()
            val month = latestZda.fields.getOrNull(2)?.trim()?.toIntOrNull()
            val year = latestZda.fields.getOrNull(3)?.trim()?.toIntOrNull()
            if (day !in 1..31 || month !in 1..12 || year == null || year < 2000) {
                issues += "ZDA 日期字段非法（$day/$month/$year）"
            }
        }

        ggaList.forEach { gga ->
            val countField = gga.fields.getOrNull(6)?.trim()
            val used = countField?.toIntOrNull()
            val quality = gga.fields.getOrNull(5)?.trim()?.toIntOrNull()
            // Some real receivers emit $GPGGA,,,,,,0,,,,,,,,*66 before obtaining a fix.
            // An explicit null field is unavailable evidence; never coerce it to a measured zero.
            val unavailable = quality == 0 && countField == ""
            if ((!unavailable && used == null) || (used != null && used < 0) || quality == null || quality !in 0..8)
                issues += "GGA 卫星数或定位质量字段非法"
            if (unavailable) sourceConcerns += "GGA 无解且卫星数未提供，不能完成该历元的数量对账"
            if (quality == 0 && used != null && used > 0) issues += "GGA 无解却声明 $used 颗卫星参与定位"
            // Network/cached/mock Location can coexist with no current GNSS fix.
            val gsa = gsaList.filter { it.timestampMillis == gga.timestampMillis }
            if (quality != null && quality > 0 && gsa.any { it.fields.getOrNull(1) == "3" } && used != null && used < 4)
                issues += "GSA 声明三维定位，但同刻 GGA 仅 $used 颗卫星在用"
        }
        gsaList.forEach { gsa ->
            val fix = gsa.fields.getOrNull(1)?.toIntOrNull()
            val dop = gsa.fields.drop(14).take(3)
            if (fix !in 1..3) issues += "GSA 定位类型非法"
            if (fix in 2..3 && (dop.size != 3 || dop.any { it.toDoubleOrNull()?.let { value -> value.isFinite() && value > 0 } != true }))
                issues += "GSA 有解但 DOP 缺失或无效"
        }

        val bursts = groupGsvBursts(parsed)
        val validation = validateGsvBursts(bursts)
        issues += validation.issues
        val burstTotals = bursts.mapNotNull { it.satelliteTotal() }

        gsaList.forEach { gsa ->
            val slots = gsa.fields.drop(2).take(12).filter(String::isNotBlank)
            if (slots.isEmpty()) return@forEach
            val systemTalker = if (gsa.talker == "GN") SYSTEM_ID_TALKERS[gsa.fields.getOrNull(17)?.toIntOrNull()]
                else gsa.talker.takeIf { it in TALKER_PRN_RANGES }
            if (systemTalker == null) {
                sourceConcerns += "GSA 卫星编号缺少可确定的星座信息，未猜测 GN 混合编号"
                return@forEach
            }
            val ranges = TALKER_PRN_RANGES.getValue(systemTalker)
            val numbers = slots.map { it.toIntOrNull() }
            if (numbers.any { number -> number == null || ranges.none { number in it } }) {
                issues += "GSA 在用卫星编号与星座不匹配或不是整数"
                return@forEach
            }
            val identities = numbers.mapNotNull { gsvIdentity(systemTalker, it!!) }
            if (identities.distinct().size != identities.size) issues += "单条 GSA 重复声明同一在用卫星"
            val burst = nearestBurst(bursts, gsa)
            if (burst != null) {
                val visible = burst.sentences.flatMap { sentence -> gsvSatelliteGroups(sentence).mapNotNull { group ->
                    group.firstOrNull()?.toIntOrNull()?.let { gsvIdentity(sentence.talker, it) }
                } }.toSet()
                val missing = identities.filter { it !in visible }
                if (missing.isNotEmpty()) sourceConcerns += "GSA 在用身份未见于同时间窗完整 GSV：${missing.take(3)}"
            }
            val status = snapshot.gnssFrames.minByOrNull { abs(it.capturedAtMillis - gsa.timestampMillis) }
                ?.takeIf { gsa.timestampMillis > 0 && abs(it.capturedAtMillis - gsa.timestampMillis) <= 1000 }
            if (status != null) {
                val used = status.satellites.filter { it.usedInFix }.mapNotNull { satellite ->
                    STATUS_SYSTEM_NAMES[satellite.constellation]?.let { it to satellite.svid }
                }.toSet()
                if (identities.any { it !in used }) sourceConcerns += "GSA 在用身份与同时间窗 GnssStatus 的 usedInFix 不一致"
            }
        }

        val comparisons = ggaList.mapNotNull { gga ->
            val ggaCount = gga.fields.getOrNull(6)?.trim()?.toIntOrNull() ?: return@mapNotNull null
            val burst = nearestBurst(bursts, gga) ?: return@mapNotNull null
            val gsvTotal = burst.satelliteTotal() ?: return@mapNotNull null
            if (gga.talker == "GN" && ggaCount > 0) {
                val usedSystems = gsaList.filter {
                    abs(it.timestampMillis - gga.timestampMillis) <= 1000 &&
                        it.fields.drop(2).take(12).any(String::isNotBlank)
                }.map { it.fields.getOrNull(17)?.toIntOrNull() ?: TALKER_SYSTEM_IDS[it.talker] }
                val represented = burst.sentences.mapNotNull { TALKER_SYSTEM_IDS[it.talker] }.toSet()
                if (usedSystems.isEmpty() || usedSystems.any { it == null || it !in represented })
                    return@mapNotNull null
            } else if (gga.talker != "GN" && burst.sentences.any { it.talker != gga.talker }) {
                // System-specific GGA cannot be compared with a combined total.
                return@mapNotNull null
            }
            GgaGsvPair(ggaCount, gsvTotal, ggaCount - gsvTotal)
        }
        val maxGgaGsvDiff = comparisons.maxOfOrNull { it.diff }
        if (maxGgaGsvDiff != null && maxGgaGsvDiff > 0) {
            issues += "同时间窗 GGA 在用数超过 GSV 可见数（最多 $maxGgaGsvDiff 颗）"
        }

        val latestGsvTotal = bursts.lastOrNull { it.isComplete() }?.satelliteTotal()
            ?: bursts.lastOrNull()?.satelliteTotal()
        var gsvVsGnssDiff: Int? = null
        val latestBurst = bursts.lastOrNull { it.isComplete() }
        var matchedFrameCount: Int? = null
        var gsvStatusPairs = 0
        var gsvIdentityDifferences = 0
        var maxGsvStatusCountDifference = 0
        bursts.filter { it.isComplete() }.forEach { burst ->
            val frame = LocationGnssReconciliation.nearestFrame(burst.anchorMillis, snapshot.gnssFrames)
                ?: return@forEach
            // A talker may report only some constellations/signals. Compare only represented systems.
            val identities = burst.identities() ?: return@forEach // GN-only IDs remain ambiguous.
            val represented = burst.sentences.flatMap { TALKER_CONSTELLATIONS[it.talker].orEmpty() }
                .mapNotNull { STATUS_SYSTEM_NAMES[it] }.toSet() + identities.map { it.first }
            val statusIdentities = frame.satellites.mapNotNull { satellite ->
                STATUS_SYSTEM_NAMES[satellite.constellation]?.takeIf { it in represented }?.let { it to satellite.svid }
            }.toSet()
            val difference = abs(statusIdentities.size - identities.size)
            gsvStatusPairs++
            maxGsvStatusCountDifference = maxOf(maxGsvStatusCountDifference, difference)
            if (statusIdentities != identities) gsvIdentityDifferences++
            if (burst === latestBurst) {
                matchedFrameCount = statusIdentities.size
                gsvVsGnssDiff = difference
            }
        }
        if (gsvIdentityDifferences > 0) sourceConcerns +=
            "完整 GSV 与同时间窗 GnssStatus 可见身份存在差异：$gsvIdentityDifferences/$gsvStatusPairs 组，最大数量差 $maxGsvStatusCountDifference"

        val gsaMismatches = gsaList.mapNotNull { gsa ->
            val systemId = gsa.fields.getOrNull(17)?.trim()?.toIntOrNull() ?: return@mapNotNull null
            val expected = TALKER_SYSTEM_IDS[gsa.talker] ?: return@mapNotNull null
            if (systemId == expected) null else "${gsa.talker}GSA systemId=$systemId（应为 $expected）"
        }
        if (gsaMismatches.isNotEmpty()) {
            issues += "talker 与 GSA systemId 不匹配：${gsaMismatches.take(2).joinToString("，")}"
        }

        val prnMismatches = mutableListOf<String>()
        gsvList.forEach { sentence ->
            val ranges = TALKER_PRN_RANGES[sentence.talker] ?: return@forEach
            val invalid = gsvSatelliteGroups(sentence)
                .mapNotNull { group -> group.firstOrNull()?.trim()?.toIntOrNull() }
                .filter { prn -> ranges.none { prn in it } }
            if (invalid.isNotEmpty()) {
                prnMismatches += "${sentence.talker}GSV 含 PRN ${invalid.take(3).joinToString("/")}"
            }
        }
        if (prnMismatches.isNotEmpty()) {
            issues += "talker 与卫星 PRN 不匹配：${prnMismatches.take(2).joinToString("，")}"
        }

        return NmeaAnalysis(
            rawCount = rawSentencesCount(snapshot),
            parsedCount = parsed.size,
            checksumFailures = summary.checksumFailures,
            unparsable = summary.unparsable,
            typeCounts = typeCounts,
            talkerCounts = talkerCounts,
            ggaSatellites = ggaSatellites,
            ggaQualities = ggaQualities,
            latestGgaQuality = latestGgaQuality,
            latestRmcStatus = latestRmcStatus,
            firstGgaUtc = ggaList.firstOrNull()?.fields?.getOrNull(0)?.trim()?.takeIf { it.isNotEmpty() },
            lastGgaUtc = ggaList.lastOrNull()?.fields?.getOrNull(0)?.trim()?.takeIf { it.isNotEmpty() },
            latestRmcDateTime = rmcList.lastOrNull()?.let { rmc ->
                val time = rmc.fields.getOrNull(0)?.trim().orEmpty()
                val date = rmc.fields.getOrNull(8)?.trim().orEmpty()
                listOf(date, time).filter { it.isNotEmpty() }.joinToString(" ").takeIf { it.isNotEmpty() }
            },
            bursts = bursts,
            boundaryBursts = validation.boundaryBursts,
            burstTotals = burstTotals,
            comparisons = comparisons,
            maxGgaGsvDiff = maxGgaGsvDiff,
            latestGsvTotal = latestGsvTotal,
            latestFrameCount = matchedFrameCount,
            gsvVsGnssDiff = gsvVsGnssDiff,
            gsvStatusPairs = gsvStatusPairs,
            gsvIdentityDifferences = gsvIdentityDifferences,
            maxGsvStatusCountDifference = maxGsvStatusCountDifference,
            issues = issues,
            sourceConcerns = sourceConcerns,
        )
    }

    private fun rawSentencesCount(snapshot: SampleSnapshot): Int = snapshot.nmeaSentences.size

    private fun buildEvidence(snapshot: SampleSnapshot, analysis: NmeaAnalysis): List<String> {
        val evidence = mutableListOf<String>()
        val durationSeconds = ((snapshot.endedAtMillis - snapshot.startedAtMillis).coerceAtLeast(0L)) / 1000
        evidence += "采样窗口 ${formatTime(snapshot.startedAtMillis)}–${formatTime(snapshot.endedAtMillis)}" +
            "（${durationSeconds}s）；原始 ${analysis.rawCount} 句，可解析 ${analysis.parsedCount}，校验和失败 " +
            "${analysis.checksumFailures.size}，无法解析 ${analysis.unparsable.size}"
        evidence += "句数：" + TYPE_ORDER.joinToString(" ") { type -> "$type=${analysis.typeCounts[type] ?: 0}" }
        evidence += "talker：" + if (analysis.talkerCounts.isEmpty()) {
            "无"
        } else {
            analysis.talkerCounts.entries.take(12).joinToString("，") { "${it.key}=${it.value}" }
        }
        if (analysis.checksumFailures.isNotEmpty()) {
            evidence += "校验和失败样例：${analysis.checksumFailures.take(2).joinToString("；") { it.take(100) }}"
        }
        if (analysis.unparsable.isNotEmpty()) {
            evidence += "无法解析样例：${analysis.unparsable.take(2).joinToString("；") { it.take(100) }}"
        }
        evidence += "GGA 卫星数：" + if (analysis.ggaSatellites.isEmpty()) {
            "无"
        } else {
            "${analysis.ggaSatellites.minOrNull()}–${analysis.ggaSatellites.maxOrNull()}" +
                "（最新 ${analysis.ggaSatellites.last()}）"
        }
        evidence += "GGA fixQuality：${histogram(analysis.ggaQualities)}；最新 GGA quality=" +
            "${analysis.latestGgaQuality ?: "n/a"}，最新 RMC status=${analysis.latestRmcStatus ?: "n/a"}，" +
            "位置样本=${snapshot.locations.size}"
        evidence += "GGA↔GSV：" + if (analysis.comparisons.isEmpty()) {
            "无可配对"
        } else {
            val latest = analysis.comparisons.last()
            "${analysis.comparisons.size} 组，最大差 ${analysis.maxGgaGsvDiff}；最新 GGA=${latest.ggaCount}" +
                " vs 最近 GSV 合计=${latest.gsvTotal}"
        }
        evidence += "GSV：${analysis.bursts.size} 组 burst" +
            (if (analysis.boundaryBursts > 0) "（边界截断 ${analysis.boundaryBursts} 组已忽略）" else "") +
            "；各组合计 ${sampleValues(analysis.burstTotals.map { it.toString() })}；最新合计=" +
            "${analysis.latestGsvTotal ?: "n/a"}，配对 GnssStatus 对应星座唯一卫星=${analysis.latestFrameCount ?: "n/a"}" +
            (analysis.gsvVsGnssDiff?.let { "，差=$it" } ?: "")
        evidence += "NMEA UTC：GGA ${analysis.firstGgaUtc ?: "无"} → ${analysis.lastGgaUtc ?: "无"}；" +
            "RMC 最新 ${analysis.latestRmcDateTime ?: "无"}"
        evidence += "GSV↔GnssStatus：${analysis.gsvStatusPairs} 组完成同时间窗身份对账；" +
            "身份差异=${analysis.gsvIdentityDifferences} 组，最大数量差=${analysis.maxGsvStatusCountDifference}"
        return evidence.filter { it.isNotEmpty() }
            .take(MAX_EVIDENCE_LINES)
            .map { it.take(MAX_EVIDENCE_CHARS) }
    }

    private fun emptyEvidence(snapshot: SampleSnapshot): List<String> {
        val evidence = mutableListOf<String>()
        val durationSeconds = ((snapshot.endedAtMillis - snapshot.startedAtMillis).coerceAtLeast(0L)) / 1000
        evidence += "采样窗口 ${formatTime(snapshot.startedAtMillis)}–${formatTime(snapshot.endedAtMillis)}（${durationSeconds}s）"
        evidence += "NMEA 句数=0，位置样本=${snapshot.locations.size}，GnssStatus 帧数=${snapshot.gnssFrames.size}"
        val notes = snapshot.notes.filter { note ->
            note.contains("nmea", ignoreCase = true) || note.contains("gnss", ignoreCase = true)
        }
        if (notes.isNotEmpty()) {
            evidence += "采集备注：${notes.take(3).joinToString("；") { it.take(120) }}"
        }
        return evidence.map { it.take(MAX_EVIDENCE_CHARS) }
    }

    companion object {
        private const val MAX_EVIDENCE_LINES = 20
        private const val MAX_EVIDENCE_CHARS = 299
    }
}

private sealed interface ParseOutcome {
    data class Parsed(val sentence: ParsedNmea) : ParseOutcome
    data class ChecksumFailure(val raw: String) : ParseOutcome
    data class Unparsable(val raw: String) : ParseOutcome
}

private data class ParsedNmea(
    val sequence: Int,
    val timestampMillis: Long,
    val talker: String,
    val type: String,
    val fields: List<String>,
    val raw: String,
)

private data class ParseSummary(
    val parsed: List<ParsedNmea>,
    val checksumFailures: List<String>,
    val unparsable: List<String>,
)

private data class GgaGsvPair(
    val ggaCount: Int,
    val gsvTotal: Int,
    val diff: Int,
)

private data class GsvValidation(
    val issues: List<String>,
    val boundaryBursts: Int,
)

private data class NmeaAnalysis(
    val rawCount: Int,
    val parsedCount: Int,
    val checksumFailures: List<String>,
    val unparsable: List<String>,
    val typeCounts: Map<String, Int>,
    val talkerCounts: Map<String, Int>,
    val ggaSatellites: List<Int>,
    val ggaQualities: List<Int>,
    val latestGgaQuality: Int?,
    val latestRmcStatus: String?,
    val firstGgaUtc: String?,
    val lastGgaUtc: String?,
    val latestRmcDateTime: String?,
    val bursts: List<GsvBurst>,
    val boundaryBursts: Int,
    val burstTotals: List<Int>,
    val comparisons: List<GgaGsvPair>,
    val maxGgaGsvDiff: Int?,
    val latestGsvTotal: Int?,
    val latestFrameCount: Int?,
    val gsvVsGnssDiff: Int?,
    val gsvStatusPairs: Int,
    val gsvIdentityDifferences: Int,
    val maxGsvStatusCountDifference: Int,
    val issues: List<String>,
    val sourceConcerns: List<String>,
)

/** 同一接收时刻内 $xxGSV 的连续块；按卫星编号是否重置划分。 */
private class GsvBurst(
    val index: Int,
    val anchorMillis: Long,
    val firstSequence: Int,
    val sentences: MutableList<ParsedNmea> = mutableListOf(),
    val bySignal: MutableMap<String, MutableList<ParsedNmea>> = linkedMapOf(),
) {
    /** Count unique spacecraft across signals; GN-only numbering is not safely resolvable. */
    fun identities(): Set<Pair<String, Int>>? {
        val identities = sentences.flatMap { sentence ->
            gsvSatelliteGroups(sentence).mapNotNull { group ->
                val prn = group.firstOrNull()?.toIntOrNull() ?: return@mapNotNull null
                gsvIdentity(sentence.talker, prn) ?: return null
            }
        }
        return identities.toSet()
    }

    fun satelliteTotal(): Int? = identities()?.size

    fun isComplete(): Boolean {
        if (bySignal.isEmpty()) return false
        bySignal.forEach { (_, talkerSentences) ->
            val header = talkerSentences.firstOrNull() ?: return false
            val totalMessages = header.fields.getOrNull(0)?.trim()?.toIntOrNull() ?: return false
            val declaredTotal = header.fields.getOrNull(2)?.trim()?.toIntOrNull() ?: return false
            if (totalMessages <= 0 || declaredTotal < 0) return false
            val numbers = talkerSentences.mapNotNull { sentence ->
                sentence.fields.getOrNull(1)?.trim()?.toIntOrNull()
            }
            if (numbers.size != totalMessages) return false
            if (numbers.toSet() != (1..totalMessages).toSet()) return false
            if (talkerSentences.sumOf { gsvSatelliteCount(it) } != declaredTotal) return false
        }
        return true
    }
}

private val TYPE_ORDER = listOf("GGA", "RMC", "GSA", "GSV", "GST", "ZDA")
private val REQUIRED_TYPES = listOf("GGA", "RMC", "GSA", "GSV")

private val TALKER_CONSTELLATIONS = mapOf(
    "GP" to setOf(GnssStatus.CONSTELLATION_GPS, GnssStatus.CONSTELLATION_SBAS),
    "BD" to setOf(GnssStatus.CONSTELLATION_BEIDOU),
    "GB" to setOf(GnssStatus.CONSTELLATION_BEIDOU),
    "GL" to setOf(GnssStatus.CONSTELLATION_GLONASS),
    "GA" to setOf(GnssStatus.CONSTELLATION_GALILEO),
    "GQ" to setOf(GnssStatus.CONSTELLATION_QZSS),
    "GI" to setOf(GnssStatus.CONSTELLATION_IRNSS),
)

/** NMEA 4.1 GSA systemId：1=GPS、2=GLONASS、3=Galileo、4=BeiDou、5=QZSS、6=NavIC。 */
private val TALKER_SYSTEM_IDS = mapOf(
    "GP" to 1,
    "GL" to 2,
    "GA" to 3,
    "BD" to 4,
    "GQ" to 5,
    "GB" to 4,
    "GI" to 6,
)

private val SYSTEM_ID_TALKERS = mapOf(1 to "GP", 2 to "GL", 3 to "GA", 4 to "GB", 5 to "GQ", 6 to "GI")
private val STATUS_SYSTEM_NAMES = mapOf(
    GnssStatus.CONSTELLATION_GPS to "GPS", GnssStatus.CONSTELLATION_SBAS to "SBAS",
    GnssStatus.CONSTELLATION_GLONASS to "GLO", GnssStatus.CONSTELLATION_GALILEO to "GAL",
    GnssStatus.CONSTELLATION_BEIDOU to "BDS", GnssStatus.CONSTELLATION_QZSS to "QZSS",
    GnssStatus.CONSTELLATION_IRNSS to "IRNSS",
)

/**
 * 各 talker 合理的 PRN/SVID 范围（含常见厂商变体与 SBAS/QZSS 混排）。
 * 用于发现“把 BDS/Galileo 卫星塞进 GPGSV”这类明显错配，低编号区间允许重叠。
 */
private val TALKER_PRN_RANGES = mapOf(
    "GP" to listOf(1..64, 120..158, 193..200),
    "BD" to listOf(1..64, 201..235),
    "GL" to listOf(1..25, 65..96),
    "GA" to listOf(1..36, 301..336),
    "GB" to listOf(1..64, 201..235),
    "GQ" to listOf(1..10, 193..202),
    "GI" to listOf(1..14),
)

private fun parseAll(sentences: List<NmeaSentenceSnapshot>): ParseSummary {
    val parsed = mutableListOf<ParsedNmea>()
    val checksumFailures = mutableListOf<String>()
    val unparsable = mutableListOf<String>()
    sentences.forEachIndexed { index, sentence ->
        when (val outcome = parseSentence(sentence, index)) {
            is ParseOutcome.Parsed -> parsed += outcome.sentence
            is ParseOutcome.ChecksumFailure -> checksumFailures += outcome.raw
            is ParseOutcome.Unparsable -> unparsable += outcome.raw
        }
    }
    return ParseSummary(parsed, checksumFailures, unparsable)
}

private fun parseSentence(snapshot: NmeaSentenceSnapshot, sequence: Int): ParseOutcome {
    val line = snapshot.sentence.trim()
    if (line.isEmpty()) return ParseOutcome.Unparsable(snapshot.sentence)
    if (!line.startsWith('$')) return ParseOutcome.Unparsable(line)
    val body = line.substring(1)
    val star = body.lastIndexOf('*')
    if (star < 0) return ParseOutcome.Unparsable(line)
    val payload = body.substring(0, star)
    val checksumText = body.substring(star + 1).trim()
    if (checksumText.length != 2) return ParseOutcome.Unparsable(line)
    val expected = checksumText.toIntOrNull(16) ?: return ParseOutcome.ChecksumFailure(line)
    val actual = payload.fold(0) { checksum, char -> checksum xor char.code }
    if (actual != expected) return ParseOutcome.ChecksumFailure(line)
    val parts = payload.split(',')
    val sentenceId = parts.firstOrNull()?.trim()?.uppercase(Locale.US).orEmpty()
    if (sentenceId.length < 5 || sentenceId.any { it !in 'A'..'Z' }) {
        return ParseOutcome.Unparsable(line)
    }
    return ParseOutcome.Parsed(
        ParsedNmea(
            sequence = sequence,
            timestampMillis = snapshot.timestampMillis,
            talker = sentenceId.substring(0, 2),
            type = sentenceId.substring(2),
            fields = parts.drop(1),
            raw = line,
        ),
    )
}

private fun groupGsvBursts(sentences: List<ParsedNmea>): List<GsvBurst> {
    val bursts = mutableListOf<GsvBurst>()
    var current: GsvBurst? = null
    var epochMarkerSeen = false
    sentences.forEach { sentence ->
        when (sentence.type) {
            "GGA", "RMC" -> epochMarkerSeen = true
            "GSV" -> {
                val number = sentence.fields.getOrNull(1)?.trim()?.toIntOrNull()
                val signalKey = gsvSignalKey(sentence)
                val previousNumber = current?.bySignal?.get(signalKey)
                    ?.lastOrNull()?.fields?.getOrNull(1)?.trim()?.toIntOrNull()
                val restart = previousNumber != null &&
                    (number == 1 || (number != null && number <= previousNumber))
                val startNew = current == null || epochMarkerSeen || restart ||
                    abs(sentence.timestampMillis - current.anchorMillis) > 1000L
                val burst = if (startNew) {
                    GsvBurst(bursts.size, sentence.timestampMillis, sentence.sequence).also {
                        bursts += it
                        current = it
                    }
                } else {
                    checkNotNull(current)
                }
                if (startNew) epochMarkerSeen = false
                burst.sentences += sentence
                burst.bySignal.getOrPut(signalKey) { mutableListOf() } += sentence
            }
            else -> Unit
        }
    }
    return bursts
}

private fun validateGsvBursts(bursts: List<GsvBurst>): GsvValidation {
    val issues = mutableListOf<String>()
    var headerMismatches = 0
    var numberMismatches = 0
    var satelliteMismatches = 0
    var boundaryBursts = 0
    val samples = mutableListOf<String>()
    bursts.forEachIndexed { index, burst ->
        // 采样开始/结束时可能截断一整组 GSV，不当作生成器错误。
        val validHeaders = burst.sentences.all {
            val messages = it.fields.getOrNull(0)?.toIntOrNull()
            val number = it.fields.getOrNull(1)?.toIntOrNull()
            messages != null && messages > 0 && number != null && number in 1..messages &&
                (it.fields.getOrNull(2)?.toIntOrNull() ?: -1) >= 0
        }
        if (validHeaders && !burst.isComplete() && (index == 0 || index == bursts.lastIndex)) {
            boundaryBursts++
            return@forEachIndexed
        }
        burst.bySignal.forEach { (talker, talkerSentences) ->
            val header = talkerSentences.firstOrNull() ?: return@forEach
            val totalMessages = header.fields.getOrNull(0)?.trim()?.toIntOrNull()
            val declaredTotal = header.fields.getOrNull(2)?.trim()?.toIntOrNull()
            if (totalMessages == null || totalMessages <= 0 || declaredTotal == null || declaredTotal < 0) {
                headerMismatches++
                if (samples.size < 2) samples += "第 ${header.sequence + 1} 句 GSV 头字段非法"
                return@forEach
            }
            val declarationsConsistent = talkerSentences.all { sentence ->
                sentence.fields.getOrNull(0)?.trim()?.toIntOrNull() == totalMessages &&
                    sentence.fields.getOrNull(2)?.trim()?.toIntOrNull() == declaredTotal
            }
            val numbers = talkerSentences.mapNotNull { sentence ->
                sentence.fields.getOrNull(1)?.trim()?.toIntOrNull()
            }
            val numbersOk = numbers.size == totalMessages &&
                numbers.toSet() == (1..totalMessages).toSet()
            val counts = talkerSentences.map { sentence -> gsvSatelliteCount(sentence) }
            val countsOk = counts.withIndex().all { (sentenceIndex, count) ->
                when {
                    declaredTotal == 0 -> count == 0
                    sentenceIndex == counts.lastIndex -> count in 1..4
                    else -> count == 4
                }
            }
            val sumOk = counts.sum() == declaredTotal
            if (!declarationsConsistent || !numbersOk || !countsOk || !sumOk) {
                if (!declarationsConsistent) headerMismatches++
                if (!numbersOk) numberMismatches++
                if (!countsOk || !sumOk) satelliteMismatches++
                if (samples.size < 2) {
                    samples += "$talker 第 ${burst.index + 1} 组：句号 ${numbers.joinToString("/")}" +
                        "（应为 1..$totalMessages），卫星 ${counts.joinToString("+")}（头总计 $declaredTotal）"
                }
            }
        }
    }
    if (headerMismatches > 0) issues += "GSV 头字段不一致或不合法（$headerMismatches 组）"
    if (numberMismatches > 0) issues += "GSV 句数与头 totalMessages 不一致（$numberMismatches 组）"
    if (satelliteMismatches > 0) {
        val sample = if (samples.isEmpty()) "" else "，如 ${samples.first()}"
        issues += "GSV 每句卫星数与头 totalSatellitesInView 不一致（$satelliteMismatches 组$sample）"
    }
    return GsvValidation(issues, boundaryBursts)
}

private fun nearestBurst(bursts: List<GsvBurst>, gga: ParsedNmea): GsvBurst? {
    if (gga.timestampMillis <= 0L) return null
    return bursts.filter { it.isComplete() && it.anchorMillis > 0 && abs(it.anchorMillis - gga.timestampMillis) <= 1000L }
        .minByOrNull { abs(it.anchorMillis - gga.timestampMillis) }

}

/** Optional NMEA 4.x signal ID belongs to a separate message sequence. */
private fun gsvSignalKey(sentence: ParsedNmea): String {
    val payload = sentence.fields.drop(3)
    val signal = if (payload.size % 4 == 1) payload.last() else ""
    return "${sentence.talker}:$signal"
}

private fun gsvIdentity(talker: String, prn: Int): Pair<String, Int>? = when (talker) {
    "GP" -> when (prn) {
        in 1..32 -> "GPS" to prn
        in 33..64 -> "SBAS" to prn + 87
        in 120..158 -> "SBAS" to prn
        in 193..202 -> "QZSS" to prn
        else -> null
    }
    "BD", "GB" -> "BDS" to if (prn >= 201) prn - 200 else prn
    "GA" -> "GAL" to if (prn >= 301) prn - 300 else prn
    "GL" -> "GLO" to if (prn >= 65) prn - 64 else prn
    "GQ" -> "QZSS" to if (prn < 193) prn + 192 else prn
    "GI" -> "IRNSS" to prn
    else -> null // Mixed GN numbering depends on receiver version; don't invent a mapping.
}

private fun gsvSatelliteGroups(sentence: ParsedNmea): List<List<String>> {
    val payload = sentence.fields.drop(3)
    if (payload.isEmpty()) return emptyList()
    return payload.dropLast(payload.size % 4).chunked(4)
}

private fun gsvSatelliteCount(sentence: ParsedNmea): Int {
    val groups = gsvSatelliteGroups(sentence)
    if (groups.isEmpty()) return 0
    return groups.count { group -> group.firstOrNull()?.trim()?.isNotEmpty() == true }
}

private fun histogram(values: List<Int>): String {
    if (values.isEmpty()) return "无"
    return values.groupingBy { it }.eachCount().toSortedMap()
        .entries.joinToString("，") { "${it.key}=${it.value}" }
}

private fun formatTime(millis: Long): String {
    if (millis <= 0L) return "--:--:--"
    return SimpleDateFormat("HH:mm:ss.SSS", Locale.US).format(Date(millis))
}

private fun sampleValues(values: List<String>, limit: Int = 12): String {
    if (values.isEmpty()) return "无"
    if (values.size <= limit) return values.joinToString(", ")
    return values.take(limit).joinToString(", ") + " …（共 ${values.size} 组）"
}
```

`detector/src/main/java/com/system/location/service/detector/checks/PrivacyChecks.kt`:

```kt
package com.system.location.service.detector.checks

import android.app.AppOpsManager
import android.content.ContentResolver
import android.os.Process
import android.provider.Settings
import com.system.location.service.detector.model.Check
import com.system.location.service.detector.model.CheckContext
import com.system.location.service.detector.model.CheckIds
import com.system.location.service.detector.model.CheckResult

/**
 * C02 · AppOps mock_location。
 *
 * 期望：目标包（默认 Portal）的 `OP_MOCK_LOCATION` 不是 MODE_ALLOWED；同时记录 detector 自身
 * 的 AppOps 状态作为对照。`checkOpNoThrow` 失败时回退 `unsafeCheckOpNoThrow`；跨包查询不可用
 * 时返回 UNKNOWN，而不是把“查不到”当成安全。
 */
class AppOpsCheck : Check {
    override val id = CheckIds.APP_OPS
    override val title = "AppOps mock_location"
    override val blocking = true

    override fun run(context: CheckContext): CheckResult = try {
        evaluate(context)
    } catch (error: Exception) {
        unknown(
            "C02 检查异常：${describeError(error)}",
            limitedEvidence(listOf("unexpected=${error.javaClass.name}")),
        )
    }

    @Suppress("DEPRECATION")
    private fun evaluate(context: CheckContext): CheckResult {
        val appContext = context.context
        val targetPackage = context.settings.targetPackage
        val appOps = appContext.getSystemService(AppOpsManager::class.java)
            ?: return unknown(
                "AppOpsManager 不可用，无法读取 OP_MOCK_LOCATION。",
                limitedEvidence(listOf("getSystemService(AppOpsManager) = null")),
            )

        val targetInfo = runCatching {
            appContext.packageManager.getApplicationInfo(targetPackage, 0)
        }
        val targetUid = targetInfo.getOrNull()?.uid
        if (targetUid == null) {
            val reason = targetInfo.exceptionOrNull()?.let(::describeError) ?: "ApplicationInfo=null"
            return unknown(
                "目标包 $targetPackage 未安装或对 detector 不可见（$reason），无法取得 UID。",
                limitedEvidence(
                    listOf(
                        "target=$targetPackage",
                        "getApplicationInfo($targetPackage, 0) 失败：$reason",
                        "提示：自定义目标包需在 detector 的 <queries> 中声明可见性",
                    )
                ),
            )
        }

        val lines = mutableListOf<String>()
        lines += "target=$targetPackage uid=$targetUid"
        val targetProbes = MOCK_LOCATION_OPS.map { (label, op) ->
            queryMockLocationOp(appOps, op, label, targetUid, targetPackage)
        }
        targetProbes.mapTo(lines) { describeProbe("target", it) }

        val selfUid = Process.myUid()
        val selfPackage = appContext.packageName
        lines += "self=$selfPackage uid=$selfUid"
        val selfProbes = MOCK_LOCATION_OPS.map { (label, op) ->
            queryMockLocationOp(appOps, op, label, selfUid, selfPackage)
        }
        selfProbes.mapTo(lines) { describeProbe("self", it) }

        // 枚举面（工作包 9 第三批修复的对应验证）：持有 PACKAGE_USAGE_STATS 的检测器可以走
        // getOpsForPackage/getUidOps 拿到完整 op 列表。detector 无该权限时记 UNKNOWN 证据，
        // 不伪造 PASS；能读到且含 mock_location 条目即泄漏。
        val enumProbes = listOf("getOpsForPackage", "getUidOps").map {
            enumSurfaceProbe(appOps, it, targetUid, targetPackage)
        }
        enumProbes.mapTo(lines) { describeEnumProbe(it) }

        val readableTarget = targetProbes.filter { it.mode != null }
        if (readableTarget.isEmpty()) {
            return unknown(
                "无法查询目标包 $targetPackage 的 OP_MOCK_LOCATION（所有查询方式均失败）。",
                limitedEvidence(lines),
            )
        }

        val firstTarget = readableTarget.first()
        val targetSummary = firstTarget.mode?.let { "${firstTarget.label}=${modeLabel(it)}" } ?: "未知"
        val selfSummary = selfProbes.firstNotNullOfOrNull { probe ->
            probe.mode?.let { "${probe.label}=${modeLabel(it)}" }
        } ?: "查询失败"
        val enumLeaks = enumProbes.filter { it.mockEntryFound == true }
        val allowed = readableTarget.any { it.mode == AppOpsManager.MODE_ALLOWED } ||
            enumLeaks.isNotEmpty()

        lines += "verdict=${if (allowed) "FAIL" else "PASS"} target_mode=$targetSummary " +
            "self_mode=$selfSummary enum_leak=${if (enumLeaks.isNotEmpty()) enumLeaks.joinToString("/") { it.label } else "无"}"

        return if (allowed) {
            fail(
                buildString {
                    append("目标包 $targetPackage 的 OP_MOCK_LOCATION=$targetSummary")
                    if (enumLeaks.isNotEmpty()) {
                        append("；枚举面(${enumLeaks.joinToString("/") { it.label }})仍含 mock_location 条目")
                    }
                    append("，第三方应用可通过该 AppOps 判定目标包被允许模拟定位。")
                },
                limitedEvidence(lines),
            )
        } else {
            pass(
                "目标包 $targetPackage 的 OP_MOCK_LOCATION 不可见（$targetSummary）；detector 自身为 $selfSummary；" +
                    "枚举面无泄漏或未授权无法验证。",
                limitedEvidence(lines),
            )
        }
    }
}

/**
 * C03 · Settings mock_location 与开发者选项。
 *
 * 期望：`Settings.Secure.getString("mock_location")` 与
 * `Settings.Global.DEVELOPMENT_SETTINGS_ENABLED` 对普通调用方不可见或为关闭状态。
 * 只做读取，不尝试 WRITE_SECURE_SETTINGS，也不调用 adb。
 */
class SettingsCheck : Check {
    override val id = CheckIds.SETTINGS
    override val title = "Settings mock_location / 开发者选项"
    override val blocking = true

    override fun run(context: CheckContext): CheckResult = try {
        evaluate(context)
    } catch (error: Exception) {
        unknown(
            "C03 检查异常：${describeError(error)}",
            limitedEvidence(listOf("unexpected=${error.javaClass.name}")),
        )
    }

    private fun evaluate(context: CheckContext): CheckResult {
        val resolver = context.context.contentResolver
        val mockLocation = readSecure(resolver, "mock_location", "Settings.Secure[mock_location]")
        val developerOptions = readGlobalInt(resolver, Settings.Global.DEVELOPMENT_SETTINGS_ENABLED)
        // 旧版开关（Android 4.2 前）仅作补充证据，不参与判定。
        val legacyAllowMock = readSecure(resolver, "allow_mock_location", "Settings.Secure[allow_mock_location]（旧 key）")
        // query 路径探针（工作包 9）：getString 走 provider.call；直接 query provider 是独立入口，
        // 响应的列集合/行数也是指纹（旧实现曾伪造单列 cursor）。
        val mockLocationViaQuery = readSecureViaQuery(resolver, "mock_location")

        val mockOn = mockLocation.value == "1" || mockLocationViaQuery.value == "1"
        val developerOn = developerOptions.value == "1"
        val legacyOn = legacyAllowMock.value == "1"

        val lines = mutableListOf(
            mockLocation.describe(),
            mockLocationViaQuery.describe(),
            developerOptions.describe(),
            legacyAllowMock.describe(),
            "verdict: mock_location_on=$mockOn developer_options_on=$developerOn legacy_on=$legacyOn（legacy 仅记录）",
        )

        return when {
            mockOn || developerOn -> fail(
                buildString {
                    append("检测到模拟定位相关设置已开启：")
                    append(
                        buildList {
                            if (mockOn) add("Settings.Secure.mock_location=1")
                            if (developerOn) add("开发者选项=1")
                        }.joinToString("、")
                    )
                    append("。")
                    if (legacyOn) append("旧 key allow_mock_location 也为 1（仅记录）。")
                },
                limitedEvidence(lines),
            )

            mockLocation.isReadable && developerOptions.isReadable &&
                mockLocationViaQuery.isReadable &&
                mockLocation.isClosed && developerOptions.isClosed && mockLocationViaQuery.isClosed -> pass(
                "模拟定位设置不可见或已关闭：mock_location=${mockLocation.displayValue()}，开发者选项=${developerOptions.displayValue()}。",
                limitedEvidence(lines),
            )

            else -> unknown(
                "无法确认 Settings 状态：${unreadableLabels(mockLocation, developerOptions)}"
                    + "（普通应用读取受限 Settings 会得到 SecurityException，无法据此证明已关闭）。",
                limitedEvidence(lines),
            )
        }
    }
}

private data class SettingsRead(
    val label: String,
    val value: String?,
    val error: String?,
    val note: String? = null,
) {
    val isReadable: Boolean get() = error == null
    val isClosed: Boolean get() = value == null || value == "0"

    fun displayValue(): String = value ?: "null（未设置）"

    fun describe(): String = buildString {
        append(if (isReadable) "$label=${displayValue()}" else "$label 读取异常：$error")
        if (note != null) append("（$note）")
    }
}

private fun readSecure(resolver: ContentResolver, key: String, label: String): SettingsRead =
    try {
        SettingsRead(label, Settings.Secure.getString(resolver, key), null)
    } catch (error: Exception) {
        SettingsRead(label, null, describeError(error))
    }

/**
 * 直接 query settings provider（`content://settings/secure`）读取一个 key。响应保留
 * provider 原生 cursor 的列集合与行数，作为与 getString(call 路径) 对齐的独立入口证据。
 */
private fun readSecureViaQuery(resolver: ContentResolver, key: String): SettingsRead =
    try {
        val cursor = resolver.query(
            Settings.Secure.CONTENT_URI,
            null,
            "name=?",
            arrayOf(key),
            null,
        )
        if (cursor == null) {
            SettingsRead("query[secure/$key]", null, null, note="cursor=null（key 未设置）")
        } else {
            cursor.use { c ->
                if (!c.moveToFirst()) {
                    SettingsRead("query[secure/$key]", null, null, note="空结果（key 未设置）")
                } else {
                    val columns = c.columnNames
                    val valueIndex = columns.indexOfFirst { it.equals("value", ignoreCase = true) }
                    SettingsRead(
                        "query[secure/$key]",
                        if (valueIndex >= 0) c.getString(valueIndex) else null,
                        null,
                        note = "列=${columns.joinToString(",")}",
                    )
                }
            }
        }
    } catch (error: Exception) {
        SettingsRead("query[secure/$key]", null, describeError(error))
    }

private fun readGlobalInt(resolver: ContentResolver, key: String): SettingsRead =
    try {
        SettingsRead("Settings.Global[$key]", Settings.Global.getInt(resolver, key, 0).toString(), null)
    } catch (error: Exception) {
        SettingsRead("Settings.Global[$key]", null, describeError(error))
    }

private fun unreadableLabels(vararg reads: SettingsRead): String =
    reads.filterNot { it.isReadable }.joinToString("、") { "${it.label}（${it.error}）" }

private data class OpProbe(
    val label: String,
    val op: String,
    val method: String?,
    val mode: Int?,
    val note: String?,
)

private val MOCK_LOCATION_OPS = listOf(
    "OPSTR_MOCK_LOCATION" to AppOpsManager.OPSTR_MOCK_LOCATION,
    "legacy" to "android:mock_location",
)

@Suppress("DEPRECATION")
private fun queryMockLocationOp(
    appOps: AppOpsManager,
    op: String,
    label: String,
    uid: Int,
    packageName: String,
): OpProbe {
    try {
        val mode = appOps.checkOpNoThrow(op, uid, packageName)
        return OpProbe(label, op, "checkOpNoThrow", mode, null)
    } catch (error: Exception) {
        val primary = describeError(error)
        return try {
            val mode = appOps.unsafeCheckOpNoThrow(op, uid, packageName)
            OpProbe(label, op, "unsafeCheckOpNoThrow", mode, "checkOpNoThrow $primary，已回退")
        } catch (fallback: Exception) {
            OpProbe(
                label,
                op,
                null,
                null,
                "checkOpNoThrow=$primary; unsafeCheckOpNoThrow=${describeError(fallback)}",
            )
        }
    }
}

private fun describeProbe(role: String, probe: OpProbe): String = buildString {
    append(role).append(" op[").append(probe.label).append('=').append(probe.op).append("] ")
    val mode = probe.mode
    if (mode != null) {
        append(probe.method).append('=').append(modeLabel(mode))
        if (probe.note != null) append(" (").append(probe.note).append(')')
    } else {
        append("查询失败：").append(probe.note)
    }
}

private fun modeLabel(mode: Int): String {
    val name = when (mode) {
        AppOpsManager.MODE_ALLOWED -> "MODE_ALLOWED"
        AppOpsManager.MODE_IGNORED -> "MODE_IGNORED"
        AppOpsManager.MODE_ERRORED -> "MODE_ERRORED"
        AppOpsManager.MODE_DEFAULT -> "MODE_DEFAULT"
        AppOpsManager.MODE_FOREGROUND -> "MODE_FOREGROUND"
        else -> "MODE_UNKNOWN"
    }
    return "$name($mode)"
}

private const val MOCK_OP_CODE = 58 // AppOpsManager.OP_MOCK_LOCATION，@hide 常量，自 API 6 起稳定

private data class EnumProbe(
    val label: String,
    val note: String?,
    /** null = 无法验证（未授权/异常）；true = 发现 mock_location 条目（泄漏）；false = 无条目 */
    val mockEntryFound: Boolean?,
    val entryCount: Int?,
)

private fun describeEnumProbe(probe: EnumProbe): String = buildString {
    append("enum[").append(probe.label).append("] ")
    append(probe.entryCount?.let { "entries=$it" } ?: "entries=未知")
    append(" mock_entry=").append(
        when (probe.mockEntryFound) {
            true -> "存在（泄漏）"
            false -> "无"
            null -> "无法验证"
        },
    )
    if (probe.note != null) append(" (").append(probe.note).append(')')
}

/**
 * 通过反射调用 `AppOpsManager.getOpsForPackage/getUidOps`（方法为公开 API，但返回的
 * `PackageOps.getOps()` 元素类型 `Op` 是 @hide，因此条目类型与 op 字段同样走反射）。
 * 未持有 PACKAGE_USAGE_STATS 的调用方会收到 SecurityException，调用方据此记 UNKNOWN。
 */
private fun enumSurfaceProbe(
    appOps: AppOpsManager,
    surface: String,
    targetUid: Int,
    targetPackage: String,
): EnumProbe = runCatching {
    val list: List<*> = when (surface) {
        "getOpsForPackage" ->
            appOps.javaClass.getMethod("getOpsForPackage", Integer.TYPE, String::class.java)
                .invoke(appOps, targetUid, targetPackage) as? List<*>
                    ?: return EnumProbe(surface, "返回 null", false, 0)
        "getUidOps" ->
            appOps.javaClass.getMethod("getUidOps", Integer.TYPE)
                .invoke(appOps, targetUid) as? List<*>
                    ?: return EnumProbe(surface, "返回 null", false, 0)
        else -> return EnumProbe(surface, "未知枚举面", null, null)
    }
    var mockFound = false
    for (entry in list) {
        val ops = entry?.javaClass?.getMethod("getOps")?.invoke(entry) as? List<*> ?: continue
        for (opEntry in ops) {
            val op = opEntry?.javaClass?.getField("op")?.getInt(opEntry) ?: continue
            if (op == MOCK_OP_CODE) mockFound = true
        }
    }
    EnumProbe(surface, null, mockFound, list.size)
}.getOrElse { EnumProbe(surface, describeError(it), null, null) }

private fun describeError(error: Throwable): String {
    val message = error.message
        ?.replace('\n', ' ')
        ?.replace('\r', ' ')
        ?.trim()
        ?.take(120)
    return error.javaClass.simpleName + if (!message.isNullOrEmpty()) ": $message" else ""
}

private const val MAX_EVIDENCE_LINES = 20

private fun limitedEvidence(lines: List<String>): List<String> {
    val normalized = lines.map(::oneLine)
    if (normalized.size <= MAX_EVIDENCE_LINES) return normalized
    return normalized.take(MAX_EVIDENCE_LINES - 1) + "…（已截断，共 ${normalized.size} 行）"
}

private fun oneLine(text: String): String {
    val flattened = text.replace('\n', ' ').replace('\r', ' ')
    return if (flattened.length <= 299) flattened else flattened.take(296) + "..."
}
```
