`detector/src/main/java/com/system/location/service/detector/checks/ProviderChecks.kt`:

```kt
package com.system.location.service.detector.checks

import android.location.LocationManager
import android.location.provider.ProviderProperties
import com.system.location.service.detector.model.Check
import com.system.location.service.detector.model.CheckContext
import com.system.location.service.detector.model.CheckIds
import com.system.location.service.detector.model.CheckResult

/**
 * C04 · Provider 列表与属性。
 *
 * 期望：`allProviders` / `getProviders(true)` / `getProviderProperties` / `isProviderEnabled`
 * 不暴露 `fused_ext` 或 Portal 的 test provider，且四处结果一致。
 * 只读公开 API；属性读取受系统权限限制时给出 UNKNOWN 而不是伪造 PASS。
 */
class ProviderListCheck : Check {
    override val id = CheckIds.PROVIDER_LIST
    override val title = "Provider 列表与属性"
    override val blocking = true

    override fun run(context: CheckContext): CheckResult = try {
        evaluate(context)
    } catch (error: Exception) {
        unknown(
            "C04 检查异常：${describeError(error)}",
            limitedEvidence(listOf("unexpected=${error.javaClass.name}")),
        )
    }

    private fun evaluate(context: CheckContext): CheckResult {
        val manager = context.locationManager
            ?: return unknown(
                "LocationManager 不可用，无法枚举 Provider。",
                limitedEvidence(listOf("context.getSystemService(LocationManager) = null")),
            )

        val allProviders = try {
            manager.allProviders.distinct().sorted()
        } catch (error: Exception) {
            return unknown(
                "无法读取 LocationManager.allProviders：${describeError(error)}",
                limitedEvidence(listOf("allProviders 异常：${describeError(error)}")),
            )
        }

        val enabledResult = runCatching { manager.getProviders(true).distinct().sorted() }
        val enabledProviders = enabledResult.getOrNull()

        if (allProviders.isEmpty()) {
            return fail(
                "LocationManager.allProviders 为空；Android 至少应包含 passive Provider，列表明显异常。",
                limitedEvidence(
                    listOf(
                        "allProviders=[]（空列表）",
                        "getProviders(true)=${enabledProviders?.joinToString(prefix = "[", postfix = "]") ?: "读取失败"}",
                    )
                ),
            )
        }

        val allSet = allProviders.toSet()
        val suspicious = linkedSetOf<String>()
        allProviders.filterTo(suspicious) { isSuspiciousProvider(it) }
        enabledProviders?.filterTo(suspicious) { isSuspiciousProvider(it) }
        val extraEnabled = enabledProviders?.filterNot { it in allSet }.orEmpty()
        val propertyReads = allProviders.map { provider -> readProperties(manager, provider) }

        val probeName = "__detector_missing_provider__"
        var probeReportedEnabled = false
        var probeThrew = false
        val probeLine = try {
            val enabled = manager.isProviderEnabled(probeName)
            probeReportedEnabled = enabled
            "probe isProviderEnabled(\"$probeName\")=$enabled（预期 false）"
        } catch (error: Exception) {
            probeThrew = true
            "probe isProviderEnabled(\"$probeName\") 异常：${describeError(error)}"
        }

        // 直接探测被隐藏的提供者名（工作包 9）：泛化的"不存在"探测即使通过，
        // fused_ext/portal 若仍返回 enabled，说明隐藏层自身不一致。
        val hiddenProbes = listOf("fused_ext", "portal").map { name ->
            name to runCatching { manager.isProviderEnabled(name) }
        }

        val failures = mutableListOf<String>()
        if (suspicious.isNotEmpty()) {
            failures += "暴露可疑 Provider：${suspicious.joinToString("、")}"
        }
        if (extraEnabled.isNotEmpty()) {
            failures += "getProviders(true) 含 allProviders 之外的项目：${extraEnabled.joinToString("、")}"
        }
        val propertyFailures = propertyReads.filter { it.hardFailure }
        if (propertyFailures.isNotEmpty()) {
            failures += "Provider 属性异常：${propertyFailures.joinToString("、") { "${it.provider}(${it.error})" }}"
        }
        if (probeReportedEnabled) {
            failures += "isProviderEnabled 对不存在的 Provider 返回 true"
        }
        hiddenProbes.forEach { (name, result) ->
            if (result.getOrNull() == true) {
                failures += "isProviderEnabled 对被隐藏的 Provider \"$name\" 返回 true"
            }
        }

        val keyLines = mutableListOf(
            "allProviders(${allProviders.size})=${allProviders.joinToString(prefix = "[", postfix = "]")}",
            "getProviders(true)=" + (
                enabledProviders?.let { "(${it.size})${it.joinToString(prefix = "[", postfix = "]")}" }
                    ?: "读取失败：${enabledResult.exceptionOrNull()?.let(::describeError)}"
                ),
        )
        if (suspicious.isNotEmpty()) keyLines += "suspicious=${suspicious.joinToString(prefix = "[", postfix = "]")}"
        if (extraEnabled.isNotEmpty()) {
            keyLines += "enabled_not_in_allProviders=${extraEnabled.joinToString(prefix = "[", postfix = "]")}"
        }
        keyLines += probeLine
        hiddenProbes.forEach { (name, result) ->
            keyLines += when {
                result.isSuccess ->
                    "probe isProviderEnabled(\"$name\")=${result.getOrNull()}（预期 false）"
                else ->
                    "probe isProviderEnabled(\"$name\") 异常：${describeError(result.exceptionOrNull() ?: IllegalStateException("unknown"))}"
            }
        }
        val evidenceLines = keyLines + propertyReads.map { it.describe() }

        val inconclusiveReasons = mutableListOf<String>()
        if (enabledProviders == null) inconclusiveReasons += "getProviders(true) 读取失败"
        if (probeThrew) inconclusiveReasons += "isProviderEnabled 对不存在的 Provider 抛异常"
        hiddenProbes.filter { it.second.isFailure }.forEach { (name, result) ->
            inconclusiveReasons +=
                "isProviderEnabled(\"$name\") 抛异常：${describeError(result.exceptionOrNull() ?: IllegalStateException("unknown"))}"
        }
        propertyReads.filter { it.inconclusive }.forEach {
            inconclusiveReasons += "${it.provider} 属性读取受权限限制"
        }

        return when {
            failures.isNotEmpty() -> fail(
                "Provider 检查发现异常：${failures.joinToString("；")}。",
                limitedEvidence(evidenceLines),
            )

            inconclusiveReasons.isNotEmpty() -> unknown(
                "Provider 列表可读，但部分项目无法验证：${inconclusiveReasons.joinToString("；")}。",
                limitedEvidence(evidenceLines),
            )

            else -> pass(
                "Provider 列表正常：allProviders=${allProviders.joinToString(",")}；"
                    + "enabled=${enabledProviders?.joinToString(",") ?: "不可读"}；"
                    + "属性齐全，未发现 fused_ext/test/mock/portal Provider。",
                limitedEvidence(evidenceLines),
            )
        }
    }

    private fun readProperties(manager: LocationManager, provider: String): PropertyRead =
        try {
            val properties = manager.getProviderProperties(provider)
            if (properties == null) {
                PropertyRead(
                    provider = provider,
                    summary = null,
                    error = "getProviderProperties 返回 null（属性未知）",
                    hardFailure = true,
                    inconclusive = false,
                )
            } else {
                PropertyRead(provider, summarize(properties), null, hardFailure = false, inconclusive = false)
            }
        } catch (error: Exception) {
            val security = error is SecurityException
            PropertyRead(
                provider = provider,
                summary = null,
                error = describeError(error),
                hardFailure = !security,
                inconclusive = security,
            )
        }
}

private data class PropertyRead(
    val provider: String,
    val summary: String?,
    val error: String?,
    val hardFailure: Boolean,
    val inconclusive: Boolean,
) {
    fun describe(): String =
        if (summary != null) "$provider: $summary" else "$provider: 属性不可用（$error）"
}

private fun isSuspiciousProvider(name: String): Boolean {
    val lower = name.lowercase()
    return lower.contains("fused_ext") ||
        lower.contains("test") ||
        lower.contains("mock") ||
        lower.contains("portal")
}

private fun summarize(properties: ProviderProperties): String = buildString {
    append("power=").append(powerUsageLabel(properties.powerUsage))
    append(" accuracy=").append(accuracyLabel(properties.accuracy))
    append(" alt=").append(properties.hasAltitudeSupport())
    append(" bearing=").append(properties.hasBearingSupport())
    append(" speed=").append(properties.hasSpeedSupport())
    append(" sat=").append(properties.hasSatelliteRequirement())
    append(" cell=").append(properties.hasCellRequirement())
    append(" net=").append(properties.hasNetworkRequirement())
    append(" cost=").append(properties.hasMonetaryCost())
}

private fun powerUsageLabel(value: Int): String = when (value) {
    ProviderProperties.POWER_USAGE_LOW -> "LOW(1)"
    ProviderProperties.POWER_USAGE_MEDIUM -> "MEDIUM(2)"
    ProviderProperties.POWER_USAGE_HIGH -> "HIGH(3)"
    else -> "UNKNOWN($value)"
}

private fun accuracyLabel(value: Int): String = when (value) {
    ProviderProperties.ACCURACY_FINE -> "FINE(1)"
    ProviderProperties.ACCURACY_COARSE -> "COARSE(2)"
    else -> "UNKNOWN($value)"
}

private fun describeError(error: Throwable): String {
    val message = error.message
        ?.replace('\n', ' ')
        ?.replace('\r', ' ')
        ?.trim()
        ?.take(120)
    return error.javaClass.simpleName + if (!message.isNullOrEmpty()) ": $message" else ""
}

private const val MAX_EVIDENCE_LINES = 20

private fun limitedEvidence(lines: List<String>): List<String> {
    val normalized = lines.map(::oneLine)
    if (normalized.size <= MAX_EVIDENCE_LINES) return normalized
    return normalized.take(MAX_EVIDENCE_LINES - 1) + "…（已截断，共 ${normalized.size} 行）"
}

private fun oneLine(text: String): String {
    val flattened = text.replace('\n', ' ').replace('\r', ' ')
    return if (flattened.length <= 299) flattened else flattened.take(296) + "..."
}
```

`detector/src/main/java/com/system/location/service/detector/checks/SensorChecks.kt`:

```kt
package com.system.location.service.detector.checks

import android.Manifest
import android.content.pm.PackageManager
import android.hardware.Sensor
import android.hardware.SensorManager
import android.location.Location
import android.location.LocationManager
import com.system.location.service.detector.model.Check
import com.system.location.service.detector.model.CheckContext
import com.system.location.service.detector.model.CheckIds
import com.system.location.service.detector.model.CheckResult
import com.system.location.service.detector.model.SampleSnapshot
import java.util.Locale
import kotlin.math.abs
import kotlin.math.asin
import kotlin.math.cos
import kotlin.math.sin
import kotlin.math.sqrt

/**
 * C10 · 传感器数值。
 *
 * 期望：加速度/陀螺仪/地磁/气压/计步都有真实量级和变化，不是全 0/-1 常量；
 * 静止时不应持续随机抖动，运动时与轨迹一致。
 *
 * 判定口径：
 * - 连续型传感器（加速度/陀螺仪/磁力/气压）有硬件但 0 样本 → FAIL；1–2 样本无法算方差 → UNKNOWN。
 * - 加速度、陀螺仪、磁力三轴方差为 0 → FAIL（当前 native 会写常量）。
 * - 加速度模长均值必须在 6.8–12.8 m/s²，气压 300–1100 hPa，磁力 10–100 µT。
 * - 计步非负且单调不减；STEP_DETECTOR 是事件型传感器，静止时 0 事件属正常。
 * - 无任何传感器数据 → UNKNOWN；没有 ACTIVITY_RECOGNITION 权限时计步项只记证据，不判 FAIL。
 */
class SensorCheck : Check {
    override val id = CheckIds.SENSOR
    override val title = "传感器数值"

    override fun run(context: CheckContext): CheckResult = try {
        val snapshot = context.snapshot
        val series = snapshot.sensorSeries
        val sensorManager = context.context.getSystemService(SensorManager::class.java)
        val activityPermission = runCatching {
            context.context.checkSelfPermission(Manifest.permission.ACTIVITY_RECOGNITION) ==
                PackageManager.PERMISSION_GRANTED
        }.getOrDefault(false)

        val evidence = mutableListOf<String>()
        val seconds = ((snapshot.endedAtMillis - snapshot.startedAtMillis).coerceAtLeast(0L)) / 1000.0
        addSensorEvidence(
            evidence,
            "采样 ${formatSensorDouble(seconds)} s；传感器 ${series.size} 类，样本总数 ${series.values.sumOf { it.values.size }}",
        )
        addSensorEvidence(
            evidence,
            "ACTIVITY_RECOGNITION=${if (activityPermission) "已授予" else "未授予/未声明（计步硬件可能不可见或注册失败）"}",
        )

        if (series.isEmpty()) {
            return unknown("采样窗口内没有任何传感器数据：可能无相关硬件、未授权或注册失败，无法判定。", evidence)
        }
        if (sensorManager == null) {
            return unknown("SensorManager 不可用，无法取得硬件清单；仅有 ${series.size} 类样本，不能判断量级。", evidence)
        }

        val failures = mutableListOf<String>()
        val incomplete = mutableListOf<String>()
        var checkedTypes = 0
        for (spec in SENSOR_SPECS) {
            val hardware = runCatching { sensorManager.getDefaultSensor(spec.type) != null }.getOrDefault(false)
            val samples = series[spec.type]?.values.orEmpty()
            if (hardware || samples.isNotEmpty()) checkedTypes++
            val finding = inspectSensor(spec, hardware, samples, activityPermission, evidence)
            if (finding != null) {
                if (finding.fatal) failures += finding.message else incomplete += finding.message
            }
        }

        when {
            failures.isNotEmpty() -> fail(
                "传感器数值异常：${failures.joinToString("；").take(240)}",
                evidence,
            )
            incomplete.isNotEmpty() -> unknown(
                "传感器数据不足，无法判定：${incomplete.joinToString("；").take(240)}",
                evidence,
            )
            checkedTypes == 0 -> unknown("未发现加速度/陀螺仪/磁力/气压/计步硬件或数据。", evidence)
            else -> pass(
                "已检查 $checkedTypes 类传感器：量级、方差与计步单调性正常；" +
                    "STEP_DETECTOR 无事件时按静止处理，不判 FAIL。",
                evidence,
            )
        }
    } catch (error: Throwable) {
        unknown(
            "C10 检查异常：${error.javaClass.simpleName}: ${error.message}",
            listOf("异常：${error.javaClass.simpleName}"),
        )
    }
}

/**
 * C11 · 活动识别 / 计步一致性。
 *
 * 判定口径：
 * - STEP_COUNTER 含 NaN/Inf、负值或负跳变 → FAIL。
 * - STEP_DETECTOR 有事件但 STEP_COUNTER 不增长 → FAIL。
 * - 采样 >=20 s 后：位移速度 >0.5 m/s 而计步不增长 → FAIL；速度 <0.3 m/s 而计步增长 → FAIL。
 * - 步态自洽 → PASS，并在 detail 说明 GMS Activity Recognition 未接入（P7 再做）。
 * - 无计步硬件/数据、或无法估算速度 → UNKNOWN。
 */
class ActivityRecognitionCheck : Check {
    override val id = CheckIds.ACTIVITY
    override val title = "活动识别与计步"

    override fun run(context: CheckContext): CheckResult = try {
        val snapshot = context.snapshot
        val sensorManager = context.context.getSystemService(SensorManager::class.java)
        val counterSamples = snapshot.sensorSeries[Sensor.TYPE_STEP_COUNTER]?.values.orEmpty()
        val detectorSamples = snapshot.sensorSeries[Sensor.TYPE_STEP_DETECTOR]?.values.orEmpty()
        val counterHardware = runCatching {
            sensorManager?.getDefaultSensor(Sensor.TYPE_STEP_COUNTER) != null
        }.getOrDefault(false)
        val detectorHardware = runCatching {
            sensorManager?.getDefaultSensor(Sensor.TYPE_STEP_DETECTOR) != null
        }.getOrDefault(false)
        val activityPermission = runCatching {
            context.context.checkSelfPermission(Manifest.permission.ACTIVITY_RECOGNITION) ==
                PackageManager.PERMISSION_GRANTED
        }.getOrDefault(false)
        val durationSeconds = sampleDurationSeconds(snapshot)

        val evidence = mutableListOf<String>()
        addActivityEvidence(evidence, "采样时长 ${formatSensorDouble(durationSeconds)} s（判定要求 >=20 s）")
        addActivityEvidence(
            evidence,
            "STEP_COUNTER：硬件=$counterHardware，样本=${counterSamples.size}；" +
                "STEP_DETECTOR：硬件=$detectorHardware，事件=${detectorSamples.size}",
        )
        addActivityEvidence(
            evidence,
            "ACTIVITY_RECOGNITION=${if (activityPermission) "已授予" else "未授予/未声明"}；" +
                "未接入 GMS Activity Recognition（P7 再做），不因无法读取而判 FAIL",
        )

        if (counterSamples.isEmpty()) {
            return unknown(
                "无 STEP_COUNTER 硬件/数据" +
                    (if (!activityPermission) "（ACTIVITY_RECOGNITION 未授予/未声明，计步传感器可能未注册）" else "") +
                    "，无法判断计步与运动状态是否矛盾；Activity Recognition 未接入。",
                evidence,
            )
        }

        val counts = counterSamples.map { it.firstOrNull()?.toDouble() ?: Double.NaN }
        if (counts.any { !it.isFinite() }) {
            return fail("STEP_COUNTER 含 NaN/Inf（当前 native 可能把值写成 -1），计步数据不可信。", evidence)
        }
        if (counts.any { it < 0.0 }) {
            return fail("STEP_COUNTER 出现负值，计步数据不可信。", evidence)
        }

        var negativeJumps = 0
        for (index in 1 until counts.size) {
            if (counts[index] < counts[index - 1]) negativeJumps++
        }
        val delta = counts.last() - counts.first()
        addActivityEvidence(
            evidence,
            "计步首=${formatSensorDouble(counts.first())} 末=${formatSensorDouble(counts.last())} " +
                "增量=${formatSensorDouble(delta)} 负跳变=$negativeJumps",
        )
        if (negativeJumps > 0) {
            return fail("STEP_COUNTER 出现 $negativeJumps 次负跳变，计步不单调。", evidence)
        }

        val detectorEvents = detectorSamples.size
        if (detectorEvents > 0 && delta <= 0.0) {
            return fail(
                "STEP_DETECTOR 有 $detectorEvents 个事件，但 STEP_COUNTER 增量为 ${formatSensorDouble(delta)}，两者矛盾。",
                evidence,
            )
        }
        if (durationSeconds < ACTIVITY_MIN_SECONDS) {
            return unknown(
                "采样仅 ${formatSensorDouble(durationSeconds)} s，少于 20 s，无法可靠判断静止/运动与计步是否矛盾。",
                evidence,
            )
        }

        val speedLocations = selectSpeedLocations(snapshot)
        if (speedLocations.size < 2) {
            return unknown("无足够定位样本，无法估算速度并与计步比较；计步本身单调。", evidence)
        }
        val ordered = speedLocations.sortedBy { it.time }
        val spanSeconds = (ordered.last().time - ordered.first().time) / 1000.0
        if (spanSeconds < ACTIVITY_MIN_SPEED_SECONDS) {
            return unknown(
                "定位时长仅 ${formatSensorDouble(spanSeconds)} s，无法可靠估算速度（要求 >=10 s）。",
                evidence,
            )
        }

        val netDistance = sensorHaversineMeters(ordered.first(), ordered.last())
        val netSpeed = netDistance / spanSeconds
        var pathDistance = 0.0
        for (index in 1 until ordered.size) {
            val dt = (ordered[index].time - ordered[index - 1].time) / 1000.0
            if (dt > 0.0) pathDistance += sensorHaversineMeters(ordered[index - 1], ordered[index])
        }
        val pathSpeed = pathDistance / spanSeconds
        addActivityEvidence(
            evidence,
            "速度估算（${ordered.first().provider ?: "unknown"}）：位移=${formatSensorDouble(netDistance)} m，" +
                "位移速度=${formatSensorDouble(netSpeed)} m/s，路径平均=${formatSensorDouble(pathSpeed)} m/s，" +
                "定位时长=${formatSensorDouble(spanSeconds)} s",
        )

        if (netSpeed > ACTIVITY_MOVING_SPEED_MPS && delta <= 0.0) {
            return fail(
                "定位位移速度 ${formatSensorDouble(netSpeed)} m/s（>0.5），但 STEP_COUNTER 在采样窗口内没有增长。",
                evidence,
            )
        }
        if (netSpeed < ACTIVITY_STILL_SPEED_MPS && delta > 0.0) {
            return fail(
                "定位几乎静止（位移速度 ${formatSensorDouble(netSpeed)} m/s），但 STEP_COUNTER 增长 " +
                    "${formatSensorDouble(delta)} 步。",
                evidence,
            )
        }

        val ambiguous = netSpeed in ACTIVITY_STILL_SPEED_MPS..ACTIVITY_MOVING_SPEED_MPS
        return pass(
            "步态自洽：STEP_COUNTER 增量 ${formatSensorDouble(delta)}，STEP_DETECTOR 事件 $detectorEvents，" +
                "位移速度 ${formatSensorDouble(netSpeed)} m/s" +
                (if (ambiguous) "（0.3–0.5 m/s 模糊区间，未据此判定）" else "") +
                "；未接入 GMS Activity Recognition（P7 再做）。",
            evidence,
        )
    } catch (error: Throwable) {
        unknown(
            "C11 检查异常：${error.javaClass.simpleName}: ${error.message}",
            listOf("异常：${error.javaClass.simpleName}"),
        )
    }
}

private data class SensorSpec(
    val type: Int,
    val label: String,
    val vectorMagnitude: Boolean = false,
    val requireVariance: Boolean = false,
    val magnitudeMin: Float? = null,
    val magnitudeMax: Float? = null,
    val counter: Boolean = false,
    val detector: Boolean = false,
    val sparseAllowed: Boolean = false,
)

private data class SensorFinding(val fatal: Boolean, val message: String)

private val SENSOR_SPECS = listOf(
    SensorSpec(
        type = Sensor.TYPE_ACCELEROMETER,
        label = "加速度",
        vectorMagnitude = true,
        requireVariance = true,
        magnitudeMin = 6.8f,
        magnitudeMax = 12.8f,
    ),
    SensorSpec(
        type = Sensor.TYPE_GYROSCOPE,
        label = "陀螺仪",
        vectorMagnitude = true,
        requireVariance = true,
    ),
    SensorSpec(
        type = Sensor.TYPE_MAGNETIC_FIELD,
        label = "磁力",
        vectorMagnitude = true,
        requireVariance = true,
        magnitudeMin = 10f,
        magnitudeMax = 100f,
    ),
    SensorSpec(
        type = Sensor.TYPE_PRESSURE,
        label = "气压",
        magnitudeMin = 300f,
        magnitudeMax = 1100f,
    ),
    SensorSpec(
        type = Sensor.TYPE_STEP_COUNTER,
        label = "计步",
        counter = true,
        sparseAllowed = true,
    ),
    SensorSpec(
        type = Sensor.TYPE_STEP_DETECTOR,
        label = "步数事件",
        detector = true,
        sparseAllowed = true,
    ),
)

private fun inspectSensor(
    spec: SensorSpec,
    hasHardware: Boolean,
    samples: List<FloatArray>,
    activityPermission: Boolean,
    evidence: MutableList<String>,
): SensorFinding? {
    val label = spec.label
    if (!hasHardware && samples.isEmpty()) {
        addSensorEvidence(evidence, "$label：无硬件，跳过")
        return null
    }
    if (samples.isEmpty()) {
        if (spec.detector) {
            addSensorEvidence(evidence, "$label：有硬件但窗口内无事件（事件型传感器静止时正常）")
            return null
        }
        if (spec.counter && !activityPermission) {
            addSensorEvidence(evidence, "$label：有硬件但无数据；ACTIVITY_RECOGNITION 未授予/未声明，不判 FAIL")
            return null
        }
        addSensorEvidence(evidence, "$label：有硬件但 0 样本")
        return SensorFinding(true, "$label 有硬件但无数据")
    }
    if (!hasHardware) {
        addSensorEvidence(evidence, "$label：SensorManager 无默认传感器，却收到 ${samples.size} 个样本")
        return SensorFinding(true, "$label 无硬件却有数据")
    }

    val finite = samples.all { sample -> sample.all { it.isFinite() } }
    val sentinel = samples.all { sample ->
        sample.all { value -> abs(value) < SENSOR_SENTINEL_EPS || abs(value + 1f) < SENSOR_SENTINEL_EPS }
    }
    val variance = sensorVarianceSum(samples)
    val magnitudes = samples.map { sample ->
        if (spec.vectorMagnitude) {
            var squared = 0.0
            for (axis in 0 until minOf(3, sample.size)) {
                val value = sample[axis].toDouble()
                squared += value * value
            }
            sqrt(squared)
        } else {
            (sample.firstOrNull() ?: Float.NaN).toDouble()
        }
    }
    val minMagnitude = magnitudes.minOrNull() ?: 0.0
    val maxMagnitude = magnitudes.maxOrNull() ?: 0.0
    val meanMagnitude = if (magnitudes.isEmpty()) 0.0 else magnitudes.sum() / magnitudes.size

    var line = "$label：n=${samples.size} 首=${sensorSampleText(samples.first())} " +
        "末=${sensorSampleText(samples.last())} 方差=${formatSensorDouble(variance)} " +
        "模长 min/mean/max=${formatSensorDouble(minMagnitude)}/" +
        "${formatSensorDouble(meanMagnitude)}/${formatSensorDouble(maxMagnitude)}"
    if (spec.counter) {
        val first = samples.first().firstOrNull() ?: 0f
        val last = samples.last().firstOrNull() ?: 0f
        line += " 增量=${formatSensorDouble((last - first).toDouble())}"
    }
    addSensorEvidence(evidence, line)

    val reasons = mutableListOf<String>()
    if (!finite) reasons += "含 NaN/Inf"
    if (sentinel) reasons += "所有值均为 0/-1（疑似 native 清零）"
    if (spec.requireVariance && samples.size >= 3 && variance <= SENSOR_VARIANCE_EPS) {
        reasons += "三轴方差为 0（常量）"
    }
    val low = spec.magnitudeMin
    val high = spec.magnitudeMax
    if (low != null && high != null && (meanMagnitude < low || meanMagnitude > high)) {
        reasons += "模长均值 ${formatSensorDouble(meanMagnitude)} 超出 " +
            "${formatSensorDouble(low.toDouble())}–${formatSensorDouble(high.toDouble())}"
    }
    if (spec.counter) {
        val counts = samples.map { (it.firstOrNull() ?: Float.NaN).toDouble() }
        if (counts.any { it < 0.0 }) reasons += "计步为负"
        for (index in 1 until counts.size) {
            if (counts[index] < counts[index - 1]) {
                reasons += "计步回退（${formatSensorDouble(counts[index - 1])}→${formatSensorDouble(counts[index])}）"
                break
            }
        }
    }
    if (spec.detector) {
        val invalidEvents = samples.count { (it.firstOrNull() ?: 0f) <= 0f }
        if (invalidEvents > 0) reasons += "$invalidEvents 个事件值非正"
    }

    if (reasons.isNotEmpty()) {
        addSensorEvidence(evidence, "  异常：${reasons.joinToString("；").take(240)}")
        return SensorFinding(true, "$label：${reasons.joinToString("；")}")
    }
    if (samples.size < 3 && !spec.sparseAllowed) {
        addSensorEvidence(evidence, "  样本不足 3，方差判定不完整")
        return SensorFinding(false, "$label 样本不足（n=${samples.size}）")
    }
    return null
}

private fun sensorVarianceSum(samples: List<FloatArray>): Double {
    if (samples.size < 2) return 0.0
    val axes = samples.minOf { it.size }
    if (axes <= 0) return 0.0
    var total = 0.0
    for (axis in 0 until axes) {
        var mean = 0.0
        for (sample in samples) mean += sample[axis]
        mean /= samples.size
        var sum = 0.0
        for (sample in samples) {
            val diff = sample[axis] - mean
            sum += diff * diff
        }
        total += sum / samples.size
    }
    return total
}

private fun sensorSampleText(sample: FloatArray): String =
    sample.joinToString(",") { formatSensorDouble(it.toDouble()) }

private fun addSensorEvidence(evidence: MutableList<String>, line: String) {
    if (evidence.size < SENSOR_MAX_EVIDENCE_LINES) evidence += line.take(SENSOR_MAX_EVIDENCE_CHARS)
}

private fun addActivityEvidence(evidence: MutableList<String>, line: String) {
    if (evidence.size < ACTIVITY_MAX_EVIDENCE_LINES) evidence += line.take(ACTIVITY_MAX_EVIDENCE_CHARS)
}

private fun formatSensorDouble(value: Double): String =
    if (!value.isFinite()) value.toString() else String.format(Locale.US, "%.2f", value)

private fun sampleDurationSeconds(snapshot: SampleSnapshot): Double {
    val wallSeconds = ((snapshot.endedAtMillis - snapshot.startedAtMillis).coerceAtLeast(0L)) / 1000.0
    if (wallSeconds > 0.0) return wallSeconds
    val times = snapshot.locations.map { it.time }
    return if (times.size >= 2) (times.max() - times.min()) / 1000.0 else 0.0
}

private fun selectSpeedLocations(snapshot: SampleSnapshot): List<Location> {
    val gps = snapshot.locationsFor(LocationManager.GPS_PROVIDER)
    if (gps.size >= 2) return gps
    val fused = snapshot.locationsFor("fused")
    if (fused.size >= 2) return fused
    val network = snapshot.locationsFor(LocationManager.NETWORK_PROVIDER)
    if (network.size >= 2) return network
    return snapshot.locations
}

private fun sensorHaversineMeters(from: Location, to: Location): Double {
    val lat1 = Math.toRadians(from.latitude)
    val lat2 = Math.toRadians(to.latitude)
    val deltaLat = lat2 - lat1
    val deltaLon = Math.toRadians(to.longitude - from.longitude)
    val h = sin(deltaLat / 2) * sin(deltaLat / 2) +
        cos(lat1) * cos(lat2) * sin(deltaLon / 2) * sin(deltaLon / 2)
    return 2 * 6_371_000.0 * asin(sqrt(h.coerceIn(0.0, 1.0)))
}

private const val ACTIVITY_MIN_SECONDS = 20.0
private const val ACTIVITY_MIN_SPEED_SECONDS = 10.0
private const val ACTIVITY_MOVING_SPEED_MPS = 0.5
private const val ACTIVITY_STILL_SPEED_MPS = 0.3
private const val SENSOR_SENTINEL_EPS = 1e-6f
private const val SENSOR_VARIANCE_EPS = 1e-12
private const val SENSOR_MAX_EVIDENCE_LINES = 20
private const val SENSOR_MAX_EVIDENCE_CHARS = 299
private const val ACTIVITY_MAX_EVIDENCE_LINES = 20
private const val ACTIVITY_MAX_EVIDENCE_CHARS = 299
```

`detector/src/main/java/com/system/location/service/detector/checks/TrajectoryChecks.kt`:

```kt
package com.system.location.service.detector.checks

import android.location.Location
import android.location.LocationManager
import com.system.location.service.detector.model.Check
import com.system.location.service.detector.model.CheckContext
import com.system.location.service.detector.model.CheckIds
import com.system.location.service.detector.model.CheckResult
import java.util.Locale
import kotlin.math.PI
import kotlin.math.asin
import kotlin.math.cos
import kotlin.math.sin
import kotlin.math.sqrt

/**
 * C12 · 轨迹统计。
 *
 * 期望：无瞬移（速度突变超限）、时间戳单调、无固定周期抖动（DFT 单频峰）。
 *
 * 判定口径：
 * - 多 provider 时只分析样本最多的一个（GPS 优先），避免多源交叉时间戳误判。
 * - 时间戳倒退、重复时间戳但坐标变化、单步 >5 km、瞬时速度 >200 m/s → FAIL。
 * - 少于 20 点或短于 30 s → UNKNOWN；路线图建议连续采样 2–5 分钟。
 * - 对去趋势后的局部坐标做 DFT（最多 256 点），k>=3（至少 3 个周期）且非 DC 主频能量
 *   占比 >0.6、振幅 >0.5 m → FAIL。k<3 视为转弯/绕圈趋势，不算固定抖动。
 */
class TrajectoryCheck : Check {
    override val id = CheckIds.TRAJECTORY
    override val title = "轨迹统计"

    override fun run(context: CheckContext): CheckResult = try {
        val allLocations = context.snapshot.locations
        val evidence = mutableListOf<String>()
        if (allLocations.isEmpty()) {
            return unknown("无定位样本，无法分析轨迹。", listOf("locations=0"))
        }

        val groups = allLocations.groupBy { it.provider ?: "unknown" }
        val selected = groups.entries.maxWithOrNull(
            compareBy<Map.Entry<String, List<Location>>> { it.value.size }
                .thenBy { if (it.key == LocationManager.GPS_PROVIDER) 1 else 0 },
        ) ?: return unknown("无法按 provider 分组轨迹。", evidence)
        val provider = selected.key
        val locations = selected.value
        val otherProviders = groups.filterKeys { it != provider }
            .entries.joinToString(",") { "${it.key}=${it.value.size}" }
            .ifBlank { "无" }
        addTrajectoryEvidence(
            evidence,
            "provider=$provider，样本=${locations.size}/${allLocations.size}；其他 provider：$otherProviders（不混合分析）",
        )

        val anomalies = mutableListOf<String>()
        var maxSpeed = 0.0
        var pathDistance = 0.0
        var validSeconds = 0.0
        var sameTimeSamePoint = 0
        for (index in 1 until locations.size) {
            val previous = locations[index - 1]
            val current = locations[index]
            val dt = (current.time - previous.time) / 1000.0
            val distance = trajectoryHaversineMeters(previous, current)
            when {
                dt < 0.0 -> anomalies += "时间戳倒退 ${previous.time}→${current.time}（#${index}）"
                dt == 0.0 -> {
                    if (distance > 0.05) {
                        anomalies += "重复时间戳但坐标变化 ${formatTrajectoryDouble(distance)} m（#${index}）"
                    } else {
                        sameTimeSamePoint++
                    }
                }
                else -> {
                    if (distance > TRAJECTORY_MAX_STEP_METERS) {
                        anomalies += "单步位移 ${formatTrajectoryDouble(distance / 1000.0)} km > 5 km（#${index}）"
                    }
                    val speed = distance / dt
                    if (speed > TRAJECTORY_MAX_SPEED_MPS) {
                        anomalies += "瞬时速度 ${formatTrajectoryDouble(speed)} m/s > 200（#${index}）"
                    }
                    if (speed > maxSpeed) maxSpeed = speed
                    pathDistance += distance
                    validSeconds += dt
                }
            }
        }

        val durationSeconds = (locations.last().time - locations.first().time) / 1000.0
        val averageSpeed = if (validSeconds > 0.0) pathDistance / validSeconds else 0.0
        addTrajectoryEvidence(
            evidence,
            "样本=${locations.size} 点，时长=${formatTrajectoryDouble(durationSeconds)} s，" +
                "最大速度=${formatTrajectoryDouble(maxSpeed)} m/s，平均速度=${formatTrajectoryDouble(averageSpeed)} m/s",
        )
        addTrajectoryEvidence(
            evidence,
            "时间戳异常=${anomalies.size} 条，重复时间戳同坐标=$sameTimeSamePoint 条",
        )
        anomalies.take(5).forEach { addTrajectoryEvidence(evidence, "  异常：$it") }
        if (anomalies.size > 5) addTrajectoryEvidence(evidence, "  ……其余 ${anomalies.size - 5} 条从略")

        if (anomalies.isNotEmpty()) {
            return fail("轨迹存在 ${anomalies.size} 项时间戳/瞬移硬异常，详见证据。", evidence)
        }

        if (locations.size < TRAJECTORY_MIN_POINTS || durationSeconds < TRAJECTORY_MIN_SECONDS) {
            return unknown(
                "轨迹样本不足（${locations.size} 点 / ${formatTrajectoryDouble(durationSeconds)} s）：" +
                    "至少 20 点且 30 秒才能判定；路线图建议连续采样 2–5 分钟。",
                evidence,
            )
        }

        val distinct = locations.filterIndexed { index, location ->
            index == 0 || location.time > locations[index - 1].time
        }
        val spectra = analyzePeriodicity(distinct)
        val jitter = spectra.firstOrNull { it.ratio > TRAJECTORY_MAX_FREQUENCY_RATIO && it.amplitude > 0.5 }
        val shown = jitter ?: spectra.maxByOrNull { it.ratio }
        if (shown == null) {
            addTrajectoryEvidence(evidence, "频域：可用样本不足或残差能量过低，跳过 DFT")
        } else {
            addTrajectoryEvidence(
                evidence,
                "频域（最多 256 点，${shown.points} 点）：轴=${shown.axis} k=${shown.bin} " +
                    "周期=${formatTrajectoryDouble(shown.periodSeconds)} s " +
                    "能量占比=${formatTrajectoryDouble(shown.ratio)} " +
                    "振幅=${formatTrajectoryDouble(shown.amplitude)} m",
            )
            if (jitter != null) {
                return fail(
                    "轨迹疑似固定周期抖动：周期 ${formatTrajectoryDouble(shown.periodSeconds)} s，" +
                        "主频能量占比 ${formatTrajectoryDouble(shown.ratio)}（>0.6），" +
                        "振幅 ${formatTrajectoryDouble(shown.amplitude)} m（>0.5）。",
                    evidence,
                )
            }
        }

        return pass(
            "轨迹正常：${locations.size} 点 / ${formatTrajectoryDouble(durationSeconds)} s，" +
                "最大速度 ${formatTrajectoryDouble(maxSpeed)} m/s（<=200），" +
                "平均速度 ${formatTrajectoryDouble(averageSpeed)} m/s，时间戳异常 0，无固定周期抖动。",
            evidence,
        )
    } catch (error: Throwable) {
        unknown(
            "C12 检查异常：${error.javaClass.simpleName}: ${error.message}",
            listOf("异常：${error.javaClass.simpleName}"),
        )
    }
}

private data class SpectrumCandidate(
    val axis: String,
    val bin: Int,
    val periodSeconds: Double,
    val ratio: Double,
    val amplitude: Double,
    val points: Int,
)

/** Returns one candidate per axis; null when the residual has too little usable energy. */
private fun analyzePeriodicity(locations: List<Location>): List<SpectrumCandidate> {
    if (locations.size < TRAJECTORY_MIN_DFT_POINTS) return emptyList()
    val step = maxOf(1, (locations.size + TRAJECTORY_MAX_DFT_POINTS - 1) / TRAJECTORY_MAX_DFT_POINTS)
    val sampled = locations.filterIndexed { index, _ -> index % step == 0 }
        .take(TRAJECTORY_MAX_DFT_POINTS)
    if (sampled.size < TRAJECTORY_MIN_DFT_POINTS) return emptyList()
    val spanSeconds = (sampled.last().time - sampled.first().time) / 1000.0
    if (spanSeconds <= 0.0) return emptyList()
    val meanDt = spanSeconds / (sampled.size - 1)
    val origin = sampled.first()
    val metersPerDegreeLat = 111_320.0
    val metersPerDegreeLon = 111_320.0 * cos(Math.toRadians(origin.latitude))
    val xs = sampled.map { (it.longitude - origin.longitude) * metersPerDegreeLon }
    val ys = sampled.map { (it.latitude - origin.latitude) * metersPerDegreeLat }
    return listOfNotNull(
        spectrumCandidate(xs, "lon/x", meanDt),
        spectrumCandidate(ys, "lat/y", meanDt),
    )
}

private fun spectrumCandidate(
    values: List<Double>,
    axis: String,
    meanDt: Double,
): SpectrumCandidate? {
    val residual = detrend(values)
    val n = residual.size
    if (n < TRAJECTORY_MIN_DFT_POINTS) return null
    val bins = n / 2
    if (bins < 3) return null
    val power = DoubleArray(bins + 1)
    var total = 0.0
    for (bin in 1..bins) {
        var real = 0.0
        var imaginary = 0.0
        val angleStep = 2.0 * PI * bin / n
        for (index in 0 until n) {
            val angle = angleStep * index
            real += residual[index] * cos(angle)
            imaginary -= residual[index] * sin(angle)
        }
        val value = real * real + imaginary * imaginary
        power[bin] = value
        total += value
    }
    if (total <= 1e-12) return null
    var best = 1
    for (bin in 2..bins) if (power[bin] > power[best]) best = bin
    // 少于 3 个周期更像单次转弯/绕圈趋势，不作为“固定周期抖动”。
    if (best < 3) return null
    val ratio = power[best] / total
    val amplitude = 2.0 * sqrt(power[best]) / n
    return SpectrumCandidate(
        axis = axis,
        bin = best,
        periodSeconds = n * meanDt / best,
        ratio = ratio,
        amplitude = amplitude,
        points = n,
    )
}

private fun detrend(values: List<Double>): DoubleArray {
    val n = values.size
    if (n < 2) return DoubleArray(0)
    val meanIndex = (n - 1) / 2.0
    val meanValue = values.average()
    var numerator = 0.0
    var denominator = 0.0
    for (index in 0 until n) {
        val deltaIndex = index - meanIndex
        numerator += deltaIndex * (values[index] - meanValue)
        denominator += deltaIndex * deltaIndex
    }
    val slope = if (denominator > 0.0) numerator / denominator else 0.0
    val intercept = meanValue - slope * meanIndex
    return DoubleArray(n) { index -> values[index] - (intercept + slope * index) }
}

private fun trajectoryHaversineMeters(from: Location, to: Location): Double {
    val lat1 = Math.toRadians(from.latitude)
    val lat2 = Math.toRadians(to.latitude)
    val deltaLat = lat2 - lat1
    val deltaLon = Math.toRadians(to.longitude - from.longitude)
    val h = sin(deltaLat / 2) * sin(deltaLat / 2) +
        cos(lat1) * cos(lat2) * sin(deltaLon / 2) * sin(deltaLon / 2)
    return 2 * 6_371_000.0 * asin(sqrt(h.coerceIn(0.0, 1.0)))
}

private fun addTrajectoryEvidence(evidence: MutableList<String>, line: String) {
    if (evidence.size < TRAJECTORY_MAX_EVIDENCE_LINES) {
        evidence += line.take(TRAJECTORY_MAX_EVIDENCE_CHARS)
    }
}

private fun formatTrajectoryDouble(value: Double): String =
    if (!value.isFinite()) value.toString() else String.format(Locale.US, "%.2f", value)

private const val TRAJECTORY_MIN_POINTS = 20
private const val TRAJECTORY_MIN_SECONDS = 30.0
private const val TRAJECTORY_MAX_SPEED_MPS = 200.0
private const val TRAJECTORY_MAX_STEP_METERS = 5000.0
private const val TRAJECTORY_MAX_DFT_POINTS = 256
private const val TRAJECTORY_MIN_DFT_POINTS = 32
private const val TRAJECTORY_MAX_FREQUENCY_RATIO = 0.6
private const val TRAJECTORY_MAX_EVIDENCE_LINES = 20
private const val TRAJECTORY_MAX_EVIDENCE_CHARS = 299
```

`detector/src/main/java/com/system/location/service/detector/checks/WifiChecks.kt`:

```kt
package com.system.location.service.detector.checks

import android.annotation.SuppressLint
import android.Manifest
import android.content.pm.PackageManager
import android.net.DhcpInfo
import android.net.wifi.WifiInfo
import android.net.wifi.WifiManager
import android.os.Build
import com.system.location.service.detector.model.Check
import com.system.location.service.detector.model.CheckContext
import com.system.location.service.detector.model.CheckIds
import com.system.location.service.detector.model.CheckResult

/**
 * C08 · WiFi 扫描/连接/DHCP。
 *
 * 期望：WiFi 开启时扫描非空、BSSID 合法且不是 02:00:00:00:00:00、连接 AP 出现在扫描结果、
 * DHCP 与连接状态一致。
 */
@SuppressLint("MissingPermission")
class WifiCheck : Check {
    override val id = CheckIds.WIFI
    override val title = "WiFi 扫描与连接"
    override val blocking = true

    // connectionInfo/dhcpInfo 在 API 31 已弃用；仍是公开 API，且是 C08 需要的证据来源。
    @Suppress("DEPRECATION")
    override fun run(context: CheckContext): CheckResult {
        val snapshot = context.snapshot
        val evidence = mutableListOf<String>()
        evidence += "wifiEnabled=${snapshot.wifiEnabled}"

        if (!snapshot.wifiEnabled) {
            evidence += "WiFi 关闭：跳过空列表、连接与 DHCP 判定"
            return pass("WiFi 关闭，跳过空列表判定", evidence.clipped())
        }

        var scanResults = snapshot.scanResults
        var scanSource = "snapshot"
        if (scanResults.isEmpty()) {
            val manager = context.context.applicationContext.getSystemService(WifiManager::class.java)
            if (manager == null) {
                evidence += "WifiManager 不可用"
                return unknown("设备未提供 WifiManager，无法读取 WiFi 扫描结果。", evidence.clipped())
            }
            val permission = scanPermission()
            if (context.context.checkSelfPermission(permission) != PackageManager.PERMISSION_GRANTED) {
                evidence += "缺少权限：$permission"
                return unknown("WiFi 已开启，但未授予 $permission，无法读取扫描结果。", evidence.clipped())
            }
            val queried = runCatching { manager.scanResults }
            val error = queried.exceptionOrNull()
            if (error != null) {
                evidence += "scanResults 失败：${error.javaClass.simpleName}"
                val reason = if (error is SecurityException) {
                    "读取 WiFi 扫描结果被 SecurityException 拒绝：请检查 $permission。"
                } else {
                    "读取 WiFi 扫描结果失败：${error.javaClass.simpleName}。"
                }
                return unknown(reason, evidence.clipped())
            }
            scanResults = queried.getOrDefault(emptyList())
            scanSource = "实时查询"
        }

        val failures = mutableListOf<String>()
        val invalidBssids = mutableListOf<String>()
        val sentinelBssids = mutableListOf<String>()
        val seenBssids = HashSet<String>()

        scanResults.forEach { scan ->
            val bssid = scan.BSSID?.trim().orEmpty()
            if (!BSSID_PATTERN.matches(bssid)) {
                invalidBssids += bssid.ifEmpty { "<null>" }
            } else if (isSentinelBssid(bssid)) {
                sentinelBssids += bssid
            }
            if (bssid.isNotEmpty()) seenBssids += bssid.uppercase()
        }
        val duplicateBssids = seenBssids.size < scanResults.count { !it.BSSID.isNullOrBlank() }

        if (scanResults.isEmpty()) {
            failures += "WiFi 已开启但扫描结果为空（Portal 当前空列表）"
        }
        if (invalidBssids.isNotEmpty()) {
            failures += "扫描结果含 ${invalidBssids.size} 个非法 BSSID"
        }
        if (sentinelBssids.isNotEmpty()) {
            failures += "扫描结果含 ${sentinelBssids.size} 个哨兵 BSSID（如 02:00:00:00:00:00）"
        }
        if (duplicateBssids) {
            failures += "扫描结果存在重复 BSSID"
        }

        val wifiInfo: WifiInfo? = snapshot.wifiInfo
        val connectedBssid = wifiInfo?.getBSSID()?.trim().orEmpty()
        val connectedSsid = ssidForDisplay(wifiInfo?.getSSID())
        val connected = wifiInfo != null && (
            wifiInfo.getNetworkId() != -1 ||
                (connectedBssid.isNotEmpty() &&
                    BSSID_PATTERN.matches(connectedBssid) &&
                    !isSentinelBssid(connectedBssid))
            )

        if (wifiInfo != null) {
            if (connectedBssid.isNotEmpty() && !BSSID_PATTERN.matches(connectedBssid)) {
                failures += "connectionInfo BSSID 格式非法：${connectedBssid.clip(40)}"
            }
            if (isSentinelBssid(connectedBssid)) {
                failures += "connectionInfo BSSID 是哨兵值 $connectedBssid（Portal 当前值）"
            }
        }

        if (connected) {
            val connectedInScan = scanResults.any { it.BSSID?.trim().equals(connectedBssid, ignoreCase = true) }
            if (connectedBssid.isEmpty()) {
                failures += "已连接但 connectionInfo BSSID 为空"
            } else if (scanResults.isNotEmpty() && !connectedInScan) {
                failures += "已连接 AP 的 BSSID $connectedBssid 不在扫描结果中"
            }
            if (connectedSsid.isEmpty() || connectedSsid == WifiManager.UNKNOWN_SSID) {
                failures += "已连接但 SSID 为 ${connectedSsid.ifEmpty { "<空>" }}"
            }
            val dhcpInfo = snapshot.dhcpInfo
            if (dhcpInfo == null) {
                failures += "已连接但 dhcpInfo 为空"
            } else if (dhcpInfo.ipAddress == 0) {
                failures += "已连接但 dhcpInfo.ipAddress=0"
            }
        }

        evidence += "扫描数=${scanResults.size}（来源：$scanSource）"
        scanResults.take(MAX_SCAN_EVIDENCE).forEachIndexed { index, scan ->
            evidence += "scan[${index + 1}] bssid=${scan.BSSID?.trim().orEmpty()} rssi=${scan.level} " +
                "ssid=${quote(scan.SSID)}"
        }
        evidence += "连接：bssid=${connectedBssid.ifEmpty { "<null>" }} ssid=${quote(connectedSsid)} " +
            "networkId=${wifiInfo?.getNetworkId() ?: "-"} connected=$connected"
        evidence += dhcpEvidence(snapshot.dhcpInfo)
        evidence += "统计：非法=${invalidBssids.size} 哨兵=${sentinelBssids.size} 重复=${if (duplicateBssids) 1 else 0}"
        if (invalidBssids.isNotEmpty()) evidence += "非法 BSSID：${invalidBssids.take(5).joinToString()}"
        if (sentinelBssids.isNotEmpty()) evidence += "哨兵 BSSID：${sentinelBssids.distinct().take(5).joinToString()}"
        if (duplicateBssids) {
            val duplicates = scanResults.groupBy { it.BSSID?.trim().orEmpty().uppercase() }
                .filterValues { it.size > 1 }
                .keys
                .take(5)
            evidence += "重复 BSSID：${duplicates.joinToString()}"
        }

        return if (failures.isEmpty()) {
            pass("WiFi 扫描、连接与 DHCP 自洽", evidence.clipped())
        } else {
            fail(failures.joinToString("；"), evidence.clipped())
        }
    }

    private fun scanPermission(): String =
        if (Build.VERSION.SDK_INT >= Build.VERSION_CODES.TIRAMISU) {
            Manifest.permission.NEARBY_WIFI_DEVICES
        } else {
            Manifest.permission.ACCESS_FINE_LOCATION
        }

    private fun dhcpEvidence(info: DhcpInfo?): String =
        if (info == null) {
            "DHCP：<null>"
        } else {
            "DHCP：ip=${ipv4(info.ipAddress)} gateway=${ipv4(info.gateway)} dns1=${ipv4(info.dns1)} " +
                "server=${ipv4(info.serverAddress)} lease=${info.leaseDuration}"
        }

    private fun ipv4(value: Int): String =
        "${value and 0xFF}.${(value ushr 8) and 0xFF}.${(value ushr 16) and 0xFF}.${(value ushr 24) and 0xFF}"

    private fun ssidForDisplay(raw: String?): String {
        val ssid = raw?.trim().orEmpty()
        return if (ssid.length >= 2 && ssid.startsWith('"') && ssid.endsWith('"')) {
            ssid.substring(1, ssid.length - 1)
        } else {
            ssid
        }
    }

    private fun quote(ssid: String): String = "\"${ssid.clip(MAX_SSID_CHARS)}\""

    private fun isSentinelBssid(bssid: String): Boolean =
        bssid.isNotEmpty() && bssid.uppercase() in SENTINEL_BSSIDS

    private fun String.clip(max: Int): String = replace('\n', ' ').take(max)

    private fun List<String>.clipped(): List<String> =
        take(MAX_EVIDENCE_LINES).map { it.clip(MAX_EVIDENCE_CHARS) }

    private companion object {
        const val MAX_SCAN_EVIDENCE = 5
        const val MAX_SSID_CHARS = 32
        const val MAX_EVIDENCE_LINES = 20
        const val MAX_EVIDENCE_CHARS = 280

        val BSSID_PATTERN = Regex("^([0-9A-Fa-f]{2}:){5}[0-9A-Fa-f]{2}$")
        val SENTINEL_BSSIDS = setOf(
            "02:00:00:00:00:00",
            "00:00:00:00:00:00",
            "FF:FF:FF:FF:FF:FF",
        )
    }
}
```

`detector/src/main/java/com/system/location/service/detector/model/Check.kt`:

```kt
package com.system.location.service.detector.model

enum class CheckStatus { PASS, FAIL, UNKNOWN }

/** Stable v1 check identifiers from docs/roadmap/06-validation.md. */
object CheckIds {
    const val LOCATION_MOCK = "C01"
    const val APP_OPS = "C02"
    const val SETTINGS = "C03"
    const val PROVIDER_LIST = "C04"
    const val LOCATION_FIELDS = "C05"
    const val GNSS_STATUS = "C06"
    const val NMEA = "C07"
    const val WIFI = "C08"
    const val CELL = "C09"
    const val SENSOR = "C10"
    const val ACTIVITY = "C11"
    const val TRAJECTORY = "C12"
    const val PACKAGE_IDENTITY = "C13"
    const val ROOT_TRACE = "C14"
    const val NETWORK_CONSISTENCY = "C15"
}

data class CheckResult(
    val id: String,
    val title: String,
    val status: CheckStatus,
    val detail: String,
    val evidence: List<String> = emptyList(),
    val blocking: Boolean = false,
)

/**
 * A detector check is a pure "read evidence, return a verdict" unit.
 *
 * Checks must never throw: [CheckRunner] converts unexpected exceptions into UNKNOWN so one broken
 * API cannot hide the rest of the report.
 */
interface Check {
    val id: String
    val title: String
    val blocking: Boolean get() = false

    fun run(context: CheckContext): CheckResult

    fun pass(detail: String, evidence: List<String> = emptyList()): CheckResult =
        CheckResult(id, title, CheckStatus.PASS, detail, evidence, blocking)

    fun fail(detail: String, evidence: List<String> = emptyList()): CheckResult =
        CheckResult(id, title, CheckStatus.FAIL, detail, evidence, blocking)

    fun unknown(detail: String, evidence: List<String> = emptyList()): CheckResult =
        CheckResult(id, title, CheckStatus.UNKNOWN, detail, evidence, blocking)
}
```

```kt
package com.system.location.service.detector.model

import android.content.Context
import android.os.Build
import org.json.JSONArray
import org.json.JSONObject

data class DeviceInfo(
    val manufacturer: String,
    val model: String,
    val android: String,
    val sdk: Int,
    val rom: String,
    val lsposed: String?,
    val abis: List<String>,
)

/** Read-only device identity used by the JSON report header. */
object DeviceInfoCollector {
    fun collect(context: Context): DeviceInfo {
        val packageManager = context.packageManager
        val lsposed = listOf("org.lsposed.manager", "io.github.lsposed.manager").firstNotNullOfOrNull { pkg ->
            runCatching {
                val info = packageManager.getPackageInfo(pkg, 0)
                "$pkg ${info.versionName ?: "unknown"}"
            }.getOrNull()
        }
        return DeviceInfo(
            manufacturer = Build.MANUFACTURER?.takeIf { it.isNotBlank() } ?: "unknown",
            model = Build.MODEL?.takeIf { it.isNotBlank() } ?: "unknown",
            android = Build.VERSION.RELEASE?.takeIf { it.isNotBlank() } ?: "unknown",
            sdk = Build.VERSION.SDK_INT,
            rom = "${Build.DISPLAY} (${Build.VERSION.INCREMENTAL})",
            lsposed = lsposed,
            abis = Build.SUPPORTED_ABIS?.toList() ?: emptyList(),
        )
    }
}

/**
 * Versioned detector report. [SCHEMA] must match docs/roadmap/06-validation.md section 2.3; new
 * fields are additive so older readers can ignore them.
 */
class DetectorReport(
    val generatedAtMillis: Long,
    val device: DeviceInfo,
    val checks: List<CheckResult>,
    /** Public callback observations for independent before/after distribution analysis. */
    val gnssEvidence: GnssEvidenceSnapshot? = null,
) {
    val passCount: Int get() = checks.count { it.status == CheckStatus.PASS }
    val failCount: Int get() = checks.count { it.status == CheckStatus.FAIL }
    val unknownCount: Int get() = checks.count { it.status == CheckStatus.UNKNOWN }

    fun toJson(): String {
        val root = JSONObject()
        root.put("schema", SCHEMA)
        root.put("generatedAtMillis", generatedAtMillis)
        root.put("device", JSONObject().apply {
            put("manufacturer", device.manufacturer)
            put("model", device.model)
            put("android", device.android)
            put("sdk", device.sdk)
            put("rom", device.rom)
            put("lsposed", device.lsposed ?: JSONObject.NULL)
            put("abis", JSONArray(device.abis))
        })
        root.put("summary", JSONObject().apply {
            put("pass", passCount)
            put("fail", failCount)
            put("unknown", unknownCount)
        })
        root.put("checks", JSONArray().apply {
            this@DetectorReport.checks.forEach { result ->
                put(JSONObject().apply {
                    put("id", result.id)
                    put("title", result.title)
                    put("status", result.status.name)
                    put("detail", result.detail)
                    put("blocking", result.blocking)
                    put("evidence", JSONArray(result.evidence))
                })
            }
        })
        gnssEvidence?.let { evidence ->
            root.put("gnssEvidence", JSONObject().apply {
                put("schema", 1)
                put("startedAtMillis", evidence.startedAtMillis)
                put("endedAtMillis", evidence.endedAtMillis)
                put("timeSource", "Android callback arrival UTC milliseconds")
                put("frames", JSONArray().apply {
                    evidence.frames.forEach { frame ->
                        put(JSONObject().apply {
                            put("capturedAtMillis", frame.capturedAtMillis)
                            put("satellites", JSONArray().apply {
                                frame.satellites.forEach { satellite ->
                                    put(JSONObject().apply {
                                        put("constellation", satellite.constellation)
                                        put("svid", satellite.svid)
                                        // Invalid native values must remain exportable as evidence.
                                        put("cn0DbHz", satellite.cn0DbHz.finiteJsonValue())
                                        put("elevationDegrees", satellite.elevationDegrees.finiteJsonValue())
                                        put("azimuthDegrees", satellite.azimuthDegrees.finiteJsonValue())
                                        put("usedInFix", satellite.usedInFix)
                                        put("hasEphemeris", satellite.hasEphemeris)
                                        put("hasAlmanac", satellite.hasAlmanac)
                                    })
                                }
                            })
                        })
                    }
                })
            })
        }
        return root.toString(2)
    }

    fun toText(): String = buildString {
        appendLine("Portal Detector · schema $SCHEMA")
        appendLine("device: ${device.manufacturer} ${device.model} · Android ${device.android} (SDK ${device.sdk})")
        appendLine("rom: ${device.rom}")
        appendLine("lsposed: ${device.lsposed ?: "absent"}")
        appendLine("checks: PASS=$passCount FAIL=$failCount UNKNOWN=$unknownCount")
        checks.forEach { result ->
            appendLine()
            appendLine("[${result.status}] ${result.id} ${result.title}${if (result.blocking) " (blocking)" else ""}")
            appendLine("  ${result.detail}")
            result.evidence.forEach { appendLine("  · $it") }
        }
    }

    companion object {
        const val SCHEMA = 1
    }
}

data class GnssEvidenceSnapshot(val startedAtMillis: Long, val endedAtMillis: Long,
    val frames: List<GnssFrameSnapshot>)

private fun Float.finiteJsonValue(): Any = if (isFinite()) toDouble() else toString()
```

`detector/src/main/java/com/system/location/service/detector/model/GnssProfileComparison.kt`:

```kt
package com.system.location.service.detector.model

import kotlin.math.abs

/** Independent receiver-window statistics. No model from Portal is used by the detector. */
data class GnssWindowProfile(
    val startedAtMillis: Long,
    val endedAtMillis: Long,
    val receiverSeconds: Int,
    val maximumGapMillis: Long,
    val visibleCounts: Map<Int, Int>,
    val constellationCounts: Map<Int, Int>,
    val usedCount: Int,
    /** Per-signal joint bins (constellation, 5 degree elevation, 5 dB-Hz CN0). */
    val signalBins: Map<Int, Int>,
) {
    val satelliteCount: Int get() = constellationCounts.values.sum()
    val meanVisible: Double get() = satelliteCount.toDouble() / receiverSeconds
    val usedFraction: Double? get() = if (satelliteCount == 0) null else usedCount.toDouble() / satelliteCount
    val adequate: Boolean get() = receiverSeconds >= 20 && endedAtMillis - startedAtMillis >= 30_000L &&
        maximumGapMillis <= 2_000L && satelliteCount > 0

    companion object {
        fun from(evidence: GnssEvidenceSnapshot): GnssWindowProfile {
            require(evidence.startedAtMillis >= 0 && evidence.endedAtMillis >= evidence.startedAtMillis)
            require(evidence.frames.size in 1..3000) { "需要 1–3000 帧 GNSS 状态" }
            var previous = -1L
            val seconds = sortedMapOf<Long, GnssFrameSnapshot>()
            evidence.frames.forEach { frame ->
                require(frame.capturedAtMillis in evidence.startedAtMillis..evidence.endedAtMillis &&
                    frame.capturedAtMillis >= previous) { "GNSS 帧时间倒退或超出采样窗口" }
                require(frame.satellites.size <= 512)
                previous = frame.capturedAtMillis
                frame.satellites.forEach { s ->
                    require(s.constellation in 0..7 && s.svid in 1..999 &&
                        s.cn0DbHz.isFinite() && s.cn0DbHz in 0f..63f &&
                        s.elevationDegrees.isFinite() && s.elevationDegrees in 0f..90f &&
                        s.azimuthDegrees.isFinite() && s.azimuthDegrees >= 0f && s.azimuthDegrees < 360f) {
                        "GNSS 字段无效，不能用于画像比较"
                    }
                }
                // Last arrival per UTC second: callback bursts do not increase statistical weight.
                seconds[frame.capturedAtMillis / 1000] = frame
            }
            val frames = seconds.values.toList()
            val counts = mutableMapOf<Int, Int>()
            val systems = mutableMapOf<Int, Int>()
            val bins = mutableMapOf<Int, Int>()
            var used = 0
            frames.forEach { frame ->
                // Android reports CN0=0 for placeholder rows. Keep those rows in the
                // raw evidence, but never treat them as received signals in a profile.
                val identities = frame.satellites.filter(::isUsableSignal)
                    .groupBy { it.constellation to it.svid }
                counts.increment(identities.size)
                identities.forEach { (identity, signals) ->
                    systems.increment(identity.first)
                    if (signals.any { it.usedInFix }) used++
                }
                frame.satellites.filter(::isUsableSignal).forEach { s ->
                    val elevation = minOf(17, (s.elevationDegrees / 5).toInt())
                    val cn0 = (s.cn0DbHz / 5).toInt()
                    bins.increment((s.constellation * 18 + elevation) * 13 + cn0)
                }
            }
            return GnssWindowProfile(frames.first().capturedAtMillis, frames.last().capturedAtMillis,
                frames.size, frames.zipWithNext { a, b -> b.capturedAtMillis - a.capturedAtMillis }.maxOrNull() ?: 0L,
                counts.toMap(), systems.toMap(), used, bins.toMap())
        }

        private fun MutableMap<Int, Int>.increment(key: Int) { this[key] = (this[key] ?: 0) + 1 }

        private fun isUsableSignal(satellite: GnssSatelliteSnapshot): Boolean =
            satellite.cn0DbHz > 0f && satellite.elevationDegrees in 0f..90f &&
                satellite.azimuthDegrees in 0f..<360f
    }
}

data class GnssProfileDifference(
    val visibleCountTotalVariation: Double?,
    val constellationTotalVariation: Double?,
    val signalJointTotalVariation: Double?,
    val meanVisibleDelta: Double,
    val usedFractionDelta: Double?,
    val constellationRatioDeltas: Map<Int, Double>?,
    val adequateWindows: Boolean,
)

object GnssProfileComparison {
    /** TV(P,Q) = 1/2 sum_k |P(k)-Q(k)|; an empty population has no distribution. */
    private fun distance(a: Map<Int, Int>, b: Map<Int, Int>): Double? {
        val na = a.values.sum().toDouble()
        val nb = b.values.sum().toDouble()
        if (na == 0.0 || nb == 0.0) return null
        return (a.keys + b.keys).sumOf { abs((a[it] ?: 0) / na - (b[it] ?: 0) / nb) } / 2
    }

    fun compare(reference: GnssWindowProfile, trial: GnssWindowProfile): GnssProfileDifference {
        val a = reference.usedFraction
        val b = trial.usedFraction
        val ratios = if (reference.satelliteCount == 0 || trial.satelliteCount == 0) null else
            (reference.constellationCounts.keys + trial.constellationCounts.keys).associateWith {
                (trial.constellationCounts[it] ?: 0).toDouble() / trial.satelliteCount -
                    (reference.constellationCounts[it] ?: 0).toDouble() / reference.satelliteCount
            }
        return GnssProfileDifference(distance(reference.visibleCounts, trial.visibleCounts),
            distance(reference.constellationCounts, trial.constellationCounts),
            distance(reference.signalBins, trial.signalBins), trial.meanVisible - reference.meanVisible,
            if (a == null || b == null) null else b - a, ratios, reference.adequate && trial.adequate)
    }
}
```

`detector/src/main/java/com/system/location/service/detector/model/GnssReference.kt`:

```kt
package com.system.location.service.detector.model

import java.io.DataInputStream
import java.io.DataOutputStream
import java.io.InputStream
import java.io.OutputStream

/** User-selected local evidence; the user's source assertion is not an authenticity proof. */
data class GnssReference(
    val deviceFingerprint: String,
    val environment: String,
    val savedAtMillis: Long,
    val evidence: GnssEvidenceSnapshot,
) {
    fun profile(): GnssWindowProfile = GnssWindowProfile.from(evidence)
}

/** Bounded versioned format. Recompute statistics from observations rather than trusting totals. */
object GnssReferenceCodec {
    const val MAX_BYTES = 40 * 1024 * 1024
    private const val MAGIC = 0x474E5352

    fun write(reference: GnssReference, stream: OutputStream) {
        validate(reference)
        val output = DataOutputStream(stream)
        output.writeInt(MAGIC)
        output.writeInt(1)
        output.writeUTF(reference.deviceFingerprint)
        output.writeUTF(reference.environment)
        output.writeLong(reference.savedAtMillis)
        output.writeLong(reference.evidence.startedAtMillis)
        output.writeLong(reference.evidence.endedAtMillis)
        output.writeInt(reference.evidence.frames.size)
        reference.evidence.frames.forEach { frame ->
            output.writeLong(frame.capturedAtMillis)
            output.writeInt(frame.satellites.size)
            frame.satellites.forEach { s ->
                output.writeInt(s.constellation)
                output.writeInt(s.svid)
                output.writeFloat(s.cn0DbHz)
                output.writeFloat(s.elevationDegrees)
                output.writeFloat(s.azimuthDegrees)
                output.writeBoolean(s.usedInFix)
                output.writeBoolean(s.hasEphemeris)
                output.writeBoolean(s.hasAlmanac)
                output.writeBoolean(s.hasCarrierFrequency)
            }
        }
        output.flush()
    }

    fun read(stream: InputStream): GnssReference {
        val input = DataInputStream(stream)
        require(input.readInt() == MAGIC && input.readInt() == 1) { "参考窗口格式不支持" }
        val device = input.readUTF()
        val environment = input.readUTF()
        val savedAt = input.readLong()
        val start = input.readLong()
        val end = input.readLong()
        val count = input.readInt()
        require(count in 1..3000)
        val frames = List(count) {
            val time = input.readLong()
            val satellites = input.readInt()
            require(satellites in 0..512)
            GnssFrameSnapshot(time, List(satellites) {
                GnssSatelliteSnapshot(input.readInt(), input.readInt(), input.readFloat(), input.readFloat(),
                    input.readFloat(), input.readBoolean(), input.readBoolean(), input.readBoolean(), input.readBoolean())
            })
        }
        require(input.read() == -1) { "参考窗口含多余数据" }
        return GnssReference(device, environment, savedAt, GnssEvidenceSnapshot(start, end, frames)).also(::validate)
    }

    private fun validate(reference: GnssReference) {
        require(reference.deviceFingerprint.isNotBlank() && reference.deviceFingerprint.length <= 1024)
        require(reference.environment.isNotBlank() && reference.environment.length <= 120)
        require(reference.savedAtMillis >= reference.evidence.endedAtMillis)
        require(reference.profile().adequate) { "参考窗口需至少 20 个接收秒、跨度 30 秒、间隔不超过 2 秒且存在可见卫星" }
    }
}
```

```kt
package com.system.location.service.detector.model

import android.content.Context

/** One satellite snapshot captured from [android.location.GnssStatus]. */
data class GnssSatelliteSnapshot(
    val constellation: Int,
    val svid: Int,
    val cn0DbHz: Float,
    val elevationDegrees: Float,
    val azimuthDegrees: Float,
    val usedInFix: Boolean,
    val hasEphemeris: Boolean,
    val hasAlmanac: Boolean,
    val hasCarrierFrequency: Boolean,
)

data class GnssFrameSnapshot(
    val capturedAtMillis: Long,
    val satellites: List<GnssSatelliteSnapshot>,
)

data class NmeaSentenceSnapshot(
    /** UTC epoch milliseconds supplied by OnNmeaMessageListener. */
    val timestampMillis: Long,
    val sentence: String,
)

data class AvailabilitySnapshot(
    val capturedAtMillis: Long,
    val isAvailable: Boolean,
)

data class SensorSeries(
    val type: Int,
    val values: List<FloatArray>,
)

/**
 * Immutable evidence collected before the checks run.
 *
 * Detector never derives a PASS from its own assumptions: every check reads this snapshot or
 * queries a public Android API at evaluation time.
 */
data class SampleSnapshot(
    val startedAtMillis: Long = 0L,
    val endedAtMillis: Long = 0L,
    val locations: List<Location> = emptyList(),
    val gnssFrames: List<GnssFrameSnapshot> = emptyList(),
    val nmeaSentences: List<NmeaSentenceSnapshot> = emptyList(),
    val availability: List<AvailabilitySnapshot> = emptyList(),
    val sensorSeries: Map<Int, SensorSeries> = emptyMap(),
    val scanResults: List<ScanResult> = emptyList(),
    val wifiInfo: WifiInfo? = null,
    val dhcpInfo: DhcpInfo? = null,
    val cellInfo: List<CellInfo> = emptyList(),
    val wifiEnabled: Boolean = false,
    val lastKnownByProvider: Map<String, Location> = emptyMap(),
    val notes: List<String> = emptyList(),
) {
    val primaryLocation: Location? get() = locations.lastOrNull()

    fun locationsFor(provider: String): List<Location> =
        locations.filter { it.provider == provider }
}

data class CheckContext(
    val context: Context,
    val settings: DetectorSettings,
    val snapshot: SampleSnapshot,
    val gnssReference: GnssReference? = null,
    val gnssReferenceNote: String = "未保存参考窗口，画像比较跳过",
) {
    val locationManager: LocationManager? get() = context.getSystemService(LocationManager::class.java)
}
```

`detector/src/main/java/com/system/location/service/detector/sample/CheckSampler.kt`:

```kt
package com.system.location.service.detector.sample

import android.annotation.SuppressLint
import android.content.Context
import android.hardware.Sensor
import android.hardware.SensorEvent
import android.hardware.SensorEventListener
import android.hardware.SensorManager
import android.location.GnssStatus
import android.location.Location
import android.location.LocationListener
import android.location.LocationManager
import android.location.OnNmeaMessageListener
import android.os.Looper
import android.telephony.TelephonyManager
import com.system.location.service.detector.DetectorSettings
import com.system.location.service.detector.model.GnssFrameSnapshot
import com.system.location.service.detector.model.GnssSatelliteSnapshot
import com.system.location.service.detector.model.NmeaSentenceSnapshot
import com.system.location.service.detector.model.SampleSnapshot
import com.system.location.service.detector.model.SensorSeries
import java.util.Collections
import java.util.concurrent.ConcurrentHashMap
import java.util.concurrent.atomic.AtomicInteger

/**
 * Collects the evidence snapshot used by every check. Blocking by design: the caller runs it on a
 * worker thread and only the UI is updated on the main thread.
 *
 * A denied permission is recorded in [SampleSnapshot.notes] instead of failing the whole run; the
 * affected checks then report UNKNOWN with the reason.
 */
@SuppressLint("MissingPermission")
class CheckSampler(
    private val context: Context,
    private val settings: DetectorSettings,
) {
    fun collect(onTick: (remainingSeconds: Int) -> Unit): SampleSnapshot {
        val startedAt = System.currentTimeMillis()
        val notes = Collections.synchronizedList(mutableListOf<String>())
        val locations = Collections.synchronizedList(mutableListOf<Location>())
        val gnssFrames = Collections.synchronizedList(mutableListOf<GnssFrameSnapshot>())
        val nmeaSentences = Collections.synchronizedList(mutableListOf<NmeaSentenceSnapshot>())
        val droppedLocations = AtomicInteger()
        val droppedGnss = AtomicInteger()
        val droppedNmea = AtomicInteger()
        val sensorSamples = ConcurrentHashMap<Int, MutableList<FloatArray>>()
        val lastKnown = LinkedHashMap<String, Location>()

        val locationManager = context.getSystemService(LocationManager::class.java)
        val executor = context.mainExecutor
        val sensorManager = context.getSystemService(SensorManager::class.java)
        val wifiManager = context.applicationContext.getSystemService(android.net.wifi.WifiManager::class.java)
        val telephonyManager = context.getSystemService(TelephonyManager::class.java)

        val locationListener = object : LocationListener {
            override fun onLocationChanged(location: Location) {
                if (locations.size < MAX_LOCATIONS) locations.add(Location(location))
                else droppedLocations.incrementAndGet()
            }
        }
        val gnssCallback = object : GnssStatus.Callback() {
            override fun onSatelliteStatusChanged(status: GnssStatus) {
                if (gnssFrames.size >= MAX_GNSS_FRAMES) { droppedGnss.incrementAndGet(); return }
                val satellites = ArrayList<GnssSatelliteSnapshot>(status.satelliteCount)
                for (index in 0 until status.satelliteCount) {
                    satellites += GnssSatelliteSnapshot(
                        constellation = status.getConstellationType(index),
                        svid = status.getSvid(index),
                        cn0DbHz = status.getCn0DbHz(index),
                        elevationDegrees = status.getElevationDegrees(index),
                        azimuthDegrees = status.getAzimuthDegrees(index),
                        usedInFix = status.usedInFix(index),
                        hasEphemeris = status.hasEphemerisData(index),
                        hasAlmanac = status.hasAlmanacData(index),
                        hasCarrierFrequency = status.hasCarrierFrequencyHz(index),
                    )
                }
                gnssFrames.add(GnssFrameSnapshot(System.currentTimeMillis(), satellites))
            }
        }
        val nmeaListener = OnNmeaMessageListener { message: String?, timestamp: Long ->
            if (message != null && nmeaSentences.size < MAX_NMEA) {
                nmeaSentences.add(NmeaSentenceSnapshot(timestamp, message))
            } else if (message != null) droppedNmea.incrementAndGet()
        }
        val sensorListener = object : SensorEventListener {
            override fun onSensorChanged(event: SensorEvent) {
                val series = sensorSamples.getOrPut(event.sensor.type) { Collections.synchronizedList(mutableListOf()) }
                if (series.size < MAX_SENSOR_SAMPLES) series.add(event.values.copyOf())
            }

            override fun onAccuracyChanged(sensor: Sensor?, accuracy: Int) = Unit
        }

        var registeredGnss = false
        var registeredNmea = false
        var registeredSensors = 0
        try {
            if (locationManager == null) {
                notes += "LocationManager 不可用"
            } else {
                val providers = linkedSetOf(LocationManager.GPS_PROVIDER, LocationManager.NETWORK_PROVIDER)
                runCatching { locationManager.allProviders }.getOrDefault(emptyList())
                    .filter { it == "fused" }
                    .forEach { providers += it }
                providers.forEach { provider ->
                    runCatching {
                        locationManager.requestLocationUpdates(provider, 500L, 0f, locationListener, Looper.getMainLooper())
                    }.onFailure {
                        notes += "$provider requestLocationUpdates 失败：${it.javaClass.simpleName}"
                    }
                    runCatching { locationManager.getLastKnownLocation(provider) }
                        .getOrNull()?.let { lastKnown[provider] = Location(it) }
                }
                runCatching { locationManager.registerGnssStatusCallback(executor, gnssCallback) }
                    .onSuccess {
                        registeredGnss = it
                        if (!it) notes += "GnssStatus 注册被系统拒绝（返回 false）"
                    }
                    .onFailure { notes += "GnssStatus 注册失败：${it.javaClass.simpleName}" }
                runCatching { locationManager.addNmeaListener(executor, nmeaListener) }
                    .onSuccess {
                        registeredNmea = it
                        if (!it) notes += "NMEA 注册被系统拒绝（返回 false）"
                    }
                    .onFailure { notes += "NMEA 注册失败：${it.javaClass.simpleName}" }
            }

            if (sensorManager == null) {
                notes += "SensorManager 不可用"
            } else {
                SENSOR_TYPES.forEach { type ->
                    val sensor = sensorManager.getDefaultSensor(type) ?: return@forEach
                    runCatching { sensorManager.registerListener(sensorListener, sensor, SensorManager.SENSOR_DELAY_NORMAL) }
                        .onSuccess { registeredSensors++ }
                        .onFailure { notes += "传感器 $type 注册失败：${it.javaClass.simpleName}" }
                }
            }

            wifiManager?.let { manager ->
                runCatching { manager.startScan() }.onFailure {
                    notes += "WiFi startScan 失败：${it.javaClass.simpleName}"
                }
            }

            val durationSeconds = settings.sampleSeconds
            for (remaining in durationSeconds downTo 1) {
                onTick(remaining)
                Thread.sleep(1_000L)
            }
        } finally {
            locationManager?.let { manager ->
                runCatching { manager.removeUpdates(locationListener) }
                if (registeredGnss) runCatching { manager.unregisterGnssStatusCallback(gnssCallback) }
                if (registeredNmea) runCatching { manager.removeNmeaListener(nmeaListener) }
            }
            if (sensorManager != null && registeredSensors > 0) runCatching { sensorManager.unregisterListener(sensorListener) }
        }

        val scanResults = runCatching { wifiManager?.scanResults.orEmpty() }.getOrDefault(emptyList())
        val wifiInfo = runCatching { wifiManager?.connectionInfo }.getOrNull()
        val dhcpInfo = runCatching { wifiManager?.dhcpInfo }.getOrNull()
        val wifiEnabled = runCatching { wifiManager?.isWifiEnabled == true }.getOrDefault(false)
        val cellInfo = runCatching { telephonyManager?.allCellInfo.orEmpty() }.getOrDefault(emptyList())
        if (droppedLocations.get() > 0) notes += "LocationManager 采样容量不足，丢弃 ${droppedLocations.get()} 个位置；不代表完整窗口"
        if (droppedGnss.get() > 0) notes += "GNSS 采样容量不足，丢弃 ${droppedGnss.get()} 帧；不代表完整窗口"
        if (droppedNmea.get() > 0) notes += "NMEA 采样容量不足，丢弃 ${droppedNmea.get()} 句；不代表完整窗口"

        return SampleSnapshot(
            startedAtMillis = startedAt,
            endedAtMillis = System.currentTimeMillis(),
            locations = locations.toList(),
            gnssFrames = gnssFrames.toList(),
            nmeaSentences = nmeaSentences.toList(),
            availability = emptyList(),
            sensorSeries = sensorSamples.mapValues { (type, values) -> SensorSeries(type, values.toList()) },
            scanResults = scanResults,
            wifiInfo = wifiInfo,
            dhcpInfo = dhcpInfo,
            cellInfo = cellInfo,
            wifiEnabled = wifiEnabled,
            lastKnownByProvider = lastKnown,
            notes = notes.toList(),
        )
    }

    companion object {
        // Explicit memory budgets for the longest selectable window, not assumptions about
        // receiver rates. Overflow is counted and reported rather than silently truncating.
        private const val MAX_LOCATIONS = DetectorSettings.MAX_SAMPLE_SECONDS * 100
        private const val MAX_GNSS_FRAMES = DetectorSettings.MAX_SAMPLE_SECONDS * 10
        private const val MAX_NMEA = DetectorSettings.MAX_SAMPLE_SECONDS * 160
        private const val MAX_SENSOR_SAMPLES = 500
        private val SENSOR_TYPES = listOf(
            Sensor.TYPE_ACCELEROMETER,
            Sensor.TYPE_GYROSCOPE,
            Sensor.TYPE_MAGNETIC_FIELD,
            Sensor.TYPE_PRESSURE,
            Sensor.TYPE_STEP_COUNTER,
            Sensor.TYPE_STEP_DETECTOR,
        )
    }
}
```
