`detector/src/test/java/com/system/location/service/detector/checks/GnssStatusCheckTest.kt`:

```kt
package com.system.location.service.detector.checks

import com.system.location.service.detector.model.GnssFrameSnapshot
import com.system.location.service.detector.model.GnssSatelliteSnapshot
import com.system.location.service.detector.model.GnssReference
import com.system.location.service.detector.model.GnssEvidenceSnapshot
import com.system.location.service.detector.model.SampleSnapshot
import org.junit.Assert.*
import org.junit.Test

class GnssStatusCheckTest {
    private val check = GnssStatusCheck()
    private fun satellite(id: Int, used: Boolean = true) = GnssSatelliteSnapshot(
        1, id, 20f + id % 20, 10f + id % 70, id * 17f % 360, used, true, true, false)
    private fun analyze(satellites: List<GnssSatelliteSnapshot>) = check.analyze(
        (0..2).map { GnssFrameSnapshot(1000L + it * 1000, satellites) })

    @Test fun referenceComparisonIsVisibleAndDescriptiveWithoutAnInventedForgeryThreshold() {
        val frames = (0L..30L).map { GnssFrameSnapshot(it * 1000, listOf(satellite(1), satellite(2))) }
        val reference = GnssReference("device", "室外", 40_000, GnssEvidenceSnapshot(0, 30_000, frames))
        val snapshot = SampleSnapshot(0, 30_000, gnssFrames = frames.map { f ->
            f.copy(satellites = f.satellites.map { it.copy(constellation = 6) })
        })
        val lines = check.profileEvidence(snapshot, reference, "")
        assertTrue(lines.any { it.contains("星座=1.000") })
        assertTrue(lines.any { it.contains("GPS=1.000") })
        assertTrue(lines.any { it.contains("GALILEO=1.000") })
        assertTrue(lines.any { it.contains("不设伪造阈值") })
        assertFalse(lines.any { it.contains("覆盖不足") })
        assertTrue(check.profileEvidence(snapshot.copy(gnssFrames = frames.take(3)), reference, "")
            .any { it.contains("覆盖不足") })
        assertEquals(listOf("画像比较：文件损坏"), check.profileEvidence(snapshot, null, "文件损坏"))
        assertTrue(check.profileEvidence(snapshot.copy(gnssFrames = emptyList()), reference, "")
            .single().startsWith("画像比较不可用"))
    }

    @Test fun negativeElevationAndInvalidAnglesCannotBeDiscardedByCorrelationFiltering() {
        for (elevation in listOf(-1f, 91f, Float.NaN)) {
            assertTrue(analyze(listOf(satellite(1).copy(elevationDegrees = elevation))).issues.any { it.contains("仰角") })
        }
        for (azimuth in listOf(-1f, 360f, Float.POSITIVE_INFINITY)) {
            assertTrue(analyze(listOf(satellite(1).copy(azimuthDegrees = azimuth))).issues.any { it.contains("方位角") })
        }
    }

    @Test fun cn0UsesAndroidRangeIncluding63() {
        assertTrue(analyze(listOf(satellite(1).copy(cn0DbHz = 63f))).issues.isEmpty())
        for (cn0 in listOf(-1f, 63.01f, Float.NaN)) {
            assertTrue(analyze(listOf(satellite(1).copy(cn0DbHz = cn0))).issues.any { it.contains("CN0") })
        }
    }

    @Test fun sparseIndoorAndSingleSystemObservationsAreNotProofOfForgery() {
        val empty = analyze(emptyList())
        assertTrue(empty.issues.isEmpty())
        assertTrue(empty.observations.isNotEmpty())
        val unfixed = analyze((1..5).map { satellite(it, false) })
        assertTrue(unfixed.issues.isEmpty())
        assertTrue(unfixed.observations.any { it.contains("未参与定位") })
        val low = analyze((1..5).map { satellite(it, it <= 3) })
        assertTrue(low.issues.isEmpty())
        assertTrue(low.observations.any { it.contains("不足以确认三维定位") })
        val gpsOnly = analyze((1..8).map { satellite(it) })
        assertTrue(gpsOnly.issues.isEmpty())
        assertFalse(gpsOnly.observations.any { it.contains("星座数") })
    }

    @Test fun multibandCountsAbove64AndRepeatedSvidDoNotImplyInvalidStatus() {
        val dualBand = (1..40).flatMap { listOf(satellite(it), satellite(it).copy(cn0DbHz = 42f)) }
        assertEquals(80, dualBand.size)
        val result = analyze(dualBand)
        assertTrue(result.issues.isEmpty())
        assertEquals(listOf(40, 40, 40), result.satellitesPerFrame)
        assertEquals(listOf(40, 40, 40), result.usedInFixPerFrame)
        assertEquals(mapOf(1 to 120), result.constellationHistogram)
        assertEquals(120, result.satelliteSamples)
        assertEquals(240, result.cn0Samples)
        val oneIdentity = analyze(List(8) { satellite(1) })
        assertTrue(oneIdentity.observations.any { it.contains("仅 1 颗独立卫星") })
    }

    @Test fun constellationRatiosCountIdentitiesAndAnyUsedSignalMarksItsSatelliteInUse() {
        val signals = listOf(satellite(1, false), satellite(1, true), satellite(2, false).copy(constellation = 6))
        val result = analyze(signals)
        assertEquals(mapOf(1 to 3, 6 to 3), result.constellationHistogram)
        assertEquals(listOf(2, 2, 2), result.satellitesPerFrame)
        assertEquals(listOf(1, 1, 1), result.usedInFixPerFrame)
        assertEquals(3, result.usedInFixTotal)
    }

    @Test fun identityTurnoverRemainsDescriptiveWithoutAttributingItToRandomization() {
        val result = check.analyze((0..2).map { index ->
            GnssFrameSnapshot(1000L + index * 1000,
                (1..8).map { satellite(it + index * 8, false).copy(cn0DbHz = 0f) })
        })
        assertEquals(listOf(0, 0, 0), result.satellitesPerFrame)
        assertNull(result.jaccardMin)
        assertNull(result.jaccardAvg)
        assertEquals(0, result.jaccardPairs)
        assertTrue(result.issues.isEmpty())
        assertTrue(result.observations.any { it.contains("没有可用信号") })
        assertFalse(result.observations.any { it.contains("shuffle") || it.contains("Jaccard") })
    }
}
```

`detector/src/test/java/com/system/location/service/detector/checks/LocationFieldValidationTest.kt`:

```kt
package com.system.location.service.detector.checks

import org.junit.Assert.*
import com.system.location.service.detector.model.*
import org.junit.Test

class LocationFieldValidationTest {
    private fun issues(fields: Map<String, Double>) = LocationFieldValidation.issues(31.0, 121.0, fields)

    @Test fun optionalGnssAndAccuracyFieldsMayBeAbsentForAnyProvider() {
        assertTrue(issues(emptyMap()).isEmpty())
        assertTrue(issues(mapOf("speed" to 0.0, "bearing" to 45.0)).isEmpty())
        assertTrue(issues(mapOf("satellites" to 0.0, "altitude" to -45.0)).isEmpty())
    }

    @Test fun zeroUncertaintyAndAccuracyAreValid() {
        val fields = listOf("accuracy", "verticalAccuracy", "speedAccuracy", "bearingAccuracy",
            "elapsedUncertainty", "mslAccuracy", "meanCn0", "maxCn0")
        assertTrue(issues(fields.associateWith { 0.0 }).isEmpty())
    }

    @Test fun suppliedNonFiniteAndNegativeUncertaintyAreErrors() {
        for (field in listOf("altitude", "mslAltitude", "speed", "accuracy", "elapsedUncertainty", "meanCn0")) {
            for (invalid in listOf(Double.NaN, Double.POSITIVE_INFINITY, Double.NEGATIVE_INFINITY)) {
                assertFalse("$field=$invalid", issues(mapOf(field to invalid)).isEmpty())
            }
        }
        assertFalse(issues(mapOf("speedAccuracy" to -1.0)).isEmpty())
    }

    @Test fun coordinatesBearingAndGnssExtrasRespectTheirOwnDomains() {
        assertFalse(LocationFieldValidation.issues(91.0, 121.0, emptyMap()).isEmpty())
        assertFalse(LocationFieldValidation.issues(31.0, -181.0, emptyMap()).isEmpty())
        assertFalse(issues(mapOf("bearing" to 360.0)).isEmpty())
        assertFalse(issues(mapOf("satellites" to 3.5)).isEmpty())
        assertFalse(issues(mapOf("meanCn0" to 64.0)).isEmpty())
        assertFalse(issues(mapOf("meanCn0" to 40.0, "maxCn0" to 30.0)).isEmpty())
    }
    private fun frame(at: Long = 10000): GnssFrameSnapshot {
        val satellite = GnssSatelliteSnapshot(1, 1, 30f, 40f, 50f, true, true, true, true)
        return GnssFrameSnapshot(at, listOf(satellite, satellite.copy(cn0DbHz = 40f),
            satellite.copy(svid = 2, usedInFix = false)))
    }

    @Test fun gpsExtrasCompareUniqueUsedSatellitesRatherThanVisibleOrSignalCount() {
        assertTrue(LocationGnssReconciliation.compare("gps", 10000,
            mapOf("satellites" to 1.0, "meanCn0" to 35.0), listOf(frame())).isEmpty())
        val mismatches = LocationGnssReconciliation.compare("gps", 10000,
            mapOf("satellites" to 12.0, "maxCn0" to 45.0), listOf(frame()))
        assertEquals(2, mismatches.size)
    }

    @Test fun networkOrStaleEvidenceDoesNotParticipateInGnssReconciliation() {
        for ((provider, at) in listOf("network" to 10000L, "gps" to 5000L)) {
            assertTrue(LocationGnssReconciliation.compare(provider, at,
                mapOf("satellites" to 12.0), listOf(frame())).isEmpty())
        }
    }

    @Test fun laterFusedCallbackCannotHideEarlierGpsContradiction() {
        val samples = listOf(
            LocationFieldSample("gps", 10000, 31.0, 121.0, mapOf("satellites" to 12.0)),
            LocationFieldSample("fused", 10001, 31.0, 121.0, emptyMap()),
        )
        val result = LocationWindowValidation.evaluate(samples, listOf(frame()))
        assertTrue(result.issues.isEmpty())
        assertEquals(1, result.discrepancies.size)
        assertEquals(1, result.gpsExtrasCount)
        assertEquals(1, result.comparedGpsCount)
    }

    @Test fun windowRetainsInvalidEarlierFieldsAndSeparatesMissingComparisonCoverage() {
        val samples = listOf(
            LocationFieldSample("network", 10000, 91.0, 121.0, mapOf("accuracy" to -1.0)),
            LocationFieldSample("gps", 5000, 31.0, 121.0, mapOf("satellites" to 12.0)),
            LocationFieldSample("gps", 10000, 31.0, 121.0, emptyMap()),
            LocationFieldSample("fused", 10001, 31.0, 121.0, emptyMap()),
        )
        val result = LocationWindowValidation.evaluate(samples, listOf(frame()))
        assertEquals(2, result.issues.size)
        assertTrue(result.discrepancies.isEmpty())
        assertEquals(1, result.gpsExtrasCount)
        assertEquals(0, result.comparedGpsCount)
    }

    @Test fun coherentMovingHighRateGpsSamplesAreAllReconciled() {
        val samples = (0..9).map { index -> LocationFieldSample("gps", 10000 + index * 100L,
            31.0 + index * 0.00001, 121.0, mapOf("satellites" to 1.0, "meanCn0" to 35.0)) }
        val result = LocationWindowValidation.evaluate(samples, listOf(frame()))
        assertTrue(result.issues.isEmpty())
        assertTrue(result.discrepancies.isEmpty())
        assertEquals(10, result.gpsExtrasCount)
        assertEquals(10, result.comparedGpsCount)
    }

    @Test fun receiverEpochKeepsLateSamplesWithTheirOwnSkyEvenWhenNextCallbackIsCloser() {
        val first = frame(10120)
        val next = first.copy(capturedAtMillis = 11120,
            satellites = first.satellites + first.satellites.first().copy(svid = 3))
        val epochs = listOf(GnssStatusEpoch(10000, first), GnssStatusEpoch(11000, next))
        val samples = listOf(
            LocationFieldSample("gps", 10800, 31.0, 121.0, mapOf("satellites" to 1.0)),
            LocationFieldSample("gps", 11020, 31.0, 121.0, mapOf("satellites" to 2.0)))
        val result = LocationWindowValidation.evaluate(samples, listOf(first, next), epochs)
        assertTrue(result.discrepancies.toString(), result.discrepancies.isEmpty())
        assertEquals(2, result.comparedGpsCount)
        val wrong = LocationWindowValidation.evaluate(samples.map { it.copy(supplied = mapOf("satellites" to 9.0)) },
            listOf(first, next), epochs)
        assertEquals(2, wrong.discrepancies.size)
    }

}
```

`detector/src/test/java/com/system/location/service/detector/checks/NmeaCheckTest.kt`:

```kt
package com.system.location.service.detector.checks

import com.system.location.service.detector.model.*
import org.junit.Assert.*
import org.junit.Test

class NmeaCheckTest {
    @Test fun emptySkyStillHasAReceiverEpochWithoutGsv() {
        val frame = GnssFrameSnapshot(10120, emptyList())
        val snapshot = SampleSnapshot(startedAtMillis = 9000, endedAtMillis = 12000,
            gnssFrames = listOf(frame), nmeaSentences = listOf(sentence("GNGGA,,,,,,0,00,,,,,,,", 10000)))
        assertEquals(listOf(GnssStatusEpoch(10000, frame)), nmeaStatusEpochs(snapshot))
    }
    @Test fun statusEpochUsesNmeaTimestampRatherThanCallbackArrival() {
        val satellite = GnssSatelliteSnapshot(1, 1, 30f, 40f, 50f, true, true, true, true)
        val frame = GnssFrameSnapshot(10120, listOf(satellite))
        val gsv = sentence("GPGSV,1,1,1,01,40,050,30", 10000)
        val snapshot = SampleSnapshot(startedAtMillis = 9000, endedAtMillis = 12000,
            gnssFrames = listOf(frame), nmeaSentences = listOf(gsv))
        assertEquals(listOf(GnssStatusEpoch(10000, frame)), nmeaStatusEpochs(snapshot))
        assertTrue(nmeaStatusEpochs(snapshot.copy(nmeaSentences = listOf(gsv.copy(sentence = "bad")))).isEmpty())
        assertTrue(nmeaStatusEpochs(snapshot.copy(nmeaSentences = listOf(
            sentence("GPGSV,2,1,5,01,40,050,30", 10000)))).isEmpty())
        assertTrue(nmeaStatusEpochs(snapshot.copy(gnssFrames = listOf(frame.copy(capturedAtMillis = 15000)))).isEmpty())
    }

    private fun sentence(body: String, at: Long = 10000): NmeaSentenceSnapshot {
        val checksum = body.fold(0) { value, char -> value xor char.code }
        return NmeaSentenceSnapshot(at, "$" + body + "*" + "%02X".format(checksum))
    }
    private fun fixture(used: Int = 4, quality: Int = 1, fix: Int = 3,
        dop: String = "1.2,1.0,0.7", gsvAt: Long = 10000): List<NmeaSentenceSnapshot> {
        val gsa = listOf("A", fix.toString()) + (1..12).map { if (it <= used && fix != 1) "%02d".format(it) else "" } + dop.split(',')
        return listOf(
            sentence("GPGGA,120000.00,3100.000,N,12100.000,E,$quality,%02d,1.0,,M,,M,,".format(used)),
            sentence("GPRMC,120000.00,${if (quality > 0) "A" else "V"},3100.000,N,12100.000,E,0,0,101126,,,${if (quality > 0) "A" else "N"}"),
            sentence("GPGSA," + gsa.joinToString(",")),
            sentence("GPGSV,2,1,8,01,10,010,25,02,20,050,26,03,30,100,28,04,40,150,30", gsvAt),
            sentence("GPGSV,2,2,8,05,50,200,32,06,60,250,34,07,70,300,36,08,80,350,38", gsvAt),
        )
    }
    private fun evaluate(lines: List<NmeaSentenceSnapshot>) = NmeaCheck().evaluate(
        SampleSnapshot(startedAtMillis = 10000, endedAtMillis = 20000, nmeaSentences = lines))

    @Test fun usedAndVisibleCountsMayDifferAndGstZdaAreOptional() {
        val result = evaluate(fixture())
        assertEquals(result.detail, CheckStatus.PASS, result.status)
    }

    @Test fun noGnssFixIsValidWithoutInventedDopOrSatelliteUse() {
        val result = evaluate(fixture(used = 0, quality = 0, fix = 1, dop = ",,"))
        assertEquals(result.detail, CheckStatus.PASS, result.status)
    }

    @Test fun noFixReceiverMayLeaveUnavailableSatelliteCountBlankWithoutInventingZero() {
        val empty = sentence("GPGGA,,,,,,0,,,,,,,,")
        val result = evaluate(listOf(empty, sentence("GPRMC,,V,,,,,,,,,,N")))
        assertEquals(result.detail, CheckStatus.UNKNOWN, result.status)
        assertFalse(result.detail.contains("字段非法"))
        assertTrue(result.evidence.any { it == "GGA 卫星数：无" })
        // A later complete epoch cannot turn a missing count into verified agreement.
        val mixed = evaluate(listOf(empty.copy(timestampMillis = 9000)) + fixture())
        assertEquals(mixed.detail, CheckStatus.UNKNOWN, mixed.status)
        assertTrue(mixed.evidence.any { it.contains("卫星数未提供") })
    }

    @Test fun nullCountsAreNotAcceptedForClaimedFixesOrMalformedFields() {
        for ((quality, count) in listOf("1" to "", "" to "", "0" to "x", "0" to "-1")) {
            val result = evaluate(listOf(sentence("GPGGA,120000,3100,N,12100,E,$quality,$count,,,,,,,")))
            assertEquals("quality=$quality count=$count", CheckStatus.FAIL, result.status)
        }
    }

    @Test fun usedCannotExceedContemporaneousVisibleCount() {
        val result = evaluate(fixture(used = 9))
        assertEquals(CheckStatus.FAIL, result.status)
        assertTrue(result.detail.contains("在用数超过"))
    }

    @Test fun staleGsvIsNotComparedWithCurrentFix() {
        val result = evaluate(fixture(used = 9, gsvAt = 1000))
        assertFalse(result.detail, result.detail.contains("在用数超过"))
        assertEquals(CheckStatus.UNKNOWN, result.status)
    }

    @Test fun threeDimensionalClaimRequiresAtLeastFourUsedSatellitesAndFiniteDop() {
        val sparse = evaluate(fixture(used = 3))
        assertEquals(CheckStatus.FAIL, sparse.status)
        assertTrue(sparse.detail.contains("三维定位"))
        for (dop in listOf(",,", "NaN,1,1", "1,0,1", "Infinity,1,1")) {
            val result = evaluate(fixture(dop = dop))
            assertTrue(result.detail, result.detail.contains("DOP"))
        }
    }

    @Test fun missingOptionalReceiverOutputIsUnknownInsteadOfForgery() {
        val result = evaluate(fixture().filterNot { it.sentence.contains("GSA") })
        assertEquals(CheckStatus.UNKNOWN, result.status)
    }

    @Test fun previousEpochZdaDoesNotContradictCurrentGga() {
        val result = evaluate(fixture() + sentence("GPZDA,115959.00,10,11,2026,00,00", 9000))
        assertEquals(result.detail, CheckStatus.PASS, result.status)
    }

    @Test fun multiSignalGsvCountsUniqueSatellitesInsteadOfAddingSignalCounts() {
        val base = fixture()
        val signalOne = base.filter { it.sentence.contains("GSV") }.map {
            sentence(it.sentence.substringAfter('$').substringBefore('*') + ",1")
        }
        val signalFive = base.filter { it.sentence.contains("GSV") }.map {
            sentence(it.sentence.substringAfter('$').substringBefore('*') + ",5")
        }
        val result = evaluate(base.filterNot { it.sentence.contains("GSV") } + signalOne + signalFive)
        assertEquals(result.detail, CheckStatus.PASS, result.status)
        assertTrue(result.evidence.joinToString().contains("最新合计=8"))
        assertTrue(result.evidence.joinToString().contains("1 组 burst"))
    }

    @Test fun multiSignalGsvDoesNotMaskTooManyUsedSpacecraft() {
        val base = fixture(used = 9)
        val gsv = base.filter { it.sentence.contains("GSV") }
        val signals = listOf(1, 5).flatMap { signal -> gsv.map {
            sentence(it.sentence.substringAfter('$').substringBefore('*') + ",$signal")
        } }
        val result = evaluate(base.filterNot { it.sentence.contains("GSV") } + signals)
        assertTrue(result.detail, result.detail.contains("在用数超过"))
    }

    @Test fun invalidGsvHeaderAtWindowBoundaryIsStillAnError() {
        val result = evaluate(fixture().filterNot { it.sentence.contains("GSV") } + sentence("GPGSV,0,1,-1"))
        assertEquals(CheckStatus.FAIL, result.status)
        assertTrue(result.detail.contains("GSV 头"))
    }

    @Test fun combinedFixWithMissingConstellationGsvIsNotCountedAsContradiction() {
        val base = fixture(used = 9).map {
            if (it.sentence.contains("GGA")) sentence(it.sentence.substringAfter('$').substringBefore('*').replace("GPGGA", "GNGGA")) else it
        }
        val bdsFields = listOf("A", "3", "01") + List(11) { "" } + listOf("1.2", "1.0", "0.7", "4")
        val result = evaluate(base + sentence("GNGSA," + bdsFields.joinToString(",")))
        assertEquals(result.detail, CheckStatus.UNKNOWN, result.status)
        assertFalse(result.detail, result.detail.contains("在用数超过"))
    }

    @Test fun sourceDifferenceNeedsTimingAndCapabilityReviewInsteadOfPassOrForgery() {
        val satellite = GnssSatelliteSnapshot(1, 1, 30f, 30f, 30f, true, true, true, false)
        val result = NmeaCheck().evaluate(SampleSnapshot(startedAtMillis = 10000, endedAtMillis = 20000,
            nmeaSentences = fixture(), gnssFrames = listOf(GnssFrameSnapshot(10000, listOf(satellite)))))
        assertEquals(result.detail, CheckStatus.UNKNOWN, result.status)
        assertTrue(result.detail.contains("GnssStatus"))
    }

    private fun visibleStatus(ids: List<Int>, at: Long): GnssFrameSnapshot = GnssFrameSnapshot(at,
        ids.map { id -> GnssSatelliteSnapshot(1, id, 30f, 30f, 30f, id <= 4, true, true, false) })

    @Test fun laterMatchingEpochCannotHideEarlierVisibleCountDifference() {
        val lines = fixture() + fixture().map { it.copy(timestampMillis = 20000) }
        val result = NmeaCheck().evaluate(SampleSnapshot(nmeaSentences = lines, gnssFrames = listOf(
            visibleStatus((1..9).toList(), 10000), visibleStatus((1..8).toList(), 20000))))
        assertEquals(result.detail, CheckStatus.UNKNOWN, result.status)
    }

    @Test fun equalCountsCannotHideDifferentUnusedVisibleIdentitiesInEarlierEpoch() {
        val lines = fixture() + fixture().map { it.copy(timestampMillis = 20000) }
        val result = NmeaCheck().evaluate(SampleSnapshot(nmeaSentences = lines, gnssFrames = listOf(
            visibleStatus((1..7).toList() + 9, 10000), visibleStatus((1..8).toList(), 20000))))
        assertEquals(result.detail, CheckStatus.UNKNOWN, result.status)
    }

    @Test fun repeatedSignalRecordsDoNotCreateCrossSourceIdentityDifferences() {
        val status = visibleStatus((1..8).toList(), 10000)
        val result = NmeaCheck().evaluate(SampleSnapshot(nmeaSentences = fixture(), gnssFrames = listOf(
            status.copy(satellites = status.satellites + status.satellites.map { it.copy(cn0DbHz = 25f) }))))
        assertEquals(result.detail, CheckStatus.PASS, result.status)
    }

    @Test fun checksumFailureRemainsAnError() {
        val lines = fixture().toMutableList()
        lines[0] = lines[0].copy(sentence = lines[0].sentence.dropLast(2) + "ZZ")
        val result = evaluate(lines)
        assertEquals(CheckStatus.FAIL, result.status)
        assertTrue(result.detail.contains("校验和"))
    }

    private fun gsa(talker: String, ids: List<String>, system: String? = null): NmeaSentenceSnapshot {
        val fields = listOf("A", "3") + ids + List(12 - ids.size) { "" } + listOf("1.2", "1.0", "0.7") + listOfNotNull(system)
        return sentence(talker + "GSA," + fields.joinToString(","))
    }

    @Test fun gsaChecksUniquePhysicalIdentityAndRejectsInvalidFields() {
        val base = fixture().filterNot { it.sentence.contains("GSA") }
        for (ids in listOf(listOf("01", "01", "02", "03"), listOf("NaN"), listOf("301"), listOf("-1"))) {
            val result = evaluate(base + gsa("GP", ids))
            assertEquals(result.detail, CheckStatus.FAIL, result.status)
            assertTrue(result.detail, result.detail.contains("GSA"))
        }
    }

    @Test fun missingGsaIdentityInGsvNeedsReviewEvenWhenCountsMatch() {
        val base = fixture().filterNot { it.sentence.contains("GSA") }
        val result = evaluate(base + gsa("GP", listOf("01", "02", "03", "09")))
        assertEquals(result.detail, CheckStatus.UNKNOWN, result.status)
        assertTrue(result.evidence.joinToString().contains("在用身份"))
    }

    @Test fun mixedGnGsaUsesExplicitSystemIdAndAmbiguousNumberingCannotPass() {
        val base = fixture().filterNot { it.sentence.contains("GSA") }
        val ambiguous = evaluate(base + gsa("GN", listOf("01", "02", "03", "04")))
        assertEquals(CheckStatus.UNKNOWN, ambiguous.status)
        val known = evaluate(base + gsa("GN", listOf("01", "02", "03", "04"), "1"))
        assertEquals(known.detail, CheckStatus.PASS, known.status)
        val bds = evaluate(base + gsa("GN", listOf("01", "02", "03", "04"), "4"))
        assertEquals(bds.detail, CheckStatus.UNKNOWN, bds.status)
    }

    @Test fun gsaAndStatusMustAgreeOnUsedIdentityWithinTheComparisonWindow() {
        val satellites = (1..8).map { id -> GnssSatelliteSnapshot(1, id, 30f, 30f, 30f,
            id in 5..8, true, true, false) }
        val result = NmeaCheck().evaluate(SampleSnapshot(startedAtMillis = 10000, endedAtMillis = 20000,
            nmeaSentences = fixture(), gnssFrames = listOf(GnssFrameSnapshot(10000, satellites))))
        assertEquals(result.detail, CheckStatus.UNKNOWN, result.status)
        assertTrue(result.evidence.joinToString().contains("usedInFix"))
        val stale = NmeaCheck().evaluate(SampleSnapshot(startedAtMillis = 10000, endedAtMillis = 20000,
            nmeaSentences = fixture(), gnssFrames = listOf(GnssFrameSnapshot(5000, satellites))))
        assertEquals(stale.detail, CheckStatus.PASS, stale.status)
    }
}
```

`detector/src/test/java/com/system/location/service/detector/model/GnssProfileComparisonTest.kt`:

```kt
package com.system.location.service.detector.model

import org.junit.Assert.*
import org.junit.Test

class GnssProfileComparisonTest {
    private fun s(id: Int, system: Int = 1, used: Boolean = false, cn0: Float = 30f) =
        GnssSatelliteSnapshot(system, id, cn0, 90f, 10f, used, true, true, false)
    private fun profile(signals: List<GnssSatelliteSnapshot>, times: List<Long> = (0L..30L).map { it * 1000 }) =
        GnssWindowProfile.from(GnssEvidenceSnapshot(0, times.maxOrNull() ?: 0,
            times.map { GnssFrameSnapshot(it, signals) }))

    @Test fun dualBandCountsOnceAndUsesAnySignalButJointDistributionCountsSignals() {
        val p = profile(listOf(s(1), s(1, used = true, cn0 = 50f), s(2, 6)))
        assertEquals(2.0, p.meanVisible, 0.0)
        assertEquals(0.5, p.usedFraction!!, 0.0)
        assertEquals(mapOf(1 to 31, 6 to 31), p.constellationCounts)
        assertEquals(93, p.signalBins.values.sum())
        assertTrue(p.adequate)
    }

    @Test fun analyticalTotalVariationAndRatioDeltas() {
        val a = profile(listOf(s(1), s(2, 6)))
        val b = profile(listOf(s(1), s(2), s(3), s(4)))
        val delta = GnssProfileComparison.compare(a, b)
        assertEquals(1.0, delta.visibleCountTotalVariation!!, 0.0)
        assertEquals(0.5, delta.constellationTotalVariation!!, 0.0)
        assertEquals(0.5, delta.signalJointTotalVariation!!, 0.0)
        assertEquals(2.0, delta.meanVisibleDelta, 0.0)
        assertEquals(mapOf(1 to 0.5, 6 to -0.5), delta.constellationRatioDeltas)
        assertEquals(0.0, GnssProfileComparison.compare(a, a).signalJointTotalVariation!!, 0.0)
    }

    @Test fun lastArrivalPerSecondPreventsCallbackBurstWeighting() {
        val evidence = GnssEvidenceSnapshot(0, 1000, listOf(
            GnssFrameSnapshot(0, listOf(s(1))), GnssFrameSnapshot(999, listOf(s(1), s(2))),
            GnssFrameSnapshot(1000, emptyList())))
        val p = GnssWindowProfile.from(evidence)
        assertEquals(mapOf(2 to 1, 0 to 1), p.visibleCounts)
        assertEquals(1.0, p.meanVisible, 0.0)
        assertFalse(p.adequate)
    }

    @Test fun emptySkyHasNoRatioAndLongGapsAreNotAdequateCoverage() {
        val empty = profile(emptyList())
        val diff = GnssProfileComparison.compare(empty, profile(listOf(s(1))))
        assertNull(diff.constellationTotalVariation)
        assertNull(diff.usedFractionDelta)
        assertNull(diff.constellationRatioDeltas)
        assertEquals(1.0, diff.visibleCountTotalVariation!!, 0.0)
        assertFalse(diff.adequateWindows)
        assertFalse(profile(listOf(s(1)), (0L..30L).map { it * 3000 }).adequate)
    }

    @Test fun zeroCn0RowsRemainRawEvidenceButAreExcludedFromProfileStatistics() {
        val p = profile(listOf(s(1, cn0 = 0f), s(2, system = 6, cn0 = 30f)))
        assertEquals(mapOf(6 to 31), p.constellationCounts)
        assertEquals(31, p.signalBins.values.sum())
        assertEquals(1.0, p.meanVisible, 0.0)
    }

    @Test fun invalidEvidenceAndClockRollbackAreRejectedInsteadOfFiltered() {
        val invalid = listOf(s(1).copy(cn0DbHz = Float.NaN), s(1).copy(elevationDegrees = -1f),
            s(1).copy(azimuthDegrees = 360f), s(0), s(1, 8))
        invalid.forEach { assertThrows(IllegalArgumentException::class.java) { profile(listOf(it)) } }
        assertThrows(IllegalArgumentException::class.java) { profile(listOf(s(1)), listOf(1000, 0)) }
    }
}
```

`detector/src/test/java/com/system/location/service/detector/model/GnssReferenceCodecTest.kt`:

```kt
package com.system.location.service.detector.model

import java.io.ByteArrayInputStream
import java.io.ByteArrayOutputStream
import org.junit.Assert.*
import org.junit.Test

class GnssReferenceCodecTest {
    private fun reference(): GnssReference {
        val s = GnssSatelliteSnapshot(1, 3, 42f, 30f, 359f, true, false, true, true)
        return GnssReference("device", "室外，同一地点，模拟已关闭", 40_000,
            GnssEvidenceSnapshot(0, 30_000, (0L..30L).map { GnssFrameSnapshot(it * 1000, listOf(s)) }))
    }
    private fun encode(reference: GnssReference): ByteArray = ByteArrayOutputStream().also {
        GnssReferenceCodec.write(reference, it)
    }.toByteArray()
    private fun decode(bytes: ByteArray) = GnssReferenceCodec.read(ByteArrayInputStream(bytes))

    @Test fun roundTripPreservesRawSignalsMetadataAndStatistics() {
        val reference = reference()
        val result = decode(encode(reference))
        assertEquals(reference, result)
        assertEquals(reference.profile(), result.profile())
    }

    @Test fun partialVersionMismatchTrailingDataAndInvalidSourceAreRejected() {
        val bytes = encode(reference())
        listOf(bytes.copyOf(7), bytes.copyOf(bytes.size - 1), bytes + byteArrayOf(0),
            bytes.clone().also { it[7] = 2 }).forEach {
            assertThrows(Exception::class.java) { decode(it) }
        }
        listOf(reference().copy(environment = ""), reference().copy(savedAtMillis = 0),
            reference().copy(evidence = reference().evidence.copy(frames = emptyList()))).forEach {
            assertThrows(IllegalArgumentException::class.java) { encode(it) }
        }
    }

    @Test fun untrustedFrameCountCannotAllocateAnUnboundedList() {
        val bytes = encode(reference())
        val header = ByteArrayInputStream(bytes)
        val input = java.io.DataInputStream(header)
        input.readInt(); input.readInt(); input.readUTF(); input.readUTF()
        input.readLong(); input.readLong(); input.readLong()
        val countOffset = bytes.size - header.available()
        for (i in 0..3) bytes[countOffset + i] = 127
        assertThrows(IllegalArgumentException::class.java) { decode(bytes) }
    }
}
```

`docs/diagnostics/gnss-default-startup.md`:

```md
# 默认目标天空启动验证

2026-11-21：启动 Xposed 定位时，若系统模块认证、协议与 Hook 安装状态有效，且 Root 实现或框架系统范围能力可用，则为未设置过卫星启动选项的用户默认开启目标天空（AUTONOMOUS）。不会因打开应用就开始定位，也不会切换用户所选的定位后端或自动启用 Native。

已选的实测回放继续使用原采集来源；来源缺失或过期仍按原规则提示，不自动改成目标天空。显式关闭卫星模拟的设置也会保留。标准无 Root 后端及不可用的模块连接不会应用这些默认值。

Root 判断兼容应用看不到 `su` 的情况：先读取 libxposed 的 `PROP_CAP_SYSTEM`，并要求实际的系统模块认证；可见的 Root 实现版本只作回退，探测限制为一秒且在后台执行，不请求额外提权。

本机 253 个应用单元测试、应用 lint、Android 测试编译及 47 个 Python 测试通过。策略测试覆盖缺少 Root、模块不可用、默认目标天空、已有回放/自动策略、显式关闭，以及默认值重复应用。

Redmi K50 / Android 14 / HyperOS 2 / KernelSU / LSPosed 7944 的结果：

| 检查 | 结果 |
| --- | --- |
| 应用 UID 的 su 可见性 | 被 KernelSU 隐藏；通过系统范围能力识别，未要求新 Root 授权 |
| 未选卫星选项，启动定位 | 自动保存 AUTONOMOUS 并开启卫星模拟 |
| 主动选择实测回放 | 准备后仍为 REPLAY，没有改成目标天空 |
| 主动关闭后重新启动定位 | 卫星模拟保持关闭 |
| 独立包名与 UID 的接收端 | 8 次 GNSS 状态、最多 59 颗卫星、178 条 NMEA、42 次 GPS 回调；未取得控制凭据 |
| Native | 未加载、未启用 |

最终后端设备测试通过，无 assumption 跳过。该测试使用预先授予的定位权限，直接检查后端，不依赖地图页面或测试 runner 替应用授权；未把 MIUI 的授权失败或跳过计作通过。

同签名应用来自 [CI run 44883782670](https://github.com/Lecheeel/Portal/actions/runs/44883782670)，最终测试 runner 来自 [CI run 44884586634](https://github.com/Lecheeel/Portal/actions/runs/44884586634)。二者应用运行代码相同；本次没有创建 Release。以上仅代表该 K50 的实际覆盖范围。
```

`docs/diagnostics/issues-11-21.md`:

```md
# #11、#21 日志分析与初步修复

分析日期：2026-11-21。先分析报告者日志，再在 Redmi K50 插卡回测；尚未在报告者的设备上验证修复。

## #11：作用域、定位与软重启需要分别判断

- [问题与讨论](https://github.com/Lecheeel/Portal/issues/11)：一加 13，ColorOS 17 / Android 17，LSPosed 7944。
- 新附件：`LSPosed_20261120_130653.zip`、`KernelSU_bugreport_2026-11-20_13_07.tar.gz.zip`。
- 13:04:44.786 的模块日志确认 SettingsProvider 安装成功；13:04:48.710–712 确认 Fused 的 `chooseBestLocation` 与两个回调安装成功。软重启后也有对应成功记录。因此，上一轮的共享系统包补装已经执行，不能继续把这次定位失败归因于 Fused 没有加载。
- 13:05:24.259、13:06:03.590 的框架日志仍在删除 SettingsProvider 的作用域条目。这是框架清理行为，Portal 的补装逻辑不改变该行为；条目取消勾选不等于共享系统进程中的 Hook 未安装。
- 13:06:09 的 `system_server_crash` 明确为 `ScanResult.getInformationElements()` 空指针，调用方是 Oplus Wi-Fi 路由器能力采集器。随后系统进程重启。这给出了软重启的直接崩溃点。
- Portal 的 Wi-Fi 代码存在匹配该崩溃的缺陷：只按包名过滤系统调用，没有排除 UID 1000，`android` 也没有命中原包名过滤；生成的 `ScanResult` 没有初始化 `informationElements`。目前没有禁用模块的对照采样，因此不把日志中扫描对象的来源认定为已证实。

修复：按 UID 的 appId 排除系统服务调用，显式排除 `android`；生成扫描结果时把信息元素初始化为空数组，使读取与 Parcel 往返满足平台契约。

这些改动处理了一个与崩溃匹配的明确代码缺陷，但不代表定位修改已经端到端验证成功。需要在包含修复的构建上重新检查运行诊断、发布状态和接收端坐标。

## #21：电话服务启动失败，具体等待位置仍待实测

- [问题与讨论](https://github.com/Lecheeel/Portal/issues/21)：Redmi K70，HyperOS 2 / Android 15，LSPosed 7769，Portal v2.3.6。
- 附件：`issue-logs-redacted.zip`。使用讨论中最新上传的副本。
- 日志持续出现 `com.android.phone ... failed to complete startup`、ANR、重新启动，以及 `telephony service is null`；状态快照中的 baseband、SIM 属性均为空。结合报告者的模块开关对照，可确认这是需要优先处理的电话服务故障，不能把空属性直接等同于基带固件被改写。
- 日志包含电话包 ready 和 `PHONE_PROCESS` 安装记录，但没有能定位本轮故障的电话主线程堆栈。部分启动尝试仍继续创建了 TelephonyProvider，因此不能声称每次都永久卡在同一个位置。
- 代码中，电话包 ready 回调会同步查询 LocationManager、交换凭据、注册代理，并最多等待 5 秒的首次状态回传；发现服务时还存在循环等待。该路径发生在电话应用启动完成之前，是实际存在的启动阻塞风险。
- 同一进程还安装了 `CarrierClientHook`，它让本地 TelephonyManager / SubscriptionManager getter 同步查询系统定位服务；定位服务的运营商解析又需要查询电话订阅信息。这个调用方向可能形成循环 Binder 等待，尤其不适合电话基础服务自身的初始化。

修复：先完成 Hook 安装与应用绑定，再由后台任务执行连接与状态同步；服务尚未 ready 或连接抛异常时退避重试，合并重复请求并限制重试次数。未收到认证状态前，模拟运行状态保持关闭。电话进程移除客户端查询 Hook，继续保留供外部应用调用的电话服务端 Hook。

这属于针对已发现风险的初步修复，尚未证明它涵盖 #21 的全部原因。#11 的新附件另外包含 IMS/RCS 初始化空指针，不能仅凭这些堆栈将其与 #21 的启动 ANR 归为同一原因。

## 验证与回测

- 本机 Xposed 单元测试覆盖 Wi-Fi 调用隔离、后台连接不阻塞调用方、连接失败重试、重复请求合并、成功后停止重试和重试上限。
- 新增 Android 测试覆盖真实 `ScanResult.getInformationElements()` 读取及 Parcel 往返；本轮只编译，未运行设备测试。
- 本轮通过 222 个 Xposed 单元测试、47 个 Python 测试、模块边界检查、`:xposed:lintDebug`、arm64 Debug APK 构建及 Android 测试编译。构建成功不替代厂商真机验证。
- 电话服务回测应先在插卡设备重启，确认 baseband / SIM 状态恢复、电话进程稳定，再启动与停止定位模拟，检查信号及模拟状态。
- 一加回测需同时检查 Wi-Fi 保持连接、无新的系统崩溃、模块运行诊断中的连接与发布状态，以及接收端的最后、单次、持续定位样本。作用域是否掉勾单独记录。
- 报告者设备尚未覆盖；本轮不发布新版本，也不将两个 issue 标记为已解决。

## 同类问题排查与修复

同日追加检查覆盖调用方识别、应用内轮询、合成 Wi-Fi 数据和定位结果对象的复用。

- 系统调用识别此前直接比较完整 UID，导致副用户的系统 appId 可能进入普通应用路径。现按 appId 判断，并让路由核心和监听器路由保持一致；共享 UID 的包名逐个判断，Fused 的例外不再覆盖同 UID 中其他包的系统身份，未知调用方保留原行为。
- 系统包过滤补上 `android`，使用完整包名或命名空间边界；第三方包名中间含有 `com.android` 不再误命中系统包。
- Wi-Fi 连接信息原先向 `setSSID` 传入 String、调用不存在的 `setIpAddress(Int)`，错误被忽略。现在使用平台 Builder 设置 UTF-8 SSID，以 InetAddress 设置 IPv4。扫描结果同时填充 WifiSsid，并通过正确方法设置 Wi-Fi standard。
- 传感器状态查询此前运行在应用的传感器 Handler / 主线程；实验性检测开关轮询也在主线程执行 Binder。现在复用平台工作池，每类轮询最多一个请求，慢调用不积压后续轮询；传感器响应还检查订阅代次，避免停止后迟到的状态恢复旧授权。
- `LocationResult.writeToParcel` 原先永久替换对象内的坐标列表。现在在序列化期间临时替换，并在成功或异常退出时恢复原列表；同一对象的写入串行处理。Provider 转发则构造独立结果和列表，避免改写发送方仍可能复用的对象。

新增单元测试覆盖副用户、共享 UID、包名边界、慢查询合并与失败恢复、独立结果副本、异常和嵌套序列化的恢复。Wi-Fi 的 Android 测试增加 SSID / IPv4 / standard 与 Parcel 往返断言，仍未在设备上执行。

追加全量验证通过 Core 845、Xposed 232、应用 248 个单元测试，以及 47 个 Python 测试；arm64 Debug 构建、Xposed lint、Android 测试编译、模块边界与 APK 入口检查一并核对。厂商真机、插卡启动和实际接收端效果仍按前述条件回测。

## Redmi K50 插卡回测（2026-11-21）

设备为 Redmi K50 / HyperOS 2 / Android 14（SDK 34），Vector API 102，插入中国移动卡。以下结果仅覆盖这台设备和本轮 Xposed 测试；没有验证一加 Android 17、K70 Android 15、标准无 Root 或 Native 后端。

| 检查 | 实测结果 |
| --- | --- |
| 原 2.3.6 启用模块时的初始状态 | 两槽报告 `ABSENT`；基带版本存在 |
| 关闭 Portal 模块并重启 | 恢复 `LOADED,ABSENT`、中国移动、`NR_SA` |
| 第一轮候选包启用并重启 | 电话进程在 RCS 初始化时反复崩溃，SIM 仍不可用 |
| 补充硬件订阅修复后两次重启 | SIM 正常，电话服务稳定；第二轮候选观察约十分钟，电话进程和系统进程 PID 未变 |
| Wi-Fi / 定位结果平台对象 | 4 项 Android 测试通过，包括 Parcel 往返和原结果列表恢复 |
| 运营商平台对象 | 9 项 Android 测试通过 |
| 最终定位与生命周期集成 | 6 项通过，包括认证、先订阅后启动、最后定位、持续回调、去重、取消订阅、Native 保持未加载 |
| 独立包名和 UID 接收端 | 最后定位与持续回调匹配测试点；时间戳未倒退；未取得控制凭据；SIM 始终就绪 |
| 单次定位 | 一轮匹配，后续轮次回调为空；未通过稳定性验证 |
| 停止后的定位缓存 | `is_start=false` 且没有持续模拟回调，但最后定位和单次定位曾返回旧测试点；未通过立即恢复真实位置验证 |

这次真机测试补充了两处修复：

1. `CarrierHardwareSubscriptionHook` 在 RCS 初始化的 `getActiveSubscriptionIdList()` 中，无条件使用另一订阅查询结果替换原列表，未开启模拟时也执行。K50 堆栈明确经过此 Hook 后在 `RcsFeatureManager.invalidate()` 崩溃。现在只在启用了模拟及虚拟运营商身份时才允许额外物理订阅查询；开机、停止和仅实体 SIM 模式保留平台原列表。新增两项策略测试，修复后插卡启动恢复。
2. 定位监听器仅在模拟已经开启时才加入模块注册表，导致“先打开接收应用、后启动模拟”的订阅遗漏。现在在框架通过权限及 Provider 检查后保存订阅，实际模拟分发仍由运行状态控制。旧候选包的注册生命周期测试失败，修复后的去重、取消注册及先订阅后发布测试通过。

单次定位仍依赖框架是否提供非空样本，当前 Hook 保留空回调；停止后平台也可能保留此前 Provider 报送的模拟缓存。本轮模块关闭时没有取得真实 GPS 新样本，因此没有验证真实新样本到来后的恢复。这些结果不能被最后定位或持续定位通过所替代，#11 仍不能标为完全解决。

传感器只核对了未加入模块作用域的独立接收端能正常取得有限的加速度事件（每轮约百个），其 Java sensor protection 为关闭。未运行实际注入目标的 Java 轮询压力测试，也未启用 Native。

同签名 Debug 候选包来自临时分支 `test/k50-issues-20261121`，最终 [CI run 44876421713](https://github.com/Lecheeel/Portal/actions/runs/44876421713) 成功，代码目标为 `122cc07f`；签名与原安装包一致，测试应用使用相同 versionCode 以便保留数据安装和恢复。这些包仅供设备测试，没有创建 Release，临时工作流没有合入 main。主工作区对应修复为 `c2cde0e4`、`1065bbdb`，新增设备测试为 `04f92761`、`4e67266f`；最终本机 234 个 Xposed 单元测试和 Xposed lint 通过。

测试结束确认模拟停止、Native 未加载且未启用，再恢复原 2.3.6 APK、偏好、保存的运行配置、权限及原测试 runner，卸载临时接收端和平台测试 APK。原版本已出现插卡故障，恢复时保持 Portal 模块关闭并重启，作用域列表不改动；最后核验 SIM、信号、APK 摘要和设置恢复结果。原始日志及含设备信息的备份仅保留在本机忽略目录。

恢复后已重新核验：原 APK SHA256 一致，核心偏好与备份相同，原作用域保留，临时权限恢复、新增测试包移除，SIM 为 `LOADED,ABSENT`、网络为 `NR_SA`，SELinux 为 Enforcing。没有留下运行中的模拟或已加载的 Native Hook。

## 同机 LSPosed 7944 回测（2026-11-21）

用户随后把 K50 切换为报告者使用的 LSPosed 2.2.1-log（7944），再次使用前述 CI 候选包测试。设备仍为 Android 14 / HyperOS 2 / 中国移动插卡；这次结果不代替一加 Android 17 或 K70 Android 15 的验证。

接入时框架守护进程因 `SQLiteException: no such table: lspd_configs` 退出：本机遗留 Vector schema 5 数据库，而 7944 使用 schema 101。完整备份后，按同版本框架表结构迁移本机模块、作用域及配置，保留本机配置值；重启后确认 7944 / API 102 守护进程正常。这是本机切换框架后的环境修复，没有修改框架二进制，也不是 Portal 的代码修复。

| 检查 | 7944 下的实测结果 |
| --- | --- |
| 系统端加载与诊断 | `SYSTEM_SERVER`，166 个 Hook 安装，失败数为 0 |
| 定位与生命周期集成 | 5 项通过：认证、最后/持续定位与停止、先订阅后启动、去重、拒绝 Provider 后清理 |
| 独立接收端持续定位 | 56 次回调全部匹配测试点，时间戳未倒退；最后定位匹配 |
| 独立接收端单次定位 | 回调到达但位置为空，未通过 |
| 停止后独立接收端 | 无持续模拟回调，最后位置为空；本轮没有重现旧测试点残留，但不证明上一轮缓存问题已修复 |
| Wi-Fi 对象读取 | 模拟时 4 条扫描的信息元素数组可读；停止后恢复真实扫描及非空信息元素，无对应崩溃 |
| 电话服务 | SIM 就绪，停止后网络为 NR；电话与系统进程 PID 保持不变，采样日志未发现电话崩溃或 ANR |

作用域掉勾在 7944 下复现。14:58:55.685 与 14:59:30.808 的框架日志明确记录删除 `com.android.providers.settings` 和 `com.android.location.fused`，包含 `removing obsolete package` / `removeAppWithoutCache`。实际保留的作用域为 `system`、`com.android.phone`、`com.xiaomi.location.fused`、`com.android.systemui`。这不是 Portal 改写勾选状态；无需反复强行写回这两个条目。

同一次启动中，SettingsProvider 已经由共享系统进程补装，日志为 `call=1 query=1`、`installed=true`；电话及小米 Fused 进程也建立了运行连接。因此不能仅由这两个条目掉勾判断所有 Hook 失效。独立接收端持续定位成功提供了实际接收证据，但不覆盖单次定位失败，也不证明其他 ROM 上的 Fused 路径有效。

独立接收端未加入模块作用域、未取得控制凭据，Java sensor protection 为关闭；收到了 106 条有限加速度事件。Native 全程未启用。首次接收端测试遇到 MIUI 初始化撤回临时定位权限，重新核验授权后才取得上述样本，不将未授权轮次算作通过。

结束前系统端再次确认 `is_start=false`、`native_loaded=false`、`native_enabled=false`。本轮没有新增 Portal 源码修复或创建 Release；单次空回调、上一轮的缓存残留及报告者设备兼容性仍为未解决项。

收尾恢复原 APK 与原测试 runner（摘要一致）、本轮初始权限及应用设置基线，移除临时接收端与设备测试文件。保留用户当前四项作用域和健康的 7944 / schema 101，Portal 模块保持关闭；重启后确认 SIM 为 `LOADED,ABSENT`、网络为 `NR_SA`、SELinux 为 Enforcing。没有回滚到导致 7944 守护进程退出的旧框架数据库。

## 单次定位修复与 7944 再验证（2026-11-21）

上一节的单次空值已有 K50 上的修复与接收端验证，结果如下。仍不将这台 Android 14 设备的结论推广到报告者的一加 Android 17 或 K70 Android 15。

原 Hook 在 `getCurrentLocation` 的回调上改写已有位置，遇到空值则原样返回；没有真实 GPS 样本时，模拟虽然持续发布，单次请求仍可能等到超时空回调。此外，服务端按回调类安装的闭包捕获首次请求的权限级别，可能影响同类后续请求；Provider 回调还会对同一结果重复改写。

现在在 `GetCurrentLocationListenerRegistration.onActive()` 的范围内，为该 Provider 的 `getLastLocationUnsafe()` 提供当前模拟样本。仍执行 Android 的原注册流程，由平台决定请求是否可激活，再执行 AppOps 记账、粗略位置处理、单次回调、取消与注销。样本只作为本次缓存读取的返回值，不写入平台真实位置缓存；线程与 Provider 隔离的上下文在异常退出时也会清除。移除了两处回调重复改写，并在这段平台处理期间保留系统已完成的粗略位置过滤。

本机 237 个 Xposed 单元测试、Xposed lint、47 个 Python 测试与 Android 测试编译通过。新增设备测试不要求真实 GPS 预热，连续发布五个不同坐标并分别请求单次定位，同时核对提前取消的 `OperationCanceledException` 和非法 Provider 的平台异常。

同签名候选包来自 [CI run 44880208737](https://github.com/Lecheeel/Portal/actions/runs/44880208737)（`06a1f74a`）；修正提前取消的测试断言后，使用 [CI run 44880727636](https://github.com/Lecheeel/Portal/actions/runs/44880727636)（`7ec424f5`）的测试 runner。两者的 Xposed 运行代码相同，均没有创建 Release。

| K50 / 7944 检查 | 实测结果 |
| --- | --- |
| 定位与生命周期集成 | 6 项全部通过，无跳过，包括无预热单次请求、认证、持续/最后定位、先订阅后启动、去重及拒绝 Provider 后清理 |
| 独立 UID 的 GPS 单次请求 | 10/10 返回测试点，耗时 13–44 毫秒，无持续订阅预热 |
| 独立 UID 的 Network / Fused 单次请求 | 各 3/3 返回测试点，保留各自 Provider |
| 仅粗略位置权限 | 3/3 返回平台粗略位置，精度 2000 米；未返回测试点的精确经纬度 |
| 无位置权限 | 系统按原规则抛出 SecurityException |
| 有权限但 AppOps 拒绝 | 2/2 返回空值，没有取得模拟位置 |
| 系统位置开关关闭 | 2/2 返回空值；结束恢复原开关 |
| 停止模拟后 | 2/2 单次请求返回空值，没有返回测试点；未取得真实 GPS 新样本，不声称已证明所有历史缓存场景恢复 |
| 通信与稳定性 | SIM 为 `LOADED,ABSENT` / NR，电话和系统进程 PID 不变；采样日志无电话崩溃、ANR 或 Wi-Fi 信息元素空指针 |

独立接收端未加入作用域、未取得控制凭据。MIUI 在测试包首次初始化时撤回临时权限的轮次未算作通过；JUnit 的 assumption 跳过也未算作通过。切换位置开关后曾读到模拟已停止，重新确认开启后的样本才用于 Network / Fused 的通过结论。最后系统端确认 `is_start=false`、`native_loaded=false`、`native_enabled=false`、Hook 失败数为 0。

两个独立作用域仍可能被 7944 清理，本次没有修改框架的勾选存储，也没有删掉推荐作用域来隐藏现象。Portal 保留共享系统包补装与独立进程安装路径：该机 SettingsProvider 经 `system` 安装成功；独立接收端的 Fused API 成功不代表其他 ROM 的共享 Android Fused 类路径均已验证。用户配置应保留 `system` 和实际存在的厂商定位进程，不能把“七项全部留勾”当作这类框架的有效性标准。

本轮结束恢复原 APK、原测试 runner 和权限快照，撤回临时后台运行授权，移除独立接收端及测试文件；保留 7944 和当前四项作用域，Portal 模块关闭。重启后再次核验 APK 摘要、权限、框架健康状态及 `LOADED,ABSENT` / `NR_SA`，SELinux 为 Enforcing。
```

`docs/releases/v1.2.0.md`:

```md
# LocationService v1.2.0

- 首页取消中心准星。点击地图、搜索或输入坐标后，通过底部卡片确认切换；拖动和缩放不再改变模拟位置。
- 首次真实定位增加独立的绿色原始位置标记，模拟期间仍可查看，切换页面和旋转后保留。
- 路线支持道路规划、逐点添加和手指画线。画线模式单指绘制、双指移动／缩放，可撤销上一点或上一笔，草稿自动恢复，支持保存和保存并启动。
- 后端与运行状态改为概览卡片及折叠分组；日志支持筛选、分页展开、复制和清空视图。
- 补充深色界面配色及路线、手势、页面交互回归检查。

手动点／笔之间按直线连接，不自动贴合道路。地图显示及在线搜索仍需要有效的高德配置和网络。原始位置记录本次会话首次取得的非模拟定位；如果启动模拟前未能取得真实定位，会明确显示尚未获取。

Android / ROM 的实际定位消费者、Xposed 和实验性 Native 行为仍依赖设备环境；本版本保留已有的 Bugly x86_64 16 KB 页对齐限制。

```

`docs/releases/v1.7.1.md`:

```md
# LocationService v1.7.1

本版本修复运行后端停止时重复调用清理接口的问题。控制器在停止成功后不再再次调用 `release()`；只有停止失败时才使用 `release()` 进行重试，减少重复 Binder/API 调用并保留失败清理的重试能力。

同时移除了 Android Manifest 中与 Gradle `useLegacyPackaging` 重复的 `extractNativeLibs` 配置，保留统一的 Native 打包设置。

```

`docs/releases/v2.0.0.md`:

```md
# 🚀 LocationService · 核心重构与体验升级

本次更新集中重构定位、GNSS/NMEA、环境与传感器链路，迁移至现代 libxposed API，并重新整理导航、运行中心和设置页面。

## 🛰️ GNSS 与定位模型

- 新增：GPS、北斗、GLONASS、Galileo、QZSS 多星座天空模型，统一生成卫星方位、仰角、CN0 与参与定位状态。
- 新增：同源 NMEA 生成，覆盖 GGA、RMC、GSA、GSV、GST、ZDA，统一处理时间、校验和与卫星数量。
- 新增：GNSS/NMEA 主动投递，在模拟启用后可独立于真实 GNSS 回调输出数据。
- 新增：基于 Kepler 轨道传播的实验性天空模型，可在设置中切换。
- 优化：GPS、Network、Fused 差异化定位画像，完善精度、延迟、字段策略与可选物理微漂移。

## 环境模拟与分应用控制

- 新增：WiFi／基站环境采集、保存与回放，支持搜索、重命名和 JSON 导入导出（实验性）。
- 新增：程序化 WiFi 环境，使用固定种子、网格化 AP 和 RSSI 路径损耗模型生成扫描与连接信息（实验性）。
- 新增：自建 WiFi 指纹库导入与回放，以及环境来源、基站画像和 SIM 状态配置（实验性）。
- 新增：分应用排除与固定点，为使用系统定位接口的应用配置独立定位规则（实验性）。
- 新增：恢复上次场景配置；分应用规则和环境配置支持运行中更新。

## Native 与 Xposed

- 重构：全面迁移至 libxposed API 102 原生 Hooker／Chain，移除 legacy 兼容层，重整 Hook 生命周期与反射调用。
- 新增：Native + Xposed 传感器扩展，由统一 SensorFrame 驱动加速度、陀螺仪、地磁、气压等事件改写（实验性）。
- 优化：步频根据速度和步幅连续变化，支持缩放与变化幅度调节；Native 负责帧缓存、插值和事件应用。
- 优化：Native 模式自动加载与启用，覆盖 HIDL／AIDL 传感器转换路径，调整载荷混淆打包及加载后的文件清理。
- 优化：system_server Java Hook 热重载与目标进程重注入流程；Native 更新继续使用重启流程。
- 优化：跨进程配置与样本协议、不可变运行快照，以及定位字段、Provider、AppOps、Settings 和模块元数据的查询处理。
- 修复：原始 GNSS 监听注销、NMEA 注册与回调处理中的问题。

## ✨ 界面与操作

- 优化：位置与卫星功能合并为“模拟”入口，通过双页签切换。
- 优化：运行中心前置当前状态，整理设备授权、模式选择、能力诊断和日志。
- 新增：选择实验性 Native + Xposed 模式时的风险确认。
- 优化：环境采集、WiFi 指纹库和回放配置移至独立“环境工具”页面。
- 优化：设置分组与辅助说明，移除小半径圆周运动相关控件，统一卡片、间距、按钮和深浅主题。

### 升级提示

- Xposed 模式需要支持 libxposed API 102 的框架，升级后请确认模块作用域并按提示重启。
- Native + Xposed 需要 Root、arm64 设备和已激活的 Xposed。停止模拟不会卸载已加载的 Native Hook，卸载或更新需重启相关进程或设备。
- Native 传感器、环境模拟和分应用能力仍为实验性；计步事件投递受硬件与 ROM 限制。
```

```md
- 新增：GPS L1 原始 GNSS 测量合成投递，完善接收机时钟连续性与监听生命周期；导航电文和天线信息仍未支持。
- 修复：模拟期间原始 GNSS 注册异常，以及真实 GNSS 状态和 NMEA 混入模拟输出的问题。
- 新增：地图 Key 设置页面，支持高德与腾讯 Key 的本机加密保存和清除。
- 优化：环境资料库与采集流程，完善 Wi-Fi、基站及 BLE 环境数据处理。
- 修复：定位时间线、标准 GPS 卫星附加字段及部分权限与隐私配置行为。

```

```md
- 新增：环境配置全页编辑，支持手动创建、采集进度和设备条目编辑。

- 修复：未运行模拟时，卫星标签页恢复观察真实卫星。
```

`gradlew`:

```
#!/usr/bin/env sh

#
# Copyright 2015 the original author or authors.
#
# Licensed under the Apache License, Version 2.0 (the "License");
# you may not use this file except in compliance with the License.
# You may obtain a copy of the License at
#
#      https://www.apache.org/licenses/LICENSE-2.0
#
# Unless required by applicable law or agreed to in writing, software
# distributed under the License is distributed on an "AS IS" BASIS,
# WITHOUT WARRANTIES OR CONDITIONS OF ANY KIND, either express or implied.
# See the License for the specific language governing permissions and
# limitations under the License.
#

##############################################################################
##
##  Gradle start up script for UN*X
##
##############################################################################

# Attempt to set APP_HOME
# Resolve links: $0 may be a link
PRG="$0"
# Need this for relative symlinks.
while [ -h "$PRG" ] ; do
    ls=`ls -ld "$PRG"`
    link=`expr "$ls" : '.*-> \(.*\)$'`
    if expr "$link" : '/.*' > /dev/null; then
        PRG="$link"
    else
        PRG=`dirname "$PRG"`"/$link"
    fi
done
SAVED="`pwd`"
cd "`dirname \"$PRG\"`/" >/dev/null
APP_HOME="`pwd -P`"
cd "$SAVED" >/dev/null

APP_NAME="Gradle"
APP_BASE_NAME=`basename "$0"`

# Add default JVM options here. You can also use JAVA_OPTS and GRADLE_OPTS to pass JVM options to this script.
DEFAULT_JVM_OPTS='"-Xmx64m" "-Xms64m"'

# Use the maximum available, or set MAX_FD != -1 to use that value.
MAX_FD="maximum"

warn () {
    echo "$*"
}

die () {
    echo
    echo "$*"
    echo
    exit 1
}

# OS specific support (must be 'true' or 'false').
cygwin=false
msys=false
darwin=false
nonstop=false
case "`uname`" in
  CYGWIN* )
    cygwin=true
    ;;
  Darwin* )
    darwin=true
    ;;
  MINGW* )
    msys=true
    ;;
  NONSTOP* )
    nonstop=true
    ;;
esac

CLASSPATH=$APP_HOME/gradle/wrapper/gradle-wrapper.jar


# Determine the Java command to use to start the JVM.
if [ -n "$JAVA_HOME" ] ; then
    if [ -x "$JAVA_HOME/jre/sh/java" ] ; then
        # IBM's JDK on AIX uses strange locations for the executables
        JAVACMD="$JAVA_HOME/jre/sh/java"
    else
        JAVACMD="$JAVA_HOME/bin/java"
    fi
    if [ ! -x "$JAVACMD" ] ; then
        die "ERROR: JAVA_HOME is set to an invalid directory: $JAVA_HOME

Please set the JAVA_HOME variable in your environment to match the
location of your Java installation."
    fi
else
    JAVACMD="java"
    which java >/dev/null 2>&1 || die "ERROR: JAVA_HOME is not set and no 'java' command could be found in your PATH.

Please set the JAVA_HOME variable in your environment to match the
location of your Java installation."
fi

# Increase the maximum file descriptors if we can.
if [ "$cygwin" = "false" -a "$darwin" = "false" -a "$nonstop" = "false" ] ; then
    MAX_FD_LIMIT=`ulimit -H -n`
    if [ $? -eq 0 ] ; then
        if [ "$MAX_FD" = "maximum" -o "$MAX_FD" = "max" ] ; then
            MAX_FD="$MAX_FD_LIMIT"
        fi
        ulimit -n $MAX_FD
        if [ $? -ne 0 ] ; then
            warn "Could not set maximum file descriptor limit: $MAX_FD"
        fi
    else
        warn "Could not query maximum file descriptor limit: $MAX_FD_LIMIT"
    fi
fi

# For Darwin, add options to specify how the application appears in the dock
if $darwin; then
    GRADLE_OPTS="$GRADLE_OPTS \"-Xdock:name=$APP_NAME\" \"-Xdock:icon=$APP_HOME/media/gradle.icns\""
fi

# For Cygwin or MSYS, switch paths to Windows format before running java
if [ "$cygwin" = "true" -o "$msys" = "true" ] ; then
    APP_HOME=`cygpath --path --mixed "$APP_HOME"`
    CLASSPATH=`cygpath --path --mixed "$CLASSPATH"`

    JAVACMD=`cygpath --unix "$JAVACMD"`

    # We build the pattern for arguments to be converted via cygpath
    ROOTDIRSRAW=`find -L / -maxdepth 1 -mindepth 1 -type d 2>/dev/null`
    SEP=""
    for dir in $ROOTDIRSRAW ; do
        ROOTDIRS="$ROOTDIRS$SEP$dir"
        SEP="|"
    done
    OURCYGPATTERN="(^($ROOTDIRS))"
    # Add a user-defined pattern to the cygpath arguments
    if [ "$GRADLE_CYGPATTERN" != "" ] ; then
        OURCYGPATTERN="$OURCYGPATTERN|($GRADLE_CYGPATTERN)"
    fi
    # Now convert the arguments - kludge to limit ourselves to /bin/sh
    i=0
    for arg in "$@" ; do
        CHECK=`echo "$arg"|egrep -c "$OURCYGPATTERN" -`
        CHECK2=`echo "$arg"|egrep -c "^-"`                                 ### Determine if an option

        if [ $CHECK -ne 0 ] && [ $CHECK2 -eq 0 ] ; then                    ### Added a condition
            eval `echo args$i`=`cygpath --path --ignore --mixed "$arg"`
        else
            eval `echo args$i`="\"$arg\""
        fi
        i=`expr $i + 1`
    done
    case $i in
        0) set -- ;;
        1) set -- "$args0" ;;
        2) set -- "$args0" "$args1" ;;
        3) set -- "$args0" "$args1" "$args2" ;;
        4) set -- "$args0" "$args1" "$args2" "$args3" ;;
        5) set -- "$args0" "$args1" "$args2" "$args3" "$args4" ;;
        6) set -- "$args0" "$args1" "$args2" "$args3" "$args4" "$args5" ;;
        7) set -- "$args0" "$args1" "$args2" "$args3" "$args4" "$args5" "$args6" ;;
        8) set -- "$args0" "$args1" "$args2" "$args3" "$args4" "$args5" "$args6" "$args7" ;;
        9) set -- "$args0" "$args1" "$args2" "$args3" "$args4" "$args5" "$args6" "$args7" "$args8" ;;
    esac
fi

# Escape application args
save () {
    for i do printf %s\\n "$i" | sed "s/'/'\\\\''/g;1s/^/'/;\$s/\$/' \\\\/" ; done
    echo " "
}
APP_ARGS=`save "$@"`

# Collect all arguments for the java command, following the shell quoting and substitution rules
eval set -- $DEFAULT_JVM_OPTS $JAVA_OPTS $GRADLE_OPTS "\"-Dorg.gradle.appname=$APP_BASE_NAME\"" -classpath "\"$CLASSPATH\"" org.gradle.wrapper.GradleWrapperMain "$APP_ARGS"

exec "$JAVACMD" "$@"

```

`gradlew.bat`:

```bat
@rem
@rem Copyright 2015 the original author or authors.
@rem
@rem Licensed under the Apache License, Version 2.0 (the "License");
@rem you may not use this file except in compliance with the License.
@rem You may obtain a copy of the License at
@rem
@rem      https://www.apache.org/licenses/LICENSE-2.0
@rem
@rem Unless required by applicable law or agreed to in writing, software
@rem distributed under the License is distributed on an "AS IS" BASIS,
@rem WITHOUT WARRANTIES OR CONDITIONS OF ANY KIND, either express or implied.
@rem See the License for the specific language governing permissions and
@rem limitations under the License.
@rem

@if "%DEBUG%" == "" @echo off
@rem ##########################################################################
@rem
@rem  Gradle startup script for Windows
@rem
@rem ##########################################################################

@rem Set local scope for the variables with windows NT shell
if "%OS%"=="Windows_NT" setlocal

set DIRNAME=%~dp0
if "%DIRNAME%" == "" set DIRNAME=.
set APP_BASE_NAME=%~n0
set APP_HOME=%DIRNAME%

@rem Resolve any "." and ".." in APP_HOME to make it shorter.
for %%i in ("%APP_HOME%") do set APP_HOME=%%~fi

@rem Add default JVM options here. You can also use JAVA_OPTS and GRADLE_OPTS to pass JVM options to this script.
set DEFAULT_JVM_OPTS="-Xmx64m" "-Xms64m"

@rem Find java.exe
if defined JAVA_HOME goto findJavaFromJavaHome

set JAVA_EXE=java.exe
%JAVA_EXE% -version >NUL 2>&1
if "%ERRORLEVEL%" == "0" goto execute

echo.
echo ERROR: JAVA_HOME is not set and no 'java' command could be found in your PATH.
echo.
echo Please set the JAVA_HOME variable in your environment to match the
echo location of your Java installation.

goto fail

:findJavaFromJavaHome
set JAVA_HOME=%JAVA_HOME:"=%
set JAVA_EXE=%JAVA_HOME%/bin/java.exe

if exist "%JAVA_EXE%" goto execute

echo.
echo ERROR: JAVA_HOME is set to an invalid directory: %JAVA_HOME%
echo.
echo Please set the JAVA_HOME variable in your environment to match the
echo location of your Java installation.

goto fail

:execute
@rem Setup the command line

set CLASSPATH=%APP_HOME%\gradle\wrapper\gradle-wrapper.jar


@rem Execute Gradle
"%JAVA_EXE%" %DEFAULT_JVM_OPTS% %JAVA_OPTS% %GRADLE_OPTS% "-Dorg.gradle.appname=%APP_BASE_NAME%" -classpath "%CLASSPATH%" org.gradle.wrapper.GradleWrapperMain %*

:end
@rem End local scope for the variables with windows NT shell
if "%ERRORLEVEL%"=="0" goto mainEnd

:fail
rem Set variable GRADLE_EXIT_CONSOLE if you need the _script_ return code instead of
rem the _cmd.exe /c_ return code!
if  not "" == "%GRADLE_EXIT_CONSOLE%" exit 1
exit /b 1

:mainEnd
if "%OS%"=="Windows_NT" endlocal

:omega

```

`nmea/src/main/java/moe/microbios/nmea/NMEA.kt`:

```kt
package moe.microbios.nmea

data class NMEA(
    val talkerId: String,
    val value: NmeaValue
) {
    companion object {
        fun calculateNmeaChecksum(nmeaSentence: String): String {
            val sentence = nmeaSentence.trimStart('$').substringBefore('*')
            var checksum = 0
            for (char in sentence) {
                checksum = checksum xor char.code
            }
            return String.format("%02X", checksum)
        }

        fun valueOf(value: String): NMEA {
            if (!value.startsWith("$")) {
                throw IllegalArgumentException("the statement doesn't start with '\$'")
            }

            val sentence = value.trimStart('$').substringBefore('*')
            val sequences = sentence.split(",")

            val (talkerId, statementId) = sequences[0].let {
                it.substring(0, 2) to it.substring(2)
            }

            when (statementId) {
                "DTM" -> {
                    val localCoordinateSystemCode = sequences[1]
                    val coordinateSystemSubCode = sequences[2]
                    val latitudeOffset = sequences[3].toDoubleOrNull()
                    val latitudeHemisphere = sequences[4]
                    val longitudeOffset = sequences[5].toDoubleOrNull()
                    val longitudeHemisphere = sequences[6]
                    val heightOffset = sequences[7].toDoubleOrNull()
                    val coordinateSystemCode = sequences[8]
                    return NMEA(talkerId, NmeaValue.DTM(
                        localCoordinateSystemCode = localCoordinateSystemCode,
                        coordinateSystemSubCode = coordinateSystemSubCode,
                        latitudeOffset = latitudeOffset,
                        latitudeHemisphere = latitudeHemisphere,
                        longitudeOffset = longitudeOffset,
                        longitudeHemisphere = longitudeHemisphere,
                        heightOffset = heightOffset,
                        coordinateSystemCode = coordinateSystemCode
                    ))
                }
                "GGA" -> {
                    val utc = sequences[1]
                    val latitude = sequences[2].toDoubleOrNull()
                    val latitudeHemisphere = sequences[3]
                    val longitude = sequences[4].toDoubleOrNull()
                    val longitudeHemisphere = sequences[5]
                    val fixQuality = sequences[6].toInt()
                    val satellites = sequences[7].toIntOrNull()
                    val hdop = sequences[8].toDoubleOrNull()
                    val antennaAltitude = sequences[9].toDoubleOrNull()
                    val antennaAltitudeUnit = sequences[10]
                    val geoidalSeparation = sequences[11].toDoubleOrNull()
                    val geoidalSeparationUnit = sequences[12]
                    val dgpsAge = sequences[13].toDoubleOrNull()
                    val dgpsStationId = sequences[14]
                    return NMEA(talkerId, NmeaValue.GGA(
                        utc = utc,
                        latitude = latitude,
                        latitudeHemisphere = latitudeHemisphere,
                        longitude = longitude,
                        longitudeHemisphere = longitudeHemisphere,
                        fixQuality = fixQuality,
                        satellites = satellites,
                        hdop = hdop,
                        antennaAltitude = antennaAltitude,
                        antennaAltitudeUnit = antennaAltitudeUnit,
                        geoidalSeparation = geoidalSeparation,
                        geoidalSeparationUnit = geoidalSeparationUnit,
                        dgpsAge = dgpsAge,
                        dgpsStationId = dgpsStationId
                    ))
                }
                "GNS" -> {
                    val utc = sequences[1]
                    val latitude = sequences[2].toDoubleOrNull()
                    val latitudeHemisphere = sequences[3]
                    val longitude = sequences[4].toDoubleOrNull()
                    val longitudeHemisphere = sequences[5]
                    val mode = sequences[6]
                    val satellites = sequences[7].toIntOrNull()
                    val hdop = sequences[8].toDoubleOrNull()
                    val altitude = sequences[9].toDoubleOrNull()
                    val geoidHeight = sequences[10].toDoubleOrNull()
                    val ageOfDifferentialData = sequences[11].toDoubleOrNull()
                    val differentialStationId = sequences[12]
                    val navStatus = if (sequences.size > 13) {
                        sequences[13]
                    } else "V"
                    return NMEA(talkerId, NmeaValue.GNS(
                        utc = utc,
                        latitude = latitude,
                        latitudeHemisphere = latitudeHemisphere,
                        longitude = longitude,
                        longitudeHemisphere = longitudeHemisphere,
                        mode = mode,
                        satellites = satellites,
                        hdop = hdop,
                        altitude = altitude,
                        geoidHeight = geoidHeight,
                        ageOfDifferentialData = ageOfDifferentialData,
                        differentialStationId = differentialStationId,
                        navStatus = navStatus
                    ))
                }
                "GSA" -> {
                    val mode = sequences[1]
                    val fixStatus = sequences[2].toInt()
                    val prn = sequences.subList(3, 15).map { it.toIntOrNull() }
                    val pdop = sequences[15].toDoubleOrNull()
                    val hdop = sequences[16].toDoubleOrNull()
                    val vdop = sequences[17].toDoubleOrNull()
                    val systemId = if (sequences.size > 18) {
                        sequences[18]
                    } else null
                    return NMEA(talkerId, NmeaValue.GSA(mode, fixStatus, prn, pdop, hdop, vdop, systemId))
                }
                "GSV" -> {
                    val totalMessages = sequences[1].toInt()
                    val messageNumber = sequences[2].toInt()
                    val totalSatellitesInView = sequences[3].toInt()
                    val remaining = sequences.size - 4
                    require(remaining % 4 in 0..1) { "incomplete GSV satellite fields" }
                    val hasInfoId = remaining % 4 == 1
                    val satelliteEnd = sequences.size - if (hasInfoId) 1 else 0
                    val satellites = sequences.subList(4, satelliteEnd).chunked(4).map {
                        NmeaValue.GSV.Satellite(
                            prn = it[0].toInt(),
                            elevation = it[1].toInt(),
                            azimuth = it[2].toInt(),
                            snr = it[3].toIntOrNull()
                        )
                    }
                    val infoId = if (hasInfoId) sequences.last() else null
                    return NMEA(talkerId, NmeaValue.GSV(totalMessages, messageNumber, totalSatellitesInView, satellites, infoId))
                }
                "RMC" -> {
                    val utc = sequences[1]
                    val status = sequences[2]
                    val latitude = sequences[3].toDoubleOrNull()
                    val latitudeHemisphere = sequences[4]
                    val longitude = sequences[5].toDoubleOrNull()
                    val longitudeHemisphere = sequences[6]
                    val speedKnots = sequences[7].toDoubleOrNull()
                    val trackAngle = sequences[8].toDoubleOrNull()
                    val date = sequences[9]
                    val magneticVariation = sequences[10].toDoubleOrNull()
                    val magneticVariationDirection = sequences[11]
                    val mode = if (sequences.size > 12) {
                        sequences[12]
                    } else ""
                    val navStatus = if (sequences.size > 13) {
                        sequences[13]
                    } else "V"
                    return NMEA(talkerId, NmeaValue.RMC(
                        utc = utc,
                        status = status,
                        latitude = latitude,
                        latitudeHemisphere = latitudeHemisphere,
                        longitude = longitude,
                        longitudeHemisphere = longitudeHemisphere,
                        speedKnots = speedKnots,
                        trackAngle = trackAngle,
                        date = date,
                        magneticVariation = magneticVariation,
                        magneticVariationDirection = magneticVariationDirection,
                        mode = mode,
                        navStatus = navStatus
                    ))
                }
                "VTG" -> {
                    val trueTrack = sequences[1].toDoubleOrNull()
                    val trueTrackMode = sequences[2]
                    val magneticTrack = sequences[3].toDoubleOrNull()
                    val magneticTrackMode = sequences[4]
                    val groundSpeedKnots = sequences[5].toDoubleOrNull()
                    val groundSpeedUnit = sequences[6]
                    val groundSpeedKph = sequences[7].toDoubleOrNull()
                    val groundSpeedKphUnit = sequences[8]
                    val mode = sequences[9]
                    return NMEA(talkerId, NmeaValue.VTG(
                        trueTrack = trueTrack,
                        trueTrackMode = trueTrackMode,
                        magneticTrack = magneticTrack,
                        magneticTrackMode = magneticTrackMode,
                        groundSpeedKnots = groundSpeedKnots,
                        groundSpeedUnit = groundSpeedUnit,
                        groundSpeedKph = groundSpeedKph,
                        groundSpeedKphUnit = groundSpeedKphUnit,
                        mode = mode
                    ))
                }
                else -> {
                    throw IllegalArgumentException("Unsupported statementId: $statementId")
                }
            }
        }
    }

    fun toNmeaString(): String {
        val data = value.toNmeaString()
        val sentence = "\$$talkerId$data*"
        val checksum = calculateNmeaChecksum(sentence)
        return "$sentence$checksum"
    }
}
```

`nmea/src/main/java/moe/microbios/nmea/NmeaGenerator.kt`:

```kt
package moe.microbios.nmea

import java.time.Instant
import java.time.ZoneOffset
import java.time.format.DateTimeFormatter
import java.util.Locale
import kotlin.math.abs
import kotlin.math.roundToLong

enum class NmeaConstellation(val talker: String, val systemId: Int) {
    GPS("GP", 1),
    GLONASS("GL", 2),
    GALILEO("GA", 3),
    BEIDOU("BD", 4),
    QZSS("GQ", 5),
    IRNSS("GI", 6),
}

data class NmeaSatellite(
    val constellation: NmeaConstellation,
    val prn: Int,
    val elevationDeg: Float,
    val azimuthDeg: Float,
    val cn0DbHz: Float,
    val usedInFix: Boolean,
) {
    init {
        require(prn in 1..999) { "prn out of range: $prn" }
        require(elevationDeg in 0f..90f) { "elevation out of range: $elevationDeg" }
        require(azimuthDeg >= 0f && azimuthDeg < 360f) { "azimuth out of range: $azimuthDeg" }
        require(cn0DbHz in 0f..99f) { "CN0 out of range: $cn0DbHz" }
    }
}

data class NmeaFix(
    val latitude: Double,
    val longitude: Double,
    val altitudeMeters: Double,
    val geoidSeparationMeters: Double? = null,
    val speedMps: Double,
    val bearingDeg: Double,
    val timeMillis: Long,
    val satellites: List<NmeaSatellite>,
    val hdop: Double?,
    val vdop: Double?,
    val pdop: Double?,
) {
    init {
        require(latitude in -90.0..90.0) { "latitude out of range" }
        require(longitude in -180.0..180.0) { "longitude out of range" }
        require(altitudeMeters.isFinite() && (geoidSeparationMeters == null || geoidSeparationMeters.isFinite())) { "invalid altitude" }
        require(speedMps.isFinite() && speedMps >= 0.0) { "invalid speed" }
        require(bearingDeg.isFinite() && bearingDeg in 0.0..360.0) { "invalid bearing" }
        require(timeMillis >= 0L) { "timeMillis must be non-negative" }
        require(satellites.map { it.constellation to it.prn }.distinct().size == satellites.size) { "duplicate NMEA satellite" }
        val dop = listOf(hdop, vdop, pdop)
        require(dop.all { it == null } || dop.all { it != null && it.isFinite() && it > 0 }) { "DOP must be finite positive or all unavailable" }
    }

    val hasFix: Boolean get() = hdop != null && satellites.count { it.usedInFix } >= 4
    val talker: String get() = if (satellites.map { it.constellation }.distinct().size == 1) satellites.first().constellation.talker else "GN"
}

/**
 * Single deterministic NMEA generator used by the GNSS hook (P3-03).
 *
 * Sentences are produced from one [NmeaFix]; GGA/RMC/GSA/GSV share the same satellite list and UTC
 * timestamp. GGA/GSA describe the used subset; GSV describes all visible satellites.
 * Unknown solution DOP and geoid separation remain empty. GST needs measured error statistics
 * (DOP alone is insufficient) and is therefore not synthesized.
 */
object NmeaGenerator {
    private val TIME = DateTimeFormatter.ofPattern("HHmmss.SS", Locale.US)
    private val DATE = DateTimeFormatter.ofPattern("ddMMyy", Locale.US)
    private val DAY = DateTimeFormatter.ofPattern("dd", Locale.US)
    private val MONTH = DateTimeFormatter.ofPattern("MM", Locale.US)
    private val YEAR = DateTimeFormatter.ofPattern("yyyy", Locale.US)

    fun generate(fix: NmeaFix): List<String> {
        val zoned = Instant.ofEpochMilli(fix.timeMillis).atZone(ZoneOffset.UTC)
        val utc = TIME.format(zoned)
        val date = DATE.format(zoned)
        val lines = mutableListOf<String>()

        lines += gga(fix, utc)
        lines += rmc(fix, utc, date)
        fix.satellites.groupBy { it.constellation }.toSortedMap(compareBy { it.ordinal }).forEach { (constellation, satellites) ->
            lines += gsa(fix, constellation, satellites)
            lines += gsv(constellation, satellites)
        }
        if (fix.satellites.isEmpty()) lines += gsa(fix, NmeaConstellation.GPS, emptyList())
        lines += zda(fix.talker, zoned, utc)
        return lines
    }

    private fun gga(fix: NmeaFix, utc: String): String {
        val (lat, ns) = latitude(fix.latitude)
        val (lon, ew) = longitude(fix.longitude)
        val quality = if (fix.hasFix) 1 else 0
        val used = if (fix.hasFix) fix.satellites.count { it.usedInFix } else 0
        val altitude = if (fix.hasFix && fix.geoidSeparationMeters != null) format1(fix.altitudeMeters - fix.geoidSeparationMeters) else ""
        val payload = "${fix.talker}GGA,$utc,$lat,$ns,$lon,$ew,$quality," +
            "${used.toString().padStart(2, '0')},${if (fix.hasFix) format1(fix.hdop) else ""}," +
            "$altitude,M,${format1(fix.geoidSeparationMeters)},M,,"
        return sentence(payload)
    }

    private fun rmc(fix: NmeaFix, utc: String, date: String): String {
        val (lat, ns) = latitude(fix.latitude)
        val (lon, ew) = longitude(fix.longitude)
        val knots = fix.speedMps * MPS_TO_KNOTS
        val status = if (fix.hasFix) "A" else "V"
        val mode = if (fix.hasFix) "A" else "N"
        val payload = "${fix.talker}RMC,$utc,$status,$lat,$ns,$lon,$ew,${format2(knots)},${format1(fix.bearingDeg)}," +
            "$date,,,$mode"
        return sentence(payload)
    }

    private fun gsa(fix: NmeaFix, constellation: NmeaConstellation, satellites: List<NmeaSatellite>): List<String> {
        val used = if (fix.hasFix) satellites.filter { it.usedInFix } else emptyList()
        val chunks = used.chunked(MAX_GSA_PRNS).ifEmpty { listOf(emptyList()) }
        return chunks.map { chunk ->
            val prns = chunk.map { it.prn.toString() } + List(MAX_GSA_PRNS - chunk.size) { "" }
            val dop = if (fix.hasFix) listOf(fix.pdop, fix.hdop, fix.vdop).joinToString(",", transform = ::format1) else ",,"
            sentence("${fix.talker}GSA,A,${if (fix.hasFix) 3 else 1},${prns.joinToString(",")},$dop,${constellation.systemId}")
        }
    }

    private fun gsv(constellation: NmeaConstellation, satellites: List<NmeaSatellite>): List<String> {
        val chunks = satellites.chunked(SATELLITES_PER_GSV)
        if (chunks.isEmpty()) return emptyList()
        return chunks.mapIndexed { index, chunk ->
            val satelliteFields = chunk.joinToString(",") { satellite ->
                "${satellite.prn.toString().padStart(2, '0')}," +
                    "${satellite.elevationDeg.toInt().toString().padStart(2, '0')}," +
                    "${satellite.azimuthDeg.toInt().toString().padStart(3, '0')}," +
                    satellite.cn0DbHz.toInt().toString().padStart(2, '0')
            }
            val payload = "${constellation.talker}GSV,${chunks.size},${index + 1}," +
                "${satellites.size.toString().padStart(2, '0')},$satelliteFields"
            sentence(payload)
        }
    }

    private fun zda(talker: String, zoned: java.time.ZonedDateTime, utc: String): String {
        val payload = "${talker}ZDA,$utc,${DAY.format(zoned)},${MONTH.format(zoned)},${YEAR.format(zoned)},00,00"
        return sentence(payload)
    }

    private fun sentence(payload: String): String {
        val checksum = NMEA.calculateNmeaChecksum("\$$payload")
        return "\$$payload*$checksum\r\n"
    }

    private fun latitude(value: Double): Pair<String, String> {
        val hemisphere = if (value >= 0) "N" else "S"
        return formatCoordinate(abs(value), 2) to hemisphere
    }

    private fun longitude(value: Double): Pair<String, String> {
        val hemisphere = if (value >= 0) "E" else "W"
        return formatCoordinate(abs(value), 3) to hemisphere
    }

    private fun formatCoordinate(value: Double, degreeDigits: Int): String {
        val ticks = (value * 60 * 10_000).roundToLong()
        val degrees = ticks / 600_000
        val minutes = (ticks % 600_000) / 10_000.0
        return String.format(Locale.US, "%0${degreeDigits}d%07.4f", degrees, minutes)
    }

    private fun format1(value: Double?): String = value?.let { String.format(Locale.US, "%.1f", it) }.orEmpty()

    private fun format2(value: Double): String = String.format(Locale.US, "%.2f", value)

    private const val MPS_TO_KNOTS = 1.9438444924406
    private const val MAX_GSA_PRNS = 12
    private const val SATELLITES_PER_GSV = 4
}

```

`nmea/src/main/java/moe/microbios/nmea/NmeaValue.kt`:

```kt
package moe.microbios.nmea

sealed class NmeaValue (
    val statementId: String,
) {
    data class DTM(
        val localCoordinateSystemCode: String?,
        val coordinateSystemSubCode: String?,
        val latitudeOffset: Double?,
        val latitudeHemisphere: String?,
        val longitudeOffset: Double?,
        val longitudeHemisphere: String?,
        val heightOffset: Double?,
        val coordinateSystemCode: String?,
    ): NmeaValue("DTM") {
//        Datum (DTM) 大地坐标系信息
//        $GPDTM,<1>,<2>,<3>,<4>,<5>,<6>,<7>,<8>*hh<CR><LF>
//        <1>本地坐标系代码 W84
//        <2>坐标系子代码 空
//        <3>纬度偏移量
//        <4>纬度半球N（北半球）或S（南半球）
//        <5>经度偏移量
//        <6>经度半球E（东经）或W（西经）
//        <7>高度偏移量
//        <8>坐标系代码 W84
        override fun toNmeaString() = "$statementId,${localCoordinateSystemCode ?: ""},${coordinateSystemSubCode ?: ""},${latitudeOffset?.let { "%011.6f".format(it) } ?: ""},${latitudeHemisphere ?: ""},${longitudeOffset?.let { "%012.6f".format(it) } ?: ""},${longitudeHemisphere ?: ""},${heightOffset?.let { "%.3f".format(it) } ?: ""},${coordinateSystemCode ?: ""}"
    }

    data class GGA(
        val utc: String?,
        var latitude: Double?,
        var latitudeHemisphere: String?,
        var longitude: Double?,
        var longitudeHemisphere: String?,
        val fixQuality: Int,
        val satellites: Int?,
        val hdop: Double?,
        val antennaAltitude: Double?,
        val antennaAltitudeUnit: String?,
        val geoidalSeparation: Double?,
        val geoidalSeparationUnit: String?,
        val dgpsAge: Double?,
        val dgpsStationId: String?,
    ): NmeaValue("GGA") {
//        1) Time (UTC)
//        2) Latitude 注释①
//        3) N or S (North or South)
//        4) Longitude 注释②
//        5) E or W (East or West)
//        6) GPS Quality Indicator,  注释③
//            0 - fix not available,
//            1 - GPS fix,
//            2 - Differential GPS fix
//        7) Number of satellites in view, 00 - 12
//        8) Horizontal Dilution of precision
//        9) Antenna Altitude above/below mean-sea-level (geoid)
//        10) Units of antenna altitude, meters
//        11) Geoidal separation, the difference between the WGS-84 earth ellipsoid and mean-sea-level (geoid), "-" means mean-sea-level below ellipsoid
//        12) Units of geoidal separation, meters
//        13) Age of differential GPS data, time in seconds since last SC104 type 1 or 9 update, null field when DGPS is not used 注释④
//        14) Differential reference station ID, 0000-1023 注释⑤
//        15) Checksum
        override fun toNmeaString() = "$statementId,$utc,${latitude?.let { "%011.6f".format(it) } ?: ""},$latitudeHemisphere,${longitude?.let { "%011.6f".format(it) } ?: ""},$longitudeHemisphere,$fixQuality,${satellites?.let { "%02d".format(it) } ?: ""},${hdop?.let { "%.1f".format(it) } ?: ""},${antennaAltitude?.let { "%.1f".format(it) } ?: ""},$antennaAltitudeUnit,${geoidalSeparation?.let { "%.1f".format(it) } ?: ""},$geoidalSeparationUnit,${dgpsAge?.let { "%.1f".format(it) } ?: ""},$dgpsStationId"
    }

    data class GNS(
        val utc: String?,
        var latitude: Double?,
        var latitudeHemisphere: String?,
        var longitude: Double?,
        var longitudeHemisphere: String?,
        /**
         * Mode
         * N = 无定位
         * A = 自主定位
         * D = 差分
         * P = 精密
         * R = RTK固定解
         * F = RTK浮点解
         * E = 估算
         * M = 手动输入
         */
        val mode: String,
        val satellites: Int?,
        val hdop: Double?,
        val altitude: Double?,
        val geoidHeight: Double?,
        val ageOfDifferentialData: Double?,
        val differentialStationId: String?,
        val navStatus: String,
    ): NmeaValue("GNS") {
        override fun toNmeaString() = "$statementId,$utc,${latitude?.let { "%011.6f".format(it) } ?: ""},$latitudeHemisphere,${longitude?.let { "%011.6f".format(it) } ?: ""},$longitudeHemisphere,$mode,${satellites?.let { "%02d".format(it) } ?: ""},${hdop?.let { "%.1f".format(it) } ?: ""},${altitude?.let { "%.1f".format(it) } ?: ""},${geoidHeight?.let { "%.1f".format(it) } ?: ""},${ageOfDifferentialData?.let { "%.1f".format(it) } ?: ""},${differentialStationId ?: ""},$navStatus"
    }

    data class GSA(
        /**
         * Mode
         * M = Manual
         * A = Automatic
         */
        val mode: String,
        /**
         * Fix status
         * 1 = No fix
         * 2 = 2D fix
         * 3 = 3D fix
         */
        val fixStatus: Int,
        val prn: List<Int?>,
        val pdop: Double?,
        val hdop: Double?,
        val vdop: Double?,
        val systemId: String? = null,
    ): NmeaValue("GSA") {
        init {
            require(prn.size == 12) { "prn size should be 12" }
        }

        override fun toNmeaString(): String = "$statementId,$mode,$fixStatus,${prn.joinToString(separator = ",") { it?.let { "%02d".format(it) } ?: "" }},${pdop ?: ""},${hdop ?: ""},${vdop ?: ""},${systemId ?: ""}"
    }

    data class GSV(
        val totalMessages: Int,
        val messageNumber: Int,
        val totalSatellitesInView: Int,
        val satellites: List<Satellite>,
        val infoId: String? = null,
    ): NmeaValue("GSV") {
        data class Satellite(
            val prn: Int,
            val elevation: Int,
            val azimuth: Int,
            val snr: Int?,
        )

        override fun toNmeaString(): String {
            val satellites = satellites.joinToString(separator = ",") { satellite ->
                "${"%02d".format(satellite.prn)},${satellite.elevation.let { "%02d".format(it) }},${satellite.azimuth.let { "%03d".format(it) }},${satellite.snr ?: ""}"
            }
            return "$statementId,$totalMessages,$messageNumber,${totalSatellitesInView.let { "%02d".format(it) }},$satellites,${infoId ?: ""}"
        }
    }

    data class RMC(
        val utc: String?,
        val status: String,
        var latitude: Double?,
        var latitudeHemisphere: String?,
        var longitude: Double?,
        var longitudeHemisphere: String?,
        val speedKnots: Double?,
        val trackAngle: Double?,
        val date: String?,
        val magneticVariation: Double?,
        val magneticVariationDirection: String,
        val mode: String,
        val navStatus: String,
    ): NmeaValue("RMC") {
//        $GPRMC
//        字段0：$GPRMC，语句ID，表明该语句为Recommended Minimum Specific GPS/TRANSIT Data（RMC）推荐最小定位信息
//        字段1：UTC时间，hhmmss.sss格式
//        字段2：状态，A=定位，V=未定位
//        字段3：纬度ddmm.mmmm，度分格式（前导位数不足则补0）
//        字段4：纬度N（北纬）或S（南纬）
//        字段5：经度dddmm.mmmm，度分格式（前导位数不足则补0）
//        字段6：经度E（东经）或W（西经）
//        字段7：速度，节，Knots
//        字段8：方位角，度
//        字段9：UTC日期，DDMMYY格式
//        字段10：磁偏角，（000 - 180）度（前导位数不足则补0）
//        字段11：磁偏角方向，E=东W=西
//        字段12：Mode指示定位系统模式，A=自主定位，R=差分，F=估算，N=数据无效
//        字段13：校验值
        override fun toNmeaString() = "$statementId,$utc,$status,${latitude?.let { "%011.6f".format(it) } ?: ""},$latitudeHemisphere,${longitude?.let { "%011.6f".format(it) } ?: ""},$longitudeHemisphere,${speedKnots?.let { "%.1f".format(it) } ?: ""},${trackAngle?.let { "%.1f".format(it) } ?: ""},${date ?: ""},${magneticVariation?.let { "%.1f".format(it) } ?: ""},$magneticVariationDirection,$mode,$navStatus"
    }

    data class VTG(
        val trueTrack: Double?,
        val magneticTrack: Double?,
        val groundSpeedKnots: Double?,
        val groundSpeedUnit: String,
        val groundSpeedKph: Double?,
        val groundSpeedKphUnit: String,
        val trueTrackMode: String,
        val magneticTrackMode: String,
        val mode: String
    ): NmeaValue("VTG") {
        override fun toNmeaString() = "$statementId,${trueTrack?.let { "%.1f".format(it) } ?: ""},$trueTrackMode,${magneticTrack?.let { "%.1f".format(it) } ?: ""},$magneticTrackMode,${groundSpeedKnots?.let { "%.1f".format(it) } ?: ""},$groundSpeedUnit,${groundSpeedKph?.let { "%.1f".format(it) } ?: ""},$groundSpeedKphUnit,$mode"
    }

    abstract fun toNmeaString(): String
}
```
