package com.android.server.location;

import android.content.Context;
import android.content.pm.PackageManager;
import android.location.Criteria;
import android.location.Location;
import android.location.provider.ProviderProperties;
import android.os.SystemClock;
import android.os.UserHandle;

import com.android.modules.utils.BasicShellCommandHandler;

import java.io.PrintWriter;
import java.util.Arrays;
import java.util.Collections;
import java.util.List;
import java.util.Objects;

/**
 * Interprets and executes 'adb shell cmd location [args]'.
 */
class LocationShellCommand extends BasicShellCommandHandler {
    private static final float DEFAULT_TEST_LOCATION_ACCURACY = 100.0f;

    private final Context mContext;
    private final LocationManagerService mService;

    LocationShellCommand(Context context, LocationManagerService service) {
        mContext = context;
        mService = Objects.requireNonNull(service);
    }

    @Override
    public int onCommand(String cmd) {
        if (cmd == null) {
            return handleDefaultCommands(null);
        }

        switch (cmd) {
            case "is-location-enabled": {
                handleIsLocationEnabled();
                return 0;
            }
            case "set-location-enabled": {
                handleSetLocationEnabled();
                return 0;
            }
            case "is-adas-gnss-location-enabled": {
                handleIsAdasGnssLocationEnabled();
                return 0;
            }
            case "set-adas-gnss-location-enabled": {
                handleSetAdasGnssLocationEnabled();
                return 0;
            }
            case "set-automotive-gnss-suspended": {
                handleSetAutomotiveGnssSuspended();
                return 0;
            }
            case "is-automotive-gnss-suspended": {
                handleIsAutomotiveGnssSuspended();
                return 0;
            }
            case "providers": {
                String command = getNextArgRequired();
                return parseProvidersCommand(command);
            }
            default:
                return handleDefaultCommands(cmd);
        }
    }

    private int parseProvidersCommand(String cmd) {
        switch (cmd) {
            case "add-test-provider": {
                handleAddTestProvider();
                return 0;
            }
            case "remove-test-provider": {
                handleRemoveTestProvider();
                return 0;
            }
            case "set-test-provider-enabled": {
                handleSetTestProviderEnabled();
                return 0;
            }
            case "set-test-provider-location": {
                handleSetTestProviderLocation();
                return 0;
            }
            case "send-extra-command": {
                handleSendExtraCommand();
                return 0;
            }
            default:
                return handleDefaultCommands(cmd);
        }
    }

    private void handleIsLocationEnabled() {
        int userId = UserHandle.USER_CURRENT_OR_SELF;

        do {
            String option = getNextOption();
            if (option == null) {
                break;
            }
            if ("--user".equals(option)) {
                userId = UserHandle.parseUserArg(getNextArgRequired());
            } else {
                throw new IllegalArgumentException("Unknown option: " + option);
            }
        } while (true);

        getOutPrintWriter().println(mService.isLocationEnabledForUser(userId));
    }

    private void handleSetLocationEnabled() {
        boolean enabled = Boolean.parseBoolean(getNextArgRequired());

        int userId = UserHandle.USER_CURRENT_OR_SELF;

        do {
            String option = getNextOption();
            if (option == null) {
                break;
            }
            if ("--user".equals(option)) {
                userId = UserHandle.parseUserArg(getNextArgRequired());
            } else {
                throw new IllegalArgumentException("Unknown option: " + option);
            }
        } while (true);

        mService.setLocationEnabledForUser(enabled, userId);
    }

    private void handleIsAdasGnssLocationEnabled() {
        if (!mContext.getPackageManager().hasSystemFeature(PackageManager.FEATURE_AUTOMOTIVE)) {
            throw new IllegalStateException("command only recognized on automotive devices");
        }

        int userId = UserHandle.USER_CURRENT_OR_SELF;

        do {
            String option = getNextOption();
            if (option == null) {
                break;
            }
            if ("--user".equals(option)) {
                userId = UserHandle.parseUserArg(getNextArgRequired());
            } else {
                throw new IllegalArgumentException("Unknown option: " + option);
            }
        } while (true);

        getOutPrintWriter().println(mService.isAdasGnssLocationEnabledForUser(userId));
    }

    private void handleSetAdasGnssLocationEnabled() {
        if (!mContext.getPackageManager().hasSystemFeature(PackageManager.FEATURE_AUTOMOTIVE)) {
            throw new IllegalStateException("command only recognized on automotive devices");
        }

        boolean enabled = Boolean.parseBoolean(getNextArgRequired());

        int userId = UserHandle.USER_CURRENT_OR_SELF;

        do {
            String option = getNextOption();
            if (option == null) {
                break;
            }
            if ("--user".equals(option)) {
                userId = UserHandle.parseUserArg(getNextArgRequired());
            } else {
                throw new IllegalArgumentException("Unknown option: " + option);
            }
        } while (true);

        mService.setAdasGnssLocationEnabledForUser(enabled, userId);
    }

    private void handleSetAutomotiveGnssSuspended() {
        if (!mContext.getPackageManager().hasSystemFeature(PackageManager.FEATURE_AUTOMOTIVE)) {
            throw new IllegalStateException("command only recognized on automotive devices");
        }

        boolean suspended = Boolean.parseBoolean(getNextArgRequired());

        mService.setAutomotiveGnssSuspended(suspended);
    }

    private void handleIsAutomotiveGnssSuspended() {
        if (!mContext.getPackageManager().hasSystemFeature(PackageManager.FEATURE_AUTOMOTIVE)) {
            throw new IllegalStateException("command only recognized on automotive devices");
        }

        getOutPrintWriter().println(mService.isAutomotiveGnssSuspended());
    }

    private void handleAddTestProvider() {
        String provider = getNextArgRequired();

        boolean requiresNetwork = false;
        boolean requiresSatellite = false;
        boolean requiresCell = false;
        boolean hasMonetaryCost = false;
        boolean supportsAltitude = false;
        boolean supportsSpeed = false;
        boolean supportsBearing = false;
        int powerRequirement = Criteria.POWER_LOW;
        int accuracy = Criteria.ACCURACY_FINE;

        List<String> extraAttributionTags = Collections.emptyList();

        do {
            String option = getNextOption();
            if (option == null) {
                break;
            }
            switch (option) {
                case "--requiresNetwork": {
                    requiresNetwork = true;
                    break;
                }
                case "--requiresSatellite": {
                    requiresSatellite = true;
                    break;
                }
                case "--requiresCell": {
                    requiresCell = true;
                    break;
                }
                case "--hasMonetaryCost": {
                    hasMonetaryCost = true;
                    break;
                }
                case "--supportsAltitude": {
                    supportsAltitude = true;
                    break;
                }
                case "--supportsSpeed": {
                    supportsSpeed = true;
                    break;
                }
                case "--supportsBearing": {
                    supportsBearing = true;
                    break;
                }
                case "--powerRequirement": {
                    powerRequirement = Integer.parseInt(getNextArgRequired());
                    break;
                }
                case "--accuracy": {
                    accuracy = Integer.parseInt(getNextArgRequired());
                    break;
                }
                case "--extraAttributionTags": {
                    extraAttributionTags = Arrays.asList(getNextArgRequired().split(","));
                    break;
                }
                default:
                    throw new IllegalArgumentException(
                            "Received unexpected option: " + option);
            }
        } while(true);

        ProviderProperties properties = new ProviderProperties.Builder()
                .setHasNetworkRequirement(requiresNetwork)
                .setHasSatelliteRequirement(requiresSatellite)
                .setHasCellRequirement(requiresCell)
                .setHasMonetaryCost(hasMonetaryCost)
                .setHasAltitudeSupport(supportsAltitude)
                .setHasSpeedSupport(supportsSpeed)
                .setHasBearingSupport(supportsBearing)
                .setPowerUsage(powerRequirement)
                .setAccuracy(accuracy)
                .build();
        mService.addTestProvider(provider, properties, extraAttributionTags,
                mContext.getOpPackageName(), mContext.getAttributionTag());
    }

    private void handleRemoveTestProvider() {
        String provider = getNextArgRequired();
        mService.removeTestProvider(provider, mContext.getOpPackageName(),
                mContext.getAttributionTag());
    }

    private void handleSetTestProviderEnabled() {
        String provider = getNextArgRequired();
        boolean enabled = Boolean.parseBoolean(getNextArgRequired());
        mService.setTestProviderEnabled(provider, enabled, mContext.getOpPackageName(),
                mContext.getAttributionTag());
    }

    private void handleSetTestProviderLocation() {
        String provider = getNextArgRequired();

        boolean hasLatLng = false;

        Location location = new Location(provider);
        location.setAccuracy(DEFAULT_TEST_LOCATION_ACCURACY);
        location.setTime(System.currentTimeMillis());
        location.setElapsedRealtimeNanos(SystemClock.elapsedRealtimeNanos());

        do {
            String option = getNextOption();
            if (option == null) {
                break;
            }
            switch (option) {
                case "--location": {
                    String[] locationInput = getNextArgRequired().split(",");
                    if (locationInput.length != 2) {
                        throw new IllegalArgumentException("Location argument must be in the form "
                                + "of \"<LATITUDE>,<LONGITUDE>\", not "
                                + Arrays.toString(locationInput));
                    }

                    location.setLatitude(Double.parseDouble(locationInput[0]));
                    location.setLongitude(Double.parseDouble(locationInput[1]));
                    hasLatLng = true;
                    break;
                }
                case "--accuracy": {
                    location.setAccuracy(Float.parseFloat(getNextArgRequired()));
                    break;
                }
                case "--time": {
                    location.setTime(Long.parseLong(getNextArgRequired()));
                    break;
                }
                default:
                    throw new IllegalArgumentException("Unknown option: " + option);
            }
        } while (true);

        if (!hasLatLng) {
            throw new IllegalArgumentException("Option \"--location\" is required");
        }

        mService.setTestProviderLocation(provider, location, mContext.getOpPackageName(),
                mContext.getAttributionTag());
    }

    private void handleSendExtraCommand() {
        String provider = getNextArgRequired();
        String command = getNextArgRequired();
        mService.sendExtraCommand(provider, command, null);
    }

    @Override
    public void onHelp() {
        PrintWriter pw = getOutPrintWriter();
        pw.println("Location service commands:");
        pw.println("  help or -h");
        pw.println("    Print this help text.");
        pw.println("  is-location-enabled [--user <USER_ID>]");
        pw.println("    Gets the master location switch enabled state. If no user is specified,");
        pw.println("    the current user is assumed.");
        pw.println("  set-location-enabled true|false [--user <USER_ID>]");
        pw.println("    Sets the master location switch enabled state. If no user is specified,");
        pw.println("    the current user is assumed.");
        if (mContext.getPackageManager().hasSystemFeature(PackageManager.FEATURE_AUTOMOTIVE)) {
            pw.println("  is-adas-gnss-location-enabled [--user <USER_ID>]");
            pw.println("    Gets the ADAS GNSS location enabled state. If no user is specified,");
            pw.println("    the current user is assumed.");
            pw.println("  set-adas-gnss-location-enabled true|false [--user <USER_ID>]");
            pw.println("    Sets the ADAS GNSS location enabled state. If no user is specified,");
            pw.println("    the current user is assumed.");
            pw.println("  is-automotive-gnss-suspended");
            pw.println("    Gets the automotive GNSS suspended state.");
            pw.println("  set-automotive-gnss-suspended true|false");
            pw.println("    Sets the automotive GNSS suspended state.");
        }
        pw.println("  providers");
        pw.println("    The providers command is followed by a subcommand, as listed below:");
        pw.println();
        pw.println("    add-test-provider <PROVIDER> [--requiresNetwork] [--requiresSatellite]");
        pw.println("      [--requiresCell] [--hasMonetaryCost] [--supportsAltitude]");
        pw.println("      [--supportsSpeed] [--supportsBearing]");
        pw.println("      [--powerRequirement <POWER_REQUIREMENT>]");
        pw.println("      [--extraAttributionTags <TAG>,<TAG>,...]");
        pw.println("      Add the given test provider. Requires MOCK_LOCATION permissions which");
        pw.println("      can be enabled by running \"adb shell appops set <uid>");
        pw.println("      android:mock_location allow\". There are optional flags that can be");
        pw.println("      used to configure the provider properties and additional arguments. If");
        pw.println("      no flags are included, then default values will be used.");
        pw.println("    remove-test-provider <PROVIDER>");
        pw.println("      Remove the given test provider.");
        pw.println("    set-test-provider-enabled <PROVIDER> true|false");
        pw.println("      Sets the given test provider enabled state.");
        pw.println("    set-test-provider-location <PROVIDER> --location <LATITUDE>,<LONGITUDE>");
        pw.println("      [--accuracy <ACCURACY>] [--time <TIME>]");
        pw.println("      Set location for given test provider. Accuracy and time are optional.");
        pw.println("    send-extra-command <PROVIDER> <COMMAND>");
        pw.println("      Sends the given extra command to the given provider.");
        pw.println();
        pw.println("      Common commands that may be supported by the gps provider, depending on");
        pw.println("      hardware and software configurations:");
        pw.println("        delete_aiding_data - requests deletion of any predictive aiding data");
        pw.println("        force_time_injection - requests NTP time injection");
        pw.println("        force_psds_injection - requests predictive aiding data injection");
        pw.println("        request_power_stats - requests GNSS power stats update");
    }
}

```aidl
/*

 * you may not use this file except in compliance with the License.
 * You may obtain a copy of the License at
 *

 *
 * Unless required by applicable law or agreed to in writing, software
 * distributed under the License is distributed on an "AS IS" BASIS,
 * WITHOUT WARRANTIES OR CONDITIONS OF ANY KIND, either express or implied.
 * See the License for the specific language governing permissions and
 * limitations under the License.
 */

package android.location;

import android.app.PendingIntent;
import android.location.Address;
import android.location.Criteria;
import android.location.GeocoderParams;
import android.location.Geofence;
import android.location.IGnssMeasurementsListener;
import android.location.IGnssStatusListener;
import android.location.IGnssNavigationMessageListener;
import android.location.ILocationListener;
import android.location.Location;
import android.location.LocationRequest;
import android.os.Bundle;

import com.android.internal.location.ProviderProperties;

/**
 * System private API for talking with the location service.
 *
 * @hide
 */
interface ILocationManager
{
    void requestLocationUpdates(in LocationRequest request, in ILocationListener listener,
            in PendingIntent intent, String packageName);
    void removeUpdates(in ILocationListener listener, in PendingIntent intent, String packageName);

    void requestGeofence(in LocationRequest request, in Geofence geofence,
            in PendingIntent intent, String packageName);
    void removeGeofence(in Geofence fence, in PendingIntent intent, String packageName);

    Location getLastLocation(in LocationRequest request, String packageName);

    boolean registerGnssStatusCallback(IGnssStatusListener callback, String packageName);
    void unregisterGnssStatusCallback(IGnssStatusListener callback);

    boolean geocoderIsPresent();
    String getFromLocation(double latitude, double longitude, int maxResults,
        in GeocoderParams params, out List<Address> addrs);
    String getFromLocationName(String locationName,
        double lowerLeftLatitude, double lowerLeftLongitude,
        double upperRightLatitude, double upperRightLongitude, int maxResults,
        in GeocoderParams params, out List<Address> addrs);

    boolean sendNiResponse(int notifId, int userResponse);

    boolean addGnssMeasurementsListener(in IGnssMeasurementsListener listener, in String packageName);
    void removeGnssMeasurementsListener(in IGnssMeasurementsListener listener);

    boolean addGnssNavigationMessageListener(
            in IGnssNavigationMessageListener listener,
            in String packageName);
    void removeGnssNavigationMessageListener(in IGnssNavigationMessageListener listener);

    int getGnssYearOfHardware();

    // --- deprecated ---
    List<String> getAllProviders();
    List<String> getProviders(in Criteria criteria, boolean enabledOnly);
    String getBestProvider(in Criteria criteria, boolean enabledOnly);
    boolean providerMeetsCriteria(String provider, in Criteria criteria);
    ProviderProperties getProviderProperties(String provider);
    String getNetworkProviderPackage();
    boolean isProviderEnabled(String provider);

    void addTestProvider(String name, in ProviderProperties properties, String opPackageName);
    void removeTestProvider(String provider, String opPackageName);
    void setTestProviderLocation(String provider, in Location loc, String opPackageName);
    void clearTestProviderLocation(String provider, String opPackageName);
    void setTestProviderEnabled(String provider, boolean enabled, String opPackageName);
    void clearTestProviderEnabled(String provider, String opPackageName);
    void setTestProviderStatus(String provider, int status, in Bundle extras, long updateTime,
            String opPackageName);
    void clearTestProviderStatus(String provider, String opPackageName);

    boolean sendExtraCommand(String provider, String command, inout Bundle extras);

    // --- internal ---

    // Used by location providers to tell the location manager when it has a new location.
    // Passive is true if the location is coming from the passive provider, in which case
    // it need not be shared with other providers.
    void reportLocation(in Location location, boolean passive);

    // for reporting callback completion
    void locationCallbackFinished(ILocationListener listener);


}

```md
# Android 定位接口参考

本目录保存 Android 定位接口的历史参考文件和 AOSP 源码入口，供比较不同版本的方法签名、回调与系统实现。当前参考范围为 Android 7.0 至 Android 17，最后核验日期为 **2026-10-16**。

这些资料不参与项目编译、打包或运行。项目当前最低支持 Android 12 / API 31；更早版本的资料作为历史记录保留。目录覆盖到某个版本，不代表应用或 Xposed / Native 后端已通过该版本的兼容性验证。

## 版本索引

源码链接使用 AOSP 固定发布标签，便于复现比较；主版本采用首发 `r1` 基线，已有带修订号的历史目录保留原基线。API 列对应所列基线，不单列 Android 8.1、12L 等中间版本。

| Android | API | AOSP 基线标签 | 参考目录 |
|---|---|---|---|
| 7.0 | 24 | `android-7.0.0_r1` | [7.0.0_r1](7.0.0_r1/README.md) |
| 7.1.1 | 25 | `android-7.1.1_r6` | [7.1.1_r6](7.1.1_r6/README.md) |
| 8.0 | 26 | `android-8.0.0_r4` | [8.0.0_r4](8.0.0_r4/README.md) |
| 9 | 28 | `android-9.0.0_r3` | [9.0.0_r3](9.0.0_r3/README.md) |
| 10 | 29 | `android-10.0.0_r1` | [10.0.0](10.0.0/README.md) |
| 11 | 30 | `android-11.0.0_r1` | [11.0.0](11.0.0/README.md) |
| 12 | 31 | `android-12.0.0_r1` | [12.0.0](12.0.0/README.md) |
| 13 | 33 | `android-13.0.0_r1` | [13.0.0](13.0.0/README.md) |
| 14 | 34 | `android-14.0.0_r1` | [14.0.0](14.0.0/README.md) |
| 15 | 35 | `android-15.0.0_r1` | [15.0.0](15.0.0/README.md) |
| 16 | 36 | `android-16.0.0_r1` | [16.0.0](16.0.0/README.md) |
| 17 | 37 | `android-17.0.0_r1` | [17.0.0](17.0.0/README.md) |

Android 7–9 的本地 `.aidl` 是历史参考文件，可能包含维护注释；对应 README 中的 AOSP 固定标签是核对原始内容的依据。Android 10 起沿用源码链接形式，避免将不参与编译的系统源码复制进仓库。

## 本地源码快照

Android 16 和 Android 17 另外提供了 `aosp/` 本地快照，并在同目录的 `sources.json` 中记录固定标签、AOSP 提交、抓取日期、文件清单和 SHA-256 校验值。快照范围是定位相关的 AIDL、公开定位类，以及 `LocationManagerService` 和相关服务类；它不是完整的 `frameworks/base` 镜像，也不参与构建。

```text
refs/17.0.0/aosp/location/java/android/location/
refs/17.0.0/aosp/services/core/java/com/android/server/location/
refs/17.0.0/sources.json
```

使用 `python scripts/sync-android-refs.py --verify` 可离线验证当前快照。需要更新固定标签时使用 `--version 17.0.0` 或其他已支持版本重新抓取；脚本会校验 Gitiles blob ID，并拒绝覆盖被手工修改的快照文件。源码版权和 Apache 2.0 许可声明随 AOSP 文件保留；重新分发前仍需核对 AOSP 的 NOTICE 要求。

## 后续维护

1. 从 [AOSP frameworks/base 发布标签](https://android.googlesource.com/platform/frameworks/base/+refs) 确认目标版本的实际标签；新增版本目录并更新上表，不根据版本号猜测分支或标签。
2. 核对 `ILocationManager`、定位 / GNSS / NMEA 回调接口，以及 `LocationManager` 和 `LocationManagerService` 的实现；将比较结论限定到实际检查的文件和标签。
3. 记录固定标签、核验日期和所需的源码链接。涉及 QPR、安全补丁或厂商 ROM 时，另行记录准确基线，不把首发 AOSP 当作全部设备实现。
4. 结合 [Android 版本与行为变更文档](https://developer.android.com/about/versions) 核对公开 API 和运行行为；在设备上验证后，再更新项目的兼容性说明。

`scripts/build_carrier_phone_metadata.py`:

```py
"""Build compact offline phone generation metadata from a pinned Apache-2.0 source.

Usage: python scripts/build_carrier_phone_metadata.py <download-directory>
Required files: phone-number-metadata.xml, phone-cn-geocoding.txt,
phone-cn-carriers.txt, phone-metadata-license.txt.
Source revision: 36931eec42d4f57335ebf0360d6cb7eec1300d50 (google/libphonenumber).
No network access or source code execution is performed by this converter.
"""
import gzip
import json
import pathlib
import re
import sys
import xml.etree.ElementTree as ET

root = pathlib.Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]
source = pathlib.Path(sys.argv[1])
target = root / 'core/src/main/resources/carrier'
target.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)

def mapping(name):
    result = {}
    for line in (source / name).read_text(encoding='utf-8').splitlines():
        if line and not line.startswith('#'):
            key, value = line.split('|', 1)
            result[key] = value
    return result

def compact(text):
    return re.sub(r'\s+', '', text or '')

regions = []
for territory in ET.parse(source / 'phone-number-metadata.xml').getroot().findall('.//territory'):
    iso = territory.attrib['id']
    if iso == '001':
        continue
    descriptor = territory.find('mobile')
    kind = 'mobile'
    if descriptor is None or descriptor.findtext('exampleNumber') is None:
        descriptor = territory.find('fixedLine')
        kind = 'fixedLine'
    if descriptor is None or descriptor.findtext('exampleNumber') is None:
        continue
    regions.append(dict(iso=iso, callingCode=territory.attrib['countryCode'],
                        example=compact(descriptor.findtext('exampleNumber')),
                        pattern=compact(descriptor.findtext('nationalNumberPattern')),
                        kind=kind))

geography = mapping('phone-cn-geocoding.txt')
carriers = mapping('phone-cn-carriers.txt')
longer = {key[:9] for key in geography if key.startswith('861') and len(key) > 9}
rows = []
for prefix, city in geography.items():
    if not re.fullmatch(r'861\d{6}', prefix) or prefix in longer:
        continue
    operator = next((carriers[prefix[:size]] for size in range(len(prefix), 1, -1)
                     if prefix[:size] in carriers), '')
    code = {'China Mobile': 'CMCC', 'China Unicom': 'CUCC', 'China Telecom': 'CTCC',
            'China Broadnet': 'CBN'}.get(operator)
    if code:
        rows.append((city, code, prefix[2:]))
rows.sort()
assert len(rows) > 50000
payload = '\n'.join('|'.join(row) for row in rows) + '\n'
with (target / 'cn-mobile-cities.tsv.gz').open('wb') as output:
    with gzip.GzipFile(fileobj=output, mode='wb', mtime=0) as gz:
        gz.write(payload.encode('utf-8'))
(target / 'phone-regions.json').write_text(json.dumps(regions, ensure_ascii=False, separators=(',', ':')), encoding='utf-8')
(target / 'libphonenumber-LICENSE.txt').write_text((source / 'phone-metadata-license.txt').read_text(encoding='utf-8'), encoding='utf-8')
print(f'{len(regions)} regions; {len(rows)} Chinese mobile prefixes; {len(set(row[0] for row in rows))} city labels')

```

`scripts/check_backup_rules.py`:

```py
#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Fail if sensitive files can be included in Android backup/device transfer (P6-04)."""

from __future__ import annotations

import sys
import xml.etree.ElementTree as ET
from pathlib import Path

ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]
RES = ROOT / "app" / "src" / "main" / "res" / "xml"

REQUIRED = (
    ("file", "environment/"),
    ("sharedpref", "fused_ext.xml"),
    ("file", "library/"),
    ("sharedpref", "sdk_privacy.xml"),
    ("sharedpref", "scenario_runtime.xml"),
)


def exclusions(node: ET.Element) -> set[tuple[str, str]]:
    return {(child.get("domain", ""), child.get("path", "")) for child in node.findall("exclude")}


def check_section(name: str, actual: set[tuple[str, str]]) -> list[str]:
    return [f"{name}: missing domain={domain} path={path}" for domain, path in REQUIRED if (domain, path) not in actual]


def main() -> int:
    errors = []
    backup = ET.parse(RES / "backup_rules.xml").getroot()
    errors += check_section("backup_rules", exclusions(backup))

    extraction = ET.parse(RES / "data_extraction_rules.xml").getroot()
    for section in ("cloud-backup", "device-transfer"):
        node = extraction.find(section)
        if node is None:
            errors.append(f"data_extraction_rules: missing {section}")
            continue
        errors += check_section(f"data_extraction_rules/{section}", exclusions(node))

    if errors:
        print("\n".join(errors))
        print(f"backup rules: {len(errors)} violation(s)")
        return 1
    print("backup rules: 0 violation(s)")
    return 0


if __name__ == "__main__":
    sys.exit(main())

```

`scripts/check_license_assets.py`:

```py
#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Ensure shipped APK asset licenses match the repository LICENSE/NOTICE (P0-05)."""

from __future__ import annotations

import sys
from pathlib import Path

ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]
TARGETS = (
    ROOT / "app" / "src" / "main" / "assets",
    ROOT / "detector" / "src" / "main" / "assets",
)


def main() -> int:
    errors = []
    for name in ("LICENSE", "NOTICE"):
        source = ROOT / name
        if not source.is_file():
            errors.append(f"missing repository {name}")
            continue
        expected = source.read_bytes()
        for directory in TARGETS:
            target = directory / name
            if not target.is_file():
                errors.append(f"missing {target.relative_to(ROOT).as_posix()}")
            elif target.read_bytes() != expected:
                errors.append(f"{target.relative_to(ROOT).as_posix()} differs from {name}")
    if errors:
        print("\n".join(errors))
        print(f"license assets: {len(errors)} violation(s)")
        return 1
    print("license assets: 0 violation(s)")
    return 0


if __name__ == "__main__":
    sys.exit(main())

```

`scripts/check_manifest_exports.py`:

```py
#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Fail if app components other than MainActivity are exported (P6-04)."""

from __future__ import annotations

import sys
import xml.etree.ElementTree as ET
from pathlib import Path

ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]
MANIFEST = ROOT / "app" / "src" / "main" / "AndroidManifest.xml"
ANDROID = "{http://schemas.android.com/apk/res/android}"
ALLOWED_EXPORTED = {
    "com.system.location.service.MainActivity",
    ".MainActivity",
    ".launcher.StandardIcon",
    ".launcher.NeonIcon",
}


def component_name(node: ET.Element) -> str:
    return node.get(f"{ANDROID}name", "")


def main() -> int:
    root = ET.parse(MANIFEST).getroot()
    application = root.find("application")
    if application is None:
        print("manifest: missing application")
        return 1
    errors = []
    permissions = {
        node.get(f"{ANDROID}name", "") for node in root.findall("uses-permission")
    }
    if "android.permission.QUERY_ALL_PACKAGES" in permissions:
        errors.append("QUERY_ALL_PACKAGES must not be requested; use package visibility queries")
    # Android still filters the developer-options mock-location app list by this manifest
    # declaration even though the permission is deprecated for runtime use (issue #9).
    if "android.permission.ACCESS_MOCK_LOCATION" not in permissions:
        errors.append("ACCESS_MOCK_LOCATION must stay declared for the mock-location app picker")
    for tag in ("activity", "activity-alias", "service", "receiver", "provider"):
        for node in application.findall(tag):
            name = component_name(node)
            exported = node.get(f"{ANDROID}exported")
            if exported == "true" and name not in ALLOWED_EXPORTED:
                errors.append(f"unexpected exported {tag}: {name}")
            if tag in ("service", "provider") and exported != "false":
                errors.append(f"{tag} must set exported=false: {name}")
    if errors:
        print("\n".join(errors))
        print(f"manifest exports: {len(errors)} violation(s)")
        return 1
    print("manifest exports: 0 violation(s)")
    return 0


if __name__ == "__main__":
    sys.exit(main())

```

`scripts/check_module_rules.py`:

```py
#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Repository guardrails for the long-term roadmap (P0-05).

The checks are intentionally small and dependency-free so they run in the existing
`python3 -m unittest discover -s scripts` PR job:

* `:core` / `:nmea` stay pure JVM (no Android imports);
* `:xposed` never depends on `:app`, `:app` never depends on `:detector`;
* `:detector` imports nothing from the implementation it evaluates;
* hook files respect the 400-line budget, with a checked-in baseline for legacy files;
* every relative Markdown link under `docs/roadmap/` resolves.
"""

from __future__ import annotations

import json
import re
import sys
from pathlib import Path

ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]
LINE_BUDGET = 400
BASELINE_PATH = Path("docs/roadmap/line-budget-baseline.json")
HOOK_DIR = Path("xposed/src/main/java/com/system/location/service/hook")
IMPORT_RE = re.compile(r"^\s*import\s+(?:static\s+)?([A-Za-z_][\w.]*)", re.MULTILINE)
LINK_RE = re.compile(r"\[[^\]]*\]\(([^)\s]+)\)")
PROJECT_DEP_RE = re.compile(r"project\s*\(\s*[\"'](:[A-Za-z0-9_.-]+)[\"']\s*\)")


def _read(path: Path) -> str:
    return path.read_text(encoding="utf-8", errors="replace")


def _imports(path: Path) -> list[str]:
    return IMPORT_RE.findall(_read(path))


def check_pure_jvm(root: Path = ROOT) -> list[str]:
    problems: list[str] = []
    for module in ("core", "nmea"):
        source_root = root / module / "src" / "main"
        if not source_root.exists():
            continue
        for path in source_root.rglob("*"):
            if path.suffix not in {".kt", ".java"}:
                continue
            for imported in _imports(path):
                if imported.startswith(("android.", "androidx.")):
                    problems.append(f"{path.relative_to(root).as_posix()}: pure JVM module imports {imported}")
    return problems


def check_forbidden_dependency(root: Path, build_rel: str, forbidden: str) -> list[str]:
    build = root / build_rel
    if not build.exists():
        return []
    dependencies = PROJECT_DEP_RE.findall(_read(build))
    if forbidden in dependencies:
        return [f"{build_rel}: forbidden project dependency {forbidden}"]
    return []


def check_detector_isolation(root: Path = ROOT) -> list[str]:
    problems: list[str] = []
    build_rel = "detector/build.gradle.kts"
    build = root / build_rel
    if build.exists():
        dependencies = PROJECT_DEP_RE.findall(_read(build))
        if dependencies:
            problems.append(f"{build_rel}: detector must not depend on project modules: {', '.join(dependencies)}")
    source_root = root / "detector" / "src"
    if source_root.exists():
        for path in source_root.rglob("*.kt"):
            for imported in _imports(path):
                if imported.startswith("com.system.location.service.") and not imported.startswith(
                    "com.system.location.service.detector"
                ):
                    problems.append(
                        f"{path.relative_to(root).as_posix()}: detector imports implementation class {imported}"
                    )
    return problems


def check_line_budget(root: Path = ROOT) -> list[str]:
    baseline: dict[str, int] = {}
    baseline_file = root / BASELINE_PATH
    if baseline_file.exists():
        baseline = json.loads(_read(baseline_file))
    problems: list[str] = []
    hook_root = root / HOOK_DIR
    if not hook_root.exists():
        return problems
    for path in hook_root.rglob("*.kt"):
        rel = path.relative_to(root).as_posix()
        current = len(_read(path).splitlines())
        allowed = int(baseline.get(rel, LINE_BUDGET))
        if current > allowed:
            suffix = " (baseline)" if rel in baseline else " (new file)"
            problems.append(f"{rel}: {current} lines > budget {allowed}{suffix}")
    return problems


def check_roadmap_links(root: Path = ROOT) -> list[str]:
    problems: list[str] = []
    doc_root = root / "docs" / "roadmap"
    if not doc_root.exists():
        return [f"docs/roadmap is missing"]
    for doc in doc_root.rglob("*.md"):
        for link in LINK_RE.findall(_read(doc)):
            if link.startswith(("http://", "https://", "#", "mailto:")):
                continue
            target = link.split("#", 1)[0].strip()
            if not target:
                continue
            if not (doc.parent / target).exists():
                problems.append(f"{doc.relative_to(root).as_posix()} -> {link} (missing)")
    return problems


def violations(root: Path = ROOT) -> list[str]:
    return [
        *check_pure_jvm(root),
        *check_forbidden_dependency(root, "xposed/build.gradle.kts", ":app"),
        *check_forbidden_dependency(root, "app/build.gradle.kts", ":detector"),
        *check_detector_isolation(root),
        *check_line_budget(root),
        *check_roadmap_links(root),
    ]


def main() -> int:
    problems = violations()
    for problem in problems:
        print(f"FAIL {problem}")
    print(f"module rules: {len(problems)} violation(s)")
    return 1 if problems else 0


if __name__ == "__main__":
    sys.exit(main())

```

`scripts/check_native_syntax.py`:

```py
#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Syntax-check the native hook sources for all packaged ABIs without invoking CMake.

This is a fast CI/local guard for P4-04. It does not link or run the library; the full
CMake build and on-device sensor validation remain separate requirements.
"""

from __future__ import annotations

import os
import shutil
import subprocess
import sys
import zipfile
from pathlib import Path

ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]
SOURCES = ("main.cpp", "sensor_hook.cpp", "antidetect/antidetect.cpp")
LINK_SOURCES = ("main.cpp", "elf_util.cpp", "sensor_hook.cpp")
ABIS = {
    "arm64-v8a": "aarch64-linux-android31",
    "armeabi-v7a": "armv7a-linux-androideabi31",
    "x86": "i686-linux-android31",
    "x86_64": "x86_64-linux-android31",
}


def find_ndk() -> Path:
    candidates = []
    for env in ("ANDROID_NDK_HOME", "ANDROID_NDK_ROOT"):
        if os.environ.get(env):
            candidates.append(Path(os.environ[env]))
    for env in ("ANDROID_SDK_ROOT", "ANDROID_HOME"):
        if os.environ.get(env):
            candidates.extend(sorted((Path(os.environ[env]) / "ndk").glob("*"), reverse=True))
    local = Path(os.environ.get("LOCALAPPDATA", "")) / "Android" / "Sdk" / "ndk"
    if local.is_dir():
        candidates.extend(sorted(local.glob("*"), reverse=True))
    for candidate in candidates:
        if (candidate / "toolchains" / "llvm").is_dir():
            return candidate
    raise SystemExit("NDK not found; set ANDROID_NDK_HOME")


def find_clang(ndk: Path) -> Path:
    pattern = "toolchains/llvm/prebuilt/*/bin/clang++*"
    matches = sorted(ndk.glob(pattern))
    if not matches:
        raise SystemExit(f"clang++ not found under {ndk}")
    return matches[0]


def find_dobby_include() -> Path:
    configured = os.environ.get("GRADLE_USER_HOME")
    if configured:
        gradle_home = Path(configured)
    else:
        user_gradle = Path.home() / ".gradle"
        gradle_home = user_gradle if user_gradle.is_dir() else ROOT / ".gradle-home"
    aars = sorted(gradle_home.glob("caches/modules-2/files-2.1/io.github.vvb2060.ndk/dobby/**/*.aar"))
    if not aars:
        raise SystemExit("dobby AAR not found; resolve :xposed dependencies first")
    temp_root = ROOT / ".tmp"
    temp_root.mkdir(exist_ok=True)
    temp = temp_root / "dobby-prefab"
    if temp.exists():
        shutil.rmtree(temp)
    temp.mkdir(parents=True)
    with zipfile.ZipFile(aars[-1]) as archive:
        for name in archive.namelist():
            if name.startswith("prefab/modules/dobby/"):
                archive.extract(name, temp)
    include = temp / "prefab" / "modules" / "dobby" / "include"
    if not include.is_dir():
        raise SystemExit("dobby prefab include not found")
    return include


def main() -> int:
    link = "--link" in sys.argv[1:]
    ndk = find_ndk()
    clang = find_clang(ndk)
    sysroot = clang.parents[1] / "sysroot"
    include = find_dobby_include()
    cpp_dir = ROOT / "xposed" / "src" / "main" / "cpp"
    failures = 0
    for abi, target in ABIS.items():
        if link:
            output_dir = ROOT / ".tmp" / "native-link"
            output_dir.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
            output = output_dir / f"liblocationext-{abi}.so"
            command = [
                str(clang), f"--target={target}", f"--sysroot={sysroot}",
                "-std=c++23", "-shared", "-fPIC", "-O2",
                "-static-libstdc++", "-static-libgcc",
                "-I", str(cpp_dir), "-I", str(include),
                *[str(cpp_dir / source) for source in LINK_SOURCES],
                str(include.parent / "libs" / f"android.{abi}" / "libdobby.a"),
                "-llog", "-landroid", "-o", str(output),
            ]
            result = subprocess.run(command, capture_output=True, text=True)
            if result.returncode == 0 and output.is_file():
                print(f"OK link {abi} ({output.stat().st_size} bytes)")
            else:
                failures += 1
                print(f"FAIL link {abi}")
                print((result.stderr or result.stdout)[:2000])
            continue
        for source in SOURCES:
            command = [
                str(clang), f"--target={target}", f"--sysroot={sysroot}",
                "-std=c++23", "-fsyntax-only",
                "-I", str(cpp_dir), "-I", str(include), str(cpp_dir / source),
            ]
            result = subprocess.run(command, capture_output=True, text=True)
            if result.returncode == 0:
                print(f"OK {abi} {source}")
            else:
                failures += 1
                print(f"FAIL {abi} {source}")
                print((result.stderr or result.stdout)[:2000])
    mode = "native link" if link else "native syntax"
    print(f"{mode}: {failures} failure(s)")
    return 1 if failures else 0


if __name__ == "__main__":
    sys.exit(main())

```

`scripts/check_release_optimization.py`:

```py
#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Check compressed Release DEX and framework/JNI callbacks after R8."""

from __future__ import annotations

import argparse
from pathlib import Path
import re
import struct
import zipfile

HOOKER = "Lio/github/libxposed/api/XposedInterface$Hooker;"
CHAIN = "Lio/github/libxposed/api/XposedInterface$Chain;"
PREFIX = "Lcom/system/location/service/"
ENTRY = PREFIX + "hook/PortalModule;"
JNI = {
    PREFIX + "jni/Dobby;": {
        ("setStatus", "(Z)V"),
        ("setSensorFrame", "(JIJ[F[F[FF)V"),
        ("prepareSensors", "()Z"),
    },
    PREFIX + "jni/AntiDetect;": {("nativeSetEnabled", "(Z)Z")},
}


def dex_definitions(data: bytes) -> dict:
    """Read class_data definitions, not just method_ids (which include references)."""
    if len(data) < 112 or not re.fullmatch(rb"dex\n[0-9]{3}\0", data[:8]):
        raise ValueError("invalid DEX header")

    def u32(offset):
        if offset < 0 or offset + 4 > len(data):
            raise ValueError("truncated DEX")
        return struct.unpack_from("<I", data, offset)[0]

    def table(header, width):
        count, offset = u32(header), u32(header + 4)
        if offset > len(data) or count > (len(data) - offset) // width:
            raise ValueError("truncated DEX table")
        return [offset + i * width for i in range(count)]

    def uleb(offset):
        result = 0
        for shift in range(0, 35, 7):
            if offset >= len(data):
                raise ValueError("truncated DEX ULEB128")
            value = data[offset]
            offset += 1
            result |= (value & 127) << shift
            if value < 128:
                return result, offset
        raise ValueError("invalid DEX ULEB128")

    strings = []
    for pos in table(56, 4):
        _, start = uleb(u32(pos))
        end = data.find(b"\0", start)
        if end < 0:
            raise ValueError("unterminated DEX string")
        # Only descriptors and method names are used below; tolerate MUTF-8 strings.
        strings.append(data[start:end].decode("utf-8", errors="replace"))
    types = [strings[u32(pos)] for pos in table(64, 4)]

    def type_list(offset):
        if not offset:
            return []
        count = u32(offset)
        if count > (len(data) - offset - 4) // 2:
            raise ValueError("truncated DEX type list")
        return [types[struct.unpack_from("<H", data, offset + 4 + i * 2)[0]]
                for i in range(count)]

    protos = ["(" + "".join(type_list(u32(pos + 8))) + ")" + types[u32(pos + 4)]
              for pos in table(72, 12)]
    methods = []
    for pos in table(88, 8):
        owner, proto, name = struct.unpack_from("<HHI", data, pos)
        methods.append((types[owner], strings[name], protos[proto]))
    classes = {}
    for pos in table(96, 32):
        owner = types[u32(pos)]
        definitions = {}
        offset = u32(pos + 24)
        if offset:
            counts = []
            for _ in range(4):
                count, offset = uleb(offset)
                counts.append(count)
            for _ in range(counts[0] + counts[1]):
                _, offset = uleb(offset)
                _, offset = uleb(offset)
            for count in counts[2:]:
                method_index = 0
                for _ in range(count):
                    diff, offset = uleb(offset)
                    flags, offset = uleb(offset)
                    code, offset = uleb(offset)
                    method_index += diff
                    method_owner, name, proto = methods[method_index]
                    if method_owner != owner:
                        raise ValueError("DEX method owner mismatch")
                    definitions[name, proto] = (flags, code)
        classes[owner] = (type_list(u32(pos + 12)), definitions)
    return classes


def validate_callbacks(classes: dict) -> None:
    entry_methods = classes.get(ENTRY, ([], {}))[1]
    for name in ("onModuleLoaded", "onSystemServerStarting", "onPackageReady"):
        if not any(method == name and code for (method, _), (_, code) in entry_methods.items()):
            raise ValueError(f"PortalModule callback missing: {name}")
    hookers = [(owner, methods) for owner, (interfaces, methods) in classes.items()
               if HOOKER in interfaces]
    if not hookers:
        raise ValueError("no Xposed Hooker implementations")
    for owner, methods in hookers:
        flags, code = methods.get(("intercept", f"({CHAIN})Ljava/lang/Object;"), (0, 0))
        if not flags & 1 or not code:
            raise ValueError(f"Xposed intercept implementation missing: {owner}")
        if not owner.startswith(PREFIX):
            raise ValueError(f"Hooker moved outside the stack-cleaning prefix: {owner}")
    for owner, required in JNI.items():
        methods = classes.get(owner, ([], {}))[1]
        for method in required:
            if not methods.get(method, (0, 0))[0] & 0x100:
                raise ValueError(f"JNI native definition missing: {owner} {method}")


def validate_apk(apk: Path) -> None:
    classes = {}
    with zipfile.ZipFile(apk) as archive:
        dex = [info for info in archive.infolist()
               if re.fullmatch(r"classes(?:[2-9]|[1-9][0-9]+)?\.dex", info.filename)]
        if not dex:
            raise ValueError("no DEX files")
        for info in dex:
            if info.compress_type != zipfile.ZIP_DEFLATED:
                raise ValueError(f"Release DEX is not compressed: {info.filename}")
            classes.update(dex_definitions(archive.read(info)))
    validate_callbacks(classes)


def main() -> int:
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description=__doc__)
    parser.add_argument("--apk-dir", required=True, type=Path)
    args = parser.parse_args()
    apks = sorted(args.apk_dir.glob("*.apk"))
    errors = [] if apks else [f"no APKs found in {args.apk_dir}"]
    for apk in apks:
        try:
            validate_apk(apk)
            print(f"Verified Release optimization: {apk.name}")
        except (ValueError, IndexError, struct.error, zipfile.BadZipFile) as error:
            errors.append(f"{apk.name}: {error}")
    for error in errors:
        print(f"FAIL {error}")
    return int(bool(errors))


if __name__ == "__main__":
    raise SystemExit(main())

```

`scripts/check_xposed_module.py`:

```py
#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Verify Portal's native libxposed 102 sources and APK entry, without Android tools."""

from __future__ import annotations

import argparse
from pathlib import Path
import re
import struct
import sys
import xml.etree.ElementTree as ET
import zipfile

ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]
ENTRY = "com.system.location.service.hook.PortalModule"
RESOURCE_DIR = "xposed/src/main/resources/META-INF/xposed"
PROPERTIES = {
    "minApiVersion": "102",
    "targetApiVersion": "102",
    "staticScope": "false",
    "autoHotReload": "true",
}
# Modern modules use "system" for system_server; "android" is the legacy spelling.
SCOPES = {
    "system", "com.android.phone", "com.android.location.fused",
    "com.xiaomi.location.fused", "com.oplus.location", "com.android.providers.settings",
    "com.android.systemui",
}
LEGACY_METADATA = {
    "xposedmodule", "xposeddescription", "xposedminversion", "xposedscope", "xposedsharedprefs",
}
ANDROID = "{http://schemas.android.com/apk/res/android}"


def lines(data: bytes) -> list[str]:
    return [line.strip() for line in data.decode("utf-8").splitlines()
            if line.strip() and not line.lstrip().startswith(("#", "!"))]


def validate_metadata(resources: dict[str, bytes]) -> None:
    if lines(resources["java_init.list"]) != [ENTRY]:
        raise ValueError("java_init.list must contain only PortalModule")
    properties = {}
    for line in lines(resources["module.prop"]):
        key, separator, value = line.partition("=")
        key, value = key.strip(), value.strip()
        if not separator or key in properties:
            raise ValueError("module.prop contains malformed or duplicate properties")
        properties[key] = value
    if any(properties.get(key) != value for key, value in PROPERTIES.items()):
        raise ValueError("module.prop must target API 102 with selectable app scopes and system_server hot reload enabled")
    scope = lines(resources["scope.list"])
    if set(scope) != SCOPES or len(scope) != len(SCOPES):
        raise ValueError("scope.list must declare Portal's seven modern scopes, including system")


def source_violations(root: Path = ROOT) -> list[str]:
    errors = []
    resources = {}
    for name in ("java_init.list", "module.prop", "scope.list"):
        path = root / RESOURCE_DIR / name
        if not path.is_file():
            errors.append(f"missing {path.relative_to(root).as_posix()}")
        else:
            resources[name] = path.read_bytes()
    if len(resources) == 3:
        try:
            validate_metadata(resources)
        except (ValueError, UnicodeError) as error:
            errors.append(str(error))
    banned = re.compile(r"de\.robv\.android\.xposed|hook\.compat\b|\b(?:XC_MethodHook|XposedBridge|XposedHelpers)\b")
    for module in ("app", "xposed"):
        source = root / module / "src" / "main"
        for path in source.rglob("*"):
            if path.name == "xposed_init":
                errors.append(f"legacy entry remains: {path.relative_to(root).as_posix()}")
            if path.suffix in {".kt", ".java"} and banned.search(path.read_text(encoding="utf-8")):
                errors.append(f"legacy/compat hook reference: {path.relative_to(root).as_posix()}")
            if path.name == "AndroidManifest.xml":
                try:
                    tree = ET.parse(path)
                    for node in tree.iter("meta-data"):
                        if node.get(f"{ANDROID}name") in LEGACY_METADATA:
                            errors.append(f"legacy module metadata: {path.relative_to(root).as_posix()}")
                except ET.ParseError as error:
                    errors.append(f"invalid manifest: {path.relative_to(root).as_posix()}: {error}")
    build_paths = [root / "settings.gradle.kts", root / "gradle/libs.versions.toml"]
    build_paths.extend(root.glob("*/build.gradle.kts"))
    for path in build_paths:
        if not path.is_file():
            continue
        content = path.read_text(encoding="utf-8")
        if re.search(r"de\.robv\.android\.xposed|api\.xposed\.info|\b(?:implementation|api)\s*\(\s*(?:libs\.libxposed\.api\b|[\"']io\.github\.libxposed:api:)", content):
            errors.append(f"legacy or packaged API dependency: {path.relative_to(root).as_posix()}")
    return errors


def dex_class_descriptors(data: bytes) -> set[str]:
    """Read class definitions, avoiding false positives from API type references in DEX."""
    if len(data) < 112 or not re.fullmatch(rb"dex\n[0-9]{3}\x00", data[:8]):
        raise ValueError("invalid DEX header")

    def u32(offset: int) -> int:
        if not 0 <= offset <= len(data) - 4:
            raise ValueError("DEX index is out of bounds")
        return struct.unpack_from("<I", data, offset)[0]

    string_count, string_offset = u32(56), u32(60)
    type_count, type_offset = u32(64), u32(68)
    class_count, class_offset = u32(96), u32(100)
    for count, offset, size in ((string_count, string_offset, 4), (type_count, type_offset, 4),
                                (class_count, class_offset, 32)):
        if offset > len(data) or count > (len(data) - offset) // size:
            raise ValueError("truncated DEX index table")
    result = set()
    for index in range(class_count):
        type_index = u32(class_offset + index * 32)
        if type_index >= type_count:
            raise ValueError("DEX class type index is out of bounds")
        string_index = u32(type_offset + type_index * 4)
        if string_index >= string_count:
            raise ValueError("DEX descriptor index is out of bounds")
        offset = u32(string_offset + string_index * 4)
        # Skip the string's ULEB128 UTF-16 length, then read its ASCII class descriptor.
        for _ in range(5):
            if offset >= len(data):
                raise ValueError("truncated DEX string")
            byte = data[offset]
            offset += 1
            if byte < 128:
                break
        else:
            raise ValueError("invalid DEX string length")
        end = data.find(b"\0", offset)
        if end == -1:
            raise ValueError("unterminated DEX descriptor")
        result.add(data[offset:end].decode("utf-8"))
    return result


def validate_apk(apk: Path) -> None:
    with zipfile.ZipFile(apk) as archive:
        names = archive.namelist()
        resources = {}
        for name in ("java_init.list", "module.prop", "scope.list"):
            full_name = f"META-INF/xposed/{name}"
            if names.count(full_name) != 1:
                raise ValueError(f"{apk.name}: missing or duplicate {full_name}")
            resources[name] = archive.read(full_name)
        validate_metadata(resources)
        if "assets/xposed_init" in names:
            raise ValueError(f"{apk.name}: legacy assets/xposed_init remains")
        native_libs = [name for name in names if name.endswith("/liblocationext.so")]
        if native_libs:
            raise ValueError(f"{apk.name}: plain native payload remains in {native_libs[0]}")
        if "assets/liblocationext.bin" in names:
            asset = archive.read("assets/liblocationext.bin")
            if asset.startswith(b"\x7fELF"):
                raise ValueError(f"{apk.name}: native asset is not encrypted")
        dex_names = [name for name in names if re.fullmatch(r"classes(?:[2-9]|[1-9][0-9]+)?\.dex", name)]
        if names.count("AndroidManifest.xml") != 1 or len(set(dex_names)) != len(dex_names):
            raise ValueError(f"{apk.name}: missing or duplicate manifest/DEX entries")
        manifest = archive.read("AndroidManifest.xml")
        if manifest.lstrip().startswith(b"<"):
            tree = ET.fromstring(manifest)
            if any(node.get(f"{ANDROID}name") in LEGACY_METADATA for node in tree.iter("meta-data")):
                raise ValueError(f"{apk.name}: legacy module metadata remains in manifest")
        # AXML string pools can encode names in UTF-8 or UTF-16LE.
        if any(key.encode("utf-8") + b"\0" in manifest or
               key.encode("utf-16le") + b"\0\0" in manifest for key in LEGACY_METADATA):
            raise ValueError(f"{apk.name}: legacy module metadata remains in manifest")
        descriptors = set()
        for name in names:
            if name in dex_names:
                descriptors.update(dex_class_descriptors(archive.read(name)))
            if name.startswith(("io/github/libxposed/api/", "de/robv/android/xposed/")):
                raise ValueError(f"{apk.name}: framework API classes must not be packaged")
        if f"L{ENTRY.replace('.', '/')};" not in descriptors:
            raise ValueError(f"{apk.name}: PortalModule class definition is missing")
        forbidden = ("Lio/github/libxposed/api/", "Lde/robv/android/xposed/",
                     "Lcom/system/location/service/hook/compat/")
        if any(descriptor.startswith(forbidden) for descriptor in descriptors):
            raise ValueError(f"{apk.name}: framework API or legacy compat classes are packaged")


def main() -> int:
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description=__doc__)
    parser.add_argument("--apk-dir", type=Path, help="also verify every APK in this directory")
    args = parser.parse_args()
    errors = source_violations()
    if args.apk_dir is not None:
        apks = sorted(args.apk_dir.glob("*.apk"))
        if not apks:
            errors.append(f"no APKs found in {args.apk_dir}")
        for apk in apks:
            try:
                validate_apk(apk)
                print(f"Verified modern Xposed entry: {apk.name}")
            except (ValueError, KeyError, UnicodeError, ET.ParseError, zipfile.BadZipFile) as error:
                errors.append(str(error))
    for error in errors:
        print(f"FAIL {error}")
    print(f"modern Xposed module: {len(errors)} violation(s)")
    return 1 if errors else 0


if __name__ == "__main__":
    sys.exit(main())

`scripts/compare_gnss_profiles.py`:

```py
#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Compare a receiver capture / detector report with another window, independently of Kotlin.

This is descriptive evidence, not a real/fake classifier or a statistical equivalence test.
Use a verified stopped-backend capture as reference; file contents cannot prove its source.
"""
from __future__ import annotations

import argparse
from collections import Counter
from dataclasses import dataclass
import json
import math
from pathlib import Path
import random
import sys

SYSTEMS = {0: "UNKNOWN", 1: "GPS", 2: "SBAS", 3: "GLONASS", 4: "QZSS",
           5: "BEIDOU", 6: "GALILEO", 7: "IRNSS"}
MAX_BYTES = 32 * 1024 * 1024


@dataclass(frozen=True)
class Satellite:
    system: str
    svid: int
    cn0: float
    elevation: float
    used: bool

    @property
    def identity(self):
        return self.system, self.svid


@dataclass(frozen=True)
class Frame:
    time: int
    signals: tuple[Satellite, ...]

    @property
    def identities(self):
        return {s.identity for s in self.signals}

    @property
    def used(self):
        return {s.identity for s in self.signals if s.used}


@dataclass
class Window:
    frames: list[Frame]
    device: object
    per_signal: bool
    source: str
    original_frames: int


def integer(value, name):
    if type(value) is not int or value < 0:
        raise ValueError(f"{name} must be a nonnegative integer")
    return value


def number(value, low, high, name, inclusive=True):
    if type(value) not in (int, float) or not math.isfinite(value):
        raise ValueError(f"invalid {name}: {value!r}")
    if value < low or (value > high if inclusive else value >= high):
        raise ValueError(f"{name} outside supported range: {value}")
    return value


def read_window(data):
    detector = "gnssEvidence" in data
    evidence = data.get("gnssEvidence") if detector else data
    if not isinstance(evidence, dict):
        raise ValueError("missing GNSS evidence; older detector reports have no frame data")
    if evidence.get("schema" if detector else "schemaVersion") != 1:
        raise ValueError("unsupported GNSS evidence schema")
    start = integer(evidence.get("startedAtMillis"), "window start")
    end = integer(evidence.get("endedAtMillis"), "window end")
    if end < start:
        raise ValueError("window ends before it starts")
    raw_frames = evidence.get("frames")
    if not isinstance(raw_frames, list) or not 1 <= len(raw_frames) <= 3000:
        raise ValueError("requires 1..3000 GNSS frames")
    by_second = {}
    previous_time = -1
    per_signal = True
    for frame in raw_frames:
        time = integer(frame.get("capturedAtMillis"), "frame time")
        if not start <= time <= end or time < previous_time:
            raise ValueError("nonchronological frame or frame outside window")
        previous_time = time
        observations = frame.get("signalObservations")
        if not detector and observations:
            records = [record["satellite"] for record in observations]
        else:
            records = frame.get("satellites")
            if not detector:
                per_signal = False
        if not isinstance(records, list) or len(records) > 512:
            raise ValueError("invalid signal record count")
        signals = []
        for record in records:
            raw_system = record.get("constellation")
            system = SYSTEMS.get(raw_system) if type(raw_system) is int else raw_system
            if system not in SYSTEMS.values():
                raise ValueError(f"unsupported constellation: {raw_system!r}")
            svid = integer(record.get("svid"), "SVID")
            if not 1 <= svid <= 999 or type(record.get("usedInFix")) is not bool:
                raise ValueError("invalid identity or usedInFix flag")
            elevation = number(record.get("elevationDegrees" if detector else "elevationDeg"),
                               0, 90, "elevation")
            number(record.get("azimuthDegrees" if detector else "azimuthDeg"), 0, 360, "azimuth", False)
            cn0 = number(record.get("cn0DbHz"), 0, 63, "CN0")
            # Validate every raw row before excluding zero-CN0 acquisition placeholders.
            # They are not evidence of a received signal or a constellation population.
            if cn0 > 0:
                signals.append(Satellite(system, svid, cn0, elevation, record["usedInFix"]))
        # Arrival bursts must not give one receiver second ten times the statistical weight.
        by_second[time // 1000] = Frame(time, tuple(signals))
    device = data.get("device") if detector else {"model": data.get("deviceModel"), "os": data.get("osVersion")}
    return Window(list(by_second.values()), device, per_signal,
                  "detector" if detector else "receiver_capture", len(raw_frames))


def metrics(frames):
    counts = Counter(identity[0] for f in frames for identity in f.identities)
    total = sum(counts.values())
    return {"meanVisible": total / len(frames),
            "usedFraction": sum(len(f.used) for f in frames) / total if total else None,
            **{f"ratio:{system}": counts[system] / total if total else None for system in SYSTEMS.values()}}


def blocks(window, block_seconds=10):
    start = window.frames[0].time
    result = {}
    for frame in window.frames:
        result.setdefault((frame.time - start) // (block_seconds * 1000), []).append(frame)
    return list(result.values())


def histogram_distance(a, b):
    """Total variation of empirical categorical probabilities: 1/2 sum |p_i-q_i|."""
    na, nb = sum(a.values()), sum(b.values())
    if not na or not nb:
        return None
    return 0.5 * sum(abs(a[key] / na - b[key] / nb) for key in a.keys() | b.keys())


def summaries(window, block_seconds):
    frames = window.frames
    gaps = [b.time - a.time for a, b in zip(frames, frames[1:])]
    return {"sourceFormat": window.source, "device": window.device,
            "receivedFrames": window.original_frames, "receiverSeconds": len(frames),
            "spanMillis": frames[-1].time - frames[0].time, "temporalBlocks": len(blocks(window, block_seconds)),
            "maximumGapMillis": max(gaps, default=0), "perSignalEvidence": window.per_signal,
            "visibleCountHistogram": dict(sorted(Counter(len(f.identities) for f in frames).items())),
            "metrics": metrics(frames)}


def enough(window, block_seconds):
    return (len(window.frames) >= 20 and window.frames[-1].time - window.frames[0].time >= 30000
            and len(blocks(window, block_seconds)) >= 3 and any(f.identities for f in window.frames))


def compare(reference, trial, minimum_satellites=0, iterations=1000, block_seconds=10):
    if (type(minimum_satellites) is not int or not 0 <= minimum_satellites <= 128 or iterations < 100
            or type(block_seconds) is not int or not 1 <= block_seconds <= 300):
        raise ValueError("invalid minimum, block size or bootstrap iteration count")
    left, right = summaries(reference, block_seconds), summaries(trial, block_seconds)
    notes = ["Reference authenticity and stopped-backend state must be established separately.",
             "Intervals describe these windows only; zero in an interval is not proof of equivalence.",
             "Separate marginal 95% intervals have no simultaneous coverage guarantee.",
             "Block resampling assumes approximate stationarity and weak dependence across blocks; check block-length sensitivity.",
             "The two windows are resampled independently; shared replay evidence does not create independent real observations."]
    eligible = enough(reference, block_seconds) and enough(trial, block_seconds)
    if not eligible:
        notes.append("Insufficient frame count/span/temporal blocks; bootstrap intervals withheld.")
    if any(s["maximumGapMillis"] > 2000 for s in (left, right)):
        notes.append("Sampling gaps exceed 2 seconds; temporal coverage is incomplete.")
    if minimum_satellites:
        notes.append("A positive visible-satellite floor changes the distribution; this is not auto-mode validation.")
    if reference.per_signal != trial.per_signal:
        notes.append("Per-signal evidence differs from spacecraft projection; joint signal distance withheld.")
    deltas = {key: {"reference": value, "trial": right["metrics"][key],
                    "deltaTrialMinusReference": right["metrics"][key] - value
                    if value is not None and right["metrics"][key] is not None else None,
                    "bootstrapPercentile95": None} for key, value in left["metrics"].items()}
    if eligible:
        rng = random.Random(0)
        lb, rb = blocks(reference, block_seconds), blocks(trial, block_seconds)
        samples = {key: [] for key in deltas}
        for _ in range(iterations):
            a = metrics([frame for _ in lb for frame in rng.choice(lb)])
            b = metrics([frame for _ in rb for frame in rng.choice(rb)])
            for key in deltas:
                if a[key] is not None and b[key] is not None:
                    samples[key].append(b[key] - a[key])
        for key, values in samples.items():
            # Do not discard empty-sky bootstrap draws and narrow the interval conditionally.
            if len(values) == iterations:
                values.sort()
                deltas[key]["bootstrapPercentile95"] = [values[math.floor(.025 * (iterations - 1))],
                                                        values[math.ceil(.975 * (iterations - 1))]]
    def joint(window):
        return Counter((s.system, min(17, int(s.elevation // 5)), int(s.cn0 // 5))
                       for f in window.frames for s in f.signals)
    identities_a = set().union(*(f.identities for f in reference.frames))
    identities_b = set().union(*(f.identities for f in trial.frames))
    return {"schema": 1, "verdict": "DESCRIPTIVE_ONLY", "minimumSatellites": minimum_satellites,
            "bootstrap": {"blockSeconds": block_seconds, "iterations": iterations, "seed": 0,
                          "method": "independent nonoverlapping temporal blocks; marginal percentile intervals"},
            "autoModeComparable": minimum_satellites == 0, "reference": left, "trial": right,
            "metrics": deltas, "visibleCountTotalVariation": histogram_distance(
                Counter(len(f.identities) for f in reference.frames), Counter(len(f.identities) for f in trial.frames)),
            "constellationTotalVariation": histogram_distance(
                Counter(i[0] for f in reference.frames for i in f.identities),
                Counter(i[0] for f in trial.frames for i in f.identities)),
            "signalJointTotalVariation": histogram_distance(joint(reference), joint(trial))
                if reference.per_signal and trial.per_signal else None,
            "addedIdentities": sorted(f"{c}:{s}" for c, s in identities_b - identities_a),
            "missingIdentities": sorted(f"{c}:{s}" for c, s in identities_a - identities_b),
            "notes": notes}


def load(path):
    if path.stat().st_size > MAX_BYTES:
        raise ValueError(f"input exceeds {MAX_BYTES} bytes")
    return read_window(json.loads(path.read_text(encoding="utf-8-sig")))


def main():
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description=__doc__)
    parser.add_argument("reference", type=Path)
    parser.add_argument("trial", type=Path)
    parser.add_argument("--minimum-satellites", type=int, required=True,
                        help="actual trial setting: 0=auto; a positive floor alters the reference distribution")
    parser.add_argument("--block-seconds", type=int, default=10,
                        help="temporal resampling block length; repeat with other lengths to assess sensitivity")
    args = parser.parse_args()
    try:
        result = compare(load(args.reference), load(args.trial), args.minimum_satellites,
                         block_seconds=args.block_seconds)
    except (ValueError, KeyError, TypeError, OSError, AttributeError) as error:
        print(f"GNSS comparison unavailable: {error}", file=sys.stderr)
        return 2
    print(json.dumps(result, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2, allow_nan=False))
    return 0


if __name__ == "__main__":
    sys.exit(main())

`scripts/deploy_vector_module.py`:

```py
#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Deploy the Portal debug APK to a Vector (libxposed) device.

Two modes:
  --hot-reload  install, start the module app so its libxposed service binds, and
                wait for Vector's automatic system_server hot reload (no reboot).
  default       install, refresh Vector's cached APK path, then full reboot.
"""
from __future__ import annotations

import argparse
import os
import shutil
import sqlite3
import subprocess
import sys
import time
from pathlib import Path

PACKAGE = "com.system.location.service"
VECTOR_CLI = "/data/adb/modules/zygisk_vector/cli"
DB = "/data/adb/lspd/config/modules_config.db"
TMP_DB = "/data/local/tmp/portal-modules.db"
SCOPES = [
    "system/0",
    "com.android.phone/0",
    "com.android.location.fused/0",
    "com.xiaomi.location.fused/0",
    "com.android.providers.settings/0",
]


def find_adb() -> str:
    for candidate in (
        os.environ.get("ADB"),
        shutil.which("adb"),
        Path(os.environ.get("LOCALAPPDATA", "")) / "Android/Sdk/platform-tools/adb.exe",
    ):
        if candidate and Path(candidate).exists():
            return str(candidate)
    raise SystemExit("adb not found; set ADB or put adb on PATH")


class Device:
    def __init__(self, adb: str, serial: str | None):
        self.base = [adb] + (["-s", serial] if serial else [])

    def run(self, *args: str, check: bool = True, timeout: int = 300) -> subprocess.CompletedProcess[str]:
        return subprocess.run(
            [*self.base, *args], check=check, text=True, capture_output=True, timeout=timeout
        )

    def shell(self, command: str, check: bool = True) -> str:
        return self.run("shell", command, check=check).stdout.strip()

    def root(self, command: str, check: bool = True) -> str:
        return self.shell(f"su -c {shlex_quote(command)}", check=check)

    def wait_boot(self, timeout: int = 180) -> None:
        deadline = time.time() + timeout
        while time.time() < deadline:
            if self.shell("getprop sys.boot_completed", check=False) == "1":
                return
            time.sleep(2)
        raise SystemExit("device did not finish booting")


def shlex_quote(value: str) -> str:
    return "'" + value.replace("'", "'\\''") + "'"


def update_db(device: Device, apk_path: str, package: str) -> None:
    tmp = Path(".tmp") / "portal-vector-deploy"
    tmp.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    local = tmp / "modules.db"
    for suffix in ("", "-wal", "-shm"):
        (tmp / f"modules.db{suffix}").unlink(missing_ok=True)
    try:
        # Vector may keep the current schema/data in WAL. Pull the WAL too, otherwise the main
        # file can look like an empty database (or even lack the modules table).
        device.root(
            f"cp {DB} {TMP_DB}; chmod 644 {TMP_DB}; "
            f"if test -e {DB}-wal; then cp {DB}-wal {TMP_DB}-wal; chmod 644 {TMP_DB}-wal; fi; "
            f"if test -e {DB}-shm; then cp {DB}-shm {TMP_DB}-shm; chmod 644 {TMP_DB}-shm; fi"
        )
        for suffix in ("", "-wal", "-shm"):
            remote = TMP_DB + suffix
            local_file = tmp / f"modules.db{suffix}"
            result = device.run("pull", remote, str(local_file), check=False)
            if result.returncode != 0 and suffix != "":
                local_file.unlink(missing_ok=True)
            elif result.returncode != 0:
                raise SystemExit(f"could not pull Vector database: {result.stderr.strip()}")
        connection = sqlite3.connect(local)
        try:
            row = connection.execute(
                "select mid from modules where module_pkg_name=?", (package,)
            ).fetchone()
            if row is None:
                raise SystemExit(f"module {package} not found in Vector database")
            connection.execute("update modules set apk_path=? where mid=?", (apk_path, row[0]))
            connection.commit()
            connection.execute("pragma wal_checkpoint(TRUNCATE)")
            connection.execute("pragma journal_mode=delete")
            connection.commit()
        finally:
            connection.close()
        device.run("push", str(local), TMP_DB)
        device.root(
            f"cp {TMP_DB} {DB}; chown root:root {DB}; chmod 660 {DB}; "
            f"rm -f {DB}-wal {DB}-shm {TMP_DB}-wal {TMP_DB}-shm"
        )
    finally:
        for suffix in ("", "-wal", "-shm"):
            (tmp / f"modules.db{suffix}").unlink(missing_ok=True)


def ensure_scope(device: Device, package: str) -> None:
    listing = device.root(f"{VECTOR_CLI} scope ls {package}", check=False)
    if "system" not in listing.split():
        device.root(f"{VECTOR_CLI} scope add {package} system/0")
        print("added system/0 scope")


def target_pids(device: Device) -> dict[str, str]:
    result = {}
    for package in ("com.android.phone", "com.xiaomi.location.fused"):
        pid = device.shell(f"pidof {package}", check=False).strip()
        if pid:
            result[package] = pid
    return result


def restart_target_processes(device: Device) -> None:
    pids = target_pids(device)
    if not pids:
        print("no phone/fused process to restart")
        return
    # These are system-spawned processes; killing them makes Android respawn and Vector
    # reinject the module from the refreshed APK path.
    device.root("kill -9 " + " ".join(pids.values()))
    time.sleep(6)
    print("restarted: " + ", ".join(f"{pkg}={device.shell(f'pidof {pkg}', check=False).strip()}" for pkg in pids))


def hot_reload(device: Device, package: str) -> None:
    device.shell("am force-stop " + package, check=False)
    time.sleep(2)
    device.shell(f"am start -W -n {package}/.MainActivity", check=False)
    # The XposedProvider starts the app process and binds the libxposed service; autoHotReload
    # then updates system_server without changing its pid.
    time.sleep(12)
    pid_before = device.shell("pidof system_server", check=False)
    log = device.root("ls -t /data/adb/lspd/log/modules_*.log | head -1", check=False)
    if log:
        tail = device.root(f"grep -i 'hot reloaded\\|hot reloading' {log} | tail -5", check=False)
        if tail:
            print(tail)
    print(f"system_server pid: {pid_before}")


def main() -> int:
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description=__doc__)
    parser.add_argument("apk", type=Path, help="debug APK to install")
    parser.add_argument("--adb", default=None)
    parser.add_argument("--serial", default=None)
    parser.add_argument("--package", default=PACKAGE)
    parser.add_argument("--hot-reload", action="store_true", help="install and trigger hot reload; no reboot")
    parser.add_argument("--restart-targets", action="store_true", help="kill phone/fused so they reinject the new APK")
    parser.add_argument("--native-lib", type=Path, default=None, help="push a new liblocationext.so; requires a restart")
    parser.add_argument("--soft-restart", action="store_true", help="restart zygote instead of a full reboot")
    args = parser.parse_args()

    if not args.apk.is_file():
        raise SystemExit(f"APK not found: {args.apk}")

    device = Device(args.adb or find_adb(), args.serial)
    print(f"installing {args.apk}")
    device.run("install", "-r", str(args.apk))
    apk_path = device.shell(f"pm path {args.package}").splitlines()[0].removeprefix("package:").strip()
    if not apk_path:
        raise SystemExit("package manager returned no APK path")
    print(f"current apk: {apk_path}")

    update_db(device, apk_path, args.package)
    ensure_scope(device, args.package)

    if args.native_lib:
        if not args.native_lib.is_file():
            raise SystemExit(f"native library not found: {args.native_lib}")
        # Dobby hook state cannot be unloaded; never hot reload after a native library update.
        print("pushing native library; restart required")
        device.run("push", str(args.native_lib), "/data/local/tmp/liblocationext.so")
        device.root(
            "umask 077; mkdir -p /data/local/ext-lib; "
            "chmod 0710 /data/local/ext-lib; chown 0:1000 /data/local/ext-lib; "
            "cp /data/local/tmp/liblocationext.so /data/local/ext-lib/liblocationext.so; "
            "chmod 0650 /data/local/ext-lib/liblocationext.so; "
            "chown 0:1000 /data/local/ext-lib/liblocationext.so; "
            "chcon u:object_r:system_file:s0 /data/local/ext-lib/liblocationext.so 2>/dev/null || true; "
            "rm -f /data/local/tmp/liblocationext.so"
        )
        args.hot_reload = False
        args.restart_targets = False
        args.soft_restart = True

    if args.hot_reload:
        hot_reload(device, args.package)
        if args.restart_targets:
            restart_target_processes(device)
        return 0

    if args.restart_targets:
        restart_target_processes(device)

    if args.soft_restart:
        device.root("setprop ctl.restart zygote")
    else:
        device.run("reboot")
    time.sleep(8)
    device.run("wait-for-device", timeout=180)
    device.wait_boot()
    print("device ready")
    return 0


if __name__ == "__main__":
    sys.exit(main())

`scripts/encrypt_native_asset.py`:

```py
#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Encrypt a stripped liblocationext.so into the app's opaque native asset.

Run after CMake/NDK build and before packaging. The key must stay in sync with
NativeLibraryInstaller.KEY.
"""
from __future__ import annotations

import argparse
from pathlib import Path

KEY = bytes((0xA7, 0x3C, 0x91, 0x5E, 0xD2, 0x44, 0xBB, 0x6F))


def main() -> int:
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser()
    parser.add_argument("library", type=Path)
    parser.add_argument("asset", type=Path)
    args = parser.parse_args()
    data = args.library.read_bytes()
    if len(data) < 64:
        raise SystemExit("native library is too small")
    args.asset.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    args.asset.write_bytes(bytes(value ^ KEY[index % len(KEY)] for index, value in enumerate(data)))
    print(f"encrypted {len(data)} bytes -> {args.asset}")
    return 0


if __name__ == "__main__":
    raise SystemExit(main())
