```py
import json
import shutil
import unittest
import uuid
from contextlib import contextmanager
from pathlib import Path

from check_module_rules import (
    LINE_BUDGET,
    ROOT,
    check_detector_isolation,
    check_forbidden_dependency,
    check_line_budget,
    check_pure_jvm,
    check_roadmap_links,
    violations,
)


@contextmanager
def temp_root():
    """Scratch tree inside the ignored .tmp directory; cleanup failure must not fail a test."""
    path = ROOT / ".tmp" / f"module-rules-{uuid.uuid4().hex}"
    path.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    try:
        yield path
    finally:
        shutil.rmtree(path, ignore_errors=True)


class ModuleRulesTest(unittest.TestCase):
    def test_pure_jvm_module_rejects_android_import(self):
        with temp_root() as raw:
            root = Path(raw)
            source = root / "core" / "src" / "main" / "kotlin" / "Sample.kt"
            source.parent.mkdir(parents=True)
            source.write_text("import android.location.Location\nclass Sample\n", encoding="utf-8")
            self.assertTrue(check_pure_jvm(root))

    def test_pure_jvm_module_accepts_plain_kotlin(self):
        with temp_root() as raw:
            root = Path(raw)
            source = root / "nmea" / "src" / "main" / "java" / "Sample.kt"
            source.parent.mkdir(parents=True)
            source.write_text("import kotlin.math.abs\nclass Sample\n", encoding="utf-8")
            self.assertEqual([], check_pure_jvm(root))

    def test_forbidden_dependency_detects_project_reference(self):
        with temp_root() as raw:
            root = Path(raw)
            build = root / "xposed" / "build.gradle.kts"
            build.parent.mkdir(parents=True)
            build.write_text('dependencies { implementation(project(":app")) }\n', encoding="utf-8")
            self.assertTrue(check_forbidden_dependency(root, "xposed/build.gradle.kts", ":app"))

    def test_detector_must_not_import_implementation_classes(self):
        with temp_root() as raw:
            root = Path(raw)
            source = root / "detector" / "src" / "main" / "java" / "Check.kt"
            source.parent.mkdir(parents=True)
            source.write_text("import com.system.location.service.core.location.LocationSample\n", encoding="utf-8")
            self.assertTrue(check_detector_isolation(root))

    def test_line_budget_allows_baseline_but_rejects_growth(self):
        with temp_root() as raw:
            root = Path(raw)
            baseline_file = root / "docs" / "roadmap" / "line-budget-baseline.json"
            baseline_file.parent.mkdir(parents=True)
            hook = root / "xposed/src/main/java/com/system/location/service/hook/Legacy.kt"
            hook.parent.mkdir(parents=True)
            hook.write_text("\n".join("// line" for _ in range(LINE_BUDGET + 10)) + "\n", encoding="utf-8")
            baseline_file.write_text(
                json.dumps({str(hook.relative_to(root)).replace("\\", "/"): LINE_BUDGET + 20}),
                encoding="utf-8",
            )
            self.assertEqual([], check_line_budget(root))

            hook.write_text("\n".join("// line" for _ in range(LINE_BUDGET + 30)) + "\n", encoding="utf-8")
            self.assertTrue(check_line_budget(root))

    def test_new_oversized_hook_fails_budget(self):
        with temp_root() as raw:
            root = Path(raw)
            hook = root / "xposed/src/main/java/com/system/location/service/hook/NewHook.kt"
            hook.parent.mkdir(parents=True)
            hook.write_text("\n".join("// line" for _ in range(LINE_BUDGET + 1)) + "\n", encoding="utf-8")
            self.assertTrue(check_line_budget(root))

    def test_roadmap_link_must_resolve(self):
        with temp_root() as raw:
            root = Path(raw)
            readme = root / "docs" / "roadmap" / "README.md"
            readme.parent.mkdir(parents=True)
            readme.write_text("[ok](present.md) [bad](missing.md)\n", encoding="utf-8")
            (readme.parent / "present.md").write_text("# present\n", encoding="utf-8")
            problems = check_roadmap_links(root)
            self.assertEqual(1, len(problems))
            self.assertIn("missing.md", problems[0])

    def test_current_repository_passes_all_guardrails(self):
        self.assertEqual([], violations(ROOT))


if __name__ == "__main__":
    unittest.main()
```

`scripts/test_release_network.py`:

```py
import unittest
from unittest.mock import patch
from urllib.error import HTTPError
from release_policy import open_release_url

class ReleaseNetworkTest(unittest.TestCase):
    @patch('release_policy.time.sleep')
    @patch('release_policy.urllib.request.urlopen')
    def test_transient_gateway_error_retries(self, open_url, sleep):
        response = object()
        open_url.side_effect = [HTTPError('https://example.test', 504, 'timeout', {}, None), response]
        self.assertIs(response, open_release_url('https://example.test'))
        self.assertEqual(2, open_url.call_count)
        sleep.assert_called_once_with(1)

    @patch('release_policy.time.sleep')
    @patch('release_policy.urllib.request.urlopen')
    def test_permanent_failure_is_not_hidden(self, open_url, sleep):
        open_url.side_effect = HTTPError('https://example.test', 404, 'missing', {}, None)
        with self.assertRaises(HTTPError): open_release_url('https://example.test')
        self.assertEqual(1, open_url.call_count)
        sleep.assert_not_called()

    @patch('release_policy.time.sleep')
    @patch('release_policy.urllib.request.urlopen')
    def test_transient_retries_remain_bounded(self, open_url, sleep):
        open_url.side_effect = HTTPError('https://example.test', 504, 'timeout', {}, None)
        with self.assertRaises(HTTPError): open_release_url('https://example.test')
        self.assertEqual(3, open_url.call_count)
```

`scripts/test_release_optimization.py`:

```py
import copy
from pathlib import Path
import struct
import tempfile
import unittest
from unittest.mock import patch
import zipfile

from check_release_optimization import (
    CHAIN, ENTRY, HOOKER, JNI, PREFIX, dex_definitions, validate_apk, validate_callbacks,
)

OWNER = PREFIX + "hook/TestHook;"
INTERCEPT = ("intercept", f"({CHAIN})Ljava/lang/Object;")


def hook_dex(defined=True):
    """Minimal DEX tables; intercept is always referenced, optionally defined."""
    types = [OWNER, HOOKER, CHAIN, "Ljava/lang/Object;"]
    strings = types + ["intercept"]
    result = bytearray(112 + len(strings) * 4 + len(types) * 4 + 12 + 8 + 32)
    result[:8] = b"dex\n039\0"
    string_off = 112
    type_off = string_off + len(strings) * 4
    proto_off = type_off + len(types) * 4
    method_off = proto_off + 12
    class_off = method_off + 8
    for header, count, offset in ((56, len(strings), string_off), (64, len(types), type_off),
                                  (72, 1, proto_off), (88, 1, method_off), (96, 1, class_off)):
        struct.pack_into("<II", result, header, count, offset)
    for i, value in enumerate(strings):
        struct.pack_into("<I", result, string_off + i * 4, len(result))
        result.extend(bytes([len(value)]) + value.encode() + b"\0")
    for i in range(len(types)):
        struct.pack_into("<I", result, type_off + i * 4, i)
    params_off = len(result)
    result.extend(struct.pack("<IH", 1, 2))
    interface_off = len(result)
    result.extend(struct.pack("<IH", 1, 1))
    data_off = len(result)
    # No fields or direct methods, one public virtual method with a code offset.
    result.extend(bytes([0, 0, 0, int(defined)]))
    if defined:
        result.extend(bytes([0, 1, 1]))
    struct.pack_into("<III", result, proto_off, 0, 3, params_off)
    struct.pack_into("<HHI", result, method_off, 0, 0, 4)
    struct.pack_into("<I", result, class_off, 0)
    struct.pack_into("<I", result, class_off + 12, interface_off)
    struct.pack_into("<I", result, class_off + 24, data_off)
    return bytes(result)


def callbacks():
    classes = dex_definitions(hook_dex())
    classes[ENTRY] = ([], {(name, "()V"): (1, 1) for name in
                          ("onModuleLoaded", "onSystemServerStarting", "onPackageReady")})
    for owner, methods in JNI.items():
        classes[owner] = ([], {method: (0x101, 0) for method in methods})
    return classes


class ReleaseOptimizationTest(unittest.TestCase):
    def test_definition_is_distinct_from_method_reference(self):
        self.assertIn(INTERCEPT, dex_definitions(hook_dex())[OWNER][1])
        self.assertNotIn(INTERCEPT, dex_definitions(hook_dex(False))[OWNER][1])
        classes = callbacks()
        classes.update(dex_definitions(hook_dex(False)))
        with self.assertRaisesRegex(ValueError, "intercept implementation missing"):
            validate_callbacks(classes)

    def test_callbacks_survive(self):
        validate_callbacks(callbacks())

    def test_missing_lifecycle_or_native_definition_is_rejected(self):
        original = callbacks()
        for owner in (ENTRY, *JNI):
            for method in original[owner][1]:
                with self.subTest(owner=owner, method=method):
                    classes = copy.deepcopy(original)
                    del classes[owner][1][method]
                    with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
                        validate_callbacks(classes)

    def test_renamed_abstract_or_private_intercept_is_rejected(self):
        for method, flags, code in ((('a', INTERCEPT[1]), 1, 1),
                                     (INTERCEPT, 0x401, 0), (INTERCEPT, 2, 1)):
            with self.subTest(method=method, flags=flags):
                classes = callbacks()
                classes[OWNER] = ([HOOKER], {method: (flags, code)})
                with self.assertRaisesRegex(ValueError, "intercept implementation missing"):
                    validate_callbacks(classes)

    def test_repackaged_hooker_is_rejected(self):
        classes = callbacks()
        classes['La/b;'] = classes.pop(OWNER)
        with self.assertRaisesRegex(ValueError, "stack-cleaning prefix"):
            validate_callbacks(classes)

    def test_uncompressed_secondary_dex_is_rejected(self):
        for compression in (zipfile.ZIP_STORED, zipfile.ZIP_DEFLATED):
            with self.subTest(compression=compression), tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as directory:
                apk = Path(directory) / 'portal.apk'
                with zipfile.ZipFile(apk, 'w') as archive:
                    archive.writestr('classes.dex', hook_dex(), compress_type=zipfile.ZIP_DEFLATED)
                    archive.writestr('classes2.dex', hook_dex(), compress_type=compression)
                # Callback validation is tested above; isolate APK compression handling.
                with patch('check_release_optimization.validate_callbacks'):
                    if compression == zipfile.ZIP_STORED:
                        with self.assertRaisesRegex(ValueError, "not compressed: classes2.dex"):
                            validate_apk(apk)
                    else:
                        validate_apk(apk)

    def test_truncated_dex_is_rejected(self):
        with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
            dex_definitions(hook_dex()[:115])


if __name__ == '__main__':
    unittest.main()
```

```py
import hashlib
import json
from pathlib import Path
import tempfile
import unittest
import zipfile
from unittest.mock import patch

from release_policy import (
    ReleasePolicyError,
    ensure_version_code_is_newer,
    parse_release_codes,
    validate_promotion_bundle,
    validate_version,
)
from promote_release import main as promotion_main


class ReleasePolicyTest(unittest.TestCase):
    def test_version_names_allow_stable_and_supported_prerelease_channels(self):
        for version in ("1.7.5", "1.7.5-beta.1", "1.7.5-canary.2", "1.7.5-rc.3"):
            with self.subTest(version=version):
                self.assertEqual(version, validate_version(version))
        for version in ("1.7.5-dev.1", "1.7.5-beta", "1.7.5-rc.0-evil", "1.7.5;echo"):
            with self.subTest(version=version), self.assertRaises(ReleasePolicyError):
                validate_version(version)

    def test_new_build_must_exceed_all_known_published_codes(self):
        ensure_version_code_is_newer(1790000014, [1790000012, None, 1790000013])
        with self.assertRaises(ReleasePolicyError):
            ensure_version_code_is_newer(1790000013, [1790000012, 1790000013])

    def test_legacy_missing_metadata_is_explicit_but_present_bad_metadata_fails_closed(self):
        valid = json.dumps({"version": "1.8.0-beta.1", "versionCode": 1790000020,
                            "certificateSha256": "fa4547514e795b2daca48bd05e9a5f9348e62531d791d746e0ffe93bb90247a3"})
        releases = [
            {"tag_name": "v1.7.5", "assets": []},
            {"tag_name": "v1.8.0-beta.1", "assets": [{"name": "verification.json", "content": valid}]},
        ]
        self.assertEqual([1790000020], parse_release_codes(releases))
        releases[1]["assets"][0]["content"] = "{}"
        with self.assertRaises(ReleasePolicyError):
            parse_release_codes(releases)

    def test_remote_promotion_execute_flag_is_explicitly_unavailable(self):
        with patch("sys.argv", ["promote_release.py", "--execute"]), self.assertRaises(SystemExit) as error:
            promotion_main()
        self.assertEqual(2, error.exception.code)

    def test_promotion_requires_three_consistent_signed_artifacts_and_hash_metadata(self):
        with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as tmp:
            directory = Path(tmp)
            artifacts = []
            for name, abis in (
                ("LocationService-v1.8.0-beta.1-all.apk", ["arm64-v8a", "x86_64"]),
                ("LocationService-v1.8.0-beta.1-arm64.apk", ["arm64-v8a"]),
                ("LocationService-v1.8.0-beta.1-x86_64.apk", ["x86_64"]),
            ):
                content = name.encode()
                with zipfile.ZipFile(directory / name, "w") as archive:
                    for abi in abis:
                        archive.writestr(f"lib/{abi}/native.so", content)
                content = (directory / name).read_bytes()
                artifacts.append({"file": name, "sha256": hashlib.sha256(content).hexdigest(), "abis": abis, "bytes": len(content)})
            report = {
                "version": "1.8.0-beta.1",
                "versionCode": 1790000020,
                "channel": "beta",
                "certificateSha256": "fa4547514e795b2daca48bd05e9a5f9348e62531d791d746e0ffe93bb90247a3",
                "artifacts": artifacts,
            }
            (directory / "verification.json").write_text(json.dumps(report), encoding="utf-8")
            signature = f"Verified using v2 scheme (APK Signature Scheme v2): true\nSigner certificate SHA-256 digest: {report['certificateSha256']}"
            manifest = "package: name='com.system.location.service' versionCode='1790000020' versionName='1.8.0-beta.1'"
            def fake_run(command, **kwargs):
                output = signature if "apksigner" in " ".join(command) else manifest
                return type("Result", (), {"stdout": output})()
            with patch.dict("os.environ", {"ANDROID_HOME": tmp}), patch("release_policy.subprocess.run", side_effect=fake_run):
                self.assertEqual(report, validate_promotion_bundle(directory))
            report["version"] = "1.8.0"
            (directory / "verification.json").write_text(json.dumps(report), encoding="utf-8")
            with self.assertRaises(ReleasePolicyError):
                validate_promotion_bundle(directory)
            report["version"] = "1.8.0-beta.1"
            artifacts[0]["sha256"] = "0" * 64
            (directory / "verification.json").write_text(json.dumps(report), encoding="utf-8")
            with self.assertRaises(ReleasePolicyError):
                with patch.dict("os.environ", {"ANDROID_HOME": tmp}), patch("release_policy.subprocess.run", side_effect=fake_run):
                    validate_promotion_bundle(directory)


if __name__ == "__main__":
    unittest.main()
```

```py
import tempfile
from pathlib import Path
import unittest
import zipfile
from verify_release_apks import RELEASE_CERT_SHA256, validate_signature, validate_manifest, validate_abis


class ReleaseVerificationTest(unittest.TestCase):
    def test_unsigned_or_wrong_signer_cannot_be_promoted(self):
        valid = f"Verified using v2 scheme (APK Signature Scheme v2): true\nSigner certificate SHA-256 digest: {RELEASE_CERT_SHA256}"
        validate_signature(valid)
        for output in ("", valid.replace(RELEASE_CERT_SHA256, "0" * 64), valid.replace(": true", ": false")):
            with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
                validate_signature(output)

    def test_mislabeled_apk_or_wrong_package_is_rejected(self):
        valid = "package: name='com.system.location.service' versionCode='1790000012' versionName='1.7.5'"
        validate_manifest(valid, "1.7.5", 1790000012)
        for output in (valid.replace("1.7.5", "1.7.4"), valid.replace("1790000012", "1790000011"), valid.replace("com.system.location.service", "other.package")):
            with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
                validate_manifest(output, "1.7.5", 1790000012)

    def test_native_architecture_must_match_the_asset_name(self):
        with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as directory:
            apk = Path(directory) / "arm64.apk"
            with zipfile.ZipFile(apk, "w") as archive:
                archive.writestr("lib/arm64-v8a/libtest.so", b"test")
                archive.writestr("assets/not-a-library", b"test")
            self.assertEqual(["arm64-v8a"], validate_abis(apk, {"arm64-v8a"}))
            with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
                validate_abis(apk, {"x86_64"})
```

```py
import struct
import tempfile
from pathlib import Path
import unittest
import zipfile

from check_xposed_module import (
    ENTRY, PROPERTIES, RESOURCE_DIR, SCOPES, dex_class_descriptors,
    source_violations, validate_apk, validate_metadata,
)


def metadata():
    return {
        "java_init.list": f"{ENTRY}\n".encode(),
        "module.prop": "".join(f"{key}={value}\n" for key, value in PROPERTIES.items()).encode(),
        "scope.list": "\n".join(sorted(SCOPES)).encode(),
    }


def dex(definitions, references=()):
    """Build index tables with separate type references and class definitions."""
    types = list(dict.fromkeys([*definitions, *references]))
    string_offset = 112
    type_offset = string_offset + len(types) * 4
    class_offset = type_offset + len(types) * 4
    result = bytearray(class_offset + len(definitions) * 32)
    result[:8] = b"dex\n039\0"
    for offset, value in ((56, len(types)), (60, string_offset), (64, len(types)),
                          (68, type_offset), (96, len(definitions)), (100, class_offset)):
        struct.pack_into("<I", result, offset, value)
    for index, descriptor in enumerate(types):
        struct.pack_into("<I", result, string_offset + index * 4, len(result))
        struct.pack_into("<I", result, type_offset + index * 4, index)
        # The parser skips this ULEB length; test descriptors fit in one byte.
        result.extend(bytes([len(descriptor)]) + descriptor.encode() + b"\0")
    for index, descriptor in enumerate(definitions):
        struct.pack_into("<I", result, class_offset + index * 32, types.index(descriptor))
    return bytes(result)


ENTRY_DESCRIPTOR = f"L{ENTRY.replace('.', '/')};"
API_DESCRIPTOR = "Lio/github/libxposed/api/XposedModule;"


class XposedModuleVerificationTest(unittest.TestCase):
    def apk(self, directory, resources=None, classes=None, extra=None, manifest=None):
        path = Path(directory) / "portal.apk"
        with zipfile.ZipFile(path, "w") as archive:
            for name, data in (metadata() if resources is None else resources).items():
                archive.writestr(f"META-INF/xposed/{name}", data)
            archive.writestr("AndroidManifest.xml", manifest or b"<manifest><application/></manifest>")
            archive.writestr("classes.dex", classes if classes is not None else dex([ENTRY_DESCRIPTOR], [API_DESCRIPTOR]))
            for name, data in (extra or {}).items():
                archive.writestr(name, data)
        return path

    def test_plain_native_elf_is_rejected(self):
        with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as directory:
            path = self.apk(directory, extra={"lib/arm64-v8a/liblocationext.so": b"\x7fELF"})
            with self.assertRaisesRegex(ValueError, "plain native payload"):
                validate_apk(path)

    def test_valid_apk_can_reference_framework_api_without_packaging_it(self):
        with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as directory:
            validate_apk(self.apk(directory))

    def test_missing_entry_resource_is_rejected(self):
        for name in metadata():
            with self.subTest(name=name), tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as directory:
                resources = metadata()
                del resources[name]
                with self.assertRaisesRegex(ValueError, "missing or duplicate"):
                    validate_apk(self.apk(directory, resources=resources))

    def test_incorrect_api_scope_and_hot_reload_are_rejected(self):
        changes = (
            ("module.prop", b"minApiVersion=102", b"minApiVersion=101"),
            ("module.prop", b"targetApiVersion=102", b"targetApiVersion=101"),
            ("module.prop", b"autoHotReload=true", b"autoHotReload=false"),
            ("module.prop", b"staticScope=false", b"staticScope=true"),
            ("scope.list", b"system", b"android"),
            ("java_init.list", ENTRY.encode(), b"example.WrongModule"),
        )
        for name, old, new in changes:
            with self.subTest(name=name, change=new):
                resources = metadata()
                resources[name] = resources[name].replace(old, new)
                with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
                    validate_metadata(resources)

    def test_duplicate_properties_or_scope_are_rejected(self):
        for name, suffix in (("module.prop", b"autoHotReload=true\n"), ("scope.list", b"\nsystem\n")):
            with self.subTest(name=name):
                resources = metadata()
                resources[name] += suffix
                with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
                    validate_metadata(resources)

    def test_legacy_entry_is_rejected(self):
        with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as directory:
            with self.assertRaisesRegex(ValueError, "legacy assets"):
                validate_apk(self.apk(directory, extra={"assets/xposed_init": b"old.Module"}))

    def test_legacy_manifest_metadata_is_rejected_in_both_axml_encodings(self):
        for encoding in ("utf-8", "utf-16le"):
            with self.subTest(encoding=encoding), tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as directory:
                manifest = b"\x03\0\x08\0" + "xposedmodule\0".encode(encoding)
                with self.assertRaisesRegex(ValueError, "legacy module metadata"):
                    validate_apk(self.apk(directory, manifest=manifest))

    def test_legacy_plain_xml_metadata_is_rejected(self):
        manifest = b'<manifest xmlns:android="http://schemas.android.com/apk/res/android"><application><meta-data android:name="xposedmodule" android:value="true"/></application></manifest>'
        with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as directory:
            with self.assertRaisesRegex(ValueError, "legacy module metadata"):
                validate_apk(self.apk(directory, manifest=manifest))

    def test_packaged_framework_and_compat_definitions_in_secondary_dex_are_rejected(self):
        for descriptor in (API_DESCRIPTOR, "Lde/robv/android/xposed/XposedBridge;",
                           "Lcom/system/location/service/hook/compat/Adapter;"):
            with self.subTest(descriptor=descriptor), tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as directory:
                with self.assertRaisesRegex(ValueError, "classes are packaged"):
                    validate_apk(self.apk(directory, extra={"classes2.dex": dex([descriptor])}))

    def test_reference_to_entry_cannot_replace_entry_definition(self):
        with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as directory:
            with self.assertRaisesRegex(ValueError, "class definition is missing"):
                validate_apk(self.apk(directory, classes=dex(["Lexample/Other;"], [ENTRY_DESCRIPTOR])))

    def test_malformed_dex_tables_fail_closed(self):
        truncated = bytearray(dex([ENTRY_DESCRIPTOR]))
        struct.pack_into("<I", truncated, 96, 0xFFFFFFFF)
        bad_type = bytearray(dex([ENTRY_DESCRIPTOR]))
        class_offset = struct.unpack_from("<I", bad_type, 100)[0]
        struct.pack_into("<I", bad_type, class_offset, 0xFFFFFFFF)
        for data in (b"not dex", bytes(truncated), bytes(bad_type)):
            with self.subTest(data=data[:8]), self.assertRaises(ValueError):
                dex_class_descriptors(data)

    def source(self, directory):
        root = Path(directory)
        for name, data in metadata().items():
            path = root / RESOURCE_DIR / name
            path.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
            path.write_bytes(data)
        return root

    def test_source_guard_accepts_native_api_and_rejects_legacy_callbacks(self):
        for content, valid in (("import io.github.libxposed.api.XposedInterface", True),
                               ("import de.robv.android.xposed.XC_MethodHook", False),
                               ("import com.system.location.service.hook.compat.Adapter", False),
                               ("class XC_MethodHook", False)):
            with self.subTest(content=content), tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as directory:
                root = self.source(directory)
                path = root / "xposed/src/main/java/Hook.kt"
                path.parent.mkdir(parents=True)
                path.write_text(content, encoding="utf-8")
                self.assertEqual(valid, not source_violations(root))

    def test_source_guard_rejects_legacy_dependency_and_packaged_api(self):
        for content, valid in (('compileOnly(libs.libxposed.api)', True),
                               ('implementation(libs.libxposed.api)', False),
                               ('api(libs.libxposed.api)', False),
                               ('implementation("io.github.libxposed:api:102.0.0")', False),
                               ('compileOnly("de.robv.android.xposed:api:82")', False)):
            with self.subTest(content=content), tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as directory:
                root = self.source(directory)
                path = root / "xposed/build.gradle.kts"
                path.write_text(content, encoding="utf-8")
                self.assertEqual(valid, not source_violations(root))

    def test_source_guard_rejects_legacy_manifest_and_entry(self):
        with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as directory:
            root = self.source(directory)
            manifest = root / "app/src/main/AndroidManifest.xml"
            manifest.parent.mkdir(parents=True)
            manifest.write_text('<manifest xmlns:android="http://schemas.android.com/apk/res/android"><application><meta-data android:name="xposedminversion"/></application></manifest>', encoding="utf-8")
            entry = root / "xposed/src/main/assets/xposed_init"
            entry.parent.mkdir(parents=True)
            entry.write_text("old.Module", encoding="utf-8")
            violations = source_violations(root)
            self.assertTrue(any("legacy module metadata" in error for error in violations))
            self.assertTrue(any("legacy entry remains" in error for error in violations))
```

`scripts/verify_release_apks.py`:

```py
"""Fail closed on unsigned, incompatible, mislabeled or incorrectly packaged releases."""
import argparse
import hashlib
import json
import os
from pathlib import Path
import re
import subprocess
import zipfile

from check_xposed_module import validate_apk as validate_xposed_module
from release_policy import (
    RELEASE_CERT_SHA256,
    ReleasePolicyError,
    ensure_version_code_is_newer,
    fetch_published_codes,
    validate_version,
    validate_version_code,
)

ABIS = {"all": {"arm64-v8a", "x86_64"}, "arm64": {"arm64-v8a"}, "x86_64": {"x86_64"}}


def validate_signature(output):
    certificates = set(re.findall(r"certificate SHA-256 digest:\s*([0-9a-fA-F]{64})", output))
    if {value.lower() for value in certificates} != {RELEASE_CERT_SHA256}:
        raise ValueError("APK signer differs from the established release certificate")
    if "Verified using v2 scheme (APK Signature Scheme v2): true" not in output:
        raise ValueError("APK Signature Scheme v2 verification is required")


def validate_manifest(output, version, version_code):
    package = re.search(r"package: name='([^']+)' versionCode='([^']+)' versionName='([^']+)'", output)
    if not package or package.groups() != ("com.system.location.service", str(version_code), version):
        raise ValueError("APK package or version does not match this release")


def validate_abis(apk, expected):
    with zipfile.ZipFile(apk) as archive:
        abis = {name.split("/")[1] for name in archive.namelist() if name.startswith("lib/") and name.endswith(".so")}
    if abis != expected:
        raise ValueError(f"{apk.name}: unexpected native ABIs {sorted(abis)}, expected {sorted(expected)}")
    return sorted(abis)


def run_tool(path, *args):
    command = [str(path), *map(str, args)]
    if os.name == "nt" and path.suffix == ".bat":
        command = ["cmd.exe", "/c", *command]
    return subprocess.run(command, check=True, capture_output=True, text=True).stdout


def main():
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description=__doc__)
    parser.add_argument("--version", required=True)
    parser.add_argument("--version-code", required=True, type=int)
    parser.add_argument("--channel", choices=("stable", "beta"), default="stable")
    parser.add_argument("--directory", type=Path, default=Path("app/build/outputs/distribution"))
    parser.add_argument("--skip-remote-version-check", action="store_true", help="offline-only; bypasses the read-only published-code guard")
    args = parser.parse_args()
    try:
        validate_version(args.version)
        validate_version_code(args.version_code)
        if not args.skip_remote_version_check:
            ensure_version_code_is_newer(args.version_code, fetch_published_codes())
    except ReleasePolicyError as exc:
        parser.error(str(exc))
    sdk = os.environ.get("ANDROID_HOME") or os.environ.get("ANDROID_SDK_ROOT")
    if not sdk:
        parser.error("ANDROID_HOME or ANDROID_SDK_ROOT is required")
    tools = Path(sdk) / "build-tools" / "37.0.0"
    expected = {f"LocationService-v{args.version}-{flavor}.apk": abis for flavor, abis in ABIS.items()}
    if {apk.name for apk in args.directory.glob("*.apk")} != set(expected):
        raise ValueError("Distribution must contain exactly the three APKs for this release")
    artifacts = []
    for name, abis in expected.items():
        apk = args.directory / name
        signer = tools / ("apksigner.bat" if os.name == "nt" else "apksigner")
        aapt = tools / ("aapt2.exe" if os.name == "nt" else "aapt2")
        validate_signature(run_tool(signer, "verify", "--verbose", "--print-certs", apk))
        validate_manifest(run_tool(aapt, "dump", "badging", apk), args.version, args.version_code)
        validate_xposed_module(apk)
        actual_abis = validate_abis(apk, abis)
        with apk.open("rb") as stream:
            digest = hashlib.file_digest(stream, "sha256").hexdigest()
        artifacts.append({"file": name, "sha256": digest, "abis": actual_abis, "bytes": apk.stat().st_size})
        print(f"Verified {name}: release signature, version, ABIs and SHA-256")
    report = {"version": args.version, "versionCode": args.version_code, "channel": args.channel,
              "certificateSha256": RELEASE_CERT_SHA256, "artifacts": artifacts}
    (args.directory / "verification.json").write_text(json.dumps(report, indent=2) + "\n", encoding="utf-8")
    (args.directory / "SHA256SUMS").write_text("".join(f"{item['sha256']}  {item['file']}\n" for item in artifacts), encoding="utf-8")


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
```

`xposed/src/androidTest/java/com/system/location/service/hook/hooks/LocationResultIsolationDeviceTest.kt`:

```kt
package com.system.location.service.hook.hooks

import android.location.Location
import android.os.Parcel
import android.os.Parcelable
import com.system.location.service.hook.runtime.Reflection
import org.junit.Assert.*
import org.junit.Test

/** Run with hidden API access, as in the injected system hook's platform context. */
class LocationResultIsolationDeviceTest {
    private val type = Class.forName("android.location.LocationResult")
    private val locations = Reflection.findField(type, "mLocations")
    private fun result(latitude: Double): Any = Reflection.callStaticMethod(type, "wrap", listOf(
        Location("gps").apply { this.latitude = latitude; longitude = 121.0; time = 1_000L;
            elapsedRealtimeNanos = 1_000_000L; accuracy = 2f }
    ))!!

    @Test fun platformParcelGetsTheReplacementWhileTheCacheRetainsItsOriginalList() {
        val original = result(30.0)
        val originalList = locations.get(original)
        val replacement = locations.get(result(31.0)) as List<*>
        val parcel = Parcel.obtain()
        try {
            LocationResultIsolation.writeWithLocations(original, locations, { replacement }) {
                (original as Parcelable).writeToParcel(parcel, 0)
            }
            assertSame(originalList, locations.get(original))
            assertEquals(30.0, ((locations.get(original) as List<*>).single() as Location).latitude, 0.0)
            parcel.setDataPosition(0)
            val creator = Reflection.getStaticObjectField(type, "CREATOR") as Parcelable.Creator<*>
            val received = requireNotNull(creator.createFromParcel(parcel))
            assertEquals(31.0, ((locations.get(received) as List<*>).single() as Location).latitude, 0.0)
        } finally { parcel.recycle() }
    }

    @Test fun forwardingBuildsAPlatformResultWithoutChangingTheSource() {
        val original = result(30.0)
        val originalList = locations.get(original)
        val copy = LocationResultIsolation.copyWithLocations(original, locations.get(result(31.0)) as List<*>)
        assertNotSame(original, copy)
        assertSame(originalList, locations.get(original))
        assertNotSame(originalList, locations.get(copy))
        assertEquals(31.0, ((locations.get(copy) as List<*>).single() as Location).latitude, 0.0)
        assertEquals(30.0, ((locations.get(original) as List<*>).single() as Location).latitude, 0.0)
    }
}
```

```kt
package com.system.location.service.hook.hooks.wlan

import android.net.wifi.SupplicantState
import android.net.wifi.WifiInfo
import android.os.Parcel
import androidx.test.ext.junit.runners.AndroidJUnit4
import com.system.location.service.core.environment.WifiAp
import org.junit.Assert.assertEquals
import org.junit.Test
import org.junit.runner.RunWith

@RunWith(AndroidJUnit4::class)
class WifiConnectionInfoTest {
    @Test fun connectedWifiHasAnEncodedSsidAndAnAddressAfterParceling() {
        for (ssid in listOf("Portal AP", "测试网络")) {
            val ap = WifiAp(ssid, "a4:50:46:12:34:56", -55, 2412, 1)
            val info = syntheticWifiInfo(ap, 42L)
            assertConnection(ap, info)
            val parcel = Parcel.obtain()
            try {
                parcel.writeParcelable(info, 0)
                parcel.setDataPosition(0)
                @Suppress("DEPRECATION")
                val restored = parcel.readParcelable<WifiInfo>(WifiInfo::class.java.classLoader)
                assertConnection(ap, requireNotNull(restored))
            } finally { parcel.recycle() }
        }
    }

    private fun assertConnection(ap: WifiAp, info: WifiInfo) {
        assertEquals("\"${ap.ssid}\"", info.ssid)
        assertEquals(ap.bssid, info.bssid)
        assertEquals(ap.rssi, info.rssi)
        assertEquals(ap.frequencyMhz, info.frequency)
        assertEquals(ap.standard, info.wifiStandard)
        assertEquals(syntheticWifiIpv4(ap.bssid), info.ipAddress)
        assertEquals(SupplicantState.COMPLETED, info.supplicantState)
    }
}
```

```kt
import android.net.wifi.ScanResult

import org.junit.Assert.assertArrayEquals

@RunWith(AndroidJUnit4::class)
class WifiScanResultTest {
    @Test fun informationElementsAreReadableBeforeAndAfterBinderParceling() {
        val profile = ProceduralWifiSource(EnvironmentConfig(apPerCell = 4))
            .profileAt(Wgs84(31.2, 121.5), 42L, 1_000L)
        assertTrue(profile.wifi.isNotEmpty())
```

`xposed/src/main/cpp/antidetect/antidetect.cpp`:

```cpp
// Experimental libc path rewriting for explicitly selected application processes.
//
// This is deliberately *not* a general-purpose root hider. It only changes the answers of the
// process's own libc file calls while the user enables the feature; a native scanner using raw
// syscalls can bypass it. The default is disabled and the Kotlin controller decides when to load
// the library.

#include <jni.h>
#include <android/log.h>
#include <atomic>
#include <cstdarg>
#include <cstdio>
#include <cstring>
#include <dirent.h>
#include <dlfcn.h>
#include <fcntl.h>
#include <limits.h>
#include <sys/stat.h>
#include <unistd.h>

#include "dobby_hook.h"

#define LOG_TAG "CodecExt"
#define LOGI(...) __android_log_print(ANDROID_LOG_INFO, LOG_TAG, __VA_ARGS__)
#define LOGE(...) __android_log_print(ANDROID_LOG_ERROR, LOG_TAG, __VA_ARGS__)

namespace {
std::atomic_bool gEnabled{false};
std::atomic_bool gHooked{false};

using OpenFn = int (*)(const char*, int, ...);
using OpenAtFn = int (*)(int, const char*, int, ...);
using FopenFn = FILE* (*)(const char*, const char*);
using AccessFn = int (*)(const char*, int);
using FAccessAtFn = int (*)(int, const char*, int, int);
using StatFn = int (*)(const char*, struct stat*);
using LstatFn = int (*)(const char*, struct stat*);
using ReadlinkFn = ssize_t (*)(const char*, char*, size_t);
using OpendirFn = DIR* (*)(const char*);

OpenFn gOpen = nullptr;
OpenAtFn gOpenAt = nullptr;
FopenFn gFopen = nullptr;
FopenFn gFopen64 = nullptr;
AccessFn gAccess = nullptr;
FAccessAtFn gFAccessAt = nullptr;
StatFn gStat = nullptr;
LstatFn gLstat = nullptr;
ReadlinkFn gReadlink = nullptr;
OpendirFn gOpendir = nullptr;

bool replaceSegment(const char* path, const char* needle, const char* replacement,
                    char* out, size_t size) {
    size_t needleLen = strlen(needle);
    for (const char* at = strstr(path, needle); at != nullptr; at = strstr(at + 1, needle)) {
        bool left = at == path || at[-1] == '/';
        bool right = at[needleLen] == '\0' || at[needleLen] == '/';
        if (!left || !right) continue;
        size_t prefix = static_cast<size_t>(at - path);
        if (prefix + strlen(replacement) + strlen(at + needleLen) + 1 > size) return false;
        memcpy(out, path, prefix);
        strcpy(out + prefix, replacement);
        strcat(out, at + needleLen);
        return true;
    }
    return false;
}

/** Returns either the original pointer or a thread-local rewritten path. */
const char* rewrite(const char* path) {
    if (!gEnabled.load(std::memory_order_relaxed) || path == nullptr) return path;
    static thread_local char buffer[PATH_MAX];
    // Removed (work package 9 audit): the previous /proc/*/maps -> /proc/self/status redirect
    // broke the proc interface contract. The payload is mapped from an app-private cache file
    // under a neutral per-load name and unlinked from disk, so a maps listing already shows an
    // ordinary-looking entry; substituting status content is *more* detectable (different line
    // format, different read semantics) than the listing it tried to hide. Raw syscall scanners
    // were never covered either way. Path rewrites for root artifacts stay below.
    if (strstr(path, "/data/adb") != nullptr) {
        snprintf(buffer, sizeof(buffer), "/data/_null");
        return buffer;
    }
    if (replaceSegment(path, "/su", "/su_f", buffer, sizeof(buffer))) return buffer;
    if (replaceSegment(path, "/sbin", "/etc", buffer, sizeof(buffer))) return buffer;
    return path;
}

int hookOpen(const char* path, int flags, ...) {
    mode_t mode = 0;
    if ((flags & O_CREAT) != 0) {
        va_list args;
        va_start(args, flags);
        mode = static_cast<mode_t>(va_arg(args, int));
        va_end(args);
    }
    return gOpen != nullptr ? gOpen(rewrite(path), flags, mode) : -1;
}

int hookOpenAt(int dirfd, const char* path, int flags, ...) {
    mode_t mode = 0;
    if ((flags & O_CREAT) != 0) {
        va_list args;
        va_start(args, flags);
        mode = static_cast<mode_t>(va_arg(args, int));
        va_end(args);
    }
    const char* effective = (path != nullptr && path[0] == '/') ? rewrite(path) : path;
    return gOpenAt != nullptr ? gOpenAt(dirfd, effective, flags, mode) : -1;
}

FILE* hookFopen(const char* path, const char* mode) {
    return gFopen != nullptr ? gFopen(rewrite(path), mode) : nullptr;
}

FILE* hookFopen64(const char* path, const char* mode) {
    return gFopen64 != nullptr ? gFopen64(rewrite(path), mode) : nullptr;
}

int hookAccess(const char* path, int mode) {
    return gAccess != nullptr ? gAccess(rewrite(path), mode) : -1;
}

int hookFAccessAt(int dirfd, const char* path, int mode, int flags) {
    const char* effective = (path != nullptr && path[0] == '/') ? rewrite(path) : path;
    return gFAccessAt != nullptr ? gFAccessAt(dirfd, effective, mode, flags) : -1;
}

int hookStat(const char* path, struct stat* info) {
    return gStat != nullptr ? gStat(rewrite(path), info) : -1;
}

int hookLstat(const char* path, struct stat* info) {
    return gLstat != nullptr ? gLstat(rewrite(path), info) : -1;
}

ssize_t hookReadlink(const char* path, char* buffer, size_t size) {
    return gReadlink != nullptr ? gReadlink(rewrite(path), buffer, size) : -1;
}

DIR* hookOpendir(const char* path) {
    return gOpendir != nullptr ? gOpendir(rewrite(path)) : nullptr;
}

template <typename T>
T resolve(const char* name) {
    return reinterpret_cast<T>(dlsym(RTLD_DEFAULT, name));
}

/** Dobby returns the trampoline; that pointer, not the patched target, must be called. */
template <typename T>
bool hookSymbol(const char* name, void* hook, T* original) {
    T target = resolve<T>(name);
    if (target == nullptr) return false;
    void* trampoline = InlineHook(reinterpret_cast<void*>(target), hook);
    if (trampoline == nullptr) return false;
    *original = reinterpret_cast<T>(trampoline);
    return true;
}

bool ensureHooks() {
    if (gHooked.exchange(true)) return true;
    bool any = false;
    any |= hookSymbol<OpenFn>("open", reinterpret_cast<void*>(hookOpen), &gOpen);
    any |= hookSymbol<OpenAtFn>("openat", reinterpret_cast<void*>(hookOpenAt), &gOpenAt);
    any |= hookSymbol<FopenFn>("fopen", reinterpret_cast<void*>(hookFopen), &gFopen);
    // Some ABIs alias fopen64 to fopen; do not patch the same address twice.
    if (resolve<FopenFn>("fopen64") != resolve<FopenFn>("fopen")) {
        any |= hookSymbol<FopenFn>("fopen64", reinterpret_cast<void*>(hookFopen64), &gFopen64);
    }
    any |= hookSymbol<AccessFn>("access", reinterpret_cast<void*>(hookAccess), &gAccess);
    any |= hookSymbol<FAccessAtFn>("faccessat", reinterpret_cast<void*>(hookFAccessAt), &gFAccessAt);
    any |= hookSymbol<StatFn>("stat", reinterpret_cast<void*>(hookStat), &gStat);
    if (reinterpret_cast<void*>(resolve<LstatFn>("lstat")) !=
        reinterpret_cast<void*>(resolve<StatFn>("stat"))) {
        any |= hookSymbol<LstatFn>("lstat", reinterpret_cast<void*>(hookLstat), &gLstat);
    }
    any |= hookSymbol<ReadlinkFn>("readlink", reinterpret_cast<void*>(hookReadlink), &gReadlink);
    any |= hookSymbol<OpendirFn>("opendir", reinterpret_cast<void*>(hookOpendir), &gOpendir);
    if (!any) LOGE("no libc file API could be hooked");
    return any;
}
} // namespace

extern "C" JNIEXPORT jint JNICALL JNI_OnLoad(JavaVM*, void*) {
    return JNI_VERSION_1_6;
}

extern "C" JNIEXPORT jboolean JNICALL
Java_com_system_location_service_jni_AntiDetect_nativeSetEnabled(JNIEnv*, jobject, jboolean enabled) {
    if (enabled && !ensureHooks()) return JNI_FALSE;
    gEnabled.store(enabled == JNI_TRUE);
    LOGI("anti-detect enabled=%d", enabled);
    return JNI_TRUE;
}

```

`xposed/src/main/cpp/dobby_hook.h`:

```h
#ifndef LOCATIONEXT_DOBBY_HOOK_H
#define LOCATIONEXT_DOBBY_HOOK_H

#include <unistd.h>
#include <dobby.h>
#include <sys/mman.h>

#define uintval(p)              reinterpret_cast<uintptr_t>(p)
#define ptr(p)                  (reinterpret_cast<void *>(p))
#define align_up(x, n)          (((x) + ((n) - 1)) & ~((n) - 1))
#define align_down(x, n)        ((x) & -(n))
#define page_size               getpagesize()
#define page_align(n)           align_up(static_cast<uintptr_t>(n), page_size)
#define ptr_align(x)            ptr(align_down(reinterpret_cast<uintptr_t>(x), page_size))
#define make_rwx(p, n)          ::mprotect(ptr_align(p), \
                                            page_align(uintval(p) + (n)) != page_align(uintval(p)) \
                                                ? page_align(n) + page_size : page_align(n),       \
                                            PROT_READ | PROT_WRITE | PROT_EXEC)
#define make_rx(p, n)           ::mprotect(ptr_align(p), \
                                            page_align(uintval(p) + (n)) != page_align(uintval(p)) \
                                                ? page_align(n) + page_size : page_align(n),       \
                                            PROT_READ | PROT_EXEC)

void* InlineHook(void* target, void* hooker) {
    make_rwx(target, page_size);
    void* origin_call;
    if (DobbyHook(target, hooker, &origin_call) == RS_SUCCESS) {
        // Leave the patched code RX; RWX is a conspicuous maps artifact.
        make_rx(target, page_size);
        return origin_call;
    } else {
        return nullptr;
    }
}

#endif //LOCATIONEXT_DOBBY_HOOK_H

```

```cpp
 *
 * Copyright (C) 2019 Swift Gan
 * Copyright (C) 2021 LSPosed Contributors

#include <fstream>
#include <fcntl.h>
#include <unistd.h>
#include <sys/mman.h>
#include "elf_util.h"
#include "logging.h"

using namespace SandHook;

ElfImg::ElfImg(std::string_view base_name) : elf(base_name) {
    initModuleBase();
    if (!isValid()) {
        return;
    }

    int fd = open(elf.data(), O_RDONLY);
    if (fd < 0) {
        LOGE("Failed to open %s", elf.data());
        return;
    }

    size = lseek(fd, 0, SEEK_END);
    if (size <= 0) {
        LOGE("lseek() failed for %s", elf.data());
    }

    header = reinterpret_cast<decltype(header)>(mmap(nullptr, size, PROT_READ, MAP_SHARED, fd, 0));
    close(fd);

    sectionHeader = offsetOf<decltype(sectionHeader)>(header, header->e_shoff);
    auto sectionOffset = reinterpret_cast<uintptr_t>(sectionHeader);

    char *section = offsetOf<char *>(header, sectionHeader[header->e_shstrndx].sh_offset);
    for (int i = 0; i < header->e_shnum; i++, sectionOffset += header->e_shentsize) {
        auto *section_h = (ElfW(Shdr) *) sectionOffset;
        char *sectionName = section_h->sh_name + section;

        switch (section_h->sh_type) {
            case SHT_DYNSYM: {
                if (bias == -4396) {
                    ElfW(Off) dynsymOffset = section_h->sh_offset;
                    dynsym = section_h;
                    dynsymStart = offsetOf<decltype(dynsymStart)>(header, dynsymOffset);
                }
                break;
            }

            case SHT_SYMTAB: {
                if (strcmp(sectionName, ".symtab") == 0) {
                    ElfW(Off) symtabSize = section_h->sh_size;
                    ElfW(Off) symtabOffset = section_h->sh_offset;
                    symtabCount = symtabSize / section_h->sh_entsize;
                    symtabStart = offsetOf<decltype(symtabStart)>(header, symtabOffset);
                }
                break;
            }

            case SHT_STRTAB: {
                if (bias == -4396) {
                    ElfW(Off) symstrOffset = section_h->sh_offset;
                    strtab = section_h;
                    strtabStart = offsetOf<decltype(strtabStart)>(header, symstrOffset);
                }

                if (strcmp(sectionName, ".strtab") == 0) {
                    symstrOffsetForSymtab = section_h->sh_offset;
                }
                break;
            }

            case SHT_PROGBITS: {
                if (strtab == nullptr || dynsym == nullptr) {
                    break;
                }

                if (bias == -4396) {
                    bias = (off_t) section_h->sh_addr - (off_t) section_h->sh_offset;
                }
                break;
            }

            case SHT_HASH: {
                auto *d_un = offsetOf<ElfW(Word)>(header, section_h->sh_offset);
                nbucket_ = d_un[0];
                bucket_ = d_un + 2;
                chain_ = bucket_ + nbucket_;
                break;
            }

            case SHT_GNU_HASH: {
                auto *d_buf = reinterpret_cast<ElfW(Word) *>(((size_t) header) + section_h->sh_offset);
                gnu_nbucket_ = d_buf[0];
                gnu_symndx_ = d_buf[1];
                gnu_bloom_size_ = d_buf[2];
                gnu_shift2_ = d_buf[3];
                gnu_bloom_filter_ = reinterpret_cast<decltype(gnu_bloom_filter_)>(d_buf + 4);
                gnu_bucket_ = reinterpret_cast<decltype(gnu_bucket_)>(gnu_bloom_filter_ + gnu_bloom_size_);
                gnu_chain_ = gnu_bucket_ + gnu_nbucket_ - gnu_symndx_;
                break;
            }
        }
    }
}

ElfImg::~ElfImg() {
    if (header) {
        munmap(header, size);
    }
}

ElfW(Addr) ElfImg::elfLookup(std::string_view name, uint32_t hash) const {
    if (nbucket_ == 0) {
        return 0;
    }

    char *strings = (char *) strtabStart;
    for (auto n = bucket_[hash % nbucket_]; n != 0; n = chain_[n]) {
        auto *sym = dynsymStart + n;
        if (name == strings + sym->st_name) {
            return sym->st_value;
        }
    }
    return 0;
}

ElfW(Addr) ElfImg::gnuLookup(std::string_view name, uint32_t hash) const {
    static constexpr auto bloomMaskBits = sizeof(ElfW(Addr)) * 8;
    if (gnu_nbucket_ == 0 || gnu_bloom_size_ == 0) {
        return 0;
    }

    auto bloomWord = gnu_bloom_filter_[(hash / bloomMaskBits) % gnu_bloom_size_];
    uintptr_t mask = 0 | (uintptr_t) 1 << (hash % bloomMaskBits) | (uintptr_t) 1 << ((hash >> gnu_shift2_) % bloomMaskBits);
    if ((mask & bloomWord) == mask) {
        auto symIndex = gnu_bucket_[hash % gnu_nbucket_];
        if (symIndex >= gnu_symndx_) {
            char *strings = (char *) strtabStart;
            do {
                auto *sym = dynsymStart + symIndex;
                if (((gnu_chain_[symIndex] ^ hash) >> 1) == 0
                    && name == strings + sym->st_name) {
                    return sym->st_value;
                }
            } while ((gnu_chain_[symIndex++] & 1) == 0);
        }
    }
    return 0;
}

ElfW(Addr) ElfImg::linearLookup(std::string_view name) const {
    initLinearMap();
    if (auto i = symtabs_.find(name); i != symtabs_.end()) {
        return i->second->st_value;
    }
    return 0;
}

ElfW(Addr) ElfImg::prefixLookup(std::string_view prefix) const {
    initLinearMap();
    if (auto i = symtabs_.lower_bound(prefix); i != symtabs_.end() && i->first.starts_with(prefix)) {
        LOGD("Found prefix %s of %s at offset %p in %s at symtab section by linear lookup", prefix.data(), i->first.data(),
             reinterpret_cast<void *>(i->second->st_value), elf.data());
        return i->second->st_value;
    }
    return 0;
}

ElfW(Addr) ElfImg::getSymbolOffset(std::string_view name, uint32_t gnuHash, uint32_t elfHash) const {
    if (auto offset = gnuLookup(name, gnuHash); offset > 0) {
        LOGD("Found JNI method %s at offset %p in %s at dynsym section by gnu hash", name.data(), reinterpret_cast<void *>(offset), elf.data());
        return offset;
    } else if (offset = elfLookup(name, elfHash); offset > 0) {
        LOGD("Found JNI method %s at offset %p in %s at dynsym section by elf hash", name.data(), reinterpret_cast<void *>(offset), elf.data());
        return offset;
    } else if (offset = linearLookup(name); offset > 0) {
        LOGD("Found JNI method %s at offset %p in %s at symtab section by linear lookup", name.data(), reinterpret_cast<void *>(offset), elf.data());
        return offset;
    }
    return 0;
}

void ElfImg::initLinearMap() const {
    if (symtabs_.empty()) {
        if (symtabStart != nullptr && symstrOffsetForSymtab != 0) {
            for (ElfW(Off) i = 0; i < symtabCount; i++) {
                unsigned int st_type = ELF_ST_TYPE(symtabStart[i].st_info);
                const char *st_name = offsetOf<const char *>(header, symstrOffsetForSymtab + symtabStart[i].st_name);
                if ((st_type == STT_FUNC || st_type == STT_OBJECT) && symtabStart[i].st_size) {
                    symtabs_.emplace(st_name, &symtabStart[i]);
                }
            }
        }
    }
}

void ElfImg::initModuleBase() {
    std::string mapsPath = std::string("/proc/self/maps");
    std::ifstream mapsStream(mapsPath);

    if (base) {
        return;
    }

    if (mapsStream.is_open()) {
        std::string line;
        while (getline(mapsStream, line)){
            if (line.find(elf) != std::string::npos) {
                std::string baseAddress = line.substr(0, line.find('-'));
                std::string elfPath = line.substr(line.find('/'));
                base = reinterpret_cast<void *>(std::stol(baseAddress, nullptr, 16));
                elf = elfPath;
                break;
            }
        }
        mapsStream.close();
    }
}
```

```h
 * along with LSPosed.  If not, see <https://www.gnu.org/licenses/>.
 *
 * Copyright (C) 2019 Swift Gan
 * Copyright (C) 2021 LSPosed Contributors
 */
#ifndef SANDHOOK_ELF_UTIL_H
#define SANDHOOK_ELF_UTIL_H

#include <string_view>
#include <string>
#include <map>
#include <link.h>

#define SHT_GNU_HASH 0x6ffffff6

namespace SandHook {
    class ElfImg {
    public:
        ElfImg(std::string_view elf);

        template<typename T = void*>
        requires(std::is_pointer_v<T>)
        constexpr const T getSymbolAddress(std::string_view name) const {
            auto offset = getSymbolOffset(name, gnuHash(name), elfHash(name));
            if (offset > 0 && base != nullptr) {
                return reinterpret_cast<T>(static_cast<ElfW(Addr)>((uintptr_t) base + offset - bias));
            }
            return nullptr;
        }

        template<typename T = void*>
        requires(std::is_pointer_v<T>)
        constexpr const T getSymbolAddressByPrefix(std::string_view prefix) const {
            auto offset = prefixLookup(prefix);
            if (offset > 0 && base != nullptr) {
                return reinterpret_cast<T>(static_cast<ElfW(Addr)>((uintptr_t) base + offset - bias));
            }
            return nullptr;
        }

        template<typename T>
        inline constexpr auto offsetOf(ElfW(Ehdr) *head, ElfW(Off) off) const {
            return reinterpret_cast<std::conditional_t<std::is_pointer_v<T>, T, T *>>(reinterpret_cast<uintptr_t>(head) + off);
        }

        constexpr uint32_t elfHash(std::string_view name) const {
            uint32_t h = 0, g;
            for (unsigned char p: name) {
                h = (h << 4) + p;
                g = h & 0xf0000000;
                h ^= g;
                h ^= g >> 24;
            }
            return h;
        }

        constexpr uint32_t gnuHash(std::string_view name) const {
            uint32_t h = 5381;
            for (unsigned char p: name) {
                h += (h << 5) + p;
            }
            return h;
        }

        constexpr inline bool contains(std::string_view a, std::string_view b) const {
            return a.find(b) != std::string_view::npos;
        }

        bool isValid() const {
            return base != nullptr;
        }

        const std::string name() const {
            return elf;
        }

        ~ElfImg();
    private:
        ElfW(Addr) getSymbolOffset(std::string_view name, uint32_t gnuHash, uint32_t elfHash) const;
        ElfW(Addr) elfLookup(std::string_view name, uint32_t hash) const;
        ElfW(Addr) gnuLookup(std::string_view name, uint32_t hash) const;
        ElfW(Addr) linearLookup(std::string_view name) const;
        ElfW(Addr) prefixLookup(std::string_view prefix) const;

        void initLinearMap() const;
        void initModuleBase();

        std::string elf;
        void *base = nullptr;

        off_t size = 0;
        off_t bias = -4396;

        ElfW(Ehdr) *header = nullptr;
        ElfW(Shdr) *sectionHeader = nullptr;
        ElfW(Shdr) *strtab = nullptr;
        ElfW(Shdr) *dynsym = nullptr;

        ElfW(Sym) *symtabStart = nullptr;
        ElfW(Sym) *dynsymStart = nullptr;
        ElfW(Sym) *strtabStart = nullptr;

        ElfW(Off) symtabCount = 0;
        ElfW(Off) symstrOffsetForSymtab = 0;

        uint32_t nbucket_{};
        uint32_t *bucket_ = nullptr;
        uint32_t *chain_ = nullptr;

        uint32_t gnu_nbucket_{};
        uint32_t gnu_symndx_{};
        uint32_t gnu_bloom_size_;
        uint32_t gnu_shift2_;
        uintptr_t *gnu_bloom_filter_;
        uint32_t *gnu_bucket_;
        uint32_t *gnu_chain_;

        mutable std::map<std::string_view, ElfW(Sym) *> symtabs_;
    };
}

#endif //SANDHOOK_ELF_UTIL_H
```

```cpp
#include <dobby.h>
#include <jni.h>
#include <sys/mman.h>
#include <unistd.h>
#include "sensor_hook.h"
#include <atomic>
#include <algorithm>

std::atomic_bool enableSensorHook{false};

JNIEXPORT jint JNICALL
JNI_OnLoad(JavaVM* vm, void* reserved) {
    JNIEnv* env;
    if (vm->GetEnv((void**) &env, JNI_VERSION_1_6) != JNI_OK) {
        return JNI_ERR;
    }
    return JNI_VERSION_1_6;
}

extern "C"
JNIEXPORT void JNICALL
Java_com_system_location_service_jni_Dobby_setStatus(JNIEnv *env, jobject thiz, jboolean status) {
    enableSensorHook.store(status);
    if (!status) clearNativeSensorFrames();
}

extern "C"
JNIEXPORT void JNICALL
Java_com_system_location_service_jni_Dobby_setSensorFrame(JNIEnv *env, jobject thiz,
        jlong stepCount, jint stepCadence, jlong syncNanos,
        jfloatArray accelerometer, jfloatArray gyroscope, jfloatArray magnetometer,
        jfloat barometerHpa) {
    if (accelerometer == nullptr || gyroscope == nullptr || magnetometer == nullptr) return;
    if (env->GetArrayLength(accelerometer) < 3 || env->GetArrayLength(gyroscope) < 3 ||
        env->GetArrayLength(magnetometer) < 3) return;

    NativeSensorFrame frame{};
    frame.stepCount = stepCount;
    frame.stepCadence = stepCadence;
    frame.syncNanos = syncNanos;
    frame.barometerHpa = barometerHpa;

    auto copyThree = [env](jfloatArray source, float* destination) {
        jfloat* values = env->GetFloatArrayElements(source, nullptr);
        if (values == nullptr) return false;
        std::copy(values, values + 3, destination);
        env->ReleaseFloatArrayElements(source, values, JNI_ABORT);
        return true;
    };
    if (!copyThree(accelerometer, frame.accelerometer) ||
        !copyThree(gyroscope, frame.gyroscope) ||
        !copyThree(magnetometer, frame.magnetometer)) return;
    setNativeSensorFrame(frame);
}

extern "C" JNIEXPORT jboolean JNICALL
Java_com_system_location_service_jni_Dobby_prepareSensors(JNIEnv *, jobject) {
    clearNativeSensorFrames();
    enableSensorHook.store(false);
    return doSensorHook();
}
```

`xposed/src/main/cpp/sensor_hook.cpp`:

```cpp
//
// Created by fuqiuluo on 2024/10/15.
//
#include <dobby.h>
#include <unistd.h>
#include <cmath>
#include <cstring>
#include <mutex>
#include <algorithm>
#include <atomic>
#include "sensor_hook.h"
#include "logging.h"
#include "elf_util.h"
#include "dobby_hook.h"

#define LIBSF_PATH "/system/lib64/libsensorservice.so"

extern std::atomic_bool enableSensorHook;

namespace {
OriginalConvertToSensorEventType OriginalConvertToSensorEvent = nullptr;
OriginalConvertToSensorEventType OriginalAidlConvertToSensorEvent = nullptr;

std::mutex gFrameMutex;
NativeSensorFrame gPrevious{};
NativeSensorFrame gCurrent{};
bool gHasPrevious = false;
bool gHasCurrent = false;

float lerp(float a, float b, float t) { return a + (b - a) * t; }
int64_t lerpRound(int64_t a, int64_t b, float t) {
    return static_cast<int64_t>(std::llround(static_cast<double>(a) +
        (static_cast<double>(b) - static_cast<double>(a)) * t));
}

float interpolationFactor(const NativeSensorFrame& previous, const NativeSensorFrame& current,
                          int64_t timestampNanos) {
    if (current.syncNanos <= previous.syncNanos) return 1.0f;
    const double span = static_cast<double>(current.syncNanos - previous.syncNanos);
    const double offset = static_cast<double>(timestampNanos - previous.syncNanos);
    return static_cast<float>(std::clamp(offset / span, 0.0, 1.0));
}
} // namespace

void setNativeSensorFrame(const NativeSensorFrame& frame) {
    std::lock_guard<std::mutex> lock(gFrameMutex);
    if (gHasCurrent) {
        gPrevious = gCurrent;
        gHasPrevious = true;
    }
    gCurrent = frame;
    gHasCurrent = true;
}

void clearNativeSensorFrames() {
    std::lock_guard<std::mutex> lock(gFrameMutex);
    gHasPrevious = false;
    gHasCurrent = false;
}

bool readNativeSensorFrame(int64_t timestampNanos, NativeSensorFrame& out) {
    std::lock_guard<std::mutex> lock(gFrameMutex);
    if (!gHasCurrent) return false;
    if (!gHasPrevious || timestampNanos >= gCurrent.syncNanos) {
        out = gCurrent;
        return true;
    }
    const float t = interpolationFactor(gPrevious, gCurrent, timestampNanos);
    out = gCurrent;
    out.stepCount = lerpRound(gPrevious.stepCount, gCurrent.stepCount, t);
    out.stepCadence = static_cast<int32_t>(std::llround(
        lerp(static_cast<float>(gPrevious.stepCadence),
             static_cast<float>(gCurrent.stepCadence), t)));
    for (int i = 0; i < 3; ++i) {
        out.accelerometer[i] = lerp(gPrevious.accelerometer[i], gCurrent.accelerometer[i], t);
        out.gyroscope[i] = lerp(gPrevious.gyroscope[i], gCurrent.gyroscope[i], t);
        out.magnetometer[i] = lerp(gPrevious.magnetometer[i], gCurrent.magnetometer[i], t);
    }
    out.barometerHpa = lerp(gPrevious.barometerHpa, gCurrent.barometerHpa, t);
    return true;
}

void applyEvent(void *dst) {
    if (!enableSensorHook.load()) return;
    auto *event = reinterpret_cast<ASensorEvent *>(dst);
    if (event == nullptr) return;
    NativeSensorFrame frame;
    if (!readNativeSensorFrame(event->timestamp, frame)) return;

    switch (event->type) {
        case 1: // accelerometer
            std::memcpy(event->data, frame.accelerometer, sizeof(frame.accelerometer));
            break;
        case 4: // gyroscope
            std::memcpy(event->data, frame.gyroscope, sizeof(frame.gyroscope));
            break;
        case 2: // magnetic field
            std::memcpy(event->data, frame.magnetometer, sizeof(frame.magnetometer));
            break;
        case 6: // pressure hPa
            event->data[0] = frame.barometerHpa;
            break;
        case 19: // step counter
            // HAL/NDK events store uint64_t here. JNI converts it to float only when
            // delivering SensorEvent.values; writing float bits corrupts the count.
            event->u64.step_counter = static_cast<uint64_t>(std::max<int64_t>(0, frame.stepCount));
            break;
        case 18: // step detector
            event->data[0] = frame.stepCadence > 0 ? 1.0f : 0.0f;
            break;
        default:
            break;
    }
}

void ConvertToSensorEvent(void *src, void *dst) {
    if (OriginalConvertToSensorEvent == nullptr) return;
    OriginalConvertToSensorEvent(src, dst);
    applyEvent(dst);
}

void ConvertToSensorEventAidl(void *src, void *dst) {
    if (OriginalAidlConvertToSensorEvent == nullptr) return;
    OriginalAidlConvertToSensorEvent(src, dst);
    applyEvent(dst);
}

bool doSensorHook() {
    if (OriginalConvertToSensorEvent != nullptr || OriginalAidlConvertToSensorEvent != nullptr)
        return true;
    SandHook::ElfImg sensorService(LIBSF_PATH);
    if (!sensorService.isValid()) {
        LOGE("failed to load libsensorservice");
        return false;
    }

    auto convertToSensorEvent = sensorService.getSymbolAddress<void*>(
        "_ZN7android8hardware7sensors4V1_014implementation20convertToSensorEventERKNS2_5EventEP15sensors_event_t");
    auto aidlConvertToSensorEvent = sensorService.getSymbolAddress<void*>(
        "_ZN7android8hardware7sensors14implementation20convertToSensorEventERKN4aidl7android8hardware7sensors5EventEP15sensors_event_t");
    if (convertToSensorEvent == nullptr && aidlConvertToSensorEvent == nullptr) {
        LOGE("convertToSensorEvent symbol not found");
        return false;
    }
    if (convertToSensorEvent != nullptr) {
        OriginalConvertToSensorEvent = (OriginalConvertToSensorEventType)
            InlineHook(convertToSensorEvent, (void *) ConvertToSensorEvent);
    }
    if (aidlConvertToSensorEvent != nullptr) {
        OriginalAidlConvertToSensorEvent = (OriginalConvertToSensorEventType)
            InlineHook(aidlConvertToSensorEvent, (void *) ConvertToSensorEventAidl);
    }
    return OriginalConvertToSensorEvent != nullptr || OriginalAidlConvertToSensorEvent != nullptr;
}
```

```h
//
// Created by fuqiuluo on 2024/10/15.
//

#ifndef LOCATIONEXT_SENSOR_HOOK_H

#include <cstdint>
```

`xposed/src/main/java/com/system/location/service/hook/BaseDivineService.kt`:

```kt
package com.system.location.service.hook

import android.content.Context
import android.location.LocationManager
import android.os.Binder
import android.os.Bundle
import android.os.Parcel
import android.os.Handler
import android.os.Looper
import com.system.location.service.hook.runtime.DeferredServiceConnection
import com.system.location.service.hook.utils.BinderUtils
import com.system.location.service.hook.utils.FakeLoc
import com.system.location.service.hook.utils.Logger
import com.system.location.service.hook.security.CommandClient

abstract class BaseDivineService {
    private var connection: DeferredServiceConnection? = null

    /**
     * Hooks may install immediately: their runtime stays disabled until authenticated state
     * arrives. Never wait for location Binder calls or proxy delivery inside package binding;
     * phone must finish starting before the location service can query its subscriptions.
     */
    protected fun initDivineService(from: String): Boolean {
        if (FakeLoc.isSystemServerProcess) return true
        val pending = synchronized(this) {
            connection ?: DeferredServiceConnection(
                schedule = { delay, task -> executor.schedule({ task() }, delay,
                    java.util.concurrent.TimeUnit.MILLISECONDS); Unit },
                connect = { connectDivineService(from) },
                onFailure = { Logger.error("Runtime peer connection failed in $from", it) },
            ).also { connection = it }
        }
        // The next main-loop turn runs after the current bindApplication/onCreate has returned.
        // Only enqueue work there; all service discovery, IPC and waits stay on the worker.
        Handler(Looper.getMainLooper()).post { pending.start() }
        return true
    }

    private fun connectDivineService(from: String): Boolean {
        val locationManager = BinderUtils.getSystemContext()?.getSystemService(Context.LOCATION_SERVICE)
            as? LocationManager ?: return false
        if (!locationManager.isProviderEnabled("fused_ext")) return false

        val client = CommandClient()
        val rely = Bundle()
        if (!client.connect(locationManager)) {
            Logger.error("Failed to init service in $from")
            return false
        }

        val session = java.util.UUID.randomUUID().toString()
        RemoteCommandHandler.resetProxySession(session)
        val initialized = java.util.concurrent.CountDownLatch(1)

        rely.putBinder("proxy", object: Binder() {
            override fun getInterfaceDescriptor(): String {
                return "android.location.service.${from}Provider"
            }

            override fun onTransact(code: Int, data: Parcel, reply: Parcel?, flags: Int): Boolean {
                if (code == RuntimeSyncCommand.TRANSACTION) {
                    if (Binder.getCallingUid() != 1000) return false
                    val bundle = data.readBundle(javaClass.classLoader) ?: return false
                    val accepted = RemoteCommandHandler.handleProxyInstruction(bundle)
                    if (accepted) initialized.countDown()
                    reply?.writeNoException()
                    reply?.writeInt(if (accepted) 1 else 0)
                    return true
                }
                return super.onTransact(code, data, reply, flags)
            }
        })
        rely.putString("proxy_name", from)
        rely.putString(RuntimeSyncCommand.SESSION, session)
        rely.putString("command_id", "set_proxy")
        if (!client.send(locationManager, rely)) {
            RemoteCommandHandler.resetProxySession(java.util.UUID.randomUUID().toString())
            Logger.error("Failed to init service proxy in $from")
            return false
        }
        val ready = try {
            initialized.await(5, java.util.concurrent.TimeUnit.SECONDS)
        } catch (_: InterruptedException) {
            Thread.currentThread().interrupt()
            false
        }
        if (!ready) {
            RemoteCommandHandler.resetProxySession(java.util.UUID.randomUUID().toString())
            Logger.error("Initial runtime state not restored in $from")
            return false
        }
        Logger.info("Runtime peer connected in $from")
        return true
    }

    private companion object {
        val executor by lazy {
            java.util.concurrent.Executors.newSingleThreadScheduledExecutor { task ->
                Thread(task, "Portal-runtime-connect").apply { isDaemon = true }
            }
        }
    }
}
```

`xposed/src/main/java/com/system/location/service/hook/BaseLocationHook.kt`:

```kt
package com.system.location.service.hook

import com.system.location.service.hook.utils.toLocation

import android.location.Location
import android.location.LocationManager
import com.system.location.service.core.location.LocationSample
import com.system.location.service.core.location.LocationBatchTimeline
import com.system.location.service.hook.utils.FakeLoc
import com.system.location.service.hook.utils.ProviderView
import com.system.location.service.hook.utils.ProviderReadContext
import com.system.location.service.hook.runtime.CurrentLocationDelivery
import com.system.location.service.core.gnss.GnssFrameRoute

abstract class BaseLocationHook: BaseDivineService() {
    /** Provider-specific view of the current fake fix (P4-03): accuracy, latency, field mask. */
    fun sampleForProvider(
        provider: String?,
        scenarioId: String? = null,
        point: com.system.location.service.core.geo.Wgs84? = null,
        context: ProviderReadContext = ProviderView.capture(),
    ): LocationSample = ProviderView.sampleFor(provider, scenarioId, point, context)

    fun locationForProvider(provider: String?, scenarioId: String? = null,
        point: com.system.location.service.core.geo.Wgs84? = null,
        context: ProviderReadContext = ProviderView.capture()): Location {
        val view = ProviderView.viewFor(provider, scenarioId, point, context)
        return view.sample.toLocation(provider, GnssFrameRoute.forObserver(scenarioId, point),
            context.state, context.validationAtMillis, view.providerSample)
    }

    fun injectLocation(originLocation: Location, realLocation: Boolean = true,
        context: ProviderReadContext? = null): Location {
        // A current request already has a synthetic provider candidate. Preserve the platform's
        // subsequent coarse filtering and copies instead of replacing them with a fine fix again.
        if (CurrentLocationDelivery.active) return originLocation
        val captured = context ?: ProviderView.capture()
        if (!captured.state.configuration.enabled) {
            if (realLocation && originLocation.provider == LocationManager.GPS_PROVIDER) {
                FakeLoc.lastLocation = originLocation
            }
            return originLocation
        }
        val provider = if (captured.state.configuration.disableNetworkLocation && originLocation.provider == LocationManager.NETWORK_PROVIDER) {
            LocationManager.GPS_PROVIDER
        } else originLocation.provider
        return locationForProvider(provider, context = captured)
    }

    /** Replace a hardware batch from one provider snapshot; none of its measured fixes survive. */
    fun injectLocationBatch(
        originLocations: List<Location>,
        context: ProviderReadContext? = null,
    ): List<Location> {
        if (originLocations.isEmpty()) return emptyList()
        if (CurrentLocationDelivery.active) return originLocations
        val captured = context ?: ProviderView.capture()
        if (!captured.state.configuration.enabled) return originLocations
        val intervalMillis = captured.state.configuration.reportIntervalMs.coerceIn(1L, 60_000L)
        val provider = originLocations.last().provider
        val retainedCount = minOf(originLocations.size, LocationBatchTimeline.MAX_BATCH_SIZE)
        val endpoint = ProviderView.viewFor(provider, context = captured)
        return LocationBatchTimeline.synthesize(endpoint.sample, retainedCount, intervalMillis).map { sample ->
            sample.toLocation(provider, GnssFrameRoute.Global, captured.state, captured.validationAtMillis,
                endpoint.providerSample?.copy(sample = sample))
        }
    }

}
```

`xposed/src/main/java/com/system/location/service/hook/ConfigCommand.kt`:

```kt
package com.system.location.service.hook

import android.os.Bundle
import com.system.location.service.core.runtime.PreparedRuntimeConfiguration
import com.system.location.service.core.runtime.RuntimeSnapshot
import com.system.location.service.hook.hooks.telephony.CarrierConfigGlobalController
import com.system.location.service.hook.utils.FakeLoc

/** Authenticated configuration is prepared completely before one atomic publication. */
object ConfigCommand {
    @Suppress("DEPRECATION")
    fun apply(rely: Bundle): Boolean {
        val published = try {
            val values = PreparedRuntimeConfiguration.keys.filter(rely::containsKey).associateWith { rely.get(it) }
            publish(values)
        } catch (_: Exception) { return false }
        if (published.configuration.enabled) LocationTicker.start() else {
            SampleCommand.clearLease()
            LocationTicker.stop()
            NativeCommand.disable()
        }
        rely.putString("carrier_identity_status", CarrierConfigGlobalController.status)
        if (published.configuration.carrierIdentityEnabled) {
            rely.putBoolean("carrier_override_supported", CarrierConfigGlobalController.supportsOwnedOverrides())
        }
        return true
    }

    internal fun publish(values: Map<String, Any?>): RuntimeSnapshot {
        val store = FakeLoc.runtimeSnapshots
        val prepared = PreparedRuntimeConfiguration.prepare(values, store.current().configuration.gnssSource)
        val published = FakeLoc.configureRuntime(prepared)
        runCatching { CarrierConfigGlobalController.onConfigurationChanged(published) }
            .onFailure {
                CarrierConfigGlobalController.recordFailure()
                com.system.location.service.hook.utils.Logger.warn("Global carrier identity failed: ${it.message}")
            }
        return published
    }
}
```
