`xposed/src/main/java/com/system/location/service/hook/ControlCommand.kt`:

```kt
package com.system.location.service.hook

import android.os.Bundle
import com.system.location.service.hook.hooks.LocationServiceHook
import com.system.location.service.hook.utils.FakeLoc
import com.system.location.service.core.geo.Wgs84
import com.system.location.service.core.runtime.RuntimeStart

/** P5-08: simple control/getter commands extracted from RemoteCommandHandler. */
object ControlCommand {
    private val startKeys = setOf("lat", "lon", "speed", "altitude", "accuracy", "report_interval")

    private inline fun <reified T> typed(values: Map<String, Any?>, key: String): T? {
        if (key !in values) return null
        return values[key] as? T ?: throw IllegalArgumentException("Invalid start field: $key")
    }

    internal fun prepareStart(values: Map<String, Any?>): RuntimeStart = RuntimeStart(
        Wgs84(typed<Double>(values, "lat") ?: throw IllegalArgumentException("Missing latitude"),
            typed<Double>(values, "lon") ?: throw IllegalArgumentException("Missing longitude")),
        typed<Double>(values, "speed"), typed<Double>(values, "altitude"), typed<Float>(values, "accuracy"),
        typed<Long>(values, "report_interval") ?: 100L,
    )

    @Suppress("DEPRECATION")
    fun start(rely: Bundle): Boolean {
        val prepared = prepareStart(startKeys.filter(rely::containsKey).associateWith { rely.get(it) })
        FakeLoc.startRuntime(prepared)
        runCatching {
            com.system.location.service.hook.hooks.telephony.CarrierConfigGlobalController
                .onConfigurationChanged(FakeLoc.runtimeSnapshots.current())
        }
        SampleCommand.clearLease()
        if (FakeLoc.isSystemServerProcess) {
            LocationServiceHook.callOnLocationChanged()
            LocationTicker.start()
        }
        return true
    }

    fun stop(): Boolean {
        FakeLoc.stopRuntime()
        SampleCommand.clearLease()
        LocationTicker.stop()
        NativeCommand.disable()
        runCatching {
            com.system.location.service.hook.hooks.telephony.CarrierConfigGlobalController
                .onSimulationStopped()
        }
        return true
    }

    fun isStart(rely: Bundle): Boolean {
        rely.putBoolean("is_start", FakeLoc.enable)
        return true
    }

    fun setGnssMock(enabled: Boolean): Boolean {
        FakeLoc.enableMockGnss = enabled
        return true
    }

    fun isGnssMock(rely: Bundle): Boolean {
        rely.putBoolean("is_gnss_start", FakeLoc.enableMockGnss)
        return true
    }

    fun setWifiMock(enabled: Boolean): Boolean {
        FakeLoc.enableMockWifi = enabled
        return true
    }

    fun isWifiMock(rely: Bundle): Boolean {
        rely.putBoolean("is_wifi_mock_start", FakeLoc.enableMockWifi)
        return true
    }

    fun location(rely: Bundle): Boolean {
        val point = FakeLoc.coordinatePair()
        rely.putDouble("lat", point.first)
        rely.putDouble("lon", point.second)
        return true
    }

    fun listenerSize(rely: Bundle): Boolean {
        rely.putInt("size", LocationServiceHook.locationListeners.size)
        return true
    }

    fun speed(rely: Bundle): Boolean {
        rely.putDouble("speed", FakeLoc.speed)
        return true
    }

    fun bearing(rely: Bundle): Boolean {
        rely.putDouble("bearing", FakeLoc.bearing)
        return true
    }

    fun altitude(rely: Bundle): Boolean {
        rely.putDouble("altitude", FakeLoc.altitude)
        return true
    }

    internal fun publishNumber(key: String, raw: Any?): com.system.location.service.core.runtime.RuntimeSnapshot {
        require(raw is Double && raw.isFinite()) { "Invalid numeric control field: $key" }
        if (key == "speed") require(raw in 0.0..com.system.location.service.core.location.LocationSanitizer.MAX_SPEED_MPS)
        return FakeLoc.runtimeSnapshots.update { current ->
            val next = when (key) {
                "speed" -> current.copy(speedMps = raw)
                "altitude" -> current.copy(altitudeMeters = raw)
                "bearing" -> current.copy(bearingDeg = raw, hasBearings = true)
                else -> error("Unknown numeric control field")
            }
            next.copy(configRevision = Math.addExact(current.configRevision, 1L))
        }
    }

    @Suppress("DEPRECATION")
    private fun setNumber(rely: Bundle, key: String): Boolean {
        publishNumber(key, rely.get(key))
        return true
    }

    fun setAltitude(rely: Bundle) = setNumber(rely, "altitude")
    fun setSpeed(rely: Bundle) = setNumber(rely, "speed")
    fun setBearing(rely: Bundle) = setNumber(rely, "bearing")
}
```

`xposed/src/main/java/com/system/location/service/hook/DiagnosticCommand.kt`:

```kt
package com.system.location.service.hook

import android.os.Bundle
import com.system.location.service.hook.scope.HookOwnership
import com.system.location.service.hook.scope.HookStatusRegistry
import com.system.location.service.hook.security.SampleWire
import com.system.location.service.hook.utils.FakeLoc
import java.util.ArrayList

/** P5-08: diagnostics command extracted from RemoteCommandHandler. */
object DiagnosticCommand {
    fun status(rely: Bundle, lastPublishMillis: Long): Boolean {
        rely.putInt("sample_version", SampleWire.VERSION)
        rely.putInt("sample_min_version", SampleWire.MIN_SUPPORTED)
        val store = FakeLoc.runtimeSnapshots
        val observed = store.observation()
        // These three fields describe one atomic observation. A stopped response alone cannot
        // detect a complete start/stop between real receiver collection checks.
        rely.putBoolean("is_start", observed.state.configuration.enabled)
        rely.putString("runtime_instance", store.instanceId)
        rely.putLong("simulation_generation", observed.simulationGeneration)
        rely.putLong("last_publish", lastPublishMillis)
        val statuses = HookStatusRegistry.snapshot()
        val scope = HookStatusRegistry.scope()
        val ownership = scope?.let { HookOwnership.audit(it, statuses) }
        rely.putInt("hook_installed", statuses.values.count { it.installed })
        rely.putInt("hook_matched", statuses.values.count { it.matched })
        rely.putInt("hook_failed", statuses.values.count { it.failed })
        rely.putInt("hook_skipped", statuses.values.count { it.skipped })
        rely.putString("hook_scope", scope?.name ?: "unknown")
        rely.putInt("hook_expected", ownership?.expected?.size ?: 0)
        rely.putInt("hook_missing", ownership?.missing?.size ?: 0)
        rely.putBoolean("native_loaded", NativeCommand.isLoaded)
        rely.putBoolean("native_enabled", NativeCommand.isEnabled)
        SampleCommand.publishStats()?.let { stats ->
            rely.putInt("publish_samples", stats.samples)
            rely.putLong("publish_p50_nanos", stats.p50Nanos)
            rely.putLong("publish_p95_nanos", stats.p95Nanos)
            rely.putLong("publish_max_nanos", stats.maxNanos)
            rely.putLong("publish_mean_nanos", stats.meanNanos)
        }
        rely.putStringArrayList("hook_missing_points", ArrayList(ownership?.missing.orEmpty()))
        rely.putStringArrayList("hook_details", ArrayList(statuses.entries.take(128).map { (point, status) ->
            "$point: supported=${status.supported}, installed=${status.installed}, matched=${status.matched}, " +
                "skipped=${status.skipped}, failed=${status.failed}; ${status.reason.orEmpty()}"
        }))
        return true
    }
}
```

```kt
@file:Suppress("LocalVariableName", "PrivateApi", "UNCHECKED_CAST")
package com.system.location.service.hook

import com.system.location.service.hook.runtime.Reflection
import com.system.location.service.hook.hooks.LocationManagerHook
import com.system.location.service.hook.hooks.LocationServiceHook
import com.system.location.service.hook.hooks.fused.AndroidFusedLocationProviderHook
import com.system.location.service.hook.hooks.fused.ThirdPartyLocationHook
import com.system.location.service.hook.hooks.oplus.OplusLocationHook
import com.system.location.service.hook.hooks.telephony.miui.MiuiTelephonyManagerHook
import com.system.location.service.hook.hooks.sensor.SystemSensorManagerHook
import com.system.location.service.hook.hooks.telephony.CarrierSubscriptionHook
import com.system.location.service.hook.hooks.telephony.TelephonyHook
import com.system.location.service.hook.hooks.wlan.WlanHook
import com.system.location.service.hook.hooks.LocationAvailabilityHook
import com.system.location.service.hook.hooks.provider.ProviderRegistryHook
import com.system.location.service.hook.hooks.pkg.PackageMetadataHook
import com.system.location.service.hook.privacy.AppOpsHook
import com.system.location.service.hook.privacy.SettingsHook
import com.system.location.service.hook.privacy.StackTraceCleanHook
import com.system.location.service.hook.utils.FakeLoc
import com.system.location.service.hook.utils.Logger

class FakeLocation {
    private lateinit var cServiceManager: Class<*> // android.os.ServiceManager
    private val mServiceManagerCache by lazy {
        kotlin.runCatching { cServiceManager.getDeclaredField("sCache") }.onSuccess {
            it.isAccessible = true
        }.getOrNull()
        // the field is not guaranteed to exist
    }

    /**
     * Entry point shared by the modern libxposed callbacks.
     */
    fun install(
        processName: String,
        packageName: String,
        classLoader: ClassLoader,
        uid: Int,
        appFlags: Int = 0,
    ) {
        val identity = com.system.location.service.hook.scope.ProcessIdentity(
            packageName, processName, uid,
            android.os.Build.VERSION.SDK_INT, android.os.Build.MANUFACTURER,
        )
        // This callback is already restricted by the framework's explicitly selected scope.
        val targets = if (packageName != "com.system.location.service" &&
            appFlags and android.content.pm.ApplicationInfo.FLAG_SYSTEM == 0)
            setOf(packageName) else emptySet()
        val scope = com.system.location.service.hook.scope.HookScopeResolver.resolve(identity, targets)
        if (packageName == "com.android.systemui" && processName == packageName) {
            runCatching {
                com.system.location.service.hook.hooks.telephony.CarrierClientHook.install(classLoader)
                com.system.location.service.hook.hooks.telephony.CarrierStatusBarHook.install(classLoader)
            }.onFailure { Logger.error("SystemUI carrier getter installation failed", it) }
            return
        }
        if (packageName == "miui.systemui.plugin") {
            runCatching {
                com.system.location.service.hook.hooks.telephony.CarrierClientHook.install(classLoader)
                com.system.location.service.hook.hooks.telephony.CarrierStatusBarHook.install(classLoader)
            }.onFailure { Logger.error("MIUI carrier installation failed", it) }
            return
        }
        val status = com.system.location.service.hook.scope.HookStatusRegistry
        android.util.Log.i("PortalModule", "install process=$processName package=$packageName uid=$uid scope=$scope hooks=${status.snapshot().size}")
        com.system.location.service.hook.runtime.HookRuntime.log("install process=$processName package=$packageName uid=$uid scope=$scope hooks=${status.snapshot().size}")
        if (scope == null) {
            status.record("process:${identity.processName}", com.system.location.service.hook.scope.HookStatus(
                skipped = true, reason = "Outside supported process scope (SDK ${identity.sdk})"))
            return
        }
        status.recordScope(scope)
        status.record("process:${identity.processName}", com.system.location.service.hook.scope.HookStatus(supported = true))
        val loader = classLoader
        fun install(name: String, action: () -> Unit) {
            runCatching(action).onFailure {
                status.record(name, com.system.location.service.hook.scope.HookStatus(supported = true,
                    failed = true, reason = it.javaClass.simpleName))
                Logger.error("Hook installation failed: $name", it)
            }
        }
        // Opt-in and runtime-gated: install in every scope so a later configuration change takes
        // effect without a process restart; the hook body checks the flag on every call.
        install("stack-trace-clean") { StackTraceCleanHook.install(loader) }
        when (scope) {
            com.system.location.service.hook.scope.HookScope.SYSTEM_SERVER -> {
                FakeLoc.isSystemServerProcess = true
                install("system-location") { startFakeLocHook(loader) }
                install("appops") { AppOpsHook.hook(loader) }
                install("provider-registry") { ProviderRegistryHook.hook(loader) }
                install("availability") { LocationAvailabilityHook.hook(loader) }
                install("telephony-registry") { TelephonyHook.hookSubOnTransact(loader) }
                install("carrier-subscription") { CarrierSubscriptionHook.install(loader) }
                install("wifi") { WlanHook(loader) }
                install("fused") { AndroidFusedLocationProviderHook(loader) }
                install("sensor") { SystemSensorManagerHook(loader) }
                install("system-sdk") { ThirdPartyLocationHook(loader) }
                // Some ROMs host SettingsProvider inside system_server; the Settings-provider
                // scope still handles the separate-process case.
                install("settings") { SettingsHook.hook(loader) }
                install("package-metadata") { PackageMetadataHook.hook(loader) }
            }
            com.system.location.service.hook.scope.HookScope.PHONE_PROCESS -> {
                install("phone") { TelephonyHook(loader) }
                // Phone owns physical telephony initialization. Client-side getters synchronously
                // query system_server, which can call phone back for subscription information.
                // Keep that cyclic Binder path out of the infrastructure process; its exported
                // PhoneInterfaceManager hooks above still serve application carrier queries.
            }
            com.system.location.service.hook.scope.HookScope.FUSED_PROCESS -> {
                install("fused") { AndroidFusedLocationProviderHook(loader) }
            }
            com.system.location.service.hook.scope.HookScope.VENDOR_LOCATION_PROCESS -> {
                if (identity.packageName == "com.oplus.location") {
                    install("oplus") { OplusLocationHook(loader) }
                } else {
                    install("xiaomi") { ThirdPartyLocationHook(loader) }
                }
            }
            com.system.location.service.hook.scope.HookScope.SETTINGS_PROVIDER -> {
                install("settings") { SettingsHook.hook(loader) }
            }
            com.system.location.service.hook.scope.HookScope.TARGET_APP -> {
                install("application-carrier-identity") {
                    com.system.location.service.hook.hooks.telephony.CarrierClientHook.install(loader)
                }
                install("application-ble-scan") {
                    com.system.location.service.hook.hooks.ble.BleScanHook.install(
                        loader, identity.packageName, identity.uid,
                    )
                }
                install("application-network-transport-info") {
                    WlanHook.installTargetApp(loader, identity.packageName, identity.uid)
                }
                install("application-cellinfo") {
                    com.system.location.service.hook.hooks.telephony.CellInfoAsyncCallbackHook.install(
                        loader, identity.packageName, identity.uid,
                    )
                }
                install("application-sensor") {
                    com.system.location.service.hook.hooks.sensor.ApplicationSensorHook.install(loader)
                }
                install("application-anti-detect") {
                    com.system.location.service.hook.antidetect.AntiDetectController.start()
                }
            }
        }
    }
    private fun startFakeLocHook(classLoader: ClassLoader) {
        cServiceManager = Reflection.findClass("android.os.ServiceManager", classLoader)

        Reflection.findClassIfExists("com.android.server.TelephonyRegistry", classLoader)?.let {
            TelephonyHook.hookTelephonyRegistry(it)
        } // for MUMU emulator

        val cLocationManager =
            Reflection.findClass("android.location.LocationManager", classLoader)

        LocationServiceHook(classLoader)
        LocationManagerHook(cLocationManager)  // intrusive hooks
    }
}
```

`xposed/src/main/java/com/system/location/service/hook/LocationCommand.kt`:

```kt
package com.system.location.service.hook

import android.os.Bundle
import com.system.location.service.hook.hooks.LocationServiceHook
import com.system.location.service.core.runtime.RuntimeTransferWire
import com.system.location.service.hook.utils.FakeLoc
import kotlin.random.Random
import com.system.location.service.core.geo.Wgs84
import com.system.location.service.core.runtime.RuntimeSnapshot
import com.system.location.service.core.runtime.RuntimePositionUpdate

/** P5-08: update/broadcast/sync commands extracted from RemoteCommandHandler. */
object LocationCommand {
    private val positionKeys = setOf("mode", "lat", "lon", "moving_speed", "bearing")

    private fun number(values: Map<String, Any?>, key: String): Double =
        (values[key] as? Double)?.also { require(it.isFinite()) } ?: error("Missing numeric field: $key")

    internal fun prepareMove(values: Map<String, Any?>, state: RuntimeSnapshot): RuntimePositionUpdate {
        require(state.configuration.enabled)
        val distance = number(values, "n").also { require(it >= 0) }
        val bearing = number(values, "bearing")
        val point = FakeLoc.moveLocation(state.latitude, state.longitude, distance, bearing)
        return RuntimePositionUpdate(Wgs84(point.first, point.second),
            if (distance > 0) state.speedMps.toFloat() else 0f, bearing)
    }

    @Suppress("DEPRECATION")
    fun normalizeMove(rely: Bundle, commandId: String): String? {
        if (commandId != "move") return commandId
        val state = FakeLoc.runtimeSnapshots.current()
        if (!state.configuration.enabled) return null
        val update = prepareMove(setOf("n", "bearing").associateWith { rely.get(it) }, state)
        rely.putString("command_id", "update_location")
        rely.putString("mode", "=")
        rely.putDouble("lat", update.coordinate.latitude)
        rely.putDouble("lon", update.coordinate.longitude)
        rely.putFloat("moving_speed", update.movementSpeedMps)
        return "update_location"
    }

    internal fun prepareUpdate(values: Map<String, Any?>, state: RuntimeSnapshot): RuntimePositionUpdate {
        val mode = values["mode"] as? String ?: error("Missing position mode")
        val bearing = if ("bearing" in values) number(values, "bearing") else null
        val speed = if ("moving_speed" in values) values["moving_speed"] as? Float
            ?: error("Invalid movement speed") else 0f
        val point = if (mode == "random") Wgs84(Random.nextDouble(-90.0, 90.0), Random.nextDouble(-180.0, 180.0)) else {
            val lat = number(values, "lat")
            val lon = number(values, "lon")
            when (mode) {
                "=" -> Wgs84(lat, lon)
                "+" -> Wgs84(state.latitude + lat, state.longitude + lon)
                "-" -> Wgs84(state.latitude - lat, state.longitude - lon)
                "*" -> Wgs84(state.latitude * lat, state.longitude * lon)
                "/" -> {
                    require(lat != 0.0 && lon != 0.0)
                    Wgs84(state.latitude / lat, state.longitude / lon)
                }
                else -> error("Unknown position mode")
            }
        }
        return RuntimePositionUpdate(point, speed, bearing)
    }

    @Suppress("DEPRECATION")
    fun update(rely: Bundle): Boolean {
        val update = prepareUpdate(positionKeys.filter(rely::containsKey).associateWith { rely.get(it) },
            FakeLoc.runtimeSnapshots.current())
        FakeLoc.updateCoordinates(update.coordinate.latitude, update.coordinate.longitude, update.movementSpeedMps,
            bearingDeg = update.bearingDeg)
        if (FakeLoc.enable && FakeLoc.isSystemServerProcess) LocationServiceHook.callOnLocationChanged()
        return true
    }

    fun broadcast(): Boolean {
        LocationServiceHook.callOnLocationChanged()
        return true
    }

    /** Diagnostic full snapshot only; live initialization uses atomic subscription instead. */
    fun sync(rely: Bundle): Boolean {
        rely.putByteArray(RuntimeSyncCommand.PAYLOAD, RuntimeTransferWire.encode(FakeLoc.captureTransfer()))
        return true
    }

}
```

```kt
package com.system.location.service.hook

import com.system.location.service.hook.hooks.LocationServiceHook
import com.system.location.service.hook.runtime.DeliveryWorker
import com.system.location.service.hook.utils.FakeLoc
import com.system.location.service.hook.utils.Logger

/** One system-side publisher; delivery continues when the UI is backgrounded. */
object LocationTicker {
    private val worker = DeliveryWorker("LocationPublisher",
        intervalMillis = { FakeLoc.reportIntervalMs.coerceIn(50, 1000) },
        delayFirstTick = true,
        tick = {
            if (RemoteCommandHandler.expirePublication(android.os.SystemClock.elapsedRealtimeNanos())) {
                stop()
            } else if (FakeLoc.enable && FakeLoc.isSystemServerProcess && !FakeLoc.externallyDriven) {
                LocationServiceHook.callOnLocationChanged()
            }
        },
        failure = { Logger.error("Location publisher failed", it) })

    fun start() = worker.start()

    fun stop(): Boolean = worker.stop()
}
```

`xposed/src/main/java/com/system/location/service/hook/NativeCommand.kt`:

```kt
package com.system.location.service.hook

import android.os.Bundle
import com.system.location.service.hook.utils.FakeLoc
import com.system.location.service.jni.Dobby

/** P5-08: native library lifecycle extracted from RemoteCommandHandler. */
object NativeCommand {
    @Volatile internal var sensorGeneration = 0L
        private set
    @Volatile
    var isLoaded = false
        private set

    @Volatile
    var isEnabled = false
        private set

    fun load(rely: Bundle): Boolean {
        val path = rely.getString("path") ?: return false
        if (!FakeLoc.isSystemServerProcess || path != "/data/local/ext-lib/liblocationext.so") return false
        if (isLoaded && path.endsWith("liblocationext.so")) {
            rely.putString("result", "success")
            return true
        }
        runCatching { System.load(path) }
            .onSuccess {
                rely.putString("result", "success")
                isLoaded = true
            }
            .onFailure { rely.putString("result", it.stackTraceToString()) }
        return true
    }

    @Synchronized fun prepare(): Boolean {
        if (!FakeLoc.isSystemServerProcess || !isLoaded) return false
        Dobby.setStatus(false)
        isEnabled = false
        sensorGeneration++
        com.system.location.service.hook.hooks.sensor.NativeSensorTicker.stop()
        return Dobby.prepareSensors()
    }

    @Synchronized fun setEnabled(enabled: Boolean): Boolean {
        if (!FakeLoc.isSystemServerProcess) return false
        if (!isLoaded) return !enabled
        if (enabled == isEnabled) return true
        Dobby.setStatus(false)
        isEnabled = enabled
        sensorGeneration++
        if (enabled) com.system.location.service.hook.hooks.sensor.NativeSensorTicker.start()
        else com.system.location.service.hook.hooks.sensor.NativeSensorTicker.stop()
        return true
    }

    fun setEnabled(rely: Bundle): Boolean = setEnabled(rely.getBoolean("enabled"))

    fun setSensorFrame(
        frame: com.system.location.service.core.sensors.SensorFrame,
        syncNanos: Long,
    ) {
        if (isLoaded) {
            Dobby.setSensorFrame(
                frame.stepCount,
                frame.stepCadence,
                syncNanos,
                frame.accelerometer,
                frame.gyroscope,
                frame.magnetometer,
                frame.barometerHpa,
            )
        }
    }

    @Synchronized internal fun applySensorTick(generation: Long,
        frame: com.system.location.service.core.sensors.SensorFrame?, nowNanos: Long) {
        if (!isLoaded || !isEnabled || generation != sensorGeneration) return
        if (frame != null) setSensorFrame(frame, nowNanos)
        Dobby.setStatus(frame != null)
    }

    @Synchronized fun disable() {
        if (isLoaded) Dobby.setStatus(false)
        isEnabled = false
        sensorGeneration++
        com.system.location.service.hook.hooks.sensor.NativeSensorTicker.stop()
    }
}
```

`xposed/src/main/java/com/system/location/service/hook/PortalModule.kt`:

```kt
package com.system.location.service.hook

import android.os.Bundle
import com.system.location.service.hook.runtime.HookRuntime
import com.system.location.service.hook.scope.HookStatusRegistry
import io.github.libxposed.api.XposedModule
import io.github.libxposed.api.XposedModuleInterface
import com.system.location.service.core.gnss.GnssBundledOrbitResources
import com.system.location.service.core.runtime.RuntimeTransferWire
import com.system.location.service.hook.runtime.ReloadExecutionGate
import com.system.location.service.hook.runtime.ReloadPreparation
import com.system.location.service.hook.hooks.LocationServiceHook
import com.system.location.service.hook.hooks.gnss.GnssListenerRouting
import com.system.location.service.hook.hooks.gnss.RawGnssCallbacks
import com.system.location.service.hook.hooks.nmea.NmeaListenerRouting
import com.system.location.service.hook.hooks.nmea.installNmeaCallback
import com.system.location.service.hook.runtime.CallbackSubscription
import com.system.location.service.hook.utils.FakeLoc

/** System hooks wait for the framework's system-server classloader. */
class PortalModule : XposedModule() {
    private var processName: String = ""
    private val lifecycle = ModuleInstallScheduler(installSystemPackageHooks = { pkg, loader ->
        HookRuntime.attach(this)
        HookRuntime.log("shared system package ready: package=$pkg loader=${loader.javaClass.name}")
        val installed = runCatching {
            when (pkg) {
                "com.android.providers.settings" -> com.system.location.service.hook.privacy.SettingsHook.hook(loader)
                "com.android.location.fused" -> com.system.location.service.hook.hooks.fused.AndroidFusedLocationProviderHook(loader)
                else -> false
            }
        }.onFailure { HookRuntime.log(it) }.getOrDefault(false)
        HookRuntime.log("shared system package hooks: package=$pkg installed=$installed")
        installed
    }) { process, pkg, loader, uid, flags ->
        HookRuntime.attach(this)
        FakeLocation().install(process, pkg, loader, uid, flags)
    }

    private fun isSystemProcess(): Boolean =
        lifecycle.isSystemServer ||
            processName == "system" || processName == "system_server" ||
            currentProcessName() == "system" || currentProcessName() == "system_server"

    private fun currentProcessName(): String = runCatching {
        java.io.File("/proc/self/cmdline").readText().trimEnd('\u0000')
    }.getOrDefault("")

    override fun onModuleLoaded(param: XposedModuleInterface.ModuleLoadedParam) {
        processName = param.processName
        moduleInfo = runCatching { getModuleApplicationInfo() }.getOrNull()
        GnssBundledOrbitResources.installExternalReader(::readModuleResource)
        HookRuntime.attach(this)
        lifecycle.moduleLoaded(param.processName, param.isSystemServer)
        android.util.Log.i("PortalModule", "Module loaded: process=${param.processName} system=${param.isSystemServer} api=$apiVersion")
    }

    override fun onSystemServerStarting(param: XposedModuleInterface.SystemServerStartingParam) {
        android.util.Log.i("PortalModule", "System server starting: loader=${param.classLoader.javaClass.name}")
        lifecycle.systemServerStarting(param.classLoader)
    }

    override fun onPackageReady(param: XposedModuleInterface.PackageReadyParam) {
        // The framework may report the shared android package before the actual phone/fused
        // package. Scope resolution, rather than isFirstPackage, decides which package to install.
        if (isSystemProcess()) {
            // Shared-process packages may only become visible through their own package loader.
            // Framework system scope covers these even when it removes their individual scopes.
            lifecycle.systemPackageReady(param.packageName, param.classLoader)
            return
        }
        android.util.Log.i("PortalModule", "Package ready: package=${param.packageName} first=${param.isFirstPackage}")
        if (moduleInfo == null) {
            moduleInfo = runCatching { getModuleApplicationInfo() }.getOrNull()
            GnssBundledOrbitResources.installExternalReader(::readModuleResource)
        }
        lifecycle.packageReady(param.packageName, param.classLoader,
            param.applicationInfo.uid, param.applicationInfo.flags)
    }

    override fun onHotReloading(param: XposedModuleInterface.HotReloadingParam): Boolean {
        // Native Dobby hooks cannot be unloaded; require a process restart once they are active.
        if (!HotReloadPolicy.allowed(isSystemProcess(), NativeCommand.isLoaded)) {
            android.util.Log.i("PortalModule", "hot reload rejected: system=${isSystemProcess()} native=${NativeCommand.isLoaded} process=${currentProcessName()}")
            return false
        }
        val gate = HookRuntime.executionGate
        if (!runCatching { gate.freeze(2000) }.getOrElse { HookRuntime.log(it); false }) return false
        return ReloadPreparation.prepare(
            pauseLocation = { LocationTicker.stop() },
            pauseGnss = { com.system.location.service.hook.hooks.gnss.GnssSignalInjection.pause() },
            save = {
                val state = Bundle().apply {
                    putByteArray("runtime", RuntimeTransferWire.encode(FakeLoc.captureTransfer()))
                    putParcelableArrayList("location", ArrayList(LocationServiceHook.locationSubscriptions().map { it.toBundle() }))
                    putParcelableArrayList("gnss", ArrayList(GnssListenerRouting.subscriptions().map { it.toBundle() }))
                    putParcelableArrayList("nmea", ArrayList(NmeaListenerRouting.subscriptions().map { it.toBundle() }))
                    putParcelableArrayList("raw", ArrayList(RawGnssCallbacks.subscriptions().map { it.toBundle() }))
                    putParcelableArrayList("peers", ArrayList(ProxyCommand.subscriptions().map { it.toBundle() }))
                    putParcelableArrayList("carrier_listeners", com.system.location.service.hook.hooks.telephony
                        .CarrierRegistryHook.saveReloadState())
                    putLong("peer_sequence", ProxyCommand.publicationSequence())
                    putBundle("carrier_identity", com.system.location.service.hook.hooks.telephony
                        .CarrierConfigGlobalController.saveReloadState())
                    putString("process", "system_server")
                    putString("package", "android")
                    putInt("uid", 1000)
                    putInt("flags", 0)
                }
                // This API transfers objects within this process; it does not parcel them.
                // Share the drained platform monitor/counters so queued old interceptors see
                // the successor generation. Copying them into a Bundle splits the gate.
                param.setSavedInstanceState(arrayOf(state, gate.transferState(), lifecycle.systemPackageLoaders()))
                // The saved subscriptions contain framework Binders, not old module objects.
                // Drop our old death recipients/mailboxes once the framework accepts the state;
                // otherwise BinderProxy would keep every retired classloader alive. Complete
                // all retirements even if one cleanup fails, without resuming a partial old table.
                listOf<() -> Unit>(
                    { LocationServiceHook.retireLocationSubscriptions() },
                    { GnssListenerRouting.clear() },
                    { NmeaListenerRouting.clear() },
                    { RawGnssCallbacks.clear() },
                    { ProxyCommand.retireSubscriptions() },
                    { com.system.location.service.hook.hooks.telephony.CarrierRegistryHook.retire() },
                ).forEach { retire -> runCatching(retire).onFailure { HookRuntime.log(it) } }
                android.util.Log.i("PortalModule", "hot reloading system_server")
        }, abort = {
            try { gate.resume() } finally {
                val configuration = FakeLoc.runtimeSnapshots.current().configuration
                try {
                    if (configuration.enabled) LocationTicker.start()
                } finally {
                    if (configuration.gnssEnabled) com.system.location.service.hook.hooks.gnss.GnssSignalInjection.ensureStarted()
                }
            }
        })
    }

    override fun onHotReloaded(param: XposedModuleInterface.HotReloadedParam) {
        if (!param.isSystemServer && !isSystemProcess()) return
        val transferred = param.getSavedInstanceState()
        val handoff = transferred as? Array<*>
        // Preserve configuration/subscriptions when upgrading from the previous Bundle format.
        val saved = handoff?.getOrNull(0) as? Bundle ?: transferred as? Bundle
        @Suppress("UNCHECKED_CAST")
        val gateState = handoff?.getOrNull(1) as? Array<Any>
        try {
            if (gateState != null) HookRuntime.executionGate = ReloadExecutionGate.adopt(gateState)
            param.oldHookHandles.forEach { runCatching { it.unhook() } }
            HookRuntime.attach(this)
            HookRuntime.clearHooks()
            HookStatusRegistry.reset()
            val loader = ClassLoader.getSystemClassLoader()
            android.util.Log.i("PortalModule", "hot reloaded system_server loader=${loader.javaClass.name}")
            saved?.getByteArray("runtime")?.let {
                val restored = FakeLoc.restoreRuntime(RuntimeTransferWire.decode(it), android.os.SystemClock.elapsedRealtimeNanos())
                SampleCommand.restoreLease(restored.state.sample, android.os.SystemClock.elapsedRealtimeNanos())
            }
            com.system.location.service.hook.hooks.telephony.CarrierConfigGlobalController
                .restoreReloadState(saved?.getBundle("carrier_identity"))
            lifecycle.systemServerStarting(loader)
            lifecycle.restoreSystemPackages(handoff?.getOrNull(2))
            com.system.location.service.hook.hooks.telephony.CarrierRegistryHook
                .restoreReloadState(saved?.getParcelableArrayList<Bundle>("carrier_listeners").orEmpty())
            restoreCallbacks(saved)
            ProxyCommand.restorePublicationSequence(saved?.getLong("peer_sequence") ?: 0L)
            restorePeers(saved)
            if (FakeLoc.runtimeSnapshots.current().configuration.enabled) LocationTicker.start()
            if (FakeLoc.runtimeSnapshots.current().configuration.gnssEnabled) com.system.location.service.hook.hooks.gnss.GnssSignalInjection.ensureStarted()
        } finally {
            // A restore error must not leave every old-snapshot call blocked forever.
            runCatching { HookRuntime.executionGate.resume() }
        }
    }

    private fun restoreCallbacks(saved: Bundle?) {
        fun rows(key: String) = saved?.getParcelableArrayList<Bundle>(key).orEmpty().mapNotNull {
            runCatching { CallbackSubscription.fromBundle(it) }.getOrNull()
        }
        rows("location").let(LocationServiceHook::restoreLocationSubscriptions)
        rows("gnss").forEach { if (GnssListenerRouting.restore(it)) LocationServiceHook.installGnssStatusCallback(it.listener) }
        rows("nmea").forEach { if (NmeaListenerRouting.restore(it)) installNmeaCallback(it.listener) }
        rows("raw").forEach(RawGnssCallbacks::restoreAndInstall)
    }

    /** Read a bundled core resource from the module APK when the injected loader has no resources. */
    private fun moduleApkPath(): String? = moduleInfo?.sourceDir ?: runCatching {
        val context = com.system.location.service.hook.utils.BinderUtils.getSystemContext()
            ?: return@runCatching null
        val packageName = javaClass.packageName.substringBeforeLast('.')
        context.packageManager.getApplicationInfo(packageName, 0).sourceDir
    }.getOrNull()

    private fun readModuleResource(name: String): String? = runCatching {
        val path = moduleApkPath() ?: return@runCatching null
        java.util.zip.ZipFile(path).use { zip ->
            val entry = zip.getEntry("gnss/$name") ?: return@runCatching null
            zip.getInputStream(entry).bufferedReader(Charsets.UTF_8).use { it.readText() }
        }
    }.getOrNull()

    companion object {
        /** Module APK metadata; used to locate the opt-in anti-detect payload. */
        @Volatile
        var moduleInfo: android.content.pm.ApplicationInfo? = null
            private set
    }

    private fun restorePeers(saved: Bundle?) {
        saved?.getParcelableArrayList<Bundle>("peers").orEmpty().forEach { row ->
            @Suppress("DEPRECATION")
            val binder = row.getBinder("binder") ?: return@forEach
            val subscription = RuntimePeerRegistry.Subscription(
                row.getInt("uid"), row.getString("name") ?: return@forEach,
                row.getString("session") ?: return@forEach, binder,
            )
            ProxyCommand.restore(subscription)
        }
        ProxyCommand.publishCurrent()
    }
}

/**
 * Hot reload is safe only where hook state and generation cleanup are process-local. system_server
 * owns that lifecycle; app processes still need a restart. Native Dobby hooks cannot be unloaded.
 */
internal object HotReloadPolicy {
    fun allowed(isSystemProcess: Boolean, nativeLoaded: Boolean): Boolean =
        isSystemProcess && !nativeLoaded
}

/** Keeps lifecycle ordering and package idempotence independent of Android installation details. */
internal class ModuleInstallScheduler(
    private val installSystemPackageHooks: (String, ClassLoader) -> Boolean = { _, _ -> false },
    private val installHooks: (String, String, ClassLoader, Int, Int) -> Unit,
) {
    private var processName = ""
    var isSystemServer = false
        private set
    private val installedPackages = mutableSetOf<String>()
    private val readySystemPackages = mutableMapOf<String, ClassLoader>()
    private val installedSystemPackages = mutableSetOf<String>()

    fun moduleLoaded(process: String, systemServer: Boolean) {
        processName = process
        isSystemServer = systemServer
    }

    @Synchronized
    fun systemServerStarting(loader: ClassLoader) {
        install("system_server", "android", loader, 1000, 0)
        readySystemPackages.toMap().forEach { (pkg, packageLoader) -> systemPackageReady(pkg, packageLoader) }
    }

    @Synchronized
    fun systemPackageReady(pkg: String, loader: ClassLoader) {
        if (pkg !in setOf("com.android.providers.settings", "com.android.location.fused")) return
        readySystemPackages[pkg] = loader
        if ("android" !in installedPackages || pkg in installedSystemPackages) return
        if (installSystemPackageHooks(pkg, loader)) installedSystemPackages.add(pkg)
    }

    /** Framework handoff stays within this process; only platform types cross module generations. */
    @Synchronized
    fun systemPackageLoaders(): Array<Array<Any>> =
        readySystemPackages.map { (pkg, loader) -> arrayOf<Any>(pkg, loader) }.toTypedArray()

    fun restoreSystemPackages(state: Any?) {
        (state as? Array<*>)?.forEach { entry ->
            val pair = entry as? Array<*> ?: return@forEach
            val pkg = pair.getOrNull(0) as? String ?: return@forEach
            val loader = pair.getOrNull(1) as? ClassLoader ?: return@forEach
            systemPackageReady(pkg, loader)
        }
    }

    fun packageReady(pkg: String, loader: ClassLoader, uid: Int, flags: Int) {
        if (isSystemServer) return
        install(processName.ifBlank { pkg }, pkg, loader, uid, flags)
    }

    @Synchronized
    private fun install(process: String, pkg: String, loader: ClassLoader, uid: Int, flags: Int) {
        if (pkg in installedPackages) return
        installHooks(process, pkg, loader, uid, flags)
        installedPackages.add(pkg)
    }
}
```

`xposed/src/main/java/com/system/location/service/hook/ProxyCommand.kt`:

```kt
package com.system.location.service.hook

import android.os.Binder
import android.os.Bundle
import android.os.Parcel
import com.system.location.service.hook.utils.FakeLoc
import com.system.location.service.hook.utils.Logger
import com.system.location.service.core.runtime.RuntimeTransferWire

/** Ordered full-state replication; no control command is replayed in another process. */
object ProxyCommand {
    private val statePeers = RuntimePeerRegistry(deliver = { binder, session, publication ->
        val message = Bundle().apply {
            putString(RuntimeSyncCommand.SESSION, session)
            putLong(RuntimeSyncCommand.SEQUENCE, publication.sequence)
            putByteArray(RuntimeSyncCommand.PAYLOAD, RuntimeTransferWire.encode(publication.transfer))
        }
        val data = Parcel.obtain()
        val reply = Parcel.obtain()
        try {
            data.writeBundle(message)
            val identity = Binder.clearCallingIdentity()
            try {
                check(binder.transact(RuntimeSyncCommand.TRANSACTION, data, reply, 0)) { "Peer transaction rejected" }
                reply.readException()
                check(reply.readInt() == 1) { "Peer state rejected" }
            } finally { Binder.restoreCallingIdentity(identity) }
        } finally { data.recycle(); reply.recycle() }
    }, onFailure = { Logger.error("Runtime peer disconnected", it) })
    private var stateSequence = 0L

    /** Called within the authoritative command order, before any subsequent state publication. */
    @Synchronized fun subscribe(rely: Bundle): Boolean {
        if (!FakeLoc.isSystemServerProcess) return false
        val binder = rely.getBinder("proxy") ?: return false
        val name = rely.getString("proxy_name") ?: return false
        val session = rely.getString(RuntimeSyncCommand.SESSION) ?: return false
        if (!statePeers.register(Binder.getCallingUid(), name, session, binder)) return false
        publishCurrent()
        return true
    }

    @Synchronized fun publishCurrent() {
        if (!FakeLoc.isSystemServerProcess || statePeers.size() == 0) return
        stateSequence = Math.addExact(stateSequence, 1L)
        statePeers.offer(RuntimePeerRegistry.Publication(stateSequence, FakeLoc.captureTransfer()))
    }

    internal fun subscriptions(): List<RuntimePeerRegistry.Subscription> = statePeers.subscriptions()
    internal fun restore(subscription: RuntimePeerRegistry.Subscription): Boolean = statePeers.restore(subscription)
    /** Detach old-generation death recipients and pending replication after saving peers. */
    internal fun retireSubscriptions() = statePeers.clear()

    @Synchronized internal fun publicationSequence(): Long = stateSequence

    /** Existing peers retain their authenticated session and last accepted sequence on reload. */
    @Synchronized internal fun restorePublicationSequence(sequence: Long) {
        require(sequence >= 0)
        stateSequence = maxOf(stateSequence, sequence)
    }

}

```

`xposed/src/main/java/com/system/location/service/hook/RemoteCommandHandler.kt`:

```kt
package com.system.location.service.hook

import android.annotation.SuppressLint
import android.os.Bundle
import android.os.SystemClock
import com.system.location.service.hook.security.CommandSecurity
import com.system.location.service.hook.security.SampleWire
import com.system.location.service.hook.security.SensitiveLog
import com.system.location.service.hook.utils.FakeLoc
import com.system.location.service.hook.utils.BinderUtils
import com.system.location.service.hook.utils.Logger

object RemoteCommandHandler {

    private val security = CommandSecurity()
    private val replicatedCommands = setOf("start", "stop", "set_altitude", "set_speed",
        "update_location", "set_bearing", "put_config", "publish_sample", "start_gnss_mock", "stop_gnss_mock",
        "start_wifi_mock", "stop_wifi_mock")

    @SuppressLint("UnsafeDynamicallyLoadedCode")
    @Synchronized
    fun handleInstruction(command: String, rely: Bundle): Boolean {
        val uid = BinderUtils.getCallerUid()
        if (command == com.system.location.service.hook.hooks.sensor.SensorSnapshotCommand.COMMAND) {
            return runCatching {
                com.system.location.service.hook.hooks.sensor.SensorSnapshotCommand.read(uid, rely)
            }.getOrDefault(false)
        }
        val role = BinderUtils.callerRole(uid)
        if (command == "exchange_key") {
            val key = security.exchange(uid, role) ?: return false
            rely.putString("key", key)
            rely.putInt("protocol_version", CommandSecurity.VERSION)
            return true
        }
        if (!security.accept(uid, role, command, rely.getString("command_id"),
                rely.getInt("protocol_version"), rely.getLong("sequence"),
                rely.getLong("sent_at", -1), SystemClock.elapsedRealtime())) return false
        return runCatching { applyInstruction(rely) }.onFailure {
            Logger.error("Invalid remote command", it)
        }.getOrDefault(false)
    }

    @Synchronized
    internal fun resetProxySession(session: String) = RuntimeSyncCommand.begin(session)

    @Synchronized
    internal fun handleProxyInstruction(rely: Bundle): Boolean {
        return runCatching { RuntimeSyncCommand.receive(rely) }.onFailure {
            Logger.error("Invalid runtime state from peer publisher", it)
        }.getOrDefault(false)
    }
    private fun applyInstruction(rely: Bundle): Boolean {
        var commandId = rely.getString("command_id") ?: return false
        val incomingSample = if (commandId == "publish_sample") SampleWire.read(rely) ?: return false else null
        if (incomingSample != null && !SampleCommand.accepts(incomingSample)) return false
        if (listOf("speed", "altitude", "bearing").any {
                rely.containsKey(it) && !rely.getDouble(it).isFinite()
            }) return false
        if (rely.containsKey("speed") && rely.getDouble("speed") < 0) return false
        if (rely.containsKey("accuracy") && (!rely.getFloat("accuracy").isFinite() || rely.getFloat("accuracy") < 0)) return false
        commandId = LocationCommand.normalizeMove(rely, commandId) ?: return false
        if (commandId == "start" || commandId == "update_location" && rely.getString("mode") == "=") {
            if (rely.getDouble("lat", Double.NaN) !in -90.0..90.0 ||
                rely.getDouble("lon", Double.NaN) !in -180.0..180.0) return false
        }

        if (FakeLoc.enableDebugLog && commandId !in setOf("publish_sample", "get_runtime_status")) {
            Logger.debug(SensitiveLog.describe(commandId, rely.keySet().associateWith { key ->
                runCatching { rely.get(key)?.toString() }.getOrNull()
            }))
        }

        val accepted = when (commandId) {
            "publish_sample" -> SampleCommand.publish(incomingSample ?: return false, rely)
            "get_runtime_status" -> DiagnosticCommand.status(rely, SampleCommand.lastPublishMillis)
            "set_proxy" -> ProxyCommand.subscribe(rely)
            "start" -> ControlCommand.start(rely)
            "stop" -> ControlCommand.stop()
            "is_start" -> ControlCommand.isStart(rely)
            "start_gnss_mock" -> ControlCommand.setGnssMock(true)
            "stop_gnss_mock" -> ControlCommand.setGnssMock(false)
            "is_gnss_start" -> ControlCommand.isGnssMock(rely)
            "is_wifi_mock_start" -> ControlCommand.isWifiMock(rely)
            "start_wifi_mock" -> ControlCommand.setWifiMock(true)
            "stop_wifi_mock" -> ControlCommand.setWifiMock(false)
            "get_location" -> ControlCommand.location(rely)
            "get_listener_size" -> ControlCommand.listenerSize(rely)
            "get_speed" -> ControlCommand.speed(rely)
            "get_bearing" -> ControlCommand.bearing(rely)
            "get_altitude" -> ControlCommand.altitude(rely)
            "set_altitude" -> ControlCommand.setAltitude(rely)
            "set_speed" -> ControlCommand.setSpeed(rely)
            "set_bearing" -> ControlCommand.setBearing(rely)
            "update_location" -> LocationCommand.update(rely)
            "put_config" -> ConfigCommand.apply(rely)
            "sync_config" -> LocationCommand.sync(rely)
            "broadcast_location" -> LocationCommand.broadcast()
            "load_library" -> NativeCommand.load(rely)
            "native_prepare" -> NativeCommand.prepare()
            "native_status" -> NativeCommand.setEnabled(rely)
            else -> return false
        }
        if (accepted && commandId in replicatedCommands) ProxyCommand.publishCurrent()
        return accepted
    }

    @Synchronized internal fun expirePublication(nowNanos: Long): Boolean {
        val expired = SampleCommand.expire(nowNanos)
        if (expired) ProxyCommand.publishCurrent()
        return expired
    }
}
```

`xposed/src/main/java/com/system/location/service/hook/RuntimePeerRegistry.kt`:

```kt
package com.system.location.service.hook

import android.os.IBinder
import com.system.location.service.core.runtime.LatestStateWorker
import com.system.location.service.core.runtime.RuntimeTransfer

/** Bounded subscriptions keyed by authenticated UID and service name, each with its own mailbox. */
internal class RuntimePeerRegistry(
    private val maxPeers: Int = 16,
    private val deliver: (IBinder, String, Publication) -> Unit,
    private val onFailure: (Throwable) -> Unit,
) {
    internal data class Publication(val sequence: Long, val transfer: RuntimeTransfer)
    internal data class Subscription(val uid: Int, val name: String, val session: String, val binder: IBinder) {
        fun toBundle() = android.os.Bundle().apply {
            putInt("uid", uid); putString("name", name); putString("session", session); putBinder("binder", binder)
        }
    }
    private data class Key(val uid: Int, val name: String)
    private class Entry(val binder: IBinder, val session: String, val death: IBinder.DeathRecipient,
        val worker: LatestStateWorker<Publication>)
    private val entries = LinkedHashMap<Key, Entry>()

    init { require(maxPeers > 0) }

    @Synchronized fun register(uid: Int, name: String, session: String, binder: IBinder): Boolean {
        require(uid >= 0 && name.isNotBlank() && name.length <= 128 && session.isNotBlank() && session.length <= 128)
        if (!binder.isBinderAlive) return false
        val key = Key(uid, name)
        val replaced = entries.filter { it.key == key || it.value.binder == binder }
        if (entries.size - replaced.size >= maxPeers) return false
        lateinit var entry: Entry
        val death = IBinder.DeathRecipient { remove(key, entry) }
        val worker = LatestStateWorker<Publication>({ deliver(binder, session, it) }, {
            remove(key, entry)
            onFailure(it)
        })
        entry = Entry(binder, session, death, worker)
        replaced.forEach { (oldKey, old) -> remove(oldKey, old) }
        entries[key] = entry
        try {
            binder.linkToDeath(death, 0)
        } catch (failure: Exception) {
            remove(key, entry)
            return false
        }
        if (!binder.isBinderAlive || entries[key] !== entry) { remove(key, entry); return false }
        return true
    }

    /** Caller orders offers; slow or reentrant Binder calls run outside all registry/command locks. */
    fun offer(publication: Publication) {
        require(publication.sequence > 0)
        val peers = synchronized(this) { entries.values.toList() }
        peers.forEach { it.worker.offer(publication) }
    }

    @Synchronized private fun remove(key: Key, expected: Entry) {
        if (entries[key] !== expected) return
        entries.remove(key)
        expected.worker.close()
        runCatching { expected.binder.unlinkToDeath(expected.death, 0) }
    }

    @Synchronized fun size(): Int = entries.size
    @Synchronized fun subscriptions(): List<Subscription> = entries.map { (key, entry) ->
        Subscription(key.uid, key.name, entry.session, entry.binder)
    }

    fun restore(subscription: Subscription): Boolean =
        register(subscription.uid, subscription.name, subscription.session, subscription.binder)

    @Synchronized fun clear() { entries.toMap().forEach { (key, entry) -> remove(key, entry) } }
}
```

`xposed/src/main/java/com/system/location/service/hook/RuntimeSyncCommand.kt`:

```kt
package com.system.location.service.hook

import android.os.Binder
import android.os.Bundle
import android.os.SystemClock
import com.system.location.service.core.runtime.OrderedRuntimeReceiver
import com.system.location.service.core.runtime.RuntimeTransferWire
import com.system.location.service.hook.utils.FakeLoc

/** UID-authenticated full-state receiver. No forwarded control commands or native enable side effects. */
object RuntimeSyncCommand {
    const val TRANSACTION = 2
    const val PAYLOAD = "runtime_transfer"
    const val SESSION = "proxy_session"
    const val SEQUENCE = "proxy_sequence"
    private val receiver = OrderedRuntimeReceiver({ FakeLoc.runtimeSnapshots.current().configuration.gnssSource }) { state, _ ->
        val now = SystemClock.elapsedRealtimeNanos()
        val restored = FakeLoc.restoreRuntime(state, now)
        check(SampleCommand.restoreLease(restored.state.sample, now))
        if (restored.externallyDriven) LocationTicker.start() else LocationTicker.stop()
    }

    @Synchronized fun begin(session: String) {
        receiver.begin(session)
        FakeLoc.stopRuntime()
        SampleCommand.clearLease()
        LocationTicker.stop()
    }

    internal data class Incoming(val session: String, val sequence: Long, val encoded: ByteArray)

    internal fun prepare(values: Map<String, Any?>): Incoming {
        val session = values[SESSION] as? String ?: error("Missing proxy session")
        val sequence = values[SEQUENCE] as? Long ?: error("Missing state sequence")
        val encoded = values[PAYLOAD] as? ByteArray ?: error("Missing complete runtime state")
        require(session.isNotBlank() && session.length <= 128 && sequence > 0)
        require(encoded.isNotEmpty() && encoded.size <= RuntimeTransferWire.MAX_COMPRESSED_BYTES)
        return Incoming(session, sequence, encoded)
    }

    @Suppress("DEPRECATION")
    @Synchronized fun receive(rely: Bundle): Boolean {
        if (Binder.getCallingUid() != 1000 || FakeLoc.isSystemServerProcess) return false
        val message = prepare(listOf(SESSION, SEQUENCE, PAYLOAD).associateWith { rely.get(it) })
        return receiver.receive(message.session, message.sequence, message.encoded, SystemClock.elapsedRealtimeNanos())
    }
}
```

`xposed/src/main/java/com/system/location/service/hook/SampleCommand.kt`:

```kt
package com.system.location.service.hook

import android.os.Bundle
import android.os.SystemClock
import com.system.location.service.core.location.LocationSample
import com.system.location.service.core.performance.PerformanceProbe
import com.system.location.service.hook.hooks.LocationServiceHook
import com.system.location.service.hook.security.PublicationLease
import com.system.location.service.core.runtime.ScenarioSampleStore
import com.system.location.service.hook.utils.FakeLoc

/** P5-08: publication lease/sample command extracted from RemoteCommandHandler. */
object SampleCommand {
    private val lease = PublicationLease()
    private val publishProbe = PerformanceProbe()

    @Volatile
    var lastPublishMillis = 0L
        private set

    fun publishStats() = publishProbe.snapshot()

    fun accepts(fix: LocationSample): Boolean =
        lease.accepts(fix.elapsedNanos, SystemClock.elapsedRealtimeNanos())

    fun clearLease() {
        lease.clear()
    }

    /** Used only by ordered full-state replication; this does not publish or start native injection. */
    fun restoreLease(fix: LocationSample?, nowNanos: Long): Boolean {
        if (fix != null && !lease.restore(fix.elapsedNanos, nowNanos)) return false
        if (fix == null) lease.clear()
        lastPublishMillis = fix?.timeMillis ?: 0L
        return true
    }

    fun publish(fix: LocationSample, rely: Bundle): Boolean {
        val started = SystemClock.elapsedRealtimeNanos()
        return try {
            publishInternal(fix, rely)
        } finally {
            publishProbe.record((SystemClock.elapsedRealtimeNanos() - started).coerceAtLeast(0L))
        }
    }

    internal fun scenarioId(value: Any?): String? {
        if (value == null) return null
        require(value is String && value.isNotBlank() && value.length <= ScenarioSampleStore.MAX_ID_LENGTH)
        return value
    }

    @Suppress("DEPRECATION")
    private fun publishInternal(fix: LocationSample, rely: Bundle): Boolean {
        val scenario = scenarioId(rely.get("scenario_id"))
        if (!lease.renew(fix.elapsedNanos, SystemClock.elapsedRealtimeNanos())) return false
        val needsTicker = !FakeLoc.enable || !FakeLoc.externallyDriven
        FakeLoc.acceptSample(fix, scenario)
        lastPublishMillis = fix.timeMillis
        if (needsTicker) LocationTicker.start()
        if (FakeLoc.isSystemServerProcess) LocationServiceHook.callOnLocationChanged()
        return true
    }

    fun expire(nowNanos: Long): Boolean {
        if (!FakeLoc.externallyDriven || !lease.expired(nowNanos)) return false
        FakeLoc.stopRuntime()
        lease.clear()
        NativeCommand.disable()
        return true
    }

}
```

`xposed/src/main/java/com/system/location/service/hook/antidetect/AntiDetectController.kt`:

```kt
package com.system.location.service.hook.antidetect

import android.app.Application
import android.content.Context
import android.location.LocationManager
import android.os.Bundle
import android.os.Handler
import android.os.Looper
import com.system.location.service.hook.runtime.HookRuntime
import com.system.location.service.hook.runtime.BackgroundQuery
import com.system.location.service.hook.utils.FakeLoc
import com.system.location.service.jni.AntiDetect

/**
 * Polls the controller for the two experimental anti-detection flags.
 *
 * Target application processes cannot read the controller's preferences directly; the existing
 * `fused_ext` command channel is the only allowed transport. The main looper only schedules polls;
 * Binder and native loading use the platform worker pool without a dedicated module thread.
 */
object AntiDetectController {
    private const val COMMAND = "get_anti_detect_state"
    private const val INTERVAL_MS = 1_000L
    @Volatile private var started = false
    private val query = BackgroundQuery()

    fun start() {
        if (started) return
        val context = currentApplication()
        if (context == null) {
            // Package-ready can arrive before ActivityThread exposes the Application on some ROMs.
            Handler(Looper.getMainLooper()).postDelayed({ start() }, 500L)
            return
        }
        started = true
        val handler = Handler(Looper.getMainLooper())
        val poll = object : Runnable {
            override fun run() {
                try {
                    query.submit({ pollOnce(context) }) { result -> result.exceptionOrNull()?.let(HookRuntime::log) }
                } catch (failure: RuntimeException) {
                    HookRuntime.log(failure)
                } finally {
                    handler.postDelayed(this, INTERVAL_MS)
                }
            }
        }
        handler.post(poll)
    }

    private fun pollOnce(context: Context) {
        val manager = context.getSystemService(LocationManager::class.java) ?: return
        val reply = Bundle()
        val accepted = runCatching {
            manager.sendExtraCommand("fused_ext", COMMAND, reply)
        }.getOrDefault(false)
        if (!accepted) return
        val stackTraceClean = reply.getBoolean("stack_trace", false)
        if (FakeLoc.stackTraceCleanEnabled != stackTraceClean) {
            FakeLoc.stackTraceCleanEnabled = stackTraceClean
        }
        val stackTraceReplace = reply.getBoolean("stack_trace_replace", false)
        if (FakeLoc.stackTraceReplaceEnabled != stackTraceReplace) {
            FakeLoc.stackTraceReplaceEnabled = stackTraceReplace
        }
        AntiDetect.setEnabled(reply.getBoolean("anti_detect", false), context)
    }

    private fun currentApplication(): Application? = runCatching {
        val activityThread = Class.forName("android.app.ActivityThread")
        val thread = activityThread.getMethod("currentActivityThread").invoke(null)
        activityThread.getMethod("getApplication").invoke(thread) as? Application
    }.onFailure { HookRuntime.log(it) }.getOrNull()
}
```

```kt
package com.system.location.service.hook.hooks

import android.location.Location
import com.system.location.service.hook.BaseLocationHook
import com.system.location.service.hook.hooks.blindhook.BlindHookLocation
import com.system.location.service.hook.runtime.Reflection
import com.system.location.service.hook.utils.FakeLoc
import com.system.location.service.hook.utils.Logger
import com.system.location.service.hook.utils.hookAllMethods
import com.system.location.service.hook.utils.toClassOrThrow
import com.system.location.service.hook.utils.ProviderView
import io.github.libxposed.api.XposedInterface

object BasicLocationHook : BaseLocationHook() {
    operator fun invoke(classLoader: ClassLoader) {

        kotlin
            .runCatching {
                val cLocationResult = "android.location.LocationResult".toClassOrThrow(classLoader)
                BlindHookLocation(cLocationResult, classLoader)

                cLocationResult.hookAllMethods(
                    "asList",
                    XposedInterface.Hooker intercept1@{ chain ->
                        val args = chain.args.toTypedArray()
                        var result = chain.proceed()

                        if (!FakeLoc.enable) return@intercept1 result

                        val locations = (result as? List<*>)?.takeIf { it.all { item -> item is Location } }
                            ?: return@intercept1 result
                        val context = ProviderView.capture()
                        result = injectLocationBatch(locations.map { it as Location }, context)

                        result
                    },
                )

                cLocationResult.hookAllMethods(
                    "writeToParcel",
                    XposedInterface.Hooker intercept2@{ chain ->
                        val args = chain.args.toTypedArray()

                        if (!FakeLoc.enable) return@intercept2 chain.proceed(args)

                        val locationResult = chain.thisObject ?: return@intercept2 chain.proceed(args)
                        val mLocationsField =
                            Reflection.findFieldIfExists(
                                locationResult.javaClass,
                                "mLocations",
                            )
                        if (mLocationsField == null) {
                            Logger.error("Failed to find mLocations in LocationResult")
                            return@intercept2 chain.proceed(args)
                        }
                        mLocationsField.isAccessible = true
                        LocationResultIsolation.writeWithLocations(locationResult, mLocationsField,
                            rewrite = { locations ->
                                if (locations.isEmpty() || locations.any { it !is Location }) null
                                else injectLocationBatch(locations.map { it as Location }, ProviderView.capture())
                            },
                            write = { chain.proceed(args) },
                        )
                    },
                )
            }
            .onFailure { Logger.error("Failed to hook LocationResult", it) }

        Location::class
            .java
            .hookAllMethods(
                "set",
                XposedInterface.Hooker intercept3@{ chain ->
                    val args = chain.args.toTypedArray()

                    if (!FakeLoc.enable) return@intercept3 chain.proceed(args)
                    args[0] = injectLocation(args[0] as Location)

                    chain.proceed(args)
                },
            )
    }
}
```

`xposed/src/main/java/com/system/location/service/hook/hooks/CurrentLocationRequests.kt`:

```kt
package com.system.location.service.hook.hooks

import java.lang.ref.ReferenceQueue
import java.lang.ref.WeakReference

/** Associates a one-shot callback with its request without retaining cancelled callbacks. */
internal class CurrentLocationRequests {
    private val collectedCallbacks = ReferenceQueue<Any>()
    private val providers = HashMap<CallbackReference, String>()

    @Synchronized
    fun register(callback: Any, provider: String) {
        discardCollectedCallbacks()
        providers[CallbackReference(callback, collectedCallbacks)] = provider
    }

    /** Consumes only this callback's provider, even when callback objects compare equal. */
    @Synchronized
    fun take(callback: Any): String? {
        discardCollectedCallbacks()
        return providers.remove(CallbackReference(callback))
    }

    /** Drops an association when installing or registering the callback fails. */
    @Synchronized
    fun remove(callback: Any) {
        discardCollectedCallbacks()
        providers.remove(CallbackReference(callback))
    }

    private fun discardCollectedCallbacks() {
        while (true) {
            val collected = collectedCallbacks.poll() as? CallbackReference ?: return
            providers.remove(collected)
        }
    }

    private class CallbackReference(
        callback: Any,
        queue: ReferenceQueue<Any>? = null,
    ) : WeakReference<Any>(callback, queue) {
        private val identityHash = System.identityHashCode(callback)

        override fun hashCode(): Int = identityHash

        override fun equals(other: Any?): Boolean {
            if (this === other) return true
            if (other !is CallbackReference) return false
            val callback = get() ?: return false
            return callback === other.get()
        }
    }
}
```

`xposed/src/main/java/com/system/location/service/hook/hooks/ListenerRouting.kt`:

```kt
package com.system.location.service.hook.hooks

import android.os.IBinder
import com.system.location.service.core.routing.CallerRouter
import com.system.location.service.core.routing.PackageUidLookup
import com.system.location.service.core.routing.RoutingConfig
import com.system.location.service.core.routing.RoutingDecision
import com.system.location.service.core.routing.RoutingMode
import com.system.location.service.core.routing.RoutingTable
import com.system.location.service.hook.utils.BinderUtils
import com.system.location.service.hook.utils.FakeLoc
import java.util.concurrent.ConcurrentHashMap

/**
 * P5-02 listener-side routing.
 *
 * The UID is captured at registration because Binder.getCallingUid() is no longer the app when the
 * callback runs. Routing mode only changes behavior for PER_APP configs; default/global configs
 * keep the current fake fix for every listener. Denied packages stop receiving fake updates; a
 * matched scenario still uses the single active fake until the multi-scenario store lands.
 */
object ListenerRouting {
    private val callerUids = ConcurrentHashMap<IBinder, Int>()
    private var cachedConfig: RoutingConfig? = null
    private var cachedRouter: CallerRouter? = null

    fun register(listener: android.os.IInterface) {
        register(listener, BinderUtils.getCallerUid())
    }

    fun register(listener: android.os.IInterface, uid: Int) {
        if (uid > 0) callerUids[listener.asBinder()] = uid
    }

    fun unregister(listener: android.os.IInterface) {
        callerUids.remove(listener.asBinder())
    }

    fun unregisterBinder(binder: IBinder) {
        callerUids.remove(binder)
    }

    /** Fixed point for an environment caller (WiFi/cell), or null when no point route matches. */
    fun fixedPointFor(packageName: String?, uid: Int = BinderUtils.getCallerUid()): com.system.location.service.core.geo.Wgs84? {
        return (decisionFor(packageName, uid) as? RoutingDecision.Point)?.point
    }

    /** Full environment routing result so explicit denial is not confused with the global route. */
    fun decisionFor(packageName: String?, uid: Int = BinderUtils.getCallerUid()): RoutingDecision =
        decisionFor(packageName, uid, FakeLoc.runtimeSnapshots.current().routing)

    /** Resolve against a caller-captured config so one request cannot mix routing revisions. */
    fun decisionFor(packageName: String?, uid: Int, config: RoutingConfig?): RoutingDecision {
        config ?: return RoutingDecision.Global
        if (config.mode == RoutingMode.GLOBAL) return RoutingDecision.Global
        if (BinderUtils.isCoreUid(uid)) return RoutingDecision.Global
        val packages = packageName?.takeIf { it.isNotBlank() }?.let { listOf(it) }
            ?: runCatching { BinderUtils.getUidPackageNames(uid = uid)?.toList().orEmpty() }.getOrDefault(emptyList())
        return decisionForPackages(uid, config, packages) { packageNameToCheck ->
            runCatching { BinderUtils.isSystemPackages(packageNameToCheck) }.getOrDefault(false)
        }
    }

    internal fun decisionForPackages(
        uid: Int,
        config: RoutingConfig,
        packages: Collection<String>,
        isSystemPackage: (String) -> Boolean = { false },
    ): RoutingDecision {
        if (BinderUtils.isCoreUid(uid)) return RoutingDecision.Global
        if (packages.isEmpty()) return RoutingDecision.Deny
        if (packages.any(isSystemPackage)) return RoutingDecision.Global
        val table = runCatching { RoutingTable(config) }.getOrNull() ?: return RoutingDecision.Deny
        return table.decision(uid, packages, false)
    }

    fun shouldDeliver(listener: android.os.IInterface): Boolean = route(listener) !is Route.Denied

    fun route(listener: android.os.IInterface, routing: RoutingConfig? = FakeLoc.runtimeSnapshots.current().routing): Route {
        val config = routing ?: return Route.Default
        if (config.mode == RoutingMode.GLOBAL) return Route.Default
        val uid = callerUids[listener.asBinder()] ?: return Route.Default
        if (BinderUtils.isCoreUid(uid)) return Route.Default
        val router = routerFor(config) ?: return Route.Default
        return when (val decision = router.decision(uid)) {
            RoutingDecision.Deny -> Route.Denied
            is RoutingDecision.Scenario -> Route.Scenario(decision.scenarioId)
            is RoutingDecision.Point -> Route.Point(decision.point)
            RoutingDecision.Global -> Route.Default
        }
    }

    sealed class Route {
        data object Default : Route()
        data object Denied : Route()
        data class Scenario(val scenarioId: String) : Route()
        data class Point(val point: com.system.location.service.core.geo.Wgs84) : Route()
    }

    @Synchronized
    private fun routerFor(config: RoutingConfig): CallerRouter? {
        if (cachedConfig !== config) {
            cachedRouter = runCatching { CallerRouter(RoutingTable(config), Lookup) }.getOrNull()
            cachedConfig = config
        }
        return cachedRouter
    }

    private object Lookup : PackageUidLookup {
        override fun packagesForUid(uid: Int): List<String> =
            runCatching { BinderUtils.getUidPackageNames(uid = uid)?.toList().orEmpty() }.getOrDefault(emptyList())

        override fun isSystemPackage(packageName: String): Boolean =
            runCatching { BinderUtils.isSystemPackages(packageName) }.getOrDefault(false)
    }
}
```

`xposed/src/main/java/com/system/location/service/hook/hooks/LocationAvailabilityHook.kt`:

```kt
package com.system.location.service.hook.hooks

import com.system.location.service.core.privacy.LocationAvailabilityPolicy
import com.system.location.service.hook.runtime.Reflection
import com.system.location.service.hook.scope.HookInstaller
import com.system.location.service.hook.scope.HookStatus
import com.system.location.service.hook.scope.HookStatusRegistry
import com.system.location.service.hook.utils.BinderUtils
import com.system.location.service.hook.utils.FakeLoc
import com.system.location.service.hook.utils.Logger
import io.github.libxposed.api.XposedInterface

/**
 * While a scenario runs, third-party callers see location enabled; system callers retain the real
 * switch.
 */
object LocationAvailabilityHook {
    fun hook(classLoader: ClassLoader): Boolean {
        val service =
            Reflection.findClassIfExists(
                "com.android.server.location.LocationManagerService",
                classLoader,
            )
        if (service == null) {
            HookStatusRegistry.record(
                "availability",
                HookStatus(
                    supported = true,
                    skipped = true,
                    reason = "LocationManagerService absent",
                ),
            )
            return false
        }
        var hooked = false
        for (methodName in METHODS) {
            val hooks =
                HookInstaller.hookAllMethods(
                    service,
                    methodName,
                    XposedInterface.Hooker { chain ->
                        val original = chain.proceed()
                        // Never report a disabled platform switch as enabled: that is directly
                        // cross-checkable through Settings.Secure.location_mode.
                        if (original != true) return@Hooker original
                        if (
                            FakeLoc.enable &&
                                LocationAvailabilityPolicy.shouldSynthesize(
                                    true,
                                    BinderUtils.getCallerUid(),
                                )
                        ) {
                            if (FakeLoc.enableDebugLog)
                                Logger.debug("$methodName: synthesized true for third-party caller")
                            true
                        } else {
                            original
                        }
                    },
                )
            hooked = hooked || hooks.isNotEmpty()
        }
        return hooked
    }

    private val METHODS = listOf("isLocationEnabledForUser", "isLocationEnabled")
}
```
