`xposed/src/main/java/com/system/location/service/hook/hooks/LocationCallbackRegistry.kt`:

```kt
package com.system.location.service.hook.hooks

import android.os.IBinder
import android.os.IInterface
import android.os.RemoteException
import com.system.location.service.hook.runtime.CallbackSubscription
import com.system.location.service.hook.utils.BinderUtils
import com.system.location.service.hook.utils.LocationCallerGuard

/** One Binder/death recipient per transport, with distinct provider subscriptions beneath it. */
internal class LocationCallbackRegistry(
    private val added: (IInterface) -> Unit = {},
    private val removed: (IBinder) -> Unit = {},
) {
    private class Entry(val listener: IInterface, val uid: Int, val death: IBinder.DeathRecipient,
        val token: Any, val coarse: Boolean, val providers: MutableSet<String> = linkedSetOf())
    private val entries = LinkedHashMap<IBinder, Entry>()

    @Synchronized
    fun register(provider: String, listener: IInterface,
        callerUid: Int = runCatching { BinderUtils.getCallerUid() }.getOrDefault(-1),
        coarse: Boolean = LocationCallerGuard.isCoarse()): Boolean {
        val binder = listener.asBinder()
        if (!binder.isBinderAlive) {
            unregisterBinder(binder)
            return false
        }
        entries[binder]?.let { it.providers += provider; return true }
        val token = Any()
        // Implement the original zero-argument callback; newer Binder APIs delegate to it too.
        val death = IBinder.DeathRecipient { unregisterBinder(binder, token) }
        val entry = Entry(listener, callerUid, death, token, coarse).apply { providers += provider }
        entries[binder] = entry
        try {
            binder.linkToDeath(death, 0)
        } catch (_: RemoteException) {
            entries.remove(binder)
            return false
        }
        if (entries[binder] !== entry || !binder.isBinderAlive) {
            unregisterBinder(binder, token)
            return false
        }
        try { added(listener) }
        catch (failure: Throwable) {
            unregisterBinder(binder, token)
            throw failure
        }
        return true
    }

    fun unregister(listener: IInterface) = unregisterBinder(listener.asBinder())

    /** True when synthetic delivery owns this transport, so real callbacks must be dropped. */
    @Synchronized
    fun contains(listener: Any?): Boolean {
        val binder = (listener as? IInterface)?.asBinder() ?: return false
        return entries.containsKey(binder)
    }

    @Synchronized
    fun subscriptions(): List<CallbackSubscription> = entries.values.map {
        CallbackSubscription(it.listener, it.uid, providers = it.providers.toList())
    }

    /** Re-links a Binder owned by the framework without invoking old-generation callbacks. */
    @Synchronized
    fun restore(subscription: CallbackSubscription): Boolean {
        val binder = subscription.listener.asBinder()
        if (!binder.isBinderAlive || entries.containsKey(binder)) return false
        val token = Any()
        val death = IBinder.DeathRecipient { unregisterBinder(binder, token) }
        val entry = Entry(subscription.listener, subscription.uid, death, token, coarse = false).apply {
            providers += subscription.providers
        }
        entries[binder] = entry
        return try {
            binder.linkToDeath(death, 0)
            if (!binder.isBinderAlive) { unregisterBinder(binder, token); false } else true
        } catch (_: RemoteException) {
            unregisterBinder(binder, token)
            false
        }
    }

    @Synchronized
    private fun unregisterBinder(binder: IBinder, expectedToken: Any? = null) {
        val entry = entries[binder] ?: return
        if (expectedToken != null && entry.token !== expectedToken) return
        entries.remove(binder)
        try { runCatching { binder.unlinkToDeath(entry.death, 0) } }
        finally { removed(binder) }
    }

    @Synchronized
    fun isCoarse(listener: IInterface): Boolean = entries[listener.asBinder()]?.coarse == true

    @Synchronized
    fun listeners(): List<Pair<String, IInterface>> {
        entries.keys.filter { !it.isBinderAlive }.toList().forEach { unregisterBinder(it) }
        return entries.values.flatMap { entry -> entry.providers.map { it to entry.listener } }
    }

    @Synchronized
    fun clear() { entries.keys.toList().forEach { unregisterBinder(it) } }
}
```

`xposed/src/main/java/com/system/location/service/hook/hooks/LocationListenerDelivery.kt`:

```kt
package com.system.location.service.hook.hooks

import android.os.DeadObjectException
import android.os.IInterface
import com.system.location.service.hook.BaseLocationHook
import com.system.location.service.hook.runtime.HookRuntime
import com.system.location.service.hook.runtime.Reflection
import com.system.location.service.hook.utils.FakeLoc
import com.system.location.service.hook.utils.Logger
import com.system.location.service.hook.utils.ProviderView
import java.lang.reflect.InvocationTargetException

/** Sends the current provider view through the listener's original implementation. */
internal object LocationListenerDelivery : BaseLocationHook() {
    fun deliver(locationListeners: Collection<Pair<String, IInterface>>) {
        if (!FakeLoc.enable) return
        val context = ProviderView.capture(force = true)
        if (!context.state.configuration.enabled) return
        if (context.state.configuration.debugLog) {
            Logger.debug("==> callOnLocationChanged: ${locationListeners.size}")
        }
        locationListeners.forEach { listenerWithProvider ->
            val listener = listenerWithProvider.second
            if (!FakeLoc.enable) return
            val route = ListenerRouting.route(listener, context.state.routing)
            if (route is ListenerRouting.Route.Denied) return@forEach
            val scenarioId = (route as? ListenerRouting.Route.Scenario)?.scenarioId
            val point = (route as? ListenerRouting.Route.Point)?.point
            val coarse = LocationServiceHook.isCoarse(listener)
            val location = runCatching {
                locationForProvider(
                        if (coarse) "network"
                        else if (listenerWithProvider.first == "GnssBatch") "gps"
                        else listenerWithProvider.first,
                        scenarioId,
                        point,
                        context,
                    ).also {
                        if (coarse) {
                            it.accuracy = maxOf(it.accuracy, 2_000f)
                            it.verticalAccuracyMeters = maxOf(it.verticalAccuracyMeters, it.accuracy * 2f)
                        }
                    }
            }.getOrNull() ?: return@forEach
            var called = false
            var error: Throwable? = null
            kotlin
                .runCatching {
                    val locations = listOf(location)
                    val mOnLocationChanged =
                        Reflection.findMethodBestMatch(
                            listener.javaClass,
                            "onLocationChanged",
                            locations,
                            null,
                        )
                    HookRuntime.invokeOriginalMethod(
                        mOnLocationChanged,
                        listener,
                        arrayOf(locations, null),
                    )
                    called = true
                }
                .onFailure {
                    if (
                        it is DeadObjectException ||
                            (it is InvocationTargetException &&
                                it.targetException is DeadObjectException)
                    ) {
                        return@forEach
                    }
                    error = it
                }

            if (!called)
                runCatching {
                        val mOnLocationChanged =
                            Reflection.findMethodBestMatch(
                                listener.javaClass,
                                "onLocationChanged",
                                location,
                            )
                        HookRuntime.invokeOriginalMethod(
                            mOnLocationChanged,
                            listener,
                            arrayOf(location),
                        )
                        called = true
                    }
                    .onFailure {
                        if (
                            it is DeadObjectException ||
                                (it is InvocationTargetException &&
                                    it.targetException is DeadObjectException)
                        ) {
                            return@forEach
                        }
                        error = it
                    }

            if (!called) {
                Logger.error(
                    "Location listener delivery failed",
                    error ?: IllegalStateException("No supported listener method"),
                )
            }
        }

        if (context.state.configuration.debugLog) {
            Logger.debug("==> callOnLocationChanged: end")
        }
    }

}
```

`xposed/src/main/java/com/system/location/service/hook/hooks/LocationManagerHook.kt`:

```kt
package com.system.location.service.hook.hooks

import android.location.Location
import com.system.location.service.hook.BaseLocationHook
import com.system.location.service.hook.runtime.HookRuntime
import com.system.location.service.hook.runtime.Reflection
import com.system.location.service.hook.utils.FakeLoc
import com.system.location.service.hook.utils.Logger
import com.system.location.service.hook.utils.hookAllMethods
import com.system.location.service.hook.utils.hookMethod
import com.system.location.service.hook.utils.onceHookAllMethod
import io.github.libxposed.api.XposedInterface

object LocationManagerHook : BaseLocationHook() {
    operator fun invoke(cLocationManager: Class<*>) {
        val hookGetLastKnownLocation =
            XposedInterface.Hooker intercept4@{ chain ->
                val args = chain.args.toTypedArray()
                var result = chain.proceed()

                if (result == null) return@intercept4 result

                if (!FakeLoc.enable) return@intercept4 result

                if (FakeLoc.enableDebugLog) {
                    Logger.debug("${chain.executable.name}: injected!")
                }

                result = injectLocation(result as Location)

                result
            }
        if (
            cLocationManager.declaredMethods
                .filter { it.name == "getLastKnownLocation" && it.parameterTypes.size > 1 }
                .map {
                    com.system.location.service.hook.scope.HookInstaller.hookMethod(
                        it,
                        hookGetLastKnownLocation,
                    )
                }
                .isEmpty()
        ) {
            com.system.location.service.hook.scope.HookInstaller.hookAllMethods(
                cLocationManager,
                "getLastLocation",
                hookGetLastKnownLocation,
            )
        }

        val hookOnLocation =
            XposedInterface.Hooker intercept5@{ chain ->
                val args = chain.args.toTypedArray()

                if (args.isEmpty() || args[0] == null) return@intercept5 chain.proceed(args)

                if (!FakeLoc.enable) return@intercept5 chain.proceed(args)

                if (FakeLoc.enableDebugLog) {
                    Logger.debug("${chain.executable.name}: injected!")
                }

                when (args[0]) {
                    is Location -> {
                        args[0] = injectLocation(args[0] as Location)
                    }
                    is List<*> -> {
                        val locations = args[0] as List<*>
                        if (locations.any { it !is Location }) return@intercept5 chain.proceed(args)
                        args[0] = injectLocationBatch(locations.map { it as Location })
                    }
                    else -> {
                        Logger.error("Unknown method when hook hookOnLocation: ${chain.executable}")
                    }
                }

                chain.proceed(args)
            }

        if (
            cLocationManager.declaredMethods
                .filter { it.name == "requestFlush" }
                .map {
                    com.system.location.service.hook.scope.HookInstaller.hookMethod(
                        it,
                        XposedInterface.Hooker intercept6@{ chain ->
                            val args = chain.args.toTypedArray()

                            if (args.size < 2 || args[1] == null)
                                return@intercept6 chain.proceed(args)

                            val listener = args[1] ?: return@intercept6 chain.proceed(args)
                            listener.javaClass.onceHookAllMethod(
                                "onLocationChanged",
                                hookOnLocation,
                            )

                            chain.proceed(args)
                        },
                    )
                }
                .isEmpty()
        ) {
            Logger.error("Hook requestFlush failed")
        }

        val hookRequestLocationUpdates =
            XposedInterface.Hooker intercept7@{ chain ->
                val args = chain.args.toTypedArray()

                if (args.size < 2 || args[1] == null) return@intercept7 chain.proceed(args)

                args
                    .filterIsInstance<android.location.LocationListener>()
                    .also {
                        if (it.isEmpty()) {
                            Logger.error(
                                "No LocationListener found in requestLocationUpdates: ${chain.executable}(${
                            args.joinToString { it?.javaClass.toString() }
                        })"
                            )
                        }
                    }
                    .forEach { it.javaClass.onceHookAllMethod("onLocationChanged", hookOnLocation) }

                chain.proceed(args)
            }
        if (
            cLocationManager.declaredMethods
                .filter { it.name == "requestLocationUpdates" }
                .map {
                    com.system.location.service.hook.scope.HookInstaller.hookMethod(
                        it,
                        hookRequestLocationUpdates,
                    )
                }
                .isEmpty()
        ) {
            Logger.error("Hook requestLocationUpdates failed")
        }

        if (
            cLocationManager.declaredMethods
                .filter { it.name == "requestSingleUpdate" }
                .map {
                    com.system.location.service.hook.scope.HookInstaller.hookMethod(
                        it,
                        hookRequestLocationUpdates,
                    )
                }
                .isEmpty()
        ) {
            Logger.error("Hook requestSingleUpdate failed")
        }

        kotlin
            .runCatching {
                Reflection.findClass(
                    "android.location.LocationManager\$GetCurrentLocationTransport",
                    cLocationManager.classLoader,
                )
            }
            .onSuccess { it.onceHookAllMethod("onLocation", hookOnLocation) }
            .onFailure { HookRuntime.log(it) }

        kotlin
            .runCatching {
                Reflection.findClass(
                    "android.location.LocationManager\$BatchedLocationCallbackWrapper",
                    cLocationManager.classLoader,
                )
            }
            .onSuccess { it.onceHookAllMethod("onLocationChanged", hookOnLocation) }

        kotlin
            .runCatching {
                Reflection.findClass(
                    "android.location.LocationManager\$LocationListenerTransport",
                    cLocationManager.classLoader,
                )
            }
            .onSuccess { it.onceHookAllMethod("onLocationChanged", hookOnLocation) }
            .onFailure { HookRuntime.log(it) }
    }
}
```

`xposed/src/main/java/com/system/location/service/hook/hooks/LocationResultIsolation.kt`:

```kt
package com.system.location.service.hook.hooks

import com.system.location.service.hook.runtime.Reflection
import java.lang.reflect.Field

/** A platform LocationResult owns its list; callers can reuse the result after delivery. */
internal object LocationResultIsolation {
    fun copyWithLocations(result: Any, locations: List<*>): Any =
        Reflection.newInstance(result.javaClass, ArrayList(locations))

    fun <T> writeWithLocations(result: Any, field: Field,
        rewrite: (List<*>) -> List<*>?, write: () -> T): T = synchronized(result) {
        val original = field.get(result)
        val values = original as? List<*> ?: return@synchronized write()
        val replacement = rewrite(values) ?: return@synchronized write()
        field.set(result, ArrayList(replacement))
        try { write() } finally { field.set(result, original) }
    }
}
```

```kt
    private val listeners = LocationCallbackRegistry(
        added = { listener -> hookILocationListener(listener); ListenerRouting.register(listener) },
        removed = ListenerRouting::unregisterBinder,
    )

    operator fun invoke(classLoader: ClassLoader) {
        val cLocationManagerService =
            Reflection.findClassIfExists(
                "com.android.server.location.LocationManagerService",
                classLoader,
            )
        if (cLocationManagerService == null) {
            hookLocationManagerServiceV2(classLoader)
        } else {
            onService(cLocationManagerService)
        }
    }

    fun onService(cILocationManager: Class<*>) {

        if (FakeLoc.enableDebugLog) {
            Logger.debug("ILocationManager.Stub: class = $cILocationManager")
        }

        cILocationManager.classLoader!!.let {
            BasicLocationHook(it)
            GnssHook(it)
            LocationProviderManagerHook(it)

            MiuiBlurLocationProviderHook(it)
            MiuiLocationManagerHook(it)
            MiuiTelephonyManagerHook(it)
        }

        LocationNMEAHook(cILocationManager)

        if (
            cILocationManager
                .hookAllMethods(
                    "getLastLocation",
                    XposedInterface.Hooker intercept8@{ chain ->
                        val args = chain.args.toTypedArray()
                        var result = chain.proceed()

                        if (!FakeLoc.enable) return@intercept8 result

                        // A hidden provider must not be a "getLastLocation returns a fix"
                        // oracle while getAllProviders/getProviderProperties say it does not
                        // exist. Resolve through the same ILocationManager surface the caller
                        // used, then fail closed for names the caller cannot see.
                        val provider = runCatching {
                            Reflection.callMethod(args[0], "getProvider") as? String
                        }.getOrNull() ?: LocationManager.GPS_PROVIDER
                        if (!providerExists(chain.thisObject, provider)) return@intercept8 null

                        val location = result as? Location ?: run {
                            // Do not invent a fix while the platform location switch is off.
                            if (!LocationCallerGuard.isLocationEnabled()) return@intercept8 null
                            Location(provider)
                        }

                        // Coarse-only callers must not receive a GPS-precision fix.
                        result = if (LocationCallerGuard.isCoarse()) {
                            runCatching { coarseLocation() }.getOrElse { injectLocation(location) }
                        } else {
                            injectLocation(location)
                        }

                        if (FakeLoc.enableDebugLog) {
                            Logger.debug("getLastLocation: injected! $result")
                        }

                            Logger.error(
                                "requestLocationUpdates: listener is null: ${chain.executable}"

    internal fun installGnssStatusCallback(callback: IInterface) {
        val statusHook = XposedInterface.Hooker status@{ event ->
            val method = event.executable as? Method ?: return@status event.proceed()
            if (method.name == "onSvStatusChanged" &&
                !ReceiverGnssStatusAdapter.supports(method)) return@status event.proceed()
            // Protection is decided by the routing policy, not by frame readiness. A missing
            // synthetic frame must suppress the real status/TTFF callback, never pass it through.
            val context = GnssReceiverRuntime.protectionContext() ?: return@status event.proceed()
            val route = GnssListenerRouting.routeFor(event.thisObject, context.state.routing)
                ?: return@status event.proceed()
            null
        }
        listOf("onSvStatusChanged", "onGnssStarted", "onFirstFix", "onGnssStopped").forEach { name ->
            callback.javaClass.onceHookAllMethod(name, statusHook)
        }
    }

    internal fun restoreLocationSubscriptions(subscriptions: List<CallbackSubscription>) {
        subscriptions.forEach { subscription ->
            if (listeners.restore(subscription)) {
                hookILocationListener(subscription.listener)
                ListenerRouting.register(subscription.listener, subscription.uid)
            }
        }
    }

    fun locationSubscriptions(): List<CallbackSubscription> = listeners.subscriptions()

    /** Release this generation's death links after its subscriptions have been saved. */
    internal fun retireLocationSubscriptions() = listeners.clear()

    private fun hookILocationListener(listener: Any) {
        val classListener = listener.javaClass
        if (FakeLoc.enableDebugLog)
            Logger.debug("will hook ILocationListener: ${classListener.name}")

        if (classListener.declaredMethods.none { it.name == "onLocationChanged" }) {
            Logger.error("No supported location callback on ${classListener.name}")
            return
        }
        classListener.onceHookAllMethod(
                    "onLocationChanged",
                    XposedInterface.Hooker intercept34@{ chain ->
                        val args = chain.args.toTypedArray()

                        if (args.isEmpty()) return@intercept34 chain.proceed(args)
                        if (!FakeLoc.enable) return@intercept34 chain.proceed(args)
                        // Synthetic delivery invokes the original method directly, so a callback
                        // that reaches this hook is a real provider update. Drop it for every
                        // listener we own; otherwise the app sees two callbacks per epoch.
                        if (listeners.contains(chain.thisObject)) return@intercept34 null
                        val context = ProviderView.capture()

                        when (args[0]) {
                            is Location -> {
                                val location =
                                    args[0] as? Location
                                        ?: run {
                                            return@intercept34 null
                                        }
                                args[0] = injectLocation(location, context = context)
                            }

                            is List<*> -> {
                                val locations = args[0] as List<*>
                                if (locations.any { it !is Location }) return@intercept34 chain.proceed(args)
                                args[0] = injectLocationBatch(locations.map { it as Location }, context)
                            }
                            else -> Logger.error("onLocationChanged args is not `Location`")
                        }

                        if (context.state.configuration.debugLog) {
                            Logger.debug("${chain.executable}: injected! ${args[0]}")
                        }

                        chain.proceed(args)
                    },
                )
    }

    private fun addLocationListenerInner(provider: String, listener: IInterface) {
        listeners.register(provider, listener)
    }

    /**
     * Resolve provider existence through the same service surface that answers
     * getAllProviders/getProviderProperties. A hidden provider therefore returns null from
     * getLastLocation instead of becoming a "provider exists" oracle.
     */
    private fun providerExists(service: Any?, provider: String): Boolean {
        val known = setOf(
            LocationManager.GPS_PROVIDER,
            LocationManager.NETWORK_PROVIDER,
            LocationManager.PASSIVE_PROVIDER,
            "fused",
        )
        return runCatching {
            Reflection.callMethod(service, "hasProvider", provider) as? Boolean
        }.getOrNull() ?: (provider in known)
    }

    internal fun isCoarse(listener: IInterface): Boolean = listeners.isCoarse(listener)

    /** Network-provider view with the platform's coarse obfuscation magnitude. */
    private fun coarseLocation(): Location =
        locationForProvider(LocationManager.NETWORK_PROVIDER).also {
            it.accuracy = maxOf(it.accuracy, COARSE_ACCURACY_METERS)
            it.verticalAccuracyMeters = maxOf(it.verticalAccuracyMeters, it.accuracy * 2f)
        }

    private fun removeLocationListenerInner(listener: IInterface) {
        listeners.unregister(listener)
    }

    @Synchronized
    fun callOnLocationChanged() {
        try { LocationListenerDelivery.deliver(locationListeners) }
        finally {
            // A free-running 1 Hz poll can repeatedly observe the same leased sample around a
            // second boundary and then skip an epoch. Drive GNSS from accepted publications.
            com.system.location.service.hook.hooks.gnss.GnssSignalInjection.onSamplePublished()
            com.system.location.service.hook.hooks.telephony.CarrierRegistryHook.onSamplePublished()
        }
    }

    private fun hookLocationManagerServiceV2(classLoader: ClassLoader) {
        kotlin
            .runCatching {
                Reflection.findClass("android.location.ILocationManager\$Stub", classLoader)
            }
            .onSuccess {
                fun hookOnTransactForServiceInstance(m: Method) {
                    val isHooked = AtomicBoolean(false)
                    com.system.location.service.hook.scope.HookInstaller.hookMethod(
                        m,
                        XposedInterface.Hooker intercept35@{ chain ->
                            val args = chain.args.toTypedArray()

                            if (chain.thisObject == null || args.size < 4)
                                return@intercept35 chain.proceed(args)

                            val service = chain.thisObject ?: return@intercept35 chain.proceed(args)
                            val code = args[0] as? Int ?: return@intercept35 chain.proceed(args)
                            val data = args[1] as? Parcel ?: return@intercept35 chain.proceed(args)
                            val reply = args[2] as? Parcel ?: return@intercept35 chain.proceed(args)
                            val flags = args[3] as? Int ?: return@intercept35 chain.proceed(args)

                            if (isHooked.compareAndSet(false, true)) {
                                onService(service.javaClass)
                            }

                            if (!FakeLoc.enable) {
                                return@intercept35 chain.proceed(args)
                            }

                            if (FakeLoc.enableDebugLog) {
                                Logger.debug("ILocationManager.Stub: onTransact(code=$code)")
                            }
                            // Work package 9 audit: the previous unconditional fake-success for
                            // transaction code 43 is removed. Cross-checking AOSP
                            // ILocationManager.aidl (android12/13/14/15/16-release) shows
                            // FIRST_CALL_TRANSACTION+42 — code 43 — is
                            // setExtraLocationControllerPackage(String) on every release Portal
                            // supports. Faking success for it broke both permission semantics
                            // (callers without LOCATION_HARDWARE got "true" instead of a
                            // SecurityException) and set/get consistency (callers with the
                            // permission got a silent no-op) — exactly the kind of fixed
                            // abnormal answer work package 9 removes. The natural result is
                            // restored; the onService capture above keeps working.
                            chain.proceed(args)
                        },
                    )
                }

                it.declaredMethods.forEach {
                    if (it.name == "onTransact") {
                        hookOnTransactForServiceInstance(it)

                        return@forEach
                    }
                }
            }
            .onFailure { Logger.error("ILocationManager.Stub not found", it) }
    }

    private fun handleInstruction(command: String, rely: Bundle): Boolean {
        return RemoteCommandHandler.handleInstruction(command, rely)
    }

    private const val COARSE_ACCURACY_METERS = 2_000f
}
```

```kt
package com.system.location.service.hook.hooks.ble

import android.bluetooth.BluetoothAdapter
import android.bluetooth.le.BluetoothLeScanner
import android.bluetooth.le.ScanCallback
import android.bluetooth.le.ScanFilter
import android.bluetooth.le.ScanRecord
import android.bluetooth.le.ScanResult
import android.bluetooth.le.ScanSettings
import android.app.PendingIntent
import android.content.Intent
import android.os.Bundle
import android.os.Handler
import android.os.Looper
import android.os.SystemClock
import com.system.location.service.core.environment.BleBeacon
import com.system.location.service.core.environment.EnvironmentReplayPolicy
import com.system.location.service.core.environment.EnvironmentSourceMode
import com.system.location.service.core.environment.ProceduralBleSource
import com.system.location.service.core.geo.Wgs84
import com.system.location.service.core.routing.RoutingDecision
import com.system.location.service.hook.hooks.ListenerRouting
import com.system.location.service.hook.runtime.Reflection
import com.system.location.service.hook.scope.HookInstaller
import com.system.location.service.hook.utils.FakeLoc
import com.system.location.service.hook.utils.Logger
import com.system.location.service.hook.utils.onceHook
import io.github.libxposed.api.XposedInterface.Hooker
import java.util.WeakHashMap
import java.util.concurrent.atomic.AtomicBoolean
import java.util.concurrent.atomic.AtomicInteger

/** Replaces callback-based BLE scan observations in the target application process. */
object BleScanHook {
    private data class ScanState(
        val filters: List<ScanFilter>,
        val callbackType: Int = ScanSettings.CALLBACK_TYPE_ALL_MATCHES,
        val reportDelayMillis: Long = 0L,
        val nextIndex: AtomicInteger = AtomicInteger(),
        val seenAddresses: MutableSet<String> = mutableSetOf(),
        val active: AtomicBoolean = AtomicBoolean(true),
        var task: Runnable? = null,
    )

    private val states = WeakHashMap<ScanCallback, ScanState>()
    private val handler = Handler(Looper.getMainLooper())
    private val injectingCallback = ThreadLocal.withInitial { false }
    private val pendingFilters = PendingScanRegistry<PendingIntent, ScanFilter>()

    fun install(classLoader: ClassLoader, packageName: String, uid: Int) {
        val scanner = Reflection.findClassIfExists("android.bluetooth.le.BluetoothLeScanner", classLoader)
            ?: return
        HookInstaller.hookAllMethods(scanner, "startScan", Hooker { chain ->
            val callbackIndex = chain.executable.parameterTypes.indexOfFirst {
                ScanCallback::class.java.isAssignableFrom(it)
            }
            val filters = chain.args.filterIsInstance<List<*>>().firstOrNull()
                ?.filterIsInstance<ScanFilter>().orEmpty()
            val callback = chain.args.getOrNull(callbackIndex) as? ScanCallback
            if (callback == null) {
                val pendingIntent = chain.args.filterIsInstance<PendingIntent>().firstOrNull()
                    ?: return@Hooker chain.proceed()
                val result = chain.proceed()
                pendingFilters.register(pendingIntent, filters)
                return@Hooker result
            }
            val settings = chain.args.filterIsInstance<ScanSettings>().firstOrNull()
            val state = ScanState(
                filters = filters,
                callbackType = settings?.callbackType ?: ScanSettings.CALLBACK_TYPE_ALL_MATCHES,
                reportDelayMillis = settings?.reportDelayMillis ?: 0L,
            )
            synchronized(states) { states.put(callback, state) }?.let(::cancel)
            hookCallback(callback, packageName, uid)
            val result = chain.proceed()
            scheduleSyntheticScan(callback, state, packageName, uid)
            result
        })
        HookInstaller.hookAllMethods(scanner, "stopScan", Hooker { chain ->
            chain.args.filterIsInstance<PendingIntent>().firstOrNull()?.let { pending ->
                pendingFilters.unregister(pending)
            }
            chain.args.filterIsInstance<ScanCallback>().firstOrNull()?.let { callback ->
                synchronized(states) { states.remove(callback) }?.let(::cancel)
            }
            chain.proceed()
        })
        HookInstaller.hookAllMethods(Intent::class.java, "getExtras", Hooker { chain ->
            val intent = chain.thisObject as? Intent ?: return@Hooker chain.proceed()
            val original = chain.proceed() as? Bundle ?: return@Hooker null
            val rewritten = rewritePendingIntentResults(original, packageName, uid) ?: return@Hooker original
            intent.replaceExtras(rewritten)
            rewritten
        })
        HookInstaller.hookAllMethods(Intent::class.java, "getParcelableArrayListExtra", Hooker { chain ->
            val intent = chain.thisObject as? Intent ?: return@Hooker chain.proceed()
            if (chain.args.firstOrNull() != BluetoothLeScanner.EXTRA_LIST_SCAN_RESULT) return@Hooker chain.proceed()
            val originalExtras = runCatching { Reflection.getObjectField(intent, "mExtras") as? Bundle }.getOrNull()
                ?: return@Hooker chain.proceed()
            val rewritten = rewritePendingIntentResults(originalExtras, packageName, uid)
                ?: return@Hooker chain.proceed()
            intent.replaceExtras(rewritten)
            rewritten.getParcelableArrayList<ScanResult>(BluetoothLeScanner.EXTRA_LIST_SCAN_RESULT)
        })
        HookInstaller.hookAllMethods(Intent::class.java, "getSerializableExtra", Hooker { chain ->
            val intent = chain.thisObject as? Intent ?: return@Hooker chain.proceed()
            if (chain.args.firstOrNull() != BluetoothLeScanner.EXTRA_LIST_SCAN_RESULT) return@Hooker chain.proceed()
            val originalExtras = runCatching { Reflection.getObjectField(intent, "mExtras") as? Bundle }.getOrNull()
                ?: return@Hooker chain.proceed()
            val rewritten = rewritePendingIntentResults(originalExtras, packageName, uid)
                ?: return@Hooker chain.proceed()
            intent.replaceExtras(rewritten)
            rewritten.getSerializable(BluetoothLeScanner.EXTRA_LIST_SCAN_RESULT)
        })
    }

    private fun rewritePendingIntentResults(bundle: Bundle, packageName: String, uid: Int): Bundle? {
        val resultKey = BluetoothLeScanner.EXTRA_LIST_SCAN_RESULT
        if (!FakeLoc.enable || !bundle.containsKey(resultKey)) return null

        val rewritten = Bundle(bundle)
        val errorCode = rewritten.getInt(BluetoothLeScanner.EXTRA_ERROR_CODE, 0)
        if (errorCode != 0) {
            rewritten.putParcelableArrayList(resultKey, arrayListOf())
            return rewritten
        }

        val selection = pendingFilters.selection()
        val results = (selection as? PendingScanSelection.Unique)?.let { selected ->
            matchingSyntheticResults(packageName, uid, ScanState(selected.filters))
        }.orEmpty()
        if (results.isEmpty()) {
            rewritten.putParcelableArrayList(resultKey, arrayListOf())
            rewritten.putInt(BluetoothLeScanner.EXTRA_ERROR_CODE, ScanCallback.SCAN_FAILED_FEATURE_UNSUPPORTED)
        } else {
            rewritten.putParcelableArrayList(resultKey, ArrayList(results))
            rewritten.remove(BluetoothLeScanner.EXTRA_ERROR_CODE)
        }
        return rewritten
    }

    private fun hookCallback(callback: ScanCallback, packageName: String, uid: Int) {
        Reflection.findMethodExactIfExists(callback.javaClass, "onScanResult", Int::class.javaPrimitiveType!!,
            ScanResult::class.java)?.onceHook(Hooker { chain ->
            if (injectingCallback.get() == true) return@Hooker chain.proceed()
            if (!FakeLoc.enable) return@Hooker chain.proceed()
            val state = synchronized(states) { states[chain.thisObject as? ScanCallback] }
                ?: return@Hooker null
            val results = matchingSyntheticResults(packageName, uid, state)
            if (results.isEmpty()) return@Hooker null
            val result = results[Math.floorMod(state.nextIndex.getAndIncrement(), results.size)]
            val args = chain.args.toTypedArray()
            args[1] = result
            chain.proceed(args)
        })
        Reflection.findMethodExactIfExists(callback.javaClass, "onBatchScanResults", List::class.java)
            ?.onceHook(Hooker { chain ->
                if (injectingCallback.get() == true) return@Hooker chain.proceed()
                if (!FakeLoc.enable) return@Hooker chain.proceed()
                val state = synchronized(states) { states[chain.thisObject as? ScanCallback] }
                    ?: return@Hooker null
                val results = matchingSyntheticResults(packageName, uid, state)
                if (results.isEmpty()) return@Hooker null
                val args = chain.args.toTypedArray()
                args[0] = results
                chain.proceed(args)
            })
        Reflection.findMethodExactIfExists(callback.javaClass, "onScanFailed", Int::class.javaPrimitiveType!!)
            ?.onceHook(Hooker { chain ->
                synchronized(states) { states[chain.thisObject as? ScanCallback] }?.let(::cancel)
                chain.proceed()
            })
    }

    private fun scheduleSyntheticScan(callback: ScanCallback, state: ScanState, packageName: String, uid: Int) {
        val task = object : Runnable {
            override fun run() {
                if (!state.active.get()) return
                if (!FakeLoc.enable) {
                    handler.postDelayed(this, RESCAN_INTERVAL_MILLIS)
                    return
                }
                val results = matchingSyntheticResults(packageName, uid, state)
                if (results.isNotEmpty()) {
                    if (state.reportDelayMillis > 0L) {
                        dispatch(callback) {
                            Reflection.callMethod(callback, "onBatchScanResults", ArrayList(results))
                        }
                    } else {
                        results.forEach { result ->
                            val address = result.device.address
                            val isFirst = synchronized(state.seenAddresses) { state.seenAddresses.add(address) }
                            when {
                                isFirst && state.callbackType and ScanSettings.CALLBACK_TYPE_FIRST_MATCH != 0 ->
                                    dispatch(callback) {
                                        Reflection.callMethod(callback, "onScanResult", ScanSettings.CALLBACK_TYPE_FIRST_MATCH, result)
                                    }
                                state.callbackType and ScanSettings.CALLBACK_TYPE_ALL_MATCHES != 0 ->
                                    dispatch(callback) {
                                        Reflection.callMethod(callback, "onScanResult", ScanSettings.CALLBACK_TYPE_ALL_MATCHES, result)
                                    }
                                isFirst -> dispatch(callback) {
                                    Reflection.callMethod(callback, "onScanResult", ScanSettings.CALLBACK_TYPE_FIRST_MATCH, result)
                                }
                            }
                            if (isFirst && state.callbackType and ScanSettings.CALLBACK_TYPE_MATCH_LOST != 0) {
                                handler.postDelayed({
                                    if (state.active.get()) dispatch(callback) {
                                        Reflection.callMethod(
                                            callback, "onScanResult", ScanSettings.CALLBACK_TYPE_MATCH_LOST, result,
                                        )
                                    }
                                }, MATCH_LOST_DELAY_MILLIS)
                            }
                        }
                    }
                }
                if (state.callbackType and ScanSettings.CALLBACK_TYPE_ALL_MATCHES != 0 || state.reportDelayMillis > 0L) {
                    handler.postDelayed(this, RESCAN_INTERVAL_MILLIS)
                }
            }
        }
        state.task = task
        if (state.active.get()) handler.postDelayed(task, INITIAL_RESULT_DELAY_MILLIS)
    }

    private fun dispatch(callback: ScanCallback, action: () -> Any?) {
        val previous = injectingCallback.get()
        injectingCallback.set(true)
        try {
            action()
        } finally {
            injectingCallback.set(previous)
        }
    }

    private fun cancel(state: ScanState) {
        state.active.set(false)
        state.task?.let(handler::removeCallbacks)
    }

    private fun matchingSyntheticResults(packageName: String, uid: Int, state: ScanState): List<ScanResult> {
        val route = ListenerRouting.decisionFor(packageName, uid)
        if (route == RoutingDecision.Deny) return emptyList()
        val point = when (route) {
            is RoutingDecision.Point -> route.point
            is RoutingDecision.Scenario -> FakeLoc.snapshotForScenario(route.scenarioId).let {
                Wgs84(it.latitude, it.longitude)
            }
            else -> Wgs84(FakeLoc.latitude, FakeLoc.longitude)
        }
        val replay = if (FakeLoc.environmentSourceMode == EnvironmentSourceMode.PROCEDURAL) null else {
            FakeLoc.replayEnvironment?.takeIf { EnvironmentReplayPolicy.isApplicable(it, point) }
        }
        val beacons = replay?.ble?.takeIf { it.isNotEmpty() }
            ?: ProceduralBleSource().beaconsAt(point, FakeLoc.environmentSeed)
        val generated = beacons.mapNotNull(::buildScanResult)
            .filter { result -> state.filters.isEmpty() || state.filters.any { filter ->
                runCatching { filter.matches(result) }.getOrDefault(false)
            } }
        if (generated.isEmpty() && FakeLoc.enableDebugLog) {
            Logger.warn("BLE scan: no synthetic results match filters for $packageName")
        }
        return generated
    }

    private fun buildScanResult(beacon: BleBeacon): ScanResult? = runCatching {
        val adapter = BluetoothAdapter.getDefaultAdapter() ?: return null
        val device = adapter.getRemoteDevice(beacon.address)
        val bytes = beacon.scanRecordHex?.takeIf(BleBeacon::isValidAdvertisementHex)
            ?.let(::hexToBytes) ?: synthesizedAdvertisementBytes(beacon)
        val parsed = parseScanRecord(bytes)
        val record = parsed ?: parseScanRecord(synthesizedAdvertisementBytes(beacon))
            ?: return null
        ScanResult(device, record, beacon.rssi, SystemClock.elapsedRealtimeNanos())
    }.getOrNull()

    private fun parseScanRecord(bytes: ByteArray): ScanRecord? =
        runCatching {
            Reflection.callStaticMethod(ScanRecord::class.java, "parseFromBytes", bytes) as? ScanRecord
        }.getOrNull()

    private fun hexToBytes(hex: String): ByteArray =
        ByteArray(hex.length / 2) { index -> hex.substring(index * 2, index * 2 + 2).toInt(16).toByte() }

    private fun synthesizedAdvertisementBytes(beacon: BleBeacon): ByteArray {
        val name = beacon.name.take(29).toByteArray(Charsets.UTF_8)
        val nameField = byteArrayOf((name.size + 1).toByte(), 0x09) + name
        val txPower = beacon.txPowerDbm?.let { byteArrayOf(2, 0x0A, it.toByte()) } ?: byteArrayOf()
        return byteArrayOf(2, 0x01, 0x06) + txPower + nameField
    }

    private const val INITIAL_RESULT_DELAY_MILLIS = 250L
    private const val RESCAN_INTERVAL_MILLIS = 5_000L
    private const val MATCH_LOST_DELAY_MILLIS = 15_000L
}
```

`xposed/src/main/java/com/system/location/service/hook/hooks/ble/PendingScanRegistry.kt`:

```kt
package com.system.location.service.hook.hooks.ble

internal sealed interface PendingScanSelection<out V> {
    data object None : PendingScanSelection<Nothing>
    data object Ambiguous : PendingScanSelection<Nothing>
    data class Unique<V>(val filters: List<V>) : PendingScanSelection<V>
}

/** Keeps PendingIntent filters paired with their registrations instead of sharing the last scan. */
internal class PendingScanRegistry<K : Any, V> {
    private val registrations = linkedMapOf<K, List<V>>()

    @Synchronized
    fun register(key: K, filters: List<V>) {
        registrations[key] = filters.toList()
    }

    @Synchronized
    fun unregister(key: K) {
        registrations.remove(key)
    }

    @Synchronized
    fun selection(): PendingScanSelection<V> = when (registrations.size) {
        0 -> PendingScanSelection.None
        1 -> registrations.values.firstOrNull()?.let { PendingScanSelection.Unique(it) }
            ?: PendingScanSelection.None
        else -> PendingScanSelection.Ambiguous
    }
}
```

`xposed/src/main/java/com/system/location/service/hook/hooks/blindhook/BlindHook.kt`:

```kt
package com.system.location.service.hook.hooks.blindhook

import android.location.Location
import com.system.location.service.hook.utils.FakeLoc
import com.system.location.service.hook.utils.Logger
import com.system.location.service.hook.utils.onceHook
import io.github.libxposed.api.XposedInterface
import java.lang.reflect.Member

object BlindHook {
    operator fun <T> invoke(
        clazz: Class<*>,
        classLoader: ClassLoader,
        handler: (Member, T?) -> T?,
    ): Int {
        var count = 0
        clazz.declaredMethods.forEach { method ->
            if (method.returnType == Location::class.java) {
                if (FakeLoc.enableDebugLog) {
                    Logger.debug(
                        "BlindHookV2 ${method.name}: ${method.parameterTypes.joinToString()}"
                    )
                }
                method.onceHook(
                    XposedInterface.Hooker { chain ->
                        @Suppress("UNCHECKED_CAST") val location = chain.proceed() as? T
                        if (location == null) null else handler(chain.executable, location)
                    }
                )
                count++
                return@forEach
            }
            val index = method.parameterTypes.indexOfFirst { it == Location::class.java }
            if (index >= 0) {
                if (FakeLoc.enableDebugLog) {
                    Logger.debug(
                        "BlindHookV2 ${method.name}: ${method.parameterTypes.joinToString()}"
                    )
                }
                method.onceHook(
                    XposedInterface.Hooker { chain ->
                        val args = chain.args.toTypedArray()
                        @Suppress("UNCHECKED_CAST") val location = args[index] as? T
                        if (location != null) args[index] = handler(chain.executable, location)
                        chain.proceed(args)
                    }
                )
                count++
            }
        }
        return count
    }
}
```

```kt
package com.system.location.service.hook.hooks.blindhook

import android.location.Location

object BlindHookLocation : BaseLocationHook() {
    operator fun invoke(clazz: Class<*>, classLoader: ClassLoader): Int {
        return BlindHook(clazz, classLoader) { method, location: Location? ->
            if (location == null || !FakeLoc.enable) return@BlindHook location

            val newLoc = injectLocation(location)

            if (FakeLoc.enableDebugLog) {
                Logger.debug("${method.name} injected: $newLoc")
            }

            newLoc
        }
    }
```

```kt
package com.system.location.service.hook.hooks.fused

import android.location.Location
import com.system.location.service.hook.BaseLocationHook
import com.system.location.service.hook.hooks.blindhook.BlindHookLocation
import com.system.location.service.hook.utils.FakeLoc
import com.system.location.service.hook.utils.Logger
import com.system.location.service.hook.runtime.HookRuntime
import com.system.location.service.hook.scope.HookInstaller
import com.system.location.service.hook.utils.onceHook
import com.system.location.service.hook.utils.toClass
import io.github.libxposed.api.XposedInterface

object AndroidFusedLocationProviderHook : BaseLocationHook() {
    operator fun invoke(classLoader: ClassLoader): Boolean {
        val cFusedLocationProvider =
            "com.android.location.fused.FusedLocationProvider".toClass(classLoader)
        if (cFusedLocationProvider == null) {
            Logger.warn("Failed to find FusedLocationProvider")
            return false
        }

        if (!initDivineService("AndroidFusedLocationProvider")) {
            Logger.error("Failed to init DivineService in AndroidFusedLocationProvider")
            return false
        }

        val chooseBestLocation = HookInstaller.findMethod(
            cFusedLocationProvider,
            "chooseBestLocation",
            Location::class.java,
            Location::class.java,
        )
        chooseBestLocation?.onceHook(
            XposedInterface.Hooker intercept59@{ chain ->
                var result = chain.proceed()

                if (result == null) return@intercept59 result

                if (FakeLoc.enable) {
                    result = injectLocation(result as Location)
                }

                result
            },
        )

        val cChildLocationListener =
            "com.android.location.fused.FusedLocationProvider\$ChildLocationListener"
                .toClass(classLoader)
        val callbacks = if (cChildLocationListener == null) {
            Logger.warn("Failed to find ChildLocationListener")
            0
        } else {
            BlindHookLocation(cChildLocationListener, classLoader)
        }
        val installed = chooseBestLocation != null || callbacks > 0
        HookRuntime.log("fused hook class=${cFusedLocationProvider.name} chooseBest=${chooseBestLocation != null} callbacks=$callbacks installed=$installed")
        return installed
    }
}
```

```kt
package com.system.location.service.hook.hooks.fused

import android.location.LocationListener
import android.os.Bundle
import com.system.location.service.hook.BaseLocationHook
import com.system.location.service.hook.hooks.blindhook.BlindHookLocation
import com.system.location.service.hook.hooks.blindhook.BlindHookLocation.invoke
import com.system.location.service.hook.runtime.Reflection
import com.system.location.service.hook.utils.FakeLoc

import com.system.location.service.hook.utils.onceHookMethod
import com.system.location.service.hook.utils.toClass
import io.github.libxposed.api.XposedInterface
import java.lang.reflect.Modifier

object ThirdPartyLocationHook : BaseLocationHook() {
    operator fun invoke(classLoader: ClassLoader) {
        if (!initDivineService("ThirdPartyLocationHook")) {
            Logger.error("Failed to init DivineService in ThirdPartyLocationHook")
            return
        }

        hookAMapNetLocManager(classLoader)
        hookBDMap(classLoader)
        hookTencent(classLoader)
    }

    private fun hookAMapNetLocManager(classLoader: ClassLoader) {
        val cNetworkLocationManager =
            "com.amap.android.location.NetworkLocationManager".toClass(classLoader)
        if (cNetworkLocationManager == null) {
            Logger.warn("Failed to find NetworkLocationManager (amap service)")
            return
        }

        cNetworkLocationManager.onceHookMethod(
            "onSendExtraCommand",
            String::class.java,
            Bundle::class.java,
            callback =
                XposedInterface.Hooker intercept60@{ chain ->
                    val args = chain.args.toTypedArray()

                    if (FakeLoc.enableDebugLog) {
                        val cmd = args[0] as String
                        val extras = args[1] as Bundle

                        Logger.debug("NetworkLocationManager.onSendExtraCommand: $cmd, $extras")
                    }
                    if (FakeLoc.enable) {
                        return@intercept60 false
                    }

                    chain.proceed(args)
                },
        )

        val boolFields =
            cNetworkLocationManager.declaredFields.filter {
                it.type == Boolean::class.java && !Modifier.isStatic(it.modifiers)
            }
        boolFields.forEach { it.isAccessible = true }
        val listenerField =
            cNetworkLocationManager.declaredFields.filter {
                it.type == LocationListener::class.java && !Modifier.isStatic(it.modifiers)
            }
        listenerField.forEach { it.isAccessible = true }
        cNetworkLocationManager.onceHookMethod(
            "requestLocationUpdates",
            Long::class.javaPrimitiveType!!,
            LocationListener::class.java,
            callback =
                XposedInterface.Hooker intercept61@{ chain ->
                    val args = chain.args.toTypedArray()

                    if (FakeLoc.enable) {
                        if (args[1] is LocationListener) {
                            args[1] = null // 拒绝高德地图注册私有listener
                        }
                        listenerField.forEach { it.set(chain.thisObject, null) }
                        boolFields.forEach { it.setBoolean(chain.thisObject, false) }
                    }

                    chain.proceed(args)
                },
        )

        cNetworkLocationManager.hookMethod(
            "updateOffLocEnable",
            Boolean::class.javaPrimitiveType!!,
            callback =
                XposedInterface.Hooker { null },
        )

        BlindHookLocation(cNetworkLocationManager, classLoader)
    }

    private fun hookBDMap(classLoader: ClassLoader) {
        run {
            val bdLocationClient = "com.baidu.location.LocationClient".toClass(classLoader)
            if (bdLocationClient == null) {
                Logger.warn("Failed to find LocationClient (baidu service)")
                return@run
            }

            bdLocationClient.hookMethod(
                "requestNLPNormal",
                String::class.java,
                Int::class.javaPrimitiveType!!,
                callback =
                    XposedInterface.Hooker intercept63@{ chain ->
                        val args = chain.args.toTypedArray()
                        var result = chain.proceed()

                        if (FakeLoc.enable) {
                            val bdLocation = result ?: return@intercept63 result

                            val jitterLat = FakeLoc.jitterLocation()
                            Reflection.callMethod(bdLocation, "setLatitude", jitterLat.first)
                            Reflection.callMethod(bdLocation, "setLongitude", jitterLat.second)
                            Reflection.callMethod(bdLocation, "setBuildingID", "")
                            Reflection.callMethod(bdLocation, "setAddrStr", "")
                        }

                        result
                    },
            )

            BlindHookLocation(bdLocationClient, classLoader)
        }
    }

    private fun hookTencent(classLoader: ClassLoader) {
        run {
            val cTencentNLPManager =
                "com.tencent.geolocation.nlp.TencentNLPManager".toClass(classLoader)
            if (cTencentNLPManager == null) {
                Logger.warn("Failed to find TencentNLPManager (tencent service)")
                return@run
            }

            BlindHookLocation(cTencentNLPManager, classLoader)
        }
    }
}
```

`xposed/src/main/java/com/system/location/service/hook/hooks/gnss/GnssCallbackRegistry.kt`:

```kt
package com.system.location.service.hook.hooks.gnss

import android.os.IBinder
import android.os.IInterface
import com.system.location.service.core.gnss.GnssFrameRoute
import com.system.location.service.core.routing.RoutingDecision
import com.system.location.service.core.routing.RoutingTable
import com.system.location.service.core.routing.RoutingConfig
import com.system.location.service.hook.utils.BinderUtils
import com.system.location.service.hook.utils.FakeLoc
import com.system.location.service.hook.runtime.CallbackSubscription

/** Strong callbacks are bounded by Binder lifetime, explicit unregister and module teardown. */
internal class GnssCallbackRegistry(
    private val callerDecision: (String?, Int, RoutingConfig?) -> RoutingDecision = ::gnssCallerDecision,
) {
    private data class Entry(val listener: IInterface, val packageName: String?, val uid: Int,
        val death: IBinder.DeathRecipient, val token: Any, var lastDeliveryKey: String? = null,
        var pendingDeliveryKey: String? = null, var nextDeliveryIndex: Int = 0)
    private val entries = LinkedHashMap<IBinder, Entry>()

    @Synchronized
    fun register(listener: IInterface, packageName: String?, uid: Int): Boolean {
        val binder = listener.asBinder()
        if (entries.containsKey(binder)) return true
        if (!binder.isBinderAlive) return false
        val token = Any()
        val death = IBinder.DeathRecipient { unregisterBinder(binder, token) }
        val entry = Entry(listener, packageName, uid, death, token)
        entries[binder] = entry
        try {
            binder.linkToDeath(death, 0)
        } catch (_: android.os.RemoteException) {
            unregisterBinder(binder, token)
            return false
        }
        if (entries[binder] !== entry || !binder.isBinderAlive) { unregisterBinder(binder, token); return false }
        return true
    }

    fun unregister(listener: IInterface) = unregisterBinder(listener.asBinder())

    @Synchronized
    fun subscriptions(): List<CallbackSubscription> = entries.values.map {
        CallbackSubscription(it.listener, it.uid, it.packageName, lastDeliveryKey = it.lastDeliveryKey,
            pendingDeliveryKey = it.pendingDeliveryKey, nextDeliveryIndex = it.nextDeliveryIndex)
    }

    @Synchronized
    fun restore(subscription: CallbackSubscription): Boolean {
        val binder = subscription.listener.asBinder()
        if (!binder.isBinderAlive || entries.containsKey(binder)) return false
        val token = Any()
        val death = IBinder.DeathRecipient { unregisterBinder(binder, token) }
        val entry = Entry(subscription.listener, subscription.packageName, subscription.uid, death, token,
            subscription.lastDeliveryKey, subscription.pendingDeliveryKey, subscription.nextDeliveryIndex)
        entries[binder] = entry
        return try {
            binder.linkToDeath(death, 0)
            if (entries[binder] !== entry || !binder.isBinderAlive) { unregisterBinder(binder, token); false } else true
        } catch (_: android.os.RemoteException) {
            unregisterBinder(binder, token)
            false
        }
    }

    @Synchronized
    private fun unregisterBinder(binder: IBinder, expectedToken: Any? = null) {
        val entry = entries[binder] ?: return
        if (expectedToken != null && entry.token !== expectedToken) return
        entries.remove(binder)
        runCatching { binder.unlinkToDeath(entry.death, 0) }
    }

    @Synchronized
    fun listeners(): List<IInterface> {
        entries.keys.filter { !it.isBinderAlive }.toList().forEach { unregisterBinder(it) }
        return entries.values.map { it.listener }
    }

    @Synchronized
    fun clear() { entries.keys.toList().forEach { unregisterBinder(it) } }

    /** The single delivery worker commits only complete successful frames; no lock spans Binder. */
    fun deliverOnce(listener: IInterface, key: String, action: () -> Boolean) {
        val binder = listener.asBinder()
        val entry = synchronized(this) { entries[binder]?.takeUnless { it.lastDeliveryKey == key } } ?: return
        if (!submit(binder, entry, action)) return
        synchronized(this) { if (entries[binder] === entry) entry.lastDeliveryKey = key }
    }

    /**
     * One producer per registry. Commit each successful Binder submission, outside the registry
     * lock, so a paused batch can resume without replaying its prefix. Unregister invalidates the
     * captured entry, including when the same Binder is immediately registered again.
     */
    fun deliverBatch(listener: IInterface, key: String, itemCount: Int,
        allowed: () -> Boolean, action: (Int) -> Unit) {
        require(itemCount > 0)
        val binder = listener.asBinder()
        val entry = synchronized(this) {
            entries[binder]?.takeUnless { it.lastDeliveryKey == key }?.also {
                if (it.pendingDeliveryKey != key) {
                    it.pendingDeliveryKey = key
                    it.nextDeliveryIndex = 0
                }
                require(it.nextDeliveryIndex <= itemCount) { "Batch progress exceeds its exact content" }
            }
        } ?: return
        val start = synchronized(this) { entry.nextDeliveryIndex }
        for (index in start until itemCount) {
            if (Thread.currentThread().isInterrupted || !allowed()) return
            if (synchronized(this) { entries[binder] !== entry }) return
            submit(binder, entry) { action(index) }
            synchronized(this) {
                if (entries[binder] !== entry) return
                entry.nextDeliveryIndex = index + 1
            }
        }
        synchronized(this) {
            if (entries[binder] === entry) {
                entry.lastDeliveryKey = key
                entry.pendingDeliveryKey = null
                entry.nextDeliveryIndex = 0
            }
        }
    }

    /** A failed old submission must never remove a replacement registration on this Binder. */
    private inline fun <T> submit(binder: IBinder, entry: Entry, action: () -> T): T =
        try { action() } catch (error: Exception) {
            if (error is android.os.DeadObjectException || !binder.isBinderAlive)
                unregisterBinder(binder, entry.token)
            throw error
        }

    fun routeFor(listener: Any?, routing: RoutingConfig? = FakeLoc.runtimeSnapshots.current().routing): GnssFrameRoute? {
        val entry = entry(listener) ?: return null
        return receiverRouteFor(callerDecision(entry.packageName, entry.uid, routing))
    }

    @Synchronized
    private fun entry(listener: Any?): Entry? = (listener as? IInterface)?.asBinder()?.let(entries::get)
}

internal fun gnssCallerRoute(packageName: String?, uid: Int,
    routing: RoutingConfig? = FakeLoc.runtimeSnapshots.current().routing): GnssFrameRoute? =
    receiverRouteFor(gnssCallerDecision(packageName, uid, routing))

private fun receiverRouteFor(decision: RoutingDecision): GnssFrameRoute? = when (decision) {
    RoutingDecision.Global -> GnssFrameRoute.Global
    RoutingDecision.Deny -> null
    is RoutingDecision.Point -> GnssFrameRoute.FixedPoint(decision.point)
    is RoutingDecision.Scenario -> GnssFrameRoute.Scenario(decision.scenarioId)
}

private fun gnssCallerDecision(packageName: String?, uid: Int, routing: RoutingConfig?): RoutingDecision {
    val config = routing ?: return RoutingDecision.Global
    val packages = packageName?.takeIf { it.isNotBlank() }?.let(::listOf)
        ?: runCatching { BinderUtils.getUidPackageNames(uid = uid)?.toList().orEmpty() }.getOrDefault(emptyList())
    val system = packages.any { runCatching { BinderUtils.isSystemPackages(it) }.getOrDefault(false) }
    return RoutingTable(config).decision(uid, packages, system)
}
```

```kt
package com.system.location.service.hook.hooks.gnss

import android.location.Location
import com.system.location.service.hook.BaseLocationHook
import com.system.location.service.hook.hooks.blindhook.BlindHookLocation
import com.system.location.service.hook.hooks.blindhook.BlindHookLocation.invoke
import com.system.location.service.hook.runtime.Reflection
import com.system.location.service.hook.utils.FakeLoc
import com.system.location.service.hook.utils.Logger
import com.system.location.service.hook.utils.hookAllMethods
import io.github.libxposed.api.XposedInterface

object GnssHook : BaseLocationHook() {
    operator fun invoke(classLoader: ClassLoader) {
        hookFrameworkGnss(classLoader)
        hookHALGnss(classLoader)
    }

    private fun hookFrameworkGnss(classLoader: ClassLoader) {
        val cGnssManagerService =
            Reflection.findClassIfExists(
                "com.android.server.location.GnssManagerService",
                classLoader,
            ) ?: return

        val rawRegistration = rawGnssRegistrationHook()

        // Rejections return the method's API-shaped false/void result and report unsupported
        // status through the callback. Preserve genuine framework failures on allowed calls.
        com.system.location.service.hook.scope.HookInstaller.hookAllMethods(
            cGnssManagerService,
            "addGnssAntennaInfoListener",
            rawRegistration,
            exceptionMode = XposedInterface.ExceptionMode.PASSTHROUGH,
        )
        com.system.location.service.hook.scope.HookInstaller.hookAllMethods(
            cGnssManagerService,
            "addGnssMeasurementsListener",
            rawRegistration,
            exceptionMode = XposedInterface.ExceptionMode.PASSTHROUGH,
        )
        com.system.location.service.hook.scope.HookInstaller.hookAllMethods(
            cGnssManagerService,
            "addGnssNavigationMessageListener",
            rawRegistration,
            exceptionMode = XposedInterface.ExceptionMode.PASSTHROUGH,
        )
        com.system.location.service.hook.scope.HookInstaller.hookAllMethods(
            cGnssManagerService,
            "removeGnssAntennaInfoListener",
            rawRegistration,
            exceptionMode = XposedInterface.ExceptionMode.PASSTHROUGH,
        )
        com.system.location.service.hook.scope.HookInstaller.hookAllMethods(
            cGnssManagerService,
            "removeGnssMeasurementsListener",
            rawRegistration,
            exceptionMode = XposedInterface.ExceptionMode.PASSTHROUGH,
        )
        com.system.location.service.hook.scope.HookInstaller.hookAllMethods(
            cGnssManagerService,
            "removeGnssNavigationMessageListener",
            rawRegistration,
            exceptionMode = XposedInterface.ExceptionMode.PASSTHROUGH,
        )
    }

    private fun hookHALGnss(classLoader: ClassLoader) {
        var hookedGnssLocationProvider = 0
        val cGnssLocationProviderImpl =
            Reflection.findClassIfExists(
                "com.android.server.location.gnss.GnssLocationProviderImpl",
                classLoader,
            )
        if (cGnssLocationProviderImpl != null) {
            BlindHookLocation(cGnssLocationProviderImpl, classLoader)
            hookedGnssLocationProvider = 1
        }

        if (hookedGnssLocationProvider == 0) {
            val cGnssLocationProvider =
                Reflection.findClassIfExists(
                    "com.android.server.location.gnss.GnssLocationProvider",
                    classLoader,
                )
            if (cGnssLocationProvider != null) {
                BlindHookLocation(cGnssLocationProvider, classLoader)
                hookedGnssLocationProvider = 2
            }
        }

        if (hookedGnssLocationProvider == 0) {
            Logger.error("Failed to find GnssLocationProvider!")
        } else {
            Logger.info("GnssLocationProvider done, status: $hookedGnssLocationProvider")
        }

        val cGnssNative =
            Reflection.findClassIfExists(
                "com.android.server.location.gnss.hal.GnssNative",
                classLoader,
            )
        if (cGnssNative != null) {
            BlindHookLocation(cGnssNative, classLoader)

            cGnssNative.hookAllMethods(
                "reportLocationBatch",
                XposedInterface.Hooker intercept38@{ chain ->
                    val args = chain.args.toTypedArray()

                    val locations = args.firstOrNull() as? Array<*>
                    if (FakeLoc.enable && locations != null &&
                        locations.javaClass.componentType == Location::class.java && locations.all { it is Location }) {
                        // The framework API takes a single Location[] argument. Copy the array:
                        // mutating the provider-owned batch can also affect other consumers.
                        args[0] = injectLocationBatch(locations.map { it as Location }).toTypedArray()
                    }

                    chain.proceed(args)
                },
            )
        } else {
            Logger.error("GnssNative not found")
        }
    }

}
```

```kt
package com.system.location.service.hook.hooks.gnss

import android.os.IInterface
import com.system.location.service.core.gnss.GnssFrameRoute
import com.system.location.service.core.routing.RoutingConfig
import com.system.location.service.hook.utils.FakeLoc
import com.system.location.service.hook.utils.BinderUtils
import com.system.location.service.hook.runtime.CallbackSubscription

object GnssListenerRouting {
    private val registry = GnssCallbackRegistry()

    fun register(listener: IInterface, packageName: String?) {
        if (registry.register(listener, packageName, BinderUtils.getCallerUid())) GnssSignalInjection.ensureStarted()
    }
    fun unregister(listener: IInterface) = registry.unregister(listener)
    fun listeners(): List<IInterface> = registry.listeners()
    fun routeFor(listener: Any?, routing: RoutingConfig? = FakeLoc.runtimeSnapshots.current().routing): GnssFrameRoute? =
        registry.routeFor(listener, routing)
    fun clear() = registry.clear()
    internal fun deliverOnce(listener: IInterface, key: String, action: () -> Boolean) =
        registry.deliverOnce(listener, key, action)
    internal fun subscriptions(): List<CallbackSubscription> = registry.subscriptions()
    internal fun restore(subscription: CallbackSubscription): Boolean = registry.restore(subscription)
}
```

`xposed/src/main/java/com/system/location/service/hook/hooks/gnss/GnssReceiverRuntime.kt`:

```kt
package com.system.location.service.hook.hooks.gnss

import android.provider.Settings
import com.system.location.service.core.geo.Wgs84
import com.system.location.service.core.gnss.CapturedGnssSource
import com.system.location.service.core.gnss.GnssFrameRoute
import com.system.location.service.core.gnss.PublishedGnssFrame
import com.system.location.service.hook.utils.FakeLoc
import com.system.location.service.hook.utils.BinderUtils
import com.system.location.service.hook.utils.ProviderView
import com.system.location.service.hook.utils.ProviderReadContext
import com.system.location.service.core.location.LocationSample
import com.system.location.service.core.runtime.RuntimeSnapshot

/** Resolves authenticated runtime policy to one shared autonomous or replay publication. */
object GnssReceiverRuntime {
    /** A callback evaluates all policy and evidence against this one captured context. */
    fun activeContext(): ProviderReadContext? {
        val initial = FakeLoc.runtimeSnapshots.current().configuration
        if (!initial.enabled || !initial.gnssEnabled || initial.gnssFrameSource() == null) return null
        val context = ProviderView.capture()
        val policy = context.state.configuration
        return context.takeIf { policy.enabled && policy.gnssEnabled && policy.gnssFrameSource() != null }
    }

    /** Raw receiver payload protection follows simulated-location scope, even without a frame source. */
    fun protectionContext(): ProviderReadContext? {
        if (!FakeLoc.runtimeSnapshots.current().configuration.enabled) return null
        val context = ProviderView.capture()
        return context.takeIf { it.state.configuration.enabled }
    }

    @Synchronized
    fun configure(payload: String?) {
        val prepared = CapturedGnssSource.prepare(payload, FakeLoc.runtimeSnapshots.current().configuration.gnssSource)
        FakeLoc.runtimeSnapshots.update { state ->
            if (state.configuration.gnssSource === prepared) state else state.copy(
                configRevision = Math.addExact(state.configRevision, 1),
                configuration = state.configuration.copy(gnssSource = prepared))
        }
    }

    fun currentFrame(point: Wgs84? = null): PublishedGnssFrame? {
        return frameForRoute(GnssFrameRoute.forObserver(point = point))
    }

    fun frameForRoute(route: GnssFrameRoute): PublishedGnssFrame? {
        if (FakeLoc.runtimeSnapshots.current().configuration.gnssFrameSource() == null) return null
        return frameForRoute(route, ProviderView.capture())
    }

    fun frameForRoute(route: GnssFrameRoute, context: ProviderReadContext): PublishedGnssFrame? {
        if (context.state.configuration.gnssFrameSource() == null) return null
        val sample = when (route) {
            GnssFrameRoute.Global -> ProviderView.sampleFor("gps", context = context)
            is GnssFrameRoute.FixedPoint -> ProviderView.sampleFor("gps", point = route.point, context = context)
            is GnssFrameRoute.Scenario -> ProviderView.sampleFor("gps", scenarioId = route.id, context = context)
        }
        return frameForSample(sample, route, context.state, context.validationAtMillis)
    }

    fun frameForSample(sample: LocationSample, route: GnssFrameRoute = GnssFrameRoute.Global,
        state: RuntimeSnapshot = FakeLoc.runtimeSnapshots.current(),
        validationAtMillis: Long = System.currentTimeMillis(),
        currentBootCount: Int? = if (state.configuration.gnssFrameSource()?.requiresBootIdentity == true)
            readBootCount() else null): PublishedGnssFrame? =
        state.configuration.gnssFrameSource()?.frame(sample, state.configuration.minimumSatellites, route,
            validationAtMillis, currentBootCount)

    private fun readBootCount(): Int? = runCatching {
        val resolver = BinderUtils.getSystemContext()?.contentResolver ?: return null
        Settings.Global.getInt(resolver, Settings.Global.BOOT_COUNT).takeIf { it >= 0 }
    }.getOrNull()
}
```
