`xposed/src/main/java/com/system/location/service/hook/hooks/gnss/GnssSignalInjection.kt`:

```kt
package com.system.location.service.hook.hooks.gnss

import android.location.GnssMeasurementsEvent
import android.os.IInterface
import com.system.location.service.core.gnss.GnssFrameRoute
import com.system.location.service.core.gnss.PublishedGnssFrame
import com.system.location.service.core.runtime.RuntimeSnapshot
import com.system.location.service.core.runtime.RuntimeSnapshotObservation
import com.system.location.service.hook.hooks.nmea.NmeaBridge
import com.system.location.service.hook.hooks.nmea.NmeaListenerRouting
import com.system.location.service.hook.runtime.HookRuntime
import com.system.location.service.hook.runtime.DeliveryWorker
import com.system.location.service.hook.utils.FakeLoc
import com.system.location.service.hook.utils.LogRateLimiter
import com.system.location.service.hook.utils.Logger
import com.system.location.service.hook.utils.ProviderView

/** The only producer of simulated GNSS callbacks, using the selected autonomous or replay source. */
object GnssSignalInjection {
    private val failures = LogRateLimiter()
    private val rawReadyListeners = java.util.Collections.newSetFromMap(
        java.util.concurrent.ConcurrentHashMap<android.os.IBinder, Boolean>())
    /** Binder -> callback for synthetic GNSS lifecycle callbacks, one pair per listener. */
    private val startedListeners = java.util.concurrent.ConcurrentHashMap<android.os.IBinder, IInterface>()
    private val firstFixListeners = java.util.Collections.newSetFromMap(
        java.util.concurrent.ConcurrentHashMap<android.os.IBinder, Boolean>())
    private val worker = DeliveryWorker("GnssSignalInjection", { 1000 },
        tick = ::tick, failure = { error -> report("worker", error) })

    fun ensureStarted() = worker.start()

    internal fun forgetRawListener(listener: IInterface) {
        val binder = listener.asBinder()
        rawReadyListeners.remove(binder)
        firstFixListeners.remove(binder)
        startedListeners.remove(binder)
    }

    /** New provider samples wake the producer; exact frame keys still limit each epoch to once. */
    fun onSamplePublished() = worker.requestTick()

    /** Pause delivery without losing subscriptions; a failed reload can resume this generation. */
    fun pause(): Boolean = worker.stop()

    fun stop(): Boolean {
        if (!pause()) return false
        startedListeners.values.forEach { listener ->
            invokeLifecycle(listener, "onGnssStopped", emptyArray<Any?>())
        }
        startedListeners.clear()
        firstFixListeners.clear()
        GnssListenerRouting.clear()
        NmeaListenerRouting.clear()
        RawGnssCallbacks.clear()
        RawGnssSyntheticDelivery.clear()
        rawReadyListeners.clear()
        return true
    }

    private fun invokeLifecycle(listener: IInterface, name: String, args: Array<Any?>) {
        val method = listener.javaClass.methods.firstOrNull {
            it.name == name && it.parameterTypes.size == args.size
        } ?: return
        runCatching { HookRuntime.invokeOriginalMethod(method, listener, args) }
            .onFailure { Logger.warn("Synthetic GNSS $name failed: ${it.message}") }
    }

    private fun tick() {
        // Avoid generating samples while inactive; the captured policy below is authoritative.
        val initial = FakeLoc.runtimeSnapshots.observation()
        val initialPolicy = initial.state.configuration
        if (!initialPolicy.enabled || !initialPolicy.gnssEnabled || initialPolicy.gnssFrameSource() == null) return
        val context = ProviderView.capture()
        val policy = context.state.configuration
        if (!policy.enabled || !policy.gnssEnabled || policy.gnssFrameSource() == null) return
        val frames = ReceiverTickFrames { GnssReceiverRuntime.frameForRoute(it, context) }
        GnssListenerRouting.listeners().forEach { listener ->
            deliver(listener) {
                val route = GnssListenerRouting.routeFor(listener, context.state.routing) ?: return@deliver
                val publication = frames.forRoute(route) ?: return@deliver
                val method = listener.javaClass.methods.firstOrNull {
                    it.name == "onSvStatusChanged" && ReceiverGnssStatusAdapter.supports(it)
                } ?: error("unsupported GNSS status callback signature")
                GnssListenerRouting.deliverOnce(listener, publication.frame.toString()) {
                    if (!receiverDeliveryAllowed(context.state, initial.simulationGeneration,
                            FakeLoc.runtimeSnapshots.observation())) return@deliverOnce false
                    // Real status lifecycle is suppressed while active; provide the equivalent
                    // synthetic start/first-fix sequence so status consumers do not stall.
                    val binder = listener.asBinder()
                    if (startedListeners.putIfAbsent(binder, listener) == null) {
                        invokeLifecycle(listener, "onGnssStarted", emptyArray<Any?>())
                    }
                    if (firstFixListeners.add(binder)) {
                        invokeLifecycle(listener, "onFirstFix", arrayOf<Any?>(0))
                    }
                    HookRuntime.invokeOriginalMethod(method, listener, ReceiverGnssStatusAdapter.arguments(method, publication))
                    true
                }
            }
        }
        deliverRawMeasurements(context, frames, initial)
        if (!policy.nmeaEnabled) return
        NmeaListenerRouting.listeners().forEach { listener ->
            deliver(listener) {
                val route = NmeaListenerRouting.routeFor(listener, context.state.routing) ?: return@deliver
                val publication = frames.forRoute(route) ?: return@deliver
                val method = listener.javaClass.methods.firstOrNull {
                    it.name == "onNmeaReceived" && it.parameterTypes.toList() ==
                        listOf(Long::class.javaPrimitiveType, String::class.java)
                } ?: error("unsupported NMEA callback signature")
                val sentences = NmeaBridge.generatedSentences(publication)
                // Compare the exact emitted epoch/text, without rounded-time windows or hashes.
                val key = "${publication.frame.generatedAtMillis}:${sentences.joinToString("")}"
                NmeaListenerRouting.deliverBatch(listener, key, sentences.size,
                    allowed = { receiverDeliveryAllowed(context.state, initial.simulationGeneration,
                        FakeLoc.runtimeSnapshots.observation(), nmea = true) }) { index ->
                    // Android OnNmeaMessageListener timestamps are UTC milliseconds, not elapsed nanos.
                    HookRuntime.invokeOriginalMethod(method, listener,
                        arrayOf(publication.frame.generatedAtMillis, sentences[index]))
                }
            }
        }
    }

    private fun deliverRawMeasurements(
        context: com.system.location.service.hook.utils.ProviderReadContext,
        frames: ReceiverTickFrames,
        initial: RuntimeSnapshotObservation,
    ) {
        RawGnssCallbacks.listeners().forEach { listener ->
            val method = listener.javaClass.methods.firstOrNull {
                it.name == "onGnssMeasurementsReceived" &&
                    it.parameterTypes.toList() == listOf(GnssMeasurementsEvent::class.java)
            } ?: return@forEach
            deliver(listener) {
                val route = RawGnssCallbacks.routeFor(listener, context.state.routing) ?: return@deliver
                val publication = frames.forRoute(route) ?: return@deliver
                val event = RawGnssSyntheticDelivery.event(route, publication, context) ?: return@deliver
                if (rawReadyListeners.add(listener.asBinder())) reportRawGnssReady(listener)
                val key = "${publication.sequence}:${publication.frame.generatedAtMillis}:" +
                    event.clock.timeNanos
                RawGnssCallbacks.deliverMeasurements(listener, key) {
                    if (!receiverDeliveryAllowed(context.state, initial.simulationGeneration,
                            FakeLoc.runtimeSnapshots.observation())) return@deliverMeasurements false
                    HookRuntime.invokeOriginalMethod(method, listener, arrayOf(event))
                    true
                }
            }
        }
    }

    private inline fun deliver(listener: IInterface, action: () -> Unit) {
        if (Thread.currentThread().isInterrupted) return
        try { action() } catch (error: Exception) {
            if (error is InterruptedException) { Thread.currentThread().interrupt(); return }
            report(listener.javaClass.name, error)
        }
    }

    private fun report(key: String, error: Exception) {
        if (failures.allow(key, System.nanoTime()))
            HookRuntime.log("GNSS delivery failed [$key]: ${error.javaClass.simpleName}: ${error.message}")
    }
}

/** Stop/configuration/routing changes invalidate a captured batch; sample renewal does not. */
internal fun receiverDeliveryAllowed(captured: RuntimeSnapshot, simulationGeneration: Long,
    current: RuntimeSnapshotObservation, nmea: Boolean = false): Boolean =
    current.simulationGeneration == simulationGeneration && current.state.configuration.enabled &&
    current.state.configuration.gnssEnabled && (!nmea || current.state.configuration.nmeaEnabled) &&
    current.state.configuration.gnssFrameSource() != null &&
    current.state.configuration == captured.configuration && current.state.routing == captured.routing

/** Freeze each route once per delivery tick, even if provider samples advance during callbacks. */
internal class ReceiverTickFrames(private val source: (GnssFrameRoute) -> PublishedGnssFrame?) {
    private val frames = mutableMapOf<GnssFrameRoute, PublishedGnssFrame?>()
    fun forRoute(route: GnssFrameRoute): PublishedGnssFrame? {
        if (!frames.containsKey(route)) frames[route] = source(route)
        return frames[route]
    }
}
```

`xposed/src/main/java/com/system/location/service/hook/hooks/gnss/RawGnssAndroidEvent.kt`:

```kt
package com.system.location.service.hook.hooks.gnss

import android.location.GnssClock
import android.location.GnssMeasurement
import android.location.GnssMeasurementsEvent
import com.system.location.service.core.gnss.Constellation
import com.system.location.service.core.gnss.GnssMeasurementBatch
import com.system.location.service.core.gnss.GnssMeasurementObservation
import com.system.location.service.core.gnss.GpsL1RawMeasurementSynthesizer
import com.system.location.service.hook.runtime.Reflection
import com.system.location.service.hook.utils.Logger

/**
 * Builds the hidden Android raw-observation objects from the same batch that the independent
 * solver test validates. Every field is set through the framework's own setters so their presence
 * flags stay coherent; a failed required field rejects the whole event rather than exposing a
 * half-populated observation.
 */
internal object RawGnssAndroidEvent {
    fun create(batch: GnssMeasurementBatch): GnssMeasurementsEvent? = try {
        val clock = clock(batch) ?: return null
        val measurements = batch.measurements.mapNotNull(::measurement)
        if (measurements.size < GpsL1RawMeasurementSynthesizer.MIN_MEASUREMENTS) {
            Logger.warn("Synthetic raw event incomplete: measurements=${measurements.size}")
            return null
        }
        event(clock, measurements)
    } catch (failure: Throwable) {
        Logger.error("Synthetic raw event creation failed", failure)
        null
    }

    private fun clock(batch: GnssMeasurementBatch): GnssClock? = try {
        val clock = Reflection.newInstance(GnssClock::class.java) as GnssClock
        require(set(clock, "setTimeNanos", batch.timeNanos))
        require(set(clock, "setHardwareClockDiscontinuityCount", batch.hardwareClockDiscontinuityCount))
        batch.fullBiasNanos?.let { require(set(clock, "setFullBiasNanos", it)) }
        batch.biasNanos?.let { set(clock, "setBiasNanos", it) }
        batch.timeUncertaintyNanos?.let { set(clock, "setTimeUncertaintyNanos", it) }
        batch.biasUncertaintyNanos?.let { set(clock, "setBiasUncertaintyNanos", it) }
        batch.driftNanosPerSecond?.let { set(clock, "setDriftNanosPerSecond", it) }
        batch.driftUncertaintyNanosPerSecond?.let { set(clock, "setDriftUncertaintyNanosPerSecond", it) }
        batch.elapsedRealtimeNanos?.let { require(set(clock, "setElapsedRealtimeNanos", it)) }
        batch.elapsedRealtimeUncertaintyNanos?.let { set(clock, "setElapsedRealtimeUncertaintyNanos", it) }
        batch.leapSecond?.let { set(clock, "setLeapSecond", it) }
        batch.referenceConstellationTypeForIsb?.let {
            set(clock, "setReferenceConstellationTypeForIsb", it)
        }
        batch.referenceCarrierHzForIsb?.let {
            set(clock, "setReferenceCarrierFrequencyHzForIsb", it)
        }
        batch.referenceCodeTypeForIsb?.let { set(clock, "setReferenceCodeTypeForIsb", it) }
        clock
    } catch (failure: Throwable) {
        Logger.error("Synthetic raw clock conversion failed", failure)
        null
    }

    private fun measurement(observation: GnssMeasurementObservation): GnssMeasurement? = try {
        val measurement = Reflection.newInstance(GnssMeasurement::class.java) as GnssMeasurement
        require(set(measurement, "setSvid", observation.svid))
        require(set(measurement, "setConstellationType", constellationType(observation.constellation)))
        require(set(measurement, "setTimeOffsetNanos", observation.timeOffsetNanos))
        require(set(measurement, "setState", observation.state))
        require(set(measurement, "setReceivedSvTimeNanos", observation.receivedSvTimeNanos))
        require(set(measurement, "setReceivedSvTimeUncertaintyNanos",
            observation.receivedSvTimeUncertaintyNanos))
        require(set(measurement, "setCn0DbHz", observation.cn0DbHz))
        require(set(measurement, "setPseudorangeRateMetersPerSecond",
            observation.pseudorangeRateMetersPerSecond))
        require(set(measurement, "setPseudorangeRateUncertaintyMetersPerSecond",
            observation.pseudorangeRateUncertaintyMetersPerSecond))
        require(set(measurement, "setAccumulatedDeltaRangeState",
            observation.accumulatedDeltaRangeState))
        require(set(measurement, "setAccumulatedDeltaRangeMeters",
            observation.accumulatedDeltaRangeMeters))
        require(set(measurement, "setAccumulatedDeltaRangeUncertaintyMeters",
            observation.accumulatedDeltaRangeUncertaintyMeters))
        observation.carrierHz?.let { set(measurement, "setCarrierFrequencyHz", it.toFloat()) }
        observation.codeType?.let { set(measurement, "setCodeType", it) }
        measurement
    } catch (failure: Throwable) {
        Logger.error("Synthetic raw measurement conversion failed", failure)
        null
    }

    private fun constellationType(constellation: Constellation): Int = when (constellation) {
        Constellation.GPS -> 1
        Constellation.SBAS -> 2
        Constellation.GLONASS -> 3
        Constellation.BEIDOU -> 5
        Constellation.GALILEO -> 6
        Constellation.QZSS -> 4
        Constellation.IRNSS -> 7
    }

    private fun set(target: Any, method: String, value: Any): Boolean = try {
        Reflection.callMethod(target, method, value)
        true
    } catch (failure: Throwable) {
        Logger.error("Synthetic raw setter $method failed", failure)
        false
    }

    private fun event(clock: GnssClock, measurements: List<GnssMeasurement>): GnssMeasurementsEvent? {
        val type = GnssMeasurementsEvent::class.java
        val constructors = listOf(
            arrayOf<Class<*>>(
                Int::class.javaPrimitiveType!!,
                GnssClock::class.java,
                List::class.java,
                List::class.java,
                Boolean::class.javaPrimitiveType!!,
            ),
            arrayOf<Class<*>>(GnssClock::class.java, Collection::class.java),
            arrayOf<Class<*>>(GnssClock::class.java, List::class.java),
        )
        for (parameters in constructors) {
            try {
                val args: Array<Any?> = when (parameters.size) {
                    5 -> arrayOf(1, clock, measurements, emptyList<Any>(), true)
                    2 -> arrayOf(clock, measurements)
                    else -> error("unsupported GnssMeasurementsEvent signature")
                }
                return type.getDeclaredConstructor(*parameters).apply { isAccessible = true }
                    .newInstance(*args) as GnssMeasurementsEvent
            } catch (failure: Throwable) {
                Logger.error("Synthetic raw event ctor ${
                    parameters.joinToString(",") { it.simpleName }
                } failed", failure)
            }
        }
        // Last resort for an OEM that hides the constructor but keeps the AOSP field names.
        return try {
            val instance = Reflection.newInstance(type) as GnssMeasurementsEvent
            setField(instance, "mFlag", 1)
            setField(instance, "mClock", clock)
            setField(instance, "mMeasurements", measurements)
            setField(instance, "mGnssAgcs", emptyList<Any>())
            setField(instance, "mIsFullTracking", true)
            instance
        } catch (failure: Throwable) {
            Logger.error("Synthetic raw event field fallback failed", failure)
            null
        }
    }

    private fun setField(target: Any, name: String, value: Any) {
        val field = Reflection.findFieldIfExists(target.javaClass, name)
            ?: error("missing $name")
        field.set(target, value)
    }
}
```

`xposed/src/main/java/com/system/location/service/hook/hooks/gnss/RawGnssCallbacks.kt`:

```kt
package com.system.location.service.hook.hooks.gnss

import android.os.IInterface
import com.system.location.service.hook.utils.BinderUtils
import com.system.location.service.hook.utils.Logger
import com.system.location.service.hook.utils.onceHook
import io.github.libxposed.api.XposedInterface
import java.lang.reflect.Method
import java.lang.reflect.Modifier

/** Retains caller routing while Android owns the actual raw registrations and permissions. */
internal object RawGnssCallbacks {
    private val registry = GnssCallbackRegistry()

    fun proceed(chain: XposedInterface.Chain,
        install: (IInterface) -> Unit = ::installRestored,
        callerUid: () -> Int = BinderUtils::getCallerUid): Any? {
        val listener = chain.args.filterIsInstance<IInterface>().firstOrNull() ?: return chain.proceed()
        val binder = listener.asBinder()
        // Serialize duplicate add/remove for one transport without locking callback delivery.
        return synchronized(binder) {
            if (chain.executable.name.startsWith("remove")) {
                val result = try {
                    chain.proceed()
                } catch (failure: UnsupportedOperationException) {
                    // Removal must never turn an unsupported OEM surface into an app crash.
                    return@synchronized rawGnssRegistrationResult(
                        chain.executable as? Method ?: return@synchronized null,
                        accepted = false,
                    )
                }
                // The app asked to remove this transport. Always drop our routing record even
                // when a synthetic-only registration never reached the framework and its remove
                // returns false.
                unregister(listener)
                result
            } else {
                val existed = registry.listeners().any { it.asBinder() == binder }
                registry.register(listener, chain.args.filterIsInstance<String>().firstOrNull(), callerUid())
                try {
                    // Hook setup can fail after installing only part of the callback surface.
                    install(listener)
                } catch (_: Exception) {
                    return@synchronized rejectInstallation(chain, listener, existed)
                } catch (_: LinkageError) {
                    // A callback method can be present but not hookable on an OEM runtime. Treat it
                    // like a normal rejected registration instead of letting an Error reach Binder.
                    return@synchronized rejectInstallation(chain, listener, existed)
                }
                try {
                    val result = chain.proceed()
                    if (result == false && !existed) unregister(listener)
                    result
                } catch (failure: UnsupportedOperationException) {
                    // The framework itself may report an unsupported raw surface. Report the API's
                    // unsupported status instead of propagating an exception into the caller.
                    val method = chain.executable as? Method ?: return@synchronized null
                    if (existed) return@synchronized rawGnssRegistrationResult(method, accepted = true)
                    unregister(listener)
                    rejectRawGnssRegistration(method, listener)
                } catch (failure: Throwable) {
                    if (!existed) unregister(listener)
                    throw failure
                }
            }
        }
    }

    /**
     * Synthetic-only registration: Android may have no raw-measurement capability at all, so the
     * framework must not be asked to start a physical reader. The app-visible API still returns
     * its normal accepted result and the producer owns every callback.
     */
    fun registerSynthetic(
        chain: XposedInterface.Chain,
        install: (IInterface) -> Unit = ::installRestored,
        callerUid: () -> Int = BinderUtils::getCallerUid,
    ): Any? {
        val listener = chain.args.filterIsInstance<IInterface>().firstOrNull() ?: return null
        val binder = listener.asBinder()
        return synchronized(binder) {
            val method = chain.executable as? Method ?: return@synchronized null
            if (!registry.register(listener, chain.args.filterIsInstance<String>().firstOrNull(), callerUid())) {
                return@synchronized rawGnssRegistrationResult(method, accepted = false)
            }
            try {
                install(listener)
            } catch (_: Exception) {
                return@synchronized rejectInstallation(chain, listener, existed = false)
            } catch (_: LinkageError) {
                return@synchronized rejectInstallation(chain, listener, existed = false)
            }
            rawGnssRegistrationResult(method, accepted = true)
        }
    }

    private fun rejectInstallation(
        chain: XposedInterface.Chain,
        listener: IInterface,
        existed: Boolean,
    ): Any? {
        val method = chain.executable as? Method ?: return null
        if (existed) return rawGnssRegistrationResult(method, accepted = true)
        unregister(listener)
        return rejectRawGnssRegistration(method, listener)
    }

    fun blocked(listener: Any?): Boolean {
        val context = GnssReceiverRuntime.protectionContext() ?: return false
        registry.routeFor(listener, context.state.routing) ?: return false
        return rawGnssPayloadProtectionApplies(context.state.configuration.enabled, protectedRoute = true)
    }

    fun listeners(): List<IInterface> = registry.listeners()

    fun routeFor(listener: Any?, routing: com.system.location.service.core.routing.RoutingConfig?):
        com.system.location.service.core.gnss.GnssFrameRoute? = registry.routeFor(listener, routing)

    fun contains(listener: Any?): Boolean {
        val binder = (listener as? IInterface)?.asBinder() ?: return false
        return registry.listeners().any { it.asBinder() == binder }
    }

    /** Remove routing and producer-side one-shot state; a later re-register gets READY again. */
    fun unregister(listener: IInterface) {
        registry.unregister(listener)
        GnssSignalInjection.forgetRawListener(listener)
    }

    /** Synthetic delivery bypasses the framework callback hook via invokeOriginalMethod. */
    fun deliverMeasurements(listener: IInterface, key: String, action: () -> Boolean) =
        registry.deliverOnce(listener, key, action)

    fun clear() = registry.clear()
    internal fun subscriptions() = registry.subscriptions()
    internal fun restore(subscription: com.system.location.service.hook.runtime.CallbackSubscription): Boolean =
        registry.restore(subscription)
    internal fun restoreAndInstall(
        subscription: com.system.location.service.hook.runtime.CallbackSubscription,
        install: (IInterface) -> Unit = ::installRestored,
    ): Boolean {
        if (!registry.restore(subscription)) return false
        return try {
            install(subscription.listener)
            true
        } catch (failure: Exception) {
            Logger.error("Failed to restore raw GNSS callback hooks for ${subscription.listener.javaClass.name}", failure)
            false
        } catch (failure: LinkageError) {
            Logger.error("Raw GNSS callback API is unavailable for ${subscription.listener.javaClass.name}", failure)
            false
        }
    }
    internal fun installRestored(listener: IInterface) {
        val hook = rawGnssCallbackHook()
        val methods = rawGnssCallbackMethods(listener.javaClass)
        methods.forEach { it.onceHook(hook) }
    }
}

private val RAW_PAYLOADS = setOf(
    "onGnssMeasurementsReceived",
    "onGnssNavigationMessageReceived",
    "onGnssAntennaInfoReceived",
    // Binder-side IGnssAntennaInfoListener name; the app-side callback uses the older name above.
    "onGnssAntennaInfoChanged",
)
private val RAW_CALLBACKS = RAW_PAYLOADS + "onStatusChanged"

internal fun rawGnssCallbackMethods(type: Class<*>): List<Method> {
    val methods = LinkedHashSet<Method>()
    var current: Class<*>? = type
    while (current != null && current != Any::class.java) {
        current.declaredMethods
            .filterTo(methods) { it.name in RAW_CALLBACKS && !Modifier.isAbstract(it.modifiers) }
        current = current.superclass
    }
    require(methods.any { it.name in RAW_PAYLOADS }) {
        "Unsupported raw GNSS callback implementation: ${type.name}"
    }
    return methods.toList()
}

/** Evaluate live policy on every callback, including listeners registered while simulation was off. */
internal fun rawGnssCallbackHook(
    blocked: (Any?) -> Boolean = RawGnssCallbacks::blocked,
): XposedInterface.Hooker = XposedInterface.Hooker { chain ->
    if (!blocked(chain.thisObject)) return@Hooker chain.proceed()
    when {
        chain.executable.name in RAW_PAYLOADS -> null
        chain.executable.name == "onStatusChanged" && chain.args.size == 1 && chain.args[0] is Int ->
            // Measurements and navigation use STATUS_NOT_SUPPORTED=0. Never report READY with no data.
            chain.proceed(arrayOf<Any>(0))
        else -> chain.proceed()
    }
}
```

`xposed/src/main/java/com/system/location/service/hook/hooks/gnss/RawGnssRegistration.kt`:

```kt
package com.system.location.service.hook.hooks.gnss

import io.github.libxposed.api.XposedInterface
import java.lang.reflect.Method
import com.system.location.service.core.gnss.RawGnssSynthesis
import com.system.location.service.hook.runtime.HookRuntime
import com.system.location.service.hook.utils.BinderUtils
import com.system.location.service.hook.utils.LocationCallerGuard
import com.system.location.service.hook.utils.Logger

/** Raw observations are either real receiver data or explicitly unsupported, never fabricated. */
internal fun rawGnssRegistrationHook(
    blocked: (List<Any?>) -> Boolean = ::rawGnssCallerBlocked,
): XposedInterface.Hooker = XposedInterface.Hooker { chain ->
    try {
        handleRawGnssRegistration(chain, blocked)
    } catch (failure: SecurityException) {
        throw failure
    } catch (failure: IllegalStateException) {
        // A genuine framework state failure remains the framework's result.
        throw failure
    } catch (failure: Throwable) {
        // A raw-registration hook must never become a new crash surface. Policy/resource/OEM
        // failures are reported as the API's unsupported result instead of crossing Binder.
        val method = chain.executable as? Method
        Logger.error("raw GNSS registration hook failed: ${method?.name}", failure)
        val listener = chain.args.filterIsInstance<android.os.IInterface>().firstOrNull()
        if (method != null) {
            reportRawGnssUnsupported(listener)
            rawGnssRegistrationResult(method, accepted = false)
        } else null
    }
}

private fun handleRawGnssRegistration(
    chain: XposedInterface.Chain,
    blocked: (List<Any?>) -> Boolean,
): Any? {
    val method = chain.executable as? Method ?: return chain.proceed()
    // Removal must always reach Android, including listeners created before simulation started.
    if (!method.name.startsWith("add") || chain.args.isEmpty() ||
        !blocked(chain.args)) return RawGnssCallbacks.proceed(chain)
    // Let a caller without location permission observe the framework's SecurityException.
    if (!LocationCallerGuard.canReadLocation()) return RawGnssCallbacks.proceed(chain)
    val listener = chain.args.filterIsInstance<android.os.IInterface>().firstOrNull()
    val syntheticMeasures = method.name.contains("Measurements") && runCatching {
        GnssReceiverRuntime.protectionContext()?.let {
            RawGnssSynthesis.canSynthesize(it.state.configuration, System.currentTimeMillis())
        } == true
    }.getOrDefault(false)
    if (syntheticMeasures) {
        // The HAL may expose no raw-measurement capability at all. Register only in our routing
        // registry: the app-visible API still succeeds, while the producer owns every payload.
        val result = RawGnssCallbacks.registerSynthetic(chain)
        if (RawGnssCallbacks.contains(listener)) {
            // READY is emitted by the producer only after the first real batch is constructed;
            // reporting it here would claim a working reader before any payload exists and would
            // make AOSP's one-shot status contract observable as two READY callbacks.
            runCatching { GnssSignalInjection.ensureStarted() }
        }
        return result
    }
    return rejectRawGnssRegistration(method, listener)
}

internal fun rejectRawGnssRegistration(method: Method, listener: Any?): Any? {
    reportRawGnssUnsupported(listener)
    return rawGnssRegistrationResult(method, accepted = false)
}

internal fun rawGnssRegistrationResult(method: Method, accepted: Boolean): Any? {
    // Some OEM entry points return void and use status callbacks for rejection.
    return if (method.returnType == Boolean::class.javaPrimitiveType ||
        method.returnType == Boolean::class.javaObjectType) accepted else null
}

private fun rawGnssCallerBlocked(args: List<Any?>): Boolean {
    val context = GnssReceiverRuntime.protectionContext() ?: return false
    gnssCallerRoute(args.filterIsInstance<String>().firstOrNull(), BinderUtils.getCallerUid(), context.state.routing)
        ?: return false
    return rawGnssPayloadProtectionApplies(context.state.configuration.enabled, protectedRoute = true)
}

internal fun rawGnssPayloadProtectionApplies(simulationEnabled: Boolean, protectedRoute: Boolean): Boolean =
    simulationEnabled && protectedRoute

/** Report unsupported because a rejected registration cannot provide measurement callbacks. */
internal fun reportRawGnssUnsupported(listener: Any?) = reportRawGnssStatus(listener, RAW_GNSS_STATUS_NOT_SUPPORTED)

/** The synthetic observation producer owns the payload, so the reader can report READY. */
internal fun reportRawGnssReady(listener: Any?) = reportRawGnssStatus(listener, RAW_GNSS_STATUS_READY)

private fun reportRawGnssStatus(listener: Any?, code: Int) {
    val callback = listener ?: return
    val status = callback.javaClass.methods.firstOrNull { method ->
        method.name == "onStatusChanged" && method.parameterTypes.toList() == listOf(Int::class.javaPrimitiveType)
    } ?: return
    // The callback proxy's onStatusChanged is itself guarded by rawGnssCallbackHook (which
    // suppresses real framework payloads). Invoke the original transport directly so a synthetic
    // READY is not rewritten to NOT_SUPPORTED by that guard.
    runCatching { HookRuntime.invokeOriginalMethod(status, callback, arrayOf(code)) }
        .recoverCatching { status.invoke(callback, code) }
}

private const val RAW_GNSS_STATUS_NOT_SUPPORTED = 0
private const val RAW_GNSS_STATUS_READY = 1
```

`xposed/src/main/java/com/system/location/service/hook/hooks/gnss/RawGnssSyntheticDelivery.kt`:

```kt
package com.system.location.service.hook.hooks.gnss

import android.location.GnssMeasurementsEvent
import android.os.SystemClock
import com.system.location.service.core.gnss.Constellation
import com.system.location.service.core.gnss.GnssFrameRoute
import com.system.location.service.core.gnss.GpsL1RawMeasurementSynthesizer
import com.system.location.service.core.gnss.GpsL1ReceiverState
import com.system.location.service.core.gnss.GpsL1SignalQuality
import com.system.location.service.core.gnss.GpsLnavEphemeris
import com.system.location.service.core.gnss.GpsTime
import com.system.location.service.core.gnss.PublishedGnssFrame
import com.system.location.service.core.gnss.RawGnssSynthesis
import com.system.location.service.hook.utils.Logger
import com.system.location.service.hook.utils.ProviderReadContext

/**
 * Per-route GPS L1 synthetic observation pipeline. One synthesizer per route preserves ADR phase
 * continuity across epochs, while a changed ephemeris set starts a new track and a fresh ADR reset.
 * The frame that drives GNSS status/NMEA is the same frame that drives these measurements.
 */
internal object RawGnssSyntheticDelivery {
    private class Track(
        val ephemerides: List<GpsLnavEphemeris>,
        val synthesizer: GpsL1RawMeasurementSynthesizer,
    ) {
        @Volatile var receiver: GpsL1ReceiverState? = null
        @Volatile var quality: Map<Int, GpsL1SignalQuality> = emptyMap()
    }

    /** Receiver clock state survives a track/ephemeris rebuild for the same route. */
    private class ClockState {
        var gpsAnchor: GpsTime? = null
        var elapsedAnchorNanos: Long? = null
        var lastElapsedNanos: Long? = null
        var lastGpsTime: GpsTime? = null
        var discontinuityCount: Int = 0
    }

    private val tracks = LinkedHashMap<GnssFrameRoute, Track>()
    private val clocks = HashMap<GnssFrameRoute, ClockState>()
    private val lock = Any()

    fun event(
        route: GnssFrameRoute,
        publication: PublishedGnssFrame,
        context: ProviderReadContext,
        elapsedRealtimeNanos: Long = SystemClock.elapsedRealtimeNanos(),
    ): GnssMeasurementsEvent? {
        val frame = publication.frame
        // A static scenario can reuse one sky publication for many ticks; raw epochs still have
        // to advance with the receiver clock or every ADR/measurement batch is rejected as stale.
        val nowMillis = System.currentTimeMillis()
        val gpsSats = frame.satellites
            .filter { it.constellation == Constellation.GPS }
            .associateBy { it.svid }
        if (gpsSats.size < GpsL1RawMeasurementSynthesizer.MIN_MEASUREMENTS) {
            Logger.warn("Synthetic raw unavailable: GPS satellites=${gpsSats.size}")
            return null
        }
        val available = RawGnssSynthesis.ephemerides(
            context.state.configuration.gnssNavigation,
            nowMillis,
        ).filter { it.svid in gpsSats }
        if (available.size < GpsL1RawMeasurementSynthesizer.MIN_MEASUREMENTS) {
            Logger.warn("Synthetic raw unavailable: usable GPS ephemerides=${available.size}")
            return null
        }

        val track = synchronized(lock) {
            val current = tracks[route]
            val clockState = clocks.getOrPut(route) { ClockState() }
            if (current != null && current.ephemerides == available) current
            else {
                // A new ephemeris track resets ADR phase; signal that discontinuity instead of
                // letting the counter fall back to zero on the next route/lookup.
                if (current != null) clockState.discontinuityCount++
                Track(available, GpsL1RawMeasurementSynthesizer(
                    available,
                    receiverAt = { currentTrack(route)?.receiver },
                    qualityAt = { ephemeris, _ -> currentTrack(route)?.quality?.get(ephemeris.svid) },
                )).also { tracks[route] = it }
            }
        }
        val clockState = synchronized(lock) { clocks.getOrPut(route) { ClockState() } }
        val clockBias = 1.5e-4
        track.receiver = GpsL1ReceiverState(
            observer = frame.observer,
            ellipsoidHeightMeters = frame.altitudeMeters,
            clockBiasSeconds = clockBias,
            clockDriftSecondsPerSecond = 2e-12,
            ionosphericDelayMeters = 4.0,
            troposphericDelayMeters = 2.5,
            clockUncertaintyNanos = 25.0,
            clockBiasUncertaintyNanos = 8.0,
            clockDriftUncertaintyNanosPerSecond = 0.2,
            elapsedRealtimeUncertaintyNanos = 20.0,
        )
        track.quality = available.associate { ephemeris ->
            val satellite = gpsSats.getValue(ephemeris.svid)
            ephemeris.svid to GpsL1SignalQuality(
                cn0DbHz = satellite.cn0DbHz.toDouble().coerceIn(20.0, 55.0),
                receivedSvTimeUncertaintyNanos = 25L,
                pseudorangeRateUncertaintyMetersPerSecond = 0.2,
                accumulatedDeltaRangeUncertaintyMeters = 0.03,
            )
        }
        // Use UTC only for the initial anchor. Every later epoch is extrapolated from the
        // monotonic elapsed clock, keeping sub-millisecond receiver time continuous even when a
        // static sky frame is reused, a track is rebuilt, or wall time is quantized to ms.
        val clock = synchronized(lock) {
            val previousElapsed = clockState.lastElapsedNanos
            val wentBackwards = previousElapsed != null && elapsedRealtimeNanos < previousElapsed
            if (previousElapsed != null && elapsedRealtimeNanos - previousElapsed > 2_000_000_000L) {
                clockState.discontinuityCount++
            }
            if (wentBackwards) {
                clockState.discontinuityCount++
                clockState.gpsAnchor = clockState.lastGpsTime ?: clockState.gpsAnchor
                clockState.elapsedAnchorNanos = elapsedRealtimeNanos
            }
            clockState.lastElapsedNanos = elapsedRealtimeNanos
            val time = if (wentBackwards) {
                clockState.lastGpsTime
            } else {
                clockState.gpsAnchor?.let { anchor ->
                    val anchorElapsed = clockState.elapsedAnchorNanos ?: elapsedRealtimeNanos
                    anchor.plusSeconds(
                        (elapsedRealtimeNanos - anchorElapsed).coerceAtLeast(0L) / 1_000_000_000.0,
                    )
                }
            } ?: RawGnssSynthesis.gpsTime(nowMillis)?.also {
                clockState.gpsAnchor = it
                clockState.elapsedAnchorNanos = elapsedRealtimeNanos
            }
            clockState.lastGpsTime = time
            time?.let { it to clockState.discontinuityCount }
        } ?: run {
            Logger.warn("Synthetic raw unavailable: UTC/GPS time scale has no valid epoch")
            return null
        }
        val time = clock.first
        val batch = track.synthesizer.synthesize(
            receptionTime = time,
            elapsedRealtimeNanos = elapsedRealtimeNanos,
            capturedAtMillis = nowMillis,
            hardwareClockDiscontinuityCount = clock.second,
        ) ?: run {
            Logger.warn("Synthetic raw unavailable: ${track.synthesizer.lastFailure ?: "synthesizer returned null"}")
            return null
        }
        return RawGnssAndroidEvent.create(batch).also {
            if (it == null) Logger.warn("Synthetic raw unavailable: Android event conversion failed")
        }
    }

    fun clear() = synchronized(lock) {
        tracks.clear()
        clocks.clear()
    }

    private fun currentTrack(route: GnssFrameRoute): Track? = synchronized(lock) { tracks[route] }
}
```

`xposed/src/main/java/com/system/location/service/hook/hooks/gnss/ReceiverGnssStatusAdapter.kt`:

```kt
package com.system.location.service.hook.hooks.gnss

import android.location.GnssStatus
import com.system.location.service.core.gnss.Constellation
import com.system.location.service.core.gnss.PublishedGnssFrame
import java.lang.reflect.Method

/** Public GnssStatus.Builder covers evolving Android parcel layouts; legacy arrays stay isolated. */
object ReceiverGnssStatusAdapter {
    fun supports(method: Method): Boolean {
        val types = method.parameterTypes.toList()
        if (types.size == 1 && types.single().name == "android.location.GnssStatus") return true
        return types.size in 5..7 && types[0] == Int::class.javaPrimitiveType &&
            types[1] == IntArray::class.java && types.drop(2).all { it == FloatArray::class.java }
    }

    fun arguments(method: Method, publication: PublishedGnssFrame): Array<Any?> {
        require(supports(method)) { "unsupported GNSS status callback signature" }
        if (method.parameterCount == 1) {
            val builder = GnssStatus.Builder()
            publication.frame.satellites.forEach { satellite ->
                builder.addSatellite(code(satellite.constellation), satellite.svid, satellite.cn0DbHz,
                    satellite.elevationDeg, satellite.azimuthDeg, satellite.hasEphemeris, satellite.hasAlmanac,
                    satellite.usedInFix, satellite.carrierHz != null, satellite.carrierHz ?: 0f, false, 0f)
            }
            return arrayOf(builder.build())
        }
        val satellites = publication.frame.satellites
        val flags = IntArray(satellites.size) { index ->
            val satellite = satellites[index]
            var bits = 0
            if (satellite.hasEphemeris) bits = bits or 1
            if (satellite.hasAlmanac) bits = bits or 2
            if (satellite.usedInFix) bits = bits or 4
            if (satellite.carrierHz != null) bits = bits or 8
            (satellite.svid shl 12) or (code(satellite.constellation) shl 8) or bits
        }
        // Baseband CN0 was not observed. The flag stays unset and the unused array contains zeroes.
        val args: Array<Any?> = arrayOf(satellites.size, flags,
            satellites.map { it.cn0DbHz }.toFloatArray(), satellites.map { it.elevationDeg }.toFloatArray(),
            satellites.map { it.azimuthDeg }.toFloatArray(), satellites.map { it.carrierHz ?: 0f }.toFloatArray(),
            FloatArray(satellites.size))
        return args.copyOf(method.parameterCount)
    }

    private fun code(system: Constellation): Int = when (system) {
        Constellation.GPS -> 1
        Constellation.SBAS -> 2
        Constellation.GLONASS -> 3
        Constellation.QZSS -> 4
        Constellation.BEIDOU -> 5
        Constellation.GALILEO -> 6
        Constellation.IRNSS -> 7
    }
}
```

```kt
package com.system.location.service.hook.hooks.nmea

import com.system.location.service.hook.BaseLocationHook
import com.system.location.service.hook.utils.hookAllMethods
import com.system.location.service.hook.utils.onceHookAllMethod
import io.github.libxposed.api.XposedInterface
import android.os.IInterface
import com.system.location.service.hook.hooks.gnss.GnssReceiverRuntime
import com.system.location.service.hook.hooks.gnss.rawGnssRegistrationHook

object LocationNMEAHook : BaseLocationHook() {
    operator fun invoke(classILocationManager: Class<*>) {
        hookGnssNmea(classILocationManager)
        NmeaServiceHook.hook(classILocationManager.classLoader!!)

        val rawRegistration = rawGnssRegistrationHook()

        // Preserve explicit unsupported results from void raw-GNSS registration methods.
        com.system.location.service.hook.scope.HookInstaller.hookAllMethods(
            classILocationManager,
            "addGnssMeasurementsListener",
            rawRegistration,
            exceptionMode = XposedInterface.ExceptionMode.PASSTHROUGH,
        )
        com.system.location.service.hook.scope.HookInstaller.hookAllMethods(
            classILocationManager,
            "removeGnssMeasurementsListener",
            rawRegistration,
            exceptionMode = XposedInterface.ExceptionMode.PASSTHROUGH,
        )
        com.system.location.service.hook.scope.HookInstaller.hookAllMethods(
            classILocationManager,
            "addGnssNavigationMessageListener",
            rawRegistration,
            exceptionMode = XposedInterface.ExceptionMode.PASSTHROUGH,
        )
        com.system.location.service.hook.scope.HookInstaller.hookAllMethods(
            classILocationManager,
            "removeGnssNavigationMessageListener",
            rawRegistration,
            exceptionMode = XposedInterface.ExceptionMode.PASSTHROUGH,
        )
        com.system.location.service.hook.scope.HookInstaller.hookAllMethods(
            classILocationManager,
            "addGnssAntennaInfoListener",
            rawRegistration,
            exceptionMode = XposedInterface.ExceptionMode.PASSTHROUGH,
        )
        com.system.location.service.hook.scope.HookInstaller.hookAllMethods(
            classILocationManager,
            "removeGnssAntennaInfoListener",
            rawRegistration,
            exceptionMode = XposedInterface.ExceptionMode.PASSTHROUGH,
        )
    }

    private fun hookGnssNmea(service: Class<*>) {
        service.hookAllMethods("registerGnssNmeaCallback", XposedInterface.Hooker registration@{ chain ->
            val args = chain.args
            val callback = args.firstOrNull() as? IInterface
            // Arm the payload guard before the real registration can emit its first sentence.
            if (callback != null) {
                installNmeaCallback(callback)
                NmeaListenerRouting.register(callback, args.getOrNull(1) as? String)
            }
            val result = try {
                chain.proceed()
            } catch (failure: Throwable) {
                callback?.let(NmeaListenerRouting::unregister)
                throw failure
            }
            if (result == false) callback?.let(NmeaListenerRouting::unregister)
            result
        })
        service.hookAllMethods("unregisterGnssNmeaCallback", XposedInterface.Hooker { chain ->
            val result = chain.proceed()
            if (result != false) (chain.args.firstOrNull() as? IInterface)?.let(NmeaListenerRouting::unregister)
            result
        })
    }
}

internal fun installNmeaCallback(callback: IInterface) {
    callback.javaClass.onceHookAllMethod("onNmeaReceived", XposedInterface.Hooker { chain ->
        val types = chain.executable.parameterTypes.toList()
        val supported = types == listOf(Long::class.javaPrimitiveType, String::class.java)
        if (supported && ownsNmeaDelivery(chain.thisObject)) null else chain.proceed()
    })
}

/**
 * Protection is independent of synthetic NMEA availability. `nmeaEnabled` controls whether we
 * generate sentences; it must never turn a protected listener back into a real-NMEA passthrough.
 * A missing frame likewise suppresses the real sentence instead of forwarding it.
 */
internal fun ownsNmeaDelivery(listener: Any?): Boolean {
    val context = GnssReceiverRuntime.protectionContext() ?: return false
    return NmeaListenerRouting.routeFor(listener, context.state.routing) != null
}
```

`xposed/src/main/java/com/system/location/service/hook/hooks/nmea/NmeaBridge.kt`:

```kt
package com.system.location.service.hook.hooks.nmea

import com.system.location.service.core.geo.Wgs84
import com.system.location.service.core.gnss.Constellation
import com.system.location.service.core.gnss.GnssSatelliteIds
import com.system.location.service.core.gnss.PublishedGnssFrame
import com.system.location.service.hook.hooks.gnss.GnssReceiverRuntime
import moe.microbios.nmea.NmeaConstellation
import moe.microbios.nmea.NmeaFix
import moe.microbios.nmea.NmeaGenerator
import moe.microbios.nmea.NmeaSatellite

/** Output from the exact shared publication. No secondary model, wall-clock read or hidden catch. */
object NmeaBridge {
    fun generatedSentences(point: Wgs84? = null): List<String> =
        GnssReceiverRuntime.currentFrame(point)?.let(::generatedSentences).orEmpty()

    fun generatedSentences(publication: PublishedGnssFrame): List<String> {
        val frame = publication.frame
        val dop = frame.geometry.dop
        val satellites = frame.satellites.map { satellite ->
            val system = when (satellite.constellation) {
                Constellation.GPS, Constellation.SBAS -> NmeaConstellation.GPS
                Constellation.GLONASS -> NmeaConstellation.GLONASS
                Constellation.BEIDOU -> NmeaConstellation.BEIDOU
                Constellation.GALILEO -> NmeaConstellation.GALILEO
                Constellation.QZSS -> NmeaConstellation.QZSS
                Constellation.IRNSS -> NmeaConstellation.IRNSS
            }
            NmeaSatellite(system, checkNotNull(GnssSatelliteIds.nmeaId(satellite.constellation, satellite.svid)),
                satellite.elevationDeg, satellite.azimuthDeg, satellite.cn0DbHz, satellite.usedInFix)
        }
        return NmeaGenerator.generate(NmeaFix(latitude = frame.observer.latitude,
            longitude = frame.observer.longitude, altitudeMeters = frame.altitudeMeters,
            speedMps = publication.speedMps, bearingDeg = publication.bearingDeg,
            timeMillis = frame.generatedAtMillis, satellites = satellites,
            hdop = dop?.hdop, vdop = dop?.vdop, pdop = dop?.pdop))
    }
}
```

`xposed/src/main/java/com/system/location/service/hook/hooks/nmea/NmeaListenerRouting.kt`:

```kt
package com.system.location.service.hook.hooks.nmea

import android.os.IInterface
import com.system.location.service.hook.hooks.gnss.GnssCallbackRegistry
import com.system.location.service.hook.hooks.gnss.GnssSignalInjection
import com.system.location.service.core.gnss.GnssFrameRoute
import com.system.location.service.core.routing.RoutingConfig
import com.system.location.service.hook.utils.FakeLoc
import com.system.location.service.hook.utils.BinderUtils
import com.system.location.service.hook.runtime.CallbackSubscription

object NmeaListenerRouting {
    private val registry = GnssCallbackRegistry()

    fun register(listener: IInterface, packageName: String?) {
        if (registry.register(listener, packageName, BinderUtils.getCallerUid())) GnssSignalInjection.ensureStarted()
    }
    fun unregister(listener: IInterface) = registry.unregister(listener)
    fun listeners(): List<IInterface> = registry.listeners()
    fun routeFor(listener: Any?, routing: RoutingConfig? = FakeLoc.runtimeSnapshots.current().routing): GnssFrameRoute? =
        registry.routeFor(listener, routing)
    fun clear() = registry.clear()
    internal fun deliverBatch(listener: IInterface, key: String, itemCount: Int,
        allowed: () -> Boolean, action: (Int) -> Unit) =
        registry.deliverBatch(listener, key, itemCount, allowed, action)
    internal fun subscriptions(): List<CallbackSubscription> = registry.subscriptions()
    internal fun restore(subscription: CallbackSubscription): Boolean = registry.restore(subscription)
}
```

`xposed/src/main/java/com/system/location/service/hook/hooks/nmea/NmeaServiceHook.kt`:

```kt
package com.system.location.service.hook.hooks.nmea

import android.os.IInterface
import com.system.location.service.hook.runtime.HookRuntime
import com.system.location.service.hook.runtime.Reflection
import com.system.location.service.hook.scope.HookInstaller
import io.github.libxposed.api.XposedInterface.Hooker

/** Android may register NMEA directly through GnssManagerService. Both transports share ownership. */
object NmeaServiceHook {
    fun hook(classLoader: ClassLoader) {
        val service = Reflection.findClassIfExists(
            "com.android.server.location.GnssManagerService", classLoader,
        ) ?: return
        val methods = service.declaredMethods.filter { method ->
            val name = method.name
            name.contains("Nmea", ignoreCase = true) &&
                listOf("register", "add", "unregister", "remove").any(name::startsWith)
        }
        methods.forEach { method ->
            val registering = method.name.startsWith("register") || method.name.startsWith("add")
            HookInstaller.hookMethod(method, Hooker { chain ->
                val args = chain.args
                val callback = args.firstOrNull() as? IInterface
                // The real registration may synchronously emit a sentence. Arm the guard and
                // routing first; roll both back if the framework rejects the registration.
                if (registering && callback != null) {
                    installNmeaCallback(callback)
                    NmeaListenerRouting.register(callback, args.getOrNull(1) as? String)
                }
                val result = try {
                    chain.proceed()
                } catch (failure: Throwable) {
                    if (registering) callback?.let(NmeaListenerRouting::unregister)
                    throw failure
                }
                if (!registering && result != false) callback?.let(NmeaListenerRouting::unregister)
                if (registering && result == false) callback?.let(NmeaListenerRouting::unregister)
                result
            })
        }
        HookRuntime.log("GnssManagerService NMEA hooks installed methods=${methods.size}")
    }
}
```

`xposed/src/main/java/com/system/location/service/hook/hooks/pkg/PackageMetadataHook.kt`:

```kt
package com.system.location.service.hook.hooks.pkg

import android.content.pm.ApplicationInfo
import android.content.pm.PackageInfo
import android.os.Binder
import android.os.Bundle
import com.system.location.service.core.privacy.XposedMetadataVisibilityPolicy
import com.system.location.service.hook.scope.HookInstaller
import com.system.location.service.hook.utils.Logger
import io.github.libxposed.api.XposedInterface.Hooker

/**
 * P6-02 + work package 9: hide legacy Xposed meta-data from ordinary PackageManager callers.
 *
 * The module's hooks are already installed before this runs; LSPosed/system callers (UID 0/1000)
 * keep the real meta-data, while third-party detectors see a sanitized copy. Consistency across
 * query entry points matters more than any single one: a detector that finds
 * `getApplicationInfo` sanitized but `getPackageInfo(GET_META_DATA)` / `getInstalledPackages`
 * still carrying `xposedmodule` would expose the hiding layer itself, so all three surfaces are
 * sanitized here.
 */
object PackageMetadataHook {
    fun hook(classLoader: ClassLoader) {
        val names = listOf(
            "com.android.server.pm.PackageManagerService",
            "com.android.server.pm.PackageManagerService\$ComputerEngine",
        )
        names.forEach { name ->
            val type = runCatching { classLoader.loadClass(name) }.getOrNull() ?: return@forEach
            listOf("getApplicationInfo", "getApplicationInfoAsUser").forEach { method ->
                HookInstaller.hookAllMethods(type, method, Hooker { chain ->
                    sanitizeResult(chain.proceed())
                })
            }
            listOf("getPackageInfo", "getPackageInfoAsUser").forEach { method ->
                HookInstaller.hookAllMethods(type, method, Hooker { chain ->
                    sanitizePackageInfoResult(chain.proceed())
                })
            }
            listOf(
                "getInstalledPackages", "getInstalledPackagesAsUser",
                "getInstalledApplications", "getInstalledApplicationsAsUser",
            ).forEach { method ->
                HookInstaller.hookAllMethods(type, method, Hooker { chain ->
                    sanitizeListResult(chain.proceed())
                })
            }
        }
    }

    private fun sanitizeResult(result: Any?): Any? {
        val callerUid = runCatching { Binder.getCallingUid() }.getOrDefault(-1)
        val info = result as? ApplicationInfo ?: return result
        if (!XposedMetadataVisibilityPolicy.shouldHide(info.packageName, callerUid)) return result
        return sanitize(info)
    }

    private fun sanitizePackageInfoResult(result: Any?): Any? {
        val callerUid = runCatching { Binder.getCallingUid() }.getOrDefault(-1)
        val info = result as? PackageInfo ?: return result
        val applicationInfo = info.applicationInfo ?: return result
        if (!XposedMetadataVisibilityPolicy.shouldHide(applicationInfo.packageName, callerUid)) {
            return result
        }
        // Copy before rewriting: PackageManager may hand out cached objects that system callers
        // (including LSPosed itself) still read.
        val copy = copyPackageInfo(info)
        copy.applicationInfo = sanitize(ApplicationInfo(applicationInfo))
        return copy
    }

    /**
     * Installed-package queries return `ParceledListSlice<ApplicationInfo|PackageInfo>` on
     * Android 12+. The slice is unwrapped, only rewritten when the module is actually present
     * (cheap early exit for the common case), and rewrapped with the same slice type. If the
     * unwrap or rewrap is impossible on a given ROM, the original result is returned so the
     * behavior degrades to the pre-hook baseline instead of crashing the query.
     */
    private fun sanitizeListResult(result: Any?): Any? {
        val callerUid = runCatching { Binder.getCallingUid() }.getOrDefault(-1)
        val list = runCatching {
            result!!.javaClass.getMethod("getList").invoke(result) as? List<*>
        }.getOrNull() ?: return result
        fun targetOf(entry: Any?): String? = when (entry) {
            is ApplicationInfo -> entry.packageName
            is PackageInfo -> entry.applicationInfo?.packageName ?: entry.packageName
            else -> null
        }
        val hasModuleEntry = list.any { entry ->
            targetOf(entry)?.let { XposedMetadataVisibilityPolicy.shouldHide(it, callerUid) } == true
        }
        if (!hasModuleEntry) return result
        val sanitized = list.map { entry ->
            when (entry) {
                is PackageInfo ->
                    if (entry.applicationInfo?.packageName?.let {
                            XposedMetadataVisibilityPolicy.shouldHide(it, callerUid)
                        } == true) {
                        copyPackageInfo(entry).also { copy ->
                            copy.applicationInfo = sanitize(ApplicationInfo(entry.applicationInfo))
                        }
                    } else entry
                is ApplicationInfo ->
                    if (XposedMetadataVisibilityPolicy.shouldHide(entry.packageName, callerUid)) {
                        sanitize(entry)
                    } else entry
                else -> entry
            }
        }
        return runCatching {
            result!!.javaClass.getConstructor(List::class.java).newInstance(sanitized)
        }.onFailure {
            Logger.warn("PackageMetadataHook: cannot rewrap ${result!!.javaClass.name}; keeping original list")
        }.getOrNull() ?: result
    }

    /** Field-wise shallow copy: [PackageInfo] has no copy constructor and mutability is required. */
    private fun copyPackageInfo(source: PackageInfo): PackageInfo {
        val copy = PackageInfo()
        for (field in PackageInfo::class.java.fields) {
            runCatching { field.set(copy, field.get(source)) }
        }
        return copy
    }

    private fun sanitize(info: ApplicationInfo): ApplicationInfo {
        val copy = ApplicationInfo(info)
        copy.metaData = sanitizeBundle(info.metaData)
        return copy
    }

    private fun sanitizeBundle(source: Bundle?): Bundle? {
        val bundle = source?.let { Bundle(it) } ?: return null
        XposedMetadataVisibilityPolicy.HIDDEN_KEYS.forEach { key ->
            runCatching { bundle.remove(key) }
        }
        if (bundle.isEmpty) return Bundle()
        return bundle
    }
}
```

`xposed/src/main/java/com/system/location/service/hook/hooks/provider/CurrentLocationProviderHook.kt`:

```kt
package com.system.location.service.hook.hooks.provider

import android.location.Location
import com.system.location.service.core.routing.RoutingDecision
import com.system.location.service.hook.BaseLocationHook
import com.system.location.service.hook.hooks.ListenerRouting
import com.system.location.service.hook.runtime.CurrentLocationDelivery
import com.system.location.service.hook.runtime.Reflection
import com.system.location.service.hook.utils.FakeLoc
import com.system.location.service.hook.utils.Logger
import com.system.location.service.hook.utils.ProviderView
import com.system.location.service.hook.utils.hook
import com.system.location.service.hook.utils.onceHook
import io.github.libxposed.api.XposedInterface

/** Supplies a one-shot cache candidate only while Android activates an eligible registration. */
internal object CurrentLocationProviderHook : BaseLocationHook() {
    fun install(loader: ClassLoader) {
        val manager = Reflection.findClassIfExists(
            "com.android.server.location.provider.LocationProviderManager", loader,
        ) ?: return
        val registration = Reflection.findClassIfExists(
            manager.name + "\$GetCurrentLocationListenerRegistration", loader,
        ) ?: return
        val activate = Reflection.findMethodExactIfExists(registration, "onActive") ?: return
        val cache = Reflection.findMethodExactIfExists(manager, "getLastLocationUnsafe",
            Int::class.javaPrimitiveType!!, Int::class.javaPrimitiveType!!,
            Boolean::class.javaPrimitiveType!!, Long::class.javaPrimitiveType!!) ?: return
        // The broad provider adapter already observes this method. This guard is additional:
        // its replacement is confined to the currently activating one-shot registration.
        cache.hook(XposedInterface.Hooker { chain ->
            val original = chain.proceed()
            CurrentLocationDelivery.sampleFor(chain.thisObject) ?: original
        })
        activate.onceHook(XposedInterface.Hooker { chain ->
            if (!FakeLoc.enable || FakeLoc.disableGetCurrentLocation) return@Hooker chain.proceed()
            val target = chain.thisObject ?: return@Hooker chain.proceed()
            // onActive is reached after the platform checks the provider switch, permissions,
            // background policy and AppOps eligibility. Never manufacture a null callback result.
            val request = runCatching {
                val owner = requireNotNull(Reflection.callMethod(target, "getOwner"))
                val provider = Reflection.callMethod(owner, "getName") as String
                val identity = requireNotNull(Reflection.callMethod(target, "getIdentity"))
                val uid = Reflection.callMethod(identity, "getUid") as Int
                val pkg = Reflection.callMethod(identity, "getPackageName") as String
                Request(owner, provider, uid, pkg)
            }.onFailure { Logger.error("Cannot resolve current-location registration", it) }
                .getOrNull() ?: return@Hooker chain.proceed()
            CurrentLocationDelivery.during(request.owner, { sample(request) }) { chain.proceed() }
        })
        Logger.info("current-location provider cache candidate installed")
    }

    private fun sample(request: Request): Location? {
        if (!FakeLoc.enable || FakeLoc.disableGetCurrentLocation) return null
        val context = ProviderView.capture()
        if (!context.state.configuration.enabled) return null
        val route = ListenerRouting.decisionFor(request.pkg, request.uid, context.state.routing)
        if (route is RoutingDecision.Deny) return null
        return locationForProvider(request.provider,
            scenarioId = (route as? RoutingDecision.Scenario)?.scenarioId,
            point = (route as? RoutingDecision.Point)?.point, context = context)
        // The original activation continues through acceptLocationChange: Android notes AppOps,
        // applies coarse filtering, delivers at most once and unregisters the request. The cache
        // candidate is never written into the manager's real last-location storage.
    }

    private data class Request(val owner: Any, val provider: String, val uid: Int, val pkg: String)
}
```

```kt
package com.system.location.service.hook.hooks.provider
```

```kt
object LocationProviderManagerHook {
    private val hookOnFetchLocationResult =
        XposedInterface.Hooker intercept42@{ chain ->
            val args = chain.args.toTypedArray()

            if (args.isEmpty() || args[0] == null) return@intercept42 chain.proceed(args)
            if (!FakeLoc.enable) return@intercept42 chain.proceed(args)

            if (FakeLoc.enableDebugLog) {
                Logger.debug("${chain.executable}: injected!")
            }

            val locationResult = args[0] ?: return@intercept42 chain.proceed(args)
            val mLocationsField =
                Reflection.findFieldIfExists(locationResult.javaClass, "mLocations")
            if (mLocationsField == null) {
                Logger.error("Failed to find mLocations in LocationResult")
                return@intercept42 chain.proceed(args)
            }
            mLocationsField.isAccessible = true
            val locations =
                mLocationsField.get(locationResult) as? List<*>
                    ?: return@intercept42 chain.proceed(args)
            if (locations.isEmpty() || locations.any { it !is Location })
                return@intercept42 chain.proceed(args)
            val context = ProviderView.capture()
            args[0] = LocationResultIsolation.copyWithLocations(
                locationResult,
                injectLocationBatch(locations.map { it as Location }, context),
            )

            chain.proceed(args)
        }

    operator fun invoke(classLoader: ClassLoader) {
        hookLocationProviderManager(classLoader)
        hookDelegateLocationProvider(classLoader)
        hookPassiveLocationProvider(classLoader)
        hookProxyLocationProvider(classLoader)
        hookAbstractLocationProvider(classLoader)
        GnssProviderHooks.install(classLoader)
        hookGeofenceProvider(classLoader)
    }

    private fun hookAbstractLocationProvider(classLoader: ClassLoader) {
        run {
            val cAbstractLocationProvider =
                Reflection.findClassIfExists(
                    "com.android.server.location.provider.AbstractLocationProvider",
                    classLoader,
                ) ?: return@run
            val cLocationResult =
                Reflection.findClassIfExists("android.location.LocationResult", classLoader)
                    ?: return@run
            val mReportLocation =
                Reflection.findMethodExactIfExists(
                    cAbstractLocationProvider,
                    "reportLocation",
                    cLocationResult,
                ) ?: return@run

            mReportLocation.onceHook(hookOnFetchLocationResult)
        }

        run {
            val cInternalState =
                Reflection.findClassIfExists(
                    "com.android.server.location.provider.AbstractLocationProvider\$InternalState",
                    classLoader,
                ) ?: return@run

            com.system.location.service.hook.scope.HookInstaller.hookAllConstructors(
                cInternalState,
                XposedInterface.Hooker intercept43@{ chain ->
                    val args = chain.args.toTypedArray()

                    val listener = args[0] ?: return@intercept43 chain.proceed(args)

                    if (FakeLoc.enableDebugLog) {
                        Logger.debug("AbstractLocationProvider.InternalState: injected!")
                    }

                    listener.javaClass.onceHookAllMethod(
                        "onReportLocation",
                        hookOnFetchLocationResult,
                    )

                    chain.proceed(args)
                },
            )
        }
    }

    private fun hookProxyLocationProvider(classLoader: ClassLoader) {
        val cProxyLocationProvider =
            Reflection.findClassIfExists(
                "com.android.server.location.provider.proxy.ProxyLocationProvider",
                classLoader,
            ) ?: return
    }

    private fun hookPassiveLocationProvider(classLoader: ClassLoader) {
        val cPassiveLocationProvider =
            Reflection.findClassIfExists(
                "com.android.server.location.provider.PassiveLocationProvider",
                classLoader,
            ) ?: return
        val cLocationResult =
            Reflection.findClassIfExists("android.location.LocationResult", classLoader) ?: return
        val updateLocation =
            Reflection.findMethodExactIfExists(
                cPassiveLocationProvider,
                "updateLocation",
                cLocationResult,
            ) ?: return

        updateLocation.hook(hookOnFetchLocationResult)
    }

    private fun hookDelegateLocationProvider(classLoader: ClassLoader) {
        val cDelegateLocationProvider =
            Reflection.findClassIfExists(
                "com.android.server.location.provider.DelegateLocationProvider",
                classLoader,
            ) ?: return

        val waitForInitialization =
            Reflection.findMethodExactIfExists(cDelegateLocationProvider, "waitForInitialization")
                ?: return
        val handle = java.util.concurrent.atomic.AtomicReference<XposedInterface.HookHandle?>()
        val matched = java.util.concurrent.atomic.AtomicBoolean(false)
        handle.set(
            waitForInitialization.onceHook(
                XposedInterface.Hooker { chain ->
                    if (FakeLoc.enableDebugLog)
                        Logger.debug("DelegateLocationProvider.waitForInitialization: injected!")
                    val locationResult =
                        Reflection.findClassIfExists("android.location.LocationResult", classLoader)
                    val provider = chain.thisObject
                    if (locationResult != null && provider != null) {
                        Reflection.findMethodExactIfExists(
                                provider.javaClass,
                                "onReportLocation",
                                locationResult,
                            )
                            ?.onceHook(hookOnFetchLocationResult)
                        Reflection.findMethodExactIfExists(
                                provider.javaClass,
                                "reportLocation",
                                locationResult,
                            )
                            ?.onceHook(hookOnFetchLocationResult)
                    }
                    matched.set(true)
                    handle.getAndSet(null)?.unhook()
                    chain.proceed()
                }
            )
        )
        // Invocation can race the return of the native registration handle.
        if (matched.get()) handle.getAndSet(null)?.unhook()
    }

    private fun hookLocationProviderManager(classLoader: ClassLoader) {
        val cLocationProviderManager =
            Reflection.findClassIfExists(
                "com.android.server.location.provider.LocationProviderManager",
                classLoader,
            ) ?: return
        BlindHookLocation(cLocationProviderManager, classLoader)

        com.system.location.service.hook.scope.HookInstaller.hookAllMethods(
            cLocationProviderManager,
            "setRealProvider",
            XposedInterface.Hooker intercept44@{ chain ->
                val args = chain.args.toTypedArray()

                val locationProvider = args[0]
                if (FakeLoc.enableDebugLog) {
                    Logger.debug("setRealProvider: $locationProvider")
                }

                chain.proceed(args)
            },
        )
        com.system.location.service.hook.scope.HookInstaller.hookAllMethods(
            cLocationProviderManager,
            "setMockProvider",
            XposedInterface.Hooker intercept45@{ chain ->
                val args = chain.args.toTypedArray()

                val locationProvider = args[0]
                if (FakeLoc.enableDebugLog) {
                    Logger.debug("setMockProvider: $locationProvider")
                }

                chain.proceed(args)
            },
        )
        com.system.location.service.hook.scope.HookInstaller.hookAllMethods(
            cLocationProviderManager,
            "sendExtraCommand",
            XposedInterface.Hooker intercept46@{ chain ->
                val args = chain.args.toTypedArray()

                if (!FakeLoc.enable) return@intercept46 chain.proceed(args)
                if (args.size < 4) return@intercept46 chain.proceed(args)
                val command = args[2]

                if (command == "force_xtra_injection" || command == "CMD_SHOW_GPS_TIPS_CONFIG") {
                    return@intercept46 null
                }

                val extras = args[3]
                if (FakeLoc.enableDebugLog) {
                    Logger.debug("sendExtraCommand: $command, $extras")
                }

                chain.proceed(args)
            },
        )

        CurrentLocationProviderHook.install(classLoader)

        cLocationProviderManager.onceHookAllMethod("onReportLocation", hookOnFetchLocationResult)
    }

    private fun hookGeofenceProvider(classLoader: ClassLoader) {
        val cGeofenceManager =
            Reflection.findClassIfExists("com.android.server.geofence.GeofenceManager", classLoader)
                ?: return
        BlindHookLocation(cGeofenceManager, classLoader)
    }


}
```

`xposed/src/main/java/com/system/location/service/hook/hooks/provider/ProviderRegistryHook.kt`:

```kt
package com.system.location.service.hook.hooks.provider

import com.system.location.service.core.providers.ProviderRegistryPolicy
import com.system.location.service.hook.runtime.Reflection
import com.system.location.service.hook.scope.HookInstaller
import com.system.location.service.hook.scope.HookStatus
import com.system.location.service.hook.scope.HookStatusRegistry
import com.system.location.service.hook.security.CallerRole
import com.system.location.service.hook.utils.BinderUtils
import com.system.location.service.hook.utils.FakeLoc
import com.system.location.service.hook.utils.Logger
import io.github.libxposed.api.XposedInterface

/** Keeps Portal's control and test providers out of the public provider registry. */
object ProviderRegistryHook {
    fun hook(classLoader: ClassLoader): Boolean {
        val service =
            Reflection.findClassIfExists(
                "com.android.server.location.LocationManagerService",
                classLoader,
            )
        if (service == null) {
            HookStatusRegistry.record(
                "provider-registry",
                HookStatus(
                    supported = true,
                    skipped = true,
                    reason = "LocationManagerService absent",
                ),
            )
            return false
        }
        return hook(service)
    }

    fun hook(locationManagerService: Class<*>): Boolean {
        val filterHook =
            XposedInterface.Hooker { chain ->
                if (!hidesFromCaller()) return@Hooker chain.proceed()
                when (val value = chain.proceed()) {
                    is List<*> -> value.filterNot { it is String && isSuspiciousProvider(it) }
                    is Array<*> ->
                        value.filterNot { it is String && isSuspiciousProvider(it) }.toTypedArray()
                    else -> value
                }
            }
        val hasProviderHook =
            XposedInterface.Hooker { chain ->
                if (!hidesFromCaller()) return@Hooker chain.proceed()
                val provider = chain.args.firstOrNull() as? String
                if (provider != null && isSuspiciousProvider(provider)) false else chain.proceed()
            }
        val propertiesHook =
            XposedInterface.Hooker { chain ->
                if (!hidesFromCaller()) return@Hooker chain.proceed()
                val provider = chain.args.firstOrNull() as? String
                if (provider != null && isSuspiciousProvider(provider)) {
                    if (FakeLoc.enableDebugLog)
                        Logger.debug("ProviderRegistry hid properties for $provider")
                    throw IllegalArgumentException("provider \"$provider\" does not exist")
                }
                chain.proceed()
            }

        var hooked = false
        for (name in LIST_METHODS) {
            hooked =
                HookInstaller.hookAllMethods(locationManagerService, name, filterHook)
                    .isNotEmpty() || hooked
        }
        hooked =
            HookInstaller.hookAllMethods(locationManagerService, "hasProvider", hasProviderHook)
                .isNotEmpty() || hooked
        // This exception is an intentional API result; the framework must propagate it to the
        // caller.
        hooked =
            HookInstaller.hookAllMethods(
                    locationManagerService,
                    "getProviderProperties",
                    propertiesHook,
                    exceptionMode = XposedInterface.ExceptionMode.PASSTHROUGH,
                )
                .isNotEmpty() || hooked
        return hooked
    }

    /**
     * Caller scoping (work package 9): the hiding answers are only meant for ordinary
     * third-party callers. The controller and framework peers (uid 0/1000, provider peers) keep
     * the natural answer so platform components and channel participants never observe the
     * hiding layer itself — the same rule AppOps/Settings/PackageMetadata hooks follow.
     */
    private fun hidesFromCaller(): Boolean =
        BinderUtils.callerRole() == CallerRole.DENIED

    private fun isSuspiciousProvider(name: String): Boolean = ProviderRegistryPolicy.isHidden(name)

    private val LIST_METHODS = listOf("getAllProviders", "getProviders")
}
```
