`xposed/src/main/java/com/system/location/service/hook/hooks/sensor/ApplicationSensorHook.kt`:

```kt
package com.system.location.service.hook.hooks.sensor

import android.content.Context
import android.hardware.Sensor
import android.location.LocationManager
import android.os.Bundle
import android.os.Handler
import android.os.Looper
import android.os.SystemClock
import com.system.location.service.core.sensors.SensorEventValues
import com.system.location.service.core.sensors.SensorPlayback
import com.system.location.service.core.sensors.SensorCadence
import com.system.location.service.hook.runtime.HookRuntime
import com.system.location.service.hook.runtime.BackgroundQuery
import com.system.location.service.core.sensors.SensorPlaybackState
import com.system.location.service.hook.scope.HookInstaller
import java.lang.reflect.Method

/** Java SensorEventQueue extension. Hardware registration still controls permissions/availability. */
object ApplicationSensorHook {
    private val lock = Any()
    private val playback = SensorPlayback()
    private val registrations = mutableListOf<Registration>()
    private var worker: Handler? = null
    private var lastPoll = 0L
    private var queryContext: Context? = null
    private val query = BackgroundQuery()
    private lateinit var dispatch: Method
    private lateinit var sensorHandle: Method
    private var lastSyntheticCounter = 0L
    private var counterOffset = 0L
    private var counterSessionActive = false
    private var suppressHardware = false
    private var session: String? = null
    private var generation = 0L
    private val supported = SensorEventValues.continuousTypes + setOf(18, 19)

    private class Registration(val manager: Any, val listener: Any, val queue: Any,
        val handle: Int, val type: Int, val handler: Handler) {
        var active = true
        var lastSteps = -1L
        var lastDetectorTimestampNanos = 0L
        var pending = false
    }

    fun install(loader: ClassLoader) {
        val manager = Class.forName("android.hardware.SystemSensorManager", false, loader)
        val queue = Class.forName("android.hardware.SystemSensorManager\$SensorEventQueue", false, loader)
        sensorHandle = Sensor::class.java.getDeclaredMethod("getHandle").apply { isAccessible = true }
        dispatch = queue.getDeclaredMethod("dispatchSensorEvent", Int::class.javaPrimitiveType,
            FloatArray::class.java, Int::class.javaPrimitiveType, Long::class.javaPrimitiveType)
            .apply { isAccessible = true }
        HookInstaller.hookAllMethods(manager, "registerListenerImpl", { chain ->
            val result = chain.proceed()
            if (result == true) runCatching {
                val sensor = chain.args.getOrNull(1) as? Sensor ?: return@runCatching
                if (sensor.type !in supported) return@runCatching
                val owner = chain.thisObject ?: return@runCatching
                val listener = chain.args[0] ?: return@runCatching
                val context = field(owner, "mContext") as Context
                val map = field(owner, "mSensorListeners") as Map<*, *>
                val eventQueue = synchronized(map) { map[listener] } ?: return@runCatching
                val looper = (chain.args.firstOrNull { it is Handler } as? Handler)?.looper
                    ?: field(owner, "mMainLooper") as Looper
                val handle = sensorHandle.invoke(sensor) as Int
                synchronized(lock) {
                    if (registrations.none { it.queue === eventQueue && it.handle == handle }) {
                        registrations.add(Registration(owner, listener, eventQueue, handle, sensor.type, Handler(looper)))
                    }
                    queryContext = context.applicationContext ?: context
                    startWorker()
                }
            }.onFailure { HookRuntime.log(it) }
            result
        })
        HookInstaller.hookAllMethods(manager, "unregisterListenerImpl", { chain ->
            val result = chain.proceed()
            val listener = chain.args.firstOrNull()
            val sensor = chain.args.getOrNull(1) as? Sensor
            val handle = sensor?.let { runCatching { sensorHandle.invoke(it) as Int }.getOrNull() }
            synchronized(lock) {
                // Failed reflection must not unregister a different sensor from our bookkeeping.
                if (sensor == null || handle != null) registrations.removeAll {
                    val remove = it.manager === chain.thisObject && it.listener === listener &&
                        (sensor == null || it.handle == handle)
                    if (remove) it.active = false
                    remove
                }
                stopWorkerIfIdle()
            }
            result
        })
        HookInstaller.hookMethod(dispatch, { chain ->
            val handle = chain.args[0] as Int
            val original = chain.args[1] as FloatArray
            val timestamp = chain.args[3] as Long
            val args = chain.args.toTypedArray()
            val action = synchronized(lock) {
                val reg = registrations.firstOrNull { it.queue === chain.thisObject && it.handle == handle }
                    ?: return@synchronized 0
                // Check receipt time too: an old queued event cannot revive an expired grant.
                if (playback.frame(SystemClock.elapsedRealtimeNanos()) == null) {
                    return@synchronized if (suppressHardware) 2 else 0
                }
                // A queued hardware event from before the current grant must not cross the boundary.
                val frame = playback.frame(timestamp) ?: return@synchronized 2
                if (reg.type == 18 || reg.type == 19) return@synchronized 2
                val values = SensorEventValues.from(frame, reg.type, original.size) ?: return@synchronized 2
                args[1] = values
                1
            }
            when (action) {
                2 -> null // Suppressed hardware events are replaced only by the motion clock.
                1 -> chain.proceed(args)
                else -> chain.proceed()
            }
        })
    }

    private fun field(owner: Any, name: String): Any? {
        var type: Class<*>? = owner.javaClass
        while (type != null) {
            val found = runCatching { type!!.getDeclaredField(name) }.getOrNull()
            if (found != null) return found.apply { isAccessible = true }.get(owner)
            type = type.superclass
        }
        error("Missing ${owner.javaClass.name}.$name")
    }

    private fun startWorker() {
        if (worker != null) return
        // Reuse an app-owned looper. A new named thread is enumerable through
        // Thread.getAllStackTraces() and is a permanent fingerprint in the target process.
        val handler = synchronized(lock) { registrations.firstOrNull()?.handler }
            ?: Handler(Looper.getMainLooper())
        worker = handler.also { it.post(tick) }
    }

    private fun stopWorkerIfIdle() {
        if (registrations.isNotEmpty()) return
        // The Handler belongs to the application; remove only our tick, never its messages.
        worker?.removeCallbacks(tick)
        worker = null
        queryContext = null
        lastPoll = 0L
        playback.update(null, SystemClock.elapsedRealtimeNanos())
        counterSessionActive = false
        suppressHardware = false
        session = null
        generation++
    }

    private data class PollResult(val protected: Boolean?, val state: SensorPlaybackState?)

    private fun pollState(context: Context?, handler: Handler, epoch: Long) {
        try {
            query.submit({
                val manager = context?.getSystemService(LocationManager::class.java)
                val result = Bundle()
                if (manager?.sendExtraCommand("fused_ext", SensorSnapshotCommand.COMMAND, result) != true)
                    PollResult(null, null)
                else PollResult(result.getBoolean(SensorSnapshotCommand.PROTECTED_KEY), SensorStateWire.read(result))
            }) { result ->
                synchronized(lock) {
                    // An unregister/re-register may reuse the same Handler. Its old in-flight
                    // Binder response must not restore a motion grant into the new subscription.
                    if (worker !== handler || generation != epoch) return@synchronized
                    val next = result.getOrDefault(PollResult(null, null))
                    next.protected?.let { suppressHardware = it }
                    if (session != next.state?.session) {
                        session = next.state?.session
                        generation++
                        counterSessionActive = false
                        registrations.forEach { it.lastSteps = -1 }
                    }
                    playback.update(next.state, SystemClock.elapsedRealtimeNanos())
                }
            }
        } catch (failure: RuntimeException) {
            HookRuntime.log(failure)
        }
    }

    private val tick = object : Runnable {
        override fun run() {
            val handler: Handler
            val context: Context?
            val epoch: Long
            val poll: Boolean
            synchronized(lock) {
                handler = worker ?: return
                context = queryContext
                epoch = generation
                val now = SystemClock.elapsedRealtimeNanos()
                poll = now - lastPoll >= 250_000_000
                if (poll) lastPoll = now
            }
            if (poll) pollState(context, handler, epoch)
            synchronized(lock) {
                if (worker !== handler) return
                val now = SystemClock.elapsedRealtimeNanos()
                val frame = playback.frame(now)
                if (frame == null) {
                    counterSessionActive = false
                    registrations.forEach { it.lastSteps = -1 }
                } else {
                    if (!counterSessionActive) {
                        counterOffset = (lastSyntheticCounter - frame.stepCount).coerceAtLeast(0)
                        counterSessionActive = true
                    }
                    counterOffset = maxOf(counterOffset, lastSyntheticCounter - frame.stepCount)
                    registrations.filter { it.type == 18 || it.type == 19 }.forEach { reg ->
                        if (reg.pending) return@forEach
                        val previous = reg.lastSteps
                        val previousDetectorTimestamp = reg.lastDetectorTimestampNanos
                        reg.lastSteps = frame.stepCount
                        if (reg.type == 18 && (previous < 0 || frame.stepCount <= previous)) return@forEach
                        if (reg.type == 19 && frame.stepCount == previous) return@forEach
                        val epoch = generation
                        val deliveries = if (reg.type == 18) (frame.stepCount - previous).coerceIn(1, 32).toInt() else 1
                        val detectorTimestamps = if (reg.type == 18) {
                            SensorCadence.detectorEventTimestamps(now, deliveries, frame.stepCadence,
                                previousDetectorTimestamp).also { reg.lastDetectorTimestampNanos = it.last() }
                        } else longArrayOf(now)
                        reg.pending = true
                        if (!reg.handler.post {
                            val delivery = synchronized(lock) {
                                reg.pending = false
                                if (!reg.active || generation != epoch || playback.frame(SystemClock.elapsedRealtimeNanos()) == null) null
                                else {
                                    val count = maxOf(lastSyntheticCounter, counterOffset + frame.stepCount)
                                    if (reg.type == 19) lastSyntheticCounter = count
                                    floatArrayOf(if (reg.type == 18) 1f else count.toFloat())
                                }
                            }
                            if (delivery != null) repeat(deliveries) { index ->
                                // Recheck after each listener call: it may unregister itself.
                                val active = synchronized(lock) { reg.active && generation == epoch }
                                if (active) HookRuntime.invokeOriginalMethod(dispatch, reg.queue,
                                    arrayOf(reg.handle, delivery, 3, detectorTimestamps[index]))
                            }
                        }) {
                            reg.pending = false
                            reg.lastSteps = previous
                            reg.lastDetectorTimestampNanos = previousDetectorTimestamp
                        }
                    }
                }
                handler.postDelayed(this, 20)
            }
        }
    }

}
```

`xposed/src/main/java/com/system/location/service/hook/hooks/sensor/NativeSensorTicker.kt`:

```kt
package com.system.location.service.hook.hooks.sensor

import android.os.SystemClock
import com.system.location.service.core.runtime.SampleStore
import com.system.location.service.core.sensors.SensorPlayback
import com.system.location.service.core.sensors.SensorPlaybackState
import com.system.location.service.core.sensors.SensorTuning
import com.system.location.service.hook.NativeCommand
import com.system.location.service.hook.runtime.DeliveryWorker
import com.system.location.service.hook.utils.FakeLoc
import com.system.location.service.hook.utils.Logger

/** Native gets a sensor-rate timeline instead of holding each low-rate location frame. */
internal object NativeSensorTicker {
    private val playback = SensorPlayback()
    private val worker = DeliveryWorker("NativeSensorMotion", { 20L }, tick = {
        val generation = NativeCommand.sensorGeneration
        val now = SystemClock.elapsedRealtimeNanos()
        val observation = FakeLoc.runtimeSnapshots.observation()
        val state = observation.state
        val fix = state.sample
        val active = NativeCommand.isEnabled && state.configuration.enabled && fix != null &&
            now >= fix.elapsedNanos && now - fix.elapsedNanos < SampleStore.DEFAULT_MAX_AGE_NANOS
        val grant = if (active) SensorPlaybackState(
            "$generation:${observation.simulationGeneration}", fix!!.elapsedNanos,
            fix.elapsedNanos + SampleStore.DEFAULT_MAX_AGE_NANOS,
            fix.speed, fix.bearing, fix.altitude.coerceIn(-500.0, 20_000.0),
            SensorTuning(state.configuration.sensorCadenceScale, state.configuration.sensorVariation),
        ) else null
        playback.update(grant, now)
        NativeCommand.applySensorTick(generation, playback.frame(now), now)
    }, failure = {
        NativeCommand.applySensorTick(NativeCommand.sensorGeneration, null, SystemClock.elapsedRealtimeNanos())
        Logger.error("Native sensor timeline failed", it)
    })

    fun start() = worker.start()
    fun stop() { worker.stop(0) }
}
```

`xposed/src/main/java/com/system/location/service/hook/hooks/sensor/SensorSnapshotCommand.kt`:

```kt
package com.system.location.service.hook.hooks.sensor

import android.os.Bundle
import android.os.SystemClock
import com.system.location.service.core.routing.RoutingDecision
import com.system.location.service.core.routing.RoutingTable
import com.system.location.service.core.runtime.SampleStore
import com.system.location.service.core.sensors.SensorPlaybackState
import com.system.location.service.core.sensors.SensorTargets
import com.system.location.service.core.sensors.SensorTuning
import com.system.location.service.hook.NativeCommand
import com.system.location.service.hook.utils.BinderUtils
import com.system.location.service.hook.utils.FakeLoc

/** Read-only IPC for an explicitly selected application UID, independent of controller auth. */
object SensorSnapshotCommand {
    const val COMMAND = "get_sensor_state"
    const val PROTECTED_KEY = "sensor_protected"

    fun read(uid: Int, output: Bundle): Boolean {
        output.clear()
        if (!FakeLoc.isSystemServerProcess) return false
        val observation = FakeLoc.runtimeSnapshots.observation()
        val state = observation.state
        val packages = BinderUtils.getUidPackageNames(uid = uid)?.toSet().orEmpty()
        val targetAllowed = SensorTargets.allows(uid, packages, state.configuration.sensorTargets)
        val route = RoutingTable(state.routing ?: com.system.location.service.core.routing.RoutingConfig())
            .decision(uid, packages, false)
        val decision = SensorProtectionPolicy.evaluate(
            targetAllowed = targetAllowed,
            simulationEnabled = state.configuration.enabled,
            nativeEnabled = NativeCommand.isEnabled,
            routeAllowed = route != RoutingDecision.Deny,
        )
        output.putBoolean(PROTECTED_KEY, decision.protected)
        if (!decision.protected) return decision.handled
        val now = SystemClock.elapsedRealtimeNanos()
        val fix = when (route) {
            is RoutingDecision.Scenario -> FakeLoc.scenarioSamples.latest(route.scenarioId, now)?.sample ?: state.sample
            else -> state.sample
        } ?: return true
        if (now < fix.elapsedNanos || now - fix.elapsedNanos >= SampleStore.DEFAULT_MAX_AGE_NANOS) return true
        val motion = SensorPlaybackState(
            "${FakeLoc.runtimeSnapshots.instanceId}:${observation.simulationGeneration}:${route.hashCode()}",
            fix.elapsedNanos,
            minOf(now + 1_000_000_000, fix.elapsedNanos + SampleStore.DEFAULT_MAX_AGE_NANOS),
            if (route is RoutingDecision.Point) 0f else fix.speed,
            fix.bearing, fix.altitude.coerceIn(-500.0, 20_000.0),
            SensorTuning(state.configuration.sensorCadenceScale, state.configuration.sensorVariation),
        )
        SensorStateWire.write(output, motion)
        return true
    }
}

internal data class SensorProtectionDecision(val handled: Boolean, val protected: Boolean)

internal object SensorProtectionPolicy {
    fun evaluate(
        targetAllowed: Boolean,
        simulationEnabled: Boolean,
        nativeEnabled: Boolean,
        routeAllowed: Boolean,
    ) = SensorProtectionDecision(
        handled = true,
        protected = targetAllowed && simulationEnabled && !nativeEnabled && routeAllowed,
    )
}

internal object SensorStateWire {
    fun write(bundle: Bundle, state: SensorPlaybackState) = with(bundle) {
        putInt("sensor_version", 1)
        putString("session", state.session)
        putLong("sample_nanos", state.sampleNanos)
        putLong("expires_nanos", state.expiresNanos)
        putFloat("speed", state.speedMps)
        putFloat("bearing", state.bearingDeg)
        putDouble("altitude", state.altitudeMeters)
        putDouble("cadence_scale", state.tuning.cadenceScale)
        putDouble("variation", state.tuning.variability)
    }

    fun read(bundle: Bundle): SensorPlaybackState? = runCatching {
        if (bundle.getInt("sensor_version") != 1) return null
        SensorPlaybackState(bundle.getString("session") ?: return null,
            bundle.getLong("sample_nanos", -1), bundle.getLong("expires_nanos", -1),
            bundle.getFloat("speed", Float.NaN), bundle.getFloat("bearing", Float.NaN),
            bundle.getDouble("altitude", Double.NaN),
            SensorTuning(bundle.getDouble("cadence_scale", Double.NaN), bundle.getDouble("variation", Double.NaN)))
    }.getOrNull()
}
```

`xposed/src/main/java/com/system/location/service/hook/hooks/sensor/SystemSensorManagerHook.kt`:

```kt
@file:Suppress("UNCHECKED_CAST")
package com.system.location.service.hook.hooks.sensor

import android.content.pm.FeatureInfo
import android.hardware.Sensor
import android.hardware.SensorEventListener
import android.util.ArrayMap
import com.system.location.service.hook.runtime.Reflection
import com.system.location.service.hook.utils.FakeLoc
import com.system.location.service.hook.utils.Logger
import io.github.libxposed.api.XposedInterface.Hooker
import com.system.location.service.hook.utils.hookAllMethods
import com.system.location.service.hook.utils.hookMethod
import com.system.location.service.hook.utils.onceHook
import java.util.concurrent.ConcurrentHashMap

object SystemSensorManagerHook {
    private val listenerMap = ConcurrentHashMap<SensorEventListener, Int>()

    operator fun invoke(classLoader: ClassLoader) {
        unlockGeoSensor(classLoader)

        hookSystemSensorManager(classLoader)
        hookSystemSensorManagerQueue(classLoader)
    }

    private fun hookSystemSensorManagerQueue(classLoader: ClassLoader) {
        val cSystemSensorManagerQueue = Reflection.findClassIfExists("android.hardware.SystemSensorManager\$SensorEventQueue", classLoader)
            ?: return


    }

    private fun hookSystemSensorManager(classLoader: ClassLoader) {
        val cSystemSensorManager = Reflection.findClassIfExists("android.hardware.SystemSensorManager", classLoader)
        if (cSystemSensorManager == null) {
            if (FakeLoc.enableDebugLog) {
                Logger.debug("Failed to find SystemSensorManager")
            }
            return
        }

        val hookRegisterListenerImpl = Hooker { chain ->
            val listener = chain.args[0] as SensorEventListener
            if (FakeLoc.enableDebugLog) {
                Logger.debug("RegisterListenerImpl: $listener, sensor: ${chain.args[1]}")
            }

            val sensor = chain.args[1] as? Sensor ?: return@Hooker chain.proceed()
            listenerMap[listener] = sensor.type

            chain.proceed()
        }
        cSystemSensorManager.declaredMethods.filter {
            it.name == "registerListenerImpl" && it.parameterTypes.size >= 2
                    && it.parameterTypes[0] == SensorEventListener::class.java
                    && it.parameterTypes[1] == Sensor::class.java
        }.forEach {
            it.onceHook(hookRegisterListenerImpl)
        }

        val hookUnregisterListenerImpl = Hooker { chain ->
            val listener = chain.args[0] as SensorEventListener
            if (FakeLoc.enableDebugLog) {
                Logger.debug("UnregisterListenerImpl: $listener")
            }
            listenerMap.remove(listener)
            chain.proceed()
        }
        cSystemSensorManager.declaredMethods.filter {
            it.name == "unregisterListenerImpl" && it.parameterTypes.isNotEmpty()
                    && it.parameterTypes[0] == SensorEventListener::class.java
        }.forEach {
            it.onceHook(hookUnregisterListenerImpl)
        }

        cSystemSensorManager.hookAllMethods("getSensorList", Hooker { chain ->
            val result = chain.proceed()
            if (FakeLoc.enableDebugLog) {
                Logger.debug("getSensorList: type: ${chain.args[0]} -> $result")
            }
            result
        })
        cSystemSensorManager.hookAllMethods("getFullSensorsList", Hooker { chain ->
            val result = chain.proceed()
            if (FakeLoc.enableDebugLog) {
                Logger.debug("getFullSensorsList-> $result")
            }
            result
        })
    }

    private fun unlockGeoSensor(classLoader: ClassLoader) {
        val cSystemConfig = Reflection.findClassIfExists("com.android.server.SystemConfig", classLoader)
            ?: return

        val openGLVersion = run {
            val cSystemProperties = Reflection.findClassIfExists("android.os.SystemProperties", classLoader)
                ?: return@run 0
            Reflection.callStaticMethod(cSystemProperties, "getInt", "ro.opengles.version", FeatureInfo.GL_ES_VERSION_UNDEFINED) as Int
        }

        cSystemConfig.hookMethod("getAvailableFeatures", callback = Hooker { chain ->
            val result = chain.proceed()
            val features = result as ArrayMap<String, FeatureInfo>
            if (FakeLoc.enableDebugLog) {
                Logger.debug("getAvailableFeatures: ${features.keys}")
            }

            features
        })
    }
}
```

`xposed/src/main/java/com/system/location/service/hook/hooks/telephony/CarrierCellRequestHook.kt`:

```kt
package com.system.location.service.hook.hooks.telephony

import android.os.Binder
import android.os.IBinder
import android.os.IInterface
import com.system.location.service.hook.scope.HookInstaller
import com.system.location.service.hook.utils.onceHookAllMethod
import io.github.libxposed.api.XposedInterface.Hooker
import java.util.concurrent.ConcurrentHashMap

/** Protects the one-shot ICellInfoCallback transport in the phone process, before registration. */
internal object CarrierCellRequestHook {
    private data class Entry(val uid: Int, val subscription: Int?, val death: IBinder.DeathRecipient)
    private val requests = ConcurrentHashMap<IBinder, Entry>()

    fun install(manager: Class<*>) {
        listOf("requestCellInfoUpdate", "requestCellInfoUpdateWithWorkSource").forEach { name ->
            HookInstaller.hookAllMethods(manager, name, Hooker { chain ->
                val listener = chain.args.filterIsInstance<IInterface>().firstOrNull { candidate ->
                    candidate.javaClass.methods.any { it.name == "onCellInfo" }
                } ?: return@Hooker chain.proceed()
                val binder = listener.asBinder()
                listener.javaClass.onceHookAllMethod("onCellInfo", Hooker { callback ->
                    val target = callback.thisObject as? IInterface ?: return@Hooker callback.proceed()
                    val entry = requests[target.asBinder()] ?: return@Hooker callback.proceed()
                    try {
                        val profile = CarrierIdentityRuntime.profileForCall("getAllCellInfo",
                            listOfNotNull(entry.subscription), entry.uid)
                        if (profile == null && !CarrierIdentityRuntime.protectsLocation(entry.uid)) {
                            return@Hooker callback.proceed()
                        }
                        val result = runCatching {
                            CellInfoSynthesis.resultForCaller(null, entry.uid, entry.subscription)
                        }.getOrDefault(CellInfoSynthesisResult.Unavailable)
                        val cells = when (result) {
                            CellInfoSynthesisResult.PassThrough -> return@Hooker callback.proceed()
                            CellInfoSynthesisResult.Unavailable -> emptyList<android.telephony.CellInfo>()
                            is CellInfoSynthesisResult.Synthetic -> result.cells
                        }
                        val args = callback.args.toTypedArray()
                        if (args.isEmpty()) return@Hooker null
                        args[0] = cells
                        callback.proceed(args)
                    } finally { remove(target.asBinder()) }
                })
                listener.javaClass.onceHookAllMethod("onError", Hooker { callback ->
                    val target = callback.thisObject as? IInterface
                    val entry = target?.asBinder()?.let { requests[it] }
                    try {
                        // The original request has already performed framework permission checks.
                        // Only timeout / confirmed no-radio modem errors can become modeled data.
                        val noRadio = canModelError(callback.args)
                        if (entry != null && noRadio) {
                            val profile = CarrierIdentityRuntime.profileForCall("getAllCellInfo",
                                listOfNotNull(entry.subscription), entry.uid)
                            if (profile?.virtual == true) {
                                val result = runCatching {
                                    CellInfoSynthesis.resultForCaller(null, entry.uid, entry.subscription)
                                }.getOrNull()
                                if (result is CellInfoSynthesisResult.Synthetic) {
                                    target.javaClass.getMethod("onCellInfo", List::class.java)
                                        .invoke(target, result.cells)
                                    return@Hooker null
                                }
                            }
                        }
                        callback.proceed()
                    } finally { target?.asBinder()?.let(::remove) }
                })
                val previous = requests[binder]
                val death = previous?.death ?: IBinder.DeathRecipient { remove(binder) }
                if (previous == null) binder.linkToDeath(death, 0)
                requests[binder] = Entry(Binder.getCallingUid(), chain.args.firstOrNull() as? Int, death)
                try { chain.proceed() } catch (failure: Throwable) {
                    if (previous == null) remove(binder) else requests[binder] = previous
                    throw failure
                }
            })
        }
    }

    internal fun canModelError(args: List<Any?>): Boolean {
        if (args.firstOrNull() == android.telephony.TelephonyManager.CellInfoCallback.ERROR_TIMEOUT) return true
        if (args.firstOrNull() != android.telephony.TelephonyManager.CellInfoCallback.ERROR_MODEM_ERROR) return false
        val detail = args.filterIsInstance<String>().joinToString(" ")
        return detail.contains("CommandException") &&
            (detail.contains("RADIO_NOT_AVAILABLE") || detail.contains("NO_NETWORK_FOUND"))
    }

    private fun remove(binder: IBinder) {
        requests.remove(binder)?.let { runCatching { binder.unlinkToDeath(it.death, 0) } }
    }
}
```

`xposed/src/main/java/com/system/location/service/hook/hooks/telephony/CarrierClientHook.kt`:

```kt
package com.system.location.service.hook.hooks.telephony

import android.location.LocationManager
import android.os.Bundle
import android.telephony.TelephonyManager
import com.system.location.service.core.carrier.CarrierRadio
import com.system.location.service.core.carrier.CarrierVirtualIdentity
import com.system.location.service.core.carrier.SimCarrierProfile
import com.system.location.service.hook.runtime.Reflection
import com.system.location.service.hook.scope.HookInstaller
import com.system.location.service.hook.utils.BinderUtils
import io.github.libxposed.api.XposedInterface.Hooker
import kotlinx.serialization.json.Json
import java.util.Locale

/** Covers public getters backed by local TelephonyProperties rather than PhoneInterfaceManager. */
object CarrierClientHook {
    private val reading = ThreadLocal.withInitial { false }
    fun install(loader: ClassLoader) {
        val type = Reflection.findClassIfExists("android.telephony.TelephonyManager", loader) ?: return
        val numeric = setOf("getSimOperator", "getSimOperatorNumeric", "getSimOperatorNumericForPhone",
            "getNetworkOperator", "getNetworkOperatorForPhone")
        val simName = setOf("getSimOperatorName", "getSimOperatorNameForPhone")
        val networkName = setOf("getNetworkOperatorName")
        val country = setOf("getSimCountryIso", "getSimCountryIsoForPhone", "getNetworkCountryIso",
            "getNetworkCountryIsoForPhone")
        val network = setOf("getDataNetworkType", "getNetworkType", "getVoiceNetworkType")
        val phone = setOf("getPhoneType")
        val simState = setOf("getSimState")
        val subscriber = setOf("getSubscriberId")
        val iccid = setOf("getIccId", "getSimSerialNumber")
        val carrierId = setOf("getSimCarrierId", "getSimCarrierIdName", "getSimSpecificCarrierId",
            "getSimSpecificCarrierIdName")
        val hook = Hooker { chain ->
            if (reading.get() == true) return@Hooker chain.proceed()
            reading.set(true)
            try {
                // Preserve original permission checks and exceptions. A virtual subscription may
                // legitimately replace an empty/absent platform result.
                val original = chain.proceed()
                val name = chain.executable.name
                val requested = chain.args.firstOrNull() as? Int
                val manager = chain.thisObject as? TelephonyManager
                val phoneId = name.endsWith("ForPhone") || requested != null &&
                    (name == "getNetworkCountryIso" || name == "getSimState")
                val id = requested ?: manager?.subscriptionId ?: -1
                val view = readSnapshot(if (phoneId) "phone" else "subscription", id,
                    identifiers = name in subscriber || name in iccid)
                    ?: return@Hooker original
                val profile = view.profile
                if (!profile.virtual) {
                    if (original == null || original is String && original.isEmpty()) return@Hooker original
                    if (original == 0 && (name in network || name in phone || name in simState)) {
                        return@Hooker original
                    }
                }
                when (name) {
                    in numeric -> profile.operatorNumeric
                    in simName -> profile.carrierName
                    in networkName -> profile.operatorName
                    in country -> profile.countryIso.lowercase(Locale.ROOT)
                    in network -> if (profile.radio == CarrierRadio.NR) TelephonyManager.NETWORK_TYPE_NR
                        else TelephonyManager.NETWORK_TYPE_LTE
                    in phone -> TelephonyManager.PHONE_TYPE_GSM
                    in simState -> if (profile.virtual) TelephonyManager.SIM_STATE_READY else original
                    in subscriber -> if (profile.virtual) view.imsi ?: original else original
                    in iccid -> if (profile.virtual) view.iccid ?: original else original
                    in carrierId -> if (profile.virtual) {
                        when (name) {
                            "getSimCarrierId", "getSimSpecificCarrierId" ->
                                CarrierVirtualIdentity.carrierId(profile)
                            else -> profile.carrierName
                        }
                    } else original
                    else -> original
                }
            } finally { reading.set(false) }
        }
        (numeric + simName + networkName + country + network + phone + simState + subscriber +
            iccid + carrierId).forEach {
            HookInstaller.hookAllMethods(type, it, hook)
        }
        installSubscriptionManager(loader)
    }

    /**
     * MIUI's plugin controller reads SubId/SimState through static SubscriptionManager helpers.
     * These calls never enter PhoneInterfaceManager, so they need their own overlay.
     */
    private fun installSubscriptionManager(loader: ClassLoader) {
        val type = Reflection.findClassIfExists("android.telephony.SubscriptionManager", loader) ?: return
        val hook = Hooker { chain ->
            if (reading.get() == true) return@Hooker chain.proceed()
            reading.set(true)
            try {
                val original = chain.proceed()
                val name = chain.executable.name
                val requestedSlot = (chain.args.firstOrNull() as? Int)?.plus(1)
                val profile = if (requestedSlot != null) virtualForSlot(requestedSlot) else {
                    if (original is Int && android.telephony.SubscriptionManager.isValidSubscriptionId(original)) {
                        return@Hooker original
                    }
                    snapshot("subscription", Int.MAX_VALUE)?.takeIf { it.virtual }
                } ?: return@Hooker original
                when (name) {
                    "getSubId" -> intArrayOf(CarrierVirtualIdentity.subscriptionId(profile))
                    "getDefaultSubscriptionId", "getDefaultDataSubscriptionId",
                    "getDefaultVoiceSubscriptionId", "getDefaultSmsSubscriptionId",
                    "getDefaultSubscriptionIdForPhone" ->
                        CarrierVirtualIdentity.subscriptionId(profile)
                    else -> original
                }
            } finally { reading.set(false) }
        }
        listOf("getSubId", "getDefaultSubscriptionId", "getDefaultDataSubscriptionId",
            "getDefaultVoiceSubscriptionId", "getDefaultSmsSubscriptionId",
            "getDefaultSubscriptionIdForPhone").forEach {
            HookInstaller.hookAllMethods(type, it, hook)
        }
    }

    internal fun statusBarProfiles(): List<SimCarrierProfile> = (1..2).mapNotNull(::virtualForSlot)

    internal fun statusBarProfile(): SimCarrierProfile? = statusBarProfiles().firstOrNull()

    private fun virtualForSlot(slot: Int): SimCarrierProfile? {
        if (slot !in 1..2) return null
        return snapshot("phone", slot - 1)?.takeIf { it.slot == slot && it.virtual }
    }

    private data class View(val profile: SimCarrierProfile, val imsi: String?, val iccid: String?)

    private fun snapshot(kind: String, id: Int): SimCarrierProfile? = readSnapshot(kind, id)?.profile

    private fun readSnapshot(kind: String, id: Int, identifiers: Boolean = false): View? = runCatching {
        val context = BinderUtils.getSystemContext() ?: return null
        val location = context.getSystemService(LocationManager::class.java) ?: return null
        val reply = Bundle().apply {
            putString("kind", kind); putInt("id", id); putBoolean("identifiers", identifiers)
        }
        if (!location.sendExtraCommand("fused_ext", CarrierIdentitySnapshotCommand.COMMAND, reply)) return null
        val encoded = reply.getString(CarrierIdentitySnapshotCommand.PROFILE) ?: return null
        if (encoded.length > 4096) return null
        View(Json.decodeFromString(SimCarrierProfile.serializer(), encoded),
            reply.getString(CarrierIdentitySnapshotCommand.IMSI),
            reply.getString(CarrierIdentitySnapshotCommand.ICCID))
    }.getOrNull()
}
```

`xposed/src/main/java/com/system/location/service/hook/hooks/telephony/CarrierConfigGlobalController.kt`:

```kt
package com.system.location.service.hook.hooks.telephony

import android.annotation.SuppressLint
import android.os.Binder
import android.os.IBinder
import com.system.location.service.hook.utils.BinderUtils
import android.os.PersistableBundle
import android.telephony.SubscriptionManager
import com.system.location.service.core.carrier.CarrierIdentityMode
import com.system.location.service.core.carrier.CarrierVirtualIdentity
import com.system.location.service.core.carrier.SimCarrierProfile
import com.system.location.service.core.runtime.RuntimeSnapshot
import com.system.location.service.hook.utils.FakeLoc
import com.system.location.service.hook.utils.Logger

/**
 * GLOBAL-mode implementation. It deliberately applies the same public CarrierConfig override
 * mechanism used by the OS: the system phone stack, SystemUI and third-party apps all observe the
 * simulated identity. PER_APP mode never calls this controller.
 *
 * The override is non-persistent and is removed when the feature is disabled or the scenario stops.
 */
object CarrierConfigGlobalController {
    private const val COUNTRY = "sim_country_iso_override_string"
    private const val NAME_OVERRIDE = "carrier_name_override_bool"
    private const val NAME = "carrier_name_string"
    private const val HOME = "force_home_network_bool"

    private var appliedSubIds: Set<Int> = emptySet()
    @Volatile var status: String = "disabled"
        private set

    fun recordFailure() { status = "failed" }

    fun supportsOwnedOverrides(): Boolean {
        if (!FakeLoc.isSystemServerProcess) return false
        return withSystemIdentity {
            runCatching {
                val loader = carrierConfigLoader() ?: return@runCatching false
                val reply = loader.javaClass.getMethod("getConfigForSubIdWithFeature",
                    Int::class.javaPrimitiveType, String::class.java, String::class.java)
                    .invoke(loader, SubscriptionManager.INVALID_SUBSCRIPTION_ID, "android",
                        CarrierOverrideProtocol.FEATURE) as? PersistableBundle
                reply?.getBoolean(CarrierOverrideProtocol.SUPPORTED) == true
            }.getOrDefault(false)
        }
    }

    @Synchronized
    fun saveReloadState(): android.os.Bundle = android.os.Bundle().apply {
        putIntArray("subscriptions", appliedSubIds.toIntArray())
        putString("status", status)
    }

    @Synchronized
    fun restoreReloadState(saved: android.os.Bundle?) {
        if (saved == null) return
        appliedSubIds = (saved.getIntArray("subscriptions") ?: intArrayOf())
            .filter { SubscriptionManager.isValidSubscriptionId(it) }.toSet()
        status = saved.getString("status") ?: "restore_pending"
    }

    @Synchronized
    fun onSimulationStopped() {
        if (!FakeLoc.isSystemServerProcess) return
        withSystemIdentity { restoreApplied() }
    }

    @Synchronized
    fun onConfigurationChanged(state: RuntimeSnapshot) {
        if (!FakeLoc.isSystemServerProcess) return
        withSystemIdentity { applyConfiguration(state) }
    }

    private inline fun <T> withSystemIdentity(action: () -> T): T {
        val token = Binder.clearCallingIdentity()
        return try { action() } finally { Binder.restoreCallingIdentity(token) }
    }

    private fun applyConfiguration(state: RuntimeSnapshot) {
        val policy = state.configuration
        val config = policy.carrierIdentity
        val enabled = policy.enabled && policy.carrierIdentityEnabled &&
            config != null && config.mode == CarrierIdentityMode.GLOBAL
        if (!enabled) {
            restoreApplied()
            status = when {
                appliedSubIds.isNotEmpty() -> "restore_pending"
                !policy.carrierIdentityEnabled -> "disabled"
                !policy.enabled -> "waiting_for_scenario"
                config?.mode == CarrierIdentityMode.PER_APP -> "per_app"
                else -> "unconfigured"
            }
            return
        }
        val loader = carrierConfigLoader()
        if (loader == null) {
            status = "service_unavailable"
            Logger.warn("Global carrier identity unavailable: carrier_config service not found")
            return
        }
        val next = LinkedHashSet<Int>()
        var succeeded = 0
        var failed = false
        for (slot in 1..2) {
            val profile = config?.profileForSlot(slot) ?: continue
            val subIds = subIdsForSlot(slot)
            for (subId in subIds) {
                runCatching {
                    overrideConfig(loader, subId, bundleFor(profile))
                    next += subId
                    succeeded++
                }.onFailure {
                    failed = true
                    next += subId
                    Logger.warn("Global carrier identity failed for slot=$slot sub=$subId: ${it.message}")
                }
            }
        }
        val removed = appliedSubIds - next
        for (subId in removed) {
            runCatching { overrideConfig(loader, subId, PersistableBundle().apply {
                    putString(CarrierOverrideProtocol.ACTION, CarrierOverrideProtocol.RESTORE)
                }) }.onFailure {
                // Keep ownership until restore succeeds, so disabling can be retried.
                failed = true
                next += subId
                Logger.warn("Global carrier restore failed for sub=$subId: ${it.message}")
            }
        }
        appliedSubIds = next
        status = when {
            failed -> "failed"
            succeeded == 0 && config.sims.any { it.enabled && it.virtual } -> "virtual_applied"
            succeeded == 0 -> "no_active_sim"
            else -> "global_applied"
        }
    }

    private fun restoreApplied() {
        if (appliedSubIds.isEmpty()) return
        val loader = carrierConfigLoader() ?: return
        val pending = LinkedHashSet<Int>()
        for (subId in appliedSubIds) {
            runCatching { overrideConfig(loader, subId, PersistableBundle().apply {
                    putString(CarrierOverrideProtocol.ACTION, CarrierOverrideProtocol.RESTORE)
                }) }.onFailure {
                pending += subId
                Logger.warn("Global carrier restore failed for sub=$subId: ${it.message}")
            }
        }
        appliedSubIds = pending
    }

    private fun bundleFor(profile: SimCarrierProfile): PersistableBundle = PersistableBundle().apply {
        putString(CarrierOverrideProtocol.ACTION, CarrierOverrideProtocol.APPLY)
        putString(COUNTRY, profile.countryIso.lowercase(java.util.Locale.ROOT))
        putBoolean(NAME_OVERRIDE, true)
        putString(NAME, profile.carrierName)
        // Matches the AOSP CTS carrier-name path used by Nrfr; it keeps the override active on
        // the home network rather than allowing roaming configuration to undo it.
        putBoolean(HOME, true)
    }

    @SuppressLint("MissingPermission")
    private fun subIdsForSlot(slot: Int): List<Int> {
        // Resolve only active subscriptions whose real slot matches. The default data/voice
        // subscription may live in either slot and must never be guessed to belong to SIM1.
        val context = BinderUtils.getSystemContext() ?: return emptyList()
        val manager = context.createAttributionContext(CarrierIdentityRuntime.PHYSICAL_QUERY_TAG)
            .getSystemService(SubscriptionManager::class.java) ?: return emptyList()
        return manager.activeSubscriptionInfoList.orEmpty()
            .filter { it.simSlotIndex == slot - 1 }
            .filter { info ->
                val modeled = FakeLoc.runtimeSnapshots.current().configuration.carrierIdentity?.sims.orEmpty()
                    .firstOrNull { CarrierVirtualIdentity.subscriptionId(it) == info.subscriptionId }
                modeled == null || info.iccId != CarrierVirtualIdentity.iccid(modeled)
            }
            .map { it.subscriptionId }
            .filter { SubscriptionManager.isValidSubscriptionId(it) }
            .distinct()
    }

    private fun carrierConfigLoader(): Any? = runCatching {
        val serviceManager = Class.forName("android.os.ServiceManager")
        val binder = serviceManager.getMethod("getService", String::class.java)
            .invoke(null, "carrier_config") as? IBinder ?: return null
        val stub = Class.forName("com.android.internal.telephony.ICarrierConfigLoader\$Stub")
        stub.getMethod("asInterface", IBinder::class.java).invoke(null, binder)
    }.getOrNull()

    private fun overrideConfig(loader: Any, subId: Int, bundle: PersistableBundle) {
        val probeMethod = loader.javaClass.getMethod("getConfigForSubIdWithFeature",
            Int::class.javaPrimitiveType, String::class.java, String::class.java)
        fun probe(): PersistableBundle? = probeMethod.invoke(loader, subId, "android",
            CarrierOverrideProtocol.FEATURE) as? PersistableBundle
        check(probe()?.getBoolean(CarrierOverrideProtocol.SUPPORTED) == true) {
            "Phone process does not support owned carrier overrides"
        }
        val method = loader.javaClass.methods.firstOrNull {
            it.name == "overrideConfig" &&
                it.parameterTypes.toList() == listOf(
                    Int::class.javaPrimitiveType,
                    PersistableBundle::class.java,
                    Boolean::class.javaPrimitiveType,
                )
        } ?: error("overrideConfig signature missing")
        method.invoke(loader, subId, bundle, false)
        val shouldOwn = bundle.getString(CarrierOverrideProtocol.ACTION) == CarrierOverrideProtocol.APPLY
        val deadline = android.os.SystemClock.elapsedRealtime() + 1_000L
        do {
            val state = probe()
            check(state?.getBoolean(CarrierOverrideProtocol.FAILED) != true) {
                "Phone process rejected carrier override; previous restore ownership is retained"
            }
            if (state != null && !state.getBoolean(CarrierOverrideProtocol.PENDING) &&
                state.getBoolean(CarrierOverrideProtocol.OWNED) == shouldOwn) return
            Thread.sleep(20)
        } while (android.os.SystemClock.elapsedRealtime() < deadline)
        error("Carrier override did not complete within the verification deadline")
    }
}
```

`xposed/src/main/java/com/system/location/service/hook/hooks/telephony/CarrierConfigOverrideHook.kt`:

```kt
package com.system.location.service.hook.hooks.telephony

import android.os.Binder
import android.os.PersistableBundle
import com.system.location.service.core.carrier.CarrierOverrideOwnership
import com.system.location.service.hook.runtime.HookRuntime
import com.system.location.service.hook.runtime.Reflection
import com.system.location.service.hook.scope.HookInstaller
import io.github.libxposed.api.XposedInterface.Hooker
import java.util.IdentityHashMap

/**
 * Owns only Portal's temporary carrier fields, inside CarrierConfigLoader's update path.
 * The public API enforces platform permissions; the private merge helper runs on the loader's
 * handler on recent Android releases. Requests are correlated by the exact clean bundle object,
 * rather than ThreadLocal state which would be lost across that handler hop.
 */
internal object CarrierConfigOverrideHook {
    @Volatile var supported = false
        private set
    private data class Request(val subId: Int, val action: String, val patch: PersistableBundle)
    private data class Ownership(val baseline: PersistableBundle, val written: PersistableBundle,
        val phoneId: Int, val layer: Array<PersistableBundle?>)
    private val pending = IdentityHashMap<PersistableBundle, Request>()
    private val owned = HashMap<Int, Ownership>()
    private val failures = HashSet<Int>()
    private val lock = Any()

    fun failed(subId: Int): Boolean = synchronized(lock) { subId in failures }

    fun status(subId: Int): Pair<Boolean, Boolean> = synchronized(lock) {
        owned.containsKey(subId) to pending.values.any { it.subId == subId }
    }

    fun install(loader: ClassLoader) {
        val type = Reflection.findClassIfExists("com.android.phone.CarrierConfigLoader", loader) ?: return
        installType(type, Binder::getCallingUid)
    }

    internal fun installType(type: Class<*>, callerUid: () -> Int) {
        val helper = type.declaredMethods.firstOrNull {
            it.name == "overrideConfig" && it.parameterTypes.toList() == listOf(
                arrayOfNulls<PersistableBundle>(0).javaClass,
                Int::class.javaPrimitiveType,
                PersistableBundle::class.java,
            )
        }
        val publicMethod = type.declaredMethods.firstOrNull {
            it.name == "overrideConfig" && it.parameterTypes.toList() == listOf(
                Int::class.javaPrimitiveType, PersistableBundle::class.java, Boolean::class.javaPrimitiveType,
            )
        } ?: return
        // Always strip/reject our protocol, including on unsupported OEMs. Never let its request
        // keys become real carrier keys merely because a private platform helper changed shape.
        HookInstaller.hookMethod(publicMethod, Hooker { chain ->
            val request = chain.args.getOrNull(1) as? PersistableBundle
            val action = request?.getString(CarrierOverrideProtocol.ACTION)
            if (action == null) return@Hooker chain.proceed()
            require(callerUid() == 1000) { "Carrier override requires system UID" }
            check(supported) { "Owned carrier override is unsupported on this platform" }
            require(action == CarrierOverrideProtocol.APPLY || action == CarrierOverrideProtocol.RESTORE)
            require(chain.args.getOrNull(2) == false) { "Portal carrier override must be temporary" }
            val subId = chain.args[0] as Int
            val patch = PersistableBundle(request).apply { remove(CarrierOverrideProtocol.ACTION) }
            require(patch.keySet().all { it in CarrierOverrideProtocol.FIELDS }) { "Unexpected carrier field" }
            val clean = PersistableBundle()
            synchronized(lock) {
                check(pending.size < 64) { "Carrier update queue is full" }
                pending[clean] = Request(subId, action, patch)
                failures.remove(subId)
            }
            val args = chain.args.toTypedArray().apply { this[1] = clean }
            try { chain.proceed(args) } catch (failure: Throwable) {
                synchronized(lock) { pending.remove(clean); failures.add(subId) }
                throw failure
            }
        }, exceptionMode = io.github.libxposed.api.XposedInterface.ExceptionMode.PASSTHROUGH)
        if (helper == null) return
        HookInstaller.hookMethod(helper, Hooker { chain ->
            val bundle = chain.args.getOrNull(2) as? PersistableBundle ?: return@Hooker chain.proceed()
            synchronized(lock) {
                val request = pending.remove(bundle) ?: return@synchronized chain.proceed()
                failures.add(request.subId)
                @Suppress("UNCHECKED_CAST")
                val values = chain.args[0] as Array<PersistableBundle?>
                val phoneId = chain.args[1] as Int
                check(phoneId in values.indices) { "Invalid carrier phone index" }
                val current = values[phoneId]?.let(::PersistableBundle) ?: PersistableBundle()
                val previous = owned[request.subId]
                check(previous == null || previous.phoneId == phoneId && previous.layer === values) {
                    "Subscription mapping changed; refusing to reuse carrier restore baseline"
                }
                check(owned.entries.none { (subId, ownership) ->
                    subId != request.subId && ownership.phoneId == phoneId && ownership.layer === values
                }) { "Carrier slot ownership belongs to another subscription" }
                val args = chain.args.toTypedArray()
                if (request.action == CarrierOverrideProtocol.APPLY) {
                    val baseline = previous?.let {
                        val rebased = CarrierOverrideOwnership.rebase(
                            it.baseline.keySet().associateWith { key -> it.baseline[key] },
                            current.keySet().associateWith { key -> current[key] },
                            it.written.keySet().associateWith { key -> it.written[key] },
                            request.patch.keySet(),
                        )
                        PersistableBundle(it.baseline).apply {
                            request.patch.keySet().forEach { key ->
                                remove(key)
                                if (key in rebased) {
                                    val source = if (it.written.containsKey(key) && current.containsKey(key) &&
                                        current[key] == it.written[key]) it.baseline else current
                                    putAll(PersistableBundle(source).apply {
                                        keySet().toList().filterNot { candidate -> candidate == key }.forEach(::remove)
                                    })
                                }
                            }
                        }
                    } ?: current
                    args[2] = request.patch
                    val result = chain.proceed(args)
                    owned[request.subId] = Ownership(baseline, PersistableBundle(request.patch), phoneId, values)
                    failures.remove(request.subId)
                    result
                } else {
                    if (previous == null) {
                        val result = chain.proceed()
                        failures.remove(request.subId)
                        return@synchronized result
                    }
                    val restored = PersistableBundle(current)
                    val baselineFields = PersistableBundle(previous.baseline)
                    val plan = CarrierOverrideOwnership.restorePlan(
                        previous.baseline.keySet().associateWith { previous.baseline[it] },
                        current.keySet().associateWith { current[it] },
                        previous.written.keySet().associateWith { previous.written[it] },
                    )
                    // Preserve changes another tool made after us, including changes to an owned
                    // key. All unowned keys remain in the current bundle untouched.
                    plan.remove.forEach(restored::remove)
                    baselineFields.keySet().toList().filterNot { it in plan.restore }
                        .forEach(baselineFields::remove)
                    restored.putAll(baselineFields)
                    // The AOSP helper merges non-null bundles. Clear only this temporary layer,
                    // then replace it before the outer method sends any config-change notification.
                    HookRuntime.invokeOriginalMethod(helper, chain.thisObject,
                        arrayOf(values, phoneId, null))
                    args[2] = restored
                    val result = try { chain.proceed(args) } catch (failure: Throwable) {
                        values[phoneId] = current
                        throw failure
                    }
                    owned.remove(request.subId)
                    failures.remove(request.subId)
                    result
                }
            }
        })
        supported = true
    }
}
```

`xposed/src/main/java/com/system/location/service/hook/hooks/telephony/CarrierConfigReadHook.kt`:

```kt
package com.system.location.service.hook.hooks.telephony

import android.os.PersistableBundle
import com.system.location.service.hook.runtime.Reflection
import com.system.location.service.hook.utils.hookAllMethods
import io.github.libxposed.api.XposedInterface.Hooker
import java.util.Locale

/** PER_APP identity overlay plus internal status handshake; GLOBAL uses the real temporary layer. */
internal object CarrierConfigReadHook {
    fun install(loader: ClassLoader) {
        val type = Reflection.findClassIfExists("com.android.phone.CarrierConfigLoader", loader) ?: return
        val hook = Hooker { chain ->
            val original = chain.proceed()
            val bundle = original as? PersistableBundle ?: return@Hooker original
            if (chain.args.getOrNull(2) == CarrierOverrideProtocol.FEATURE &&
                android.os.Binder.getCallingUid() == 1000) {
                val status = CarrierConfigOverrideHook.status(chain.args.firstOrNull() as? Int ?: -1)
                return@Hooker PersistableBundle().apply {
                    putBoolean(CarrierOverrideProtocol.SUPPORTED, CarrierConfigOverrideHook.supported)
                    putBoolean(CarrierOverrideProtocol.OWNED, status.first)
                    putBoolean(CarrierOverrideProtocol.PENDING, status.second)
                    putBoolean(CarrierOverrideProtocol.FAILED,
                        CarrierConfigOverrideHook.failed(chain.args.firstOrNull() as? Int ?: -1))
                }
            }
            // AOSP returns an empty bundle when READ_PHONE_STATE is denied. Keep that
            // redaction intact; profile availability is not authorization to expose new data.
            if (bundle.isEmpty) return@Hooker original
            val mode = com.system.location.service.hook.utils.FakeLoc.runtimeSnapshots.current()
                .configuration.carrierIdentity?.mode
            val profile = CarrierIdentityRuntime.profileForCall(chain.executable.name, chain.args)
                ?: return@Hooker original
            // GLOBAL physical SIMs already receive the real temporary CarrierConfig layer.
            // Virtual slots (including no-SIM topology) need a caller-scoped read overlay.
            if (mode == com.system.location.service.core.carrier.CarrierIdentityMode.GLOBAL &&
                !profile.virtual) return@Hooker original
            val subset = chain.executable.name == "getConfigSubsetForSubIdWithFeature"
            val requested = chain.args.filterIsInstance<Array<*>>().flatMap { it.filterIsInstance<String>() }.toSet()
            overlay(bundle, profile, if (subset) requested else null)
        }
        listOf("getConfigForSubId", "getConfigForSubIdWithFeature", "getConfigSubsetForSubIdWithFeature")
            .forEach { name -> type.hookAllMethods(name, hook) }
    }

    internal fun overlay(bundle: PersistableBundle,
        profile: com.system.location.service.core.carrier.SimCarrierProfile,
        requested: Set<String>?): PersistableBundle {
        if (bundle.isEmpty) return bundle
        return PersistableBundle(bundle).apply {
            fun includes(key: String) = requested == null || key in requested
            if (includes("sim_country_iso_override_string")) {
                putString("sim_country_iso_override_string", profile.countryIso.lowercase(Locale.ROOT))
            }
            if (includes("carrier_name_override_bool")) putBoolean("carrier_name_override_bool", true)
            if (includes("carrier_name_string")) putString("carrier_name_string", profile.carrierName)
            if (profile.virtual && includes("carrier_id_int")) {
                putInt("carrier_id_int", com.system.location.service.core.carrier.CarrierVirtualIdentity.carrierId(profile))
            }
        }
    }
}
```

```kt
package com.system.location.service.hook.hooks.telephony

import android.telephony.TelephonyDisplayInfo
import android.telephony.TelephonyManager
import com.system.location.service.core.carrier.CarrierRadio
import com.system.location.service.core.carrier.SimCarrierProfile
import com.system.location.service.hook.runtime.Reflection

/** SA reports NR as the underlying RAT. LTE+NR override values describe NSA, not SA. */
internal object CarrierDisplayInfo {
    fun create(profile: SimCarrierProfile): TelephonyDisplayInfo =
        Reflection.newInstance(TelephonyDisplayInfo::class.java,
            if (profile.radio == CarrierRadio.NR) TelephonyManager.NETWORK_TYPE_NR
            else TelephonyManager.NETWORK_TYPE_LTE,
            TelephonyDisplayInfo.OVERRIDE_NETWORK_TYPE_NONE) as TelephonyDisplayInfo

    fun unavailable(): TelephonyDisplayInfo = Reflection.newInstance(TelephonyDisplayInfo::class.java,
        TelephonyManager.NETWORK_TYPE_UNKNOWN, TelephonyDisplayInfo.OVERRIDE_NETWORK_TYPE_NONE) as TelephonyDisplayInfo
}
```

`xposed/src/main/java/com/system/location/service/hook/hooks/telephony/CarrierGlobalProperties.kt`:

```kt
package com.system.location.service.hook.hooks.telephony

import android.os.Binder
import android.os.Process
import com.system.location.service.core.carrier.CarrierIdentityMode
import com.system.location.service.core.carrier.CarrierListPropertyOwnership
import com.system.location.service.core.carrier.SimCarrierProfile
import com.system.location.service.hook.runtime.Reflection
import com.system.location.service.hook.utils.FakeLoc
import com.system.location.service.hook.utils.Logger
import com.system.location.service.hook.utils.onceHookAllMethod
import io.github.libxposed.api.XposedInterface.Hooker
import java.util.Locale

/** GLOBAL property-backed getters also work in applications outside module injection scope. */
internal object CarrierGlobalProperties {
    private val lock = Any()
    private val writing = ThreadLocal.withInitial { false }
    private val fields: Map<String, (SimCarrierProfile) -> String?> = linkedMapOf(
        "icc_operator_numeric" to { it.operatorNumeric },
        "icc_operator_alpha" to { it.carrierName },
        "icc_operator_iso_country" to { it.countryIso.lowercase(Locale.ROOT) },
        "operator_numeric" to { it.operatorNumeric },
        "operator_alpha" to { it.operatorName },
        "operator_iso_country" to { it.countryIso.lowercase(Locale.ROOT) },
        "sim_state" to { if (it.virtual) "READY" else null },
        "data_network_type" to { if (!it.virtual) null else
            if (it.radio == com.system.location.service.core.carrier.CarrierRadio.NR) "NR" else "LTE" },
    )
    private val ownership = fields.keys.associateWith { CarrierListPropertyOwnership() }
    @Volatile private var type: Class<*>? = null
    private var journal: CarrierPropertyJournalStore? = null
    private var recovered = false

    fun install(loader: ClassLoader) {
        val properties = Reflection.findClassIfExists("android.sysprop.TelephonyProperties", loader) ?: return
        type = properties
        fields.keys.forEach { field ->
            properties.onceHookAllMethod(field, Hooker { chain ->
                val result = chain.proceed()
                if (chain.args.size == 1 && writing.get() != true) refresh()
                result
            })
        }
        refresh()
    }

    private fun store(): CarrierPropertyJournalStore = journal ?: run {
        val system = com.system.location.service.hook.utils.BinderUtils.getSystemContext()
            ?: error("System context unavailable")
        val phone = system.createPackageContext("com.android.phone", 0).createDeviceProtectedStorageContext()
        CarrierPropertyJournalStore(phone, fields.keys).also { journal = it }
    }

    @Suppress("UNCHECKED_CAST")
    private fun read(properties: Class<*>, field: String): List<String> =
        properties.getMethod(field).invoke(null) as List<String>

    private fun recover(properties: Class<*>, store: CarrierPropertyJournalStore) {
        store.entries().forEach { (field, entry) ->
            val current = read(properties, field)
            val original = entry.recover(current)
            if (original != current) properties.getMethod(field, List::class.java).invoke(null, original)
        }
        store.clear()
        ownership.values.forEach { it.restore(com.system.location.service.core.carrier.CarrierListPropertyState()) }
        recovered = true
    }

    fun refresh() {
        if (writing.get() == true || runCatching { Process.myUid() }.getOrDefault(-1) != 1001) return
        val properties = type ?: return
        synchronized(lock) {
            if (writing.get() == true) return
            writing.set(true)
            val token = Binder.clearCallingIdentity()
            try {
                val store = store()
                if (!recovered) recover(properties, store)
                val policy = FakeLoc.runtimeSnapshots.current().configuration
                val global = policy.enabled && policy.carrierIdentityEnabled &&
                    policy.carrierIdentity?.mode == CarrierIdentityMode.GLOBAL
                val profiles = if (global) (0..1).mapNotNull { phone ->
                    CarrierIdentityRuntime.profileForCall("getSimOperatorNumericForPhone", listOf(phone), 1001)
                }.distinctBy { it.slot } else emptyList()
                fields.forEach { (field, value) ->
                    val owner = ownership.getValue(field)
                    if (profiles.isEmpty() && !owner.ownsValues()) return@forEach
                    val current = read(properties, field)
                    val next = profiles.mapNotNull { profile ->
                        value(profile)?.let { profile.slot - 1 to it }
                    }.toMap()
                    if (next.isEmpty() && !owner.ownsValues()) return@forEach
                    val before = owner.snapshot()
                    val proposal = owner.plan(current, next)
                    if (proposal.values == current && proposal.state == before) return@forEach
                    store.put(field, com.system.location.service.core.carrier.CarrierPropertyJournalEntry(before, proposal.state))
                    if (proposal.values != current)
                        properties.getMethod(field, List::class.java).invoke(null, proposal.values)
                    owner.restore(proposal.state)
                    store.put(field, if (owner.ownsValues())
                        com.system.location.service.core.carrier.CarrierPropertyJournalEntry(owner.snapshot()) else null)
                }
            } catch (failure: Exception) {
                journal = null
                recovered = false
                Logger.warn("Global carrier property recovery/apply unavailable: ${failure.javaClass.simpleName}")
            } finally {
                Binder.restoreCallingIdentity(token)
                writing.set(false)
            }
        }
    }
}
```

`xposed/src/main/java/com/system/location/service/hook/hooks/telephony/CarrierHardwareSubscriptionHook.kt`:

```kt
package com.system.location.service.hook.hooks.telephony

import android.annotation.SuppressLint
import android.telephony.SubscriptionManager
import com.system.location.service.hook.runtime.Reflection
import com.system.location.service.hook.utils.BinderUtils
import com.system.location.service.hook.utils.Logger
import com.system.location.service.hook.utils.FakeLoc
import com.system.location.service.hook.utils.hookAllMethods
import io.github.libxposed.api.XposedInterface.Hooker

/** Software subscriptions do not create modem IMS/RCS features or provisioning credentials. */
internal object CarrierHardwareSubscriptionHook {
    private val hardwareQuery = ThreadLocal.withInitial { false }
    internal fun hardwareQueryActive(): Boolean = hardwareQuery.get() == true
    internal fun <T> withHardwareQuery(action: () -> T): T {
        val previous = hardwareQueryActive()
        hardwareQuery.set(true)
        try { return action() } finally {
            if (previous) hardwareQuery.set(true) else hardwareQuery.remove()
        }
    }

    @SuppressLint("MissingPermission")
    fun install(loader: ClassLoader) {
        val monitor = Reflection.findClassIfExists("com.android.phone.RcsProvisioningMonitor", loader) ?: return
        monitor.hookAllMethods("onSubChanged", Hooker { chain -> withHardwareQuery { chain.proceed() } })
        SubscriptionManager::class.java.hookAllMethods("getActiveSubscriptionIdList", Hooker { chain ->
            val original = chain.proceed() // retain the framework's original checks
            // Startup must use the platform's own active-ID snapshot. Querying a different
            // subscription surface here can expose a SIM before IMS/RCS is ready for it.
            val policy = FakeLoc.runtimeSnapshots.current().configuration
            if (!hardwareQueryActive() || !requiresPhysicalQuery(policy)) return@Hooker original
            runCatching {
                val context = BinderUtils.getSystemContext() ?: error("System context unavailable")
                val physical = context.createAttributionContext(CarrierIdentityRuntime.PHYSICAL_QUERY_TAG)
                    .getSystemService(SubscriptionManager::class.java) ?: error("Subscription service unavailable")
                physical.activeSubscriptionInfoList.orEmpty().map { it.subscriptionId }
                    .filter(SubscriptionManager::isValidSubscriptionId).distinct().toIntArray()
            }.getOrElse {
                Logger.warn("Hardware subscription query unavailable: ${it.javaClass.simpleName}")
                // Unavailable hardware cannot be safely provisioned from a modeled subscription.
                intArrayOf()
            }
        })
    }

    internal fun requiresPhysicalQuery(policy: com.system.location.service.core.runtime.HookConfiguration): Boolean =
        policy.enabled && policy.carrierIdentityEnabled &&
            policy.carrierIdentity?.sims.orEmpty().any { it.enabled && it.virtual }
}
```

```kt
package com.system.location.service.hook.hooks.telephony

import android.content.pm.PackageManager
import com.system.location.service.hook.utils.BinderUtils

/** Virtual subscriptions have no carrier access rules, SMS role or device-owner delegation. */
internal object CarrierIdentifierAccess {
    fun permitted(): Boolean = runCatching {
        val context = BinderUtils.getSystemContext() ?: return false
        context.checkCallingOrSelfPermission("android.permission.READ_PRIVILEGED_PHONE_STATE") ==
            PackageManager.PERMISSION_GRANTED
    }.getOrDefault(false)
}
```
