`xposed/src/main/java/com/system/location/service/hook/hooks/telephony/CarrierIdentityRuntime.kt`:

```kt
package com.system.location.service.hook.hooks.telephony

import android.annotation.SuppressLint
import android.os.Binder
import android.telephony.SubscriptionInfo
import android.telephony.SubscriptionManager
import com.system.location.service.core.carrier.CarrierIdentityConfig
import com.system.location.service.core.carrier.CarrierIdentityMode
import com.system.location.service.core.carrier.CarrierIdentityResolver
import com.system.location.service.core.carrier.CarrierTarget
import com.system.location.service.core.carrier.CarrierVirtualIdentity
import com.system.location.service.core.carrier.SimCarrierProfile
import com.system.location.service.hook.utils.BinderUtils
import com.system.location.service.hook.utils.FakeLoc
import java.util.Locale

/** Resolves physical subscriptions under system identity; caller identity is captured beforehand. */
internal object CarrierIdentityRuntime {
    internal const val PHYSICAL_QUERY_TAG = "portal.carrier.physical-topology"
    private val resolving = ThreadLocal.withInitial { false }

    internal fun protectsLocation(uid: Int): Boolean {
        val state = FakeLoc.runtimeSnapshots.current()
        if (!state.configuration.enabled || uid < 0 || uid % 100000 < 10000) return false
        val context = BinderUtils.getSystemContext() ?: return true
        val packages = runCatching { context.packageManager.getPackagesForUid(uid)?.toList().orEmpty() }
            .getOrDefault(emptyList())
        if (packages.isEmpty()) return true
        if (packages.any { name -> runCatching {
            context.packageManager.getApplicationInfo(name, 0).flags and
                (android.content.pm.ApplicationInfo.FLAG_SYSTEM or android.content.pm.ApplicationInfo.FLAG_UPDATED_SYSTEM_APP) != 0
        }.getOrDefault(false) }) return false
        return runCatching {
            com.system.location.service.hook.hooks.ListenerRouting.decisionFor(null, uid, state.routing) !=
                com.system.location.service.core.routing.RoutingDecision.Deny
        }.getOrDefault(true)
    }

    fun profileForCall(methodName: String, args: List<Any?>,
        callerUid: Int = Binder.getCallingUid()): SimCarrierProfile? {
        val policy = FakeLoc.runtimeSnapshots.current().configuration
        if (!policy.enabled || !policy.carrierIdentityEnabled || resolving.get() == true) return null
        val config = policy.carrierIdentity ?: return null
        val context = BinderUtils.getSystemContext() ?: return null
        val packages = packagesFor(context, callerUid)
        val systemCaller = isSystemCaller(context, callerUid, packages)
        resolving.set(true)
        val token = Binder.clearCallingIdentity()
        return try {
            val manager = context.createAttributionContext(PHYSICAL_QUERY_TAG)
                .getSystemService(SubscriptionManager::class.java) ?: return null
            val physical = physicalSubscriptions(manager)
            val physicalSlots = physical.map { it.simSlotIndex + 1 }.toSet()
            val virtual = virtualProfiles(config, physicalSlots, packages, systemCaller)
                .filter { profile -> physical.none { it.subscriptionId == CarrierVirtualIdentity.subscriptionId(profile) } }
            val combined = physical.associate { it.subscriptionId to (it.simSlotIndex + 1) } +
                virtual.associate { CarrierVirtualIdentity.subscriptionId(it) to it.slot }
            val defaultSubId: Int = physical.firstOrNull { it.subscriptionId ==
                SubscriptionManager.getDefaultSubscriptionId() }?.subscriptionId
                ?: virtual.firstOrNull()?.let { CarrierVirtualIdentity.subscriptionId(it) }
                ?: SubscriptionManager.getDefaultSubscriptionId()
            val requested = args.firstOrNull() as? Int
            val phoneIndex = methodName.endsWith("ForPhone") || methodName.endsWith("ForSlot")
            val slot = if (methodName.contains("SimSlotIndex") || methodName.contains("ForSlotIndex")) {
                requested?.takeIf { it in 0..1 }?.plus(1)
            } else if (phoneIndex && requested == null) {
                // Some PhoneInterfaceManager getters omit the phone index and resolve the current
                // default phone internally. Treat them like the default subscription.
                combined[defaultSubId] ?: combined.values.firstOrNull()
            } else if (phoneIndex && requested != null) {
                requested.takeIf { it in 0..1 }?.plus(1)
            } else {
                com.system.location.service.core.carrier.CarrierSubscriptionSelection.slot(
                    methodName, requested, combined, defaultSubId,
                )
            }
            val resolvedSlot = slot ?: return null
            val resolved = CarrierIdentityResolver.profile(config, resolvedSlot, physicalSlots, packages, systemCaller)
            resolved?.takeIf { profile -> !profile.virtual || virtual.any {
                it.slot == profile.slot && CarrierVirtualIdentity.subscriptionId(it) == CarrierVirtualIdentity.subscriptionId(profile)
            } }
        } catch (_: Exception) {
            // An unavailable mapping cannot be guessed: preserve the platform result.
            null
        } finally {
            Binder.restoreCallingIdentity(token)
            resolving.set(false)
        }
    }

    /** Virtual profiles visible to this caller; used to synthesize the SubscriptionInfo list. */
    internal fun virtualProfilesForCall(callerUid: Int = Binder.getCallingUid()): List<SimCarrierProfile> {
        val policy = FakeLoc.runtimeSnapshots.current().configuration
        if (!policy.enabled || !policy.carrierIdentityEnabled || resolving.get() == true) return emptyList()
        val config = policy.carrierIdentity ?: return emptyList()
        val context = BinderUtils.getSystemContext() ?: return emptyList()
        val packages = packagesFor(context, callerUid)
        val systemCaller = isSystemCaller(context, callerUid, packages)
        resolving.set(true)
        val token = Binder.clearCallingIdentity()
        return try {
            val manager = context.createAttributionContext(PHYSICAL_QUERY_TAG)
                .getSystemService(SubscriptionManager::class.java) ?: return emptyList()
            val physical = physicalSubscriptions(manager)
            virtualProfiles(config, physical.map { it.simSlotIndex + 1 }.toSet(), packages, systemCaller)
                .filter { profile -> physical.none { it.subscriptionId == CarrierVirtualIdentity.subscriptionId(profile) } }
        } catch (_: Exception) {
            emptyList()
        } finally {
            Binder.restoreCallingIdentity(token)
            resolving.set(false)
        }
    }

    internal fun isResolving(): Boolean = resolving.get() == true

    @SuppressLint("MissingPermission")
    private fun physicalSubscriptions(manager: SubscriptionManager): List<SubscriptionInfo> =
        manager.activeSubscriptionInfoList.orEmpty()
            .filter { it.simSlotIndex in 0..1 && SubscriptionManager.isValidSubscriptionId(it.subscriptionId) }
            // The SubscriptionInfo hook may have already added our synthetic slots in this
            // process. Never feed them back into the physical-slot resolver.
            .filter { info ->
                val modeled = FakeLoc.runtimeSnapshots.current().configuration.carrierIdentity?.sims.orEmpty()
                    .firstOrNull { CarrierVirtualIdentity.subscriptionId(it) == info.subscriptionId }
                modeled == null || info.iccId != CarrierVirtualIdentity.iccid(modeled)
            }

    private fun virtualProfiles(
        config: CarrierIdentityConfig,
        physicalSlots: Set<Int>,
        packages: List<String>,
        systemCaller: Boolean,
    ): List<SimCarrierProfile> {
        if (config.mode == CarrierIdentityMode.GLOBAL) {
            return config.sims.filter { it.enabled && it.virtual && it.virtualSubscriptionId > 0 && it.slot !in physicalSlots }
                .map { it.copy(virtual = true) }
        }
        if (systemCaller || packages.isEmpty()) return emptyList()
        val targets = packages.map { config.targetFor(it, false) }.distinct()
        if (targets.size != 1) return emptyList()
        val target = targets.single()
        if (target == CarrierTarget.REAL) return emptyList()
        if (target == CarrierTarget.INHERIT) {
            // A selected app with the default route inherits the physical slot. On a no-SIM
            // fixture that slot does not exist, so inherit the first explicitly configured
            // virtual slot rather than silently disabling per-app identity.
            return config.sims.filter { it.enabled && it.virtual && it.virtualSubscriptionId > 0 && it.slot !in physicalSlots }
                .sortedBy { it.slot }.take(1).map { it.copy(virtual = true) }
        }
        val slot = when (target) {
            CarrierTarget.SIM1 -> 1
            CarrierTarget.SIM2 -> 2
            else -> return emptyList()
        }
        if (slot in physicalSlots) return emptyList()
        return listOfNotNull(config.profileForSlot(slot)?.takeIf { it.virtual && it.virtualSubscriptionId > 0 })
    }

    private fun packagesFor(context: android.content.Context, uid: Int): List<String> =
        runCatching { context.packageManager.getPackagesForUid(uid)?.toList().orEmpty() }
            .getOrDefault(emptyList())

    private fun isSystemCaller(
        context: android.content.Context,
        uid: Int,
        packages: List<String>,
    ): Boolean = uid % 100000 < 10000 || packages.isEmpty() || packages.any { name ->
        runCatching {
            val flags = context.packageManager.getApplicationInfo(name, 0).flags
            flags and (android.content.pm.ApplicationInfo.FLAG_SYSTEM or
                android.content.pm.ApplicationInfo.FLAG_UPDATED_SYSTEM_APP) != 0
        }.getOrDefault(true)
    }
}
```

`xposed/src/main/java/com/system/location/service/hook/hooks/telephony/CarrierIdentitySnapshotCommand.kt`:

```kt
package com.system.location.service.hook.hooks.telephony

import android.os.Bundle
import com.system.location.service.core.carrier.SimCarrierProfile
import kotlinx.serialization.json.Json

/** Read-only caller-scoped view; never exposes controller tokens, routing tables or real SIM IDs. */
object CarrierIdentitySnapshotCommand {
    const val COMMAND = "portal_carrier_identity_snapshot"
    const val PROFILE = "profile"
    const val IMSI = "imsi"
    const val ICCID = "iccid"
    fun read(request: Bundle): Boolean {
        request.remove(PROFILE)
        request.remove(IMSI)
        request.remove(ICCID)
        val kind = request.getString("kind") ?: return false
        val method = when (kind) {
            "phone" -> "getSimCountryIsoForPhone"
            "subscription" -> "getSimOperatorForSubscriber"
            else -> return false
        }
        if (!request.containsKey("id")) return false
        val profile = CarrierIdentityRuntime.profileForCall(method, listOf(request.getInt("id")))
            ?: return false
        request.putString(PROFILE, Json.encodeToString(SimCarrierProfile.serializer(), profile.copy(identitySeed = 0L, phoneNumber = "", phoneNumberCity = "")))
        if (profile.virtual && request.getBoolean("identifiers", false) && CarrierIdentifierAccess.permitted()) {
            request.putString(IMSI, com.system.location.service.core.carrier.CarrierVirtualIdentity.imsi(profile))
            request.putString(ICCID, com.system.location.service.core.carrier.CarrierVirtualIdentity.iccid(profile))
        }
        return true
    }
}
```

`xposed/src/main/java/com/system/location/service/hook/hooks/telephony/CarrierPhoneNumberAccess.kt`:

```kt
package com.system.location.service.hook.hooks.telephony

import android.app.AppOpsManager
import android.content.pm.PackageManager
import android.os.Binder
import com.system.location.service.hook.utils.BinderUtils

/** Modeled numbers still require the caller's phone-number permission and matching AppOp. */
internal object CarrierPhoneNumberAccess {
    fun permitted(packageName: String? = null, legacy: Boolean = true): Boolean = runCatching {
        val context = BinderUtils.getSystemContext() ?: return false
        if (CarrierIdentifierAccess.permitted()) return true
        val uid = Binder.getCallingUid()
        val packages = context.packageManager.getPackagesForUid(uid)?.toList().orEmpty()
        val name = if (packageName != null) packageName.takeIf { it in packages } ?: return false
            else packages.singleOrNull() ?: return false
        val ops = context.getSystemService(AppOpsManager::class.java)
        fun allowed(permission: String, operation: String): Boolean =
            context.checkCallingOrSelfPermission(permission) == PackageManager.PERMISSION_GRANTED &&
                ops.checkOpNoThrow(operation, uid, name) == AppOpsManager.MODE_ALLOWED
        if (allowed("android.permission.READ_PHONE_NUMBERS", AppOpsManager.OPSTR_READ_PHONE_NUMBERS)) return true
        if (!legacy) return false
        if (allowed("android.permission.READ_SMS", AppOpsManager.OPSTR_READ_SMS)) return true
        if (context.packageManager.getApplicationInfo(name, 0).targetSdkVersion <= 29 &&
            allowed("android.permission.READ_PHONE_STATE", AppOpsManager.OPSTR_READ_PHONE_STATE)) return true
        name == android.provider.Telephony.Sms.getDefaultSmsPackage(context) &&
            ops.checkOpNoThrow("android:write_sms", uid, name) == AppOpsManager.MODE_ALLOWED
    }.getOrDefault(false)
}
```

`xposed/src/main/java/com/system/location/service/hook/hooks/telephony/CarrierPhoneNumberHook.kt`:

```kt
package com.system.location.service.hook.hooks.telephony

import com.system.location.service.hook.runtime.Reflection
import com.system.location.service.hook.utils.hookAllMethods
import io.github.libxposed.api.XposedInterface.Hooker

/** Covers both legacy line-1 and Android 13+ SubscriptionManager phone number sources. */
internal object CarrierPhoneNumberHook {
    fun install(loader: ClassLoader) {
        val hosts = mapOf(
            "com.android.internal.telephony.PhoneSubInfoController" to listOf("getLine1NumberForSubscriber", "getLine1Number"),
            "com.android.phone.PhoneInterfaceManager" to listOf("getLine1NumberForDisplay"),
            "com.android.internal.telephony.SubscriptionController" to listOf("getPhoneNumber", "getPhoneNumberFromFirstAvailableSource"),
            "com.android.internal.telephony.subscription.SubscriptionManagerService" to listOf("getPhoneNumber", "getPhoneNumberFromFirstAvailableSource"),
        )
        hosts.forEach { (name, methods) ->
            val host = Reflection.findClassIfExists(name, loader) ?: return@forEach
            methods.forEach { method -> host.hookAllMethods(method, Hooker { chain ->
                val original = chain.proceed() // retain permission, attribution, invalid-source exceptions
                if (!CarrierPhoneNumberAccess.permitted(chain.args.filterIsInstance<String>().firstOrNull(),
                    legacy = chain.executable.name.startsWith("getLine1Number")))
                    return@Hooker original
                // SOURCE_UICC=1; no IMS/carrier record is invented for other explicit sources.
                if (chain.executable.name == "getPhoneNumber" && chain.args.getOrNull(1) is Int && chain.args[1] != 1)
                    return@Hooker original
                val profile = CarrierIdentityRuntime.profileForCall("getActiveSubscriptionInfo", chain.args)
                    ?: return@Hooker original
                profile.phoneNumber.takeIf { it.isNotEmpty() } ?: original
            }) }
        }
    }
}
```

`xposed/src/main/java/com/system/location/service/hook/hooks/telephony/CarrierPropertyJournalStore.kt`:

```kt
package com.system.location.service.hook.hooks.telephony

import android.content.Context
import android.provider.Settings
import android.util.AtomicFile
import com.system.location.service.core.carrier.CarrierPropertyJournalData
import com.system.location.service.core.carrier.CarrierPropertyJournalEntry
import java.io.ByteArrayOutputStream
import java.io.File
import kotlinx.serialization.json.Json

/** Private, boot-scoped write-ahead journal. Stores operator property values, never SIM credentials. */
internal class CarrierPropertyJournalStore(context: Context, private val allowed: Set<String>) {
    private val boot = Settings.Global.getInt(context.contentResolver, Settings.Global.BOOT_COUNT, -1)
        .also { require(it >= 0) { "Boot count unavailable" } }
    private val file = AtomicFile(File(context.noBackupFilesDir, "portal-carrier-property-journal-v1.json"))
    private var data: CarrierPropertyJournalData = load()

    fun entries(): Map<String, CarrierPropertyJournalEntry> = data.fields.toMap()

    fun put(field: String, entry: CarrierPropertyJournalEntry?) {
        require(field in allowed)
        val fields = data.fields.toMutableMap()
        if (entry == null) fields.remove(field) else fields[field] = entry
        commit(data.copy(fields = fields))
    }

    fun clear() = commit(CarrierPropertyJournalData(boot))

    private fun validate(value: CarrierPropertyJournalData) {
        require(value.version == 1 && value.bootCount >= 0)
        require(value.fields.keys.all { it in allowed })
        value.fields.values.forEach { entry ->
            entry.committed.validate()
            entry.pending?.validate()
        }
    }

    private fun load(): CarrierPropertyJournalData {
        val inputStream = try { file.openRead() } catch (failure: java.io.FileNotFoundException) {
            if (file.baseFile.exists() || File(file.baseFile.path + ".bak").exists()) throw failure
            return CarrierPropertyJournalData(boot)
        }
        val text = inputStream.use { input ->
            val bytes = ByteArrayOutputStream()
            val buffer = ByteArray(4096)
            while (true) {
                val count = input.read(buffer)
                if (count < 0) break
                require(bytes.size() + count <= 65_536) { "Carrier property journal too large" }
                bytes.write(buffer, 0, count)
            }
            bytes.toString("UTF-8")
        }
        val saved = Json.decodeFromString(CarrierPropertyJournalData.serializer(), text)
        validate(saved)
        // Non-persistent telephony properties are rebuilt by the OS on a new boot.
        return if (saved.bootCount == boot) saved else CarrierPropertyJournalData(boot)
    }

    private fun commit(next: CarrierPropertyJournalData) {
        validate(next)
        val bytes = Json.encodeToString(CarrierPropertyJournalData.serializer(), next).toByteArray(Charsets.UTF_8)
        require(bytes.size <= 65_536) { "Carrier property journal too large" }
        val output = file.startWrite()
        try {
            output.write(bytes)
            file.finishWrite(output)
            check(load() == next) { "Carrier property journal commit verification failed" }
            data = next
        } catch (failure: Exception) {
            file.failWrite(output)
            throw failure
        }
    }
}
```

`xposed/src/main/java/com/system/location/service/hook/hooks/telephony/CarrierRegistrationPolicy.kt`:

```kt
package com.system.location.service.hook.hooks.telephony

/** AOSP notifyNow follows events; never mistake the leading location-renunciation flags for it. */
internal object CarrierRegistrationPolicy {
    fun notifyNow(args: List<Any?>): Boolean {
        val eventsIndex = args.indexOfLast { it is IntArray }
        return eventsIndex >= 0 && args.getOrNull(eventsIndex + 1) == true
    }
}
```

`xposed/src/main/java/com/system/location/service/hook/hooks/telephony/CarrierRegistryHook.kt`:

```kt
package com.system.location.service.hook.hooks.telephony

import android.os.Binder
import android.os.IBinder
import android.os.IInterface
import android.telephony.ServiceState
import com.system.location.service.hook.scope.HookInstaller
import com.system.location.service.hook.utils.onceHookAllMethod
import io.github.libxposed.api.XposedInterface.Hooker
import java.util.concurrent.ConcurrentHashMap

/** Binds callback transports to the original caller and requested subscription before notifyNow. */
internal object CarrierRegistryHook {
    private const val EVENT_SERVICE_STATE_CHANGED = 1
    private const val EVENT_CELL_INFO_CHANGED = 11
    private const val EVENT_SIGNAL_STRENGTHS_CHANGED = 9
    private const val EVENT_DISPLAY_INFO_CHANGED = 21
    private class Entry(val uid: Int, val subId: Int, val death: IBinder.DeathRecipient,
        val serviceState: Boolean, val cellInfo: Boolean, val signalStrength: Boolean, val displayInfo: Boolean) {
        @Volatile var displaySent = false
        @Volatile var lastDisplay: android.telephony.TelephonyDisplayInfo? = null
        @Volatile var realDisplay: android.telephony.TelephonyDisplayInfo? = null
        @Volatile var signalSent = false
        @Volatile var lastSignal: android.telephony.SignalStrength? = null
        val movementGate = com.system.location.service.core.carrier.CarrierCellPublicationGate()
        @Volatile var cellsSent = false
        @Volatile var lastRealState: ServiceState? = null
        @Volatile var virtualSent = false
    }
    private val dispatching = ThreadLocal.withInitial { false }
    private val updates = java.util.concurrent.Executors.newSingleThreadExecutor { runnable ->
        Thread(runnable, "PortalCarrierCallbacks").apply { isDaemon = true }
    }
    private val listeners = ConcurrentHashMap<IBinder, Entry>()

    fun install(registry: Class<*>) {
        registry.declaredMethods.filter { method ->
            method.name == "getServiceStateForSubscriber" &&
                method.returnType == ServiceState::class.java
        }.forEach { method ->
            HookInstaller.hookMethod(method, Hooker { chain ->
                val original = chain.proceed()
                val subId = chain.args.firstOrNull() as? Int
                if (subId == null) return@Hooker original
                val profile = CarrierIdentityRuntime.profileForCall(
                    "getServiceStateForSubscriber", listOf(subId), Binder.getCallingUid())
                if (profile?.virtual == true) CarrierServiceStateHook.virtualState(profile)
                else original
            })
        }
        HookInstaller.hookAllMethods(registry, "listenWithEventList", Hooker { chain ->
            val listener = chain.args.filterIsInstance<IInterface>().firstOrNull {
                it.javaClass.methods.any { method -> method.name == "onServiceStateChanged" }
            } ?: return@Hooker chain.proceed()
            val subId = chain.args.filterIsInstance<Int>().firstOrNull() ?: return@Hooker chain.proceed()
            val events = chain.args.filterIsInstance<IntArray>().firstOrNull() ?: return@Hooker chain.proceed()
            val binder = listener.asBinder()
            if (events.isEmpty()) {
                val result = chain.proceed()
                remove(binder)
                return@Hooker result
            }
            installCallback(listener)
            // Registry may send its cached state synchronously while registering. Install before
            // proceeding, but roll back if framework permission validation throws.
            val previous = listeners[binder]
            val death = previous?.death ?: IBinder.DeathRecipient { remove(binder) }
            if (previous == null) binder.linkToDeath(death, 0)
            listeners[binder] = Entry(Binder.getCallingUid(), subId, death,
                EVENT_SERVICE_STATE_CHANGED in events, EVENT_CELL_INFO_CHANGED in events,
                EVENT_SIGNAL_STRENGTHS_CHANGED in events, EVENT_DISPLAY_INFO_CHANGED in events).apply {
                displaySent = previous?.displaySent ?: false
                lastDisplay = previous?.lastDisplay
                realDisplay = previous?.realDisplay
                signalSent = previous?.signalSent ?: false
                lastSignal = previous?.lastSignal
                cellsSent = previous?.cellsSent ?: false
                lastRealState = previous?.lastRealState
                virtualSent = previous?.virtualSent ?: false
            }
            try {
                val result = chain.proceed()
                if (!CarrierRegistrationPolicy.notifyNow(chain.args)) return@Hooker result
                // A no-SIM virtual subscription has no modem registration to generate the first
                // ServiceState callback. Seed the listener so SystemUI can render the carrier.
                val callerUid = listeners[binder]?.uid ?: -1
                val profile = CarrierIdentityRuntime.profileForCall(
                    "getServiceStateForSubscriber", listOf(subId), callerUid,
                )
                if (profile?.virtual == true && EVENT_SERVICE_STATE_CHANGED in events) {
                    val synthetic = CarrierServiceStateHook.virtualState(profile)
                    runCatching {
                        val method = listener.javaClass.methods.firstOrNull { method ->
                            method.name == "onServiceStateChanged" &&
                                method.parameterTypes.toList() == listOf(ServiceState::class.java)
                        } ?: error("onServiceStateChanged proxy method missing")
                        val entry = listeners[binder] ?: return@runCatching
                        dispatching.set(true)
                        try { method.invoke(listener, synthetic); entry.virtualSent = true }
                        finally { dispatching.set(false) }
                    }.onFailure {
                        com.system.location.service.hook.utils.Logger.warn(
                            "virtual ServiceState seed failed: ${it.javaClass.simpleName}:${it.message}")
                    }
                }
                if (profile?.virtual == true && EVENT_CELL_INFO_CHANGED in events) {
                    listeners[binder]?.let { updateCells(binder, it) }
                }
                if (profile?.virtual == true && EVENT_SIGNAL_STRENGTHS_CHANGED in events) {
                    listeners[binder]?.let { updateSignal(binder, it) }
                }
                if (profile?.virtual == true && EVENT_DISPLAY_INFO_CHANGED in events) {
                    listeners[binder]?.let { updateDisplay(binder, it) }
                }
                result
            } catch (failure: Throwable) {
                if (previous == null) remove(binder) else listeners[binder] = previous
                throw failure
            }
        })
    }

    private fun installCallback(listener: IInterface) {
        listener.javaClass.onceHookAllMethod("onDisplayInfoChanged", Hooker { callback ->
            if (dispatching.get() == true) return@Hooker callback.proceed()
            val target = callback.thisObject as? IInterface ?: return@Hooker callback.proceed()
            val entry = listeners[target.asBinder()] ?: return@Hooker callback.proceed()
            entry.realDisplay = callback.args.firstOrNull() as? android.telephony.TelephonyDisplayInfo
            val profile = CarrierIdentityRuntime.profileForCall("getServiceStateForSubscriber", listOf(entry.subId), entry.uid)
            if (profile?.virtual != true) {
                entry.displaySent = false
                return@Hooker callback.proceed()
            }
            val display = CarrierDisplayInfo.create(profile)
            val args = callback.args.toTypedArray()
            if (args.isEmpty()) return@Hooker callback.proceed()
            args[0] = display
            val result = callback.proceed(args)
            entry.displaySent = true
            entry.lastDisplay = display
            result
        })
        listener.javaClass.onceHookAllMethod("onSignalStrengthsChanged", Hooker { callback ->
            if (dispatching.get() == true) return@Hooker callback.proceed()
            val target = callback.thisObject as? IInterface ?: return@Hooker callback.proceed()
            val entry = listeners[target.asBinder()] ?: return@Hooker callback.proceed()
            val signal = CarrierSignalStrengthHook.forCaller(entry.uid, entry.subId) ?: return@Hooker callback.proceed()
            val args = callback.args.toTypedArray()
            if (args.isEmpty()) return@Hooker callback.proceed()
            args[0] = signal
            val result = callback.proceed(args)
            entry.signalSent = true
            entry.lastSignal = signal
            result
        })
        listener.javaClass.onceHookAllMethod("onServiceStateChanged", Hooker { callback ->
            if (dispatching.get() == true) return@Hooker callback.proceed()
            val target = callback.thisObject as? IInterface ?: return@Hooker callback.proceed()
            val entry = listeners[target.asBinder()] ?: return@Hooker callback.proceed()
            val original = callback.args.firstOrNull() as? ServiceState ?: return@Hooker callback.proceed()
            entry.lastRealState = CarrierServiceStateHook.copyWithoutCellIdentity(original)
            val profile = CarrierIdentityRuntime.profileForCall("getServiceStateForSubscriber",
                listOf(entry.subId), entry.uid)
            val args = callback.args.toTypedArray()
            args[0] = when {
                profile != null -> CarrierServiceStateHook.copyWithIdentity(original, profile)
                CarrierIdentityRuntime.protectsLocation(entry.uid) -> CarrierServiceStateHook.copyWithoutCellIdentity(original)
                else -> return@Hooker callback.proceed()
            }
            val result = callback.proceed(args)
            entry.virtualSent = profile?.virtual == true
            result
        })
        listener.javaClass.onceHookAllMethod("onCellInfoChanged", Hooker { callback ->
            if (dispatching.get() == true) return@Hooker callback.proceed()
            val target = callback.thisObject as? IInterface ?: return@Hooker callback.proceed()
            val entry = listeners[target.asBinder()] ?: return@Hooker callback.proceed()
            val identity = CarrierIdentityRuntime.profileForCall("getAllCellInfo", listOf(entry.subId), entry.uid)
            if (identity == null && !CarrierIdentityRuntime.protectsLocation(entry.uid)) return@Hooker callback.proceed()
            val result = runCatching { CellInfoSynthesis.resultForCaller(null, entry.uid, entry.subId) }
                .getOrDefault(CellInfoSynthesisResult.Unavailable)
            val cells = when (result) {
                CellInfoSynthesisResult.PassThrough -> return@Hooker callback.proceed()
                CellInfoSynthesisResult.Unavailable -> emptyList<android.telephony.CellInfo>()
                is CellInfoSynthesisResult.Synthetic -> result.cells
            }
            val args = callback.args.toTypedArray()
            if (args.isEmpty()) return@Hooker null
            args[0] = cells
            val delivered = callback.proceed(args)
            entry.cellsSent = identity?.virtual == true && cells.isNotEmpty()
            delivered
        })
    }

    private fun updateDisplay(binder: IBinder, entry: Entry) {
        if (!entry.displayInfo || listeners[binder] !== entry || !binder.isBinderAlive) return
        runCatching {
            val profile = CarrierIdentityRuntime.profileForCall("getServiceStateForSubscriber", listOf(entry.subId), entry.uid)
            val virtual = profile?.virtual == true
            val display = if (virtual) CarrierDisplayInfo.create(profile!!) else if (entry.displaySent)
                entry.realDisplay ?: CarrierDisplayInfo.unavailable() else return@runCatching
            if (virtual && entry.displaySent && display == entry.lastDisplay) return@runCatching
            val listener = Class.forName("com.android.internal.telephony.IPhoneStateListener\$Stub")
                .getMethod("asInterface", IBinder::class.java).invoke(null, binder) as IInterface
            if (listeners[binder] !== entry) return@runCatching
            dispatching.set(true)
            try {
                listener.javaClass.getMethod("onDisplayInfoChanged", android.telephony.TelephonyDisplayInfo::class.java)
                    .invoke(listener, display)
                entry.displaySent = virtual
                entry.lastDisplay = if (virtual) display else null
            } finally { dispatching.set(false) }
        }.onFailure {
            com.system.location.service.hook.utils.Logger.warn("Carrier display update failed: ${it.javaClass.simpleName}")
        }
    }

    private fun updateSignal(binder: IBinder, entry: Entry) {
        if (!entry.signalStrength || listeners[binder] !== entry || !binder.isBinderAlive) return
        runCatching {
            val modeled = CarrierSignalStrengthHook.forCaller(entry.uid, entry.subId)
            if (modeled != null && entry.signalSent && modeled == entry.lastSignal) return@runCatching
            val signal = modeled ?: if (entry.signalSent)
                com.system.location.service.hook.runtime.Reflection.newInstance(android.telephony.SignalStrength::class.java)
                    as android.telephony.SignalStrength else return@runCatching
            val listener = Class.forName("com.android.internal.telephony.IPhoneStateListener\$Stub")
                .getMethod("asInterface", IBinder::class.java).invoke(null, binder) as IInterface
            if (listeners[binder] !== entry) return@runCatching
            dispatching.set(true)
            try {
                listener.javaClass.getMethod("onSignalStrengthsChanged", android.telephony.SignalStrength::class.java)
                    .invoke(listener, signal)
                entry.signalSent = modeled != null
                entry.lastSignal = modeled
            } finally { dispatching.set(false) }
        }.onFailure {
            com.system.location.service.hook.utils.Logger.warn("Carrier signal update failed: ${it.javaClass.simpleName}")
        }
    }

    private fun updateCells(binder: IBinder, entry: Entry) {
        if (!entry.cellInfo || listeners[binder] !== entry || !binder.isBinderAlive) return
        runCatching {
            val profile = CarrierIdentityRuntime.profileForCall("getAllCellInfo", listOf(entry.subId), entry.uid)
            val cells = if (profile?.virtual == true) {
                when (val result = CellInfoSynthesis.resultForCaller(null, entry.uid, entry.subId)) {
                    is CellInfoSynthesisResult.Synthetic -> result.cells
                    else -> emptyList()
                }
            } else if (entry.cellsSent) emptyList() else return@runCatching
            val listener = Class.forName("com.android.internal.telephony.IPhoneStateListener\$Stub")
                .getMethod("asInterface", IBinder::class.java).invoke(null, binder) as IInterface
            if (listeners[binder] !== entry) return@runCatching
            dispatching.set(true)
            try {
                listener.javaClass.getMethod("onCellInfoChanged", List::class.java).invoke(listener, cells)
                entry.cellsSent = profile?.virtual == true && cells.isNotEmpty()
            } finally { dispatching.set(false) }
        }.onFailure {
            com.system.location.service.hook.utils.Logger.warn("Carrier cell update failed: ${it.javaClass.simpleName}")
        }
    }

    private var lastMovementCheck = Long.MIN_VALUE
    private val movementPending = java.util.concurrent.atomic.AtomicBoolean()

    @Synchronized
    fun onSamplePublished() {
        if (updates.isShutdown || listeners.values.none { it.cellInfo || it.signalStrength }) return
        val state = com.system.location.service.hook.utils.FakeLoc.runtimeSnapshots.current()
        if (!state.configuration.enabled || !state.configuration.carrierIdentityEnabled) return
        if (movementPending.get()) return
        val now = android.os.SystemClock.elapsedRealtimeNanos()
        if (lastMovementCheck != Long.MIN_VALUE && now >= lastMovementCheck && now - lastMovementCheck < 1_500_000_000L) return
        if (!movementPending.compareAndSet(false, true)) return
        lastMovementCheck = now
        val generation = com.system.location.service.hook.runtime.GenerationDelivery(
            com.system.location.service.hook.runtime.HookRuntime.executionGate)
        try {
            updates.execute {
                try { generation.run {
                    val current = com.system.location.service.hook.utils.FakeLoc.runtimeSnapshots.current()
                    listeners.entries.toList().forEach { (binder, entry) ->
                        updateSignal(binder, entry)
                        if (!entry.cellInfo) return@forEach
                        runCatching {
                            val point = CellInfoSynthesis.pointForCaller(entry.uid, current) ?: return@runCatching
                            if (entry.movementGate.changed(point.latitude, point.longitude,
                                    android.os.SystemClock.elapsedRealtimeNanos())) updateCells(binder, entry)
                        }.onFailure {
                            com.system.location.service.hook.utils.Logger.warn("Carrier movement update failed: ${it.javaClass.simpleName}")
                        }
                    }
                } } finally { movementPending.set(false) }
            }
        } catch (_: java.util.concurrent.RejectedExecutionException) { movementPending.set(false) }
    }

    fun onConfigurationChanged() {
        if (listeners.isEmpty() || updates.isShutdown) return
        val generation = com.system.location.service.hook.runtime.GenerationDelivery(
            com.system.location.service.hook.runtime.HookRuntime.executionGate)
        runCatching { updates.execute { generation.run {
            listeners.entries.toList().forEach { (binder, entry) ->
                updateCells(binder, entry)
                updateSignal(binder, entry)
                updateDisplay(binder, entry)
                if (!entry.serviceState || listeners[binder] !== entry || !binder.isBinderAlive) return@forEach
                runCatching {
                    val profile = CarrierIdentityRuntime.profileForCall("getServiceStateForSubscriber",
                        listOf(entry.subId), entry.uid)
                    val state = when {
                        profile?.virtual == true -> CarrierServiceStateHook.virtualState(profile)
                        entry.virtualSent -> entry.lastRealState?.let(::ServiceState) ?: ServiceState()
                        else -> return@runCatching
                    }
                    val listener = Class.forName("com.android.internal.telephony.IPhoneStateListener\$Stub")
                        .getMethod("asInterface", IBinder::class.java).invoke(null, binder) as IInterface
                    val method = listener.javaClass.getMethod("onServiceStateChanged", ServiceState::class.java)
                    if (listeners[binder] !== entry) return@runCatching
                    dispatching.set(true)
                    try { method.invoke(listener, state); entry.virtualSent = profile?.virtual == true }
                    finally { dispatching.set(false) }
                }.onFailure {
                    com.system.location.service.hook.utils.Logger.warn("Carrier callback update failed: ${it.javaClass.simpleName}")
                }
            }
        } } }.onFailure {
            com.system.location.service.hook.utils.Logger.warn("Carrier callback scheduling failed: ${it.javaClass.simpleName}")
        }
    }

    fun saveReloadState(): ArrayList<android.os.Bundle> = ArrayList(listeners.entries.map { (binder, entry) ->
        android.os.Bundle().apply {
            putBinder("binder", binder)
            putInt("uid", entry.uid)
            putInt("subscription", entry.subId)
            putBoolean("service_state", entry.serviceState)
            putBoolean("cell_info", entry.cellInfo)
            putBoolean("signal_strength", entry.signalStrength)
            putBoolean("display_info", entry.displayInfo)
            putBoolean("display_sent", entry.displaySent)
            entry.lastDisplay?.let { putParcelable("last_display", it) }
            entry.realDisplay?.let { putParcelable("real_display", it) }
            putBoolean("signal_sent", entry.signalSent)
            entry.lastSignal?.let { putParcelable("last_signal", it) }
            putBoolean("cells_sent", entry.cellsSent)
            putBoolean("virtual_sent", entry.virtualSent)
            entry.lastRealState?.let { putParcelable("real_state", it) }
        }
    })

    fun retire() {
        updates.shutdownNow()
        listeners.keys.toList().forEach(::remove)
    }

    fun restoreReloadState(rows: List<android.os.Bundle>) {
        rows.forEach { row ->
            val binder = row.getBinder("binder") ?: return@forEach
            if (!binder.isBinderAlive) return@forEach
            try {
                val stub = Class.forName("com.android.internal.telephony.IPhoneStateListener\$Stub")
                val listener = stub.getMethod("asInterface", IBinder::class.java).invoke(null, binder) as IInterface
                installCallback(listener)
                val death = IBinder.DeathRecipient { remove(binder) }
                binder.linkToDeath(death, 0)
                listeners[binder] = Entry(row.getInt("uid"), row.getInt("subscription"), death,
                    row.getBoolean("service_state", false), row.getBoolean("cell_info", false),
                    row.getBoolean("signal_strength", false), row.getBoolean("display_info", false)).apply {
                    displaySent = row.getBoolean("display_sent", false)
                    @Suppress("DEPRECATION")
                    lastDisplay = row.getParcelable<android.telephony.TelephonyDisplayInfo>("last_display")
                    @Suppress("DEPRECATION")
                    realDisplay = row.getParcelable<android.telephony.TelephonyDisplayInfo>("real_display")
                    signalSent = row.getBoolean("signal_sent", false)
                    @Suppress("DEPRECATION")
                    lastSignal = row.getParcelable<android.telephony.SignalStrength>("last_signal")
                    cellsSent = row.getBoolean("cells_sent", false)
                    virtualSent = row.getBoolean("virtual_sent", false)
                    @Suppress("DEPRECATION")
                    lastRealState = row.getParcelable<ServiceState>("real_state")
                }
            } catch (failure: Exception) {
                com.system.location.service.hook.utils.Logger.warn("Carrier listener restore failed: ${failure.javaClass.simpleName}")
            }
        }
    }

    private fun remove(binder: IBinder) {
        listeners.remove(binder)?.let { runCatching { binder.unlinkToDeath(it.death, 0) } }
    }
}
```

`xposed/src/main/java/com/system/location/service/hook/hooks/telephony/CarrierServiceStateHook.kt`:

```kt
package com.system.location.service.hook.hooks.telephony

import android.annotation.SuppressLint
import android.telephony.ServiceState
import com.system.location.service.core.carrier.SimCarrierProfile
import com.system.location.service.hook.runtime.Reflection
import com.system.location.service.hook.utils.hookAllMethods
import io.github.libxposed.api.XposedInterface.Hooker

/** Keep the original registration, emergency, roaming and transport state in a caller-local copy. */
object CarrierServiceStateHook {
    fun install(loader: ClassLoader) {
        val type = Reflection.findClassIfExists("com.android.phone.PhoneInterfaceManager", loader) ?: return
        val hook = Hooker { chain ->
            val original = chain.proceed()
            val profile = CarrierIdentityRuntime.profileForCall(chain.executable.name, chain.args)
            val state = original as? ServiceState
            if (state == null) {
                return@Hooker if (profile?.virtual == true) virtualState(profile)
                else original
            }
            when {
                profile != null -> copyWithIdentity(state, profile)
                CarrierIdentityRuntime.protectsLocation(android.os.Binder.getCallingUid()) -> copyWithoutCellIdentity(state)
                else -> original
            }
        }
        listOf("getServiceStateForSubscriber", "getServiceState").forEach { type.hookAllMethods(it, hook) }
    }

    @SuppressLint("MissingPermission")
    fun copyWithoutCellIdentity(original: ServiceState): ServiceState = runCatching {
        ServiceState(original).apply {
            @Suppress("UNCHECKED_CAST")
            val registrations = Reflection.getObjectField(this, "mNetworkRegistrationInfos") as List<Any>
            registrations.forEach { Reflection.setObjectField(it, "mCellIdentity", null) }
        }
    }.getOrElse {
        ServiceState().apply {
            state = original.state
            roaming = original.roaming
            setOperatorName(original.operatorAlphaLong, original.operatorAlphaShort, original.operatorNumeric)
        }
    }

    fun virtualState(profile: SimCarrierProfile): ServiceState = ServiceState().apply {
        val builder = Reflection.newInstance(Class.forName("android.telephony.NetworkRegistrationInfo\$Builder"))
        Reflection.callMethod(builder, "setDomain", 2) // DOMAIN_PS
        Reflection.callMethod(builder, "setTransportType", 1) // TRANSPORT_TYPE_WWAN
        Reflection.callMethod(builder, "setRegistrationState", 1) // REGISTRATION_STATE_HOME
        Reflection.callMethod(builder, "setAccessNetworkTechnology",
            if (profile.radio == com.system.location.service.core.carrier.CarrierRadio.NR)
                android.telephony.TelephonyManager.NETWORK_TYPE_NR
            else android.telephony.TelephonyManager.NETWORK_TYPE_LTE)
        Reflection.callMethod(builder, "setRegisteredPlmn", profile.operatorNumeric)
        Reflection.callMethod(builder, "setEmergencyOnly", false)
        Reflection.callMethod(builder, "setAvailableServices", listOf(2)) // SERVICE_TYPE_DATA
        val registration = Reflection.callMethod(builder, "build")!!
        Reflection.callMethod(this, "addNetworkRegistrationInfo", registration)
        state = ServiceState.STATE_IN_SERVICE
        Reflection.callMethod(this, "setDataRegState", ServiceState.STATE_IN_SERVICE)
        Reflection.callMethod(this, "setEmergencyOnly", false)
        roaming = false
        setOperatorName(profile.operatorName, profile.carrierName, profile.operatorNumeric)
    }

    @SuppressLint("MissingPermission")
    fun copyWithIdentity(original: ServiceState, profile: SimCarrierProfile): ServiceState {
        // Never copy absent/emergency modem registrations into a virtual subscriber. Both the
        // query and callback must use the same modeled PS registration and omit real CellIdentity.
        if (profile.virtual) return virtualState(profile)
        val copy = runCatching {
            ServiceState(original).apply {
                @Suppress("UNCHECKED_CAST")
                val registrations = Reflection.getObjectField(this, "mNetworkRegistrationInfos") as List<Any>
                registrations.forEach { info ->
                    Reflection.setObjectField(info, "mCellIdentity", null)
                    val plmn = Reflection.getObjectField(info, "mRplmn") as? String
                    if (!plmn.isNullOrEmpty()) Reflection.setObjectField(info, "mRplmn", profile.operatorNumeric)
                    val registered = Reflection.callMethod(info, "isRegistered") == true
                    val domain = Reflection.callMethod(info, "getDomain") as? Int
                    val transport = Reflection.callMethod(info, "getTransportType") as? Int
                    if (registered && domain == 2 && transport == 1) {
                        Reflection.callMethod(info, "setAccessNetworkTechnology",
                            if (profile.radio == com.system.location.service.core.carrier.CarrierRadio.NR)
                                android.telephony.TelephonyManager.NETWORK_TYPE_NR
                            else android.telephony.TelephonyManager.NETWORK_TYPE_LTE)
                    }
                }
                listOf("mOperatorAlphaLongRaw" to profile.operatorName,
                    "mOperatorAlphaShortRaw" to profile.carrierName).forEach { (fieldName, value) ->
                    val field = Reflection.findFieldIfExists(javaClass, fieldName)
                    if (!(field?.get(this) as? String).isNullOrEmpty()) field?.set(this, value)
                }
            }
        }.getOrElse {
            // Unknown OEM layout must not make the hook return a real CellIdentity. Keep only
            // the coarse service/roaming state in an otherwise empty platform object.
            ServiceState().apply { state = original.state; roaming = original.roaming }
        }
        copy.setOperatorName(
            if (original.operatorAlphaLong.isNullOrEmpty()) original.operatorAlphaLong else profile.operatorName,
            if (original.operatorAlphaShort.isNullOrEmpty()) original.operatorAlphaShort else profile.carrierName,
            if (original.operatorNumeric.isNullOrEmpty()) original.operatorNumeric else profile.operatorNumeric,
        )
        return copy
    }
}
```

```kt
package com.system.location.service.hook.hooks.telephony

import android.telephony.CellSignalStrengthNr
import com.system.location.service.hook.runtime.Reflection
import com.system.location.service.hook.utils.Logger

/** Some ROMs cache an additional level that their SystemUI reads instead of getLevel(). */
internal object CarrierSignalLevelCompatibility {
    private val setters by lazy {
        listOf("setMiuiLevel", "setOptimizedLevel").mapNotNull { name ->
            Reflection.findMethodExactIfExists(CellSignalStrengthNr::class.java, name, Int::class.javaPrimitiveType!!)
        }
    }

    fun initialize(signal: CellSignalStrengthNr) {
        // Use the already validated platform level. Never invent a full-strength UI value.
        setters.forEach { method ->
            runCatching { method.invoke(signal, signal.level) }.onFailure {
                Logger.warn("NR cached signal level ${method.name} unavailable: ${it.javaClass.simpleName}")
            }
        }
    }
}
```

`xposed/src/main/java/com/system/location/service/hook/hooks/telephony/CarrierSignalStrengthHook.kt`:

```kt
package com.system.location.service.hook.hooks.telephony

import android.os.Binder
import android.telephony.CellInfoNr
import android.telephony.CellSignalStrengthNr
import android.telephony.SignalStrength
import com.system.location.service.hook.runtime.Reflection
import com.system.location.service.hook.utils.hookAllMethods
import io.github.libxposed.api.XposedInterface.Hooker

/** NR SA aggregate signal uses the same serving record as per-subscription CellInfo. */
internal object CarrierSignalStrengthHook {
    fun install(loader: ClassLoader) {
        val manager = Reflection.findClassIfExists("com.android.phone.PhoneInterfaceManager", loader) ?: return
        listOf("getSignalStrength", "getSignalStrengthForSubscriber").forEach { name ->
            manager.hookAllMethods(name, Hooker { chain ->
                val original = chain.proceed() // retain permission checks and platform exceptions
                val subId = chain.args.firstOrNull() as? Int ?: return@Hooker original
                forCaller(Binder.getCallingUid(), subId) ?: original
            })
        }
    }

    internal fun forCaller(uid: Int, subId: Int): SignalStrength? {
        val profile = CarrierIdentityRuntime.profileForCall("getSignalStrength", listOf(subId), uid) ?: return null
        if (!profile.virtual || profile.radio != com.system.location.service.core.carrier.CarrierRadio.NR) return null
        val result = CellInfoSynthesis.resultForCaller(null, uid, subId) as? CellInfoSynthesisResult.Synthetic
            ?: return null
        val serving = result.cells.filterIsInstance<CellInfoNr>().firstOrNull { it.isRegistered } ?: return null
        return aggregate(serving.cellSignalStrength as CellSignalStrengthNr)
    }

    internal fun aggregate(serving: CellSignalStrengthNr): SignalStrength =
        (Reflection.newInstance(SignalStrength::class.java) as SignalStrength).apply {
        // Default platform object initializes other RATs to unavailable. Keep them that way for SA,
        // rather than carrying absent-modem GSM/LTE state into the virtual NR subscriber.
        val copy = Reflection.newInstance(CellSignalStrengthNr::class.java, serving) as CellSignalStrengthNr
        Reflection.setObjectField(this, "mNr", copy)
    }
}
```

`xposed/src/main/java/com/system/location/service/hook/hooks/telephony/CarrierStatusBarHook.kt`:

```kt
package com.system.location.service.hook.hooks.telephony

import android.os.Handler
import android.os.Looper
import com.system.location.service.core.carrier.SimCarrierProfile
import com.system.location.service.hook.runtime.Reflection
import com.system.location.service.hook.scope.HookInstaller
import com.system.location.service.hook.utils.Logger
import com.system.location.service.hook.utils.onceHookMethod
import io.github.libxposed.api.XposedInterface.Hooker
import java.util.Collections
import java.util.WeakHashMap
import java.util.concurrent.atomic.AtomicBoolean

/** MIUI carrier text adapter. Uses the ROM's renderer and listener notifications on its UI thread. */
internal object CarrierStatusBarHook {
    private const val TYPE = "com.android.systemui.statusbar.policy.MiuiCarrierTextControllerImpl"
    private val fields = listOf("mCarrier", "mCustomCarrier", "mCardDisable", "mSimError")
    private val controllers = Collections.synchronizedMap(WeakHashMap<Any, Handler>())
    private val installed = Collections.synchronizedSet(mutableSetOf<Class<*>>())
    private val workerStarted = AtomicBoolean()
    @Volatile private var profiles: List<SimCarrierProfile> = emptyList()

    fun install(loader: ClassLoader) {
        val type = Reflection.findClassIfExists(TYPE, loader) ?: return
        if (fields.any { Reflection.findFieldIfExists(type, it) == null }) return
        synchronized(installed) {
            if (type in installed) return
            type.onceHookMethod("updateCarrierText", callback = Hooker { chain ->
                val target = chain.thisObject ?: return@Hooker chain.proceed()
                withVirtualCarriers(target, profiles) { chain.proceed() }
            }) ?: return
            HookInstaller.hookAllConstructors(type, Hooker { chain ->
                val result = chain.proceed()
                chain.thisObject?.let { target ->
                    val handler = runCatching { Reflection.getObjectField(target, "mMainHandler") as? Handler }
                        .getOrNull() ?: Handler(Looper.getMainLooper())
                    controllers[target] = handler
                }
                result
            })
            installed.add(type)
        }
        startWorker()
    }

    private fun startWorker() {
        if (!workerStarted.compareAndSet(false, true)) return
        Thread({
            while (!Thread.currentThread().isInterrupted) {
                try {
                    if (controllers.isNotEmpty()) {
                        // A read-only caller-scoped snapshot returns no profiles for SystemUI in
                        // PER_APP or while stopped. Binder work stays off the UI thread.
                        val next = CarrierClientHook.statusBarProfiles()
                        if (next != profiles) {
                            profiles = next
                            val targets = synchronized(controllers) { controllers.entries.map { it.key to it.value } }
                            targets.forEach { (target, handler) ->
                                val reference = java.lang.ref.WeakReference(target)
                                handler.post {
                                    reference.get()?.let { instance ->
                                        runCatching { Reflection.callMethod(instance, "updateCarrierText") }
                                            .onFailure { Logger.warn("Carrier text refresh failed: ${it.javaClass.simpleName}") }
                                    }
                                }
                            }
                        }
                    }
                    Thread.sleep(1500)
                } catch (_: InterruptedException) {
                    Thread.currentThread().interrupt()
                } catch (failure: Exception) {
                    Logger.warn("Carrier text snapshot failed: ${failure.javaClass.simpleName}")
                }
            }
        }, "PortalCarrierText").apply { isDaemon = true }.start()
    }

    /** Replace array references only for this render; the ROM retains every original cache value. */
    internal fun withVirtualCarriers(target: Any, visible: List<SimCarrierProfile>, render: () -> Any?): Any? {
        val virtuals = visible.filter { it.virtual && it.enabled }
        if (virtuals.isEmpty()) return render()
        val carrierField = Reflection.findFieldIfExists(target.javaClass, "mCarrier") ?: return render()
        val customField = Reflection.findFieldIfExists(target.javaClass, "mCustomCarrier") ?: return render()
        val disabledField = Reflection.findFieldIfExists(target.javaClass, "mCardDisable") ?: return render()
        val errorsField = Reflection.findFieldIfExists(target.javaClass, "mSimError") ?: return render()
        val originalCarrier = carrierField.get(target) as? Array<*> ?: return render()
        val originalCustom = customField.get(target)
        val originalDisabled = disabledField.get(target) as? BooleanArray ?: return render()
        val originalErrors = errorsField.get(target) as? BooleanArray ?: return render()
        val emergencyField = Reflection.findFieldIfExists(target.javaClass, "mEmergencyOnly")
        val originalEmergency = emergencyField?.get(target) as? Boolean
        val carrier = originalCarrier.copyOf()
        @Suppress("UNCHECKED_CAST")
        val custom = (originalCustom as? Array<*>)?.copyOf() ?: arrayOfNulls<String>(carrier.size)
        val disabled = originalDisabled.copyOf()
        val errors = originalErrors.copyOf()
        @Suppress("UNCHECKED_CAST")
        virtuals.forEach { profile ->
            val index = profile.slot - 1
            if (index in carrier.indices && index in custom.indices && index in disabled.indices && index in errors.indices) {
                (carrier as Array<Any?>)[index] = profile.carrierName
                (custom as Array<Any?>)[index] = null
                disabled[index] = false
                errors[index] = false
            }
        }
        try {
            carrierField.set(target, carrier)
            customField.set(target, custom)
            disabledField.set(target, disabled)
            errorsField.set(target, errors)
            if (originalEmergency != null) emergencyField?.setBoolean(target, false)
            return render()
        } finally {
            carrierField.set(target, originalCarrier)
            customField.set(target, originalCustom)
            disabledField.set(target, originalDisabled)
            errorsField.set(target, originalErrors)
            if (originalEmergency != null) emergencyField?.setBoolean(target, originalEmergency)
        }
    }
}
```

`xposed/src/main/java/com/system/location/service/hook/hooks/telephony/CarrierSubscriptionCaches.kt`:

```kt
package com.system.location.service.hook.hooks.telephony

import android.os.Binder
import android.os.Process
import android.telephony.SubscriptionManager
import com.system.location.service.core.runtime.RuntimeSnapshot
import com.system.location.service.hook.utils.Logger

/** Invalidate framework client mapping caches after the owning process accepts a new topology. */
internal object CarrierSubscriptionCaches {
    fun onChanged(previous: RuntimeSnapshot, current: RuntimeSnapshot) {
        val before = previous.configuration
        val after = current.configuration
        if (before.enabled == after.enabled && before.carrierIdentityEnabled == after.carrierIdentityEnabled &&
            before.carrierIdentity == after.carrierIdentity) return
        // Only OS processes can publish these property-invalidated cache generations. In particular,
        // run in the phone peer after its asynchronous transfer, not just before dispatching it.
        val uid = runCatching { Process.myUid() }.getOrDefault(-1)
        if (uid != 1000 && uid != 1001) return
        if (uid == 1001) CarrierGlobalProperties.refresh()
        if (com.system.location.service.hook.utils.FakeLoc.isSystemServerProcess) {
            CarrierRegistryHook.onConfigurationChanged()
        }
        runCatching {
            val token = Binder.clearCallingIdentity()
            try {
                SubscriptionManager::class.java.declaredMethods.filter {
                    it.name.startsWith("invalidate") && it.name.contains("Cache") &&
                        it.parameterCount == 0 && java.lang.reflect.Modifier.isStatic(it.modifiers)
                }.forEach { method -> method.isAccessible = true; method.invoke(null) }
            } finally { Binder.restoreCallingIdentity(token) }
        }.onFailure { Logger.warn("Subscription cache invalidation unavailable: ${it.javaClass.simpleName}") }
        if (uid == 1001) CarrierSubscriptionNotifications.schedule()
    }
}
```

`xposed/src/main/java/com/system/location/service/hook/hooks/telephony/CarrierSubscriptionHook.kt`:

```kt
package com.system.location.service.hook.hooks.telephony

import android.os.Binder
import android.os.Parcel
import android.telephony.SubscriptionInfo
import android.telephony.SubscriptionManager
import com.system.location.service.core.carrier.CarrierVirtualIdentity
import com.system.location.service.core.carrier.SimCarrierProfile
import com.system.location.service.hook.runtime.Reflection
import com.system.location.service.hook.utils.Logger
import com.system.location.service.hook.utils.hookAllMethods
import io.github.libxposed.api.XposedInterface.Hooker

/** Preserves real IDs while adding a bounded virtual subscription only when the caller may see it. */
internal object CarrierSubscriptionHook {
    private val countingPhysical = ThreadLocal.withInitial { false }
    private val countMethods = setOf("getActiveSubscriptionInfoCount", "getActiveSubInfoCount")
    private val recentVirtual = LinkedHashMap<Pair<Int, Int>, Long>()
    private fun remember(virtuals: List<SimCarrierProfile>, uid: Int) = synchronized(recentVirtual) {
        val now = android.os.SystemClock.elapsedRealtime()
        recentVirtual.entries.removeAll { it.value < now }
        virtuals.forEach { recentVirtual[CarrierVirtualIdentity.subscriptionId(it) to (uid / 100000)] = now + 30_000 }
        while (recentVirtual.size > 128) recentVirtual.remove(recentVirtual.keys.first())
    }
    private fun knownVirtual(subId: Int): Boolean {
        val uid = Binder.getCallingUid()
        val active = CarrierIdentityRuntime.profileForCall("getActiveSubscriptionInfo", listOf(subId))
        if (active?.virtual == true) return true
        return synchronized(recentVirtual) {
            (recentVirtual[subId to (uid / 100000)] ?: 0L) > android.os.SystemClock.elapsedRealtime()
        }
    }
    fun install(loader: ClassLoader) {
        listOf("com.android.internal.telephony.SubscriptionController",
            "com.android.internal.telephony.subscription.SubscriptionManagerService").forEach { name ->
            val type = Reflection.findClassIfExists(name, loader) ?: return@forEach
            type.hookAllMethods("getSubscriptionUserHandle", Hooker { chain ->
                try { chain.proceed() } catch (failure: IllegalArgumentException) {
                    val subId = chain.args.firstOrNull() as? Int ?: throw failure
                    if (failure.message != "getSubscriptionUserHandle: Invalid subId: $subId" ||
                        !CarrierIdentifierAccess.permitted()) throw failure
                    if (!knownVirtual(subId)) throw failure
                    android.os.UserHandle.getUserHandleForUid(Binder.getCallingUid())
                }
            })
            type.hookAllMethods("setDisplayNumber", Hooker { chain ->
                try { chain.proceed() } catch (failure: IllegalArgumentException) {
                    val subId = chain.args.filterIsInstance<Int>().firstOrNull() ?: throw failure
                    if (failure.message != "Subscription doesn't exist. subId=$subId, columnName=number" ||
                        !CarrierIdentifierAccess.permitted() || !knownVirtual(subId)) throw failure
                    0 // No physical subscription record was updated.
                }
            })
            val hook = Hooker { chain ->
                if (CarrierHardwareSubscriptionHook.hardwareQueryActive()) return@Hooker chain.proceed()
                if (CarrierIdentityRuntime.isResolving() || countingPhysical.get() == true) return@Hooker chain.proceed()
                if (Binder.getCallingUid() in setOf(1000, 1001) &&
                    chain.args.any { it == CarrierIdentityRuntime.PHYSICAL_QUERY_TAG }) return@Hooker chain.proceed()
                val original = if (chain.executable.name in countMethods) {
                    countingPhysical.set(true)
                    try { chain.proceed() } finally { countingPhysical.set(false) }
                } else chain.proceed()
                if (chain.executable.name == "getAccessibleSubscriptionInfoList") return@Hooker original
                val virtuals = CarrierIdentityRuntime.virtualProfilesForCall(Binder.getCallingUid())
                remember(virtuals, Binder.getCallingUid())
                val requested = chain.args.firstOrNull() as? Int
                val topology = com.system.location.service.core.carrier.CarrierVirtualTopology
                when (chain.executable.name) {
                    "getPhoneId", "getSlotIndex" -> requested?.let {
                        topology.slotForSubscription(virtuals, it)?.minus(1)
                    } ?: original
                    "getSubId", "getSubIds", "getSubscriptionId" -> {
                        val id = requested?.let { topology.subscriptionForPhone(virtuals, it) }
                        if (id == null) original else when ((chain.executable as java.lang.reflect.Method).returnType) {
                            IntArray::class.java -> intArrayOf(id)
                            Int::class.javaPrimitiveType -> id
                            else -> original
                        }
                    }
                    "isActiveSubId", "isActiveSubscriptionId" ->
                        if (requested != null && topology.slotForSubscription(virtuals, requested) != null)
                            true else original
                    "getActiveSubIdList" -> if (original is IntArray)
                        topology.activeIds(original, virtuals) else original
                    "getActiveSubscriptionInfoList",
                    "getAvailableSubscriptionInfoList", "getSelectableSubscriptionInfoList" ->
                        if (original is List<*>) mergeList(original, virtuals) else original
                    "getActiveSubscriptionInfo" -> {
                        val id = chain.args.firstOrNull() as? Int
                        virtualForSubId(virtuals, id) ?: overlay(original)
                    }
                    "getActiveSubscriptionInfoForIccId" -> {
                        val iccId = chain.args.firstOrNull() as? String
                        virtuals.firstOrNull { CarrierVirtualIdentity.iccid(it) == iccId }
                            ?.let(CarrierVirtualSubscription::info) ?: overlay(original)
                    }
                    "getActiveSubscriptionInfoForSimSlotIndex" -> {
                        val slot = (chain.args.firstOrNull() as? Int)?.plus(1)
                        virtuals.firstOrNull { it.slot == slot }
                            ?.let(CarrierVirtualSubscription::info) ?: overlay(original)
                    }
                    "getActiveSubscriptionInfoCount", "getActiveSubInfoCount" -> {
                        val physical = (original as? Int) ?: 0
                        physical + virtuals.size
                    }
                    "getActiveSubscriptionInfoCountMax" ->
                        maxOf((original as? Int) ?: 0, virtuals.maxOfOrNull { it.slot } ?: 0)
                    "getDefaultSubId", "getDefaultDataSubId", "getDefaultVoiceSubId",
                    "getDefaultSmsSubId" -> {
                        val current = (original as? Int) ?: SubscriptionManager.INVALID_SUBSCRIPTION_ID
                        if (SubscriptionManager.isValidSubscriptionId(current)) current
                        else virtuals.firstOrNull()?.let { CarrierVirtualIdentity.subscriptionId(it) }
                            ?: current
                    }
                    else -> overlay(original)
                }
            }
            listOf("getPhoneId", "getSlotIndex", "getSubId", "getSubIds", "getSubscriptionId",
                "isActiveSubId", "isActiveSubscriptionId", "getActiveSubIdList",
                "getActiveSubscriptionInfo", "getActiveSubscriptionInfoForIccId",
                "getActiveSubscriptionInfoForSimSlotIndex", "getActiveSubscriptionInfoList",
                "getAccessibleSubscriptionInfoList", "getAvailableSubscriptionInfoList",
                "getSelectableSubscriptionInfoList", "getActiveSubscriptionInfoCount", "getActiveSubInfoCount",
                "getActiveSubscriptionInfoCountMax", "getDefaultSubId", "getDefaultDataSubId",
                "getDefaultVoiceSubId", "getDefaultSmsSubId")
                .forEach { method -> type.hookAllMethods(method, hook) }
        }
    }

    private fun mergeList(original: Any?, virtuals: List<SimCarrierProfile>): List<SubscriptionInfo> {
        val physical = (original as? List<*>).orEmpty().mapNotNull { it as? SubscriptionInfo }
            .map(::overlay)
        val physicalSlots = physical.map { it.simSlotIndex + 1 }.toSet()
        val extra = virtuals.filter { it.slot !in physicalSlots }.mapNotNull(CarrierVirtualSubscription::info)
        return physical + extra
    }

    private fun virtualForSubId(
        virtuals: List<SimCarrierProfile>,
        subId: Int?,
    ): SubscriptionInfo? {
        val slot = subId?.let { CarrierVirtualIdentity.slotForSubscriptionId(it, virtuals) } ?: return null
        return virtuals.firstOrNull { it.slot == slot }?.let(CarrierVirtualSubscription::info)
    }

    private fun overlay(original: Any?): Any? = when (original) {
        is SubscriptionInfo -> overlay(original)
        is List<*> -> original.map { item -> if (item is SubscriptionInfo) overlay(item) else item }
        else -> original
    }

    private fun overlay(info: SubscriptionInfo): SubscriptionInfo {
        val profile = CarrierIdentityRuntime.profileForCall("getActiveSubscriptionInfo",
            listOf(info.subscriptionId)) ?: return info
        return runCatching { copyWithIdentity(info, profile) }.getOrElse {
            Logger.warn("Subscription identity overlay unavailable: ${it.javaClass.simpleName}")
            info
        }
    }

    internal fun copyWithIdentity(info: SubscriptionInfo, profile: SimCarrierProfile): SubscriptionInfo {
        val parcel = Parcel.obtain()
        val copy = try {
            info.writeToParcel(parcel, 0)
            parcel.setDataPosition(0)
            SubscriptionInfo.CREATOR.createFromParcel(parcel)
        } finally { parcel.recycle() }
        Reflection.setObjectField(copy, "mCarrierName", profile.carrierName)
        Reflection.setObjectField(copy, "mDisplayName", profile.operatorName)
        Reflection.setObjectField(copy, "mCountryIso", profile.countryIso.lowercase(java.util.Locale.ROOT))
        Reflection.setObjectField(copy, "mMcc", profile.mcc.toString().padStart(3, '0'))
        Reflection.setObjectField(copy, "mMnc", profile.mnc.toString().padStart(profile.mncDigits, '0'))
        if (profile.phoneNumber.isNotEmpty()) Reflection.setObjectField(copy, "mNumber",
            if (CarrierPhoneNumberAccess.permitted()) profile.phoneNumber else "")
        return copy
    }
}
```

`xposed/src/main/java/com/system/location/service/hook/hooks/telephony/CarrierSubscriptionNotifications.kt`:

```kt
package com.system.location.service.hook.hooks.telephony

import android.os.Binder
import android.os.Handler
import android.os.IBinder
import android.os.Looper
import com.system.location.service.hook.utils.Logger
import java.util.concurrent.atomic.AtomicLong

/** Notify the framework's real subscription listeners after the phone peer accepts a new view. */
internal object CarrierSubscriptionNotifications {
    private val revision = AtomicLong()

    fun schedule() {
        val request = revision.incrementAndGet()
        val generation = com.system.location.service.hook.runtime.GenerationDelivery(
            com.system.location.service.hook.runtime.HookRuntime.executionGate)
        Handler(Looper.getMainLooper()).postDelayed({
            if (revision.get() != request) return@postDelayed
            generation.run {
                val token = Binder.clearCallingIdentity()
                try {
                    val manager = Class.forName("android.os.ServiceManager")
                    val binder = manager.getMethod("getService", String::class.java)
                        .invoke(null, "telephony.registry") as? IBinder ?: return@run
                    val stub = Class.forName("com.android.internal.telephony.ITelephonyRegistry\$Stub")
                    val registry = stub.getMethod("asInterface", IBinder::class.java).invoke(null, binder)
                    registry.javaClass.getMethod("notifySubscriptionInfoChanged").invoke(registry)
                } catch (failure: Exception) {
                    Logger.warn("Subscription listener notification unavailable: ${failure.javaClass.simpleName}")
                } finally { Binder.restoreCallingIdentity(token) }
            }
        }, 250)
    }
}
```

`xposed/src/main/java/com/system/location/service/hook/hooks/telephony/CarrierVirtualSubscription.kt`:

```kt
package com.system.location.service.hook.hooks.telephony

import android.telephony.SubscriptionInfo
import com.system.location.service.core.carrier.CarrierVirtualIdentity
import com.system.location.service.core.carrier.SimCarrierProfile
import com.system.location.service.hook.runtime.Reflection
import com.system.location.service.hook.utils.Logger
import java.util.Locale

/** Constructs a complete platform object, including platform defaults and derived fields. */
internal object CarrierVirtualSubscription {
    fun info(profile: SimCarrierProfile): SubscriptionInfo? = create(profile, CarrierIdentifierAccess.permitted()).onFailure {
        Logger.warn("Virtual SubscriptionInfo construction failed: ${it.javaClass.simpleName}")
    }.getOrNull()

    internal fun create(profile: SimCarrierProfile, includeIdentifiers: Boolean): Result<SubscriptionInfo> = runCatching {
        val builderClass = Class.forName("android.telephony.SubscriptionInfo\$Builder")
        val builder = Reflection.newInstance(builderClass)
        fun set(name: String, value: Any) { Reflection.callMethod(builder, name, value) }
        set("setId", CarrierVirtualIdentity.subscriptionId(profile))
        set("setIccId", if (includeIdentifiers) CarrierVirtualIdentity.iccid(profile) else "")
        set("setSimSlotIndex", profile.slot - 1)
        set("setDisplayName", profile.operatorName)
        set("setCarrierName", profile.carrierName)
        set("setMcc", profile.mcc.toString().padStart(3, '0'))
        set("setMnc", profile.mnc.toString().padStart(profile.mncDigits, '0'))
        set("setCountryIso", profile.countryIso.lowercase(Locale.ROOT))
        set("setCarrierId", CarrierVirtualIdentity.carrierId(profile))
        set("setNumber", if (CarrierPhoneNumberAccess.permitted()) profile.phoneNumber else "")
        // A virtual logical UICC port within its physical slot. Other fields deliberately keep
        // the framework Builder defaults, rather than Unsafe's null/zero uninitialized fields.
        set("setPortIndex", 0)
        val info = Reflection.callMethod(builder, "build") as SubscriptionInfo
        check(info.subscriptionId == CarrierVirtualIdentity.subscriptionId(profile))
        check(info.simSlotIndex == profile.slot - 1)
        check(info.mccString == profile.mcc.toString().padStart(3, '0'))
        check(info.mncString == profile.mnc.toString().padStart(profile.mncDigits, '0'))
        info
    }
}
```

`xposed/src/main/java/com/system/location/service/hook/hooks/telephony/CdmaIdentitySynthesis.kt`:

```kt
package com.system.location.service.hook.hooks.telephony

import com.system.location.service.hook.utils.FakeLoc

/** Deterministic CDMA sector identity shared by the telephony and MIUI compatibility paths. */
internal data class CdmaIdentity(
    val cid: Int,
    val lac: Int,
    val psc: Int,
    val baseStationId: Int,
    val systemId: Int,
    val networkId: Int,
    val latitudeQuarterMinutes: Int,
    val longitudeQuarterMinutes: Int,
)

/**
 * A real sector is a nearby tower, not a tower exactly at the device's coordinates. The old
 * `Int.MAX_VALUE` sentinel in every field was a more obvious synthetic marker than a missing cell.
 */
internal fun currentCdmaIdentity(): CdmaIdentity {
    val random = kotlin.random.Random(FakeLoc.environmentSeed.toInt() xor 0x43444D41)
    val latitudeOffset = random.nextInt(-40, 41) / 14_400.0
    val longitudeOffset = random.nextInt(-40, 41) / 14_400.0
    return CdmaIdentity(
        cid = random.nextInt(0, 65_536),
        lac = random.nextInt(0, 65_536),
        psc = random.nextInt(0, 512),
        baseStationId = random.nextInt(0, 65_536),
        systemId = random.nextInt(0, 32_768),
        networkId = random.nextInt(0, 65_536),
        latitudeQuarterMinutes = ((FakeLoc.latitude + latitudeOffset) * 14_400.0).toInt(),
        longitudeQuarterMinutes = ((FakeLoc.longitude + longitudeOffset) * 14_400.0).toInt(),
    )
}
```
