`xposed/src/main/java/com/system/location/service/hook/hooks/telephony/CellInfoAsyncCallbackHook.kt`:

```kt
package com.system.location.service.hook.hooks.telephony

import android.telephony.TelephonyManager
import android.telephony.PhoneStateListener
import android.telephony.TelephonyCallback
import com.system.location.service.hook.runtime.Reflection
import com.system.location.service.hook.scope.HookInstaller
import com.system.location.service.hook.utils.FakeLoc
import com.system.location.service.hook.utils.Logger
import com.system.location.service.hook.utils.onceHook
import io.github.libxposed.api.XposedInterface.Hooker
import java.util.concurrent.ConcurrentHashMap

/** Replaces requestCellInfoUpdate results in the requesting app process. */
object CellInfoAsyncCallbackHook {
    private val reportedUnavailable = ConcurrentHashMap.newKeySet<String>()

    fun install(classLoader: ClassLoader, packageName: String, uid: Int) {
        val telephonyManager = Reflection.findClassIfExists("android.telephony.TelephonyManager", classLoader)
            ?: return
        HookInstaller.hookAllMethods(telephonyManager, "requestCellInfoUpdate", Hooker { chain ->
            val callbackIndex = chain.executable.parameterTypes.indexOfFirst {
                TelephonyManager.CellInfoCallback::class.java.isAssignableFrom(it)
            }
            val callback = chain.args.getOrNull(callbackIndex) as? TelephonyManager.CellInfoCallback
                ?: return@Hooker chain.proceed()
            hookCallback(callback, packageName, uid)
            chain.proceed()
        })
        HookInstaller.hookAllMethods(telephonyManager, "listen", Hooker { chain ->
            val listenerIndex = chain.executable.parameterTypes.indexOfFirst {
                PhoneStateListener::class.java.isAssignableFrom(it)
            }
            val listener = chain.args.getOrNull(listenerIndex) as? PhoneStateListener
                ?: return@Hooker chain.proceed()
            hookListCallback(listener, "onCellInfoChanged", packageName, uid) {
                reportUnavailable(packageName, "listen")
                null
            }
            chain.proceed()
        })
        HookInstaller.hookAllMethods(telephonyManager, "registerTelephonyCallback", Hooker { chain ->
            val callbackIndex = chain.executable.parameterTypes.indexOfFirst {
                TelephonyCallback::class.java.isAssignableFrom(it)
            }
            val callback = chain.args.getOrNull(callbackIndex) as? TelephonyCallback
                ?: return@Hooker chain.proceed()
            hookListCallback(callback, "onCellInfoChanged", packageName, uid) {
                reportUnavailable(packageName, "registerTelephonyCallback")
                null
            }
            chain.proceed()
        })
    }

    private fun hookCallback(callback: TelephonyManager.CellInfoCallback, packageName: String, uid: Int) {
        hookListCallback(callback, "onCellInfo", packageName, uid) { target ->
            reportUnavailable(packageName, "requestCellInfoUpdate")
            runCatching {
                Reflection.callMethod(
                    target,
                    "onError",
                    TelephonyManager.CellInfoCallback.ERROR_MODEM_ERROR,
                    UnsupportedOperationException("Synthetic cell information is unavailable"),
                )
            }
            null
        }
    }

    private fun hookListCallback(
        callback: Any,
        methodName: String,
        packageName: String,
        uid: Int,
        unavailable: (Any) -> Any?,
    ) {
        val method = Reflection.findMethodExactIfExists(callback.javaClass, methodName, List::class.java)
            ?: return
        method.onceHook(Hooker { chain ->
            if (!FakeLoc.enable) return@Hooker chain.proceed()
            when (val result = CellInfoSynthesis.resultForCaller(packageName, uid)) {
                CellInfoSynthesisResult.PassThrough -> chain.proceed()
                CellInfoSynthesisResult.Unavailable -> unavailable(chain.thisObject)
                is CellInfoSynthesisResult.Synthetic -> dispatchCellInfoCallback(
                    protectedCall = true,
                    synthetic = result.cells,
                    passThrough = { chain.proceed() },
                    deliver = { cells ->
                        val args = chain.args.toTypedArray()
                        args[0] = cells
                        chain.proceed(args)
                    },
                    unavailable = { unavailable(chain.thisObject) },
                )
            }
        })
    }

    private fun reportUnavailable(packageName: String, entryPoint: String) {
        if (reportedUnavailable.add("$packageName:$entryPoint")) {
            Logger.warn("$entryPoint: cell simulation unavailable for $packageName; real cell update suppressed")
        }
    }
}

internal sealed interface CellInfoCallbackDecision<out T> {
    data object PassThrough : CellInfoCallbackDecision<Nothing>
    data class Deliver<T>(val cells: List<T>) : CellInfoCallbackDecision<T>
    data object Unsupported : CellInfoCallbackDecision<Nothing>
}

internal fun <T> cellInfoCallbackDecision(
    protectedCall: Boolean,
    synthetic: List<T>,
): CellInfoCallbackDecision<T> = when {
    !protectedCall -> CellInfoCallbackDecision.PassThrough
    synthetic.isEmpty() -> CellInfoCallbackDecision.Unsupported
    else -> CellInfoCallbackDecision.Deliver(synthetic)
}

internal fun <T, R> dispatchCellInfoCallback(
    protectedCall: Boolean,
    synthetic: List<T>,
    passThrough: () -> R,
    deliver: (List<T>) -> R,
    unavailable: () -> R,
): R = when (val decision = cellInfoCallbackDecision(protectedCall, synthetic)) {
    CellInfoCallbackDecision.PassThrough -> passThrough()
    is CellInfoCallbackDecision.Deliver -> deliver(decision.cells)
    CellInfoCallbackDecision.Unsupported -> unavailable()
}

```

`xposed/src/main/java/com/system/location/service/hook/hooks/telephony/CellInfoSynthesis.kt`:

```kt
package com.system.location.service.hook.hooks.telephony

import android.telephony.CellIdentityLte
import android.telephony.CellIdentityNr
import android.telephony.CellIdentityCdma
import android.telephony.CellIdentityGsm
import android.telephony.CellIdentityWcdma
import android.telephony.CellInfo
import android.telephony.CellInfoCdma
import android.telephony.CellInfoGsm
import android.telephony.CellInfoLte
import android.telephony.CellInfoNr
import android.telephony.CellInfoWcdma
import android.telephony.CellSignalStrengthCdma
import android.telephony.CellSignalStrengthGsm
import android.telephony.CellSignalStrengthLte
import android.telephony.CellSignalStrengthNr
import android.telephony.CellSignalStrengthWcdma
import android.os.SystemClock
import com.system.location.service.hook.runtime.Reflection
import com.system.location.service.core.environment.CellMode
import com.system.location.service.core.environment.CellType
import com.system.location.service.core.environment.CdmaTower
import com.system.location.service.core.environment.EnvironmentProfile
import com.system.location.service.core.environment.EnvironmentReplayPolicy
import com.system.location.service.core.environment.EnvironmentSourceMode
import com.system.location.service.core.geo.Wgs84
import com.system.location.service.core.routing.RoutingDecision
import com.system.location.service.core.runtime.RuntimeSnapshot
import com.system.location.service.hook.utils.BinderUtils
import com.system.location.service.hook.utils.FakeLoc
import com.system.location.service.hook.utils.Logger
import io.github.libxposed.api.XposedInterface.Hooker
import java.util.concurrent.ConcurrentHashMap

/** Replaces protected getAllCellInfo results with modeled records when construction succeeds. */
object CellInfoSynthesis {
    private val reportedUnavailable = ConcurrentHashMap.newKeySet<String>()

    internal fun resultForCaller(packageName: String?, uid: Int, subscriptionId: Int? = null): CellInfoSynthesisResult {
        val state = FakeLoc.runtimeSnapshots.current()
        if (!state.configuration.enabled) return CellInfoSynthesisResult.PassThrough
        val identity = if (state.configuration.carrierIdentityEnabled) {
            CarrierIdentityRuntime.profileForCall("getAllCellInfo", listOfNotNull(subscriptionId), uid)
        } else null
        val virtuals = if (subscriptionId == null && state.configuration.carrierIdentityEnabled)
            CarrierIdentityRuntime.virtualProfilesForCall(uid) else emptyList()
        val hasVirtual = identity?.virtual == true || virtuals.isNotEmpty()
        val route = com.system.location.service.hook.hooks.ListenerRouting.decisionFor(packageName, uid, state.routing)
        if (route == RoutingDecision.Deny) return CellInfoSynthesisResult.PassThrough
        if (state.cellMode == CellMode.NO_SIM_WIFI_ONLY && !hasVirtual) {
            return CellInfoSynthesisResult.Unavailable
        }
        val point = pointForRoute(route, state) ?: return CellInfoSynthesisResult.Unavailable
        val replay = capturedProfile(state, point)
        val hasCapturedCells = !replay?.cells.isNullOrEmpty() || !replay?.cdmaCells.isNullOrEmpty()
        if (!state.simReady && !hasCapturedCells && !hasVirtual) {
            return CellInfoSynthesisResult.Unavailable
        }
        val cells = runCatching {
            if (virtuals.isNotEmpty()) {
                val profiles = (listOfNotNull(identity?.takeUnless { it.virtual }) + virtuals).distinctBy { it.slot }
                val perSlot = profiles.map { build(state.environmentSourceMode, replay, it, point, state.environmentSeed) }
                if (perSlot.any { it.isEmpty() }) emptyList() else perSlot.flatten()
            } else build(state.environmentSourceMode, replay, identity, point, state.environmentSeed)
        }.getOrDefault(emptyList())
        return cells.takeIf { it.isNotEmpty() }
            ?.let(CellInfoSynthesisResult::Synthetic)
            ?: CellInfoSynthesisResult.Unavailable
    }

    fun hook(cPhoneInterfaceManager: Class<*>) {
        val method = cPhoneInterfaceManager.declaredMethods.find { it.name == "getAllCellInfo" } ?: return
        val hook = Hooker { chain ->
            val state = FakeLoc.runtimeSnapshots.current()
            // Run the framework path first to preserve its permission and exception semantics.
            val original = chain.proceed()
            val identity = if (state.configuration.carrierIdentityEnabled) {
                CarrierIdentityRuntime.profileForCall(chain.executable.name, chain.args)
            } else null
            if (!state.configuration.enabled) return@Hooker original
            val uid = BinderUtils.getCallerUid()
            if (identity == null && CarrierIdentityRuntime.virtualProfilesForCall(uid).isEmpty() &&
                BinderUtils.isSystemAppsCall()) return@Hooker original
            if (original !is List<*>) return@Hooker original
            when (val result = resultForCaller(chain.args.firstOrNull() as? String, uid)) {
                CellInfoSynthesisResult.PassThrough -> original
                CellInfoSynthesisResult.Unavailable -> unavailable(original, "target_cell_profile_unavailable")
                is CellInfoSynthesisResult.Synthetic ->
                    selectCellInfoResult(protectedCall = true, frameworkResult = original, synthetic = result.cells)
            }
        }
        com.system.location.service.hook.scope.HookInstaller.hookMethod(method, hook)
    }

    private fun unavailable(original: Any?, reason: String): Any? {
        if (reportedUnavailable.add(reason)) {
            Logger.warn("getAllCellInfo: simulation unavailable ($reason); framework result suppressed")
        }
        return selectCellInfoResult<CellInfo>(protectedCall = true, frameworkResult = original, synthetic = emptyList())
    }

    internal fun profileForRoute(state: RuntimeSnapshot, route: RoutingDecision): EnvironmentProfile? {
        val point = pointForRoute(route, state) ?: return null
        return capturedProfile(state, point)
    }

    private fun capturedProfile(state: RuntimeSnapshot, point: Wgs84) =
        if (state.environmentSourceMode == com.system.location.service.core.environment.EnvironmentSourceMode.PROCEDURAL) {
            null
        } else {
            state.environment?.takeIf { EnvironmentReplayPolicy.isApplicable(it, point) }
        }

    internal fun pointForCaller(uid: Int, state: RuntimeSnapshot): Wgs84? = pointForRoute(
        com.system.location.service.hook.hooks.ListenerRouting.decisionFor(null, uid, state.routing), state)

    private fun pointForRoute(route: RoutingDecision, state: RuntimeSnapshot): Wgs84? = when (route) {
        RoutingDecision.Deny -> null
        is RoutingDecision.Point -> route.point
        is RoutingDecision.Scenario -> FakeLoc.scenarioSamples
            .latest(route.scenarioId, SystemClock.elapsedRealtimeNanos())?.sample
            ?.let { Wgs84(it.latitude, it.longitude) }
            ?: Wgs84(state.latitude, state.longitude)
        RoutingDecision.Global -> Wgs84(state.latitude, state.longitude)
    }

    private fun build(
        sourceMode: EnvironmentSourceMode,
        replay: com.system.location.service.core.environment.EnvironmentProfile?,
        identity: com.system.location.service.core.carrier.SimCarrierProfile? = null,
        point: Wgs84? = null,
        seed: Long = 0L,
    ): List<CellInfo> {
        val records = selectExplicitCellRecords(sourceMode, replay)
            ?: if (identity?.radio == com.system.location.service.core.carrier.CarrierRadio.NR && point != null)
                ExplicitCellRecords(emptyList(), emptyList()) else return emptyList()
        val towers = identity?.let {
            val matching = com.system.location.service.core.carrier.CarrierCellIdentity.overlay(records.cells, it)
            if (matching.isEmpty() && it.radio == com.system.location.service.core.carrier.CarrierRadio.NR && point != null)
                com.system.location.service.core.carrier.CarrierNrCellSource.cellsAt(point, seed, it, records.cells)
            else matching
        } ?: records.cells
        val standardCells = buildAllOrNothing(towers) { tower ->
            when (tower.type) {
                CellType.GSM -> buildGsm(tower)
                CellType.WCDMA -> buildWcdma(tower)
                CellType.LTE -> buildLte(tower)
                CellType.NR -> buildNr(tower)
            }
        }
        if (towers.isNotEmpty() && standardCells.isEmpty()) return emptyList()
        val cdmaTowers = if (identity == null) records.cdmaCells else emptyList()
        val cdmaCells = buildAllOrNothing(cdmaTowers) { tower -> buildCdma(tower) }
        if (cdmaTowers.isNotEmpty() && cdmaCells.isEmpty()) return emptyList()
        return standardCells + cdmaCells
    }

    private fun buildGsm(tower: com.system.location.service.core.environment.CellTower): CellInfo? =
        runCatching {
            val mncDigits = tower.mncDigits ?: return null
            val identity = Reflection.newInstance(CellIdentityGsm::class.java) as CellIdentityGsm
            Reflection.setIntField(identity, "mLac", tower.areaCode)
            Reflection.setIntField(identity, "mCid", tower.cellId.toInt())
            Reflection.setIntField(identity, "mArfcn", tower.arfcn ?: Int.MAX_VALUE)
            Reflection.setIntField(identity, "mBsic", tower.pci ?: Int.MAX_VALUE)
            Reflection.setObjectField(identity, "mMccStr", tower.mcc.toString().padStart(3, '0'))
            Reflection.setObjectField(identity, "mMncStr", tower.mnc.toString().padStart(mncDigits, '0'))
            val signal = Reflection.newInstance(CellSignalStrengthGsm::class.java) as CellSignalStrengthGsm
            Reflection.setIntField(signal, "mRssi", tower.rsrp)
            Reflection.setIntField(signal, "mBitErrorRate", Int.MAX_VALUE)
            Reflection.setIntField(signal, "mTimingAdvance", Int.MAX_VALUE)
            Reflection.setIntField(signal, "mLevel", gsmLevel(tower.rsrp))
            val cell = Reflection.newInstance(CellInfoGsm::class.java) as CellInfoGsm
            Reflection.setObjectField(cell, "mCellIdentityGsm", identity)
            Reflection.setObjectField(cell, "mCellSignalStrengthGsm", signal)
            Reflection.callMethod(cell, "setRegistered", tower.registered)
            Reflection.callMethod(cell, "setTimeStamp", SystemClock.elapsedRealtimeNanos())
            cell
        }.getOrNull()

    private fun buildWcdma(tower: com.system.location.service.core.environment.CellTower): CellInfo? =
        runCatching {
            val mncDigits = tower.mncDigits ?: return null
            val identity = Reflection.newInstance(CellIdentityWcdma::class.java) as CellIdentityWcdma
            Reflection.setIntField(identity, "mLac", tower.areaCode)
            Reflection.setIntField(identity, "mCid", tower.cellId.toInt())
            Reflection.setIntField(identity, "mPsc", tower.pci ?: Int.MAX_VALUE)
            Reflection.setIntField(identity, "mUarfcn", tower.arfcn ?: Int.MAX_VALUE)
            Reflection.setObjectField(identity, "mMccStr", tower.mcc.toString().padStart(3, '0'))
            Reflection.setObjectField(identity, "mMncStr", tower.mnc.toString().padStart(mncDigits, '0'))
            val signal = Reflection.newInstance(CellSignalStrengthWcdma::class.java) as CellSignalStrengthWcdma
            Reflection.setIntField(signal, "mRssi", Int.MAX_VALUE)
            Reflection.setIntField(signal, "mBitErrorRate", Int.MAX_VALUE)
            Reflection.setIntField(signal, "mRscp", tower.rsrp)
            Reflection.setIntField(signal, "mEcNo", tower.rssnr ?: Int.MAX_VALUE)
            Reflection.setIntField(signal, "mLevel", wcdmaLevel(tower.rsrp))
            val cell = Reflection.newInstance(CellInfoWcdma::class.java) as CellInfoWcdma
            Reflection.setObjectField(cell, "mCellIdentityWcdma", identity)
            Reflection.setObjectField(cell, "mCellSignalStrengthWcdma", signal)
            Reflection.callMethod(cell, "setRegistered", tower.registered)
            Reflection.callMethod(cell, "setTimeStamp", SystemClock.elapsedRealtimeNanos())
            cell
        }.getOrNull()

    private fun buildCdma(tower: CdmaTower): CellInfo? = runCatching {
        if (tower.cdmaDbm == null && tower.evdoDbm == null) return null
        val identity = Reflection.newInstance(
            CellIdentityCdma::class.java,
            tower.networkId,
            tower.systemId,
            tower.baseStationId,
            tower.latitudeQuarterSeconds ?: Int.MAX_VALUE,
            tower.longitudeQuarterSeconds ?: Int.MAX_VALUE,
            null,
            null,
        ) as CellIdentityCdma
        val signal = Reflection.newInstance(
            CellSignalStrengthCdma::class.java,
            tower.cdmaDbm ?: Int.MAX_VALUE,
            tower.cdmaEcio ?: Int.MAX_VALUE,
            tower.evdoDbm ?: Int.MAX_VALUE,
            tower.evdoEcio ?: Int.MAX_VALUE,
            tower.evdoSnr ?: Int.MAX_VALUE,
        ) as CellSignalStrengthCdma
        val cell = Reflection.newInstance(CellInfoCdma::class.java) as CellInfoCdma
        Reflection.setObjectField(cell, "mCellIdentity", identity)
        Reflection.setObjectField(cell, "mCellSignalStrength", signal)
        Reflection.callMethod(cell, "setRegistered", tower.registered)
        Reflection.callMethod(cell, "setTimeStamp", SystemClock.elapsedRealtimeNanos())
        Reflection.callMethod(cell, "setCellConnectionStatus", if (tower.registered) 1 else 0)
        cell
    }.getOrNull()

    private fun buildLte(tower: com.system.location.service.core.environment.CellTower): CellInfo? =
        runCatching {
            val mncDigits = tower.mncDigits ?: return null
            val identity = Reflection.newInstance(
                CellIdentityLte::class.java,
                tower.mcc.toString().padStart(3, '0'), tower.mnc.toString().padStart(mncDigits, '0'),
                tower.cellId.toInt(), tower.pci ?: 0, tower.areaCode, tower.arfcn ?: 0,
            ) as CellIdentityLte
            val signal = Reflection.newInstance(CellSignalStrengthLte::class.java) as CellSignalStrengthLte
            Reflection.setIntField(signal, "mRsrp", tower.rsrp)
            Reflection.setIntField(signal, "mRsrq", tower.rsrq ?: -10)
            Reflection.setIntField(signal, "mRssnr", tower.rssnr ?: 5)
            Reflection.setIntField(signal, "mRssi", (tower.rsrp + 25).coerceIn(-113, -51))
            Reflection.setIntField(signal, "mLevel", lteLevel(tower.rsrp))
            val cell = Reflection.newInstance(CellInfoLte::class.java) as CellInfoLte
            Reflection.setObjectField(cell, "mCellIdentityLte", identity)
            Reflection.setObjectField(cell, "mCellSignalStrengthLte", signal)
            Reflection.callMethod(cell, "setRegistered", tower.registered)
            Reflection.callMethod(cell, "setTimeStamp", SystemClock.elapsedRealtimeNanos())
            cell
        }.getOrNull()

    fun buildNr(tower: com.system.location.service.core.environment.CellTower): CellInfo? =
        buildNrResult(tower).getOrNull()

    fun buildNrResult(tower: com.system.location.service.core.environment.CellTower): Result<CellInfo> =
        runCatching {
            val mncDigits = requireNotNull(tower.mncDigits) { "NR MNC digit count is required" }
            val identity = Reflection.newInstance(
                CellIdentityNr::class.java,
                tower.pci ?: Int.MAX_VALUE, tower.areaCode, tower.arfcn ?: Int.MAX_VALUE,
                tower.bands.toIntArray(),
                tower.mcc.toString().padStart(3, '0'), tower.mnc.toString().padStart(mncDigits, '0'),
                tower.cellId, tower.operatorName, tower.operatorName, emptyList<String>(),
            ) as CellIdentityNr
            val signal = Reflection.newInstance(CellSignalStrengthNr::class.java,
                CellInfo.UNAVAILABLE, CellInfo.UNAVAILABLE, CellInfo.UNAVAILABLE,
                tower.rsrp, tower.rsrq ?: CellInfo.UNAVAILABLE, tower.rssnr ?: CellInfo.UNAVAILABLE,
            ) as CellSignalStrengthNr
            CarrierSignalLevelCompatibility.initialize(signal)
            val cell = Reflection.newInstance(CellInfoNr::class.java) as CellInfoNr
            Reflection.setObjectField(cell, "mCellIdentity", identity)
            Reflection.setObjectField(cell, "mCellSignalStrength", signal)
            Reflection.callMethod(cell, "setRegistered", tower.registered)
            Reflection.callMethod(cell, "setTimeStamp", SystemClock.elapsedRealtimeNanos())
            Reflection.callMethod(cell, "setCellConnectionStatus", if (tower.registered) 1 else 0)
            cell
        }

    /** 3GPP TS 36.133 RSRP thresholds, so level cannot contradict the reported RSRP. */
    private fun gsmLevel(rssi: Int): Int = when {
        rssi >= -89 -> 4
        rssi >= -97 -> 3
        rssi >= -103 -> 2
        rssi >= -109 -> 1
        else -> 0
    }

    private fun wcdmaLevel(rscp: Int): Int = when {
        rscp >= -75 -> 4
        rscp >= -85 -> 3
        rscp >= -95 -> 2
        rscp >= -105 -> 1
        else -> 0
    }

    private fun lteLevel(rsrp: Int): Int = when {
        rsrp >= -85 -> 4
        rsrp >= -95 -> 3
        rsrp >= -105 -> 2
        rsrp >= -115 -> 1
        else -> 0
    }

}

internal data class ExplicitCellRecords(
    val cells: List<com.system.location.service.core.environment.CellTower>,
    val cdmaCells: List<CdmaTower>,
)

internal sealed interface CellInfoSynthesisResult {
    data object PassThrough : CellInfoSynthesisResult
    data object Unavailable : CellInfoSynthesisResult
    data class Synthetic(val cells: List<CellInfo>) : CellInfoSynthesisResult
}

internal fun selectExplicitCellRecords(
    sourceMode: EnvironmentSourceMode,
    profile: EnvironmentProfile?,
): ExplicitCellRecords? {
    if (sourceMode == EnvironmentSourceMode.PROCEDURAL || profile == null) return null
    if (profile.cells.isEmpty() && profile.cdmaCells.isEmpty()) return null
    return ExplicitCellRecords(profile.cells, profile.cdmaCells)
}

internal fun <T> selectCellInfoResult(
    protectedCall: Boolean,
    frameworkResult: Any?,
    synthetic: List<T>,
): Any? = if (protectedCall && frameworkResult is List<*>) synthetic else frameworkResult

internal fun <I, O : Any> buildAllOrNothing(inputs: List<I>, build: (I) -> O?): List<O> {
    if (inputs.isEmpty()) return emptyList()
    val results = inputs.map(build)
    return if (results.all { it != null }) results.filterNotNull() else emptyList()
}
```

```kt
package com.system.location.service.hook.hooks.telephony

import android.telephony.TelephonyManager
import com.system.location.service.hook.utils.BinderUtils
import com.system.location.service.hook.utils.FakeLoc
import io.github.libxposed.api.XposedInterface.Hooker
import com.system.location.service.hook.utils.hookAllMethods
import com.system.location.service.hook.hooks.ListenerRouting

/** Returns radio types derived from the caller's applicable target cell profile. */
object PhoneTypeHooks {
    fun hook(classLoader: ClassLoader) {
        val manager = com.system.location.service.hook.runtime.Reflection
            .findClassIfExists("com.android.phone.PhoneInterfaceManager", classLoader) ?: return

        val gsmPhoneType = Hooker { chain ->
            val original = chain.proceed()
            val state = FakeLoc.runtimeSnapshots.current()
            if (state.configuration.carrierIdentityEnabled) {
                val carrier = CarrierIdentityRuntime.profileForCall(chain.executable.name, chain.args)
                if (carrier != null) return@Hooker TelephonyManager.PHONE_TYPE_GSM
                if (original == 0) return@Hooker original
            }
            val route = ListenerRouting.decisionFor(null, BinderUtils.getCallerUid(), state.routing)
            if (!TelephonyCallerPolicy.shouldRewrite(
                    state.configuration.enabled,
                    BinderUtils.isSystemAppsCall(),
                    route,
                )
            ) return@Hooker original
            val profile = CellInfoSynthesis.profileForRoute(state, route)
            telephonyTargetIdentity(profile)?.phoneType ?: TelephonyManager.PHONE_TYPE_NONE
        }
        listOf("getActivePhoneType", "getActivePhoneTypeForSlot").forEach {
            manager.hookAllMethods(it, gsmPhoneType)
        }

        val networkType = Hooker { chain ->
            val original = chain.proceed()
            val state = FakeLoc.runtimeSnapshots.current()
            if (state.configuration.carrierIdentityEnabled) {
                val carrier = CarrierIdentityRuntime.profileForCall(chain.executable.name, chain.args)
                if (carrier != null) return@Hooker if (carrier.radio ==
                    com.system.location.service.core.carrier.CarrierRadio.NR)
                    TelephonyManager.NETWORK_TYPE_NR else TelephonyManager.NETWORK_TYPE_LTE
                if (original == 0) return@Hooker original
            }
            val route = ListenerRouting.decisionFor(null, BinderUtils.getCallerUid(), state.routing)
            if (!TelephonyCallerPolicy.shouldRewrite(
                    state.configuration.enabled,
                    BinderUtils.isSystemAppsCall(),
                    route,
                )
            ) return@Hooker original
            val profile = CellInfoSynthesis.profileForRoute(state, route)
            telephonyTargetIdentity(profile)?.networkType ?: TelephonyManager.NETWORK_TYPE_UNKNOWN
        }
        listOf(
            "getNetworkType",
            "getDataNetworkType",
            "getNetworkTypeForSubscriber",
            "getDataNetworkTypeForSubscriber",
        ).forEach { manager.hookAllMethods(it, networkType) }
    }
}
```

```kt
package com.system.location.service.hook.hooks.telephony

import com.system.location.service.core.carrier.CarrierVirtualIdentity
import com.system.location.service.hook.utils.BinderUtils
import com.system.location.service.hook.utils.FakeLoc
import io.github.libxposed.api.XposedInterface.Hooker
import com.system.location.service.hook.utils.hookAllMethods
import com.system.location.service.hook.hooks.ListenerRouting

/** Returns operator strings only when they are present in the caller's applicable target profile. */
object SimOperatorHooks {
    fun hook(classLoader: ClassLoader) {
        val manager = com.system.location.service.hook.runtime.Reflection
            .findClassIfExists("com.android.phone.PhoneInterfaceManager", classLoader) ?: return

        val carrierIdMethods = setOf("getSubscriptionCarrierId", "getSubscriptionSpecificCarrierId")
        (carrierIdMethods + setOf("getSubscriptionCarrierName", "getSubscriptionSpecificCarrierName")).forEach { name ->
            manager.hookAllMethods(name, Hooker { chain ->
                val original = chain.proceed()
                val profile = CarrierIdentityRuntime.profileForCall(chain.executable.name, chain.args)
                if (profile?.virtual != true) return@Hooker original
                if (chain.executable.name in carrierIdMethods) CarrierVirtualIdentity.carrierId(profile)
                else profile.carrierName
            })
        }

        manager.hookAllMethods("getMergedImsisFromGroup", Hooker { chain ->
            val profile = CarrierIdentityRuntime.profileForCall(chain.executable.name, chain.args)
            if (profile?.virtual != true) return@Hooker chain.proceed()
            val context = BinderUtils.getSystemContext() ?: return@Hooker chain.proceed()
            // This API requires READ_PRIVILEGED_PHONE_STATE. Preserve the original check for
            // every caller not holding it; never convert an invalid real subId into an identity.
            if (context.checkCallingOrSelfPermission("android.permission.READ_PRIVILEGED_PHONE_STATE") !=
                android.content.pm.PackageManager.PERMISSION_GRANTED) return@Hooker chain.proceed()
            arrayOf(CarrierVirtualIdentity.imsi(profile))
        })

        val numeric = Hooker { chain ->
            val original = chain.proceed()
            val state = FakeLoc.runtimeSnapshots.current()
            if (state.configuration.carrierIdentityEnabled) {
                return@Hooker CarrierIdentityRuntime.profileForCall(chain.executable.name, chain.args)
                    ?.operatorNumeric ?: original
            }
            val route = ListenerRouting.decisionFor(null, BinderUtils.getCallerUid(), state.routing)
            if (!TelephonyCallerPolicy.shouldRewrite(
                    state.configuration.enabled,
                    BinderUtils.isSystemAppsCall(),
                    route,
                )
            ) return@Hooker original
            val carrier = CarrierIdentityRuntime.profileForCall(chain.executable.name, chain.args)
            if (carrier != null) return@Hooker carrier.operatorNumeric
            val profile = CellInfoSynthesis.profileForRoute(state, route)
            telephonyTargetIdentity(profile)?.operatorNumeric.orEmpty()
        }
        listOf(
            "getSimOperatorNumericForPhone",
            "getSimOperatorNumericForSubscriber",
            "getSimOperatorNumeric",
        ).forEach { manager.hookAllMethods(it, numeric) }

        val name = Hooker { chain ->
            val original = chain.proceed()
            val state = FakeLoc.runtimeSnapshots.current()
            if (state.configuration.carrierIdentityEnabled) {
                return@Hooker CarrierIdentityRuntime.profileForCall(chain.executable.name, chain.args)
                    ?.carrierName ?: original
            }
            val route = ListenerRouting.decisionFor(null, BinderUtils.getCallerUid(), state.routing)
            if (!TelephonyCallerPolicy.shouldRewrite(
                    state.configuration.enabled,
                    BinderUtils.isSystemAppsCall(),
                    route,
                )
            ) return@Hooker original
            val carrier = CarrierIdentityRuntime.profileForCall(chain.executable.name, chain.args)
            if (carrier != null) return@Hooker carrier.carrierName
            val profile = CellInfoSynthesis.profileForRoute(state, route)
            telephonyTargetIdentity(profile)?.operatorName.orEmpty()
        }
        listOf(
            "getSimOperatorNameForPhone",
            "getSimOperatorNameForSubscriber",
            "getSimOperatorName",
        ).forEach { manager.hookAllMethods(it, name) }

        // These methods are version-dependent. hookAllMethods simply installs nothing when a
        // ROM lacks an entry; original execution still enforces framework permission semantics.
        val networkNumeric = Hooker { chain ->
            val original = chain.proceed()
            CarrierIdentityRuntime.profileForCall(chain.executable.name, chain.args)
                ?.operatorNumeric ?: original
        }
        listOf("getNetworkOperatorForPhone", "getNetworkOperatorForSubscriber", "getNetworkOperator")
            .forEach { manager.hookAllMethods(it, networkNumeric) }
        val networkName = Hooker { chain ->
            val original = chain.proceed()
            CarrierIdentityRuntime.profileForCall(chain.executable.name, chain.args)
                ?.operatorName ?: original
        }
        listOf("getNetworkOperatorNameForPhone", "getNetworkOperatorNameForSubscriber", "getNetworkOperatorName")
            .forEach { manager.hookAllMethods(it, networkName) }
        val country = Hooker { chain ->
            val original = chain.proceed()
            CarrierIdentityRuntime.profileForCall(chain.executable.name, chain.args)
                ?.countryIso?.lowercase(java.util.Locale.ROOT) ?: original
        }
        listOf("getSimCountryIsoForPhone", "getSimCountryIsoForSubscriber", "getSimCountryIso",
            "getNetworkCountryIsoForPhone", "getNetworkCountryIsoForSubscriber", "getNetworkCountryIso")
            .forEach { manager.hookAllMethods(it, country) }

        val simState = Hooker { chain ->
            val original = chain.proceed()
            val profile = CarrierIdentityRuntime.profileForCall(chain.executable.name, chain.args)
            if (profile?.virtual == true) android.telephony.TelephonyManager.SIM_STATE_READY else original
        }
        listOf("getSimStateForSlotIndex", "getSimStateForSubscriber", "getSimState")
            .forEach { manager.hookAllMethods(it, simState) }

        val subscriber = Hooker { chain ->
            val original = chain.proceed()
            val profile = CarrierIdentityRuntime.profileForCall(chain.executable.name, chain.args)
            if (profile?.virtual == true && CarrierIdentifierAccess.permitted()) CarrierVirtualIdentity.imsi(profile) else original
        }
        listOf("getSubscriberIdForSubscriber", "getSubscriberId", "getSubscriberIdForPhone")
            .forEach { manager.hookAllMethods(it, subscriber) }

        val icc = Hooker { chain ->
            val original = chain.proceed()
            val profile = CarrierIdentityRuntime.profileForCall(chain.executable.name, chain.args)
            if (profile?.virtual == true && CarrierIdentifierAccess.permitted()) CarrierVirtualIdentity.iccid(profile) else original
        }
        listOf("getIccIdForSubscriber", "getIccId", "getSimSerialNumberForSubscriber",
            "getSimSerialNumber").forEach { manager.hookAllMethods(it, icc) }
    }
}
```

```kt
package com.system.location.service.hook.hooks.telephony

import com.system.location.service.core.routing.RoutingDecision

internal object TelephonyCallerPolicy {
    fun shouldRewrite(
        simulationEnabled: Boolean,
        systemCaller: Boolean,
        route: RoutingDecision,
    ): Boolean = simulationEnabled && !systemCaller && route != RoutingDecision.Deny
}
```

```kt
package com.system.location.service.hook.hooks.telephony

import android.os.Build
import android.os.Bundle
import android.os.Parcel
import android.os.SystemClock
import android.telephony.CellIdentity
import android.telephony.CellIdentityCdma
import android.telephony.CellInfo
import android.telephony.CellInfoCdma
import android.telephony.CellSignalStrengthCdma
import android.telephony.NeighboringCellInfo
import android.telephony.SignalStrength
import com.system.location.service.hook.runtime.Reflection
import com.system.location.service.hook.utils.BinderUtils
import com.system.location.service.hook.utils.FakeLoc

import com.system.location.service.hook.utils.hookAllMethods
import com.system.location.service.hook.utils.hook
import com.system.location.service.hook.utils.hookMethod
import com.system.location.service.hook.utils.onceHookMethod
import java.lang.reflect.Modifier

object TelephonyHook: BaseTelephonyHook() {
    operator fun invoke(classLoader: ClassLoader) {
        if(!initDivineService("TelephonyHook")) {
            Logger.error("Failed to init mock service in TelephonyHook")
            return
        }

        Reflection.findClassIfExists("com.android.phone.PhoneInterfaceManager", classLoader)?.let {
            CellInfoSynthesis.hook(it)
            CarrierCellRequestHook.install(it)
        }
        PhoneTypeHooks.hook(classLoader); SimOperatorHooks.hook(classLoader)
        CarrierConfigOverrideHook.install(classLoader)
        CarrierConfigReadHook.install(classLoader)
        CarrierSubscriptionHook.install(classLoader)
        CarrierHardwareSubscriptionHook.install(classLoader)
        CarrierServiceStateHook.install(classLoader)
        CarrierSignalStrengthHook.install(classLoader)
        CarrierSubscriberInfoHook.install(classLoader)
        CarrierPhoneNumberHook.install(classLoader)
        CarrierGlobalProperties.install(classLoader)
        if (!FakeLoc.needDowngradeToCdma) return
        val cPhoneInterfaceManager = Reflection.findClassIfExists("com.android.phone.PhoneInterfaceManager", classLoader)
            ?: return

        val hookGetPhoneTyp = Hooker { chain ->
            val original = chain.proceed()
            if (FakeLoc.enable && !BinderUtils.isSystemAppsCall()) {
                if (FakeLoc.enableDebugLog) {
                    Logger.debug("getActivePhoneType: injected!")
                }

                return@Hooker 2
            }
            original
        }

        if(cPhoneInterfaceManager.hookAllMethods("getActivePhoneType", hookGetPhoneTyp).isEmpty()) {
            Logger.error("Hook PhoneInterfaceManager.getActivePhoneType failed")
        }
        if(cPhoneInterfaceManager.hookAllMethods("getActivePhoneTypeForSlot", hookGetPhoneTyp).isEmpty()) {
            Logger.warn("Hook PhoneInterfaceManager.getActivePhoneTypeForSlot failed")
        }

        if(com.system.location.service.hook.scope.HookInstaller.hookAllMethods(cPhoneInterfaceManager, "getCellLocation", Hooker { chain ->
                val original = chain.proceed()
                if (!FakeLoc.enable || BinderUtils.isSystemAppsCall()) {
                    return@Hooker original
                }
                if (FakeLoc.enableDebugLog) {
                    Logger.debug("${chain.executable.name}: injected!")
                }

                // A missing real cell (no permission, radio off, no neighbour) must stay missing.
                if (original == null) return@Hooker null
                if (original is Bundle && (original.getBoolean("empty") || original.getBoolean("emptyParcel"))) {
                    return@Hooker original
                }
                val identity = cdmaIdentity()
                if (Build.VERSION.SDK_INT < Build.VERSION_CODES.R || original?.javaClass?.name == "android.os.Bundle") {
                    Bundle().apply {
                        putInt("cid", identity.cid)
                        putInt("lac", identity.lac)
                        putInt("psc", identity.psc)
                        putInt("baseStationLatitude", identity.latitudeQuarterMinutes)
                        putInt("baseStationLongitude", identity.longitudeQuarterMinutes)
                        putBoolean("empty", false)
                        putBoolean("emptyParcel", false)
                        putInt("mFlags", 1536)
                        putBoolean("parcelled", false)
                        putInt("baseStationId", identity.baseStationId)
                        putInt("systemId", identity.systemId)
                        putInt("networkId", identity.networkId)
                        putInt("size", 0)
                    }
                } else {
                    CellIdentityCdma::class.java.getConstructor(
                        Int::class.java,
                        Int::class.java,
                        Int::class.java,
                        Int::class.java,
                        Int::class.java,
                        String::class.java,
                        String::class.java
                    ).newInstance(
                        identity.networkId,
                        identity.systemId,
                        identity.baseStationId,
                        identity.latitudeQuarterMinutes,
                        identity.longitudeQuarterMinutes,
                        null, null
                    )
                }
            }).isEmpty()) {
            Logger.error("Hook PhoneInterfaceManager.getCellLocation failed")
        }

        Hooker { chain ->
            val original = chain.proceed()
            if (FakeLoc.enable && !BinderUtils.isSystemAppsCall()) {
                if (FakeLoc.enableDebugLog) {
                    Logger.debug("getDataNetworkType: injected!")
                }
                return@Hooker 4
            }
            original
        }.let {
            cPhoneInterfaceManager.hookAllMethods("getDataNetworkType", it)
            cPhoneInterfaceManager.hookAllMethods("getNetworkType", it)
            cPhoneInterfaceManager.hookAllMethods("getDataNetworkTypeForSubscriber", it)
            cPhoneInterfaceManager.hookAllMethods("getNetworkTypeForSubscriber", it)
        }

        if (Build.VERSION.SDK_INT >= Build.VERSION_CODES.P) {
            if (cPhoneInterfaceManager.hookAllMethods("getNeighboringCellInfo", Hooker { chain ->
                // Preserve the framework permission result before replacing the list.
                val original = chain.proceed()
                if (!FakeLoc.enable || BinderUtils.isSystemAppsCall()) {
                    return@Hooker original
                }
                if (original !is List<*> || original.isEmpty()) return@Hooker original

                kotlin.runCatching {
                    val identity = cdmaIdentity()
                    val nCellInfo = NeighboringCellInfo::class.java.getConstructor().newInstance()
                    Reflection.setIntField(nCellInfo, "mRssi", -73)
                    Reflection.setIntField(nCellInfo, "mCid", identity.cid)
                    Reflection.setIntField(nCellInfo, "mLac", identity.lac)
                    Reflection.setIntField(nCellInfo, "mPsc", identity.psc)
                    Reflection.setIntField(nCellInfo, "mNetworkType", 4)
                    listOf(nCellInfo)
                }.getOrElse {
                    arrayListOf()
                }
            }).isEmpty()) {
                Logger.error("Hook PhoneInterfaceManager.getNeighboringCellInfo failed")
            }
        }

        val cTelephonyRegistry = Reflection.findClassIfExists("com.android.server.TelephonyRegistry", classLoader)
        if (cTelephonyRegistry == null) {
            Logger.error("TelephonyRegistry not found")
        } else {
            hookTelephonyRegistry(cTelephonyRegistry)
        }

    }

    fun hookTelephonyRegistry(cTelephonyRegistry: Class<*>) {
        CarrierRegistryHook.install(cTelephonyRegistry)
        // The CDMA replacement is a legacy path. Leaving it active in LTE/5G mode makes callback
        // consumers see CDMA cells while getAllCellInfo returns LTE/NR cells.
        if (!FakeLoc.needDowngradeToCdma) return
        cTelephonyRegistry.declaredMethods.filter { (it.name == "listen" || it.name == "listenWithEventList") && !Modifier.isAbstract(it.modifiers) }
            .map {
                it to it.parameterTypes.indexOfFirst { typ -> typ.simpleName == "IPhoneStateListener" }
            }.forEach {
                val (m, idx) = it
                if (idx == -1) {
                    Logger.error("IPhoneStateListener not found")
                    return@forEach
                }
                m.hook(Hooker { chain ->
                    if (!FakeLoc.enable || BinderUtils.isSystemAppsCall()) {
                        return@Hooker chain.proceed()
                    }

                    val listener = chain.args[idx] as Any
                    val hasHookOnCellLocationChanged = if (Build.VERSION.SDK_INT >= Build.VERSION_CODES.P) {
                        listener.javaClass.onceHookMethod("onCellLocationChanged", CellIdentity::class.java, callback = Hooker callback@ { callbackChain ->
                            if (FakeLoc.enable) {
                                val identity = cdmaIdentity()
                                return@callback CellIdentityCdma::class.java.getConstructor(
                                    Int::class.java,
                                    Int::class.java,
                                    Int::class.java,
                                    Int::class.java,
                                    Int::class.java,
                                    String::class.java,
                                    String::class.java
                                ).newInstance(
                                    identity.networkId,
                                    identity.systemId,
                                    identity.baseStationId,
                                    identity.latitudeQuarterMinutes,
                                    identity.longitudeQuarterMinutes,
                                    null, null
                                )
                            }
                            callbackChain.proceed()
                        })
                    } else {
                        listener.javaClass.onceHookMethod("onCellLocationChanged", Bundle::class.java, callback = Hooker callback@ { callbackChain ->
                            if (FakeLoc.enable) {
                                val identity = cdmaIdentity()
                                return@callback Bundle().apply {
                                    putInt("cid", identity.cid)
                                    putInt("lac", identity.lac)
                                    putInt("psc", identity.psc)
                                    putInt("baseStationLatitude", identity.latitudeQuarterMinutes)
                                    putInt("baseStationLongitude", identity.longitudeQuarterMinutes)
                                    putBoolean("empty", false)
                                    putBoolean("emptyParcel", false)
                                    putInt("mFlags", 1536)
                                    putBoolean("parcelled", false)
                                    putInt("baseStationId", identity.baseStationId)
                                    putInt("systemId", identity.systemId)
                                    putInt("networkId", identity.networkId)
                                    putInt("size", 0)
                                }
                            }
                            callbackChain.proceed()
                        })
                    } != null
                    if (!hasHookOnCellLocationChanged) {
                        Logger.error("Hook onCellLocationChanged failed")
                    }
                    val suppressSignal = Hooker { callbackChain ->
                        if (FakeLoc.enable) null else callbackChain.proceed()
                    }
                    listener.javaClass.onceHookMethod("onSignalStrengthChanged", Int::class.java, callback = suppressSignal)
                    listener.javaClass.onceHookMethod("onSignalStrengthsChanged", SignalStrength::class.java, callback = suppressSignal)
                    chain.proceed()
                })
            }

        cTelephonyRegistry.hookMethod("notifyCellInfo", List::class.java, callback = Hooker { chain ->
            val args = chain.args.toTypedArray()
            if (!FakeLoc.enable || BinderUtils.isSystemAppsCall()) {
                return@Hooker chain.proceed()
            }

            if (FakeLoc.enableDebugLog) {
                Logger.debug("notifyCellInfo: injected!")
            }

            val cellInfos = arrayListOf<CellInfo>()
            val cellInfo = kotlin.runCatching {
                CellInfoCdma::class.java.getConstructor().newInstance().also {
                    Reflection.callMethod(it, "setRegistered", true)
                    Reflection.callMethod(it, "setTimeStamp", SystemClock.elapsedRealtimeNanos())
                    Reflection.callMethod(it, "setCellConnectionStatus", 0)
                }
            }.getOrElse {
                CellInfoCdma::class.java.getConstructor(
                    Int::class.java,
                    Boolean::class.java,
                    Long::class.java,
                    CellIdentityCdma::class.java,
                    CellSignalStrengthCdma::class.java
                ).newInstance(0, true, SystemClock.elapsedRealtimeNanos(), CellIdentityCdma::class.java.newInstance(), CellSignalStrengthCdma::class.java.newInstance())
            }
            cellInfos.add(cellInfo)

            args[0] = cellInfos
            chain.proceed(args)
        })

        cTelephonyRegistry.hookMethod("notifyCellInfoForSubscriber", Int::class.java, List::class.java, callback = Hooker { chain ->
            val args = chain.args.toTypedArray()
            if (!FakeLoc.enable || BinderUtils.isSystemAppsCall()) {
                return@Hooker chain.proceed()
            }

            if (FakeLoc.enableDebugLog) {
                Logger.debug("notifyCellInfoForSubscriber: injected!")
            }

            val cellInfos = arrayListOf<CellInfo>()
            val cellInfo = kotlin.runCatching {
                CellInfoCdma::class.java.getConstructor().newInstance().also {
                    Reflection.callMethod(it, "setRegistered", true)
                    Reflection.callMethod(it, "setTimeStamp", SystemClock.elapsedRealtimeNanos())
                    Reflection.callMethod(it, "setCellConnectionStatus", 0)
                }
            }.getOrElse {
                CellInfoCdma::class.java.getConstructor(
                    Int::class.java,
                    Boolean::class.java,
                    Long::class.java,
                    CellIdentityCdma::class.java,
                    CellSignalStrengthCdma::class.java
                ).newInstance(0, true, SystemClock.elapsedRealtimeNanos(), CellIdentityCdma::class.java.newInstance(), CellSignalStrengthCdma::class.java.newInstance())
            }
            cellInfos.add(cellInfo)

            args[1] = cellInfos
            chain.proceed(args)
        })

        cTelephonyRegistry.hookMethod("notifyCellLocation", Bundle::class.java, callback = Hooker { chain ->
            val args = chain.args.toTypedArray()
            if (!FakeLoc.enable || BinderUtils.isSystemAppsCall()) {
                return@Hooker chain.proceed()
            }

            if (FakeLoc.enableDebugLog) {
                Logger.debug("notifyCellLocation: injected!")
            }

            val identity = cdmaIdentity()
            args[0] = Bundle().apply {
                putInt("cid", identity.cid)
                putInt("lac", identity.lac)
                putInt("psc", identity.psc)
                putInt("baseStationLatitude", identity.latitudeQuarterMinutes)
                putInt("baseStationLongitude", identity.longitudeQuarterMinutes)
                putBoolean("empty", false)
                putBoolean("emptyParcel", false)
                putInt("mFlags", 1536)
                putBoolean("parcelled", false)
                putInt("baseStationId", identity.baseStationId)
                putInt("systemId", identity.systemId)
                putInt("networkId", identity.networkId)
                putInt("size", 0)
            }
            chain.proceed(args)
        })
        cTelephonyRegistry.hookMethod("notifyCellLocationForSubscriber", Int::class.java, Bundle::class.java, callback = Hooker { chain ->
            val args = chain.args.toTypedArray()
            if (!FakeLoc.enable || BinderUtils.isSystemAppsCall()) {
                return@Hooker chain.proceed()
            }

            if (FakeLoc.enableDebugLog) {
                Logger.debug("notifyCellLocationForSubscriber: injected!")
            }

            val identity = cdmaIdentity()
            args[1] = Bundle().apply {
                putInt("cid", identity.cid)
                putInt("lac", identity.lac)
                putInt("psc", identity.psc)
                putInt("baseStationLatitude", identity.latitudeQuarterMinutes)
                putInt("baseStationLongitude", identity.longitudeQuarterMinutes)
                putBoolean("empty", false)
                putBoolean("emptyParcel", false)
                putInt("mFlags", 1536)
                putBoolean("parcelled", false)
                putInt("baseStationId", identity.baseStationId)
                putInt("systemId", identity.systemId)
                putInt("networkId", identity.networkId)
                putInt("size", 0)

    @Suppress("LocalVariableName")
    fun hookSubOnTransact(classLoader: ClassLoader) {
        val cISub = Reflection.findClassIfExists("com.android.internal.telephony.ISub\$Stub", classLoader)
        if (cISub == null) {
            Logger.error("ISub.Stub not found")
            return
        }

        val subClassName = "com.android.internal.telephony.ISub"
        val TRANSACTION_getPhoneId = kotlin.runCatching { Reflection.getStaticIntField(cISub, "TRANSACTION_getPhoneId") }.getOrDefault(-1)
        val TRANSACTION_getSimStateForSlotIndex = kotlin.runCatching { Reflection.getStaticIntField(cISub, "TRANSACTION_getSimStateForSlotIndex") }.getOrDefault(-1)
        val TRANSACTION_isActiveSubId = kotlin.runCatching { Reflection.getStaticIntField(cISub, "TRANSACTION_isActiveSubId") }.getOrDefault(-1)
        val TRANSACTION_getNetworkCountryIsoForPhone = kotlin.runCatching { Reflection.getStaticIntField(cISub, "TRANSACTION_getNetworkCountryIsoForPhone") }.getOrDefault(-1)
        val TRANSACTION_getSimStateForSubscriber = kotlin.runCatching { Reflection.getStaticIntField(cISub, "TRANSACTION_getSimStateForSubscriber") }.getOrDefault(-1)
        val TRANSACTION_getSimStateForSlotIdx = kotlin.runCatching { Reflection.getStaticIntField(cISub, "TRANSACTION_getSimStateForSlotIdx") }.getOrDefault(-1)

        val hookOnTransact = Hooker { chain ->
            val original = chain.proceed()
            if (original != true) return@Hooker original
            val args = chain.args
            if (args.size < 3) return@Hooker original
            val code = args[0] as? Int ?: return@Hooker original
            val operation = when {
                TRANSACTION_getPhoneId > 0 && code == TRANSACTION_getPhoneId -> TelephonySubOperation.PHONE_ID
                TRANSACTION_isActiveSubId > 0 && code == TRANSACTION_isActiveSubId -> TelephonySubOperation.ACTIVE_SUBSCRIPTION
                (TRANSACTION_getSimStateForSlotIndex > 0 && code == TRANSACTION_getSimStateForSlotIndex) ||
                    (TRANSACTION_getSimStateForSlotIdx > 0 && code == TRANSACTION_getSimStateForSlotIdx) ->
                    TelephonySubOperation.SIM_STATE_FOR_SLOT
                TRANSACTION_getSimStateForSubscriber > 0 && code == TRANSACTION_getSimStateForSubscriber ->
                    TelephonySubOperation.SIM_STATE_FOR_SUBSCRIPTION
                TRANSACTION_getNetworkCountryIsoForPhone > 0 && code == TRANSACTION_getNetworkCountryIsoForPhone ->
                    TelephonySubOperation.NETWORK_COUNTRY_ISO
                else -> return@Hooker original
            }
            val data = args[1] as? Parcel ?: return@Hooker original
            val requestedId = runCatching {
                data.setDataPosition(0)
                data.enforceInterface(subClassName)
                data.readInt()
            }.getOrNull() ?: return@Hooker original
            val state = FakeLoc.runtimeSnapshots.current()
            if (state.configuration.carrierIdentityEnabled) {
                if (operation == TelephonySubOperation.NETWORK_COUNTRY_ISO) {
                    val identity = CarrierIdentityRuntime.profileForCall("getNetworkCountryIsoForPhone", listOf(requestedId))
                    identity?.let {
                        rewriteSubReply(args[2] as? Parcel ?: return@Hooker original,
                            it.countryIso.lowercase(java.util.Locale.ROOT))
                    }
                }
                // Real active subscriptions and slot mappings are required by the dual-SIM model.
                return@Hooker original
            }
            val uid = BinderUtils.getCallerUid()
            val route = com.system.location.service.hook.hooks.ListenerRouting
                .decisionFor(null, uid, state.routing)
            if (!TelephonyCallerPolicy.shouldRewrite(
                    state.configuration.enabled,
                    BinderUtils.isSystemAppsCall(uid),
                    route,
                )
            ) return@Hooker original

            val profile = CellInfoSynthesis.profileForRoute(state, route)
            val value = telephonySubReply(operation, requestedId, telephonyTargetIdentity(profile))
            rewriteSubReply(args[2] as? Parcel ?: return@Hooker original, value)
            original
        }
        if(cISub.hookAllMethods("onTransact", hookOnTransact).isEmpty()) {
            Logger.error("Hook ISub.Stub.onTransact failed")
        }
    }

    private fun rewriteSubReply(reply: Parcel, value: Any): Boolean {
        val originalPosition = reply.dataPosition()
        reply.setDataPosition(0)
        val successful = runCatching { reply.readException() }.isSuccess
        reply.setDataPosition(originalPosition)
        if (!successful) return false

        val backup = Parcel.obtain()
        try {
            val originalSize = reply.dataSize()
            reply.setDataPosition(0)
            backup.appendFrom(reply, 0, originalSize)
            reply.setDataPosition(originalPosition)

            reply.setDataPosition(0)
            reply.writeNoException()
            when (value) {
                is Boolean -> if (Build.VERSION.SDK_INT >= Build.VERSION_CODES.Q) {
                    reply.writeBoolean(value)
                } else {
                    reply.writeInt(if (value) 1 else 0)
                }
                is Int -> reply.writeInt(value)
                is String -> reply.writeString(value)
                else -> error("Unsupported ISub reply type")
            }
            reply.setDataSize(reply.dataPosition())
            reply.setDataPosition(0)
            return true
        } catch (error: Throwable) {
            runCatching {
                reply.setDataSize(0)
                reply.appendFrom(backup, 0, backup.dataSize())
                reply.setDataPosition(0)
            }
            Logger.warn("ISub reply rewrite failed; preserved framework result", error)
            return false
        } finally {
            backup.recycle()
        }
    }

    private fun cdmaIdentity(): CdmaIdentity = currentCdmaIdentity()

}
```

`xposed/src/main/java/com/system/location/service/hook/hooks/telephony/TelephonySubReplyPolicy.kt`:

```kt
package com.system.location.service.hook.hooks.telephony

import android.telephony.TelephonyManager

internal enum class TelephonySubOperation {
    PHONE_ID,
    ACTIVE_SUBSCRIPTION,
    SIM_STATE_FOR_SLOT,
    SIM_STATE_FOR_SUBSCRIPTION,
    NETWORK_COUNTRY_ISO,
}

internal fun telephonySubReply(
    operation: TelephonySubOperation,
    requestedId: Int,
    identity: TelephonyTargetIdentity?,
): Any =
    when (operation) {
        TelephonySubOperation.PHONE_ID -> -1
        TelephonySubOperation.ACTIVE_SUBSCRIPTION -> false
        TelephonySubOperation.SIM_STATE_FOR_SLOT -> if (requestedId == 0 && identity != null) {
            TelephonyManager.SIM_STATE_READY
        } else {
            TelephonyManager.SIM_STATE_UNKNOWN
        }
        TelephonySubOperation.SIM_STATE_FOR_SUBSCRIPTION -> TelephonyManager.SIM_STATE_UNKNOWN
        TelephonySubOperation.NETWORK_COUNTRY_ISO -> ""
    }
```

`xposed/src/main/java/com/system/location/service/hook/hooks/telephony/TelephonyTargetIdentity.kt`:

```kt
package com.system.location.service.hook.hooks.telephony

import android.telephony.TelephonyManager
import com.system.location.service.core.environment.CellType
import com.system.location.service.core.environment.EnvironmentProfile

internal data class TelephonyTargetIdentity(
    val operatorNumeric: String?,
    val operatorName: String?,
    val phoneType: Int,
    val networkType: Int,
)

internal fun telephonyTargetIdentity(profile: EnvironmentProfile?): TelephonyTargetIdentity? {
    profile ?: return null
    val registeredCell = profile.registeredCell()
    if (registeredCell != null) {
        val networkType = when (registeredCell.type) {
            CellType.GSM -> TelephonyManager.NETWORK_TYPE_UNKNOWN
            CellType.WCDMA -> TelephonyManager.NETWORK_TYPE_UMTS
            CellType.LTE -> TelephonyManager.NETWORK_TYPE_LTE
            CellType.NR -> TelephonyManager.NETWORK_TYPE_NR
        }
        return TelephonyTargetIdentity(
            operatorNumeric = registeredCell.operatorNumeric,
            operatorName = registeredCell.operatorName,
            phoneType = TelephonyManager.PHONE_TYPE_GSM,
            networkType = networkType,
        )
    }
    if (profile.registeredCdmaCell() != null) {
        return TelephonyTargetIdentity(
            operatorNumeric = null,
            operatorName = null,
            phoneType = TelephonyManager.PHONE_TYPE_CDMA,
            networkType = TelephonyManager.NETWORK_TYPE_CDMA,
        )
    }
    return null
}
```

```kt
package com.system.location.service.hook.hooks.wlan

import com.system.location.service.hook.utils.BinderUtils

/** The system uses package "android", which the vendor package-name filter does not cover. */
internal object WifiCallerPolicy {
    fun mayRewrite(packageName: String, uid: Int): Boolean =
        uid >= 0 && uid % 100000 >= 10000 && packageName != "android" &&
            !BinderUtils.isSystemPackages(packageName)
}
```

`xposed/src/main/java/com/system/location/service/hook/hooks/wlan/WifiConnectionInfo.kt`:

```kt
package com.system.location.service.hook.hooks.wlan

import android.net.wifi.SupplicantState
import android.net.wifi.WifiInfo
import com.system.location.service.core.environment.WifiAp
import com.system.location.service.hook.runtime.Reflection
import com.system.location.service.hook.utils.FakeLoc
import com.system.location.service.hook.utils.Logger
import java.net.InetAddress

internal fun syntheticWifiInfo(ap: WifiAp, seed: Long): WifiInfo {
    // WifiInfo.setSSID takes WifiSsid, not String. The public builder handles its platform type
    // and UTF-8 encoding on every supported Android version instead of silently leaving it null.
    val info = WifiInfo.Builder().setSsid(ap.ssid.toByteArray(Charsets.UTF_8))
        .setBssid(ap.bssid.lowercase()).setRssi(ap.rssi)
        .setNetworkId(ap.bssid.lowercase().hashCode() and Int.MAX_VALUE).build()
    val linkSpeed = if (ap.frequencyMhz >= 5_000) 433 else 144
    val ip = syntheticWifiIpv4(ap.bssid)
    val address = InetAddress.getByAddress(ByteArray(4) { (ip ushr (it * 8)).toByte() })
    listOf<Pair<String, Any>>(
        "setMacAddress" to syntheticWifiMac(seed, ap.bssid),
        "setFrequency" to ap.frequencyMhz,
        "setLinkSpeed" to linkSpeed,
        "setRxLinkSpeedMbps" to linkSpeed,
        "setTxLinkSpeedMbps" to linkSpeed,
        "setMaxSupportedRxLinkSpeedMbps" to linkSpeed,
        "setMaxSupportedTxLinkSpeedMbps" to linkSpeed,
        "setWifiStandard" to ap.standard,
        "setInetAddress" to address,
        "setSupplicantState" to SupplicantState.COMPLETED,
        "setHiddenSSID" to false,
    ).forEach { (method, value) ->
        runCatching { Reflection.callMethod(info, method, value) }.onFailure {
            if (FakeLoc.enableDebugLog) Logger.debug("WifiInfo.$method unavailable: ${it.javaClass.simpleName}")
        }
    }
    return info
}
```

`xposed/src/main/java/com/system/location/service/hook/hooks/wlan/WifiScanResult.kt`:

```kt
package com.system.location.service.hook.hooks.wlan

import android.net.wifi.ScanResult
import android.net.wifi.WifiSsid
import android.os.Build
import com.system.location.service.core.environment.WifiAp
import com.system.location.service.hook.runtime.Reflection

internal fun syntheticWifiScanResult(ap: WifiAp, observedMicros: Long): ScanResult =
    ScanResult().apply {
        SSID = ap.ssid
        val ssidBytes = ap.ssid.toByteArray(Charsets.UTF_8)
        val wifiSsid = if (Build.VERSION.SDK_INT >= 33) WifiSsid.fromBytes(ssidBytes) else
            Reflection.callStaticMethod(Class.forName("android.net.wifi.WifiSsid"), "createFromByteArray", ssidBytes)
        Reflection.setObjectField(this, "wifiSsid", wifiSsid)
        BSSID = ap.bssid.lowercase()
        capabilities = ap.capabilities
        frequency = ap.frequencyMhz
        level = ap.rssi
        timestamp = observedMicros
        channelWidth = if (ap.frequencyMhz >= 5_000) ScanResult.CHANNEL_WIDTH_80MHZ
            else ScanResult.CHANNEL_WIDTH_20MHZ
        centerFreq0 = if (ap.frequencyMhz >= 5_000) ap.frequencyMhz + 30 else ap.frequencyMhz
        centerFreq1 = 0
        // A default ScanResult has a null array. Android's getter calls Arrays.asList(array),
        // which crashes even when a caller only wants to iterate the information elements.
        Reflection.setObjectField(this, "informationElements", emptyArray<ScanResult.InformationElement>())
        Reflection.callMethod(this, "setWifiStandard", ap.standard)
    }
```
