`xposed/src/main/java/com/system/location/service/hook/hooks/wlan/WlanHook.kt`:

```kt
@file:Suppress("UNCHECKED_CAST", "PrivateApi")
package com.system.location.service.hook.hooks.wlan

import android.net.NetworkCapabilities
import android.net.wifi.ScanResult
import android.net.wifi.SupplicantState
import android.net.wifi.WifiInfo
import android.os.Build
import android.os.SystemClock
import android.util.ArrayMap
import dalvik.system.PathClassLoader
import io.github.libxposed.api.XposedInterface.Hooker
import com.system.location.service.hook.runtime.Reflection
import com.system.location.service.core.environment.EnvironmentConfig
import com.system.location.service.core.environment.EnvironmentProfile
import com.system.location.service.core.environment.EnvironmentSourceMode
import com.system.location.service.core.environment.FingerprintWifiSource
import com.system.location.service.core.environment.ProceduralWifiSource
import com.system.location.service.core.environment.ReplayEnvironmentSource
import com.system.location.service.core.environment.WifiFingerprintImporter
import com.system.location.service.core.geo.Wgs84
import com.system.location.service.hook.hooks.ListenerRouting
import com.system.location.service.hook.utils.BinderUtils
import com.system.location.service.hook.utils.FakeLoc
import com.system.location.service.hook.utils.Logger
import com.system.location.service.hook.utils.hookAllMethods
import com.system.location.service.hook.utils.toClass

/**
 * P2-04: replace the old empty-list/sentinel-BSSID WiFi answers with the deterministic procedural
 * environment (P2-03). Only third-party callers are rewritten; system callers keep the real state so
 * framework services and Settings behave normally.
 */
object WlanHook {
    private var source = ProceduralWifiSource(EnvironmentConfig(apPerCell = 4))
    private var sourceApCount = 4
    private val profileLock = Any()
    private var cachedKey: WifiProfileCacheKey? = null
    private var cachedProfile: EnvironmentProfile? = null
    private var cachedFingerprintJson: String? = null
    private var cachedFingerprintSource: FingerprintWifiSource? = null
    private var cachedFingerprintEnabled: Boolean? = null
    private var fingerprintRevision = 0L

    operator fun invoke(classLoader: ClassLoader) {
        if (Build.VERSION.SDK_INT >= Build.VERSION_CODES.TIRAMISU) {
            val cSystemServerClassLoaderFactory = Reflection.findClassIfExists(
                "com.android.internal.os.SystemServerClassLoaderFactory", classLoader)
            if (cSystemServerClassLoaderFactory == null) {
                Logger.warn("Failed to find SystemServerClassLoaderFactory")
                return
            }
            val sLoadedPaths = Reflection.getStaticObjectField(
                cSystemServerClassLoaderFactory, "sLoadedPaths") as ArrayMap<String, PathClassLoader>
            val wifiClassLoader = sLoadedPaths.firstNotNullOfOrNull {
                if (it.key.contains("service-wifi.jar")) it.value else null
            }
            if (wifiClassLoader == null) {
                Logger.warn("Failed to find wifiClassLoader")
                return
            }
            val wifiClazz = "com.android.server.wifi.WifiServiceImpl".toClass(wifiClassLoader)
            if (wifiClazz == null) {
                Logger.warn("Failed to find WifiServiceImpl class")
                return
            }
            hookWifiServiceImpl(wifiClazz)
        } else if (Build.VERSION.SDK_INT >= Build.VERSION_CODES.R) {
            val cSystemServiceManager = Reflection.findClassIfExists(
                "com.android.server.SystemServiceManager", classLoader)
            if (cSystemServiceManager == null) {
                Logger.warn("Failed to find SystemServiceManager")
                return
            }
            cSystemServiceManager.hookAllMethods("loadClassFromLoader", Hooker { chain ->
                val original = chain.proceed()
                if (chain.args[0] == "com.android.server.wifi.WifiService") {
                    kotlin.runCatching {
                        val classloader = chain.args[1] as PathClassLoader
                        val wifiClazz = classloader.loadClass("com.android.server.wifi.WifiServiceImpl")
                        hookWifiServiceImpl(wifiClazz)
                    }.onFailure {
                        Logger.error("Failed to hook WifiService", it)
                    }
                }
                original
            })
        }
    }

    fun installTargetApp(classLoader: ClassLoader, packageName: String, uid: Int) {
        val capabilities = Reflection.findClassIfExists("android.net.NetworkCapabilities", classLoader)
            ?: return
        capabilities.hookAllMethods("getTransportInfo", Hooker { chain ->
            val original = chain.proceed()
            if (original !is WifiInfo || !shouldRewrite(packageName, uid)) return@Hooker original
            val hasWifiTransport = runCatching {
                Reflection.callMethod(chain.thisObject, "hasTransport", NetworkCapabilities.TRANSPORT_WIFI) == true
            }.getOrDefault(false)
            if (!hasWifiTransport || !isVisibleWifiInfo(original)) return@Hooker original
            val synthetic = runCatching { buildWifiInfo(currentProfile(packageName, uid)) }.getOrNull()
                ?: disconnectedWifiInfo()
            if (synthetic == null && FakeLoc.enableDebugLog) {
                Logger.warn("NetworkCapabilities.getTransportInfo: synthetic WifiInfo unavailable for $packageName")
            }
            synthetic
        })
    }

    private fun hookWifiServiceImpl(wifiClazz: Class<*>) {
        wifiClazz.hookAllMethods("getConnectionInfo", Hooker { chain ->
            // Run the framework path first. It enforces the caller's location permission and
            // returns a redacted/disconnected WifiInfo when the caller may not see SSID/BSSID.
            val original = chain.proceed() as? WifiInfo ?: return@Hooker disconnectedWifiInfo()
            val packageName = chain.args.firstOrNull() as? String
            if (packageName.isNullOrEmpty() || !shouldRewrite(packageName)) return@Hooker original
            if (!isRealWifiConnected(original)) return@Hooker original
            // Never return null for WifiManager.getConnectionInfo(): the platform API is non-null
            // and a null here becomes an app-side NPE. A disconnected synthetic record is the
            // fail-closed value when a full profile cannot be constructed.
            val info = buildWifiInfo(currentProfile(packageName)) ?: disconnectedWifiInfo()
            if (FakeLoc.enableDebugLog) Logger.debug("getConnectionInfo: procedural $packageName")
            info
        })

        wifiClazz.hookAllMethods("getScanResults", Hooker { chain ->
            // Preserve an empty result: it carries the real permission/Wi-Fi-off state.
            val original = chain.proceed()
            val packageName = chain.args.firstOrNull() as? String
            if (packageName.isNullOrEmpty() || !shouldRewrite(packageName)) return@Hooker original
            if (scanResultCount(original) == 0) return@Hooker original
            val generated = buildScanResults(currentProfile(packageName))
            if (generated.isEmpty()) return@Hooker emptyList<ScanResult>()
            val result = when (val existing = original) {
                null -> {
                    val returnType = (chain.executable as? java.lang.reflect.Method)?.returnType
                    if (returnType != null && returnType.name.contains("ParceledListSlice")) {
                        sliceOrNull(returnType, generated) ?: return@Hooker emptyList<ScanResult>()
                    } else {
                        generated
                    }
                }
                is List<*> -> generated
                is Array<*> -> generated.toTypedArray()
                // WifiManager.getScanResults() is non-null; an empty list is the fail-closed
                // value when the OEM return type cannot be constructed. Never leak the real list.
                else -> sliceOrNull(existing.javaClass, generated) ?: return@Hooker emptyList<ScanResult>()
            }
            if (FakeLoc.enableDebugLog) Logger.debug("getScanResults: ${generated.size} procedural APs for $packageName")
            result
        })
    }

    private fun isRealWifiConnected(info: WifiInfo): Boolean =
        info.supplicantState == SupplicantState.COMPLETED &&
            !info.ssid.isNullOrBlank() &&
            !info.ssid.contains("unknown ssid", ignoreCase = true) &&
            !info.bssid.isNullOrBlank() &&
            info.bssid != REDACTED_BSSID

    private fun scanResultCount(value: Any?): Int = when (value) {
        null -> 0
        is List<*> -> value.size
        is Array<*> -> value.size
        else -> runCatching {
            (Reflection.callMethod(value, "getList") as? List<*>)?.size ?: 1
        }.getOrDefault(1)
    }

    private fun shouldRewrite(packageName: String, uid: Int = BinderUtils.getCallerUid()): Boolean =
        WifiCallerPolicy.mayRewrite(packageName, uid) && FakeLoc.enable && FakeLoc.enableMockWifi &&
            ListenerRouting.decisionFor(packageName, uid) != com.system.location.service.core.routing.RoutingDecision.Deny

    private fun currentProfile(packageName: String? = null, uid: Int = BinderUtils.getCallerUid()): EnvironmentProfile {
        val snapshot = FakeLoc.runtimeSnapshots.current()
        val route = ListenerRouting.decisionFor(packageName, uid)
        val point = when (route) {
            com.system.location.service.core.routing.RoutingDecision.Deny -> Wgs84(snapshot.latitude, snapshot.longitude)
            is com.system.location.service.core.routing.RoutingDecision.Point -> route.point
            is com.system.location.service.core.routing.RoutingDecision.Scenario -> FakeLoc.snapshotForScenario(route.scenarioId).let {
                Wgs84(it.latitude, it.longitude)
            }
            com.system.location.service.core.routing.RoutingDecision.Global -> Wgs84(snapshot.latitude, snapshot.longitude)
        }
        val config = snapshot.configuration
        synchronized(profileLock) {
            refreshFingerprintSource(config.wifiFingerprintCatalogJson, config.wifiFingerprintEnabled)
            val key = WifiProfileCacheKey(
                point = point,
                seed = snapshot.environmentSeed,
                apCount = snapshot.environmentApCount,
                environmentVersion = snapshot.environmentVersion,
                sourceMode = snapshot.environmentSourceMode,
                fingerprintEnabled = config.wifiFingerprintEnabled,
                fingerprintRevision = fingerprintRevision,
            )
            cachedProfile?.let { if (cachedKey == key) return it }
            val now = System.currentTimeMillis()
            val fingerprint = fingerprintProfile(point, now, snapshot.environmentSeed, config.wifiFingerprintEnabled)
            val replay = if (snapshot.environmentSourceMode == EnvironmentSourceMode.PROCEDURAL) null else snapshot.environment
            val result = fingerprint
                ?: replay?.let { profile -> runCatching { ReplayEnvironmentSource(profile).profileAt(point, snapshot.environmentSeed, now) }.getOrNull() }
                    ?.takeIf { it.wifi.isNotEmpty() }
                ?: source(snapshot.environmentApCount).profileAt(point, snapshot.environmentSeed, now)
            return result.also {
                cachedKey = key
                cachedProfile = it
            }
        }
    }

    private fun refreshFingerprintSource(json: String?, enabled: Boolean) {
        if (cachedFingerprintJson == json && cachedFingerprintEnabled == enabled) return
        cachedFingerprintJson = json
        cachedFingerprintEnabled = enabled
        fingerprintRevision = Math.addExact(fingerprintRevision, 1L)
        cachedFingerprintSource = if (!enabled || json.isNullOrBlank()) null else {
            runCatching { FingerprintWifiSource(WifiFingerprintImporter.importJson(json).catalog.database()) }
                .onFailure { if (FakeLoc.enableDebugLog) Logger.debug("wifi fingerprint parse failed: ${it.message}") }
                .getOrNull()
        }
    }

    private fun fingerprintProfile(point: Wgs84, nowMillis: Long, seed: Long, enabled: Boolean): EnvironmentProfile? {
        if (!enabled) return null
        return cachedFingerprintSource?.profileAt(point, seed, nowMillis)
    }

    private fun source(apCount: Int): ProceduralWifiSource {
        if (sourceApCount != apCount) {
            source = ProceduralWifiSource(EnvironmentConfig(apPerCell = apCount))
            sourceApCount = apCount
            cachedKey = null
            cachedProfile = null
        }
        return source
    }

    private fun buildScanResults(profile: EnvironmentProfile): List<ScanResult> {
        val baseTimestamp = SystemClock.elapsedRealtimeNanos() / 1_000L
        return profile.wifi.mapIndexed { index, ap ->
            syntheticWifiScanResult(ap, baseTimestamp + index * 137L)
        }
    }

    private fun buildWifiInfo(profile: EnvironmentProfile): WifiInfo? {
        val ap = profile.connectedWifi() ?: profile.wifi.maxByOrNull { it.rssi } ?: return null
        return runCatching { syntheticWifiInfo(ap, FakeLoc.environmentSeed) }.getOrNull()
    }

    /**
     * Non-null, disconnected fallback that preserves the WifiInfo API contract without exposing
     * any real connection field. Used only when the synthetic profile cannot be constructed.
     */
    private fun disconnectedWifiInfo(): WifiInfo? = runCatching {
        Reflection.newInstance(WifiInfo::class.java) as WifiInfo
    }.getOrNull()?.apply {
        listOf<Pair<String, Any>>(
            "setSupplicantState" to SupplicantState.DISCONNECTED,
            "setBSSID" to REDACTED_BSSID,
            "setNetworkId" to -1,
            "setIpAddress" to 0,
            "setMacAddress" to "02:00:00:00:00:00",
            "setRssi" to -127,
            "setFrequency" to 0,
            "setLinkSpeed" to 0,
        ).forEach { (method, value) ->
            runCatching { Reflection.callMethod(this, method, value) }
        }
    }

    private fun isVisibleWifiInfo(info: WifiInfo): Boolean =
        !info.ssid.isNullOrBlank() && !info.ssid.contains("unknown ssid", ignoreCase = true) &&
            !info.bssid.isNullOrBlank() && info.bssid != REDACTED_BSSID

    private fun sliceOrNull(type: Class<*>, values: List<ScanResult>): Any? =
        if (type.name.contains("ParceledListSlice")) {
            runCatching {
                val constructor = type.getConstructor(List::class.java)
                if (!constructor.isAccessible) constructor.isAccessible = true
                constructor.newInstance(values)
            }.onFailure { Logger.error("getScanResults: ParceledListSlice failed", it) }.getOrNull()
        } else {
            Logger.error("getScanResults: unknown return type ${type.name}")
            null
        }

    private const val REDACTED_BSSID = "02:00:00:00:00:00"
}

internal fun syntheticWifiMac(seed: Long, bssid: String): String {
    val random = kotlin.random.Random(seed xor bssid.lowercase().hashCode().toLong())
    return buildString {
        append("02")
        repeat(5) { append(':').append("%02x".format(random.nextInt(256))) }
    }
}

/** WifiInfo stores IPv4 as a little-endian Int; keep this address synthetic and RFC1918. */
internal fun syntheticWifiIpv4(bssid: String): Int {
    val hash = bssid.lowercase().hashCode()
    val octets = intArrayOf(10, 64 + ((hash ushr 16) and 0x3f), (hash ushr 8) and 0xff, 2 + (hash and 0x7d))
    return octets[0] or (octets[1] shl 8) or (octets[2] shl 16) or (octets[3] shl 24)
}
```

`xposed/src/main/java/com/system/location/service/hook/privacy/AppOpsHook.kt`:

```kt
package com.system.location.service.hook.privacy

import android.app.AppOpsManager
import android.os.Binder
import io.github.libxposed.api.XposedInterface.Hooker
import com.system.location.service.hook.runtime.Reflection
import com.system.location.service.hook.scope.HookInstaller
import com.system.location.service.hook.utils.BinderUtils
import com.system.location.service.hook.utils.FakeLoc
import com.system.location.service.core.privacy.AppOpsVisibilityPolicy
import com.system.location.service.hook.utils.Logger

/**
 * Hides `OP_MOCK_LOCATION` from third-party callers that inspect another package's AppOps state
 * (P1-02, work package 9).
 *
 * The controller (Portal itself) still receives the real mode because it asks about its own UID;
 * system/shell callers (uid < 10000) and the controller's self-check are deliberately left
 * untouched. Two surfaces are covered:
 *
 * 1. `checkOperation(code, callingUid, callingPid, packageName[, rawMode])` — the AOSP signature
 *    carries the CALLER uid in `callingUid`; the queried package is identified by `packageName`
 *    and its uid is resolved here. (The previous implementation passed `callingUid` as the
 *    queried uid, so `queriedUid == callerUid` always failed the self-check rule and the hiding
 *    never fired.)
 * 2. `getOpsForPackage` / `getUidOps` — privileged enumerators (they need `PACKAGE_USAGE_STATS`
 *    or system privileges, but a detector may legitimately hold them). Baseline for a package
 *    that is not the mock provider is *absence* of the mock_location entry, so the entry is
 *    removed from the reply instead of being rewritten to a mode value.
 *
 * `AppOpsManager.PackageOps` / `Op` are @hide, so every touch goes through reflection and any
 * reflection failure falls back to the original reply (fail-open to the pre-hook baseline).
 */
object AppOpsHook {
    fun hook(classLoader: ClassLoader): Boolean {
        val service = Reflection.findClassIfExists("com.android.server.appop.AppOpsService", classLoader)
            ?: return false

        val checkCallback = Hooker { chain ->
            val original = chain.proceed()
            if (original !is Int) return@Hooker original
            val ints = chain.args.filterIsInstance<Int>()
            if (ints.isEmpty() || ints[0] != AppOpsVisibilityPolicy.OP_MOCK_LOCATION) {
                return@Hooker original
            }
            // AOSP signature: (code, callingUid, callingPid, packageName[, rawMode]).
            val packageName = chain.args.filterIsInstance<String>().firstOrNull()
            val callerUid = Binder.getCallingUid()
            val queriedUid = resolveQueriedUid(packageName) ?: return@Hooker original
            if (!AppOpsVisibilityPolicy.shouldHideMockLocation(ints[0], queriedUid, callerUid)) {
                return@Hooker original
            }
            if (FakeLoc.enableDebugLog) {
                Logger.debug("AppOps hidden mock_location queried=$packageName/$queriedUid caller=$callerUid")
            }
            // Baseline answer for a non-mock package (see AppOpsVisibilityPolicy.HIDDEN_MODE_BASELINE).
            AppOpsManager.MODE_ERRORED
        }

        val opsForPackageCallback = Hooker { chain ->
            val original: Any? = chain.proceed()
            if (original == null) return@Hooker null
            val identity = packageOpsIdentity(original) ?: return@Hooker original
            val (packageName, uid) = identity
            val callerUid = Binder.getCallingUid()
            if (!AppOpsVisibilityPolicy.shouldHideMockLocation(
                    AppOpsVisibilityPolicy.OP_MOCK_LOCATION,
                    uid,
                    callerUid,
                )
            ) {
                return@Hooker original
            }
            val (changed, result) = withoutMockOp(original)
            if (changed && FakeLoc.enableDebugLog) {
                Logger.debug(
                    "AppOps getOpsForPackage removed mock_location for $packageName/$uid caller=$callerUid",
                )
            }
            if (changed) result else original
        }

        val uidOpsCallback = Hooker { chain ->
            val original: Any? = chain.proceed()
            if (original == null) return@Hooker null
            val list = original as? List<*> ?: return@Hooker original
            val callerUid = Binder.getCallingUid()
            var changed = false
            val sanitized = list.map { entry ->
                entry ?: return@map entry
                val identity = packageOpsIdentity(entry) ?: return@map entry
                val (_, uid) = identity
                if (!AppOpsVisibilityPolicy.shouldHideMockLocation(
                        AppOpsVisibilityPolicy.OP_MOCK_LOCATION,
                        uid,
                        callerUid,
                    )
                ) {
                    return@map entry
                }
                val (entryChanged, result) = withoutMockOp(entry)
                if (entryChanged) {
                    changed = true
                    result
                } else {
                    entry
                }
            }
            if (changed && FakeLoc.enableDebugLog) {
                Logger.debug("AppOps getUidOps removed mock_location entries for caller=$callerUid")
            }
            if (changed) sanitized else original
        }

        var installed = false
        for (name in CHECK_METHODS) {
            val hooks = HookInstaller.hookAllMethods(service, name, checkCallback)
            installed = installed || hooks.isNotEmpty()
        }
        // Enumerators are optional across versions; absence only narrows the covered surface.
        for ((name, callback) in listOf(
            "getOpsForPackage" to opsForPackageCallback,
            "getUidOps" to uidOpsCallback,
        )) {
            val hooks = HookInstaller.hookAllMethods(service, name, callback)
            if (hooks.isEmpty() && FakeLoc.enableDebugLog) {
                Logger.debug("AppOpsService.$name not found; enumerator surface uncovered")
            }
        }
        if (!installed) {
            Logger.warn("AppOpsService.checkOperation* not found; OP_MOCK_LOCATION cannot be hidden")
        }
        return installed
    }

    /**
     * Resolves the queried package's uid from its name. Returns null (fail-open to the real
     * answer) when the package cannot be resolved — hiding must never widen its own authority by
     * guessing identities.
     */
    private fun resolveQueriedUid(packageName: String?): Int? {
        if (packageName.isNullOrEmpty()) return null
        return runCatching {
            BinderUtils.getSystemContext()?.packageManager?.getApplicationInfo(packageName, 0)?.uid
        }.getOrNull()
    }

    /** (packageName, uid) of a PackageOps reply entry, read reflectively. */
    private fun packageOpsIdentity(entry: Any): Pair<String, Int>? = runCatching {
        val packageName = entry.javaClass.getMethod("getPackageName").invoke(entry) as? String
            ?: return null
        val uid = entry.javaClass.getMethod("getUid").invoke(entry) as Int
        packageName to uid
    }.getOrNull()

    /**
     * Removes the mock_location op entry from a PackageOps reply. Returns the original entry
     * unchanged when it carries no mock_location op or the reply cannot be rebuilt.
     */
    private fun withoutMockOp(entry: Any): Pair<Boolean, Any> = runCatching {
        val identity = packageOpsIdentity(entry) ?: return false to entry
        val (packageName, uid) = identity
        if (!AppOpsVisibilityPolicy.shouldHideMockLocation(
                AppOpsVisibilityPolicy.OP_MOCK_LOCATION,
                uid,
                Binder.getCallingUid(),
            )
        ) {
            return false to entry
        }
        val ops = entry.javaClass.getMethod("getOps").invoke(entry) as? List<*>
            ?: return false to entry
        val filtered = ops.filterNot { opEntry ->
            opEntry == null ||
                runCatching {
                    opEntry.javaClass.getField("op").getInt(opEntry)
                }.getOrDefault(-1) == AppOpsVisibilityPolicy.OP_MOCK_LOCATION
        }
        if (filtered.size == ops.size) return false to entry
        val constructor = entry.javaClass.constructors.firstOrNull { candidate ->
            candidate.parameterTypes.size == 3 &&
                candidate.parameterTypes[0] == String::class.java &&
                candidate.parameterTypes[1] == Integer.TYPE &&
                List::class.java.isAssignableFrom(candidate.parameterTypes[2])
        } ?: return false to entry
        true to constructor.newInstance(packageName, uid, filtered)
    }.getOrDefault(false to entry)

    private val CHECK_METHODS = listOf("checkOperation", "checkOperationImpl")
}
```

`xposed/src/main/java/com/system/location/service/hook/privacy/SettingsHook.kt`:

```kt
package com.system.location.service.hook.privacy

import android.content.Context
import android.database.MatrixCursor
import android.net.Uri
import android.os.Binder
import android.os.Bundle
import io.github.libxposed.api.XposedInterface.Hooker
import com.system.location.service.hook.runtime.Reflection
import com.system.location.service.hook.scope.HookInstaller
import com.system.location.service.hook.utils.FakeLoc
import com.system.location.service.hook.utils.Logger
import com.system.location.service.core.privacy.SettingsPrivacyPolicy

/**
 * Hides the two Settings keys that reveal a mock-location setup (P1-03):
 *
 * - `Settings.Secure.mock_location` / legacy `allow_mock_location`
 *
 * Developer-options and adb keys are intentionally not rewritten: they are not caused by mock
 * location, and a false answer is cross-checkable against build properties and device policy.
 * The hook only changes answers for third-party callers (uid >= 10000); System/Settings UI
 * callers keep the real values, so developer options and the mock-location app picker still work.
 * `SettingsProvider.call` is the path used by `Settings.Secure.getString`; the `query` path is
 * handled as a fallback for clients that read the provider directly.
 */
object SettingsHook {
    @Volatile private var installed = false

    fun hook(classLoader: ClassLoader): Boolean {
        if (installed) return true
        val provider = Reflection.findClassIfExists(
            "com.android.providers.settings.SettingsProvider",
            classLoader,
        ) ?: settingsPackageLoader()?.let { loader ->
            Reflection.findClassIfExists("com.android.providers.settings.SettingsProvider", loader)
        } ?: return false

        val callHook = HookInstaller.hookAllMethods(provider, "call", Hooker { chain ->
            val original = chain.proceed()
            if (!SettingsPrivacyPolicy.shouldHide(Binder.getCallingUid())) return@Hooker original
            val strings = chain.args.filterIsInstance<String>()
            if (strings.size < 2) return@Hooker original
            val command = strings[0]
            val key = strings[1]
            if (!SettingsPrivacyPolicy.isRestricted(command, key)) return@Hooker original
            val reply = original as? Bundle ?: return@Hooker original
            // AOSP SettingsProvider returns only the "value" entry. Adding the key name would
            // make the Bundle itself a hook fingerprint.
            // Baseline preservation: when the key is absent on this device, the stock reply has
            // no "value" entry at all. Writing one here would fabricate a value that the system
            // never stored, so only existing answers are rewritten (work package 9).
            if (!reply.containsKey("value")) return@Hooker original
            reply.putString("value", SettingsPrivacyPolicy.HIDDEN_VALUE)
            if (FakeLoc.enableDebugLog) {
                Logger.debug("Settings hidden $command/$key from uid=${Binder.getCallingUid()}")
            }
            reply
        })

        val queryHook = HookInstaller.hookAllMethods(provider, "query", Hooker { chain ->
            val original = chain.proceed()
            if (!SettingsPrivacyPolicy.shouldHide(Binder.getCallingUid())) return@Hooker original
            val uri = chain.args.filterIsInstance<Uri>().firstOrNull() ?: return@Hooker original
            val key = uri.lastPathSegment ?: return@Hooker original
            if (!SettingsPrivacyPolicy.isQueryKey(key)) return@Hooker original
            // Contract preservation: mirror the original cursor shape exactly — same column set,
            // same row count. An absent key stays absent (empty cursor passes through untouched)
            // and present rows keep every column value except the restricted "value" entry.
            // Fabricating a one-column cursor would itself be a queryable fingerprint.
            // NOTE: the provider-side cursor must be returned open; it is closed by the transport
            // layer, so this code must not wrap it in Cursor.use.
            val cursor = original as? android.database.Cursor ?: return@Hooker original
            if (!cursor.moveToFirst()) return@Hooker cursor
            val columns = cursor.columnNames
            val valueIndex = columns.indexOfFirst { it.equals("value", ignoreCase = true) }
            val row = Array<Any?>(columns.size) { index ->
                if (index == valueIndex) SettingsPrivacyPolicy.HIDDEN_VALUE
                else runCatching { cursor.getString(index) }.getOrNull()
            }
            MatrixCursor(columns).apply { addRow(row) }
        })

        com.system.location.service.hook.runtime.HookRuntime.log(
            "settings hook class=${provider.name} call=${callHook.size} query=${queryHook.size}"
        )

        val hooked = callHook.isNotEmpty() || queryHook.isNotEmpty()
        if (hooked) installed = true
        return hooked
    }

    /** SettingsProvider is a package loaded into system_server on some ROMs; resolve its loader. */
    private fun settingsPackageLoader(): ClassLoader? = runCatching {
        val activityThreadClass = Class.forName("android.app.ActivityThread")
        val activityThread = activityThreadClass.getMethod("currentActivityThread").invoke(null)
        val systemContext = activityThreadClass.getMethod("getSystemContext").invoke(activityThread) as Context
        systemContext.createPackageContext(
            "com.android.providers.settings",
            Context.CONTEXT_INCLUDE_CODE or Context.CONTEXT_IGNORE_SECURITY,
        ).classLoader
    }.getOrNull()
}
```

`xposed/src/main/java/com/system/location/service/hook/privacy/StackTraceCleanHook.kt`:

```kt
package com.system.location.service.hook.privacy

import com.system.location.service.core.privacy.StackCleanPolicy
import com.system.location.service.hook.scope.HookInstaller
import com.system.location.service.hook.utils.FakeLoc
import io.github.libxposed.api.XposedInterface

/**
 * Experimental stack-frame cleaning (default off).
 *
 * Strategies come from [StackCleanPolicy]:
 * - FILTER removes this module's frames and the libxposed dispatch frames that a detector would
 *   otherwise see in a callback invoked from a hooked method. It cannot change
 *   `getStackTraceDepth()` (the native count), so the reported length diverges from the native
 *   depth — a known, reproducible artifact.
 * - REPLACE rewrites module frames in place with a neutral frame, keeping the reported array
 *   length identical to the uncleaned depth. Length parity is not invisibility; the neutral
 *   frame is a constant and cause chains are left alone (known boundary).
 *
 * Both are opt-in experiments; neither is a default strategy, and both must be validated with the
 * canary application. `get_anti_detect_state` publishes the two switches from the controller.
 */
object StackTraceCleanHook {
    fun install(classLoader: ClassLoader) {
        val throwable = runCatching { Class.forName("java.lang.Throwable", false, classLoader) }.getOrNull()
        val thread = runCatching { Class.forName("java.lang.Thread", false, classLoader) }.getOrNull()
        val hooker = XposedInterface.Hooker { chain ->
            val original = chain.proceed()
            val mode = currentMode()
            if (mode == StackCleanPolicy.Mode.OFF) return@Hooker original
            if (FakeLoc.enableDebugLog && mode == StackCleanPolicy.Mode.REPLACE) {
                // REPLACE is the newer experiment: make its activation visible in diagnostics.
                com.system.location.service.hook.utils.Logger.debug("stack-clean mode=replace")
            }
            clean(original, mode)
        }
        throwable?.let { HookInstaller.hookAllMethods(it, "getStackTrace", hooker) }
        thread?.let { HookInstaller.hookAllMethods(it, "getStackTrace", hooker) }
    }

    internal fun currentMode(): StackCleanPolicy.Mode = when {
        !FakeLoc.stackTraceCleanEnabled -> StackCleanPolicy.Mode.OFF
        FakeLoc.stackTraceReplaceEnabled -> StackCleanPolicy.Mode.REPLACE
        else -> StackCleanPolicy.Mode.FILTER
    }

    private fun clean(value: Any?, mode: StackCleanPolicy.Mode): Any? {
        val frames = value as? Array<StackTraceElement>
            ?: (value as? Array<*>)?.mapNotNull { it as? StackTraceElement }?.toTypedArray()
            ?: return value
        if (!StackCleanPolicy.hasModuleFrames(frames)) return value
        return when (mode) {
            StackCleanPolicy.Mode.FILTER -> StackCleanPolicy.filter(frames)
            StackCleanPolicy.Mode.REPLACE -> StackCleanPolicy.replace(frames)
            StackCleanPolicy.Mode.OFF -> value
        }
    }
}
```

`xposed/src/main/java/com/system/location/service/hook/runtime/BackgroundQuery.kt`:

```kt
package com.system.location.service.hook.runtime

import java.util.concurrent.Executor
import java.util.concurrent.ForkJoinPool
import java.util.concurrent.atomic.AtomicBoolean

/** Reuse platform workers; a slow Binder call must not stall a looper or build a polling queue. */
internal class BackgroundQuery(private val executor: Executor = ForkJoinPool.commonPool()) {
    private val pending = AtomicBoolean()

    fun <T> submit(read: () -> T, receive: (Result<T>) -> Unit): Boolean {
        if (!pending.compareAndSet(false, true)) return false
        try {
            executor.execute {
                try { receive(runCatching(read)) }
                finally { pending.set(false) }
            }
        } catch (failure: RuntimeException) {
            pending.set(false)
            throw failure
        }
        return true
    }
}
```

```kt
package com.system.location.service.hook.runtime

import android.os.IBinder
import android.os.IInterface

/** Local metadata only. The wire row contains no listener proxy or module-defined object. */
internal data class CallbackSubscription(
    val listener: IInterface,
    val uid: Int,
    val packageName: String? = null,
    val providers: List<String> = emptyList(),
    val lastDeliveryKey: String? = null,
    val pendingDeliveryKey: String? = null,
    val nextDeliveryIndex: Int = 0,
) {
    init {
        require(nextDeliveryIndex >= 0 && (pendingDeliveryKey != null || nextDeliveryIndex == 0))
    }
    fun toBundle(): android.os.Bundle = android.os.Bundle().apply {
        putBinder("binder", listener.asBinder())
        putString("descriptor", listener.asBinder().interfaceDescriptor)
        putInt("uid", uid)
        putString("package", packageName)
        putStringArrayList("providers", ArrayList(providers))
        putString("last_delivery", lastDeliveryKey)
        putString("pending_delivery", pendingDeliveryKey)
        putInt("next_delivery_index", nextDeliveryIndex)
    }
    fun encode(): Array<Any?> {
        val binder = listener.asBinder()
        return arrayOf(binder, binder.interfaceDescriptor, uid, packageName, providers.toTypedArray(), lastDeliveryKey,
            pendingDeliveryKey, nextDeliveryIndex)
    }

    companion object {
        fun fromBundle(bundle: android.os.Bundle,
            resolve: (String, IBinder) -> IInterface = ::frameworkCallback): CallbackSubscription? {
            @Suppress("DEPRECATION")
            val binder = bundle.getBinder("binder") ?: return null
            val descriptor = bundle.getString("descriptor") ?: return null
            val providers = bundle.getStringArrayList("providers")?.toList().orEmpty()
            return decode(arrayOf(binder, descriptor, bundle.getInt("uid"),
                bundle.getString("package"), providers.toTypedArray(), bundle.getString("last_delivery"),
                bundle.getString("pending_delivery"), bundle.getInt("next_delivery_index")), resolve)
        }

        fun decode(row: Array<*>, resolve: (String, IBinder) -> IInterface = ::frameworkCallback): CallbackSubscription? {
            require(row.size in 5..6 || row.size == 8)
            val binder = row[0] as IBinder
            if (!binder.isBinderAlive) return null
            val descriptor = row[1] as String
            require(descriptor.startsWith("android.location.")) { "Unexpected callback interface" }
            require(binder.interfaceDescriptor == descriptor) { "Callback interface changed" }
            val uid = row[2] as Int
            val packageName = row[3] as String?
            val providers = (row[4] as Array<*>).map { it as String }
            val callback = try { resolve(descriptor, binder) }
            catch (dead: android.os.DeadObjectException) { return null }
            check(callback.asBinder() == binder)
            return CallbackSubscription(callback, uid, packageName, providers, row.getOrNull(5) as String?,
                row.getOrNull(6) as String?, row.getOrNull(7) as Int? ?: 0)
        }

        private fun frameworkCallback(descriptor: String, binder: IBinder): IInterface =
            Class.forName("${descriptor}\$Stub", false, ClassLoader.getSystemClassLoader())
                .getDeclaredMethod("asInterface", IBinder::class.java).invoke(null, binder) as IInterface
    }
}
```

```kt
package com.system.location.service.hook.runtime

/** Keeps a framework one-shot delivery intact after it applies permission-level filtering. */
internal object CurrentLocationDelivery {
    private data class Delivery(val owner: Any, val sample: () -> Any?)
    private val current = ThreadLocal<Delivery>()

    val active: Boolean get() = current.get() != null

    fun sampleFor(owner: Any?): Any? = current.get()?.takeIf { it.owner === owner }?.sample?.invoke()

    fun <T> during(owner: Any, sample: () -> Any?, deliver: () -> T): T {
        val previous = current.get()
        current.set(Delivery(owner, sample))
        return try { deliver() } finally {
            if (previous == null) current.remove() else current.set(previous)
        }
    }
}
```

`xposed/src/main/java/com/system/location/service/hook/runtime/DeferredServiceConnection.kt`:

```kt
package com.system.location.service.hook.runtime

/** A bounded, coalesced connection job. Scheduling never runs Binder work on the caller. */
internal class DeferredServiceConnection(
    private val schedule: (Long, () -> Unit) -> Unit,
    private val connect: () -> Boolean,
    private val onFailure: (Exception) -> Unit,
    private val maxAttempts: Int = 60,
) {
    private val lock = Any()
    private var running = false
    private var connected = false

    init { require(maxAttempts > 0) }

    fun start() {
        synchronized(lock) {
            if (running || connected) return
            running = true
        }
        enqueue(0)
    }

    private fun enqueue(attempt: Int) {
        try {
            schedule(if (attempt == 0) 0L else minOf(250L * attempt, 2_000L)) {
                attemptConnection(attempt)
            }
        } catch (failure: Exception) {
            synchronized(lock) { running = false }
            onFailure(failure)
        }
    }

    private fun attemptConnection(attempt: Int) {
        var interrupted = false
        val ready = try { connect() } catch (failure: Exception) {
            if (failure is InterruptedException) {
                Thread.currentThread().interrupt()
                interrupted = true
            }
            onFailure(failure)
            false
        }
        synchronized(lock) {
            if (ready) connected = true
            if (ready || interrupted || attempt + 1 >= maxAttempts) {
                running = false
                return
            }
        }
        enqueue(attempt + 1)
    }
}
```

`xposed/src/main/java/com/system/location/service/hook/runtime/DeliveryWorker.kt`:

```kt
package com.system.location.service.hook.runtime

import java.util.concurrent.TimeUnit

/** A replacement starts only after the previous callback has returned, including after timeout. */
internal class DeliveryWorker(
    private val name: String,
    private val intervalMillis: () -> Long,
    private val delayFirstTick: Boolean = false,
    private val tick: () -> Unit,
    private val failure: (Exception) -> Unit,
) {
    private class Run {
        @Volatile var stopping = false
        lateinit var thread: Thread
        val wakeup = Object()
        var requested = false // guarded by wakeup; multiple publications coalesce
    }

    private var current: Run? = null
    private var restartRequested = false

    @Synchronized fun start() {
        val run = current
        if (run != null) {
            if (run.stopping) restartRequested = true
            return
        }
        launch()
    }

    /** Wake the existing producer without running callbacks on the publishing thread. */
    fun requestTick() {
        val run = synchronized(this) { current?.takeUnless { it.stopping } } ?: return
        synchronized(run.wakeup) {
            run.requested = true
            run.wakeup.notifyAll()
        }
    }

    /** Returns true only when the stopped thread has exited. Never waits for itself. */
    fun stop(timeoutMillis: Long = 2000): Boolean {
        require(timeoutMillis in 0L..60_000L)
        val run = synchronized(this) {
            restartRequested = false
            current?.also { it.stopping = true; it.thread.interrupt() }
        } ?: return true
        if (run.thread === Thread.currentThread()) return false
        // Thread.join(0) means an unlimited wait, not a zero-duration poll.
        if (timeoutMillis > 0) run.thread.join(timeoutMillis)
        return !run.thread.isAlive
    }

    private fun launch() {
        val run = Run()
        run.thread = Thread({
            try {
                if (delayFirstTick) pause(run)
                while (!run.stopping && !Thread.currentThread().isInterrupted) {
                    try { tick() }
                    catch (interrupted: InterruptedException) { throw interrupted }
                    catch (error: Exception) { failure(error) }
                    if (!run.stopping) pause(run)
                }
            } catch (_: InterruptedException) {
                Thread.currentThread().interrupt()
            } finally {
                synchronized(this) {
                    check(current === run)
                    current = null
                    if (restartRequested) {
                        restartRequested = false
                        launch()
                    }
                }
            }
        }, name).apply { isDaemon = true }
        current = run
        run.thread.start()
    }

    private fun pause(run: Run) {
        val duration = TimeUnit.MILLISECONDS.toNanos(intervalMillis().also { require(it > 0) })
        val deadline = System.nanoTime() + duration
        synchronized(run.wakeup) {
            var remaining = duration
            while (!run.requested && !run.stopping && remaining > 0) {
                TimeUnit.NANOSECONDS.timedWait(run.wakeup, remaining)
                remaining = deadline - System.nanoTime()
            }
            run.requested = false
        }
    }
}
```

`xposed/src/main/java/com/system/location/service/hook/runtime/HookRuntime.kt`:

```kt
package com.system.location.service.hook.runtime

import android.util.Log
import io.github.libxposed.api.XposedInterface
import java.lang.reflect.InvocationTargetException
import java.lang.reflect.Constructor
import java.lang.reflect.Executable
import java.lang.reflect.Method
import java.util.concurrent.CopyOnWriteArrayList

/** Process-local framework access. Interceptors use the native libxposed chain directly. */
object HookRuntime {
    @Volatile internal var executionGate = ReloadExecutionGate()
    @Volatile private var framework: XposedInterface? = null
    private val handles = CopyOnWriteArrayList<XposedInterface.HookHandle>()
    internal fun attachedInterface(): XposedInterface? = framework
    fun attach(value: XposedInterface) { framework = value }
    fun interfaceInstance(): XposedInterface = checkNotNull(framework) {
        "libxposed module has not been loaded"
    }
    internal fun track(handle: XposedInterface.HookHandle) {
        handles.add(handle)
    }
    fun clearHooks() {
        handles.forEach { runCatching { it.unhook() } }
        handles.clear()
    }
    fun log(message: String) {
        framework?.log(Log.INFO, "Portal", message) ?: Log.i("Portal", message)
    }
    fun log(error: Throwable) {
        val message = error.message ?: error.javaClass.name
        framework?.log(Log.ERROR, "Portal", message, error) ?: Log.e("Portal", message, error)
    }
    /** Listener delivery skips our hooks and exposes the listener's actual exception. */
    fun invokeOriginalMethod(method: Method, receiver: Any?, args: Array<Any?>): Any? = try {
        interfaceInstance().getInvoker(method)
            .setType(XposedInterface.Invoker.Type.ORIGIN)
            .invoke(receiver, *args)
    } catch (error: InvocationTargetException) {
        throw error.targetException
    }

    /** A queued interceptor from a retired snapshot must execute the successor's complete chain. */
    internal fun invokeCurrentChain(executable: Executable, receiver: Any?, args: Array<Any?>): Any? = try {
        when (executable) {
            is Method -> interfaceInstance().getInvoker(executable)
                .setType(XposedInterface.Invoker.Type.Chain.FULL).invoke(receiver, *args)
            is Constructor<*> -> interfaceInstance().getInvoker(executable)
                .setType(XposedInterface.Invoker.Type.Chain.FULL).invoke(receiver, *args)
            else -> error("Unsupported executable: $executable")
        }
    } catch (error: InvocationTargetException) {
        throw error.targetException
    }
}
```

`xposed/src/main/java/com/system/location/service/hook/runtime/Reflection.kt`:

```kt
package com.system.location.service.hook.runtime

import java.lang.reflect.Field
import java.lang.reflect.InvocationTargetException
import java.lang.reflect.Method
import java.lang.reflect.Modifier

/** Reflection only: hook registration and outcomes belong to libxposed's native chain. */
object Reflection {
    fun findClass(name: String, loader: ClassLoader?): Class<*> =
        Class.forName(name, false, loader ?: ClassLoader.getSystemClassLoader())

    fun findClassIfExists(name: String, loader: ClassLoader?): Class<*>? =
        try { findClass(name, loader) } catch (_: ClassNotFoundException) { null }

    fun findMethodExact(type: Class<*>, name: String, vararg parameters: Class<*>): Method =
        findMethodExactIfExists(type, name, *parameters)
            ?: throw NoSuchMethodException("${type.name}#$name(${parameters.joinToString { it.name }})")

    fun findMethodExactIfExists(type: Class<*>, name: String, vararg parameters: Class<*>): Method? =
        hierarchy(type).firstNotNullOfOrNull { parent ->
            try { parent.getDeclaredMethod(name, *parameters).apply { isAccessible = true } }
            catch (_: NoSuchMethodException) { null }
        }

    fun findMethodBestMatch(type: Class<*>, name: String, vararg args: Any?): Method =
        bestMethod(type, name, args.map { if (it is Class<*>) it else it?.javaClass })

    private fun bestMethod(type: Class<*>, name: String, args: List<Class<*>?>, static: Boolean? = null): Method {
        val methods = (hierarchy(type).flatMap { it.declaredMethods.asSequence() } + type.methods.asSequence())
            .filter { it.name == name && (static == null || Modifier.isStatic(it.modifiers) == static) }
            // Prefer a subclass declaration over the same signature inherited from its parent.
            .distinctBy { it.parameterTypes.toList() }
            .toList()
        return select(methods, args) { it.parameterTypes }.apply { isAccessible = true }
    }

    fun findField(type: Class<*>, name: String): Field = findFieldIfExists(type, name)
        ?: throw NoSuchFieldException("${type.name}#$name")

    fun findFieldIfExists(type: Class<*>, name: String): Field? =
        hierarchy(type).firstNotNullOfOrNull { parent ->
            try { parent.getDeclaredField(name).apply { isAccessible = true } }
            catch (_: NoSuchFieldException) { null }
        }

    fun getObjectField(instance: Any?, name: String): Any? =
        findField(requireNotNull(instance).javaClass, name).get(instance)

    fun getStaticObjectField(type: Class<*>, name: String): Any? = findField(type, name).get(null)

    fun setObjectField(instance: Any?, name: String, value: Any?) {
        findField(requireNotNull(instance).javaClass, name).set(instance, value)
    }

    fun getStaticIntField(type: Class<*>, name: String): Int = findField(type, name).getInt(null)
    fun getIntField(instance: Any?, name: String): Int = findField(requireNotNull(instance).javaClass, name).getInt(instance)
    fun setIntField(instance: Any?, name: String, value: Int) {
        findField(requireNotNull(instance).javaClass, name).setInt(instance, value)
    }

    fun callMethod(instance: Any?, name: String, vararg args: Any?): Any? {
        val target = requireNotNull(instance)
        return invoke(bestMethod(target.javaClass, name, args.map { it?.javaClass }, false), target, args)
    }

    fun callStaticMethod(type: Class<*>, name: String, vararg args: Any?): Any? =
        invoke(bestMethod(type, name, args.map { it?.javaClass }, true), null, args)

    private fun invoke(method: Method, receiver: Any?, args: Array<out Any?>): Any? = unwrap {
        // FULL is the default invoker type: ordinary reflected calls must retain other hooks.
        val framework = HookRuntime.attachedInterface()
        if (framework == null) method.invoke(receiver, *args)
        else framework.getInvoker(method).invoke(receiver, *args)
    }

    fun newInstance(type: Class<*>, vararg args: Any?): Any = unwrap {
        val constructor = select(type.declaredConstructors.toList(), args.map { it?.javaClass }) { it.parameterTypes }
        constructor.isAccessible = true
        HookRuntime.attachedInterface()?.getInvoker(constructor)?.newInstance(*args)
            ?: constructor.newInstance(*args)
    }

    private fun <T> unwrap(action: () -> T): T = try { action() }
        catch (error: InvocationTargetException) { throw error.targetException }

    private fun hierarchy(type: Class<*>): Sequence<Class<*>> = generateSequence(type) { it.superclass }

    private fun <T> select(candidates: List<T>, args: List<Class<*>?>, parameters: (T) -> Array<Class<*>>): T {
        val ranked = candidates.mapNotNull { candidate ->
            cost(parameters(candidate), args)?.let { candidate to it }
        }
        // An interface supertype may be further away than Object in the graph, but is still
        // more specific. Remove dominated signatures before applying conversion costs.
        val specific = ranked.filter { candidate ->
            ranked.none { other -> moreSpecific(parameters(other.first), parameters(candidate.first)) }
        }
        val best = specific.minOfOrNull { it.second }
            ?: throw NoSuchMethodException("No matching member for ${args.map { it?.name }}")
        val tied = specific.filter { it.second == best }.map { it.first }
        if (tied.size == 1) return tied.single()
        return tied.singleOrNull { candidate ->
            tied.all { other -> candidate == other || moreSpecific(parameters(candidate), parameters(other)) }
        } ?: throw NoSuchMethodException("Ambiguous member for ${args.map { it?.name }}")
    }

    private fun moreSpecific(left: Array<Class<*>>, right: Array<Class<*>>): Boolean =
        left.indices.all { right[it].isAssignableFrom(left[it]) } && !left.contentEquals(right)

    private fun cost(parameters: Array<Class<*>>, args: List<Class<*>?>): Int? {
        if (parameters.size != args.size) return null
        var total = 0
        for (index in parameters.indices) {
            val parameter = parameters[index]
            val argument = args[index]
            total += when {
                argument == null -> if (parameter.isPrimitive) return null else 0
                parameter == argument -> 0
                parameter.isPrimitive -> {
                    val primitive = unbox(argument)
                    if (primitive == parameter) 1 else {
                        val widening = widenings[primitive]?.indexOf(parameter) ?: -1
                        if (widening < 0) return null else 3 + widening
                    }
                }
                parameter.isAssignableFrom(argument) -> 10 + distance(argument, parameter)
                else -> return null
            }
        }
        return total
    }

    private fun distance(from: Class<*>, to: Class<*>): Int {
        var frontier = setOf(from)
        val seen = mutableSetOf<Class<*>>()
        var steps = 0
        while (frontier.isNotEmpty()) {
            if (to in frontier) return steps
            seen.addAll(frontier)
            frontier = frontier.flatMap { listOfNotNull(it.superclass) + it.interfaces }.filterNot { it in seen }.toSet()
            steps++
        }
        return steps
    }

    private fun unbox(type: Class<*>): Class<*> = wrappers[type] ?: type
    private val wrappers = mapOf(
        java.lang.Boolean::class.java to Boolean::class.javaPrimitiveType!!,
        java.lang.Byte::class.java to Byte::class.javaPrimitiveType!!,
        java.lang.Character::class.java to Char::class.javaPrimitiveType!!,
        java.lang.Short::class.java to Short::class.javaPrimitiveType!!,
        java.lang.Integer::class.java to Int::class.javaPrimitiveType!!,
        java.lang.Long::class.java to Long::class.javaPrimitiveType!!,
        java.lang.Float::class.java to Float::class.javaPrimitiveType!!,
        java.lang.Double::class.java to Double::class.javaPrimitiveType!!,
    )
    private val widenings = mapOf(
        Byte::class.javaPrimitiveType to listOf(Short::class.javaPrimitiveType, Int::class.javaPrimitiveType, Long::class.javaPrimitiveType, Float::class.javaPrimitiveType, Double::class.javaPrimitiveType),
        Short::class.javaPrimitiveType to listOf(Int::class.javaPrimitiveType, Long::class.javaPrimitiveType, Float::class.javaPrimitiveType, Double::class.javaPrimitiveType),
        Char::class.javaPrimitiveType to listOf(Int::class.javaPrimitiveType, Long::class.javaPrimitiveType, Float::class.javaPrimitiveType, Double::class.javaPrimitiveType),
        Int::class.javaPrimitiveType to listOf(Long::class.javaPrimitiveType, Float::class.javaPrimitiveType, Double::class.javaPrimitiveType),
        Long::class.javaPrimitiveType to listOf(Float::class.javaPrimitiveType, Double::class.javaPrimitiveType),
        Float::class.javaPrimitiveType to listOf(Double::class.javaPrimitiveType),
    )
}
```

`xposed/src/main/java/com/system/location/service/hook/runtime/ReloadExecutionGate.kt`:

```kt
package com.system.location.service.hook.runtime

import java.util.IdentityHashMap
import java.util.concurrent.TimeUnit

/**
 * Drains a generation without retaining its code in the successor. Only platform objects cross
 * the boundary: an Object monitor, primitive counters and an empty platform map of active threads.
 * Nested calls from an existing reader remain allowed while a writer waits, avoiding read/write
 * upgrade deadlocks inside hooked framework methods.
 */
internal class ReloadExecutionGate private constructor(private val shared: Array<Any>,
    private val generation: Long) {
    constructor() : this(arrayOf(java.lang.Object(), longArrayOf(0L, 0L, 0L),
        IdentityHashMap<Thread, Int>()), 0L)

    private val monitor get() = shared[0] as java.lang.Object
    private val counters get() = shared[1] as LongArray
    @Suppress("UNCHECKED_CAST")
    private val readers get() = shared[2] as IdentityHashMap<Thread, Int>
    private var transitionOwner: Thread? = null
    val isFrozen: Boolean get() = synchronized(monitor) { counters[FROZEN] != 0L }

    fun <T> enter(action: (currentGeneration: Boolean) -> T): T {
        val thread = Thread.currentThread()
        val current = synchronized(monitor) {
            // A queued old interceptor can outlive replacement of its hook. The caller must
            // re-enter the current framework hook chain when this returns false.
            while (counters[FROZEN] != 0L && readers[thread] == null && transitionOwner !== thread)
                monitor.wait()
            readers[thread] = (readers[thread] ?: 0) + 1
            counters[ACTIVE]++
            counters[GENERATION] == generation
        }
        try { return action(current) }
        finally {
            synchronized(monitor) {
                val remaining = checkNotNull(readers[thread]) - 1
                if (remaining == 0) readers.remove(thread) else readers[thread] = remaining
                counters[ACTIVE]--
                monitor.notifyAll()
            }
        }
    }

    /** A timeout cancels the freeze; the same generation remains usable. */
    fun freeze(timeoutMillis: Long): Boolean = synchronized(monitor) {
        require(timeoutMillis in 0L..60_000L)
        check(readers[Thread.currentThread()] == null) { "Cannot reload from inside a hooked call" }
        if (counters[FROZEN] != 0L || counters[GENERATION] != generation) return false
        counters[FROZEN] = 1L
        transitionOwner = Thread.currentThread()
        val started = System.nanoTime()
        val timeout = TimeUnit.MILLISECONDS.toNanos(timeoutMillis)
        try {
            while (counters[ACTIVE] != 0L) {
                val remaining = timeout - (System.nanoTime() - started)
                if (remaining <= 0L) { thaw(); return false }
                monitor.wait(remaining / 1_000_000L, (remaining % 1_000_000L).toInt())
            }
            true
        } catch (interrupted: InterruptedException) {
            thaw()
            throw interrupted
        }
    }

    fun transferState(): Array<Any> = synchronized(monitor) {
        check(counters[FROZEN] == 1L && counters[ACTIVE] == 0L && readers.isEmpty())
        check(counters[GENERATION] == generation)
        shared
    }

    fun resume() = synchronized(monitor) {
        check(counters[GENERATION] == generation) { "A retired generation cannot resume delivery" }
        thaw()
    }

    private fun thaw() {
        counters[FROZEN] = 0L
        transitionOwner = null
        monitor.notifyAll()
    }

    companion object {
        private const val ACTIVE = 0
        private const val FROZEN = 1
        private const val GENERATION = 2

        fun adopt(shared: Array<Any>): ReloadExecutionGate {
            require(shared.size == 3 && shared[0].javaClass == java.lang.Object::class.java &&
                shared[1] is LongArray && shared[2].javaClass == IdentityHashMap::class.java)
            val monitor = shared[0] as java.lang.Object
            return synchronized(monitor) {
                val counters = shared[1] as LongArray
                require(counters.size == 3 && counters[FROZEN] == 1L && counters[ACTIVE] == 0L &&
                    (shared[2] as Map<*, *>).isEmpty())
                counters[GENERATION] = Math.addExact(counters[GENERATION], 1L)
                ReloadExecutionGate(shared, counters[GENERATION]).also {
                    it.transitionOwner = Thread.currentThread()
                }
            }
        }

    }
}
```

`xposed/src/main/java/com/system/location/service/hook/runtime/ReloadPreparation.kt`:

```kt
package com.system.location.service.hook.runtime

/** A rejected/failed handoff must leave the current generation able to resume delivery. */
internal object ReloadPreparation {
    fun prepare(pauseLocation: () -> Boolean, pauseGnss: () -> Boolean,
        save: () -> Unit, abort: () -> Unit): Boolean {
        var prepared = false
        var failure: Throwable? = null
        try {
            // Always quiesce both producers, including when the first one times out.
            val locationStopped = pauseLocation()
            val gnssStopped = pauseGnss()
            if (!locationStopped || !gnssStopped) return false
            save()
            prepared = true
            return true
        } catch (error: Throwable) {
            failure = error
            throw error
        } finally {
            if (!prepared) try { abort() } catch (rollback: Throwable) {
                if (failure == null) throw rollback
                if (rollback !== failure) failure.addSuppressed(rollback)
            }
        }
    }
}
```

`xposed/src/main/java/com/system/location/service/hook/scope/HookInstaller.kt`:

```kt
package com.system.location.service.hook.scope

import com.system.location.service.hook.runtime.HookRuntime
import com.system.location.service.hook.runtime.Reflection
import io.github.libxposed.api.XposedInterface
import io.github.libxposed.api.XposedInterface.HookHandle
import io.github.libxposed.api.XposedInterface.Hooker
import java.lang.reflect.Executable
import java.lang.reflect.Member
import java.util.concurrent.atomic.AtomicBoolean

/** Observes the first invocation without installing a second probe hook. */
object HookInstaller {
    fun hookMethod(
        member: Member,
        callback: Hooker,
        priority: Int = XposedInterface.PRIORITY_DEFAULT,
        exceptionMode: XposedInterface.ExceptionMode = XposedInterface.ExceptionMode.PROTECTIVE,
    ): HookHandle {
        val executable = member as? Executable
            ?: throw IllegalArgumentException("Only methods and constructors can be hooked: $member")
        val key = member.toString()
        val matched = AtomicBoolean(false)
        val generation = HookRuntime.executionGate
        val handle = try {
            HookRuntime.interfaceInstance().hook(executable)
                .setPriority(priority)
                .setExceptionMode(exceptionMode)
                .intercept { chain ->
                    generation.enter { current ->
                        if (!current) HookRuntime.invokeCurrentChain(chain.executable, chain.thisObject, chain.args.toTypedArray())
                        else {
                            if (matched.compareAndSet(false, true)) HookStatusRegistry.matched(key)
                            callback.intercept(chain)
                        }
                    }
                }
        } catch (error: Throwable) {
            HookStatusRegistry.record(key, HookStatus(supported = true, failed = true,
                reason = error.javaClass.simpleName))
            throw error
        }
        HookStatusRegistry.installed(key)
        HookRuntime.track(handle)
        // A call can arrive while the framework is still returning the registration handle.
        if (matched.get()) HookStatusRegistry.matched(key)
        return handle
    }

    fun hookAllMethods(
        type: Class<*>, name: String, callback: Hooker,
        priority: Int = XposedInterface.PRIORITY_DEFAULT,
        exceptionMode: XposedInterface.ExceptionMode = XposedInterface.ExceptionMode.PROTECTIVE,
    ): Set<HookHandle> {
        val methods = type.declaredMethods.filter { it.name == name }
        if (methods.isEmpty()) HookStatusRegistry.record("${type.name}#$name",
            HookStatus(skipped = true, reason = "Method absent"))
        return methods.mapTo(mutableSetOf()) { hookMethod(it, callback, priority, exceptionMode) }
    }

    fun hookAllConstructors(type: Class<*>, callback: Hooker): Set<HookHandle> =
        type.declaredConstructors.mapTo(mutableSetOf()) { hookMethod(it, callback) }

    fun findMethod(type: Class<*>, name: String, vararg parameters: Class<*>): java.lang.reflect.Method? {
        val method = Reflection.findMethodExactIfExists(type, name, *parameters)
        if (method == null) HookStatusRegistry.record("${type.name}#$name(${parameters.joinToString { it.name }})",
            HookStatus(skipped = true, reason = "Method absent"))
        return method
    }
}
```

`xposed/src/main/java/com/system/location/service/hook/scope/HookOwnership.kt`:

```kt
package com.system.location.service.hook.scope

/** Ownership audit for one hooked process: which entry points should exist and which responded. */
data class HookOwnershipReport(
    val scope: HookScope,
    val expected: List<String>,
    val recorded: List<String>,
    val missing: List<String>,
    val installed: Int,
    val matched: Int,
    val failed: Int,
    val skipped: Int,
) {
    val healthy: Boolean get() = missing.isEmpty() && failed == 0
}

/**
 * Static ownership table for P0-04.
 *
 * The table is intentionally small: it names the top-level hook installers. Method-level hook points
 * still live in [HookStatusRegistry] under their own keys and show up in `hook_details`.
 */
object HookOwnership {
    private val expectedByScope: Map<HookScope, List<String>> = mapOf(
        HookScope.SYSTEM_SERVER to listOf(
            "system-location",
            "appops",
            "provider-registry",
            "availability",
            "telephony-registry",
            "wifi",
            "fused",
            "sensor",
            "system-sdk",
            "package-metadata",
        ),
        HookScope.PHONE_PROCESS to listOf("phone"),
        HookScope.FUSED_PROCESS to listOf("fused"),
        HookScope.VENDOR_LOCATION_PROCESS to listOf("oplus", "xiaomi"),
        HookScope.SETTINGS_PROVIDER to listOf("settings"),
        HookScope.TARGET_APP to emptyList(),
    )

    fun expectedFor(scope: HookScope): List<String> = expectedByScope[scope].orEmpty()

    fun audit(scope: HookScope, statuses: Map<String, HookStatus>): HookOwnershipReport {
        val expected = expectedFor(scope)
        val recorded = expected.filter { statuses.containsKey(it) }
        val missing = expected.filterNot { statuses.containsKey(it) }
        val relevant = expected.mapNotNull { statuses[it] }
        return HookOwnershipReport(
            scope = scope,
            expected = expected,
            recorded = recorded,
            missing = missing,
            installed = relevant.count { it.installed },
            matched = relevant.count { it.matched },
            failed = relevant.count { it.failed },
            skipped = relevant.count { it.skipped },
        )
    }
}
```

`xposed/src/main/java/com/system/location/service/hook/scope/HookScopeResolver.kt`:

```kt
package com.system.location.service.hook.scope

enum class HookScope { SYSTEM_SERVER, PHONE_PROCESS, FUSED_PROCESS, VENDOR_LOCATION_PROCESS, SETTINGS_PROVIDER, TARGET_APP }

data class ProcessIdentity(val packageName: String, val processName: String, val uid: Int,
    val sdk: Int, val manufacturer: String)

object HookScopeResolver {
    fun resolve(identity: ProcessIdentity, targets: Set<String> = emptySet()): HookScope? = with(identity) {
        if (uid < 0 || sdk < 31) return null
        when {
            packageName == "android" && processName in setOf("android", "system_server") && uid == 1000 -> HookScope.SYSTEM_SERVER
            packageName == "com.android.phone" && processName == packageName -> HookScope.PHONE_PROCESS
            packageName == "com.android.location.fused" && processName == packageName -> HookScope.FUSED_PROCESS
            packageName in setOf("com.xiaomi.location.fused", "com.oplus.location") && processName == packageName -> HookScope.VENDOR_LOCATION_PROCESS
            packageName == "com.android.providers.settings" && processName == packageName -> HookScope.SETTINGS_PROVIDER
            packageName in targets && (processName == packageName || processName.startsWith("$packageName:")) &&
                uid % 100000 in 10000..89999 -> HookScope.TARGET_APP
            else -> null
        }
    }
}
```

`xposed/src/main/java/com/system/location/service/hook/scope/HookStatus.kt`:

```kt
package com.system.location.service.hook.scope

import java.util.concurrent.ConcurrentHashMap

data class HookStatus(val supported: Boolean = false, val installed: Boolean = false,
    val matched: Boolean = false, val skipped: Boolean = false, val reason: String? = null,
    val failed: Boolean = false)

/** Bounded, in-memory diagnostics. No log or disk writes on a location callback. */
object HookStatusRegistry {
    private val entries = ConcurrentHashMap<String, HookStatus>()
    @Volatile private var processScope: HookScope? = null

    fun record(point: String, status: HookStatus) {
        if (entries.size < 2048 || entries.containsKey(point)) entries[point] = status
    }
    fun matched(point: String) {
        entries.computeIfPresent(point) { _, old -> old.copy(matched = true) }
    }
    fun installed(point: String) {
        entries.compute(point) { _, old -> (old ?: HookStatus()).copy(supported = true, installed = true, failed = false, skipped = false, reason = null) }
    }
    fun recordScope(scope: HookScope) { processScope = scope }
    fun scope(): HookScope? = processScope
    fun snapshot(): Map<String, HookStatus> = entries.toSortedMap()
    fun reset() {
        entries.clear()
        processScope = null
    }
}
```

`xposed/src/main/java/com/system/location/service/hook/security/CommandClient.kt`:

```kt
package com.system.location.service.hook.security

import android.location.LocationManager
import android.os.Bundle
import android.os.SystemClock

/** Serializes requests so sequence allocation and Binder delivery have the same order. */
class CommandClient {
    @Volatile private var token: String? = null
    private var sequence = 0L
    val connected: Boolean get() = token != null

    @Synchronized fun connect(manager: LocationManager): Boolean {
        token = null
        val reply = Bundle()
        if (!manager.sendExtraCommand(PROVIDER, "exchange_key", reply)) return false
        if (reply.getInt("protocol_version") != CommandSecurity.VERSION) return false
        token = reply.getString("key")
        sequence = 0
        return connected
    }

    @Synchronized fun send(manager: LocationManager, data: Bundle): Boolean {
        val key = token ?: return false
        data.putInt("protocol_version", CommandSecurity.VERSION)
        data.putLong("sequence", ++sequence)
        data.putLong("sent_at", SystemClock.elapsedRealtime())
        return manager.sendExtraCommand(PROVIDER, key, data)
    }

    companion object { const val PROVIDER = "fused_ext" }
}
```

`xposed/src/main/java/com/system/location/service/hook/security/CommandSecurity.kt`:

```kt
package com.system.location.service.hook.security

import java.security.SecureRandom

enum class CallerRole { CONTROLLER, PEER, DENIED }

/** Package ownership comes from PackageManager, never from the request Bundle. */
object CallerPolicy {
    const val CONTROLLER_PACKAGE = "com.system.location.service"
    val peerPackages = setOf("android", "com.android.phone", "com.android.location.fused",
        "com.xiaomi.location.fused", "com.oplus.location")

    fun resolve(uid: Int, packages: Set<String>, controllerUid: Int?, systemPackages: Set<String>): CallerRole {
        if (uid < 0 || packages.isEmpty()) return CallerRole.DENIED
        if (uid == controllerUid && packages == setOf(CONTROLLER_PACKAGE)) return CallerRole.CONTROLLER
        if (packages.any { it in peerPackages && it in systemPackages }) return CallerRole.PEER
        return CallerRole.DENIED
    }
}

/** One session per caller UID. A new handshake invalidates the previous session. */
class CommandSecurity(private val tokenFactory: () -> String = {
    ByteArray(32).also { SecureRandom().nextBytes(it) }.joinToString("") { "%02x".format(it) }
}) {
    private data class Session(val token: String, var sequence: Long = 0)
    private val sessions = mutableMapOf<Int, Session>()

    @Synchronized fun exchange(uid: Int, role: CallerRole): String? {
        if (role == CallerRole.DENIED) return null
        return tokenFactory().also { sessions[uid] = Session(it) }
    }

    @Synchronized fun accept(uid: Int, role: CallerRole, token: String, command: String?,
        version: Int, sequence: Long, sentAt: Long, now: Long): Boolean {
        if (role == CallerRole.DENIED || command !in commands || version != VERSION) return false
        if (role == CallerRole.PEER && command !in peerCommands) return false
        val session = sessions[uid] ?: return false
        if (token != session.token || sequence <= session.sequence || sentAt < 0 ||
            sentAt > now || now - sentAt > MAX_AGE_MS) return false
        session.sequence = sequence
        return true
    }

    companion object {
        const val VERSION = 1
        const val MAX_AGE_MS = 30_000L
        val peerCommands = setOf("sync_config", "set_proxy")
        val commands = peerCommands + setOf("start", "stop", "is_start", "start_gnss_mock",
            "stop_gnss_mock", "is_gnss_start", "is_wifi_mock_start", "start_wifi_mock",
            "stop_wifi_mock", "get_location", "get_listener_size", "get_speed", "get_bearing",
            "get_altitude", "set_altitude", "set_speed", "set_bearing",
            "update_location", "move", "put_config", "broadcast_location", "load_library", "publish_sample", "get_runtime_status",
            "native_prepare", "native_status")
    }
}
```

`xposed/src/main/java/com/system/location/service/hook/security/PublicationLease.kt`:

```kt
package com.system.location.service.hook.security

/** Pure monotonic freshness policy. All peer processes apply the same deadline. */
class PublicationLease(private val durationNanos: Long = 5_000_000_000L) {
    init { require(durationNanos > 0L) }
    private var latestSample = -1L
    private var deadline = -1L
    private fun fresh(sampleNanos: Long, nowNanos: Long) = sampleNanos >= 0 &&
        sampleNanos <= Long.MAX_VALUE - durationNanos && sampleNanos <= nowNanos &&
        nowNanos - sampleNanos < durationNanos
    @Synchronized fun accepts(sampleNanos: Long, nowNanos: Long): Boolean =
        sampleNanos > latestSample && fresh(sampleNanos, nowNanos)
    @Synchronized fun renew(sampleNanos: Long, nowNanos: Long): Boolean {
        if (!accepts(sampleNanos, nowNanos)) return false
        latestSample = sampleNanos
        deadline = sampleNanos + durationNanos
        return true
    }
    /** Full-state ordering is enforced by the caller; repeated samples keep their original deadline. */
    @Synchronized fun restore(sampleNanos: Long, nowNanos: Long): Boolean {
        if (!fresh(sampleNanos, nowNanos)) { clear(); return false }
        latestSample = sampleNanos
        deadline = sampleNanos + durationNanos
        return true
    }
    @Synchronized fun expired(nowNanos: Long) = deadline >= 0 && nowNanos >= deadline
    @Synchronized fun clear() { latestSample = -1; deadline = -1 }
}
```

`xposed/src/main/java/com/system/location/service/hook/security/SampleWire.kt`:

```kt
package com.system.location.service.hook.security

import android.os.Bundle
import com.system.location.service.core.config.SampleEnvelope
import com.system.location.service.core.geo.Wgs84
import com.system.location.service.core.location.LocationSample
import com.system.location.service.core.providers.ProviderKind

/**
 * Versioned primitive-only wire format, independent of class loaders and Parcelable models.
 *
 * v1 carries only the LocationSample fields. v2 adds optional provider/field/environment metadata;
 * readers accept v1 and v2, writers always emit v2. The app checks [isCompatible] instead of
 * pinning a single version so an old module can still feed the new controller until reboot.
 */
object SampleWire {
    const val MIN_SUPPORTED = 1
    const val VERSION = 2

    data class Metadata(
        val provider: ProviderKind? = null,
        val fieldsMask: Int = 0,
        val environmentVersion: Long = 0L,
        val configRevision: Long = 0L,
    )

    fun write(bundle: Bundle, sample: LocationSample, metadata: Metadata = Metadata()) = with(bundle) {
        putInt("sample_version", VERSION)
        putDouble("sample_lat", sample.latitude); putDouble("sample_lon", sample.longitude)
        putDouble("sample_altitude", sample.altitude); putFloat("sample_accuracy", sample.accuracy)
        putFloat("sample_speed", sample.speed); putFloat("sample_bearing", sample.bearing)
        putLong("sample_wall", sample.timeMillis); putLong("sample_elapsed", sample.elapsedNanos)
        putString("sample_provider", metadata.provider?.name ?: "")
        putInt("sample_fields_mask", metadata.fieldsMask)
        putLong("sample_environment_version", metadata.environmentVersion)
        putLong("sample_config_revision", metadata.configRevision)
    }

    fun read(bundle: Bundle): LocationSample? = readEnvelope(bundle)?.sample

    fun readEnvelope(bundle: Bundle): SampleEnvelope? = runCatching {
        val version = bundle.getInt("sample_version", 0)
        require(isCompatible(version))
        val sample = LocationSample(
            Wgs84(bundle.getDouble("sample_lat", Double.NaN), bundle.getDouble("sample_lon", Double.NaN)),
            bundle.getDouble("sample_altitude", Double.NaN),
            bundle.getFloat("sample_accuracy", Float.NaN),
            bundle.getFloat("sample_speed", Float.NaN),
            bundle.getFloat("sample_bearing", Float.NaN),
            bundle.getLong("sample_wall", -1),
            bundle.getLong("sample_elapsed", -1),
        )
        val provider = bundle.getString("sample_provider")
            ?.takeIf { it.isNotBlank() }
            ?.let { name -> ProviderKind.entries.firstOrNull { it.name == name } }
        SampleEnvelope(
            sample = sample,
            provider = provider,
            fieldsMask = bundle.getInt("sample_fields_mask", 0).coerceAtLeast(0),
            environmentVersion = bundle.getLong("sample_environment_version", 0L).coerceAtLeast(0L),
            configRevision = bundle.getLong("sample_config_revision", 0L).coerceAtLeast(0L),
        )
    }.getOrNull()

    fun isCompatible(version: Int): Boolean = version in MIN_SUPPORTED..VERSION
}
```

`xposed/src/main/java/com/system/location/service/hook/security/SensitiveLog.kt`:

```kt
package com.system.location.service.hook.security

/** P6-04: redact location/config payloads before writing a debug log line. */
object SensitiveLog {
    private val sensitiveKeys = setOf(
        "lat", "lon", "latitude", "longitude", "altitude",
        "sample_lat", "sample_lon", "sample_altitude",
        "environment_json", "routing_json", "gnss_capture", "gnss_navigation", "runtime_transfer", "proxy_session", "key", "token",
    )

    fun isSensitive(key: String): Boolean {
        val normalized = key.lowercase()
        return normalized in sensitiveKeys ||
            normalized.endsWith("_lat") || normalized.endsWith("_lon") ||
            normalized.endsWith("_latitude") || normalized.endsWith("_longitude")
    }

    fun describe(commandId: String?, values: Map<String, String?>): String {
        val fields = values.map { (key, value) ->
            "$key=${if (isSensitive(key)) "<redacted>" else value}"
        }.joinToString(", ")
        return "commandId=$commandId, rely={$fields}"
    }
}
```
