`xposed/src/main/java/com/system/location/service/hook/transport/SharedMemorySampleBuffer.kt`:

```kt
package com.system.location.service.hook.transport

import android.os.SharedMemory
import com.system.location.service.core.location.LocationSample
import com.system.location.service.core.runtime.SharedSampleHeader
import com.system.location.service.core.runtime.SharedSampleLayout
import java.io.Closeable
import java.nio.ByteBuffer

/**
 * P5-06: Android SharedMemory adapter for the contiguous header/two-slot layout.
 *
 * This class only owns the mapping. Binder fd transfer and the system_server-side mapping are not
 * wired yet; creation/mmap must be validated on a device before enabling the experimental path.
 */
class SharedMemorySampleBuffer private constructor(
    private val memory: SharedMemory,
    private val mapped: ByteBuffer,
) : Closeable {
    val size: Int get() = mapped.capacity()

    fun write(sample: LocationSample, sequence: Long, elapsedNanos: Long): SharedSampleHeader {
        val bytes = ByteArray(SharedSampleLayout.SIZE)
        val header = SharedSampleLayout.write(bytes, sample, sequence, elapsedNanos)
        mapped.position(0)
        mapped.put(bytes)
        return header
    }

    fun read(): Pair<SharedSampleHeader, LocationSample>? {
        val bytes = ByteArray(SharedSampleLayout.SIZE)
        mapped.position(0)
        mapped.get(bytes)
        return SharedSampleLayout.read(bytes)
    }

    override fun close() {
        runCatching { SharedMemory.unmap(mapped) }
        runCatching { memory.close() }
    }

    companion object {
        fun create(name: String = "portal-sample"): SharedMemorySampleBuffer {
            val memory = SharedMemory.create(name, SharedSampleLayout.SIZE)
            val mapped = memory.mapReadWrite()
            mapped.order(java.nio.ByteOrder.LITTLE_ENDIAN)
            return SharedMemorySampleBuffer(memory, mapped)
        }
    }
}
```

`xposed/src/main/java/com/system/location/service/hook/utils/BinderUtils.kt`:

```kt
@file:Suppress("LocalVariableName", "PrivateApi")
package com.system.location.service.hook.utils

import android.content.Context
import android.os.Binder
import android.os.Build
import android.content.pm.ApplicationInfo
import com.system.location.service.hook.security.CallerPolicy
import com.system.location.service.hook.security.CallerRole
import com.system.location.service.hook.runtime.HookRuntime


object BinderUtils {
    private fun getActivityContext(): Context? {
        // public static ActivityManagerService self()
        // frameworks/base/services/java/com/android/server/am/ActivityManagerService.java
        try {
            val cam = Class.forName("com.android.server.am.ActivityManagerService")
            val am = cam.getMethod("self").invoke(null) ?: return null
            val mContext = cam.getDeclaredField("mContext")
            mContext.isAccessible = true
            return mContext.get(am) as? Context
        } catch (e: Throwable) {
            return null
        }
    }

    fun getSystemContext(): Context? {
        try {
            val cActivityThread = Class.forName("android.app.ActivityThread")
            val activityThread = cActivityThread.getMethod("currentActivityThread")
                .invoke(null) ?: return null
            return (cActivityThread.getMethod("getSystemContext").invoke(activityThread) as? Context) ?: getActivityContext()
        } catch (e: Throwable) {
            e.printStackTrace()
        }
        return null
    }

    fun getUidPackageNames(context: Context = getSystemContext()!!, uid: Int = getCallerUid()): Array<String>? {
        val packageManager = context.packageManager
        return packageManager.getPackagesForUid(uid)
    }

    fun getCallerUid(): Int {
        return if (Build.VERSION.SDK_INT >= Build.VERSION_CODES.Q) {
            kotlin.runCatching { Binder.getCallingUidOrThrow() }.getOrNull() ?: -1
        } else {
            Binder.getCallingUid()
        }
    }

    /**
     * Check whether the `LocationService` is started properly
     */
    fun isLocationProviderEnabled(uid: Int): Boolean {
        return callerRole(uid) != CallerRole.DENIED
    }

    fun callerRole(uid: Int = getCallerUid()): CallerRole = runCatching {
        val pm = getSystemContext()?.packageManager ?: return CallerRole.DENIED
        val packages = pm.getPackagesForUid(uid)?.toSet() ?: return CallerRole.DENIED
        val userId = uid / 100000
        // getApplicationInfo resolves in the system user's context; appId is stable across users.
        val controllerUid = runCatching {
            userId * 100000 + pm.getApplicationInfo(CallerPolicy.CONTROLLER_PACKAGE, 0).uid % 100000
        }.getOrNull()
        val systemPackages = packages.filterTo(mutableSetOf()) { name ->
            val info = pm.getApplicationInfo(name, 0)
            info.flags and (ApplicationInfo.FLAG_SYSTEM or ApplicationInfo.FLAG_UPDATED_SYSTEM_APP) != 0
        }
        CallerPolicy.resolve(uid, packages, controllerUid, systemPackages)
    }.getOrDefault(CallerRole.DENIED)

    fun isSystemPackages(packageName: String): Boolean {
        if (packageName in setOf("com.xiaomi.location.fused", "com.xiaomi.metoknlp",
                "com.android.location.fused")) return false
        return packageName == "android" || packageName.startsWith("android.framework") ||
            listOf("com.android", "com.miui", "com.xiaomi", "com.oplus", "com.coloros",
                "com.heytap", "com.qualcomm", "com.google.android.permissioncontroller").any {
                packageName == it || packageName.startsWith("$it.")
            }
    }

    internal fun isCoreUid(uid: Int): Boolean = uid < 0 || uid % 100000 < 10000

    internal fun systemCallForPackages(uid: Int, packages: Collection<String>?): Boolean =
        isCoreUid(uid) || packages.isNullOrEmpty() || packages.any(::isSystemPackages)

    fun isSystemAppsCall(uid: Int = getCallerUid()): Boolean {
        if (isCoreUid(uid)) return true
        val packages = runCatching { getUidPackageNames(uid = uid)?.toList() }.getOrNull()
        // Check each shared-UID package independently: an allowed fused package must not
        // cancel another package's system status, and unknown callers keep physical state.
        return systemCallForPackages(uid, packages)
    }
}
```

```kt
package com.system.location.service.hook.utils

import android.location.Location
import com.system.location.service.core.environment.EnvironmentConfig
import android.os.SystemClock
import com.system.location.service.core.geo.Wgs84

import com.system.location.service.core.runtime.RuntimeSnapshotStore

object FakeLoc {
    /**
     * 是否允许打印日志
     */
    var enableLog: Boolean
        get() = runtimeSnapshots.current().configuration.logEnabled
        set(value) { updateSnapshot { it.copy(configuration = it.configuration.copy(logEnabled = value)) } }

    val runtimeSnapshots = RuntimeSnapshotStore()

    private fun updateSnapshot(transform: (RuntimeSnapshot) -> RuntimeSnapshot) {

    }

    /**
     * 是否允许打印调试日志
     */
    var enableDebugLog: Boolean
        get() = runtimeSnapshots.current().configuration.debugLog
        set(value) { updateSnapshot { it.copy(configuration = it.configuration.copy(debugLog = value)) } }

     */

        get() = runtimeSnapshots.current().configuration.enabled
        set(value) { updateSnapshot { it.copy(configuration = it.configuration.copy(enabled = value)) } }

    /**

     */
    var enableMockGnss: Boolean
        get() = runtimeSnapshots.current().configuration.gnssEnabled
        set(value) { updateSnapshot { it.copy(configuration = it.configuration.copy(gnssEnabled = value)) } }

    /**
     * 模拟WLAN数据（默认开启，仅在模拟定位启动时生效）
     */
    var enableMockWifi: Boolean
        get() = runtimeSnapshots.current().configuration.wifiEnabled
        set(value) { updateSnapshot { it.copy(configuration = it.configuration.copy(wifiEnabled = value)) } }

     * 是否禁用GetCurrentLocation方法（在部分系统不禁用可能导致hook失效）

    /** P5-02: per-scenario samples; routing falls back to the active fix when a scenario has none. */
    val scenarioSamples = com.system.location.service.core.runtime.ScenarioSampleStore()

    @Synchronized
    fun acceptScenarioSample(scenarioId: String, fix: LocationSample) {
        scenarioSamples.publish(scenarioId, fix, fix.elapsedNanos)
    }

    @Synchronized
    fun snapshotForScenario(
        scenarioId: String?,
        force: Boolean = false,
        now: Long = SystemClock.elapsedRealtimeNanos(),
        timeMillis: Long = System.currentTimeMillis(),
    ): LocationSample {
        if (scenarioId == null) return snapshot(force, now, timeMillis)
        return scenarioSamples.latest(scenarioId, now)?.sample ?: snapshot(force, now, timeMillis)
    }

    @Volatile var externallyDriven = false
        private set
    private var lastSampleNanos = 0L
    private var lastMovementNanos = 0L
    private var movementSpeed = 0f

    @Synchronized
    internal fun providerContext(force: Boolean, now: Long, timeMillis: Long): ProviderReadContext =
        ProviderReadContext(snapshotState(force, now, timeMillis), scenarioSamples.snapshot(now), timeMillis)

    @Synchronized
    fun captureTransfer(now: Long = SystemClock.elapsedRealtimeNanos()): RuntimeTransfer {
        require(now >= 0L)
        val state = runtimeSnapshots.current()
        val external = externallyDriven && state.configuration.enabled && state.sample != null
        return RuntimeTransfer(if (external) state else state.copy(sample = null, provider = null),
            external, scenarioSamples.snapshot(now), movementSpeed, lastMovementNanos)
    }

    /** Caller must order authenticated full restores against forwarded commands. */
    @Synchronized
    fun restoreRuntime(transfer: RuntimeTransfer, now: Long = SystemClock.elapsedRealtimeNanos()): RuntimeTransfer {
        val received = transfer.atReception(now)
        val previous = runtimeSnapshots.current()
        scenarioSamples.replace(received.scenarios)
        runtimeSnapshots.set(received.state)
        com.system.location.service.hook.hooks.telephony.CarrierSubscriptionCaches.onChanged(previous, received.state)
        externallyDriven = received.externallyDriven
        movementSpeed = received.movementSpeedMps
        lastMovementNanos = received.lastMovementNanos
        lastSampleNanos = maxOf(lastSampleNanos, received.state.sample?.elapsedNanos ?: 0L)
        return received
    }

    @Synchronized
    fun startRuntime(start: com.system.location.service.core.runtime.RuntimeStart,
        nowNanos: Long = SystemClock.elapsedRealtimeNanos()): RuntimeSnapshot {
        require(nowNanos >= 0L)
        val previous = runtimeSnapshots.current()
        val state = runtimeSnapshots.update(start::applyTo)
        com.system.location.service.hook.hooks.telephony.CarrierSubscriptionCaches.onChanged(previous, state)
        movementSpeed = 0f
        lastMovementNanos = nowNanos
        externallyDriven = false
        return state
    }

    @Synchronized
    fun configureRuntime(prepared: com.system.location.service.core.runtime.PreparedRuntimeConfiguration): RuntimeSnapshot {
        val previous = runtimeSnapshots.current()
        val published = runtimeSnapshots.update { current ->
            prepared.applyTo(current).let { next ->
                if (next.configuration.enabled) next else next.copy(sample = null, provider = null, hasBearings = false)
            }
        }
        com.system.location.service.hook.hooks.telephony.CarrierSubscriptionCaches.onChanged(previous, published)
        if (!published.configuration.enabled) {
            externallyDriven = false
            movementSpeed = 0f
            scenarioSamples.replace(emptyMap())
        }
        return published
    }

    @Synchronized
    fun stopRuntime(): RuntimeSnapshot {
        val previous = runtimeSnapshots.current()
        val stopped = runtimeSnapshots.update {
            it.copy(configuration = it.configuration.copy(enabled = false), hasBearings = false, sample = null, provider = null,
                configRevision = Math.addExact(it.configRevision, 1L))
        }
        com.system.location.service.hook.hooks.telephony.CarrierSubscriptionCaches.onChanged(previous, stopped)
        externallyDriven = false
        movementSpeed = 0f
        scenarioSamples.replace(emptyMap())
        return stopped
    }

    @Synchronized
    fun updateCoordinates(lat: Double, lon: Double, movingSpeed: Float = 0f,
        nowNanos: Long = SystemClock.elapsedRealtimeNanos(), bearingDeg: Double? = null) {
        val update = com.system.location.service.core.runtime.RuntimePositionUpdate(Wgs84(lat, lon), movingSpeed, bearingDeg)
        require(nowNanos >= 0L)
        runtimeSnapshots.update(update::applyTo)
        movementSpeed = movingSpeed
        lastMovementNanos = nowNanos
        externallyDriven = false
    }

    @Synchronized
    fun acceptSample(fix: LocationSample, scenarioId: String? = null) {
        scenarioId?.let { acceptScenarioSample(it, fix) }
        runtimeSnapshots.update {
            it.copy(
                latitude = fix.latitude,
                longitude = fix.longitude,
                altitudeMeters = fix.altitude,
                accuracyMeters = fix.accuracy.coerceAtLeast(0.1f),
                speedMps = fix.speed.toDouble().coerceAtLeast(0.0),
                bearingDeg = fix.bearing.toDouble(),
                hasBearings = true,
                sample = fix,
                configuration = it.configuration.copy(enabled = true),
                configRevision = Math.addExact(it.configRevision, 1L),
            )
        }
        externallyDriven = true
    }

    fun snapshot(force: Boolean = false, now: Long = SystemClock.elapsedRealtimeNanos(),
        timeMillis: Long = System.currentTimeMillis()): LocationSample = snapshotState(force, now, timeMillis).sample!!

    /** Return the policy and the sample from the same successful CAS, including on config races. */
    @Synchronized
    fun snapshotState(force: Boolean = false, now: Long = SystemClock.elapsedRealtimeNanos(),
        timeMillis: Long = System.currentTimeMillis()): RuntimeSnapshot {
        val nextSampleNanos = maxOf(now, Math.addExact(lastSampleNanos, 1))
        val published = runtimeSnapshots.update { state ->
            val interval = state.configuration.reportIntervalMs
            val existing = state.sample
            if (existing != null && (externallyDriven || (!force && now - existing.elapsedNanos < interval * 1_000_000))) {
                state
            } else state.copy(sample = LocationSample(
                Wgs84(state.latitude, state.longitude), state.altitudeMeters, state.accuracyMeters,
                if (now >= lastMovementNanos && now - lastMovementNanos <= maxOf(500L, interval * 2) * 1_000_000) movementSpeed else 0f,
                ((state.bearingDeg % 360 + 360) % 360).toFloat().coerceAtMost(359.99997f),
                timeMillis, nextSampleNanos,
            ))
        }
        lastSampleNanos = maxOf(lastSampleNanos, published.sample!!.elapsedNanos)
        return published
    }

    var accuracy: Float
        get() = runtimeSnapshots.current().accuracyMeters
        set(value) {
            runtimeSnapshots.update { it.copy(accuracyMeters = kotlin.math.abs(value).coerceAtLeast(0.1f)) }
        }

    fun haversine(lat1: Double, lon1: Double, lat2: Double, lon2: Double): Double =
        LocationGeometry.haversine(lat1, lon1, lat2, lon2)

    // Accuracy is metadata, not movement noise.
    fun jitterLocation(): Pair<Double, Double> = coordinatePair()

    fun moveLocation(lat: Double = latitude, lon: Double = longitude, n: Double, angle: Double = bearing): Pair<Double, Double> =
        LocationGeometry.moveLocation(lat, lon, n, angle)

    fun calculateBearing(latA: Double, lonA: Double, latB: Double, lonB: Double): Double =
        LocationGeometry.calculateBearing(latA, lonA, latB, lonB)
}
```

`xposed/src/main/java/com/system/location/service/hook/utils/LocationCallerGuard.kt`:

```kt
package com.system.location.service.hook.utils

import android.Manifest
import android.app.AppOpsManager
import android.content.pm.PackageManager
import android.location.LocationManager
import android.os.Binder
import android.provider.Settings

/**
 * Read-only checks for hooks that must stay on the framework's success path.
 *
 * The real value of these hooks is replacing data after Android has decided that the caller is
 * allowed to receive it. Returning a synthetic value before that decision makes a no-permission
 * application receive location/Wi-Fi/cell data, which is both a security bug and the easiest
 * possible "is a hook installed?" probe.
 */
internal object LocationCallerGuard {

    enum class Access { FINE, COARSE, DENIED }

    /** Permission + AppOps check for callers of a void/synchronous API. */
    fun access(): Access {
        val context = BinderUtils.getSystemContext() ?: return Access.FINE
        val uid = Binder.getCallingUid()
        val pid = Binder.getCallingPid()
        val fine = context.checkPermission(Manifest.permission.ACCESS_FINE_LOCATION, pid, uid) ==
            PackageManager.PERMISSION_GRANTED
        val coarse = context.checkPermission(Manifest.permission.ACCESS_COARSE_LOCATION, pid, uid) ==
            PackageManager.PERMISSION_GRANTED
        if (!fine && !coarse) return Access.DENIED
        val packageName = runCatching {
            context.packageManager.getPackagesForUid(uid)?.firstOrNull()
        }.getOrNull() ?: return Access.DENIED
        val ops = context.getSystemService(AppOpsManager::class.java) ?: return Access.FINE
        fun allowed(op: String): Boolean = runCatching {
            ops.unsafeCheckOpNoThrow(op, uid, packageName) == AppOpsManager.MODE_ALLOWED
        }.getOrDefault(true)
        return when {
            fine && allowed(AppOpsManager.OPSTR_FINE_LOCATION) -> Access.FINE
            coarse && allowed(AppOpsManager.OPSTR_COARSE_LOCATION) -> Access.COARSE
            else -> Access.DENIED
        }
    }

    fun canReadLocation(): Boolean = access() != Access.DENIED

    fun isCoarse(): Boolean = access() == Access.COARSE

    /**
     * The real user location switch. Read through Settings instead of LocationManager so the
     * module's own availability hook cannot answer this check for us.
     */
    fun isLocationEnabled(): Boolean {
        val context = BinderUtils.getSystemContext() ?: return true
        // LocationAvailabilityHook forwards the real framework answer, so this stays truthful.
        runCatching {
            context.getSystemService(LocationManager::class.java)?.isLocationEnabled()
        }.getOrNull()?.let { return it }
        val mode = runCatching {
            Settings.Secure.getInt(
                context.contentResolver,
                Settings.Secure.LOCATION_MODE,
                Settings.Secure.LOCATION_MODE_OFF,
            )
        }.getOrDefault(Settings.Secure.LOCATION_MODE_OFF)
        return mode != Settings.Secure.LOCATION_MODE_OFF
    }
}
```

`xposed/src/main/java/com/system/location/service/hook/utils/LocationGeometry.kt`:

```kt
package com.system.location.service.hook.utils

import kotlin.math.atan2
import kotlin.math.cos
import kotlin.math.pow
import kotlin.math.sin
import kotlin.math.sqrt
import kotlin.math.asin

/** Existing spherical movement model, separate from GNSS ellipsoidal observation geometry. */
internal object LocationGeometry {
    fun haversine(lat1: Double, lon1: Double, lat2: Double, lon2: Double): Double {
        val radius = 6371000.0
        val phi1 = Math.toRadians(lat1)
        val phi2 = Math.toRadians(lat2)
        val deltaPhi = Math.toRadians(lat2 - lat1)
        val deltaLambda = Math.toRadians(lon2 - lon1)
        val a = sin(deltaPhi / 2).pow(2) + cos(phi1) * cos(phi2) * sin(deltaLambda / 2).pow(2)
        val c = 2 * atan2(sqrt(a), sqrt(1 - a))
        return radius * c
    }

    fun moveLocation(lat: Double, lon: Double, n: Double, angle: Double): Pair<Double, Double> {
        require(n.isFinite() && n >= 0 && angle.isFinite())
        if (n == 0.0) return lat to lon
        val distance = n / 6371000.0
        val latitudeRadians = Math.toRadians(lat)
        val direction = Math.toRadians(angle)
        val newLat = asin((sin(latitudeRadians) * cos(distance) + cos(latitudeRadians) * sin(distance) * cos(direction)).coerceIn(-1.0, 1.0))
        val newLon = Math.toRadians(lon) + atan2(sin(direction) * sin(distance) * cos(latitudeRadians), cos(distance) - sin(latitudeRadians) * sin(newLat))
        return Math.toDegrees(newLat) to ((Math.toDegrees(newLon) + 540) % 360 - 180)
    }

    fun calculateBearing(latA: Double, lonA: Double, latB: Double, lonB: Double): Double {
        val lat1 = Math.toRadians(latA)
        val lon1 = Math.toRadians(lonA)
        val lat2 = Math.toRadians(latB)
        val lon2 = Math.toRadians(lonB)

        val deltaLon = lon2 - lon1

        val y = sin(deltaLon) * cos(lat2)
        val x = cos(lat1) * sin(lat2) - sin(lat1) * cos(lat2) * cos(deltaLon)

        var bearing = Math.toDegrees(atan2(y, x))
        bearing = (bearing + 360) % 360  // 标准化到0-360度

        return bearing
    }
}
```

`xposed/src/main/java/com/system/location/service/hook/utils/LocationHookArguments.kt`:

```kt
package com.system.location.service.hook.utils

/** Argument guards shared by hooks; unknown signatures must pass through untouched. */
internal object LocationHookArguments {
    fun canIntercept(enabled: Boolean, args: Array<out Any?>, callbackIndex: Int): Boolean =
        enabled && args.getOrNull(callbackIndex) != null

    inline fun <reified T> rewriteBatch(
        enabled: Boolean, args: Array<Any?>, index: Int, transform: (T) -> T
    ): Boolean {
        if (!enabled) return false
        val original = args.getOrNull(index) as? Array<*> ?: return false
        if (original.any { it !is T }) return false
        args[index] = original.map { transform(it as T) }.toTypedArray()
        return true
    }
}
```

`xposed/src/main/java/com/system/location/service/hook/utils/LocationSample.kt`:

```kt
package com.system.location.service.hook.utils

import android.location.Location
import android.location.LocationManager
import android.os.Build
import android.os.Bundle
import com.system.location.service.core.location.LocationSample
import com.system.location.service.core.location.LocationSanitizer
import com.system.location.service.core.gnss.GnssLocationExtras
import com.system.location.service.core.gnss.GnssFrameRoute
import com.system.location.service.hook.hooks.gnss.GnssReceiverRuntime
import com.system.location.service.core.runtime.RuntimeSnapshot
import com.system.location.service.core.providers.ProviderFieldMask
import com.system.location.service.core.providers.ProviderSample

/** Android conversion derives GPS extras from the same provider sample as status and NMEA. */
fun LocationSample.toLocation(provider: String?, route: GnssFrameRoute = GnssFrameRoute.Global,
    state: RuntimeSnapshot = FakeLoc.runtimeSnapshots.current(), validationAtMillis: Long = System.currentTimeMillis(),
    providerSample: ProviderSample? = null): Location {
    val sample = this
    val fields = LocationSanitizer.fieldsFor(sample)
    val effectiveProvider = provider ?: LocationManager.GPS_PROVIDER
    val policy = state.configuration
    val mslAltitude = providerSample?.mslAltitudeMeters
    val publication = if (policy.enabled && policy.gnssEnabled && effectiveProvider == LocationManager.GPS_PROVIDER)
        GnssReceiverRuntime.frameForSample(sample, route, state, validationAtMillis) else null
    // Each publication starts empty; absent fields need no API 33/34 removal calls.
    return Location(effectiveProvider).also {
        it.latitude = sample.latitude
        it.longitude = sample.longitude
        it.accuracy = sample.accuracy
        it.time = sample.timeMillis
        it.elapsedRealtimeNanos = sample.elapsedNanos
        fun has(mask: Int) = providerSample == null || providerSample.has(mask)
        if (has(ProviderFieldMask.ALTITUDE)) it.altitude = sample.altitude
        if (has(ProviderFieldMask.SPEED)) it.speed = sample.speed
        if (has(ProviderFieldMask.BEARING)) it.bearing = sample.bearing
        if (has(ProviderFieldMask.VERTICAL_ACCURACY)) {
            it.verticalAccuracyMeters = providerSample?.verticalAccuracyMeters ?: fields.verticalAccuracyMeters
        }
        if (has(ProviderFieldMask.SPEED_ACCURACY)) {
            it.speedAccuracyMetersPerSecond = providerSample?.speedAccuracyMps ?: fields.speedAccuracyMetersPerSecond
        }
        if (has(ProviderFieldMask.BEARING_ACCURACY)) {
            it.bearingAccuracyDegrees = providerSample?.bearingAccuracyDeg ?: fields.bearingAccuracyDegrees
        }
        if (has(ProviderFieldMask.ELAPSED_REALTIME_UNCERTAINTY)) {
            it.elapsedRealtimeUncertaintyNanos =
                (providerSample?.elapsedRealtimeUncertaintyNanos ?: fields.elapsedRealtimeUncertaintyNanos).toDouble()
        }
        if (Build.VERSION.SDK_INT >= Build.VERSION_CODES.UPSIDE_DOWN_CAKE &&
            providerSample?.has(ProviderFieldMask.MSL_ALTITUDE) == true && mslAltitude != null) {
            it.mslAltitudeMeters = mslAltitude
        }
        it.extras = if (effectiveProvider == LocationManager.GPS_PROVIDER) {
            // A GPS fix without the standard satellite extras is itself a fingerprint. Keep the
            // shape even when GNSS simulation is disabled; zero means no satellites used.
            val summary = publication?.let(GnssLocationExtras::from)
            Bundle().apply {
                putInt("satellites", summary?.satellites ?: 0)
                putFloat("meanCn0", summary?.meanCn0DbHz ?: 0f)
                putFloat("maxCn0", summary?.maxCn0DbHz ?: 0f)
            }
        } else null
        it.isMock = !policy.hideMock
    }
}
```

`xposed/src/main/java/com/system/location/service/hook/utils/LogRateLimiter.kt`:

```kt
package com.system.location.service.hook.utils

/** Bounded per-key deduplication plus a global burst ceiling, using monotonic time. */
class LogRateLimiter(private val intervalNanos: Long = 5_000_000_000L, private val capacity: Int = 256,
    private val maxPerSecond: Int = 10) {
    private val last = LinkedHashMap<String, Long>()
    private var window = -1L
    private var count = 0
    @Synchronized fun allow(key: String, now: Long): Boolean {
        if (last[key]?.let { now - it < intervalNanos } == true) return false
        if (window < 0 || now - window >= 1_000_000_000L) { window = now; count = 0 }
        if (count >= maxPerSecond) return false
        if (key !in last && last.size >= capacity) last.remove(last.keys.first())
        last[key] = now
        count++
        return true
    }
}
```

`xposed/src/main/java/com/system/location/service/hook/utils/Logger.kt`:

```kt
package com.system.location.service.hook.utils

import com.system.location.service.hook.runtime.HookRuntime

object Logger {
    private val normal = LogRateLimiter()
    private val errors = LogRateLimiter()
    private fun write(level: String, msg: String, throwable: Throwable? = null) {
        if (level == "DEBUG" && (!FakeLoc.enableLog || !FakeLoc.enableDebugLog)) return
        if (level == "INFO" && !FakeLoc.enableLog) return
        val limiter = if (level == "ERROR" || level == "WARN") errors else normal
        if (!limiter.allow("$level:${msg.substringBefore(':').take(120)}", System.nanoTime())) return
        HookRuntime.log("[LocationService][$level] $msg" + (throwable?.let { ": ${it.stackTraceToString()}" } ?: ""))
    }
    fun info(msg: String) = write("INFO", msg)
    fun info(msg: String, throwable: Throwable) = write("INFO", msg, throwable)
    fun debug(msg: String) = write("DEBUG", msg)
    fun debug(msg: String, throwable: Throwable) = write("DEBUG", msg, throwable)
    fun error(msg: String) = write("ERROR", msg)
    fun error(msg: String, throwable: Throwable) = write("ERROR", msg, throwable)
    fun warn(msg: String) = write("WARN", msg)
    fun warn(msg: String, throwable: Throwable) = write("WARN", msg, throwable)
}
```

`xposed/src/main/java/com/system/location/service/hook/utils/ProviderView.kt`:

```kt
package com.system.location.service.hook.utils

import android.location.LocationManager
import com.system.location.service.core.location.LocationSample
import com.system.location.service.core.playback.NoiseProfile
import com.system.location.service.core.playback.PhysicalNoise
import com.system.location.service.core.providers.ProviderKind
import com.system.location.service.core.providers.ProviderMixer
import com.system.location.service.core.providers.ProviderSample
import com.system.location.service.core.runtime.RuntimeSnapshot
import com.system.location.service.core.gnss.GnssFrameRoute
import com.system.location.service.core.geo.Wgs84

/** One delivery's immutable configuration and leased samples, with provider views memoized locally. */
class ProviderReadContext internal constructor(
    val state: RuntimeSnapshot,
    scenarios: Map<String, LocationSample>,
    val validationAtMillis: Long,
) {
    private val scenarios = scenarios.toMap()
    private val views = mutableMapOf<Pair<String?, GnssFrameRoute>, ProviderLocationView>()
    init { require(state.sample != null) }

    internal fun base(route: GnssFrameRoute): LocationSample = when (route) {
        GnssFrameRoute.Global -> state.sample!!
        is GnssFrameRoute.FixedPoint -> state.sample!!.copy(coordinate = route.point, speed = 0f, bearing = 0f)
        is GnssFrameRoute.Scenario -> scenarios[route.id] ?: state.sample!!
    }

    @Synchronized
    internal fun view(provider: String?, route: GnssFrameRoute, create: () -> ProviderLocationView): ProviderLocationView =
        views.getOrPut(provider to route, create)
}

internal data class ProviderLocationView(val sample: LocationSample, val providerSample: ProviderSample?)

/** Provider-specific view of the current fake fix; shared by all injection paths (P4-03). */
object ProviderView {
    private val mixer = ProviderMixer()
    private var noise: PhysicalNoise? = null
    private var noiseSeed: Long? = null

    fun capture(now: Long = android.os.SystemClock.elapsedRealtimeNanos(),
        timeMillis: Long = System.currentTimeMillis(), force: Boolean = false): ProviderReadContext =
        FakeLoc.providerContext(force, now, timeMillis)

    fun sampleFor(provider: String?, scenarioId: String? = null, point: Wgs84? = null,
        context: ProviderReadContext = capture()): LocationSample =
        viewFor(provider, scenarioId, point, context).sample

    internal fun viewFor(provider: String?, scenarioId: String? = null, point: Wgs84? = null,
        context: ProviderReadContext = capture()): ProviderLocationView {
        val route = when {
            point != null -> GnssFrameRoute.FixedPoint(point)
            scenarioId != null -> GnssFrameRoute.Scenario(scenarioId)
            else -> GnssFrameRoute.Global
        }
        return context.view(provider, route) {
            val base = applyNoise(context.base(route), context.state)
            val kind = kindFor(provider)
            val providerSample = kind?.let { mixer.mix(base)[it] }
            ProviderLocationView(providerSample?.sample ?: base, providerSample)
        }
    }

    private fun kindFor(provider: String?): ProviderKind? = when (provider) {
            LocationManager.GPS_PROVIDER, "GnssBatch" -> ProviderKind.GPS
            LocationManager.NETWORK_PROVIDER -> ProviderKind.NETWORK
            "fused" -> ProviderKind.FUSED
            else -> null
        }

    private fun applyNoise(sample: LocationSample, state: RuntimeSnapshot): LocationSample {
        if (!state.physicalNoise) return sample
        synchronized(this) {
            if (noise == null || noiseSeed != state.physicalNoiseSeed) {
                noise = PhysicalNoise(NoiseProfile(enabled = true, seed = state.physicalNoiseSeed))
                noiseSeed = state.physicalNoiseSeed
            }
            return noise!!.apply(sample, sample.elapsedNanos)
        }
    }
}
```

`xposed/src/main/java/com/system/location/service/hook/utils/Xposed.kt`:

```kt
package com.system.location.service.hook.utils

import com.system.location.service.hook.runtime.Reflection
import com.system.location.service.hook.scope.HookInstaller
import com.system.location.service.hook.scope.HookStatus
import com.system.location.service.hook.scope.HookStatusRegistry
import io.github.libxposed.api.XposedInterface.HookHandle
import io.github.libxposed.api.XposedInterface.Hooker
import java.lang.reflect.Method

private val hookedMethods = mutableSetOf<Method>()

/** Method identity includes the declaring classloader, unlike textual signatures. */
fun Method.onceHook(callback: Hooker): HookHandle? = synchronized(hookedMethods) {
    if (this in hookedMethods) null else HookInstaller.hookMethod(this, callback).also {
        hookedMethods.add(this)
    }
}

fun Class<*>.onceHookAllMethod(methodName: String, callback: Hooker): Set<HookHandle> =
    declaredMethods.filter { it.name == methodName }.mapNotNullTo(mutableSetOf()) { it.onceHook(callback) }

fun Class<*>.onceHookMethod(
    methodName: String, vararg parameterTypes: Class<*>, callback: Hooker,
): HookHandle? = HookInstaller.findMethod(this, methodName, *parameterTypes)?.onceHook(callback)

fun Class<*>.hookAllMethods(methodName: String, callback: Hooker): Set<HookHandle> =
    HookInstaller.hookAllMethods(this, methodName, callback)

fun Method.hook(callback: Hooker): HookHandle = HookInstaller.hookMethod(this, callback)

fun Class<*>.hookMethod(
    methodName: String, vararg parameterTypes: Class<*>, callback: Hooker,
): HookHandle? = HookInstaller.findMethod(this, methodName, *parameterTypes)?.hook(callback)

fun <T> T.callMethod(methodName: String, vararg args: Any?): Any? =
    Reflection.callMethod(this, methodName, *args)

fun Class<*>.callStaticMethod(methodName: String, vararg args: Any?): Any? =
    Reflection.callStaticMethod(this, methodName, *args)

fun String.toClass(classLoader: ClassLoader?): Class<*>? =
    Reflection.findClassIfExists(this, classLoader).also {
        if (it == null) HookStatusRegistry.record(this, HookStatus(skipped = true, reason = "Class absent"))
    }

fun String.toClassOrThrow(classLoader: ClassLoader?): Class<*> = Reflection.findClass(this, classLoader)
```

`xposed/src/main/java/com/system/location/service/jni/AntiDetect.kt`:

```kt
package com.system.location.service.jni

import android.content.Context
import com.system.location.service.hook.PortalModule
import com.system.location.service.hook.runtime.HookRuntime
import java.io.File

/**
 * Loads the experimental libc path-rewriting payload into the selected application process.
 *
 * The payload is copied to the app-private code cache under a neutral per-load name, loaded, then
 * removed from disk; the surviving mapping therefore shows an ordinary cache entry in
 * `/proc/self/maps`. Maps *content* is not rewritten (the experiment that did so was retired —
 * see docs/anti-detection.md). This is best-effort and intentionally not part of the default path.
 */
object AntiDetect {
    @Volatile private var loaded = false
    @Volatile private var enabled = false

    fun setEnabled(enabled: Boolean, context: Context): Boolean {
        if (this.enabled == enabled && loaded) return true
        if (!loaded) {
            if (!enabled) return true
            if (!load(context)) return false
        }
        return runCatching { nativeSetEnabled(enabled) }
            .onSuccess { this.enabled = enabled }
            .onFailure { HookRuntime.log(it) }
            .getOrDefault(false)
    }

    private fun load(context: Context): Boolean = runCatching {
        val info = PortalModule.moduleInfo
            ?: error("module ApplicationInfo unavailable")
        val source = File(info.nativeLibraryDir, "libcodecext.so")
        if (!source.isFile) error("libcodecext.so missing: ${source.absolutePath}")
        // A per-load neutral name keeps the /proc/self/maps entry from being a fixed fingerprint;
        // the file itself is unlinked right after dlopen.
        val target = File(
            context.codeCacheDir,
            "cache_" + java.util.UUID.randomUUID().toString().substring(0, 8) + ".so",
        )
        source.copyTo(target, overwrite = true)
        try {
            System.load(target.absolutePath)
        } finally {
            // The mapping survives unlink; a deleted file cannot be listed from the cache.
            target.delete()
        }
        loaded = true
        true
    }.onFailure { HookRuntime.log(it) }.getOrDefault(false)

    private external fun nativeSetEnabled(enabled: Boolean): Boolean
}
```

`xposed/src/test/java/com/system/location/service/hook/ConfigCommandTest.kt`:

```kt
package com.system.location.service.hook

import com.system.location.service.core.runtime.*
import com.system.location.service.hook.utils.FakeLoc
import java.util.concurrent.CountDownLatch
import java.util.concurrent.Executors
import java.util.concurrent.TimeUnit
import java.util.concurrent.atomic.AtomicBoolean
import org.junit.Assert.*
import org.junit.Test

class ConfigCommandTest {
    @Test fun disablingConfigurationCannotLeaveAnExternalFixToBeRevivedLater() {
        val saved = FakeLoc.runtimeSnapshots.current()
        try {
            FakeLoc.runtimeSnapshots.set(RuntimeSnapshot())
            val fix = com.system.location.service.core.location.LocationSample(
                com.system.location.service.core.geo.Wgs84(31.0, 121.0), 10.0, 5f, 4f, 90f, 1000, 1000)
            FakeLoc.acceptSample(fix, "route")
            val stopped = ConfigCommand.publish(mapOf("enable" to false, "min_satellites" to 24))
            assertFalse(FakeLoc.externallyDriven)
            assertNull(stopped.sample)
            assertEquals(24, stopped.configuration.minimumSatellites)
            assertTrue(FakeLoc.scenarioSamples.scenarioIds().isEmpty())
            ConfigCommand.publish(mapOf("enable" to true))
            assertFalse(FakeLoc.captureTransfer(2000).externallyDriven)
        } finally {
            FakeLoc.stopRuntime()
            FakeLoc.runtimeSnapshots.set(saved)
        }
    }

    @Test fun invalidWireTypeOrScalarNeverChangesPublishedState() {
        val saved = FakeLoc.runtimeSnapshots.current()
        try {
            val initial = RuntimeSnapshot(configuration = HookConfiguration(enabled = true, minimumSatellites = 20))
            FakeLoc.runtimeSnapshots.set(initial)
            for (invalid in listOf(mapOf("gnss_capture" to 123), mapOf("min_satellites" to -1),
                mapOf("routing_json" to "invalid"), mapOf("enable_nmea" to 0))) {
                assertThrows(IllegalArgumentException::class.java) {
                    ConfigCommand.publish(mapOf("enable" to false) + invalid)
                }
                assertSame(initial, FakeLoc.runtimeSnapshots.current())
            }
        } finally { FakeLoc.runtimeSnapshots.set(saved) }
    }

    @Test fun corruptOptionalCaptureStillPublishesCompleteRequiredConfiguration() {
        val saved = FakeLoc.runtimeSnapshots.current()
        try {
            FakeLoc.runtimeSnapshots.set(RuntimeSnapshot())
            val result = ConfigCommand.publish(mapOf("gnss_capture" to "invalid",
                "min_satellites" to 24, "enable_nmea" to false))
            assertEquals(24, result.configuration.minimumSatellites)
            assertFalse(result.configuration.nmeaEnabled)
            assertTrue(result.configuration.gnssCaptureRejected)
            assertNull(result.configuration.gnssSource)
        } finally { FakeLoc.runtimeSnapshots.set(saved) }
    }

    @Test fun concurrentReadersObserveOnlyCompleteBatches() {
        val saved = FakeLoc.runtimeSnapshots.current()
        val executor = Executors.newSingleThreadExecutor()
        val done = AtomicBoolean(false)
        val started = CountDownLatch(1)
        try {
            FakeLoc.runtimeSnapshots.set(RuntimeSnapshot(configuration = HookConfiguration(minimumSatellites = 0)))
            val reader = executor.submit {
                started.countDown()
                while (!done.get()) {
                    val config = FakeLoc.runtimeSnapshots.current().configuration
                    assertEquals(if (config.enabled) 25 else 0, config.minimumSatellites)
                    assertEquals(!config.enabled, config.nmeaEnabled)
                    // Raw GNSS is always suppressed while protected simulation is active.
                }
            }
            started.await(5, TimeUnit.SECONDS)
            repeat(2_000) { i ->
                val enabled = i % 2 == 0
                ConfigCommand.publish(mapOf("enable" to enabled, "min_satellites" to if (enabled) 25 else 0,
                    "enable_nmea" to !enabled))
            }
            done.set(true)
            reader.get(10, TimeUnit.SECONDS)
            assertEquals(2_000L, FakeLoc.runtimeSnapshots.current().configRevision)
        } finally {
            done.set(true)
            executor.shutdownNow()
            FakeLoc.runtimeSnapshots.set(saved)
        }
    }
}
```

`xposed/src/test/java/com/system/location/service/hook/ControlCommandTest.kt`:

```kt
package com.system.location.service.hook

import com.system.location.service.core.geo.Wgs84
import com.system.location.service.core.runtime.RuntimeSnapshot
import com.system.location.service.hook.utils.FakeLoc
import org.junit.Assert.*
import org.junit.Test

class ControlCommandTest {
    @Test fun numericControlsRejectMissingWrongTypesAndInvalidValuesBeforeAnyPublication() {
        val saved = FakeLoc.runtimeSnapshots.current()
        try {
            val initial = RuntimeSnapshot(configRevision = 7, latitude = 31.0, longitude = 121.0)
            FakeLoc.runtimeSnapshots.set(initial)
            for (key in listOf("speed", "altitude", "bearing")) {
                for (value in listOf(null, 1, 1f, "1", Double.NaN, Double.POSITIVE_INFINITY)) {
                    assertThrows(IllegalArgumentException::class.java) { ControlCommand.publishNumber(key, value) }
                    assertSame(initial, FakeLoc.runtimeSnapshots.current())
                }
            }
            assertThrows(IllegalArgumentException::class.java) { ControlCommand.publishNumber("speed", -1.0) }
            assertThrows(IllegalArgumentException::class.java) { ControlCommand.publishNumber("speed", 1_000.1) }
            val bearing = ControlCommand.publishNumber("bearing", 270.0)
            assertTrue(bearing.hasBearings)
            assertEquals(270.0, bearing.bearingDeg, 0.0)
            assertEquals(8L, bearing.configRevision)
            val altitude = ControlCommand.publishNumber("altitude", -100.0)
            assertEquals(-100.0, altitude.altitudeMeters, 0.0)
            assertEquals(270.0, altitude.bearingDeg, 0.0)
            assertEquals(9L, altitude.configRevision)
        } finally { FakeLoc.runtimeSnapshots.set(saved) }
    }

    @Test fun startRequiresRealTypedCoordinatesAndValidOptionalFields() {
        val valid = mapOf<String, Any?>("lat" to 31.0, "lon" to 121.0)
        val prepared = ControlCommand.prepareStart(valid + mapOf("speed" to 4.0, "accuracy" to 8f, "report_interval" to 200L))
        assertEquals(Wgs84(31.0, 121.0), prepared.coordinate)
        assertEquals(4.0, prepared.speedMps!!, 0.0)
        assertEquals(8f, prepared.accuracyMeters!!)
        assertEquals(200L, prepared.reportIntervalMs)
        assertNull(ControlCommand.prepareStart(valid).speedMps)
        assertThrows(IllegalArgumentException::class.java) { ControlCommand.prepareStart(emptyMap()) }
        val invalid = mapOf<String, Any?>("lat" to 1f, "lon" to Double.NaN, "speed" to -1.0,
            "accuracy" to 0f, "altitude" to Double.POSITIVE_INFINITY, "report_interval" to 10L)
        invalid.forEach { (key, value) ->
            assertThrows("Must reject $key", IllegalArgumentException::class.java) {
                ControlCommand.prepareStart(valid + (key to value))
            }
            assertThrows("Must reject null $key", IllegalArgumentException::class.java) {
                ControlCommand.prepareStart(valid + (key to null))
            }
        }
    }
}
```

```kt
    }
```

`xposed/src/test/java/com/system/location/service/hook/LocationCommandTest.kt`:

```kt
package com.system.location.service.hook

import com.system.location.service.core.geo.Wgs84
import com.system.location.service.core.runtime.*
import org.junit.Assert.*
import org.junit.Test

class LocationCommandTest {
    private val state = RuntimeSnapshot(latitude = 20.0, longitude = 100.0,
        speedMps = 4.0, configuration = HookConfiguration(enabled = true))

    @Test fun coordinateArithmeticUsesOneStateAndDividesCurrentCoordinateByOperand() {
        val operands = mapOf<String, Any?>("lat" to 2.0, "lon" to 4.0)
        val expected = mapOf("=" to Wgs84(2.0, 4.0), "+" to Wgs84(22.0, 104.0),
            "-" to Wgs84(18.0, 96.0), "*" to Wgs84(40.0, 100.0), "/" to Wgs84(10.0, 25.0))
        expected.forEach { (mode, point) ->
            val input = if (mode == "*") operands + ("lon" to 1.0) else operands
            val prepared = LocationCommand.prepareUpdate(input + ("mode" to mode), state)
            assertEquals(point, prepared.coordinate)
        }
        val equator = state.copy(latitude = 0.0, longitude = 0.0)
        assertEquals(Wgs84(0.0, 0.0), LocationCommand.prepareUpdate(operands + ("mode" to "/"), equator).coordinate)
    }

    @Test fun malformedOrOutOfRangeFieldsAreRejectedBeforePositionOrHeadingChanges() {
        val valid = mapOf<String, Any?>("mode" to "=", "lat" to 31.0, "lon" to 121.0,
            "bearing" to 90.0, "moving_speed" to 4f)
        for ((key, value) in mapOf("mode" to "unknown", "lat" to 91.0, "lon" to Double.NaN,
            "bearing" to 90f, "moving_speed" to Double.POSITIVE_INFINITY)) {
            assertThrows(Exception::class.java) { LocationCommand.prepareUpdate(valid + (key to value), state) }
        }
        for (key in listOf("mode", "lat", "lon")) {
            assertThrows(Exception::class.java) { LocationCommand.prepareUpdate(valid - key, state) }
        }
        assertThrows(IllegalArgumentException::class.java) {
            LocationCommand.prepareUpdate(valid + mapOf("mode" to "/", "lat" to 0.0), state)
        }
        val prepared = LocationCommand.prepareUpdate(valid, state)
        assertEquals(90.0, prepared.bearingDeg!!, 0.0)
        assertEquals(4f, prepared.movementSpeedMps)
    }

    @Test fun movementUsesCapturedSpeedAndDoesNotReadAnotherLiveTarget() {
        val prepared = LocationCommand.prepareMove(mapOf("n" to 0.0, "bearing" to 270.0), state)
        assertEquals(Wgs84(20.0, 100.0), prepared.coordinate)
        assertEquals(0f, prepared.movementSpeedMps)
        assertEquals(4f, LocationCommand.prepareMove(mapOf("n" to 10.0, "bearing" to 90.0), state).movementSpeedMps)
        assertThrows(Exception::class.java) { LocationCommand.prepareMove(mapOf("n" to 10f, "bearing" to 90.0), state) }
        assertThrows(IllegalArgumentException::class.java) {
            LocationCommand.prepareMove(mapOf("n" to -1.0, "bearing" to 90.0), state)
        }
    }
}
```

`xposed/src/test/java/com/system/location/service/hook/PortalModuleLifecycleTest.kt`:

```kt
package com.system.location.service.hook

import com.system.location.service.hook.scope.HookScope
import com.system.location.service.hook.scope.HookScopeResolver
import com.system.location.service.hook.scope.ProcessIdentity
import org.junit.Assert.assertEquals
import org.junit.Assert.assertFalse
import org.junit.Assert.assertSame
import org.junit.Assert.assertTrue
import org.junit.Test

/** Exercises the actual install scheduler without installing Android hooks in the JVM. */
class PortalModuleLifecycleTest {
    @Test
    fun sharedAndroidPackageDoesNotPreventTheLaterPhonePackageFromInstalling() {
        val installations = mutableListOf<Installation>()
        val scheduler = recorder(installations)
        val loader = loader()
        scheduler.moduleLoaded("com.android.phone", false)

        // The framework reports android as its first package and phone as a later package.
        scheduler.packageReady("android", loader, 1001, 1)
        scheduler.packageReady("com.android.phone", loader, 1001, 1)

        assertEquals(listOf("android", "com.android.phone"), installations.map { it.pkg })
        val phone = installations.last()
        assertEquals("com.android.phone", phone.process)
        assertEquals(HookScope.PHONE_PROCESS, HookScopeResolver.resolve(
            ProcessIdentity(phone.pkg, phone.process, phone.uid, 37, "test")))
        assertSame(loader, phone.loader)
    }

    @Test
    fun systemServerWaitsForItsOfficialLoaderAndIgnoresPackageCallbacks() {
        val installations = mutableListOf<Installation>()
        val scheduler = recorder(installations)
        val packageLoader = loader()
        val systemLoader = loader()

        scheduler.moduleLoaded("system_server", true)
        scheduler.packageReady("android", packageLoader, 1000, 1)
        assertTrue(installations.isEmpty())

        scheduler.systemServerStarting(systemLoader)
        scheduler.packageReady("com.android.phone", packageLoader, 1001, 1)

        val installation = installations.single()
        assertSame(systemLoader, installation.loader)
        assertEquals("system_server", installation.process)
        assertEquals("android", installation.pkg)
        assertEquals(1000, installation.uid)
    }

    @Test
    fun duplicatePackageAndSystemCallbacksDoNotInstallTwice() {
        val installations = mutableListOf<Installation>()
        val packages = recorder(installations)
        packages.moduleLoaded("com.android.phone", false)
        packages.packageReady("com.android.phone", loader(), 1001, 7)
        packages.packageReady("com.android.phone", loader(), 1001, 9)
        assertEquals(1, installations.size)
        assertEquals(7, installations.single().flags)

        val system = recorder(installations)
        system.moduleLoaded("system_server", true)
        system.systemServerStarting(loader())
        system.systemServerStarting(loader())
        assertEquals(2, installations.size)
    }

    @Test
    fun failedInstallationCanBeRetriedByTheNextCallback() {
        val expected = IllegalStateException("Installer unavailable")
        var attempts = 0
        val scheduler = ModuleInstallScheduler { _, _, _, _, _ ->
            if (attempts++ == 0) throw expected
        }
        scheduler.moduleLoaded("com.android.phone", false)

        assertSame(expected, runCatching {
            scheduler.packageReady("com.android.phone", loader(), 1001, 0)
        }.exceptionOrNull())
        scheduler.packageReady("com.android.phone", loader(), 1001, 0)
        scheduler.packageReady("com.android.phone", loader(), 1001, 0)

        assertEquals(2, attempts)
    }

    @Test
    fun sharedSystemPackagesWaitForCoreHooksAndUseTheirOwnLoadersOnce() {
        val installations = mutableListOf<Installation>()
        val shared = mutableListOf<Pair<String, ClassLoader>>()
        val scheduler = ModuleInstallScheduler(installSystemPackageHooks = { pkg, loader ->
            assertEquals("android", installations.single().pkg)
            shared.add(pkg to loader)
            true
        }) { process, pkg, loader, uid, flags ->
            installations.add(Installation(process, pkg, loader, uid, flags))
        }
        val settingsLoader = loader()
        val fusedLoader = loader()
        val systemLoader = loader()
        scheduler.moduleLoaded("system", true)
        scheduler.systemPackageReady("com.android.providers.settings", settingsLoader)
        scheduler.systemPackageReady("com.android.location.fused", fusedLoader)
        assertTrue(shared.isEmpty())

        scheduler.systemServerStarting(systemLoader)
        scheduler.systemPackageReady("com.android.location.fused", fusedLoader)
        scheduler.systemPackageReady("com.android.providers.settings", settingsLoader)
        scheduler.systemServerStarting(systemLoader)

        assertEquals(listOf("com.android.providers.settings", "com.android.location.fused"), shared.map { it.first })
        assertSame(settingsLoader, shared[0].second)
        assertSame(fusedLoader, shared[1].second)
        assertSame(systemLoader, installations.single().loader)
    }

    @Test
    fun missingSharedPackageHooksRetryOnALaterCallbackWithTheNewLoader() {
        val attemptedLoaders = mutableListOf<ClassLoader>()
        val scheduler = ModuleInstallScheduler(installSystemPackageHooks = { _, loader ->
            attemptedLoaders.add(loader)
            attemptedLoaders.size > 1
        }) { _, _, _, _, _ -> }
        scheduler.moduleLoaded("system_server", true)
        scheduler.systemServerStarting(loader())
        val early = loader()
        val ready = loader()
        scheduler.systemPackageReady("com.android.location.fused", early)
        scheduler.systemPackageReady("com.android.location.fused", ready)
        scheduler.systemPackageReady("com.android.location.fused", ready)

        assertEquals(listOf(early, ready), attemptedLoaders)
    }

    @Test
    fun sharedPackageLoadersSurviveHotReloadWithoutTransferringOldModuleObjects() {
        val old = ModuleInstallScheduler { _, _, _, _, _ -> }
        val fusedLoader = loader()
        old.moduleLoaded("system", true)
        old.systemServerStarting(loader())
        old.systemPackageReady("com.android.location.fused", fusedLoader)
        val installed = mutableListOf<Pair<String, ClassLoader>>()
        val replacement = ModuleInstallScheduler(installSystemPackageHooks = { pkg, loader ->
            installed.add(pkg to loader)
            true
        }) { _, _, _, _, _ -> }
        replacement.systemServerStarting(loader())
        replacement.restoreSystemPackages(old.systemPackageLoaders())
        replacement.systemPackageReady("com.android.location.fused", fusedLoader)

        assertEquals("com.android.location.fused", installed.single().first)
        assertSame(fusedLoader, installed.single().second)
    }

    @Test
    fun unrelatedPackagesAndOldReloadStateDoNotInstallSharedSystemHooks() {
        val installed = mutableListOf<String>()
        val scheduler = ModuleInstallScheduler(installSystemPackageHooks = { pkg, _ ->
            installed.add(pkg)
            true
        }) { _, _, _, _, _ -> }
        scheduler.systemServerStarting(loader())
        scheduler.systemPackageReady("com.android.phone", loader())
        scheduler.systemPackageReady("com.example.app", loader())
        scheduler.restoreSystemPackages(null)
        scheduler.restoreSystemPackages(arrayOf("legacy", arrayOf("com.android.location.fused")))

        assertTrue(installed.isEmpty())
        assertTrue(scheduler.systemPackageLoaders().isEmpty())
    }

    @Test
    fun hotReloadIsLimitedToSystemServerWithoutNativeHooks() {
        assertFalse(HotReloadPolicy.allowed(isSystemProcess = false, nativeLoaded = false))
        assertTrue(HotReloadPolicy.allowed(isSystemProcess = true, nativeLoaded = false))
        assertFalse(HotReloadPolicy.allowed(isSystemProcess = true, nativeLoaded = true))
    }

    private fun recorder(installations: MutableList<Installation>): ModuleInstallScheduler =
        ModuleInstallScheduler { process, pkg, loader, uid, flags ->
            installations.add(Installation(process, pkg, loader, uid, flags))
        }

    private fun loader(): ClassLoader = object : ClassLoader(javaClass.classLoader) {}

    private data class Installation(
        val process: String,
        val pkg: String,
        val loader: ClassLoader,
        val uid: Int,
        val flags: Int,
    )
}
```

`xposed/src/test/java/com/system/location/service/hook/RuntimePeerRegistryTest.kt`:

```kt
package com.system.location.service.hook

import android.os.IBinder
import com.system.location.service.core.runtime.RuntimeSnapshot
import com.system.location.service.core.runtime.RuntimeTransfer
import java.lang.reflect.Proxy
import java.util.concurrent.CountDownLatch
import java.util.concurrent.TimeUnit
import org.junit.Assert.*
import org.junit.Test

class RuntimePeerRegistryTest {
    private val publication = RuntimePeerRegistry.Publication(1, RuntimeTransfer(RuntimeSnapshot(), false))

    @Test fun replacesSameServiceDeduplicatesBindersBoundsCapacityAndCleansDeath() {
        val registry = RuntimePeerRegistry(1, { _, _, _ -> }, { throw AssertionError(it) })
        val first = Transport()
        val second = Transport()
        try {
            assertTrue(registry.register(1001, "phone", "a", first.binder))
            assertFalse(registry.register(1002, "fused", "b", second.binder))
            assertTrue(registry.register(1001, "phone", "b", second.binder))
            assertEquals(1, first.unlinks)
            first.death!!.binderDied()
            assertEquals(1, registry.size())
            assertTrue(registry.register(1001, "other-name", "c", second.binder))
            assertEquals(1, registry.size())
            second.alive = false
            second.death!!.binderDied()
            assertEquals(0, registry.size())
            assertFalse(registry.register(1001, "phone", "d", second.binder))
        } finally { registry.clear() }
    }

    @Test fun stalledPeerDoesNotHoldRegistryLockOrBlockOtherPeersAndOldFailureCannotRemoveReplacement() {
        val blocked = Transport()
        val fast = Transport()
        val entered = CountDownLatch(1)
        val release = CountDownLatch(1)
        val delivered = CountDownLatch(1)
        val failed = CountDownLatch(1)
        val registry = RuntimePeerRegistry(2, { binder, _, _ ->
            if (binder == blocked.binder) {
                entered.countDown()
                check(release.await(5, TimeUnit.SECONDS))
                error("old transport failed")
            } else delivered.countDown()
        }, { failed.countDown() })
        try {
            registry.register(1001, "phone", "a", blocked.binder)
            registry.offer(publication)
            assertTrue(entered.await(5, TimeUnit.SECONDS))
            assertTrue(registry.register(1002, "fused", "b", fast.binder))
            registry.offer(publication.copy(sequence = 2))
            assertTrue(delivered.await(5, TimeUnit.SECONDS))
            assertTrue(registry.register(1001, "phone", "c", Transport().binder))
            release.countDown()
            assertTrue(failed.await(5, TimeUnit.SECONDS))
            assertEquals(2, registry.size())
        } finally { release.countDown(); registry.clear() }
    }

    @Test fun subscriptionsCanBeRecreatedWithOriginalUidNameSessionAndBinder() {
        val first = RuntimePeerRegistry(2, { _, _, _ -> }, { throw AssertionError(it) })
        val restored = RuntimePeerRegistry(2, { _, _, _ -> }, { throw AssertionError(it) })
        val transport = Transport()
        try {
            assertTrue(first.register(1001, "phone", "session-a", transport.binder))
            val row = first.subscriptions().single()
            assertEquals(1001, row.uid)
            assertEquals("phone", row.name)
            assertEquals("session-a", row.session)
            assertSame(transport.binder, row.binder)
            val oldDeath = transport.death!!
            first.clear()
            assertEquals(1, transport.unlinks)
            assertEquals(0, first.size())
            assertTrue(restored.restore(row))
            oldDeath.binderDied()
            assertEquals(1, restored.size())
        } finally { first.clear(); restored.clear() }
        assertEquals(2, transport.unlinks)
    }

    private class Transport {
        @Volatile var alive = true
        var unlinks = 0
        var death: IBinder.DeathRecipient? = null
        val binder = Proxy.newProxyInstance(IBinder::class.java.classLoader, arrayOf(IBinder::class.java)) { proxy, method, args ->
            when (method.name) {
                "isBinderAlive" -> alive
                "linkToDeath" -> { death = args!![0] as IBinder.DeathRecipient; null }
                "unlinkToDeath" -> { unlinks++; true }
                "hashCode" -> System.identityHashCode(proxy)
                "equals" -> proxy === args?.get(0)
                else -> null
            }
        } as IBinder
    }
}
```

`xposed/src/test/java/com/system/location/service/hook/RuntimeSyncCommandTest.kt`:

```kt
package com.system.location.service.hook

import com.system.location.service.core.runtime.RuntimeTransferWire
import org.junit.Assert.*
import org.junit.Test

class RuntimeSyncCommandTest {
    private val valid = mapOf<String, Any?>("proxy_session" to "session", "proxy_sequence" to 1L,
        "runtime_transfer" to byteArrayOf(1))

    @Test fun rejectsWrongTypesMissingFieldsAndOversizedMessages() {
        for ((key, badValues) in mapOf(
            "proxy_session" to listOf(null, "", "x".repeat(129), 1),
            "proxy_sequence" to listOf(null, 1, 0L, -1L, "1"),
            "runtime_transfer" to listOf(null, "encoded", byteArrayOf(),
                ByteArray(RuntimeTransferWire.MAX_COMPRESSED_BYTES + 1)),
        )) for (value in badValues) {
            assertThrows(Exception::class.java) { RuntimeSyncCommand.prepare(valid + (key to value)) }
        }
        for (key in valid.keys) {
            assertThrows(Exception::class.java) { RuntimeSyncCommand.prepare(valid - key) }
        }
        val message = RuntimeSyncCommand.prepare(valid)
        assertEquals("session", message.session)
        assertEquals(1L, message.sequence)
        assertArrayEquals(byteArrayOf(1), message.encoded)
    }
}
```

`xposed/src/test/java/com/system/location/service/hook/hooks/CurrentLocationRequestsTest.kt`:

```kt
package com.system.location.service.hook.hooks

import java.util.concurrent.CountDownLatch
import java.util.concurrent.Executors
import java.util.concurrent.TimeUnit
import org.junit.Assert.assertEquals
import org.junit.Assert.assertNull
import org.junit.Assert.assertTrue
import org.junit.Test

class CurrentLocationRequestsTest {
    @Test
    fun callbacksOfTheSameClassKeepTheirOwnProviders() {
        val requests = CurrentLocationRequests()
        val gps = Callback()
        val network = Callback()
        requests.register(gps, "gps")
        requests.register(network, "network")

        assertEquals("network", requests.take(network))
        assertEquals("gps", requests.take(gps))
    }

    @Test
    fun callbackEqualityDoesNotMergeSeparateRequests() {
        val requests = CurrentLocationRequests()
        val first = EqualCallback()
        val second = EqualCallback()
        assertEquals(first, second)
        requests.register(first, "gps")
        requests.register(second, "fused")

        assertEquals("gps", requests.take(first))
        assertEquals("fused", requests.take(second))
    }

    @Test
    fun providerIsConsumedOnceAndUnknownCallbackHasNoProvider() {
        val requests = CurrentLocationRequests()
        val callback = Callback()
        requests.register(callback, "gps")

        assertNull(requests.take(Callback()))
        assertEquals("gps", requests.take(callback))
        assertNull(requests.take(callback))
    }

    @Test
    fun registeringTheSameObjectReplacesItsPreviousRequest() {
        val requests = CurrentLocationRequests()
        val callback = Callback()
        requests.register(callback, "gps")
        requests.register(callback, "network")

        assertEquals("network", requests.take(callback))
        assertNull(requests.take(callback))
    }

    @Test
    fun failedRegistrationCanBeRemovedWithoutAffectingOtherCallbacks() {
        val requests = CurrentLocationRequests()
        val failed = EqualCallback()
        val retained = EqualCallback()
        requests.register(failed, "gps")
        requests.register(retained, "fused")

        requests.remove(failed)
        requests.remove(failed)

        assertNull(requests.take(failed))
        assertEquals("fused", requests.take(retained))
    }

    @Test
    fun racingDeliveriesConsumeTheRequestOnlyOnce() {
        val requests = CurrentLocationRequests()
        val callback = Callback()
        requests.register(callback, "gps")
        val start = CountDownLatch(1)
        val pool = Executors.newFixedThreadPool(8)
        try {
            val deliveries = (1..16).map {
                pool.submit<String?> {
                    assertTrue(start.await(5, TimeUnit.SECONDS))
                    requests.take(callback)
                }
            }
            start.countDown()

            val results = deliveries.map { it.get(5, TimeUnit.SECONDS) }
            assertEquals(listOf("gps"), results.filterNotNull())
            assertNull(requests.take(callback))
        } finally {
            pool.shutdownNow()
        }
    }

    @Test
    fun concurrentDistinctCallbacksDoNotLoseAssociations() {
        val requests = CurrentLocationRequests()
        val callbacks = List(32) { EqualCallback() }
        val registered = CountDownLatch(callbacks.size)
        val pool = Executors.newFixedThreadPool(8)
        try {
            val registrations = callbacks.mapIndexed { index, callback ->
                pool.submit {
                    requests.register(callback, "provider-$index")
                    registered.countDown()
                }
            }
            assertTrue(registered.await(5, TimeUnit.SECONDS))
            registrations.forEach { it.get(5, TimeUnit.SECONDS) }

            val deliveries = callbacks.mapIndexed { index, callback ->
                pool.submit {
                    assertEquals("provider-$index", requests.take(callback))
                }
            }
            deliveries.forEach { it.get(5, TimeUnit.SECONDS) }
            callbacks.forEach { assertNull(requests.take(it)) }
        } finally {
            pool.shutdownNow()
        }
    }

    private class Callback

    private class EqualCallback {
        override fun equals(other: Any?): Boolean = other is EqualCallback
        override fun hashCode(): Int = 1
    }
}
```

`xposed/src/test/java/com/system/location/service/hook/hooks/ListenerRoutingSnapshotTest.kt`:

```kt
package com.system.location.service.hook.hooks

import com.system.location.service.core.geo.Wgs84
import com.system.location.service.core.routing.AppRoute
import com.system.location.service.core.routing.RoutingConfig
import com.system.location.service.core.routing.RoutingDecision
import com.system.location.service.core.routing.RoutingMode
import org.junit.Assert.assertEquals
import org.junit.Test

class ListenerRoutingSnapshotTest {
    @Test
    fun decisionUsesTheRoutingConfigCapturedForThisRequest() {
        val captured = RoutingConfig(mode = RoutingMode.PER_APP, routes = listOf(
            AppRoute(packageName = "target.app", point = Wgs84(31.0, 121.0)),
        ))

        assertEquals(RoutingDecision.Point(Wgs84(31.0, 121.0)),
            ListenerRouting.decisionFor("target.app", 10_123, captured))
        assertEquals(RoutingDecision.Global,
            ListenerRouting.decisionFor("target.app", 10_123, RoutingConfig()))
    }

    @Test
    fun explicitDenyIsPreservedFromTheCapturedConfig() {
        val captured = RoutingConfig(mode = RoutingMode.PER_APP, deniedPackages = setOf("target.app"))

        assertEquals(RoutingDecision.Deny, ListenerRouting.decisionFor("target.app", 10_123, captured))
    }

    @Test
    fun unresolvedCallerCannotInheritTheGlobalScenarioRoute() {
        val captured = RoutingConfig(mode = RoutingMode.PER_APP, globalScenarioId = "fallback")

        assertEquals(RoutingDecision.Deny,
            ListenerRouting.decisionForPackages(10_123, captured, emptyList()))
    }

    @Test
    fun verifiedSystemCallerKeepsTheGlobalRoute() {
        val captured = RoutingConfig(mode = RoutingMode.PER_APP, deniedPackages = setOf("system.app"))

        assertEquals(RoutingDecision.Global,
            ListenerRouting.decisionForPackages(10_123, captured, listOf("system.app")) { true })
    }

    @Test fun secondaryUserServicesDoNotRequirePackageLookupOrInheritAppRoutes() {
        val config = RoutingConfig(mode = RoutingMode.PER_APP, globalScenarioId = "app-only",
            deniedPackages = setOf("system.app"))
        for (uid in listOf(101000, 101001, 99901000)) {
            assertEquals(RoutingDecision.Global, ListenerRouting.decisionFor(null, uid, config))
            assertEquals(RoutingDecision.Global,
                ListenerRouting.decisionForPackages(uid, config, emptyList()))
            assertEquals(RoutingDecision.Global,
                ListenerRouting.decisionForPackages(uid, config, listOf("system.app")))
        }
    }
}
```

`xposed/src/test/java/com/system/location/service/hook/hooks/LocationCallbackRegistryTest.kt`:

```kt
package com.system.location.service.hook.hooks

import android.os.IBinder
import android.os.IInterface
import java.lang.reflect.Proxy
import org.junit.Assert.*
import org.junit.Test

class LocationCallbackRegistryTest {
    @Test fun retirementReleasesOldDeathLinkWhileSavedProvidersRestoreInSuccessor() {
        val transport = Transport()
        val old = LocationCallbackRegistry()
        val successor = LocationCallbackRegistry()
        old.register("gps", transport.listener(), 10001)
        old.register("network", transport.listener(), 10001)
        val saved = old.subscriptions()
        val oldDeath = transport.death!!
        old.clear()
        assertEquals(1, transport.unlinks)
        assertTrue(old.listeners().isEmpty())
        assertTrue(successor.restore(saved.single()))
        assertEquals(2, transport.links)
        oldDeath.binderDied()
        assertEquals(listOf("gps", "network"), successor.listeners().map { it.first })
        assertEquals(10001, successor.subscriptions().single().uid)
        successor.clear()
        assertEquals(transport.links, transport.unlinks)
    }

    @Test fun duplicateProviderSubscriptionsShareOneDeathRecipientAndPreserveOtherProviders() {
        val transport = Transport()
        var added = 0
        val registry = LocationCallbackRegistry(added = { added++ })
        repeat(20) { assertTrue(registry.register("gps", transport.listener())) }
        assertTrue(registry.register("network", transport.listener()))
        assertEquals(listOf("gps", "network"), registry.listeners().map { it.first })
        assertEquals(1, transport.links)
        assertEquals(1, added)
        registry.unregister(transport.listener())
        assertTrue(registry.listeners().isEmpty())
        assertEquals(1, transport.unlinks)
    }

    @Test fun explicitUnregisterUnlinksAndRemovesRoutingExactlyOnce() {
        val transport = Transport()
        var removed = 0
        val registry = LocationCallbackRegistry(removed = { removed++ })
        registry.register("gps", transport.listener())
        repeat(3) { registry.unregister(transport.listener()) }
        assertTrue(registry.listeners().isEmpty())
        assertEquals(1, transport.unlinks)
        assertEquals(1, removed)
    }

    @Test fun originalZeroArgumentBinderDeathRemovesAllSubscriptionsAndRouting() {
        val transport = Transport()
        var removed = 0
        val registry = LocationCallbackRegistry(removed = { removed++ })
        registry.register("gps", transport.listener())
        registry.register("fused", transport.listener())
        transport.alive = false
        transport.death!!.binderDied()
        assertTrue(registry.listeners().isEmpty())
        assertEquals(1, transport.unlinks)
        assertEquals(1, removed)
    }

    @Test fun deathBeforeOrDuringLinkCannotLeaveAPublishedListenerOrRouting() {
        for (duringLink in listOf(false, true)) {
            val transport = Transport().apply { alive = duringLink; dieDuringLink = duringLink }
            var added = 0
            val registry = LocationCallbackRegistry(added = { added++ })
            assertFalse(registry.register("gps", transport.listener()))
            assertTrue(registry.listeners().isEmpty())
            assertEquals(0, added)
        }
    }

    @Test fun delayedOldDeathDoesNotRemoveAReplacementRegistration() {
        val transport = Transport()
        val registry = LocationCallbackRegistry()
        registry.register("gps", transport.listener())
        val oldDeath = transport.death!!
        registry.unregister(transport.listener())
        registry.register("network", transport.listener())
        oldDeath.binderDied()
        assertEquals(listOf("network"), registry.listeners().map { it.first })
        registry.clear()
        assertEquals(2, transport.unlinks)
    }

    @Test fun missedDeathIsPrunedAndClearUnlinksRemainingTransports() {
        val first = Transport()
        val second = Transport()
        var removed = 0
        val registry = LocationCallbackRegistry(removed = { removed++ })
        registry.register("gps", first.listener())
        registry.register("network", second.listener())
        first.alive = false
        assertEquals(listOf("network"), registry.listeners().map { it.first })
        registry.clear()
        assertEquals(2, removed)
        assertEquals(1, first.unlinks)
        assertEquals(1, second.unlinks)
    }

    @Test fun routingFailureRollsBackTheLinkAndRegistration() {
        val transport = Transport()
        val registry = LocationCallbackRegistry(added = { error("routing unavailable") })
        assertTrue(runCatching { registry.register("gps", transport.listener()) }.isFailure)
        assertTrue(registry.listeners().isEmpty())
        assertEquals(1, transport.unlinks)
    }

    private class Transport {
        var alive = true
        var dieDuringLink = false
        var links = 0
        var unlinks = 0
        var death: IBinder.DeathRecipient? = null
        private val binder = Proxy.newProxyInstance(IBinder::class.java.classLoader,
            arrayOf(IBinder::class.java)) { proxy, method, args ->
            when (method.name) {
                "isBinderAlive" -> alive
                "linkToDeath" -> {
                    links++
                    death = args!![0] as IBinder.DeathRecipient
                    if (dieDuringLink) { alive = false; death!!.binderDied() }
                    null
                }
                "unlinkToDeath" -> { unlinks++; true }
                "hashCode" -> System.identityHashCode(proxy)
                "equals" -> proxy === args?.get(0)
                "toString" -> "test-location-binder"
                else -> null
            }
        } as IBinder
        fun listener() = object : IInterface { override fun asBinder(): IBinder = binder }
    }
}
```

`xposed/src/test/java/com/system/location/service/hook/hooks/LocationResultIsolationTest.kt`:

```kt
package com.system.location.service.hook.hooks

import org.junit.Assert.*
import org.junit.Test

class LocationResultIsolationTest {
    private class Result private constructor(val mLocations: ArrayList<String>) {
        companion object { fun physical() = Result(arrayListOf("physical")) }
    }
    private val field = Result::class.java.getDeclaredField("mLocations").apply { isAccessible = true }

    @Test fun forwardingUsesAnIndependentResultAndList() {
        val original = Result.physical()
        val rewritten = arrayListOf("synthetic")
        val copy = LocationResultIsolation.copyWithLocations(original, rewritten) as Result
        rewritten.clear()
        assertNotSame(original, copy)
        assertEquals(listOf("physical"), original.mLocations)
        assertEquals(listOf("synthetic"), copy.mLocations)
    }

    @Test fun parcelFailureRestoresTheSameOriginalList() {
        val original = Result.physical()
        val list = original.mLocations
        val failure = IllegalStateException("parcel full")
        assertSame(failure, assertThrows(IllegalStateException::class.java) {
            LocationResultIsolation.writeWithLocations(original, field, { listOf("synthetic") }) {
                assertEquals(listOf("synthetic"), original.mLocations)
                throw failure
            }
        })
        assertSame(list, original.mLocations)
        assertEquals(listOf("physical"), original.mLocations)
    }

    @Test fun nestedWritesRestoreTheOuterViewAndThenThePhysicalView() {
        val original = Result.physical()
        val list = original.mLocations
        LocationResultIsolation.writeWithLocations(original, field, { listOf("outer") }) {
            LocationResultIsolation.writeWithLocations(original, field, { listOf("inner") }) {
                assertEquals(listOf("inner"), original.mLocations)
            }
            assertEquals(listOf("outer"), original.mLocations)
        }
        assertSame(list, original.mLocations)
    }
}
```

```kt
package com.system.location.service.hook.hooks.ble

import org.junit.Assert.assertEquals
import org.junit.Assert.assertTrue
import org.junit.Test

class PendingScanRegistryTest {
    @Test fun soleRegistrationKeepsItsOwnFilterSnapshot() {
        val registry = PendingScanRegistry<Any, String>()
        val token = Any()
        registry.register(token, listOf("beacon-a"))

        assertEquals(PendingScanSelection.Unique(listOf("beacon-a")), registry.selection())
    }

    @Test fun multipleRegistrationsAreAmbiguousInsteadOfUsingTheMostRecentFilter() {
        val registry = PendingScanRegistry<Any, String>()
        registry.register(Any(), listOf("beacon-a"))
        registry.register(Any(), listOf("beacon-b"))

        assertEquals(PendingScanSelection.Ambiguous, registry.selection())
    }

    @Test fun stoppingOneRegistrationRestoresTheRemainingFilterSnapshot() {
        val registry = PendingScanRegistry<Any, String>()
        val first = Any()
        val second = Any()
        registry.register(first, listOf("beacon-a"))
        registry.register(second, listOf("beacon-b"))
        registry.unregister(first)

        val selected = registry.selection()
        assertTrue(selected is PendingScanSelection.Unique)
        assertEquals(listOf("beacon-b"), (selected as PendingScanSelection.Unique).filters)
    }
}
```
