`xposed/src/test/java/com/system/location/service/hook/hooks/gnss/AutonomousGnssLifecycleTest.kt`:

```kt
package com.system.location.service.hook.hooks.gnss

import com.system.location.service.core.geo.Wgs84
import com.system.location.service.core.gnss.*
import com.system.location.service.core.location.LocationSample
import com.system.location.service.core.runtime.HookConfiguration
import com.system.location.service.hook.hooks.nmea.NmeaBridge
import moe.microbios.nmea.NMEA
import moe.microbios.nmea.NmeaValue
import org.junit.Assert.*
import org.junit.Test

class AutonomousGnssLifecycleTest {
    @Test fun twoDaysAcrossResourceExpiryKeepThreeRoutesAndAllOutputsCoherent() {
        val almanac = GpsAlmanacResource.decode(requireNotNull(javaClass.getResource("/gnss/gps-yuma.json")).readText())
        val start = almanac.referenceEpochMillis + 7 * 86_400_000L - 300_000
        val policy = GnssSimulationPolicy(mode = GnssSimulationMode.AUTONOMOUS,
            minimumPolicy = GnssMinimumPolicy.GUARANTEE_QUANTITY, virtualSeed = 80712)
        val configuration = HookConfiguration(gnssSimulation = policy, minimumSatellites = 64)
        val source = configuration.gnssFrameSource()!!
        val destinations = listOf(
            GnssFrameRoute.Global to Wgs84(31.0, 121.0),
            GnssFrameRoute.FixedPoint(Wgs84(-31.0, -59.0)) to Wgs84(-31.0, -59.0),
            GnssFrameRoute.Scenario("equator") to Wgs84(0.0, -78.0))
        var lastSequence = 0L
        var sawAlmanac = false
        var sawEntirelyVirtual = false
        repeat(577) { step -> // Five-minute snapshots over 48 hours, not a wall-time device soak.
            val at = start + step * 300_000L
            val elapsed = 1_000_000_000L + step * 300_000_000_000L
            val publications = destinations.map { (route, point) ->
                val sample = LocationSample(point, 10.0, 5f, 2f, 90f, at, elapsed)
                val publication = source.frame(sample, 64, route, at, 10)!!
                assertTrue(publication.sequence > lastSequence)
                lastSequence = publication.sequence
                assertEquals(point, publication.frame.observer)
                assertSame(publication, source.frame(sample.copy(timeMillis = at + 200,
                    elapsedNanos = elapsed + 200_000_000), 64, route, at + 200, 10))
                val frame = publication.frame
                assertEquals(64, frame.satellites.size)
                assertEquals(64, frame.satellites.map { it.constellation to it.svid }.distinct().size)
                assertTrue(frame.satellites.all { it.elevationDeg >= 0f && it.azimuthDeg in 0f..<360f })
                assertTrue(frame.satellites.filter { it.usedInFix }.all { it.hasEphemeris })
                assertEquals(GnssGeometry.solve(frame.satellites).dop, frame.geometry.dop)
                sawAlmanac = sawAlmanac || frame.orbitProvenance.values.any { it.kind == GnssOrbitSourceKind.ALMANAC }
                sawEntirelyVirtual = sawEntirelyVirtual || frame.orbitProvenance.values.all { it.kind == GnssOrbitSourceKind.VIRTUAL }
                val sentences = NmeaBridge.generatedSentences(publication)
                assertTrue(sentences.all { it.length <= 82 && NMEA.calculateNmeaChecksum(it) == it.substringAfter('*').trim() })
                val gga = sentences.single { it.substringBefore(',').endsWith("GGA") }.substringBefore('*').split(',')
                assertEquals(GnssLocationExtras.from(publication).satellites, gga[7].toInt())
                val gsv = sentences.filter { it.substringBefore(',').endsWith("GSV") }.map(NMEA::valueOf)
                val ids = gsv.flatMap { sentence -> (sentence.value as NmeaValue.GSV).satellites.map { sentence.talkerId to it.prn } }
                assertEquals(64, ids.size)
                assertEquals(ids.size, ids.distinct().size)
                val method = ReceiverGnssStatusAdapterTest.Callbacks::class.java.getDeclaredMethod("status5",
                    Int::class.javaPrimitiveType, IntArray::class.java, FloatArray::class.java,
                    FloatArray::class.java, FloatArray::class.java)
                val arrays = ReceiverGnssStatusAdapter.arguments(method, publication)
                assertEquals(64, arrays[0])
                assertEquals(frame.satellites.count { it.usedInFix }, (arrays[1] as IntArray).count { it and 4 != 0 })
                if (step % 144 == 0) {
                    // A fresh engine reconstructs the same sky from durable resource/policy state.
                    val restarted = GnssBundledOrbitResources.model(policy, GnssOutputLimits(128, 36, 32), 604800.0)
                        .frame(GnssSkyRequest(at, point, 10.0), 64)!!
                    assertEquals(frame, restarted)
                }
                publication
            }
            assertEquals(destinations.size, publications.map { it.sequence }.distinct().size)
            assertNotEquals(publications[0].frame.satellites, publications[1].frame.satellites)
        }
        assertTrue("Resource expiry was not exercised", sawAlmanac && sawEntirelyVirtual)
    }
}
```

`xposed/src/test/java/com/system/location/service/hook/hooks/gnss/AutonomousGnssOutputTest.kt`:

```kt
package com.system.location.service.hook.hooks.gnss

import com.system.location.service.core.geo.Wgs84
import com.system.location.service.core.gnss.*
import com.system.location.service.hook.hooks.nmea.NmeaBridge
import moe.microbios.nmea.NMEA
import moe.microbios.nmea.NmeaValue
import java.time.Instant
import org.junit.Assert.*
import org.junit.Test

class AutonomousGnssOutputTest {
    private val limits = GnssOutputLimits(128, 36, 32)

    @Test fun quantity128SurvivesLegacyStatusArraysAndNmeaWithoutTruncation() {
        for (at in listOf("2026-11-11T04:00:00Z", "2028-01-01T00:00:00Z")) {
            val model = GnssBundledOrbitResources.model(GnssSimulationPolicy(
                minimumPolicy = GnssMinimumPolicy.GUARANTEE_QUANTITY), limits, 604800.0)
            val frame = model.frame(GnssSkyRequest(Instant.parse(at).toEpochMilli(), Wgs84(31.0, 121.0), 10.0), 128)!!
            assertNotNull(frame.geometry.dop)
            val publication = PublishedGnssFrame(1, frame, 2.0, 90.0)
            for (method in ReceiverGnssStatusAdapterTest.Callbacks::class.java.declaredMethods.filter {
                it.name.startsWith("status") }) {
                val args = ReceiverGnssStatusAdapter.arguments(method, publication)
                assertEquals(128, args[0])
                val flags = args[1] as IntArray
                assertEquals(128, flags.size)
                assertEquals(128, flags.map { it ushr 8 }.distinct().size)
                frame.satellites.forEachIndexed { index, satellite ->
                    assertEquals(satellite.svid, flags[index] ushr 12)
                    assertEquals(satellite.usedInFix, flags[index] and 4 != 0)
                    assertEquals(satellite.hasEphemeris, flags[index] and 1 != 0)
                }
                for (array in args.drop(2)) assertEquals(128, (array as FloatArray).size)
            }
            val lines = NmeaBridge.generatedSentences(publication)
            for (line in lines) {
                assertTrue("Oversized NMEA: $line", line.length <= 82)
                assertEquals(NMEA.calculateNmeaChecksum(line), line.substringAfter('*').trim())
            }
            val gsv = lines.filter { it.substringBefore(',').endsWith("GSV") }.map { NMEA.valueOf(it) }
            assertEquals(128, gsv.sumOf { (it.value as NmeaValue.GSV).satellites.size })
            val reconstructed = gsv.flatMap { sentence -> (sentence.value as NmeaValue.GSV).satellites.map {
                sentence.talkerId to it.prn
            } }.toSet()
            assertEquals(128, reconstructed.size)
            for ((_, sentences) in gsv.groupBy { it.talkerId }) {
                val fields = sentences.map { it.value as NmeaValue.GSV }
                assertTrue(fields.size <= 9)
                assertEquals((1..fields.size).toList(), fields.map { it.messageNumber })
                assertTrue(fields.all { it.totalMessages == fields.size })
                assertTrue(fields.all { it.totalSatellitesInView == fields.sumOf { item -> item.satellites.size } })
            }
            val gga = lines.single { it.substringBefore(',').endsWith("GGA") }.substringBefore('*').split(',')
            assertEquals(frame.satellites.count { it.usedInFix }, gga[7].toInt())
            assertTrue(gga[7].length <= 2)
            val gsaIds = lines.filter { it.substringBefore(',').endsWith("GSA") }.flatMap { line ->
                val fields = line.substringBefore('*').split(',')
                fields.subList(3, 15).filter { it.isNotEmpty() }.map { fields[18].toInt() to it.toInt() }
            }.toSet()
            assertEquals(frame.satellites.count { it.usedInFix }, gsaIds.size)
        }
    }
}
```

`xposed/src/test/java/com/system/location/service/hook/hooks/gnss/GnssBatchDeliveryTest.kt`:

```kt
package com.system.location.service.hook.hooks.gnss

import android.os.IBinder
import android.os.IInterface
import com.system.location.service.hook.runtime.DeliveryWorker
import java.lang.reflect.Proxy
import java.util.concurrent.CopyOnWriteArrayList
import java.util.concurrent.CountDownLatch
import java.util.concurrent.TimeUnit
import java.util.concurrent.atomic.AtomicReference
import org.junit.Assert.*
import org.junit.Test

class GnssBatchDeliveryTest {
    @Test fun policyStopAndReloadResumeOnlyTheUnsentSuffix() {
        val listener = listener()
        val old = GnssCallbackRegistry()
        old.register(listener, "app", 10001)
        val sent = mutableListOf<Int>()
        var allowed = true
        old.deliverBatch(listener, "exact batch", 4, { allowed }) {
            sent += it
            allowed = false
        }
        assertEquals(listOf(0), sent)
        val saved = old.subscriptions().single()
        assertEquals(1, saved.nextDeliveryIndex)
        assertNull(saved.lastDeliveryKey)
        old.clear()
        val successor = GnssCallbackRegistry()
        assertTrue(successor.restore(saved))
        successor.deliverBatch(listener, "exact batch", 4, { true }) { sent += it }
        repeat(3) { successor.deliverBatch(listener, "exact batch", 4, { true }) { fail("Repeated completed batch") } }
        assertEquals(listOf(0, 1, 2, 3), sent)
        assertNull(successor.subscriptions().single().pendingDeliveryKey)
        assertEquals(0, successor.subscriptions().single().nextDeliveryIndex)
        successor.clear()
    }

    @Test fun failedSubmissionRetriesItsItemWithoutRepeatingTheSuccessfulPrefix() {
        val listener = listener()
        val registry = GnssCallbackRegistry()
        registry.register(listener, "app", 10001)
        val sent = mutableListOf<Int>()
        assertThrows(IllegalStateException::class.java) {
            registry.deliverBatch(listener, "batch", 3, { true }) {
                if (it == 1) error("Submission failed before acceptance")
                sent += it
            }
        }
        registry.deliverBatch(listener, "batch", 3, { true }) { sent += it }
        assertEquals(listOf(0, 1, 2), sent)
        registry.clear()
    }

    @Test fun aDifferentEpochDiscardsTheOldUnsentSuffixAndStartsAtItsFirstSentence() {
        val listener = listener()
        val registry = GnssCallbackRegistry()
        registry.register(listener, "app", 10001)
        val sent = mutableListOf<String>()
        var allowed = true
        registry.deliverBatch(listener, "old epoch", 3, { allowed }) {
            sent += "old:$it"; allowed = false
        }
        registry.deliverBatch(listener, "new epoch", 2, { true }) { sent += "new:$it" }
        assertEquals(listOf("old:0", "new:0", "new:1"), sent)
        registry.clear()
    }

    @Test fun unregisterCanFinishDuringBlockedBinderAndReregistrationInvalidatesOldSuffix() {
        val listener = listener()
        val registry = GnssCallbackRegistry()
        registry.register(listener, "app", 10001)
        val entered = CountDownLatch(1)
        val release = CountDownLatch(1)
        val removed = CountDownLatch(1)
        val sent = CopyOnWriteArrayList<Int>()
        val failure = AtomicReference<Throwable?>()
        val sender = Thread {
            runCatching {
                registry.deliverBatch(listener, "batch", 4, { true }) {
                    sent += it; entered.countDown()
                    check(release.await(3, TimeUnit.SECONDS))
                }
            }.onFailure(failure::set)
        }.apply { start() }
        val remover = Thread {
            runCatching {
                check(entered.await(2, TimeUnit.SECONDS))
                registry.unregister(listener)
                registry.register(listener, "app", 10001)
                removed.countDown()
            }.onFailure(failure::set)
        }.apply { start() }
        try {
            assertTrue("Registry lock must not span Binder delivery", removed.await(2, TimeUnit.SECONDS))
        } finally {
            release.countDown(); sender.join(3000); remover.join(3000)
        }
        assertFalse(sender.isAlive); assertFalse(remover.isAlive)
        failure.get()?.let { throw AssertionError(it) }
        assertEquals(listOf(0), sent)
        assertNull(registry.subscriptions().single().pendingDeliveryKey)
        registry.deliverBatch(listener, "batch", 4, { true }) { sent += it }
        assertEquals(listOf(0, 0, 1, 2, 3), sent) // The second 0 belongs to the new registration.
        registry.clear()
    }

    @Test fun deliveryWorkerPauseCommitsTheAcceptedItemBeforeInterruptingTheSuffix() {
        val listener = listener()
        val registry = GnssCallbackRegistry()
        registry.register(listener, "app", 10001)
        val entered = CountDownLatch(1)
        val release = CountDownLatch(1)
        val sent = CopyOnWriteArrayList<Int>()
        val failure = AtomicReference<Throwable?>()
        val worker = DeliveryWorker("batch-pause-test", { 1000 }, tick = {
            registry.deliverBatch(listener, "batch", 3, { true }) {
                sent += it; entered.countDown()
                var interrupted = false
                while (release.count > 0) try { release.await() }
                catch (_: InterruptedException) { interrupted = true }
                if (interrupted) Thread.currentThread().interrupt()
            }
        }, failure = { failure.set(it) })
        try {
            worker.start()
            assertTrue(entered.await(2, TimeUnit.SECONDS))
            assertFalse(worker.stop(0))
        } finally { release.countDown(); assertTrue(worker.stop(2000)) }
        failure.get()?.let { throw AssertionError(it) }
        assertEquals(listOf(0), sent)
        assertEquals(1, registry.subscriptions().single().nextDeliveryIndex)
        registry.deliverBatch(listener, "batch", 3, { true }) { sent += it }
        assertEquals(listOf(0, 1, 2), sent)
        registry.clear()
    }

    private fun listener(): IInterface {
        val binder = Proxy.newProxyInstance(IBinder::class.java.classLoader, arrayOf(IBinder::class.java)) { proxy, method, args ->
            when (method.name) {
                "isBinderAlive", "unlinkToDeath" -> true
                "hashCode" -> System.identityHashCode(proxy)
                "equals" -> proxy === args?.get(0)
                else -> null
            }
        } as IBinder
        return object : IInterface { override fun asBinder(): IBinder = binder }
    }
}
```

`xposed/src/test/java/com/system/location/service/hook/hooks/gnss/GnssCallbackRegistryTest.kt`:

```kt
package com.system.location.service.hook.hooks.gnss

import android.os.IBinder
import android.os.IInterface
import com.system.location.service.core.geo.Wgs84
import com.system.location.service.core.gnss.GnssFrameRoute
import com.system.location.service.core.routing.*
import java.lang.reflect.Proxy
import org.junit.Assert.*
import org.junit.Test

class GnssCallbackRegistryTest {
    @Test fun submissionDeathOnlyUnlinksTheRegistrationThatSubmittedIt() {
        for (batch in listOf(false, true)) for (replace in listOf(false, true)) {
            val transport = Transport()
            val registry = GnssCallbackRegistry()
            val listener = transport.listener()
            registry.register(listener, "old", 10001)
            val failSubmission = {
                if (replace) {
                    registry.unregister(listener)
                    assertTrue(registry.register(listener, "new", 10002))
                }
                throw android.os.DeadObjectException()
            }
            assertThrows(android.os.DeadObjectException::class.java) {
                if (batch) registry.deliverBatch(listener, "epoch", 3, { true }) { failSubmission() }
                else registry.deliverOnce(listener, "epoch") { failSubmission() }
            }
            if (replace) {
                assertEquals(10002, registry.subscriptions().single().uid)
                assertNull(registry.subscriptions().single().lastDeliveryKey)
            } else assertTrue(registry.subscriptions().isEmpty())
            registry.clear()
            assertEquals(transport.links, transport.unlinks)
        }
    }

    @Test fun successfulFrameIsNotRepeatedAndCursorSurvivesRetirement() {
        val transport = Transport()
        val old = GnssCallbackRegistry()
        val listener = transport.listener()
        old.register(listener, "app", 10001)
        var calls = 0
        repeat(3) { old.deliverOnce(listener, "epoch-a exact output") { calls++; true } }
        assertEquals(1, calls)
        val saved = old.subscriptions().single()
        old.clear()
        val successor = GnssCallbackRegistry()
        assertTrue(successor.restore(saved))
        successor.deliverOnce(listener, "epoch-a exact output") { calls++; true }
        assertEquals(1, calls)
        successor.deliverOnce(listener, "epoch-a changed output") { calls++; true }
        successor.deliverOnce(listener, "epoch-b exact output") { calls++; true }
        assertEquals(3, calls)
        successor.unregister(listener)
        successor.register(listener, "app", 10001)
        successor.deliverOnce(listener, "epoch-b exact output") { calls++; true }
        assertEquals(4, calls)
        successor.clear()
    }

    @Test fun partialOrFailedDeliveryDoesNotCommitAndOldInFlightCannotAffectReregistration() {
        val transport = Transport()
        val registry = GnssCallbackRegistry()
        val listener = transport.listener()
        registry.register(listener, "app", 10001)
        registry.deliverOnce(listener, "frame") { false }
        assertNull(registry.subscriptions().single().lastDeliveryKey)
        assertThrows(IllegalStateException::class.java) {
            registry.deliverOnce(listener, "frame") { error("Binder failed") }
        }
        assertNull(registry.subscriptions().single().lastDeliveryKey)
        registry.deliverOnce(listener, "frame") {
            registry.unregister(listener)
            registry.register(listener, "app", 10001)
            true
        }
        assertNull(registry.subscriptions().single().lastDeliveryKey)
        registry.deliverOnce(listener, "frame") { true }
        assertEquals("frame", registry.subscriptions().single().lastDeliveryKey)
        registry.clear()
    }

    @Test fun deathDuringLinkCannotReportASuccessfulRegistrationOrRestore() {
        for (restoring in listOf(false, true)) {
            val transport = Transport().apply { dieDuringLink = true }
            val registry = GnssCallbackRegistry()
            val listener = transport.listener()
            val registered = if (restoring) registry.restore(
                com.system.location.service.hook.runtime.CallbackSubscription(listener, 10001, "app"))
            else registry.register(listener, "app", 10001)
            assertFalse(registered)
            assertTrue(registry.listeners().isEmpty())
            assertEquals(transport.links, transport.unlinks)
        }
    }

    @Test fun delayedDeathFromReplacedRegistrationCannotRemoveCurrentListener() {
        val transport = Transport()
        val registry = GnssCallbackRegistry()
        val listener = transport.listener()
        assertTrue(registry.register(listener, "old", 10001))
        val oldDeath = transport.death!!
        registry.unregister(listener)
        assertTrue(registry.register(listener, "new", 10002))
        oldDeath.binderDied()
        assertEquals(10002, registry.subscriptions().single().uid)
        registry.clear()
        assertEquals(transport.links, transport.unlinks)
    }

    @Test fun retirementUnlinksOldGenerationAndRestoresOnlyOneSuccessorDeathLink() {
        val transport = Transport()
        val old = GnssCallbackRegistry()
        val successor = GnssCallbackRegistry()
        assertTrue(old.register(transport.listener(), "app", 10001))
        val saved = old.subscriptions().single()
        val oldDeath = transport.death!!
        old.clear()
        assertTrue(old.listeners().isEmpty())
        assertEquals(1, transport.unlinks)
        assertTrue(successor.restore(saved))
        assertFalse(successor.restore(saved))
        oldDeath.binderDied()
        assertEquals(1, successor.listeners().size)
        successor.clear()
        assertEquals(2, transport.links)
        assertEquals(transport.links, transport.unlinks)
    }

    @Test fun receiverRouteRetainsScenarioAndPointIdentityAcrossLiveConfigChanges() {
        val point = Wgs84(31.0, 121.0)
        var config = RoutingConfig(mode = RoutingMode.PER_APP, routes = listOf(
            AppRoute("app", scenarioId = "route-a", uid = 10001)))
        val registry = GnssCallbackRegistry { packageName, uid, captured -> RoutingTable(captured ?: RoutingConfig()).decision(uid, packageName, false) }
        val listener = Transport().listener()
        assertNull(registry.routeFor(listener, config))
        registry.register(listener, "app", 10001)
        assertEquals(GnssFrameRoute.Scenario("route-a"), registry.routeFor(listener, config))
        val retained = config
        config = config.copy(routes = listOf(AppRoute("app", point = point)))
        assertEquals(GnssFrameRoute.Scenario("route-a"), registry.routeFor(listener, retained))
        assertEquals(GnssFrameRoute.Global, registry.routeFor(listener, null))
        assertEquals(GnssFrameRoute.FixedPoint(point), registry.routeFor(listener, config))
        config = config.copy(routes = emptyList(), globalScenarioId = "route-b")
        assertEquals(GnssFrameRoute.Scenario("route-b"), registry.routeFor(listener, config))
        config = config.copy(deniedPackages = setOf("app"))
        assertNull(registry.routeFor(listener, config))
        config = config.copy(mode = RoutingMode.GLOBAL)
        assertEquals(GnssFrameRoute.Global, registry.routeFor(listener, config))
        registry.unregister(listener)
        assertNull(registry.routeFor(listener, config))
    }

    @Test fun duplicateTransportRegistrationIsDeduplicatedAndDeathReleasesTheCallback() {
        val transport = Transport()
        val registry = GnssCallbackRegistry()
        assertTrue(registry.register(transport.listener(), "app", 10001))
        assertTrue(registry.register(transport.listener(), "app", 10001))
        assertEquals(1, registry.listeners().size)
        assertEquals(1, transport.links)
        transport.alive = false
        transport.death!!.binderDied()
        assertTrue(registry.listeners().isEmpty())
        assertEquals(1, transport.unlinks)
    }

    @Test fun explicitUnregisterAndClearUnlinkRecipientsAndDeadBindersCannotRegister() {
        val transport = Transport()
        val registry = GnssCallbackRegistry()
        val listener = transport.listener()
        registry.register(listener, "app", 10001)
        registry.unregister(listener)
        assertTrue(registry.listeners().isEmpty())
        registry.register(listener, "app", 10001)
        registry.clear()
        assertEquals(2, transport.unlinks)
        transport.alive = false
        assertFalse(registry.register(listener, "app", 10001))
    }

    private class Transport {
        var alive = true
        var dieDuringLink = false
        var links = 0
        var unlinks = 0
        var death: IBinder.DeathRecipient? = null
        private val binder = Proxy.newProxyInstance(IBinder::class.java.classLoader, arrayOf(IBinder::class.java)) { proxy, method, args ->
            when (method.name) {
                "isBinderAlive" -> alive
                "linkToDeath" -> {
                    links++; death = args!![0] as IBinder.DeathRecipient
                    if (dieDuringLink) { alive = false; death!!.binderDied() }
                    null
                }
                "unlinkToDeath" -> { unlinks++; true }
                "hashCode" -> System.identityHashCode(proxy)
                "equals" -> proxy === args?.get(0)
                "toString" -> "test-binder"
                else -> null
            }
        } as IBinder
        fun listener() = object : IInterface { override fun asBinder(): IBinder = binder }
    }
}
```

`xposed/src/test/java/com/system/location/service/hook/hooks/gnss/RawGnssCallbackTest.kt`:

```kt
package com.system.location.service.hook.hooks.gnss

import io.github.libxposed.api.XposedInterface
import java.lang.reflect.Proxy
import org.junit.Assert.*
import org.junit.Test

class RawGnssCallbackTest {
    @Suppress("UNUSED_PARAMETER")
    private class Callback {
        fun onGnssMeasurementsReceived(event: Any) = Unit
        fun onGnssNavigationMessageReceived(event: Any) = Unit
        fun onGnssAntennaInfoReceived(event: Any) = Unit
        fun onStatusChanged(status: Int) = Unit
    }
    private class Call(name: String) {
        var proceeds = 0
        var arguments: List<Any?> = listOf(if (name == "onStatusChanged") 1 else Any())
        private val executable = Callback::class.java.declaredMethods.single { it.name == name }
        val result = Any()
        val chain = Proxy.newProxyInstance(XposedInterface.Chain::class.java.classLoader,
            arrayOf(XposedInterface.Chain::class.java)) { _, method, args -> when (method.name) {
                "getExecutable" -> executable
                "getArgs" -> arguments
                "getThisObject" -> null
                "proceed" -> {
                    proceeds++
                    if (!args.isNullOrEmpty()) arguments = (args.single() as Array<*>).toList()
                    result
                }
                else -> error(method.name)
            } } as XposedInterface.Chain
    }

    @Test fun existingRawListenerFollowsLivePolicyAndCanResume() {
        var blocked = false
        val hook = rawGnssCallbackHook { blocked }
        for (name in listOf("onGnssMeasurementsReceived", "onGnssNavigationMessageReceived", "onGnssAntennaInfoReceived")) {
            val real = Call(name)
            assertSame(real.result, hook.intercept(real.chain))
            blocked = true
            val suppressed = Call(name)
            assertNull(hook.intercept(suppressed.chain))
            assertEquals(0, suppressed.proceeds)
            blocked = false
            val resumed = Call(name)
            assertSame(resumed.result, hook.intercept(resumed.chain))
            assertEquals(1, resumed.proceeds)
        }
    }

    @Test fun blockedRawCallbackReportsUnsupportedRatherThanReady() {
        val call = Call("onStatusChanged")
        rawGnssCallbackHook { true }.intercept(call.chain)
        assertEquals(1, call.proceeds)
        assertEquals(listOf(0), call.arguments)
    }
}
```

`xposed/src/test/java/com/system/location/service/hook/hooks/gnss/RawGnssRegistrationTest.kt`:

```kt
package com.system.location.service.hook.hooks.gnss

import io.github.libxposed.api.XposedInterface
import java.lang.reflect.Proxy
import org.junit.Assert.*
import org.junit.Test

class RawGnssStatusCallbackForTest {
    var status: Int? = null
    var fail = false
    fun onStatusChanged(value: Int) {
        if (fail) error("callback failed")
        status = value
    }
}

class RawGnssRegistrationTest {
    private class Call(name: String, val failure: RuntimeException? = null) {
        var proceeds = 0
        val result = Any()
        val arguments = listOf(Any())
        private val executable = Service::class.java.getDeclaredMethod(name, Any::class.java)
        val chain = Proxy.newProxyInstance(XposedInterface.Chain::class.java.classLoader,
            arrayOf(XposedInterface.Chain::class.java)) { _, method, _ -> when (method.name) {
                "getExecutable" -> executable
                "getArgs" -> arguments
                "proceed" -> { proceeds++; if (failure != null) throw failure; result }
                else -> error(method.name)
            } } as XposedInterface.Chain
    }
    @Suppress("UNUSED_PARAMETER")
    private class Service {
        fun addBoolean(listener: Any): Boolean = true
        fun addVoid(listener: Any) = Unit
        fun removeListener(listener: Any) = Unit
    }

    private open class MeasurementCallbackBase {
        fun onGnssMeasurementsReceived(event: Any) = Unit
        fun onStatusChanged(status: Int) = Unit
    }
    private class InheritedMeasurementCallback : MeasurementCallbackBase()
    private class UnsupportedCallback { fun onLocationChanged(value: Any) = Unit }

    @Test fun rejectionUsesApiReturnContractWithoutCallingPhysicalRegistration() {
        val hook = rawGnssRegistrationHook { true }
        val boolean = Call("addBoolean")
        assertEquals(false, hook.intercept(boolean.chain))
        assertEquals(0, boolean.proceeds)
        val void = Call("addVoid")
        assertNull(hook.intercept(void.chain))
        assertEquals(0, void.proceeds)
    }

    @Test fun voidRejectionReportsUnsupportedAndCallbackFailureDoesNotEscape() {
        val callback = RawGnssStatusCallbackForTest()
        reportRawGnssUnsupported(callback)
        assertEquals(0, callback.status)

        callback.fail = true
        reportRawGnssUnsupported(callback)
        assertEquals(0, callback.status)
    }

    @Test fun hookSetupRejectionMatchesBooleanAndVoidRegistrationContracts() {
        val booleanMethod = Service::class.java.getDeclaredMethod("addBoolean", Any::class.java)
        val voidMethod = Service::class.java.getDeclaredMethod("addVoid", Any::class.java)

        assertEquals(false, rejectRawGnssRegistration(booleanMethod, null))
        assertNull(rejectRawGnssRegistration(voidMethod, null))
    }

    @Test fun policyPassthroughLeavesRealRegistrationIntact() {
        val call = Call("addBoolean")
        assertSame(call.result, rawGnssRegistrationHook { false }.intercept(call.chain))
        assertEquals(1, call.proceeds)
    }

    @Test fun policyReceivesTheCurrentCallArgumentsExactlyOnce() {
        val call = Call("addBoolean")
        var queries = 0
        val hook = rawGnssRegistrationHook { args ->
            queries++
            assertEquals(call.chain.args, args)
            true
        }
        assertEquals(false, hook.intercept(call.chain))
        assertEquals(1, queries)
        val excluded = rawGnssRegistrationHook { false }
        assertSame(call.result, excluded.intercept(call.chain))
    }

    @Test fun unregistrationAndOriginalFailureAlwaysReachAndroidExactlyOnce() {
        val call = Call("removeListener")
        val hook = rawGnssRegistrationHook { true }
        assertSame(call.result, hook.intercept(call.chain))
        assertEquals(1, call.proceeds)
        val noQuery = rawGnssRegistrationHook { error("removal queried policy") }
        assertSame(call.result, noQuery.intercept(call.chain))
        assertEquals(2, call.proceeds)
        val failure = IllegalStateException("Android registration failure")
        val failed = Call("addVoid", failure)
        assertSame(failure, assertThrows(IllegalStateException::class.java) {
            rawGnssRegistrationHook { false }.intercept(failed.chain)
        })
        assertEquals(1, failed.proceeds)
    }

    @Test fun callbackDiscoveryIncludesInheritedPayloadMethodsAndRejectsUnknownInterfaces() {
        val methods = rawGnssCallbackMethods(InheritedMeasurementCallback::class.java)
        assertTrue(methods.any { it.name == "onGnssMeasurementsReceived" })
        assertTrue(methods.any { it.name == "onStatusChanged" })
        assertThrows(IllegalArgumentException::class.java) {
            rawGnssCallbackMethods(UnsupportedCallback::class.java)
        }
    }
}
```

`xposed/src/test/java/com/system/location/service/hook/hooks/gnss/RawGnssRollbackTest.kt`:

```kt
package com.system.location.service.hook.hooks.gnss

import android.os.IBinder
import android.os.IInterface
import io.github.libxposed.api.XposedInterface
import com.system.location.service.hook.runtime.CallbackSubscription
import com.system.location.service.hook.runtime.HookRuntime
import java.lang.reflect.Proxy
import org.junit.Assert.*
import org.junit.After
import org.junit.Before
import org.junit.Test

class RawGnssRollbackTest {
    private val frameworkField = HookRuntime::class.java.getDeclaredField("framework").apply {
        isAccessible = true
    }
    private var previousFramework: XposedInterface? = null

    @Before
    fun installJvmLogFramework() {
        previousFramework = frameworkField.get(HookRuntime) as? XposedInterface
        frameworkField.set(HookRuntime, Proxy.newProxyInstance(
            XposedInterface::class.java.classLoader,
            arrayOf(XposedInterface::class.java),
        ) { proxy, method, args ->
            when (method.name) {
                "log" -> null
                "equals" -> proxy === args?.get(0)
                "hashCode" -> System.identityHashCode(proxy)
                "toString" -> "JvmLogFramework"
                else -> error("Unexpected framework call: ${method.name}")
            }
        })
    }

    @After
    fun restoreFramework() {
        frameworkField.set(HookRuntime, previousFramework)
    }

    @Test fun partialHookInstallationFailureUnlinksTheProvisionalListenerWithoutCallingAndroid() {
        val call = Call()
        try {
            assertEquals(false, RawGnssCallbacks.proceed(call.chain, install = {
                assertEquals(1, RawGnssCallbacks.subscriptions().size)
                error("Second callback hook could not be installed")
            }, callerUid = { 10001 }))
            assertEquals(0, call.proceeds)
            assertTrue("Failed hook setup leaked a raw subscription", RawGnssCallbacks.subscriptions().isEmpty())
            assertEquals(call.links, call.unlinks)
        } finally { RawGnssCallbacks.clear() }
    }

    @Test fun duplicateRegistrationFailurePreservesTheOriginalSubscription() {
        val call = Call()
        try {
            assertTrue(RawGnssCallbacks.proceed(call.chain, install = {}, callerUid = { 10001 }) as Boolean)
            val saved = RawGnssCallbacks.subscriptions().single()
            assertEquals(true, RawGnssCallbacks.proceed(call.chain,
                install = { error("Hook setup failed") }, callerUid = { 10002 }))
            assertEquals(saved, RawGnssCallbacks.subscriptions().single())
            assertEquals(1, call.proceeds)
            assertEquals(1, call.links)
            assertEquals(0, call.unlinks)
        } finally { RawGnssCallbacks.clear() }
        assertEquals(call.links, call.unlinks)
    }

    @Test fun platformRejectionAndFailureRollBackNewRegistrationsButNotExistingOnes() {
        for (existing in listOf(false, true)) for (throws in listOf(false, true)) {
            val call = Call()
            try {
                if (existing) RawGnssCallbacks.proceed(call.chain, install = {}, callerUid = { 10001 })
                val failure = IllegalArgumentException("Android rejected registration")
                call.failure = if (throws) failure else null
                call.result = false
                if (throws) assertSame(failure, assertThrows(IllegalArgumentException::class.java) {
                    RawGnssCallbacks.proceed(call.chain, install = {}, callerUid = { 10001 })
                }) else assertEquals(false, RawGnssCallbacks.proceed(call.chain, install = {}, callerUid = { 10001 }))
                assertEquals(if (existing) 1 else 0, RawGnssCallbacks.subscriptions().size)
                assertEquals(if (existing) 2 else 1, call.proceeds)
            } finally { RawGnssCallbacks.clear() }
            assertEquals(call.links, call.unlinks)
        }
    }

    @Test fun callbackHookLinkageErrorIsRejectedWithoutCallingAndroid() {
        val call = Call()
        try {
            assertEquals(false, RawGnssCallbacks.proceed(call.chain, install = {
                throw NoClassDefFoundError("OEM callback surface")
            }, callerUid = { 10001 }))
            assertEquals(0, call.proceeds)
            assertTrue("LinkageError leaked a raw subscription", RawGnssCallbacks.subscriptions().isEmpty())
            assertEquals(call.links, call.unlinks)
        } finally { RawGnssCallbacks.clear() }
    }

    @Test fun frameworkUnsupportedRegistrationBecomesApiShapedRejection() {
        val call = Call().apply { error = UnsupportedOperationException("raw GNSS unavailable") }
        try {
            assertEquals(false, RawGnssCallbacks.proceed(call.chain, install = {}, callerUid = { 10001 }))
            assertEquals(1, call.proceeds)
            assertTrue("Framework rejection leaked a raw subscription", RawGnssCallbacks.subscriptions().isEmpty())
            assertEquals(call.links, call.unlinks)
        } finally { RawGnssCallbacks.clear() }
    }

    @Test fun duplicateRegistrationPreservesExistingSubscriptionWhenFrameworkIsUnsupported() {
        val call = Call()
        try {
            assertTrue(RawGnssCallbacks.proceed(call.chain, install = {}, callerUid = { 10001 }) as Boolean)
            val saved = RawGnssCallbacks.subscriptions().single()
            call.error = UnsupportedOperationException("raw GNSS unavailable")
            assertEquals(true, RawGnssCallbacks.proceed(call.chain, install = {}, callerUid = { 10002 }))
            assertEquals(saved, RawGnssCallbacks.subscriptions().single())
            assertEquals(2, call.proceeds)
        } finally { RawGnssCallbacks.clear() }
    }

    @Test fun restoreHookFailureDoesNotEscapeAndKeepsSubscriptionForInstalledGuards() {
        val call = Call()
        try {
            val subscription = CallbackSubscription(call.listener, 10001, "app")
            assertFalse(RawGnssCallbacks.restoreAndInstall(subscription) {
                error("An OEM callback method cannot be hooked")
            })
            assertEquals(1, RawGnssCallbacks.subscriptions().size)
            assertEquals(1, call.links)
            assertEquals(0, call.unlinks)
        } finally { RawGnssCallbacks.clear() }
        assertEquals(call.links, call.unlinks)
    }

    private class Call {
        var links = 0
        var unlinks = 0
        var proceeds = 0
        var result = true
        var failure: RuntimeException? = null
        var error: Throwable? = null
        private val binder = Proxy.newProxyInstance(IBinder::class.java.classLoader,
            arrayOf(IBinder::class.java)) { proxy, method, args -> when (method.name) {
                "isBinderAlive" -> true
                "linkToDeath" -> { links++; null }
                "unlinkToDeath" -> { unlinks++; true }
                "hashCode" -> System.identityHashCode(proxy)
                "equals" -> proxy === args?.get(0)
                else -> null
            } } as IBinder
        val listener = object : IInterface { override fun asBinder(): IBinder = binder }
        val chain = Proxy.newProxyInstance(XposedInterface.Chain::class.java.classLoader,
            arrayOf(XposedInterface.Chain::class.java)) { _, method, _ -> when (method.name) {
                "getExecutable" -> Service::class.java.getDeclaredMethod("addListener", IInterface::class.java)
                "getArgs" -> listOf(listener, "app")
                "proceed" -> {
                    proceeds++
                    (error ?: failure)?.let { throw it }
                    result
                }
                else -> error(method.name)
            } } as XposedInterface.Chain
    }
    private class Service {
        @Suppress("UNUSED_PARAMETER") fun addListener(listener: IInterface): Boolean = true
    }
}
```

`xposed/src/test/java/com/system/location/service/hook/hooks/gnss/ReceiverDeliveryPolicyTest.kt`:

```kt
package com.system.location.service.hook.hooks.gnss

import com.system.location.service.core.geo.Wgs84
import com.system.location.service.core.gnss.GnssSimulationMode
import com.system.location.service.core.gnss.GnssSimulationPolicy
import com.system.location.service.core.location.LocationSample
import com.system.location.service.core.routing.RoutingConfig
import com.system.location.service.core.runtime.HookConfiguration
import com.system.location.service.core.runtime.RuntimeSnapshot
import com.system.location.service.core.runtime.RuntimeSnapshotStore
import com.system.location.service.core.runtime.RuntimeSnapshotObservation
import com.system.location.service.core.runtime.RuntimeTransfer
import com.system.location.service.hook.utils.FakeLoc
import org.junit.Assert.*
import org.junit.Test

class ReceiverDeliveryPolicyTest {
    private val initial = RuntimeSnapshot(configRevision = 10,
        configuration = HookConfiguration(enabled = true, nmeaEnabled = true))

    @Test fun autonomousDeliveryNeedsNoCaptureButOffAndEmptyReplayNeverOwnCallbacks() {
        assertNull(initial.configuration.gnssSource)
        assertTrue(receiverDeliveryAllowed(initial, 0, RuntimeSnapshotObservation(initial, 0)))
        for (mode in listOf(GnssSimulationMode.OFF, GnssSimulationMode.REPLAY)) {
            val inactive = initial.copy(configuration = initial.configuration.copy(
                gnssSimulation = GnssSimulationPolicy(mode = mode)))
            assertFalse(receiverDeliveryAllowed(inactive, 0, RuntimeSnapshotObservation(inactive, 0)))
            assertFalse(receiverDeliveryAllowed(inactive, 0, RuntimeSnapshotObservation(inactive, 0), nmea = true))
        }
    }

    @Test fun sampleRenewalDoesNotSplitACapturedBatchButStopAndRestartInvalidateIt() {
        val store = RuntimeSnapshotStore(initial)
        store.publishSample(LocationSample(Wgs84(31.0, 121.0), 0.0, 5f, 1f, 0f, 1000, 1000))
        assertTrue(receiverDeliveryAllowed(initial, 0, store.observation(), nmea = true))
        store.update { it.copy(configRevision = 11, configuration = it.configuration.copy(enabled = false)) }
        assertFalse(receiverDeliveryAllowed(initial, 0, store.observation()))
        store.update { it.copy(configRevision = 12, configuration = it.configuration.copy(enabled = true)) }
        assertFalse("A resumed session cannot finish its predecessor's captured batch",
            receiverDeliveryAllowed(initial, 0, store.observation(), nmea = true))
    }

    @Test fun switchAndRouteChangesRejectTheOldBatchEvenIfTheirWriterFailedToBumpRevision() {
        for (current in listOf(
            initial.copy(configuration = initial.configuration.copy(gnssEnabled = false)),
            initial.copy(configuration = initial.configuration.copy(nmeaEnabled = false)),
            initial.copy(configuration = initial.configuration.copy(minimumSatellites = 20)),
            initial.copy(routing = RoutingConfig(globalScenarioId = "another-route")),
        )) assertFalse(receiverDeliveryAllowed(initial, 0, RuntimeSnapshotObservation(current, 0), nmea = true))
        val disabledNmea = initial.copy(configuration = initial.configuration.copy(nmeaEnabled = false))
        assertTrue("NMEA off must still allow a captured status batch",
            receiverDeliveryAllowed(disabledNmea, 0, RuntimeSnapshotObservation(disabledNmea, 0)))
        assertFalse(receiverDeliveryAllowed(disabledNmea, 0, RuntimeSnapshotObservation(disabledNmea, 0), nmea = true))
    }

    @Test fun actualProductionSampleAcceptanceAdvancesRevisionWithoutInvalidatingBatch() {
        val before = FakeLoc.captureTransfer(1000)
        try {
            FakeLoc.restoreRuntime(RuntimeTransfer(initial, false), 1000)
            val captured = FakeLoc.runtimeSnapshots.observation()
            val first = LocationSample(Wgs84(31.0, 121.0), 0.0, 5f, 1f, 0f, 1000, 1000)
            repeat(20) { index ->
                FakeLoc.acceptSample(first.copy(timeMillis = 1000L + index * 100,
                    elapsedNanos = 1000L + index * 100_000_000))
                val current = FakeLoc.runtimeSnapshots.observation()
                assertTrue(current.state.configRevision > captured.state.configRevision)
                assertTrue(receiverDeliveryAllowed(captured.state, captured.simulationGeneration, current, nmea = true))
            }
        } finally { FakeLoc.restoreRuntime(before, 1000) }
    }
}
```

`xposed/src/test/java/com/system/location/service/hook/hooks/gnss/ReceiverGnssStatusAdapterTest.kt`:

```kt
package com.system.location.service.hook.hooks.gnss

import com.system.location.service.core.geo.Wgs84
import com.system.location.service.core.gnss.*
import org.junit.Assert.*
import org.junit.Test

class ReceiverGnssStatusAdapterTest {
    private val publication = PublishedGnssFrame(1, ReceiverGnssFrame(1790000000000, Wgs84(31.0, 121.0), 10.0,
        listOf(GnssSatellite(Constellation.BEIDOU, 9, 25f, 90f, 33f, true, true, true, 1561e6f)),
        GnssGeometryResult(null), ReceiverGnssSource.STATISTICAL_REPLAY), 0.0, 0.0)

    @Test fun arraySignaturesAreSizedExactlyAndUnobservedFieldsAreNotAdvertised() {
        for (method in Callbacks::class.java.declaredMethods.filter { it.name.startsWith("status") }) {
            assertTrue(ReceiverGnssStatusAdapter.supports(method))
            val args = ReceiverGnssStatusAdapter.arguments(method, publication)
            assertEquals(method.parameterCount, args.size)
            assertEquals(1, args[0])
            val packed = (args[1] as IntArray).single()
            assertEquals(9, packed ushr 12)
            assertEquals(5, (packed ushr 8) and 0xf)
            assertEquals(0, packed and 16)
            assertEquals(15, packed and 15)
            assertArrayEquals(floatArrayOf(33f), args[2] as FloatArray, 0f)
        }
    }

    @Test fun unsupportedSignaturesAreExplicit() {
        val method = Callbacks::class.java.getDeclaredMethod("unsupported", String::class.java)
        assertFalse(ReceiverGnssStatusAdapter.supports(method))
        assertThrows(IllegalArgumentException::class.java) { ReceiverGnssStatusAdapter.arguments(method, publication) }
    }

    @Suppress("UNUSED_PARAMETER")
    class Callbacks {
        fun status5(n: Int, s: IntArray, c: FloatArray, e: FloatArray, a: FloatArray) = Unit
        fun status6(n: Int, s: IntArray, c: FloatArray, e: FloatArray, a: FloatArray, f: FloatArray) = Unit
        fun status7(n: Int, s: IntArray, c: FloatArray, e: FloatArray, a: FloatArray, f: FloatArray, b: FloatArray) = Unit
        fun unsupported(value: String) = Unit
    }
}
```

`xposed/src/test/java/com/system/location/service/hook/hooks/gnss/ReceiverTickFramesTest.kt`:

```kt
package com.system.location.service.hook.hooks.gnss

import com.system.location.service.core.geo.Wgs84
import com.system.location.service.core.gnss.*
import org.junit.Assert.*
import org.junit.Test

class ReceiverTickFramesTest {
    @Test fun bothTransportsAndAllRecipientsShareOnePublicationForEachRoute() {
        var calls = 0L
        val frames = ReceiverTickFrames { route ->
            PublishedGnssFrame(++calls, ReceiverGnssFrame(1000, (route as? GnssFrameRoute.FixedPoint)?.point ?: Wgs84(31.0, 121.0),
                0.0, emptyList(), GnssGeometryResult(null), ReceiverGnssSource.STATISTICAL_REPLAY), 0.0, 0.0)
        }
        val global = frames.forRoute(GnssFrameRoute.Global)
        repeat(20) { assertSame(global, frames.forRoute(GnssFrameRoute.Global)) }
        val point = GnssFrameRoute.FixedPoint(Wgs84(40.0, 116.0))
        val fixed = frames.forRoute(point)
        assertNotSame(global, fixed)
        repeat(20) { assertSame(fixed, frames.forRoute(point)) }
        val scenario = GnssFrameRoute.Scenario("route-a")
        val routed = frames.forRoute(scenario)
        assertNotSame(global, routed)
        repeat(20) { assertSame(routed, frames.forRoute(scenario)) }
        assertEquals(3L, calls)
    }

    @Test fun missingPublicationIsAlsoStableForOneDeliveryTick() {
        var calls = 0
        val frames = ReceiverTickFrames { calls++; null }
        repeat(20) { assertNull(frames.forRoute(GnssFrameRoute.Global)) }
        assertEquals(1, calls)
    }
}
```

`xposed/src/test/java/com/system/location/service/hook/hooks/nmea/NmeaBridgeTest.kt`:

```kt
package com.system.location.service.hook.hooks.nmea

import com.system.location.service.core.geo.Wgs84
import com.system.location.service.core.gnss.*
import com.system.location.service.hook.hooks.gnss.GnssReceiverRuntime
import com.system.location.service.hook.utils.FakeLoc
import org.junit.Assert.*
import org.junit.Test

class NmeaBridgeTest {
    private fun publication() = PublishedGnssFrame(1, ReceiverGnssFrame(1790000000000,
        Wgs84(31.0, 121.0), 10.0, listOf(
            GnssSatellite(Constellation.GPS, 1, 30f, 10f, 35f, false, true, true),
            GnssSatellite(Constellation.SBAS, 120, 25f, 50f, 32f, false, true, true),
            GnssSatellite(Constellation.GLONASS, 1, 20f, 80f, 30f, false, true, true),
            GnssSatellite(Constellation.QZSS, 193, 40f, 120f, 40f, false, true, true),
            GnssSatellite(Constellation.IRNSS, 3, 20f, 180f, 30f, false, true, true)),
        GnssGeometryResult(null, "test no solution"), ReceiverGnssSource.STATISTICAL_REPLAY), 0.0, 0.0)
    private fun fields(line: String) = line.substringBefore('*').removePrefix("$").split(',')

    @Test fun replayWithoutCaptureDoesNotInventSentences() {
        val original = FakeLoc.runtimeSnapshots.current()
        try {
            FakeLoc.runtimeSnapshots.update { it.copy(configuration = it.configuration.copy(
                gnssSource = null, gnssSimulation = GnssSimulationPolicy(mode = GnssSimulationMode.REPLAY))) }
            assertTrue(NmeaBridge.generatedSentences().isEmpty())
        } finally { FakeLoc.runtimeSnapshots.update { original } }
    }

    @Test fun allSupportedIdentitiesSurviveNmeaMappingAndNoFixIsExplicit() {
        val lines = NmeaBridge.generatedSentences(publication())
        val gsv = lines.filter { it.substringBefore(',').endsWith("GSV") }.map(::fields)
        assertEquals(5, gsv.sumOf { (it.size - 4) / 4 })
        assertEquals("65", gsv.first { it[0] == "GLGSV" }[4])
        assertEquals("01", gsv.first { it[0] == "GQGSV" }[4])
        assertEquals("03", gsv.first { it[0] == "GIGSV" }[4])
        assertEquals("33", gsv.first { it[0] == "GPGSV" }[8])
        val gga = fields(lines.first())
        assertEquals("0", gga[6])
        assertEquals("00", gga[7])
        assertEquals("", gga[8])
    }

    @Test fun publicationTimestampAndObserverDetermineOutputWithoutGlobalState() {
        val first = publication()
        assertEquals(NmeaBridge.generatedSentences(first), NmeaBridge.generatedSentences(first))
        val point = first.copy(frame = first.frame.copy(observer = Wgs84(-20.0, -60.0)))
        val gga = fields(NmeaBridge.generatedSentences(point).first())
        assertEquals("S", gga[3])
        assertEquals("W", gga[5])
        assertEquals(fields(NmeaBridge.generatedSentences(first).first())[1], gga[1])
    }
}
```

```kt
package com.system.location.service.hook.hooks.telephony
```

```kt
import com.system.location.service.core.carrier.SimCarrierProfile
```
```kt
import org.junit.Assert.*
```

```kt
class CarrierStatusBarRenderTest {
    private fun sim(slot: Int, name: String) = SimCarrierProfile(slot, virtual = true,
        countryIso = "US", mcc = 310, mnc = 260, carrierName = name)

    @Test fun bothSlotsRenderTemporarilyAndOffUsesUntouchedLatestRomCaches() {
        val controller = Controller()
        val originalCarrier = controller.mCarrier
        val originalDisabled = controller.mCardDisable
        val originalCustom = controller.mCustomCarrier
        assertEquals("One | Two", CarrierStatusBarHook.withVirtualCarriers(controller,
            listOf(sim(1, "One"), sim(2, "Two"))) {
            assertFalse(controller.mCardDisable.any { it })
            assertFalse(controller.mSimError.any { it })
            assertFalse(controller.mEmergencyOnly)
            assertTrue(controller.mCustomCarrier.all { it == null })
            controller.mCarrier.joinToString(" | ")
        })
        assertSame(originalCarrier, controller.mCarrier)
        assertTrue(controller.mEmergencyOnly)
        assertSame(originalCustom, controller.mCustomCarrier)
        assertSame(originalDisabled, controller.mCardDisable)
        controller.mCarrier[0] = "Updated by ROM"
        assertEquals("Updated by ROM", CarrierStatusBarHook.withVirtualCarriers(controller, emptyList()) {
            controller.mCarrier[0]
        })
    }

    @Test fun simTwoDoesNotChangeSimOneAndExceptionsRestoreEveryReference() {
        val controller = Controller()
        val originalCarrier = controller.mCarrier
        val originalErrors = controller.mSimError
        val failure = IllegalStateException("Renderer rejected update")
        assertSame(failure, assertThrows(IllegalStateException::class.java) {
            CarrierStatusBarHook.withVirtualCarriers(controller, listOf(sim(2, "Two"))) {
                assertEquals("Real one", controller.mCarrier[0])
                assertTrue(controller.mCardDisable[0])
                assertEquals("Two", controller.mCarrier[1])
                assertFalse(controller.mEmergencyOnly)
                throw failure
            }
        })
        assertSame(originalCarrier, controller.mCarrier)
        assertTrue(controller.mEmergencyOnly)
        assertSame(originalErrors, controller.mSimError)
        assertTrue(controller.mCardDisable.all { it })
    }

    class Controller {
        @JvmField var mEmergencyOnly = true
        @JvmField var mCarrier: Array<String?> = arrayOf("Real one", "Real two")
        @JvmField var mCustomCarrier: Array<String?> = arrayOf("Custom one", null)
        @JvmField var mCardDisable = booleanArrayOf(true, true)
        @JvmField var mSimError = booleanArrayOf(true, true)
    }
}
```

`xposed/src/test/java/com/system/location/service/hook/hooks/telephony/CellInfoResultPolicyTest.kt`:

```kt
package com.system.location.service.hook.hooks.telephony

import com.system.location.service.core.environment.CellTower
import com.system.location.service.core.environment.CellType
import com.system.location.service.core.environment.EnvironmentProfile
import com.system.location.service.core.environment.EnvironmentSourceMode
import com.system.location.service.core.environment.EnvironmentSourceType
import org.junit.Assert.assertEquals
import org.junit.Assert.assertNull
import org.junit.Assert.assertSame
import org.junit.Test

class CellInfoResultPolicyTest {
    @Test
    fun protectedCallsNeverReturnFrameworkRecordsWhenSynthesisIsUnavailable() {
        val frameworkRecords = listOf("real-cell")

        val result = selectCellInfoResult<String>(
            protectedCall = true,
            frameworkResult = frameworkRecords,
            synthetic = emptyList(),
        )

        assertEquals(emptyList<String>(), result)
    }

    @Test
    fun unprotectedCallsKeepTheFrameworkResult() {
        val frameworkResult = listOf("framework-cell")

        val result = selectCellInfoResult<String>(
            protectedCall = false,
            frameworkResult = frameworkResult,
            synthetic = listOf("synthetic-cell"),
        )

        assertSame(frameworkResult, result)
    }

    @Test
    fun protectedCallsUseOnlySyntheticRecords() {
        val synthetic = listOf("synthetic-cell")

        val result = selectCellInfoResult(
            protectedCall = true,
            frameworkResult = listOf("real-cell"),
            synthetic = synthetic,
        )

        assertSame(synthetic, result)
    }

    @Test fun nullOrUnexpectedFrameworkResultsAreNeverExpandedIntoSyntheticData() {
        for (protected in listOf(true, false)) {
            assertNull(selectCellInfoResult(protected, null, listOf("synthetic")))
            val unexpected = Any()
            assertSame(unexpected, selectCellInfoResult(protected, unexpected, listOf("synthetic")))
        }
    }

    @Test
    fun synthesisFailsAsAWholeWhenOneRecordCannotBeBuilt() {
        val built = buildAllOrNothing(listOf(1, 2, 3)) { value ->
            value.takeIf { it != 2 }
        }

        assertEquals(emptyList<Int>(), built)
    }

    @Test
    fun synthesisKeepsEveryRecordWhenAllBuildsSucceed() {
        val built = buildAllOrNothing(listOf(1, 2, 3)) { value -> value * 10 }

        assertEquals(listOf(10, 20, 30), built)
    }

    @Test
    fun proceduralModeDoesNotDeriveTargetCellsFromDeviceSimIdentity() {
        val profile = profileWithCell()

        assertNull(selectExplicitCellRecords(EnvironmentSourceMode.PROCEDURAL, profile))
        assertNull(selectExplicitCellRecords(EnvironmentSourceMode.AUTO, null))
    }

    @Test
    fun replayModeUsesOnlyExplicitCellRecords() {
        val profile = profileWithCell()

        assertEquals(
            ExplicitCellRecords(profile.cells, profile.cdmaCells),
            selectExplicitCellRecords(EnvironmentSourceMode.REPLAY, profile),
        )
    }

    private fun profileWithCell() = EnvironmentProfile(
        source = EnvironmentSourceType.REPLAY,
        generatedAtMillis = 1L,
        seed = 1L,
        cells = listOf(
            CellTower(
                type = CellType.LTE,
                mcc = 310,
                mnc = 260,
                areaCode = 10,
                cellId = 20,
                rsrp = -90,
            ),
        ),
    )

    @Test
    fun asyncCellInfoReportsUnsupportedInsteadOfReturningAnEmptyOrRealList() {
        assertEquals(CellInfoCallbackDecision.Unsupported, cellInfoCallbackDecision(true, emptyList<String>()))
    }

    @Test
    fun asyncCellInfoPreservesFrameworkResultForExplicitlyDeniedRoute() {
        assertEquals(CellInfoCallbackDecision.PassThrough, cellInfoCallbackDecision(false, listOf("real-cell")))
    }

    @Test
    fun asyncCellInfoDeliversOnlyTheSyntheticList() {
        val synthetic = listOf("synthetic-cell")
        var delivered: List<String>? = null
        var reportedUnavailable = false
        var passedThrough = false

        val result = dispatchCellInfoCallback(
            protectedCall = true,
            synthetic = synthetic,
            passThrough = { passedThrough = true; "framework" },
            deliver = { delivered = it; "delivered" },
            unavailable = { reportedUnavailable = true; "unsupported" },
        )

        assertEquals("delivered", result)
        assertSame(synthetic, delivered)
        assertEquals(false, reportedUnavailable)
        assertEquals(false, passedThrough)
    }

    @Test
    fun asyncCellInfoUsesErrorPathWhenSynthesisIsUnavailable() {
        var delivered = false
        var reportedUnavailable = false
        var passedThrough = false

        val result = dispatchCellInfoCallback(
            protectedCall = true,
            synthetic = emptyList<String>(),
            passThrough = { passedThrough = true; "framework" },
            deliver = { delivered = true; "delivered" },
            unavailable = { reportedUnavailable = true; "unsupported" },
        )

        assertEquals("unsupported", result)
        assertEquals(false, delivered)
        assertEquals(true, reportedUnavailable)
        assertEquals(false, passedThrough)
    }

    @Test
    fun asyncCellInfoDoesNotRewriteFrameworkResultForUnprotectedRoute() {
        var delivered = false
        var reportedUnavailable = false
        var passedThrough = false

        val result = dispatchCellInfoCallback(
            protectedCall = false,
            synthetic = emptyList<String>(),
            passThrough = { passedThrough = true; "framework" },
            deliver = { delivered = true; "delivered" },
            unavailable = { reportedUnavailable = true; "unsupported" },
        )

        assertEquals("framework", result)
        assertEquals(true, passedThrough)
        assertEquals(false, delivered)
        assertEquals(false, reportedUnavailable)
    }
}
```

```kt
        assertNull(telephonyTargetIdentity(null))
        assertNull(telephonyTargetIdentity(profile()))
        val identity = telephonyTargetIdentity(legacy)
        assertNull(identity?.operatorNumeric)
        assertNull(identity?.operatorName)
        assertEquals(TelephonyManager.NETWORK_TYPE_LTE, identity?.networkType)
    }

    @Test
    fun registeredCdmaCellSelectsCdmaPhoneAndNetworkType() {
        val profile = profile().copy(cdmaCells = listOf(CdmaTower(1, 2, 3, cdmaDbm = -90, registered = true)))

        val identity = telephonyTargetIdentity(profile)

        assertEquals(TelephonyManager.PHONE_TYPE_CDMA, identity?.phoneType)
        assertEquals(TelephonyManager.NETWORK_TYPE_CDMA, identity?.networkType)
        assertNull(identity?.operatorNumeric)
        assertNull(identity?.operatorName)
    }

    @Test
    fun subServiceReplyUsesModeledIdentityOrUnknownValues() {
        val identity = telephonyTargetIdentity(profile().copy(cells = listOf(
            CellTower(
                type = CellType.LTE,
                mcc = 310,
                mnc = 1,
                areaCode = 10,
                cellId = 20,
                rsrp = -90,
                registered = true,
                mncDigits = 2,
            ),
        )))

        assertEquals(-1, telephonySubReply(TelephonySubOperation.PHONE_ID, 1, identity))
        assertEquals(false, telephonySubReply(TelephonySubOperation.ACTIVE_SUBSCRIPTION, 1, identity))
        assertEquals(
            TelephonyManager.SIM_STATE_READY,
            telephonySubReply(TelephonySubOperation.SIM_STATE_FOR_SLOT, 0, identity),
        )
        assertEquals(
            TelephonyManager.SIM_STATE_UNKNOWN,
            telephonySubReply(TelephonySubOperation.SIM_STATE_FOR_SUBSCRIPTION, 1, identity),
        )
        assertEquals("", telephonySubReply(TelephonySubOperation.NETWORK_COUNTRY_ISO, 0, identity))
        assertEquals(-1, telephonySubReply(TelephonySubOperation.PHONE_ID, 0, null))
        assertEquals(false, telephonySubReply(TelephonySubOperation.ACTIVE_SUBSCRIPTION, 0, null))
        assertEquals(
            TelephonyManager.SIM_STATE_UNKNOWN,
            telephonySubReply(TelephonySubOperation.SIM_STATE_FOR_SLOT, 0, null),
        )
    }

    private fun profile() = EnvironmentProfile(
        source = EnvironmentSourceType.REPLAY,
        generatedAtMillis = 1,
        seed = 1,
    )
}
```

`xposed/src/test/java/com/system/location/service/hook/runtime/BackgroundQueryTest.kt`:

```kt
package com.system.location.service.hook.runtime

import java.util.concurrent.CountDownLatch
import java.util.concurrent.Executors
import java.util.concurrent.TimeUnit
import java.util.concurrent.RejectedExecutionException
import org.junit.Assert.*
import org.junit.Test

class BackgroundQueryTest {
    @Test fun aBlockedQueryDoesNotBlockTheCallerOrQueueMorePolls() {
        val entered = CountDownLatch(1)
        val release = CountDownLatch(1)
        val received = CountDownLatch(1)
        val executor = Executors.newSingleThreadExecutor()
        val query = BackgroundQuery(executor)
        val caller = Thread.currentThread()
        var worker: Thread? = null
        try {
            assertTrue(query.submit({
                worker = Thread.currentThread()
                entered.countDown()
                release.await()
                42
            }) { result -> assertEquals(42, result.getOrThrow()); received.countDown() })
            assertTrue(entered.await(2, TimeUnit.SECONDS))
            assertNotSame(caller, worker)
            repeat(100) { assertFalse(query.submit({ error("must not queue") }) { }) }
            release.countDown()
            assertTrue(received.await(2, TimeUnit.SECONDS))
        } finally {
            release.countDown()
            executor.shutdownNow()
            assertTrue(executor.awaitTermination(2, TimeUnit.SECONDS))
        }
    }

    @Test fun aFailedReadIsDeliveredAndTheNextPollCanRun() {
        val tasks = ArrayDeque<Runnable>()
        val query = BackgroundQuery { tasks.add(it) }
        val failure = IllegalStateException("service unavailable")
        var received: Throwable? = null
        assertTrue(query.submit({ throw failure }) { received = it.exceptionOrNull() })
        tasks.removeFirst().run()
        assertSame(failure, received)
        assertTrue(query.submit({ 42 }) { assertEquals(42, it.getOrThrow()) })
        tasks.removeFirst().run()
    }

    @Test fun aRejectedSubmissionDoesNotPermanentlySuppressPolling() {
        var reject = true
        val tasks = ArrayDeque<Runnable>()
        val query = BackgroundQuery {
            if (reject) throw RejectedExecutionException()
            tasks.add(it)
        }
        assertThrows(RejectedExecutionException::class.java) { query.submit({ 1 }) { } }
        reject = false
        assertTrue(query.submit({ 2 }) { assertEquals(2, it.getOrThrow()) })
        tasks.removeFirst().run()
    }
}
```

`xposed/src/test/java/com/system/location/service/hook/runtime/CallbackTransferTest.kt`:

```kt
package com.system.location.service.hook.runtime

import android.os.IBinder
import android.os.IInterface
import java.lang.reflect.Proxy
import org.junit.Assert.*
import org.junit.Test

class CallbackTransferTest {
    @Test fun transfersBinderAndOriginalIdentityWithoutRetainingOldProxy() {
        var alive = true
        val binder = Proxy.newProxyInstance(IBinder::class.java.classLoader, arrayOf(IBinder::class.java)) { proxy, method, args ->
            when (method.name) {
                "isBinderAlive" -> alive
                "getInterfaceDescriptor" -> "android.location.ILocationListener"
                "hashCode" -> System.identityHashCode(proxy)
                "equals" -> proxy === args?.get(0)
                else -> null
            }
        } as IBinder
        val old = object : IInterface { override fun asBinder() = binder }
        val replacement = object : IInterface { override fun asBinder() = binder }
        val row = CallbackSubscription(old, 10272, "receiver", listOf("gps", "network"),
            "exact emitted frame", "partially emitted frame", 3).encode()
        assertSame(binder, row[0])
        assertFalse(row.any { it === old })
        val restored = CallbackSubscription.decode(row) { descriptor, transport ->
            assertEquals("android.location.ILocationListener", descriptor)
            assertSame(binder, transport)
            replacement
        }!!
        assertSame(replacement, restored.listener)
        assertEquals(10272, restored.uid)
        assertEquals("receiver", restored.packageName)
        assertEquals(listOf("gps", "network"), restored.providers)
        assertEquals("exact emitted frame", restored.lastDeliveryKey)
        assertEquals("partially emitted frame", restored.pendingDeliveryKey)
        assertEquals(3, restored.nextDeliveryIndex)
        assertNull(CallbackSubscription.decode(row.take(5).toTypedArray()) { _, _ -> replacement }!!.lastDeliveryKey)
        val previous = CallbackSubscription.decode(row.take(6).toTypedArray()) { _, _ -> replacement }!!
        assertEquals("exact emitted frame", previous.lastDeliveryKey)
        assertNull(previous.pendingDeliveryKey)
        assertEquals(0, previous.nextDeliveryIndex)
        assertThrows(IllegalArgumentException::class.java) {
            CallbackSubscription(old, 10272, nextDeliveryIndex = 1)
        }
        assertThrows(IllegalArgumentException::class.java) {
            CallbackSubscription(old, 10272, pendingDeliveryKey = "pending", nextDeliveryIndex = -1)
        }
        alive = false
        assertNull(CallbackSubscription.decode(row) { _, _ -> error("dead binder must not resolve") })
    }
}
```

`xposed/src/test/java/com/system/location/service/hook/runtime/CurrentLocationDeliveryTest.kt`:

```kt
package com.system.location.service.hook.runtime

import java.util.concurrent.Executors
import java.util.concurrent.TimeUnit
import org.junit.Assert.*
import org.junit.Test

class CurrentLocationDeliveryTest {
    @Test fun samplesAreConfinedToTheActiveProviderAndThread() {
        val owner = Any()
        val pool = Executors.newSingleThreadExecutor()
        try {
            assertFalse(CurrentLocationDelivery.active)
            CurrentLocationDelivery.during(owner, { "mock" }) {
                assertTrue(CurrentLocationDelivery.active)
                assertEquals("mock", CurrentLocationDelivery.sampleFor(owner))
                assertNull(CurrentLocationDelivery.sampleFor(Any()))
                assertFalse(pool.submit<Boolean> { CurrentLocationDelivery.active }.get(5, TimeUnit.SECONDS))
            }
            assertFalse(CurrentLocationDelivery.active)
            assertNull(CurrentLocationDelivery.sampleFor(owner))
        } finally { pool.shutdownNow() }
    }

    @Test fun nestedDeliveryRestoresItsParentEvenWhenTheFrameworkThrows() {
        val owner = Any()
        val nested = Any()
        CurrentLocationDelivery.during(owner, { "outer" }) {
            val failure = runCatching {
                CurrentLocationDelivery.during(nested, { "inner" }) {
                    assertNull(CurrentLocationDelivery.sampleFor(owner))
                    assertEquals("inner", CurrentLocationDelivery.sampleFor(nested))
                    error("framework failure")
                }
            }.exceptionOrNull()
            assertEquals("framework failure", failure?.message)
            assertEquals("outer", CurrentLocationDelivery.sampleFor(owner))
        }
        assertFalse(CurrentLocationDelivery.active)
    }

    @Test fun sampleAvailabilityIsRecheckedAtReadTime() {
        val owner = Any()
        var enabled = true
        CurrentLocationDelivery.during(owner, { if (enabled) "mock" else null }) {
            assertEquals("mock", CurrentLocationDelivery.sampleFor(owner))
            enabled = false
            assertNull(CurrentLocationDelivery.sampleFor(owner))
        }
    }
}
```

`xposed/src/test/java/com/system/location/service/hook/runtime/DeferredServiceConnectionTest.kt`:

```kt
package com.system.location.service.hook.runtime

import java.util.concurrent.CountDownLatch
import java.util.concurrent.Executors
import java.util.concurrent.TimeUnit
import org.junit.Assert.*
import org.junit.Test

class DeferredServiceConnectionTest {
    @Test fun startupReturnsWhileBinderWorkIsBlockedOnAnotherThread() {
        val entered = CountDownLatch(1)
        val release = CountDownLatch(1)
        val caller = Thread.currentThread()
        var worker: Thread? = null
        val executor = Executors.newSingleThreadScheduledExecutor()
        val finished = CountDownLatch(1)
        val job = DeferredServiceConnection(
            schedule = { delay, task -> executor.schedule({ task() }, delay, TimeUnit.MILLISECONDS); Unit },
            connect = {
                worker = Thread.currentThread()
                entered.countDown()
                release.await()
                finished.countDown()
                true
            },
            onFailure = { throw AssertionError(it) },
        )
        try {
            job.start()
            assertTrue(entered.await(2, TimeUnit.SECONDS))
            assertNotSame(caller, worker)
            assertEquals(1L, finished.count)
            job.start() // Coalesce callbacks while the first Binder call is blocked.
            release.countDown()
            assertTrue(finished.await(2, TimeUnit.SECONDS))
        } finally {
            release.countDown()
            executor.shutdownNow()
            assertTrue(executor.awaitTermination(2, TimeUnit.SECONDS))
        }
    }

    @Test fun unavailableServiceAndBinderExceptionRetryThenStopAfterAcknowledgment() {
        val tasks = ArrayDeque<() -> Unit>()
        val delays = mutableListOf<Long>()
        val failures = mutableListOf<Exception>()
        var calls = 0
        val job = DeferredServiceConnection(
            schedule = { delay, task -> delays.add(delay); tasks.add(task) },
            connect = { when (++calls) {
                1 -> false
                2 -> throw IllegalStateException("service starting")
                else -> true
            } },
            onFailure = failures::add,
        )
        job.start()
        job.start()
        assertEquals(0, calls)
        assertEquals(1, tasks.size)
        while (tasks.isNotEmpty()) tasks.removeFirst()()
        assertEquals(3, calls)
        assertEquals(1, failures.size)
        assertEquals(listOf(0L, 250L, 500L), delays)
        job.start()
        assertTrue(tasks.isEmpty())
    }

    @Test fun repeatedFailureIsBoundedAndAllowsAnExplicitLaterRetry() {
        val tasks = ArrayDeque<() -> Unit>()
        var calls = 0
        val job = DeferredServiceConnection(
            schedule = { _, task -> tasks.add(task) },
            connect = { calls++; false },
            onFailure = { throw AssertionError(it) },
            maxAttempts = 3,
        )
        job.start()
        while (tasks.isNotEmpty()) tasks.removeFirst()()
        assertEquals(3, calls)
        job.start()
        while (tasks.isNotEmpty()) tasks.removeFirst()()
        assertEquals(6, calls)
    }
}
```

`xposed/src/test/java/com/system/location/service/hook/runtime/DeliveryWorkerTest.kt`:

```kt
package com.system.location.service.hook.runtime

import java.util.concurrent.CountDownLatch
import java.util.concurrent.TimeUnit
import java.util.concurrent.atomic.AtomicInteger
import org.junit.Assert.*
import org.junit.Test

class DeliveryWorkerTest {
    @Test fun publicationDuringBlockedTickIsCoalescedAndDeliveredWithoutWaitingForTimer() {
        val entered = CountDownLatch(1)
        val release = CountDownLatch(1)
        val next = CountDownLatch(1)
        val calls = AtomicInteger()
        val worker = worker {
            if (calls.incrementAndGet() == 1) {
                entered.countDown()
                check(release.await(2, TimeUnit.SECONDS))
            } else next.countDown()
        }
        try {
            worker.requestTick() // A publication must not create an unregistered producer.
            assertEquals(0, calls.get())
            worker.start()
            assertTrue(entered.await(2, TimeUnit.SECONDS))
            repeat(100) { worker.requestTick() }
            release.countDown()
            assertTrue("Must not wait for the 60 second fallback timer", next.await(2, TimeUnit.SECONDS))
            assertTrue(worker.stop())
            assertEquals(2, calls.get())
        } finally { release.countDown(); worker.stop() }
    }

    @Test fun publicationWakesASleepingProducerAndStopStillCancelsItsWait() {
        val sleeping = CountDownLatch(1)
        val delivered = CountDownLatch(1)
        val worker = DeliveryWorker("PublicationWakeup", {
            sleeping.countDown()
            60_000
        }, delayFirstTick = true, tick = { delivered.countDown() }, failure = { throw AssertionError(it) })
        try {
            worker.start()
            assertTrue(sleeping.await(2, TimeUnit.SECONDS))
            worker.requestTick()
            assertTrue(delivered.await(2, TimeUnit.SECONDS))
            assertTrue(worker.stop())
            worker.requestTick()
        } finally { worker.stop() }
    }

    @Test fun repeatedStartAndConfirmedStop() {
        val calls = AtomicInteger()
        val first = CountDownLatch(1)
        val second = CountDownLatch(1)
        val worker = worker {
            if (calls.incrementAndGet() == 1) first.countDown() else second.countDown()
        }
        try {
            worker.start()
            assertTrue(first.await(2, TimeUnit.SECONDS))
            repeat(10) { worker.start() }
            assertEquals(1, calls.get())
            assertTrue(worker.stop())
            worker.start()
            assertTrue(second.await(2, TimeUnit.SECONDS))
            assertTrue(worker.stop())
            assertEquals(2, calls.get())
        } finally { worker.stop() }
    }

    @Test fun timedOutStopRetainsRestartUntilBlockedCallbackReturns() {
        val entered = CountDownLatch(1)
        val release = CountDownLatch(1)
        val restarted = CountDownLatch(1)
        val calls = AtomicInteger()
        val active = AtomicInteger()
        val peak = AtomicInteger()
        val worker = worker {
            peak.accumulateAndGet(active.incrementAndGet(), ::maxOf)
            try {
                if (calls.incrementAndGet() == 1) {
                    entered.countDown()
                    // A Binder callback may consume interrupts without returning.
                    while (release.count != 0L) {
                        try { release.await() } catch (_: InterruptedException) { }
                    }
                } else restarted.countDown()
            } finally { active.decrementAndGet() }
        }
        try {
            worker.start()
            assertTrue(entered.await(2, TimeUnit.SECONDS))
            assertFalse(worker.stop(20))
            repeat(10) { worker.start() }
            assertEquals(1, calls.get())
            release.countDown()
            assertTrue(restarted.await(2, TimeUnit.SECONDS))
            assertTrue(worker.stop())
            assertEquals(2, calls.get())
            assertEquals(1, peak.get())
        } finally { release.countDown(); worker.stop() }
    }

    @Test fun anotherStopCancelsPendingRestart() {
        val entered = CountDownLatch(1)
        val release = CountDownLatch(1)
        val calls = AtomicInteger()
        val worker = worker {
            calls.incrementAndGet()
            entered.countDown()
            while (release.count != 0L) {
                try { release.await() } catch (_: InterruptedException) { }
            }
        }
        try {
            worker.start()
            assertTrue(entered.await(2, TimeUnit.SECONDS))
            assertFalse(worker.stop(0))
            worker.start()
            assertFalse(worker.stop(0))
            release.countDown()
            assertTrue(worker.stop())
            assertEquals(1, calls.get())
        } finally { release.countDown(); worker.stop() }
    }

    @Test fun selfStopDoesNotJoinItselfAndDelayCanBeCancelled() {
        val stopped = CountDownLatch(1)
        lateinit var worker: DeliveryWorker
        worker = worker { assertFalse(worker.stop()); stopped.countDown() }
        worker.start()
        assertTrue(stopped.await(2, TimeUnit.SECONDS))
        assertTrue(worker.stop())

        val calls = AtomicInteger()
        val delayed = DeliveryWorker("Delayed", { 60_000 }, true,
            { calls.incrementAndGet() }, { throw AssertionError(it) })
        delayed.start()
        assertTrue(delayed.stop())
        assertEquals(0, calls.get())
    }

    private fun worker(tick: () -> Unit) = DeliveryWorker("TestDelivery", { 60_000 },
        tick = tick, failure = { throw AssertionError(it) })
}
```
