`xposed/src/test/java/com/system/location/service/hook/runtime/GenerationDeliveryTest.kt`:

```kt
package com.system.location.service.hook.runtime

import java.util.concurrent.CountDownLatch
import java.util.concurrent.Executors
import java.util.concurrent.TimeUnit
import java.util.concurrent.atomic.AtomicInteger
import org.junit.Assert.*
import org.junit.Test

class GenerationDeliveryTest {
    @Test fun queuedOldProducerSkipsAfterGateIsTransferredButNewProducerRuns() {
        val gate = ReloadExecutionGate()
        val old = GenerationDelivery(gate)
        val worker = Executors.newSingleThreadExecutor()
        val ready = CountDownLatch(1)
        val release = CountDownLatch(1)
        val sends = AtomicInteger()
        try {
            worker.submit { ready.countDown(); release.await() }
            assertTrue(ready.await(1, TimeUnit.SECONDS))
            val queued = worker.submit { old.run { sends.incrementAndGet() } }
            assertTrue(gate.freeze(1000))
            val successor = ReloadExecutionGate.adopt(gate.transferState())
            release.countDown()
            successor.resume()
            queued.get(1, TimeUnit.SECONDS)
            assertEquals(0, sends.get())
            worker.submit { GenerationDelivery(successor).run { sends.incrementAndGet() } }.get(1, TimeUnit.SECONDS)
            assertEquals(1, sends.get())
        } finally { release.countDown(); worker.shutdownNow() }
    }

    @Test fun runningProducerPreventsFreezeAndAbortLeavesSameGenerationUsable() {
        val gate = ReloadExecutionGate()
        val worker = Executors.newSingleThreadExecutor()
        val entered = CountDownLatch(1)
        val release = CountDownLatch(1)
        val sends = AtomicInteger()
        try {
            val job = worker.submit { GenerationDelivery(gate).run {
                entered.countDown(); release.await(); sends.incrementAndGet()
            } }
            assertTrue(entered.await(1, TimeUnit.SECONDS))
            assertFalse(gate.freeze(10))
            release.countDown()
            job.get(1, TimeUnit.SECONDS)
            GenerationDelivery(gate).run { sends.incrementAndGet() }
            assertEquals(2, sends.get())
        } finally { release.countDown(); worker.shutdownNow() }
    }
}
```

```kt
import com.system.location.service.hook.scope.HookInstaller
import com.system.location.service.hook.scope.HookStatusRegistry

import io.github.libxposed.api.XposedInterface
import io.github.libxposed.api.XposedInterface.Chain
import io.github.libxposed.api.XposedInterface.HookBuilder
import io.github.libxposed.api.XposedInterface.HookHandle

import java.lang.reflect.Executable

import java.util.Collections
import java.util.concurrent.CountDownLatch

import org.junit.Assert.assertEquals
import org.junit.Assert.assertFalse

import org.junit.Assert.assertNotSame
import org.junit.Assert.assertSame
import org.junit.Assert.assertTrue
import org.junit.After
import org.junit.Before
import org.junit.Test

/** JVM contract tests; the fake framework does not emulate ART or framework API protection. */
class NativeHookRuntimeTest {
    private val frameworkField = HookRuntime::class.java.getDeclaredField("framework").apply {
        isAccessible = true
    }
    private var previousFramework: XposedInterface? = null

    @Before
    fun isolateFramework() {
        previousFramework = frameworkField.get(HookRuntime) as? XposedInterface
        frameworkField.set(HookRuntime, null)
    }

    @After
    fun restoreFramework() {
        frameworkField.set(HookRuntime, previousFramework)
    }

    @Test
    fun originalInvocationUsesOriginAndForwardsReceiverAndArguments() {
        val framework = FakeFramework()
        HookRuntime.attach(framework.api)
        val receiver = Target()
        val method = Target::class.java.getDeclaredMethod("original", String::class.java)

        assertEquals("received:sample", HookRuntime.invokeOriginalMethod(method, receiver, arrayOf("sample")))

        assertSame(method, framework.invokedMethod)
        assertSame(receiver, framework.invokedReceiver)
        assertEquals(listOf("sample"), framework.invokedArguments)
        assertTrue(framework.invokerType is Invoker.Type.Origin)
    }

    @Test
    fun originalInvocationUnwrapsTheListenersException() {
        val framework = FakeFramework()
        HookRuntime.attach(framework.api)
        val receiver = Target()
        val method = Target::class.java.getDeclaredMethod("throwsFromListener")

        val failure = runCatching { HookRuntime.invokeOriginalMethod(method, receiver, emptyArray()) }.exceptionOrNull()

        assertSame(receiver.failure, failure)
    }

    @Test
    fun nativeCallbackRewritesArgumentsAndReturnsTheProceededOutcome() {
        val framework = FakeFramework()
        HookRuntime.attach(framework.api)
        val method = targetMethod("rewrite")
        HookInstaller.hookMethod(
            method,
            Hooker { chain ->
                val arguments = chain.args.toTypedArray()
                arguments[0] = "rewritten"
                "hook:${chain.proceed(arguments)}"
            },
            priority = 123,
            exceptionMode = XposedInterface.ExceptionMode.PASSTHROUGH,
        )
        val installed = framework.registrations.single()
        val proceeded = AtomicInteger()
        var received: List<Any?>? = null
        val chain = fakeChain(method, listOf("input")) {
            proceeded.incrementAndGet()
            received = it
            "original:${it.single()}"
        }

        assertEquals("hook:original:rewritten", installed.callback.intercept(chain))

        assertEquals(123, installed.priority)
        assertEquals(XposedInterface.ExceptionMode.PASSTHROUGH, installed.mode)
        assertEquals(listOf("rewritten"), received)
        assertEquals(1, proceeded.get())
        assertEquals(listOf("input"), chain.args)
        assertTrue(HookStatusRegistry.snapshot().getValue(method.toString()).matched)
    }

    @Test
    fun nativeCallbackCanShortCircuitWithoutCallingTheOriginal() {
        val framework = FakeFramework()
        HookRuntime.attach(framework.api)
        val method = targetMethod("shortCircuit")
        HookInstaller.hookMethod(method, Hooker { "replacement" })
        val chain = fakeChain(method, listOf("input")) { error("Original must not execute") }

        assertEquals("replacement", framework.registrations.single().callback.intercept(chain))
    }

    @Test
    fun nativeCallbackPreservesTheOriginalException() {
        val framework = FakeFramework()
        HookRuntime.attach(framework.api)
        val method = targetMethod("throwingChain")

    }

    @Test
    fun failedInstallationRecordsFailureAndPropagatesIt() {
        val framework = FakeFramework().apply { failuresRemaining.set(1) }
        HookRuntime.attach(framework.api)
        val method = targetMethod("failedInstallation")

        val error = runCatching { HookInstaller.hookMethod(method, Hooker { it.proceed() }) }.exceptionOrNull()

        assertTrue(status.failed)
        assertFalse(status.installed)
        assertTrue(framework.registrations.isEmpty())
    }

    @Test
    fun firstInvocationDuringRegistrationIsNotLost() {
        val framework = FakeFramework()
        HookRuntime.attach(framework.api)
        val method = targetMethod("registrationRace")
        val calls = AtomicInteger()
        framework.beforeHandleReturned = { callback ->
            assertEquals("early", callback.intercept(fakeChain(method, emptyList()) { "early" }))
        }

        HookInstaller.hookMethod(method, Hooker { chain ->
            calls.incrementAndGet()
            chain.proceed()
        })

        val status = HookStatusRegistry.snapshot().getValue(method.toString())
        assertTrue(status.installed)
        assertTrue(status.matched)
        assertEquals(1, calls.get())
        assertEquals(1, framework.registrations.size)
    }

    @Test
    fun onceHookDeduplicatesConcurrentInstallationsOfTheSameMethod() {
        val framework = FakeFramework()
        HookRuntime.attach(framework.api)
        val method = targetMethod("concurrentOnce")
        val start = CountDownLatch(1)
        val pool = Executors.newFixedThreadPool(8)
        try {
            val requests = (1..16).map {
                pool.submit<HookHandle?> {
                    check(start.await(5, TimeUnit.SECONDS))
                    method.onceHook(Hooker { it.proceed() })
                }
            }
            start.countDown()

            assertEquals(1, requests.map { it.get(5, TimeUnit.SECONDS) }.count { it != null })
            assertEquals(1, framework.registrations.size)
        } finally {
            pool.shutdownNow()
        }
    }

    @Test
    fun onceHookCanRetryAfterAnInstallationFailure() {
        val framework = FakeFramework().apply { failuresRemaining.set(1) }
        HookRuntime.attach(framework.api)
        val method = targetMethod("retryOnce")

        assertSame(framework.installFailure, runCatching { method.onceHook(Hooker { it.proceed() }) }.exceptionOrNull())
        assertNotNull(method.onceHook(Hooker { it.proceed() }))

        assertEquals(2, framework.attempts.get())
        assertEquals(1, framework.registrations.size)
        val recovered = HookStatusRegistry.snapshot().getValue(method.toString())
        assertTrue(recovered.installed)
        assertFalse(recovered.failed)
        assertEquals(null, recovered.reason)
    }

    @Test
    fun onceHookKeepsIdenticalSignaturesFromDifferentClassloadersSeparate() {
        val framework = FakeFramework()
        HookRuntime.attach(framework.api)
        val source = LoaderTarget::class.java
        val bytes = source.getResourceAsStream("/${source.name.replace('.', '/')}.class")!!.use { it.readBytes() }
        fun duplicate(): Class<*> = object : ClassLoader(source.classLoader) {
            fun defineCopy(): Class<*> = defineClass(source.name, bytes, 0, bytes.size)
        }.defineCopy()
        val first = duplicate().getDeclaredMethod("value")
        val second = duplicate().getDeclaredMethod("value")
        assertEquals(first.toString(), second.toString())
        assertNotSame(first.declaringClass.classLoader, second.declaringClass.classLoader)

        assertNotNull(first.onceHook(Hooker { it.proceed() }))
        assertNotNull(second.onceHook(Hooker { it.proceed() }))

        assertEquals(2, framework.registrations.size)
    }

    @Test
    fun fusedHooksRetryWithThePackageLoaderWithoutDuplicatingAnEarlyInstallation() {
        val framework = FakeFramework()
        HookRuntime.attach(framework.api)
        val packageLoader = javaClass.classLoader!!
        val earlyLoader = object : ClassLoader(packageLoader) {
            override fun loadClass(name: String, resolve: Boolean): Class<*> {
                if (name.startsWith("com.android.location.fused.")) throw ClassNotFoundException(name)
                return super.loadClass(name, resolve)
            }
        }
        val wasSystemServer = FakeLoc.isSystemServerProcess
        FakeLoc.isSystemServerProcess = true
        try {
            assertFalse(AndroidFusedLocationProviderHook(earlyLoader))
            assertTrue(framework.registrations.isEmpty())
            assertTrue(AndroidFusedLocationProviderHook(packageLoader))
            assertEquals(setOf("chooseBestLocation", "onLocationChanged"),
                framework.registrations.map { it.executable.name }.toSet())
            assertTrue(AndroidFusedLocationProviderHook(packageLoader))
            assertEquals(2, framework.registrations.size)
        } finally {
            FakeLoc.isSystemServerProcess = wasSystemServer
        }
    }

    private fun targetMethod(name: String): Method = Target::class.java.declaredMethods.single { it.name == name }

    private fun fakeChain(method: Method, arguments: List<Any?>, proceed: (List<Any?>) -> Any?): Chain =
        proxy(Chain::class.java) { called, values ->
            when (called.name) {
                "getExecutable" -> method
                "getThisObject" -> null
                "getArgs" -> Collections.unmodifiableList(arguments)
                "getArg" -> arguments[values!![0] as Int]
                "proceed" -> proceed(if (values.isNullOrEmpty()) arguments else (values[0] as Array<*>).toList())
                else -> error("Unexpected chain call: ${called.name}")
            }
        }

    private data class Registration(
        val executable: Executable,
        val priority: Int,
        val mode: XposedInterface.ExceptionMode,
        val callback: Hooker,
    )

    private class FakeFramework {
        val registrations: MutableList<Registration> = Collections.synchronizedList(mutableListOf())
        val attempts = AtomicInteger()
        val failuresRemaining = AtomicInteger()
        val installFailure = IllegalStateException("Cannot register hook")
        var beforeHandleReturned: ((Hooker) -> Unit)? = null
        var invokedMethod: Method? = null
        var invokedReceiver: Any? = null
        var invokedArguments: List<Any?>? = null
        var invokerType: Any? = null

        val api: XposedInterface = proxy(XposedInterface::class.java) { method, args ->
            when (method.name) {
                "hook" -> builder(args!![0] as Executable)
                "getInvoker" -> invoker(args!![0] as Method)
                "log" -> null
                else -> error("Unexpected framework call: ${method.name}")
            }
        }

        private fun builder(executable: Executable): HookBuilder {
            var priority = XposedInterface.PRIORITY_DEFAULT
            var mode = XposedInterface.ExceptionMode.DEFAULT
            lateinit var builder: HookBuilder
            builder = proxy(HookBuilder::class.java) { method, args ->
                when (method.name) {
                    "setPriority" -> builder.also { priority = args!![0] as Int }
                    "setExceptionMode" -> builder.also { mode = args!![0] as XposedInterface.ExceptionMode }
                    "intercept" -> {
                        attempts.incrementAndGet()
                        if (failuresRemaining.getAndUpdate { if (it > 0) it - 1 else 0 } > 0) throw installFailure
                        val callback = args!![0] as Hooker
                        registrations.add(Registration(executable, priority, mode, callback))
                        beforeHandleReturned?.invoke(callback)
                        proxy(HookHandle::class.java) { called, _ ->
                            when (called.name) {
                                "getExecutable" -> executable
                                "unhook" -> null
                                else -> error("Unexpected handle call: ${called.name}")
                            }
                        }
                    }
                    else -> error("Unexpected builder call: ${method.name}")
                }
            }
            return builder
        }

        private fun invoker(target: Method): Invoker<*, *> {
            lateinit var invoker: Invoker<*, *>
            invoker = proxy(Invoker::class.java) { method, args ->
                when (method.name) {
                    "setType" -> invoker.also { invokerType = args!![0] }
                    "invoke" -> {
                        invokedMethod = target
                        invokedReceiver = args!![0]
                        val arguments = args[1] as Array<*>
                        invokedArguments = arguments.toList()
                        target.invoke(invokedReceiver, *arguments)
                    }
                    else -> error("Unexpected invoker call: ${method.name}")
                }
            }
            return invoker
        }
    }

    class Target {
        val failure = IllegalArgumentException("Listener failed")
        fun original(value: String): String = "received:$value"
        fun throwsFromListener(): Nothing = throw failure
        fun rewrite(value: String): String = value
        fun shortCircuit(value: String): String = value
        fun throwingChain() = Unit
        fun failedInstallation() = Unit
        fun registrationRace() = Unit
        fun concurrentOnce() = Unit
        fun retryOnce() = Unit
    }

    class LoaderTarget { fun value(): Int = 7 }

    companion object {
        private fun <T : Any> proxy(type: Class<T>, call: (Method, Array<out Any?>?) -> Any?): T {
            val instance = Proxy.newProxyInstance(type.classLoader, arrayOf(type)) { proxy, method, args ->
                when (method.name) {
                    "equals" -> proxy === args?.get(0)
                    "hashCode" -> System.identityHashCode(proxy)
                    "toString" -> "Fake${type.simpleName}"
                    else -> call(method, args)
                }
            }
            return requireNotNull(type.cast(instance))
        }
    }
}
```

```kt
package com.system.location.service.hook.runtime

import org.junit.After

import org.junit.Assert.assertEquals
import org.junit.Assert.assertNull

class ReflectionTest {
    private val frameworkField =
        HookRuntime::class.java.getDeclaredField("framework").apply { isAccessible = true }

        previousFramework = frameworkField.get(HookRuntime)
        frameworkField.set(HookRuntime, null)
    }

    @After

        frameworkField.set(HookRuntime, previousFramework)
    }

    @Test
    fun inheritedPrivateFieldsAndMethodsRemainAccessible() {
        val child = Child()
        assertEquals("parent", Reflection.getObjectField(child, "secret"))
        Reflection.setObjectField(child, "secret", "changed")
        assertEquals("changed!", Reflection.callMethod(child, "privateMessage", "!"))
        assertEquals(
            Parent::class.java,
            Reflection.findField(Child::class.java, "secret").declaringClass,
        )
        assertEquals(
            Parent::class.java,
            Reflection.findMethodExact(Child::class.java, "privateMessage", String::class.java)
                .declaringClass,
        )
        assertNull(Reflection.findFieldIfExists(Child::class.java, "missing"))
        assertNull(Reflection.findMethodExactIfExists(Child::class.java, "missing"))
    }

    @Test
    fun publicMethodsOnNonPublicClassesCanBeInvoked() {
        assertEquals("hidden:value", Reflection.callMethod(Hidden(), "message", "value"))
        val method = Reflection.findMethodExact(Hidden::class.java, "message", String::class.java)
        assertEquals("hidden:direct", method.invoke(Hidden(), "direct"))
    }

    @Test
    fun nullFieldValueIsReturnedAndCanBeWritten() {
        val fields = Fields()
        assertNull(Reflection.getObjectField(fields, "nullable"))
        Reflection.setObjectField(fields, "nullable", "value")
        assertEquals("value", Reflection.getObjectField(fields, "nullable"))
        Reflection.setObjectField(fields, "nullable", null)
        assertNull(Reflection.getObjectField(fields, "nullable"))
        assertEquals(3, Reflection.getIntField(fields, "number"))
        Reflection.setIntField(fields, "number", 8)
        assertEquals(8, Reflection.getIntField(fields, "number"))
    }

    @Test
    fun staticFieldAccessPreservesNullAndPrimitiveValues() {
        assertNull(Reflection.getStaticObjectField(Fields::class.java, "staticNullable"))
        assertEquals(12, Reflection.getStaticIntField(Fields::class.java, "staticNumber"))
    }

    @Test
    fun nullChoosesMostSpecificReferenceAndNeverMatchesPrimitive() {
        val target = Overloads()
        assertEquals("string", Reflection.callMethod(target, "choose", null))
        assertThrows(NoSuchMethodException::class.java) {
            Reflection.callMethod(target, "onlyInt", null)
        }
        assertThrows(NoSuchMethodException::class.java) {
            Reflection.newInstance(PrimitiveConstructor::class.java, null)
        }
    }

    @Test
    fun mostSpecificReferenceWinsEvenWithLongerInheritanceDistance() {
        assertEquals("contract", Reflection.callMethod(Overloads(), "contract", ContractArgument()))
        assertEquals("string", Reflection.callMethod(Overloads(), "choose", "text"))
        assertEquals(
            "sequence",
            Reflection.callMethod(Overloads(), "choose", StringBuilder("text")),
        )
    }

    @Test
    fun boxingAndPrimitiveWideningUseInvocableMethods() {
        val target = Overloads()
        assertEquals(7, Reflection.callMethod(target, "onlyInt", 7))
        assertEquals("long:7", Reflection.callMethod(target, "widen", 7))
        assertEquals("long:65", Reflection.callMethod(target, "widen", 'A'))
        assertEquals(6.0, Reflection.callMethod(target, "onlyDouble", 6.toByte()))
        assertArrayEquals(
            arrayOf(Long::class.javaPrimitiveType),
            Reflection.findMethodBestMatch(
                    Overloads::class.java,
                    "widen",
                    Int::class.javaObjectType,
                )
                .parameterTypes,
        )
        assertThrows(NoSuchMethodException::class.java) {
            Reflection.callMethod(target, "onlyInt", 7L)
        }
        assertThrows(NoSuchMethodException::class.java) {
            Reflection.callMethod(target, "onlyInt", true)
        }
    }

    @Test
    fun staticAndInstanceLookupDoNotSelectTheOtherKind() {
        val target = StaticMethods()

    @Test

        }
        assertThrows(NoSuchMethodException::class.java) {
            Reflection.callMethod(Overloads(), "ambiguous", null)

        assertThrows(NoSuchMethodException::class.java) {

    @Test
    fun privateConstructorsUseReferenceSpecificityAndWidening() {
        val specific =
            Reflection.newInstance(ReferenceConstructor::class.java, null) as ReferenceConstructor
        assertEquals("string", specific.selected)
        val widened =
            Reflection.newInstance(PrimitiveConstructor::class.java, 5) as PrimitiveConstructor
        assertEquals(5L, widened.value)
    }

    @Test
    fun targetMethodAndConstructorExceptionsKeepTheirIdentity() {
        val failure = IllegalStateException("target failure")
        assertSame(
            failure,

                Reflection.callMethod(ThrowingMethods(), "fail", failure)
            },
        )

    @Test

        assertSame(

        )
        assertNull(Reflection.findClassIfExists("portal.missing.Absent", javaClass.classLoader))

            object : ClassLoader(javaClass.classLoader) {

                }
            }
        assertSame(
            failure,
            assertThrows(LinkageError::class.java) {
                Reflection.findClassIfExists("portal.broken.Type", broken)
            },
        )
    }

    private open class Parent {
        private var secret = "parent"

        private fun privateMessage(suffix: String) = secret + suffix
    }

    private class Child : Parent()

    private class Hidden {

    }

    private class Fields {
        private var nullable: String? = null
        private var number = 3

        companion object {
            @JvmField val staticNullable: String? = null
            @JvmField val staticNumber = 12
        }
    }

    private interface ParentContract

    private interface ChildContract : ParentContract

    private class ContractArgument : ChildContract

    private interface LeftContract

    private interface RightContract

    private class BothContracts : LeftContract, RightContract

    @Suppress("UNUSED_PARAMETER")
    private class Overloads {
        fun choose(value: Any?) = "object"

        fun choose(value: CharSequence?) = "sequence"

        fun choose(value: String?) = "string"

        fun contract(value: Any) = "object"

        fun contract(value: ParentContract) = "contract"

        fun onlyInt(value: Int) = value

        fun onlyDouble(value: Double) = value

        fun widen(value: Long) = "long:$value"

        fun widen(value: Double) = "double:$value"

        fun ambiguous(value: LeftContract?) = "left"

        fun ambiguous(value: RightContract?) = "right"
    }

    private class StaticMethods {

        companion object {

        }

    private class PrimitiveConstructor private constructor(val value: Long)
```

`xposed/src/test/java/com/system/location/service/hook/runtime/ReloadExecutionGateTest.kt`:

```kt
package com.system.location.service.hook.runtime

import java.util.concurrent.CountDownLatch
import java.util.concurrent.TimeUnit
import java.util.concurrent.atomic.AtomicBoolean
import java.util.concurrent.atomic.AtomicInteger
import java.util.concurrent.atomic.AtomicReference
import org.junit.Assert.*
import org.junit.Test

class ReloadExecutionGateTest {
    @Test fun activeCallDrainsAndQueuedOldCallEntersTheSuccessorInsteadOfOldCode() {
        val old = ReloadExecutionGate()
        val inside = CountDownLatch(1)
        val release = CountDownLatch(1)
        val frozen = CountDownLatch(1)
        val committed = CountDownLatch(1)
        val oldBodies = AtomicInteger()
        val newBodies = AtomicInteger()
        val failure = AtomicReference<Throwable?>()
        val active = Thread {
            runCatching { old.enter { assertTrue(it); inside.countDown(); release.await() } }
                .onFailure(failure::set)
        }.apply { start() }
        assertTrue(inside.await(2, TimeUnit.SECONDS))
        val successor = AtomicReference<ReloadExecutionGate>()
        val writer = Thread {
            runCatching {
                assertTrue(old.freeze(2000))
                successor.set(ReloadExecutionGate.adopt(old.transferState()))
                frozen.countDown()
                committed.await()
                successor.get().resume()
            }.onFailure(failure::set)
        }.apply { start() }
        awaitFreeze(old)
        assertEquals("Freeze completed before its active reader exited", 1L, frozen.count)
        release.countDown()
        assertTrue(frozen.await(2, TimeUnit.SECONDS))
        val waiting = CountDownLatch(1)
        val queued = Thread {
            runCatching {
                waiting.countDown()
                old.enter { current ->
                    if (current) oldBodies.incrementAndGet()
                    else successor.get().enter { assertTrue(it); newBodies.incrementAndGet() }
                }
            }.onFailure(failure::set)
        }.apply { start() }
        assertTrue(waiting.await(2, TimeUnit.SECONDS))
        committed.countDown()
        for (thread in listOf(active, writer, queued)) { thread.join(3000); assertFalse(thread.isAlive) }
        failure.get()?.let { throw AssertionError(it) }
        assertEquals(0, oldBodies.get())
        assertEquals(1, newBodies.get())
    }

    @Test fun nestedFrameworkCallsCanFinishWhileFreezeWaits() {
        val gate = ReloadExecutionGate()
        val entered = CountDownLatch(1)
        val nested = CountDownLatch(1)
        val failure = AtomicReference<Throwable?>()
        val active = Thread {
            runCatching {
                gate.enter {
                    entered.countDown()
                    nested.await()
                    gate.enter { assertTrue(it) }
                }
            }.onFailure(failure::set)
        }.apply { start() }
        assertTrue(entered.await(2, TimeUnit.SECONDS))
        val drained = AtomicBoolean()
        val writer = Thread {
            runCatching { drained.set(gate.freeze(2000)); gate.resume() }.onFailure(failure::set)
        }.apply { start() }
        awaitFreeze(gate)
        nested.countDown()
        active.join(3000); writer.join(3000)
        assertFalse(active.isAlive); assertFalse(writer.isAlive)
        failure.get()?.let { throw AssertionError(it) }
        assertTrue(drained.get())
    }

    @Test fun failedFreezeResumesTheSameGenerationWithoutLosingReaders() {
        val gate = ReloadExecutionGate()
        val entered = CountDownLatch(1)
        val release = CountDownLatch(1)
        val active = Thread { gate.enter { entered.countDown(); release.await() } }.apply { start() }
        try {
            assertTrue(entered.await(2, TimeUnit.SECONDS))
            assertFalse(gate.freeze(0))
            gate.enter { assertTrue(it) }
        } finally { release.countDown(); active.join(2000) }
        assertFalse(active.isAlive)
        assertTrue(gate.freeze(1000))
        val state = gate.transferState()
        assertTrue((state[2] as Map<*, *>).isEmpty())
        assertNull(state.javaClass.classLoader)
        assertNull(state[0].javaClass.classLoader)
        assertNull(state[1].javaClass.classLoader)
        assertNull(state[2].javaClass.classLoader)
        gate.resume()
    }

    @Test fun successorMayRunOnAnotherThreadAndRetiredGenerationCannotThawIt() {
        val gate = ReloadExecutionGate()
        assertTrue(gate.freeze(1000))
        val state = gate.transferState()
        val failure = AtomicReference<Throwable?>()
        val next = Thread {
            runCatching {
                val successor = ReloadExecutionGate.adopt(state)
                successor.enter { assertTrue(it) } // New transition owner may install/restore hooks.
                assertTrue(runCatching { gate.resume() }.isFailure)
                successor.resume()
            }.onFailure(failure::set)
        }.apply { start() }
        next.join(2000)
        assertFalse(next.isAlive)
        failure.get()?.let { throw AssertionError(it) }
        gate.enter { assertFalse(it) }
    }

    private fun awaitFreeze(gate: ReloadExecutionGate) {
        val started = System.nanoTime()
        while (!gate.isFrozen && System.nanoTime() - started < TimeUnit.SECONDS.toNanos(2)) Thread.yield()
        assertTrue("Writer did not start draining", gate.isFrozen)
    }
}
```

`xposed/src/test/java/com/system/location/service/hook/runtime/ReloadPreparationTest.kt`:

```kt
package com.system.location.service.hook.runtime

import java.util.concurrent.CountDownLatch
import java.util.concurrent.TimeUnit
import java.util.concurrent.atomic.AtomicInteger
import org.junit.Assert.*
import org.junit.Test

class ReloadPreparationTest {
    @Test fun confirmedHandoffStopsBothProducersAndDoesNotResumeTheRetiredGeneration() {
        val order = mutableListOf<String>()
        assertTrue(ReloadPreparation.prepare({ order += "location"; true }, { order += "gnss"; true },
            { order += "save" }, { fail("Successful handoff must stay quiesced") }))
        assertEquals(listOf("location", "gnss", "save"), order)
    }

    @Test fun failureOfEitherPauseDoesNotSaveAndRollsBackOnce() {
        for (location in listOf(false, true)) for (gnss in listOf(false, true)) {
            if (location && gnss) continue
            val calls = AtomicInteger()
            val aborts = AtomicInteger()
            assertFalse(ReloadPreparation.prepare({ calls.incrementAndGet(); location },
                { calls.incrementAndGet(); gnss }, { fail("Cannot save live delivery") }, { aborts.incrementAndGet() }))
            assertEquals(2, calls.get())
            assertEquals(1, aborts.get())
        }
    }

    @Test fun snapshotFailureRetainsTheOriginalErrorAndRollsBack() {
        val failure = IllegalStateException("snapshot failed")
        val aborts = AtomicInteger()
        val actual = assertThrows(IllegalStateException::class.java) {
            ReloadPreparation.prepare({ true }, { true }, { throw failure }, { aborts.incrementAndGet() })
        }
        assertSame(failure, actual)
        assertEquals(1, aborts.get())
    }

    @Test fun timedOutBinderDeliveryResumesAfterReturnWithoutOverlappingReplacement() {
        val entered = CountDownLatch(1)
        val release = CountDownLatch(1)
        val resumed = CountDownLatch(1)
        val calls = AtomicInteger()
        val active = AtomicInteger()
        val peak = AtomicInteger()
        val worker = DeliveryWorker("Reload rollback regression", { 60_000 }, tick = {
            peak.accumulateAndGet(active.incrementAndGet(), ::maxOf)
            try {
                if (calls.incrementAndGet() == 1) {
                    entered.countDown()
                    while (release.count > 0L) {
                        try { release.await() } catch (_: InterruptedException) { }
                    }
                } else resumed.countDown()
            } finally { active.decrementAndGet() }
        }, failure = { throw AssertionError(it) })
        try {
            worker.start()
            assertTrue(entered.await(2, TimeUnit.SECONDS))
            assertFalse(ReloadPreparation.prepare({ worker.stop(0) }, { true },
                { fail("In-flight callback must prevent handoff") }, { worker.start() }))
            assertEquals(1, calls.get())
            release.countDown()
            assertTrue(resumed.await(2, TimeUnit.SECONDS))
            assertTrue(worker.stop())
            assertEquals(2, calls.get())
            assertEquals(1, peak.get())
        } finally { release.countDown(); worker.stop() }
    }

    @Test fun rollbackFailureDoesNotHideTheOriginalSnapshotFailure() {
        val snapshot = IllegalStateException("snapshot failed")
        val rollback = IllegalStateException("rollback failed")
        val actual = assertThrows(IllegalStateException::class.java) {
            ReloadPreparation.prepare({ true }, { true }, { throw snapshot }, { throw rollback })
        }
        assertSame(snapshot, actual)
        assertArrayEquals(arrayOf(rollback), actual.suppressed)
    }
}
```

```kt
    fun reportsMissingSystemServerPoints() {

            HookScope.SYSTEM_SERVER,
            mapOf("system-location" to HookStatus(supported = true, installed = true, matched = true)),
        )

        assertEquals(listOf("system-location"), report.recorded)
        assertTrue(report.missing.contains("wifi"))
        assertTrue(report.missing.contains("fused"))
        assertEquals(1, report.installed)
        assertEquals(1, report.matched)
        assertFalse(report.healthy)
    }

    @Test
    fun completeSystemServerScopeIsHealthy() {
        val statuses = HookOwnership.expectedFor(HookScope.SYSTEM_SERVER).associateWith {
            HookStatus(supported = true, installed = true, matched = true)
        }

        val report = HookOwnership.audit(HookScope.SYSTEM_SERVER, statuses)

        assertTrue(report.missing.isEmpty())
        assertEquals(report.expected.size, report.installed)
        assertEquals(report.expected.size, report.matched)
        assertEquals(0, report.failed)
        assertTrue(report.healthy)
    }

    @Test
    fun failedExpectedHookBreaksHealth() {
        val statuses = HookOwnership.expectedFor(HookScope.SYSTEM_SERVER).associateWith {
            HookStatus(supported = true, installed = true)
        } + ("wifi" to HookStatus(supported = true, installed = true, failed = true, reason = "VerifyError"))

        val report = HookOwnership.audit(HookScope.SYSTEM_SERVER, statuses)

        assertTrue(report.missing.isEmpty())
        assertEquals(1, report.failed)
        assertFalse(report.healthy)
    }

    @Test
    fun phoneScopeOnlyExpectsPhoneHook() {
        val report = HookOwnership.audit(HookScope.PHONE_PROCESS, emptyMap())

        assertEquals(listOf("phone"), report.expected)
        assertEquals(listOf("phone"), report.missing)
        assertFalse(report.healthy)
    }

    @Test
    fun targetAppOwnsNoHooksByDesign() {
        val report = HookOwnership.audit(HookScope.TARGET_APP, emptyMap())

        assertTrue(report.expected.isEmpty())
        assertTrue(report.missing.isEmpty())
        assertTrue(report.healthy)
    }
```

```kt
package com.system.location.service.hook.scope

import org.junit.Assert.*
import org.junit.Test

class HookScopeResolverTest {
    private fun resolve(pkg: String, process: String = pkg, uid: Int = 1001, sdk: Int = 31) =
        HookScopeResolver.resolve(ProcessIdentity(pkg, process, uid, sdk, "test"))

    @Test fun everyExistingSystemBranchIsReachable() {
        assertEquals(HookScope.SYSTEM_SERVER, resolve("android", "system_server", 1000))
        assertEquals(HookScope.PHONE_PROCESS, resolve("com.android.phone"))
        assertEquals(HookScope.FUSED_PROCESS, resolve("com.android.location.fused"))
        assertEquals(HookScope.VENDOR_LOCATION_PROCESS, resolve("com.xiaomi.location.fused"))
        assertEquals(HookScope.VENDOR_LOCATION_PROCESS, resolve("com.oplus.location"))
        assertEquals(HookScope.SETTINGS_PROVIDER, resolve("com.android.providers.settings"))
    }

    @Test fun unrelatedProcessesAndSubstringMatchesAreRejected() {
        assertNull(resolve("android", uid = 10123))
        assertNull(resolve("com.android.phone.fake"))
        assertNull(resolve("com.android.phone", "com.android.phone:other"))
        assertNull(resolve("com.android.location.fused", sdk = 30))
        assertNull(resolve("com.oplus.location", uid = -1))
        assertNull(resolve("com.example.app"))
    }

    @Test fun targetAppsRequireExplicitExactOptIn() {
        val identity = ProcessIdentity("com.example.app", "com.example.app", 10123, 31, "test")
        assertEquals(HookScope.TARGET_APP, HookScopeResolver.resolve(identity, setOf(identity.packageName)))
        assertNull(HookScopeResolver.resolve(identity.copy(packageName = "com.example.app.fake"), setOf(identity.packageName)))
        assertEquals(HookScope.TARGET_APP, HookScopeResolver.resolve(identity.copy(processName = "com.example.app:remote"), setOf(identity.packageName)))
        assertNull(HookScopeResolver.resolve(identity.copy(processName = "com.example.app.fake:remote"), setOf(identity.packageName)))
        assertNull(HookScopeResolver.resolve(identity.copy(uid = 99001), setOf(identity.packageName)))
        assertNull(HookScopeResolver.resolve(identity.copy(uid = 1000), setOf(identity.packageName)))
    }

    @Test fun installedIsNotTheSameAsMatched() {
        HookStatusRegistry.record("example", HookStatus(supported = true, installed = true))
        assertFalse(HookStatusRegistry.snapshot().getValue("example").matched)
        HookStatusRegistry.matched("example")
        assertTrue(HookStatusRegistry.snapshot().getValue("example").matched)
    }
}
```

`xposed/src/test/java/com/system/location/service/hook/security/CommandSecurityTest.kt`:

```kt
package com.system.location.service.hook.security

import org.junit.Assert.*
import org.junit.Test

class CommandSecurityTest {
    @Test fun identityRequiresOwnedExactPackageAndUid() {
        val pkg = CallerPolicy.CONTROLLER_PACKAGE
        assertEquals(CallerRole.CONTROLLER, CallerPolicy.resolve(10123, setOf(pkg), 10123, emptySet()))
        assertEquals(CallerRole.DENIED, CallerPolicy.resolve(10124, setOf(pkg), 10123, emptySet()))
        assertEquals(CallerRole.DENIED, CallerPolicy.resolve(10123, setOf("$pkg.fake"), 10123, emptySet()))
        assertEquals(CallerRole.DENIED, CallerPolicy.resolve(-1, emptySet(), null, emptySet()))
        assertEquals(CallerRole.DENIED, CallerPolicy.resolve(0, setOf("untrusted"), null, emptySet()))
        assertEquals(CallerRole.PEER, CallerPolicy.resolve(1001, setOf("com.android.phone"), null, setOf("com.android.phone")))
        assertEquals(CallerRole.DENIED, CallerPolicy.resolve(11000, setOf("com.android.phone"), null, emptySet()))
    }

    @Test fun deniedExchangeCannotAuthorizeAnyCommand() {
        val gate = CommandSecurity { "secret" }
        assertNull(gate.exchange(10123, CallerRole.DENIED))
        assertFalse(gate.accept(10123, CallerRole.DENIED, "exchange_key", "start", 1, 1, 100, 100))
    }

    @Test fun sessionIsBoundToUidAndRejectsMalformedReplayAndStaleRequests() {
        var tokens = 0
        val gate = CommandSecurity { "key${++tokens}" }
        val token = gate.exchange(10123, CallerRole.CONTROLLER)!!
        fun accept(command: String? = "start", seq: Long = 1, sent: Long = 100, version: Int = 1) =
            gate.accept(10123, CallerRole.CONTROLLER, token, command, version, seq, sent, 100)
        assertFalse(gate.accept(10124, CallerRole.CONTROLLER, token, "start", 1, 1, 100, 100))
        assertFalse(accept(null)); assertFalse(accept("unknown")); assertFalse(accept(version = 2))
        assertFalse(accept(sent = 101)); assertFalse(accept(sent = -1))
        assertFalse(gate.accept(10123, CallerRole.CONTROLLER, token, "start", 1, 1, 0, 30_001))
        assertTrue(accept()); assertFalse(accept()); assertTrue(accept(seq = 2))
        gate.exchange(10123, CallerRole.CONTROLLER)
        assertFalse(accept(seq = 3))
    }

    @Test fun peersCanSyncButCannotControlSimulation() {
        val gate = CommandSecurity { "peer" }
        gate.exchange(1001, CallerRole.PEER)
        assertFalse(gate.accept(1001, CallerRole.PEER, "peer", "start", 1, 1, 100, 100))
        assertTrue(gate.accept(1001, CallerRole.PEER, "peer", "sync_config", 1, 1, 100, 100))
        assertTrue(gate.accept(1001, CallerRole.PEER, "peer", "set_proxy", 1, 2, 100, 100))
    }
}
```

`xposed/src/test/java/com/system/location/service/hook/security/PublicationLeaseTest.kt`:

```kt
package com.system.location.service.hook.security

import org.junit.Assert.*
import org.junit.Test

class PublicationLeaseTest {
    @Test fun fullStateRestoreAcceptsRepeatedSampleWithoutExtendingDeadline() {
        val lease = PublicationLease(100)
        assertTrue(lease.restore(1000, 1001))
        assertTrue(lease.restore(1000, 1099))
        assertFalse(lease.expired(1099))
        assertTrue(lease.expired(1100))
        assertFalse(lease.restore(1000, 1100))
        assertFalse(lease.renew(1000, 1100))
        assertFalse(lease.restore(1200, 1199))
    }
    @Test fun invalidDurationAndOverflowCannotCreateNonExpiringLease() {
        assertThrows(IllegalArgumentException::class.java) { PublicationLease(0) }
        val lease = PublicationLease(100)
        assertFalse(lease.renew(Long.MAX_VALUE, Long.MAX_VALUE))
        assertFalse(lease.restore(Long.MAX_VALUE - 99, Long.MAX_VALUE))
        assertTrue(lease.restore(Long.MAX_VALUE - 100, Long.MAX_VALUE - 1))
        assertTrue(lease.expired(Long.MAX_VALUE))
    }
    @Test fun staleFutureAndRepeatedSamplesAreRejected() {
        val lease = PublicationLease(100)
        assertFalse(lease.renew(-1, 0))
        assertFalse(lease.renew(201, 200))
        assertFalse(lease.renew(0, 200))
        assertTrue(lease.renew(150, 200))
        assertFalse(lease.renew(150, 200))
        assertFalse(lease.renew(149, 200))
    }
    @Test fun silenceExpiresAtSharedSampleDeadlineAndCanRestart() {
        val system = PublicationLease(100); val peer = PublicationLease(100)
        assertTrue(system.renew(1000, 1000)); assertTrue(peer.renew(1000, 1050))
        assertFalse(system.expired(1099)); assertFalse(peer.expired(1099))
        assertTrue(system.expired(1100)); assertTrue(peer.expired(1100))
        system.clear(); assertFalse(system.expired(1200))
        assertTrue(system.renew(1200, 1200))
    }
}
```

`xposed/src/test/java/com/system/location/service/hook/utils/LocationHookArgumentsTest.kt`:

```kt
package com.system.location.service.hook.utils

import org.junit.Assert.*
import org.junit.Test

class LocationHookArgumentsTest {
    private data class Fix(val sequence: Int)

    @Test fun inactiveOrUnknownCallbacksPassThrough() {
        val callback = Any()
        assertFalse(LocationHookArguments.canIntercept(false, arrayOf(true, 1, 2, callback), 3))
        assertFalse(LocationHookArguments.canIntercept(true, emptyArray(), 3))
        assertFalse(LocationHookArguments.canIntercept(true, arrayOf(null), 0))
        assertTrue(LocationHookArguments.canIntercept(true, arrayOf(callback), 0))
    }

    @Test fun gnssBatchPreservesBooleanArgumentCardinalityAndInputArray() {
        val input = arrayOf(Fix(1), Fix(2))
        val args = arrayOf<Any?>(true, input)
        assertTrue(LocationHookArguments.rewriteBatch<Fix>(true, args, 1) { Fix(it.sequence + 10) })
        assertEquals(true, args[0])
        assertArrayEquals(arrayOf(Fix(11), Fix(12)), args[1] as Array<*>)
        assertArrayEquals(arrayOf(Fix(1), Fix(2)), input)
    }

    @Test fun disabledAndUnexpectedPayloadsAreNeverReplaced() {
        val batch = arrayOf(Fix(1))
        val args = arrayOf<Any?>(false, batch)
        assertFalse(LocationHookArguments.rewriteBatch<Fix>(false, args, 1) { error("disabled") })
        assertSame(batch, args[1])
        assertFalse(LocationHookArguments.rewriteBatch<Fix>(true, args, 0) { error("boolean is not a batch") })
        val unknown = arrayOf<Any?>(true, arrayOf("unexpected"))
        assertFalse(LocationHookArguments.rewriteBatch<Fix>(true, unknown, 1) { error("wrong payload type") })
    }
}
```

```kt
package com.system.location.service.hook.utils

import com.system.location.service.core.geo.Wgs84
import com.system.location.service.core.location.LocationSample
import com.system.location.service.core.runtime.RuntimeSnapshot
import org.junit.Assert.*
import org.junit.Test

class ProviderViewTest {
    private val global = LocationSample(Wgs84(31.0, 121.0), 10.0, 5f, 2f, 90f, 1000, 1000)
    private val scenario = global.copy(coordinate = Wgs84(32.0, 122.0), altitude = 20.0)

    @Test fun contextRetainsItsPolicyAndAllRouteSamplesAfterLiveStateChanges() {
        val saved = FakeLoc.runtimeSnapshots.current()
        try {
            val samples = mutableMapOf("route" to scenario)
            val context = ProviderReadContext(RuntimeSnapshot(sample = global), samples, 1000)
            samples["route"] = scenario.copy(coordinate = Wgs84(40.0, 120.0))
            FakeLoc.runtimeSnapshots.set(RuntimeSnapshot(sample = global.copy(coordinate = Wgs84(50.0, 120.0)),
                physicalNoise = true, physicalNoiseSeed = 123))
            val gps = ProviderView.sampleFor("gps", context = context)
            assertEquals(global.coordinate, gps.coordinate)
            assertEquals(scenario.coordinate, ProviderView.sampleFor("gps", scenarioId = "route", context = context).coordinate)
            assertEquals(global.coordinate, ProviderView.sampleFor("gps", scenarioId = "missing", context = context).coordinate)
            val point = ProviderView.sampleFor("gps", point = Wgs84(33.0, 123.0), context = context)
            assertEquals(Wgs84(33.0, 123.0), point.coordinate)
            assertEquals(0f, point.speed)
            assertEquals(0f, point.bearing)
            assertSame(gps, ProviderView.sampleFor("gps", context = context))
            assertEquals(1000L, context.validationAtMillis)
            assertFalse(context.state.physicalNoise)
        } finally { FakeLoc.runtimeSnapshots.set(saved) }
    }

    @Test fun allProvidersUseOneBaseAndRetainTheirExistingFieldPolicies() {
        val context = ProviderReadContext(RuntimeSnapshot(sample = global), emptyMap(), 1000)
        val gps = ProviderView.sampleFor("gps", context = context)
        val network = ProviderView.sampleFor("network", context = context)
        assertEquals(global.coordinate, gps.coordinate)
        assertEquals(global.coordinate, network.coordinate)
        assertEquals(global.timeMillis - 400, network.timeMillis)
        assertEquals(0.0, network.altitude, 0.0)
        assertEquals(0f, network.speed)
        assertSame(global, ProviderView.sampleFor("unknown", context = context))
    }

    @Test fun repeatedProviderReadsAndContextsShareNoiseForTheSameTimestamp() {
        fun context(time: Long) = ProviderReadContext(RuntimeSnapshot(
            sample = global.copy(elapsedNanos = time), physicalNoise = true, physicalNoiseSeed = 8675309), emptyMap(), 1000)
        ProviderView.sampleFor("gps", context = context(1_000_000_000))
        val second = context(2_000_000_000)
        val gps = ProviderView.sampleFor("gps", context = second)
        assertNotEquals(global.coordinate, gps.coordinate)
        assertEquals(gps.coordinate, ProviderView.sampleFor("network", context = second).coordinate)
        assertEquals(gps, ProviderView.sampleFor("gps", context = context(2_000_000_000)))
    }
}
```

```kt
package com.system.location.service.hook.utils

import com.system.location.service.core.geo.Wgs84
import com.system.location.service.core.location.LocationSample
import com.system.location.service.core.runtime.*
import org.junit.Assert.*
import org.junit.Test

class RuntimeLifecycleTest {
    @Test fun configurationDisableClearsSampleOwnershipInTheSameLifecycleTransition() {
        val saved = FakeLoc.runtimeSnapshots.current()
        try {
            FakeLoc.runtimeSnapshots.set(RuntimeSnapshot())
            val sample = LocationSample(Wgs84(31.0, 121.0), 10.0, 5f, 8f, 90f, 1000, 1000)
            FakeLoc.acceptSample(sample, "route")
            val disabled = FakeLoc.configureRuntime(PreparedRuntimeConfiguration.prepare(mapOf("enable" to false,
                "min_satellites" to 24)))
            assertEquals(2L, disabled.configRevision)
            assertFalse(disabled.configuration.enabled)
            assertNull(disabled.sample)
            assertFalse(FakeLoc.externallyDriven)
            assertTrue(FakeLoc.scenarioSamples.scenarioIds().isEmpty())
            FakeLoc.configureRuntime(PreparedRuntimeConfiguration.prepare(mapOf("enable" to true)))
            assertNotSame(sample, FakeLoc.snapshot(true, 2000, 2000))
        } finally {
            FakeLoc.stopRuntime()
            FakeLoc.runtimeSnapshots.set(saved)
        }
    }

    @Test fun targetAndHeadingAreValidatedAndReplacedTogetherWithMotion() {
        val saved = FakeLoc.runtimeSnapshots.current()
        try {
            FakeLoc.runtimeSnapshots.set(RuntimeSnapshot())
            FakeLoc.updateCoordinates(31.0, 121.0, 4f, 1000, 270.0)
            val before = FakeLoc.captureTransfer(1001)
            for (bearing in listOf(Double.NaN, Double.POSITIVE_INFINITY)) {
                assertThrows(IllegalArgumentException::class.java) { FakeLoc.updateCoordinates(40.0, 116.0, 8f, 2000, bearing) }
                assertEquals(before, FakeLoc.captureTransfer(1001))
            }
            val context = FakeLoc.snapshotState(true, 1001, 1001)
            assertEquals(31.0, context.sample!!.latitude, 0.0)
            assertEquals(270f, context.sample!!.bearing)
            assertEquals(4f, context.sample!!.speed)
            assertTrue(context.hasBearings)
        } finally {
            FakeLoc.updateCoordinates(0.0, 0.0, nowNanos = 0)
            FakeLoc.runtimeSnapshots.set(saved)
        }
    }

    @Test fun sampleActivationAndScenarioUseOnePublicationAndOriginalDeadline() {
        val saved = FakeLoc.runtimeSnapshots.current()
        try {
            FakeLoc.runtimeSnapshots.set(RuntimeSnapshot())
            FakeLoc.scenarioSamples.replace(emptyMap())
            val sample = LocationSample(Wgs84(31.0, 121.0), 10.0, 5f, 8f, 90f, 1000, 1000)
            assertThrows(IllegalArgumentException::class.java) { FakeLoc.acceptSample(sample, "x".repeat(256)) }
            assertFalse(FakeLoc.enable)
            assertNull(FakeLoc.runtimeSnapshots.current().sample)
            FakeLoc.acceptSample(sample, "route")
            val captured = FakeLoc.captureTransfer(2000)
            assertTrue(captured.externallyDriven)
            assertTrue(captured.state.configuration.enabled)
            assertEquals(1L, captured.state.configRevision)
            assertSame(sample, captured.state.sample)
            assertEquals(mapOf("route" to sample), captured.scenarios)
            assertTrue(FakeLoc.captureTransfer(5_000_002_000).scenarios.isEmpty())
        } finally {
            FakeLoc.scenarioSamples.replace(emptyMap())
            FakeLoc.updateCoordinates(0.0, 0.0, nowNanos = 0)
            FakeLoc.runtimeSnapshots.set(saved)
        }
    }

    @Test fun restoringMovementDoesNotRestartItsActivityWindow() {
        val saved = FakeLoc.runtimeSnapshots.current()
        try {
            FakeLoc.runtimeSnapshots.set(RuntimeSnapshot(configuration = HookConfiguration(enabled = true)))
            FakeLoc.updateCoordinates(31.0, 121.0, 4f, 1_000_000_000)
            val transfer = FakeLoc.captureTransfer(1_100_000_000)
            FakeLoc.restoreRuntime(transfer, 1_200_000_000)
            assertEquals(4f, FakeLoc.snapshot(true, 1_200_000_000, 1000).speed)
            FakeLoc.restoreRuntime(transfer, 2_000_000_000)
            assertEquals(0f, FakeLoc.snapshot(true, 2_000_000_000, 2000).speed)
            FakeLoc.restoreRuntime(transfer, 999_999_999)
            assertEquals(0f, FakeLoc.snapshot(true, 999_999_999, 2000).speed)
        } finally {
            FakeLoc.updateCoordinates(0.0, 0.0, nowNanos = 0)
            FakeLoc.runtimeSnapshots.set(saved)
        }
    }

    @Test fun fullRestoreReplacesPolicyAndScenariosTogetherAndDoesNotReviveStaleSamples() {
        val saved = FakeLoc.runtimeSnapshots.current()
        try {
            val sample = LocationSample(Wgs84(31.0, 121.0), 10.0, 5f, 8f, 90f, 1000, 1_000_000_000)
            val transfer = RuntimeTransfer(RuntimeSnapshot(configRevision = 7, sample = sample,
                configuration = HookConfiguration(enabled = true, minimumSatellites = 24, nmeaEnabled = false)),
                true, mapOf("route" to sample))
            FakeLoc.restoreRuntime(transfer, 2_000_000_000)
            assertTrue(FakeLoc.externallyDriven)
            assertSame(sample, FakeLoc.snapshot(true, 2_000_000_000, 2000))
            val captured = FakeLoc.captureTransfer(2_000_000_000)
            assertEquals(transfer, captured)
            FakeLoc.restoreRuntime(transfer, 6_000_000_000)
            assertFalse(FakeLoc.enable)
            assertFalse(FakeLoc.externallyDriven)
            assertTrue(FakeLoc.scenarioSamples.scenarioIds().isEmpty())
            val stale = FakeLoc.captureTransfer(6_000_000_000)
            assertNull(stale.state.sample)
            assertEquals(24, stale.state.configuration.minimumSatellites)
        } finally {
            FakeLoc.scenarioSamples.replace(emptyMap())
            FakeLoc.updateCoordinates(0.0, 0.0, nowNanos = 0)
            FakeLoc.runtimeSnapshots.set(saved)
        }
    }

    @Test fun startDropsPreviousExternalFixAndMovementBeforeAnyNewSampleIsRead() {
        val saved = FakeLoc.runtimeSnapshots.current()
        try {
            FakeLoc.runtimeSnapshots.set(RuntimeSnapshot())
            FakeLoc.acceptSample(LocationSample(Wgs84(31.0, 121.0), 10.0, 5f, 8f, 90f, 1000, 1000))
            assertTrue(FakeLoc.externallyDriven)
            val started = FakeLoc.startRuntime(RuntimeStart(Wgs84(40.0, 116.0), 3.0, 20.0, 8f), 2000)
            assertFalse(FakeLoc.externallyDriven)
            assertTrue(started.configuration.enabled)
            assertNull(started.sample)
            val sample = FakeLoc.snapshot(true, 3000, 3000)
            assertEquals(Wgs84(40.0, 116.0), sample.coordinate)
            assertEquals(20.0, sample.altitude, 0.0)
            assertEquals(8f, sample.accuracy)
            assertEquals(0f, sample.speed)
        } finally {
            FakeLoc.updateCoordinates(0.0, 0.0, nowNanos = 0)
            FakeLoc.runtimeSnapshots.set(saved)
        }
    }

    @Test fun stopPublishesDisabledPolicyAndClearedBearingTogether() {
        val saved = FakeLoc.runtimeSnapshots.current()
        try {
            FakeLoc.runtimeSnapshots.set(RuntimeSnapshot(configRevision = 4, hasBearings = true,
                configuration = HookConfiguration(enabled = true, minimumSatellites = 20)))
            val stopped = FakeLoc.stopRuntime()
            assertFalse(stopped.configuration.enabled)
            assertFalse(stopped.hasBearings)
            assertEquals(5L, stopped.configRevision)
            assertEquals(20, stopped.configuration.minimumSatellites)
        } finally { FakeLoc.runtimeSnapshots.set(saved) }
    }

    @Test fun stopClearsExternalOwnershipAndScenariosSoReenableCannotResurrectOldFix() {
        val saved = FakeLoc.runtimeSnapshots.current()
        try {
            FakeLoc.runtimeSnapshots.set(RuntimeSnapshot())
            val sample = LocationSample(Wgs84(31.0, 121.0), 10.0, 5f, 8f, 90f, 1000, 1000)
            FakeLoc.acceptSample(sample, "route")
            val stopped = FakeLoc.stopRuntime()
            assertNull(stopped.sample)
            assertFalse(FakeLoc.externallyDriven)
            assertTrue(FakeLoc.scenarioSamples.scenarioIds().isEmpty())
            FakeLoc.enable = true
            val restored = FakeLoc.snapshot(true, 2000, 2000)
            assertNotSame(sample, restored)
            assertEquals(2000L, restored.timeMillis)
            assertEquals(0f, restored.speed)
            assertFalse(FakeLoc.captureTransfer(2000).externallyDriven)
        } finally {
            FakeLoc.stopRuntime()
            FakeLoc.runtimeSnapshots.set(saved)
        }
    }
}
```

`xposed/src/test/java/com/system/location/service/hook/utils/SnapshotTest.kt`:

```kt
package com.system.location.service.hook.utils

import org.junit.Assert.*
import org.junit.Test

class SnapshotTest {
    @Test fun sampleAndConfigurationComeFromOnePublicationDuringConcurrentUpdates() {
        val saved = FakeLoc.runtimeSnapshots.current()
        val executor = java.util.concurrent.Executors.newSingleThreadExecutor()
        val done = java.util.concurrent.atomic.AtomicBoolean(false)
        val started = java.util.concurrent.CountDownLatch(1)
        try {
            FakeLoc.updateCoordinates(1.0, 2.0, nowNanos = 0)
            FakeLoc.runtimeSnapshots.set(com.system.location.service.core.runtime.RuntimeSnapshot(
                latitude = 1.0, longitude = 2.0, altitudeMeters = 10.0, accuracyMeters = 10f))
            val writer = executor.submit {
                started.countDown()
                while (!done.get()) {
                    FakeLoc.runtimeSnapshots.update { state ->
                        val altitude = if (state.altitudeMeters == 10.0) 20.0 else 10.0
                        state.copy(altitudeMeters = altitude, accuracyMeters = altitude.toFloat(),
                            configuration = state.configuration.copy(minimumSatellites = altitude.toInt()))
                    }
                }
            }
            started.await(5, java.util.concurrent.TimeUnit.SECONDS)
            repeat(5_000) { i ->
                val result = FakeLoc.snapshotState(true, 1_000_000_000L + i, 1_000L + i)
                val sample = result.sample!!
                assertEquals(result.altitudeMeters, sample.altitude, 0.0)
                assertEquals(result.accuracyMeters, sample.accuracy)
            }
            done.set(true)
            writer.get(10, java.util.concurrent.TimeUnit.SECONDS)
        } finally {
            done.set(true)
            executor.shutdownNow()
            FakeLoc.runtimeSnapshots.set(saved)
        }
    }
    @Test fun legacyBearingNearFullCircleRemainsValidAfterFloatRounding() {
        val old = FakeLoc.bearing
        try {
            FakeLoc.bearing = 359.9999999
            FakeLoc.updateCoordinates(25.0, 119.0, nowNanos = 1)
            assertTrue(FakeLoc.snapshot(true, 2, 2).bearing < 360f)
        } finally { FakeLoc.bearing = old }
    }
    @Test fun externallyPublishedFixIsSharedWithoutRewritingItsFieldsOrTime() {
        val fix = com.system.location.service.core.location.LocationSample(
            com.system.location.service.core.geo.Wgs84(25.123456789123, 119.123456789123), 82.0, 4f, 8f, 92f, 100, 100)
        FakeLoc.acceptSample(fix)
        assertSame(fix, FakeLoc.snapshot(true, 150, 150))
        assertSame(fix, FakeLoc.snapshot(false, 200, 200))
        assertEquals(fix.coordinate.latitude, FakeLoc.coordinatePair().first, 0.0)
        FakeLoc.updateCoordinates(0.0, 0.0, nowNanos = 201)
        assertFalse(FakeLoc.externallyDriven)
    }
    @Test fun fixedPositionHasNoNoiseAndTimeAlwaysAdvances() {
        FakeLoc.accuracy = 1000f
        FakeLoc.updateCoordinates(39.9, 116.4, nowNanos = 0)
        var previous = 0L
        repeat(1000) {
            val sample = FakeLoc.snapshot(true, it * 100_000_000L, it * 100L)
            assertEquals(39.9, sample.latitude, 0.0)
            assertEquals(116.4, sample.longitude, 0.0)
            assertEquals(0f, sample.speed)
            assertTrue(sample.elapsedNanos > previous)
            assertEquals(it * 100L, sample.timeMillis)
            previous = sample.elapsedNanos
        }
    }

    @Test fun changingTargetImmediatelyInvalidatesThePreviousSample() {
        FakeLoc.updateCoordinates(39.9, 116.4, 3f, 0)
        assertEquals(3f, FakeLoc.snapshot(true, 1, 1).speed)
        FakeLoc.updateCoordinates(31.2, 121.5, nowNanos = 2)
        val updated = FakeLoc.snapshot(false, 2, 2)
        assertEquals(31.2, updated.latitude, 0.0)
        assertEquals(121.5, updated.longitude, 0.0)
        assertEquals(0f, updated.speed)
    }

    @Test fun stoppedMovementExpiresWithoutInventingASpeed() {
        FakeLoc.reportIntervalMs = 100
        FakeLoc.updateCoordinates(39.9, 116.4, 3f, 0)
        assertEquals(3f, FakeLoc.snapshot(true, 100_000_000, 100).speed)
        assertEquals(0f, FakeLoc.snapshot(true, 600_000_000, 600).speed)
    }

    @Test fun readersShareOneSampleUntilTheNextPublication() {
        val now = System.nanoTime()
        FakeLoc.updateCoordinates(39.9, 116.4, nowNanos = now)
        val sample = FakeLoc.snapshot(true, now, 10)
        repeat(100) { assertSame(sample, FakeLoc.snapshot(false, now + it, 10)) }
    }
}
```
